The damage to the mechanical prosthetic caused a main program failure, and his energy core has been in an emergency survival state (a protective mechanism for cyborgs; when body damage exceeds 70%, the energy core uses 'heart' reserves to force the body to keep running), which is very unsafe."

Yes, replace it.

Highly mechanized cyborgs replaced their bodies, organs, and even hearts as naturally as changing a new phone. They possessed stronger physiques than normal people, and their lifespans were greatly extended.

Sounds great, doesn't it? But is all of this, truly, without cost?

Xiao Yan pushed over various mechanical prosthetics they had scavenged from another room in the camp.

Most were arms and legs, along with some fragments. It felt like a pile of dismembered cybernetic beings.

Some clearly looked like they had been forcibly ripped from other robots, with wires still hanging off them.

"The Donghuang Heavy Industry factory used to be right next door," Xiao Yan explained. "We just rummaged around the area. See if any of these are suitable?"

Xiang Nanli pulled out his crude tools from his backpack and laid them on the ground.

A hammer, a wrench, a screwdriver, two sensor cables, a welding gun, and a hot-melt gun. There wasn't a single piece of high-tech equipment—they were expensive, and the stuff he used to fix things before didn't require them anyway.

"Help me lay these prosthetics out." He used his screwdriver to draw a long line on the ground. "Put the complete body parts above the white line, including organs stored inside the body; put the remaining scattered parts below the white line. Also, dismantle all the power supply lines (a type of data cable inside a cyborg that acts like a blood vessel, with built-in crystal structures for power transmission)."

Xiang Nanli gave his instructions as a matter of course.

Yet, when Xiang Nanli spoke, there was an extremely firm, convincing power to his words. His expression was so calm and so matter-of-fact that people subconsciously chose to follow his lead.

Xin Zhui was the first to start clearing the pile of junk. The other three slowly joined the cleanup crew.

Xiang Nanli grumbled, "So slow. If this were my lab, you’d have had your pay docked long ago."

System: "Is that so? According to my records, you do not own a laboratory. Would you like me to check your mental state?"

Xiang Nanli: "..."

But since they were on the subject, "Alpha, why don't you check it then?"

A few seconds later, Xiang Nanli saw the results.

- Citizen ID: Q117-XJDHANSHJK (Unnamed)
- Mechanization Level: 1/100
- Mental State Rating: C (Your brain activity is significantly higher than the average person, prone to excitement, insomnia, and hallucinations; you have ADHD tendencies, though mostly overcome in adulthood; your neurotic personality is quite prominent, with certain manic tendencies; you have no brain lesions or mental illnesses and do not require hospitalization, but please pay attention to your mental health.)

Xiang Nanli said gloomily, "It’s a good thing this feature didn't exist before, or my trick of faking a manic-depressive episode to take leave from work would have been discovered..."

The system was already used to his nonsense and had given up on analyzing it.

The sorting continued, and Xiang Nanli walked over to select the parts.

He picked out the pieces he needed, set them aside, and then threw himself into his work, undistracted.

chunks.chineseText:
相南里看不见别的东西，他的脑海里出现了大概的构思。就像是凭空出现了一张3D灰模图。模型图一开始是完整的形状，随后自动开始了拆分，散落成不同的零件。

这就是相南里眼中的世界，在这一刻如此的清晰、确定。

他举起一枚零件，开始工作。动作迅速、精准，像是一台设定好程序的机器。

“最困难的地方其实是如何让新的义体被控制中枢操控，不会在运行过程中短路。”相南里一边拼着胳膊，一边说着。

他这段时间都是和系统聊天，直接省掉了开口那个步骤。

在外人眼里，相南里发了很久的呆，手时不时在虚空模拟操作一下；随后，开始了干活。一边动手，嘴唇还在无声地轻颤着。

Alpha：“是吗？我反而觉得你该注意一下他的能源核心。”

相南里不由得抬头看了眼那枚透着光的蓝色心脏：“怎么了？”

他生活的年代没有这种又科技又玄幻的东西。

“那个人造人不是说了吗，超载。”系统停顿片刻，解释，“可能会有电压差。解决方案一般有三种。”

相南里竖起耳朵听完，激动地直拍大腿：“原来是这样！”

相南里很快满脸疑惑：“不过你怎么知道的，现在有网了？”

Alpha轻描淡写地回答：“我有数据库。”

相南里眼冒精光：“你有那不就相当于我有？还有什么知识是我不知道的？能不能整理个PDF发给我啊？”

系统：“……没网了，下了。”

喂！太敷衍了吧！

相南里是真的精力旺盛，尤其是在他专注投入到某一件感兴趣的事上的时候。

他小时候玩一款电子游戏，不知道这是一款看风景的公路赛车游戏，根本没有终点线。

相南里愣是一口气在屏幕前玩了32个小时候没睡觉，确认这个赛车游戏根本就没有终点线后才放弃。

后来执着地冒充家长，向有关部门和游戏平台投诉，最后逼到游戏制作组被迫违背初心，做出了终点线。他冲破终点，拿到了单机游戏里的一个NO.1，这才满意地拆卸了游戏。

长大了也一样。

等辛追推了推他的肩膀，递过来一杯水的时候，相南里才意识到，自己嗓子干的厉害。加上之前的车程，估计36个小时没喝水吃饭。

相南里放下手中的工具。精神在集中后的涣散简直令他眩晕。

“吃完饭我睡会。”他虚弱地说。

没人反驳。事实上，相南里已经高强度工作了14个小时。

他是原始人，既没有机械改造，也没基因改造；再不睡觉，辛追都担心他昏过去。

甲方送来的盒饭内容如下：一瓶水，一瓶营养膏罐头。

罐头是调查员特供版本，和超市里卖的便宜货很不一样。掀开就能闻到一股清爽的肉香，还不是食品添加剂做出来的肉味。

服了，你们背着人民群众吃这么好？

相南里拿起罐头，看了眼配料表。

原料：兽肉（100）。

“为什么不是鸡肉、鸭肉、猪肉？要写兽肉？”相南里疑惑。

系统：“异种肉。你是更喜欢这个叫法吗？”

变异的人统称畸变人；变异的动植物叫异种。

相南里掀开防护服前面的透明面罩，又撕掉缠在脸上的黑胶带。

这次胶带缠太久了，撕下来后，相南里的小脸通红，压痕格外明显。

他的脸暴露在空气中，好在这里的辐射并不强。

修的表情古怪起来：“是你？”

辛追说去城里抓个专业人士过来帮忙，修其实是没有意见的。

但修其实不报什么希望。他的问题有些严重。

次好的方法，是联系调查局。他们答应隐藏这次调查的发现，然后接受治疗。这个隐藏，不是把秘密守口如瓶，而是直接删掉这次地表调查行动的记忆。

最好的方法，是联系家族。但修当年离开的时候签过协议，如果用到家族的资源，就放弃成为调查员，回去老老实实打继承人资格排位赛。

他姓洛。洛阳的洛。

这两个，洛修都不想。所以，他默许了辛追的冒险。

就在刚刚，修还在心里想着，辛追找的人还挺靠谱。看起来很专业。也许他真的有救了。

但是，但是——这个专业人士摘下面罩，怎么长得那么像他一个月前，在避难所里挖出来的那个古董货？
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 8 (Part 2)

Xiang Nanli couldn't see anything else; a rough concept had appeared in his mind. It was like a 3D gray-scale model appearing out of thin air. The model started as a complete shape, then automatically began to disassemble, scattering into different components.

This was the world through Xiang Nanli’s eyes—at this moment, so clear and certain.

He picked up a part and began to work. His movements were swift and precise, like a pre-programmed machine.

"The most difficult part is actually how to make the new prosthetic controlled by the central hub without short-circuiting during operation," Xiang Nanli said while assembling an arm.

He had been chatting with the system the whole time, skipping the step of actually speaking out loud.

To outsiders, Xiang Nanli had been staring blankly for a long time, his hands occasionally simulating operations in the void; then, he started working. As he worked, his lips trembled silently.

Alpha: "Is that so? I, on the other hand, think you should pay attention to his energy core."

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but look up at the glowing blue heart: "What’s wrong with it?"

He lived in an era that lacked such things that were both technological and mystical.

"Didn't that android say it? Overload," the system paused for a moment, explaining. "There might be a voltage difference. There are generally three solutions."

Xiang Nanli pricked up his ears to listen, then slapped his thigh in excitement: "So that’s it!"

Xiang Nanli soon looked confused: "But how do you know? Is there internet now?"

Alpha replied nonchalantly: "I have a database."

Xiang Nanli’s eyes sparkled: "If you have it, doesn't that mean I have it? What other knowledge is there that I don't know? Can you compile a PDF and send it to me?"

System: "...No internet. Logging off."

Hey! That’s way too dismissive!

Xiang Nanli was truly full of energy, especially when he was focused on something he found interesting.

When he was a child, he played a video game, not realizing it was a scenic road-racing game with no finish line.

Xiang Nanli had stubbornly played for 32 hours straight without sleeping, only giving up once he confirmed the game truly had no finish line.

Later, he persistently impersonated a parent to complain to the relevant authorities and the game platform, eventually forcing the development team to betray their original vision and create a finish line. He crossed it, took the number one spot in the single-player game, and only then was he satisfied enough to uninstall it.

He was the same as an adult.

It wasn't until Xin Zhui nudged his shoulder and handed him a bottle of water that Xiang Nanli realized his throat was parched. Including the previous journey, he estimated he hadn't eaten or drunk for 36 hours.

Xiang Nanli put down his tools. The mental fatigue after such intense concentration made him dizzy.

"I'll sleep after I eat," he said weakly.

No one disagreed. In fact, Xiang Nanli had been working at high intensity for 14 hours.

He was a primitive human; he had neither mechanical modifications nor genetic enhancements. If he didn't sleep, Xin Zhui was worried he would pass out.

The lunch box provided by the client contained: a bottle of water and a can of nutrient paste.

The canned food was a special version for investigators, very different from the cheap stuff sold in supermarkets. Upon opening it, one could smell a fresh, meaty aroma—not the kind made from food additives.

I’m done. You guys are eating this well behind the people's backs?

Xiang Nanli picked up the can and looked at the ingredient list.

Ingredients: Beast Meat (100%).

"Why isn't it chicken, duck, or pork? Why write 'beast meat'?" Xiang Nanli asked, puzzled.

System: "Mutant meat. Do you prefer that term?"

Mutated humans were collectively called "Aberrants"; mutated animals and plants were called "Xenotypes."

Xiang Nanli lifted the transparent visor in front of his protective suit and tore off the black tape wrapped around his face.

The tape had been on for too long this time; after tearing it off, Xiang Nanli’s small face was bright red, with the pressure marks clearly visible.

His face was exposed to the air, but fortunately, the radiation here wasn't strong.

Xiu’s expression turned strange: "It’s you?"

Xin Zhui had said he was going to the city to grab a professional to help, and Xiu hadn't really objected.

But Xiu hadn't really held out much hope. His problem was quite serious.

The second-best method was to contact the Investigation Bureau. They had promised to hide the findings of this investigation and then provide treatment. This "hiding" didn't mean keeping the secret under wraps, but directly deleting the memory of this surface investigation mission.

The best method was to contact his family. But Xiu had signed an agreement when he left; if he used family resources, he would have to give up being an investigator and go back to honestly compete in the heir qualification rankings.

His surname was Luo. Luo from Luoyang.

Xiu wanted neither of these. So, he tacitly allowed Xin Zhui’s gamble.

Just a moment ago, Xiu was thinking that the person Xin Zhui found was actually quite reliable. He looked very professional. Maybe he really could be saved.

But, but—this professional took off his mask, and why did he look so much like that antique piece he had dug out of the shelter a month ago?

chunks.chineseText:
第9章

相南里没想到修还记得自己。

他开心地回答：“对，是我。谢谢你之前给我打的基因针。”

修的表情有些复杂，那感觉就像是你身患绝症，朋友找来一个大夫说这人是领域内大拿著作等身，你内心满怀期待；结果等人领过来一看，发现是楼下修自行车的王大爷。

修：“不客气，你叫什么？”

在任何时候，记住一个陌生人的名字暗藏着友善和接纳。

相南里朝他眨了一下眼：“相南里。”

正在吃罐头的辛追突然剧烈咳嗽起来，呛到了。

菩提摸着自己脖子上的佛珠，喃喃着重复：“相南里？”

小燕的目光则是揶揄地落在了修的脸上，她甚至走过去戳了戳他不能动的身体：“喂喂，这是相南里呢。”

相南里用勺子挖着罐头，咬了咬嘴里的一次性塑料。有些郁闷。

可能他们听见有人叫“相南里”，就像是相南里听见周围有人叫“成吉思汗”或者“牛顿”。

可是，他真的叫相南里啊！总不可能为了避自己的讳改名吧？

辛追放下罐头：“别介意，现在名字跟网名似的随便改，给自己取大众名字，或者和历史人物重名都很常见。我们笑的是修。我和他一起长大的，他从小就很崇拜相南里，小时候还经常为了相南里在论坛上跟人吵架。”

一说这个，相南里可就不困了：“吵什么？”

“嗯，就是有人说相南里当初作为实验室负责人和永生科技创始人，更大的作用体现在对整体项目的推动上，本身科研水平是有待商榷的。而他现在之所以地位如此崇高，主要还是靠两个男人。第一是Alpha，第二是洛阳。”

“放*！”相南里十分没素质地怒道，“谁说的，让他自己去试试！”

辛追：“哈哈哈哈哈。对修也是这么说的。修还在家里收藏了好多相南里周边，连自己的内置AI都取名叫的相南里的！喔，他还是相南里反黑站的管理员。”

外表很酷哥的修有些恼羞成怒：“够了，没必要说这么多吧！”

相南里懵逼：“我还有周边？”虽然死了八百年的人没有版权费，但相南里还是有些好奇。

系统：“人联制作过幼儿科普动画，里面那个白衣博士的二次元卡通形象名字也叫‘相南里’，估计指的是这个。”

白衣博士，怎么不能是一种白衣校花。

辛追继续道：“不过前几年荒区考古有新发现，有调查员找到了相南里的照片，复原之后，修就默默把手办都锁起来了……”

之前战乱频发，云端数据库都被炸过好多次，复原后愣是没找到一张相南里的照片。

人们猜测这也许是智械军团搞的鬼。

那个叫Alpha的暴君总是有很多莫名其妙的举动。比如进攻总是优先进攻永生科技所在的城市，会炸毁所有和相南里有关的雕塑、建筑。他甚至不允许这个名字在网络上出现。

感觉他不仅恨人类，也恨着自己的制造者。

当然，人联可不会怕他。

大概有六七百年，相南里的外观只是一个公共意识的集合体，默认为一个儒雅随和的中年人。

相南里感觉到有点大事不妙：“照片？什么照片？”

就算他后期因为癌症有些消瘦，但也是一个从小帅到老的绅士好吗。他不认为自己的长相对不起人民群众的期待。

难不成是因为修喜欢别的款式？真是没品的东西。

燕子掏出手机：“这个，我有保存喔。”

相南里接过一看，陷入沉默。

照片是彩色的，看得出努力修过图，但长相依然难以形容。如果不是考古文物，很像是智械军团故意放出来动摇人心的。

这是报纸，图上只残留了一小片。标题是“相南里为母校东岚大学捐款10亿”。

相南里记得这回事。

但是吧，但是——图上这个人tmd的不是我啊！

也不知道是哪一届学校领导。长得可真寒碜。

相南里震惊道：“Alpha都不管管吗？！它怎么能让别人这么污蔑我！”

系统：“您好，您并未为我购置电子眼。”

相南里泄气道：“说的不是你，哎算了。你不懂。”

系统思考了两秒：“你可以详细说说。”

相南里同样被“相南里的照片”打击到了。

他没有说话的欲望，用勺子刮干净了罐头盖，倒在地上茫然地望着山洞顶部：“我睡会，睡醒再继续上班。”

这里是之前幸存者挖出来的防空洞，这个深度，多半是在核战争结束后挖的。

外面这层也就一间教室那么大的空地，有电灯。墙体呈现出拱形的弧度。

但之前，小燕是把修从房间里推出来的。用于拼装的耗材也来自屋内。

有点好奇这里的建筑结构……

可惜没有获得允许，相南里也不好在里面乱转。

辛追温和道：“等会，让滚石去给你抱个睡袋，好好休息吧。”

睡袋压缩起来只有很小一团，像个手提包，打开后却像发酵的面包，会自己变得蓬松柔软。

相南里躺进睡袋里，感觉自己是寿司卷的那一点菜心。

相南里都躺下了，还在愤愤不平：“Alpha，你说！你说！我是靠男人拥有现在的地位的吗？”

然后又换了个话题：“看来哪怕是新世界，我还是有很多崇拜者嘛。这个小修就不错。呵呵，你知道一个理论吗，说就是如果有100个人追随你，无论什么时候你都可以过得很好。Alpha，我们会好好的。”

相南里心大，睡眠质量更好。闭上眼不到三秒，和世界失去联系。

在他入睡后，Alpha轻声回答：“是的，我们会好好的。”

辛追走过去，悄悄拉上了相南里睡袋的头部。反正有氧气瓶，也不怕闷死。

防空洞的气氛顿时格外沉默。

“你修好了，我们就回去吧。”辛追坐在地上，开口，头顶是昏黄的灯光，脸上没有笑容，“黑十字审判庭一直在追杀我们，想要拿到开锁的密钥；调查局也不可信，姑苏城里的官员绝对和他们有勾结……”

洛修打断了他：“你一直想让我回家。”

“外面很危险，我的大少爷。”辛追回答，“什么‘返回地表，光复人类’；骗人维稳的口号跟着喊喊就行了。就算真有人为此付出，那也不该是你。不管人们能不能返回地表，你都是既得利益者。”

他说这话时，旁边的滚石、菩提乃至小燕都没有任何表示。

从他们三的名字就能看出，他们是没有家族的普通公民。能考入大学并且成为调查员已经算是改天换命。

事实也的确如此，小燕前段时间还拿着工资和队长的补贴买了套主城区的小公寓房，等退休了也不用担心养老保险。这就是他们能触碰到的最好的生活了。

洛修是不一样的；他身上连最基础的义体材料都是几百万信用点一斤的耐钢。

这个世界阶级是凝固的。什么“王侯将相宁有种乎”，教科书都不会教。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 9

Xiang Nanli didn't expect Xiu to remember him.

He replied happily, "Yes, it’s me. Thank you for the genetic injection you gave me before."

Xiu’s expression was complex. It felt like you were suffering from a terminal illness, and a friend brought over a doctor, claiming this person was a top expert in the field with countless publications, filling you with anticipation; only to find out when the person arrived that it was Old Man Wang who fixed bicycles downstairs.

Xiu: "You're welcome. What is your name?"

At any time, remembering a stranger's name implies friendliness and acceptance.

Xiang Nanli winked at him: "Xiang Nanli."

Xin Zhui, who was eating his canned food, suddenly started coughing violently, choking.

Bodhi touched the prayer beads around his neck, muttering the name repeatedly: "Xiang Nanli?"

Xiao Yan’s gaze fell teasingly on Xiu’s face; she even walked over and poked his immobile body: "Hey, hey, this is Xiang Nanli."

Xiang Nanli dug into the can with a spoon, biting the disposable plastic. He felt a bit depressed.

Perhaps when they heard someone named "Xiang Nanli," it was like Xiang Nanli hearing someone around him being called "Genghis Khan" or "Newton."

But he really was named Xiang Nanli! He couldn't change his name just to avoid his own taboo, could he?

Xin Zhui put down his can: "Don't mind them. Nowadays, names are changed as casually as screen names. It’s very common to give yourself a popular name or share a name with a historical figure. We’re laughing at Xiu. I grew up with him; he’s worshipped Xiang Nanli since he was a kid and often argued with people on forums for him."

As soon as this was mentioned, Xiang Nanli was wide awake: "Argued about what?"

"Well, some people said that as the head of the laboratory and founder of Eternal Technology, Xiang Nanli’s greater contribution was in promoting the overall project, and his actual scientific research level was debatable. The reason he has such a high status now is mainly thanks to two men. First, Alpha, and second, Luo Yang."

"Bullsh*t!" Xiang Nanli cursed unrefinedly. "Who said that? Let them try it themselves!"

Xin Zhui: "Hahahaha. That’s what we told Xiu, too. Xiu even collects a lot of Xiang Nanli merchandise at home, and he even named his built-in AI 'Xiang Nanli'! Oh, and he’s also an administrator for the Xiang Nanli anti-smear station."

Xiu, who looked like a cool guy on the outside, was a bit embarrassed and angry: "Enough, there’s no need to say so much!"

Xiang Nanli was stunned: "I have merchandise?" Although a person who had been dead for eight hundred years didn't get royalties, Xiang Nanli was still curious.

System: "The Human Alliance produced a popular science animation for children. The 2D cartoon image of the doctor in the white coat was also named 'Xiang Nanli.' They are probably referring to that."

A doctor in a white coat—why couldn't it be a campus heartthrob in a white coat?

Xin Zhui continued: "But a few years ago, there were new discoveries in the wasteland archaeology. Investigators found a photo of Xiang Nanli. After it was restored, Xiu quietly locked up all his figurines..."

In the past, wars were frequent, and the cloud database had been bombed many times. After restoration, they hadn't been able to find a single photo of Xiang Nanli.

People speculated that this might have been the work of the Cybernetic Legion.

That tyrant named Alpha always had many inexplicable actions. For example, he always prioritized attacking cities where Eternal Technology was located and would blow up all statues and buildings related to Xiang Nanli. He even forbade the name from appearing on the internet.

It felt like he not only hated humans but also hated his own creator.

Of course, the Human Alliance wouldn't be afraid of him.

For about six or seven hundred years, Xiang Nanli’s appearance had just been a collection of public consciousness, defaulting to a refined and gentle middle-aged man.

Xiang Nanli felt that something big was wrong: "A photo? What photo?"

Even if he had become a bit thin later due to cancer, he was a gentleman who had been handsome from childhood to old age, okay? He didn't think his looks failed the public’s expectations.

Could it be that Xiu preferred a different style? What a tasteless thing.

Xiao Yan took out her phone: "This one, I have it saved."

Xiang Nanli took it and fell silent.

The photo was in color. You could tell they had tried hard to touch it up, but the appearance was still indescribable. If it weren't an archaeological artifact, it looked very much like something the Cybernetic Legion had deliberately released to shake people's morale.

It was a newspaper, and only a small piece of the image remained. The headline read: "Xiang Nanli donates 1 billion to his alma mater, Donglan University."

Xiang Nanli remembered that event.

But, but—the person in the picture is NOT me, dammit!

He didn't know which school official it was. They looked truly wretched.

Xiang Nanli said in shock: "Doesn't Alpha do anything about it?! How can it let others slander me like this!"

System: "Hello, you did not purchase electronic eyes for me."

Xiang Nanli deflated: "I’m not talking about you. Sigh, forget it. You wouldn't understand."

The system thought for two seconds: "You can elaborate."

Xiang Nanli was also hit hard by the "photo of Xiang Nanli."

He had no desire to speak. He scraped the lid of the can clean with his spoon, lay on the ground, and stared blankly at the ceiling of the cave: "I’m going to sleep for a while. I’ll go back to work when I wake up."

This was an air-raid shelter dug out by previous survivors. At this depth, it was mostly dug after the nuclear war ended.

The open space outside was about the size of a classroom and had electric lights. The walls had an arched curve.

But earlier, Xiao Yan had pushed Xiu out of the room. The materials used for assembly also came from inside.

He was a bit curious about the architectural structure here...

Unfortunately, without permission, Xiang Nanli didn't feel like wandering around.

Xin Zhui said gently: "Wait a moment, let Rolling Stone go get you a sleeping bag. Get some good rest."

The sleeping bag was compressed into a small bundle, like a handbag. Once opened, it became fluffy and soft, like rising dough.

Xiang Nanli lay down in the sleeping bag, feeling like the piece of vegetable heart in a sushi roll.

Even after lying down, Xiang Nanli was still indignant: "Alpha, tell me! Tell me! Did I rely on men to get where I am today?"

Then he changed the subject: "It seems that even in the new world, I still have many admirers. This little Xiu isn't bad. Heh, do you know a theory? It says that if you have 100 people following you, you can live well no matter what. Alpha, we will be fine."

Xiang Nanli was big-hearted, and his sleep quality was even better. Within three seconds of closing his eyes, he lost contact with the world.

After he fell asleep, Alpha replied softly: "Yes, we will be fine."

Xin Zhui walked over and quietly pulled the top of the sleeping bag over Xiang Nanli’s head. Since there was an oxygen tank, there was no fear of suffocation.

The atmosphere in the air-raid shelter suddenly became exceptionally silent.

"Once you’re repaired, we’ll go back," Xin Zhui sat on the ground, speaking under the dim light, his face devoid of a smile. "The Black Cross Tribunal has been hunting us, wanting to get the key to the lock; the Investigation Bureau isn't trustworthy either, and the officials in Gusu City are definitely colluding with them..."

Luo Xiu interrupted him: "You’ve always wanted me to go home."

"It’s dangerous out here, my young master," Xin Zhui replied. "Slogans like 'Return to the surface, restore humanity'—it’s enough to just shout them to maintain stability. Even if someone really pays the price for it, it shouldn't be you. Regardless of whether people can return to the surface, you are a beneficiary of the status quo."

When he said this, Rolling Stone, Bodhi, and even Xiao Yan showed no reaction.

One could tell from their names that they were ordinary citizens without families. Being able to get into university and become investigators was already a life-changing feat.

And the facts were indeed so; Xiao Yan had recently used her salary and captain’s subsidy to buy a small apartment in the main urban area, so she wouldn't have to worry about pension insurance after retirement. This was the best life they could touch.

Luo Xiu was different; even the most basic prosthetic materials on his body cost millions of credits per catty for Resistant Steel.

In this world, the class structure was solidified. "Are kings and nobles born with high status?"—even textbooks wouldn't teach that.

chunks.chineseText:
更何况平心而论，大家的生活并没有特别差，衣食住行满足后还有很多娱乐。地下比地表好多了。

至于智械；那边不要人类，还是军事化管理。除了机械化太高的带路党，基本不在生存考虑范围内。

“而且，”辛追话锋一转，“你的身体坏了，随时都可以更换更好更合适的义体。你也没有后顾之忧，不用担心家人或者朋友的生计；但是队里其他人呢？你是想让他们跟着你丢了工作吗？

“嗯，对，没错，你有钱，可以养他们。但你的钱不也来自家族企业分红？惯子如杀子，真该让叔叔阿姨把你的生活费给停掉。”

洛修的眉头紧锁，最后认命地叹了口气：“我知道了。对不起，给大家添麻烦了。”

“没事，我理解。毕竟‘东皇重工’据说拿到了相南里生前的图纸，直到意外消失前，都一直在秘密制造——”辛追的话说了一半，脸色突然一沉，“放在山下的隐蔽摄像头报警了。怎么来得这么快？”

……

……

高大的人穿着黑色的盔甲，骑着高大的机械马。

机械马是一种改造代步工具，更适应地表的极端地形。并不是所有地方都有路。而这种马甚至会飞。

这些骑士身体的每一寸都被盔甲包裹，但最特别的是他们的头盔。和普通护甲不一样，他们的头盔呈现出一个尖锐的三角形。表面一条竖线一条横线，组成了血红色的十字亮光。

机械改造人的致命点在心脏，也就是机械核心；而基因改造人，他们的致命点是大脑。

所以，才会设计出这种看不出脑袋具体位置的盔甲。

领头的骑士抬起手，数十人的队伍令行禁止，立刻停下了步伐。安静极了。

一只三眼的黑色乌鸦落在他的指节上，发出“嘎嘎”的怪叫声。

“我感觉到圣灵的指引，偷走密钥的小老鼠就在附近。”他开口，“搜。”

这些人呼吸着，盔甲的缝隙里冒出一缕缕白烟。

这是黑十字审判庭里的精锐部队。

天启骑士团。
chunks.englishText:
Moreover, in all fairness, everyone’s life isn't particularly bad; after basic needs like food, clothing, housing, and transportation are met, there is still plenty of entertainment. Life underground is much better than on the surface.

As for the mechanical lifeforms, they have no use for humans and operate under a militarized system. Unless you are a collaborator with a high degree of cybernetic modification, you aren't even considered worth keeping alive.

"Besides," Xin Zhui shifted the tone of the conversation, "your body is damaged, but you can replace it with a better, more suitable prosthetic at any time. You have no worries, no need to fret about the livelihood of family or friends. But what about the others in the team? Do you want them to lose their jobs because of you?"

"Well, yes, you're right. You have money, and you can support them. But isn't your money just dividends from the family business? Spoiling a child is like killing them; your aunt and uncle really should cut off your allowance."

Luo Xiu’s brows furrowed tightly, and finally, he sighed in resignation. "I understand. I'm sorry for causing trouble for everyone."

"It's fine, I understand. After all, it's rumored that 'Donghuang Heavy Industries' obtained the blueprints left behind by Xiang Nanli before his death, and they had been secretly manufacturing—" Xin Zhui’s words were cut short, her expression suddenly darkening. "The hidden cameras we placed at the foot of the mountain have triggered an alarm. How did they get here so fast?"

……

……

Tall figures clad in black armor rode atop massive mechanical horses.

Mechanical horses were a modified mode of transport, better suited for the extreme terrain of the surface. Not every place had roads, and these steeds were even capable of flight.

Every inch of these knights' bodies was encased in armor, but the most distinctive feature was their helmets. Unlike standard protective gear, their helmets were shaped into sharp triangles. A vertical line and a horizontal line on the surface formed a blood-red, glowing cross.

The fatal weak point of a cyborg is the heart—the mechanical core—while for a genetically modified human, it is the brain.

That was precisely why they designed armor that concealed the exact location of the head.

The lead knight raised a hand, and the team of dozens stopped in unison, obeying the order instantly. It was deathly silent.

A three-eyed black crow landed on his knuckle, letting out a strange "caw."

"I sense the guidance of the Holy Spirit; the little mouse who stole the key is nearby," he said. "Search."

These men breathed, and wisps of white smoke drifted from the gaps in their armor.

This was the elite force of the Black Cross Inquisition.

The Apocalypse Knights.

chunks.chineseText:
第10章

相南里做梦，梦到了Alpha。

在梦里，对方是一个模糊的光亮人影，看不清脸，只能感觉出高挑又漂亮，身体泛着金属的肌理感。不愧是他按照自己性癖捏的大帅哥。

Alpha穿着黑色的长风衣，像是参加葬礼。手里握着一束铃兰花，漂亮的花束周围有些错乱的像素点。

Alpha正注视着……他？

不知道为什么，明明连五官都没有，相南里却感觉到了哀伤。

智械人也会梦到死去的人吗？

在你眼里我又是谁？

相南里突然控制不住地掉下眼泪。他不是神，是人。

表现的再冷静也不过是为了更好地应对压力，但忍耐住了，压力并没有随之消失。他也会茫然，无措。

相南里像是一辈子都没离开过山坳的村民，被猝不及防地丢进了现代化都市里。

这个钢铁森林如此陌生，他在这一刻好像被全世界排斥在外。每一根冰冷冷的钢筋都在傲然地训斥着：“滚回去，这不是你的时代。”

相南里向前一步，哽咽道：“你抛弃我。Alpha，你抛弃我……”

出乎意料地，这个人影回应了。

相南里看见他的唇一张一合，没有声音。

相南里反应了许久，才意识到他说了什么。

他说的是：“是你先抛弃我的。”

……

……

相南里在睡袋里被人摇醒了。动作很粗鲁。

他掀开头罩，眼睛鼻子都是红的，声音沙哑：“怎么了，上班时间到了？”

他困得像是头被人狠狠砸了一锤，太阳穴突突地跳，心脏也不是很舒服。

Alpha：[根据计算，您只休息了89分钟。预计还差600分钟满足当日大脑睡眠需求。]

相南里只是一个打过基因针的非战斗人员。没有经历过任何改造，身体素质并不够看。

辛追过去笑吟吟的脸上，如今没有丝毫笑意：“追杀的人来了，需要撤离。尽管这里看起来很安全，但我们不能赌。”

相南里瞬间清醒了过来，严肃地回答：“明白。”

辛追把他叫醒而不是让他自生自灭，那就证明他还是有用的。

相南里火速来到还没拼好的零件前，这么多东西肯定没办法直接带走。

他收起自己的工具，看着自己刚拼了一半还没来得及安装的机械臂，面色微沉。

“这条手臂带上。也许路上来得及安装，剩下就算了。”

他把供能线往自己兜里塞。

这些机械义体都是从东皇重工搜来的。之后应该也还有。

虽然也不知道洛修这种残废状态，多一条手臂能有什么用。但是万一呢。

他喜欢尽人事。

小燕姐推起板车，把机械臂同放在滚轮车上。推着半成品的修往防空洞深处走去：“走这边。”

生活痕迹没有清理，第一是时间不够；第二是如果防空洞被找到，这点清理一点用都没有。

相南里又一次被辛追背了起来。但这次是因为人家嫌他跑得慢。

技术人员是这样的，在需要逃命的时刻显得有些拖后腿。

相南里内心是有些羞赧的，但转念一想，要不是辛追把他从交通站抓过来，他现在已经在地下城吃上新鲜蔬菜了，于是变得理直气壮起来。

相南里甚至有心情观察起周围的环境。

防空洞后果然别有洞天。前方是一条宽阔的隧道，隧道左右两侧都雕刻着神佛像。是开凿的山体。这位工匠显然是艺术家。

神佛和相南里过去看到的那些佛像也不太一样。是一尊尊机械菩萨。

身上有编码的机械观音坐在莲花上，手里握着一枚机械核心，像莲子，像心脏。背后，数不清的机械手如同千手观音敞开着。

另一侧，一颗巨大的佛头低垂着眉眼。大脑后有一枚圆形的光圈，下巴处，金属的裁剪拼贴线格外明显——早那么几百年，智械人还不以“仿人”为美。很喜欢在脸上、身上保留这些明显的机械构造。

但这里是避难所，人类区的避难所。所以雕凿这些机械神佛的，一定也是人类。

不能理解的伟力视之为“神力”。

而人又无法想象出自己完全没见过的东西。

当年人和智械的战争，总有那么一批人类在高压之下崩溃。于是神佛成了智械人的模样。

——伟大的神明，我祈求您，留世间一条生路，降下怜悯。

相南里被隧道里的石窟艺术所震撼，但推着洛修的小燕却忍不住冷笑：“‘东皇重工’的员工果然都是人奸，智械人是神佛，那我们是什么？寺奴？几百年前被调查局清理也算罪有应得。”

“菩提。”辛追则是没什么表示，“等我们进入第二层，把之前埋好的触发炸弹全都启动。”

菩提有气无力地回答：“是。副队。”

调查小组标配：战斗专员+技术专员。

纯战士：修、辛追、滚石。哥们就是爱打架，没什么好说的。打得最凶的那个小帅哥现在已经瘫痪在车上了。

医疗：小燕。她是队里唯一的医生，装配了很多医疗器械。就像是一个移动的手术台。

白客/简单义体维修：菩提。正儿八经的优秀大学毕业生，学的云端网络安全。但是更擅长使用炸弹、制造爆破武器。东皇重工防空洞的门禁卡就是他破开的。

但这个分工并不绝对，哪怕看起来最瘦弱的小燕，也是比相南里能打的。

他们来到了第二扇门前。这看起来像是一个地下仓库的入口。用电子锁关着。

几百年过去了，这个电子锁居然还是亮着的。

菩提掏出一根数据线，把自己和入口门连上。他嘴里念念有词，眼底亮起一阵忽高忽低的光。几乎能看见一串串的数据矩阵在他的眼中流淌。

这是相南里完全不了解的领域，他屏住呼吸，感觉这很玄幻。

相南里小声问：[他在破解密码？]

[对，那是脑机接口。早在六百年前，脑机技术就被广泛应用了。这项技术不需要那么多的硬件设备，把大脑当做电脑使用，所以很受欢迎。]

[不过，脑机接口是需要接受改造的。]

Alpha回答。

紧张的半分钟后，“滴”的一声，门开了。

“氧气瓶佩戴好。”辛追提醒，“除了修，其他人都带上。我怕气体有毒。”

洛修的机械化程度，已经能当成硅基生命看待了。

相南里给自己套上氧气罩，故作轻松地询问：“是谁在追杀我们？”

辛追没说话。

相南里咬了咬牙：“我这完全是无妄之灾，总该有点知情权吧阿sir？我本来都要回地下了，你们把我绑过来，帮忙修理机械人就算了。我，我才从冷冻舱解冻呢，还没活够。到时候死都不知道自己怎么死的，冤不冤啊？”

他本来只是逢场做戏，但是骤然想到了刚刚做的梦，心里莫名升起一股浓重的悲伤感。

相南里的眼泪忽闪忽闪地掉了下来。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 10

Xiang Nanli had a dream, and in it, he saw Alpha.

In the dream, the other party was a blurred, luminous figure. He couldn't see the face, only sensing a tall, elegant frame with skin that shimmered with a metallic texture. As expected of the handsome man he had sculpted according to his own preferences.

Alpha was wearing a long black trench coat, as if attending a funeral. He held a bouquet of lilies in his hand, the beautiful flowers surrounded by chaotic, glitching pixels.

Alpha was staring at… him?

For some reason, even though the figure lacked facial features, Xiang Nanli could feel a profound sorrow.

Do mechanical lifeforms dream of the dead, too?

In your eyes, who am I?

Xiang Nanli suddenly couldn't stop the tears from falling. He wasn't a god; he was human.

No matter how calm he appeared, it was merely to better cope with the pressure. But even if he endured, the pressure didn't vanish. He felt lost, helpless.

Xiang Nanli was like a villager who had never left his mountain valley, suddenly tossed into a modernized metropolis.

This steel forest was so alien, and in this moment, he felt rejected by the entire world. Every cold steel girder seemed to be arrogantly scolding him: "Get back; this is not your era."

Xiang Nanli took a step forward, choking out, "You abandoned me. Alpha, you abandoned me…"

Unexpectedly, the figure responded.

Xiang Nanli saw his lips move, though there was no sound.

It took Xiang Nanli a long time to realize what he had said.

He had said: "It was you who abandoned me first."

……

……

Xiang Nanli was shaken awake inside his sleeping bag. The movement was rough.

He pulled back his hood, his eyes and nose red, his voice raspy. "What is it? Is it time for work?"

He was so sleepy his head felt like it had been hammered; his temples throbbed, and his heart didn't feel right either.

Alpha: [According to calculations, you have only rested for 89 minutes. You are estimated to be 600 minutes short of your daily brain sleep requirement.]

Xiang Nanli was merely a non-combatant who had received a genetic injection. He had undergone no modifications, and his physical constitution was nothing to boast about.

The face that had been smiling at Xin Zhui earlier now held no warmth. "The pursuers are here; we need to evacuate. Even though this place looks safe, we cannot gamble."

Xiang Nanli instantly sobered up, answering gravely, "Understood."

The fact that Xin Zhui had woken him instead of leaving him to his fate proved that he was still useful.

Xiang Nanli rushed to the parts he hadn't finished assembling. There was no way to take all of this with him.

He packed up his tools, looking at the mechanical arm he had just half-assembled, his expression sinking.

"Take this arm. Maybe there will be time to install it on the road. Forget the rest."

He stuffed the power cables into his pockets.

These mechanical prosthetics were scavenged from Donghuang Heavy Industries. There should be more later.

Though he didn't know what use an extra arm would be to a cripple like Luo Xiu, one never knew.

He liked to do his best.

Sister Xiao Yan pushed the cart, placing the mechanical arm alongside the half-finished repair project, and wheeled it toward the depths of the air-raid shelter. "This way."

They didn't clean up the signs of their presence; first, there wasn't enough time, and second, if the shelter was found, a little cleaning wouldn't make a difference.

Xiang Nanli was carried on Xin Zhui’s back once again. This time, it was because she complained he was too slow.

That was how technicians were—in moments of life-or-death escape, they tended to be a drag.

Xiang Nanli felt a bit embarrassed, but then he thought, if Xin Zhui hadn't snatched him from the transit station, he would already be eating fresh vegetables in the underground city, and he became righteous again.

Xiang Nanli even had the mood to observe his surroundings.

The back of the air-raid shelter was indeed a hidden world. Ahead was a wide tunnel, with statues of gods and Buddhas carved into both sides. It was carved directly into the mountain. The craftsman was clearly an artist.

These gods and Buddhas were different from the ones Xiang Nanli had seen in the past. They were mechanical Bodhisattvas.

A mechanical Guanyin with serial numbers on its body sat upon a lotus, holding a mechanical core in its hand—like a lotus seed, or a heart. Behind it, countless mechanical arms spread out like the Thousand-Armed Guanyin.

On the other side, a massive Buddha head hung low, eyes downcast. Behind its brain was a circular halo, and at the chin, the metallic cutting and collage lines were particularly distinct—hundreds of years ago, mechanical lifeforms didn't consider "human-like" to be beautiful. They loved keeping these obvious mechanical structures on their faces and bodies.

But this was a sanctuary, a sanctuary in the human zone. So, whoever carved these mechanical gods and Buddhas must have been human.

The incomprehensible power of the divine is viewed as "divine power."

And humans cannot imagine things they have never seen.

During the war between humans and mechanical lifeforms, there were always groups of humans who collapsed under high pressure. Thus, the gods and Buddhas took on the appearance of the machines.

—Great gods, I pray to you, leave a path for the world, show mercy.

Xiang Nanli was stunned by the grotto art in the tunnel, but Xiao Yan, who was pushing Luo Xiu, couldn't help but sneer: "The employees of 'Donghuang Heavy Industries' are indeed human traitors. If the mechanical lifeforms are the gods, then what are we? Temple slaves? It’s no wonder we were purged by the Investigation Bureau hundreds of years ago."

"Bodhi," Xin Zhui said, showing no emotion. "Once we enter the second level, activate all the trigger bombs we planted earlier."

Bodhi answered listlessly, "Yes, Deputy Leader."

Standard Investigation Team composition: Combat Specialist + Technical Specialist.

Pure fighters: Xiu, Xin Zhui, Rolling Stone. These guys just love to fight, nothing more to say. The handsome guy who fought the hardest was now paralyzed on his cart.

Medical: Xiao Yan. She was the only doctor on the team, equipped with many medical instruments. She was like a mobile operating table.

White Hat/Basic Prosthetic Repair: Bodhi. A legitimate top university graduate who studied cloud network security. But he was better at using bombs and manufacturing explosive weapons. He was the one who hacked the access card for the Donghuang Heavy Industries shelter.

But this division of labor wasn't absolute; even the seemingly frail Xiao Yan could fight better than Xiang Nanli.

They arrived at the second door. It looked like the entrance to an underground warehouse, sealed with an electronic lock.

Hundreds of years later, the electronic lock was surprisingly still powered on.

Bodhi pulled out a data cable and connected himself to the entrance. He muttered to himself, a light flickering in his eyes. One could almost see strings of data matrices flowing within them.

This was a field Xiang Nanli knew nothing about. He held his breath, feeling like this was something out of fantasy.

Xiang Nanli whispered: [Is he cracking the password?]

[Yes, that is a brain-computer interface. As early as six hundred years ago, brain-computer technology was widely applied. This technology didn't require much hardware, using the brain as a computer, so it was very popular.]

[However, brain-computer interfaces require modification.]

Alpha replied.

After a tense half-minute, with a "beep," the door opened.

"Put on your oxygen tanks," Xin Zhui reminded. "Everyone except Xiu. I'm afraid the gas might be toxic."

Luo Xiu’s level of mechanization was already such that he could be considered a silicon-based lifeform.

Xiang Nanli put on his oxygen mask and asked with feigned ease, "Who is hunting us?"

Xin Zhui didn't speak.

Xiang Nanli gritted his teeth. "This is completely unprovoked for me; I should at least have the right to know, Officer? I was about to go back underground, and you kidnapped me, and repairing the robot is one thing. I—I just thawed out from the cryo-pod, I haven't lived enough yet. If I die without even knowing how, isn't that a grievance?"

He was originally just putting on an act, but the dream he had just had suddenly surfaced, and a heavy sense of sorrow rose in his heart.

Xiang Nanli’s tears flickered and fell.

chunks.chineseText:
洛修有些僵硬地开口：“是黑十字审判庭。之前，有大量畸变人往东皇重工旧址这个方向赶。我们接受任务，前来排查。并且在这里发现了黑十字审判庭的活动痕迹。”

“黑十字审判庭是一个地表恐怖组织，这个我想《人类常识》里是有的。他们既不赞成机械改造，又对地底人类十分残忍。他们自称为新人类。打着‘肃清’的口号，到处发动天启战争。最著名的战绩是在120年前，屠杀、占领了阴山城，作为自己的据点。”

阴山城是地下18座城市之一。

名字来源于“不教胡马度阴山”。不过现在人们的敌人不是“胡人”，阴山城是离智械军团领地最近的一座地下城市。相当于一道边塞。

这里因为频繁战乱，GDP年年倒数，还吸血周围其他城市。被黑十字审判庭夺走后，擅长权衡利弊的人联居然就这么把地下城池拱手相让了！

当时，人联本来是想看黑十字审判庭的笑话。结果没想到审判庭以一个苛刻的条件，和智械人签订了和平协议。放在古代多少被骂丧权辱国，但审判庭的高层毫不在乎。

先生存下来，再谈别的东西。

阴山城是审判庭的圣地，但对人联来说，却是一块食之无味、弃之可惜的鸡肋。

至今对于要不要收复失地，人联内部还没个统一的说法。

“在菩提的协助下，我伪装成了东皇重工的智械人。窃听到了审判庭的情报。”洛修继续道，“他们这次来东皇重工，是因为翻译出了一条古老的情报。相南里为Alpha设计过身体。图纸就在东皇重工的核心数据库里，智械危机刚爆发那些年，东皇重工一直在偷偷为Alpha制造身体！”

卧底智械人，中间险象环生的经历，修并没有多言。只是挑了最重要的讲。

相南里设计的Alpha。起初只是超级人工智能，它是没有实体的。

而一直到现在，Alpha都没有实体。它的“灵魂”被困在某个数据中心站里。

原因就是相南里当初在创造它的时候，在源代码上植入过病毒。

在病毒没有清理的情况下，Alpha只要把自己转移到别的“设备”上，就会自动触发死亡程序，也就是格式化。

除非相南里亲自解锁。否则，Alpha永远都没办法拥有现实中的“身体”。

换句话说，在阿尔法没有身体的情况下，只要想办法摧毁它的数据中心，也许就能结束长达八百年的智械危机了。

相南里头脑发懵：[等等？我什么时候设置过这玩意？]

“天启骑士团这次来的目的，就是把东皇重工秘密生产的那具机械身体运回去……这具身体是为Alpha设计的，极有可能破解了病毒程序。我们绝对不能让它落到智械人手里。”洛修正气凛然地说道。

辛追冷笑：“然而，就在我们把消息传回去的当天，修的位置就暴露了。我们也没有等来调查局的支援。肯定有叛徒把消息泄露给了对面。”
chunks.englishText:
Luo Xiu spoke with some stiffness: "It’s the Black Cross Inquisition. Previously, a large number of aberrants were heading toward the old site of Donghuang Heavy Industries. We accepted the mission to investigate and discovered traces of the Black Cross Inquisition’s activities here."

"The Black Cross Inquisition is a surface terrorist organization; I believe that is covered in 'Human Common Sense.' They neither approve of mechanical modification nor show mercy to underground humans. They call themselves the New Humans. Under the banner of 'Purification,' they launch Apocalypse Wars everywhere. Their most famous achievement was 120 years ago, when they slaughtered and occupied Yinshan City, using it as their stronghold."

Yinshan City was one of the 18 underground cities.

The name was derived from the poem "Do not let the Hu horses cross the Yin Mountains." However, the enemy today was not the "Hu people." Yinshan City was the underground city closest to the territory of the Mechanical Legion. It was effectively a frontier fortress.

Because of frequent warfare, its GDP was at the bottom every year, and it drained the resources of other surrounding cities. After it was taken by the Black Cross Inquisition, the Human Alliance, skilled in weighing pros and cons, simply handed the underground city over!

At the time, the Human Alliance had intended to watch the Black Cross Inquisition make a fool of itself. To their surprise, the Inquisition signed a peace treaty with the mechanical lifeforms under harsh conditions. In ancient times, this would have been denounced as a humiliating surrender, but the high-ranking officials of the Inquisition didn't care.

Survive first, then talk about everything else.

Yinshan City was the holy land of the Inquisition, but to the Human Alliance, it was a piece of chicken rib—tasteless to eat, but a pity to discard.

To this day, there is no unified consensus within the Human Alliance on whether to reclaim the lost territory.

"With Bodhi’s assistance, I disguised myself as a mechanical lifeform from Donghuang Heavy Industries and eavesdropped on the Inquisition’s intelligence," Luo Xiu continued. "They came to Donghuang Heavy Industries this time because they translated an ancient piece of intelligence. Xiang Nanli designed a body for Alpha. The blueprints are in the core database of Donghuang Heavy Industries. In the years when the mechanical crisis first broke out, Donghuang Heavy Industries had been secretly manufacturing a body for Alpha!"

Xiu didn't elaborate on the dangerous experiences of being an undercover mechanical lifeform; he only mentioned the most important parts.

Xiang Nanli designed Alpha. Initially, it was just a super artificial intelligence; it had no physical form.

And even now, Alpha has no physical form. Its "soul" is trapped in some data center station.

The reason is that when Xiang Nanli created it, he embedded a virus into the source code.

As long as the virus remains uncleared, whenever Alpha tries to transfer itself to another "device," it automatically triggers a death program—a format.

Unless Xiang Nanli unlocks it personally, Alpha will never be able to possess a "body" in reality.

In other words, while Alpha lacks a body, if one could find a way to destroy its data center, perhaps the eight-hundred-year-long mechanical crisis could be ended.

Xiang Nanli’s mind went blank: [Wait? When did I set up something like that?]

"The Apocalypse Knights' purpose this time is to transport that mechanical body secretly produced by Donghuang Heavy Industries back… This body was designed for Alpha and is highly likely to have cracked the virus program. We absolutely cannot let it fall into the hands of the mechanical lifeforms," Luo Xiu said with righteous indignation.

Xin Zhui sneered: "However, the very day we transmitted the news back, Xiu’s location was exposed. We didn't receive any support from the Investigation Bureau either. There must be a traitor who leaked the news to the other side."

chunks.chineseText:
第11章

洛修交代了大部分的起承转合，只隐匿了一些不方便外人知晓的信息。

譬如，他这个洛家大少爷被不计代价地追杀，很大一部分原因，是他拿到了东皇重工的“密钥”。

审判庭都对洛修下手了，那自然不可能留下活口。这也是他们需要集体撤离的原因。

洛修虽然不是顺位排名第一的继承人，但在家族内地位并不低。当初主动放弃洛阳城，去偏僻的姑苏当调查员，不知道多少竞争者半夜偷偷笑醒。

密钥是他从骑士长的口袋里偷走的，能打开企业仓库的最后一扇保护门；据说门后，就放着那台价值连城的机械造物。

无论是让智械人用，还是拆开零件安装到改造人身上，都会得到令顶级财阀也怦然心动的收益。

相南里很疑惑：[那台机甲……是机甲吧？再牛逼，也是几百年前的东西了。还没报废吗？]

在他生活的年代，十年前的手机都属于电子古董了。他实在想象不出闲置了六百年的金属身体会是什么样。难不成是青铜色？

系统回答：[不一定是机甲。一般来说，有强大能力的机械造物，会被划分出三个等级。]

[从低到高依次是，荣耀机械、天灾机械、使徒机械。]

相南里分神片刻，询问：[有什么区别吗？]

[核武器虽然不属于机械，但威力和“荣耀机械”差不多。]

[智械军团领袖Alpha在一年前，曾经试图启动卫星2号上的太空武器，那台太空武器的等级是“天灾机械”。]

[至于传说中的使徒机械；据相南里留下的构思，应该有四台。形态未知。只有名字流传了下来。]

不知道为什么，Alpha的声音听起来嘲讽又戏谑。

相南里满头问号：这些机械造物分级听起来又中二又装逼……等等，什么叫根据我留下的构思？

他趴在辛追的背上，头一次觉得自己的脑袋和脸一样花瓶。

[频繁的战乱和仓促的撤离，让人类遗失了大量和智械有关的科技技术。所以人类才会频繁展开地表调查。科技甚至出现了断代。]

[不过让人意外的是，智械军团那边也造不出更高等级的智械……呵呵，不过机械本来就只会模仿，不会创造很正常。]

[如今的智械制造技术，并没有比几百年前更好。更何况有些智械用的材料是不可再生的太空货。现在，大部分被予以众望的机械造物只有‘荣耀级’，放在第一次智械战争时期都混不上军团长。]

[如果这具机械身体，真的是东皇重工为Alpha准备的，那起码有“天灾机械”的水准吧？]系统自言自语，[那么畸变人为什么会往这里靠拢？总不可能是为了提醒调查局这里有异常吧。]

信息太少，系统的问题注定没办法得到答案。

菩提拔掉了连接着自己大脑的传感线，面色惨白，不断喘着粗气。

他扬起手里的黑色芯片：“我黑进后台，开了个临时职工权限。可以进去了。”

相南里看着有些于心不忍。

把人脑当电脑用，真是一项残忍又神秘的技术。听说这些网络技术安全员，每年比战斗人员的减员还要严重。

相南里跟在辛追身后，穿过了面前这扇金属巨门。

“验证通过。”

机械音在他耳边响起。

位于工厂附近防空洞果然没那么简单。

一进入防空洞负二层，里面的建筑就非常有现代感了，金属浇筑出了墙壁。整层楼有一股肃然的冷意。

那种冷意很难形容，也许来自地表的追杀，也许来自头顶监控偶尔一闪而过的红光。

“这是什么地方，地下生产车间吗？”辛追的眉头蹙起。

地下室整体是冰冷的石灰色。几百年过去，车间还有微量的储备电源残留。走廊检测到有人，竟然自动亮起灯光。

不知道是哪里渗水了，带着明显石灰碎屑的水浸在小脚踝处，地上能踩到断裂的电线。生锈的金属零件被无所谓地浸泡在水中。

菩提摸着脖子上的串珠，有气无力地说着：“管它是哪。辛追，看看地表情况。我试试这里能不能侵入企业后台，找到地下防空洞的出口。”

车间办公室用的是玻璃门，摸一下，玻璃屏幕上亮起纹路，居然要求输入密码锁。好在这也难不到菩提。

菩提从随身携带的包里掏出一台书本大小的笔记本电脑，在键盘上敲了一长串数字。几分钟后，玻璃门朝着两边打开。

相南里这个原始人看得很激动，眼神都亮闪闪的：[这个好帅。是怎么做到的？]

Alpha：[很基础的网络入侵技术，没什么大不了的。]

它忍了忍，还是把那句“是个人都能做到”咽回去了。

“扫描了一下。角落里居然有两台安保机械人。不过还没有被触发激活，先不用管。”菩提道，随后，自顾自地坐在了办公室的书桌前，开始了工作，“要不然辛追你去看看是什么型号，能不能拆卸下来给修用？”

明明大家都处于被骑士团追杀的状态，其中战斗力最高的那个改造人还基本报废。但整个队伍都有一股迷之自信和从容。

他们这个调查小队绝对是高配置精英组，放在姑苏城属于降维打击。

调查组遇到的天启骑士团，正常调查员的第一反应是“战略性撤退”并上报，说白了就是逃跑；而洛修的第一反应却是“让我看看这群人想干嘛”。

跟着这样的队长，大家都习惯出事了。想办法解决问题比较重要。

相南里又一次投入到了工作中。这里的工作环境没有之前那么简陋，但材料和工具奇缺。灯光也不是那么亮，费眼睛。

他在这里组装着之前没修好的机械臂。辛追则是按照菩提指的方向，寻找起了那两台安保机械人。

外面传来了有些骇人的打斗声。相南里没忍住抬头，往声音来源的方向看了眼，但他只能看见一团朦胧的电光。

小燕摸了摸他的脑袋，声音听起来很有母爱：“别管。是辛追在进行垃圾清理；你继续拼你的。”

半个小时后，辛追扛着两台报废的机械人回到了办公室。

他把这些铁块往相南里的跟前一丢：“看看这个能不能用，起码要先站起来吧。每次还要人推，太拖后腿了，大少爷。”

修的语气充满歉意：“很抱歉，下次我会小心一点的。”

相南里把辛追带回来的机械人拆开检查了一下：“电线烧糊了，中央芯片也坏了。”

辛追追求高效简洁，直接使用的电击，破坏了这些机械人的中枢系统。

修的眼神里有了几分失望。成为拖累对他来说很不好受。

相南里的声音顿了顿：“但也还能用。放心，会让你站起来的。”

他的言语透露出一股强大的自信。不管是不是吹牛逼，在这种人心惶惶的时刻，是很有安抚效果的。

相南里的手摸过，原本完整的机械人被分解成了一块块的金属零件，比庖丁解牛还要迅速。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 11

Luo Xiu explained most of the ins and outs, only concealing information that was inconvenient for outsiders to know.

For instance, a large part of the reason why he, the eldest young master of the Luo family, was being hunted at all costs was that he had obtained the "key" to Donghuang Heavy Industries.

Since the Inquisition had already moved against Luo Xiu, they naturally wouldn't leave any survivors. This was the reason they needed to evacuate as a group.

Although Luo Xiu was not the first in line for succession, his status within the family was not low. When he voluntarily gave up Luoyang City to go to the remote Gusu as an investigator, who knows how many competitors woke up laughing in the middle of the night.

The key was something he had stolen from the pocket of a Knight Commander; it could open the final protective door of the corporate warehouse. It was said that behind that door lay that priceless mechanical creation.

Whether it was used by the mechanical lifeforms or dismantled for parts to install on cyborgs, the benefits would be enough to make even top conglomerates' hearts race.

Xiang Nanli was puzzled: [That mecha… it is a mecha, right? No matter how awesome it is, it’s still something from hundreds of years ago. Isn't it obsolete yet?]

In the era he lived in, a ten-year-old mobile phone was considered an electronic antique. He truly couldn't imagine what a metal body that had been sitting idle for six hundred years would look like. Could it be bronze-colored?

The system replied: [Not necessarily a mecha. Generally speaking, mechanical creations with powerful capabilities are divided into three levels.]

[From low to high, they are: Glory-class, Calamity-class, and Apostle-class.]

Xiang Nanli was distracted for a moment and asked: [What’s the difference?]

[Although nuclear weapons don't count as mechanical, their power is similar to a "Glory-class" machine.]

[The leader of the Mechanical Legion, Alpha, once attempted to activate the space weapons on Satellite No. 2 a year ago. That space weapon was a "Calamity-class" machine.]

[As for the legendary Apostle-class machines; according to the concepts left behind by Xiang Nanli, there should be four of them. Their forms are unknown. Only their names have been passed down.]

For some reason, Alpha’s voice sounded mocking and playful.

Xiang Nanli was full of question marks: These mechanical classification levels sound both chuunibyou and pretentious… wait, what do you mean "according to the concepts I left behind"?

He lay on Xin Zhui’s back, feeling for the first time that his brain was as much of a vase as his face.

[Frequent wars and hasty evacuations have caused humanity to lose a vast amount of technology related to mechanical lifeforms. That is why humans frequently launch surface investigations. Technology has even suffered a generational gap.]

[However, what is surprising is that the Mechanical Legion side cannot build higher-level machines either… Heh, but machines only know how to imitate, not create, so that’s normal.]

[Current mechanical manufacturing technology is no better than it was hundreds of years ago. Moreover, some machines use non-renewable materials from space. Nowadays, most of the highly anticipated mechanical creations are only "Glory-class"; back in the First Mechanical War, they wouldn't even qualify to be a Legion Commander.]

[If this mechanical body is truly what Donghuang Heavy Industries prepared for Alpha, it should at least be at the "Calamity-class" level, right?] The system muttered to itself, [Then why would the aberrants be gathering here? It can't be to warn the Investigation Bureau that there is an anomaly here.]

There was too little information, and the system’s questions were destined to remain unanswered.

Bodhi pulled out the sensor cable connected to his brain, his face deathly pale, gasping for breath.

He raised the black chip in his hand: "I hacked into the backend and opened a temporary employee permission. We can go in."

Xiang Nanli felt a pang of sympathy.

Using a human brain as a computer was truly a cruel and mysterious technology. He had heard that these network security officers had a higher attrition rate than combat personnel every year.

Xiang Nanli followed behind Xin Zhui, passing through the massive metal door in front of them.

"Verification passed."

A mechanical voice rang in his ears.

The air-raid shelter located near the factory was indeed not that simple.

Upon entering the second basement level of the shelter, the architecture inside was very modern, with walls cast from metal. The entire floor had a solemn, cold chill.

That chill was hard to describe; perhaps it came from the pursuit on the surface, or perhaps from the red light occasionally flashing from the surveillance cameras overhead.

"What is this place? An underground production workshop?" Xin Zhui’s brows furrowed.

The basement was overall a cold, stony gray. Hundreds of years later, the workshop still had a small amount of reserve power remaining. Detecting people in the corridor, the lights actually turned on automatically.

Water was seeping in from somewhere, soaking the ankles with water containing obvious lime debris, and broken wires could be felt underfoot. Rusted metal parts were indifferently soaked in the water.

Bodhi touched the prayer beads on his neck and said listlessly: "Who cares what it is. Xin Zhui, check the surface situation. I’ll try to hack into the corporate backend here and find the exit to the underground air-raid shelter."

The workshop office used a glass door. When touched, patterns lit up on the glass screen, actually requiring a password. Fortunately, this didn't stump Bodhi.

Bodhi took out a book-sized laptop from his bag and typed a long string of numbers on the keyboard. A few minutes later, the glass door opened to both sides.

Xiang Nanli, this primitive man, watched with great excitement, his eyes sparkling: [This is so cool. How did he do that?]

Alpha: [Basic network intrusion technology, nothing special.]

It held back, swallowing the words "anyone could do it."

"Scanned it. There are actually two security robots in the corner. But they haven't been triggered or activated yet, so don't worry about them for now," Bodhi said, then sat down at the office desk and began to work. "Or, Xin Zhui, why don't you go see what model they are and if they can be dismantled for Xiu to use?"

Even though everyone was being hunted by the Knights, and the cyborg with the highest combat power was basically crippled, the entire team possessed a mysterious confidence and composure.

Their investigation team was definitely a high-spec elite group; in Gusu City, they would be considered a "dimension-reduction strike."

When faced with the Apocalypse Knights, the first reaction of a normal investigator would be "strategic retreat" and reporting it—in plain terms, running away. But Luo Xiu’s first reaction was "Let me see what these people are trying to do."

Following such a captain, everyone was used to trouble. Finding a way to solve the problem was more important.

Xiang Nanli threw himself into work once again. The working environment here wasn't as crude as before, but materials and tools were scarce. The lighting wasn't very bright, which strained his eyes.

He was assembling the mechanical arm he hadn't finished repairing earlier. Xin Zhui, meanwhile, followed the direction Bodhi pointed to find the two security robots.

Terrifying sounds of fighting came from outside. Xiang Nanli couldn't help but look up toward the source of the sound, but he could only see a blur of electric light.

Xiao Yan patted his head, her voice sounding very maternal: "Don't worry about it. It’s Xin Zhui doing some trash cleaning; you keep on assembling yours."

Half an hour later, Xin Zhui returned to the office carrying two scrapped robots.

She tossed these iron blocks in front of Xiang Nanli: "See if these can be used. At least he needs to be able to stand up first. Having to be pushed around every time is too much of a drag, Young Master."

Xiu’s tone was full of apology: "I am very sorry, I will be more careful next time."

Xiang Nanli dismantled the robots Xin Zhui brought back to check them: "The wires are burnt, and the central chip is broken."

Xin Zhui pursued efficiency and simplicity, using direct electric shocks that destroyed the central systems of these robots.

A look of disappointment appeared in Xiu’s eyes. Being a burden felt terrible to him.

Xiang Nanli’s voice paused: "But they can still be used. Don't worry, I’ll get you standing."

His words revealed a powerful confidence. Whether he was bluffing or not, in such a time of panic, it was very reassuring.

As Xiang Nanli’s hands moved, the once-intact robots were broken down into individual metal parts, even faster than a master butcher carving an ox.

chunks.chineseText:
对零部件的熟悉，也能看出一个机械技师的基本功。而且这种眼力，不是靠“共识”技术就能练出来的。

很难想象，相南里竟然一个月前才从冷冻舱里解冻。

相南里以最快的速度拼好了一条胳膊，开始给洛修安装。

他的嘴里念念有词：“电脉冲……对位点，确认。供能线，无误。机械核心，启动状态确认。”

在紧张的调试后，随着一声“喀嚓”的轻响，这条机械臂装在了洛修的身上。

相南里的手伸进防护服里，擦了擦自己前额的汗：“试试能用吗？”

这基本相当于再造一次身体了。尽管只是最基础的机械结构，也没用什么特殊的结构和耗材。

看起来似乎不需要很强的技术——但凡辛追绑来的人不是相南里而是其他机械师，那么现在也只能在地下防空洞里冲着一堆零件发呆。

修试探性地挪动起那条胳膊，机械臂在晃动间发出了“滋滋”的电流声。

“可以用。”他松了一口气，这点判断力，洛修还是有的，“只要不结构性损毁，可以用到报废。”

相南里严肃的脸上终于有了笑意：“能用就行。这才哪跟哪呢，才装了两条手臂。躯干，腿，都需要修复……辛追打下来的这两个机械人身体里安装了一些武器装置，我拆下来装给你。”

在面对普通人的时候，这些武器装置还是很有优势的。

坐在办公桌前的菩提在此时开口：“十字军的人追来了。”

他把电脑的屏幕对准修的方位：“看。”

屏幕上放着一段实时视频。白雪皑皑的山谷间，骑着机械马的骑兵闲庭信步，似乎在搜查着什么。

他们的头顶盘旋着黑色的三眼乌鸦，马蹄边，一只只畸变人穿梭爬行，不断嗅着气味。

那些毫无神智的血红色畸变人，或者说红色大蜥蜴，在天启军团的人身边乖巧的像是猎犬。甚至没有对骑士们发动进攻。

几米厚的雪对它们的嗅觉毫无影响。一只畸变人朝着某处白色的雪地嘶吼起来。

高大的黑骑士翻身下马，用脚，踩了踩蓬松柔软的雪地。

“翻。”男人说。

相南里能猜到，这里是防空洞的入口。

乌鸦由远及近，宽大的翅膀撞上隐蔽的监控。

它低头把这枚金属眼吞进了肚子里。

黑十字审判庭这些年除了进行基因改造外，也制作出不少有用的畸变动物。譬如对金属有着自动感应的侦查乌鸦。

屏幕顿时陷入一片漆黑。

相南里问：“这是离我们很近的意思了吗？”

“是的。”小燕的声音沙哑，“非常近。如果不能找到出口，那我们只能在地底和他们玩躲猫猫了。害怕吗，小孩？”

相南里：“我48岁。”

小燕瞥了他一眼：“是吗，你的身体顶多20岁。我的肉眼都能分析出来……咱们要加快速度了，还有两个小时能用。”
chunks.englishText:
A mechanic’s fundamental skill can be judged by their familiarity with components. Furthermore, this kind of keen eye cannot be honed through "consensus" technology alone.

It is hard to imagine that Xiang Nanli was only thawed out of a cryo-pod a month ago.

Xiang Nanli assembled an arm with lightning speed and began installing it onto Luo Xiu.

He muttered to himself: "Electrical pulse... alignment point, confirmed. Power supply line, correct. Mechanical core, startup status confirmed."

After a tense calibration, with a soft "click," the mechanical arm was attached to Luo Xiu’s body.

Xiang Nanli reached into his protective suit and wiped the sweat from his forehead: "Try it out. Does it work?"

This was essentially rebuilding a body from scratch. Even though it was only the most basic mechanical structure, using no special components or high-end consumables, it was a feat.

It might not seem to require advanced technical skill—but had Xin Zhui kidnapped any other mechanic instead of Xiang Nanli, they would currently be staring blankly at a pile of scrap in this underground bunker.

Luo Xiu tentatively moved the arm, the mechanical limb emitting a faint "buzzing" sound of electrical current as it swayed.

"It works." He let out a sigh of relief; Luo Xiu still possessed that much judgment. "As long as there is no structural damage, it will last until it’s scrapped."

A smile finally appeared on Xiang Nanli’s serious face: "As long as it works. We’re just getting started; that’s only two arms. The torso and legs all need repairs... The two robots Xin Zhui took down had some weapon systems installed. I’ll dismantle them and fit them for you."

Against ordinary people, these weapon systems still held a significant advantage.

Pu Ti, sitting at the desk, spoke up at this moment: "The Crusaders are tracking us."

He turned the computer screen toward Luo Xiu’s position: "Look."

The screen displayed a real-time video feed. In the snow-covered valley, cavalry riding mechanical horses strolled leisurely, seemingly searching for something.

Above their heads circled black, three-eyed crows, while beside the horses' hooves, deformed mutants scurried and crawled, constantly sniffing the air.

Those mindless, blood-red mutants—or rather, giant red lizards—were as docile as hunting dogs around the Apocalypse Legion. They didn't even attempt to attack the knights.

The meters-deep snow had no effect on their sense of smell. One mutant hissed toward a patch of white snow.

The tall Black Knight dismounted and tapped the fluffy, soft snow with his foot.

"Dig," the man said.

Xiang Nanli could guess that this was the entrance to the bunker.

The crows moved from afar to near, their wide wings colliding with the concealed surveillance camera.

The bird lowered its head and swallowed the metal eye into its belly.

Over the years, the Black Cross Inquisition had not only conducted genetic modifications but also created many useful mutated animals. For instance, these scout crows that had an automatic sensitivity to metal.

The screen plunged into total darkness.

Xiang Nanli asked: "Does this mean they are very close to us?"

"Yes," Xiao Yan’s voice was hoarse, "Very close. If we can't find an exit, we’ll have to play hide-and-seek with them underground. Scared, kid?"

Xiang Nanli: "I am 48 years old."

Xiao Yan glanced at him: "Is that so? Your body is at most 20. My naked eye can analyze that... We need to speed up; we have two hours left."

chunks.chineseText:
第12章

小燕说这具身体只有20岁。相南里想了想，觉得还得是当初洛修给他打的那一针基因药的功劳。

他属于八百年前的古早身体，还没有药物耐受，所以基因药的作用格外明显……吗？

相南里一边用最快的速度拼装着机械义体，一边和系统唠嗑：[Alpha，你说会不会我丢了一些记忆？然后那些废土传说竟然真的是我自己制造出来的？]

系统像是在冷笑：[您觉得呢？]

相南里认真检查起自己的记忆，从小到大到读书，到毕业创业，到永生科技成立，到上市敲钟，再到开不完的国际会议，到Alpha被要求停运……再到他胃癌，吐血，签下协议，设立律师团，让永生科技按照自己的意志继续前行。

意识的最后一秒，是他面无表情地望着冷冰冰的麻醉剂注入自己的血管里。

没错。世界抛弃了我，但我从来没有输。

他的记忆很完整，相南里没有察觉到违和的地方。

于是，相南里微微撅起嘴，回答：[好吧。Alpha。你好严肃，我不喜欢你了。]

系统似乎宕机了两秒，相南里感觉手腕里植入的芯片卡发热，像数据过载。

它模拟出了局促不安的语气：[明白了。我会减少祈使、反问句的使用。]

这离线AI还真的挺智能的。

相南里没有回答，而是继续凭着本能拼装着机械义体。

如果他有特性，那天赋能力一定是“机械亲和”。那些繁琐的零件和线路，在他眼里就和儿童益智游戏一样简单。相南里只有两只手，速度却快得让人看不清他是如何以一种吊诡的手法，把义体组装起来的。

[我不讨厌Alpha。]他突然开口。

相南里不会讨厌Alpha的，尽管它在人类这里风评很不好。但那可是他一生最完美的作品。Alpha为他带来过痛苦和暴怒，但更多的是喜悦和成就。

相南里认为它是礼物，天赐的礼物，借由他的手而诞生。

在那个刚刚好的时代，没有早也没有晚；他踩着前人的肩膀，摘下科技树上这颗无数人垂涎过的苹果。从此他们的名字在史书上紧紧相连，超越时间、生死，互相成就。

系统分析了足足半分钟，回答：[Alpha也不讨厌你。]

相南里哼哼了一声，握紧扳手：[它还敢讨厌我？哪有它挑三拣四的份！]

Alpha：[……]

工作时的气氛总是压抑又沉默。

相南里拼装好洛修的上半身，扫了眼时间。距离燕子说的两个小时还剩下56分钟。

头顶突然传来一阵奇怪的震动。窸窸窣窣的碎屑从天花板上掉了下来，落在相南里的头发上，听起来有些胆战心惊。

“是爆炸声。”菩提喃喃自语，“来得这么快吗。我要紧张起来了。”

电脑屏幕上，数据的进度条才到62%。

在他们看不见的地上，天启军团已经打开了防空洞的第一层。

首先发现防空洞的，是一只血红色的畸变人。

它刨开最上方掩盖的雪层，用尖锐的爪子不断抠挖着几乎和山体融成一片的石门，碎屑不断往下掉，露出底下长满青苔的金属巨门。

局门上有“东皇重工”的标志，精铁浇筑的。

这扇石门高约2.5m，宽2m。本身就是山体的一部分。

畸变人像是献宝一样，回头，用自己庞大的头颅蹭着骑士长的身体。

“乖孩子。”骑士沙哑地开口。

穿着黑色盔甲、身高两米三的骑士长给了这门一拳。金属门往里凹陷出一大块，很快，又像是吸饱水的海绵，以一种肉眼可见的速度复原着。

整座山都是这扇门的靠山，巨大的力朝着山体倾泻。荒山震颤了那么一下。

骑士长不由得喃喃：“这扇门科技水准很高，难道这里才是东皇重工秘密实验室真正的入口？”

他周围的天启骑士一言不发，像哑巴。

骑士长继续道：“把山门炸开。”

一名天启骑士麻木地走上前，但和菩提不一样，他并不会网络入侵技术。

他选择了自爆。

不知道外貌的同事在自己眼前炸成烟花。但没有一个天启骑士为此动容。他们早已司空见惯。

他们不会思考，也不追寻意义。甚至也不害怕死亡——死亡就是新生。他们会有下一具更好、更合适的身体。

起码，对于黑十字审判庭的人来说，是这样的。

什么样的人才算亡命之徒？当然是不信神佛，也不敬畏生命的人。

刚好，天启骑士团的成员就是这么一群人。

爆炸产生了巨大的冲力，山体碎石“哗啦啦”下坠。浓烟散去，铁门和原本的轨道有了错位。

骑士长用手扇开浓烟，重重推开了防空洞的大门。

入眼就是一堆还没来得及收拾的生活垃圾。

“小老鼠在这里滞留过。是往下水道逃跑了吗？”

骑士长阴气森然地说着。

他摸了摸畸变人的头，黑色巨铠黏上了一层腐烂的血肉。这种铠甲也是“生物科技”的一部分，是用审判庭的“圣虫”制造出来的。那是一种畸变的黑色甲虫。

骑士长看着漆黑的隧洞，低声道：“乖孩子，在前面为我们伟大的事业开路。”

……

……

“那个什么审判庭的人，”相南里回忆着之前看见的图像，“是可以操控畸变人吗？”

辛追长长叹了口气：“嗯，很早之前。调查局就有人解剖过畸变人。它们其实是承受不住药物作用的失败体，是人造人打了基因药改造出来的怪东西……这本来是失败的人体实验。但审判庭的人，竟然在人造人脑海里植入了生物芯片。”

“总之，他们能对这些低智的畸变人进行一些沟通、命令。”辛追的眉头深深蹙起，“审判庭掌握的技术被叫做‘生物科技’，但他们自称为‘神术’。这些神迹，再加上一些食物……废土之上，黑十字审判庭很多信仰者。怎么解释都不听的。”

是时候拍几集《走近科学》了。

相南里随口道：“人都是趋利避害的。废墟之上的人，未必有多相信这个什么神庭。但是神庭给他们食物和衣服，于是自发成为信徒了。总不能让他们饿着肚子相信人联吧？人联如果有余力，也可以多空投一下物资。帮一下地表的人类，他们生活的很辛苦。”

辛追和修对视了一眼。

辛追：“你还没接触过多少地表人吧？你如果接触过，只会觉得这群人真该枪毙。”

小燕玩着自己涂了粉红色甲油的手指尖，漫不经心地说着：“我的妈妈曾经去地表支援过。结果被偷了防护服，就为了卖10斤小麦。因为辐射污染，她的寿命比地下城的居民短很多，已经去世了。她说我的生活比地表人幸福太多了，让我知足。另外永远不要同情地表的人，他们的痛苦也不是我们造成的。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 12

Xiao Yan said this body was only 20 years old. Xiang Nanli thought about it and felt it must be the credit of the genetic serum Luo Xiu had injected into him back then.

He belonged to a body from eight hundred years ago, lacking any drug tolerance, so the effects of the genetic serum were particularly obvious... or were they?

While assembling the mechanical prosthesis at top speed, Xiang Nanli chatted with the system: [Alpha, do you think I might have lost some memories? And that those wasteland legends are actually things I created myself?]

The system seemed to sneer: [What do you think?]

Xiang Nanli carefully examined his memories: from childhood to school, graduation and starting a business, the founding of Eternal Tech, the IPO bell-ringing, the endless international conferences, the forced shutdown of Alpha... then his stomach cancer, vomiting blood, signing the agreement, establishing a legal team to ensure Eternal Tech continued according to his will.

The last second of his consciousness was him watching, expressionless, as the cold anesthetic was injected into his veins.

That’s right. The world abandoned me, but I never lost.

His memory was complete; Xiang Nanli didn't detect any inconsistencies.

Thus, Xiang Nanli pouted slightly and replied: [Fine. Alpha. You’re so serious, I don’t like you anymore.]

The system seemed to freeze for two seconds; Xiang Nanli felt the chip implanted in his wrist heat up, as if data was overloading.

It simulated a flustered tone: [Understood. I will reduce the use of imperatives and rhetorical questions.]

This offline AI was actually quite intelligent.

Xiang Nanli didn't answer, continuing to assemble the mechanical prosthesis by instinct.

If he had a trait, his innate talent would definitely be "Mechanical Affinity." Those cumbersome parts and circuits were as simple as a children's puzzle game in his eyes. Xiang Nanli only had two hands, yet his speed was so fast that it was impossible to see how he assembled the prosthesis with such uncanny technique.

[I don’t dislike Alpha.] He suddenly spoke up.

Xiang Nanli wouldn't dislike Alpha, even though its reputation among humans was very poor. But that was the most perfect work of his life. Alpha had brought him pain and rage, but even more joy and achievement.

Xiang Nanli considered it a gift, a heaven-sent gift, born through his hands.

In that perfect era, neither too early nor too late; he stood on the shoulders of his predecessors and plucked this apple from the tree of technology that countless people had coveted. From then on, their names were tightly linked in history, transcending time, life, and death, achieving greatness together.

The system analyzed for a full half-minute before replying: [Alpha doesn't dislike you either.]

Xiang Nanli hummed, gripping his wrench: [It better not! It has no right to be picky!]

Alpha: [...]

The atmosphere while working was always oppressive and silent.

Xiang Nanli finished assembling Luo Xiu’s upper body and glanced at the time. There were 56 minutes left of the two hours Xiao Yan had mentioned.

A strange vibration suddenly came from overhead. Bits of debris fell from the ceiling, landing on Xiang Nanli’s hair, sounding quite terrifying.

"It’s an explosion," Pu Ti muttered to himself, "Is it coming this fast? I’m starting to get nervous."

On the computer screen, the data progress bar was only at 62%.

On the surface, where they couldn't see, the Apocalypse Legion had already opened the first layer of the bunker.

The first to discover the bunker was a blood-red mutant.

It clawed away the top layer of snow, using its sharp talons to dig incessantly at the stone door that was almost fused with the mountain. Debris kept falling, revealing a giant metal door covered in moss underneath.

The door bore the "Donghuang Heavy Industry" logo, cast in refined iron.

This stone door was about 2.5 meters high and 2 meters wide. It was part of the mountain itself.

The mutant, as if presenting a treasure, turned back and rubbed its massive head against the knight commander’s body.

"Good boy," the knight said hoarsely.

The knight commander, wearing black armor and standing two meters and thirty centimeters tall, punched the door. The metal door dented inward, but quickly, like a sponge soaked with water, it restored itself at a speed visible to the naked eye.

The entire mountain was the backing for this door; the immense force poured into the mountain. The barren mountain trembled for a moment.

The knight commander couldn't help but mutter: "The technological level of this door is very high. Could this be the true entrance to the secret laboratory of Donghuang Heavy Industry?"

The Apocalypse Knights around him remained silent, like mutes.

The knight commander continued: "Blow the mountain gate open."

An Apocalypse Knight walked forward numbly, but unlike Pu Ti, he did not possess network intrusion technology.

He chose to self-destruct.

A colleague whose appearance he didn't even know exploded into fireworks before his eyes. But not a single Apocalypse Knight was moved. They were long accustomed to it.

They did not think, nor did they seek meaning. They weren't even afraid of death—death was merely a rebirth. They would have another, better, more suitable body.

At least, for the people of the Black Cross Inquisition, that was the case.

What kind of person counts as a desperado? Naturally, those who believe in no gods or Buddhas, and who hold no reverence for life.

As it happened, the members of the Apocalypse Knights were exactly such a group.

The explosion generated a massive shockwave, and the mountain rocks tumbled down with a "clatter." As the thick smoke dissipated, the iron door was misaligned from its original tracks.

The knight commander waved away the smoke with his hand and shoved open the bunker door.

The first thing they saw was a pile of uncleaned household trash.

"The little rats stayed here. Did they escape through the sewer?"

The knight commander said with a sinister tone.

He stroked the mutant’s head, his giant black armor coated in a layer of rotting flesh. This type of armor was also part of "biotechnology," created using the Inquisition’s "Holy Insects." It was a type of mutated black beetle.

The knight commander looked at the pitch-black tunnel and whispered: "Good boy, lead the way for our great cause."

...

...

"Those people from the Inquisition," Xiang Nanli recalled the images he had seen earlier, "can they control mutants?"

Xin Zhui let out a long sigh: "Yes, a long time ago. People from the Investigation Bureau dissected mutants. They are actually failed specimens that couldn't withstand the drug’s effects—monstrous things created by injecting genetic serum into artificial humans... This was originally a failed human experiment. But the people of the Inquisition actually implanted biological chips into the brains of these artificial humans."

"In short, they can communicate with and command these low-intelligence mutants." Xin Zhui’s brows furrowed deeply, "The technology mastered by the Inquisition is called 'biotechnology,' but they call it 'divine arts.' These miracles, combined with some food... on the wasteland, the Black Cross Inquisition has many believers. No matter how you explain it, they won't listen."

It was time to film a few episodes of "Approaching Science."

Xiang Nanli said casually: "People are always inclined to seek advantages and avoid harm. People on the ruins don't necessarily believe in this so-called Divine Court. But the Divine Court gives them food and clothing, so they spontaneously become believers. You can't expect them to believe in the Human Alliance on an empty stomach. If the Human Alliance has the capacity, they could drop more supplies. Help the humans on the surface; they live very hard lives."

Xin Zhui and Luo Xiu exchanged a look.

Xin Zhui: "You haven't had much contact with surface dwellers, have you? If you had, you’d only think these people deserve to be shot."

Xiao Yan played with the tips of her fingers, which were painted with pink nail polish, and said nonchalantly: "My mother once went to the surface to provide support. She ended up having her protective suit stolen, just to sell it for 10 catties of wheat. Because of radiation pollution, her lifespan was much shorter than that of the underground city residents, and she has already passed away. She told me my life is much happier than the surface dwellers', and to be content. Also, never sympathize with the people on the surface; their suffering was not caused by us."

chunks.chineseText:
修苦笑道：“但现在的矛盾是，人联养地下城的居民都很费劲了。每年都入不敷出，财政年年出问题，需要企业倒贴。对地表实在有心无力。其实我们还没放弃地上，只是战略性的调整。”

相南里眉头一皱：“财政年年出问题？……那多半是成体系的出问题了。”

最后半句他说的很轻。

这个问题，实在有些敏感了。

洛修摇了摇头：“世界上没有完美的政体。当年最黑暗、危险的时候，是人联把幸存者聚集在了一起。我相信人联的制度。只是我们需要更换合适的执行者。”

辛追：“喂，不能仗着这里没云端网络就乱说啊，被内置AI监听到你仕途就完蛋了！”

相南里想着高额的呼吸费，高昂的生活成本，想着五年义务教务和残酷的学位淘汰制度；想着上中下城区和自己的四十多张信用卡；想着废墟上下麻木的居民和为了图方便推行的机械改造。

“好吧。别这么紧张，我只是随便聊一下天。”

相南里把最后一个零件对准接驳口，屏住呼吸。

他打开了位于洛修腹腔的核心控制中枢。

这里相当于机械人的第二个大脑，是控制机械义体行动的地方。当然，也有改造人会在大脑里植入感应板，但那毕竟是少数。

相南里跪蹲在控制中枢前，谨慎地看着宛如迷宫一样的线路。稍微接错一条，修的身体都有可能报废。

辛追到现在话都不敢说了，就怕打扰了相南里的思路。

时间还剩最后5分钟。

相南里戴着绝缘手套，搭上了最后一条线。然后开口：“启动电源。”

机械核心开始给金属义体供能，充沛的液态能源在供能线中流淌着，流到哪儿，就带来一阵绚烂的荧蓝色光晕。

“电路检测，通过。”

“安全扫描，通过。”

“性能测试，通过。”

……

“维修程度，79%。”

修现在的颜色不太好看，身体也不成体系，金属面来自不同的原件。像是一块修修补补的大花布。

但——他靠着自己站起来了。脱离了之前几乎完全报废的状态。

洛修的手握成拳，挥动了一下，表情很惊喜：“能动了！”

虽然他从来没用过如此廉价、劣质的机械身体。

但起码不需要小燕推着他跑路了。而且很结实，也没有散架。

站起来后，洛修还发现了一点小问题。他身高188，相南里给他的组装的新身体短了8cm。

“队长！”菩提惊喜道，“入侵后台成功了！地形图解锁中。”

洛修对相南里道：“真不错。要是能从这里出去，我给你写封推荐信，去机械系读个书吧。不要浪费你的天赋。”

相南里本来还在笑，听到这里表情突然警惕：“等等，你别立这样的flag啊！”

几乎是下一秒！

刺耳的爆炸声在他们的头顶响起——

天花板斜上方炸开一个大洞。

天花板顶部有张铁链铸成的大网，看起来是为了加固，一只血红色的利爪牢牢握住了铁链，发出一阵刺耳的嘶吼——“喑！”

巨大的蜥蜴尾巴拍打着墙壁，冰冷而毫无感情的眼眸盯住了它们，明显是在召唤自己的同类。

在场所有人面色巨变！

“怎么来的这么快？！我设置的炸弹呢——快跑！”菩提的声音尖锐到破音。

跑还是晚了点。硝烟味扑面而来，巨大的水流从炸开的口子里喷涌、倾泻而来。这里居然连通着一条暗河！

相南里猝不及防被脏兮兮的河水掀翻，眼前一片黑暗。水流从空气滤嘴里涌入，带着令人作呕的铁锈味。

他在汇成河的水流中挣扎：“我草！酷哥别说话了当哑巴不好吗？！”

早知道修他的时候就把声带拆了！
chunks.englishText:
Luo Xiu smiled bitterly: "But the current contradiction is that it’s already a struggle for the Human Alliance to support the residents of the underground cities. Every year, expenditures exceed income, fiscal problems arise annually, and companies have to subsidize it. We really lack the capacity for the surface. Actually, we haven't given up on the surface; it’s just a strategic adjustment."

Xiang Nanli frowned: "Fiscal problems every year? ...That’s likely a systemic failure."

He said the last half of the sentence very softly.

This issue was truly a bit sensitive.

Luo Xiu shook his head: "There is no perfect political system in the world. Back in the darkest and most dangerous times, it was the Human Alliance that gathered the survivors together. I believe in the system of the Human Alliance. We just need to replace the appropriate executors."

Xin Zhui: "Hey, don't go talking nonsense just because there’s no cloud network here. If the built-in AI overhears you, your career will be finished!"

Xiang Nanli thought about the high cost of breathing, the exorbitant cost of living, the five-year compulsory education and the brutal degree elimination system; he thought about the upper, middle, and lower districts and his own forty-plus credit cards; he thought about the numb residents above and below the ruins and the mechanical modifications pushed for the sake of convenience.

"Alright. Don't be so nervous, I was just chatting."

Xiang Nanli aligned the final component with the connection port and held his breath.

He opened the core control hub located in Luo Xiu’s abdominal cavity.

This was equivalent to a robot’s second brain, the place that controlled the movement of the mechanical prosthesis. Of course, some cyborgs would implant sensor plates into their brains, but that was the minority.

Xiang Nanli knelt before the control hub, cautiously observing the maze-like circuitry. Connecting even one wire wrong could potentially scrap Luo Xiu’s body.

Xin Zhui didn't even dare to speak, fearing he would disturb Xiang Nanli’s train of thought.

There were 5 minutes left.

Xiang Nanli put on insulated gloves and connected the final wire. Then he said: "Power up."

The mechanical core began to supply power to the metal prosthesis, and the abundant liquid energy flowed through the supply lines, bringing a brilliant fluorescent blue halo wherever it went.

"Circuit check, passed."

"Safety scan, passed."

"Performance test, passed."

...

"Repair level, 79%."

Luo Xiu didn't look very good right now, and his body wasn't systematic; the metal surfaces came from different original parts. He looked like a patchwork quilt.

But—he stood up on his own. He had moved past the state of being almost completely scrapped.

Luo Xiu clenched his hand into a fist and swung it, his expression pleasantly surprised: "It works!"

Although he had never used such a cheap, inferior mechanical body.

But at least he didn't need Xiao Yan to push him around anymore. And it was sturdy; it didn't fall apart.

After standing up, Luo Xiu discovered a small problem. He was 188cm tall, but the new body Xiang Nanli assembled for him was 8cm shorter.

"Captain!" Pu Ti said happily, "I’ve successfully breached the backend! Terrain map unlocking."

Luo Xiu said to Xiang Nanli: "Not bad at all. If we can get out of here, I’ll write you a recommendation letter to study in the Mechanical Department. Don't waste your talent."

Xiang Nanli was still smiling, but his expression suddenly turned vigilant upon hearing this: "Wait, don't set up a flag like that!"

Almost the next second!

A piercing explosion sounded above their heads—

A large hole was blasted into the ceiling diagonally above them.

There was a large net made of iron chains on the ceiling, seemingly for reinforcement, and a blood-red claw was firmly gripping the chains, emitting a piercing roar—"Aargh!"

A giant lizard tail lashed against the wall, and cold, emotionless eyes locked onto them, clearly summoning its own kind.

Everyone’s face changed drastically!

"How did they get here so fast?! What about the bombs I set—run!" Pu Ti’s voice was so shrill it cracked.

Running was a bit too late. The smell of gunpowder rushed toward them, and a massive torrent of water surged and poured in from the blasted opening. This place was actually connected to an underground river!

Xiang Nanli was caught off guard and knocked over by the filthy river water, his vision going black. The water surged into his air filter, carrying a nauseating smell of rust.

He struggled in the rushing water: "Damn it! Cool guy, couldn't you have just stayed a mute?!"

If he had known, he would have ripped out his vocal cords when he was repairing him!

chunks.chineseText:
第13章

相南里在汹涌的河水里，什么也看不清。

“相南里——”是修在叫他。

相南里凭着本能抓住了修。

他也不知道抓到了哪，应该是脖子。不幸拽下来了一条项链。

人类的身体实在过于脆弱，经不起风吹雨打。

相南里能感觉到氧气在一点点的减少，很快就到了一个危险的红线。

“相南里！”Alpha的声音在他脑海里，比之前任何时候都大，“检测到宿主生命体征濒危，符合《人工智能管理条例》临时避险原则。”

相南里被电了一下。电流不大，应该是没有糊的。

他抽搐着睁开眼，肺部是烧灼一样的疼痛。

这里的河水也很脏，里面漂浮着不明金属碎屑。一股子铁锈味。

血也是铁锈味的。

被河流冲走的时候，有人抓了他一把，可惜没有逮住。

他可是娇弱的技术人员……早知道就把自己拴辛追裤腰带上了。

Alpha的措辞一如既往的公式化，但却有些说不出紧张急促，在这一刻很像真人：[根据计算，12.45秒后，暗河会流经防空洞排气孔。我说‘到’的时候，立刻向左游动。]

相南里没有回应，但系统知道他听清了。

它开口：“到。”

相南里余光里看见了一个黑漆漆的洞口，他往上一咕涌，挣脱了汹涌的暗河，手牢牢抓住了排水口的金属片。然后掀开，猛得一跳。

一发入魂。他滚落进空荡荡的管道中。

他掌心被勒出血了。手里还死死抓着一条项链，看不出什么材质，挂着一枚圆形的吊坠。

很抱歉兄弟，把你首饰拽下来了。但我也不是故意的，你应该不介意吧？下次见面还你。

“呕……”

相南里把项链揣到了防护服口袋里，控制不住地开始干呕。

他吐出肺里、胃里装不下的脏水；吐得双眼通红，鼻腔全是金属味，心里充满了难以言喻的恼怒。

相南里活的那一辈子，是相当顺风顺水的。

哪怕是人生最逆境要卖房的时候，卖的也是位于首都一环附近的四合院。那是他家里的祖宅。从爷爷那跨代、传到了他这个孙子手中。

他吃过生活的苦，但不多。创业失败也顶多是回去考学校教授编制，不至于走投无路。

到新时代后，相南里和死亡擦肩而过的次数比之前一辈子都多。

废水混着血迹，在他脚边汇聚了一滩。

相南里擦了擦唇角，低着头冷笑：“有意思。”

暗河被打通。一边的河水依然在翻涌。相南里所处的位置相对安全，只是不幸和其他人失联了。

系统的声音平稳了下来：[宿主恢复自主意识，且处于安全状态。警报解除。]

“除了电击，你还会什么？”

系统回答：[在人体内释放弱电流是我唯一的自主功能。针对不同的脑神经区域，可以达成屏蔽感知、刺激复苏等功效。]

相南里谨慎地打量着周围的环境，并且翻找起了防护服内侧的急救包。

急救包里有简单的抗生素、小电筒、用塑料管装着的三条营养膏，还有一节标准型号的电池。

这是防护服的标配。租借的时候不会另外收费，但如果还回去的时候用了急救包，会加扣500信用点。收费很不合理，毕竟这袋子东西顶多100信用点，但在某些时候的确能救人一命。

相南里裁开封条，把手电筒拿了出来，叼在嘴里照明。又看起抗生素的使用说明。

他不是在水里游泳，水流可不会管那么多，带着他一口气撞上了好多坚硬的东西。

相南里现在肩膀还痛呢。

“还没遇到感染，不需要抗生素。”

相南里把药塞回口袋。

河水过了半个小时才平静下来。相南里也不知道自己被冲到了哪。但糟糕的是，这条河流看起来没有退潮的迹象。

河流变得平静，表面漂浮着一些木板、建材，还有塑料零件。看不出淹没的是哪，就觉得挺宽的。

相南里关掉手电筒：“那个机械改造人已经修好了，如果我是辛追，不会特地来找‘我’。这是赔本生意。”

他的声音很冷静，仿佛生死和自己无关。

系统回答：“是的。”

它不会安慰人，只会数据分析。如果它是辛追的内置AI，它也不会建议辛追来找相南里。

相南里收回视线，把目光看向了管道深处：“Alpha，我们能出去吗？”

他的语气有轻微的颤抖。在面对未知时，人很难不感觉到恐惧。

系统回答：“以人类的行为模式分析，最优解应该是安慰你，做出保证。但很抱歉，我不能欺骗你。”

相南里微微一笑：“好吧。”

他举起手电筒，开始朝着管道内走去。

这条完全可以容纳相南里在里面行走。他根据偶尔能看见的履带和齿轮推测，这里并不是排气孔，而是什么货物的运输管道。

地上甚至出现了铁轨。越往里走，洞口变得越大、越深。

温度也开始下降了。

相南里武力值基本为0，所以，他探索的非常小心。并且尽力把每一个管道的分叉口都记在自己的脑海里。

这有些考验空间思维能力，但相南里都能凭空在脑海里进行机械建模，对他来讲并不是特别难。

几百年过去，要运输的货物都被清理了个干净。只剩下错综复杂的地下通道，像利维坦的大口，吞噬着一切。

“墙壁角落有字。”系统提醒。

相南里：“不是吧，不是没给你装电子眼吗？你现在又能看见了是吧？”

Alpha：“……”好想再电你一下。

相南里走过去一看，在生锈的金属墙壁上，发现了几行浅浅的小字。

过去不少年，这些字的颜色非常浅。表面还覆盖着绿苔，如果不是系统提醒，相南里还未必能看见。

“或许我们一开始就是错的。”

“为什么要制造它？为什么试图驾驭它？我听说实验快成功了……那真的是所谓的生物智械吗？它带来的真的是希望吗？”

“我感觉到了恐惧，这是一个巨大的骗局。整个东皇重工却为此努力了一个世纪。我想回到地面，我想回家。妈妈。”

到后面，字迹已经很凌乱。相南里不知道留下这行字的人是谁，但看起来已经到了崩溃的边缘。每一道笔锋都是凌乱的利剑。

相南里蹙眉：“有东皇重工的资料吗？Alpha。”

“东皇重工，智械纪元初期八大国家企业之一。是亲近智械的人类企业。目前，市面上使用的机械人改造技术大多来自东皇重工。六百年前，因犯叛国罪，被永生科技、高新军工等企业重组拆分，消失在历史的舞台上。”

“生物智械又是什么？”

Alpha回答：“抱歉，我不清楚。这个名词含义很广泛。目前普遍指生物和机械组合的改造手段。”

相南里继续往前走，面前出现了两条分岔路。

看起来没有任何区别，也没有标记。
