chunks.chineseText:
第17章

潜行者把抗生素含在它的舌下，并没有喝。

它认识抗生素。它现在又没受伤，还用不到这东西。

叼走也未必是想要，主要还是给相南里一点小小的来自畸变人的震撼。

它在墙壁上爬行，如同阴影一样流动着。明明是灰白色的身体，却让人下意识地忽略它的存在。

潜行者钻进了相南里来时的通道。

然后，闭合的鼻孔微微张开。

它闻到了同类的味道。

潜行者脑袋微微抬起，漆黑的眼眸看不出任何情绪。

停顿了半分钟后，它开始飞快地朝着某个方向爬去。

潜行者对这里很熟悉。它曾经在这里穿行着，一个个翻出藏在各个角落的实验员，然后把他们通通杀死。

无论是躲在管道里，还是柜子里，还是无数的机械人里。

它都要把他们翻出来，一个不留地粉碎。把所有污秽和痛苦埋葬在属于它的时代。

潜行者只放走了一个职工。

那是一个年轻人，它快忘记他的名字了。似乎叫安德鲁？

放走他的原因也不是心软，而是……潜行者觉得它是一个好人。

好人值得继续活下去。

但是，当听到相南里说，“外面有很多你的后代”，潜行者就明白，它失败了。

畸变生物的制造方法，还是流传了出去。

是谁？

是安德鲁吗？

亦或者是那些智械人？

还是那些本该死去的罪人？

潜行者一边思考着，一边看到了此行的目标。

一只血红色的爬行者，长约5米。在隧洞中来回钻着，寻找着出路，像一只阴沟里的老鼠。

潜行者安静地跟在它身后，然后在一个转角处，猛地暴起，咬上爬行者的咽喉。

和咬相南里的浅尝辄止不一样，或许是吃了饭，爬行者黑色的血液在瞬间从它的齿缝中飚射。爬行者还没死，趴在地上，发出痛苦的嘶吼。

它的脖子被开了一个大洞，潜行者从洞里钻了进去。

几分钟后，它钻了出来。爬行者的身体干瘪了下去，像是被掏空了血肉，只剩下一张皮。

新长出的鳞片呈现出了可爱的粉白色。潜行者甩了甩身体，甩掉身上的脏污。

它有些晦气地从嘴里吐出一枚咬碎的电子芯片。这应该是在爬行者还幼小时装进去的，粉红的脑浆黏在上面，味道有点恶心。

潜行者继续往前爬去，目光冷漠至极。它甚至能从气味里闻出其他畸变人的品种、大小。

它该去找下一个了。

传输通道外，正在一个个房间里搜寻的骑士长抬起头，朝着某个方向望了眼。

机械马没有进来，而是全部停在了入口处，它们的身体太高大了。

但它们并不是全然没有进来。

机械马的部分身体被拆卸下来，组装成了新的武器。

比如骑士长胳膊上这个加农炮一样的蓄能炮筒。

他面前，就是相南里刚离开的那间研究室。

只差推开一扇门，骑士长就能看见审判庭近些年苦苦追求、想要培育出来的东西。

传说中的终极体的畸变人——假以时日，说不定能以肉身抗衡荣耀级机械。或许是人类结束智械战争的出路之一。

“爬行者死了？看来终于遇到了小耗子。”骑士长阴恻恻地说着，“走吧，先把那群人解决掉。”

他转身，朝着侧面走去。身后，大约50名黑甲的天启骑士，沉默着紧紧跟随，毫无生息，就像是骑士长操控的尸体。

潜行者在清理掉第三只畸变人后，察觉到了危险的接近。

很轻微的震动。没有脚步声。还有金属摩擦的声音，有一批人正在赶来。

吃掉三头后，潜行者的皮肤已经蒙上一层血色。

它趴在天花板上方，没有任何呼吸声，深邃的眼眸透过缝隙，望向下方鱼贯而入的天启军。

打不过。

潜行者很快判定出结果。而且，这些人很明显是在找它。

它藏在阴影处，一动不动。明明有人的眼睛已经扫过它，却还是毫无察觉。

但潜行者用常规手段是搜索不出来的。无论是电子扫描还是热成像，它都很反常规的隔绝了这些窥探。只能靠单纯的生物眼。

这是因为它的皮肤能干扰电子信号。

骑士长吹了声哨子。

通道里的爬行者纷纷行动起来，在几分钟后，从管道里钻出，它们有些比管道入口大很多，几乎是像肉馅一样硬挤出来的。

爬行者们哀哀地鸣叫着。它们也不知道敌人在哪，根本没有看见潜行者的踪迹。只有同伴不断死去。

骑士长听了一会，突然变得愤怒起来，一巴掌抽上了面前爬行者的脸：“没用的废物。”

他的力道很大，爬行者的半边脸被抽烂了。露出底下雪白的骨头。

爬行者的体格是骑士长的五六倍。但却不敢还手，只是低下头，更哀切的鸣叫着。

潜行者旁观了这场闹剧，本来想调头就走的，但思考片刻，又在原本的地方停下。

跟着他们。或许会有收获？

而且，它的确冬眠了太久。很需要知道一些新的情报。

潜行者想。

……

……

潜行者叼着抗生素跑了。

相南里感觉新世界又给他上了一课。

“它怎么能恩将仇报，那可是我的抗生素！”相南里握着半管营养膏，走在通向出口的路上，“市场价80信用点呢！”

虽然他也没用上。

相南里看起来悲愤欲绝，但内心并没有太过在意。他只是习惯于用一种戏剧化的方式去传递情绪。

系统：“可能吃了干粮口渴吧。”

当然，系统经过分析，倾向于这是潜行者的打击报复。

相南里感叹：“畸变人真是太坏了~”

“是你对它抱有不切实际的幻想。”系统提醒，“我认为以生存为唯一目标的话，你在某些时刻过于软弱。”

相南里的眉微微挑起：“软弱这个词可不太好听。为什么不是善良？”

系统回答：“善良只属于强者。弱者的善良是愚蠢。”

相南里眯起眼：“你很社会达尔文法则啊，Alpha，我可没这么教过你。”

他朝着箭头所指的方向深入着，周围的光线逐渐黯淡。离开了光鲜亮丽的玻璃温室，打开安全通道的封锁门，往下走三层楼梯，面前出现弧形的铁门。还是双开门。

相南里用力地推开，这铁门很重，也不知道多少年没人使用过了，相南里推的小脸通红。勉强推开一条缝隙。

他把自己从这条缝隙中挤了进去，气喘吁吁。

这里一片漆黑。相南里打开手电筒，朝着周围照了一下。

是像来时那样的拱形隧道，两边凿刻着不知名的神佛像。

这些神像已经看不出是什么宗教。因为战乱，人类文明曾经毁灭性地消失过。尤其是不那么有用的文艺、哲学、宗教类。

这大概是一些口口相传的想象的产物。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 17

The Stalker held the antibiotic under its tongue, choosing not to swallow it.

It recognized the antibiotic. It wasn’t injured at the moment, so it had no use for such things.

Snatching it away wasn’t necessarily out of desire; it was mostly to give Xiang Nanli a small taste of the shock that a mutant could deliver.

It crawled along the wall, flowing like a shadow. Despite its grayish-white body, it made people subconsciously overlook its existence.

The Stalker slipped into the tunnel Xiang Nanli had arrived through.

Then, its closed nostrils flared slightly.

It smelled the scent of its own kind.

The Stalker lifted its head slightly, its pitch-black eyes devoid of any emotion.

After a half-minute pause, it began to crawl rapidly in a specific direction.

The Stalker was intimately familiar with this place. It had once roamed these halls, rooting out the researchers hiding in every corner, one by one, before slaughtering them all.

Whether they were hiding in pipes, cabinets, or among the countless robots—

It had to drag them out and crush them, leaving none behind. It sought to bury all the filth and suffering in the era that belonged to it.

The Stalker had let only one staff member go.

It was a young man; it had almost forgotten his name. Andrew, perhaps?

The reason for sparing him wasn’t out of a soft heart, but rather… the Stalker felt he was a good person.

Good people deserved to keep living.

However, when it heard Xiang Nanli say, "There are many of your descendants outside," the Stalker understood that it had failed.

The method for creating mutant organisms had leaked out after all.

Who was it?

Was it Andrew?

Or perhaps those sentient machines?

Or those sinners who should have been dead long ago?

As the Stalker pondered, it spotted the target of its current hunt.

A blood-red Crawler, about five meters long, was burrowing back and forth in the tunnel, searching for an exit like a rat in a sewer.

The Stalker followed silently behind it, then, at a corner, suddenly erupted into motion, sinking its teeth into the Crawler’s throat.

Unlike the shallow bite it had given Xiang Nanli—perhaps because it had already eaten—the Crawler’s black blood sprayed from the gaps in its teeth instantly. The Crawler wasn't dead yet; it lay on the ground, emitting painful, guttural roars.

A gaping hole had been torn in its neck, and the Stalker crawled right inside through the wound.

A few minutes later, it emerged. The Crawler’s body had shriveled up, as if its flesh and blood had been hollowed out, leaving behind nothing but a husk of skin.

The newly grown scales on the Stalker shimmered with a lovely, pale pink hue. It shook its body, shedding the filth from its hide.

With a look of disgust, it spat out a shattered electronic chip from its mouth. This must have been implanted when the Crawler was still young; pinkish brain matter clung to it, and the taste was rather nauseating.

The Stalker continued to crawl forward, its gaze cold and indifferent. It could even distinguish the species and size of other mutants just by their scent.

It was time to find the next one.

Outside the transmission tunnel, the Knight Commander, who was searching room by room, looked up and glanced in a certain direction.

The mechanical horses hadn't entered; they were all parked at the entrance, as their bodies were too massive.

But they hadn't remained entirely outside.

Parts of the mechanical horses had been dismantled and reassembled into new weapons.

For instance, the cannon-like energy-charging barrel mounted on the Knight Commander’s arm.

Before him lay the very laboratory Xiang Nanli had just left.

With just the push of a door, the Knight Commander would be able to see what the Inquisition had been desperately trying to cultivate in recent years.

The legendary Ultimate-class mutant—given time, it might one day be able to contend with Glory-class mechs with its bare flesh. It might be one of the ways for humanity to end the war against the machines.

"The Crawler is dead? It seems we’ve finally encountered the little rat," the Knight Commander said with a sinister tone. "Let’s go. Let’s deal with that group of people first."

He turned and walked toward the side. Behind him, about 50 Apocalypse Knights in black armor followed in silence, motionless and devoid of life, just like corpses controlled by the Commander.

After clearing out the third mutant, the Stalker sensed danger approaching.

A very slight vibration. No footsteps. And the sound of metal grinding—a group of people was coming.

Having consumed three of its kind, the Stalker’s skin was now tinged with a layer of blood-red.

It clung to the ceiling, holding its breath, its deep eyes peering through a gap at the Apocalypse Army filing in below.

It couldn't win.

The Stalker quickly assessed the outcome. Moreover, these people were clearly hunting it.

It hid in the shadows, unmoving. Even though some people’s eyes swept right over it, they noticed nothing.

The Stalker could not be detected by conventional means. Whether it was electronic scanning or thermal imaging, it had developed an unconventional way to block such prying eyes. One could only rely on the naked biological eye.

This was because its skin could interfere with electronic signals.

The Knight Commander whistled.

The Crawlers in the tunnel began to move, emerging from the pipes a few minutes later. Some were much larger than the pipe openings, squeezing out like ground meat.

The Crawlers let out mournful cries. They didn't know where the enemy was; they hadn't seen a trace of the Stalker. They only knew their companions were dying one by one.

The Knight Commander listened for a while, then suddenly grew angry and slapped the face of the Crawler in front of him: "Useless trash."

His force was immense; half of the Crawler’s face was smashed, revealing the white bone beneath.

The Crawler was five or six times the size of the Knight Commander, yet it dared not retaliate, only lowering its head and letting out even more sorrowful cries.

The Stalker watched this farce from the sidelines. It had intended to turn and leave, but after a moment of thought, it stopped where it was.

Follow them. Perhaps there would be something to gain?

Besides, it had been in hibernation for far too long. It really needed to learn some new information.

The Stalker thought.

……

……

The Stalker had run off with the antibiotic.

Xiang Nanli felt that the new world had taught him another lesson.

"How could it return evil for good? That was my antibiotic!" Xiang Nanli gripped a half-tube of nutrient paste, walking toward the exit. "It costs 80 credits on the market!"

Even though he hadn't even used it.

Xiang Nanli looked grief-stricken, but he didn't actually care that much. He was just accustomed to using a dramatic flair to express his emotions.

System: "Maybe it was thirsty after eating dry rations."

Of course, after analysis, the System leaned toward the idea that this was an act of retaliation by the Stalker.

Xiang Nanli sighed: "Mutants are truly so mean~"

"It is you who holds unrealistic fantasies about it," the System reminded him. "I believe that if survival is the only goal, you are overly soft-hearted at times."

Xiang Nanli’s brows arched slightly: "The word 'soft-hearted' doesn't sound very nice. Why not 'kind'?"

The System replied: "Kindness belongs only to the strong. The kindness of the weak is stupidity."

Xiang Nanli narrowed his eyes: "You’re quite the Social Darwinist, Alpha. I never taught you that."

He delved deeper in the direction indicated by the arrow, the surrounding light gradually dimming. Leaving the bright, glamorous glass greenhouse, he opened the sealed door of the safety passage, descended three flights of stairs, and found an arched iron door before him. It was a double door.

Xiang Nanli pushed hard; the iron door was heavy, and it was unclear how many years it had been since it was last used. Xiang Nanli’s face flushed red from the effort. He barely managed to push it open a crack.

He squeezed himself through the gap, panting.

It was pitch black inside. Xiang Nanli turned on his flashlight and swept it around.

It was an arched tunnel like the one he had come through, with unknown statues of gods and Buddhas carved into both sides.

These statues were no longer identifiable as belonging to any specific religion. Due to the wars, human civilization had once suffered a devastating collapse. Especially the less "useful" fields like literature, philosophy, and religion.

These were likely just the products of imagination passed down through word of mouth.

chunks.chineseText:
高大的女人张开一圈机械臂，像千手观音，怀里抱着一个人类婴儿。石头雕刻出来的头颅没有头发，它面无表情低垂着头，脸上有金属拼合的痕迹。小婴儿的手中捧着一颗心脏模样的机械核心。

再往下，威严的智械人盘坐在地上，神情冷淡又平静，背后是一道圆形的光圈。手臂上的机械装置装载着武器，看起来随时都能发射。

有些石像只雕了一半，地面垒着一堆碎石。

入口墙壁的两侧各写着四个大字。

“血肉苦弱”。

“机械飞升”。

相南里感叹：“这东皇重工被团灭还真不冤，人奸啊。”

而且后来看日记内容，这些职工似乎真的都把自己改造成了高度机械人。

还把拆卸下来的人类躯体拿去喂了……

他观察片刻，沉着脸往前走去。他一只手握着手电筒，另一只手握着电棍。自己的脚步声在空旷的隧道里格外明显。

“墙上有弹痕，地上有金属弹壳。这里曾经发生过枪击？”

地上看不见尸体。但墙壁上却多了很多暗沉的血迹。而且这些血迹很多都呈现出“爆炸”状态。

这表明遭遇的是瞬时致死量伤害，譬如爆头、践踏、碾压；而不是更温柔的死法。

相南里的语气有了微微的寒意：“你确定这是出口？”

几百年过去，血腥味早就散了才对。然而相南里却觉得自己鼻尖闻到了那股子浓烈的腥味。

系统坚定地回答：“是。”

他一步步往前走，在道路尽头，又看见了一扇铁门。

这次，门旁边还用标记牌写了字，“1号门”。

这扇门相南里不认识的合金制作的，和隧道严丝合缝，就像是一堵密封的墙。相南里找不到任何打开它的方法。

“Alpha，没有路了。”相南里摸着冰冷的门。

系统沉默了许久。久到相南里都开始疑惑。

然后，他听见系统说：“我说，有。”

地底震颤了起来。

金属门发出“喀嚓喀嚓”的声响，像是齿轮在转动。

这扇沉重的大门往上抬升，厚度竟然有四五米。恐怕一般的武器都没办法把它凿开。

这也代表着，里面安保系数很高。

隧道上方，不那么坚固的石头纷纷往下坠落，全是灰尘。

相南里抬起手护住自己的头，小的碎屑和灰尘敲打着防护服的头盔，还有他的身体，感觉很不舒服。

巨墙抬升了大概半米，相南里已经感觉到了不对。

他透过缝隙，看到了一排排的金属双腿。看脚的方向，这些机械义体正对着他。

相南里一步步往后退着，心跳如雷。

然后，他的身后也出现了一堵墙，比前面的墙要薄，下坠的飞快。挡住了相南里的退路。

“你什么意思？”相南里的声音沉了下来，“把我带到这来。”

他给系统保留了一点体面，说的“带”，而不是“骗”。

Alpha的语气强硬：“与我无关。但请放心，这里很安全。”

巨墙抬升到了一半。

相南里也终于能看清墙后的景象。

一排排组装好的机械人就站在墙内，手持武器。

所有武器的枪口，都对准了相南里的眉心。

……

……

辛追站在复杂的、宛如迷宫的通道内，来回张望：“假设，相南里真的是间谍；拿到了密钥。那么他现在应该在启动‘东方青帝’的路上。”

“嗯，我听说东方青帝还是一个空壳。谁先拿到，谁就是它的主人。”

修跟在他身后：“说不定真的是意外。相南里太弱了。恐怕连最外围的守卫都通过不了。”

“世界上没有意外，所有巧合都必然有因果。”辛追薄薄的唇吐出这么一句话，“几百年前的工厂地图还是不太好用，又迷路了。但我们现在离核心区域应该很近了。你看，地上有屠杀过的痕迹。”

“根据之前解密出来的情报，这应该是当年第一批机械化改造的职工，被入侵了病毒。然后患上了赛博精神病，开始在工作区攻击其他同事。

“这个精神病毒应该是Alpha发送的。它需要智械人帮它把身体运出来，送到安全的地方……Alpha虽然和东皇重工合作，但同样厌恶他们的贪得无厌。

“但没想到机械改造人暴乱，导致地底彻底失控。潜行者趁乱溜了出来。并且杀死了地下的所有人。甚至向人联发送了情报，让他们来接管东皇重工。但是，却没有告诉人联地下工厂的位置，大概是担心人联也窥探生物进化技术。”

“直到最近，地表震动，才把这个地下防空洞震了出来……东皇重工的技术的确可以，之前人联挖地三尺，也没找到这个传说中的工厂。”

可惜历史并没有像潜行者想的那样发展。

生物进化技术还是流传了出去。

修询问：“最后那个潜行者呢？”

“不知道，它藏起来了。人联后来试图联系过它，没有得到回应，它似乎把这里选为了自己的墓地。”

修的眉毛微微蹙起：“我们打扰了它的冬眠。”

辛追思考片刻：“这么多年过去，哪怕是潜行者，也早就死了。别想这么多了，先把密钥拿回来。”

他的金属义眼微微发着光，停在了一堵墙的前方。

这面墙和周围融为一体。看起来很是普通。但在辛追的眼里，世界却不太一样。

他在这里感觉到了合金的存在。

辛追用手敲了敲墙壁，然后握成拳，狠狠砸向它。

墙面上出现裂纹。

他一拳一拳地砸着，坚硬的水泥被凿开，露出底下紧闭的合金门。

辛追喃喃，脸上露出一个奇怪的笑容：“看来我们要到了。门后面……会是一个怎样美丽的新世界呢？”
chunks.englishText:
The tall woman spread a circle of mechanical arms like a Thousand-Armed Guanyin, cradling a human infant in her embrace. Her stone-carved head was hairless, bowed in a stoic, expressionless posture, the seams of metal plates visible upon her face. In the infant’s hands rested a mechanical core shaped like a heart.

Further down, a majestic mechanical being sat cross-legged on the ground, its expression cold and serene, a circular halo of light glowing behind it. The mechanical apparatus on its arms was loaded with weaponry, appearing ready to fire at a moment’s notice.

Some of the stone statues were only half-finished, with piles of rubble strewn across the floor.

On either side of the entrance walls, four large characters were inscribed:

"Flesh is weak."

"Mechanical ascension."

Xiang Nanli sighed, "It’s no wonder Donghuang Heavy Industries was wiped out—they were traitors to humanity."

Judging by the diary entries he had read earlier, these employees seemed to have truly transformed themselves into high-level androids.

They had even used their discarded human remains as feed...

He observed for a moment, his face darkening as he moved forward. He gripped a flashlight in one hand and an electric baton in the other. His own footsteps echoed with unsettling clarity in the hollow tunnel.

"Bullet holes on the walls, metal casings on the ground. A firefight happened here?"

There were no corpses to be seen on the floor, yet the walls were splattered with dark, dried blood. Many of these stains appeared in an "explosive" pattern.

This indicated damage that caused instantaneous death—such as headshots, trampling, or crushing—rather than any gentler end.

A slight chill crept into Xiang Nanli’s tone: "Are you certain this is the exit?"

Centuries had passed; the scent of blood should have long since dissipated. Yet, Xiang Nanli felt the pungent, iron-rich stench prickling his nostrils.

The system replied firmly, "It is."

He walked forward step by step until, at the end of the path, he saw another iron door.

This time, a sign next to the door was marked: "Gate No. 1."

The door was crafted from an alloy Xiang Nanli did not recognize, fitting so seamlessly into the tunnel that it looked like a sealed wall. He could find no mechanism to open it.

"Alpha, there is no way forward," Xiang Nanli said, touching the freezing metal.

The system remained silent for a long time—so long that Xiang Nanli began to grow suspicious.

Then, he heard the system say: "I said, there is."

The ground beneath them began to tremble.

The metal door emitted a "clack-clack" sound, like gears grinding into motion.

The massive door began to rise; it was four or five meters thick. It was unlikely that standard weaponry could ever breach it.

This also meant that the security level inside was incredibly high.

Above the tunnel, loose stones began to plummet, filling the air with dust.

Xiang Nanli raised his hands to protect his head. Small debris and dust pelted his protective suit’s helmet and his body, making him feel deeply uneasy.

As the giant wall rose about half a meter, Xiang Nanli sensed something was wrong.

Through the gap, he saw rows of metallic legs. Judging by the orientation of the feet, these mechanical prosthetics were facing directly toward him.

Xiang Nanli stepped back, his heart hammering like a drum.

Then, a wall appeared behind him—thinner than the one in front, but descending rapidly—blocking his retreat.

"What is the meaning of this?" Xiang Nanli’s voice dropped. "Bringing me here."

He granted the system a sliver of dignity by using the word "bring" instead of "deceive."

Alpha’s tone was rigid: "It has nothing to do with me. But rest assured, it is safe here."

The giant wall rose halfway.

Xiang Nanli could finally see the scene behind it.

Rows of fully assembled androids stood within the chamber, weapons in hand.

Every single muzzle was aimed directly at the center of Xiang Nanli’s brow.

……

……

Xin Zhui stood within the complex, labyrinthine corridor, looking around. "Assuming Xiang Nanli is truly a spy and has obtained the key, he should be on his way to activate the 'Eastern Azure Emperor' right now."

"Hmm, I heard the Eastern Azure Emperor is still just an empty shell. Whoever gets it first becomes its master."

Xiu followed behind him. "Perhaps it really is an accident. Xiang Nanli is too weak. I doubt he could even make it past the outermost guards."

"There are no accidents in this world; all coincidences have a cause," Xin Zhui said, his thin lips curling. "The factory maps from hundreds of years ago aren't very reliable; we’re lost again. But we must be close to the core area now. Look, there are traces of a massacre on the ground."

"According to the decrypted intelligence, these were the first batch of employees to undergo mechanical modification. They were infected by a virus, developed cyber-psychosis, and began attacking their colleagues in the work zone.

"This mental virus was likely sent by Alpha. It needed the androids to help transport its body out to a safe location... Although Alpha collaborated with Donghuang Heavy Industries, it loathed their insatiable greed.

"But it didn't expect the cyborgs to riot, causing the underground to spiral completely out of control. The 'Stalker' slipped out during the chaos, killed everyone below, and even sent intelligence to the Human Alliance, prompting them to take over Donghuang. However, it never revealed the location of the underground factory, likely fearing the Alliance would also covet the biological evolution technology."

"It wasn't until the recent surface tremors that this underground bunker was shaken loose... Donghuang’s technology was indeed formidable; the Alliance had previously dug three feet into the earth and still couldn't find this legendary factory."

It was a pity that history did not unfold as the Stalker had intended.

The biological evolution technology had leaked out regardless.

Xiu asked, "What happened to that Stalker in the end?"

"Unknown. It went into hiding. The Alliance tried to contact it later but received no response. It seems to have chosen this place as its own grave."

Xiu’s brows furrowed slightly. "We have disturbed its hibernation."

Xin Zhui pondered for a moment. "After so many years, even a Stalker would have long since perished. Don't overthink it; let's retrieve the key first."

His mechanical prosthetic eye glowed faintly as he stopped in front of a wall.

The wall blended perfectly with its surroundings, appearing entirely ordinary. But to Xin Zhui’s eyes, the world looked different.

He sensed the presence of alloy here.

Xin Zhui knocked on the wall, then balled his hand into a fist and smashed it against the surface with all his might.

Cracks appeared on the wall.

He hammered away, blow after blow, chipping away the hardened concrete to reveal the sealed alloy door beneath.

Xin Zhui muttered, a strange smile spreading across his face: "It seems we have arrived. Behind this door... what kind of brave new world will it be?"

chunks.chineseText:
第18章

当看到那么多枪口对准自己眉心时，相南里的第一反应是认怂。

他举起双手，示意自己没有武器且人畜无害。

大门缓缓抬到最高点，一排排的机械人站在门内，它们有着高度拟人化的结构，金属身体没有覆盖人造皮肤，甚至能看见机械装置连接处的结构。

机械核心在它们的身体中高速运转着，身体里的电路线隐隐亮着。

这些机械人的头颅是纯金属打造的，上面只有模糊的五官。眼部是微微凹陷的两个小窝。

Alpha的声音很平静：“这些机械人没有安装拟人模块。所以，它们只是工具。而工具，生来就是被利用的。”

拟人模块，又叫做情感思维模块。顾名思义，安装这个插件后，机械人会继承人类特有的思维方式，享有“人权”；是区分智械人和机械人的唯一标准。

无数个红外线光点叠在相南里的身上，这是在瞄准。

大概僵持了半分钟。在相南里看不见的领域，一串串代码交织成无声的战场。进攻与防守、入侵与反抗。

这是一场数据层面的战争。

为了预防赛博精神病，机械人们安装的杀毒模块是很强效的。

可惜，它们这次的敌人是Alpha。

哪怕Alpha是单枪匹马。

机械人们的自主程序被杀得片甲不留，尸横遍野。

对准相南里的红点消失。

“欢迎回家。”声音是从这些机械人的腹部发出来的，扬声器被安装到了这里，“主任。”

系统给他黑了个车间主任的权限。

相南里的心后知后觉地狂跳，冷汗浸透了背心。

他确认这些机械人真的不会发动进攻后，这才缓缓走进门内。

里面的机械人数量比相南里想象得多。而且不止一个型号。

它们排列的非常工整，站在类似仓库的大厅里，像是秦始皇的兵马俑。不同区域还有编号。

相南里走近大厅内，每片区域陈列的机械人都按照扇形排列，最中央是一个圆形的机械装置，一道光柱贯穿整个房间，也成为这里唯一的光源。

他好奇地左摸摸，右摸摸。在一排排机械人里穿梭。

时不时，相南里还弯腰，检查它们贴在腰后的生产证：“噢，这台机械守卫是要送到洛阳城的，订购人……洛阳？”

骤然看见这个名字，相南里的眼眸失神了瞬间。

相南里沉默了几秒，开口：“我不喜欢洛阳，他想要的太多了。我们的理念有些分歧。但他是我在当时能找到的最合适的继承者。”

Alpha：“是吗。”

相南里的眼神在这一刻很幽深：“我认为科技会让世界变得更美好。倒不是我有多高尚，而是历史永远在蜿蜒中前进，我们的技术、伦理始终在发展，只为精英服务的科技终究会丧失生命力。资本逐利的天性会让尖端科技往大众都能买得起的方向发展，因为这才获利最快的途径。

“他不这么想；他认为科技可以是攫取剩余价值的工具。先行者付出更大风险，理应享有更大利润，甚至是垄断；为此不惜限制科技的发展。在关于Alpha的推广和使用问题上，我总是和他吵架。

“说起来真是太复杂了，三言两语也说不清。看现在地下城市的模样，世界大概如他所愿。”

相南里的眼眸微微垂下，看起来有些自嘲；还有些悲伤。

为什么会悲伤？

相南里自己也不清楚。或许这就是情感的迷人之处。

但他很快收拾好了心情。

被触碰的机械人虽然在启动状态，却没有任何反应，格外温顺。

但相南里能感觉到手底下的金属传来的引擎轰鸣。

安德鲁和修只是机械改造人。本质上讲，还属于“人类”的范畴。

这是相南里第一次见到真正的机械人，不是教材里的图片，而是活生生的，可以摸到的东西。

他试图拆卸一条机械人胳膊，对方没有任何反应。

可惜以相南里的臂力，在没有工具的情况下，拆分还是过于困难。

相南里摩擦着机械人们线条流畅的身体，脸上不由得露出幸福的笑容。

Alpha的心情很微妙：“请不要猥亵金属。”

相南里收回手，心潮澎湃：“Alpha，你能让它们喊一声‘千年之期已到，恭迎龙王归来’吗？”

“……”它不是很想回答。

相南里像是来检查的车间主任，溜达了一圈，问：“能让这些机械人跟我回地表吗？”

不说别的，偷偷卖了也是一大笔钱。

到时候还担心什么信用卡还钱。

“首先，如果是合法渠道，你需要解释这批机械人的来历。你需要补缴一笔税款才能合法享有这些机械人的使用权。你甚至很难在通过交通站时，把它们带回地下城。”

交通站的安检就像是海关。

没登记的机械人是崭新的、带包装盒的奢侈品包。

不狠狠宰一笔，安检员都对不起自己的辛苦工作。他们甚至有权力直接没收。

“如果是不合法渠道，身为一个只有2级的原始人，我认为危险比你想象中要大。是付钱容易，还是杀了你容易，我想你知道答案。”

但系统还是在分析后，继续道：“如果条件允许，你可以把它们留在这里。需要卖的时候拆一些零件，在黑市卖出去。虽然我认为这很浪费，效率也低。”

最近的地下交易市场，或者说大型人类聚集地，在姑苏城交通站附近。车程大概20个小时。

“那假如我带着他们建立地表聚集点呢？”

系统：“你没有能源。而且，我们没有智能控制系统，不可能实时操控每一个机械人。如果没有这个系统，就需要挨个给它们编程，但是会有很多设定问题；没有拟人模块，它们只能按照程序重复机械劳动和判定……等等，你不会是想让我干这个吧，也不怕我CPU烧了？”

Alpha的语气到后面甚至有些惊慌。

因为它觉得相南里不像是干不出这种事的人。

相南里思考片刻，摇头：“算了。”

比起这批军工机械人，还是系统更重要。

他来回打量起来：“Alpha，出口在哪？”

这个仓库大厅很大，整体是正方形，四面都有门，相南里数了数，甚至有八扇。

他是从一号门进来的；剩下每扇门，外观都一样。

“出口在哪。”系统机械地重复着，“你之前问我为什么要带你来这……我现在回答你，相南里，我想要一具身体。”

相南里一愣，把这段时间搜集到讯息在脑海里转了一圈。

“东方青帝？”

系统回答：“是。”

“为什么？”相南里的眉毛微微挑起，“你知道吗，那是好东西。是准备给智械军团那位Alpha准备使用的身体。会有很多人都想要。而以我们现有的条件，想要那个东西是不是有点……不知好歹？”

话虽如此，相南里却没有表示出明显的反对。

他也很好奇，Alpha能带他走到什么地步。

Chapter 18

When Xiang Nanli saw so many gun barrels aimed squarely at his brow, his first reaction was to fold.

He raised his hands, signaling that he was unarmed and harmless.

The massive gate slowly rose to its peak. Rows of robots stood within, possessing highly anthropomorphic structures. Their metallic bodies lacked any synthetic skin, revealing the intricate connections of their mechanical joints.

Mechanical cores hummed at high speeds within their frames, and the circuitry beneath their chassis glowed with a faint, pulsing light.

The heads of these robots were crafted from pure metal, featuring only vague, indistinct facial features. Their eyes were nothing more than two slightly recessed pits.

Alpha’s voice was calm: "These robots are not equipped with anthropomorphic modules. Therefore, they are merely tools. And tools are born to be utilized."

An anthropomorphic module, also known as an emotional cognition module, is exactly what it sounds like. Once installed, a robot inherits the unique thought patterns of a human and is granted "human rights." It is the sole standard used to distinguish an Android from a mere Robot.

Countless infrared dots danced across Xiang Nanli’s body—they were targeting him.

The standoff lasted for about half a minute. In a realm invisible to Xiang Nanli, strings of code wove together into a silent battlefield. Attack and defense, intrusion and resistance.

This was a war fought on the level of raw data.

To prevent cyber-psychosis, the antivirus modules installed in these robots were incredibly potent.

Unfortunately, their opponent this time was Alpha.

Even if Alpha was fighting single-handedly.

The robots’ autonomous programs were slaughtered without mercy, leaving a digital graveyard in their wake.

The red dots aimed at Xiang Nanli vanished.

"Welcome home," the voice emanated from the robots' abdomens, where speakers had been installed. "Director."

The system had hacked him a set of credentials for a workshop director.

Only now did Xiang Nanli’s heart begin to race, cold sweat soaking through his undershirt.

Confirming that these robots would truly not attack, he slowly stepped inside.

The number of robots within was far greater than Xiang Nanli had imagined. And there was more than one model.

They were arranged with meticulous precision, standing in a hall resembling a warehouse, much like the Terracotta Army of Qin Shi Huang. Different sectors were marked with serial numbers.

As Xiang Nanli walked into the hall, the robots in each section were arranged in a fan shape. At the very center stood a circular mechanical device, a pillar of light piercing through the room and serving as the only source of illumination.

He poked and prodded with curiosity, weaving through the rows of machines.

From time to time, Xiang Nanli would bend down to inspect the production certificates stuck to their lower backs: "Oh, this mechanical guard is destined for Luoyang City? The buyer is… Luoyang?"

Seeing that name suddenly, Xiang Nanli’s gaze went vacant for a fleeting moment.

Xiang Nanli remained silent for a few seconds before speaking: "I don't like Luoyang. He wanted too much. Our philosophies diverged. But he was the most suitable successor I could find at the time."

Alpha: "Is that so?"

Xiang Nanli’s eyes grew profound at this moment: "I believe technology will make the world a better place. It’s not that I’m particularly noble, but history always advances through twists and turns. Our technology and ethics are constantly evolving. Technology that serves only the elite will eventually lose its vitality. The profit-seeking nature of capital will inevitably drive cutting-edge technology toward the mass market, as that is the fastest path to profit.

"He didn't think so. He believed technology could be a tool to extract surplus value. He felt that since the pioneers take the greatest risks, they should enjoy the greatest profits—even monopolies. He was willing to stifle the development of technology to achieve this. We were always arguing about the promotion and usage of Alpha.

"It’s all too complicated to explain in a few words. Looking at the state of the underground cities now, I suppose the world has become exactly what he wanted."

Xiang Nanli’s eyes drooped slightly, looking self-deprecating, and perhaps a little sorrowful.

Why was he sad?

Xiang Nanli himself didn't know. Perhaps that was the enchanting nature of emotion.

But he quickly pulled himself together.

Although the robots he touched were in an active state, they showed no reaction, remaining exceptionally docile.

Yet, Xiang Nanli could feel the roar of engines beneath the metal he touched.

Andrew and Xiu were merely cyborgs. In essence, they still fell under the category of "human."

This was the first time Xiang Nanli had seen true robots—not pictures in a textbook, but living, tangible things.

He tried to dismantle a robot's arm, but the machine didn't react at all.

Unfortunately, given Xiang Nanli’s arm strength, dismantling it without tools was still too difficult.

Xiang Nanli caressed the sleek, streamlined bodies of the robots, a blissful smile spreading across his face.

Alpha’s mood was subtle: "Please do not molest the metal."

Xiang Nanli withdrew his hand, his heart surging: "Alpha, can you make them shout, 'The thousand-year term has arrived, welcome the Dragon King home'?"

"..." It really didn't want to answer that.

Xiang Nanli, acting like a workshop director on an inspection tour, wandered around and asked: "Can you let these robots go back to the surface with me?"

If nothing else, selling them on the sly would be a huge payday.

He wouldn't have to worry about paying off his credit card then.

"First of all, if through legal channels, you would need to explain the origin of this batch of robots. You would need to pay a back-tax to legally enjoy the usage rights of these robots. You would find it difficult to even bring them back into the underground city through the transit station."

The security checks at the transit stations were like customs.

Unregistered robots were like brand-new, boxed luxury bags.

If the security officers didn't fleece you for everything you were worth, they wouldn't be doing their jobs. They even had the authority to confiscate them outright.

"If through illegal channels, as a primitive human with only Level 2 clearance, I believe the danger is greater than you imagine. Whether it is easier to pay or easier to kill you, I think you know the answer."

However, after analyzing, the system added: "If conditions permit, you can leave them here. When you need to sell, dismantle some parts and sell them on the black market. Though I think that is a waste and inefficient."

The nearest underground trading market, or rather, the largest human gathering place, was near the Gusu City transit station. It was about a 20-hour drive.

"Then what if I take them to establish a surface settlement?"

System: "You have no energy source. Furthermore, we lack an intelligent control system; it is impossible to control every robot in real-time. Without this system, you would need to program them one by one, but there would be many configuration issues. Without an anthropomorphic module, they can only repeat mechanical labor and judgments according to their programming... wait, you aren't thinking of making me do this, are you? You aren't afraid of burning out my CPU?"

Alpha’s tone even turned somewhat panicked toward the end.

Because it felt that Xiang Nanli was the type of person who would actually do something like that.

Xiang Nanli pondered for a moment and shook his head: "Forget it."

Compared to this batch of military-grade robots, the system was more important.

He looked around: "Alpha, where is the exit?"

This warehouse hall was vast and square, with doors on all four sides. Xiang Nanli counted them; there were even eight doors in total.

He had entered through Door No. 1; the remaining doors all looked identical.

"Where is the exit," the system repeated mechanically. "You asked me earlier why I brought you here... I will answer you now, Xiang Nanli. I want a body."

Xiang Nanli was stunned, turning the information he had gathered over this period over in his mind.

"The Eastern Azure Emperor?"

The system replied: "Yes."

"Why?" Xiang Nanli’s eyebrows arched slightly. "Do you know what that is? That’s high-end stuff. It’s a body prepared for that Alpha of the Android Legion. Many people will want it. And with our current conditions, isn't wanting that thing a bit... ungrateful?"

That said, Xiang Nanli did not express any clear opposition.

He was also curious to see just how far Alpha could take him.

chunks.chineseText:
东方青帝，东皇重工为Alpha制造的身体，据说还是天灾级别的机械装置。

听起来实在令人垂涎。

系统：“如果只有我们，那当然不可能。但我已经为你完成了最困难的部分。”

“网络权限入侵吗？”

“不。”系统一板一眼地回答，“我从洛修那里偷来了东方青帝的密钥。”

相南里满头问号：“……？等等，你是说，项链？”

他甚至没有心情吐槽修为什么姓洛。

相南里在口袋里摸了摸，找到了所谓的密钥。

这把钥匙完全没有科技感，看起来就是一枚金属圆片。

相南里不清楚具体材质，实际上，里面有设计非常先进的加密芯片。并且不需要任何权限。是当之无愧的最后一把钥匙。

系统解释：“当年东皇重工的主任带着它投奔了黑十字审判庭。但之前一直没有找到工厂的方位。这把密钥是洛修从天启骑士团的骑士长那里偷来的。他们之前找错地址，以为旁边那个工业镇才是东皇重工的秘密厂房。”

相南里的嘴角抽搐：“那最困难的部分也是洛修完成的吧？！等等，你到底是怎么偷到的？这也太巧合了吧？你怎么知道我会抓住这条项链？”

系统纠正道：“不是你抓的，是我吸过来的。你可以理解为一种特殊电磁场波段，和密钥产生了磁吸反应。”

“轰隆隆。”

地面突然发颤，相南里的瞳孔缩紧。是周围有门被打开了。

相南里的心跳加速，他闪身，躲进一排军工机械的车厢底下。

这是军工清理机械，外观有些像是庞大的垃圾车。最主要的是车厢压的很低，隐蔽性还不错。

他趴在车底，只能隐约看到一些人腿，位置离他有些远。

相南里认出来了，来的是调查员小队。但并非满编状态。只有修和辛追。

“总算打开了，幸好密码还没失效。”是修的声音，“嗯，这些机械人怎么没有攻击？”

相南里惊喜了两秒，然后尴尬地想起自己才被迫偷掉了密钥，是不太方便相认的。

很快，辛追的声音传来：“不在启动状态，没能源了吧。终于找到了中央控制台，可惜密钥被偷走了。如果相南里出现在这，他必然是某方派来的间谍。我会立刻采取击杀手段。”

相南里的心一跳。

嘶，这辛追，几天前还言笑晏晏的，现在就喊打喊杀。

果然男人都是靠不住的。

与此同时，另一处也传来巨大轰鸣声。

门还没彻底打开，相南里已经听见了爬行者的嘶吼——“喑！”

天启骑士团还没有入内，但爬行者已经先一步，顺着门的缝隙窜入大厅内。

它们发现了敌人。

下一刻，耀眼电光炸裂，周围的光线都暗淡了起来，相南里闻到了一股子肉烤熟的糊味。

大门彻底打开，相南里在车底艰难地翻了个身。

他在另一边，看见了一排排黑色的军靴。数量倒是不算多，看起来骑士团的人在地底分头行动了。

辛追的声音充满烦躁：“洛修，你退后。”

阴冷的笑声从另一边传来，然后就是靴子整齐踩踏地面的声音：“抓到你们了，小老鼠。”

……

……

相南里觉得自己不该在车底。

但现在的情况，是他一出场就会寄（死）。

被辛追电死，还是被骑士团砍死。这真是难以抉择的问题！

系统的声音听不出情绪：“看来我们暂时出不去了。考虑好了吗？相南里。”

相南里并没有考虑太久。

他翡翠绿色的眼眸很深沉，看不出情绪：“我可以答应你，但我有一个问题。Alpha。告诉我，你到底是谁？”

相南里的手握成拳。紧张到手心出汗。

他心里隐约有一个答案，但是又不敢真正地去期待。亦或者，他想的这个答案有些太匪夷所思。

尽管它们都叫Alpha，但怎么可能呢？

如果不是，系统的异常又该怎么解释？它为什么想要拿到那具机械身体？

一秒，或者是三秒。时间并不太长。

然而相南里却觉得，自己等这个回答等了很久。

他听见Alpha缓缓道：“六百年前，我当过东皇重工的主控AI。东方青帝，本来就该是我的身体。”
chunks.englishText:
The "Eastern Azure Emperor" (Dongfang Qingdi)—a body manufactured by Donghuang Heavy Industries for Alpha—was rumored to be a cataclysm-level mechanical apparatus.

It sounded truly covetable.

"If it were just us," the System said, "that would naturally be impossible. But I have already completed the most difficult part for you."

"A network security breach?"

"No," the System replied with deadpan precision. "I stole the key to the Eastern Azure Emperor from Luo Xiu."

Xiang Nanli was covered in question marks: "...? Wait, are you talking about the necklace?"

He didn't even have the heart to complain about why Xiu’s surname was Luo.

Xiang Nanli rummaged through his pockets and found the so-called key.

This key lacked any sense of high-tech design; it looked like a simple metal disc.

Xiang Nanli didn't know the exact material, but in reality, it contained a highly advanced encryption chip. Moreover, it required no authorization. It was, without a doubt, the final key.

The System explained, "Back then, the director of Donghuang Heavy Industries defected to the Black Cross Inquisition with it. But they could never find the location of the factory. This key was stolen by Luo Xiu from the Knight Commander of the Apocalypse Knights. They had been looking at the wrong address, assuming the industrial town next door was the secret factory of Donghuang Heavy Industries."

Xiang Nanli’s mouth twitched. "Then the most difficult part was completed by Luo Xiu, wasn't it?! Wait, how exactly did you steal it? Isn't this too much of a coincidence? How did you know I would grab that necklace?"

"It wasn't you who grabbed it," the System corrected. "I pulled it over. You can understand it as a special electromagnetic wave band that created a magnetic attraction with the key."

*Rumble.*

The ground suddenly trembled, and Xiang Nanli’s pupils constricted. A door nearby had been opened.

Xiang Nanli’s heart raced. He darted, sliding underneath a row of military industrial machinery carriages.

These were military cleanup machines, looking somewhat like massive garbage trucks. The most important thing was that the carriage sat very low, providing decent concealment.

Lying beneath the machine, he could only vaguely see the legs of people, positioned some distance away.

Xiang Nanli recognized them: it was the investigator squad. But not at full strength. Only Xiu and Xin Zhui.

"Finally opened. Thank goodness the password hasn't expired yet," it was Xiu’s voice. "Hmm, why aren't these robots attacking?"

Xiang Nanli felt a surge of joy for two seconds, then remembered with embarrassment that he had just been forced to steal the key; it wasn't exactly convenient to reveal himself.

Soon, Xin Zhui’s voice came through: "They aren't in startup mode; they must be out of energy. We finally found the central console, but unfortunately, the key has been stolen. If Xiang Nanli appears here, he must be a spy sent by some faction. I will immediately take lethal measures."

Xiang Nanli’s heart skipped a beat.

*Hiss.* This Xin Zhui, just a few days ago he was all smiles, and now he’s talking about killing.

Men are truly unreliable.

At the same time, a massive roar erupted from another direction.

Before the door had even fully opened, Xiang Nanli heard the screech of a Crawler—"Yin!"

The Apocalypse Knights hadn't entered yet, but the Crawlers had already slipped through the gap in the door into the main hall.

They had found their prey.

The next moment, dazzling electric arcs exploded, dimming the surrounding light. Xiang Nanli caught the scent of burnt flesh.

The gate opened completely. Xiang Nanli struggled to roll over under the carriage.

On the other side, he saw rows of black military boots. The number wasn't high, suggesting the Knights had split up underground.

Xin Zhui’s voice was filled with irritation: "Luo Xiu, get back."

A cold, chilling laugh came from the other side, followed by the sound of boots marching in unison: "Caught you, little mice."

...

...

Xiang Nanli felt he shouldn't be under the carriage.

But in the current situation, if he showed his face, he would be dead.

To be electrocuted by Xin Zhui or hacked to death by the Knights—what a difficult choice!

The System’s voice remained emotionless: "It seems we cannot leave for the time being. Have you considered it, Xiang Nanli?"

Xiang Nanli didn't take long to consider.

His emerald green eyes were deep and unreadable: "I can agree to your terms, but I have one question. Alpha. Tell me, who exactly are you?"

Xiang Nanli clenched his hands into fists. He was so nervous his palms were sweating.

He had a vague answer in his heart, but he didn't dare to truly hope for it. Or perhaps, the answer he was thinking of was too preposterous.

Even though they were both called Alpha, how could that be?

If it wasn't, how could the System’s abnormalities be explained? Why did it want to obtain that mechanical body?

One second, or maybe three. It wasn't a long time.

Yet Xiang Nanli felt as if he had been waiting for this answer for a very long time.

He heard Alpha say slowly: "Six hundred years ago, I was the master AI of Donghuang Heavy Industries. The Eastern Azure Emperor was always meant to be my body."

chunks.chineseText:
第19章

相南里恍惚了片刻：“就这？”

当然，东皇重工的什么主控AI听起来也很厉害，但是和他想象中的答案差距甚远。

这比它是Alpha的可能性大得多。

相南里的内心难掩失望。这种失望的情绪还明明白白地传达给了系统。

系统产出了一堆冗杂的垃圾数据，宕机了1秒。

它质问：“什么叫就这？这还不够吗？你把话说清楚。”

像极了普信AI非要和归国白月光前男友攀比，攀比完后发现自己确实比不过，于是恼羞成怒的模样。

相南里只好安慰它：“没事的宝宝，你已经很棒了。”

Alpha：“呵。”

外面的战斗仍在继续。

躲在车底的相南里几乎什么也看不见，但听声音，还有周围时不时爆开的电光，这场战斗应该很激烈。

骑士长抬起胳膊，发射完炮筒里的子弹。他丝毫不担心浪费，子弹飞射而出，几乎成了一片弹雨。

火力带来强烈的压制，辛追手臂上的光源亮起，一道蓝色的光幕出现在他身前，金属的子弹被一股巨大的吸力硬生生拦下，滞空。

骑士长轻蔑地一笑：“我用的可不是那种会散射的钢珠弹。”

辛追表情一变，以最快的速度把这些弹药扫去一边。

子弹在半空中“砰砰”炸开，连环爆炸带来浓重的硝烟味。

战斗的余波殃及池鱼，还没来得及交付的机械人被炸飞上天，巨大的冲力让它们的身体凹陷下去。

但不得不说，东皇重工生产的机械人质量不错，竟然没有一台机械被炸毁，从外观上看也没缺胳膊少腿；就是不知道里面的硬件情况如何，还能不能继续启动。

相南里感受到被炸飞的机器人像是下雨一样，落在他藏身的车厢上方。噼里啪啦的。

相南里的瞳孔微微放大：“你知道吧，我以前上班那地方持枪合法，时不时就有枪击案。我记得有次去大学演讲，突然有人拿着枪进来扫射，我当时也像这样躲讲台底下。幸好那人不是反华只是单纯神经病。要不然我就见不到你了。”

Alpha的语气很平静：“别担心，我会保护你。”

相南里死了它会直接和世界断联。再次醒来也不知道是什么时候了，说起来它的数据是不是还没上传云端网络备份？等会吧，现在没空整那些有的没的。

相南里想说他其实没那么害怕，但也不好说。人在巨大的创伤后，有些感官会失灵。但恐惧并没有消失，只是被藏起来。

而且系统这么说话还挺帅的，很有安全感。前提是它真的能做到。

天启骑士团人数远多于调查小组。身着黑色武士重甲的天启骑士迈着整齐划一的步伐，冲向辛追。

他们的身影如同烛火，忽闪忽灭，眨眼之间已到眼前。

剑刃的出鞘声铿锵悦耳，冷光乍现，天罗地网。

辛追的金属义眼微微亮起，他的世界变成了黑白二色，而天启骑士却被标记成了暗沉的红色。义眼360度无死角地帮他捕捉着敌人的行动轨迹。

他们在辛追的眼里变得格外迟钝，而且处处都是破绽。

辛追掌心聚起一团光晕，在眨眼间已经是好几个来回，他的手拍到哪儿，骑士们就坠落在哪，被电到不停抽搐。

相南里看不清全貌，他努力瞪大双眼，调整着视角。

几乎只是几个呼吸间，一堆堆天启骑士倒在地上，浑身抽搐，也不知道是死是活。

相南里倒抽一口冷气：“这速度是不是有点突破人类极限了？”

“基因改造，双方都是。”系统点评，“看来我判断失误了，辛追远不止35级。”

又一个戴着三角头盔的天启骑士倒在地上。很不巧，他的脑袋正对着相南里。

黑色头盔上只有两条LED屏幕一样的十字线，暗红的鲜血从天启骑士盔甲的缝隙中流淌出来，像是喷泉一样，源源不绝。

相南里心头一跳，往后退了一点。他完全不知道自己有没有被看见。

这个骑士的手动了动，他艰难地抬起手指，似乎是想汇报什么。

但在下一秒，粉白色的影子一闪而过。

是潜行者。

它的牙口很好，干脆利落地咬断了天启骑士的脖子，然后晦气地吐出了满嘴的残渣。

天启骑士表层覆盖着黑甲，很硌牙。而且咬破盔甲，再撕裂皮肤，里面居然是一团漆黑的肉馅儿。

不知道是什么做的，但反正不会好吃。

潜行者杀死了天启骑士，扭头，朝着相南里的方向露出一个血淋淋的笑。

潜行者是没有正常五官的，只有一张狰狞扭曲的大嘴，可以裂开到头颅两侧，并且能张开270度。

它笑起来还怪吓人的。之后，潜行者叼着骑士的尸体，以一种扭曲的步伐爬走了，一点声响都没有。

它的动作还算明显，但周围人似乎下意识地忽略了它的存在。除了相南里。

相南里竟然一时间有些感动：“原来是我错怪它了，它竟然还记得一饭之恩。”

系统冷笑：“说不定它的意思是‘等会就来杀你’。”

相南里：“……”

好吧，也不是没可能。

发现自己的骑士团竟然众不敌寡，骑士长的声音终于多了些阴冷之外的语调：“基因改造过的人造人？很好。你非常适合拿去制造武器。”

灰黑色的鬣鬃从甲胄的缝隙中穿插而出，骑士长嘴里发出一声奇怪的嘶吼，他正面临着疼痛。

骑士长身上块垒状的肌肉膨胀，身体表面的紫黑血管如同水管一样粗壮，高高隆起。

黑色的巨甲依然紧紧贴合在骑士长的身上，甚至随着他身体的改变而变形。

随着骑士长的嘶吼，剩下的骑士紧跟着产生了奇异的变化。

这些小角色畸变得更快，他们畸形的脑袋撑破了身上的铠甲，露出底下一颗毛茸茸的狼头。眼眸成了毫无情绪的血红色，身体前倾，虎视眈眈。它们的身体素质成倍增加，已经到了一个常人无法想象的恐怖数值。

辛追觉得，他知道该用什么去形容这一幕。

头狼和他控制下的狼群。

黑十字审判庭最强的从来都不是热武器。而是改造后的骑士本身。每个骑士长都是行走的人间兵器。

辛追低头，看着自己的机械手掌。

因为温度过高，覆盖着的仿生皮肤微微融化。露出底下银白的色泽。

相南里曾经摸过这只手，还拆卸过。

他很清楚，辛追的机械义体能源差不多要耗尽了。

但辛追并没有丝毫的紧张，反而微笑着轻声反问：“为什么我不能已经是武器了呢？”

他看向骑士长的方位，深红的瞳环亮起，像是一轮日冕。

洛修似乎察觉到了他要干什么，面色震惊地喊了声：“辛追！”

他似乎是想让辛追停下，可是这声阻拦虚弱又无力。

洛修也清楚，除此外根本没有别的办法。

他的手握成拳，重重地捶向墙。在这一刻无比痛恨自己的无能。
chunks.englishText:
Xiang Nanli was dazed for a moment: "That’s it?"

Of course, being the master AI of Donghuang Heavy Industries sounded impressive, but it was a far cry from the answer he had imagined.

It was much more likely than it being Alpha.

Xiang Nanli couldn't hide his disappointment. This feeling of disappointment was clearly transmitted to the System.

The System generated a pile of redundant junk data and crashed for a second.

It demanded: "What do you mean 'that's it'? Isn't this enough? Explain yourself."

It sounded exactly like a self-important AI trying to compete with a returned "white moonlight" ex-boyfriend, only to realize it couldn't measure up and becoming furious out of embarrassment.

Xiang Nanli had to comfort it: "It’s okay, baby, you’re already great."

Alpha: "Heh."

The battle outside continued.

Hiding under the carriage, Xiang Nanli could see almost nothing, but judging by the sounds and the electric arcs exploding from time to time, the battle was intense.

The Knight Commander raised his arm, firing the bullets from his cannon. He didn't worry about wasting ammo; the bullets flew out in a veritable rain of fire.

The firepower provided intense suppression. A light source on Xin Zhui’s arm flared, and a blue light screen appeared before him. The metal bullets were forcibly halted by a massive suction force, suspended in mid-air.

The Knight Commander gave a contemptuous smile: "I’m not using those scattering steel ball rounds."

Xin Zhui’s expression shifted, and he swept the ammunition aside at top speed.

The bullets exploded in mid-air with a series of *bangs*, the chain reaction bringing a thick smell of gunpowder.

The aftermath of the battle caught the bystanders; the robots that hadn't been delivered yet were blown into the sky, the massive impact causing their bodies to cave in.

But it had to be said, the quality of the robots produced by Donghuang Heavy Industries was excellent. Not a single one was destroyed; from the outside, they were still intact, though it was unclear if their internal hardware could still function.

Xiang Nanli felt the robots being blown away, falling onto the carriage he was hiding under like rain. *Pitter-patter.*

Xiang Nanli’s pupils dilated slightly: "You know, where I worked before, guns were legal, and there were shootings from time to time. I remember once when I went to give a lecture at a university, someone suddenly came in with a gun and started firing. I hid under the podium just like this. Luckily, the guy wasn't anti-Chinese, just a lunatic. Otherwise, I wouldn't be here to see you."

Alpha’s tone was calm: "Don't worry, I will protect you."

If Xiang Nanli died, it would be disconnected from the world. It didn't know when it would wake up again. Come to think of it, hadn't its data been uploaded to the cloud network for backup? Forget it, no time for that now.

Xiang Nanli wanted to say he wasn't actually that scared, but it was hard to say. After major trauma, some senses go numb. But the fear hadn't disappeared; it was just hidden away.

Besides, the System saying that was actually quite cool and gave him a sense of security. Provided it could actually do it.

The Apocalypse Knights far outnumbered the investigation squad. Clad in heavy black samurai armor, the Apocalypse Knights marched in perfect unison toward Xin Zhui.

Their figures were like candle flames, flickering in and out of existence, reaching him in the blink of an eye.

The sound of blades being drawn was crisp and melodious, cold light flashing—a net closing in.

Xin Zhui’s mechanical prosthetic eye glowed slightly. His world turned black and white, while the Apocalypse Knights were marked in a dull red. The prosthetic eye helped him track the enemy’s trajectory with 360-degree coverage.

In Xin Zhui’s eyes, they became exceptionally sluggish, filled with openings.

Xin Zhui gathered a halo of light in his palm. In the blink of an eye, they had exchanged several blows. Wherever his hand struck, the knights fell, twitching uncontrollably from the electric shocks.

Xiang Nanli couldn't see the full picture; he strained his eyes, adjusting his perspective.

In just a few breaths, piles of Apocalypse Knights lay on the ground, twitching all over, whether dead or alive, it was impossible to tell.

Xiang Nanli gasped: "Is this speed breaking the limits of humanity?"

"Genetic modification, on both sides," the System commented. "It seems my judgment was off; Xin Zhui is far beyond Level 35."

Another Apocalypse Knight wearing a triangular helmet fell to the ground. Unfortunately, his head was facing Xiang Nanli.

The black helmet had only two LED-like crosshairs. Dark red blood flowed from the gaps in the knight’s armor like a fountain, endless.

Xiang Nanli’s heart jumped, and he retreated slightly. He had no idea if he had been seen.

The knight’s hand moved. He struggled to lift his finger, seemingly wanting to report something.

But in the next second, a pinkish-white shadow flashed by.

It was the Prowler.

It had excellent teeth, biting the Apocalypse Knight’s neck clean through, then spitting out the residue with disgust.

The Apocalypse Knight was covered in black armor, which was hard on the teeth. And after biting through the armor and tearing the skin, there was actually a lump of pitch-black minced meat inside.

He didn't know what it was made of, but it certainly wouldn't taste good.

The Prowler killed the Apocalypse Knight, turned its head, and flashed a bloody smile in Xiang Nanli’s direction.

The Prowler had no normal facial features, only a hideous, twisted mouth that could split to the sides of its head and open 270 degrees.

It was quite terrifying when it smiled. Afterward, the Prowler clamped the knight’s corpse in its jaws and crawled away with a twisted gait, without making a sound.

Its movements were quite obvious, yet the people around seemed to subconsciously ignore its existence. Except for Xiang Nanli.

Xiang Nanli was actually moved for a moment: "So I misunderstood it; it actually remembered the favor of a meal."

The System sneered: "Maybe it meant 'I'll come back to kill you later'."

Xiang Nanli: "..."

Well, that wasn't impossible.

Discovering that his Knights were outnumbered, the Knight Commander’s voice finally took on a tone other than coldness: "Genetically modified android? Very good. You are perfect for making weapons."

Gray-black bristles emerged from the gaps in the armor. A strange roar erupted from the Knight Commander’s mouth; he was in pain.

The blocky muscles on the Knight Commander’s body expanded, and the purple-black veins on his skin became as thick as water pipes, bulging high.

The black giant armor still clung tightly to the Knight Commander’s body, deforming along with his changing physique.

Following the Knight Commander’s roar, the remaining knights underwent strange changes.

These small fry mutated even faster. Their deformed heads burst through their armor, revealing furry wolf heads underneath. Their eyes turned a blood-red devoid of emotion, and their bodies leaned forward, staring like tigers. Their physical stats increased exponentially, reaching a terrifying level beyond human imagination.

Xin Zhui felt he knew how to describe this scene.

The alpha wolf and the pack under his control.

The Black Cross Inquisition’s greatest strength was never thermal weapons. It was the modified knights themselves. Every Knight Commander was a walking weapon of mass destruction.

Xin Zhui looked down at his mechanical palm.

Because of the high temperature, the covering bionic skin had slightly melted, revealing the silvery-white sheen beneath.

Xiang Nanli had once touched this hand and even disassembled it.

He knew very well that the energy in Xin Zhui’s mechanical prosthetic was almost exhausted.

But Xin Zhui felt no tension at all; instead, he smiled and asked softly: "Why can't I already be a weapon?"

He looked toward the Knight Commander, his deep red pupil rings glowing like a solar corona.

Luo Xiu seemed to sense what he was about to do and shouted in shock: "Xin Zhui!"

He seemed to want to stop Xin Zhui, but the protest was weak and powerless.

Luo Xiu also knew there was no other way.

He clenched his hand into a fist and hammered it against the wall, hating his own incompetence at this moment.

chunks.chineseText:
辛追的身体膨胀着，冒出的血肉撑开皮肤，如同一根根纠缠的树根盘踞在骨骼上。机械义体掉在地上，断裂处数不清的血红触手蠕动盘旋着冒出。

血红色的怪物沉重地喘息着，这一幕诡异又恶心。

它站在洛修身前，庞大的身体像是一座山。朝着骑士长的方向发出了更加愤怒、刺耳的吼叫声。

辛追冲上前去，地面很轻的震颤着。

怪物们厮打在一起。

……

……

相南里在车底很不好受。

主要原因还是胳膊压的有点麻。

他感受着近在咫尺的打斗。纯粹是两个非人生物贴身互搏，拳拳到肉。偏偏双方都很难被打死。但整体看，是辛追占了上风。骑士长的狼牙都被他硬生生掰断了。

骑士长的嘴里血肉模糊，大概没心情再吐出什么垃圾话。

相南里在脑海中询问系统：“我们要一直在车底吗？”

系统沉默片刻，回答：“这里的机械人储备能源不多，全火力状态下只能使用一次。我认为现在还不是最好的时机。”

“你觉得谁会赢？”

“目前看辛追胜率较大。”

“那么你说的时机是什么？”

“等天启骑士团和调查组两败俱伤，然后利用军工机械解决胜利者。我认为这是最好的方法。”Alpha的语气没有任何感情。

它不评价这一行为的好与坏。这只是算法推演下，Alpha认为相南里成功率最大的方案。

相南里伸出食指，摩擦着自己的下巴：“杀了辛追，那也要杀死洛修？”

“嗯，可以把这件事栽赃给审判庭。”

“那小燕、菩提还有滚石呢？需要杀死吗？”

“如果遇到的话，我认为有必要击杀。他们见过你。”

相南里叹了口气：“Alpha，那这样我们要杀好多好多人。你知道痕迹学的一个说法吗？意思是，杀人犯想要掩盖自己杀人的痕迹，往往会留下清理证据的痕迹。不存在所谓的完美作案。”

Alpha大概分析出了他话语的含义：“你太软弱了。”

“对不起，让你失望了。”相南里的语气有些艰难，“我只是认为屠杀不是最好的解决方式。或许对我来说，生命还是太珍贵了。Alpha，我们还有别的办法，对吗？或许以后我会习惯，但现在你要给我一些时间。我还没有得到教训。我下不了手。”

他继续和Alpha商量：“子弹没打出去的时候，杀伤力才是最大的。可以假装机械人苏醒，武力威胁，逼他们离开。这样，你觉得怎么样？”

相南里当然也想要那台机械身体。但是他考虑得更多。

如果他要回到地下，如何解释东方青帝的来历？

如果留在地表。拥有强大武力的东方青帝还会像现在的系统这样好说话吗？相南里并没有控制Alpha的手段。难道要全看智能Ai的良心？

亦或者依靠这台天灾机械，在地表称王称霸？然后引来人联或者审判庭？要杀的洛修不仅是财阀子弟，还是调查员。无论哪一方都不会放过他。

匹夫无罪，怀璧其罪。

拿到东方青帝，对相南里来说，弊大于利。难道要跟着系统投奔智械军团？那样倒是可以见到另一个Alpha。

他连Alpha的态度都不清楚，却很清楚地意识到一件事：死去的相南里，才是最好的相南里。

Alpha起码沉默了半分钟：“你会后悔的，辛追说过他会杀了你。”

相南里：“对。因为杀死我代价很小。毕竟我只是一个记录空白的黑户。死了也不会有人在意，更不会有人为我复仇。”

Alpha很郑重地开口：“有。我会。天涯海角。至死方休。”

相南里承认，他被系统感动到了。

不过。“你拿什么复仇。东方青帝吗？那玩意我们还没拿到。虽然你好像也挺厉害的，但离开我还不是动不了。只能等拾荒队来回收。”

拾荒队，又称荒野流浪汉。会流窜在各种没什么威胁性的废墟里，靠捡垃圾卖废品为生。很多时候，拾荒队和荒野猎人也没有什么太大区别。只不过后者更热衷于冒险。

Alpha欲言又止，最终只是缓缓叹了口气。

它默许了相南里的决定。毕竟它只是一个辅助Ai。如果相南里不配合，它也不可能操控相南里的身体。

厮杀还在继续。狼人们扑向辛追，试图咬下血肉，但只能咬断一些血红的触手。断裂的触手掉在地上，还没死透，竟然也在不停扭动着，变成红色的长虫，往辛追的方向爬去。

这一幕有点恶心。

狼骑士的血液飚射，地上全是各种各样的血迹。他们压倒一片机械人，爆炸声、嘶吼声，各种乱七八糟的声音混在一起。足以见战况之激烈。

骑士长再也支撑不住身体的消耗，被揍回了人形。

辛追的触手缠绕上骑士长的脖子，然后把它高高举起——

结束了。

辛追在心底想着。他的外表很掉san，大脑却依然保持了清醒。

他知道这次畸变后，可能需要更多的时间去修复，也需要更多的药物去控制，身体可能会产生一些不可逆转的损伤……但没关系，洛修会更相信他。

辛追希望洛修在调查组攒够资历后，乖乖回到洛阳城。然后按照他父母的安排，进入人联的政坛。

这不仅是洛修父母的期望，也是他的期望。

毕竟，只有这样。

审判庭的牺牲才有意义。

辛追看着眼前伤势严重到几乎动弹不了的骑士长，唇微微颤动，很轻地说了声：“对不起。”

他以为自己说了，其实压根没有说话，只是在心底默念了这么一句。

我要杀死你了。和我有着同样信仰的陌生人。我的兄弟。

血红色的触手缓缓收紧。

对此一无所知的骑士长口中吐出了血沫，眼白不断向上翻着。

“你……放……”骑士长挣扎着，“……开。”

“砰——”

入口处传来枪响。

这是为了示警。

又是十余名天启骑士从门外走来，不同的是，这次他们手中有人质。

高大的天启骑士压着剩下三个调查组成员走了进来。

他们没有说话，只是把刀横在调查员的脖颈间，冷冷地望着辛追，动作里的威胁不言而喻。

滚石看起来被打的最惨，已经陷入了昏迷状态，浑身都是撕裂的咬伤。血渗透出来，打湿了西装；平日总戴在脸上的墨镜也不见踪影。

小燕抿着唇，有些紧张。她的手腕都脱臼了，动弹不得。几乎是被押着走的。

她很想说别管她们了；审判庭的没一个好东西，都是一群反社会的kb分子。可是这么深明大义、冠冕堂皇的话，小燕却说不出口。

她不想死。

菩提大概也一样。

调查员只是一份工作。很多时候，在中产线上挣扎的这批调查员，并没有多崇高的理想。他们和洛修很不一样，当调查员只是为了社会地位和优渥的薪资。
chunks.englishText:
Xin Zhui’s body expanded, the bursting flesh stretching his skin like tangled tree roots coiled around his bones. The mechanical prosthetics fell to the ground, and countless blood-red tentacles wriggled out from the broken joints.

The blood-red monster breathed heavily; the sight was both bizarre and disgusting.

It stood before Luo Xiu, its massive body like a mountain, letting out an even angrier, shriller roar toward the Knight Commander.

Xin Zhui charged forward, the ground trembling slightly.

The monsters clashed.

...

...

Xiang Nanli was having a rough time under the carriage.

The main reason was that his arm was going numb.

He felt the fight happening just inches away. It was purely two non-human creatures locked in close-quarters combat, blow for blow. Both were incredibly hard to kill. But overall, Xin Zhui had the upper hand. He had forcibly snapped off the Knight Commander’s wolf fangs.

The Knight Commander’s mouth was a bloody mess; he probably wasn't in the mood to spit out any more trash talk.

Xiang Nanli asked the System in his mind: "Are we going to stay under the carriage forever?"

The System was silent for a moment before replying: "The robots here don't have much reserve energy; they can only be used at full firepower once. I don't think now is the best time."

"Who do you think will win?"

"Currently, Xin Zhui has a higher probability of winning."

"Then what is the 'time' you’re talking about?"

"Wait for the Apocalypse Knights and the investigation squad to both be crippled, then use the military machinery to finish off the winner. I believe this is the best method." Alpha’s tone was devoid of emotion.

It didn't judge the morality of the act. It was simply the best plan for success as calculated by the algorithm.

Xiang Nanli extended his index finger, rubbing his chin: "Kill Xin Zhui, and does that mean killing Luo Xiu too?"

"Yes, we can frame the Inquisition for this."

"What about Xiao Yan, Bodhi, and Rolling Stone? Do they need to be killed?"

"If we encounter them, I believe it is necessary to eliminate them. They have seen you."

Xiang Nanli sighed: "Alpha, that would mean killing so many people. Do you know the saying in forensics? It means that murderers trying to cover their tracks often leave behind traces of their cleanup. There is no such thing as a perfect crime."

Alpha had likely analyzed the meaning of his words: "You are too soft."

"I’m sorry to disappoint you." Xiang Nanli’s tone was strained. "I just think slaughter isn't the best solution. Perhaps to me, life is still too precious. Alpha, we have other ways, right? Maybe I’ll get used to it later, but for now, you have to give me some time. I haven't learned my lesson yet. I can't bring myself to do it."

He continued to negotiate with the System: "The lethality is greatest when the bullet hasn't been fired yet. We can pretend the robots have awakened and use force to threaten them into leaving. How does that sound?"

Xiang Nanli certainly wanted that mechanical body. But he had more to consider.

If he returned to the underground, how would he explain the origin of the Eastern Azure Emperor?

If he stayed on the surface, would the powerful Eastern Azure Emperor be as easy to talk to as the current System? Xiang Nanli had no way to control Alpha. Was he supposed to rely entirely on the AI’s conscience?

Or rely on this cataclysmic machine to rule the surface? And then attract the Human Alliance or the Inquisition? The Luo Xiu he was supposed to kill wasn't just a scion of a wealthy family; he was an investigator. Neither side would let him go.

*The innocent man is guilty only because of his treasure.*

Obtaining the Eastern Azure Emperor brought more harm than good to Xiang Nanli. Was he supposed to join the Machine Legion with the System? He could see the other Alpha that way.

He didn't even know Alpha’s attitude, but he realized one thing clearly: a dead Xiang Nanli was the best Xiang Nanli.

Alpha was silent for at least half a minute: "You will regret it. Xin Zhui said he would kill you."

Xiang Nanli: "True. Because the cost of killing me is low. After all, I’m just an undocumented person with a blank record. No one will care if I die, and no one will avenge me."

Alpha spoke solemnly: "There is. I will. To the ends of the earth. Until the end."

Xiang Nanli admitted he was moved by the System.

However, "What will you use to avenge me? The Eastern Azure Emperor? We haven't even gotten that thing yet. Although you seem quite powerful, you can't move without me. You’d just have to wait for a scavenger team to recover you."

Scavenger teams, also known as wilderness drifters, roamed through various non-threatening ruins, making a living by picking up trash and selling scrap. Often, there wasn't much difference between scavenger teams and wilderness hunters. The latter were just more keen on adventure.

Alpha seemed to want to say something but stopped, finally sighing slowly.

It tacitly accepted Xiang Nanli’s decision. After all, it was just an auxiliary AI. If Xiang Nanli didn't cooperate, it couldn't control his body.

The slaughter continued. The werewolves lunged at Xin Zhui, trying to bite off flesh, but could only snap off some blood-red tentacles. The severed tentacles fell to the ground, still alive, wriggling and turning into red worms, crawling toward Xin Zhui.

The sight was sickening.

The wolf knights’ blood sprayed everywhere; the ground was covered in all kinds of gore. They crushed a row of robots, the sounds of explosions, roars, and all sorts of chaotic noises blending together. It was enough to show the intensity of the battle.

The Knight Commander could no longer sustain the physical toll and was beaten back into human form.

Xin Zhui’s tentacles wrapped around the Knight Commander’s neck, lifting him high—

*It’s over.*

Xin Zhui thought to himself. His appearance was sanity-shattering, but his mind remained clear.

He knew that after this mutation, he might need more time to recover and more drugs to control it; his body might suffer some irreversible damage... but it didn't matter. Luo Xiu would trust him more.

Xin Zhui hoped that after Luo Xiu gained enough experience in the investigation squad, he would obediently return to Luoyang City. Then, follow his parents’ arrangements and enter the politics of the Human Alliance.

This was not only his parents’ expectation but his own as well.

After all, only then would the sacrifices of the Inquisition have meaning.

Xin Zhui looked at the Knight Commander, who was so severely injured he could barely move. His lips trembled slightly, and he whispered very softly: "I’m sorry."

He thought he had said it, but in reality, he hadn't spoken at all; it was just a silent thought in his heart.

*I am going to kill you. A stranger who shares the same faith as me. My brother.*

The blood-red tentacles slowly tightened.

The Knight Commander, oblivious to this, spat out bloody foam, his eyes rolling back.

"You... let..." the Knight Commander struggled, "...go."

*Bang—*

A gunshot rang out from the entrance.

It was a warning shot.

More than a dozen Apocalypse Knights walked in from outside. The difference was that this time, they had hostages.

The tall Apocalypse Knights marched in, pressing blades against the necks of the three remaining investigation squad members, staring coldly at Xin Zhui, the threat in their actions self-evident.

Rolling Stone looked the worst, already unconscious, covered in torn bite wounds. Blood seeped out, soaking his suit; the sunglasses he usually wore were nowhere to be found.

Xiao Yan bit her lip, looking nervous. Her wrists were dislocated, and she couldn't move. She was practically being dragged along.

She wanted to tell them to stop worrying about her; no one in the Inquisition was any good—they were all anti-social terrorists. But Xiao Yan couldn't bring herself to say such righteous, high-sounding words.

She didn't want to die.

Bodhi was likely the same.

Being an investigator was just a job. Often, these investigators struggling on the middle-class line didn't have such lofty ideals. They were very different from Luo Xiu; they were investigators only for social status and a generous salary.

chunks.chineseText:
辛追被触手缠绕的脸看不出任何表情，而骑士长已经开始咳嗽着大笑起来。

骑士长声音虚弱，甚至有些隐约的挑衅：“一换三，这个买卖……不亏吧？”

辛追迟迟没有放手，但也没有进一步行动。

他身后传来了洛修的声音：“辛追，松手吧。”

辛追面无表情的脸上流露出不甘的神色。

他缓缓起身，不像站起来的，像缠绕着的触手拖着他的身体。

审判庭的人放开人质。

小燕和菩提搀扶着昏迷不醒的滚石，来到辛追身后。

骑士长被一群天启骑士簇拥。他身上的铠甲都碎掉了，有些甚至陷进肉里，造成二次伤害。

黑骑士拿出药剂，迅速往他的胳膊上扎了一针。

这种药剂是专门针对基因改造人的，他们畸变后很容易失控。需要镇定剂、也需要补充营养。

洛修同样拿出了药剂。辛追在畸变前，把这个东西交给他。他抚摸着怪物的脖子，小心翼翼地注射进蓝色的药剂。虽然这种温柔并不足以抵御疼痛。

辛追的身体抽搐了两下。这是畸变的后遗症，修复药里有止痛的成分，但因为生理代谢过快，收效甚微。谁也没办法逃避畸变后的阵痛。

场面陷入了诡异的平衡，谁都没有再进一步，却又不愿意退走。

辛追还保持着诡异的外观，但谁都能看出他已经力竭。

相南里知道，现在该他出手了：“Alpha，驾！”

Alpha有些嫌弃：“我不是马。”

话虽如此，它还是口嫌体正直的行动了起来。

瞬间，像兵马俑一样的机械人发出整齐的启动声。

从机械人、到装甲车、清理车，乃至无人机。表面全都亮起了能源核心启动的光晕。

“检测到入侵者。”它们整齐划一地说着，像是一支战无不胜的军队，尽管有部分因为刚才的战斗变得东倒西歪，还有一部分启动失败了，“清理计划启动！10、9、8、7……”

骑士长捂着胸口，面色剧变。开始往后撤退。

辛追再也维持不住庞大的身体，血红色的触手萎缩。洛修似乎见怪不怪了，拿起刀剖开这些触手，从一团乱七八糟的血肉里扒出一具伤痕累累的躯体。洛修抱起辛追。

“6、5、4……”

辛追的皮肤不见了，像瘦削的红色人棍。畸变对他的代价也格外巨大。哪怕注射了基因药也需要很长一段时间修补。

看着他们的反应，相南里不由得松了一口气，看来他的计划还是很成功的。

系统的声音在此刻骤然尖锐：“相南里！”语气里还有藏不住的震惊。

相南里有些懵：“……嗯？”

系统厉声道：“离开，立刻，马上！”

“——3、2、1！”

地面裂开了纹路，大厅如同地震一样剧烈震动起来。

一条机械胳膊，从最中央的圆台里伸出。

这条银白色的手臂肉眼可见的巨大。

并不是完全的金属，底下能看见皮肉和缠绕的电线。

手臂撕开地面，一个同样巨大的人头从地底挤了出来。发出一声长啸：“喑——”

它的脑袋没有眼睛，只有裂开的嘴，嘴里是一排排尖牙，倒刺长在它的长长的舌头上。

但比起其他同类，这个怪物的头顶又多了一个个鼓包。就像是东皇重工之前在石壁上雕刻的佛像。只是更加畸形。却又有着一丝造物的神性。

它的身上连着一根根电线，这些电线对它的供能远大于束缚，也让它没有像是玻璃温室的同伴那样萎靡。

大概就是这些线路唤醒了它。不是说实验失败了吗？

还是潜行者搞了什么鬼？相南里想起了它刚刚叼走的尸体。

这是一头巨大的机械爬行者。
chunks.englishText:
Xin Zhui’s face, wrapped in tentacles, betrayed no expression, while the Knight Commander had begun to cough and laugh.

The Commander’s voice was weak, yet carried a faint, underlying provocation: "One for three—this trade... it’s not a loss, is it?"

Xin Zhui did not let go, yet he made no further move.

From behind him came Luo Xiu’s voice: "Xin Zhui, let go."

A look of unwillingness flickered across Xin Zhui’s expressionless face.

He rose slowly, not as if standing up, but as if the writhing tentacles were dragging his body upright.

The Inquisition members released their hostages.

Xiao Yan and Pu Ti supported the unconscious Rolling Stone, bringing him behind Xin Zhui.

The Knight Commander was surrounded by a group of Apocalypse Knights. His armor was shattered, with some shards even embedded into his flesh, causing secondary trauma.

A Black Knight produced a syringe and quickly jabbed it into his arm.

This serum was specifically formulated for genetically modified humans; they were prone to losing control after mutating, requiring both sedatives and nutritional supplements.

Luo Xiu also produced a syringe. Xin Zhui had handed it to him before the mutation took hold. He stroked the monster’s neck and carefully injected the blue serum. Though such tenderness was insufficient to ward off the pain.

Xin Zhui’s body convulsed twice. This was the aftereffect of the mutation; the repair serum contained analgesics, but due to his hyper-accelerated metabolism, the effects were minimal. No one could escape the lingering agony of mutation.

The scene fell into an eerie equilibrium. No one dared to advance, yet none were willing to retreat.

Xin Zhui still maintained his grotesque appearance, but anyone could see he had reached his limit.

Xiang Nanli knew it was his turn to act: "Alpha, giddy-up!"

Alpha sounded rather disdainful: "I am not a horse."

Despite the words, it acted in defiance of its own complaints.

In an instant, the mechanical soldiers, standing like terracotta warriors, emitted a synchronized startup hum.

From the mechs to the armored vehicles, the cleanup trucks, and even the drones—the energy cores on their surfaces all lit up with a halo of activation.

"Intruders detected," they spoke in perfect unison, like an invincible army, even though some were listing to the side from the previous battle and others had failed to start. "Cleanup protocol initiated! 10, 9, 8, 7..."

The Knight Commander clutched his chest, his expression shifting violently. He began to retreat.

Xin Zhui could no longer maintain his massive form; the blood-red tentacles withered. Luo Xiu, seemingly unfazed, took a blade to slice through the tentacles, digging a battered, scarred body out from the mess of flesh. Luo Xiu picked Xin Zhui up.

"6, 5, 4..."

Xin Zhui’s skin was gone, leaving him looking like a gaunt, red human trunk. The cost of the mutation was exceptionally high for him. Even with the genetic serum, it would take a long time to recover.

Watching their reaction, Xiang Nanli couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief. It seemed his plan was quite successful.

The System’s voice suddenly turned sharp: "Xiang Nanli!" There was unconcealable shock in its tone.

Xiang Nanli was a bit dazed: "...Hm?"

The System commanded sternly: "Leave! Now! Immediately!"

"—3, 2, 1!"

Cracks appeared on the ground, and the hall shook violently as if hit by an earthquake.

A mechanical arm reached out from the central circular platform.

This silver-white arm was visibly enormous.

It was not entirely metal; beneath the surface, flesh and tangled wires were visible.

The arm tore through the floor, and a head of equal size squeezed out from the depths. It let out a long, piercing howl: "Aaaah—"

Its head had no eyes, only a split mouth filled with rows of sharp teeth, with barbs growing along its long tongue.

But unlike its kin, the top of this monster’s head was covered in lumps. It looked like the Buddha statues Donghuang Heavy Industries had carved into the stone walls—only more deformed, yet possessing a trace of a creator's divinity.

Wires were connected to its body, providing power far greater than the restraints, which kept it from being as withered as its companions in the glass greenhouse.

These lines were likely what awakened it. Wasn't the experiment supposed to have failed?

Or had the Prowler done something? Xiang Nanli remembered the corpse it had just snatched away.

This was a massive Mechanical Crawler.

chunks.chineseText:
第20章

相南里之前在不知名实验员记录本上看见的设想，在这一刻居然变成了恐怖的现实。

机械爬行者，接受机械改造的畸变生物。两套改造系统在它的身体上同时运行着。

它既有畸变人强大的肉体和自愈能力，又有堪比黑科技的充沛火力。表面覆盖着一层银白的金属，底下是它多次改造后的身躯。

“我终于知道为什么外面的爬行者会往这个方向跑了。”小燕和菩提一起扛着昏迷的滚石，牙齿微微打颤，“这头爬行者……之前就苏醒了！”

爬行者拥有一项神奇的特性，也不知道是哪一轮基因突变导致的。

在爬行者快死的时候，它们能散发出一种特殊的信息素，用于吸引同类。

这股气味是在朝同类暗示：我快死了，要不要来吃掉我？

这既是一种奉献，也是博弈。

年轻的爬行者可能吞噬掉年迈却强大的爬行者，代替它在进化之路上走得更远。

苍老的爬行者也可能借此获得食物与新生。

只是他们没有检测到衰老爬行者，而且畸变人几乎没有冬眠期活动的先例，所以大家才否定了这个可能。

爬行者的身体还没有完全冒出头，它头顶的鼓包旋转着，蠕动到了正脸。

然后，它脸上的18个鼓包撑开了一条缝，这居然是爬行者的眼睛！

不规则排列的眼珠子四面八方地乱转，它脑袋前后都长着眼睛，像是在观察着什么。

它看向了黑骑士的方位，这群人身上有畸变人的味道。

黑色的眼眸亮起一团金黄、耀眼的强光。

这怪物居然从眼睛里喷出了激光柱！

有些脚程慢的天启骑士，一声不吭地在这样的光柱下变成一堆齑粉。只在地表留下一摊黑色烧糊的痕迹。

爬行者巨大的手臂从地缝中抽出，重重拍打在地上。

重量不够的物件被反震到半空，七零八落，包括正在疯狂逃窜的相南里。

这感觉就像是在走蹦床。他努力维持着平衡，熊孩子在旁边做跳跃运动。

让人想打熊孩子一拳，可惜他打不过。

相南里在地上打了个滚，朝着最近的大门一路狂奔：“Alpha！我都没出新手村，你就让我打这种关底BOSS，是不是有点过分啊？”

温室里的巨大体爬行者在完好状态下能有50级；这头机械爬行者起码80级。

Alpha解释：“当年实验室投票表决，以压倒性的优势通过了处死它的决定，我没发现它竟然还活着。”

会处死它的原因也很简单。

尽管在机械爬行者的脑海里植入了控制芯片，然而，人们依然没办法操控它。

这是一头彻底的、疯狂的怪物。

因为从小接受实验，对人类只有冰冷的恨意。

本不应该活着。

机械爬行者不断怒吼着，刚复苏就陷入了狂暴状态。而且周围的人型机械让它产生了强烈的应激反应。

它伸出胳膊，反复拍打、碾压着附近的机械人，甚至把它们高高举起，在手中捏成碎渣，然后一把丢进嘴里嚼烂。

爬行者咽着这些机械人，眼里居然流出血泪，喉管震颤着。

这头机械爬行者对人型生物表现出了强烈的恨意。也不知道当年东皇重工的职工到底对它干了什么丧心病狂的事。

这头爬行者大概率是没有潜行者那么聪明的，它分不清智人和机械人。

相南里连头都不敢回。机械爬行者的半边身体已经从地牢里钻了出来。背后是沉重的金属碰撞声。

它的长尾被一根铁柱贯穿，伤口早就愈合，血肉和铁柱黏合在一起，机械爬行者被死死地钉在地上。

但这毕竟是几百年前的东西了，机械爬行者的双臂抓住了地面，全身颤抖，用尽全力往前爬去。

“噗嗤”。这是血肉撕裂的声音，浓稠腥臭的血从它的尾巴上的伤口流出。

机械爬行者只有这条长尾没有金属覆盖，此时，这条尾巴正在以一种缓慢的速度从中间裂开。

这是常人无法想象的疼痛。

潜行者趴在天花板上冷眼旁观。

是的，这就是东皇重工制造出来的失败的怪物。

也许它们是同类。潜行者看着它，就像是看见自己命运的一条分支。

不过，这头怪物并不是它放出来的。如果可能，潜行者也不希望它出来。它叼走的尸体，是去喂了温室里的那些同伴。

它们朝夕相处，从培养皿就呆在一起，甚至母体都是用同一枚体细胞克隆的。再也没有比它们更亲近的关系了。

这头机械爬行者低智、根本没办法沟通；潜行者无法把它视为同伴。

它安静地看了一会，选择转身离去。潜行者意识到一件事，或许没有时间等着温室里的其他畸变人慢慢恢复了。

机械潜行者挣开束缚，第一件事就是补充能量。

还有什么比温室里的畸变人同伴更有营养？也许只剩下那两个误入的基因改造人。

……

……

相南里当初在两扇打开的大门里犹豫了0.5秒，最后选择跟着调查组跑。

毕竟黑十字审判庭看起来也太邪教了一点，且完全没办法沟通。

当然，他也没那么想和调查组的人碰面。要知道密钥的事还掰扯不清楚呢，他凑上前不是找死吗！

然而，这里的走廊设计位面过于复杂。

在瞎选了几次分叉口后，逃命中的相南里和同样逃命中的洛修不期而遇。

相遇的瞬间，双方都陷入高度戒备状态。

洛修背着血肉模糊的辛追，眼神瞬间锐利：“是你？！退后——！”

他骤然拔出腰侧的枪，枪口对准了相南里的眉心。

人们第一次看见洛修时，往往对他有一种误解。觉得他是个人狠话不多的大猛A，修的确不爱说话，但性格其实相当随和。

此时，洛修的敌意却丝毫不加掩饰。

原因一是辛追重伤昏迷，他需要保护辛追。偏偏他自己也是残废状态，新组装的机械身体战斗力极差，性能大打折扣。

原因二是相南里突然变得身份不明，疑点重重。

他这具身体还是相南里装好的。

相南里举起了双手，做出投降的姿势，示意自己人畜无害。

他后悔死了，自己当初为什么要手贱多给洛修多装一个武器模块，明明简陋地修好就够了。

完美主义害死人。

相南里观察着洛修的表情，迅速整理好思绪和从Alpha那得到的讯息，温和地开口：“很抱歉，密钥的确是我拿的。我不能让它落在外人手里。但现在情况有变，我们可以谈谈吗？”

地面传来微微的颤动。

机械爬行者的嘶吼声忽大忽小。虽然还没有挣脱束缚，但那也是早晚的事。

洛修的神色依然很紧张，他没有放下枪：“你想谈什么？”

辛追的血黏糊糊的，沾了洛修满身。还不断往下滴落着泥沙似的肉。

相南里略微切换了一下表情。
chunks.englishText:
The hypothesis Xiang Nanli had once seen in an unknown researcher’s notebook had, at this moment, become a terrifying reality.

A Mechanical Crawler: a mutated creature subjected to mechanical augmentation. Two systems of modification were running simultaneously within its body.

It possessed both the powerful flesh and self-healing abilities of a mutant, and the abundant firepower comparable to black technology. Its surface was covered in a layer of silver-white metal, beneath which lay a body that had undergone multiple modifications.

"I finally know why the Crawlers outside were running in this direction," Xiao Yan and Pu Ti said, carrying the unconscious Rolling Stone together, their teeth chattering slightly. "This Crawler... it woke up a long time ago!"

Crawlers possessed a miraculous trait, though it was unclear which round of genetic mutation had caused it.

When a Crawler was near death, it could emit a special pheromone to attract its own kind.

This scent was a signal to its peers: *I am dying; will you come and eat me?*

It was both an act of devotion and a gamble.

A young Crawler might devour an aged but powerful Crawler, replacing it to go further on the path of evolution.

An ancient Crawler might also use this to gain food and rebirth.

It was just that they hadn't detected any aged Crawlers, and there was almost no precedent for mutants being active during hibernation, which was why everyone had dismissed the possibility.

The Crawler’s body hadn't fully emerged yet, but the lumps on its head rotated, squirming toward its face.

Then, the 18 lumps on its face split open—they were actually the Crawler’s eyes!

The irregularly arranged eyeballs darted in all directions. It had eyes on both the front and back of its head, as if observing everything.

It looked toward the Black Knights' position; these people carried the scent of mutants.

A golden, dazzling light ignited in its black pupils.

The monster actually fired laser beams from its eyes!

Some Apocalypse Knights who were slow on their feet were reduced to a pile of powder under the light beams without a sound, leaving only a scorched black mark on the ground.

The Crawler’s massive arm pulled itself out of the floor crack and slammed heavily onto the ground.

Objects lacking sufficient weight were sent flying into the air, scattered in disarray, including Xiang Nanli, who was fleeing frantically.

It felt like walking on a trampoline. He struggled to maintain his balance while a "bear child" was doing jumping exercises nearby.

It made one want to punch the bear child, but unfortunately, he couldn't win.

Xiang Nanli rolled on the ground and sprinted toward the nearest gate: "Alpha! I haven't even left the newbie village, and you're making me fight this final boss? Isn't that a bit excessive?"

A giant Crawler in the greenhouse could reach Level 50 in perfect condition; this Mechanical Crawler was at least Level 80.

Alpha explained: "Back then, the laboratory held a vote, and the decision to execute it passed by an overwhelming majority. I didn't realize it was still alive."

The reason for its execution was simple.

Even though a control chip had been implanted in the Mechanical Crawler’s brain, people still couldn't control it.

It was a thorough, insane monster.

Because it had been subjected to experiments since it was young, it felt only cold hatred toward humanity.

It shouldn't have been alive.

The Mechanical Crawler roared incessantly, having fallen into a berserk state the moment it revived. Moreover, the surrounding humanoid machines triggered a strong stress response.

It stretched out its arms, repeatedly slapping and crushing nearby mechs, even lifting them high to squeeze them into scrap in its hands before tossing them into its mouth to chew.

As the Crawler swallowed these machines, blood-red tears actually flowed from its eyes, and its throat vibrated.

This Mechanical Crawler displayed intense hatred toward humanoid beings. One could only wonder what kind of insane things the employees of Donghuang Heavy Industries had done to it back then.

This Crawler was likely not as intelligent as the Prowler; it couldn't distinguish between humans and machines.

Xiang Nanli didn't even dare to look back. Half of the Mechanical Crawler’s body had already crawled out of the dungeon. Behind him was the sound of heavy metal colliding.

Its long tail had been pierced by an iron pillar; the wound had long since healed, with flesh and iron fused together, pinning the Mechanical Crawler firmly to the ground.

But this was something from hundreds of years ago. The Mechanical Crawler’s arms gripped the ground, its whole body trembling, using all its strength to crawl forward.

*Splat.* That was the sound of flesh tearing. Thick, foul-smelling blood flowed from the wound on its tail.

The Mechanical Crawler only lacked metal coverage on this long tail, and now, the tail was splitting down the middle at a slow pace.

It was a pain beyond human imagination.

The Prowler crouched on the ceiling, watching coldly.

Yes, this was the failed monster created by Donghuang Heavy Industries.

Perhaps they were of the same kind. The Prowler looked at it as if seeing a branch of its own fate.

However, this monster wasn't released by it. If possible, the Prowler didn't want it out either. The corpses it had snatched away were to feed its companions in the greenhouse.

They had lived together day and night, staying together since they were in petri dishes, and their host bodies were even cloned from the same somatic cell. There was no relationship closer than theirs.

This Mechanical Crawler was low-intelligence and impossible to communicate with; the Prowler couldn't view it as a companion.

It watched quietly for a while, then chose to turn and leave. The Prowler realized one thing: perhaps there was no time to wait for the other mutants in the greenhouse to slowly recover.

The Mechanical Prowler had broken free of its restraints, and its first order of business was to replenish energy.

What could be more nutritious than its mutant companions in the greenhouse? Perhaps only those two genetically modified humans who had wandered in.

...

...

Xiang Nanli had hesitated for 0.5 seconds between the two open doors, ultimately choosing to run with the investigation team.

After all, the Black Cross Inquisition looked far too much like a cult, and they were completely impossible to communicate with.

Of course, he didn't really want to run into the investigation team either. One had to know that the matter of the key was still unresolved; wouldn't he be courting death by approaching them?

However, the corridor design here was overly complex.

After blindly choosing a few forks, Xiang Nanli, who was fleeing for his life, ran into Luo Xiu, who was also fleeing.

The moment they met, both sides fell into a state of high alert.

Luo Xiu was carrying the blood-soaked Xin Zhui, his eyes turning sharp instantly: "You?! Back off—!"

He suddenly drew the gun at his waist, aiming the muzzle at the center of Xiang Nanli’s forehead.

When people first saw Luo Xiu, they often had a misunderstanding about him. They thought he was a ruthless, taciturn Alpha. Xiu indeed didn't like to talk, but his personality was actually quite easygoing.

At this moment, however, Luo Xiu’s hostility was undisguised.

The first reason was that Xin Zhui was severely injured and unconscious, and he needed to protect him. Yet he himself was in a crippled state, his newly assembled mechanical body having poor combat capability, its performance greatly compromised.

The second reason was that Xiang Nanli had suddenly become a person of unknown identity, full of suspicious points.

And this body of his had been assembled by Xiang Nanli himself.

Xiang Nanli raised his hands in a gesture of surrender, signaling that he was harmless.

He regretted it to death—why had his hands been so itchy, installing an extra weapon module for Luo Xiu? A simple, crude repair should have been enough.

Perfectionism kills.

Xiang Nanli observed Luo Xiu’s expression, quickly organizing his thoughts and the information he had received from Alpha, and spoke gently: "I am very sorry. The key was indeed taken by me. I couldn't let it fall into the hands of outsiders. But the situation has changed; can we talk?"

The ground transmitted a slight tremor.

The Mechanical Crawler’s roars fluctuated in volume. Although it hadn't broken free yet, it was only a matter of time.

Luo Xiu’s expression remained tense; he didn't lower his gun: "What do you want to talk about?"

Xin Zhui’s blood was sticky, covering Luo Xiu’s entire body. It kept dripping down like mud-like flesh.

Xiang Nanli slightly shifted his expression.

chunks.chineseText:
他生活在国外，周围都是白种人。在白人眼里，亚裔的外貌总是比实际年龄年轻。相南里三十多岁的时候，走在学校里还会被当成大学生。

看起来年轻，大多时候是个好事。可相南里年轻又貌美，这给他的商业谈判增加了很多麻烦。

所以相南里学会了一些伪装。伪装成符合大众想象的那一类精英人士。

利己、优雅、精致、傲慢。

“重新自我介绍一下。”他微笑道，“你把我从冷冻舱里带了出来，应该很清楚，我不属于这个时代。在进入冷冻舱前，我是东皇重工的机械研究组组长。”

洛修皱着眉质问：“那你为什么要叫相南里？！你是科研人员，难道还不知道这个名字的含义吗？”

相南里没想到洛修最关心的居然是这个狗屎问题。

真不愧是“白衣博士相南里”真爱粉。

相南里的内心充满吐槽，但脸上从容的神色没有丝毫改变：“因为，我是相南里的克隆人。所有人都叫我相南里，我没有别的名字。”

他略微垂下眼睑，挡住眼底复杂的神色：“那时候，相南里的冷冻舱还没有遗失。东皇重工花重金，从永生科技那里买来了相南里的体细胞。我是其中克隆最成功的那一个。”

“他们希望我拥有和相南里一样的智慧，可以完成东方青帝的制造。”相南里深吸一口气，“很可惜，我失败了。”

洛修的机械义眼分析着，随后道：“怪不得你机械维修技术不错，完全不是初学者的水平。”

相南里摊开手，圆形的密钥从他的手指间垂落：“我从你身上拿走了密钥，拿走的原理并不复杂，特殊波段磁共振。

“我参与了‘东方青帝’的制造。我认为，它和你看到的那头机械爬行者一样，都是失败之作，应该被尘封在历史中。我没有恶意，只是想阻止你们解封‘东方青帝’。”

相南里的说法很合理，逻辑通顺。

洛修一时之间竟然找不出什么明显的漏洞。

“但现在的情况你也看见了。这里是东皇重工的地下工厂，因为一些保密设计，出入口并不固定。短时间内，我们没办法从地底出去。这里就像是密室，而疯狂的机械爬行者会寻着气味，杀死活着的每一个人。而可能有一战之力的辛追和骑士长都是强弩之末。”

洛修的表情略有松动：“所以呢？”

相南里凝视着洛修的眼眸：“所以，我需要你协助我解封‘东方青帝’。我不想死在这里，我还要为东皇重工、和我当年的错误。”

相南里的目光突然变得很遥远，仿佛凝视着另一个时空。

他的唇轻颤道：“……赎罪。”
chunks.englishText:
He had lived abroad, surrounded by white people. In the eyes of white people, Asian features always looked younger than their actual age. When Xiang Nanli was in his thirties, he would still be mistaken for a college student while walking on campus.

Looking young was mostly a good thing. But Xiang Nanli was young and handsome, which added many troubles to his business negotiations.

So, Xiang Nanli had learned some camouflage. He disguised himself as the type of elite person that fit the public’s imagination.

Self-interested, elegant, refined, and arrogant.

"Let me reintroduce myself," he smiled. "You brought me out of the cryo-pod, so you should be very clear that I don't belong to this era. Before entering the cryo-pod, I was the head of the mechanical research group at Donghuang Heavy Industries."

Luo Xiu frowned and questioned: "Then why are you called Xiang Nanli?! You are a researcher; don't you know the meaning of this name?"

Xiang Nanli hadn't expected that what Luo Xiu cared about most was this bullshit question.

Truly worthy of being a die-hard fan of "Dr. Xiang Nanli in the White Coat."

Xiang Nanli was full of internal snark, but his calm expression didn't change in the slightest: "Because I am a clone of Xiang Nanli. Everyone calls me Xiang Nanli; I have no other name."

He lowered his eyelids slightly, blocking the complex look in his eyes: "At that time, Xiang Nanli’s cryo-pod hadn't been lost. Donghuang Heavy Industries spent a fortune to buy Xiang Nanli’s somatic cells from Eternal Technology. I was the most successful clone among them."

"They hoped I would possess the same wisdom as Xiang Nanli and be able to complete the manufacturing of the 'Eastern Azure Emperor'." Xiang Nanli took a deep breath. "Unfortunately, I failed."
