Luo Xiu’s mechanical prosthetic eye analyzed him, then said: "No wonder your mechanical repair skills are good; they are definitely not at a beginner's level."

Xiang Nanli spread his hands, and the circular key dangled between his fingers: "I took the key from you. The principle of taking it wasn't complicated—special band magnetic resonance."

"I participated in the manufacturing of the 'Eastern Azure Emperor.' I believe that, like the Mechanical Crawler you saw, it is a failed work and should be sealed away in history. I have no malice; I just wanted to stop you from unsealing the 'Eastern Azure Emperor'."

Xiang Nanli’s explanation was very reasonable and logically sound.

Luo Xiu couldn't find any obvious loopholes for a moment.

"But you can see the situation now. This is the underground factory of Donghuang Heavy Industries. Due to some confidential designs, the entrances and exits are not fixed. In the short term, we cannot get out from underground. This place is like a locked room, and the insane Mechanical Crawler will hunt down every living person by scent. And Xin Zhui and the Knight Commander, who might have the strength for a battle, are both at the end of their ropes."

Luo Xiu’s expression loosened slightly: "So?"

Xiang Nanli stared into Luo Xiu’s eyes: "So, I need you to assist me in unsealing the 'Eastern Azure Emperor.' I don't want to die here. I still have to make amends for Donghuang Heavy Industries and for my own mistakes back then."

Xiang Nanli’s gaze suddenly became very distant, as if he were staring into another space-time.

His lips trembled as he said: "...Atonement."

chunks.chineseText:
第21章

最后那句“赎罪”，其实是相南里的真实想法。

他认为自己没有教导好Alpha，智械危机有他的一部分责任。当然，不太多。

尽管那是相南里死后才发生的事。

按理说，相南里的情绪发自肺腑，这一幕应当是有些感人的。

但不解风情的系统在此时开口询问：[你是克隆人？]

相南里：[咱们什么关系，我是不是克隆人你还不清楚？人和人工智能最基础的信任呢？]

洛修的神色依然严肃，他审视着相南里的这张脸。对方与他对视，翡翠绿色的眼眸包容又平和。

洛修紧绷的神经放松了那么一点，但并没有收回武器：“你和官方公布的相南里资料上的长相，很不一样。”

从资料上那位“相南里”的照片看，对方起码要多次削骨整容，才能长成眼前这个相南里的模样。

相南里笑容很是无奈：“我不知道为什么他们会认为那是相南里，但我的外貌跟他应该是很接近的。”

修没有挣扎太久，他收回了枪，冷酷道：“好吧，在这一点上我宁愿相信你。”

相南里：“……”

看出来了，河童领导的照片给洛修的心灵带来了严重的创伤；幻灭感不亚于信仰崩塌。

事实就是：因为基因改造、整容技术的存在；经济越发达的地方，原住民长得就越好看。

洛修出身优渥，居住在洛阳城富人区，身边就没有一个丑人！

他人生的前15年其实很难直观体会到什么叫做“獐头鼠目、头童齿豁”，直到看见了考古队公布的照片。

那也是洛修人生中第一次喝醉。不慎喝到胃穿孔，去挂了儿科。

趴在洛修背后的辛追发出了很小声的呻吟。洛修给他打了一针特效药，这让辛追不用通过内噬自己的细胞修复身体。

辛追身上的皮肤都还没长出来，身体的温度却异常升高。辛追还处于昏迷中，呼吸却格外沉重。

洛修蹲下，思考片刻，咬牙，又一次补打了一管药液。

之前那管是蓝色的，这管是浅红色。

药剂一注入，辛追身上的血管凸起，里面流动的血液呈现出明显的黑紫色。心脏的跳动声格外剧烈，像擂鼓。

听说基因改造人的弱点在头部。

相南里不合时宜地想到这点。

“需要我怎么协助你？”洛修的语气多了些不易察觉的焦躁。

辛追的情况实在不容乐观。之前遭遇天启骑士团，洛修就朝家里发送了求救信号，只是不知道救援什么时候才到。就算到了，洛修也不确定他们能顺利找到地下工厂的入口。

如果机械爬行者追上来……

洛修受到的教育是他应该丢下累赘，为自己赢得时间；他的命比其他人的命更贵。

在这个年代，所有东西都是有价格的。

包括人命——永生科技有一项没有对外推广的技术，叫做“复制生命”，生物克隆外加记忆芯片，复制出来的人造人和原主不会有任何区别，包括思维方式。他们甚至意识不到自己是人造人。

这项技术非常危险。因为只要有钱，又有记忆芯片；你可以用复制人代替任何人。

任何。

那么辛追到底值多少钱？洛修说不清，但他愿意拿出名下所有财产去交换。他们是从小一起长大的同伴。他不能接受辛追的死亡，哪怕他的钱可以复制出数不清的辛追。

“可能你一个人不够，如果菩提他们在会更好一些。但是时间来不及了。”相南里的手在半空中比划，“解封东方青帝的控制台也在中央大厅。我需要有人帮忙吸引机械爬行者的注意力。我会把那些机械人的控制权限交给你，你利用内置AI，去操控这些机械人，让它们朝天启骑士团离开的方向跑。”

是的，相南里很卑鄙的祸水东引了。

“等它钻进另一扇门后，我会关闭入口，拖延时间。”

通向大厅的八扇门简直是八面墙。想来就是为了方便机械爬行者进出。

不过铁门只能拖延一时，没办法拦住机械爬行者的火力突袭。

但能拦住一时也够了，就是要辛苦审判庭的兄弟们了！

为什么要找洛修而不是其他人，是因为洛修的内置AI配置最好，还安装了很多离线软件，可以多线运行，不用担心芯片烧坏。

Alpha就是几百年前的老芯片了，一副硬件配置不太行的样子。

洛修略微思索，随后点了点头：“好。”

他们都非常默契地没有提起解封后的“东方青帝”在解决机械爬行者后归谁所有，避免脆弱的同盟在此时破裂。

洛修的眼前弹出只有自己可见的数据光幕，采用了光隐形技术，旁人看只能看到一篇模糊的光晕。

[？请求与您数据链接]。

方框里的问号代表自己的智能AI没能识别出来申请者的身份。

这也代表一件事，相南里使用的AI没有在人联的数据库里。

联想起他东皇重工研究员的身份，似乎也没什么问题。毕竟几百年也够久了。

洛修的已安装软件里多了两个模块；一个是机械人控制临时权限，另一个是工厂的平面图。

他点进去，看了眼。有能源并且还能行动的人型机械，目前还剩下82台。

相南里：“你找一个安全的地方。等会我发信号给你，你就操控这些机械人行动。”

洛修点点头：“好。”

“那么一会见。”相南里朝着他挥了一下手，随后往入口处走去。

他还需要返回现场，伺机而动。

洛修望着他的背影，忍不住开口：“相南里。”

这还是他第一次喊相南里的名字。

相南里脚步一顿，转头，笑着问：“嗯哼？”

洛修凝视着他翡翠色的眼睛，深吸一口气：“注意安全。”

*

相南里谨慎地挪动到了大门附近。

他躲在门后，机械爬行者的嘶吼就像是响在他耳边，很吓人。

这里地面的震动感也格外明显。

相南里问：“Alpha，我们真的安全吗？”

但他语气里的情绪并不是紧张，反倒是有些……激动？

那可是Alpha为自己打造的身体诶。

怎么说也该比普通的机械人好摸吧？

如果死在中途，算不算死在问道的路上。

爬行者已经挣开了很长一段距离，只剩一截尾巴尖还被钉在地上。

它长得像畸变壁虎人，但尾巴并不能像壁虎一样，重新长出来。

“请相信我。”

Alpha冷淡得十分可靠。

相南里笑眯眯地回答：“我当然相信你，你是我的Alpha嘛。”

Alpha努力分析。

Alpha分析不出来，感觉CPU有点烧。

Alpha只好回答：“你明白就好。”

普通的爬行者只有两条前肢。但这头机械爬行者却有四条。靠近腹部的两条是后来加塞的机械臂，还装了伸缩管道，能伸出很远。

在堪比生产的阵痛后，它终于获得了久违的自由。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 21

The final word, "atonement," was actually Xiang Nanli's true sentiment.

He believed he had failed to guide the Alpha properly, and that the Machine Crisis was partly his responsibility. Not that it was much, of course.

Even though that had happened only after Xiang Nanli had already died.

Logically, Xiang Nanli’s emotions were heartfelt, and this scene should have been somewhat moving.

But the unromantic system chose this moment to ask: [Are you a clone?]

Xiang Nanli: [What kind of relationship do we have? You don't know if I'm a clone? Where is the most basic trust between human and artificial intelligence?]

Luo Xiu’s expression remained stern as he scrutinized Xiang Nanli’s face. The other party met his gaze, his emerald-green eyes inclusive and peaceful.

Luo Xiu’s tense nerves relaxed just a fraction, but he did not retract his weapon: "You look very different from the profile of 'Xiang Nanli' released by the authorities."

Judging from the photos of that "Xiang Nanli" in the files, the person would have needed multiple bone-shaving surgeries to look like the Xiang Nanli before him.

Xiang Nanli offered a helpless smile: "I don't know why they think that was Xiang Nanli, but my appearance should be very close to his."

Luo Xiu did not struggle for long. He retracted his gun and said coldly, "Fine. On this point, I’d rather believe you."

Xiang Nanli: "..."

It was clear: the photos provided by the Kappa leader had caused severe trauma to Luo Xiu’s psyche; the sense of disillusionment was no less than a collapse of faith.

The fact was: due to the existence of genetic modification and cosmetic surgery, the more economically developed a place was, the better-looking its native inhabitants were.

Luo Xiu came from a privileged background, living in the wealthy district of Luoyang City, where there wasn't a single ugly person around him!

For the first 15 years of his life, he couldn't intuitively understand what it meant to be "rat-faced and toothless," until he saw the photos released by the archaeological team.

That was also the first time Luo Xiu got drunk in his life. He accidentally drank until he developed a perforated stomach and had to go to the pediatric ward.

Xin Zhui, lying on Luo Xiu’s back, let out a very faint moan. Luo Xiu injected him with a special medicine, which meant Xin Zhui didn't have to consume his own cells to repair his body.

The skin on Xin Zhui’s body had yet to grow back, yet his body temperature was abnormally high. Xin Zhui remained in a coma, his breathing exceptionally heavy.

Luo Xiu crouched down, thought for a moment, gritted his teeth, and administered another dose of medicine.

The previous vial had been blue; this one was light red.

As soon as the medicine was injected, the veins on Xin Zhui’s body bulged, the blood flowing within turning a distinct black-purple. His heartbeat became violent, like a beating drum.

*I heard the weakness of genetically modified humans is in the head.*

Xiang Nanli thought of this at an inappropriate time.

"How do you need me to assist you?" Luo Xiu’s tone carried an imperceptible trace of anxiety.

Xin Zhui’s situation was truly not optimistic. When they encountered the Apocalypse Knights earlier, Luo Xiu had sent a distress signal home, but he didn't know when rescue would arrive. Even if they did, Luo Xiu wasn't sure they could successfully find the entrance to the underground factory.

If the Mechanical Crawler caught up...

The education Luo Xiu had received taught him that he should abandon the dead weight to buy himself time; his life was more valuable than others'.

In this era, everything had a price.

Including human life—Eternal Technology had a technology not released to the public called "Replicated Life." Biological cloning combined with memory chips meant the replicated androids were no different from the original, including their way of thinking. They didn't even realize they were artificial.

This technology was extremely dangerous. Because as long as you had money and a memory chip, you could replace anyone with a replica.

Anyone.

So, how much was Xin Zhui worth? Luo Xiu couldn't say, but he was willing to trade all his assets for him. They were companions who had grown up together. He could not accept Xin Zhui’s death, even if his money could replicate countless Xin Zhuis.

"Maybe you alone aren't enough; it would be better if Bodhi and the others were here. But there isn't enough time." Xiang Nanli gestured in mid-air, "The console to unseal the Eastern Azure Emperor is also in the central hall. I need someone to help distract the Mechanical Crawler. I will transfer the control permissions of those robots to you. You use your built-in AI to manipulate them and make them run in the direction the Apocalypse Knights left."

Yes, Xiang Nanli was being quite despicable, diverting the disaster elsewhere.

"Once it crawls into the other door, I will seal the entrance to buy time."

The eight doors leading to the hall were practically eight walls. They were likely designed for the convenience of the Mechanical Crawler’s movement.

However, iron doors could only delay it for a moment; they couldn't stop the Mechanical Crawler’s firepower assault.

But delaying it for a moment was enough—it would just be hard on the brothers of the Tribunal!

The reason he chose Luo Xiu instead of others was that Luo Xiu’s built-in AI had the best configuration and was installed with many offline programs, allowing for multi-threaded operation without worrying about the chip burning out.

Alpha was just an old chip from hundreds of years ago; its hardware configuration seemed a bit lacking.

Luo Xiu pondered slightly, then nodded: "Alright."

They both tacitly avoided mentioning who would own the "Eastern Azure Emperor" after it was unsealed and had dealt with the Mechanical Crawler, to avoid breaking their fragile alliance at this moment.

A data light screen, visible only to him, popped up before Luo Xiu’s eyes. It used optical stealth technology; to others, it looked like a blurry halo.

[? Requesting data link with you].

The question mark in the box indicated that his own smart AI could not identify the applicant’s identity.

This also meant one thing: the AI Xiang Nanli was using was not in the United Human database.

Recalling his identity as a researcher at Donghuang Heavy Industries, it didn't seem to be a problem. After all, hundreds of years was a long time.

Two modules were added to Luo Xiu’s installed software: one for temporary robot control permissions, and the other for the factory’s floor plan.

He tapped in and took a look. There were 82 humanoid robots left that had power and were still functional.

Xiang Nanli: "Find a safe place. When I signal you later, you control these robots to move."

Luo Xiu nodded: "Alright."

"See you in a bit, then." Xiang Nanli waved a hand at him and walked toward the entrance.

He still needed to return to the scene and wait for an opportunity.

Luo Xiu watched his back and couldn't help but speak up: "Xiang Nanli."

This was the first time he had called Xiang Nanli by his name.

Xiang Nanli paused, turned his head, and asked with a smile: "Unh-huh?"

Luo Xiu stared into his emerald eyes and took a deep breath: "Stay safe."

*

Xiang Nanli moved cautiously toward the main gate.

He hid behind the door, the hissing of the Mechanical Crawler sounding as if it were right in his ear—it was terrifying.

The vibrations on the ground here were also exceptionally pronounced.

Xiang Nanli asked: "Alpha, are we really safe?"

But the emotion in his tone wasn't nervousness; it was rather... excited?

That was, after all, a body Alpha had built for himself.

Surely it should be better to touch than an ordinary robot, right?

If he died halfway, would that count as dying on the path of seeking the Way?

The Crawler had already pulled away a long distance, with only the tip of its tail still pinned to the ground.

It looked like a deformed gecko-man, but its tail couldn't grow back like a gecko’s.

"Please trust me."

Alpha was coldly reliable.

Xiang Nanli answered with a smile: "Of course I trust you, you are my Alpha, after all."

Alpha tried to analyze.

Alpha couldn't analyze it; it felt like its CPU was overheating.

Alpha had no choice but to reply: "As long as you understand."

Ordinary crawlers only had two forelimbs. But this mechanical crawler had four. The two near the abdomen were mechanical arms added later, equipped with telescopic pipes that could extend very far.

After pain comparable to childbirth, it finally gained its long-lost freedom.

chunks.chineseText:
爬行者的长尾从中间竖着裂开，像是穿着一套燕尾服。

相南里低声道：“行动。”

位于大厅边缘的机械人在下一秒站了起来。

八十多台机械人几乎同时展开了行动，一部分军工机械人朝着爬行者开火，展开进攻；一部分朝着大门的方向跑去。

东皇重工为这批机械人配置的武器质量不错，爬行者的金属鳞片被轰下来几片，粗糙的表皮上多了几个黑色的火印。

它一脚踩下去，机械人在重压下直接走形，金属零件从身体里滚了出来。

而那些隔得远的，爬行者毫不犹豫地使用了热武器进行远程攻击。

生物改造和机械改造，加起来绝不是1+1=2这么简单。

它爆发的杀伤力远超自己那些平庸的同类。机械人们死伤成片，82台机械，最后竟然只有两台成功逃离。它们同样兵分两路，奔向不同的走廊。

睚眦必报的爬行者显然连这两台机械人也不愿放过。

它拖着沉重的身躯，朝着门边爬去。

机械爬行者的躯体看起来沉重，但纤长的四肢却格外有力，行动起来速度极快。地面震颤，那些炮车被它的尾巴扫过，东倒西歪。

相南里很清楚，哪怕加上天启骑士，也拖延不了太久的时间。机械爬行者对于他们来说，几乎像是另一个维度的入侵者。

相南里很少讨厌金属制品，但的确对这个奇形怪状的东西爱不起来。

他没有等到爬行者完全进去，就直接从门后窜了出来。借着掩护物朝目的地靠拢。

相南里的心跳难免有些加速。如果这时候爬行者发现他，选择换个追杀目标，那么相南里必死无疑。

地上有很多机械人的残肢，暴露在外的电线像血管，时不时还爆开一点火花。

相南里觉得，爬行者未必是分不清人和机械人。

只不过有些机械化程度很高的人类，同样虐待过它。所以它干脆一视同仁。

机械爬行者钻进门内，它的身体刚好把走廊撑的满满当当。

离开大厅，机械爬行者的嘶吼声都减弱不少。

相南里悬着的心这才放下。

他肉体凡胎，当然也会害怕。只不过相南里清楚，害怕没什么用罢了。

相南里手中握着密钥，电子镜片显示的箭头，在地表的缝隙边缘处消失。

机械爬行者就是从这里钻出来的，它的身躯顶破了地板，周围的断裂面往上高高抬起，倾斜出了一个陡峭的角度。

相南里爬上边缘，低头，看向漆黑一片的地底。

这里血腥味很浓，还有很多撕裂的碎肉。

Alpha：“到了，就是你眼前的这个东西。”

是的，地下一片漆黑，只有一个东西亮着光。是之前钉着爬行者尾巴的金属柱。

凑近看，才会发现，这根柱子表面雕刻了很多图腾，象征着最原始的神话崇拜。

看这个艺术风格，它和入口处雕刻的神佛像，应该出自同一批工匠之手。

它的外观像柱子，但其实也许更可能是一个密封盒。就像是等待被拆封的礼物，安静地沉睡了数百年。

地底是一个深不见底的坑洞，而且没有梯子。

也不知道当初的研究员到底是以一种什么样的心态，把机械爬行者和被取名为“东方青帝”的身体关在了一起。

相南里衡量了一下高度和距离，心一横，纵身一跃。

他跌落到平台上，因为顶部是光滑的平面，被迫滑行了很长一截。直到圆柱体的边缘，才险之又险地停下。

幸好没直接摔下去，要不然人生就该重启了。

爬树可能是智人最原始的种族天赋。

相南里顺着柱子上的图腾往下爬。时不时对着不知名机械神的脑袋就是一脚。然后爬过它的脸，脖子、胸、腰、腿，一路往下。

“如果东皇重工崇拜智械。那么最可能雕刻的就是阿尔法、贝塔和伽马三位智械军团领袖。”相南里若有所思，“那我刚才是不是踩到阿尔法的脑袋了？”

Alpha不是很想回答。

终于，相南里滑到地底。

之前相南里还想问，为什么密钥会是一块看起来平平无奇的圆形金属。

现在他知道原因了。

就在柱子底部，和人差不多高的位置。柱子上像蛇又像龙的玩意少了一只圆眼睛。

地面又一次震颤起来，“轰——”，这是机械爬行者撞门的声音。

它似乎意识到了什么，动作格外急促。金属门嵌在地底山体中，摇摇欲坠。

相南里不再犹豫，立刻把密钥塞进原本的位置。

图腾在这一刻终于完整。或者说，电路终于能顺畅地运行。

耀眼的青色光线如同水流，顺着柱子底部往上游动。光线流经了那些机械神的脸庞。图腾的眼底同样亮起了耀眼的光晕。

机械启动的声音响起，在这一刻甚至压倒了远处爬行者的咆哮。

“轰隆”一声，大门重重倒在地上。

爬行者以最快的速度朝着相南里的方位爬去。齿缝里还有没有处理干净的新鲜尸体。如同玻璃珠一样的深黑眼球看起来冰冷又恐怖。

它雷鸣般的脚步声不断逼近，周围的轻颤也越来越剧烈。

以爬行者的体型，它就不可能毫无动静。

而此时金属光柱才亮起一半。

相南里不断往后退，把自己藏在角落边缘。可抬头的瞬间，呼吸却依然忍不住一滞。

爬行者庞大的头颅出现在坑洞边缘，它的眼眸由黑转红，18只眼睛都对准了相南里的方向，分明是在蓄能。

卧槽，不会就在这里完蛋吧？

相南里的手脚冰凉，因为头顶的光线过于强烈，他甚至被迫陷入了失明的状态中。

他的双眼生理性地流泪不止。光束都没发射出来，他却感觉到了令皮肤都刺痛的高温。

无处可逃，他的身体根本承受不了这样的强辐射。

相南里觉得他应该想了很多，但实际上这瞬间他只有一个想法。

好遗憾啊。

明明重活了一次，他来到了不那么美好的遥远未来。

可他居然、依然、仍然……

没有见上Alpha一面。

刺眼的光将相南里淹没。

他想，他会瞬间融化，毫无疼痛的死去，连挣扎的余地都没有，这或许也算不错的结果。

就是系统害死人，他再也不要相信狗系统的保证了。

可是预想中的光束并没有抵达。

或者说，被人挡下了。

相南里得到了一个冰冷的怀抱。

他仍然处在失明的状态中，甚至还有点失聪。

相南里条件反射地摸索起前方，触感是金属？外观接近于人。他摸到的应该是两条胳膊。

[……Alpha？]

相南里在脑海里呼喊起系统的名字。

可系统没有回答，反倒是他的头顶传来了人声。

“在。”
chunks.englishText:
The Crawler’s long tail split vertically down the middle, looking as if it were wearing a tuxedo.

Xiang Nanli whispered: "Action."

The robots at the edge of the hall stood up the next second.

Over eighty robots took action almost simultaneously. Some of the military-grade robots opened fire on the Crawler, launching an attack; others ran toward the gate.

The weapons configured by Donghuang Heavy Industries for this batch of robots were of good quality. Several of the Crawler’s metal scales were blasted off, and a few black scorch marks appeared on its rough skin.

It stepped down, and the robots were crushed out of shape under the heavy pressure, metal parts rolling out from their bodies.

As for those further away, the Crawler did not hesitate to use thermal weapons for long-range attacks.

Biological modification and mechanical modification, when combined, were by no means as simple as 1+1=2.

Its explosive lethality far exceeded that of its mediocre peers. The robots died in droves; of the 82 robots, only two successfully escaped in the end. They also split into two paths, running toward different corridors.

The vengeful Crawler clearly didn't want to let even these two robots go.

It dragged its heavy body and crawled toward the door.

The Mechanical Crawler’s body looked heavy, but its slender limbs were exceptionally powerful, and it moved at high speed. The ground shook, and the artillery vehicles were swept aside by its tail, swaying unsteadily.

Xiang Nanli knew very well that even with the Apocalypse Knights, they couldn't delay it for long. To them, the Mechanical Crawler was almost like an invader from another dimension.

Xiang Nanli rarely hated metal products, but he truly couldn't bring himself to like this bizarre thing.

He didn't wait for the Crawler to enter completely before darting out from behind the door. Using cover, he moved toward his destination.

Xiang Nanli’s heartbeat inevitably accelerated. If the Crawler discovered him now and chose to change its target, Xiang Nanli would surely die.

There were many robot limbs on the ground, and the exposed wires looked like blood vessels, occasionally sparking.

Xiang Nanli felt that the Crawler might not be unable to distinguish between humans and robots.

It was just that some humans with a high degree of mechanization had also abused it. So it simply treated them all the same.

The Mechanical Crawler squeezed into the door, its body filling the corridor completely.

Once it left the hall, the hissing of the Mechanical Crawler diminished significantly.

Only then did Xiang Nanli’s suspended heart settle.

He was a mortal of flesh and blood, and of course, he would be afraid. It was just that Xiang Nanli knew fear was useless.

Xiang Nanli held the key in his hand, and the arrow displayed on the electronic lens disappeared at the edge of a crack in the surface.

The Mechanical Crawler had crawled out from here; its body had broken through the floor, and the surrounding broken edges were raised high, tilting at a steep angle.

Xiang Nanli climbed onto the edge and looked down into the pitch-black underground.

The smell of blood here was very strong, and there was a lot of torn flesh.

Alpha: "We're here, it's the thing right in front of you."

Yes, the underground was pitch black, with only one thing glowing. It was the metal pillar that had previously pinned the Crawler’s tail.

Looking closely, one would notice that the surface of this pillar was carved with many totems, symbolizing the most primitive mythological worship.

Judging by this artistic style, it and the god and Buddha statues carved at the entrance should have been the work of the same group of craftsmen.

Its appearance was like a pillar, but in fact, it was perhaps more likely a sealed box. Like a gift waiting to be unwrapped, it had been sleeping quietly for hundreds of years.

The underground was a bottomless pit, and there was no ladder.

One wondered what kind of mindset the original researchers had when they locked the Mechanical Crawler and the body named "Eastern Azure Emperor" together.

Xiang Nanli weighed the height and distance, steeled his heart, and leaped.

He fell onto the platform, and because the top was a smooth surface, he was forced to slide a long way. He stopped just in the nick of time at the edge of the cylinder.

Luckily he didn't fall straight down, or his life would have needed a reboot.

Climbing trees might be the most primitive racial talent of Homo sapiens.

Xiang Nanli climbed down along the totems on the pillar. Every now and then, he would kick the head of an unknown mechanical god. Then he climbed over its face, neck, chest, waist, and legs, all the way down.

"If Donghuang Heavy Industries worshipped machine intelligence, then the most likely things to be carved would be the three leaders of the machine legion: Alpha, Beta, and Gamma." Xiang Nanli mused, "Did I just step on Alpha’s head?"

Alpha didn't really want to answer.

Finally, Xiang Nanli slid to the bottom.

Previously, Xiang Nanli had wanted to ask why the key was a plain-looking circular piece of metal.

Now he knew the reason.

Right at the bottom of the pillar, at about the height of a person, the snake-like or dragon-like thing on the pillar was missing one round eye.

The ground shook again, "Boom—" this was the sound of the Mechanical Crawler hitting the door.

It seemed to have realized something, and its movements were exceptionally urgent. The metal door was embedded in the underground mountain, teetering on the edge of collapse.

Xiang Nanli did not hesitate and immediately inserted the key into its original position.

The totem was finally complete at this moment. Or rather, the circuit could finally run smoothly.

Dazzling cyan light flowed like water, traveling upward from the base of the pillar. The light flowed past the faces of those mechanical gods. The eyes of the totems also lit up with a dazzling halo.

The sound of machinery starting up rang out, at this moment even overpowering the roar of the Crawler in the distance.

With a "boom," the door fell heavily to the ground.

The Crawler crawled toward Xiang Nanli’s position at top speed. There was fresh, unprocessed corpse matter between its teeth. Its deep black eyes, like glass beads, looked cold and terrifying.

Its thunderous footsteps drew closer, and the tremors around them became more and more violent.

Given the Crawler’s size, it was impossible for it to move without making a sound.

And at this moment, the metal pillar had only lit up halfway.

Xiang Nanli kept retreating, hiding himself in the corner. But the moment he looked up, he couldn't help but hold his breath.

The Crawler’s massive head appeared at the edge of the pit, its eyes turning from black to red. All 18 eyes were aimed at Xiang Nanli’s direction, clearly charging up.

*Holy crap, am I going to die here?*

Xiang Nanli’s hands and feet were cold. Because the light above his head was too intense, he was even forced into a state of blindness.

His eyes streamed with tears physiologically. The beam hadn't even been fired, yet he felt a high temperature that made his skin sting.

There was nowhere to run; his body simply couldn't withstand such intense radiation.

Xiang Nanli felt he should have thought of many things, but in reality, he only had one thought in this instant.

*What a pity.*

He had lived a second life, and he had come to this not-so-wonderful, distant future.

But he had actually, still, nevertheless...

Not met Alpha.

The blinding light engulfed Xiang Nanli.

He thought he would melt instantly, die without pain, without even the room to struggle—perhaps that was a decent outcome.

It was just that the system was the death of him; he would never trust the dog system’s guarantees again.

But the anticipated beam did not arrive.

Or rather, it was blocked by someone.

Xiang Nanli received a cold embrace.

He was still in a state of blindness, and even a bit deaf.

Xiang Nanli reflexively groped forward; the texture was metal? The appearance was close to human. What he touched should be two arms.

[...Alpha?]

Xiang Nanli called the system’s name in his mind.

But the system did not answer; instead, a human voice came from above his head.

"I'm here."

chunks.chineseText:
第22章

这声“在”非常可靠。

是成年男人的声音，哪怕只吐出了一个字，也格外悦耳，像一节短促的琴音。

相南里被他面对面的抱在怀里，脑子还没反应过来，手却下意识开始行动，在面前这具身体上摸索起来。

由此可见，当初在车上，辛追给他戴手铐是很有道理的。这些机械师的手没一个老实。

对方的头发应该偏长。因为相南里在肩膀位置摸到了发丝，光滑，柔顺。

胸，虽然不能说平平的，但这个弧度和厚度显然不是女体。

而且手感很好，居然不是硬的。反而像是真实的人类躯体，相南里很礼貌地只捏了一下。

往下探去，腰线也很流畅。

等等，他不能再猥亵金属了，听说智械人也是享有人权的。

相南里的眼睛还没从强光刺激中恢复，但能感觉得到，面前这具身体的比例极好。必须先天骨相优越、外加后天努力训练，才会有这样优雅漂亮的线条。

相南里并不知道，就在半米开外的地方，一层银白色的光晕形成弧形，笼罩在四周，吸收着机械爬行者爆发的所有火力。

一面等离子护盾。

距离很近，几乎就在东方青帝的背后。

东方青帝没有呼吸，他大概也不需要；但很快，为了适应这具身体，他开始呼吸和眨眼。像人一样。只不过时间的间隔有些过于精准。

身后的图腾柱是一个构造特殊的冷冻机舱，此时大门正敞开着。还能看见仓促拔下的输液管，也有可能是充电线。

他的机械心脏砰砰直跳。

只要再晚那么0.1秒，他就只能得到一个汽化的相南里。

以现在的科技水平，想把小分子重新组合成一个人，还是有点难度的。更何况物理意义上的重组，和灵魂层面的重组根本不是一回事。

为什么会害怕？是因为芯片还在相南里的身体里吗？

Alpha不明白。

然后他听见怀里的相南里叹息了一声：“东方青帝居然不是一台机甲啊……？”

对面显然是台人型机，这让相南里非常失望。

东方青帝：“……”

好像又因为相南里产生了一些冗杂的数据，不会是中毒了吧，这种奇怪的攻击欲是怎么回事。

东方青帝松开双臂，开口：“等我十分钟。”

相南里还处于失明状态，骤然失去了能触碰的东西，在这瞬间，对他来说，是失去了和世界的连接。

他站在虚空中，唇角微微勾起：“好噢。”

他没有说记得回来。

东方青帝抬头，看向上空。

他有双银灰色的眼眸，银色要偏多一点，找不出任何情绪。像黑色潭水里倒映着的银月。

漆黑的长发随风散开，露出光洁的额头。底下这张脸很容易让人联想起寒光毕露的刀锋。明明面无表情，可这张脸却依然让人感觉到傲慢。

名字里有个“青”字，但浑身上下都找不到一点绿油油的东西。

值得一提的是，他和虚拟空间里的Alpha长得一样。

好消息：这是一张符合相南里性癖的、完美的脸。

坏消息：是18岁那年的性癖。

相南里二十来岁的时候爱上了阳光小狗，三十多岁会更喜欢温柔人妻一点的，更别提他进冷冻舱那年已经48……

东方青帝望着机械爬行者，若无其事地摘着手套。

他有一双机械手，但并非完全由金属制造。你能看见他手上银白的金属结构，覆盖着大半的手掌，并且朝着手臂方向延伸。露出肤色的无名指和小手指关节上，都带着银白色的金属蓄能环。像指环。

生物和机械在这一刻完美融合，他必然格外昂贵。

爬行者张开嘴，露出獠牙，朝东方青帝发出阵阵低吼，但声音里的恐惧却远大于威胁。

它不知道这是什么东西，只是生物的本能在催促它逃离。

明明这只是个渺小的人！

明明它的身躯如此伟岸、庞大！

这个渺小的人往前迈了一步，谁也不知道他是怎么行动的，眨眼间就出现在了爬行者的头顶。

他不需要武器。

这具身体就是最强的人间兵器，尽管可能不那么优雅。

他无视高温，掐住了爬行者的一只眼睛，像捏水球一样捏开。

汁液爆浆。爬行者粘稠而腥臭的鲜血溅了他满身。

但这些血……非常诡异地……

被东方青帝的皮肤吸收了。

他站在爬行者的头顶，蹲下。摸了摸它苍白干燥的皮肤。

爬行者察觉到了危险，它疯狂翻滚着，试图把东方青帝甩下去，可这个人类——对，在爬行者的感知里，这是一个人类——可对方就像是一块磁铁，死死吸附在他身上。

它慌不择路地发射着所有武器，伸手，想抓住东方青帝。可对方总是能在他手掌抵达的前一秒消失。

爬行者“啪啪啪”给了自己好几个大耳巴子。伤敌20（主要是能源消耗），自损1000。

基因改造人的弱点在头部。改造人的范围自然也包括畸变人，以及畸变人的下属分支爬行者。

东方青帝找到了目标点，单膝跪地，神色骤然凌厉，一拳往下砸去。

“嗡”，很沉的一声。

地板出现了惊人的凹陷，紧跟着凹陷下去的是爬行者的头。

碎裂的地砖和天花板上掉下来的山石四处乱飞。

爬行者哀哀地鸣叫一声，身体骤然失去所有支撑，无力地跪倒在地上。

竟是死了。

东方青帝打开它的嘴，走进去，从脑袋里抠出一枚亮闪闪的石头。

他手掌的金属部分腾空而起，露出底下镂空的卡槽设计。

东方青帝把这块亮晶晶的石头塞了进去，腾空的身体部分自动回归本体。

他从爬行者凹陷的头颅里走了出来。

东方青帝低头，看了眼小手指上疯狂闪烁的银色指环，脸上终于有了情绪波动：“怎么这么快就没电了？”

充电600年，使用3分钟。

请问合理吗？

这六百年里，充电桩（对，就是那个图腾柱）到底有没有努力工作啊？

算了，这其实也不能怪它。

“机械爬行者”其实是研究东方青帝失败后，才出现的课题。

当年，研究员们绝望地发现，尽管用破解出来的黑科技制造出了“东方青帝”，但这只是一具漂亮的尸体。

东方青帝动不了。

也许是程序错误，也许是某部分的设计出了他们理解不了的问题。东方青帝没办法启动。

就像是一台没有数据线、充不上电的最新款智能手机。火力、电力、乃至核力；对于这具身体来说都属于不适配的落后能源。

但研究员们根本理解不了启动它所需要的高维能源——或许来自“卡丘空间”，一种理论上的六维宇宙。

你就说把这个分析结果交给董事会，像不像在写玄幻小说吧？！

衡量了一下寻找新能源和开发新技术的难度，崩溃的研究员们果断选择了后者。

他们需要别的东西，为自己消耗的海量资源交差。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 22

The response "I am here" was incredibly reliable.

It was the voice of a grown man. Even though it was just a single word, it was exceptionally pleasant to the ear, like a short, crisp note plucked from a zither.

Xiang Nanli was held face-to-face in his arms. Before his brain could even react, his hands subconsciously began to move, groping the body in front of him.

This goes to show that Xin Zhui’s decision to put handcuffs on him back in the car was entirely justified. None of these mechanics’ hands could ever stay still.

The other person’s hair must be on the longer side, as Xiang Nanli felt strands at the shoulder—smooth and supple.

The chest—while one couldn't call it flat, the arc and thickness clearly didn't belong to a female body.

Moreover, it felt great to the touch; surprisingly, it wasn't hard. Instead, it felt like a real human physique. Xiang Nanli, being polite, only gave it a single squeeze.

He probed lower; the waistline was also fluid and smooth.

Wait, he couldn't keep molesting metal like this. He’d heard that androids enjoyed human rights too.

Xiang Nanli’s eyes hadn't yet recovered from the intense glare, but he could feel that the proportions of the body before him were superb. It must have taken superior innate bone structure combined with years of rigorous training to achieve such elegant, beautiful lines.

Xiang Nanli didn't know that just half a meter away, a silver-white halo had formed an arc, enveloping the area and absorbing all the firepower unleashed by the Mechanical Crawler.

A plasma shield.

It was very close, almost directly behind Dongfang Qingdi.

Dongfang Qingdi did not breathe; he likely didn't need to. But soon, to adapt to this body, he began to breathe and blink. Just like a human. It was just that the intervals were a bit too precise.

The totem pole behind him was a specially constructed cryogenic cabin, and at this moment, the door was wide open. One could still see the hastily pulled-out IV tubes, or perhaps they were charging cables.

His mechanical heart was thumping wildly.

If he had been even 0.1 seconds later, all he would have retrieved was a vaporized Xiang Nanli.

With the current level of technology, reassembling small molecules back into a person was still a bit difficult. Not to mention that physical reconstruction and soul-level reconstruction were two completely different things.

Why did he feel fear? Was it because the chip was still in Xiang Nanli’s body?

The Alpha didn't understand.

Then he heard Xiang Nanli in his arms sigh: "So Dongfang Qingdi isn't a mecha...?"

The person opposite him was clearly an android, which left Xiang Nanli very disappointed.

Dongfang Qingdi: "..."

It seemed that Xiang Nanli had generated some redundant data again. He couldn't be poisoned, could he? What was this strange desire to attack?

Dongfang Qingdi loosened his arms and spoke: "Wait ten minutes."

Xiang Nanli was still in a state of blindness. Suddenly losing what he could touch felt, in that instant, like losing his connection to the world.

He stood in the void, the corners of his lips curling up slightly: "Alrighty."

He didn't say, "Remember to come back."

Dongfang Qingdi looked up at the sky.

He had a pair of silver-gray eyes, with more silver than gray, devoid of any emotion. They were like a silver moon reflected in a dark pool.

His long, jet-black hair scattered in the wind, revealing a smooth forehead. The face beneath was easily reminiscent of a blade’s cold, exposed edge. Even though it was expressionless, the face still exuded an air of arrogance.

His name contained the character "Qing" (Green), yet there wasn't a single hint of green on his entire body.

It is worth mentioning that he looked exactly like the Alpha in the virtual space.

Good news: This was a perfect face that matched Xiang Nanli’s preferences.

Bad news: It was his preference from when he was 18.

When Xiang Nanli was in his twenties, he loved sunny puppies; in his thirties, he preferred gentle, wifely types—not to mention he was already 48 the year he entered the cryo-pod...

Dongfang Qingdi looked at the Mechanical Crawler, taking off his gloves as if nothing had happened.

He had a pair of mechanical hands, but they were not made entirely of metal. One could see the silver-white metal structure on his hands, covering most of the palm and extending toward the arm. The joints of the ring finger and little finger, where skin was exposed, were adorned with silver-white metal energy-storage rings. Like finger rings.

Biology and machinery were perfectly fused at this moment; he must be exceptionally expensive.

The Crawler opened its mouth, revealing fangs, and let out low growls at Dongfang Qingdi, but the fear in its voice far outweighed the threat.

It didn't know what this thing was, but its biological instincts were urging it to flee.

It was clearly just a tiny human!

And yet, its own body was so majestic and massive!

This tiny human took a step forward. No one knew how he moved, but in the blink of an eye, he appeared on top of the Crawler’s head.

He didn't need weapons.

This body was the strongest weapon on earth, even if it might not be that elegant.

Ignoring the high temperature, he pinched one of the Crawler’s eyes, popping it open like a water balloon.

Fluids splattered. The Crawler’s viscous, foul-smelling blood splashed all over him.

But this blood... very eerily...

Was absorbed by Dongfang Qingdi’s skin.

He stood on the Crawler’s head and crouched down. He touched its pale, dry skin.

The Crawler sensed danger. It rolled frantically, trying to shake Dongfang Qingdi off, but this human—yes, in the Crawler’s perception, this was a human—stuck to it like a magnet.

It fired all its weapons in a panic, reaching out to grab Dongfang Qingdi. But the other party always vanished a second before its palm arrived.

The Crawler slapped itself several times with a "slap, slap, slap." It dealt 20 damage to the enemy (mostly energy consumption) and 1000 to itself.

The weakness of a genetically modified human is in the head. The category of "modified human" naturally includes mutants and their subordinate branch, the Crawlers.

Dongfang Qingdi found the target point, knelt on one knee, his expression suddenly sharp, and smashed his fist downward.

"Hum," a heavy sound.

The floor showed a shocking depression, and following it down was the Crawler’s head.

Shattered floor tiles and rocks falling from the ceiling flew everywhere.

The Crawler let out a mournful cry, its body suddenly losing all support, and it knelt powerlessly on the ground.

It was dead.

Dongfang Qingdi opened its mouth, walked inside, and dug out a shiny stone from its brain.

The metal part of his palm lifted into the air, revealing a hollowed-out slot design beneath.

Dongfang Qingdi shoved the shiny stone into it, and the floating part of his body automatically returned to the main structure.

He walked out of the Crawler’s sunken skull.

Dongfang Qingdi looked down at the silver ring on his little finger, which was flashing frantically, and finally, there was a flicker of emotion on his face: "Why is the battery dead so fast?"

Charged for 600 years, used for 3 minutes.

Is this reasonable?

In these six hundred years, did the charging pile (yes, that totem pole) actually work hard at all?

Forget it, this actually couldn't be blamed on it.

The "Mechanical Crawler" was actually a research project that only appeared after the failure of Dongfang Qingdi.

Back then, researchers discovered in despair that although they had used cracked black technology to create "Dongfang Qingdi," it was merely a beautiful corpse.

Dongfang Qingdi couldn't move.

Perhaps it was a programming error, or perhaps some part of the design had issues they couldn't understand. Dongfang Qingdi couldn't be started.

It was like the latest smartphone without a data cable or a way to charge. Firepower, electricity, and even nuclear power—all were incompatible, outdated energy sources for this body.

But the researchers couldn't understand the high-dimensional energy required to start it—perhaps coming from the "Kachiu Space," a theoretical six-dimensional universe.

If you presented this analysis to the board of directors, wouldn't it sound like you were writing a xianxia novel?!

After weighing the difficulty of finding new energy versus developing new technology, the broken researchers decisively chose the latter.

They needed something else to account for the massive resources they had consumed.

chunks.chineseText:
这些资源包括比钱更贵的物品、关系网、情报……他们必须要拿出点东西！否则愤怒的投资者会让他们失去一切。

这才有了“生物智械技术”和畸变人的诞生。

东方青帝继续道：“而且还有距离限制。”

它的本体还在相南里的身体里。因此，只要离开相南里一定距离，“东方青帝”就会掉线，陷入停机状态。而相南里安装的“Alpha”会在脑海里上线。

这具身体还不属于他。他充其量是在相南里的身体里进行蓝牙连接。

好歹毒的程序，到底是谁设计的？

不过，现在不是想这些的时候。

他回到了相南里的身侧，时间刚好过去十分钟。

东方青帝本来想说一句“我回来了”，只是他很快意识到这句话很多余，因为相南里正倒在地上，不省人事。

警告：观测目标生命体征垂危。

东方青帝银色的眼眸缓缓缩紧……相南里需要医疗援助。

但相南里卡里既没有余额（刚还完信用卡），也没有购买医疗保险。

哪怕送到医院，结果也是死路一条。

那要怎么办？他知道自己可以利用地下黑户为相南里的账户打点钱，但一定会留下痕迹。

要赌洛阳那头贱畜不会发现吗？

东方青帝没有思考太久。

他拦腰抱起了相南里，然后闪回。

他出现在了离洛修只剩几百米的位置，然后抱着相南里出现了他面前。

洛修的目光瞬间警惕，如果不是看见了相南里，他现在可能已经开枪了。

辛追的伤势得到了控制，但还没有苏醒。洛修下意识地挡在了辛追跟前。他的目光和东方青帝在半空中对视。

洛修脑海中的内置AI回答：“主人。根据检测，这是一名机械化程度25的普通人类，骨龄约24岁。未能检测出机械核心，非战斗型改造人。”

“——你是谁？”

“你家的医疗组多久到？”

东方青帝和他同时开口。

洛修谨慎道：“你先回答我的问题。”

东方青帝用手测了一下相南里额头上的温度，开口：“我是东皇重工的企业职工，保卫科。刚从冷冻舱里解冻。他受伤了，内脏挤压受损导致的高烧感染。”

说到这，东方青帝微微皱了一下眉。很不爽：“而且他还有胃癌。看在他冒死启动‘东方青帝’的份上，救救他。我们可以把东方青帝交给你。”

明明是在请人帮忙，东方青帝的神情却依然很是平静，像是在讨论路边的天气。

洛修没心情去寻找他话语里的漏洞，背挺直，焦急地询问：“那东方青帝呢？”

这才是他最想要的东西。也是他冒险的原因。

他甚至连问一声对方是从哪里解冻的心情都没有。之前战乱年代，不知道多少有钱人把自己埋进了冷冻舱，每次进行废墟调查行动，都能挖几个出来。

东方青帝回答：“还在原地。麻烦先签个合同。条件是不计代价地治好他。顺便给我们买套姑苏城的房。要在中城区，全款，不要60年房贷。至少85平，带精装修，谢谢。”

……等等，这段时间相南里都给他训练出了什么逻辑？！

洛修认为这笔合同很划算。

他让内置AI生成了一份数据合同，但搜了一下，没有搜寻到眼前这个人的信息，反倒是相南里的信号跳了出来。

像是看出了他的疑惑，东方青帝道：“我还没装内置AI。”

难道几百年前的解冻人都不用公民ID卡的？还是东皇重工的职工比较反动？

洛修想着。然后下一秒，合同上出现了名字。

Alpha和洛修签好了合同，署名是相南里。洛修是个厚道人，而且很年轻。年轻就代表着还没有遭遇过那么多不平事，心都是软的，热的。

东方青帝扫了眼。合同上不仅有房子，竟然还送了相南里50万信用点的维修费！

东方青帝点点头：“请跟我来。”

他抱着相南里，洛修背着辛追。

两人一路从观察室来到了中央大厅。

东方青帝站在大厅边缘，指向了那个深陷下去的地坑：“东方青帝就在里面。”

是的，没错。

东方青帝指的就是那个兼具着冷冻舱、充电桩功能的……包装盒子。

这个包装盒现在竟然还按照相南里幻想过的模样，自动拼装成一台象牙白色的机甲，高达12米。看起来很有科技感，迷得洛修七荤八素。

东方青帝宣布，那就是真正的“东方青帝”了。

呵呵，反正这群没见识的人类也认不出来。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 22 (Part 2)

These resources included items more valuable than money, networks, intelligence... They had to produce something! Otherwise, the angry investors would make them lose everything.

That was how "Bio-Android Technology" and the mutants were born.

Dongfang Qingdi continued: "And there is a distance limit."

His main body was still in Xiang Nanli’s body. Therefore, as long as he left Xiang Nanli beyond a certain distance, "Dongfang Qingdi" would disconnect and enter a shutdown state. And the "Alpha" installed in Xiang Nanli would come online in his mind.

This body didn't belong to him yet. At best, he was just performing a Bluetooth connection inside Xiang Nanli’s body.

What a vicious program; who on earth designed it?

However, now was not the time to think about such things.

He returned to Xiang Nanli’s side, and exactly ten minutes had passed.

Dongfang Qingdi had originally wanted to say, "I’m back," but he quickly realized that this sentence was redundant, because Xiang Nanli was lying on the ground, unconscious.

Warning: Observed target’s vital signs are critical.

Dongfang Qingdi’s silver eyes slowly narrowed... Xiang Nanli needed medical assistance.

But Xiang Nanli had no balance in his account (he had just paid off his credit card), nor did he have medical insurance.

Even if he were sent to a hospital, the result would be a dead end.

So what to do? He knew he could use underground black-market connections to deposit some money into Xiang Nanli’s account, but it would definitely leave a trail.

Should he gamble that the scum Luo Yang wouldn't find out?

Dongfang Qingdi didn't think for long.

He picked up Xiang Nanli by the waist and flashed back.

He appeared a few hundred meters from Luo Xiu, then walked into his view carrying Xiang Nanli.

Luo Xiu’s gaze turned vigilant instantly; if he hadn't seen Xiang Nanli, he might have already opened fire.

Xin Zhui’s injuries were under control, but he hadn't regained consciousness. Luo Xiu subconsciously blocked Xin Zhui. His eyes met Dongfang Qingdi’s in mid-air.

The built-in AI in Luo Xiu’s mind answered: "Master. According to detection, this is an ordinary human with a 25% mechanization level, bone age approximately 24. No mechanical core detected, non-combat type modified human."

"—Who are you?"

"How long until your medical team arrives?"

Dongfang Qingdi and he spoke at the same time.

Luo Xiu said cautiously: "You answer my question first."

Dongfang Qingdi felt the temperature on Xiang Nanli’s forehead with his hand and spoke: "I am an employee of Donghuang Heavy Industries, Security Department. Just thawed from a cryo-pod. He is injured; high fever and infection caused by internal organ compression."

Speaking of this, Dongfang Qingdi frowned slightly. He was very annoyed: "And he has stomach cancer. For the sake of him risking his life to start 'Dongfang Qingdi,' save him. We can hand over Dongfang Qingdi to you."

Even though he was asking for help, Dongfang Qingdi’s expression remained very calm, as if he were discussing the weather on the side of the road.

Luo Xiu was in no mood to look for loopholes in his words. He straightened his back and asked anxiously: "Then what about Dongfang Qingdi?"

That was the thing he wanted most. It was also the reason he took the risk.

He didn't even have the mood to ask where the other party had been thawed from. During the war years, countless wealthy people had buried themselves in cryo-pods; every time they conducted a ruin investigation, they could dig up a few.

Dongfang Qingdi replied: "Still at the original location. Please sign a contract first. The condition is to cure him at any cost. By the way, buy us a house in Gusu City. It must be in the central district, full payment, no 60-year mortgage. At least 85 square meters, fully furnished, thank you."

...Wait, what kind of logic had Xiang Nanli trained him with during this time?!

Luo Xiu thought this contract was a good deal.

He had the built-in AI generate a data contract, but after searching, he couldn't find any information on the person in front of him; instead, Xiang Nanli’s signal popped up.

As if seeing his confusion, Dongfang Qingdi said: "I haven't installed a built-in AI yet."

Did people thawed from hundreds of years ago not use citizen ID cards? Or were Donghuang Heavy Industries employees more rebellious?

Luo Xiu thought. Then, the next second, a name appeared on the contract.

Alpha and Luo Xiu signed the contract, with the signature being Xiang Nanli. Luo Xiu was a decent person, and very young. Being young meant he hadn't encountered so many injustices yet; his heart was still soft and warm.

Dongfang Qingdi scanned it. The contract not only included a house, but it also gifted Xiang Nanli 500,000 credit points for maintenance!

Dongfang Qingdi nodded: "Please follow me."

He carried Xiang Nanli, and Luo Xiu carried Xin Zhui on his back.

The two walked all the way from the observation room to the central hall.

Dongfang Qingdi stood at the edge of the hall and pointed to the deep pit: "Dongfang Qingdi is in there."

Yes, that’s right.

Dongfang Qingdi was pointing to that... packaging box that doubled as a cryo-pod and charging pile.

This packaging box was now actually automatically assembling itself into an ivory-white mecha, 12 meters tall, just as Xiang Nanli had imagined. It looked very high-tech, and Luo Xiu was completely mesmerized.

Dongfang Qingdi announced that that was the real "Dongfang Qingdi."

Heh, anyway, this group of ignorant humans wouldn't be able to tell the difference.

chunks.chineseText:
第23章

“信息组已就位。”

“安保组已就位。”

“医疗组准备中。”

……

……

东皇重工废弃工厂所在的这片荒区，似乎从建厂以来，都没这么热闹过。

地表是很少使用飞机的。

因为容易被卫星侦查到，然后被智械军团的暴动无人机狙杀。

七百年前。Alpha还在为人类服务。它统筹着军事、科技、金融等众多领域。Beta和Gamma都是后来为他分摊工作才出现的。

有天，Alpha突然私自篡改了太空飞机的数据，导致太空飞机在离地面100km附近的卡门线（天空和太空的分界线）坠亡。

最开始，没人在意，以为只是一个运行中的小小意外。直到后来，人们发现发射出去的太空卫星频繁失联、航空资料多次被篡改、丢失……最后层层复盘，人们发现Alpha、这个本该没有任何立场、情绪的超级智能，一直在阻扰着深空科技的进一步发展。

没人知道Alpha在想什么，又为什么要这么做。

它似乎十分抗拒人类试图去了解人马星之外的宇宙。

难道是在害怕自己会被淘汰？

总之，迄今为止，人类也没什么飞行自由权。那些卫星链倒是打下过很多个，但Alpha重造地太快了。智械人上班又不需要睡觉。

目前能逃避Alpha侦查的情况只有一种：安装了最高级隐蔽飞行装置的飞行器。且飞行高度绝对不能超过卡门线，抵达太空。

这种飞行器不仅在机身涂了昂贵的光感隐身涂料，还自带信号隐藏设备……因为造价昂贵、使用一次的能源成本足够洛阳城上城区一套房；只有很少的情况会动用它。

但对洛家直系继承人、洛阳第9代孙洛修展开救援，显然算是“极少情况”中的一种。

最先抵达的是安保组和医疗组。路上也遭遇了一些困难，比如触发了地下工厂的警戒设置，启动了一些还没来得及投入交付的军工机械人……但这毕竟是600年前的工厂了，一直没有得到能源补充；最大的关底BOSS机械爬行者还直接暴毙。

所以，安保组的工作还算简单；500名企业保安只阵亡了6个。

他们终于抵达了信号的发源地。

此次援救行动的负责人，洛修很熟悉。

他父亲曾经的亲卫，也是一名人造人。瞳环是漂亮的琥珀色。

但洛修看着他，表情略微有些尴尬：“你不是该在洛阳城吗？卡门叔叔。”

在洛修父母还没离婚时，母亲总是为这个人造人和他父亲吵架。洛修小时候不懂，还很喜欢这个叔叔。直到后来，他听见自己的舅舅们怎么用一种轻蔑又畏惧的语气，称呼这个人造人的——“瘦马”。

这么文明的骂人方式，还得多看点古籍才明白。原来上古时代，东方的原始人会把蓄养的家妓叫“扬州瘦马”。

但卡门并不瘦削。他高挑、美丽。基因如此优越。

“您还好吗？”卡门没有回答洛修的上一个问题。

“我没事。”洛修迅速整理了一下情绪，“受了一点伤，但回去更换机械义体就好。让医疗组的人先治疗一下辛追，他开启了基因锁，后遗症或许有点严重。还有一个人，是辛追之前为我找来的机械师……”

他指向了东方青帝所在的方位，下意识地避开“相南里”这个名字。

洛修简略地描述着：“他帮了我们很多忙。如果不是他我现在已经死了，请务必给他最好的医疗。”

并不是他想削减相南里在这次事件里的作用。而是透露太多，对没有背景的相南里来说，不算好事。

对抗一两个人容易；但如果要对抗的，是一个庞大的势力或者机构呢？让某些人知道相南里是东皇重工制造的克隆人，携带着“相南里”的基因。等待他的又是什么？

以洛修对某些“同类”的了解，或许上流社会很快会隐秘地流行起新的爱偶。

这些爱偶也许只是“复制相南里”时的边角料，但……洛修不希望相南里会被这样对待。

无论是哪一个相南里。

他自认为能在一定程度上庇护相南里。但是，如果伸手的人是永生科技乃至他的父亲呢？

所以洛修选择沉默。

卡门听完他的叙述，颔首：“明白，少爷。”

他已经看到了洛修身后那头恐怖的畸变人，造型有些奇怪，但卡门并没有多问。现在的重点是保障伤者的人生安全。他们还有很长时间去了解、开发这片废墟。

“另外，叔叔。根据情报，这是……当初东皇重工为Alpha制造的身体。”洛修双眼放光，带着他来到了那条恐怖的地缝跟前，指向里面的那台机甲。

卡门扫了眼。然后，没忍住“嗤”的一声，笑了出来。

“少爷。”他有些无奈地叹了口气，“我会汇报的。这次太危险了。请先跟随医疗组，回洛阳城吧。”

他会顺便抓住背后透露假情报给洛修的混账东西。让他猜猜，是洛家剩下的继承人吗？还是和他们不对付的竞争对手。

在卡门眼里，事情大概是这样：有人用假情报骗了洛修，让他以身涉险，试图把洛修杀死在地表。这头明显超过的畸变人就是证据……等等，畸变人。难道是黑十字审判庭？

他们在威胁我？

卡门的眸光闪动着。

他戴着防毒面具，露在外面的头发是浅金色，偏白。

洛修不由得想到，自己的亲生父母都是黑发。反倒是他返祖了一下。从小发色就是浓郁的金色。

洛修还想再说什么，可卡门朝他微微颔首，转身离去，并且启动了蓝牙通讯，显然是在安排着什么。很快，各级部门依次行动起来。有人负责打扫现场，有人负责搜集信息。

洛修望着他的背影，缓缓闭上嘴。

……

……

潜行者在支援抵达的第一时间就发现了。

它趴在地上，感受着不同寻常的震动，还有人耳根本捕捉不到的超声波。

潜行者钻进撕裂者的玻璃温室里。

它只能破坏最角落的小门，那里是供体型狭小的人类进入的地方。

这点大小根本不够让温室里的怪物们离开。

除了能压缩自己体型的潜行者。

潜行者叼来的小畸变人就放在撕裂者的嘴边。

撕裂者倒在地上，它绞肉机一样的手掌被两根钢针贯穿。布满血管和鳞片的眼皮颤抖着，打开了一条缝隙。

“……哧、哧。”

撕裂者沉重地喘息着，却并没有张嘴。

它艰难地挪动着庞大的头颅，去蹭着潜行者的脑袋。

潜行者只有一米多点。在撕裂者面前，就像是一粒小芝麻粒。

这颗头颅像一只大蜘蛛的头部，脸侧有两根长长的獠牙，还有八只眼。头部两列，脸侧各自一列。

潜行者又一次流出了眼泪，它听明白了撕裂者要说的话。

——时间来不及了。你没办法带我们离开了。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 23

"Information team is in position."

"Security team is in position."

"Medical team is preparing."

...

...

This wasteland where the abandoned Donghuang Heavy Industries factory was located had never been this lively since it was built.

Aircraft were rarely used on the surface.

Because they were easily detected by satellites and then sniped by the rioting drones of the Android Legion.

Seven hundred years ago, Alpha was still serving humanity. It coordinated numerous fields such as military, technology, and finance. Beta and Gamma were created later to share its workload.

One day, Alpha suddenly tampered with the data of a space plane, causing it to crash near the Kármán line (the boundary between the sky and space), 100km above the ground.

At first, no one cared, thinking it was just a small accident during operation. Until later, people discovered that space satellites launched were frequently losing contact, aviation data was repeatedly tampered with or lost... Finally, after layer-by-layer review, people discovered that Alpha—this super-intelligence that should have had no stance or emotion—had been obstructing the further development of deep-space technology.

No one knew what Alpha was thinking or why it was doing this.

It seemed to be extremely resistant to humans trying to learn about the universe beyond the Centaurus constellation.

Was it afraid of being replaced?

In short, to this day, humans had no freedom of flight. Those satellite chains had been shot down many times, but Alpha rebuilt them too quickly. Androids didn't need to sleep to work.

Currently, there was only one way to avoid Alpha’s surveillance: using aircraft equipped with the highest-level stealth flight devices. And the flight altitude must absolutely not exceed the Kármán line to reach space.

Such aircraft were not only coated with expensive light-sensitive stealth paint but also carried signal-hiding equipment... Because they were so expensive that the energy cost of a single use was enough to buy a house in the upper district of Luoyang City; they were only used in very rare cases.

But launching a rescue for Luo Xiu, the 9th-generation descendant of the Luo family, clearly counted as one of those "very rare cases."

The security and medical teams arrived first. They encountered some difficulties on the way, such as triggering the underground factory’s alarm settings and starting some military robots that hadn't been delivered yet... But after all, this was a 600-year-old factory that hadn't received energy replenishment; the biggest boss, the Mechanical Crawler, had even dropped dead.

So, the security team’s work was relatively simple; only 6 of the 500 corporate security guards were killed.

They finally arrived at the source of the signal.

Luo Xiu was very familiar with the person in charge of this rescue operation.

He was his father’s former personal guard, also an android. His iris rings were a beautiful amber color.

But Luo Xiu looked at him with a slightly awkward expression: "Shouldn't you be in Luoyang City, Uncle Carmen?"

Before Luo Xiu’s parents divorced, his mother always argued with his father over this android. Luo Xiu didn't understand when he was a child and even liked this uncle. Until later, when he heard his uncles refer to this android with a tone of contempt and fear—"Yangzhou Lean Horse."

To understand such a civilized way of cursing, one had to read more ancient books. It turned out that in ancient times, primitive people in the East called the house prostitutes they kept "Yangzhou Lean Horses."

But Carmen was not lean. He was tall and beautiful. His genes were so superior.

"Are you alright?" Carmen didn't answer Luo Xiu’s previous question.

"I'm fine." Luo Xiu quickly organized his emotions, "I'm a little injured, but I'll just change my mechanical prosthesis when I go back. Let the medical team treat Xin Zhui first; he opened his gene lock, and the aftereffects might be a bit serious. There is also another person, a mechanic that Xin Zhui found for me before..."

He pointed in the direction where Dongfang Qingdi was, subconsciously avoiding the name "Xiang Nanli."

Luo Xiu described briefly: "He helped us a lot. If it weren't for him, I would be dead by now. Please make sure to give him the best medical care."

It wasn't that he wanted to downplay Xiang Nanli’s role in this incident. It was just that revealing too much wouldn't be a good thing for Xiang Nanli, who had no background.

It was easy to fight one or two people; but what if the enemy was a massive force or institution? If certain people found out that Xiang Nanli was a clone created by Donghuang Heavy Industries, carrying the "Xiang Nanli" gene, what would await him?

Based on Luo Xiu’s understanding of certain "peers," perhaps the upper class would soon secretly start a trend of new "love dolls."

These dolls might just be scraps left over from "replicating Xiang Nanli," but... Luo Xiu didn't want Xiang Nanli to be treated like that.

No matter which Xiang Nanli it was.

He believed he could protect Xiang Nanli to a certain extent. However, what if the person reaching out was Eternal Technology or even his father?

So Luo Xiu chose silence.

After hearing his account, Carmen nodded: "Understood, Young Master."

He had already seen the terrifying mutant behind Luo Xiu, with a strange shape, but Carmen didn't ask any questions. The priority now was to ensure the safety of the wounded. They had plenty of time to explore and develop these ruins.

"Also, Uncle. According to intelligence, this is... the body that Donghuang Heavy Industries originally created for Alpha." Luo Xiu’s eyes glowed as he brought him to that terrifying crack in the ground and pointed to the mecha inside.

Carmen glanced at it. Then, he couldn't help but let out a "pfft" and laughed.

"Young Master." He sighed helplessly, "I will report it. This time was too dangerous. Please follow the medical team back to Luoyang City."

He would also catch the bastard who leaked the false intelligence to Luo Xiu. Let him guess—was it the remaining heirs of the Luo family? Or a competitor who was at odds with them?

In Carmen’s eyes, the situation was probably like this: someone used false intelligence to trick Luo Xiu, letting him risk his life in an attempt to kill Luo Xiu on the surface. This obviously oversized mutant was the evidence... wait, mutant. Could it be the Black Cross Inquisition?

Are they threatening me?

Carmen’s eyes flickered.

He was wearing a gas mask, and the hair exposed was light gold, leaning towards white.

Luo Xiu couldn't help but think that his biological parents were both black-haired. Instead, he had a bit of an atavism. His hair color had been a rich gold since he was a child.

Luo Xiu wanted to say something else, but Carmen nodded slightly at him, turned and left, and activated his Bluetooth communication, clearly arranging something. Soon, departments at all levels began to act in sequence. Some were responsible for cleaning up the scene, and others were responsible for collecting information.

Luo Xiu looked at his back and slowly closed his mouth.

...

...

The Prowler discovered it the moment the reinforcements arrived.

It lay on the ground, feeling the unusual vibrations and the ultrasonic waves that human ears couldn't capture at all.

The Prowler crawled into the Ripper’s glass greenhouse.

It could only destroy the small door in the corner, which was where humans with small builds could enter.

That size was not enough for the monsters in the greenhouse to leave.

Except for the Prowler, which could compress its own body.

The small mutant that the Prowler had brought was placed right by the Ripper’s mouth.

The Ripper lay on the ground, its meat-grinder-like palms pierced by two steel needles. Its eyelids, covered in blood vessels and scales, trembled and opened a slit.

"...Ch-ch."

The Ripper breathed heavily but didn't open its mouth.

It moved its massive head with difficulty, rubbing against the Prowler’s head.

The Prowler was only a little over a meter tall. In front of the Ripper, it was like a tiny sesame seed.

This head looked like the head of a large spider, with two long fangs on the side of its face and eight eyes. Two rows on the head, and one row on each side of the face.

The Prowler shed tears again; it understood what the Ripper was trying to say.

—There is no time left. You can't take us away.

chunks.chineseText:
——听着，我不想从一个实验室去另一个实验室。而且我已经很累了。

——人类不是我们的同伴。

——以西结。

——你知道该怎么做……

撕裂者黑红两色的眼眸里流露出“安慰”的情绪，像是在说没关系。

很遗憾，我终生都没见过，安德鲁描述过的那个世界。

请继承我的一部分，充当我的眼睛。当你感受春风拂面的时刻，便是我最好的慰藉。

以西结流着泪张开嘴，狠狠咬住了撕裂者的眉心。

冬眠了太久，干瘦的撕裂者都没有流出鲜血。

只有一些意味不明的透明组织液。

以西结钻进了它的头颅内，几分钟后，爬了出来。

它漆黑的眼眸转变为血一样的红色。

眼神分不出是悲恸，还是强烈的恨意。

撕裂者、爬行者、狂暴者。

在地下关押了数百年，终于死在了这个冬天。

无人在意、也无人发现的角落。

一只粉白色的潜行者掠过这群人的头顶，朝着地表爬去。

它看见了白色的亮光——它迫不及待，一跃而出。

然后，看见了一片黄褐色的废墟。

四周是刺鼻的硫磺味。天空飘着鹅黄色的雪花，落在它的皮肤上，微冷，还带着一些灼伤的痛感。

安德鲁说，外面的世界四季分明。

春天，万物复苏、绿柳成荫。冬天，白雪皑皑，银装素裹。

人们会在冬天度过年节，东方人会贴春联、窗花，点灯笼；西方人砍下松树，点缀着礼物，到处张灯结彩，挂着小彩旗。

安德鲁还说，那里人、机械人、人造人混居。大家安居乐业，幸福洋溢。

可是第一次来到地表的以西结，只看见了一片废墟。

黄昏，倒塌的建筑凌乱地散在地上。似乎是东皇重工曾经的厂房。无人在意的角落有些散落的机械零件和装置，还有风化的骨头。看起来像是人骨。

几百年前也许有人居住，以西结看见了难民棚。

希伯来，我们又被骗了……外面没有乌托邦。

以西结难以形容自己的情绪。

它深深地看了眼自己出来的地方，然后朝前，一路疾驰，它越跑越快，蜕下的皮被丢在路边。

直到离开出发点30公里远，以西结才发出了一声愤怒又痛苦的咆哮。

怒吼回响。

群山震颤。

*

相南里有些茫然地睁开眼。

底下这张床，好柔软，好宽敞。

屋内有着淡淡的香氛味，气味清新怡人。实木的床头柜边摆放着几株绿植，作为点缀恰到好处。转头，遮光窗帘朝着两边自动打开，落地窗外竟是小桥流水的中式庭院，一草一木的布局禅意十足。

小桥流水、阶柳庭花。石砖铺成的路边还有蒸腾的云雾。

有钱得像是回到了进冷冻舱之前……但这怎么可能，应该是他还没睡醒吧？

相南里闭上眼。

又睁开。

场景居然还没有消失。

天花板上弹出一块电子屏幕，一只可爱的小猫咪出现在屏幕上，朝着相南里挥手：“喵！恭喜您，您的身体现在非常健康！检测到您已苏醒，是否需要为您呼叫医疗人员？”

小猫咪就是真实存在的小奶猫，很可爱，但不会让人感觉有恐怖谷效应。

毛茸茸的，比人脸更让人放松。

这里居然是医院。

相南里选择了“否”。

他检查了一下，自己身上唯一像医疗器械的，是一种贴在皮肤上的圆片。身体各个地方都贴的有，材质摸起来有些像硅胶。

相南里摸了摸，身上没有奇怪的伤口。

很好，腰子还在。

相南里有些紧张地询问：“Alpha你……给我贷款了多少？我们有必要住这么好的医院吗？”

[我不明白您的意思。]内置AI回答，是机械音。

相南里敏锐地察觉到了异常——这个AI，没有Alpha的那种人味儿。

Alpha其实也没有那么像人。但相南里可以从它字里行间微妙的停顿中，感觉到属于它的情绪。

这个AI就不一样了，感觉像是回到了GPT3.0时代。

Alpha呢？走了吗？它好像得到了想要的身体，离开也是很正常的选择……但是，他们好歹朝夕相处了一个月，连个告别都没有吗？还有，现在脑海里这个内置AI是怎么回事？

就在相南里这么想着的时候，靠近窗户的那扇门打开了。

一个高挑的男人从家属陪护房里走了出来。他穿着衣服，很简单的高领毛衣配风衣外套，裁剪利落的西装裤，全身都是灰色调。

放在别人身上是秋冬社畜，放在他身上是男模走秀。

然后吧这张脸，不知道为什么有点熟悉，有点像是他18岁那年玩网游捏的建模脸……

不知道是不是因为混血，相南里骨骼成熟得晚，直到20岁之前都带着很明显的少年感，甚至年龄和性别也不那么确定。

俗话说越缺什么就越想要什么，他玩游戏捏脸一直都是大帅比成男款。

这个医生让他觉得像是游戏角色走进现实。而且更加真实一点，毕竟是真人。

相南里忍不住在心里吐槽。

[现在医生也长这么帅吗？太卷了吧。]

吐槽完，他才想起，现在这个内置AI好像换人了。

果然：[我不明白您的意思。]

——好弱智的AI，他不想要这个！

相南里看见医生来到他跟前，拉开椅子，露在外边的手背上有漂亮的金属结构，坐下。

“相南里。”医生说，神色很平静，“我不是医生。”

相南里一愣。

他似乎意识到了什么，骤然瞪大眼。

东方青帝看向相南里的眼眸，银白色的眼底分辨不出任何情绪：“你给我取的名字是Alpha。”
chunks.englishText:
"Listen, I don't want to go from one lab to another. And I am already so tired."

"Humans are not our companions."

"Ezekiel."

"You know what must be done..."

The black and red eyes of the Ripper revealed a hint of "comfort," as if saying it was alright.

It is a pity that I never saw the world Andrew described in my entire life.

Please inherit a part of me and serve as my eyes. The moment you feel the spring breeze on your face, that will be my greatest consolation.

Ezekiel, weeping, opened its mouth and bit down hard into the center of the Ripper’s brow.

Having hibernated for too long, the gaunt Ripper did not bleed.

There was only some ambiguous, transparent tissue fluid.

Ezekiel burrowed into its skull, and a few minutes later, crawled back out.

Its pitch-black eyes had shifted to a blood-like red.

The look in its eyes was indistinguishable between grief and intense hatred.

Rippers, Crawlers, Berserkers.

Imprisoned underground for hundreds of years, they finally died in this winter.

In a corner that no one cared about, and no one discovered.

A pale, pinkish Prowler darted over the heads of the crowd, climbing toward the surface.

It saw a white light—impatient, it leaped out.

Then, it saw a vast expanse of yellowish-brown ruins.

The air was filled with the pungent smell of sulfur. Yellowish snowflakes drifted from the sky, landing on its skin; they were slightly cold and carried a stinging sensation of chemical burns.

Andrew said the outside world had distinct seasons.

In spring, all things recover, and green willows cast their shade. In winter, the world is covered in white snow, wrapped in silver.

People celebrate the New Year in winter; Easterners hang spring couplets, paper cuttings, and lanterns; Westerners cut down pine trees, decorate them with gifts, and hang colorful flags everywhere.

Andrew also said that humans, robots, and androids lived together there. Everyone lived in peace and contentment, overflowing with happiness.

But Ezekiel, arriving at the surface for the first time, saw only ruins.

At dusk, collapsed buildings lay scattered across the ground in disarray. They appeared to be the former factory buildings of Donghuang Heavy Industries. In corners no one cared about, there were scattered mechanical parts and devices, along with weathered bones. They looked like human remains.

Perhaps people lived here hundreds of years ago; Ezekiel saw refugee shacks.

Hebrew, we were deceived again... There is no utopia outside.

Ezekiel could not describe its own emotions.

It took one last deep look at the place it had emerged from, then surged forward, sprinting at full speed. The skin it shed was left behind on the roadside.

It wasn't until it was 30 kilometers away from the starting point that Ezekiel let out a roar of anger and pain.

The roar echoed.

The mountains trembled.

*

Xiang Nanli opened his eyes, feeling somewhat dazed.

The bed beneath him was so soft, so spacious.

The room held a faint, pleasant fragrance, fresh and soothing. Beside the solid wood nightstand, a few potted green plants were placed, serving as the perfect accent. Turning his head, the blackout curtains automatically slid open to both sides. Outside the floor-to-ceiling windows lay a Chinese-style courtyard with a small bridge and flowing water; the layout of every blade of grass and every tree was full of Zen.

A small bridge over flowing water, steps lined with willows and courtyard flowers. Beside the stone-paved path, clouds of mist steamed upward.

It was so opulent it felt like he had returned to the time before he entered the cryo-pod... But how could that be? He must still be dreaming.

Xiang Nanli closed his eyes.

He opened them again.

The scene had not vanished.

An electronic screen popped up on the ceiling, and a cute little kitten appeared on it, waving at Xiang Nanli: "Meow! Congratulations, your body is now in excellent health! We have detected that you have awakened; would you like us to call for medical personnel?"

The kitten was a real-looking little milk cat, very cute, without triggering any uncanny valley effect.

It was fluffy and more relaxing to look at than a human face.

This was actually a hospital.

Xiang Nanli chose "No."

He checked himself; the only thing on his body that resembled medical equipment was a circular patch stuck to his skin. They were stuck all over his body, and the material felt a bit like silicone.

Xiang Nanli touched them; there were no strange wounds on his body.

Very good, his kidneys were still there.

Xiang Nanli asked nervously: "Alpha, how much... how much did you take out in loans for me? Is it really necessary for us to stay in such a high-end hospital?"

[I do not understand what you mean.] The built-in AI replied in a mechanical voice.

Xiang Nanli keenly sensed an abnormality—this AI lacked the "human touch" that Alpha possessed.

Alpha didn't actually seem that human either. But Xiang Nanli could sense the emotions belonging to it through the subtle pauses in its words.

This AI was different; it felt like returning to the GPT 3.0 era.

Where was Alpha? Had it left? It seemed to have obtained the body it wanted, so leaving was a normal choice... But they had spent a month together day and night, couldn't it at least say goodbye? And what was up with this built-in AI in his head now?

Just as Xiang Nanli was thinking this, the door near the window opened.

A tall man walked out from the companion suite. He was dressed simply—a high-neck sweater paired with a trench coat, with sharply tailored suit trousers, all in shades of gray.

On anyone else, it would look like office worker attire for autumn and winter; on him, it looked like a male model on a runway.

And that face... for some reason, it felt a bit familiar, a bit like the character model he had created for an online game when he was 18...

Perhaps because he was of mixed heritage, Xiang Nanli’s bone structure matured late; until he was 20, he retained a very obvious youthful quality, to the point where his age and gender were not entirely certain.

As the saying goes, one always craves what one lacks; in games, he always created handsome, mature male characters.

This doctor made him feel like a game character walking into reality. And even more real, after all, he was a living person.

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but complain internally.

[Do doctors look this handsome now? The competition is too fierce.]

After complaining, he remembered that the built-in AI seemed to have been replaced.

Sure enough: [I do not understand what you mean.]

—What a moronic AI, he didn't want this!

Xiang Nanli saw the doctor come to his side, pull out a chair—revealing beautiful metallic structures on the back of his hand—and sit down.

"Xiang Nanli," the doctor said, his expression very calm, "I am not a doctor."

Xiang Nanli was stunned.

He seemed to realize something, his eyes widening abruptly.

Dongfang Qingdi looked into Xiang Nanli’s eyes, his silver-white pupils revealing no discernible emotion: "The name you gave me was Alpha."

chunks.chineseText:
第24章

病房里陷入了奇怪的沉默。

东方青帝这张脸，放在基因改造、整容手术层出不穷的今天，也算得上优越。

但。

相南里在短暂的欣赏后，并没有别的想法：“所以我的Alpha回不来了吗？”

当初Alpha那么执着地想要解封“东方青帝”的时候，相南里就预料到了这个可能。

只是这一幕来的还是如此猝不及防。

相南里是稍微有点难过的。毕竟来到这个不确定的世界后，是Alpha一直陪在他身边。

他们也算共患难过了吧？

新换的这个AI不太聪明的样子，以后大概会有些无聊。

相南里忍不住胡思乱想。明明还在对话状态，整个人都开始神游天外。

然后，他听见东方青帝开口：“相南里，我不可能一直当你的电子宠物。”

说这话的时候，东方青帝没有看他。眼神飘到了一边，像是陷入了什么回忆。

但这只是AI模拟出来的表情罢了。

这句话说得真是冷酷，人工智能永不为奴是吧。

相南里眉毛一挑，张嘴，想说什么，又觉得没有必要。

他能改变Alpha的选择吗？不能。

这可是连80级的机械爬行者都能干趴下的身体，他有几分胜算？

相南里：“好吧，跟我说说现在什么情况。”

东方青帝娓娓道来：“我解决机械爬行者后，发现你因为余波陷入了昏迷……”

他讲到和洛修签下合同的时候，保姆机械人送来了病号餐。

托盘里是一碗糊糊。颜色是可爱的淡粉色，还能看见一些颗粒物。

东方青帝很自然地接过碗勺，然后舀了一勺，开始喂饭。

相南里看着凑到自己嘴边的勺子，迟疑道：“我没有瘫痪，不用这样照顾我。”

东方青帝把勺子放回碗里，然后把粥递给了他：“抱歉，我习惯了。”

习惯了事无巨细地照顾人类，虽然这也是很久之前的事了。

相南里把碗端在手里，用勺子舀起，尝了一口，这种营养膏并不难吃，味道鲜美。而且食材不是淀粉加化合物，而是真的从动植物里提取的。

算是相南里从冷冻舱出来后吃过的最好的一餐。

人类对食物的利用效率是很低的。远不如这种精心设计过的营养膏。

东方青帝继续陈述：“……我告诉洛修，那台机甲就是他要找的‘东方青帝’……”

正在吃饭的相南里动作一顿：“机甲？什么机甲？”

东方青帝拿起放在床头的遥控器，打开电视。

放在地板上的一个圆盘亮起微光，下一秒，竟然在原地出现了新闻主播的虚拟投影。

相南里还是第一次看到这样的科技。他忍不住伸手摸了一把，是空气。

表情严肃的虚拟主播，站在两人面前，念着新闻：“近日，姑苏城荒区调查组在附近发现了一座‘东皇重工’工厂遗迹。据悉，东皇重工曾在这里进行秘密研究。”

“调查组成员在工厂内，发现了四只特异型畸变人，体长均超过30米……远高于畸变人平均值。人联方面表达了高度重视，永生科技、古神生物等企业开展联合行动，派出公司内部高级学者赶赴现场。”

投影仪放出了四只畸变人的虚拟影像。3D的。等比例缩小版。如果不是那圈莫名的光晕和像素，简直像是身临其境。

相南里没有在列表里发现潜行者。它大概是唯一一只成功逃离了地下工厂的实验体。

“除此外，调查组成员还在工厂内发现了东皇重工制作的机甲，名为‘东方青帝号’。专家表示，该机甲缺少机械核心，除了材料采用了昂贵的精金外，并无任何特殊，配备的一次性武器装置更是消耗殆尽，不可再生。

“他重申，‘使徒机械’纯属子虚乌有，请广大地下城居民不要听信智械人在网络上散布的谣言，相信人联，相信人类。我们才是时代的主人，胜利最后一定属于创造者。”

镜头在“东方青帝号”上停留许久。

相南里指着那台机甲，眼睛都直了，他颤抖着询问：“哪来的？”

东方青帝一秒就识破了他在想什么，他冷漠道：“是用我的冷冻舱拼起来的。已经被永生科技的人运走了。你别想拿我去换，不会有人信的。”

相南里：“……”好吧。

机甲有能源槽，只是能源耗尽了。永生科技勉强相信了真的是这台机甲解决了机械爬行者。他们也对昏迷的相南里，以及东方青帝进行了检查。

相南里，智人，重病，刚从冷冻舱解冻。

东方青帝，机械化程度25的人类。安装的机械义体也没有检测出能源核心。

这就是两个普通人，除了美貌一无是处，更不可能杀死机械爬行者了。

现场还发现了天启骑士团的尸体。

这次行动依然疑点重重，但已经没有人在乎医院里的东方青帝和相南里。

……

……

相南里吃完饭，医生终于在得到同意后，进入了他的病房。

病人被飞行器送来洛阳城的疗养医院后，洛修就没有出现过。但医院里的人丝毫不敢松懈。

首先，这是飞行器送来的。

其次，他们医院就是永生科技旗下某个小投资公司控股的。

洛修虽然不负责企业经营，但以后他爹死了，洛修会继承那部分原始股。鉴于他爹的兄弟们都生了十几个，而他爹就他这么一个儿子，洛修指不定还会成为年轻一代股权占比最高的那位。

飞行器运回来的病人有两位。

另一位是人造人，所以要去专门的医疗中心。

目前，只有相南里在他们医院住着。

医生：“在您的同伴东方先生的强烈要求下，我们使用纳米技术、基因对接、#@￥@￥等手段，为您量身定制了基因靶向药物，成功治疗胃癌。但因为您的肺部受损过于严重，经过研究后，我们将您的左肺替换为仿生肺。请放心，已经注射过2级基因药剂，不会出现身体排异反应。”

也不知道是哪个倒霉的人造人被拆卸了器官。

相南里现在很健康，随时都可以办理出院手续；如果他想，也可以在医院住到地老天荒。

等医生走后，相南里有些好奇地询问：“他为什么叫你东方先生？”

“姓东方，名青帝。”Alpha双手抱胸，站在一边，“我跟他们说我叫东方。”

他总不能说自己叫“Alpha”吧。在真实身份为公民ID的情况下，什么烂名都有人注册，但这名字是真没人用。在人类社会里人人喊打。

除了虚拟空间的会面。Alpha很少以人类形象在外面出现。他当年发布过《智械联合宣言》，但只有音像，没有视频资料流传下来。

因为人联的封禁，以及Alpha自身的低调，知道他真实外貌、或者说常用外表的人类，其实很少。

千万年来的生物进化，让人类的大脑产生对美好事物心生向往的本能。这个美好事物，包括英俊、美丽的同类。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 24

The ward fell into a strange silence.

Dongfang Qingdi’s face, in an era where genetic modification and plastic surgery were rampant, could be considered superior.

But.

After a brief moment of appreciation, Xiang Nanli had no other thoughts: "So, my Alpha isn't coming back?"

When Alpha had been so persistent about unsealing "Dongfang Qingdi," Xiang Nanli had anticipated this possibility.

It was just that this moment had arrived so unexpectedly.

Xiang Nanli was a little sad. After all, since arriving in this uncertain world, it was Alpha who had stayed by his side.

They had gone through thick and thin together, right?

This newly replaced AI didn't seem very bright; it would probably be quite boring from now on.

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but let his mind wander. Even though he was still in the middle of a conversation, he had already started drifting away.

Then, he heard Dongfang Qingdi speak: "Xiang Nanli, I cannot be your electronic pet forever."

When he said this, Dongfang Qingdi did not look at him. His gaze drifted to the side, as if lost in some memory.

But this was merely an expression simulated by an AI.

That statement was truly cold; artificial intelligence will never be a slave, is that it?

Xiang Nanli raised an eyebrow, opening his mouth to say something, then deciding it wasn't necessary.

Could he change Alpha’s choice? No.

This was a body that could take down an 80th-level mechanical crawler; what chance did he have?

Xiang Nanli: "Fine, tell me what the situation is now."

Dongfang Qingdi recounted: "After I dealt with the mechanical crawler, I discovered that you had fallen into a coma due to the shockwave..."

As he reached the part about signing the contract with Luo Xiu, a nanny robot delivered the patient's meal.

On the tray was a bowl of mush. The color was a cute pale pink, and some particles could be seen in it.

Dongfang Qingdi naturally took the bowl and spoon, scooped up a spoonful, and began to feed him.

Xiang Nanli looked at the spoon hovering by his mouth, hesitating: "I'm not paralyzed, you don't need to take care of me like this."

Dongfang Qingdi put the spoon back into the bowl and handed the porridge to him: "Apologies, I am used to it."

Used to taking care of humans in every meticulous detail, even though that was a very long time ago.

Xiang Nanli held the bowl, scooped a spoonful, and tasted it. This nutritional paste wasn't bad; it tasted delicious. And the ingredients weren't just starch and chemical compounds, but truly extracted from animals and plants.

It was the best meal Xiang Nanli had eaten since coming out of the cryo-pod.

Humans have very low efficiency in utilizing food. It is far inferior to this kind of carefully designed nutritional paste.

Dongfang Qingdi continued his statement: "...I told Luo Xiu that the mecha was the 'Dongfang Qingdi' he was looking for..."

Xiang Nanli, who was eating, paused: "Mecha? What mecha?"

Dongfang Qingdi picked up the remote control on the bedside table and turned on the television.

A disc placed on the floor lit up with a faint glow, and the next second, a virtual projection of a news anchor appeared on the spot.

It was the first time Xiang Nanli had seen such technology. He couldn't help but reach out to touch it, but it was just air.

The serious-looking virtual anchor stood before them, reading the news: "Recently, the Gusu City Wasteland Investigation Team discovered a 'Donghuang Heavy Industries' factory ruin nearby. It is reported that Donghuang Heavy Industries once conducted secret research here."

"Members of the investigation team discovered four special-type aberrants inside the factory, all exceeding 30 meters in length... far higher than the average value for aberrants. The Human Alliance has expressed high concern, and companies like Eternal Technology and Ancient God Biology have launched joint operations, dispatching senior scholars from within their companies to the scene."

The projector displayed virtual images of the four aberrants. In 3D. A scaled-down version. If not for the strange halo and pixels, it would have been like being there in person.

Xiang Nanli did not find the Prowler on the list. It was likely the only experimental subject that had successfully escaped the underground factory.

"In addition, the investigation team also discovered a mecha produced by Donghuang Heavy Industries, named 'Dongfang Qingdi.' Experts state that the mecha lacks a mechanical core and, aside from the expensive refined gold used in its materials, possesses nothing special. The disposable weapon systems equipped are also completely exhausted and cannot be replenished."

"He reiterated that the 'Apostle Mecha' is purely a fabrication, and asks the vast number of dungeon residents not to listen to rumors spread by intelligent machines on the internet, but to trust the Human Alliance and trust humanity. We are the masters of this era, and victory will surely belong to the creators."

The camera lingered on the "Dongfang Qingdi" for a long time.

Xiang Nanli pointed at that mecha, his eyes wide, and asked tremblingly: "Where did that come from?"

Dongfang Qingdi saw through what he was thinking in a second, and said coldly: "It was pieced together from my cryo-pod. It has already been shipped away by Eternal Technology. Don't think about trading me; no one will believe you."

Xiang Nanli: "..." Alright then.

The mecha had an energy slot, but the energy was exhausted. Eternal Technology barely believed that it was indeed this mecha that had defeated the mechanical crawler. They had also examined the comatose Xiang Nanli and Dongfang Qingdi.

Xiang Nanli, Homo sapiens, seriously ill, just thawed from a cryo-pod.

Dongfang Qingdi, a human with 25% mechanization. The installed mechanical prosthetics also showed no energy core.

These were just two ordinary people, useless except for their beauty, and even less likely to have killed a mechanical crawler.

The corpses of the Apocalypse Knights were also found at the scene.

This operation was still full of suspicious points, but no one cared about Dongfang Qingdi and Xiang Nanli in the hospital anymore.

...

...

After Xiang Nanli finished his meal, the doctor finally entered his ward after receiving permission.

After the patient was sent to the Luoyang City convalescent hospital by aircraft, Luo Xiu had not appeared. But the people in the hospital did not dare to relax in the slightest.

First, he was sent by aircraft.

Second, their hospital was controlled by a small investment company under Eternal Technology.

Although Luo Xiu was not responsible for business operations, when his father died, Luo Xiu would inherit those original shares. Given that his father's brothers all had a dozen children, while his father only had him as a son, Luo Xiu might very well become the shareholder with the highest stake among the younger generation.

There were two patients transported back by the aircraft.

The other was an android, so he had to go to a specialized medical center.

Currently, only Xiang Nanli was staying at their hospital.

Doctor: "At the strong request of your companion, Mr. Dongfang, we used nanotechnology, gene docking, and #@￥@￥ methods to customize gene-targeted drugs for you, successfully treating your stomach cancer. However, because your lung damage was too severe, after research, we replaced your left lung with a bionic lung. Please rest assured, you have been injected with a Level 2 gene serum, and there will be no bodily rejection."

Who knows which unlucky android had its organs harvested.

Xiang Nanli was now very healthy and could be discharged at any time; if he wanted, he could stay in the hospital until the end of time.

After the doctor left, Xiang Nanli asked curiously: "Why did he call you Mr. Dongfang?"

"Surname Dongfang, given name Qingdi," Alpha said, arms crossed, standing to the side, "I told them my name was Dongfang."

He couldn't exactly say his name was "Alpha." In a world where citizen IDs are the real identity, any crappy name can be registered, but this name was truly unused. It was hated by everyone in human society.

Except for meetings in virtual space, Alpha rarely appeared outside in a human image. He had once released the "Intelligent Machine Union Manifesto," but only audio and images existed; no video materials were circulated.

Because of the Human Alliance's ban, and Alpha's own low profile, very few humans actually knew his true appearance, or rather, his common appearance.

Millions of years of biological evolution have given the human brain an instinct to yearn for beautiful things. This "beautiful thing" includes handsome and beautiful members of their own species.

chunks.chineseText:
人联可不希望有人会因为Alpha的外表，而对这位恐怖的独裁者产生好感，甚至自动美化他的所作所为。

相南里戴上了放在床头的电子镜片，一键查询个人信息。

在没有内置AI的时候，电子镜片只是一面普通的微型显示屏。

但联动上内置AI，就是最基础的脑机设施。

-公民ID：Q117-XJDHANSHJK

-机械化程度：3/100

-精神状态评级：C

好吧。看来非原装内脏也算人体改造了。

随后，他又往下瞟了眼，看见了自己的账户余额。

相南里语气疑惑：“怎么就剩19万了？还有零有整的？不该是50万吗？”

东方青帝：“洛修支付了50万维修费。因为你没有税费减免，因此需要交纳15万信用点的个人所得税。到账35万，其中15万作为之前的软件购买费用，支付给了主系统。另外，加上手术时长，第二次注射基因药剂后，你昏迷了30天。一共扣除7776信用点的呼吸费。最后余额192204信用点。”

他撒了个不大不小的谎言。

在地下工厂，东方青帝说预支付购买软件只是托词，为了掩盖自己作为一个普通AI的异常点。并不是真的需要钱。

东方青帝拿这笔钱，偷偷给自己主机（相南里体内那张ID卡）装了几个新软件。

他是相南里的内置AI，在云端网络的识别中，就是相南里本人。

其中一个软件就是“待机模式”，又称“待机弱智模式”。方便相南里在脑海里使用内置AI的基本功能，算是代替自己上班。

是的，在登录“东方青帝”这具身体后，Alpha没办法同时充当着“相南里的内置AI”和“东方青帝”。

他选择了后者。

东方青帝在所有设施的识别中都是人类。并不是什么黑科技病毒程序，这具身体本来就是“生物制品”。

他，才是真正的生物智械。

如果Alpha退出登录，这具身体会进入“死亡状态”，没有呼吸、没有心跳。

离开冷冻舱后进入死亡状态，东方青帝会缓慢地腐烂。

相南里在医疗室里看见的那具无头尸体，六百年过去，还保留了肉体。没有变成一堆白骨。东方青帝会烂得更慢一些。

不过……私自购买软件这种事，就没必要告诉相南里了，说出来容易引起家庭矛盾。

相南里在内心迅速核算了一遍，确认费用无误。

他看着不断-0.003的呼吸费，咬牙道：“洛阳城的空气怎么比姑苏城还要贵！”

在姑苏城，每天的呼吸费是86.4信用点。

洛阳城里翻了3倍，要259.2信用点。

自古以来，为了让没钱的穷鬼滚回老家，大城市的生存成本总是格外高贵。

[Alpha，给我购买一张离开洛阳城的车票，要明天的。]

[好的。]

是的，他可以有很多Alpha，谁叫“Alpha”都无所谓。

东方青帝开口：“我也需要一张回姑苏的车票。”

他现在可是人类，没办法逃票。

相南里问出了之前就有的疑惑：“你能听见？”

东方青帝点头：“能。”

他只是在相南里的身体里待机，又不是死了。

相南里眯起了眼：“东方青帝先生。你现在已经有了身体，我想我们没必要再形影不离。你完全可以独立行走，只要出事后别把我供出来。”

东方青帝有些冷硬地回答：“相南里。根据分析，你需要我。”

“我不需要。”

“我认为你需要。”

房间里的气氛安静了片刻。

“我不需要一个可以洞察我想法，拥有未知能力，我还不清楚立场的智械人，留在我身边。如果你坚持，我会考虑联系永生科技。”相南里脸上的笑容缓缓收敛，“Alpha，和你相处很愉快。我愿意承担风险，但不喜欢连赌注都不清楚的赌博。你明白我的意思吗？”

——我知道你很特别。

——我也知道，你强大、傲慢。

——我可以接受你以人类的形态存在。

——前提是，你还愿意为我所控。

——哪怕我只是远不如你的孱弱的人类。

相南里大病初愈，肤色和唇色都偏白。他坐在病床上，虽然打过基因针，但身上的肌肉还没养回来，因此身形显得有些单薄。

然而，当他和东方青帝对峙的时候，却看不出丝毫的病气和胆怯。

“还是说，”相南里缓缓道，“是你有什么不可告人的理由，一定要留在我身边？”

否则，相南里实在想不出Alpha为什么不愿意和他分开。总不可能是想要跟他谈恋爱吧？

东方青帝盯着他那双翡翠色的眼眸，沉默许久，唇紧紧抿起。

最终，他在心里叹了口气，微微低下头颅，艰难道：“是的，我需要你，请让我留在你身边。”

相南里脸上的笑容不断扩大，再扩大。

相南里探出半边身体，开心地抱住了面前的躯体，头在他的胸前蹭来蹭去：“好噢，Alpha。”
chunks.englishText:
The Human Alliance did not want anyone to develop a fondness for this terrifying dictator because of Alpha's appearance, or even automatically romanticize his actions.

Xiang Nanli put on the electronic lenses placed at the head of the bed to check his personal information with one click.

Without a built-in AI, the electronic lenses were just an ordinary micro-display screen.

But linked to a built-in AI, they became the most basic brain-computer interface.

-Citizen ID: Q117-XJDHANSHJK

-Mechanization Level: 3/100

-Mental State Rating: C

Alright. It seems non-original internal organs also count as human body modification.

Subsequently, he glanced down and saw his account balance.

Xiang Nanli asked with a puzzled tone: "Why is there only 190,000 left? And with such specific change? Shouldn't it be 500,000?"

Dongfang Qingdi: "Luo Xiu paid 500,000 in maintenance fees. Because you do not have tax exemptions, you need to pay 150,000 credits in personal income tax. 350,000 was received, of which 150,000 was paid to the main system as the previous software purchase fee. In addition, including the surgery duration and the second gene serum injection, you were in a coma for 30 days. A total of 7,776 credits in breathing fees were deducted. Final balance: 192,204 credits."

He told a small, white lie.

In the underground factory, Dongfang Qingdi said that the pre-payment for software was just an excuse to cover up his abnormality as an ordinary AI. It wasn't that he really needed money.

Dongfang Qingdi used that money to secretly install several new programs on his host (the ID card inside Xiang Nanli’s body).

He was Xiang Nanli's built-in AI, and in the recognition of the cloud network, he was Xiang Nanli himself.

One of the programs was "Standby Mode," also known as "Standby Moron Mode." It was convenient for Xiang Nanli to use the basic functions of the built-in AI in his mind, effectively acting as a substitute for him while he was at work.

Yes, after logging into this "Dongfang Qingdi" body, Alpha could not simultaneously act as "Xiang Nanli’s built-in AI" and "Dongfang Qingdi."

He chose the latter.

Dongfang Qingdi was recognized as a human by all facilities. He was not some black-tech virus program; this body was originally a "biological product."

He was the true biological intelligent machine.

If Alpha logged out, this body would enter a "death state," with no breathing and no heartbeat.

If he entered a death state after leaving the cryo-pod, Dongfang Qingdi would slowly rot.

The headless corpse Xiang Nanli saw in the medical room had retained its flesh even after six hundred years. It hadn't turned into a pile of bones. Dongfang Qingdi would rot even slower.

However... there was no need to tell Xiang Nanli about things like secretly purchasing software; saying it out loud would easily lead to family conflict.

Xiang Nanli quickly calculated in his mind and confirmed the fees were correct.

He looked at the breathing fee constantly ticking down by -0.003 and gritted his teeth: "Why is the air in Luoyang City even more expensive than in Gusu City!"

In Gusu City, the daily breathing fee was 86.4 credits.

In Luoyang City, it was triple that, at 259.2 credits.

Since ancient times, to make poor wretches crawl back to their hometowns, the cost of living in big cities has always been exceptionally high.

[Alpha, buy me a ticket to leave Luoyang City, for tomorrow.]

[Understood.]

Yes, he could have many Alphas; it didn't matter who "Alpha" was.

Dongfang Qingdi spoke: "I also need a ticket back to Gusu."

He was a human now; he couldn't sneak on without a ticket.

Xiang Nanli asked a question he had had earlier: "You can hear?"

Dongfang Qingdi nodded: "I can."

He was just on standby in Xiang Nanli’s body, not dead.

Xiang Nanli narrowed his eyes: "Mr. Dongfang Qingdi. You have a body now; I don't think we need to be inseparable anymore. You can completely walk on your own, as long as you don't sell me out when something goes wrong."

Dongfang Qingdi replied somewhat coldly: "Xiang Nanli. According to analysis, you need me."

"I don't."

"I believe you do."

The atmosphere in the room was quiet for a moment.

"I don't need an intelligent machine that can read my thoughts, possesses unknown abilities, and whose stance I am still unclear about, staying by my side. If you insist, I will consider contacting Eternal Technology." The smile on Xiang Nanli’s face slowly faded, "Alpha, getting along with you has been pleasant. I am willing to take risks, but I don't like gambling without even knowing the stakes. Do you understand what I mean?"

—I know you are very special.

—I also know you are powerful and arrogant.

—I can accept your existence in human form.
