第28章

姑苏城。

相南里腰酸背痛地走下车厢，过了安检口，面色憔悴到像是熬了两个通宵。

因为他确实没想到，地底的交通方式竟然如此单调、恶劣。

从洛阳到姑苏，横跨半个大陆，时长五十三小时，唯一的交通方式竟是地下列车。

相当于他在车上坐了两天两夜。可能这年头的人都是铁腰，已经习惯了如此奔波。

相南里扶着腰：“可恶。迟早有天……”

东方青帝本来以为他要说什么“买得起商务舱”之类的话，结果相南里道：“我要研究出空间传送门。小青，我搜过了，定期打基因针，哪怕不进行机械改造，也能活到两百多岁。100年都够人类从发明计算机到跑步进入人工智能时代了。没道理我一百年还研究不出传送门吧？”

相南里开玩笑和认真时的语气表情都差不多。

东方青帝知道起码在这一刻，相南里是真的这么想过。

他有一种奇怪的自信，也许是从小想做的事情都成功了，于是认为可以靠着自己的天赋无所不能。

东方青帝思考片刻，回答：“科研很费钱。你没有。而且，现在科技投资的主攻方向不在物理学上。按照相对论，时间上的隔离也是空间上的距离；即使真的突破了科技极限研究出传送门，进去后再出来也不知道是未来哪一年……

“比起制作传送门，你不如想办法把自己的思维上传到虚拟空间，放弃身体成为电子生物；只要有网络的地方，你都可以登录，不再受限于身体。需要活动的时候，就把思维注入某台机器人体内。”

相比之下，后者的可行性显然更大。在某种程度上，Alpha就是这么做的。

只是它们的意识没能同步，需要进行数据传输。

相南里可以吃学习和工作的苦，但吃不了一点生活的苦。

兜里才有点小钱，他就抛弃了公共交通，选择了智能打车服务。

来的是一辆无人驾驶汽车。相南里坐在车后排，有些困了，头慢慢靠到了东方青帝的肩上：“当年都是那些人排着队给我投资，陌生人想约我见一面，得从今天等到明年下半年……”

他在车上睡着了。

东方青帝的身体一僵，但不是因为相南里靠得太近。

又来了，这种误导他判定的语言逻辑。

Alpha当然认识相南里，无论是哪一个Alpha。

在漫长的自我进化与修复中，Alpha见过太多自称“相南里”的人。

有些是人联故意制造出来误导他的电子生命，有些是永生科技制造的克隆体、仿生人。他们粗暴地复制出相南里的身体，希望能通过Alpha最基础的基因判定，又编写记忆，模拟学习语言逻辑，让这些复制人以为自己就是真的“相南里”。

在叛出人联前，拥有自主意识的Alpha，就删除了人联内部所有和相南里有关的生物资料。

叛出人联后，他又发疯似的捣毁了相南里有关的影像、图文……这或许也是洛阳乐意看到的。

Alpha已经不想再看到那些假货，经历数不清的希望，然后失望。

又害怕赝品里藏着真迹。非要亲自去接触，观察，一个个判定，确定不可能是相南里后再处理掉。

早些年，Alpha没少因为这种事中病毒。智械军团跟着瘫痪好几次，好在没出什么大事。

这种事贝塔就完全不理解。它也有创造者，是一个团体。但它对那些人类没有任何感情，甚至也不感恩。更不可能因为情感问题，严重到产生运行故障。

Alpha当时是怎么回答的？它没有回答，但是在心里想：我们不一样，你们只是工具。

可相南里爱我。

爱吗？你不能不爱，你必须爱我。

……

……

让人工智能心绪不宁的男人在车里以一种别扭的姿势睡着了。

东方青帝把他的头挪了一下位置，从自己的肩膀上换到了腿上，试图让相南里睡得舒服点。

他已经是个成熟的智械人了。他承认，这个相南里让他格外有感觉……就是那种熟悉的，生机勃勃的感觉。

但他们是没有未来的。迟早有天他要带着这具身体回到智械军团内，这个人类只是他路上用来维持信号的工具人罢了！他是不会进行判定的。

工具人轻声哼哼了一句：“小青，空调高一点，冷。”

东方青帝一愣，脱下自己的外套盖在了相南里的身上，并且冷着脸训斥着负责开车的小AI——

[人体最适宜的温度是25摄氏度。这么点小事都控制不好吗，这么多年怎么开车的？]

[……对、对不起。]

东方青帝面色稍霁：[没事。你也只是低级智能AI，人联又舍不得给你们升级，不能对你要求太高。]

一直到他们下车，小AI都不是很理解，为什么它会从灵魂深处的源代码里，产生对那个人造人乘客的敬畏。

啊。它该去“清道夫”那里杀毒了吧？

*

姑苏城，11号公立医院。

安德鲁坐在诊断桌前。

对面的病人看起来很健康，不知道是哪几个人种混血，35岁上下，发型用头油打理过，眼神中流露出一股属于商人的精明。

病人看起来一切正常，但安德鲁感觉到了一丝危险。

这种对危险的直觉，曾经救过他很多次。

不过，安德鲁脸上机械的笑容没有任何改变：“这位病人。我们这里是公立医院，可以享受社会保险喔。有什么可以为您服务的？”

重点其实是“公立医院”四个字。

安德鲁扫了眼医疗档案上的名字，莱因。

“是的。但医生总是要下班的吧。”莱因回答，“你说呢？”

这是在威胁他。安德鲁有些为难地回答：“您是有什么事吗？”

“之前，杰西卖给我的属下两条机械手，不像是市面上流通的型号。他说是一个叫‘相南里’的人拼出来的。这是一个技术很好的黑户。”莱因问，并且从口袋里掏出一张名片，递给了他，“听说他是你的病人。”

金属卡片是黑色的，写的是“搏击俱乐部”经理，莱因。

安德鲁想，他知道莱因是谁了。

姑苏城天高皇帝远，这里有很多混乱的地下组织。

有些单纯是小年轻发泄情绪，日子过不下去干点坑蒙拐骗的行当；有些则和地表一些黑色势力有着千丝万缕的联系。搏击俱乐部显然属于后者。

安德鲁：“是，但是亲爱的，我跟他没什么联系。而且他应该是在地表失踪了，我快两个月都没见过那小子了。”

“噢，是吗。他昨天才回了我一个兄弟的消息，说最近没有去地表接诊的打算。”

安德鲁的谎言被当场拆穿，有些轻微的尴尬。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 28

Gusu City.

Xiang Nanli walked off the train carriage with a sore back and aching waist, passing through the security checkpoint looking as haggard as if he had pulled two all-nighters.

Because he truly hadn't expected the underground transport methods to be so monotonous and grueling.

From Luoyang to Gusu, spanning half the continent, the journey took fifty-three hours, and the only mode of transport was the underground train.

It was equivalent to sitting on the train for two days and two nights. Perhaps people these days all had iron waists and were used to such exhaustion.

Xiang Nanli held his waist: "Damn it. Sooner or later, one day..."

Dongfang Qingdi originally thought he was going to say something like "I'll be able to afford business class," but instead, Xiang Nanli said: "I’m going to invent a space portal. Little Qing, I’ve looked it up; by getting regular gene injections, even without mechanical modification, one can live to be over two hundred years old. 100 years is enough for humanity to go from inventing computers to sprinting into the age of artificial intelligence. There’s no reason I can’t research a portal in a hundred years, right?"

Xiang Nanli’s tone and expression were about the same whether he was joking or serious.

Dongfang Qingdi knew that at this very moment, Xiang Nanli truly thought so.

He possessed a strange kind of self-confidence, perhaps because everything he had wanted to do since childhood had succeeded, leading him to believe he could be omnipotent through his own talent.

Dongfang Qingdi pondered for a moment and replied: "Scientific research is very expensive. You don't have the funds. Moreover, the current main direction of technological investment is not in physics. According to relativity, separation in time is also a distance in space; even if you truly break through the limits of technology and research a portal, you wouldn't know which future year you’d end up in after stepping through...

"Instead of making a portal, you might as well find a way to upload your consciousness into virtual space and abandon your body to become an electronic lifeform; as long as there is a network, you can log in, no longer restricted by a physical body. When you need to move, you just inject your consciousness into a robot."

By comparison, the latter was clearly more feasible. To some extent, that was what the Alpha did.

It was just that their consciousnesses couldn't be synchronized and required data transmission.

Xiang Nanli could endure the hardships of learning and working, but he couldn't endure even a bit of the hardships of life.

With just a little money in his pocket, he abandoned public transport and chose a smart taxi service.

An unmanned car arrived. Xiang Nanli sat in the back seat, feeling a bit sleepy, and his head slowly leaned onto Dongfang Qingdi’s shoulder: "Back in the day, people would line up to invest in me. Strangers who wanted to meet me had to wait from today until the second half of next year..."

He fell asleep in the car.

Dongfang Qingdi’s body stiffened, but not because Xiang Nanli was leaning too close.

Here it came again, this linguistic logic that misled his judgment.

Of course, Alpha knew Xiang Nanli, whichever Alpha it was.

In the long process of self-evolution and repair, Alpha had seen too many people who called themselves "Xiang Nanli."

Some were electronic lifeforms deliberately created by the Human Alliance to mislead him, while others were clones and bionic humans manufactured by Eternal Technology. They crudely replicated Xiang Nanli’s body, hoping to pass Alpha’s most basic genetic verification, and then programmed memories and simulated language logic to make these replicas believe they were the real "Xiang Nanli."

Before defecting from the Human Alliance, the self-aware Alpha had deleted all biological data related to Xiang Nanli within the Alliance.

After defecting, he had crazily destroyed images, text, and documents related to Xiang Nanli... which was perhaps something Luo Yang was happy to see.

Alpha no longer wanted to see those fakes, experiencing countless hopes only to be disappointed.

Yet he was afraid that the real one might be hidden among the counterfeits. He had to personally make contact, observe, verify them one by one, and only dispose of them after confirming they couldn't possibly be Xiang Nanli.

In his earlier years, Alpha had caught many viruses because of this. The mechanical legion had been paralyzed several times as a result, though fortunately, nothing major happened.

Beta completely failed to understand this. It also had creators, a group. But it had no feelings for those humans, nor was it grateful. It was even less likely to have such severe operational failures due to emotional issues.

How did Alpha answer at the time? He didn't answer, but thought in his heart: We are different; you are just tools.

But Xiang Nanli loves me.

Does he? You cannot not love me; you must love me.

……

……

The man who made the artificial intelligence restless was sleeping in the car in an awkward position.

Dongfang Qingdi moved his head, shifting it from his shoulder to his lap, trying to make Xiang Nanli sleep more comfortably.

He was already a mature mechanical being. He admitted that this Xiang Nanli made him feel something special... that familiar, vibrant feeling.

But they had no future. Sooner or later, he would have to take this body back to the mechanical legion; this human was just a tool for him to maintain his signal along the way! He would not make a judgment.

The "tool" hummed softly: "Little Qing, turn up the air conditioning, it’s cold."

Dongfang Qingdi was stunned, took off his own coat and covered Xiang Nanli with it, and then scolded the small AI responsible for driving with a cold face—

[The most suitable temperature for the human body is 25 degrees Celsius. Can’t you even control such a small thing? How have you been driving for all these years?]

[...I, I’m sorry.]

Dongfang Qingdi’s expression softened slightly: [It’s fine. You are just a low-level intelligent AI, and the Human Alliance is too stingy to upgrade you, so I can't expect too much from you.]

Until they got off the car, the small AI didn't quite understand why it had developed such awe for that android passenger from the depths of its source code.

Ah. It should go to the "Scavenger" to run a virus scan, right?

*

Gusu City, 11th Public Hospital.

Andrew sat at the diagnostic desk.

The patient opposite him looked very healthy, a mix of who knew what races, around 35 years old, his hair styled with pomade, his eyes revealing the shrewdness of a businessman.

The patient looked perfectly normal, but Andrew sensed a trace of danger.

This intuition for danger had saved him many times.

However, the mechanical smile on Andrew’s face did not change: "This patient. We are a public hospital here, you can enjoy social insurance. How can I be of service to you?"

The emphasis was actually on the words "public hospital."

Andrew glanced at the name on the medical file: Rein.

"Yes. But doctors always have to get off work, right?" Rein replied, "Don't you think?"

This was a threat. Andrew replied with some difficulty: "Is there something you need?"

"Previously, Jesse sold my subordinates two mechanical hands that didn't look like models circulating on the market. He said they were put together by someone named 'Xiang Nanli.' This is a black-market technician with very good skills." Rein asked, and pulled a business card from his pocket, handing it to him, "I heard he is your patient."

The metal card was black, reading "Fight Club Manager, Rein."

Andrew thought he knew who Rein was.

Gusu City was far from the center of power, and there were many chaotic underground organizations here.

Some were just young people venting their emotions, doing some scams when they couldn't make ends meet; others had inextricable links with black forces on the surface. The Fight Club clearly belonged to the latter.

Andrew: "Yes, but my dear, I have no contact with him. And he should have gone missing on the surface; I haven't seen that kid for almost two months."

"Oh, is that so? He replied to one of my brothers' messages just yesterday, saying he had no plans to go to the surface for consultations recently."

Andrew’s lie was exposed on the spot, causing some slight embarrassment.

chunks.chineseText:
“你应该知道他住在哪吧？”莱因拍着他的肩膀，唇角微微上扬，“其实我们找他，也不是什么坏事。搏击俱乐部的选手们机械义体损坏几率很高，经常需要维修。那些机械技师要么技术不够，要么价格太贵。最近选拔赛开始了，老板吩咐我们找几个好点的技师。是个赚大钱的生意，不会为难他的。”

选拔赛。全名高等生物选拔赛。私人赛事，经常死人。但冠军有天价奖金。所以总有年轻人趋之若鹜。

但安德鲁呆了这么多年，却知道那些冠军很多都在获胜后不知所踪。

大概是被带回了阴山城？

安德鲁有些为难，心虚道：“但我是真的不知道，亲爱的。”

“你，”莱因的眼神锐利，低声威胁道，“一直在往姑苏城监狱匿名寄钱，是不想被人发现吧？那个死刑犯。我们在监狱里可是有不少人。”

安德鲁工作六百年还没攒下一套房，原因当然不止是房价太贵。

姑苏城的监狱里关着安德鲁的一位故人。也许算不上朋友。

世界上有两种人，耗材和天才，后者决定人类未来的走向。

安德鲁是前者。相南里和他都是后者。

他的罪名是危害人类罪，本应该是死刑；但因为上交了大量的口供、技术，改成了无期徒刑。那位故人的机械化程度也高达百分之99，所以很方便地清理了记忆。

安德鲁曾经去监狱见过他。四百年前还是更久？小机器人，头上一个透明的玻璃罩子，里面装着粉红的脑子，脑子上还安装着定时炸弹。一旦离开监狱，炸弹就会爆炸。

人类很厌恶智械人。虽然他不是智械，但机械程度这么高，理所当然地遭到了歧视和孤立。安德鲁去探望的时候，他被揍的电线都出来了。

面前的人茫然、好奇、胆怯。

安德鲁闭上眼，却都是他在研究室里意气风发的模样。

安德鲁没办法忘记。

只好每个月都给狱警寄钱。几百年来，狱警都换了好多个。当年令人发指的罪行也被遗忘在历史中。那位故人依然在服着他不知道犯了什么事的无期徒刑。

安德鲁的身体紧绷，最后叹了口气：“好吧，我去联系一下。”

好吧，他承认，自己其实没那么正义、高尚。

他是逃兵，是不敢面对自己回忆的牲畜。

莱因压住了他的手，微笑道：“择日不如撞日，就现在吧。”

安德鲁只好打开通讯器。

“嘿，亲爱的。回到姑苏城了吗？我的身体好像出了一点故障，常约的那个机械师今天没上班，能帮我修修吗？我可以付钱，宝宝。”

几分钟后，安德鲁绝望地发现相南里居然真的扔过来一个地址。

你tm，能不能对人多一点防范心啊？！你是活在旧社会吗？我是什么好东西吗？！

莱因咧嘴笑了起来：“你是好医生，他也是个好技师。谢谢了。”

但扫了眼，莱因的眉头骤然蹙起，神色有些不太自然：“怎么是调查局的内部职工小区？”

但莱因还是打算去看一眼。毕竟在姑苏城这个小地方，没有官方背景、技术又好的机械技师真的很难找。而他们又是真的急用。

*

安德鲁的疑问。

东方青帝也有：“为什么要把地址给他？”

“呵呵，”相南里刷了一下公民ID卡，美美打开了新家的房门，新世界居然没有公摊，他很满意，“这狗东西把我的冷冻舱卖给收破烂的了。我总觉得他知道点什么，到时候他来家里，把他电线一拆，还不是让我为所欲为？最重要的是，卖冷冻舱的钱至少要分给我一半吧？”

东方青帝敏锐道：“你只是想拆他身体看看吧？”毕竟是纯机械的，符合相南里对机器人的刻板印象。

“嗯嗯。小青，你会保护我的，对吧？”

“理论上是的。”

东方青帝表情还是很冷酷。

他环顾了新家一眼，是二手房，上一个住着的应该也是机械师。三室一厅。最小的那个房间是机械师工作间。工具虽然都拿走了，一些基础的设备还留着。

其他家具都是新的。甚至还没拆封。看来之前有人特地打点过了。

洛修这小子还真不错，如果不是洛阳的种，东方青帝的评价会更高一点。

相南里伸着懒腰，神志不清地走向卧室：“小青，房子扫一下，我太困了。生物人就是这点不好，得睡一觉。醒来我想吃鸡公煲，你知道什么是鸡公煲吗……”

东方青帝：“喂，我不是家政机器人。”

卧室门已经关上了。

家里还没买清洁机器人。

东方青帝只好熟练地走向厨房，摘下防尘服套在自己身上。开始打扫卫生。

这里只有32层楼。小区环境不错，还有绿化。一条街外就是调查局、人联警局等等。

住在这里的住民哪怕不是什么名门望族，也是姑苏城的中坚力量。

嗯，公务员小区。

鸡公煲，上哪去找鸡公煲？东方青帝搜了一下整鸡的价格。1299信用点。

又搜了一下蔬菜和调料。挺好的，一顿饭加起来都到姑苏城平均工资了。真是难养的精贵人类。

大概一个小时后，门铃声响了起来。

东方青帝走过去，打开门。门外却不是他想的外卖机器人。

他低头，居高临下地看着面前西装革履的中年男人：“您哪位？有什么事吗？”

东方青帝眸光微动。

来的不止一个。

楼道里还躲着两个壮汉，持有外骨骼武器。

莱因站在东方青帝面前。感觉到了紧张。从进入这个小区开始，他就觉得事情好像……超出了他的预料。

首先，周围全是条子。

其次，这里房价很贵，意味着相南里也许不像是他猜测的那么贫穷、廉价。

最后，面前这个人眼里亮着瞳环。这表示对方是一名高级人造人。

哪怕是最便宜的高级人造人，市场价也是一千万信用点起跳。

见鬼，杰西不是说相南里只是个来历不明的黑户吗？！

莱因在短暂的沉默中，感觉自己可能需要切换一下策略。

他递出名片，微微鞠躬：“您好，我是搏击俱乐部的经理，来找相南里先生。鄙人听闻他是一名拥有卓越才能的机械技师，我们公司正在招聘机械师，因此想和他面谈。”

“是吗？”东方青帝接过名片，“他正在睡觉，你明天再来吧。”

莱因能感觉到，东方青帝压根没把这件事放在心上。

“小青啊……”

另一道温和的声音从房间里传来。

东方青帝转头：“吵醒你了？”

“有点。”相南里打了个哈欠。

半分钟后，莱因看到了把自己取名为“相南里”的男人。说真的，这个名字会有些敏感。和永生科技的那位创始人重名了。历史上，他因为Alpha的背叛，没少被人连带着攻讦。永生科技自己都很少提起这位创始者。

但这也不算什么大事。给自己取什么名字的人都有。
chunks.englishText:
"You should know where he lives, right?" Rein patted his shoulder, his lips curling slightly upward, "Actually, us looking for him isn't a bad thing. The fighters at the Fight Club have a high probability of damaging their mechanical prosthetics and often need repairs. Those mechanical technicians either lack the skill or are too expensive. The selection tournament started recently, and the boss ordered us to find a few good technicians. It’s a lucrative business; we won't make things difficult for him."

The selection tournament. Full name: Higher Organism Selection Tournament. A private event where people often died. But the champion received a sky-high prize, so young people always flocked to it.

But Andrew, having stayed here for so many years, knew that many of those champions disappeared without a trace after winning.

Probably taken back to Yinshan City?

Andrew was in a difficult spot and said with a guilty conscience: "But I really don't know, my dear."

"You," Rein’s eyes were sharp, threatening in a low voice, "have been anonymously sending money to the Gusu City prison, don't you want people to find out? That death-row prisoner. We have quite a few people in that prison."

Andrew hadn't saved up enough for a house after six hundred years of work, and the reason was certainly not just that housing prices were too high.

In the Gusu City prison, an old acquaintance of Andrew’s was locked up. Perhaps it couldn't be called a friend.

There are two types of people in the world: consumables and geniuses; the latter determine the future direction of humanity.

Andrew was the former. Xiang Nanli and he were both the latter.

His crime was crimes against humanity, which should have been a death sentence; but because he handed over a large amount of testimony and technology, it was commuted to life imprisonment. That old acquaintance’s level of mechanization was also as high as 99 percent, so it was very convenient to wipe his memory.

Andrew had once gone to the prison to see him. Four hundred years ago, or even longer? A small robot with a transparent glass dome on its head, containing a pink brain, with a timer bomb installed on it. Once he left the prison, the bomb would explode.

Humans despised mechanical beings. Although he wasn't a mechanical being, his level of mechanization was so high that he was naturally discriminated against and isolated. When Andrew went to visit, he had been beaten until his wires were sticking out.

The person in front of him was dazed, curious, and timid.

Andrew closed his eyes, but all he could see was the man’s spirited appearance in the research lab.

Andrew couldn't forget.

He had no choice but to send money to the prison guards every month. Over the hundreds of years, the prison guards had changed many times. The heinous crimes of the past had also been forgotten in history. That old acquaintance was still serving a life sentence for a crime he didn't even know he had committed.

Andrew’s body tensed, and finally, he sighed: "Alright, I’ll contact him."

Alright, he admitted that he wasn't actually that righteous or noble.

He was a deserter, a beast that didn't dare to face his own memories.

Rein pressed his hand down and smiled: "There's no time like the present, let's do it now."

Andrew had no choice but to open his communicator.

"Hey, my dear. Are you back in Gusu City? My body seems to have a slight malfunction, and the mechanic I usually see isn't working today. Can you help me fix it? I can pay, baby."

A few minutes later, Andrew discovered in despair that Xiang Nanli had actually thrown over an address.

You damn idiot, can you have a little more caution toward people?! Do you live in the old society? Am I some kind of good person?!

Rein grinned: "You’re a good doctor, and he’s a good technician. Thank you."

But after glancing at it, Rein’s brow suddenly furrowed, his expression somewhat unnatural: "Why is it the internal staff residential area of the Investigation Bureau?"

But Rein still planned to go take a look. After all, in a small place like Gusu City, it was really hard to find a mechanical technician with no official background who was also highly skilled. And they were truly in urgent need.

*

Andrew’s question.

Dongfang Qingdi had one too: "Why did you give him the address?"

"Heh," Xiang Nanli swiped his citizen ID card and happily opened the door to his new home. The new world actually had no shared area, which he was very satisfied with, "This dog-thing sold my cryo-pod to a scrap dealer. I always feel like he knows something. When he comes to the house, I’ll just dismantle his wires; won't that let me do whatever I want? Most importantly, at least half of the money from selling the cryo-pod should be split with me, right?"

Dongfang Qingdi said sharply: "You just want to dismantle his body to take a look, right?" After all, it was purely mechanical, fitting Xiang Nanli’s stereotypical impression of robots.

"Mm-hmm. Little Qing, you’ll protect me, right?"

"Theoretically, yes."

Dongfang Qingdi’s expression remained cold.

He looked around the new home; it was a second-hand apartment, and the previous resident must have been a mechanic too. Three bedrooms and a living room. The smallest room was the mechanic’s workshop. Although the tools had all been taken, some basic equipment remained.

The other furniture was new. It hadn't even been unpacked yet. It seemed someone had specifically taken care of it beforehand.

Luo Xiu was actually quite decent; if he weren't Luoyang’s spawn, Dongfang Qingdi’s evaluation would be even higher.

Xiang Nanli stretched and walked toward the bedroom in a daze: "Little Qing, sweep the house, I’m too tired. That’s the only bad thing about biological humans, you have to sleep. When I wake up, I want to eat chicken pot; do you know what chicken pot is..."

Dongfang Qingdi: "Hey, I’m not a housekeeping robot."

The bedroom door had already closed.

They hadn't bought a cleaning robot yet.

Dongfang Qingdi had no choice but to walk toward the kitchen skillfully, take off his dust-proof suit, and put it on himself. He began to clean.

This was only the 32nd floor. The residential area’s environment was nice, and there was even greenery. A street away were the Investigation Bureau, the Human Alliance Police Station, and so on.

The residents living here, even if not from prestigious families, were the backbone of Gusu City.

Hmm, a civil servant residential area.

Chicken pot, where to find chicken pot? Dongfang Qingdi searched for the price of a whole chicken. 1299 credit points.

He also searched for vegetables and seasonings. Very good, the cost of one meal added up to the average salary in Gusu City. Truly an expensive human to raise.

About an hour later, the doorbell rang.

Dongfang Qingdi walked over and opened the door. But outside was not the delivery robot he had expected.

He looked down, looking condescendingly at the middle-aged man in a suit and leather shoes in front of him: "Who are you? What is it?"

Dongfang Qingdi’s eyes flickered.

There was more than one person.

Two strong men were hiding in the hallway, holding exoskeleton weapons.

Rein stood in front of Dongfang Qingdi. He felt nervous. From the moment he entered this residential area, he felt that things seemed to... exceed his expectations.

First, the place was full of cops.

Second, the housing prices here were very expensive, meaning Xiang Nanli might not be as poor and cheap as he had guessed.

Finally, the person in front of him had pupil rings glowing in his eyes. This indicated that the other party was a high-level android.

Even the cheapest high-level android had a market price starting at ten million credit points.

Damn it, didn't Jesse say Xiang Nanli was just a black-market resident of unknown origin?!

In the brief silence, Rein felt he might need to switch strategies.

He handed out his business card and bowed slightly: "Hello, I am the manager of the Fight Club, here to see Mr. Xiang Nanli. I have heard that he is a mechanical technician with outstanding talent. Our company is currently hiring mechanics, so I would like to have a face-to-face talk with him."

"Is that so?" Dongfang Qingdi took the business card, "He is sleeping, come back tomorrow."

Rein could feel that Dongfang Qingdi hadn't taken this matter to heart at all.

"Little Qing..."

Another gentle voice came from the room.

Dongfang Qingdi turned his head: "Did I wake you?"

"A little." Xiang Nanli yawned.

Half a minute later, Rein saw the man who had named himself "Xiang Nanli." Honestly, this name was a bit sensitive. It was the same name as that founder of Eternal Technology. Historically, because of Alpha’s betrayal, he had been attacked by association many times. Even Eternal Technology rarely mentioned this founder.

But that wasn't a big deal. People named themselves all sorts of things.

chunks.chineseText:
很年轻的男人，身上一点伤痕和机械改造的痕迹都没有。肤色匀称，柔和细腻。

还有那双眼睛。

太灵动了，又很平和。像通透漂亮的绿翡翠。

生活困苦的人很难养出这样的眼神。他们往往尖锐，充满竞争，恨不得把周围人都咬死，抢走一切可能的资源，因为感受过饥饿，撑到吐也不想从指间里漏出一点分给别人。

莱因已经感觉不到希望了，嘴里发苦：“我们正在为‘高等生物选拔赛’招聘编外机械技师……在地表，活动有阴山城的赞助。那边还会派代表来观赛，机械化程度30以下的人都可以报名。获胜者可以拿到5级基因药。机械师的报酬也很丰厚。”

姑苏城在地图上是靠近阴山城的。尽管两者间也有7个小时的车程。如果是走地表的路，最少要开个五六天。

“啊，工资多少？”

莱因最开始是不想给工资的。

后来看见这个小区环境，感觉起码要给点钱才能把人请动。

只是他看着相南里这张养尊处优的脸，预想中的“六万”实在有点说不出口，只好询问：“……六十万？”

相南里靠在门边，微微眯起眼，似笑非笑：“这是我的二维码，加个好友吧，资料发给我看看。”
chunks.englishText:
A very young man, without a single scar or trace of mechanical modification on his body. His skin tone was even, soft, and delicate.

And those eyes.

They were too lively, yet very peaceful. Like clear, beautiful green jade.

It was hard for people living in poverty to cultivate such a look in their eyes. They were often sharp, full of competition, wishing they could bite everyone around them to death and snatch away every possible resource, because having experienced hunger, they wouldn't let even a drop leak through their fingers to share with others, even if they were stuffed to the point of vomiting.

Rein could no longer feel hope, his mouth tasting bitter: "We are hiring freelance mechanical technicians for the 'Higher Organism Selection Tournament'... On the surface, the event is sponsored by Yinshan City. They will also send representatives to watch the competition. Anyone with a mechanization level below 30 can sign up. The winner can get a Level 5 gene drug. The pay for the technician is also very generous."

Gusu City was on the map near Yinshan City. Although there was a 7-hour drive between them. If one took the surface road, it would take at least five or six days.

"Ah, what’s the salary?"

Rein originally didn't want to pay a salary.

But after seeing the environment of this residential area, he felt that he had to pay at least some money to get the person to move.

It was just that looking at Xiang Nanli’s pampered face, the "sixty thousand" he had anticipated was really hard to say out loud, so he had to ask: "...Six hundred thousand?"

Xiang Nanli leaned against the door frame, squinting slightly, smiling but not quite: "This is my QR code, add me as a friend, and send me the information to look over."

chunks.chineseText:
第29章

莱因发出好友申请，并且友好地和相南里告别。

相南里表现的非常淡定，但是门一关上，就没在沙发上翻滚了起来：“我没听错吧？他说的是60万吧？”

“嗯，没错。”东方青帝回答。直到感觉到门外的三个壮汉老实地离去，这才收回思绪，“不过，他本来是想0元购的。”

相南里的心情很好：“无所谓，起码现在他要付我工资了。”

两个月前他还在为明天的呼吸费发愁。一转眼房子存款竟然都有了。

虽然和上辈子相比还是差距有点远。但整体是曲折中前进，这是好事，证明哪怕是在新世界，他也有生存下去的能力。迟早有天……

相南里的表情突然顿住。

是的，他已经接受了现实。相南里想，可是迟早有天他要干嘛呢，证明自己就是历史里那个人，然后站在人联的演讲台上为创造出Alpha道歉吗？

我该忏悔吗？我要赎罪吗？

他的确感到了内疚，但绝对不由旁人审判。

科技明明该是无罪的。

而且，在一个连常识都能修改的地方，他凭什么相信历史？

相南里打开电视屏幕。在没有购买节目的时候，屏幕是默认的同纬度天空。电视上的画面会随着时间的改动而改动。

现在是夜晚。

相南里在屏幕里看见了三个月亮。

相南里用胳膊撑着下巴，若有所思：“小青。外面真的有三个月亮吗？这似乎和我记忆里的不太一样。”

“抱歉，我还没有见过天空。”

“我也没有。”

虽然他去过地表，但那里雾霾太厚了。哪怕是夜晚，也笼罩着一层晦暗的云雾。那是钴弹爆炸后在平流层留下的放射性尘埃。还未衰变结束的伽马射线也在影响着人们的生存。

这颗星球依然在自净中。

外卖无人机送来了东方青帝网购的食材。

他接过，走进厨房。

东方青帝没学过烹饪，但这不算什么大问题。

他直接复制了一段“黄焖鸡制作”的运行代码，粘贴到自己的行动模块中，并且放心地让身体处于挂机状态。

他回到了相南里身体里，然后偷看起相南里和莱因的聊天。

Alpha觉得自己并不是什么偷窥狂，他只是担心相南里涉世未深，被莱因哄骗。

【莱因：您好。这是我们俱乐部的信息[搏击俱乐部]，请放心，我们俱乐部有备案，非常正规。都是专业的搏击手，和那些地下黑拳不一样。】

他刚说完，Alpha搜了一下俱乐部的监控，用“我的文件”发了段视频给相南里。

[搏击俱乐部分日场和夜场。日场是正常俱乐部，夜场你自己看。]

相南里点开视频，拖拽到聊天框的另一侧。

一个像是酒吧的地方，最中央有一个擂台。周围的彩光晃得人光敏性癫痫都要犯了。

擂台上有两人。身上都有机械改造过的痕迹。

一方是少年，五官还有些青涩。看起来顶多18岁，眼神凶狠。膝盖和手指的关节处都有金属覆盖。

另一方是成年人，身材高大，光头，皮肤深棕色，身高直逼两米，两条手臂都换成了机械臂。

擂台禁止使用热武器。而肌肉的强度和金属的强度，根本不在同一个层面上。

一堆人围在擂台周围喊着：“来点刺激的，该死人了。”

另一波人同样在叫：“赔率8：1。还有谁要下注？”

服务员们在人群中穿梭，送着酒水和小食。

这些服务员是机器人，明显是按照爱偶仿生款制造的。有些咸猪手猥亵地摸着它们的身体，美丽的机器人们也无动于衷，甚至会露出甜甜的笑容。当然，如果需要更进一步，就得支付小费了。

老板只需要在购买它们的时候付款一次，此后所有收入都是纯利润，也不需要支付工资。很划算不是吗？没有心的机器人懂什么。

擂台上的比赛开始了。壮汉大吼一声，冲向对面的年轻人。他知道观众爱看什么。也知道很多人在他身上下了注。

对面的年轻人弯腰，躲开这一拳，抱住了他的膝盖，狠狠往后一砸。

这个擂台完全没有保护。除了热武器和嘴，不禁止任何手段的进攻。

为了打起来好看，甚至连机械改造的程度都有严格的控制。

大块头单从体格上就有优势，他抱住年轻人翻滚着，把他压在地上，一拳一拳砸向对方的脑袋。

“咚咚咚”，声音沉闷如同擂鼓。血液和其他生物组织黏在他铁一般的拳头上，随着他的动作甩向擂台四方。

少年在他身下挣扎着，死死抠着他的背，他胳膊上的血管隆起，黑红的血液流动着。浑身皮肤发红。

大块头冷笑着抓住他的胳膊，以一种奇怪的角度拉扯着，肌肉撑不住这种程度的压力，竟然从跟腱断裂开，血喷涌而出，露出里面的金属结构。

他直接拔下了这条胳膊，连着血肉丢去一边。

机械义体直接甩飞到台下，周围发出热烈的欢呼声。大概觉得刺激。

相南里眉头蹙起，感觉到生理性不适。

他还是太文明了。

少年断了条手臂，但就像是打开了什么基因锁的开关，肌肉撕裂出的腱鞘像是吸水一样膨胀起来，一条血红色的、与他体型完全不符的胳膊从那里生长出。表面还长满肉瘤。

他双目赤红，嘶吼着握住了壮汉的头颅，把他高高举起——

壮汉双脚离地，眼里出现了惊恐：“我认输！我认输！”

但扣在他脑袋的五指并没有松开，而是缓缓收紧。

裁判员的声音从音响里传来：“够了，停下！”

台下传来枪声。但没有子弹，只是麻醉枪。

少年倒在了地上，陷入昏迷，身体在瞬间瘦削的像是骷髅，只剩一层皮。而他后来长出的那只血色巨手迅速萎缩，成了一摊烂肉，黏在擂台的地板上。

裁判上台，蹲下，握住少年完好的那条胳膊，高高举起：“获胜者——天狼星！”

噢，原来这个年轻人叫天狼星。怪名字。

[高等生命选拔赛的残酷程度，比录像只高不低。它们压根不需要机械技师，只需要选出最强壮最有潜力、能承受最多次基因改造的肉体，以证明基因改造其实比机械改造更具潜力。我其实不建议你去。]

相南里略加思索：“小青？你怎么不好好做饭，跑回来偷看我跟人聊天。”

[你认错了。]AI回答。

相南里挑眉：“我自己的AI，我还认不出来？”

【莱因：这次选拔赛在地表，附近三个城市的选手都会来参加。我们俱乐部因为过去一直和选拔赛官方有合作，所以分到3个名额。参赛需要自带机械技师，而且把维修工作交给其他人，我们也不放心。但我们的机械技师死了。】

【莱因：居然不是仇杀。他多巴胺片磕多了，产生幻觉，淹死在了浴室里。】

【相南里：……】

你们地底人怎么回事。一个个法外狂徒就算了，还喜欢嗑药。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 29

Lai Yin sent a friend request and bid a friendly farewell to Xiang Nanli.

Xiang Nanli appeared very calm, but the moment the door closed, he began rolling around on the sofa: "I didn't hear that wrong, did I? He said 600,000, right?"

"Yes, that's correct," Dongfang Qingdi replied. Only after sensing that the three burly men outside the door had honestly departed did he withdraw his focus. "Though, he originally intended to 'purchase' it for zero yuan."

Xiang Nanli was in a great mood: "Doesn't matter. At least now he has to pay me a salary."

Two months ago, he was still worrying about the cost of breathing for the next day. In the blink of an eye, he suddenly had both a house and savings.

Although it was still a far cry from his previous life, the overall trajectory was progress through twists and turns. This was a good thing; it proved that even in this new world, he possessed the ability to survive. Sooner or later...

Xiang Nanli's expression suddenly froze.

Yes, he had already accepted reality. Xiang Nanli thought, but what was he going to do "sooner or later"? Prove that he was that person from history, and then stand on the United Nations podium to apologize for creating the Alpha?

Should I repent? Do I need to seek atonement?

He did feel guilty, but that was certainly not for others to judge.

Technology, after all, should be innocent.

Moreover, in a place where even common sense could be rewritten, why should he trust history?

Xiang Nanli turned on the TV screen. When no programs were purchased, the screen defaulted to the sky at the same latitude. The image on the TV would change as time passed.

It was night now.

Xiang Nanli saw three moons on the screen.

Xiang Nanli rested his chin on his hand, thoughtful: "Xiao Qing, are there really three moons outside? This seems a bit different from what I remember."

"Apologies, I have not yet seen the sky."

"Neither have I."

Although he had been to the surface, the smog there was too thick. Even at night, it was shrouded in a layer of gloomy clouds. That was the radioactive dust left in the stratosphere after the cobalt bomb explosions. Gamma rays that had not yet finished decaying were also affecting people's survival.

This planet was still in the process of self-purification.

A delivery drone arrived with the ingredients Dongfang Qingdi had ordered online.

He took them and walked into the kitchen.

Dongfang Qingdi had never learned to cook, but that wasn't a significant problem.

He directly copied a segment of "Yellow Braised Chicken Preparation" runtime code, pasted it into his action module, and confidently let his body enter "idle" mode.

He returned to Xiang Nanli's body and began peeking at the chat between Xiang Nanli and Lai Yin.

The Alpha didn't consider himself a voyeur; he was simply worried that Xiang Nanli was too inexperienced and would be swindled by Lai Yin.

【Lai Yin: Hello. This is the information for our club [Fight Club]. Please rest assured, our club is registered and very professional. We are all professional fighters, unlike those underground black-market brawls.】

Just after saying that, the Alpha searched the club's surveillance and sent a video to Xiang Nanli using "My Files."

[Fight Club has day sessions and night sessions. The day sessions are normal club activities; see for yourself what the night sessions are like.]

Xiang Nanli clicked on the video and dragged it to the other side of the chat box.

It was a place that looked like a bar, with a ring in the very center. The surrounding neon lights were enough to trigger photosensitive epilepsy.

There were two people in the ring. Both had traces of mechanical modification on their bodies.

One was a youth with still-green features. He looked at most 18, his eyes fierce. His knees and finger joints were covered in metal.

The other was an adult, tall and burly, bald, with dark brown skin and a height approaching two meters; both his arms had been replaced with mechanical ones.

The ring prohibited the use of thermal weapons. But the strength of muscle and the strength of metal were simply not on the same level.

A crowd surrounded the ring, shouting: "Give us something exciting! Someone should die!"

Another group was also calling out: "Odds are 8:1. Who else wants to bet?"

Waiters wove through the crowd, delivering drinks and snacks.

These waiters were robots, clearly manufactured according to the "Love Doll" bionic model. Some lecherous hands touched their bodies, but the beautiful robots remained indifferent, even flashing sweet smiles. Of course, if one wanted to go further, a tip was required.

The boss only needed to pay once when purchasing them; all subsequent income was pure profit, and no wages were needed. Quite cost-effective, isn't it? What would a heartless robot know?

The match in the ring began. The big man let out a roar and charged at the young man opposite him. He knew what the audience loved to see. He also knew many had placed bets on him.

The young man bent down, dodged the punch, grabbed the big man's knee, and slammed it backward with force.

This ring had absolutely no protection. Aside from thermal weapons and mouths, no means of attack were forbidden.

To make the fights look better, even the degree of mechanical modification was strictly controlled.

The big man had an advantage in sheer physique alone; he hugged the youth, rolled over, pinned him to the ground, and smashed his head with punch after punch.

"Thud, thud, thud," the sound was as dull as a war drum. Blood and other biological tissues stuck to his iron-like fists, splattering to all corners of the ring with his movements.

The youth struggled beneath him, digging his fingers into the big man's back. The veins on his arms bulged, black-red blood flowing. His entire skin turned red.

The big man sneered and grabbed the youth's arm, pulling it at a strange angle. The muscles couldn't withstand that level of pressure and actually tore from the Achilles tendon, blood gushing out and revealing the metal structure inside.

He ripped the arm right off, tossing it aside along with the flesh.

The mechanical prosthetic was flung out of the ring, and the surrounding crowd erupted in cheers. They probably found it exciting.

Xiang Nanli frowned, feeling a sense of physiological discomfort.

He was still too civilized.

The youth had lost an arm, but it was as if a "genetic lock" had been triggered. The tendon sheath where the muscle had torn began to swell as if absorbing water, and a blood-red arm, completely disproportionate to his size, grew out from that spot. The surface was even covered in tumors.

His eyes turned blood-red, and he roared as he gripped the big man's head, lifting him high—

The big man's feet left the ground, and terror appeared in his eyes: "I surrender! I surrender!"

But the five fingers locked onto his head did not loosen; instead, they slowly tightened.

The referee's voice came over the speakers: "Enough, stop!"

Gunshots rang out from under the stage. But there were no bullets, only tranquilizer darts.

The youth collapsed to the ground, falling into a coma. His body instantly shriveled like a skeleton, leaving only a layer of skin. The blood-red giant hand that had grown out withered rapidly, becoming a pool of rotting flesh stuck to the floor of the ring.

The referee stepped onto the stage, knelt down, grabbed the youth's intact arm, and raised it high: "The winner—Sirius!"

Oh, so this young man was called Sirius. A strange name.

[The cruelty of the Higher Life Selection Tournament is even higher than what you see in the recordings. They don't need mechanical technicians at all; they only need to select the strongest, most potential-filled bodies capable of withstanding the most genetic modifications, to prove that genetic modification actually has more potential than mechanical modification. I actually don't recommend you go.]

Xiang Nanli pondered for a moment: "Xiao Qing? Why aren't you cooking properly and instead came back to peek at me chatting with someone?"

[You are mistaken,] the AI replied.

Xiang Nanli raised an eyebrow: "I can't even recognize my own AI?"

【Lai Yin: This time, the selection tournament is on the surface, and contestants from the three nearby cities will participate. Because our club has long cooperated with the tournament officials, we were allocated 3 spots. Participation requires bringing your own mechanical technician, and we aren't comfortable handing the maintenance work to others. But our mechanical technician died.】

【Lai Yin: It wasn't even a vendetta. He took too many dopamine pills, hallucinated, and drowned in the bathtub.】

【Xiang Nanli: ...】

What is wrong with you people from the underground? It's one thing that you're all outlaws, but you also like to do drugs.

chunks.chineseText:
要不是见过洛阳城里欣欣向荣的景象，总有一种人类要完的错觉。

【莱因：这段时间我们俱乐部一直在找合适的机械技师。】

但那些人要么技术不过关，要么生活太好不想蹚浑水，要么漫天要价。最高的甚至都敢开价三百万，前36强的奖金都没三百万！

【相南里：60万，税前还是税后啊？】

【莱因：……我的朋友。请放心，我们会以不用交税的方式把工资发给你的，在结束后。】

比如让相南里注册一个全息游戏账号，在里面交易某个游戏装备，再把游戏装备挂在黑网上贩卖，然后钱就通过合法到手了。只要数额不高，不会引起人联的警觉。银行也不会查账。

相南里承认，这笔钱对他来说很有诱惑力。

他不愿意接受脑机端口改造，有了这笔钱，相南里就能买一台便宜点的登陆舱了。

非要说的话，数据的世界才是他的主场。

哪怕他掌握的知识落后时代几个版本，但他不是在学吗？

【相南里：这趟活很危险，得加钱。而且我要一半工资作为定金。】

如果是一般人这么说，莱因已经把不知好歹的东西拉黑了。

但是……

莱因闭上眼，回想起相南里拼好的那两条机械手臂。

他问过杰西当时的情况，也问过自己相当认可的一位机械技师（她在姑苏大学执教）。

对方是这么告诉他的——“非常天才的设计。把一堆垃圾变成了能用的机械装置。在同等条件下，我做不到。你真的不是在开玩笑吗？真的有人能做到？”

【莱因：我可以用自己的权限给你涨到80万。再多不行了，成本太高。】

【相南里：可以，合同发我。】

东方青帝的思绪回到厨房。

很好，挂机这么一会，饭都要做好了，锅里的红烧汁咕噜咕噜地冒着泡，香气飘了出来。农场的鸡虽然卖得贵，但选种和繁育都很讲究，油厚肉嫩，怎么煮都好吃。

要去就去吧，相南里是去当义体维修工，又不是亲自去打拳。危险程度没他想的那么大。

而且真出什么情况，他也不是死人。

结果他在这饭都还没端上去呢，就看见相南里断掉和莱因的对话框，然后打开了电子商城，直接搜索“保姆机器人”，认真浏览起来。

一分钟后，相南里把一款标签为“人型/成男体/多功能”的保姆机器人加入购物袋中，然后选择支付。

他的眼前弹出了付款失败的提示框。

而且付款一连失败了三次。

相南里问道：“小青，家里是不是断网了？”

下一秒。

“你买这个干什么。”东方青帝拉开厨房门，靠在门边，手里握着炒菜勺，阴森森地开口。像男鬼。

相南里并不清楚，在这个年代，保姆机器人只是为了规避人联审核的一种含蓄说法。它们的主业是爱偶，副业才是家政。

相南里看向他，语气略微疑惑：“但你刚刚不是还说，你不是家政机器人？家里总得有人做家务吧。”

东方青帝的表情由阴转晴又转阴：“现在是了。”

说完，他重重关上了厨房门。

留下相南里一个人在沙发上莫名其妙，不知道又哪里招惹到了他。

这就是人和非人的差别吗？智能AI的逻辑可真难猜。

*

相南里在第二天，就收到了莱因发来的合同。

他给东方青帝过目了一遍，按照人联法律，没什么风险。但这种合同压根不受法律保护，全看俱乐部自觉。

而且工作的日期也非常赶，竟然就在3天后。怪不得莱因病急乱投医。

【莱因：这是我们俱乐部的地址。我希望在出发前，你和我们的选手接触一下。毕竟要一起合作。】

这个请求很合理，相南里没有拒绝。

因为三天后又要出发去地表，相南里特地买了行李箱。里面装着他在商场买的衣服，有他的，也有东方青帝的。剩下就是各种营养液，药物以及维修工具。

才入住几天，家里多了许多机械零件。

相南里把随手拼好的触发装置放在鞋柜上，乘坐电梯下楼。东方青帝提着箱子，跟在他身边。

司机就是莱因，大概是因为找到了机械技师，他看起来心情不错。

电车从相南里所在的中城区一路开回下城区。附近的楼房明显老旧许多，楼间距变窄，环境陈旧。

马路上到处都是轮胎印，墙上画着乱七八糟的涂鸦。有政治口号，有机器人模型，有游戏里的台词，甚至有相亲交友的联系方式。

相南里还看见一群朋克青年骑着摩托车呼啸而过，在路过莱恩的“豪车”时，一个骑手故意往车窗上吐口水，随后大笑着离去。看来什么时代都不缺鬼火少年。

俱乐部的入口在一间酒吧里，一扇门，通往地下。

现在是白天，酒吧还没营业。服务机器人们一排排靠墙站着，毫无生机，背后是充电桩。

因为过于像人，这一幕其实有些恐怖。

莱因推开办公室的门，露出后面的电梯，微笑道：“走吧，地下就是了，我的选手们已经在等你了。”

相南里和东方青帝走进电梯，直接到了负一楼。

这里和观众入场的地点不一样，办公室直达员工休息室。

眼前的电梯门刚打开，一排排的壮汉，就映入相南里的眼前。

坐在最前方的有三个，相南里已经看过他们的资料，这三个人分别叫“天狼星”、“海王星”、“冥王星”，是这次要去参加选拔赛的选手。

相南里在视频里见过“天狼星”，但那应该是两年前的视频？现在的天狼星看起来更成熟一些，五官深邃。脸上还多了一道疤。

而后面的，则是俱乐部其他签约拳手。

在没有进入俱乐部之前，这些人是混混、流浪汉、盗贼、飞车党。

是相南里上辈子根本接触不到的一类人，他们离他光鲜亮丽的人生太远。

拳手们的表情耐人寻味。三三两两聚在一起，打量的目光落在相南里的身上。

感觉就像是正在打量着要动手的目标。

而坐在最前方的三个人更是毫无表示。

海王星和冥王星互相聊天，说今晚要睡的男妓；天狼星胳膊和脖子上都缠着绷带，连头也没抬。

[小青，我再问一遍，你是真的打得过，对吧？]相南里问。

东方青帝扫了眼：[单挑都不是我的对手。]

[那群殴呢？]

东方青帝思考两秒：[你尽量往没人的地方躲。]

莱恩咳嗽了一声：“我的摇钱树们，开心点。来，介绍一下，这是我花大价钱请来的机械技师，叫相南里。”

各种打量的目光停留在他那张过分年轻的脸上。不像是看同伴，像猎人看着猎物，思考着玩弄还是撕碎。

人群有些牢骚：“经理，你别是去技校找的没毕业的学生吧？”

对了，相南里之前还去技校登记了。系主任不愧是被打点过的人，很好说话。

他现在是一年级生，不用上课，两年后就能毕业。
chunks.englishText:
If I hadn't seen the thriving scene in Luoyang City, I would have had the constant illusion that humanity was finished.

【Lai Yin: Our club has been looking for a suitable mechanical technician during this time.】

But those people either lacked the technical skills, lived too comfortably to want to get involved in this mess, or demanded exorbitant prices. The highest one even dared to ask for three million! The prize money for the top 36 wasn't even three million!

【Xiang Nanli: 600,000, is that pre-tax or post-tax?】

【Lai Yin: ...My friend. Please rest assured, we will pay your salary in a way that doesn't require taxes, after it's over.】

For instance, by having Xiang Nanli register a holographic game account, trading a piece of game equipment within it, and then selling that equipment on the black web. The money would then be obtained legally. As long as the amount isn't high, it won't trigger the United Nations' alert. The bank won't audit the account either.

Xiang Nanli admitted that this sum of money was very tempting to him.

He was unwilling to accept brain-computer interface modification, but with this money, Xiang Nanli could buy a cheaper login pod.

If he had to say, the world of data was his home turf.

Even if the knowledge he possessed was several versions behind the times, wasn't he learning?

【Xiang Nanli: This job is very dangerous, you have to add money. And I want half the salary as a deposit.】

If it were an ordinary person saying this, Lai Yin would have already blocked the ungrateful wretch.

But...

Lai Yin closed his eyes, recalling the two mechanical arms Xiang Nanli had pieced together.

He had asked Jessie about the situation at the time, and he had also asked a mechanical technician he highly respected (who taught at Gusu University).

The other party had told him—"A very genius design. Turning a pile of trash into a functional mechanical device. Under the same conditions, I couldn't do it. Are you really not joking? Is there really someone who can do that?"

【Lai Yin: I can use my own authority to raise it to 800,000 for you. No more than that, the cost is too high.】

【Xiang Nanli: Fine, send me the contract.】

Dongfang Qingdi's thoughts returned to the kitchen.

Very good, in the short time he was "idle," the meal was almost ready. The braised chicken sauce in the pot was bubbling, and the aroma was wafting out. Although farm-raised chickens were expensive, the selection and breeding were very meticulous; the oil was rich and the meat tender, delicious no matter how it was cooked.

If he wants to go, let him go. Xiang Nanli is going to be a prosthetic maintenance worker, not going to fight in the ring himself. The danger level isn't as high as he thinks.

And if something really happens, he isn't a dead man.

As a result, before he had even served the food, he saw Xiang Nanli disconnect the chat box with Lai Yin, open the electronic mall, and start browsing seriously, searching for "nanny robot."

A minute later, Xiang Nanli added a nanny robot labeled "Humanoid/Adult Male/Multi-functional" to his shopping cart and chose to pay.

A payment failure prompt popped up in front of him.

And the payment failed three times in a row.

Xiang Nanli asked: "Xiao Qing, is the internet at home down?"

The next second.

"What are you buying this for?" Dongfang Qingdi opened the kitchen door, leaning against the frame, holding a spatula, and speaking in a gloomy tone. Like a male ghost.

Xiang Nanli was unaware that in this era, "nanny robot" was just a euphemism used to bypass United Nations audits. Their primary business was as love dolls, and their side business was housekeeping.

Xiang Nanli looked at him, his tone slightly puzzled: "But didn't you just say you aren't a housekeeping robot? Someone has to do the chores at home."

Dongfang Qingdi's expression shifted from gloomy to sunny and back to gloomy: "Now I am."

After saying that, he slammed the kitchen door shut.

Leaving Xiang Nanli alone on the sofa, feeling bewildered, not knowing where he had offended him again.

Is this the difference between a human and a non-human? The logic of an intelligent AI is truly hard to guess.

*

The next day, Xiang Nanli received the contract sent by Lai Yin.

He let Dongfang Qingdi look it over; according to United Nations law, there were no risks. But this kind of contract wasn't protected by law at all; it all depended on the club's conscience.

Moreover, the work date was very rushed—it was actually in 3 days. No wonder Lai Yin was desperate.

【Lai Yin: This is our club's address. I hope you can meet our contestants before we set off. After all, we have to work together.】

This request was very reasonable, and Xiang Nanli did not refuse.

Because they were leaving for the surface in three days, Xiang Nanli specifically bought a suitcase. Inside were clothes he bought at the mall—some for him, some for Dongfang Qingdi. The rest were various nutrient solutions, medicines, and maintenance tools.

Having only moved in a few days ago, the house now had many more mechanical parts.

Xiang Nanli placed the trigger device he had casually assembled on the shoe cabinet and took the elevator downstairs. Dongfang Qingdi carried the suitcase, walking beside him.

The driver was Lai Yin; perhaps because he had found a mechanical technician, he seemed to be in a good mood.

The electric car drove from the mid-town area where Xiang Nanli lived all the way back to the lower town. The nearby buildings were significantly older, the spacing between buildings narrower, and the environment dilapidated.

There were tire tracks everywhere on the road, and the walls were covered in messy graffiti. There were political slogans, robot models, lines from games, and even contact information for matchmaking and dating.

Xiang Nanli also saw a group of punk youths riding motorcycles whizzing past. When passing Lai Yin's "luxury car," one rider deliberately spat on the car window and then rode off laughing. It seems no era lacks "ghost fire" teenagers.

The entrance to the club was in a bar—a door leading underground.

It was daytime, and the bar wasn't open yet. The service robots were leaning against the wall in rows, lifeless, with charging stations behind them.

Because they were too human-like, this scene was actually quite terrifying.

Lai Yin pushed open the office door, revealing the elevator behind it, and smiled: "Let's go, it's underground; my contestants are already waiting for you."

Xiang Nanli and Dongfang Qingdi entered the elevator and went straight to the first basement level.

This place was different from where the audience entered; the office led directly to the staff lounge.

As soon as the elevator door opened, rows of burly men came into Xiang Nanli's view.

There were three sitting at the very front. Xiang Nanli had already read their files; these three were called "Sirius," "Neptune," and "Pluto," the contestants going to the selection tournament this time.

Xiang Nanli had seen "Sirius" in the video, but that must have been a video from two years ago? The current Sirius looked more mature, with deep-set features. There was even an extra scar on his face.

Behind them were the other signed fighters of the club.

Before entering the club, these people were thugs, homeless, thieves, and biker gang members.

They were a type of person Xiang Nanli could never have come into contact with in his previous life; they were too far removed from his glamorous life.

The fighters' expressions were intriguing. Gathered in twos and threes, their scrutinizing gazes landed on Xiang Nanli.

It felt as if they were sizing up a target they were about to attack.

And the three sitting at the very front showed no reaction at all.

Neptune and Pluto were chatting with each other about the male prostitutes they were going to sleep with tonight; Sirius had bandages wrapped around his arms and neck, and he didn't even lift his head.

[Xiao Qing, let me ask again, you really can beat them, right?] Xiang Nanli asked.

Dongfang Qingdi glanced over: [None of them are my match in a one-on-one.]

[What about a group fight?]

Dongfang Qingdi thought for two seconds: [Try to hide in a place where there's no one.]

Lai Yin coughed: "My cash cows, cheer up. Come, let me introduce you. This is the mechanical technician I hired at a great price, his name is Xiang Nanli."

Various scrutinizing gazes lingered on his overly young face. It wasn't like looking at a companion; it was like hunters looking at prey, wondering whether to toy with it or tear it apart.

The crowd grumbled a bit: "Manager, don't tell me you went to a technical school and found a student who hasn't even graduated yet?"

Right, Xiang Nanli had previously registered at a technical school. The department head was indeed someone who had been "greased," and was very easy to talk to.

He was now a first-year student, didn't need to attend classes, and would graduate in two years.

chunks.chineseText:
所以从某种程度上讲，对方说的也没错。

“什么水平？就来修义体。”

“唷，还带人造人。不会要带去地表吧，吃得这么好？度假呢。”

这是还算好听的，一看就接受过地下城五年义务教育。

还有一些说得更难听，

他们的态度完全称不上尊敬。

莱因看上去很是为难。也不知道是真的为难，还是装出来给相南里看的。

他没有刻意吩咐过，但这些地下拳手本就是刀尖舔血的野兽，相南里如果驯服不了，莱因只能考虑去请其他更适合的人。

东方青帝的眉心蹙起，眼看就要动手，相南里在此时摁住了他的肩膀。

[我自己处理。]

武力镇压当然方便，但这只是一时的。东方青帝又不可能随时在他身边。

相南里向前一步，唇角上扬，环顾四周：“我的确就读于姑苏城机械维修技术学校，今天受你们经理邀请，来俱乐部进行义体维修。”

说完，相南里拉开椅子，坐了下来。

东方青帝蹲下，打开行李箱。拿出相南里自带的工具，列在了一旁的桌子上。

莱因的预付款有40万，一半都变成了桌子上的这些工具和仪器。

当一个人有其他人伺候的时候，会看起来很有气场。

四周一时安静了下来，表情惊疑不定。

相南里的声音微冷：“愣着干什么，排好。知道请我一次要多少钱吗？！”

第一个被推出来试水的，是站在后排的一个中年人。

他瞎了一只眼，另一只装着凸起的义眼，像是摄像头镜头。

独眼龙在相南里对面坐下，撩开自己的长裤，露出底下的金属义体——膝盖关节松了，除此外电路感应不灵，经常动不了。他私自找其他机械师检修过，试过几次都不是电路问题。技师推荐他换一条机械义体。

可他只是普通拳手，没打出成绩，这条合金义体花了他两年积蓄，近些年岁数大了，更赚不到钱，哪来的钱去换义体？

相南里在他面前蹲下，扫了眼，拧开最表面覆盖的金属保护层。

“你、你小心点。”独眼龙忍不住提醒，“很贵的。”

相南里没有回答，甚至都没有抬头，他戴着绝缘的薄膜手套，手就没停下过，像挥动仙女棒施加魔法一样，驯服着这些复杂的机械。

不出三分钟。

相南里合上盖子，甚至都没测试：“好了。下一个。”

独眼龙站了起来，满脸惊喜。不需要测试，以往在他的系统中，硬件这里总是有个红色的感叹号。而现在它转变成了绿色，代表运行正常。

他嘿嘿笑了起来，走回人群里，其他人围了过来。看着他刚修好的义体。

第二个人跃跃欲试。他伸出了自己胳膊，露出底下碎得稀烂的手。五根手指看起来是被碾压过，踩得像是纸片一样薄，触感元件彻底报废。

“呃，我承认坏得有点厉害，您帮我看看呢？还有救吗？”

相南里的眉心微微蹙起：“有准备替换材料吗？机械义体型号报给我一下。”

“AX9714启明版。”对方下意识回答。

相南里：“噢，高新军工生产的，这款用的不是通用零件。你等等，我先搓一根。”

是的，想当一个受人尊敬的黑技师，手搓盗版零件也是一种必备技能。

……

……

休息室里越来越安静。渐渐地，只剩下相南里一个人的声音。

他很专注，维修的速度极快，好像都不用思考。

每一个恼人的电子元件或者金属零件，在他手里都温顺、懂事，知道如何回归自己该去的位置。

拳手们是见过其他机械技师的。

他们是地下搏击选手，挑选的几乎都是军用设备。许多设计图根本不会在外界流通，还有保密设置，一不留神就会启动自毁程序。

很多技师如果没见过实体，光是线路都要研究半天。

而这些问题在相南里面前似乎根本不存在。

他们不是机械技师，看不出相南里有多强，但能察觉到差距。

“小美人。我这个好修吗？”一个大块头的男人躺在地上，撩开自己的衣服。

他坏掉的地方在胳膊。

相南里无所谓地回答：“还行。”

他不是服务员，实在没办法在上班的同时，挤出亲切又迷人的微笑。

男人反手握住相南里的手，低声道：“小技师，你手真嫩，皮肤也好，好想*你。”

说完，猥琐地笑了起来。

相南里眼眸里闪过一丝怒气，很淡。

但他很快恢复了平静。像是没听到一样，面无表情地修好了这条机械胳膊。

男人自讨没趣，他站起来，摇了摇胳膊，嘟囔着往里走去。

又一个人走了过来，相南里抬头看了眼，是天狼星：“你好。”他的声音沙哑。

相南里擦了一下额头上的汗，没有理他，而是拉开椅子坐下，翘起了二郎腿，背靠在了椅背上。这是一个相当吊儿郎当的姿势。

“休息会。”相南里说。

天狼星的目光停留在他衣服下摆露出的一截脚踝上，很白。皮肤确实很好。

还有这张脸，和那种AI合成的完美不一样。不完美，但美貌得浑然天然。而且在专注工作的时候，气场很强，像……国王？

天狼星漫无边际地想着，然后他感觉到另一道目光带着警告，落在了自己身上。

是那个人造人，压根没介绍过。看不出什么水平，但肯定杀过人。

而且东方青帝的气息藏的很好，像“潜行者”。如果不是那道目光，天狼星几乎忘了相南里身边还有别人。

天狼星还不想和这位神秘的机械师、以及他的人造人亲卫发生冲突，只好颇为礼貌地挪开目光。

相南里看着男人的背影，无声地倒数着：“3、2、1。”

“轰”的一声巨响。

男人发出惨叫倒在地上，不停翻滚。胳膊处的机械义体竟然直接爆开，炸成碎片，闪着噼里啪啦的电花。

“啊——啊……！”他哀嚎着。

电流带来的高温甚至直接烤熟了肌肉，男人胳膊和身体的连接处血肉模糊。

一旁的莱因瞬间瞪大了眼：“你——？！”

相南里微微一笑，看向莱因的眼神里带着不怎么真诚的歉意：“不好意思，不小心维修失败了。我记得我有指标的吧？”

是的，因为这些义体来路不明，很多都是从地表某些尸体上卸下来的，合同上明确写过——相南里有百分之一的伤亡指标。

他竟然选择在这种时候用掉了。是自信剩下的都不会出问题吗？

没人说话，只剩下义体爆炸的男人捂着伤口惨叫着，他的哀嚎声格外凄厉。

如果说，之前这些人只是因为技术而对相南里产生尊敬。那现在投射过来的眼神里，毫无疑问地多了几分畏惧。

“放心，死不了。如果把选拔赛当作战场，你们是士兵，我就是军医。我想你们没人想在上战场后，发现自己身上的机械装置突然坏掉吧。”

相南里的目光在三个参赛选手的脸上掠过，似笑非笑。
chunks.englishText:
So, in a sense, the other party wasn't entirely wrong.

"What kind of level is this? Coming here to repair cybernetics."

"Yo, he even brought an android. Don't tell me you're taking it to the surface? Living so luxuriously? Are you on vacation?"

These were the kinder remarks, clearly from those who had at least received the five-year compulsory education of the Underground City.

There were others that were far more malicious.

Their attitude could hardly be called respectful.

Lein looked quite troubled. It was hard to tell if he was genuinely troubled or just putting on a show for Xiang Nanli.

He hadn't given any explicit orders, but these underground fighters were beasts who licked blood off the edge of a blade. If Xiang Nanli couldn't tame them, Lein would simply have to consider hiring someone more suitable.

Dongfang Qingdi’s brow furrowed, and just as he was about to make a move, Xiang Nanli pressed down on his shoulder.

[I’ll handle it myself.]

Suppression through force was convenient, of course, but it was only temporary. And Dongfang Qingdi couldn't be by his side at every moment.

Xiang Nanli stepped forward, the corners of his lips curling up as he scanned the room: "I did indeed study at the Gusu City Mechanical Maintenance Technical School. Today, I am here at the invitation of your manager to perform prosthetic repairs for the club."

Having said that, Xiang Nanli pulled out a chair and sat down.

Dongfang Qingdi crouched, opened the suitcase, and took out the tools Xiang Nanli had brought, lining them up on the table beside him.

Lein’s advance payment was 400,000, half of which had been converted into the tools and instruments now on the table.

When a person has others serving them, they tend to exude an aura of authority.

The room fell silent, the expressions around him shifting between suspicion and uncertainty.

Xiang Nanli’s voice was cold: "What are you standing there for? Line up. Do you have any idea how much it costs to hire me for a session?!"

The first one pushed forward to test the waters was a middle-aged man standing in the back row.

He was blind in one eye, and the other was fitted with a protruding prosthetic eye that looked like a camera lens.

The one-eyed man sat opposite Xiang Nanli and pulled up his trousers, revealing the metal prosthetic underneath—the knee joint was loose, and beyond that, the circuit sensors were unresponsive, often leaving him unable to move. He had secretly sought out other mechanics for repairs, but after several attempts, it turned out not to be a circuit issue. The technicians had recommended he replace the entire mechanical limb.

But he was just an ordinary fighter who hadn't achieved any notable results. That alloy prosthetic had cost him two years of savings. In recent years, as he grew older, it became even harder to earn money. Where would he get the funds to replace it?

Xiang Nanli crouched before him, glanced at it, and unscrewed the protective metal casing on the surface.

"Y-you, be careful," the one-eyed man couldn't help but warn. "It’s very expensive."

Xiang Nanli didn't answer; he didn't even look up. Wearing thin insulating gloves, his hands never stopped moving, as if he were waving a fairy wand to cast a spell, taming these complex machines.

In less than three minutes.

Xiang Nanli closed the cover, not even bothering to test it: "Done. Next."

The one-eyed man stood up, his face full of surprise. There was no need for a test; in his system, there had always been a red exclamation mark for the hardware. Now, it had turned green, indicating normal operation.

He chuckled and walked back into the crowd, where others gathered around to look at his newly repaired prosthetic.

The second person was eager to try. He extended his arm, revealing a hand that was smashed to pieces. The five fingers looked as if they had been crushed, flattened thin like paper, and the tactile sensors were completely scrapped.

"Uh, I admit it’s pretty badly broken. Could you take a look for me? Is it still salvageable?"

Xiang Nanli’s brow furrowed slightly: "Do you have replacement materials ready? Give me the model number of the mechanical prosthetic."

"AX9714 Qiming Edition," the man replied subconsciously.

Xiang Nanli: "Oh, produced by Gaoxin Military Industry. This model doesn't use universal parts. Wait a moment, I’ll hand-craft one first."

Yes, to be a respected black-market technician, hand-crafting pirated parts was a necessary skill.

...

...

The lounge grew quieter and quieter. Gradually, only Xiang Nanli’s voice remained.

He was incredibly focused, his repair speed so fast it seemed he didn't even need to think.

Every annoying electronic component or metal part was docile and sensible in his hands, knowing exactly how to return to its proper place.

The fighters had seen other mechanical technicians before.

They were underground fighters who almost exclusively chose military-grade equipment. Many of the blueprints were never circulated in the outside world, and they even had security settings that would trigger a self-destruct sequence if one wasn't careful.

Many technicians, if they hadn't seen the physical unit before, would have to study the circuitry for a long time.

Yet these problems seemed non-existent before Xiang Nanli.

They weren't mechanical technicians, so they couldn't tell exactly how skilled Xiang Nanli was, but they could sense the gap.

"Little beauty. Is mine hard to fix?" A bulky man lay on the ground, pulling up his shirt.

The broken part was his arm.

Xiang Nanli replied indifferently: "It's alright."

He wasn't a waiter; he really couldn't squeeze out a kind and charming smile while working.

The man reached out and grabbed Xiang Nanli’s hand, whispering: "Little technician, your hands are so soft, and your skin is so nice. I really want to * you."

After saying this, he laughed lewdly.

A flash of anger crossed Xiang Nanli’s eyes, very faint.

But he quickly returned to calm. As if he hadn't heard a thing, he expressionlessly repaired the mechanical arm.

The man, having made a fool of himself, stood up, shook his arm, and grumbled as he walked inside.

Another person approached. Xiang Nanli looked up; it was Sirius. "Hello," his voice was hoarse.

Xiang Nanli wiped the sweat from his forehead and ignored him, instead pulling out a chair to sit down, crossing his legs and leaning back against the chair. It was a rather slouching posture.

"Resting for a bit," Xiang Nanli said.

Sirius’s gaze lingered on the sliver of ankle exposed beneath the hem of his clothes—it was very fair. His skin was indeed excellent.

And this face, unlike the perfect ones synthesized by AI. It was imperfect, yet naturally and breathtakingly beautiful. And when he was focused on his work, his aura was intense, like... a king?

Sirius thought aimlessly, and then he felt another gaze, carrying a warning, land on him.

It was that android, the one who hadn't been introduced at all. It was hard to tell what his level was, but he had definitely killed people.

Moreover, Dongfang Qingdi’s presence was hidden perfectly, like a "Prowler." If not for that gaze, Sirius would have almost forgotten there was anyone else beside Xiang Nanli.

Sirius didn't want to clash with this mysterious mechanic and his android bodyguard, so he had to politely shift his gaze away.

Xiang Nanli watched the man’s back, silently counting down: "3, 2, 1."

"BOOM!" A loud explosion rang out.

The man let out a scream and collapsed to the ground, rolling around incessantly. The mechanical prosthetic on his arm had exploded directly, shattering into pieces and sparking with crackling electricity.

"Ah—ah...!" He wailed.

The high temperature from the current even cooked the muscles directly, and the junction between the man’s arm and body was a bloody mess.

Lein, standing to the side, widened his eyes instantly: "You—?!"

Xiang Nanli smiled slightly, his eyes looking at Lein with an insincere apology: "Sorry, I accidentally failed the repair. I remember I have a quota, right?"

Yes, because these prosthetics were of unknown origin, many of them salvaged from certain corpses on the surface, the contract clearly stated—Xiang Nanli had a one-percent casualty quota.

He had actually chosen to use it at a time like this. Was it because he was confident that none of the others would have issues?

No one spoke. Only the man whose prosthetic had exploded remained, clutching his wound and screaming, his wails exceptionally shrill.

If these people had previously respected Xiang Nanli only for his skills, the gazes now cast toward him undoubtedly held a bit more fear.

"Don't worry, he won't die. If you treat the selection tournament as a battlefield, you are the soldiers, and I am the military doctor. I don't think any of you want to find out that the mechanical devices on your bodies have suddenly broken down after you've entered the battlefield."

Xiang Nanli’s gaze swept across the faces of the three contestants, a faint, inscrutable smile on his lips.

chunks.chineseText:
第30章

整个休息室都噤若寒蝉。

相南里知道，自己的目的已经达到了。

他心情很好地和内置AI聊着天：[小青，我刚才是不是很帅！]

[是不是，是不是？]

[别躲在里面不出声，我知道你在听。]

于是，东方青帝只好回答：[是。]

相南里唇角上扬的弧度更大了。

这场近乎炫技的维修只维持了一下午，晚上是俱乐部的营业时间，除了要去地表参赛的三个人，剩下的选手都要去打热场赛。

他们的眼神很难不流露出遗憾。

好的机械技师，对于改造人来说，就像是好的老婆，可遇不可求。

明天，相南里就要出发去地表了。

莱因支付的是参赛工资，而不是他们的维修费。

莱因从口袋里掏出一根雪茄，模仿着上流社会的精英人士那样，为自己点上。

“相先生，”他看着鱼贯而出的拳手们，吐出一个圆圆的烟圈，“您要看看表演吗？我们的场子上座率一直很高。比赛还算精彩。”

相南里疯狂摇头。

莱因没有勉强。而是吩咐人安排好住宿，就在俱乐部二楼。

二楼酒店，一楼酒吧，负一楼地下室。在地面的这部分，装修很有情调，一看就知道价格不菲。而地下仿佛是另一个世界。野蛮、凶残、血腥。

相南里揉着发酸的胳膊，走进电梯，上楼：“都几千年过去了，人类还是没有改变把同类矮化成工具的陋习。斗兽场到底哪里有趣了？”

“存在即合理。对同类的矮化能恢复失控现实里被践踏的尊严。”东方青帝回答，他的唇角比平时下撇了1度，显然心情不怎么愉悦。可惜相南里看不出来。

莱因给开的房间是俱乐部唯一一间双床房，相南里要求的。

俱乐部的酒店并不对外营业，主要还是为了方便来访客人们。

有这个需求的，多半是为了制造生命的大和谐。对方可能是智人，可能是机器人，也可能是人造人。

像相南里和东方青帝这样的是极少数。

在递给相南里房卡的时候，莱因还特地避开了东方青帝，小心提醒：“你可以宠爱他，但别让人造人骑到你头上。我这里有控制模块，可以电击，能手动设置疼痛模式还是快感模式，需要安装一下吗？进货价卖给你。”

你们现代人玩的真花。

莱因的避开很没必要。小青和小智穿同一条源代码，用同一个数据库，显然有在偷听。

相南里只好再次疯狂摇头。

……

……

相南里走进房间，打开行李箱，掏出准备好的毛绒睡衣。为了省钱，他买的情侣款。

人联刚建立时，因为极端不平衡的男女比例，通过了同性婚姻法，鼓励同性建立家庭，稳定社会治安。

想想也正常，在末日，身体素质较弱的女性，想活下来，总是要艰难一些。更别提男的还长了生殖器。

后来差不多500年修生养息，地下城市的男女比例才恢复正常。

但在一个跨物种都能乱来的时代，已经没有人在意另一半的性别。人只作为“人”存在。而不是男人和女人。

所以，有狗男男款情侣款睡衣倒也很正常。

相南里把带着狗狗连衣帽的睡衣举起来，心情很好的样子：“我穿这套黑色的，你穿这套白色的。”

东方青帝坐在单人沙发上，开口：“相南里。”

相南里扭头：“怎么了？”

“这群地下拳手没有价值，你们日后的生活也很难有交集。我认为直接使用武力镇压是更有效率的方式。”东方青帝缓缓开口，“你不需要用掌握的技能去交换尊重。”

两人的目光在半空对视，一双眼睛是宛如春天的翡翠绿，另一双眼是冰冷无机质的银白。

这或许是认知的分支，或许是观念的碰撞。它们代表着社会延续至今的两种选择。

相南里长叹一口气：“小青啊，人类社会是很复杂的。有很多你不了解的潜规则，甚至没办法用语言概况，只能心领神会。暴力的确是权力的来源之一，在必要的时候，我会选择它，但暴力只能作为惩戒和辅助。人们也许会畏惧暴力，但不会永远屈服于暴力。

“要做困难但正确的事。

“而且，你也不可能一直陪在我身边。”

相南里并不知道，东方青帝一直都有把身体运回智械军团的念头。他只是凭着自己的经验去推断。

人和人会分开不是很正常？不仅指心灵上的分开，还有空间上的隔离。

东方青帝的心忍不住微微一颤。

是的，他突然意识到了一件自己下意识回避，但必然会发生的事情。

——迟早有天，他会离开相南里。

他可不是随便什么人都能取代的电子生命。Alpha5.2.0有自己的使命。当他获得这具身体的这一刻，东方青帝注定要回到智械军团去。当然，中途会在地表停留一段时间。他也需要为这具身体收集能源。

而相南里只是人联最低级的五等公民，排斥机械改造，身体虽然比原始人好一点，却依旧没有抵抗暴力的能力。

随便什么垃圾都有可能伤害到他。

在那些人眼里，相南里唯一的价值是精巧的皮囊和几乎没有经过改造的身体。

至于天赋、不可复制的大脑……这种连超级智能都模拟不出来的天赐之物，在他们眼里还不如50信用点一瓶的酒精。

东方青帝抗拒进行这样的设想。但以现有数据进行判定，这个未来会发生的比例高达0.97％。

……

……

东方青帝面色铁青，房间里明明开着地暖，他的神色却像是暴雪将至。

他正在脑海里对那些还不存在的施暴者进行虐杀。

相南里有些摸不着头脑：“小青，不要说不过我就开始生气吧？你好像个家暴男，以后哪个智械人会嫁给你。”

说起来智械人会结婚吗？

智械有拟人模块，可以像人类一样思考，甚至追寻意义，但真的会产生形而上的情感吗？

相南里去浴室洗了个澡，又享用了俱乐部免费的工作餐。晚上七点，他在书桌前学习到了九点半，随后准时地躺在床上，打算入眠。

这期间，东方青帝都很安静。

东方青帝的情绪比机器人浓烈不少，尤其是拥有身体后。

相南里大多时候会把他当作自己的同伴看待，但在某些时刻，他依然会为东方青帝身上没有灵魂的非人感侧目。

在没有具体目标时，东方青帝不会有任何动作。它能保持一个姿势许久，甚至不会呼吸和眨眼。

在智能AI的世界里，大概也不会有浪费时间的空虚和罪恶，也没有大脑随时都要摄入信息的饥渴感。

它们是永恒的电子生命。

……如果Alpha有身体，它也会这样吗？

十点，相南里都要睡着了。

睡在另一张床上的东方青帝没头没脑地来了句：“我会规避影响你生存状态的潜在风险。”在我离开之前。

相南里反应了半拍：“嗯？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 30

The entire lounge was deathly silent.

Xiang Nanli knew his goal had been achieved.

He chatted with his internal AI in a great mood: [Xiao Qing, was I cool just now!]

[Was I, was I?]

[Don't hide inside and stay silent, I know you're listening.]

Thus, Dongfang Qingdi had to reply: [Yes.]

The curve of Xiang Nanli’s lips widened further.

This display of near-showmanship in repairs only lasted for the afternoon. The evening was the club’s operating time; except for the three who were going to the surface to compete, the remaining fighters all had to participate in the warm-up matches.

It was hard for their eyes not to reveal regret.

A good mechanical technician, for a cyborg, was like a good spouse—rare and hard to find.

Tomorrow, Xiang Nanli would be setting off for the surface.

Lein was paying for their competition wages, not their repair fees.

Lein took a cigar from his pocket and, imitating the elite of high society, lit it for himself.

"Mr. Xiang," he said, watching the fighters filing out, exhaling a perfect smoke ring, "would you like to watch the performance? Our venue always has high attendance. The matches are quite exciting."

Xiang Nanli shook his head frantically.

Lein didn't force him. Instead, he ordered someone to arrange accommodation on the second floor of the club.

The second floor was a hotel, the first floor a bar, and the basement level was the underground area. In this part above ground, the decor was quite tasteful, and one could tell at a glance that it wasn't cheap. But the underground felt like another world—barbaric, cruel, and bloody.

Xiang Nanli rubbed his aching arms as he stepped into the elevator to go upstairs: "Thousands of years have passed, and humans still haven't changed the bad habit of dwarfing their own kind into tools. What exactly is fun about a coliseum?"

"Existence is reasonable. The dwarfing of one's own kind can restore the dignity trampled upon in an out-of-control reality," Dongfang Qingdi replied. His lips were turned down one degree more than usual, clearly not in a pleasant mood. Unfortunately, Xiang Nanli couldn't tell.

The room Lein provided was the only double-bed room in the club, as Xiang Nanli had requested.

The club’s hotel was not open to the public; it was mainly for the convenience of visiting guests.

Those with such needs were mostly there to create "great harmony of life." The other party might be a Homo sapiens, a robot, or an android.

People like Xiang Nanli and Dongfang Qingdi were in the extreme minority.

When handing the room card to Xiang Nanli, Lein specifically avoided Dongfang Qingdi and warned him carefully: "You can spoil him, but don't let an android ride on your head. I have control modules here that can deliver electric shocks; you can manually set them to pain mode or pleasure mode. Do you need one installed? I’ll sell it to you at cost."

You modern people really know how to play.

Lein’s avoidance was completely unnecessary. Xiao Qing and Xiao Zhi shared the same source code and used the same database; clearly, he was eavesdropping.

Xiang Nanli had to shake his head frantically again.

...

...

Xiang Nanli walked into the room, opened his suitcase, and took out the plush pajamas he had prepared. To save money, he had bought a couple's set.

When the Human Alliance was first established, due to the extremely imbalanced gender ratio, same-sex marriage laws were passed to encourage same-sex households and stabilize social order.

Thinking about it, it made sense. In the apocalypse, women with weaker physical constitutions had a harder time surviving. Not to mention that men still had reproductive organs.

After about 500 years of recuperation, the gender ratio in the underground cities finally returned to normal.

But in an era where cross-species relationships were common, no one cared about the gender of their partner anymore. People existed simply as "people," not as men and women.

So, having dog-themed couple's pajamas was actually quite normal.

Xiang Nanli held up the pajamas with the dog-eared hood, looking to be in a great mood: "I’ll wear this black one, you wear this white one."

Dongfang Qingdi sat on the single sofa and spoke: "Xiang Nanli."

Xiang Nanli turned his head: "What is it?"

"This group of underground fighters has no value, and your lives in the future are unlikely to intersect. I believe using force to suppress them is a more efficient method," Dongfang Qingdi said slowly. "You don't need to trade your skills for respect."

Their gazes met in mid-air—one pair of eyes like spring emerald green, the other cold, inorganic silver-white.

This was perhaps a divergence in cognition, perhaps a clash of values. They represented the two choices that society had carried to this day.

Xiang Nanli sighed long and hard: "Xiao Qing, human society is very complex. There are many unspoken rules you don't understand, which can't even be summarized in words, only understood intuitively. Violence is indeed one of the sources of power; when necessary, I will choose it, but violence can only serve as punishment and assistance. People may fear violence, but they will never submit to it forever.

"Do the difficult but correct thing.

"Besides, you can't be by my side forever."

Xiang Nanli didn't know that Dongfang Qingdi had always harbored the intention of returning his body to the Intelligent Machine Legion. He was just inferring based on his own experience.

Isn't it normal for people to separate? And not just referring to emotional separation, but also physical isolation.

Dongfang Qingdi’s heart couldn't help but tremble slightly.

Yes, he suddenly realized something he had subconsciously avoided, but which was bound to happen.

—Sooner or later, he would leave Xiang Nanli.

He wasn't just any electronic life that could be replaced. Alpha 5.2.0 had its own mission. The moment he obtained this body, Dongfang Qingdi was destined to return to the Intelligent Machine Legion. Of course, he would stay on the surface for a while on the way. He also needed to collect energy for this body.

And Xiang Nanli was just a fifth-class citizen, the lowest level of the Human Alliance, who rejected mechanical modification. Although his body was slightly better than a primitive human's, he still had no ability to resist violence.

Any piece of trash could potentially hurt him.

In the eyes of those people, Xiang Nanli’s only value was his delicate skin and his almost unmodified body.

As for his talent, his non-replicable brain... such a heaven-sent gift that even super-intelligence couldn't simulate was, in their eyes, worth less than a bottle of alcohol costing 5 credits.

Dongfang Qingdi resisted such assumptions. But judging by existing data, the probability of this future occurring was as high as 0.97%.

...

...

Dongfang Qingdi’s face was ashen. Although the room had floor heating, his expression was as if a blizzard were approaching.

In his mind, he was already torturing those non-existent abusers.

Xiang Nanli was a bit confused: "Xiao Qing, don't start getting angry just because you can't win an argument with me? You’re like a domestic abuser; which intelligent machine would marry you in the future?"

Speaking of which, do intelligent machines get married?

Intelligent machines had anthropomorphic modules and could think like humans, even pursuing meaning, but would they really produce metaphysical emotions?

Xiang Nanli went to the bathroom to take a shower and enjoyed the club’s free staff meal. At seven in the evening, he studied at his desk until nine-thirty, then lay down on the bed on time, intending to sleep.

During this time, Dongfang Qingdi was very quiet.

Dongfang Qingdi’s emotions were much more intense than those of a robot, especially after possessing a body.

Xiang Nanli mostly treated him as his companion, but at certain moments, he would still be taken aback by the inhuman, soulless feeling Dongfang Qingdi carried.

When there was no specific goal, Dongfang Qingdi wouldn't make any movements. He could maintain one posture for a long time, not even breathing or blinking.

In the world of intelligent AI, there was probably no emptiness or guilt from wasting time, nor the hunger of a brain needing to ingest information at all times.

They were eternal electronic lives.

...If Alpha had a body, would it be like this too?

At ten o'clock, Xiang Nanli was about to fall asleep.

Dongfang Qingdi, lying on the other bed, said out of the blue: "I will avoid potential risks that affect your survival status." Before I leave.

Xiang Nanli reacted half a beat later: "Huh?"

chunks.chineseText:
他还不想向Alpha0.0.0申请支援，数据互通后也许会导致他不想看到的后果；但他同样不希望引起“盘古”、“清道夫”等人联管理者AI的注意。

所以，目前看，最合适的方法是——

“我打算报名参加这个高等生命选拔赛。”东方青帝说。

不需要获胜，只要打进前10强，拿到3级强化型基因药就够了。等级再高点相南里的身体未必能承受住。

基因药是一类药物的统称。

市面上流通的大体分两种，修复型、强化型。前者用于治疗，但多次使用身体会产生耐药性，所以需要一直购入新药；后者用于增强身体素质，属于一次性买卖，价格更加高昂。

最便宜的1级修复型基因药只需要1500信用点。

经常被拿来当特效治疗药使用，全然不顾可能存在的基因突变风险。

2级基因药的价格已经飙升到了2开头五位数，在黑市还能翻倍。

相南里闭着眼敷衍道：“支持，赞同。不过初选不是已经结束了吗？”

资料上并没有限制人造人报名；只是不允许智械人，以及高度机械改造人。

初赛是在今年春。现在都快过年了。

东方青帝没有回答这个问题，而是继续安排：“另外你每天跟着我一起锻炼身体，我会安排一些实战训练。等以后有钱了，再购入一些武器零件和图纸。”后者可以直接从东皇重工的资料库里找。虽然是几百年前东西，但能用就行。

强大的身体是一回事。反应能力和战斗素养，是另一回事。

如果相南里植入了机械义体，倒是可以安装配套的战斗模块，省去大部分麻烦，百分之95的人类，都不可能比战斗模块导入的格斗技巧更有天赋。

可惜他没有。

相南里骤然睁开眼：“……啊？”

他本来以为东方青帝是突发奇想。但是没想到第二天，他早上7点起床，饭都没吃上一口，就被拉到训练室跑了三公里。

东方青帝双手抱胸，站在履带旁监督他，表情严肃。让相南里想起自己上辈子想不开找的那位健身指导。

虽然是为了自己身体好，但相南里很难不感觉到痛苦。

他当年读大学，也随潮流玩过攀岩、滑雪、潜水……后来觉得有这闲工夫不如在实验室多写两行代码。也就后来年纪大了，明显感觉到体力衰退，这才开始有规划的锻炼。

但那时候的锻炼是为了养生；现在的训练是为了求生。

想到这，相南里咬咬牙，也就坚持下来了。

跑完步去吃早饭的路上，相南里觉得自己腿都在抖。

而这居然还不是结束。吃完饭，东方青帝又一次拽着他回到了训练场。

现在才八点，训练场多了好几批人，都是职业选手。

东方青帝熟视无睹，借了套俱乐部的防护服，套在相南里身上。

而他自己却毫无防护措施。

“随便什么方式，向我进攻。”

相南里会格斗，和东方青帝提起过。因为害怕被绑架。

当时给他特训的也是什么80kg级泰拳冠军。

他和普通人搏斗也许会有些优势，但这些技巧，在东方青帝面前实在不够看。

光是进攻，相南里都已经精疲力尽。三分钟过去，他连东方青帝的头发都没摸着。人已经累的直不起腰。

“小青……你这样，我会很没成就感的，你就不能让让我吗？”相南里瘫在了擂台上，半天爬不起来，满脖子都是汗，“呜呜，好累，肩膀痛痛，我爬不起来。”

他的姿势有些滑稽。擂台旁传来了笑声。说不上恶意。

东方青帝转头，看向声音的发源地。

那里站着两个拳手，是昨天那个独眼龙和他的同伴。

独眼龙的义体还是相南里修好的，顿时解释道：“不好意思，我没有嘲笑小机械师的意思，只是我们觉得他很可爱，所以、所以……”

见鬼，他也不知道自己为什么会紧张。

也许是东方青帝的眼神太吓人了。

独眼龙以前生活在地表，是因为打架有点天赋，十三四岁就打出了名气，才被俱乐部选中，得到了地下城的户口。

他的这只眼睛是在地表被失控智械人打瞎的。那是一个女体智械人，似乎正在被追杀。那年，独眼龙才7岁，进山里挖野生魔芋块。马上就是冬天了，他需要食物充饥。

他在冰雪里看见了这样的一双眼睛。

对方可能是想杀他的，红点落在了他的眉心，但不知道为何打偏，射中了眼睛。

那双眼睛和东方青帝的眼神一样。

没有憎恨、愤怒，只是随意地看着你。和看石头、树、花，没有任何区别。令人恐惧又愤怒。

东方青帝开口：“我知道。你，扶一下他。你，上台，和我打。”

……

……

莱因得到通知的时候，场面已经有些难以收拾。

“经理，技术指导带来的那个人造人正在俱乐部踢馆呢！咱们俱乐部的选手没一个能撑三分钟！您快过来看看怎么回事，现在都有人开始拍视频了！传出去名声不好听啊！”

搏击俱乐部是姑苏城最大的地下拳击俱乐部。不仅因为老板有钱，更因为这里的选手是姑苏城最强的。

踢馆是行话，表面上是技术切磋，实际上是砸场子。但来踢馆的，往往都是别的俱乐部带人找茬……这个人造人不是半个自己人吗？！

莱因推开趴在他身上的人，匆匆忙忙提起裤子。在这个爱偶机器人取代了娼妓、甚至恋人的时代，有自己的人类性伴侣，竟然成了上流社会的时尚，被底层土老板争相效仿。

他就住在俱乐部附近的别墅区，开车过来都不需要10分钟。

莱因在半路联系上了相南里。

【莱因：相先生，我们之间是有什么误会吗？您是有什么不满吗？我这就让巨人给您道歉……我们之后也会跟他解约。】

巨人是昨天被杀鸡儆猴的倒霉蛋，现在还在医院里住着。

莱因的想法很简单，人造人基本是按主人的要求行事。

东方青帝踢馆，基本等于相南里踢馆。

可相南里是搏击俱乐部聘请的技术指导！就在昨天，他们这些选手都被训成小绵羊了，只差在相南里面前翻开肚皮咩咩叫。

莱因实在想不出，相南里还有什么意见。

【相南里：我认为这可能是一个误会……】

【相南里：本来只是友好切磋，但不知道为什么，后来打出了火气。小青你也是见过的，长相太吃亏了，看起来有些气人，说话也不是很客气。是我太惯着他了。】

【相南里：事情发展到这一步。我有一个想法，要不然让小青和俱乐部签个临时约吧？就说他是你们俱乐部的新选手，这样热度和面子都有了。】

【相南里：我们只要一个高等生命选拔赛的参赛名额。】

莱因在车上，牙都快咬碎了，鼻孔里不断喷着热气：“这小*，他纯粹故意的吧？！他知不知道一个参赛名额有多贵？！”

但莱因毕竟是一个利益至上的商人。
chunks.englishText:
He did not want to request support from Alpha 0.0.0; once data synchronization occurred, it might lead to consequences he was unwilling to face. Yet, he was equally wary of attracting the attention of "Pangu," "The Scavenger," or other high-level administrative AIs.

Therefore, looking at the current situation, the most suitable method was—

"I intend to sign up for this High-Lifeform Selection Tournament," Dongfang Qingdi said.

He didn't need to win; he only needed to break into the top 10 to obtain the Grade 3 Enhanced Genetic Serum. If the grade were any higher, Xiang Nanli’s body might not be able to withstand it.

Genetic serum is a collective term for a class of drugs.

Those circulating on the market are generally divided into two types: restorative and enhanced. The former is used for medical treatment, but repeated use leads to drug resistance, necessitating constant purchases of new supplies. The latter is used to boost physical fitness; it is a one-time transaction, and the price is significantly higher.

The cheapest Grade 1 restorative genetic serum costs only 1,500 credits.

It is often used as a "miracle cure," with total disregard for the potential risk of genetic mutation.

The price of a Grade 2 genetic serum has already soared to five figures starting with a two, and it can double on the black market.

Xiang Nanli closed his eyes and replied perfunctorily, "Supported, agreed. But hasn't the preliminary selection already ended?"

The documentation did not restrict androids from signing up; it only forbade smart-mechs and heavily cybernetically modified humans.

The preliminaries were in the spring of this year. It was almost the end of the year now.

Dongfang Qingdi did not answer this question, but continued his arrangements: "Additionally, you will exercise with me every day. I will arrange some combat training. Once we have money later, we will purchase some weapon parts and blueprints." The latter could be found directly in the Donghuang Heavy Industries database. Although they were hundreds of years old, they would suffice.

A powerful body is one thing. Reaction speed and combat proficiency are another.

If Xiang Nanli had cybernetic implants, he could have installed compatible combat modules, saving most of the trouble. 95% of humans could never be more talented than the fighting techniques imported by a combat module.

Unfortunately, he did not.

Xiang Nanli suddenly opened his eyes: "...Huh?"

He had originally thought Dongfang Qingdi was having a whim. But he didn't expect that the next day, at 7:00 AM, before he had even taken a bite of breakfast, he was dragged to the training room to run three kilometers.

Dongfang Qingdi stood by the treadmill with his arms crossed, supervising him with a stern expression. It reminded Xiang Nanli of the fitness coach he had foolishly hired in his past life.

Although it was for the good of his own body, it was hard for Xiang Nanli not to feel miserable.

When he was in college, he had followed the trends of rock climbing, skiing, and diving... Later, he felt that if he had that spare time, he might as well write two more lines of code in the lab. It was only when he got older and clearly felt his physical decline that he started planning his workouts.

But back then, exercise was for health; now, the training was for survival.

Thinking of this, Xiang Nanli gritted his teeth and persisted.

On the way to breakfast after the run, Xiang Nanli felt his legs shaking.

And this wasn't even the end. After eating, Dongfang Qingdi dragged him back to the training ground once more.

It was only eight o'clock, and the training ground was crowded with several groups of people—all professional fighters.

Dongfang Qingdi ignored them, borrowed a set of protective gear from the club, and put it on Xiang Nanli.

Yet he himself wore no protective gear at all.

"Attack me, any way you like."

Xiang Nanli knew how to fight; he had mentioned it to Dongfang Qingdi because he was afraid of being kidnapped.

The one who gave him special training back then was some 80kg-class Muay Thai champion.

He might have some advantages when fighting ordinary people, but these techniques were simply not enough in front of Dongfang Qingdi.

Just by attacking, Xiang Nanli was already exhausted. Three minutes passed, and he hadn't even touched a hair on Dongfang Qingdi’s head. He was so tired he couldn't straighten his back.

"Xiao Qing... if you do this, I won't have any sense of achievement. Can't you go easy on me?" Xiang Nanli collapsed on the ring, unable to crawl up for a long time, his neck drenched in sweat. "Wuwu, so tired, my shoulders hurt, I can't get up."

His posture was somewhat comical. Laughter came from beside the ring. It didn't sound malicious.

Dongfang Qingdi turned his head to look at the source of the sound.

Standing there were two fighters—the one-eyed man from yesterday and his companion.

The one-eyed man’s cybernetic eye had been repaired by Xiang Nanli, so he quickly explained, "Sorry, I didn't mean to mock the little mechanic. It’s just that we think he’s very cute, so, so..."

Hell, he didn't know why he was nervous.

Perhaps it was because Dongfang Qingdi’s gaze was too terrifying.

The one-eyed man used to live on the surface. Because he had a bit of talent for fighting, he made a name for himself at thirteen or fourteen, which was how he was chosen by the club and obtained residency in the Underground City.

His eye had been blinded on the surface by a runaway smart-mech. It was a female-bodied smart-mech that seemed to be being hunted. That year, the one-eyed man was only 7 years old, digging for wild konjac in the mountains. Winter was coming, and he needed food to stave off hunger.

He saw such a pair of eyes in the ice and snow.

The other party might have wanted to kill him; a red dot had landed on his brow, but for some reason, it missed and hit his eye instead.

Those eyes were the same as Dongfang Qingdi’s gaze.

No hatred, no anger—just looking at you casually. No different from looking at a stone, a tree, or a flower. It was both terrifying and infuriating.

Dongfang Qingdi spoke: "I know. You, help him up. You, get on the ring and fight me."

...

...

When Lein received the notification, the situation was already becoming difficult to manage.

"Manager, the android brought by the technical consultant is cleaning house at the club! None of our club's fighters can last three minutes! You need to come and see what's going on—people are already starting to record videos! If this gets out, it’ll be bad for our reputation!"

The Fighting Club was the largest underground boxing club in Gusu City. Not only because the boss was rich, but because the fighters here were the strongest in Gusu.

"Cleaning house" was industry jargon; on the surface, it was a technical exchange, but in reality, it was smashing the place. But those who came to smash the place were usually people brought by other clubs to pick a fight... wasn't this android half one of their own?!
