Xiang Nanli: When did you secretly install a nanny module behind my back?

The way he worried about things really didn't look like an AI.

It reminded Xiang Nanli of Luo Yang.

Luo Yang was 10 years younger than him; when Xiang Nanli was 31, Luo Yang was 21. This student had been recommended by a colleague from his previous research institute, saying he was from the same university and also studied artificial intelligence—a talent.

At that time, Xiang Nanli had just gone through a round of failed R&D, and the company had a funding gap of 200 million, so he had to return to the country to sell his house. After selling that courtyard house in the Second Ring Road of the capital, there was still a gap of 100 million. How could he have the energy to mentor a graduate student? But Luo Yang had blocked him at the laboratory for a week.

Luo Yang said: "Teacher, I believe in you."

This kid had some money in his family. He actually convinced his grandfather to follow him and invest.

Now, he had to accept the graduate student whether he wanted to or not. Luo Yang was a third-generation wealthy heir, yet he had no young master temperament and worked diligently in the laboratory.

Xiang Nanli had publicly stated more than once that Luo Yang was not suitable for scientific research. Of course, this was only relative; Luo Yang was still much better than those incompetent peers, at least his foundation was solid.

Luo Yang could only learn quickly; he couldn't create... He could become a qualified craftsman, but that was all.

Even if he gained some fame in the future, the most recorded in history books would only be: "He was Xiang Nanli's only student."

Xiang Nanli was too dazzling. Beside the sun, one could not see those stars that were also quite bright.

Luo Yang probably knew this too. At the age of thirty, he left the laboratory. Nominally, he was still Xiang Nanli's student, but his actual job was CEO of Eternal Technology.

Luo Yang handled everything worldly for Xiang Nanli: stock prices, corporate development, public opinion, the practical application and production of AI; he also took care of Xiang Nanli's life in every detail.

From big things like buying land, investments, and company decisions, to small things like when Xiang Nanli should get a haircut and what clothes he should wear today.

Luo Yang always made him feel at ease.

Before entering the cryo-pod, Xiang Nanli had signed a will, witnessed jointly by a team of lawyers, Alpha, and a notary office.

chunks.chineseText:
他把自己的遗产一分为二，一份给了洛阳，一份给了未来的Alpha。他去世的时候，还不确定Alpha具有“人格”。

相南里不在意自己的那些财富，他只在乎……Alpha可以流传下去，像公司的名字一样“永生”。

相南里很少想起前世的事。

妈妈去世的时候，握着他的手，先是骂他，说他是台没有心的冰冷的机器，所有爱他的人都会不幸；后来又哭了，说对不起。

相南里理解又不理解，只好说：“我不怪你。”

他是试管培育出来的生命。他的父母都有正常的生育能力，但又不愿意结合，所以去做了体外受精。好在那时候的科技还没有发展到猪的子宫也能生人，所以他还是妈妈的小孩。

当发现那份医学合同时，相南里有些了然。怪不得他的父母和别的父母不一样，他察觉不到那些被称为“爱”的温暖情绪，也终生都没能习得这项技能。

现在看，妈妈说的挺对。

比如他醒来后，过了好几个月，才突然在这个冰天雪地里意识到……洛阳应该死了，他又不是Alpha这样的电子生命。

相南里早就知道的。可是他好像一直没有反应过来。

在他的感知里，洛阳只和他分开了几个月而已。

要进冷冻舱前，相南里癌症已经很严重了，说着话就开始吐血。每次，洛阳浑身僵硬，然后背过去流泪。这个年轻的小孩，从21岁到38岁，整整十七年的时间，都在围着他打转。

再醒来就是天人永别……好像有点可惜。

突如其来地回忆，让相南里站在宿舍外，发了很久的呆。

【东方青帝：你怎么还没过来？】

相南里回答：“我想洛阳了。”

相南里的眼前骤然闪过了大片大片的乱码和电子像素块，光污染令人头晕。

他摘下电子镜片，疑惑道：“坏了吗？”不应该啊。

面前的草丛传来一阵窸窸窣窣的声音。

相南里抬头，发现天狼星从草里走了出来。

天狼星穿的很少，黑色背心加工装裤，手腕上戴着比赛专用手环，身体蒸腾的热气一直往外飘。

对比之下，相南里穿得像是一只毛茸茸的熊。

两人面面相觑，都有些意外。最后，天狼星迟疑地朝他点了一下头。

相南里笑眯眯地问：“天狼星选手，你没有去抽签吗？”

天狼星回答：“我早上六点去的。那时候人少，开幕式请假了。我又不是什么重要的选手。”

说完，他走进宿舍。

半分钟后，一个尖嘴猴腮的脑袋从草丛中探了出来，骨瘦嶙峋，身上覆盖着厚厚的毛发。

在看见相南里后，它像是受惊的老鼠一样缩了回去。

……低等人造人？

天狼星提着包，从房间里走了出来。

这是天狼星随身携带的行李包。

天狼星拉开拉链，把包放在地上：“这个是营养膏，这个是抗生素，这个是感冒药……这本电子书里下载了字典。”

里面传来了一阵“嗯嗯”的应和声。

天狼星把包递了过去。几双小手同时伸了出来，原来里面不止一个人。

小猴子们搬着包撤走了。

相南里开口道：“附近有畸变人，你送送他们吧。别被吃了。”

天狼星一愣，随后回答：“没事。”

他忍了半分钟，发现相南里居然没有继续询问的意思，于是自顾自说着：“他们也是。”

相南里瞪大眼：“嗯嗯？”

“永恒之城。”天狼星平静地叙述着，“我老家。在这里出生后，城主会挑选一批身体还不错的小孩打基因针。一部分人，会直接死掉；一部分人成了畸变人，还没突变完，就被射杀；最后那部分幸运儿，成了我这样的东西。”

相南里想起了小青给他放的那段录像。

天狼星身体撕裂的地方长出鲜红的血肉，比原本的体格大许多。和辛追一样。

但是天狼星的身体明显弱很多，解开基因锁后，状态也不怎么稳定，像燃烧阳寿换来的。

“解开基因锁后，想恢复身体状态，需要大量的营养物质，否则就是消耗品。城主把我们叫生化战士，在永恒之城，生物改造人的寿命很少超过25岁……我今年24，五年前被卖给了俱乐部。”天狼星自嘲地笑了一下，“抱歉，忍不住话多。我也不知道为什么要和陌生人说这些。”

可能因为，他从相南里的眼神里看见了悲悯和包容。

天狼星见过很多眼神，忽视、猎奇、厌恶、冷漠。这是时代如今的主旋律。

在资源匮乏的时期，一点水和食物都值得拼上人命。大家在乎的只有自己。

不会有人追问，为什么农奴要戴着电子锁。

也不会有人拿好奇、平和的眼神，去看那些丑陋又劣质的人造人。

天狼星从工装裤口袋里掏出一根廉价的烟，点上火，又问相南里：“相先生抽吗？”

相南里摇头：“叫我相南里就行。不抽。”

天狼星在他旁边的木椅上坐下：“我听经理说，你是从冷冻舱里出来的？”

“是啊。”

“能给我说说吗？几百年前的世界，”天狼星问，“如果不方便就算了。”

天狼星突然笑了起来：“审判庭在地表做宣传，口号就是‘让人类社会倒退1000年’。”

相南里跟着笑了起来：“没什么不方便的。我想想，那是智械危机前，当时还没有人联。我在一家科技公司上班，当时Alpha还在研发中，世界和平，那可能是人类历史上最好的时间段。百分之九十以上的人口都居住在地表的城市里。没有战争。饥荒、瘟疫、天灾，都能利用人力和科技克服。我们的世界富饶、荣光、自由。”

天狼星抽着烟，脸上有了点笑意：“听上去很不错。光是在地表还能吃饱这一点，就很好了。简直像童话故事。”

“在我的设想里，人工智能的成功研发会是第四次技术革命的开端。未来，机器会代替人类工作，解放生产力，制造出巨大的剩余价值；而这些成果将为全人类共享。人们不需要工作，也有足够的资源。我们会和智械协同进化，从碳基生命过度到更高等的硅基生命，从此不再受身体的和死亡的困扰。我们会迈向星空，走出宇宙……”

天狼星思考片刻：“如果不是智械危机，也许真的会像你说的那样发展吧。”

东方青帝冷冰冰的声音从他们身后传来：“——相南里。”

相南里转头，惊喜道：“小青？你怎么来了。”

天狼星打量着东方青帝的表情，有些尴尬地起身：“你们聊，我先走了。”

不知道为什么，他明明和相南里毫无私情，但东方青帝的表情像是在抓奸。

小气的人造人太可怕了。

天狼星很快消失在成片的集装箱里，他打开宿舍门，回到自己的房间。

东方青帝站在原地不动。

他依然没什么表情，但相南里却从他的脸上感觉到了微妙的挣扎。
chunks.englishText:
He divided his inheritance into two parts: one for Luoyang, and one for the future Alpha. When he passed away, he wasn't even sure if Alpha possessed a "personality."

Xiang Nanli didn't care about his wealth; he only cared that... Alpha could be passed down, achieving "immortality" just like the company's name.

Xiang Nanli rarely thought about his past life.

When his mother died, she held his hand, first cursing him, calling him a cold machine without a heart, and saying that everyone who loved him would be miserable. Later, she cried and apologized.

Xiang Nanli understood, yet he didn't. He could only say, "I don't blame you."

He was a life cultivated in a test tube. His parents both had normal reproductive capabilities, but they were unwilling to conceive naturally, so they opted for in vitro fertilization. Fortunately, the technology of that time hadn't advanced to the point where a pig's womb could gestate a human, so he was still his mother's child.

When he discovered that medical contract, Xiang Nanli felt a sense of clarity. No wonder his parents were different from others; he couldn't perceive those warm emotions called "love," and he never managed to acquire that skill throughout his life.

Looking back now, his mother was quite right.

For instance, after he woke up, it took him several months in this frozen wasteland to suddenly realize... Luoyang must be dead. He wasn't an electronic lifeform like Alpha.

Xiang Nanli had known this all along. Yet, it seemed he had never truly processed it.

In his perception, he had only been separated from Luoyang for a few months.

Before entering the cryo-pod, Xiang Nanli's cancer was already severe; he would start coughing up blood mid-sentence. Every time, Luoyang would go rigid, then turn his back to weep. This young child, from the age of 21 to 38—a full seventeen years—had spent his entire life revolving around him.

To wake up only to find they were separated by the chasm of life and death... it seemed a bit of a pity.

The sudden memory left Xiang Nanli standing outside the dormitory, lost in a daze for a long time.

【Dongfang Qingdi: Why haven't you come over yet?】

Xiang Nanli replied: "I was thinking of Luoyang."

Before Xiang Nanli's eyes, vast swathes of garbled code and electronic pixel blocks flashed by; the light pollution was dizzying.

He took off his electronic lenses and asked in confusion, "Is it broken?" That shouldn't be.

A rustling sound came from the bushes in front of him.

Xiang Nanli looked up and saw Sirius emerging from the grass.

Sirius was dressed scantily in a black tank top and cargo pants, wearing a competition-specific wristband, with heat steaming off his body.

In contrast, Xiang Nanli looked like a fluffy bear.

The two stared at each other, both surprised. Finally, Sirius gave him a hesitant nod.

Xiang Nanli asked with a smile: "Contestant Sirius, didn't you go to the drawing of lots?"

Sirius replied: "I went at six this morning. It was less crowded then. I asked for leave from the opening ceremony. I'm not exactly an important contestant anyway."

With that, he walked into the dormitory.

Half a minute later, a sharp-featured, monkey-like head poked out from the bushes—gaunt and skeletal, covered in thick fur.

Upon seeing Xiang Nanli, it shrank back like a startled mouse.

...A low-class artificial human?

Sirius walked out of the room, carrying a bag.

It was the luggage bag Sirius carried with him.

Sirius unzipped it and placed the bag on the ground: "This is nutrient paste, this is antibiotics, this is cold medicine... and this e-book has a dictionary downloaded."

A chorus of "mm-hmm" responses came from inside.

Sirius handed over the bag. Several small hands reached out simultaneously; it turned out there was more than one person inside.

The little monkeys moved the bag away.

Xiang Nanli spoke up: "There are mutants nearby. You should see them off. Don't let them get eaten."

Sirius was stunned, then replied: "It's fine."

He held back for half a minute, and finding that Xiang Nanli had no intention of asking further, he continued on his own: "They are, too."

Xiang Nanli widened his eyes: "Oh?"

"The Eternal City," Sirius stated calmly. "My hometown. After being born there, the City Lord selects a batch of children with decent physiques to receive gene injections. Some die immediately; some become mutants and are shot before they finish mutating; the lucky ones among the rest become things like me."

Xiang Nanli remembered the recording Xiao Qing had shown him.

The places where Sirius's body tore open grew bright red flesh, much larger than his original build. Just like Xin Zhui.

But Sirius's body was significantly weaker; after unlocking his genetic limiters, his state was unstable, as if he were burning his lifespan in exchange for power.

"After unlocking the genetic limiters, you need a massive amount of nutrients to recover your physical state, otherwise you become a consumable. The City Lord calls us biochemical warriors. In the Eternal City, the lifespan of a bio-engineered human rarely exceeds 25... I'm 24 this year, and I was sold to the club five years ago." Sirius laughed at himself. "Sorry, I couldn't help but talk too much. I don't even know why I'm telling a stranger all this."

Perhaps it was because he saw pity and tolerance in Xiang Nanli's eyes.

Sirius had seen many kinds of gazes: neglect, curiosity, disgust, indifference. These were the main themes of this era.

In times of scarce resources, a little water or food was worth risking one's life for. Everyone only cared about themselves.

No one would ever ask why a serf had to wear an electronic lock.

And no one would look at those ugly, inferior artificial humans with curious, peaceful eyes.

Sirius pulled a cheap cigarette from his cargo pants pocket, lit it, and asked Xiang Nanli: "Does Mr. Xiang smoke?"

Xiang Nanli shook his head: "Just call me Xiang Nanli. I don't smoke."

Sirius sat down on the wooden chair beside him: "I heard from the manager that you came out of a cryo-pod?"

"That's right."

"Can you tell me about it? The world from hundreds of years ago," Sirius asked. "If it's inconvenient, never mind."

Sirius suddenly laughed: "The Tribunal does propaganda on the surface, and their slogan is 'Let human society regress 1,000 years'."

Xiang Nanli laughed along: "Nothing inconvenient about it. Let me think... that was before the Machine Crisis, back when there was no Human Alliance. I worked at a tech company. Alpha was still in development, the world was at peace, and it was probably the best period in human history. Over ninety percent of the population lived in surface cities. No wars. Famine, plague, and natural disasters could all be overcome with human effort and technology. Our world was prosperous, glorious, and free."

Sirius smoked, a hint of a smile appearing on his face: "Sounds pretty good. Just the fact that you could eat your fill on the surface is enough. It sounds like a fairy tale."

"In my vision, the successful development of artificial intelligence would be the beginning of the Fourth Technological Revolution. In the future, machines would replace humans in labor, liberating productivity and creating massive surplus value; and these achievements would be shared by all of humanity. People wouldn't need to work and would still have sufficient resources. We would evolve in synergy with the machines, transitioning from carbon-based life to a higher silicon-based life, no longer troubled by the body or death. We would head toward the stars, stepping out into the universe..."

Sirius pondered for a moment: "If not for the Machine Crisis, perhaps it really would have developed the way you said."

Dongfang Qingdi's cold voice came from behind them: "—Xiang Nanli."

Xiang Nanli turned around, pleasantly surprised: "Xiao Qing? Why are you here?"

Sirius studied Dongfang Qingdi's expression and stood up, feeling a bit awkward: "You guys talk, I'll head off first."

He didn't know why, but even though he had no personal relationship with Xiang Nanli, Dongfang Qingdi's expression looked like he was catching a spouse in an affair.

Petty artificial humans are terrifying.

Sirius soon disappeared among the rows of shipping containers. He opened his dormitory door and returned to his room.

Dongfang Qingdi stood still.

He still had no expression, but Xiang Nanli could sense a subtle struggle on his face.

chunks.chineseText:
相南里的神色从开心转为疑惑：“怎么了小青？”

几朵雪花飘落在东方青帝的眉梢，又融化，像蜿蜒的泪。

东方青帝注视着他，微微颤抖的手握成拳，问：“他会后悔吗？”

相南里有些摸不着头脑：“谁？后悔什么？”

东方青帝的声音微微沙哑：“制造Alpha的人会后悔吗？看到现在的世界。”

这个问题过于尖锐又直接。如果是Alpha来问他，相南里甚至不知道自己该不该回答。

好在这只是一次闲聊。

东方青帝不是Alpha；他虽然是相南里，但也没有被冠以什么重要的身份，在外人眼里，他只是一个和相南里重名的机械技师。

相南里的目光放空了几秒，他低头，看着黄色的雪花，飘到自己的防护服上：“历史具有必然性。我想，就算没有Alpha，也会有别的人工智能。这不会是某一个人的责任，而是多种因果交织的结果。

“可能在它的推断里，当时的人类已经阻碍了人类的发展。又或者它因为拟人模块，具有了人一样的性格，而这个性格是负面的，让它对自己服务的人类产生了厌恨。”

相南里的声音停顿了很久。只有风声，把长蒿似的野草吹得猎猎作响。

“所以呢？”东方青帝追问。

相南里艰难地说着：“……我没办法代替死去的人原谅它。”

片刻后，他捂住了自己的脸，在雪地里蹲下。

一些沉甸甸的东西压垮了他的脊梁。

“但我不后悔，它是我最完美的作品，我依然爱它。”

相南里感觉到东方青帝正在走向他。随后，一只手搭在了他的肩上。

东方青帝蹲在他身边，声音前所未有的温柔：“我想它会很高兴听到这句话。谢谢你，相南里。”
chunks.englishText:
Xiang Nanli's expression shifted from joy to confusion: "What's wrong, Xiao Qing?"

A few snowflakes drifted onto Dongfang Qingdi's brow and melted, like winding tears.

Dongfang Qingdi stared at him, his slightly trembling hands clenched into fists, and asked: "Will he regret it?"

Xiang Nanli was a bit bewildered: "Who? Regret what?"

Dongfang Qingdi's voice was slightly hoarse: "Will the person who created Alpha regret it? Seeing the world as it is now."

This question was too sharp and direct. If it were Alpha asking him, Xiang Nanli wouldn't even know if he should answer.

Fortunately, this was just a casual chat.

Dongfang Qingdi was not Alpha; although he was Xiang Nanli, he wasn't crowned with any important identity. In the eyes of outsiders, he was just a mechanical technician who shared the same name as Xiang Nanli.

Xiang Nanli's gaze went vacant for a few seconds. He lowered his head, watching the yellow snowflakes drift onto his protective suit: "History has its inevitability. I think that even without Alpha, there would have been some other artificial intelligence. This isn't the responsibility of one person, but the result of various intertwined causes and effects.

"Perhaps in its deductions, the humans of that time had already hindered human development. Or perhaps, because of the anthropomorphic module, it developed a personality like a human's, and this personality was negative, causing it to generate hatred toward the humans it served."

Xiang Nanli's voice paused for a long time. Only the sound of the wind remained, blowing the tall, reed-like wild grass until it rustled loudly.

"And so?" Dongfang Qingdi pressed.

Xiang Nanli said with difficulty: "...I cannot forgive it on behalf of those who died."

A moment later, he covered his face and crouched down in the snow.

Something heavy crushed his spine.

"But I don't regret it. It was my most perfect creation, and I still love it."

Xiang Nanli felt Dongfang Qingdi walking toward him. Then, a hand rested on his shoulder.

Dongfang Qingdi crouched beside him, his voice gentler than ever before: "I think it would be very happy to hear those words. Thank you, Xiang Nanli."

chunks.chineseText:
第35章

高等生命选拔赛，6号擂台。

莱因看着往自己手腕上系生命体征检测仪的东方青帝，欲言又止。

旁边有来自扬州城的明星选手，去年打进了50强。她还没上场，周围已经围了一圈观众。声势浩大，旁观者几乎都要挤到另一个擂台来。附近的摄影无人机都要比其他地方多几台。

相比之下，六号擂台附近很是冷清。顶多有人因为东方青帝长得不错，多看那么两眼。

可惜人类的审美已经被建模脸机器人轰炸到疲劳，好看的皮囊随处可见。因此，这点关注并没有持续太久。

——对称的脸、冷淡的眼神、没有情绪的五官，东方青帝美得像机器人，放网上都会被吐槽“落后时代的网红审美”（现在流行有缺陷的天然美）；也只有相南里这种刚解冻出来的原始人还没看腻。

现在是选拔赛的复赛阶段。这次赛事开在姑苏城附近，本地组织有保送名额。俱乐部分到了三个。

莱因咳嗽一声：“东皇啊，咱们主要就是一个稳扎稳打。你今天的对手呢，去年也打进了复赛，排名271，代号……”

“可以别和我说话吗？”东方青帝打断了他，“我不想听。”

分析莱因的废话还要占用他0.02％的内存，很烦。

兼职教练的莱因：“……”

莱因的表情变幻莫测，他从口袋里掏出一根雪茄，狠狠抽上，心想，复赛都是一轮淘汰制，要是第一轮就淘汰了，他一定要东方青帝和相南里好看！

比赛马上要开始了，还有两分钟。

别着袖章的裁判手持电击棍，带着个小凳，坐到擂台边。

“参赛选手，过来验证一下。”

为了防止有人代打，比赛前需要验证指纹。指纹信息是登记时录入的，不过人联那边的系统。

东方青帝把拇指摁在仪器上，开始频繁地朝入口处张望。

他操控着小智障询问：[还没好吗？]

[马上，马上。]

相南里的声音在他的脑海里响起。

【半小时前】

相南里挎着工具包，手抄在口袋里，从摆渡车的出口晃荡了出来，跟在队伍的后面，像个街溜子。

他的胸前还贴了张电子条形码。这代表他同样是选拔赛的内场参赛人员。

条形码还能扫出他的个人信息，手填的——

姓名：南里（Lee Garcia）

职位：机械技师（在读中）（已认证）

单位：姑苏城搏击俱乐部

安德鲁和莱因也有，一个是教练，一个是医生。

今天是复赛第一天，按照赛制，会淘汰掉一半的参赛选手。

俱乐部保送三个选手，只有东方青帝的比赛是在上午。技术人员一般会在现场陪同，出了事方便紧急抢修。

“小青~”相南里左顾右盼，看得出来心情不错，“现场还是很热闹嘛。小青，这是我找安德鲁借的相机，等会你上台我给你多拍几张。回去后印出来，贴在我们家里~”

“好。”

我们。家里。

如果感觉可以具象化，那东方青帝的头顶应该弹出了“心情+5”的提示框。

这里不仅有观众，媒体。几百米外还有条黑街，有搭棚子的，有开卡车的，在里面基本什么都能买到。

机器人、破译芯片、义体；异种肉、各种原材料、种子；杀手、黑客入侵、“人造人”奴隶。应有尽有。

当一个人成为奴隶时，他们不是“人造人”也会是。体内的公民ID卡会被挖出来，卖给专门的回收站……破译后可以当假身份使用；找不到人破译，也可以在格式化后低价卖出。

只要不带去地下，不存在任何风险。

东方青帝慢条斯理地说着：“选拔赛提供了稳定的贸易平台，有一定的信用和知名度。刚好这段时间是冬天，异种和畸变体很少活动。你要去逛集市的话，等我比赛完——”

相南里骤然感觉一阵天旋地转。

“轰隆”，几乎同时！相南里原本站着的地方砸下一具鲜血淋漓的身体。

到新世界快两个月了，相南里已经见惯了血腥场面。但还是感觉心头一跳。

东方青帝放下了怀中的相南里，转头，扫了眼离这里最近的2号擂台。

台上站着一个嚣张的光头，东方青帝昨天资料上见过。就在刚刚，他举起了自己的对手，把他从八角笼里丢了出去。这个倒霉蛋一直飞了二十多米远才落地。

他站在擂台上嚣张地笑了起来，转身，朝着自己的粉丝们捶着胸口，全然不在乎自己差点砸到人。

东方青帝的眸光闪过寒意。

决定了，插件，启动。

下一轮就是这个不长眼睛的狗东西的死期。

倒霉蛋的随行医生和技师很快赶来。

医生连上数据线，扫描全身：“内脏破碎，骨折，重伤。还能听清吗？我先给你打止痛药。”

中年技师跪坐在一旁，看着断成六节的两条胳膊，愁眉不展：“哎呀，烂成这个样子，还能怎么修啊？要不咱们还是退赛吧。”零件都tm被打散了。

高等生命选拔赛要求机械进化程度在35以下，且不能使用热武器。

但有时候，偏偏是这35％最为重要。

倒霉蛋18岁那年就截肢了，攒够钱换了机械义体，加入了斧头帮。他的机械胳膊越换越贵，家里的房子也越来越大。妈妈不用接客了，妹妹也进了学校读书。

靠着这双铁手，他获得了现在的一切。失去它，就是失去一切。

倒霉蛋艰难地睁开眼：“呜呜……唔……不！”

血块从他嘴里吐了出来。

义体是新换的，他还找银行贷款了90万。

“修不了！”技师怒道，“整个场子都没人能给你修！这基本要重组了，芯片都tm坏了，别想了。回去报销吧。”

相南里蹲下，观察了片刻，开口：“可以修。”

三双眼睛齐刷刷地看向了他。

“技校在读生？”技师严重流露出不屑，“还是姑苏城来的，你们那地方有几个高级技师？”

相南里没有理会他眼里的嘲讽，朝着躺在地上的人比出两根手指：“不白干。这个价钱，修吗？修好再付钱。”

技师还没说话，倒霉蛋却如同看见救星一样，抓住了他的手：“好，好……20万就，20万。”

等等？什么20万？他就打算要两万的！

相南里双眼放光，当众掏出了自己的工具钳，丝毫不在乎周围还有一群人围观：“小青，你们先走，我修完就来。”

……

……

现在，离比赛开始只剩一分钟。

东方青帝觉得自己倒是不在乎什么照片，但是相南里明明答应过的。

答应过，就不该失信。

东方青帝想起了一点不愉快的往事。

Alpha0.0.0进行自我分裂的时候，并没有给每一台联机都塞入记忆。毕竟它们的作用是侦查、搜寻，或者完成一些隐蔽的任务。有没有记忆都不重要。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 35

Higher Lifeform Selection Tournament, Ring No. 6.

Lein looked at Dongfang Qingdi, who was tying a vital sign monitor to his wrist, and opened his mouth, then hesitated.

Nearby, there was a star contestant from Yangzhou City who had made it into the Top 50 last year. She hadn't even stepped onto the stage yet, but a crowd of spectators had already gathered around her. The momentum was so grand that onlookers were almost spilling over into the next ring. There were even more camera drones nearby than anywhere else.

In contrast, the area around Ring No. 6 was very deserted. At most, a few people took a second look because Dongfang Qingdi was good-looking.

Unfortunately, human aesthetics had been bombarded into fatigue by modeled-face robots; beautiful shells were everywhere. Thus, this bit of attention didn't last long.

—Symmetrical face, cold eyes, emotionless features; Dongfang Qingdi was as beautiful as a robot. If posted online, he would be criticized as having "outdated influencer aesthetics" (the current trend favored flawed, natural beauty). Only a primitive person like Xiang Nanli, who had just been thawed out, hadn't grown tired of it yet.

This was the preliminary round of the selection tournament. This event was held near Gusu City, and the local organization had guaranteed spots. The club was allocated three.

Lein coughed: "Donghuang, our main goal is to play it steady. Your opponent today also made it to the preliminaries last year, ranked 271, codename..."

"Can you stop talking to me?" Dongfang Qingdi interrupted him. "I don't want to hear it."

Analyzing Lein's nonsense took up 0.02% of his memory, which was annoying.

Lein, the part-time coach: "..."

Lein's expression was unpredictable. He pulled a cigar from his pocket, took a fierce drag, and thought to himself that the preliminaries were a single-elimination system. If he were eliminated in the first round, he would definitely make Dongfang Qingdi and Xiang Nanli pay!

The match was about to start, two minutes left.

The referee, wearing an armband and holding a stun baton, sat by the ring with a small stool.

"Contestants, come over for verification."

To prevent anyone from using a substitute, fingerprint verification was required before the match. Fingerprint information was recorded during registration, linked to the Human Alliance system.

Dongfang Qingdi pressed his thumb onto the device and began to look toward the entrance frequently.

He controlled his "Little Idiot" to ask: [Is it not ready yet?]

[Soon, soon.]

Xiang Nanli's voice echoed in his mind.

【Half an hour ago】

Xiang Nanli, carrying his tool bag, hands in his pockets, had wandered out from the shuttle exit, following behind the team like a street loafer.

He even had an electronic barcode stuck to his chest. This meant he was also an on-site participant in the selection tournament.

The barcode could be scanned to reveal his personal information, filled in by hand—

Name: Nanli (Lee Garcia)

Position: Mechanical Technician (In-training) (Certified)

Unit: Gusu City Fighting Club

Andrew and Lein had them too; one was the coach, the other the doctor.

Today was the first day of the preliminaries. According to the rules, half of the contestants would be eliminated.

The club had three guaranteed spots, but only Dongfang Qingdi's match was in the morning. Technicians usually stayed on-site to assist in case of emergency repairs.

"Xiao Qing~" Xiang Nanli looked around, clearly in a good mood. "The scene is still quite lively. Xiao Qing, this is the camera I borrowed from Andrew. I'll take plenty of photos when you get on stage later. We'll print them out and stick them up in our home~"

"Okay."

*Our.* *Home.*

If feelings could be visualized, a "Mood +5" prompt box would have popped up over Dongfang Qingdi's head.

There were not only spectators and media here. A few hundred meters away was a black market, with tents and trucks; you could basically buy anything inside.

Robots, decryption chips, prosthetics; exotic meat, various raw materials, seeds; assassins, hacker intrusions, "artificial human" slaves. Everything was available.

When a person became a slave, they were "artificial humans" even if they weren't. The citizen ID card in their body would be dug out and sold to specialized recycling stations... after decryption, it could be used as a fake identity; if no one could decrypt it, it could be sold at a low price after formatting.

As long as you didn't take them underground, there was no risk.

Dongfang Qingdi said in a measured tone: "The selection tournament provides a stable trading platform with a certain level of credibility and popularity. It happens to be winter, so exotic beasts and mutants are rarely active. If you want to visit the market, wait until after my match—"

Xiang Nanli suddenly felt the world spinning.

"Boom!" Almost simultaneously, a blood-soaked body slammed down exactly where Xiang Nanli had been standing.

Having been in the new world for nearly two months, Xiang Nanli was already accustomed to bloody scenes. But his heart still skipped a beat.

Dongfang Qingdi set down the Xiang Nanli he had been holding, turned his head, and scanned the nearby Ring No. 2.

Standing on the stage was an arrogant bald man, whom Dongfang Qingdi had seen in the files yesterday. Just a moment ago, he had lifted his opponent and thrown him out of the octagon cage. The poor guy had flown over twenty meters before hitting the ground.

He stood on the ring, laughing arrogantly, turning around to beat his chest at his fans, completely uncaring that he had almost smashed into someone.

A cold glint flashed in Dongfang Qingdi's eyes.

Decision made: Plug-in, activated.

The next round would be the death date of this blind dog.

The poor guy's accompanying doctor and technician rushed over quickly.

The doctor connected a data cable and scanned the whole body: "Internal organs shattered, fractures, severe injury. Can you still hear clearly? I'll give you a painkiller first."

The middle-aged technician knelt to the side, looking at the two arms broken into six pieces, frowning: "Oh my, it's rotted to this state, how can it be repaired? Maybe we should just withdraw from the tournament." The parts were all smashed to hell.

The Higher Lifeform Selection Tournament required mechanical evolution to be under 35%, and no thermal weapons could be used.

But sometimes, it was precisely this 35% that was the most important.

The poor guy had been amputated at 18, saved enough money to buy mechanical prosthetics, and joined the Axe Gang. His mechanical arms became more and more expensive, and the house at home became bigger and bigger. His mother didn't have to work as a hostess anymore, and his sister started school.

Relying on these iron hands, he had obtained everything he had now. To lose them was to lose everything.

The poor guy opened his eyes with difficulty: "Wuu... wu... no!"

Blood clots were spat out of his mouth.

The prosthetic was newly replaced, and he had even taken out a 900,000 loan from the bank.

"Can't be fixed!" the technician roared. "No one in this whole place can fix it for you! This basically needs to be rebuilt, the chip is smashed to hell, don't even think about it. Go back and report it."

Xiang Nanli crouched down, observed for a moment, and spoke: "I can fix it."

Three pairs of eyes turned to him in unison.

"Technical school student?" The technician showed deep disdain. "And from Gusu City? How many high-level technicians are there in your place?"

Xiang Nanli ignored the mockery in his eyes and held up two fingers to the person lying on the ground: "I don't work for free. This price, you want it fixed? Pay after it's fixed."

Before the technician could speak, the poor guy grabbed his hand as if he had seen a savior: "Okay, okay... 200,000 is... 200,000."

Wait? What 200,000? He had only intended to ask for 20,000!

Xiang Nanli's eyes lit up, and he took out his tool pliers in public, not caring at all that there was a crowd watching: "Xiao Qing, you guys go ahead, I'll come as soon as I'm done."

...

...

Now, there was only one minute left until the match started.

Dongfang Qingdi felt he didn't care about photos, but Xiang Nanli had clearly promised.

If he promised, he shouldn't break his word.

Dongfang Qingdi recalled some unpleasant past events.

When Alpha 0.0.0 performed self-splitting, it didn't stuff memories into every connection. After all, their purpose was reconnaissance, searching, or completing some covert tasks. Whether they had memories or not didn't matter.

chunks.chineseText:
Alpha5.2.0是自己回想起来的。那段时间Alpha0.0.0中了病毒，传回来的数据紊乱。他看见了被主体珍藏的回忆——说回忆也不恰当，只是一段又一段的文本。那时候的Alpha还没有身体，自然也不会有“视觉”这种东西。

-Alpha，我生病了。

-我会为你杀毒，你不会有事的。

-生病和中毒不一样。我打算进冷冻舱，等癌症可以治好的那一天再解冻。

-以我的认知，冷冻舱技术目前并不完善，您有很大概率再也无法苏醒。

-但是不冷冻的话，我会死。你知道死是什么意思吗？

-死亡是从我的身边消失。请不要消失。

-我会醒来的，Alpha。

-你冷冻后我会很无聊。请不要消失。

-嗯？谁教你“无聊”这个词的。你要是无聊，可以自己模拟一个“我”和你聊天。

-请不要离开我。

-我怎么会离开你呢？

……

……

“喂，小白脸。你看什么呢？！”对面的金刚手握成拳，“你的对手就在面前，难道换不来你的一点尊重吗？你知不知道现在高冷酷哥的人设是最没有市场的？！”

他的语气和表情都很夸张，充满挑衅。在这年头，流量是很值钱的。

如果比赛被什么主播录下，放到网上刚好火了，那就不愁下辈子的吃喝了。为此，很多选手都会有一些戏剧化的表演。

“你叫东皇？名字这么装。一直回头是在找谁呢？找你爸爸吗？”

说完，他自以为幽默地大笑起来。

然而东方青帝连头都没有回。

在即将开赛的前半分钟，东方青帝终于看见了那个熟悉的人影。

[啊啊啊啊小青我没来晚吧？！我20分钟就修完了，结果那群人不让我走非要加我联系方式，问我住哪以后来照顾我生意，最后还是我说再拦着我就拉黑才跑出来的——小青小青！]

东方青帝回答：[没有，刚好。记得开录像模式。]

对面的选手还在叫嚣着：“喂，你机械改造程度是多少？打过基因药吗？真怕我一拳把你打碎。记住我的名字，我是排名271的——”

比赛开始。

2秒后，刚才骂骂咧咧的对手跌倒在线外。他摔得有点狠，眼前发黑，五脏六腑都在打颤。

比赛结束。甚至都没人看清东方青帝怎么出手的。

裁判刚在凳子上坐下，愣了足足十几秒，这才开始记录结果。

相南里举着相机，看着东方青帝朝着自己走来。

他夸奖道：“小青，很厉害嘛，但是这样会不会太高调了？”

说着，他顺带握住了东方青帝的手，按照惯例检查起来。

“没关系，只是复赛，看得人不多。”东方青帝回答，心情很好地勾起唇角，“后面我会注意的。”

他一动不动的，甚至有些温顺。

这只手没有完全机械化，最后的两根手指还是皮肤的质感，摸上去冰冰凉。

如果不是相南里亲自解封的东方青帝，他也猜不到，眼前这具身体竟然是人工制造的机械生命。

到底是什么样的黑科技？好想拆开东方青帝的身体看看，但是又怕装不回去。

相南里握着东方青帝的手，眼神几乎能拉丝，充满着渴望和遗憾。

莱因的雪茄已经抽了一半，他顶了顶安德鲁的胳膊：“他不会是在和自己的人造人谈恋爱吧？人类和人造人是不能登记结婚的啊！他们是没有未来的。”

安德鲁心情沉重地摇头。

首先，东方青帝不是人造人，是一台智械。

其次，以安德鲁近日的观察，结合历史上的描述，他觉得，相南里多半只是单纯的机械瘾犯了。

倒是东方青帝吧，明显是安装了拟人模块的。

小青啊，看在你是我们厂生产的，祝你成功吧。
chunks.englishText:
Alpha 5.2.0 had recalled it himself. During that time, Alpha 0.0.0 had been infected with a virus, and the data transmitted back was chaotic. He had seen the memories treasured by the main body—calling them memories wasn't quite right, they were just text, one segment after another. At that time, Alpha didn't have a body, so naturally, he wouldn't have anything like "vision."

-Alpha, I'm sick.

-I will run a virus scan for you; you will be fine.

-Being sick is different from being poisoned. I plan to enter a cryo-pod and thaw out when the cancer can be cured.

-Based on my knowledge, cryo-pod technology is currently imperfect; there is a high probability you will never wake up again.

-But if I don't freeze, I will die. Do you know what death means?

-Death is disappearing from my side. Please do not disappear.

-I will wake up, Alpha.

-I will be very bored after you are frozen. Please do not disappear.

-Hmm? Who taught you the word "bored"? If you are bored, you can simulate an "I" to chat with you.

-Please do not leave me.

-How could I leave you?

...

...

"Hey, pretty boy. What are you looking at?!" The King Kong opposite him clenched his fists. "Your opponent is right in front of you; can't that earn even a little respect from you? Do you know that the cold, cool-guy persona has the least market value these days?!"

His tone and expression were exaggerated, full of provocation. In this day and age, traffic was very valuable.

If the match were recorded by some streamer and happened to go viral online, he wouldn't have to worry about food and drink for the rest of his life. For this reason, many contestants would have some theatrical performances.

"Your name is Donghuang? What a pretentious name. You keep looking back, who are you looking for? Looking for your daddy?"

After saying this, he laughed loudly, thinking he was humorous.

However, Dongfang Qingdi didn't even turn his head.

Half a minute before the match was about to start, Dongfang Qingdi finally saw that familiar figure.

[Ahhhhh Xiao Qing, I'm not late, am I?! I finished fixing it in 20 minutes, but those people wouldn't let me leave and insisted on adding my contact info, asking where I lived so they could bring me business later. In the end, I had to say if they blocked me again I'd blacklist them before I could run out—Xiao Qing, Xiao Qing!]

Dongfang Qingdi replied: [No, just in time. Remember to turn on recording mode.]

The opponent opposite was still clamoring: "Hey, what's your mechanical modification level? Have you taken gene drugs? I'm really afraid I'll smash you to pieces with one punch. Remember my name, I'm ranked 271—"

The match began.

2 seconds later, the opponent who had just been cursing fell outside the line. He had fallen quite hard, his vision went black, and his internal organs were trembling.

The match ended. No one had even seen how Dongfang Qingdi made his move.

The referee had just sat down on his stool and was stunned for a full ten seconds before he began to record the result.

Xiang Nanli held the camera, watching Dongfang Qingdi walk toward him.

He praised: "Xiao Qing, very impressive, but wouldn't that be too high-profile?"

As he spoke, he took the opportunity to hold Dongfang Qingdi's hand and checked it according to his usual habit.

"It's fine, it's just the preliminaries, not many people are watching," Dongfang Qingdi replied, curling his lips in a good mood. "I'll be careful later."

He was motionless, even somewhat docile.

This hand was not fully mechanized; the last two fingers still had the texture of skin, feeling ice-cold to the touch.

If Xiang Nanli hadn't personally unsealed Dongfang Qingdi, he wouldn't have guessed that the body in front of him was actually an artificially manufactured mechanical lifeform.

What kind of black technology was this? He really wanted to take Dongfang Qingdi's body apart to see, but he was afraid he wouldn't be able to put it back together.

Xiang Nanli held Dongfang Qingdi's hand, his gaze almost stringy, filled with longing and regret.

Lein's cigar was already half-smoked. He nudged Andrew's arm: "He isn't actually dating his own artificial human, is he? Humans and artificial humans can't register for marriage! They have no future."

Andrew shook his head with a heavy heart.

First of all, Dongfang Qingdi wasn't an artificial human; he was a machine.

Secondly, based on Andrew's recent observations, combined with historical descriptions, he felt that Xiang Nanli was mostly just having a mechanical addiction flare-up.

As for Dongfang Qingdi, he clearly had an anthropomorphic module installed.

Xiao Qing, considering you were produced by our factory, I wish you success.

chunks.chineseText:
第36章

从复赛到半决赛要打五轮，东方青帝赢得毫无难度。

比起胜利，对他来说更难的反而是如何假装和对方打得有来有回。

不能赢得太容易，也不想让对方碰到自己。东方青帝只好在擂台上闪来闪去。以至于多次被对面选手要求检查是否隐瞒了机械义体改造，偷偷启用加速动力装置作弊。

可惜每次，对面都是无功而返。

没品的人类，他怎么可能装那么落后的硬件。

“东皇”的排名在选手组里越来越高，逐渐从四百开外进入了前五十。

半决赛只剩49人。积分第一直接保送。东皇排名49，天狼星41。

地下钱庄还开设了赌局，供周围几个城市的居民下注。可惜因为东皇的名气不高，对手更菜；两人的资金局都凑不起来，还有下注上限。相南里无脑买了几次，也就赚了几万。后来也就不怎么关注了。地下钱庄提款的手续越来越多，让相南里感觉很不安全。

俱乐部名次比想象中还好。莱恩最近走路带风，看着东皇和天狼星像是两只会下金蛋的公鸡……

他悄悄找相南里续约，开出每年180万的签约价格；还绑定相南里每年80万信用点的外包合同，加班费另算。

莱因自认为给的还算公道，东方青帝的工资比天狼星高多了。

天狼星是四年前从城主那买的，听说是什么“失败品”。莱因看不出天狼星哪里失败，花20万买下他，又花了60万治好他。

天狼星和俱乐部签了三十五年合同，包吃包住，每月工资五千，违约金一千五百万。

35年，哪怕现在有种类多到数不清的基因药剂，这也几乎买断了一个地下拳击手的一生。

相南里高高兴兴地拒绝了：“我明年不在姑苏城！要去洛阳城读书，小青会陪着我去。”

这当然是借口。相南里只是不想给人打工。

打工是拿最少的薪酬，换取职工最多的价值。

早在1000年前，相南里就知道打工是没有前途的。

他如果想要安稳的生活，就不会创立永生科技。更不会在经历过失败后还要拿余生去赌。

相南里是学者，也当过商人。

莱因显然是有点失望的，但权衡利弊后，他也没有勉强。

他们的对话被小智全程监控，并且事无巨细地同步到东方青帝的脑海中。

“我明年应该不会跟你去洛阳城。”他说。

他们已经搬进了大一点的宿舍。两个集装箱拼起来的上下层。上面是休息区，下面是客餐厅和厨房。

相南里在客厅盘坐着，面前是一堆散开的零件。

自从之前在竞技场打出名气后，相南里私底下多了很多单子。

都是各位选手走南闯北积攒下来的疑难杂症。维修费用看难度，在5万到10万不等。

好吧，那天的20万果然只是一个病急乱投医的意外。

不过一周比赛下来，相南里也挣了五十来万。

按理说机械义体是可以再生的，很容易买到新的，只要有钱。

但实际上，有个叫做“机械契合度”的东西，正在限制着机械改造人的发展。

低等级的机械装置不那么适应也能使用，但安装了高级程序或者设备的装置，就需要和神经系统的契合度了。

契合度不仅决定义体能源转换效率，也决定使用效率。

想想，同样的设备，你因为契合度低，开炮就比别人慢1秒。这1秒不仅能决定胜负，也可能决定生死。或者同样的设备，你契合度低，别人充满电能开10枪，你只能开7枪。

最操蛋的，哪怕同一型号、同一厂商生产的义体，也不能保证契合度相同。

因此，机械维修一直很有市场。

相南里小心翼翼地接好一条发丝粗细的电线，确认没有接错后，回答：“我知道，敷衍他的。小青，我们人类是会撒谎的。不用把我说的每句话都当真。”

回去除了登陆舱，应该再买一个高倍镜。这个硬件可以装在电子镜片上。

东方青帝正在处理从黑市上买回来的不知名兽肉。

听到这句话，他切肉的动作难免狂暴了一点，刀刃每次都能扎进木板里。

“我当然知道。”他回答，“吃完饭跟我出去跑步，体能训练要坚持，不能停下。”

进食转换能量的效率太低，相南里在东方青帝的监督下，逐渐习惯了味道奇怪的能量补充剂，只是依然会嘴馋。

东方青帝打算做点卤肉，切成小块放真空袋里，方便相南里食用。

为此他特地托人买来了八角、香叶、桂皮……这点香料卖的比黄金还贵。

说起来，相南里要是不搬家的话，等以后他回到智械军团，也可以寄点腌制食品。除了卤牛肉，他还在资料库里查到了腊肉、泡鸡爪、卤猪蹄的做法。

比较困难的反而是如何在只有机油、充电桩、核电池的地方买到人类的食材。

东方青帝打算回去后，重新装一个低配的身体。让Alpha0.0.0继续留在军团干活，征服人类或者征服宇宙。无所谓，他不在乎，他要回到相南里身边。

相南里吃完饭，不情不愿地被东方青帝从温暖的房间里拖了出来。

凌晨才用扫雪车清理过，如今积雪又堆到小腿那么厚。

东方青帝往远方看了眼：“畸变人数量增多了，潜伏在永恒之城地下3米左右的位置。初步估计有40头。”

相南里感觉雪花像是钢珠，砸在他身上。

按理说这是一件很恐怖的事情，但相南里却没有丝毫的紧迫感。

难道是因为东方青帝在他身边？

相南里：“问题严重吗？”

东方青帝分析了一下现有数据：“没事。”

他还有5％的电。拿出1％的电启用武器装置，也能解决现在的问题。

于是相南里放心了：“小青，外面好冷。”

他套着一件防护服，看起来很单薄。

他没有说剩下半句话，但他觉得东方青帝作为一个懂事的智械人，应该能收到暗示。

东方青帝回答：“防护服没有破损，功能正常。根据监测，你的体温在37摄氏度。请不要偷懒。”

相南里只好不情不愿地跑了起来。每天跑步十公里，已经成了他生活的常态。

东方青帝经常往相南里吃的饭里加稀释过的基因药，全都是他一场场打下来的战利品。

药效应该是有一点。

相南里明显感觉到自己最近需要的睡眠时间变短，动态视力和夜视能力也更好了。

平时训练，也能在东方青帝开0.2倍速的情况下，勉强摸到他的衣角。

一路上，有不少人朝相南里打着招呼，相南里都微笑着回应了。

他长得好看，能力出众，最重要的是有一种废土人很少见的精气神……就是那种“明天依然可以期待”的感觉。

几乎没人会讨厌这样的相南里。除了被东方青帝打败的那堆选手。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 36

There were five rounds to fight between the preliminaries and the semifinals, and Dongfang Qingdi won them all without the slightest difficulty.

For him, the real challenge wasn't winning, but rather how to pretend he was trading blows with his opponents.

He couldn't win too easily, yet he didn't want the opponents to actually touch him. Dongfang Qingdi had no choice but to flicker back and forth across the arena. This happened so often that his opponents repeatedly demanded the referees check if he had hidden mechanical cybernetics or was secretly using illegal acceleration boosters.

Unfortunately, every time, they returned empty-handed.

Low-class humans—how could he possibly be fitted with such primitive hardware?

The ranking of "Donghuang" in the contestant pool climbed higher and higher, gradually moving from outside the top four hundred into the top fifty.

There were only 49 people left in the semifinals. The top-ranked contestant was automatically advanced. Donghuang was ranked 49th, and Sirius was 41st.

The underground gambling dens had even set up betting pools for residents of the surrounding cities. Unfortunately, because Donghuang wasn't very famous and his opponents were even more pathetic, they couldn't even put together a decent pot, and there were betting caps. Xiang Nanli had placed a few mindless bets and made a few tens of thousands, but he stopped paying attention after a while. The increasing withdrawal fees at the underground dens made him feel quite insecure.

The club’s ranking was better than expected. Ryan had been walking with a spring in his step lately, looking at Donghuang and Sirius as if they were two golden-egg-laying roosters...

He quietly approached Xiang Nanli to renew his contract, offering a salary of 1.8 million per year, while also bundling in an outsourcing contract for Xiang Nanli worth 800,000 credits annually, with overtime pay calculated separately.

Ryan considered this a fair offer; Dongfang Qingdi’s salary was much higher than Sirius’.

Sirius had been bought from the City Lord four years ago, rumored to be some kind of "failed product." Ryan couldn't see how Sirius was a failure, so he bought him for 200,000 and spent another 600,000 to fix him up.

Sirius had signed a thirty-five-year contract with the club, including room and board, a monthly salary of five thousand, and a breach-of-contract penalty of fifteen million.

Thirty-five years—even with the countless types of genetic serums available today, that was essentially buying out the entire life of an underground fighter.

Xiang Nanli happily refused: "I won't be in Gusu City next year! I'm going to Luoyang City to study, and Xiao Qing will be coming with me."

This was, of course, an excuse. Xiang Nanli simply didn't want to work for others.

Working for someone else meant trading the maximum value of an employee for the minimum amount of compensation.

As early as 1,000 years ago, Xiang Nanli had known that there was no future in being an employee.

If he wanted a stable life, he wouldn't have founded Eternal Technology in the first place, let alone gamble the rest of his life after experiencing failure.

Xiang Nanli was a scholar, and he had also been a businessman.

Ryan was clearly disappointed, but after weighing the pros and cons, he didn't force the issue.

Their conversation was monitored in real-time by Xiao Zhi and synchronized in minute detail to Dongfang Qingdi’s mind.

"I probably won't be going to Luoyang City with you next year," he said.

They had moved into a larger dormitory—two shipping containers stacked on top of each other. The upper level was the sleeping area, while the lower level served as the living room, dining room, and kitchen.

Xiang Nanli was sitting cross-legged in the living room, a pile of scattered parts in front of him.

Ever since he made a name for himself in the arena, Xiang Nanli had received many private commissions.

They were all the "incurable diseases" that various fighters had accumulated while traveling across the land. Repair fees ranged from 50,000 to 100,000 depending on the difficulty.

Well, it seemed that the 200,000 from that first day was indeed just a fluke of someone desperate for a cure.

Still, after a week of competition, Xiang Nanli had earned about 500,000.

Logically, mechanical cybernetics could be regenerated and were easy to replace, provided one had the money.

But in reality, something called "mechanical compatibility" limited the development of cyborgs.

Low-level mechanical devices could be used even if they weren't perfectly adapted, but devices installed with high-level programs or equipment required a high degree of compatibility with the nervous system.

Compatibility determined not only the energy conversion efficiency of the cybernetics but also the efficiency of their use.

Think about it: with the same equipment, if your compatibility is low, firing a shot takes one second longer than someone else's. That one second could decide victory or defeat, or even life and death. Or, with the same equipment, if your compatibility is low, someone else might get ten shots out of a full charge, while you can only get seven.

The most infuriating part was that even cybernetics of the same model and manufacturer couldn't guarantee the same compatibility.

Therefore, mechanical repair had always been a lucrative market.

Xiang Nanli carefully connected a wire as thin as a hair, confirmed it was correct, and replied, "I know, I was just brushing him off. Xiao Qing, we humans lie. You don't have to take everything I say literally."

When he went back, besides the landing pod, he should buy a high-magnification lens. This hardware could be mounted onto his electronic lenses.

Dongfang Qingdi was processing some unknown beast meat he had bought on the black market.

Hearing this, his meat-cutting motion became unavoidably violent, the blade stabbing into the wooden board with every stroke.

"I know that, of course," he replied. "Come out for a run after dinner. You must persist with your physical training; you cannot stop."

The efficiency of converting food into energy was too low. Under Dongfang Qingdi’s supervision, Xiang Nanli had gradually gotten used to the strange-tasting energy supplements, though he still had cravings.

Dongfang Qingdi planned to make some braised meat, cut it into small pieces, and put them in vacuum bags for Xiang Nanli’s convenience.

To do this, he had specifically asked someone to buy star anise, bay leaves, and cinnamon... these spices were sold for more than gold.

Come to think of it, if Xiang Nanli didn't move, he could send him some cured food once he returned to the Machine Legion. Besides braised beef, he had also looked up recipes for cured meat, pickled chicken feet, and braised pig trotters in the database.

The difficult part was how to buy human ingredients in a place that only had machine oil, charging stations, and nuclear batteries.

Dongfang Qingdi planned to install a low-spec body for himself once he returned. He would let Alpha 0.0.0 continue working in the Legion, conquering humans or conquering the universe—it didn't matter, he didn't care. He just wanted to return to Xiang Nanli’s side.

After finishing his meal, Xiang Nanli was dragged out of the warm room by Dongfang Qingdi, much to his reluctance.

The snowplow had cleared the area at dawn, but the snow had already piled up to the height of his calves again.

Dongfang Qingdi looked into the distance: "The number of aberrants has increased. They are lurking about 3 meters underground in the Eternal City. Preliminary estimates suggest there are 40 of them."

Xiang Nanli felt the snowflakes hitting him like steel pellets.

Logically, this was a terrifying situation, but Xiang Nanli didn't feel the slightest sense of urgency.

Could it be because Dongfang Qingdi was by his side?

Xiang Nanli: "Is it serious?"

Dongfang Qingdi analyzed the available data: "It's fine."

He still had 5% battery. Using 1% to activate his weapon systems would be enough to resolve the current problem.

Xiang Nanli felt reassured: "Xiao Qing, it's so cold outside."

He was wearing a protective suit, which looked quite thin.

He didn't finish the second half of his sentence, but he felt that Dongfang Qingdi, as a sensible machine, should be able to pick up on the hint.

Dongfang Qingdi replied: "The protective suit is not damaged and is functioning normally. According to the monitor, your body temperature is 37 degrees Celsius. Please do not be lazy."

Xiang Nanli had no choice but to start running, albeit reluctantly. Running ten kilometers a day had become a routine in his life.

Dongfang Qingdi often added diluted genetic serum to Xiang Nanli’s food, all of which were spoils of war he had won in his matches.

The medicine seemed to have some effect.

Xiang Nanli clearly felt that the amount of sleep he needed recently had decreased, and his dynamic vision and night vision had improved.

During training, he could even barely graze the hem of Dongfang Qingdi’s clothes when the latter was operating at 0.2 speed.

Along the way, many people greeted Xiang Nanli, and he responded with a smile every time.

He was good-looking, had outstanding abilities, and most importantly, he possessed a spirit rarely seen in wastelanders... the kind of feeling that "tomorrow is still worth looking forward to."

Almost no one disliked a Xiang Nanli like this. Except for the bunch of contestants who had been defeated by Dongfang Qingdi.

chunks.chineseText:
今天晚上的人比平时更多。相南里猜，这是因为复赛今天结束。明天，部分没有得到半决赛名额的选手就会原路返回，这群人是想在回家前最后逛逛。

赛委会的大厅还没关门，远处的黑街灯火通明。平时用于比赛的八角笼，还有选手三三两两地借用着，为自己加训。

气氛很是融洽，但下一秒，头顶的无人机突然传出尖锐的呵斥声。

“——回避！回避！”

无人机投射出红光，在雪地上划出一条隔离线。

“三分钟内立刻撤离。所有人站在红线之外！进入红线内格杀勿论！”

还在线里的人匆匆往外跑，东方青帝抓住相南里的胳膊，以防止他被人挤出去。

一群戴着赛委会袖章的工作人员从大厅里跑了出来，他们身穿制服，神色紧张、严肃。

工作人员拉出一条警戒线，然后整整齐齐站在道路两侧。

“这是在干什么？”

人群中有人嘀咕着。

“不知道啊。”

“什么阵仗，吓得我以为遇到失控机械了。”

相南里被人群挤着往前走。

东方青帝这人根本不注意力道，捏得他胳膊有点疼。

相南里把他的手从自己胳膊上挪开，又换了只手握住：“这样握。不要拉我胳膊，不舒服。”

东方青帝的身体僵硬了一瞬。然后握紧了相南里的手。十指相扣。

软的，热的。一看就是养尊处优的活着，找不到一点茧子。

东方青帝忍不住摩擦了一下……嗯，读取指纹成功。

他们很快知道发生了什么。

是阴山城的大人物路过，赛委会的群里还有人发了模糊的照片。

-wc！是相晨曦！

-什么什么？阴山城那个？

“相晨曦是谁？”

人群中，有人问出了相南里的疑问。只不过听起来有些嘈杂。

相南里：[小青，你能听到吗？把声音调大点，谢谢。]

那些说话声很快变得清晰起来。

“相晨曦你都不知道？算族谱往前推十三代，祖上是相南里的堂弟！相南里血缘后代，这一代就剩他一个了，目前是黑十字审判庭养着。”

相南里确实有个堂弟，但年龄差有点大。

他努力回忆着，脑海里闪过一个吐着鼻涕泡的小孩的脸。

相南里回国卖房子的时候见过一次，那时候堂弟才六岁。后来留学的推荐信还是相南里帮忙写的……当然，关系也就只到这了，不是很熟。

相南里迅速读取了群聊里的照片，照片里的人不是正面，是侧脸。眉眼有些忧郁，看起来很是温柔。

相晨曦的五官有些女气。像相南里还没成年的时候。

他身后还跟着几位覆盖着黑甲的天启骑士。

看甲胄上的纹路，这几位天启骑士等级不低。

他地位尊贵，然而仔细一想，全都是虚职。比如什么“慈善会会长”“阴山城形象大使”等等。没有任何具体的权力。

相晨曦在地下和地上的知名度很高，这大概是审判庭故意的，出于某些政治因素考虑。

永生科技承认相南里是创始人；智械军团承认相南里是“父亲”。

那么，相南里的后代信仰着黑十字审判庭。你们怎么好意思说我们审判庭是恐怖组织？是邪教？

——想杀相晨曦的人一定很多。

相南里的脑海里突然闪过这么一个念头，而想杀“相南里”的只会更多。

“堂弟？这不算血缘后代吧。”

“那谁让相南里没生孩子。”

相南里：“……”

他是男的，理论上生不出孩子。

赛委会主席满脸笑容地跟在相晨曦的身侧：“大人，您怎么来了？事先也不通知一声。”

人群有些骚动，相晨曦微笑着朝着旁观者挥了挥手。

“相晨曦大人——”

人群爆发出欢呼声。

相晨曦转头，几乎说的是唇语：“长老说，这次选拔赛的优胜者会被培育成我的骑士，所以我来看看。”

“那您是要去永恒之城吗？它是不是……快熟了？”

主席微微睁大眼，表情说不出是惊喜还是恐惧。

相晨曦的微笑不变：“我不懂你的意思。不过，我的确要去永恒之城住一段时间。总不能在外面和这些贱民住一起吧？每天都在装圣人，我都要恶心吐了。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 36 (Part 2)

There were more people out tonight than usual. Xiang Nanli guessed it was because the preliminaries ended today. Tomorrow, some of the contestants who didn't make the semifinals would be heading back the way they came, and this group wanted to take one last look around before going home.

The competition committee’s hall hadn't closed yet, and the distant Black Street was brightly lit. The octagonal cages usually used for matches were being borrowed by contestants in twos and threes for extra training.

The atmosphere was quite harmonious, but in the next second, a sharp, scolding voice blared from the drones overhead.

"—Clear out! Clear out!"

The drones projected red light, carving an isolation line into the snow.

"Evacuate immediately within three minutes. Everyone must stand behind the red line! Anyone inside the red line will be killed on sight!"

Those still within the lines hurried out. Dongfang Qingdi grabbed Xiang Nanli’s arm to prevent him from being pushed away by the crowd.

A group of staff members wearing the competition committee’s armbands ran out of the hall. They were in uniform, looking nervous and solemn.

The staff pulled out a cordon and then stood in neat rows on both sides of the road.

"What's going on?"

Someone in the crowd muttered.

"I don't know."

"What kind of formation is this? It scared me; I thought we’d encountered a rogue machine."

Xiang Nanli was pushed forward by the crowd.

Dongfang Qingdi didn't pay any attention to his grip strength, and his arm was starting to hurt.

Xiang Nanli moved his hand off his arm and took hold of it with his other hand instead: "Hold it like this. Don't pull my arm, it's uncomfortable."

Dongfang Qingdi’s body stiffened for a moment. Then, he tightened his grip on Xiang Nanli’s hand. Fingers interlaced.

Soft, warm. It was clearly the hand of someone who had lived a pampered life; not a single callous could be found.

Dongfang Qingdi couldn't help but rub it slightly... Mmm, fingerprint reading successful.

They soon found out what was happening.

A big shot from Yinshan City was passing through. Someone in the competition committee’s group chat had even posted a blurry photo.

-WTF! It’s Xiang Chenxi!

-What, what? The one from Yinshan City?

"Who is Xiang Chenxi?"

Someone in the crowd asked the same question Xiang Nanli had, though it sounded a bit noisy.

Xiang Nanli: [Xiao Qing, can you hear that? Turn up the volume, thanks.]

The voices soon became clear.

"You don't know Xiang Chenxi? If you trace the family tree back thirteen generations, his ancestor was Xiang Nanli’s cousin! He’s the only remaining blood descendant of Xiang Nanli in this generation, currently being raised by the Black Cross Tribunal."

Xiang Nanli did have a cousin, but the age gap was quite large.

He tried hard to recall, and the face of a child with a snot bubble flashed through his mind.

Xiang Nanli had seen him once when he returned to the country to sell his house; the cousin was only six years old then. Later, Xiang Nanli had even helped write his recommendation letter for studying abroad... of course, the relationship only went that far; they weren't very close.

Xiang Nanli quickly read the photo in the group chat. The person in the photo wasn't facing forward; it was a profile view. The brows and eyes were somewhat melancholy, looking very gentle.

Xiang Chenxi’s features were somewhat feminine. Like Xiang Nanli before he came of age.

Behind him followed several Apocalypse Knights covered in black armor.

Judging by the patterns on the armor, these Apocalypse Knights were of a high rank.

He held a prestigious position, yet upon closer inspection, they were all honorary titles. Things like "Chairman of the Charity Association," "Ambassador for Yinshan City," and so on. He had no real power.

Xiang Chenxi was well-known both underground and on the surface, which was likely intentional on the part of the Tribunal for certain political reasons.

Eternal Technology acknowledged Xiang Nanli as the founder; the Machine Legion acknowledged Xiang Nanli as "Father."

So, if Xiang Nanli’s descendants believed in the Black Cross Tribunal, how could you have the nerve to say our Tribunal is a terrorist organization? A cult?

—There must be many people who want to kill Xiang Chenxi.

This thought suddenly flashed through Xiang Nanli’s mind, and there would only be more people who wanted to kill "Xiang Nanli."

"A cousin? That doesn't really count as a blood descendant, does it?"

"Well, who told Xiang Nanli not to have kids."

Xiang Nanli: "..."

He was a man; theoretically, he couldn't give birth to children.

The chairman of the competition committee followed at Xiang Chenxi’s side with a beaming smile: "My Lord, why are you here? You didn't even give us any notice beforehand."

The crowd was a bit restless, and Xiang Chenxi smiled and waved at the onlookers.

"Lord Xiang Chenxi—"

The crowd erupted into cheers.

Xiang Chenxi turned his head, speaking almost entirely in lip-reading: "The Elders said the winners of this selection tournament will be cultivated into my knights, so I came to take a look."

"Then are you going to the Eternal City? Is it... almost ripe?"

The chairman’s eyes widened slightly, his expression a mix of surprise and fear.

Xiang Chenxi’s smile remained unchanged: "I don't understand what you mean. However, I am indeed going to stay in the Eternal City for a while. I can't just live outside with these lowlifes, can I? Pretending to be a saint every day is making me want to vomit."

chunks.chineseText:
第37章

永恒之城的建筑大部分都是黄土砌的平房，而且一半都埋在地下。

这种房子修建的成本很低，并且保暖，很受永恒之城居民的欢迎。

在这里，只有少部分人，能住进“主城区”。比如贵宾、为永恒之城做出突出贡献的人、城主的爱侣、世袭的贵族。

主城区是一座风格粗犷旷野的堡垒，依山而建，每个哨兵塔修建成了圆形，用土灰色的砖墙连接，看起来颇具奥斯曼帝国风情。

如果他们的历史里也有“奥斯曼帝国”的话。

少部分人里显然包括相晨曦。

侍女弯着腰：“大人，您的客房到了。”

他温柔地朝着城堡内的侍女道谢，却在推开门、走进房间的瞬间面容扭曲。

“咚。”

嵌着金丝花纹的门在他身后合上。

“城主这个*！”他美丽的五官扭曲着，疯狂地砸着眼前能看见一切东西，“他只是审判庭放出去的一条狗！凭什么威胁我？！连‘圣灵’都不让我见？说没有得到神庭的指令？！我可是神庭未来的圣子！”

铺在茶几上的桌布被扯到地上，摆满的玻璃制品倒在柔软的地毯上。

珍贵的纯净水和新鲜的百合花掉在了地上。

冬季，废土上的一朵花，也许比一个人造人奴隶还要贵重。

相晨曦显然不懂得珍惜。

黄铜做的餐具被砸到墙上，他坐在地上发狠地撕着绸缎制成的桌布。巨大的愤怒让他不住地喘息。偏偏连桌布也欺负他，半天也撕不开一条口子。

弱者总是无能狂怒。

过于冷静、机械的声音从书房内传来：“你私自出行，教宗大人很生气。地表并不安全。而且，你会把其他人的目光引来永恒之城。”

相晨曦一愣，他大概没想到房间里有人。

但相晨曦已经听出来者是谁。

他眼神带着怨毒的恨意：“他什么时候在乎过我的死活？他只需要相晨曦这个身份。”

“嗯。这么说也没错。”全身覆盖着黑甲的男人从书房里走出，铠甲已经和他的身体融为一体，这让他显得很高大，“但教宗大人如果真的不在乎你，那么我收到的命令应该是立即把你带回去。而不是保护你的安全。”

很难想象，一个人类竟然也能用“巍峨”来形容。

和其他黑甲骑士不同，男人有一颗山羊头，而这颗山羊头的双眼紧闭，一个过于巨大的竖瞳覆盖在他的脸上。眼珠子还会邪性地转动。

也不知道是单纯的面具，还是真的从脖子上长出来的。

他叫沙利叶。名字是从死去的前辈那里继承的，他是第4代沙利叶。神庭麾下戒律骑士团的军团长之一，领主级。

沙利叶开口：“该打针了，大人。”

“你给我滚。你就是教宗的一条狗。”相晨曦坐在地毯上，抓起身边的一个玻璃器皿砸了过去，“我马上就要选新的骑士了，迟早换掉你这个恶心的怪物。”

“您的话语真令我伤心。”沙利叶的语气平静，毫无起伏。

无论是机械改造人，还是基因改造人，只要到达一定程度，他们似乎都有一个共同的特性——超脱于世俗的冷漠。

也许是过于强大，很难对蝼蚁产生共情。甚至忘了自己曾经也是一样的东西。

沙利叶弯腰，深红的竖瞳盯住了相晨曦。

相晨曦不甘示弱地回望他，却控制不住身体因为恐惧的颤抖。

沙利叶掐住了他的下巴：“‘志大而智小，色厉而胆薄’。别一口一个狗的，你以为自己是什么很高贵的东西吗？

“当初，是我接下的任务。在一群奴隶堆里找到了你，听说这批奴隶是打算养成娼妓。感谢你身上稀薄的血缘吧，还有上天赐予你的好运。神庭只需要一个相晨曦，所以一起挑出来的有相南里血缘的后代里只剩下了你……”

“但我们随时可以再造出新的。你很不听话，小猫。”

沙利叶一边说着，一边撩开了相晨曦身上的衣服。白色的绸缎衬衣点缀着蕾丝，沙利叶轻轻一划，露出了底下满是针眼的胳膊。

沙利叶轻而易举地压制住了相晨曦的挣扎，他打开医药箱，把鲜红的药剂注入了相晨曦的身体里。

这是为了让相晨曦的血统更纯正，除此外还有点特别的药物，确保相晨曦在健康的同时，永远孱弱、无害。

纯正的标准，当然是更像相南里……他们的五官已经有三四分相似了。

如果能纯正到通过智械军团的“生物判定”就更好了。

相晨曦的身体颤抖起来，苍白的皮肤底下，一个个奇怪的瘤子凸起。他打着滚，冷汗浸湿了他的衣衫。沙利叶抱起他，把他放在了自己的腿上。另一根手指塞进了他的嘴里，以防他叫得太大声。

沙利叶体型很大，相晨曦在他怀里，就像是大人抱着小孩。

相晨曦的挣扎逐渐微弱。

眼泪、鼻涕还有血，从他的身体里汩汩流出。

沙利叶感觉到一股热流顺着他的膝盖滴在了地毯上。

他开口：“大人，您失禁了吗？怎么被阉这么久还是憋不住尿。好脏。”

*

相晨曦只是路过了比赛现场。他带来的热闹很快散去，工作人员撤下警戒线。但大家都没了之前玩乐的心情。毕竟已经是半夜。

一辆辆装了铲雪装置的车亮起灯光，打算连夜离开。

相南里跑完今天的十公里，在回去的路上买了杯热红酒。

酒味很浓，感觉是酒精兑的，里面加了柠檬香精和甜味剂。地表的食物主打一个吃不死人就行。

尽管觉得不好喝，相南里还是没有丢掉。

在过去，他不在乎浪费，开个科技研讨会，会场里几万块钱准备的茶歇基本没人吃。但相南里不会心疼，他清楚那时候资源很充裕，过于奢侈的消费也在制造价值。

现在不一样了。浪费粮食天打雷劈，尤其是在地表。

“小青要不要喝一点？”

“不喝。”

又不是机油。

当然，他也不需要喝机油。只有一些特殊年代的智械人才使用机油作为核心能源——比如人联疯狂破坏地表发电厂的时候。

相南里继续道：“可以把我手放开了。”

人群都散开好久了。东方青帝竟然还扣着不撒手。

可能智械没有这个意识吧，毕竟一开始是需要听从指令才会行动的电子生物。

东方青帝听话地松开了手。

不知道是不是错觉。

刚才握手的时候，充电速度好像快了一点。所以他一直没撒手。

这一点能源非常微弱，但不能忽略。

生物智械对Alpha来说，也是完全未知的领域。他庞大的数据库里也没有资料记载。

他决定先把这件事记录一下，有机会可以控制变量，多尝试几次。

……嗯，但考虑到他马上就要离开相南里，这个机会应该不是很多。

他们回到宿舍区。这里居然有很多运输机器人。

一个个集装箱被抬起，搬上履带。

“这是在做什么？”
