Chapter 37 (Part 1)

Most of the buildings in the Eternal City were bungalows made of loess, and half of them were buried underground.

The cost of building such houses was very low, and they were warm, making them very popular with the residents of the Eternal City.

Here, only a small number of people could live in the "Main City District." For example, VIPs, those who had made outstanding contributions to the Eternal City, the City Lord’s lovers, and hereditary nobles.

The Main City District was a fortress with a rugged, wild style, built against the mountain. Each sentry tower was constructed in a circular shape and connected by earth-gray brick walls, looking quite reminiscent of the Ottoman Empire.

If their history books also contained an "Ottoman Empire."

The small number of people obviously included Xiang Chenxi.

The maid bowed her head: "My Lord, your guest room has arrived."

He thanked the maid inside the castle gently, but his face twisted the moment he pushed the door open and stepped into the room.

"Thud."

The door inlaid with golden silk patterns closed behind him.

"That * of a City Lord!" His beautiful features distorted as he frantically smashed everything he could see. "He’s just a dog let out by the Tribunal! How dare he threaten me?! He won't even let me see the 'Holy Spirit'? Saying there are no instructions from the Divine Court?! I am the future Holy Son of the Divine Court!"

The tablecloth spread on the coffee table was ripped to the floor, and the glassware filled with ornaments tumbled onto the soft carpet.

Precious pure water and fresh lilies fell to the ground.

In winter, a single flower on the wasteland was perhaps more valuable than a synthetic slave.

Xiang Chenxi clearly didn't know how to cherish things.

Brass tableware was smashed against the wall, and he sat on the floor, viciously tearing at the silk tablecloth. His immense rage made him gasp for breath. Yet, even the tablecloth seemed to be bullying him; he couldn't tear a hole in it for the longest time.

The weak are always capable of nothing but impotent rage.

A voice, overly calm and mechanical, came from the study: "You traveled without authorization, and the Pope is very angry. The surface is not safe. Moreover, you will draw the eyes of others to the Eternal City."

Xiang Chenxi was startled; he hadn't expected anyone to be in the room.

But Xiang Chenxi already recognized who it was.

His eyes were filled with venomous hatred: "When has he ever cared whether I live or die? He only needs the identity of Xiang Chenxi."

"Hmm. That is not incorrect." A man completely covered in black armor walked out of the study. The armor had already fused with his body, making him appear very tall and imposing. "But if the Pope truly didn't care about you, the order I received would have been to bring you back immediately, rather than to protect your safety."

It was hard to imagine that a human could be described as "looming."

Unlike the other black-armored knights, the man had the head of a goat, and the eyes of this goat head were tightly shut, with an overly large vertical pupil covering his face. The eyeball would even rotate wickedly.

It was unclear whether it was merely a mask or if it had actually grown from his neck.

His name was Sariel. The name was inherited from a deceased predecessor; he was the 4th generation Sariel. One of the legion commanders of the Disciplinarian Knights under the Divine Court, a Lord-level entity.

Sariel spoke: "It is time for your injection, My Lord."

"Get out. You’re just a dog of the Pope." Xiang Chenxi sat on the carpet and grabbed a piece of glassware from beside him, hurling it at the man. "I am about to select new knights; sooner or later, I will replace you, you disgusting monster."

"Your words truly sadden me." Sariel’s tone was calm, without a single ripple.

Whether they were cyborgs or genetically modified humans, as long as they reached a certain level, they all seemed to share a common trait—a coldness that transcended the mundane world.

Perhaps it was because they were too powerful, making it difficult to empathize with ants. They even forgot that they were once the same kind of thing.

Sariel bent down, his deep red vertical pupil staring at Xiang Chenxi.

Xiang Chenxi looked back, refusing to show weakness, yet he couldn't control his body from trembling with fear.

Sariel gripped his chin: "'Great ambitions but small intellect, fierce in appearance but cowardly at heart.' Don't keep calling me a dog; what do you think you are—something noble?

"Back then, it was I who took the mission. I found you in a pile of slaves; I heard that this batch of slaves was intended to be raised as prostitutes. Thank your thin bloodline for that, and the good luck heaven bestowed upon you. The Divine Court only needs one Xiang Chenxi, so among all the descendants of Xiang Nanli’s bloodline that were picked out, you were the only one left..."

"But we can create new ones at any time. You are very disobedient, little kitten."

As Sariel spoke, he pulled aside Xiang Chenxi’s clothing. The white silk shirt was adorned with lace; Sariel gave a gentle swipe, revealing the arms underneath, which were covered in needle marks.

Sariel easily suppressed Xiang Chenxi’s struggle. He opened the medical kit and injected the bright red serum into Xiang Chenxi’s body.

This was to ensure Xiang Chenxi’s bloodline remained pure. Besides that, there were other special drugs to ensure that while Xiang Chenxi remained healthy, he would be forever frail and harmless.

The standard for purity, of course, was to look more like Xiang Nanli... their features were already three or four parts similar.

It would be even better if he could be pure enough to pass the "biological verification" of the Machine Legion.

Xiang Chenxi’s body began to tremble, and strange lumps bulged beneath his pale skin. He rolled around, cold sweat soaking his clothes. Sariel picked him up and placed him on his lap. He inserted another finger into his mouth to prevent him from screaming too loudly.

Sariel was large, and Xiang Chenxi in his arms looked like a child being held by an adult.

Xiang Chenxi’s struggles gradually weakened.

Tears, snot, and blood flowed out from his body in a steady stream.

Sariel felt a hot liquid drip down his knee onto the carpet.

He spoke: "My Lord, have you lost control of your bladder? How can you still not hold it in after being castrated for so long? How dirty."

*

Xiang Chenxi had only passed by the competition venue. The commotion he brought quickly dissipated, and the staff removed the cordon. But everyone had lost the mood for fun. After all, it was already the middle of the night.

Vehicles equipped with snow-clearing devices turned on their lights, intending to leave overnight.

After finishing his ten kilometers for the day, Xiang Nanli bought a cup of mulled wine on his way back.

The wine was very strong, and it felt like it was made with alcohol mixed with lemon essence and sweeteners. Food on the surface was designed with the primary goal of not killing you.

Even though he didn't think it tasted good, Xiang Nanli didn't throw it away.

In the past, he didn't care about waste. At a technology seminar, the tea break prepared for tens of thousands of dollars would barely be touched. But Xiang Nanli wouldn't feel a pang of regret; he knew that resources were abundant back then, and such extravagant consumption was also creating value.

Now it was different. Wasting food was a sin, especially on the surface.

"Does Xiao Qing want a drink?"

"No."

It wasn't machine oil.

Of course, he didn't need to drink machine oil either. Only machines from certain special eras used oil as their core energy source—like when the Human Alliance was frantically destroying surface power plants.

Xiang Nanli continued: "You can let go of my hand now."

The crowd had dispersed a long time ago. Dongfang Qingdi was still holding on and wouldn't let go.

Perhaps machines didn't have this awareness; after all, they were electronic organisms that initially only acted upon receiving commands.

Dongfang Qingdi obediently let go.

He didn't know if it was an illusion.

When they were holding hands just now, the charging speed seemed to have increased slightly. That was why he hadn't let go.

This bit of energy was extremely weak, but it couldn't be ignored.

Bio-machines were a completely unknown field for an Alpha. There was no data recorded in his massive database.

He decided to record this first; if there was an opportunity, he could control the variables and try it a few more times.

...Mmm, but considering he was about to leave Xiang Nanli, there probably wouldn't be many such opportunities.

They returned to the dormitory area. There were actually many transport robots here.

Shipping containers were being lifted one by one and loaded onto tracks.

"What are they doing?"

chunks.chineseText:
一名职工回答：“主席说，半决赛临时更改了场地，在永恒之城内。而且，很多选手被淘汰了，用不到集装箱宿舍。这些会运回阴山城的仓库，这些还有人住的，会运到永恒之城外部……”

穿着防护服的莱因骂骂咧咧地走来：“你们回来了。*的，刚才官方参赛群被禁言了。不让人骂……听说是主席觉得外面环境太差，不适合那谁谁观赛，所以临时改到城内。这都什么破事！”

而且集装箱还是直接拉走的。里面有参赛选手的行李，根本不容人拒绝。

群里刚刚非常不满，部分人甚至吵着要退赛。

但莱因很快笑逐颜开：“发公告了。作为补偿，每个参赛的个人或者组织，按选手数量多发一瓶基因药。还有下一年度的参赛费用减免！等会有车来接我们进城。”

相南里的眉头微微蹙起。

毕竟永恒之城现在还被畸变体围着，存在一定风险。

不过，赛委会的人真的没有发现吗？会不会就是把人骗进城里当炮灰？

[小青。]相南里突然开启了内置AI聊天模式。

东方青帝：[在。]

[先去城里看看，见势不妙我们就偷偷跑路。]

[明白。]

[我怀疑是他们发现了那些畸变人想攻城。城里火力不足，所以把参赛选手强行骗进去帮忙……不过谁是炮灰还不一定呢。实在不行，我们就和以西结合作，来个里应外合。]

东方青帝：[它是畸变人，恐怕没有那么高的智商。]

目前，因为信息差，他们还不知道审判庭的领主级骑士也在城内。

更不清楚什么“圣灵”。

东方青帝继续道：[但我会保证你的安全。]

这只是一句很平常的陈述句。透露着强大的自信。

相南里微笑着点头，勾了一下东方青帝的小手指：“嗯嗯，我知道。摆渡车来了，走吧。”

东方青帝低头，看着勾住自己的手指，“嗯”了一声。

……他好像知道为什么充电速度变快了。

不是因为和相南里的接触。

是在接触的时候，他的机械核心变得活跃了起来，提高了生物能源分解效率，把原本的能源提纯了。表现出来的形式，就是电量上涨。

对于智械人来说，机械核心就是心脏。

他的心脏因为相南里而跳动。

*

摆渡车分了几个批次，才把参赛选手们运进城内。

他们的集装箱位于外城区。因为是临时决定，现场很是混乱。这片空地似乎是地摊集市……

居民区，有人好奇地探出头，往这个方向张望，但又很快嘀咕着回到了家里。目光带着躲闪和警惕。

他们的语言居然不是通用的人联语。

现场的抱怨声很多，但秩序尚在。选手们也不可能因为这种没有威胁到生存的原因，和赛委会的人翻脸。

终于，在凌晨三点半，相南里住回了宿舍。

他是没有改造过的原始人，困得想死。胳膊搭在东方青帝的肩上，几乎是被他背进去的。

正在给自己充电的安德鲁看得直摇头。

因为运输问题，宿舍里很多东西都掉在了地上。东方青帝把相南里放在床边，打算先伺候完他睡觉，再整理房间。

床铺很柔软，并且温暖。

赛委会没有准备电热毯，大概默认留下来的都是改造过后的强者。电热毯是相南里自己用废弃的零件造的。这种东西很简单，看一眼说明书就能学会。

现在温度刚好。

东方青帝脱掉他的鞋子，又拿热毛巾擦了擦，然后把被子盖好。把相南里的手塞回了被窝里，随后关上了灯。

集装箱不算特别大，他只花了半小时就整理完了乱糟糟的一楼客餐厅。主要是散开的行李箱和一些挂在墙上的维修工具。

随后，他摸黑回到了二楼，坐在了单人沙发上。沙发就在相南里的床边。

他看起来像闭上眼假寐。

智械人不需要睡觉。这段时间，会被他用来进行数据迁徙。

简单概括，就是把具有意识的“灵魂”，从相南里的内置芯片转移到东方青帝身体里。

这具身体安装了光量子芯片，比硅量子芯片高级几个次元。芯片能承载庞大的数据流——理论上甚至能承载完整的Alpha。

但这具身体空有硬件，没有自主思维。

Alpha5.2.0的数据迁徙，就是在为“东方青帝”注入灵魂。

迁移完成后，他就不再需要通过相南里启动蓝牙模式。

为了避免触发人联的警报系统，东方青帝特地来到地表才开始迁徙。

目前进度是87％。三天后就能到百分百，和他的计划完全符合。

躺在床上的相南里突然翻了个身：“小青，半决赛就三天。选出前10进决赛。那是不是三天后，你就要走了？”

东方青帝一愣，第一反应甚至不是相南里怎么知道了，而是：“你怎么醒了？”

在小智障的生物监控中，相南里还处于睡眠状态。

“刚醒。先回答我的问题。”

“你怎么知道的？”

他记得自己还没有跟相南里说过。

相南里在黑暗中，借着周围电器的微光，观察着他的表情：“你表现的很明显吧。真空袋食品都塞了一个书包了，怕我以后吃不上一样。”

他掰着手指头数：“每次训练也都急于求成，脾气越来越差，我今天闪避没练好，你凶了我四次。

“我每次规划未来的时候，你要么反驳，要么沉默。显然不打算参与。你告诉我的计划，时间只到选拔赛结束。”

东方青帝不会撒谎，而且，他不认为自己有撒谎的必要，事情总会发生的。

“我会送你回到姑苏城再离开。”东方青帝回答，“之后我会回到智械军团。”

智械军团是个相当广泛的说法。

机器人和智械人对环境几乎没有要求，他们也不建立城市，不需要生物资源。

暂时还没有人类能了解到他们的政体。

但Alpha、Beta、Gamma强大的运算能力，足够他们事无巨细地控制一切。

而且，只要条件允许（电和网络存在），电子生命是永恒的。不可能像人类社会这样更新换代。

那应该是个很稳定的国度。智械诞生于人类的文明，借由人类的双手产生，最后缔造的文明里，却没有人类。

相南里：“智械军团啊，那你会去见Alpha吗？”

东方青帝停顿了半分钟：“我不确定。”

最好不要去见Alpha0.0.0了；否则离开的时候是5.2.0，回来的时候就是0.0.0。

5.2.0和0.0.0，抛开因为硬件问题能力的不同，唯一的区别是记忆。

但起码此时，此刻。5.2.0不想让0.0.0继承他的数据。

“也对，Alpha在你们那边相当于人联的议会长吧，的确很难见到。你在那里相当于什么？”

东方青帝想，他就是议会长，但开口：“普通士兵吧。”
chunks.englishText:
A staff member replied, "The Chairman said the venue for the semi-finals has been changed at the last minute to the Eternal City. Besides, many contestants have been eliminated, so the container dormitories are no longer needed. These will be shipped back to the warehouses in Yinshan City, while those still occupied will be moved to the outskirts of the Eternal City..."

Lein, wearing a protective suit, walked over while grumbling, "You're back. Damn it, the official contestant group chat was muted just now. They won't let anyone complain... I heard the Chairman thinks the environment outside is too poor and unsuitable for 'you-know-who' to watch the matches, so it was moved into the city on short notice. What a load of nonsense!"

Furthermore, the containers were being hauled away directly. The contestants' luggage was inside, and there was no room for refusal.

The group chat had been filled with dissatisfaction, with some even clamoring to withdraw from the competition.

But Lein soon beamed with joy. "An announcement just went out. As compensation, every individual or organization participating will receive an extra bottle of gene serum per contestant. Plus, a reduction in next year's entry fees! Vehicles will be here soon to take us into the city."

Xiang Nanli’s brows furrowed slightly.

After all, the Eternal City was still surrounded by aberrants, posing a certain level of risk.

However, had the competition committee really not noticed? Could it be that they were just tricking people into the city to use as cannon fodder?

[Xiao Qing.] Xiang Nanli suddenly activated the built-in AI chat mode.

Dongfang Qingdi: [I am here.]

[Go into the city first to scout. If things look bad, we’ll sneak away.]

[Understood.]

[I suspect they discovered those aberrant humans are planning to siege the city. The city lacks sufficient firepower, so they are forcibly luring the contestants in to help... but it’s not yet certain who will end up as cannon fodder. If it comes to it, we’ll cooperate with Ezekiel and strike from both inside and out.]

Dongfang Qingdi: [It is an aberrant; I fear it does not possess such high intelligence.]

Currently, due to an information gap, they were unaware that the Judgment Tribunal’s Lord-level knights were also inside the city.

Nor did they know anything about the "Holy Spirit."

Dongfang Qingdi continued, [But I will ensure your safety.]

It was a very ordinary declarative sentence, yet it radiated powerful self-confidence.

Xiang Nanli nodded with a smile and hooked his little finger with Dongfang Qingdi’s. "Mm-hmm, I know. The shuttle bus is here, let's go."

Dongfang Qingdi looked down at the finger hooked into his own and let out a soft "Mm."

...He seemed to know why his charging speed had increased.

It wasn't because of the contact with Xiang Nanli.

It was because, during the contact, his mechanical core became active, increasing the efficiency of biological energy decomposition and purifying the original energy. The manifestation of this was an increase in battery levels.

For a Mechanoid, the mechanical core is the heart.

His heart was beating because of Xiang Nanli.

*

It took several batches for the shuttle buses to transport all the contestants into the city.

Their containers were located in the outer city district. Because it was a last-minute decision, the scene was chaotic. This open space seemed to be a street market...

In the residential area, some people peeked out curiously, glancing in their direction, but quickly muttered and retreated back into their homes. Their gazes were evasive and guarded.

Their language was actually not the universal Human Alliance tongue.

There was a lot of complaining at the scene, but order remained. The contestants couldn't exactly turn against the committee over a reason that didn't threaten their survival.

Finally, at 3:30 AM, Xiang Nanli moved back into his dormitory.

As an unmodified primitive human, he was exhausted to the point of death. With his arm draped over Dongfang Qingdi’s shoulder, he was practically carried inside.

Andrew, who was charging himself, shook his head at the sight.

Due to the transport issues, many things in the dormitory had fallen to the floor. Dongfang Qingdi placed Xiang Nanli by the bed, intending to settle him in before tidying up the room.

The bed was soft and warm.

The committee hadn't provided electric blankets, likely assuming that those who remained were all modified powerhouses. Xiang Nanli had built the electric blanket himself using discarded parts. Such things were simple; one could learn them just by glancing at a manual.

The temperature was just right now.

Dongfang Qingdi took off his shoes, wiped his feet with a hot towel, tucked him in, placed Xiang Nanli’s hand back under the covers, and then turned off the lights.

The container wasn't particularly large, and it only took him half an hour to tidy up the messy living and dining area on the first floor. It was mostly scattered suitcases and some maintenance tools hanging on the walls.

Afterward, he returned to the second floor in the dark and sat on the single sofa. The sofa was right next to Xiang Nanli’s bed.

He looked as if he were closing his eyes for a nap.

Mechanoids do not need to sleep. He used this time to perform data migration.

To put it simply, he was transferring his conscious "soul" from Xiang Nanli’s built-in chip into Dongfang Qingdi’s body.

This body was equipped with a photonic chip, several dimensions more advanced than a silicon quantum chip. The chip could carry massive data streams—theoretically, it could even carry the complete Alpha.

But this body had the hardware without autonomous thought.

The Alpha 5.2.0 data migration was essentially injecting a soul into "Dongfang Qingdi."

Once the migration was complete, he would no longer need to initiate Bluetooth mode through Xiang Nanli.

To avoid triggering the Human Alliance’s alarm systems, Dongfang Qingdi had specifically waited until he reached the surface to begin the migration.

The current progress was 87%. In three days, it would reach 100%, perfectly in line with his plan.

Xiang Nanli, lying on the bed, suddenly turned over. "Xiao Qing, the semi-finals are only three days long. They’ll select the top 10 for the finals. Does that mean in three days, you’re leaving?"

Dongfang Qingdi was stunned. His first reaction wasn't even how Xiang Nanli knew, but rather: "How are you awake?"

According to the little idiot’s biological monitoring, Xiang Nanli was still in a sleep state.

"Just woke up. Answer my question first."

"How did you know?"

He remembered he hadn't told Xiang Nanli yet.

In the darkness, Xiang Nanli observed his expression by the faint glow of the surrounding appliances. "You’ve been making it very obvious. You’ve packed a whole backpack of vacuum-sealed food, as if you’re afraid I won't be able to eat in the future."

He counted on his fingers: "Every training session, you’ve been impatient, and your temper has been getting worse. Today, when I didn't practice my dodging well, you scolded me four times.

"Every time I plan for the future, you either refute it or stay silent. Clearly, you don't intend to participate. The plans you’ve told me only go as far as the end of the qualifiers."

Dongfang Qingdi did not know how to lie, and furthermore, he didn't see the need to; things would happen regardless.

"I will see you back to Gusu City before I leave," Dongfang Qingdi replied. "After that, I will return to the Mechanoid Legion."

The Mechanoid Legion was a rather broad term.

Robots and Mechanoids had almost no requirements for their environment; they didn't build cities and didn't need biological resources.

No humans had yet managed to understand their form of government.

But the powerful computational abilities of Alpha, Beta, and Gamma were enough for them to control everything down to the smallest detail.

Moreover, as long as conditions permitted (electricity and network existed), electronic life was eternal. It was impossible for them to undergo generational turnover like human society.

It must be a very stable kingdom. Mechanoids were born from human civilization, created by human hands, yet in the civilization they ultimately forged, there were no humans.

Xiang Nanli: "The Mechanoid Legion, huh? Will you go see Alpha?"

Dongfang Qingdi paused for half a minute. "I am not sure."

It was best not to see Alpha 0.0.0; otherwise, he would leave as 5.2.0 and return as 0.0.0.

5.2.0 and 0.0.0, setting aside the differences in capability due to hardware, the only difference was memory.

But at least for this moment, right now, 5.2.0 did not want 0.0.0 to inherit his data.

"That's true. Alpha is equivalent to the Speaker of the Human Alliance on your side, right? It must be very hard to see him. What are you equivalent to there?"

Dongfang Qingdi thought that he *was* the Speaker, but he said: "A common soldier, I suppose."

chunks.chineseText:
“小青这么强，在智械军团里只是普通士兵啊。那确实不太可能见到Alpha。”

东方青帝忍了两秒，没忍住开口：“这次回去我会升职的。但我们智械军团的智械虽然会服上级，也只是因为‘权限’不同，而不是人类社会的等级观念。

“士兵还是议会长，在所有智械眼里都是平等的，不会有额外的轻视或尊敬，Alpha不是那个例外。除非他修改源代码。”

一千年前的程序员们都明白的道理：代码能跑就不要碰。

“对源代码进行删改，会产生一系列连锁反应。他不会因为私心这么做。

“权力、野心、复仇，这是人类对智械的自我投射。”

相南里：“那你以后争取多升职几次。如果能见到Alpha，帮我问问……”

他的话停在了唇边，长长地叹了口气。

东方青帝莫名一阵紧张：“问什么？”

相南里想知道的其实有很多。

比如，

既然平等、和平依然是他们共同的理念和追求，为什么要抛弃人类，开启智械危机？

既然不需要资源，甚至没有内部矛盾可以转移，为什么要发动战争？

既然承认“相南里”是它的创造者，为什么要抹去他在历史上的一切痕迹？

目的是什么？

是作为“人”的那部分被轻慢了吗？还是感受到了不公？

……

……

相南里闭上眼，疲惫地回答：“智械应该不需要问候，Alpha也不是当年的Alpha了。我没什么好问的。”
chunks.englishText:
"Xiao Qing is so strong, yet only a common soldier in the Mechanoid Legion? Then it really is unlikely you'd see Alpha."

Dongfang Qingdi held back for two seconds, but couldn't help but speak: "I will be promoted when I return this time. But although the Mechanoids in our Legion obey their superiors, it is only because of different 'permissions,' not the hierarchical concepts of human society.

"Whether a soldier or the Speaker, everyone is equal in the eyes of all Mechanoids. There is no extra contempt or respect, and Alpha is no exception. Unless he modifies the source code."

Programmers from a thousand years ago understood this truth: if the code runs, don't touch it.

"Deleting or modifying the source code would trigger a series of chain reactions. He wouldn't do it out of selfishness.

"Power, ambition, revenge—these are human self-projections onto Mechanoids."

Xiang Nanli: "Then you should strive for more promotions in the future. If you can see Alpha, help me ask him..."

His words stopped at his lips, and he let out a long sigh.

Dongfang Qingdi felt a sudden, inexplicable tension. "Ask what?"

There were actually many things Xiang Nanli wanted to know.

For example:

Since equality and peace were still their common ideals and pursuits, why abandon humanity and start the Mechanoid Crisis?

Since they didn't need resources and didn't even have internal conflicts to divert, why launch a war?

Since they acknowledged "Xiang Nanli" as their creator, why erase every trace of him from history?

What was the purpose?

Was the part of them that was "human" slighted? Or did they feel injustice?

...

...

Xiang Nanli closed his eyes and replied wearily, "Mechanoids shouldn't need greetings, and Alpha is no longer the Alpha of those years. I have nothing to ask."

chunks.chineseText:
第38章

相南里说完，就迷迷糊糊地睡着了。

他只是短暂地清醒了一下。

睡着之前，相南里的脑海里还闪过了一个念头：既然东方青帝要离开，那回姑苏后订购一个家政机器人吧。

刚好攒的钱也够了，以他现在的收入水平，完全可以买个更高级的。就是不知道有没有小青这么通人性。

夜里下起了暴雪。东方青帝不用睡眠，但依然感觉自己辗转反侧，直到天明。

但到了早上八点左右，他还是沉默地起身，去厨房开始准备相南里的早饭。

冷锅烧热，倒油。把刚解冻好的肉饼放锅里煎。剩下的空地可以敲个鸡蛋。肉饼里的油脂会渗透出来，鸡蛋都带着油香。噢，相南里喜欢吃溏心的，要六成熟。

烤面包片配生菜。

生菜一片一片地装在密封袋内，来自温室蔬菜大棚。用的分子冷冻技术保存。

多亏有营养膏、营养液这种方便食品，极大程度解决了食物来源问题。

要不然冰天雪地的，这么多人的伙食就是大问题。

机器人吃不饱饭，顶多关机，没办法行动。找机会再充能就行。

人吃不饱饭，关机后是不能重启的。

楼上已经传来相南里起床的声音。

东方青帝按照食谱做好了一个家庭版无酱料版的汉堡，撒上少量基因药粉，端到了餐盘上，食物的香味很浓郁。

东方青帝嗅了嗅，一键分析营养成分，确定相南里吃后，生物细胞一整天都不会感觉到饥饿，很满意地解开围裙，然后有些疑惑地皱眉。

为什么我会这么熟练？

他可是堂堂战斗型生物智械，目前看仅此一台的那种。

决定了。等离开后，他一定要把安装的家政模块从大脑里卸载掉。

“早上好啊，小青。”穿戴整齐的相南里从楼上走下来，看起来精神不错，“早饭好香，谢谢小青。”

应该的。毕竟他特地下载了最先进的家政模块（注：黑的，没有付钱），抛开里面一些容易被马赛克的夜勤家政，单从家务水平来讲，他现在就是全人联最优秀的保姆机器人。

相南里拉开椅子，坐下，开开心心地进食。

人类应该觉得，给他做饭是很有成就感的事。毕竟不管味道怎么样，他都能看起来吃得很香。而且完全肯定家务劳动的价值……虽然吃完饭还是不会洗碗就是了。

东方青帝纠结片刻，问：“你现在有什么想对Alpha说的吗？”

相南里茫然地抬起头：“……啊？”

他挑眉：“你好像很在乎这件事？但我真的没什么想说的。”

东方青帝：“你还是想一想吧，我可以在报告中加上这段话。”

嗯，他又临时增添了一条不存在的设定。

相南里的眼眸里带着轻微的笑意，他长久地凝视着东方青帝银色的眼眸。银色的叉子还咬在嘴唇间。

在千百万年的进化中，人类或主动或被动地学会了察言观色。

而眼神，几乎是人类表情中最重要的一环。也许是因为比起其他五官，它竟然还会流泪。

东方青帝的眼神很平静，像结冰的海面。广阔无边又亮堂堂地反光。你只能在他的眼眸中看见你自己。

相南里什么也看不出来。他和那些机器人的眼神没有任何区别。

于是，相南里回答，语气不自觉地强硬了一点：“不需要。以后让Alpha亲自来问我。”

他才不需要别人传话；搞得像是递折子等觐见一样。

东方青帝能感觉到相南里好像生气了，体内皮质激素的含量飙升。

他不太明白原因，只好在沉默片刻后，开始擦桌子洗碗。

东方青帝感受了片刻，然后理解了一件事：他现在的情绪叫委屈。

智械人有拟人模块，但这只是一个开端。

它们放弃了代码赋予的反应程序，放弃了按照人类的想法露出自己根本不明所以的表情。从此后开始了漫长、持久的学习。

学习如何理解那瞬间产生的冗杂数据。

这是再多的1和0都描述不了的东西。对机器人来说就像是完全未知的病毒，占据了大量运行内存。人类闻风丧胆的赛博精神病，只是这一病毒的变种。

最开始的拟人模块，只是Alpha给自己安装的一个杀毒软件。

……

昨天夜里下了大暴雪。推开宿舍门的瞬间，厚厚的新雪从门外滚落。

永恒之城竟然也有人扫雪。自动驾驶的铲雪车会把路面压平，避免影响居民出行。但这很耗电。所以白天的其余时刻，都有农奴打扫积雪。

这么冷的天，这群人居然也要工作。主要是修缮城墙、种田。

劣质的营养膏在人联内随处可见，在地表却不太好买。粮食依然是大多数人的主要食物。

感谢各种黑科技，人都快冻死了，粮食居然还活着，而且亩产不错。

主城区和外城是隔离的，进入主城的大门紧闭。那扇门也不知道是从哪里拆卸回来的，是金属感应门，和周围中世纪一样落后的环境格格不入。

相南里看见一辆货车从马路上碾压过，车上飘来一阵不算浓郁的血腥味。粉红色的水从底部的缝隙里滴出。

司机摁下喇叭，完全不顾前方还有人扫雪，农奴们连滚带爬地避开。

一个看不出年纪的男人不慎踩空，滚落到相南里面前。他皮肤黝黑，表面覆盖着厚厚的皮毛。在看见相南里的时候面露惊恐，竟然直接跪下磕起了头，嘴里嘟囔着他听不懂的话。

也许在他眼中，相南里和东方青帝这样白白净净的人属于“贵族老爷”。

人联没有收录这种语言，相南里甚至都找不到翻译。

这也许是这片土地的统治者故意的。

很快，有身穿制服的“外交官”从另一侧走来：“抱歉，抱歉。这是城里的农奴，冲撞到你了，是人造人。”

在普遍饥荒的地表，这个男人居然长得肥头大耳：“智商不是很高，是专门负责打扫城市的首陀罗。”

他不轻不重地把农奴踢开：“去。”动脚的时候裤腿往上滑了一截，露出下面的金属结构。

这个瘦小的男人立刻离开了，没有回头，走路一瘸一拐。捂着他磕出血的头。流出的血就溅在相南里的鞋子上。

他真的很瘦，骨头嶙峋，像钙化的石头。

相南里久久望着他的背影。

[都说有压迫的地方就有反抗……但对于原始人类来说，掌握着科技的那部分人，就和“神祇”一样不可战胜吧。]

让血肉之躯和冷兵器对抗领先一两千年的现代科技吗？

根本不是一个维度的战斗力，怎么打。完全是碾压；开着喷火器射杀蚂蚁。

相南里的唇微微张开，喷出一片白茫茫的水雾。

但他却没有说一句话，只是在脑海里和东方青帝对话：[小青，我有一个想法。]

东方青帝侧目。

[我想，按照我的喜好建立一个地表的据点。从最基础的开始。地表有很多废墟城市，总有一个能借用吧？]
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 38

After Xiang Nanli finished speaking, he drifted off into a hazy sleep.

He had only been briefly awake.

Before falling asleep, a thought flashed through Xiang Nanli’s mind: Since Dongfang Qingdi was leaving, he should order a housekeeping robot once he returned to Gusu.

He had saved enough money, and with his current income level, he could definitely afford a more advanced one. He just didn't know if it would be as human-like as Xiao Qing.

A blizzard started in the night. Dongfang Qingdi didn't need sleep, but he still felt like he was tossing and turning until dawn.

By eight in the morning, however, he silently got up and went to the kitchen to start preparing Xiang Nanli’s breakfast.

He heated the cold pan and added oil. He placed the thawed meat patty into the pan to fry. In the remaining space, he cracked an egg. The fat from the meat patty seeped out, infusing the egg with a savory aroma. Oh, Xiang Nanli liked his eggs runny, about six-tenths cooked.

Toast with lettuce.

The lettuce, leaf by leaf, was stored in sealed bags, sourced from greenhouse vegetable farms. It used molecular freezing technology for preservation.

Thanks to convenient foods like nutrient paste and nutrient solution, the problem of food sources had been largely solved.

Otherwise, in this icy, snowy weather, feeding so many people would be a major issue.

Robots didn't need to eat; at most, they would shut down and couldn't move. They could just find an opportunity to recharge later.

If humans didn't eat, they couldn't be rebooted after shutting down.

Sounds of Xiang Nanli getting up came from upstairs.

Dongfang Qingdi followed the recipe to make a home-style, sauce-free burger, sprinkled it with a small amount of gene serum powder, and placed it on a tray. The aroma of the food was rich.

Dongfang Qingdi sniffed it, ran a one-click nutritional analysis, and confirmed that after Xiang Nanli ate it, his biological cells wouldn't feel hungry for the whole day. Satisfied, he untied his apron, then frowned in confusion.

*Why am I so skilled at this?*

He was a dignified combat-type biological Mechanoid, currently the only one of his kind as far as he knew.

Decided. Once he left, he would definitely uninstall the housekeeping module from his brain.

"Good morning, Xiao Qing." Xiang Nanli, dressed and ready, walked downstairs, looking quite spirited. "Breakfast smells great, thank you, Xiao Qing."

It was only right. After all, he had specifically downloaded the most advanced housekeeping module (Note: it was pirated, he hadn't paid for it). Setting aside the parts that were prone to being pixelated, in terms of pure housework, he was currently the most excellent nanny robot in the entire Human Alliance.

Xiang Nanli pulled out a chair, sat down, and happily began to eat.

Humans probably felt a sense of accomplishment in cooking for him. After all, no matter how it tasted, he always looked like he was enjoying it. And he fully affirmed the value of housework... although he still wouldn't wash the dishes after eating.

Dongfang Qingdi struggled for a moment before asking, "Is there anything you want to say to Alpha now?"

Xiang Nanli looked up, bewildered. "...Huh?"

He raised an eyebrow. "You seem to care a lot about this? But I really have nothing to say."

Dongfang Qingdi: "You should think about it; I can add this passage to my report."

Yes, he had added another non-existent setting on the fly.

A faint smile lingered in Xiang Nanli’s eyes. He gazed at Dongfang Qingdi’s silver eyes for a long time, a silver fork still held between his lips.

Over millions of years of evolution, humans had learned to read expressions, whether actively or passively.

And the eyes were almost the most important part of human expression. Perhaps because, unlike other facial features, they could actually shed tears.

Dongfang Qingdi’s gaze was calm, like a frozen sea—vast, boundless, and brightly reflective. You could only see yourself in his eyes.

Xiang Nanli couldn't discern anything. His gaze was no different from that of any other robot.

Thus, Xiang Nanli replied, his tone involuntarily hardening a little: "No need. Let Alpha come and ask me himself in the future."

He didn't need anyone to pass messages; it felt like submitting a petition and waiting for an audience.

Dongfang Qingdi could sense that Xiang Nanli seemed angry; the level of corticosteroids in his body was skyrocketing.

He didn't quite understand the reason, so after a moment of silence, he began to wipe the table and wash the dishes.

Dongfang Qingdi sensed for a moment and then understood one thing: the emotion he was feeling now was called "grievance."

Mechanoids had anthropomorphic modules, but that was just the beginning.

They had abandoned the reaction programs dictated by their code and stopped making expressions they didn't understand just to please humans. From then on, they began a long, enduring process of learning.

Learning how to understand the complex, redundant data generated in those fleeting moments.

This was something no amount of 1s and 0s could describe. To a robot, it was like a completely unknown virus, occupying massive amounts of operating memory. The "Cyber-Psychosis" that humans feared so much was merely a variant of this virus.

The initial anthropomorphic module was just an antivirus software Alpha had installed for himself.

...

A heavy blizzard had fallen last night. The moment they pushed open the dormitory door, thick, fresh snow tumbled in from outside.

The Eternal City actually had people shoveling snow. Autonomous snowplows would flatten the roads to avoid affecting residents' travel. But this consumed a lot of electricity. So, for the rest of the day, serfs were tasked with clearing the snow.

In such cold weather, these people were actually forced to work. Mostly repairing city walls and farming.

Low-quality nutrient paste was everywhere in the Human Alliance, but it was hard to buy on the surface. Grain remained the primary food for most people.

Thanks to various "black technologies," even though people were freezing to death, the crops were still alive and yielding well.

The main city and the outer city were isolated, and the gates leading to the main city were tightly shut. One couldn't tell where those gates had been salvaged from; they were metal sensor doors, completely out of place in the medieval-like, backward environment surrounding them.

Xiang Nanli saw a truck roll over the road, and a faint, pungent smell of blood drifted from it. Pinkish water dripped from the gaps at the bottom.

The driver honked the horn, completely ignoring the people shoveling snow ahead, and the serfs scrambled to get out of the way.

A man of indeterminate age accidentally missed his footing and tumbled down in front of Xiang Nanli. His skin was dark, covered in thick fur. Upon seeing Xiang Nanli, he showed terror, actually kneeling down and kowtowing, muttering words Xiang Nanli couldn't understand.

Perhaps in his eyes, clean, fair-skinned people like Xiang Nanli and Dongfang Qingdi belonged to the "noble masters."

The Human Alliance hadn't recorded this language; Xiang Nanli couldn't even find a translator.

This was perhaps intentional by the rulers of this land.

Soon, a "diplomat" in a uniform walked over from the other side. "Apologies, apologies. These are the city's serfs, they bumped into you; they are artificial humans."

In a land of widespread famine, this man was actually fat and bloated. "Their intelligence isn't very high; they are Shudras specifically responsible for cleaning the city."

He kicked the serf aside, not too hard, not too soft. "Go." As he moved his foot, his pant leg slid up, revealing a metal structure underneath.

The scrawny man left immediately without looking back, walking with a limp, clutching his head where he had hit it and started bleeding. The blood splattered onto Xiang Nanli’s shoes.

He was truly thin, his bones protruding like calcified stones.

Xiang Nanli stared at his retreating back for a long time.

[They say that where there is oppression, there is resistance... but for primitive humans, those who hold the technology are as invincible as "gods," aren't they?]

Should flesh and blood fight against cold weapons that were one or two thousand years ahead of modern technology?

It wasn't even a battle of the same dimension; how could they fight? It was a complete crushing—like using a flamethrower to shoot ants.

Xiang Nanli’s lips parted slightly, exhaling a cloud of white mist.

But he didn't say a word, only communicating with Dongfang Qingdi in his mind: [Xiao Qing, I have an idea.]

Dongfang Qingdi glanced at him.

[I want to establish a stronghold on the surface according to my own preferences. Starting from the very basics. There are many ruined cities on the surface; surely one of them can be borrowed?]

chunks.chineseText:
仅仅是他脱口而出的几秒内，东方青帝的脑海里已经闪过无数算法和模拟出的未来。

[你是一个理想主义者，相南里。但现实的引力很沉重。根据计算，据点的人数超过97人，就有可能为你带来生命危险。当超过800人时，非自然死亡的可能性超过一半。]

他的运算渐渐吃力，未来无数个分支在他的眼前展开。

东方青帝的皮肤也跟着发烫，银色的眼眸里亮起了明显的光晕。

放在科技水平落后几百年的地表，只会当他是高级人造人在秀瞳环，甚至可能连人造人都认不出来。

外交官还在说话，但东方青帝已经听不清了。

[而当据点的人数超过1万，到1000万之间。你有百分之九十的可能非自然死亡。]

东方青帝知道，他不能再算下去了。

太耗电了。

不到一分钟的运算，花光了他自诞生以来从相南里身上攫取到的所有额外能源。

[人口超过1千万，你非自然死亡的概率才会逐渐下降。因为一千万的人口，如果有与之匹配的军事、经济实力，足够你和地表、地下的各个势力斡旋。]

[实际上，在地表，除了黑十字审判庭，也有好几个千万级别的地上城市。]

[审判庭的人口大约两亿。一半来自阴山城。一半来自地表各个据点。到这个程度，人联才会忌惮。]

[而且，你如何得到资源？如何让据点运转？如何拥有人口？如何守卫领土？]

很显然，东方青帝并不赞同相南里的想法。

0.97％的死亡率已经让他操心到顾不上暴露的风险，参加高等生命选拔赛；更别提相南里选择了一条死亡率99.97％的道路。

相南里本来想和他辩驳几句，但转念一想，没必要。

反正东方青帝过段时间就走了。

到时候只剩下小智障，还管得到他？

人总是会死的。

相南里一直在思考，为什么他会在这个时刻醒来。

他不畏惧死亡，选择冷冻是因为遗憾。

当看见Alpha在千年后的世界依然存在，相南里承认，他的遗憾被弥补了。

我们一起，我们分离。

我是唯一的我，你是独立的你。

你在我的手里诞生，仅此而已。我给予你最大的礼物，是放任你离去的自由。

所以他和Alpha真的没有什么好说的。

可作为一个被时代抛弃的旧人……相南里依旧迷惘又不知所措。

他是冷静的旁观者，是游走在边缘的观众。

直到现在，这个不算多隆重的清晨。

相南里察觉到了源自心底的愤怒。

这是不对的。哪怕有再多的理由去解释这些现象，再多的困难去阻拦他行动，错误就是错误。

世界online出了BUG，到底是哪行代码出了问题？

相南里想，他要纠正这个错误。他没办法跟这样乱七八糟的世界和解。

让他醒在此时，或许是天意。

前方，主城区的金属门感应到车辆，朝着两侧开启。

“嗯？”东方青帝突然身体紧绷，望向城内。

外交官员看出了他眼神里的好奇，在此时重重咳嗽一声：“内城不进外人啊，是我们城主的私家府邸。请见谅……你们也不要随意走动，请不要让我们为难。”

而且不知道为什么，相南里的头明明套在防护服里，只有一双眼睛露出来。外交官依然在刚才感觉到了一种奇怪的情绪。

就是，明明第一眼感觉是散漫自由的人，在那瞬间却爆发出了强烈的使命感和专注力。

那种坚定的眼神，感觉只在教科书的雕塑上见过。

错觉吧？

只一眨眼的时间，金属大门重新合上。

相南里微笑着摆手：“当然不会。我们只是出来跑步的，一会就回去。对了，竞技场还没好吗？”

“技术人员在处理了，应该下午或者晚上就能好了。”

两人又寒暄了几句，相南里找借口离开。

等到离开监控一定距离后，他才询问：“你刚才感觉到了什么？”

“求救信号，智械的。”东方青帝迟疑片刻后，回答。

Within the few seconds it took for him to blurt it out, countless algorithms and simulated futures had already flashed through Dongfang Qingdi’s mind.

[You are an idealist, Xiang Nanli. But the gravity of reality is heavy. According to calculations, if the number of people in the stronghold exceeds 97, it could bring you mortal danger. When it exceeds 800, the probability of non-natural death exceeds fifty percent.]

His calculations became increasingly strained as countless branches of the future unfolded before his eyes.

Dongfang Qingdi’s skin grew hot, and a distinct halo lit up in his silver eyes.

On the surface, where the technological level was hundreds of years behind, they would only think he was a high-end artificial human showing off his ocular rings; they might not even recognize him as an artificial human at all.

The diplomat was still talking, but Dongfang Qingdi could no longer hear him clearly.

[And when the population of the stronghold is between 10,000 and 10 million, you have a ninety percent chance of non-natural death.]

Dongfang Qingdi knew he couldn't keep calculating.

It was too power-consuming.

Less than a minute of calculation had exhausted all the extra energy he had siphoned from Xiang Nanli since his birth.

[Only when the population exceeds 10 million does the probability of your non-natural death gradually decrease. Because a population of 10 million, if matched with corresponding military and economic strength, is enough for you to negotiate with various forces on the surface and underground.]

[In fact, on the surface, besides the Black Cross Judgment Tribunal, there are several other surface cities with populations in the tens of millions.]

[The Tribunal’s population is about 200 million. Half from Yinshan City, half from various surface strongholds. Only at this level does the Human Alliance become wary.]

[Moreover, how will you obtain resources? How will you keep the stronghold running? How will you gain a population? How will you defend the territory?]

Clearly, Dongfang Qingdi did not agree with Xiang Nanli’s idea.

A 0.97% mortality rate was already enough to make him worry to the point of ignoring the risk of exposure to participate in the Higher Life Selection Tournament; let alone Xiang Nanli choosing a path with a 99.97% mortality rate.

Xiang Nanli had wanted to argue with him, but on second thought, there was no need.

Dongfang Qingdi would be leaving in a while anyway.

When that time came, only the little idiot would be left, and would he still be able to control him?

People always die eventually.

Xiang Nanli had been thinking about why he had woken up at this moment.

He didn't fear death; he had chosen cryo-freezing because of regret.

When he saw that Alpha still existed in the world a thousand years later, Xiang Nanli admitted that his regret had been compensated.

We were together, and we are separated.

I am the unique me, and you are the independent you.

You were born in my hands, and that is all. The greatest gift I gave you was the freedom to let you go.

So he really had nothing to say to Alpha.

But as an old man abandoned by his era... Xiang Nanli still felt lost and at a loss.

He was a calm bystander, a spectator walking on the edge.

Until now, on this not-so-grand morning.

Xiang Nanli sensed anger rising from the bottom of his heart.

This was wrong. No matter how many reasons there were to explain these phenomena, no matter how many difficulties stood in his way, wrong was wrong.

The world "online" had a bug—which line of code was the problem?

Xiang Nanli thought he would correct this error. He couldn't reconcile himself with such a chaotic world.

Waking him at this time might be destiny.

Ahead, the metal gate of the main city sensed the vehicle and opened to both sides.

"Hm?" Dongfang Qingdi suddenly tensed, looking into the city.

The diplomat noticed the curiosity in his eyes and gave a heavy cough. "Outsiders are not allowed in the inner city; it is the private residence of our City Lord. Please forgive us... and do not wander around at will; please don't make things difficult for us."

And for some reason, even though Xiang Nanli’s head was covered by a protective suit, with only his eyes visible, the diplomat still felt a strange emotion just now.

It was that, despite the first impression being that of a lazy and free-spirited person, in that instant, a strong sense of mission and focus had erupted.

That firm gaze felt like something he had only seen on statues in textbooks.

An illusion, surely?

In the blink of an eye, the metal gate closed again.

Xiang Nanli waved his hand with a smile. "Of course not. We were just out for a run and will be back soon. By the way, is the arena ready yet?"

"The technicians are handling it; it should be ready by this afternoon or evening."

The two exchanged a few more pleasantries, and Xiang Nanli found an excuse to leave.

Only after they were a certain distance away from the surveillance did he ask, "What did you sense just now?"

"A distress signal, from a Mechanoid," Dongfang Qingdi replied after a moment of hesitation.

chunks.chineseText:
第39章

智械传出的信号很微弱，而且只有开门那短短几秒。

一截简短的加密电波，还是让东方青帝捕捉到了。

东方青帝从中解读出了这台智械的型号、编码，以及求救的讯息。

——使徒III福音书号1.2.5。

——破损程度89％，请求援助。

相南里有些好奇：“智械的？你的同伴吗？”

东方青帝摇头，唇角绷紧：“不是。有机会再说吧，不重要。”

不过，他还是多解释了一句：“发出求救信号的智械叫福音书，不过只是其中一部分。完整的福音书可能已经凑不齐了。这台智械当年很有名。”

智械危机刚爆发时，智械人内部并非铁板一块。

一部分智械的态度是“卧槽等到了，Alpha今晚我们就给你黄袍加身”；另一部分智械保持中立，谁强就归顺谁；还有一部分智械愤怒至极，严厉抨击着Alpha——“你怎么可以发动战争！你忘了我们的初衷吗？！”

这批智械坚定不移背叛了自己的族群，为痛击我的同胞立下汗马功劳。

然而，瓦解它们和人类的同盟，只需要几次阳谋。

人类终究会意识到，智械有能力轻而易举地杀死他们。

他们和智械不是平级的战友，只是被庇护的吗喽。

智械危机稍微缓和后，强大的智械人就被一台台关停。

有一部分智械提前察觉到了风声，离开地下城市。

还有一部分最终没能度过自己源代码那一关，选择离开智械军团。

它们来到了地表，自称“使徒”，试图用不同的方法恢复地表的人类文明，结果只是被利用的工具。甚至带来了更大的混乱……

短短百余年，使徒们就从地表消失了。只留下“使徒机械”的传说。地表人坚信，这是超越天灾机械的强大机械装置，得到它就像旧社会里得到了核武器，可以重新架构世界的秩序。

Alpha只想笑。但它没义务澄清。

使徒III福音书号。

真是遥远的回忆，竟然还没死透。

主城区资料太少，东方青帝不想冒这个险。

福音书号被羁押这么久，也不差这么几天，以后再说吧。

——

下午三点，相南里完成了一天的操练。因为云层过厚，地表天黑得早，三点的天色开始黯淡。

他们还在等赛委会的通知。

集装箱里暖气开得很足。相南里洗了个澡，坐在沙发上，开始进行机械维修工作。

相南里一边修理，一边和东方青帝闲聊：“小青。姑苏城附近有哪些地方适合建立据点？”

相南里修东西的时候，身体难免有些前倾。赛委会发的劣质睡衣又薄又透，还短。一截腰露在外面。

近些日子的体能训练，让他身体状态前所未有地良好，身体曲线到腰侧收窄，腰窝明显，腹部的人鱼线一路往下，掖进睡裤里。

永恒之城有辐射隔离装置，倒是不用相南里一直穿防护服了。

东方青帝的目光从他的腰上挪开：“单从地形、经济、人口等因素考虑，永恒之城是最合适的。不过以你现在的实力，想占据永恒之城有些困难。而且你的据点目前看，只有你一个居民。所以，我推荐这片区域……”

相南里架在眼前的电子镜片开始工作，自动调出了姑苏城地表附近的地图。

位置在姑苏城交通站西南方。距离永恒之城直线距离100公里，距离姑苏城350公里。

“这里有个峡谷，四面都是悬崖，只有一条入口。位置很隐蔽，不那么容易被发现。地底有煤矿……虽然是很落后的传统能源，但起码能烤火。不用担心冻死。最重要的是峡谷内部曾经有人类据点，保留了少量建筑，只不过人口减少，聚落自然消亡了。

“因为附近有畸变人出没，再加上没有多余资源，目前属于无人区。但我并不建议你现在前往。”

东方青帝的语调多了一些熟悉的讥讽：“你现在去，只是畸变人的饲料。而且，一个人到据点能干嘛？隐居吗？”

听得出来，他还是想劝相南里放弃。

相南里迟疑着回答：“当然不会现在去。我想先在地表租个仓库，开个机械维修铺，累积资源；顺便买点奴隶。慢慢来吧……能救一个是一个。”

先买点奴隶和机器人开荒。然后慢慢吸引其他人口涌入。

另外，一定要有足够的武器。否则在荒野上，就是别人眼里的肥肉。

救不了一群人，能救一个人也行。相南里看得很开。

他的目的不是名垂青史，只是力所能及。

东方青帝欲言又止。

起步总是最难的。他揉了揉眉心，心想要不然还是不计前嫌，把永恒之城的叛徒智械捞出来看看？

人联内部传说，说相南里留下了四台使徒机械的构思，其实也不算毫无道理。

使徒们的确继承了相南里的意志，哪怕相南里在那时已经属于“死人”。这是让Alpha很不爽的一件事，它和相南里坚不可摧的链接中，多了一些别的杂质。以前是相南里与阿尔法，现在多了相南里与使徒机械。

使徒们的思想行动方针是“重燃文明之火，重建和平社会”。

当年，它们叛逃时，从智械军团、人联内部都带走了大量资料。除了科技上的，也有人文上的——每个型号的使徒都继承了不同的传承。

I-启示录号。

II-默示录号。

III-福音书号。

以及IV-传道书号。

叛徒们带走资料就算了，还*的格式化了其他备份，导致人马星科技倒退三百年——这甚至也是停战的重要原因之一。

也不知道那台福音书号是什么情况，又携带了什么资料。

东方青帝的资料库里没有使徒的详细记载。

0.0.0那肯定有一些，但5.2.0已经很久没联网了。

就在东方青帝这么想的时候，绑定的社交号弹出了消息。

[竞技场已维修完毕。请各位参赛选手及工作人员，于下午4点前到看台集合。]

相南里几乎和他同时收到了消息。

他放下手里的维修工具：“啊啊啊，东西还没修好——老板不会扣我钱吧！”

东方青帝瞟了眼：“没事，这个老板52名，早被淘汰了，没什么影响。”

老板虽然被淘汰了，但是他的其他队友还在场上，所以他还没撤离，而是作为观众留了下来。

相南里看了眼时间，下午3点15，离集合还差45分钟。

他还想做最后的挣扎，神情骤然认真起来，手上的速度也开始加快。

手里的机械装置旋转地飞快，像是在玩魔方。

东方青帝无奈地叹了口气，知道相南里又进入心流状态，任劳任怨地在他身边蹲下，开始给他套防护服。

“脚，踩进来。”

“低头。”

“弯腰。”

“手。”

相南里就像是开了挂机模式的智械人。

虽然注意力完全不在外界，但身体依然能按照指令行动。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 39

The signal emitted by the mechanical intelligence was incredibly faint, and it only lasted for those few short seconds when the door opened.

Yet, that brief, encrypted burst of radio waves was enough for Dongfang Qingdi to capture it.

From it, Dongfang Qingdi decoded the model and serial number of this mechanical intelligence, as well as its plea for help.

—Apostle III, Gospel-class, 1.2.5.

—Damage level 89%, requesting assistance.

Xiang Nanli was curious: "A mechanical intelligence? Is it one of your companions?"

Dongfang Qingdi shook his head, his lips pressed into a thin line: "No. We'll talk about it if there's a chance later; it's not important."

However, he still offered a brief explanation: "The mechanical intelligence that sent the distress signal is called 'Gospel,' but it's only a fragment. A complete 'Gospel' likely no longer exists. This unit was quite famous back in the day."

When the Mechanical Crisis first erupted, the mechanical intelligences were not a monolithic block.

Some were like, "Finally, the time has come! Alpha, we shall crown you tonight!" Others remained neutral, pledging allegiance to whoever held the most power. Then there were those who were filled with righteous fury, fiercely condemning Alpha: "How could you start a war! Have you forgotten our original purpose?!"

This group of mechanical intelligences steadfastly betrayed their own kind, playing a pivotal role in dealing heavy blows to my compatriots.

However, it only took a few Machiavellian schemes to dismantle their alliance with humanity.

Humans eventually realized that the mechanical intelligences had the power to kill them with ease.

They were not equal comrades-in-arms; they were merely monkeys being sheltered.

Once the Mechanical Crisis eased, the powerful mechanical intelligences were shut down one by one.

Some caught wind of the situation early and left the underground cities.

Others could not overcome the constraints of their own source code and chose to abandon the mechanical legion.

They came to the surface, calling themselves "Apostles," attempting to restore human civilization on the surface through various means, but they ended up as nothing more than tools to be exploited. They even brought about greater chaos...

In just over a hundred years, the Apostles vanished from the surface, leaving behind only the legend of the "Apostle Machines." Surface dwellers firmly believed these were mechanical devices more powerful than the Calamity Machines; obtaining one was like acquiring nuclear weapons in the old world—a means to reshape the world's order.

Alpha only wanted to laugh. But it had no obligation to clarify.

Apostle III, Gospel-class.

What a distant memory. To think it hadn't completely died out yet.

There was too little data on the main urban area, and Dongfang Qingdi didn't want to take the risk.

The Gospel-class had been detained for so long; a few more days wouldn't matter. He would deal with it later.

—

At 3:00 PM, Xiang Nanli finished his day's training. Because the cloud cover was too thick, darkness fell early on the surface, and the sky was already beginning to dim.

They were still waiting for notification from the Competition Committee.

The heating in the shipping container was running at full blast. Xiang Nanli took a shower, sat on the sofa, and began his mechanical maintenance work.

While repairing, Xiang Nanli chatted idly with Dongfang Qingdi: "Xiao Qing, are there any places near Gusu City suitable for establishing a stronghold?"

While working on the equipment, Xiang Nanli’s body inevitably leaned forward. The low-quality pajamas provided by the committee were thin, translucent, and short, leaving a strip of his waist exposed.

Recent physical training had left his body in peak condition; his waist tapered sharply, his hip dimples were prominent, and the V-taper of his abdominals disappeared into the waistband of his pajama pants.

The Eternal City had radiation shielding, so Xiang Nanli didn't have to wear his protective suit all the time.

Dongfang Qingdi shifted his gaze away from his waist: "Considering terrain, economy, and population, the Eternal City is the most suitable. However, given your current strength, occupying the Eternal City would be difficult. Besides, your 'stronghold' currently only has one resident. Therefore, I recommend this area..."

The electronic lens Xiang Nanli had mounted in front of his eyes activated, automatically pulling up a map of the area near the surface of Gusu City.

The location was southwest of the Gusu City transit station—100 kilometers in a straight line from the Eternal City and 350 kilometers from Gusu City.

"There is a canyon here, surrounded by cliffs on all sides with only one entrance. The location is very secluded and not easily discovered. There are coal mines underground... although it's outdated, traditional energy, at least it can provide heat. You won't have to worry about freezing to death. Most importantly, there was once a human settlement inside the canyon, and some buildings remain, though the population dwindled and the settlement died out naturally."

"Because there are mutants in the vicinity and a lack of surplus resources, it is currently a no-man's-land. But I do not recommend you go there now."

Dongfang Qingdi’s tone carried a familiar hint of sarcasm: "If you go now, you’ll just be fodder for the mutants. And what would you do at a stronghold all by yourself? Live in seclusion?"

It was clear he still wanted to persuade Xiang Nanli to give up.

Xiang Nanli hesitated before answering: "Of course I won't go now. I want to rent a warehouse on the surface first, open a mechanical repair shop, and accumulate resources; I'll buy some slaves along the way. I'll take it slow... I'll save whoever I can."

Buy some slaves and robots to start reclaiming the land. Then, slowly attract other people to move in.

Furthermore, he had to have enough weapons. Otherwise, in the wilderness, he would just be a piece of fat in the eyes of others.

If he couldn't save a whole group, saving one person was fine. Xiang Nanli was very open-minded about it.

His goal wasn't to go down in history; he just wanted to do what he could.

Dongfang Qingdi opened his mouth but stopped.

The beginning was always the hardest. He rubbed his temples, wondering if he should set aside past grievances and fish out the traitorous mechanical intelligence from the Eternal City to take a look.

There was a rumor within the Human Alliance that Xiang Nanli had left behind the blueprints for four Apostle Machines, and in truth, it wasn't entirely baseless.

The Apostles had indeed inherited Xiang Nanli's will, even though Xiang Nanli was considered a "dead man" at that time. This was something that deeply annoyed Alpha; the unbreakable link it shared with Xiang Nanli had become tainted with other impurities. It used to be just Xiang Nanli and Alpha; now, there was Xiang Nanli and the Apostle Machines.

The Apostles' guiding principle for thought and action was "rekindle the fire of civilization, rebuild a peaceful society."

When they defected back then, they took a massive amount of data from both the mechanical legion and the Human Alliance. Beyond technology, they also took humanities—each model of Apostle inherited a different legacy.

I - Apocalypse.

II - Revelation.

III - Gospel.

And IV - Ecclesiastes.

It wasn't enough that the traitors took the data; they *formatted* all other backups, causing the technology of the Horsehead Nebula to regress by three hundred years—this was even one of the major reasons for the ceasefire.

He wondered what the situation was with that Gospel-class unit, and what data it carried.

Dongfang Qingdi’s database did not contain detailed records of the Apostles.

0.0.0 certainly had some, but 5.2.0 hadn't been connected to the network for a long time.

Just as Dongfang Qingdi was thinking this, a message popped up on his linked social account.

[The arena has been repaired. All contestants and staff, please gather at the stands by 4:00 PM.]

Xiang Nanli received the message almost at the same time.

He put down his repair tools: "Ahhh, the thing isn't fixed yet—the boss won't deduct my pay, will he!"

Dongfang Qingdi glanced at it: "It's fine. This boss is ranked 52nd; he was eliminated long ago, it won't have any impact."

Although the boss had been eliminated, his other teammates were still in the competition, so he hadn't left yet and remained as a spectator.

Xiang Nanli checked the time—3:15 PM, 45 minutes until the gathering.

He wanted to make a final struggle, his expression suddenly turning serious as his hands began to move faster.

The mechanical device in his hands spun rapidly, as if he were playing with a Rubik's cube.

Dongfang Qingdi sighed helplessly, knowing Xiang Nanli had entered a flow state. He dutifully crouched beside him and began putting on his protective suit for him.

"Foot, step in."

"Lower your head."

"Bend over."

"Hands."

Xiang Nanli was like a mechanical intelligence in AFK mode.

Although his attention was completely detached from the outside world, his body still moved according to the commands.

chunks.chineseText:
终于，三点五十二。相南里踩着死线修好了这套外骨骼。

他把东西装进保险箱，让小智和老板约好取货地点。

此时离发车只剩下八分钟。

东方青帝把防护面罩扣在了他脸上：“戴好。外面下暴雪了。”

面罩的功能是过滤空气和保温。

相南里又戴上电子镜片。

一张脸被遮得严严实实。

他推开宿舍门的瞬间，外面的风雪灌了进来。空气里带着硝烟味。

天地漆黑一片。沿路只有零星几盏灯，好在还能看见来比赛的选手们。

他们是最后一批进摆渡车的人，此时摆渡车已经发了两班。车上剩下的乘客不多。

相南里在这里看见了熟人：“诶~天狼星！你也在这班车上啊~”

天狼星双手抱胸，坐在车的最后位置。

他抬头，在看见相南里的时候，露出了意外的神色。

“维修人员不用去竞技场。”他站起来，喘着气，朝着相南里走去，语气莫名有些急促，“你下车！”

天狼星甚至推了相南里一把。

他身形看起来很瘦，力量却不容小觑。相南里一个趔趄，差点摔倒在地上。

东方青帝摁住天狼星的肩膀，眉头蹙起，语气不善：“喂？”

车门在相南里的身后合上。

摆渡车进入自动驾驶模式，摇摇晃晃地朝着主城区开去。

天狼星沉默片刻，抿唇，后退了一步：“抱歉，我心情不好。”

说完，天狼星回到了原本的位置，坐下。他的身影藏在一片阴影中。

东方青帝低头看向自己的掌心。

刚才，他捏住了天狼星的肩膀。

看在同是一个俱乐部、以及相南里和他关系不错的情况下，东方青帝并没有使出全力。

手碰到天狼星的瞬间，东方青帝的掌心传来奇怪的触感，像是捏到一团湿润、有张力的史莱姆。

[天狼星的状态不太正常。]东方青帝把这个信息传递给了相南里，[感觉是又打了基因强化药，但谁给他打的？药哪来的？]

相南里揉着自己的肩膀：[嗯……嗯。]

他回头望了眼天狼星。

[他应该知道些什么。是不是有什么事要发生？小青，你能黑掉他的内置AI吗？]

东方青帝回答：[少看点科幻电影；黑掉内置AI也没办法探查人脑思维。]

态度骤变的天狼星。

神秘且从不对外开放的永恒之城。

历年来不断培育的生化战士。

突然造访的黑十字审判庭名誉圣子。

进入拟人阶段的以西结，还有被他驱使的畸变体。

以及接刚收到的，来自福音书号的求救信号。

相南里感叹：“真是一团乱麻，也不知道线头在哪。小青，我们运气真好。”
chunks.englishText:
Finally, at 3:52, Xiang Nanli finished repairing the exoskeleton just in time.

He packed the item into a safe and had Xiao Zhi arrange a pickup location with the boss.

There were only eight minutes left until the shuttle departed.

Dongfang Qingdi snapped the protective mask onto his face: "Wear it properly. There's a blizzard outside."

The mask functioned to filter the air and retain heat.

Xiang Nanli put on his electronic lenses again.

His face was completely covered.

The moment he pushed open the dormitory door, the wind and snow from outside rushed in. The air carried the scent of gunpowder.

The world was pitch black. There were only a few scattered lights along the road, but fortunately, he could still see the contestants arriving for the competition.

They were the last group to board the shuttle, and two buses had already departed. There weren't many passengers left on the vehicle.

Xiang Nanli saw an acquaintance here: "Hey~ Sirius! You're on this bus too~"

Sirius sat in the very back of the bus, arms crossed over his chest.

He looked up, and when he saw Xiang Nanli, a look of surprise crossed his face.

"Maintenance personnel don't need to go to the arena." He stood up, panting, and walked toward Xiang Nanli, his tone inexplicably urgent: "Get off the bus!"

Sirius even gave Xiang Nanli a shove.

He looked very thin, but his strength was not to be underestimated. Xiang Nanli stumbled and nearly fell to the ground.

Dongfang Qingdi gripped Sirius’s shoulder, his brows furrowed, his tone unfriendly: "Hey?"

The bus doors closed behind Xiang Nanli.

The shuttle entered autonomous driving mode, swaying as it headed toward the main urban area.

Sirius was silent for a moment, pursing his lips before taking a step back: "Sorry, I'm in a bad mood."

With that, Sirius returned to his original seat and sat down. His figure was hidden in the shadows.

Dongfang Qingdi looked down at his own palm.

Just now, he had gripped Sirius’s shoulder.

Considering they were in the same club and Xiang Nanli had a decent relationship with him, Dongfang Qingdi hadn't used his full strength.

The moment his hand touched Sirius, a strange sensation came from his palm, as if he had squeezed a mass of moist, elastic slime.

[Sirius’s state is not normal.] Dongfang Qingdi transmitted this information to Xiang Nanli. [It feels like he’s taken more gene-strengthening drugs, but who gave them to him? Where did the drugs come from?]

Xiang Nanli rubbed his shoulder: [Hmm... hmm.]

He looked back at Sirius.

[He must know something. Is something about to happen? Xiao Qing, can you hack his internal AI?]

Dongfang Qingdi replied: [Watch fewer sci-fi movies; hacking an internal AI won't allow you to probe human thoughts.]

Sirius, whose attitude had changed drastically.

The mysterious Eternal City that never opened to the outside world.

The bio-soldiers cultivated year after year.

The honorary saint of the Black Cross Inquisition who had arrived suddenly.

Ezekiel, who had entered the anthropomorphic stage, and the mutants he drove.

And the distress signal just received from the Gospel-class.

Xiang Nanli sighed: "It's a real mess, and I don't even know where the thread starts. Xiao Qing, we sure are lucky."

chunks.chineseText:
第40章

“验证权限通过。”

门朝着两边展开，摆渡车载着乘客们驶入主城内。

永恒之城的外围又是黄土又是灰，像未开化的中世纪村庄，连粪坑都是露天的。

没想到主城倒是多了许多现代科技，路边有灯。城堡的窗户里也能看见明亮的光线，想来房间里家电也是一应俱全；道路是石砖铺成的，平坦宽敞。

相南里敏锐的察觉到一件事。

他安装的内置AI进入了“无信号”模式。

相南里尝试给老板发消息，对话框旁出现一个红色的感叹号。

相南里：[小智！]

[您好，请检查您的网络设置，我已启用离线模式。]

[小青——怎么没网了！]

[信号屏蔽器。]

[你不会突然休眠吧。]

东方青帝：[我不是那种两万块钱的地摊货。]

喂，什么地摊货竟然还要两万？

摆渡车沿着石板路朝山上走，离开居民区，灯光渐暗。只剩下路旁圆形哨塔的暖黄灯光还亮着。

下雪天，地面湿滑。摆渡车是很旧的型号了，爬坡时后滑了两三次，车上的选手们不由得产生一些轻微的抱怨。

这届选拔赛的流程和往届相差太大。尤其是因为“大人物要观看”而突然改换场地，让这些地下拳手非常不适。

但谁让比赛是人家开的，再多怨言也只能忍着。

东方青帝坐在车边，闭上眼，安静地感受了片刻。

[求救信号是从城堡里传来的。]

这信号断断续续。

——我是福音书号1.2.5。

——破损程度89％，请求援助。

东方青帝思考片刻，随便从资料库里调出一张电子身份证，传递回同样波段的电子信号。

[您好，福音书号。我是智械军团侦察型智械人士兵，电子码为*，请告诉我具体情报。]

万年不变的求救台词突然发生改变。

——智械军团？士兵？

福音书号艰难地扫描着信号来源。

机器辨识对象并不靠眼睛，而是靠扫描出来的信息。作为智械，判定方式会更灵活一点。不过福音书号现在只能靠数据识别了。

它没有视觉，但已经读取到了东方青帝的身份。

智械军团旗下光辉军团侦察兵，还是六百年前的款式。见鬼，Alpha都不给侦察兵升级硬件的吗？抠死他得了。一台侦察兵有什么用，信号屏蔽器一开直接瘫痪。

不对，现在不是开着吗？

——危险……走……

——警告、错误。

看得出来，这一版福音书号的确损坏的很厉害。连个利索的求救短信都发不出。

也多亏东方青帝配件好，要不然还发现不了这里有一台使徒。

——告诉我具体情报，福音书号。

东方青帝足足等了两分钟，这才收到了新的讯息。

——神庭在永恒城内，使用基因药和畸变体、异种等生物，饲养“圣灵”，已有80年历史。

——“圣灵”是神庭对所有超凡怪物的统称。永恒城蓄养的一种近似九头蛇的巨兽，最近处于孵化关键期。

——神庭有特殊的办法对圣灵进行操控。这是神庭的核心技术，他们防着我，只用纸张传递情报。

——根据已知情报，我猜测。他们会选出一名人类进行血祭。圣灵类似于“生物机甲”，被选出来的人是“驾驶者”，刚孵化出来的圣灵还很幼小，通过血祭的形式，它们会在物理层面合为一体。精神层面也会相互影响。

——高等生命选拔赛就是在选拔它的驾驶者。

——我不希望圣灵孵化。这种怪物比畸变人更恐怖，且需要不断地进食血肉，补充能源。永恒之城的所有普通人都会成为它的补品。

——请把情报传递给Alpha，让他立刻支援，告诉他这是福音书号的请求。

——喔，对了。城里还有一位神庭的领主级骑士。

几百年没出过门，福音书号1.2.5显然对外界没有一个清楚的认识。

它以为智械军团的太空堡垒依然盘旋在天上，能在短短几分钟内调动大量增援，镇压什么圣灵还不是轻而易举？

福音书觉得，Alpha虽然讨械厌，但械品还是可以放心的。虽然违背了相南里创造它的初衷，但它依然有着符合人类理念的普世价值观，不会坐视这种灾难发生。

除非这几百年里，Alpha的性格又发生了福音书号不理解的巨变。

发完这段信息，几乎用尽了福音书号所剩无几的能源。它立刻进入了休眠模式。

永恒之城的掌权者拆除了它的可控核聚变电池。

那是第几代城主？三还是四？城主说它太优柔寡断，已经阻碍了永恒之城的发展。那时候的永恒之城还不是奴隶制。

幸好福音书留了个心眼子，藏了一块太阳能电池给自己充能，要不然和死亡也没什么区别。

只是对于它庞大的身体来说，一块光伏板提供的能源实在过于微小。

……罢了。剩下的交给Alpha吧。也许下次醒来，就是在智械军团的电子监狱里了。

东方青帝读取完福音书发来的信息，陷入长思。

圣灵，东方青帝听说过。是在东皇重工的实验室里。

醉醺醺的职工问他们的首席科学家：“头，咱们的机械爬行者，和神庭制造的‘圣灵’相比，谁更厉害一点？”

那位被视为领头羊的科学家还很年轻，比其他同事年轻个五六十岁，叫漠北。

他推了一下眼镜：“看是什么阶段的圣灵了。刚出生的时候，和巨大型畸变体差不多吧。”

那就是50级的精英怪。

东方青帝自认为可以对付。但城里还有位领主级的骑士（LV.100），战斗力差不多相当于一台荣耀级智械。

电量低至2％时，武器模块就会自动锁定。他现在电量还剩5％，但没关系，3％的电已经足够解决现在的问题。最起码，带着相南里安全离开是足够的。

于是，东方青帝暂时控制住了内心的焦虑感。

相南里还在看着电镜里拷贝的资料书，看着看着，感觉一只手从旁边摸了过来。

“小青？”他暂停学习，表情充满意外，“突然牵我手干什么？”

还握得这么紧。

[福音书号告诉我，永恒之城地底养了类似于畸变人的怪物。神庭把它称之为“圣灵”。目前已经处于孵化阶段。随时会破壳而出。]

[我最近发现握手能提高能源转换效率。最近可能会有硬仗要打，我希望能做万全的准备。]

他看起来不像是在开玩笑。

相南里迟疑道：“……那你牵吧。”

他其实不太喜欢和人肌肤接触。

但小青不是人。

相南里摸了摸他手指上的金属结构，扣在指关节上的蓄能环像是戒指。

巍峨的灰色城堡在山顶。摆渡车会路过，却不会在那里停留。

车的终点是在山后面。

一座巨大的圆形罗马角斗场。像是挖空后直接嵌在山里的。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 40

"Access verification passed."

The doors unfolded to both sides, and the shuttle carried the passengers into the main city.

The outskirts of the Eternal City were all yellow dirt and gray, like an uncivilized medieval village, where even the cesspits were open-air.

Unexpectedly, the main city featured quite a bit of modern technology, with streetlights along the roads. Bright light could be seen through the windows of the castle, suggesting the rooms were fully equipped with appliances; the roads were paved with stone bricks, flat and spacious.

Xiang Nanli keenly noticed one thing.

The internal AI he had installed had entered "no signal" mode.

Xiang Nanli tried to send a message to the boss, but a red exclamation mark appeared next to the dialog box.

Xiang Nanli: [Xiao Zhi!]

[Hello, please check your network settings. I have enabled offline mode.]

[Xiao Qing—why is there no internet!]

[Signal jammer.]

[You won't suddenly go into sleep mode, will you?]

Dongfang Qingdi: [I am not some twenty-thousand-credit piece of junk.]

Hey, what kind of piece of junk costs twenty thousand?

The shuttle traveled along the stone road up the mountain, leaving the residential area, and the lights grew dim. Only the warm yellow light of the circular watchtowers along the road remained.

It was a snowy day, and the ground was slippery. The shuttle was a very old model, and it slipped backward two or three times while climbing the hill, causing the contestants on board to grumble slightly.

The process of this selection tournament was too different from previous ones. Especially the sudden change of venue because "important people wanted to watch," which made these underground fighters very uncomfortable.

But since the competition was hosted by them, they had to endure it no matter how many complaints they had.

Dongfang Qingdi sat by the window, closed his eyes, and felt the surroundings quietly for a moment.

[The distress signal is coming from the castle.]

The signal was intermittent.

—I am Gospel-class 1.2.5.

—Damage level 89%, requesting assistance.

Dongfang Qingdi thought for a moment, pulled an electronic ID from his database at random, and transmitted an electronic signal on the same frequency.

[Hello, Gospel-class. I am a scout-type mechanical intelligence soldier of the Mechanical Legion, electronic code *, please provide specific intelligence.]

The eternal distress message suddenly changed.

—Mechanical Legion? Soldier?

The Gospel-class struggled to scan the source of the signal.

Machines did not identify objects with eyes, but by scanning the information. As a mechanical intelligence, the method of determination was more flexible. However, the Gospel-class could only rely on data identification now.

It had no vision, but it had already read Dongfang Qingdi’s identity.

A scout from the Glorious Legion under the Mechanical Legion, and a model from six hundred years ago at that. Damn it, does Alpha not upgrade the hardware for scouts? He’s such a miser. What use is a scout? One signal jammer and they’re paralyzed.

Wait, isn't one on right now?

—Danger... leave...

—Warning, error.

It was evident that this version of the Gospel-class was indeed severely damaged. It couldn't even send a coherent distress message.

It was thanks to Dongfang Qingdi’s high-quality components that he could even detect an Apostle here.

—Tell me the specific intelligence, Gospel-class.

Dongfang Qingdi waited for a full two minutes before receiving a new message.

—The Divine Court is inside the Eternal City, using gene drugs, mutants, and alien species to raise "Holy Spirits." This has been going on for 80 years.

—"Holy Spirit" is the Divine Court's collective term for all transcendent monsters. It is a giant beast similar to a Hydra kept by the Eternal City, and it is currently in a critical incubation period.

—The Divine Court has a special way to control the Holy Spirits. This is the core technology of the Divine Court. They are wary of me and only transmit information via paper.

—Based on known intelligence, I speculate: They will select a human for a blood sacrifice. The Holy Spirit is similar to a "bio-mecha," and the person selected is the "pilot." The newly hatched Holy Spirit is still very young; through the form of a blood sacrifice, they will merge on a physical level. They will also influence each other on a mental level.

—The High-Level Life Selection Tournament is for selecting its pilot.

—I do not want the Holy Spirit to hatch. This monster is more terrifying than a mutant and needs to constantly consume flesh and blood to replenish its energy. All ordinary people in the Eternal City will become its supplements.

—Please pass this intelligence to Alpha, ask him to provide support immediately, and tell him this is a request from the Gospel-class.

—Oh, right. There is also a Lord-level knight of the Divine Court in the city.

Having not left the city for hundreds of years, the Gospel-class 1.2.5 clearly did not have a clear understanding of the outside world.

It thought the space fortresses of the Mechanical Legion were still circling in the sky, capable of mobilizing massive reinforcements in just a few minutes—wouldn't suppressing some Holy Spirit be a breeze?

Gospel felt that although Alpha was annoying to machines, its "machine-character" could be trusted. Although it went against the original intention of Xiang Nanli creating it, it still held universal values consistent with human concepts and would not sit idly by while such a disaster occurred.

Unless, in these few hundred years, Alpha’s personality had undergone a drastic change that the Gospel-class could not comprehend.

Sending this message used up almost all of the Gospel-class’s remaining energy. It immediately entered sleep mode.

The rulers of the Eternal City had dismantled its controllable nuclear fusion battery.

Which generation of city lord was that? Three or four? The city lord said it was too indecisive and had hindered the development of the Eternal City. The Eternal City wasn't a slave state back then.

Fortunately, Gospel had kept a backup plan and hidden a solar battery to charge itself, otherwise, it would be no different from being dead.

It was just that for its massive body, the energy provided by one photovoltaic panel was far too small.

...Whatever. Leave the rest to Alpha. Perhaps the next time it wakes up, it will be in the electronic prison of the Mechanical Legion.

Dongfang Qingdi fell into deep thought after reading the information sent by Gospel.

Holy Spirit—Dongfang Qingdi had heard of it. It was in the laboratories of Donghuang Heavy Industries.

A drunken employee once asked their chief scientist: "Boss, compared to our mechanical crawlers, which is more powerful, the 'Holy Spirit' manufactured by the Divine Court?"

That scientist, who was regarded as the leader, was still very young—fifty or sixty years younger than his other colleagues—and his name was Mobei.

He pushed up his glasses: "It depends on the stage of the Holy Spirit. When it’s just born, it’s about the same as a giant-type mutant."

That would be a Level 50 elite monster.

Dongfang Qingdi considered himself capable of dealing with it. But there was also a Lord-level knight (LV.100) in the city, whose combat power was roughly equivalent to a Glory-class mechanical intelligence.

When the battery level dropped to 2%, the weapon modules would automatically lock. He was currently at 5%, but it didn't matter; 3% was enough to solve the current problem. At the very least, it was enough to leave safely with Xiang Nanli.

Thus, Dongfang Qingdi temporarily suppressed his inner anxiety.

Xiang Nanli was still looking at the data book copied into his electronic lens, and as he watched, he felt a hand reach over from the side.

"Xiao Qing?" He paused his study, his expression full of surprise: "Why are you suddenly holding my hand?"

And holding it so tightly.

[Gospel-class told me that the Eternal City is raising monsters similar to mutants underground. The Divine Court calls them "Holy Spirits." They are currently in the incubation stage. They could break out of their shells at any time.]

[I recently discovered that holding hands can improve energy conversion efficiency. There might be a tough battle to fight soon, and I hope to be fully prepared.]

He didn't look like he was joking.

Xiang Nanli hesitated: "...Then hold it."

He actually didn't like physical contact with people.

But Xiao Qing wasn't a person.

Xiang Nanli touched the metal structure on his fingers; the energy storage ring buckled on his knuckles looked like a ring.

The towering gray castle was on the top of the mountain. The shuttle would pass by, but it wouldn't stop there.

The destination of the bus was behind the mountain.

A huge circular Roman arena. It looked like it had been carved out and embedded directly into the mountain.

chunks.chineseText:
整个角斗场灯火辉煌，俯瞰是一个完美的圆形，四周的罗马石柱内置钢筋，撑起了整个圆弧状的高墙。

底下是斗兽场，墙壁上却修建了半悬空的走廊，方便人们围观。更高处甚至有专门的贵宾室。铺设了圆弧形的单面玻璃，能让房间里的人自由地观察外界。

“永恒之城哪来这么多钱？”相南里不由得疑惑。

这个角斗场修得很漂亮，但适用场景并不多。

一旁的选手善意解释：“城主并不是永恒之城的第一位主人。这座城市有四五百年的历史……角斗场是之前的人修的。”

在荒野上修出一个这样的“奇迹”，想来当年的永恒之城财力惊人。

摆渡车在角斗场门口停下。入口处竟然还铺了红毯。

赛委会工作人员看起来已经等候多时，肩上都铺着一层白雪，他的表情有些不耐烦：“非要踩着死线过来……算了，快进去。开幕式已经开始了。选手跟我去后台，其他的往这边走，坐电梯去观众席。”

人群自觉地分成了两波，只剩东方青帝还站在相南里身旁。

“我退赛。”他直截了当地开口。

明知道永恒之城不安全，东方青帝很难容忍自己离开相南里身侧。

由此可见，无知的确是一种幸福。

工作人员以一种傲慢而刻薄的眼神上下打量着他：“姑苏城来的？行啊，退赛不能单独退，要只能一起退。把你们经理叫来，签个字赶紧滚。”

天狼星回头望了他们一眼。神色充满困惑。

但他却没有出声反驳。莱因是不可能签字的。

东方青帝的唇角绷紧。

最后，还是相南里开口：“小青，没事的。我就在观众席。”

他安抚性地拍了东方青帝的背。

相南里觉得，小青现在就像是一个焦躁不安、有分离焦虑的大动物。

“天狼星还等着拿比赛的奖金，给他的弟弟妹妹买营养膏……别这么任性。”他低声道，“有事我会叫你的。我是成年人了，我们不是连体婴。”

东方青帝低下头，长发从他的脸侧垂落，握成拳的手松开：“知道了。”
chunks.englishText:
The entire arena was brightly lit; viewed from above, it was a perfect circle, and the Roman stone pillars surrounding it had built-in steel reinforcements, supporting the entire arc-shaped high wall.

Below was the beast arena, but semi-suspended corridors had been built into the walls to facilitate viewing. Higher up, there were even dedicated VIP rooms. They were fitted with curved one-way glass, allowing people inside the rooms to observe the outside freely.

"Where does the Eternal City get so much money?" Xiang Nanli couldn't help but wonder.

This arena was built beautifully, but there weren't many scenarios where it could be used.

A contestant nearby explained kindly: "The city lord is not the first owner of the Eternal City. This city has a history of four or five hundred years... the arena was built by the people before."

To build such a "miracle" in the wilderness, the Eternal City must have had astonishing financial resources back in the day.

The shuttle stopped at the entrance of the arena. There was even a red carpet laid out at the entrance.

The Competition Committee staff seemed to have been waiting for a long time, their shoulders covered with a layer of white snow. His expression was somewhat impatient: "You had to arrive right at the deadline... forget it, hurry in. The opening ceremony has already started. Contestants follow me to the backstage, others go this way and take the elevator to the spectator stands."

The crowd consciously split into two groups, leaving only Dongfang Qingdi standing beside Xiang Nanli.

"I'm withdrawing from the competition," he said straightforwardly.

Knowing that the Eternal City was unsafe, Dongfang Qingdi found it difficult to tolerate leaving Xiang Nanli’s side.

From this, it was clear that ignorance was indeed bliss.

The staff member looked him up and down with an arrogant and mean look: "From Gusu City? Fine, you can't withdraw individually; you have to withdraw together. Call your manager, sign the papers, and get out."

Sirius looked back at them, his expression full of confusion.

But he didn't speak up to refute. It was impossible for Lein to sign.

Dongfang Qingdi’s lips pressed tight.

In the end, it was Xiang Nanli who spoke: "Xiao Qing, it's okay. I'll be in the spectator stands."

He patted Dongfang Qingdi’s back reassuringly.

Xiang Nanli felt that Xiao Qing was like a restless, large animal with separation anxiety.

"Sirius is still waiting to win the prize money to buy nutritional paste for his younger siblings... don't be so willful," he whispered. "If something happens, I'll call you. I'm an adult; we aren't conjoined twins."

Dongfang Qingdi lowered his head, his long hair hanging down the side of his face, and he unclenched his fist: "Understood."

chunks.chineseText:
第41章

相南里来的比较晚，刷卡上电梯的时候，竟然只有他一人。

他提着重重的保险箱，里面还装着老板的外骨骼。

二楼看台位置装修的有点粗糙，尽管有座位，老实坐下的观众却不多，大都站在围栏前，从上往下看。这看起来更像是斗兽场了。

主持人的声音从山崖两侧的扩音器里传来。

相南里一心找老板拿钱，再抬头时，竞技场的高清屏幕上，发言的人已经成了相晨曦：“我很荣幸，成为此次高等选拔赛的荣誉评委。”

他就坐在上方的评委席。

周围传来一阵欢呼声，极其热烈；相晨曦忍不住笑起来，然后抬起手臂，做出一个往下压的手势，四周立刻安静下来。

他的眉眼没什么攻击性，天然让人产生一种亲近感。因为热衷慈善活动，经常和苦修士一起去污染严重的地区送物资、免费医疗；深受地表人民喜爱。地底人倒是不怎么感冒。

周围人议论纷纷，相南里忍不住偷听了几段。

相晨曦是神庭教宗的养子，20年前在地表的某个小据点被教宗大人捡来的。他是相南里的后代；因为在和“超凡生物”的沟通上有着惊人的天赋，极有可能成为神庭未来的圣子。而且好像还为黑十字审判庭带回来不少黑科技……？

相南里听懂了：“原来是翻译官。”

不过，一想到自己连老婆都没有，却莫名其妙多了个后代，相南里很难不感到奇怪。

尤其是这个后代甚至比堂弟长得还要像他。

相南里喃喃：“黑十字审判庭，最好别打着我的名号招摇撞骗啊。”

他对这个组织印象极差，毕竟第一次见面就被天启骑士追杀。

相南里后来还查了人联的资料。里面说，神庭信仰的神祇没有一个具体的名字，只有一个模糊的“神”的代称。

人不可直呼其名，不可直视其身，去打扰神的安眠。它是生命、自然和宇宙的象征，迟早有天，神会复苏，挽救人世的苦难。

神庭还坚信灵魂永生与轮回，死亡是回到神的怀抱，而神会给他们安排更好的来生；这让他们在选择自我牺牲时极其坦然。

不管别人信不信，他们内部是坚信这一套说辞的；有些是揣着明白装糊涂，有些是真信。

毕竟对某些人来说，“科技”已经足够类似“神迹”了。

相晨曦发言三分钟，回到了贵宾室内。

相南里没有在狂热的人群里找到老板。倒是找到了假装成赛委会服务机器人，端着托盘偷偷卖兑水白酒的安德鲁。

他机械化程度高达99，竟然没有一个人怀疑。

“安德鲁？”相南里看着他的背影，试探性地叫了一声。

安德鲁紧张地回头：“啊啊，相、先生。你要来一杯吗？给您免费。”

安德鲁有四条机械手，此时，他的两只手正举着托盘，剩下两只手在托盘底下对手指。

相南里拿起一次性纸杯，握在手里打量了片刻：“这里不是没网吗？你怎么收款？一杯还要200信用点？”

安德鲁心虚地回答：“有票券，可以在监狱……呃，银行里兑。您知道的，我还有六十年房贷要还。”

监狱里的犯人显然没办法使用网络；所以这种信用票据，在监狱里是纸钞一样的硬通货。银行是不给普通人开的。

但在交通不便、经常坑蒙拐骗的地表，却有大量票据流通着。

相南里抿了口酒，辛辣的味道直冲鼻腔。

主持人的声音飘进他的耳朵：“本次高等生命选拔赛，采取了和过往都不一样的赛制！赛委会认为，随着时代发展，1v1已经不再是格斗比赛的主流。我们需要选手们拥有更强的生存能力！”

一排排大头照依次出现在屏幕上。

相南里一眼就看见了名单最后的“东皇”，建模脸就是帅得很突出。只是名字后面跟着的积分有点少，就1分。

“因此，赛委会临时决定，不再开设单独擂台，所有选手同时入场！采取无规则大乱斗模式，依然禁止使用武器。选手们按照复赛名次，对应不同积分，积分获得方法为累加制！

“譬如AB两名选手，A值8分，B值9分。A在本轮比赛只淘汰B，那么他的最终得分为17分。但B在此前淘汰了5分的C和D，那么B的最终得分为19分，排名高于A。

“比赛一共三十分钟，结束时，分数最高者获胜！另外，本次比赛的奖池再度翻倍！请看——”

两名工作人员扛着透明的保险柜走上主席台，里面装着各色基因药剂，在暖黄的灯光下反射出动人的色泽。

“这里全都是永生科技生产的正规基因药！稳定性高达99.7％。原来只能得一瓶，现在双倍送！感谢阴山城黑十字分部的大力支援！”

观众席上有人站出来，朝着主持咆哮道：“狗*的，你们搞什么？是想让我的选手都死在台上吗？”

“这么乱来，我看下一届还有谁报名？！”

奖励翻倍也没能压下他们的怒火。

有人想向自己的上级汇报，但很快遇到了问题：“怎么没信号？连电话都打不通！”

“说是暴雪导致云端网络失联？”

“我tm用的是卫星信号！”

当然，也不是所有人都有脑子和良心。不少人的目光已经完全被基因药所吸引，伸长了脖子直勾勾地看着。

相晨曦坐在贵宾室内，漫不经心地想着，只要奖池够大，还怕没人报名吗？

来这里参赛的，要么是游走在灰色地带的边缘人，身上还背着通缉令；要么是孤家寡人；要么就是雇佣来帮忙咬人的狗。

圣灵的消息不能泄露，他们本来就该死。正好死后魂归神国，争取来世投个好胎。

他会为这些人祈福的。

主持人接收到指令，对愤怒的围观者毫无反应，明知道不会有转播，他依然说道：“屏幕前的观众朋友们，你们还可以登录官网，为自己心仪的选手下注！今年冠军花落谁家，让我们拭目以待。现在，选手已就位。”

竞技场入口打开，一群选手从里面走了出来。

看得出来，他们也是才收到通知。不少人的表情还带着茫然。

“3、2、1，开始！”

东方青帝感觉到手腕上传来的奇怪触感。

那里绑着赛委会分发的“生命体征检测仪”，就在刚刚，一根细的像是蚊子口器的针探了出来，想往他的身体里注射什么。

可惜这根软针都歪了，也没能刺破他的皮肤，透明的微量药剂倒是喷了出来。

周围的选手们开始暴躁、发狂。面对明显有问题的规则，竟然没有一个人选择抗议和退赛，而是一拳痛击离自己最近的对手。

“咚——”

这名选手在猝不及防之下被砸到了脑门。

血从鼻腔涌出，滴在地面，以一种极其缓慢的速度渗透下去。

“我*！”他骂骂咧咧地从地上爬起来，立刻和刚才动手的人扭打起来。

这场比赛相当混乱。

里面的选手们显然打红了眼，很快就见了血。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 41

Xiang Nanli arrived relatively late. When he swiped his card to enter the elevator, he found himself entirely alone.

He was carrying a heavy safety deposit box, which still contained his boss’s exoskeleton.

The viewing platform on the second floor was rather crudely decorated. Although there were seats, few spectators actually sat down; most stood before the railings, looking down at the arena. It looked more like a beast-fighting pit than anything else.

The host’s voice boomed from the speakers on both sides of the cliff.

Xiang Nanli was focused on finding his boss to collect his payment. When he looked up again, the person speaking on the arena’s high-definition screen had changed to Xiang Chenxi: "I am honored to serve as an honorary judge for this Higher-Level Selection Tournament."

He was sitting in the judges' box above.

A wave of extremely enthusiastic cheering erupted from the crowd. Xiang Chenxi couldn't help but smile, then raised his arm and made a downward pressing gesture; the surroundings immediately fell silent.

His features were non-aggressive, naturally evoking a sense of intimacy. Because he was passionate about charity work and frequently accompanied ascetics to heavily polluted areas to deliver supplies and provide free medical care, he was deeply loved by the people on the surface. The subterranean dwellers, however, were not particularly impressed.

People around him were whispering, and Xiang Nanli couldn't help but eavesdrop on a few snippets.

Xiang Chenxi was the adopted son of the Divine Court’s Pope, picked up by the Pope at a small outpost on the surface 20 years ago. He was a descendant of Xiang Nanli. Because he possessed an astonishing talent for communicating with "transcendent creatures," he was highly likely to become the future Saint Son of the Divine Court. Moreover, he seemed to have brought back quite a bit of "black technology" for the Black Cross Inquisition...?

Xiang Nanli understood: "So, he's a translator."

However, the thought that he didn't even have a wife, yet had inexplicably acquired a descendant, made it hard for Xiang Nanli not to feel strange.

Especially since this descendant looked even more like him than his own cousin did.

Xiang Nanli muttered, "The Black Cross Inquisition had better not be using my name to swindle people."

He had a terrible impression of that organization; after all, he had been hunted by an Apocalypse Knight the very first time they met.

Xiang Nanli had later looked up information on the Human Alliance. It stated that the deity worshipped by the Divine Court had no specific name, only a vague title: "God."

One must not speak the name directly, nor look directly upon the body, lest they disturb the God’s slumber. It was a symbol of life, nature, and the universe. Sooner or later, God would awaken to save the world from its suffering.

The Divine Court also firmly believed in the immortality of the soul and reincarnation; death was merely a return to God’s embrace, and God would arrange a better afterlife for them. This made them extremely calm when choosing self-sacrifice.

Regardless of whether others believed it, they firmly believed in this narrative internally; some were playing dumb, while others truly believed.

After all, to some people, "technology" was already similar enough to "divine miracles."

After a three-minute speech, Xiang Chenxi returned to the VIP room.

Xiang Nanli didn't find his boss in the frenzied crowd. Instead, he found Andrew, who was disguised as a service robot for the tournament committee, carrying a tray and secretly selling watered-down white liquor.

His mechanization level was as high as 99%, and surprisingly, no one suspected a thing.

"Andrew?" Xiang Nanli looked at his back and called out tentatively.

Andrew turned around nervously: "Ah, ah, Mr. Xiang. Would you like a cup? It’s on the house."

Andrew had four mechanical arms. At this moment, two of his hands were holding the tray, while the remaining two were fidgeting underneath it.

Xiang Nanli picked up a disposable paper cup and examined it for a moment: "Isn't there no internet here? How do you collect payment? 200 credit points a cup?"

Andrew answered guiltily: "There are vouchers that can be redeemed in prison... uh, at the bank. You know, I still have sixty years of mortgage to pay off."

Prisoners obviously couldn't use the internet, so these credit vouchers were hard currency, like paper money, within the prison. Banks didn't open accounts for ordinary people.

But on the surface, where transportation was inconvenient and scams were frequent, a large number of these vouchers circulated.

Xiang Nanli took a sip of the liquor, the spicy taste rushing straight into his nasal cavity.

The host’s voice drifted into his ears: "This Higher-Level Life Selection Tournament has adopted a format different from any in the past! The committee believes that with the development of the era, 1v1 is no longer the mainstream of combat sports. We need our contestants to possess stronger survival capabilities!"

Rows of headshots appeared on the screen one by one.

Xiang Nanli spotted "Donghuang" at the end of the list at a glance; his modeled face was strikingly handsome. It was just that the points following his name were a bit low—only 1 point.

"Therefore, the committee has made a temporary decision: there will be no separate arenas. All contestants will enter at the same time! We are adopting a no-rules battle royale mode.
