Weapons are still prohibited. Contestants will receive points based on their ranking in the preliminary rounds, and the scoring method is cumulative!

"For example, take contestants A and B. A has 8 points, and B has 9. If A only eliminates B in this round, his final score is 17. But if B previously eliminated C and D, who were worth 5 points each, B’s final score would be 19, ranking higher than A.

"The match lasts for a total of thirty minutes. At the end, the person with the highest score wins! Additionally, the prize pool for this tournament has doubled again! Please look—"

Two staff members carried a transparent safety deposit box onto the podium. Inside were various gene serums, reflecting alluring colors under the warm yellow lights.

"These are all legitimate gene serums produced by Eternal Technology! The stability is as high as 99.7%. Originally, you could only win one bottle, but now we are giving away double! Thanks to the strong support from the Yinshan City Black Cross branch!"

Someone in the audience stood up and roared at the host: "You sons of b*tches, what are you doing? Are you trying to get all my contestants killed on stage?"

"If you act so recklessly, let's see who signs up for the next tournament!"

Even doubling the rewards couldn't suppress their anger.

Some wanted to report to their superiors, but they quickly encountered a problem: "Why is there no signal? I can't even make a phone call!"

"They say the blizzard caused the cloud network to go offline?"

"I'm using a satellite signal, damn it!"

Of course, not everyone had brains or a conscience. Many people’s gazes were already completely captivated by the gene serums, their necks stretched out as they stared fixedly.

Xiang Chenxi sat in the VIP room, thinking nonchalantly: As long as the prize pool is big enough, why worry about no one signing up?

Those who came here to compete were either fringe people walking in the gray areas with warrants on their heads, loners, or dogs hired to do the biting.

The news of the Holy Spirit could not be leaked; they were meant to die anyway. It was just as well that their souls would return to the Divine Kingdom after death, hopefully to be reborn into a better life.

He would pray for these people.

The host received instructions and ignored the angry onlookers. Knowing full well there would be no broadcast, he still said: "Friends in the audience in front of the screens, you can still log in to the official website to place bets on your favorite contestants! Let us wait and see who will take home the championship this year. Now, the contestants are in position."

The arena entrance opened, and a group of contestants walked out.

It was clear they had only just received the notification. Many of them still wore expressions of bewilderment.

"3, 2, 1, start!"

Dongfang Qingdi felt a strange sensation on his wrist.

Tied there was the "Vital Sign Detector" distributed by the committee. Just a moment ago, a needle as thin as a mosquito’s proboscis had emerged, trying to inject something into his body.

Unfortunately, the soft needle had bent and failed to pierce his skin, though a trace of transparent serum had sprayed out.

The surrounding contestants began to grow irritable and frantic. Faced with rules that were clearly problematic, not a single person chose to protest or withdraw; instead, they punched the opponent nearest to them.

"Thud—"

The contestant was caught off guard and struck in the forehead.

Blood gushed from his nasal cavity, dripping onto the ground and seeping in at an extremely slow pace.

"F*ck!" He cursed as he scrambled up from the ground and immediately began brawling with the person who had just attacked him.

The match was incredibly chaotic.

The contestants inside had clearly gone bloodthirsty, and blood was drawn very quickly.

chunks.chineseText:
第一名失去意识的选手被机器人裁判抬了下去。

……

……

安德鲁目瞪口呆：“这么做的目的是什么？赛委会不要转播费了？”

相南里蹙眉：“节省时间，可能也想多弄死几个人。”

[小青。你还好吧？]

[我没事。]

东方青帝在人群中穿梭着。他依然在不停地躲闪，每次出手时动作相当隐蔽。几乎看不见血，又能让人瞬间丧失行动力。

他和天狼星结成了同盟。看起来像是个捡便宜的。

天狼星双眼通红，他还没打开基因锁，但身体已经不正常地膨胀起来，肤色不一的皮肤下，深黑的血管格外明显，不停地喘着气。

被东方青帝淘汰的都是一些不起眼的小角色。

只是在蛊虫疯狂厮杀时，他的冷静未免有些过于刺眼。

相晨曦调取屏幕上的截图，朝沙利叶道：“这个人看起来还不错。”

沙利叶看了眼资料，淡淡道：“他是人造人。”

“那算了。”相晨曦顿时兴致怏怏。

神庭内部是有不少人造人的，但和人联采取的是完全不同的培育技术。

总之，对家制造的人造人，并不符合他们的需求。

沙利叶摸了摸下巴，他额间的第三只竖瞳紧闭，取而代之的是原本的眼睛。

但他的眼睛没有瞳仁，只有青灰色的眼白，看起来像是塑料球。

沙利叶很快闭上眼，重新打开了竖瞳：“倒是他旁边这个人还不错。我看见了，他的灵魂之火格外旺盛。”

相晨曦嗤笑着：“神神叨叨；骗骗地表那些愚民还行，别把自己也骗了。”

沙利叶并不反驳：“圣灵快孵化了，我先去地底守着。别乱跑。”

人没办法理解自己没见过的东西。

至少，在沙利叶的眼里，天狼星就是一团熊熊燃烧的青白色火焰，大补。

而相晨曦是朵莲花似的金色火焰，虽然不够旺盛，但纯度足够高，尝起来会很美味。

……

……

竞技场上的斗争已经到了白热化阶段，留在场上的选手也越来越少。

东方青帝算了一下分数，很确定自己掉不出前十，于是给天狼星使了个眼色。

他让天狼星把自己淘汰掉了。

为了看起来不那么扎眼，东方青帝还特地在地上滚了一圈，浑身都是别人的血。

被入侵的生命体征检测仪显示他正处于濒死状态。

眼疾手快的机器人（车型）上台，在人群中找到了他。

相南里看着东方青帝被机器人扛走，消失在自己的视线中，微微松了口气。

他询问：[小青，你还好吗？]

几分钟后，东方青帝的声音才传了回来：[这里信号有些弱。赛委会不当人，这些选手被带下去，直接从后台运到了地底喂蛇。我把视野和你同步一下。我正在前往地面，马上就好。等我。]

东方青帝直接在半路黑掉了运输机器人的系统，从密封的棺材里爬了出来。那玩意真的很像棺材。

他入侵小机器人几乎毫无难度，回到别人后台就像是回到家一样。

借着这台运输机器人，东方青帝看见了孵化室里的场景。

共享的画面只能看见运输机器人的视野，这台机器人安装的摄像头像素不太好，出来的画面是黑白两色。

的确，就像福音书说的那样，圣灵就快孵化了。黏糊糊的血肉从竞技场地板渗透到地下，经过提纯后滴在白色蛋壳的表面。蛋壳非常薄，能看见附着在蛋壳上的血丝，里面的怪物挣扎扭动着。

直径接近十五米的白蛋悬浮在血池里，这个池子就是它的羊水。里面能看见没消化干净的畸变体、异种。现在又多了选手们的尸体。

相南里数了数，入口处守着二十名黑甲骑士。

被操控的运输机器人继续往前。这台机器人来过很多次了，并没有引起其他人的警觉。

机器人背着空棺材，履带碾过地表，逐渐朝着圣灵靠近。

以它安装的武器，是不可能对圣灵造成伤害的。不过，东方青帝依然想试试。

“哒、哒、哒——”

入口处响起沉重的脚步声。

运输机器人在远程操控下转头，看向来人。

那是一尊高大的羊头人，外表诡异。透露出一股邪性。

“沙利叶大人。”

这群雕塑一样的天启骑士居然是会说话的。

下一秒，羊头人上前，一脚踩烂了运输机器人。

相南里的眼前失去影像，收音设备只捕捉到了沙利叶的最后一句话：“说过多少次了，不要相信任何机器！是过去的教训还不够吗？”
chunks.englishText:
The first contestant to lose consciousness was carried away by a robot referee.

...

...

Andrew was dumbfounded: "What is the purpose of doing this? Does the committee not want the broadcast fees?"

Xiang Nanli frowned: "To save time, and perhaps they also want to get a few more people killed."

[Xiao Qing. Are you alright?]

[I'm fine.]

Dongfang Qingdi wove through the crowd. He was still dodging constantly, his movements extremely subtle every time he struck. He barely left any blood, yet he could instantly incapacitate someone.

He had formed an alliance with Sirius. He looked like someone picking up scraps.

Sirius’s eyes were bloodshot. He hadn't opened his gene lock yet, but his body was swelling abnormally. Beneath his discolored skin, deep black blood vessels were particularly prominent, and he was panting incessantly.

Those eliminated by Dongfang Qingdi were all insignificant small-timers.

It was just that while the insects were fighting frantically, his calmness seemed a bit too glaring.

Xiang Chenxi pulled up a screenshot from the screen and said to Sariel: "This person looks pretty good."

Sariel glanced at the profile and said indifferently: "He is an artificial human."

"Never mind then." Xiang Chenxi immediately lost interest.

There were quite a few artificial humans within the Divine Court, but they used completely different cultivation techniques than the Human Alliance.

In short, artificial humans made by the opposition did not meet their requirements.

Sariel stroked his chin. The third vertical eye on his forehead was tightly closed, replaced by his original eyes.

But his eyes had no pupils, only grayish-white irises, looking like plastic balls.

Sariel quickly closed his eyes and reopened the vertical eye: "Actually, the person next to him is not bad. I saw it; his soul fire is exceptionally vigorous."

Xiang Chenxi sneered: "Mystical nonsense; it’s fine to fool those ignorant people on the surface, but don't fool yourself."

Sariel did not refute: "The Holy Spirit is about to hatch. I’m going to the underground to stand guard. Don't run around."

People could not understand things they had never seen.

At least, in Sariel’s eyes, Sirius was a raging cyan-white flame—a great tonic.

And Xiang Chenxi was a golden flame like a lotus; although not vigorous enough, its purity was high enough that it would taste delicious.

...

...

The struggle in the arena had reached a fever pitch, and the number of contestants remaining on the field was dwindling.

Dongfang Qingdi calculated the points and was certain he wouldn't fall out of the top ten, so he gave Sirius a look.

He had Sirius eliminate him.

To avoid being too conspicuous, Dongfang Qingdi specifically rolled on the ground, covering himself in other people's blood.

The compromised vital sign detector showed he was in a near-death state.

A quick-acting robot (vehicle type) entered the arena and found him among the crowd.

Xiang Nanli watched as Dongfang Qingdi was carried away by the robot and disappeared from his sight, feeling a slight sense of relief.

He asked: [Xiao Qing, are you okay?]

A few minutes later, Dongfang Qingdi’s voice returned: [The signal here is a bit weak. The committee is heartless; these contestants are taken down and transported directly to the underground to feed the snakes. I’ll synchronize my vision with yours. I’m heading to the surface, it’ll be ready soon. Wait for me.]

Dongfang Qingdi had hacked the transport robot’s system halfway there and crawled out of the sealed coffin. That thing really looked like a coffin.

Invading the small robot was almost effortless for him; returning to someone else’s backend was like returning home.

Through this transport robot, Dongfang Qingdi saw the scene in the incubation room.

The shared feed could only see the transport robot’s perspective. The camera installed on this robot didn't have great resolution, so the image was black and white.

Indeed, just as the Gospel said, the Holy Spirit was about to hatch. Sticky flesh and blood seeped from the arena floor into the underground, where it was purified and dripped onto the surface of a white eggshell. The shell was extremely thin; one could see blood vessels attached to it, and the monster inside was struggling and writhing.

The white egg, nearly fifteen meters in diameter, floated in a pool of blood; this pool was its amniotic fluid. Inside, one could see undigested aberrations and xenomorphs. Now, there were also the corpses of the contestants.

Xiang Nanli counted; twenty black-armored knights were guarding the entrance.

The controlled transport robot continued forward. This robot had been here many times and had not aroused anyone’s suspicion.

The robot carried the empty coffin, its tracks grinding over the ground as it gradually approached the Holy Spirit.

With the weapons it was equipped with, it was impossible to cause any damage to the Holy Spirit. However, Dongfang Qingdi still wanted to try.

"Clack, clack, clack—"

Heavy footsteps sounded at the entrance.

The transport robot turned its head under remote control to look at the newcomer.

It was a tall goat-headed man, his appearance eerie. He exuded a sense of evil.

"Lord Sariel."

These statue-like Apocalypse Knights could actually speak.

The next second, the goat-headed man stepped forward and crushed the transport robot with one foot.

The image disappeared from Xiang Nanli’s eyes, and the audio equipment only captured Sariel’s final words: "How many times have I said it? Do not trust any machines! Have the lessons of the past not been enough?"

chunks.chineseText:
第42章

天狼星喘息着，血顺着他的额角滑落，应该是咸的。

他有些看不清眼前的路，但依然能本能的感觉到对手的方位。

场上还剩三个人。除了他，剩下两人都当过之前的拳王。

“喂，要不我们先把这小子淘汰出去？”

是谁在说话呢？不重要。

刚烈的拳风带来破空之声，天狼星只能躲开一个。他感觉到自己胸口凹陷了下去，铁锈味充斥在他的喉间。

19岁那年，天狼星被俱乐部买了下来。城主说，他是进化失败的生化战士，如果俱乐部不嫌弃，可以20万带走。

莱因当然嫌弃，他是商人，是俱乐部买手。是来买好苗子的，不是找病死鬼。

19岁的天狼星瘦得像是竹竿，皮黏在骨架上，没有一点肉。他的身体压根禁不起打开基因锁的消耗，城主看起来也不想治好他。

莱因转身就要走，天狼星却牢牢地、牢牢地抓住了他的脚踝。

他匍匐着跪在地上，头叩在地面，天狼星说，你买我吧，我不会让你失望的。

天狼星很清楚，如果不是莱因买下他，他的下场应该是死亡。

他会被丢进池子里，溶解，成为怪物的基底液。

荒野上不养废物，一个生化战士而已，只要有人愿意源源不断的生孩子，总会有新的耗材。

莱因终归是地底人，他看着这样的天狼星，产生了那么一丝怜悯。

这成了他最正确的投资。

天狼星是他的代号，艺名；他从未说过自己原本的名字。

天狼星果然没让莱因失望。他排名越来越高，在地下拳击场的名气越来越大。他每年都为俱乐部带来可观的收入，但依然月薪五千。

靠着他，莱因从普通员工，晋升成俱乐部的总经理。

天狼星从来没提过加薪，唯一的要求是不想去参加高等生命选拔赛。

“那太危险了，我想活着。”天狼星说，“姑苏城我能应付，选拔赛不一定。”

不上班的时候，天狼星会在一楼喝酒。一般是下午三四点或者早上十点，酒吧还没有对外营业，他坐在吧台最里边的位置，只喝最便宜的“狼酒”。他说这个酒的味道和他在地表喝过的最相像。

酒吧的射灯会打在他斑驳的皮肤上。天狼星只喝半醉，怕醉后醒不来。他也害怕睡觉。

刚被带回地底时，天狼星能戒备一整夜。一点风声都能让他立马从浅眠中惊醒。直到几年后，他才能安心地在寝室睡到天亮。

天狼星不谈恋爱，不消费，甚至没有太多爱好；和那些劣迹斑斑的地下拳手截然不同。

他留在世界上的痕迹太浅了，简直像是随时准备好去死一样。

但这次选拔赛，竟然是天狼星主动要求参加的。

莱因问他为什么。天狼星靠在门边，抽着烟望向窗外，说：“我24岁了，莱因。”

生化战士很少活过25岁。

莱因和俱乐部官方都很感动，以为他是要在生命的最后关头，为俱乐部争夺出一个名次。

……当然不是这样。

“现在，比赛还差5分钟结束，但场上只剩下三位选手——可以看见，猿人和巨蟒达成了共识，想要一起淘汰掉天狼星。这匹黑马异军突起，能站到最后，想必观众们和我一样，也相当意外，不过，他的好运应该到此为止了。”主持人尽职地解说着。

天狼星寡不敌众，被一前一后夹在中间，坚硬的拳头砸在他身上，他动不了，像一个被固定住的沙包。人们几乎能听见他骨头碎裂的声音。

相比于其他身材健壮的选手，天狼星过于瘦弱了。他身高一米八，体重只有一百三十斤。身上的肌肉薄薄一层。比起拳击手，更适合他的职业应该是公司文员。

天狼星只剩一条胳膊露在外面，他死死地扣在前面人的胳膊上，似乎想把对手推开。

换来的是更用力的挤压。血和不知名的碎肉从两座肉山的缝隙中流出。

观众席一时之间竟然非常安静，竟然没人欢呼叫好。

台上的选手因为注射的药剂，成了不理智的怪物。

观众们亢奋过，可在亢奋后，依然意识到一件事：台上的选手，是和他们一样的人类。他们是同胞。同类。那是天狼星，也可以是在座的任何一位。

他正在被另外两个人虐杀。

“天狼星，天狼星！”站在观众席上的莱因嘶吼着，他的身体往前俯冲，被一旁的职工摁着，双脸通红，额头上青筋毕露，“别打了，下场！下场！我们退赛——安德鲁，相南里！你们站在那干什么！过来帮我啊！”

天狼星其实听到的，他的脚悬空，眼前一片血红，意识是前所未有的冷静，连听觉都敏锐了不少。

天狼星听见了莱因的呐喊，可他不能退出。

他已经24了。

【“你想复仇吗？”】

【“可惜，以你现在的水平，甚至都没资格见城主一面。”】

扣在猿人身上的手指骤然收紧，狠狠抓进他的肉里。

莱因啊。你知道我从小到大，见过多少死人吗？他们是我的亲人，玩伴。在我眼前一个个的，变成了怪物，我今年24岁。

再不回到这里，他要如何向永恒之城；向那个由制度、权力、贵族组成的、没有身体的庞然大物，复仇？

【“告诉你一个秘密，城主是神庭的教徒。而现在，你有两种方法杀死他。”】

【“第一，是在选拔赛的决赛上，杀死相晨曦，他会来观赛；只要沙利叶不在他身边。震怒的神庭不会放过他。”】

【“第二，是成为选拔赛的优胜者。这样，你也许可以成为‘圣灵’的实际操控者。这样，你就可以亲手撕碎他了。”】

血红色的肉块膨胀着，撕开了天狼星布满伤疤的皮肤。

“啊啊啊啊啊啊——”他咆哮着，感觉自己像是充气的皮球一样膨胀着。

原本比他高半截身体的男人需要他低头才能看见，两位拳王面露惊恐。

【“可惜，你两个都做不到。不过呢，我可以给你一个机会。”】

浑身鲜红的天狼星扑了上去，他现在起码有三米长，几乎要赶上小体型的畸变人。像头被剥皮的人型怪物。

他嘶吼着，咬下猿人的脸。

好饿，妈妈……好饿。

【“我可怜的小孩，你把一切过错归于城主。可城主也是奉命行事呀，错的不是他一个人，是自上而下的每一个人。”】

【“我是谁？”】

【“嗯，好问题。”操控着赛委会服务机器人的洛阳漫不经心地开口，递出手里的药剂，“记住，我叫福音书。”】

好饿……但我不能吃掉他们，这是不对的。

在一片寂静中，天狼星缓缓松口。

鲜血淋漓的猿人和巨蟒被急救机器人抬走。看起来毫无还手之力。

几秒后，主持人干巴巴的声音传来：“啊，看积分榜，最后获胜的……竟然是我们天狼星选手。让我们恭喜他——恭喜天狼星，恭喜搏击俱乐部！”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 42

Sirius panted, blood sliding down his forehead; it must have been salty.

His vision was blurring, but he could still instinctively sense the positions of his opponents.

There were three people left on the field. Besides him, the other two had both been former boxing champions.

"Hey, why don't we eliminate this kid first?"

Who was speaking? It didn't matter.

The fierce wind of a fist brought the sound of tearing air; Sirius could only dodge one. He felt his chest cave in, and the taste of rust flooded his throat.

At 19, Sirius had been bought by the club. The City Lord said he was an evolution-failed biochemical soldier, and if the club didn't mind, they could take him for 200,000.

Lein, of course, minded. He was a businessman, a club scout. He was here to buy good prospects, not to look for a dying ghost.

The 19-year-old Sirius was as thin as a bamboo pole, his skin clinging to his skeleton, not a shred of meat on him. His body couldn't withstand the consumption of opening a gene lock, and the City Lord didn't seem to want to cure him.

Lein turned to leave, but Sirius grabbed his ankle tightly, firmly.

He crawled on the ground, kowtowing, and said, "Buy me, I won't let you down."

Sirius knew very well that if Lein hadn't bought him, his fate would have been death.

He would have been thrown into the pool, dissolved, and become the base fluid for the monsters.

The wasteland didn't raise waste. A biochemical soldier was just that—as long as there were people willing to keep giving birth, there would always be new consumables.

Lein was, after all, a subterranean dweller. Looking at Sirius like that, he felt a sliver of pity.

This became his most correct investment.

Sirius was his codename, his stage name; he had never mentioned his original name.

Sirius certainly didn't let Lein down. His ranking climbed higher and higher, and his fame in the underground boxing ring grew. He brought the club considerable income every year, yet he still earned a monthly salary of five thousand.

Relying on him, Lein was promoted from an ordinary employee to the general manager of the club.

Sirius never mentioned a raise; his only request was that he didn't want to participate in the Higher-Level Life Selection Tournament.

"That’s too dangerous, I want to live," Sirius said. "I can handle Gusu City, but the selection tournament is not a certainty."

When he wasn't working, Sirius would drink on the first floor. Usually at three or four in the afternoon or ten in the morning, before the bar was open to the public. He would sit in the innermost seat at the bar, drinking only the cheapest "Wolf Liquor." He said the taste of this liquor was most similar to what he had drunk on the surface.

The bar’s spotlights would hit his mottled skin. Sirius only drank until he was half-drunk, afraid he wouldn't wake up if he passed out. He was also afraid of sleeping.

When he was first brought back to the underground, Sirius could stay on guard all night. The slightest sound would make him wake up instantly from a light sleep. It wasn't until years later that he could sleep peacefully in the dormitory until dawn.

Sirius didn't date, didn't spend money, and didn't even have many hobbies; he was completely different from those underground boxers with checkered pasts.

The traces he left on the world were too shallow, as if he were always ready to die.

But for this selection tournament, Sirius had actually requested to participate himself.

Lein asked him why. Sirius leaned against the door, smoking and looking out the window, and said, "I'm 24, Lein."

Biochemical soldiers rarely lived past 25.

Lein and the club officials were very moved, thinking he wanted to fight for a ranking for the club at the final moment of his life.

...Of course, that wasn't it.

"Now, there are 5 minutes left in the match, but only three contestants remain on the field—as you can see, the Ape-Man and the Giant Python have reached a consensus to eliminate Sirius together. This dark horse has risen abruptly; standing until the end, I’m sure the audience is as surprised as I am, but his luck should end here," the host narrated dutifully.

Sirius was outnumbered, caught between the two, and hard fists slammed into his body. He couldn't move, like a fixed punching bag. People could almost hear his bones shattering.

Compared to the other robust contestants, Sirius was too thin. He was 1.8 meters tall and weighed only 130 pounds. The muscle on his body was just a thin layer. Compared to a boxer, a more suitable profession for him would have been a corporate clerk.

Only one of Sirius’s arms remained exposed; he gripped the arm of the person in front of him tightly, as if trying to push his opponent away.

What he got in return was even more forceful squeezing. Blood and nameless fragments of flesh flowed from the gaps between the two mountains of meat.

The audience was surprisingly quiet for a moment; no one cheered or applauded.

Because of the injected serum, the contestants on stage had become irrational monsters.

The audience had been excited, but after the excitement, they realized one thing: the contestants on stage were human beings just like them. They were compatriots. Their own kind. That was Sirius, and it could be anyone sitting here.

He was being tortured to death by two other people.

"Sirius, Sirius!" Lein, standing in the audience, roared. His body lunged forward, held back by the staff beside him. His face was flushed red, and the veins on his forehead were bulging. "Stop fighting, get off! Get off! We withdraw from the tournament—Andrew, Xiang Nanli! What are you standing there for! Come help me!"

Sirius actually heard him. His feet were off the ground, his vision was blood-red, and his consciousness was calmer than ever before; even his hearing had become much sharper.

Sirius heard Lein’s shouts, but he couldn't withdraw.

He was already 24.

【"Do you want revenge?"】

【"Unfortunately, at your current level, you aren't even qualified to see the City Lord."】

The fingers hooked into the Ape-Man’s flesh tightened suddenly, digging deep into his muscle.

Lein, do you know how many dead people I’ve seen since I was a child? They were my family, my playmates. One by one, they turned into monsters before my eyes. I am 24 this year.

If he didn't return here, how could he take revenge on the Eternal City—that behemoth made of systems, power, and nobles, that entity without a body?

【"Let me tell you a secret: the City Lord is a believer of the Divine Court. And now, you have two ways to kill him."】

【"First, kill Xiang Chenxi in the finals of the selection tournament; he will come to watch the match—as long as Sariel is not by his side. The enraged Divine Court will not let him go."】

【"Second, become the winner of the selection tournament. This way, you might be able to become the actual controller of the 'Holy Spirit.' Then, you can tear him apart with your own hands."】

The blood-red flesh swelled, tearing through Sirius’s scar-covered skin.

"Ahhhhhhh—" he roared, feeling himself swelling like an inflatable ball.

The man who had been half a head taller than him now required him to look down to see him; the two boxing champions showed expressions of terror.

【"Unfortunately, you can't do either. However, I can give you a chance."】

Sirius, covered in fresh blood, pounced. He was at least three meters long now, almost catching up to the smaller aberrations. He looked like a skinned humanoid monster.

He roared and bit off the Ape-Man’s face.

So hungry, Mom... so hungry.

【"My poor child, you blame everything on the City Lord. But the City Lord is also just following orders. It’s not just him who is wrong; it’s everyone from the top down."】

【"Who am I?"】

【"Hmm, good question." Luoyang, who was controlling the tournament committee’s service robot, spoke nonchalantly, handing out the serum. "Remember, my name is Gospel."】

So hungry... but I can't eat them, that’s not right.

In the silence, Sirius slowly loosened his bite.

The blood-drenched Ape-Man and Giant Python were carried away by emergency robots. They looked completely incapacitated.

A few seconds later, the host’s dry voice came: "Ah, looking at the scoreboard, the final winner... is actually our contestant Sirius. Let us congratulate him—congratulations to Sirius, congratulations to the Fighting Club!"

chunks.chineseText:
相晨曦温柔的声音从前方传来：“天狼星选手，你还能站起来吗？到我这来，这是领奖台。”

相南里的手紧握着栏杆。他的眉头微微蹙起，那种不安的感觉，几乎达到巅峰。

之前赛委会为了决赛顺利进行，开飞机驱散过上空的云层。但现在，竟然又下雪了。

天狼星挪动着身体，一步一步朝着前方走进。他并没有恢复成人类的状态。和所有开启基因锁的生物改造人一样，一旦恢复人型，他会陷入意识清醒但无法行动的状态。

只差最后一点。天狼星不愿意在这种时刻倒下，全凭意志力强撑。

太好了，相晨曦就在眼前。沙利叶不在……但沙利叶是谁，天狼星其实也不清楚。

看着朝自己走来的肌肉怪物，相晨曦其实有些许的迟疑，不过，他并没有在天狼星的身上感觉到杀意。

如果沙利叶在就好了。相晨曦承认自己不可避免地这么想着。

但，他佩戴的自动防护机械装置，足够把天狼星射成筛子。

所以，相晨曦的脸上依然保持着微笑。

他看着即将走到面前的天狼星，举起了象征着冠军的花环，这其实是一个意识控制装置。

“只差最后一步。”

天狼星和相晨曦都在心中重复着同一句话。

下一秒，竞技场的灯光熄灭了。

大地剧烈颤抖起来——四周漆黑一片，乱石从山崖上滚滚落下。惨叫声响起，相南里的耳边全是噪音。

“相南里！”安德鲁抱住他的腰，大喊道，“小心！这边！”

他机械化程度极高，眼睛除了最基本的摄影功能，还有红外扫描功能，在这种时候比夜视好使。

地面朝着两边裂开，竞技场的罗马柱倾斜，山崖上的观众纷纷往地底坠落着。

安德鲁在喊他，东方青帝也在喊他。相南里几乎分不清谁在说话，周围全是叫喊和惊呼声。

“我真是！”

相南里咬牙切齿，趁着廊桥还没有坍到他这里，以最快的速度打开了保险箱。

他摸黑，凭着记忆和手感，把要交付给老板的外骨骼套在了自己身上。

对不起，老板。保命要紧。

之后你要是还活着，一定给你买套新的。

相南里还没用过外骨骼，顶多在维修时用传感器试了一下。

这是一套穿在上半身的套装，外骨骼在瞬间激活。

相南里听到了脑海里人工智能的声音：“外骨骼连接中……”

“机械契合度，100％。”

卧槽，竟然能直接用。

相南里以为自己还需要黑个使用权限呢！

脚下的地板坍塌，相南里抓住安德鲁的机械手，蜘蛛腿一样的外骨骼展开，金属义肢狠狠插入面前的峭壁中。

山上传来叫声：“喑——”

地底传来叫声：“吼吼——”

城外传来叫声：“喑喑喑——”

是以西结、圣灵和畸变体们。
chunks.englishText:
Xiang Chenxi’s gentle voice drifted from ahead: "Contestant Sirius, can you still stand? Come to me; this is the podium."

Xiang Nanli’s hand gripped the railing tightly. His brows furrowed slightly; the sense of unease he felt had reached its peak.

Earlier, to ensure the smooth progress of the finals, the competition committee had deployed aircraft to disperse the clouds above. Yet now, snow was falling once again.

Sirius moved his body, inching forward step by step. He did not revert to his human form. Like all bio-engineered humans who had unlocked their genetic locks, once he returned to human shape, he would fall into a state of conscious paralysis—awake, but unable to move.

Just a little further. Sirius refused to collapse at such a moment, relying entirely on sheer willpower to hold on.

Thank goodness, Xiang Chenxi was right there. Sariel wasn't around... though Sirius didn't actually know who Sariel was.

Watching the muscle-bound monster walking toward him, Xiang Chenxi felt a flicker of hesitation. However, he sensed no killing intent from Sirius.

*If only Sariel were here,* Xiang Chenxi admitted to himself, unable to stop the thought.

But the automated defensive mechanical device he wore was more than enough to turn Sirius into a sieve.

And so, a smile remained on Xiang Chenxi’s face.

He watched Sirius, who was about to reach him, and raised the wreath that symbolized the championship—which was, in reality, a mind-control device.

"Just one last step."

Both Sirius and Xiang Chenxi repeated the same sentence in their hearts.

The next second, the arena lights went out.

The earth trembled violently—the surroundings plunged into pitch-black darkness, and boulders came crashing down from the cliffs. Screams erupted; Xiang Nanli’s ears were filled with nothing but noise.

"Xiang Nanli!" Andrew grabbed his waist and shouted, "Watch out! This way!"

Andrew was highly mechanized; his eyes possessed not only basic photographic functions but also infrared scanning, which was far more useful than night vision in such a situation.

The ground split open on both sides, the Roman columns of the arena tilted, and the spectators on the cliffs tumbled into the abyss below.

Andrew was calling him, and Dongfang Qingdi was calling him too. Xiang Nanli could barely distinguish who was speaking; the air was thick with screams and gasps.

"Damn it!"

Xiang Nanli gritted his teeth. Taking advantage of the fact that the corridor bridge hadn't collapsed on him yet, he opened the safe at top speed.

Feeling around in the dark, relying on memory and touch, he donned the exoskeleton he was supposed to deliver to his boss.

*Sorry, Boss. Survival comes first.*

*If you’re still alive after this, I’ll definitely buy you a new one.*

Xiang Nanli had never used an exoskeleton before; at most, he had tested it with sensors during maintenance.

It was a suit worn on the upper body, and it activated in an instant.

Xiang Nanli heard the voice of the AI in his mind: "Exoskeleton connecting..."

"Mechanical synchronization: 100%."

*Holy crap, it actually works right out of the box.*

Xiang Nanli had assumed he would need to hack the usage permissions!

The floor beneath his feet collapsed. Xiang Nanli grabbed Andrew’s mechanical hand, and the spider-leg-like exoskeleton deployed, its metal limbs digging fiercely into the cliff face in front of them.

A cry came from the mountain: "Aaaah—"

A roar came from the depths: "Grrr—"

A screech came from outside the city: "Aaaah-aaah-aaah—"

It was Ezekiel, the Holy Spirits, and the Aberrants.

chunks.chineseText:
第43章

四周一片漆黑，不断有碎石从高处落下。

黑夜如同潮水把人们淹没。哀嚎声四起，有的远，有的近。还有重物落地的声音。但几乎没人听清其他人在说什么。

纤长的机械臂深深插进石块里，但相比于尖锐的金属刃，山石显得有些过于柔软。

相南里不断往下滑着，眼前闪过一串火星子。他们的双脚彻底悬空，机械臂成了唯一的着力点。

安德鲁的四条手臂紧紧抱住相南里的腰，哀嚎着：“呜呜呜啊啊啊救命！”

纯机械化的安德鲁身体和成年男性差不多，身体也老化地差不多了。

他要是摔下去，恐怕会碎成一堆零件。考虑到不止一个人会摔成了零件，想拼回完整的遗体，恐怕还是有点困难。

相南里没有回答，他眼前全是灰尘和碎土，呼吸都不太顺畅，让他张嘴未免太强人所难。

他抓住安德鲁的机械手，往上一提。

安德鲁小心翼翼地调整着自己的姿势，像是树袋熊一样，环住了相南里的脖子。

老板的机械外骨骼是佩戴式，主体像是一个巨大的金属肋骨，连接着四条蜘蛛腿一样的可收缩机械臂，连上神经传感线后，能够自动感知体型，扣在胸腔位置。另外还有两个臂环，作为装置的固定。

这套外骨骼叫做“探索者”，是永生科技旗下的产品。这是一套为适应极端地形而设计的辅助设备，最开始用于地底城市的人工勘测。

神经传感线通常连在后脖颈位置，新时代的人会在那里安装接入口，那是一种外观为圆形金属片的装置，能让外骨骼装备直接连接脑部神经。

有些人为了多连几个外骨骼，后脖颈上的圆片多的像是月球表面。

相南里并没有做过这种人体改造手术，设备的神经传感线被他缠绕在手腕上。为了防止数据线掉落，相南里还掏出口袋里的静电胶带多缠了两圈。

这种粗糙的连接方式换谁来都不该成功，简直是对多年来神经外骨骼科学的蔑视，可他偏偏就成功了，契合度还是百分之百。

这种感觉就像是……

实验室的菌子：空气湿度比昨天高0.01，我死了。

野外的菌子：生命会自己找到出路[奋斗][奋斗]

相南里并不清楚这件事的难度，他感觉到了庆幸。

幸好，幸好他只是死线战士，而不是拖到第二天；要不然现在就成了地上肉饼中的一块。

剧烈的震动足足持续了两分钟，可地面的轻颤绵延不绝。

相南里操控着机械臂，怀抱安德鲁，在峭壁上攀爬，像一只灵活的机械蜘蛛。

他在脑海里呼叫着东方青帝：[小青，你到哪儿了？]

没有回应。

相南里的唇角抿起。

相南里本来是想到地下看看情况，然而就在距离地面10米的距离，他嗅到一股极其浓烈的血腥味。

“相。相南里……”安德鲁的机械心脏砰砰直跳，“我扫描到下面有生命体，一大片。但我不知道是什么。”

原本的观众席是没有这么远的，是地底坍塌了。

相南里掏出防护服里的照明设备，打开手电筒，往下一看。那瞬间感觉到什么叫心率飙升，手脚发凉。

圆形的坑洞里，血色的巨蛇交缠着。它们像剥了皮的泥鳅，互相纠缠着、蠕动着。视觉冲击强烈。那些断裂的建筑被蛇躯覆盖着，像是沉入了沼泽中。

这哪里是竞技场，分明是怪物的巢穴。

光线让蛇群躁动起来。几条血红色的小蛇抬起头，嘶吼一声，朝相南里的位置飞扑而来。不过它们肌肉弹跳力有限，只扑出半米就跌回地面。

更多的蛇顺着石壁悄然往上攀爬。

相南里关掉手电，以最快的速度逃离地底，机械臂几乎搓出了火星子。

“轰隆——”

远处传来开火的声音，是城防武器启用了。

永恒之城，外城。

这里火光冲天，浓烟滚滚。许多只爬行者在雪地上，发出一阵愤怒的嘶吼。

不少爬行者的身体也染上火光，化学燃料沾在他们的皮肤上，爬行者怎么滚也没办法将火焰扑灭。

它们是从地底钻出来的。体型巨大的爬行者顶开龟裂的土地，从缝隙中钻出。如果可能，它们当然也想直接潜入内城，可惜内城是一座完整的金属堡垒。除了以西结，它们都只能从地表入侵。

爬行者的身体素质比普通生物强大许多，体表可以呼吸，只需要极低的含氧量就能维持生命体征。这些火焰虽然恼人，但还不足以让它们退却。

“喑——”爬行者嘶吼着往前。

以西结给它们的命令只有一个：攻城。

它们的智商听不懂太复杂的指令，更理解不了什么计谋。以西结说攻城，那就朝眼前的铜墙铁壁发动进攻就好。

爬上去，撕开一切阻拦，进入内城。

这是畸变体们唯一的目标，它们心无旁骛，都没有看脚边的人一眼。

可怜的是无辜的平民。浓烟摧毁了排气管道，躲在屋里的人不得不推开天窗，从地底钻出来。

他们的体格在爬行者面前不值一提，有些被直接踩死，更多人被燃烧的火焰烧死，而从城墙上射出的武器没有一刻停歇过。

永恒之城一共有7万人居住。

求生的本能让数以万计的农奴来到了主城区的城墙下，黑压压的，像一群蚂蚁。他们的衣服正好也是棕黑的颜色。还有少部分穿着官服，平时趾高气昂，自认为高人一等，但在此时，同样被拦在门外。

有些人忘记了往日的恐惧，愤怒地敲打着城门；有些跪在城下，重重磕头，希望有人大发慈悲。还有人靠在墙边，进行着无用的祷告。

畸变体正在靠近，地面随着它们的步伐颤动。

平民们说着永恒之城的官话。

但好笑的是，站在城上的大人物根本听不懂。

他们学的是人联语，顶多再懂一点神庭的禁文。

不仅是语言，这些农奴长得瘦小、丑陋，一看就知道营养不良。和城上白白净净的大人们像是两个物种。

城主就站在墙角的圆形塔楼内，穿着教廷的长袍，双手背在身后。他看着远方，没有看就在城角的他的子民。

无人机传回城内的景象，犹如炼狱，但城主的表情看不出丝毫动容。

城主的双眼是摄像头一样的义眼，镜片倒映出灼热的火光。

黑十字审判庭分三部分，元老院、骑士团和教廷。

城主来自教廷。作为组织的中层人员，他身上有着神庭推崇的特质：服从、冷静且不畏牺牲。

他身边的大臣裹着大氅，看起来是半夜才从温柔乡里爬起来，瑟缩道：“大人？这些爬行者好像要聪明一点？就像是有组织一样……”

爬行者们来到墙下，平民们哀嚎着跑开，把空位让给了这群怪物。

城墙光滑且坚硬。爬行者的爪子只能在表面留下浅浅的划痕，它们往往爬到一半就会跌落回去。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 43

The surroundings were pitch black, with debris constantly falling from above.

The night engulfed the people like a tide. Wails rose from all directions—some near, some far. There was also the sound of heavy objects hitting the ground. But almost no one could hear what anyone else was saying.

The slender mechanical arms were buried deep into the stone, but compared to the sharp metal blades, the mountain rock seemed far too soft.

Xiang Nanli kept sliding downward, a trail of sparks flashing before his eyes. Their feet were dangling completely in the air; the mechanical arms were their only point of leverage.

Andrew’s four arms clung tightly to Xiang Nanli’s waist, wailing, "Wuu-wuu-aaah-aaah, help me!"

The purely mechanical Andrew was about the size of an adult male, and his body was aging just as much.

If he fell, he would likely shatter into a pile of parts. Considering that more than one person would likely end up as scrap, reassembling a complete corpse would probably be quite difficult.

Xiang Nanli didn't answer. His vision was filled with dust and dirt, and his breathing was labored; asking him to open his mouth was too much to expect.

He grabbed Andrew’s mechanical hand and pulled him upward.

Andrew carefully adjusted his posture, clinging to Xiang Nanli’s neck like a koala.

The boss’s mechanical exoskeleton was a wearable unit. The main body resembled a massive metal ribcage connected to four retractable, spider-leg-like mechanical arms. Once the neural sensor wires were connected, it could automatically sense the wearer's physique and lock onto the chest cavity. There were also two armbands to secure the device.

This exoskeleton was called the "Explorer," a product under the Eternal Tech banner. It was an auxiliary device designed for extreme terrain, originally used for manual surveying in underground cities.

Neural sensor wires were usually connected at the nape of the neck. People of the new era would install an access port there—a circular metal disc that allowed exoskeleton equipment to connect directly to the brain's nerves.

Some people, wanting to connect multiple exoskeletons, had so many discs on the back of their necks that they looked like the surface of the moon.

Xiang Nanli had never undergone such body modification surgery, so he had wrapped the device’s neural sensor wires around his wrist. To prevent the data cable from falling off, he had even pulled out some anti-static tape from his pocket and wrapped it a few extra times.

This crude connection method shouldn't have worked for anyone; it was practically an insult to years of neural exoskeleton science. Yet, it worked perfectly, with a synchronization rate of one hundred percent.

It felt like...

Laboratory fungus: "The air humidity is 0.01 higher than yesterday; I'm dead."

Wild fungus: "Life will find a way [Strive][Strive]"

Xiang Nanli didn't realize the difficulty of this feat; he only felt relieved.

Thank goodness, thank goodness he was a "deadline warrior" and not someone who procrastinated until the next day; otherwise, he would have been just another piece of meat pancake on the ground.

The violent tremors lasted for a full two minutes, and the light quaking of the ground continued incessantly.

Xiang Nanli operated the mechanical arms, cradling Andrew, and climbed the cliff like an agile mechanical spider.

He called out to Dongfang Qingdi in his mind: [Xiao Qing, where are you?]

No response.

Xiang Nanli’s lips pressed into a thin line.

Xiang Nanli had originally intended to go underground to see the situation, but just ten meters from the ground, he caught a scent of extremely pungent blood.

"Xiang... Xiang Nanli..." Andrew’s mechanical heart was thumping wildly. "I’m scanning a large number of life forms below. But I don't know what they are."

The original spectator stands hadn't been this far away; the ground had collapsed.

Xiang Nanli took out the lighting equipment from his protective suit, clicked on the flashlight, and looked down. In that instant, he felt his heart rate skyrocket and his hands and feet turn cold.

In the circular pit, blood-red giant snakes were intertwined. They looked like skinned loaches, writhing and tangling with one another. The visual impact was intense. The broken structures were covered by the snake bodies, as if they had sunk into a swamp.

This was no arena; it was clearly a monster’s nest.

The light agitated the snake swarm. Several small, blood-red snakes raised their heads, hissed, and lunged toward Xiang Nanli’s position. However, their muscular leaping power was limited, and they fell back to the ground after jumping only half a meter.

More snakes began to silently climb up the stone wall.

Xiang Nanli turned off the flashlight and fled the underground area as fast as he could, the mechanical arms practically sparking with friction.

"Boom—"

The sound of gunfire came from afar; the city defense weapons had been activated.

Eternal City, Outer City.

The sky here was filled with fire and rolling smoke. Many Crawlers were on the snow, letting out angry hisses.

Quite a few Crawlers were also stained with flames; the chemical fuel clung to their skin, and no matter how they rolled, they couldn't extinguish the fire.

They had crawled out from underground. The massive Crawlers pushed aside the cracked earth and emerged from the fissures. If possible, they would have loved to sneak directly into the Inner City, but the Inner City was a complete metal fortress. Except for Ezekiel, they could only invade from the surface.

The Crawlers’ physical constitution was far superior to ordinary creatures; they could breathe through their skin and required very little oxygen to maintain vital signs. These flames, while annoying, were not enough to make them retreat.

"Aaaah—" The Crawlers hissed as they charged forward.

Ezekiel had given them only one order: Attack the city.

Their intelligence couldn't comprehend complex instructions, let alone understand strategy. If Ezekiel said attack the city, then they would just launch an assault on the copper walls and iron bastions before them.

Climb up, tear apart everything that blocked their way, and enter the Inner City.

This was the only goal of the Aberrants. They were single-minded, not even glancing at the people at their feet.

The poor, innocent civilians were the victims. The thick smoke destroyed the ventilation ducts, and those hiding in their homes had to push open skylights and crawl out from underground.

Their physiques were insignificant before the Crawlers. Some were trampled to death instantly, more were burned to death by the raging flames, and the weapons firing from the city walls never ceased for a moment.

Eternal City had a population of 70,000.

The instinct for survival drove tens of thousands of serfs to the walls of the main city district, a black mass like a swarm of ants. Their clothes happened to be brown and black, matching the color of the earth. There were also a small number of people in official robes who, usually arrogant and considering themselves superior, were now equally blocked outside the gates.

Some forgot their past fears and pounded on the city gates in anger; others knelt at the foot of the wall, kowtowing heavily, hoping someone would show mercy. Still others leaned against the wall, offering useless prayers.

The Aberrants were approaching, and the ground trembled with their footsteps.

The civilians spoke the official language of Eternal City.

But ironically, the big shots standing on the walls couldn't understand them at all.

They had learned the Human Alliance language, and at most, a little bit of the forbidden texts of the Divine Court.

It wasn't just the language; these serfs looked thin, ugly, and obviously malnourished. They seemed like a different species compared to the clean, well-fed masters on the walls.

The City Lord stood in a circular tower at the corner of the wall, wearing the robes of the Holy See, his hands behind his back. He looked into the distance, not looking at his own people at the corner of the wall.

Drones transmitted the scene inside the city—it was like purgatory—but the City Lord’s expression showed no sign of being moved.

The City Lord’s eyes were prosthetic, like camera lenses, and the firelight reflected in his pupils.

The Black Cross Inquisition was divided into three parts: the Senate, the Knights, and the Holy See.

The City Lord came from the Holy See. As a mid-level member of the organization, he possessed the traits championed by the Divine Court: obedience, calmness, and a lack of fear of sacrifice.

The minister beside him, wrapped in a heavy cloak—looking as if he had just crawled out of a bed of luxury in the middle of the night—shivered and said, "My Lord? These Crawlers seem a bit smarter? As if they have some organization..."

The Crawlers reached the foot of the wall, and the civilians wailed and ran away, leaving the space to the monsters.

The city wall was smooth and hard. The Crawlers’ claws could only leave shallow scratches on the surface, and they often fell back down halfway up.

chunks.chineseText:
一名长约8米的爬行者愤怒嚎叫，它抓起燃烧的砖瓦，往城墙内投掷。其他怪物顿时模仿起它的操作。

这群爬行者的确比普通的怪物聪明，它们竟然学会了使用工具。

以西结功不可没。

城防系统识别到威胁，射出拦截网。压缩的网面在半空铺开成一片圆形。

城主是个冷峻的中年男人，他的两眼倒映着熊熊的火光：“不重要，我们的任务是拦下它们。不能打扰到圣灵的出生和融合。沙利叶大人呢，还没传来消息吗？”

“大、大人说，马上。让我们再拖延一段时间。”大臣脸上露出谄媚的笑容。

城主沉思片刻，继续道：“先停止防空拦截系统，太浪费了。”

这些砖瓦虽然有一定的威胁，但伤害力有限。

“是。”

城主继续道：“竞技场那边的情况呢？”

大臣的手交叠在身前，十根手指上的十二枚宝石戒指闪闪发光：“圣灵的伴生物已经孵化出来了，它们孵化时引发地震，我们失去相晨曦大人的信号。”

大臣故意省略了一些重点。

比如他就很难解释为什么竞技场会从上方开始坍塌。他的属下去看过了，那里空无一人，监控里也没找到什么生物证据。想来是年久失修，疏于防范。

但这种锅明显会甩到他头上的事，大臣就不太想提。

竞技场本来就很久没有启用了；是相晨曦非要嫌外面的场地不够气派，也不方便保密，这才挪到城内。

反正结果都是一样的，过程不重要。以后有需要再调查吧……

说到“相晨曦”三个字，城主不由得蹙起眉头。

“沙利叶大人不会让他有事的。真出问题，现在赶过去也来不及了；我们离山顶可有五六公里。不能自乱阵脚，严防死守，不能让一只畸变体冲入内城。”

说完，城主不动声色地拨弄了一下手中紧握的金属物。这是福音书的启动钥匙。

……

……

相南里艰难地从山崖边爬了上来。他的双臂发麻，背后的机械臂伸直，收缩，折叠回背后的收纳包。

从竞技场倒塌到现在，只过去了不到十分钟。

相南里看见山脚处刺眼的火光。还有化学物燃烧的味道，很刺鼻，幸好他还带着防护面罩。

安德鲁的双脚重新落回地面，魂不守舍：“到底怎么回事？天狼星呢？莱因呢？还有，东、东皇呢？”

他的脸上没有微笑之外的表情，语气却透露出茫然。

莱因多半凶多吉少，大概率成了蛇饲料。

天狼星和相晨曦一起坠入地底。

小青失联了，多半还在地下。沙利叶和圣灵也在地下，也不知道小青状态如何。

“外面有畸变人的声音，多半是畸变人在攻城。先找个安全的地方观察一下形势，我需要更多信息才能判断……”

相南里一边往前走，一边说着；但声音骤然停顿。

有人型生物从路边走了过来，挡在了他的正前方。

相南里回溯了自己的记忆，骤然意识到，对方其实一直都在，只是一直没人察觉到它。直到它行动起来。

是以西结。

到底该用它还是他来形容？

他的皮肤是粉红色的，五官还在形成中。四肢的比例过于纤长，身上竟然很人性化地穿了件制服。

相南里往后退了半步，身后的机械臂展开。毫无疑问，这是一个警戒的状态。

以西结歪了一下头，指了指自己身上的衣服：“好看吗？从刚刚那个人身上扒下来的。”

只是扒的时候不太小心。

连着表面那层皮一起扒下来了，血腥味稍微重了点。

倒霉蛋是大臣派来搜查的城防官。刚汇报完工作，就遭遇了不测。

相南里深吸一口气，笑容浮现在了他的脸上：“好久不见，以西结。”
chunks.englishText:
An eight-meter-long Crawler howled in anger, grabbed burning bricks and tiles, and hurled them inside the city walls. The other monsters immediately imitated its actions.

This group of Crawlers was indeed smarter than ordinary monsters; they had actually learned to use tools.

Ezekiel deserved the credit for that.

The city defense system identified the threat and fired an interception net. The compressed mesh spread out in mid-air into a circular barrier.

The City Lord was a cold, middle-aged man, the raging fire reflected in his eyes: "It doesn't matter. Our mission is to stop them. We cannot disturb the birth and fusion of the Holy Spirit. What about Lord Sariel? Has there been no news yet?"

"M-my Lord says, soon. He asks us to stall for a little longer." A sycophantic smile appeared on the minister’s face.

The City Lord pondered for a moment and continued: "Stop the anti-aircraft interception system first; it’s too wasteful."

While these bricks and tiles posed a certain threat, their damage was limited.

"Yes."

The City Lord continued: "What about the situation at the arena?"

The minister’s hands were folded in front of him, the twelve gemstone rings on his ten fingers sparkling: "The Holy Spirit’s companion organisms have hatched. The earthquake caused by their hatching made us lose the signal for Lord Xiang Chenxi."

The minister deliberately omitted some key points.

For instance, he would find it hard to explain why the arena had started collapsing from the top down. His subordinates had gone to check; the place was empty, and no biological evidence had been found on the surveillance footage. He figured it was just due to years of disrepair and lack of maintenance.

But since such a blunder would clearly be blamed on him, the minister didn't want to mention it.

The arena hadn't been used for a long time anyway; it was Xiang Chenxi who had insisted that the outdoor venue wasn't grand enough and wasn't convenient for maintaining secrecy, which was why it had been moved inside the city.

Regardless, the result was the same, and the process didn't matter. He could investigate if needed later...

At the mention of the name "Xiang Chenxi," the City Lord couldn't help but frown.

"Lord Sariel won't let anything happen to him. If there really is a problem, it’s too late to rush over now; we are five or six kilometers away from the mountain peak. We cannot lose our composure. Defend strictly; do not let a single Aberrant break into the Inner City."

After saying this, the City Lord calmly fiddled with the metal object gripped in his hand. It was the activation key for the Gospel.

...

...

Xiang Nanli climbed up from the edge of the cliff with great difficulty. His arms were numb, and the mechanical arms on his back straightened, retracted, and folded back into the storage pack.

Less than ten minutes had passed since the arena collapsed.

Xiang Nanli saw the blinding firelight at the foot of the mountain. There was also the pungent smell of burning chemicals; fortunately, he was still wearing his protective mask.

Andrew’s feet touched the ground again, his mind clearly elsewhere: "What on earth is going on? Where is Sirius? Where is Rhine? And, where is... the Eastern Emperor?"

His face held no expression other than his smile, but his tone revealed his bewilderment.

Rhine was likely doomed; he had probably become snake feed.

Sirius and Xiang Chenxi had fallen into the underground together.

Xiao Qing was out of contact, likely still underground. Sariel and the Holy Spirit were also underground, and he had no idea what state Xiao Qing was in.

"There are sounds of Aberrants outside; they are likely attacking the city. Let’s find a safe place to observe the situation first. I need more information to judge..."

Xiang Nanli said as he walked forward, but his voice stopped abruptly.

A humanoid creature walked over from the side of the road, blocking his path.

Xiang Nanli retraced his memories and suddenly realized that the entity had actually been there the whole time, but no one had noticed it. Not until it started moving.

It was Ezekiel.

Should he describe it as "it" or "he"?

Its skin was pink, and its facial features were still forming. Its limbs were disproportionately long, and it was wearing a uniform in a strangely human-like manner.

Xiang Nanli took a half-step back, and the mechanical arms behind him deployed. Without a doubt, this was a state of high alert.

Ezekiel tilted its head and pointed to the clothes on its body: "Do they look good? I peeled them off that person just now."

It was just a bit careless when peeling them off.

It had peeled off the layer of skin along with the clothes, so the smell of blood was a bit heavy.

The unlucky fellow was a city defense officer sent by the minister to investigate. He had just finished reporting his work when he met with misfortune.

Xiang Nanli took a deep breath, and a smile appeared on his face: "Long time no see, Ezekiel."

chunks.chineseText:
第44章

以西结饶有兴趣地盯着他：“你知道我的名字？”

相南里回答：“新闻里有写。”

“噢，那其实是研究员给我取的名字，我并不喜欢。”以西结慢吞吞地回答，“不过，就叫我以西结吧。毕竟人类需要一个名字来称呼我。”

相南里还没什么反应，背后突然传来“哐当”一声巨响。

原来是安德鲁正在偷偷开溜，不小心被路边的碎石绊倒了。

卧槽！刚刚还在同舟共济患难与共，现在遇到危险就独自逃生是吧！

黑心医生果然还是熟悉的配方，早知道刚才就该把他踹蛇堆里。

相南里感觉后槽牙有点痒，但依然维持了表面的风度：“很高兴能再次看见你，我的朋友。你是刚好路过吗？你看上去还有正事要忙，我就不打扰你了。”

说完，他往外挪了一小步，让开一条道路。

相南里接受过培训，培训的老师说，面对歹徒最好的办法是保持冷静，不卑不亢。当然，这只能提高一点点生存几率……如果对方非要杀你，而你又打不过，那也是没办法的事。

冷静说起来简单，但很少有人可以做到；因为在面对危险时保持冷静是反人性的，身体的本能在督促你战斗或者逃跑。

相南里感觉到腥热的风迎面而来，那是新鲜血液的味道。

他下意识闭上眼，睫毛颤了颤，隔了两三秒才想起自己可以呼吸。

相南里睁眼，以西结光秃秃的脸就在他跟前。他甚至能看见对方脸上鳞状的皮肤。

他总感觉以西结下一秒就会吐出蛇信子。

以西结接近脸颊的位置张开两条缝，狭长的黑色眼珠暴露在空气中。

他故意凑近了一点，脸几乎要碰到相南里的鼻尖：“害怕我？”

相南里认真打量了片刻，由衷道：“其实还好。”

他比较喜欢机器人。这种兼具力量与科技的金属造物简直是工业美学的极致享受，相南里曾经坚信机械化是碳基生命最终的归宿。

但其他类型的人外也不是不能接受……以西结丑是丑了点，比不上他的机械爬行者同事，但万一人家还能再长呢？

以西结：“……”

他意兴阑珊地退了回去。

一个塑料口袋朝着相南里丢了过去，他下意识地接住，感觉手里的东西沉甸甸的。

以西结的声音远远传来：“是，我现在有别的事需要处理，不过我可不是路过。我不喜欢欠人情，这个拿去。城里很危险。我的畸变人不会伤人，你们可以从城门位置离开。嗯~你知道怎么打开城门吗？在城墙西北处的哨塔里，里面有控制器。”

以西结的脸上露出了诡异的笑，像是熊孩子完成了一次恶作剧。

他略微停顿了半秒：“下次见面，我们就是陌生人了，相南里。”

以西结消失在原地，他得赶紧去地底。

那里有他需要的东西。

以西结没看过什么科学文献，他不知道那是什么玩意，他暂且称之为“进化石”。早在半个月前，以西结就感应到了它。他毕竟是真正的“生物”，在感知这方面，其实比东方青帝敏锐很多。

东方青帝或许会把它叫作“生物能源”。

对于大多数人来说，神庭的“圣灵”是一种恐怖的生化怪物。但在东方青帝和以西结的眼里，那只是会动的石油。

潜行者想隐蔽自己时，无论是肉眼还是电子扫描，都很难察觉到。

相南里感觉到那股阴冷的压力骤然减退。

手里的塑料袋看起来有点潦草，相南里打开，然后看见了一大片叠起来的皮甲，质感像猪皮。

他拿起，摊开，抖了抖。皮肤上覆盖着一层层瓶盖大小的鳞片。

“这是什么玩意？”相南里的心情充满疑惑。

小智障：[猜您想找：潜行者的皮蜕。]

[潜行者的皮蜕：一种特殊的生物光隐材料，具有较强的延展性；能在一定程度上屏蔽电子眼扫描、模糊他人感知。但突然运动及长时间与侦察者处于同一空间，都有可能令皮蜕失效。]

[因潜行者濒临灭绝，该材料属于违禁品，不在市场流通。]

[另：该物品的使用效果会随着生物活性的降低而减弱，属于消耗品。]

相南里颇为意外：“小智，你竟然还能用？！”

[您好，我只是没有网络，不是故障了。]

相南里把东西打包，挎在了胸前，思考片刻，还是来到路边，朝背后的石头喊了一声：“安德鲁。”

虽然刚才安德鲁跑路速度快得令人生气，但好在相南里本来就对他没什么期待。或者说，他对所有人都没有什么期待。

起码安德鲁只是单纯的跑路，而不是推他一把再跑。

一台身高不到一米六的机器人从石头背后探出头来：“以西结走了吗？”

以西结三个字，安德鲁说的很轻。像是怕把人召回来一样。

相南里：“嗯。他说他养的爬行者不会伤害人类，让我们从城门出去。走吧。”

安德鲁精神恍惚地跟在他身后，垂头丧气的。

下山的路走了一半，他才猛然惊醒：“东方青帝呢？还有天狼星他们。”

“地底吧。”相南里思考着，“还没有收到信号。我们去城外等吧，如果他没事，会来找我的。”

安德鲁欲言又止：“可是……”

“你是觉得我该担心吗？”相南里转头，朝着他笑了笑，“其实我是有些担心的，如果小青出事，我应该会难过，我不知道……”

他的脸上多了些茫然：“他是接触的第一个装载了拟人模块的人工智能。按照人联法律，我可以把他当人看待。小青比我们强很多，他解决不了的困难，我们去了也是白搭。我安全的活着，就是帮忙了。

“至于天狼星选手。他很可怜，我有些同情，但我救不了他。”

安德鲁知道他说的是事实，但心脏依然很沉很沉地下坠着。

“我刚才不是想逃跑。”安德鲁磕磕绊绊地为自己辩解，“我和以西结认识，害怕他发现我。”

事实证明，安德鲁想太多。以西结认识的，是那个完整的安德鲁。而不是现在这个机器人。

安德鲁会躲起来，甚至不是怕死。他只是害怕以西结的质问，还有那双失望的眼睛。

相南里眯起眼：“以西结可是最近才从地下工厂逃出来的。”

“是，当年，我就职于东皇重工。是专门负责生物进化研究的学者。我毕业于人联最好的大学，博士学历。还没毕业就签订了终生雇佣合同。”谈起当年的辉煌，安德鲁的脸上却没有丝毫喜悦，“那时候人联已经和智械宣战。你知道的，人在集体的状态下，会丧失理智的判断。我们做了很多违背伦理道德的实验。因此，在事情暴露后受到制裁。”

安德鲁陷入了痛苦的回忆中，因为心情激动，他体内电压飙升。可尘封多年的秘密有了倾听者。他又很难不感觉到解脱。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 44

Ezekiel stared at him with interest. "You know my name?"

Xiang Nanli replied, "It was in the news."

"Oh, that was actually a name given to me by the researchers; I don't particularly like it," Ezekiel answered slowly. "However, just call me Ezekiel. After all, humans need a name to address me by."

Before Xiang Nanli could react, a loud "clatter" suddenly erupted behind him.

It turned out that Andrew had been trying to sneak away and had accidentally tripped over some loose gravel on the roadside.

*Damn it!* We were just in the same boat, weathering the storm together, and now that danger has arrived, you're trying to escape on your own?

The black-hearted doctor was true to his familiar form. If he had known, he should have kicked him into the snake pit earlier.

Xiang Nanli felt his molars ache, but he maintained his outward composure. "I'm glad to see you again, my friend. Were you just passing by? You look like you have important business to attend to, so I won't disturb you."

With that, he stepped aside slightly to clear a path.

Xiang Nanli had undergone training, and his instructor had said that the best way to deal with a criminal was to remain calm and neither humble nor pushy. Of course, this only increased one's survival chances by a tiny margin... if the other party was determined to kill you and you couldn't fight back, there was nothing to be done.

Staying calm sounds simple, but few can actually do it; because remaining calm in the face of danger is counter-intuitive—your body's instincts urge you to either fight or flee.

Xiang Nanli felt a fishy, hot wind blowing toward him; it was the scent of fresh blood.

He closed his eyes instinctively, his eyelashes trembling. It took two or three seconds before he remembered he could breathe.

Xiang Nanli opened his eyes, and Ezekiel’s bald face was right in front of him. He could even see the scale-like skin on the man's face.

He had a nagging feeling that Ezekiel would flick out a snake-like tongue at any second.

Two slits opened near Ezekiel's cheeks, exposing long, narrow black pupils to the air.

He leaned in deliberately, his face nearly touching the tip of Xiang Nanli's nose. "Afraid of me?"

Xiang Nanli examined him carefully for a moment and said sincerely, "Actually, not really."

He preferred robots. Such metallic creations, combining power and technology, were the ultimate enjoyment of industrial aesthetics. Xiang Nanli had once firmly believed that mechanization was the final destination for carbon-based life.

But other types of non-human entities weren't entirely unacceptable... Ezekiel might be a bit ugly compared to his mechanical crawler colleagues, but what if he could still grow into something better?

Ezekiel: "..."

He retreated, looking disinterested.

A plastic bag was tossed toward Xiang Nanli. He caught it instinctively, feeling the heavy weight of the contents.

Ezekiel’s voice drifted from afar: "Yes, I have other matters to attend to now, but I wasn't just passing by. I don't like owing favors, so take this. The city is dangerous. My aberrants won't hurt people; you can leave through the city gate. Hmm~ do you know how to open the city gate? There's a controller inside the watchtower on the northwest side of the wall."

A strange smile appeared on Ezekiel's face, like a mischievous child who had just pulled off a prank.

He paused for half a second. "Next time we meet, we will be strangers, Xiang Nanli."

Ezekiel vanished from the spot; he needed to get underground quickly.

There was something he needed there.

Ezekiel hadn't read any scientific literature; he didn't know what it was, so he tentatively called it an "Evolution Stone." Half a month ago, Ezekiel had sensed it. After all, he was a true "biological" entity, and in terms of perception, he was actually much sharper than the Eastern Azure Emperor.

The Eastern Azure Emperor might call it "bio-energy."

To most people, the "Holy Spirit" of the God’s Court was a terrifying biochemical monster. But in the eyes of the Eastern Azure Emperor and Ezekiel, it was just liquid oil that could move.

When a Prowler wanted to conceal itself, it was difficult to detect, whether by the naked eye or electronic scanning.

Xiang Nanli felt the cold, oppressive pressure suddenly recede.

The plastic bag in his hand looked a bit sloppy. Xiang Nanli opened it and saw a large pile of folded leather armor, with a texture like pigskin.

He picked it up, unfolded it, and gave it a shake. The skin was covered in layers of scales the size of bottle caps.

"What on earth is this?" Xiang Nanli felt puzzled.

Little Idiot: [Guess you are looking for: Prowler's Molted Skin.]

[Prowler's Molted Skin: A special bio-optical stealth material with high elasticity; it can, to a certain extent, block electronic eye scans and blur the perception of others. However, sudden movement or prolonged presence in the same space as a scout may cause the skin to lose its effectiveness.]

[Because Prowlers are near extinction, this material is considered contraband and does not circulate on the market.]

[Note: The effectiveness of this item diminishes as its biological activity decreases; it is a consumable.]

Xiang Nanli was quite surprised. "Little Zhi, you can actually still function?!"

[Hello, I just don't have a network connection; I am not malfunctioning.]

Xiang Nanli packed the items and slung them over his chest. After thinking for a moment, he walked to the side of the road and called out to the rock behind him: "Andrew."

Although Andrew's speed in running away earlier was infuriating, fortunately, Xiang Nanli hadn't expected much from him in the first place. Or rather, he didn't expect much from anyone.

At least Andrew had simply run away, rather than pushing him down before fleeing.

A robot less than 1.6 meters tall poked its head out from behind the rock. "Has Ezekiel left?"

Andrew said the name "Ezekiel" very softly, as if afraid of summoning him back.

Xiang Nanli: "Yes. He said the crawlers he keeps won't harm humans and told us to leave through the city gate. Let's go."

Andrew followed him, looking dazed and dejected.

They were halfway down the mountain when he suddenly snapped out of it. "What about the Eastern Azure Emperor? And Sirius and the others?"

"Underground, probably," Xiang Nanli mused. "I haven't received a signal yet. Let's wait outside the city; if he's okay, he'll come find me."

Andrew hesitated, wanting to say something. "But..."

"Do you think I should be worried?" Xiang Nanli turned and smiled at him. "Actually, I am a little worried. If Xiao Qing gets into trouble, I suppose I would feel sad. I don't know..."

A look of confusion crossed his face. "He is the first AI I've encountered that has an anthropomorphic module installed. According to Human Alliance law, I can treat him as a person. Xiao Qing is much stronger than us; if he can't solve a problem, our going there would be useless. Me staying alive and safe is the best way to help.

"As for the contestant Sirius. He is pitiful, and I sympathize with him, but I cannot save him."

Andrew knew he was speaking the truth, but his heart still sank heavily.

"I wasn't trying to run away earlier," Andrew stammered, defending himself. "I know Ezekiel, and I was afraid he would recognize me."

As it turned out, Andrew was overthinking it. The Ezekiel he knew was the one who remembered the "complete" Andrew, not the robot he was now.

Andrew hid not even out of fear of death. He was simply afraid of Ezekiel's questioning and those eyes filled with disappointment.

Xiang Nanli narrowed his eyes. "Ezekiel only escaped from the underground factory recently."

"Yes. Back then, I worked at Donghuang Heavy Industries. I was a scholar specializing in biological evolution research. I graduated from the best university in the Human Alliance with a doctorate. I signed a lifetime employment contract before I even graduated." Speaking of his past glory, there was no joy on Andrew's face. "At that time, the Human Alliance had already declared war on the Machina. You know, when people are in a collective state, they lose rational judgment. We conducted many experiments that violated ethics and morals. Consequently, we faced sanctions after the truth was exposed."

Andrew fell into painful memories. Because of his agitation, the voltage in his body spiked. But having someone to listen to the secrets buried for years, he couldn't help but feel a sense of relief.

chunks.chineseText:
“最核心的研发组在其他城市开会，一部分人被直接逮捕；另一部分离开人联，投靠了当时还很弱势的黑十字审判庭。我是唯一的特例，我早该死的，是以西结放过了我。”

“近日，我时常感觉自己时日无多，因此有一件事想告诉你……当年东皇重工的首席研究员还活着。”

相南里听到这，难免问了句：“怎么，是要我帮忙杀了他吗？”

安德鲁立刻反驳：“不，不是的。他叫漠北。目前在姑苏城的监狱里，因为多次记忆清洗，现在什么也不知道。他已经为自己的错误付出过代价了。编号是GS719，终身监禁。全身都机械化了，只剩大脑还留着。思维能力正常。”

“我只是想告诉你，他除了畸变人，还研发了营养膏，就是现在所有贫民都吃过的那个东西；他读大学时就参与了基因药的实验！他救过很多人，只是历史上没有他的名字。他是特别天才、特别伟大的科学家，像你一样。你们都是可以改变时代的人。”

“我总觉得，他应该更有用才对，而不是一直被关在监狱里。我害怕我死后，就没有人还记得了，所以才告诉你的。”

安德鲁的声音充满着彷徨和哀戚：“相南里，你可以理解的吧？科技是无罪的。就像人工智能和智械。你可以理解吧？”

相南里不由得停下脚步。

他转头，看向身后的人。

安德鲁只会笑，可在这一刻，他应该是哭惨了。

相南里从来没改过名，也不想改。只是几乎没有人认为他是“相南里”。

而安德鲁似乎格外的确信和肯定。

相南里轻轻地叹息了一声：“漠北吗？好的，我知道了。”

安德鲁一愣，喜出望外地疯狂点头。

人才库+1，虽然不知道什么时候才能用上。

等回姑苏城问问滚石吧，看看能不能把死刑犯放出来。放出来之后……先养着吧。建设据点总需要人手。做不了实验，帮忙浇菜也不错。

滚石作为普通的姑苏城公务员，当然没这个权力。

相南里想联系的其实是辛追。辛追当初留了滚石的联系方式，作为人情往来的一环，大概意思是遇到问题，可以通过滚石找他帮个忙。

只是人情总会耗尽的。不出意外，这会是他最后一次联系上辛追。

漠北这种没有社会关系的人，很适合成为基地的成员。其实小青也很合适，干活勤快又能打，可惜要回智械军团。

相南里这么想着，逐渐走下山。前方的道路变得平坦，是他之前坐车经过的地方。

路灯熄灭了，宫殿内亮着灯，街上却没有几个人。

明明是下雪天，可因为火光冲天，温度高得像是熔炉。不远处的外城浓烟滚滚，像是在焚烧秸秆。

相南里再次庆幸，自己居然没有嫌麻烦不穿防护服。

他们很快到了城墙边。

一墙之隔，畸变人的嘶吼声震天。

血红色的畸变人们用庞大的身躯撞着城墙，墙上的土块往下坠落，露出里面的金属结构。

但比畸变人的嘶吼更刺耳的，是人群的哭声。这些哭声混在硝烟里，本该不那么明显。只是他们的数量太多了。

几名机器人士兵守在城门前，看起来无所事事。

安德鲁拦下相南里：“你等等，这附近有很多机器人。我先去试试。我机械化程度很高，经常被新型号的机器人当成古董同类。”

说完，他两股颤颤地走了出去。

相南里听不清他们交流了什么，但看起来安德鲁和那些机器人相处地不错，几分钟，他走了回来。

“我说我是赛委会的服务机器人。”安德鲁的语气充满庆幸，“幸好我为了卖酒买了个假证。”

“它们是永恒之城的机器人守卫，只负责看守，没有打开城门的权限。内城和外城的开启权限都在二楼。哨塔也在城墙边缘，上城墙的唯一方式是搭乘电梯。”

相南里掏出望远镜，鬼鬼祟祟的观察了片刻。

电梯应该位于城墙底下的门洞处，不止一台。门口有机器人守卫。

城墙边还有巡逻队，牵着电子狗。天色太黑，相南里完全分不清他们是机器人还是人类。

电梯使用的人不多，需要刷卡，能看见一些衣着华美的男男女女进出。

甚至还有黑十字审判庭的黑甲骑士。

相南里骤然明白，为什么以西结要好心给他一件隐身衣。

感情是预判了他没这套装备根本没办法混进敌人内部。

他解开包装，把皮蜕套在自己身上。这套装备弹性极好，甚至连他背后的外骨骼都一起装了进去。不愧是能把自己从十几米压缩到巴掌大小的潜行者。

潜行者的皮蜕是粉白色的，可里面的人却能清楚的看见外界。

相南里呼吸顺畅。如果不是触感冰凉，他甚至想不起自己套了层皮。

他伸手，拍了拍安德鲁的肩膀。

安德鲁骤然转过头：“相南里？人呢？”

他安装了电子眼，除了摄像头，也靠感应装置收集信息。哪怕在黑暗中也能清楚躲避障碍物。

但现在，相南里从他的感应系统里消失了，摄像头里更是不见踪影。

他甚至感觉不到相南里拍了自己的肩——触觉也是需要感应系统的。

“你在这等我，找个安全的地方躲起来，我先上去看看。”相南里说。

相南里钻出漆黑的小巷。

然后来到了电梯边上。

附近的机器人果然对他毫无反应。一只长相凶狠的机械狗甚至从相南里脚边路过，他忍了很久，才忍住上去摸一把的冲动。

几分钟后，一名身穿黑甲的骑士来到了电梯前。

他有一顶尖锐的三角金属帽，看帽子，应该是骑士长级别的角色。

和上次带头追杀洛修的骑士一个级别。

相南里跟着他走进电梯内，小心翼翼地躲在电梯角落。

这名骑士正在打电话：“按理说，圣灵应该孵化成功了，为什么到现在还没出世……？”

“沙利叶大人倒是发来消息，让我去城墙支援。”

“城墙很安全，永恒之城可是建在福音书身体上的，没那么容易被一群畸变人攻破。放心。”

“要加班了，先挂了。爱你宝贝，mua。”

相南里：“……”

他还以为是在跟领导汇报工作。原来你们天启骑士私底下也是有感情的吗。

半分钟后，电梯抵达60米高的城墙上。

与此同时——

正在努力拦截信号，并且到处乱发假消息的福音书号：“呜呜呜呜呜说好只需要坚持五分钟呢？侦察兵，你信号到底发出去了吗？不是让你去摇Alpha吗？我真的要没电了！你人呢？！”
chunks.englishText:
"The core R&D team was holding a meeting in another city; some were arrested on the spot, while others defected from the Human Alliance to join the Black Cross Inquisition, which was still quite weak at the time. I was the only exception. I should have died long ago; it was Ezekiel who spared me."

"Lately, I’ve often felt that my time is running out, so there is something I want to tell you... The chief researcher of the Eastern Emperor Heavy Industries is still alive."

Hearing this, Xiang Nanli couldn't help but ask: "What, do you want me to help you kill him?"

Andrew immediately retorted: "No, that’s not it. His name is Mo Bei. He is currently in a prison in Gusu City. Due to repeated memory wipes, he doesn't know anything now. He has already paid the price for his mistakes. His inmate number is GS719, serving a life sentence. His entire body has been mechanized, leaving only his brain. His cognitive abilities are normal."

"I just wanted to tell you that, besides the Aberrants, he also developed the nutrient paste—the very thing that every impoverished person eats today. He was involved in gene-drug experiments back in college! He has saved countless lives; it’s just that his name is absent from history. He is a brilliant, truly great scientist, just like you. You are both people capable of changing the era."

"I just feel that he should be put to better use, rather than rotting in a prison cell forever. I’m afraid that after I die, no one will remember him, which is why I’m telling you."

Andrew’s voice was filled with hesitation and sorrow: "Xiang Nanli, you can understand, right? Technology is innocent. Just like Artificial Intelligence and Machina. You can understand, can't you?"

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but stop in his tracks.

He turned his head to look at the person behind him.

Andrew only knew how to smile, but at this moment, he looked as if he had been crying his heart out.

Xiang Nanli had never changed his name, nor did he want to. Yet, almost no one believed he was truly "Xiang Nanli."

And yet, Andrew seemed exceptionally certain and convinced.

Xiang Nanli sighed softly: "Mo Bei, is it? Alright, I understand."

Andrew was stunned, then beamed with joy, nodding frantically.

*Talent pool +1, though I have no idea when I'll be able to make use of him.*

*I’ll ask Rolling Stone when I get back to Gusu City to see if it’s possible to get a death-row inmate released. Once he’s out... I’ll just keep him for now. A base always needs hands. If he can’t do research, helping to water the crops is fine too.*

As a mere civil servant in Gusu City, Rolling Stone certainly wouldn't have the authority for that.

What Xiang Nanli actually wanted to do was contact Xin Zhui. Xin Zhui had left his contact information with Rolling Stone as a favor, implying that if he ever ran into trouble, he could reach out through Rolling Stone to ask for help.

But favors always run out. If nothing went wrong, this would likely be the last time he could contact Xin Zhui.

Someone like Mo Bei, who had no social ties, was perfect for becoming a member of the base. Actually, Xiao Qing would have been a good fit too—hardworking and capable in a fight—but unfortunately, she had to return to the Machina Legion.

With these thoughts, Xiang Nanli gradually walked down the mountain. The road ahead became flat; it was the path he had traveled by vehicle earlier.

The streetlights were extinguished. Lights glowed within the palace, yet there were few people on the streets.

Even though it was snowing, the temperature was as high as a furnace due to the soaring flames. Not far away, the outer city was billowing with thick smoke, as if burning straw.

Xiang Nanli felt fortunate once again that he hadn't been too lazy to put on his protective suit.

They soon reached the city wall.

Separated by a single wall, the roars of the Aberrants were deafening.

The blood-red Aberrants were slamming their massive bodies against the wall, causing chunks of earth to crumble and revealing the metal structure beneath.

But even more piercing than the roars of the Aberrants were the cries of the people. These cries, mixed into the smoke of gunpowder, should not have been so distinct. It was just that there were too many of them.

Several robotic soldiers stood guard before the city gate, looking idle.

Andrew stopped Xiang Nanli: "Wait here, there are many robots in this area. Let me go try first. My level of mechanization is high; I’m often mistaken for an antique model by newer robots."

With that, he walked out, his legs trembling.

Xiang Nanli couldn't hear what they were communicating, but it seemed Andrew got along well with the robots. A few minutes later, he walked back.

"I told them I was a service robot for the Competition Committee," Andrew said, his tone full of relief. "Luckily, I bought a fake ID just to sell alcohol."

"They are the robot guards of the Eternal City, responsible only for surveillance; they don't have the authority to open the gates. The access permissions for both the inner and outer cities are on the second floor. The sentry towers are also on the edge of the wall, and the only way up is by elevator."

Xiang Nanli took out his binoculars and observed sneakily for a moment.

The elevators were located at the gatehouse beneath the city wall, and there was more than one. There were robot guards at the entrance.

There were also patrols along the wall, leading electronic dogs. It was too dark for Xiang Nanli to tell whether they were robots or humans.

Not many people used the elevators, and it required a keycard; he could see some elegantly dressed men and women coming and going.

There were even Black-Armored Knights from the Black Cross Inquisition.

Xiang Nanli suddenly understood why Ezekiel had been so kind as to give him a stealth cloak.

It turned out he had anticipated that without this gear, there would be no way to infiltrate the enemy's ranks.

He unwrapped the package and pulled the skin-shedding over himself. The gear was incredibly elastic, even accommodating the exoskeleton on his back. It was worthy of a Prowler capable of compressing itself from over ten meters down to the size of a palm.

The Prowler’s skin was a pale pink, yet the person inside could see the outside world with perfect clarity.

Xiang Nanli breathed easily. If not for the cold sensation against his skin, he wouldn't even have remembered he was wearing a second layer.

He reached out and patted Andrew on the shoulder.

Andrew turned his head abruptly: "Xiang Nanli? Where are you?"

He had installed electronic eyes, and besides cameras, he relied on sensory devices to collect information. Even in the dark, he could clearly avoid obstacles.

But now, Xiang Nanli had vanished from his sensory system, and he was nowhere to be seen on his cameras.

He couldn't even feel Xiang Nanli patting his shoulder—touch also required a sensory system.

"Wait for me here, find a safe place to hide. I’ll go up and take a look first," Xiang Nanli said.

Xiang Nanli slipped out of the dark alley.

He arrived at the elevator.

The nearby robots truly had no reaction to him. A fierce-looking mechanical dog even walked past his feet; he had to restrain himself for a long time to suppress the urge to reach out and pet it.

A few minutes later, a knight in black armor arrived at the elevator.

He wore a sharp, triangular metal helmet; judging by the headgear, he was likely at the level of a Knight Commander.

He was the same rank as the knight who had led the pursuit of Luo Xiu last time.

Xiang Nanli followed him into the elevator, carefully hiding in the corner.

The knight was on a call: "Logically, the Holy Spirit should have hatched successfully by now. Why hasn't it emerged...?"

"Lord Sariel did send word, telling me to go to the city wall to provide support."

"The city wall is safe. The Eternal City is built upon the body of the Gospel; it’s not that easy for a bunch of Aberrants to breach it. Don't worry."

"I have to work overtime, hanging up now. Love you, baby, mua."

Xiang Nanli: "..."

*He thought he was reporting to his superior. So, you Apocalypse Knights actually have feelings in private, too.*

Half a minute later, the elevator reached the 60-meter-high city wall.

At the same time—

The *Gospel*, currently struggling to intercept signals and spamming fake news everywhere: "Wuwuwuwu, you said it would only take five minutes! Scout, have you sent the signal out yet? Didn't I tell you to go summon the Alpha? I’m really about to run out of power! Where are you?!"

chunks.chineseText:
第45章

相南里尾随着黑甲骑士走出电梯，来到城墙上。

这名骑士一出电梯，就恢复了生人勿近的状态。

“大人，这边请。”永恒之城的官员弯着腰，头恨不得低到地上，“那些畸变体还在攻城……有，有好几头差点爬上了城墙。”

对于他们这些地表遗民来说，神庭的骑士长已经是不可多得的大人物。

骑士的声音带着金属质感：“慌什么，畸变人而已。”

他的声音略微停顿：“那些生化战士呢？”

生化战士和神庭的骑士，其实走的是一个路子。可惜待遇天差地别。

生化战士因为本身身体素质差，除了那些天赋异禀的，基本都是只能使用一两次的消耗品。

“已经派出去了。还有一批。他们不愿意去。”

骑士长严肃道：“苟利国家生死以，岂因祸福避趋之！都给我丢下去，我就不信他们不打！”

他说完，感觉自己之前在杂志上看见的这句古文显得自己十分有文化，不由得满意地点头。

一台台炮车架在城墙的射口位置。炮车旁，小脸乌漆嘛黑的士兵正在充填弹药。

看得出来城里人手不太够，这个小士兵明显没有成年，制服都松松垮垮的，瘦得像是一只猴子。

畸变人往上丢着燃烧的金属碎片，大多数被高大的城墙拦住了，但也有极少部分凶器砸了进来。

城墙下，就有一名士兵的半截身体。他腰部以下的躯体不翼而飞，伤口处焦黑一片，痛苦的呻吟着。

在发现骑士长路过时，这名士兵颤抖道：“骑士……长……！”

骑士长一愣，他走过去，来到伤者聚集的墙角，蹲下，握住士兵的手，语气温和：“我在。士兵，神庭为你骄傲。”

士兵留着血泪：“我，想加入天启骑士团，我，想。”

“好，好。神庭有肌体再生手术，能让你重获新生。你的英勇都倒映在神巨大宏伟的眼眸中。”

说完，竟然亲自抱起这名士兵，朝着哨塔走去。

周围人不由得露出羡慕的眼神，一时之间“骑士长”的叫声此起彼伏。

骑士长抬起一条胳膊，把这些声音往下压，示意人群稍安勿躁：“神国的子民们！你们的牺牲都会得到嘉奖！”

城墙上的士气显然振奋起来，连最瘦小的士兵传递火药都变得有力起来。哪怕他还没吃早饭。

相南里小心翼翼地靠着墙根走，身体隐藏在一片阴影之中。

骑士长抱着缺少下半截身躯的士兵走了很长一截路，沿途的士兵纷纷对他致以崇高的礼节。士兵激动极了，热泪盈眶。

一直到他们走入塔楼内。戒备森严的门在骑士长背后合上。

骑士长抬手，挡住了士兵的眼眸。随后毫不犹豫地拔出袖口的刀，刺穿士兵的心脏。

骑士长拔出刀，随意地把尸体丢在地上：“处理掉。”

这个负责带路的官员浑身战栗，弯腰，僵硬地提起尸体，嘴大张着，半天，也只有冷风灌进去。

不仅是外交官，就连悄悄潜入的相南里，都被这一举动吓到。

骑士长瞥了她一眼，面无表情地解释：“他不值得被治，肌体再生的价格比他的生命更昂贵。我是在减少他的痛苦。一个是肉体上的痛苦，一个是余生活在谎言和期待里的痛苦。不用担心，我们的灵魂之火会在神的脑海中重聚。”

“您说的对。”外交官艰涩地开口。

骑士长大步朝前，走上楼梯，很快来到哨塔里的简陋会议室。

这是永恒之城规格最高的政治会议，一共六人参与，但主导者其实只有两人，那就是骑士长和城主，剩下的人只负责执行。

相南里同样溜了进来，门禁设备对他没有任何反应。

小智发出善意的提醒：[警告：长时间滞留在同一区域，可能导致区域内生物感应增强，增加暴露风险，请注意时间。]

城主皱眉：“半个小时前，沙利叶大人就传来信号，说圣灵正在孵化，不可打扰。命令我们全力拦截畸变人。”

一名黑甲骑士道：“平时都是天启骑士团在干苦活累活，要摘果子了，就戒律骑士来……我看沙利叶大人这么久没消息，说不定就是在自己偷吃圣灵……”

周围人还没有反应，骑士长骤然站起身，一巴掌甩到了这名黑甲骑士的脸上。

这名黑甲骑士直接倒飞了出去，撞在墙上。头盔掉在地上，就连骨骼都发出去了扭曲的“咯咯”声。

天启骑士长怒道：“那是军团长！你算什么东西，竟然妄议沙利叶大人？！传出去，是想我们都死吗？！”

黑甲骑士血流如注，呜呜咽咽地哭起来：“对不起，大人。对不起。”

城主蹙眉：“好了，骑士长。这批畸变人非常难缠，似乎发生了一些我们不理解的进化。请看。”

屏幕上出现蜂鸟无人机传回来的监控。

这批畸变人仔细一数，其实只有三十多头。冲在最前方的是大块头，大概15米高。

城墙有60米。

最开始，畸变体尝试爬上去，只是指甲不够尖锐，没办法在墙体上留下着力点。

于是它们一个个叠着，托举着体型较小的畸变体。后面的人踩着它们身体往上爬。

一部分畸变体甚至忍痛，挖出一大块血肉，黏在墙体上。方便其他畸变体踏上去，这些血肉甚至是蠕动着的，像是一团红色的果冻。

镜头里也出现了生化战士的身影。

他们营养不良，体型也比畸变体小很多，几乎没有一战之力。

但他们依然冲了上去，奋不顾身。

这些生化战士是永恒之城的原住民，来自贫民窟。成为生化战士后，他们的亲人便被接入主城区。既是人质，也是阶级跨越。

他们没见过外面的世界，对城主充满感激，甚至愿意赌上自己的性命，去捍卫现在的一切。

天狼星曾经也是其中一员。

所以，当他来到地下城市后，才那么痛苦和愤怒。原来他人生的前19年，是一个巨大的谎言。就在五百公里外，就在地下；这里的小孩不用一出生就学习厮杀，不用担心冬天零下四十度的寒冷和饥荒……

诚然，人联的地下城市也有很多糟糕透顶的地方，但对地表的奴隶来说，已经是天堂。

这是一个摆烂的世界，客观条件就在那里，你不需要完美，只要比其他烂货更好就够了。

城主道：“他们似乎具备了一些智力。甚至学会了工具和策略。你们看，这批攻城的畸变体甚至会轮流当脚垫。而且它们也没有呈现出无脑进食的状态，周围还有很多平民，足够它们餐补。但它们看都不看一眼。”

大臣：“也许是被圣灵的味道引诱了。”

“或许吧，”城主眉头蹙起，“总之，不能让它们进入内城。骑士长，拜托你带着天启骑士，出城一趟。主城门不能开，麻烦从城墙下去。我会配备降落伞和飞行器。”

就在他们说话时，地面狂颤起来。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 45

Xiang Nanli followed the Black-Armored Knight out of the elevator and onto the city walls.

The moment the knight stepped out of the elevator, he reverted to his "keep away" persona.

"My Lord, please, this way." The official of the Eternal City bowed so low that his head nearly touched the ground. "Those aberrants are still attacking the city... some, some of them almost climbed over the walls."

To these survivors of the surface, a Knight Commander of the Divine Court was already an unattainable, high-ranking figure.

The knight’s voice carried a metallic resonance: "What is there to panic about? They are merely aberrants."

His voice paused slightly: "What about the bio-warriors?"

Bio-warriors and the knights of the Divine Court technically followed the same path. Unfortunately, the treatment they received was worlds apart.

Because bio-warriors possessed poor physical constitutions, aside from those with innate, extraordinary talents, they were essentially disposable items that could only be used once or twice.

"They have already been dispatched. There is another batch, but they are unwilling to go."

The Knight Commander said sternly, "One should dedicate their life to the nation, regardless of personal fortune or misfortune! Throw them all down there; I refuse to believe they won't fight!"

After speaking, he felt that this classical quote he had seen in a magazine made him seem very cultured, and he nodded in satisfaction.

Artillery carriages were set up at the embrasures of the city walls. Beside the cannons, soldiers with soot-stained faces were busy loading ammunition.

It was clear that the city was short on manpower; this young soldier was obviously not yet an adult, his uniform hanging loosely on a frame as thin as a monkey’s.

The aberrants were throwing burning metal fragments upward. Most were blocked by the towering city walls, but a very small number of lethal projectiles smashed through.

Below the wall lay the severed half of a soldier. His body from the waist down was gone, the wound charred black, and he was groaning in agony.

Upon noticing the Knight Commander passing by, the soldier trembled: "Knight... Commander...!"

The Knight Commander paused. He walked over to the corner where the wounded were gathered, crouched down, took the soldier’s hand, and said in a gentle tone: "I am here. Soldier, the Divine Court is proud of you."

The soldier wept tears of blood: "I... I want to join the Apocalypse Knight Order. I... I want to."

"Good, good. The Divine Court has limb-regeneration surgery that can grant you a new life. Your heroism is reflected in the great, magnificent eyes of the Divine."

Having said this, he actually picked up the soldier himself and walked toward the watchtower.

Those around them couldn't help but show expressions of envy, and for a moment, cries of "Knight Commander" rose one after another.

The Knight Commander raised an arm to quiet the voices, signaling the crowd to remain calm: "Children of the Divine Kingdom! Your sacrifices will all be rewarded!"

The morale on the city walls clearly surged; even the skinniest soldier seemed to gain strength while passing the gunpowder, even though he hadn't eaten breakfast yet.

Xiang Nanli walked cautiously along the base of the wall, his body hidden within a patch of shadow.

The Knight Commander carried the soldier—missing his lower half—for a long distance, and the soldiers along the way offered him their highest respects. The soldier was extremely moved, his eyes brimming with hot tears.

They walked until they entered the watchtower. The heavily guarded door closed behind the Knight Commander.

The Knight Commander raised his hand, covering the soldier’s eyes. Then, without hesitation, he drew the blade from his cuff and pierced the soldier’s heart.

The Knight Commander pulled out the blade and tossed the corpse onto the floor casually: "Dispose of it."

The official responsible for leading the way trembled all over. He bowed and stiffly picked up the corpse, his mouth agape, but for a long time, only cold wind poured in.

Not only the diplomat but even Xiang Nanli, who had snuck in, was shocked by this act.

The Knight Commander glanced at him, explaining expressionlessly: "He is not worth curing; the price of limb regeneration is more expensive than his life. I am reducing his suffering. One is physical pain, the other is the pain of living the rest of his life in lies and expectations. Do not worry, our soul-fire will reunite in the mind of the Divine."

"You are right," the diplomat said with difficulty.

The Knight Commander strode forward, climbed the stairs, and soon arrived at the simple meeting room inside the watchtower.

This was the highest-level political meeting in the Eternal City, with six people participating, but there were only two leaders: the Knight Commander and the City Lord. The rest were only responsible for execution.

Xiang Nanli had also snuck in; the access control equipment did not react to him at all.

Xiao Zhi issued a friendly reminder: [Warning: Staying in the same area for a long time may increase biological sensing in the area and increase the risk of exposure. Please pay attention to the time.]

The City Lord frowned: "Half an hour ago, Lord Sariel sent a signal saying that the Holy Spirit is hatching and must not be disturbed. He ordered us to intercept the aberrants with all our might."

A Black-Armored Knight said: "Usually, the Apocalypse Knight Order does the dirty work. Now that it's time to reap the rewards, the Discipline Knights show up... I think Lord Sariel hasn't had news for so long because he might be secretly consuming the Holy Spirit himself..."

Before those around could react, the Knight Commander suddenly stood up and slapped the Black-Armored Knight across the face.

The Black-Armored Knight flew backward, crashing into the wall. His helmet fell to the ground, and even his bones made a distorted "clucking" sound.

The Apocalypse Knight Commander raged: "That is the Legion Commander! Who do you think you are to discuss Lord Sariel?! If this gets out, do you want us all to die?!"

The Black-Armored Knight bled profusely, whimpering and crying: "I'm sorry, my Lord. I'm sorry."

The City Lord frowned: "Enough, Knight Commander. This batch of aberrants is very difficult to deal with; they seem to have undergone some evolution we don't understand. Look."

The screen displayed surveillance footage transmitted by a hummingbird drone.

Counting carefully, there were only about thirty of these aberrants. Charging at the very front was a massive one, about 15 meters tall.

The city wall was 60 meters high.

At first, the aberrants tried to climb up, but their nails weren't sharp enough to leave a foothold on the wall.

So, they stacked themselves up, lifting the smaller aberrants. The ones behind climbed up by stepping on their bodies.

Some aberrants even endured the pain of digging out large chunks of their own flesh and sticking them to the wall to make it easier for others to step on. These chunks of flesh were even wriggling, like balls of red jelly.

The figures of bio-warriors also appeared in the footage.

They were malnourished and much smaller than the aberrants, with almost no power to fight.

But they still charged forward, regardless of their own safety.

These bio-warriors were the original inhabitants of the Eternal City, from the slums. After becoming bio-warriors, their families were moved into the main city area. They were both hostages and a means of class advancement.

They had never seen the outside world and were full of gratitude toward the City Lord, even willing to gamble their lives to defend everything they had now.

Sirius had once been one of them.

That was why, when he arrived at the underground city, he was so pained and angry. It turned out that the first 19 years of his life had been a giant lie. Just 500 kilometers away, right underground; children here didn't have to learn to kill from birth, didn't have to worry about the minus-forty-degree cold of winter and famine...

Admittedly, the Human Alliance's underground cities had many terrible aspects, but to the slaves on the surface, it was already heaven.

This was a world of "giving up." The objective conditions were there; you didn't need to be perfect, you just needed to be better than the other trash.

The City Lord said: "They seem to possess some intelligence. They have even learned to use tools and strategies. Look, this batch of attacking aberrants even takes turns acting as footrests. And they haven't shown a mindless state of feeding; there are many civilians around, enough for them to snack on. But they don't even look at them."

A minister said: "Perhaps they are lured by the scent of the Holy Spirit."

"Perhaps," the City Lord frowned. "In any case, we cannot let them enter the inner city. Knight Commander, please take the Apocalypse Knights and go outside the city. The main city gate cannot be opened; please go down from the city wall. I will equip you with parachutes and flying devices."

Just as they were speaking, the ground began to shake violently.

chunks.chineseText:
城主慌乱地握住椅子，等待着这股强震过去。也多亏永恒之城是一个完整的金属体，这才没有出现地面龟裂。只是建筑表面的石块掉落不少。

尖锐的嘶吼从竞技场的位置传出，房间里的人骤然转头，看向窗外。

鲜红的血色巨蛇从地面破土而出，哪怕黑夜中，也能感觉到它庞大的身躯，在虚空中扭动着！

这条蛇躯暴露在空气中，腹部位置挣扎着长出第二条躯体，比主干细那么一点。

它翻滚着，城堡内地动山摇。住在主城区的富人们也不再安宁，宫殿里亮起一盏盏灯，却无人敢前往后山。

片刻后，地震停歇。圣灵也匍匐了下去。

骑士长沉默片刻：“沙利叶大人真的什么也没说吗？只让我们死守？”

“是的。”

骑士长叹息一声：“好吧，我们服从命令，我会召集骑士们出征。”

这对相南里来说，是一个重要的利好。

毕竟这个硬邦邦的骑士一看就很难应付。

经过小青多日基因药的喂养，相南里已经从1.5级脆皮机械师，升到了5级脆皮机械师，并且习得了不需要联网就能使用的初级格斗术。

他的身体素质是好了一些，还装配有传奇宝具[潜行者的皮蜕]，15级机械外骨骼装备[探索者]，但是想硬刚30级的骑士长，还是有些不自量力。

骑士长环顾一圈，指着被他打了一巴掌的黑甲骑士道：“你跪在这里，好好反省。”

这名黑甲骑士的地位骑士比其他天启骑士要高一点。很重要的原因之一，是他是骑士长的亲弟弟。

打仗这么危险的事就不带他了，反正分军功时也一样的。

黑甲骑士抱着自己的头盔，跪在角落：“是。”

骑士长故意落在最后，等人都走了，才语重心长道：“你是我弟弟，更应该警惕落人口实。你本来身体素质就不行，其他人不希望你接任我的位置。我今年39岁，还差一年就是考核期。如果晋级失败，马上就会魂归神国，又能庇护你多久？”

骑士长匆匆往城墙赶去。城主和其他人，则是走向楼上的阁楼。只剩黑甲骑士一人还在房间内。

他低垂着头，抱着自己的头盔，眼泪啪嗒啪嗒落在名贵的地毯上。

相南里感觉自己盯着他看了许久，其实也没多久，顶多一分钟。

[小智。]相南里呼唤着。

[我在。]

相南里：[你能扫描出城主大概什么等级吗？]

[抱歉，数据库内没有信息。但根据过往资料推测，城主大概20级左右。]

[城主身边还有守卫，想和他单独相处很难。但如果有这个小骑士的身份，会方便很多。穿着全套的盔甲，谁也认不出我是谁吧？]

[是的。神庭会根据甲胄区别骑士，每个甲胄都有自己的数据库。]

[我得开门，要打开外城的门。一方面，我自己得出去，城内其实也不安全；另一方面，外城区的平民也需要出去。哪怕畸变体不会吃他们，他们也会被余威波及。]

更多的人其实死于烟熏火烤。

[是的。]

[开城门，这大概就是以西结的目的。城外的畸变人会进来……但其实我们打不开，对他来说也没什么影响。]

[综合考虑，杀死这个骑士的性价比最高。拿到他的身份，去找控制室里的城主，解决掉他，拿到城堡的控制权。这是目前看最好的方案。中间会有一定的风险，但我认为这值得冒险。]

[是的。]

相南里沮丧道：[但我还没杀过人，我连鱼都没杀过。我很害怕，你能理解吗？]

嘴上说着害怕，相南里的精神状态其实非常平静。

他体内激素水平稳定的让人工智能都觉得意外。

如果Alpha5.2.0还在，大概会刨根问底。

为什么要害怕？

是害怕发现自己的确是社会里的那个“异类”吗？

无论多少人称赞他美丽、优越。只有生育他的母亲才会意识到，自己产下的是一个怪胎。

可惜现在在的只有小智：[没关系。根据黑十字审判庭的信仰，死亡即为新生，他会投个好胎的。]

[嗯呐。]

相南里上前一步，用机械刃，从背后划开了黑甲骑士的脖子。东方青帝教过他很多次。
