快、准、狠。有血迹，但不多。很好处理。断裂面是平滑的，完整的。

相南里感觉自己像在梦游，直到他把完整的尸体从盔甲里取出，扛到了会议室的厕所。

骑士的头在洗漱台上，平静地望着他。表情还残留着一丝委屈。

相南里脱下皮蜕，被隔离的血液味道和油脂的臭味钻进了他的鼻腔，才过去几分钟，骑士的瞳孔出现了涣散。按理说基因改造过的人会腐烂的很慢，可丢在地上的尸体已经流出腥臭的水。

相南里拧开水龙头，洗手。隔了会，没忍住狂吐不止。温热的触感好像还残留在他手上。

他成功了，可他不快乐。

小青跟他聊过很多次建立基地的事，看得出来，东方青帝一直没有放弃让相南里放弃的想法。

——他说：“不管什么样的社会结构，理想都只是表层，最后把体制里所有人凝聚在一起的，还是利益。‘让所有人都吃饱穿暖’，这也是一种利益。必然会和现有的食利阶层产生冲突。甚至，他们的利益在某方面也是合理的——不用现在回答我，如果你不放弃，迟早有天会遇上这样的抉择。”

——“你能做到为了你想要的利益，去剥夺其他人的利益吗？”

——“我并不是反对你。我只是……认为这会很辛苦。”

相南里吐干净胃里的酸水，关掉水龙头。

他喃喃道：“我能。”

相南里把皮蜕叠了起来，压成薄薄一层，可以勉强塞进防护服的口袋里。至于机械外骨骼，还是放在卫生间吧，实在塞不下了。就是有些对不起老板。

他离开洗手间，回到会议室。刚才他就发现了，黑骑们的甲胄更像是一种轻薄款式的机甲。内部有很多神经传感线。

相南里钻了进去，然后戴上头盔。

[精神链接中……验证通过。]

[契合度，100％。]

黑甲骑士从地上站了起来，身高两米二，很多杂乱的数据载入相南里的脑海中，感觉像是奇怪的精神污染。赛博精神病的变种。

相南里匆匆扫了眼，居然是历代黑甲使用者们的宝贵记忆。因为内存有限，大家都传输的最重要的部分……

相南里是个缺德的机械师。

他研究了一下操作系统，选择了一键删除。

相南里一边朝着控制室走去，一边思考着：“神庭的人老说死亡即为新生，不会是这种代代相传的数据寄生吧？”

这怎么不算一种赛博夺舍。
chunks.englishText:
The City Lord gripped his chair in a panic, waiting for the intense tremor to pass. Thanks to the Eternal City being a complete metal structure, the ground did not crack, though many stones fell from the surfaces of the buildings.

A sharp roar erupted from the direction of the arena. The people in the room turned abruptly to look out the window.

A giant, blood-red serpent broke through the ground. Even in the dark of night, one could feel its massive body twisting in the void!

This serpent body was exposed to the air, and a second body was struggling to grow from its abdomen, slightly thinner than the main trunk.

It rolled, causing the castle to shake. The wealthy living in the main city area were no longer at peace; lamps lit up in the palaces, but no one dared to head toward the back mountain.

A moment later, the earthquake ceased. The Holy Spirit also slithered back down.

The Knight Commander was silent for a moment: "Did Lord Sariel really say nothing else? Just to hold the line?"

"Yes."

The Knight Commander sighed: "Very well, we obey orders. I will assemble the knights to set out."

For Xiang Nanli, this was a significant piece of good news.

After all, this rigid knight looked very difficult to deal with.

After days of being fed Xiao Qing’s genetic medicine, Xiang Nanli had risen from a Level 1.5 "glass cannon" mechanic to a Level 5 "glass cannon" mechanic, and he had learned basic combat techniques that didn't require a network connection.

His physical fitness had improved, and he was equipped with the legendary treasure [Stalker's Skin] and the Level 15 mechanical exoskeleton [Explorer], but trying to go head-to-head with a Level 30 Knight Commander was still a bit overreaching.

The Knight Commander looked around the circle and pointed at the Black-Armored Knight he had slapped earlier: "You, kneel here and reflect on your actions."

The status of this Black-Armored Knight was slightly higher than the other Apocalypse Knights. One very important reason was that he was the Knight Commander’s younger brother.

He wouldn't be taken on such dangerous military missions; he would get the same military merit anyway.

The Black-Armored Knight hugged his helmet and knelt in the corner: "Yes."

The Knight Commander deliberately lagged behind. Once everyone else had left, he said earnestly: "You are my brother, and you should be even more vigilant about giving others cause to criticize you. Your physical constitution is already poor, and others don't want you to succeed me. I am 39 this year, and in one year, it will be the assessment period. If I fail to advance, I will return to the Divine Kingdom soon. How long can I protect you then?"

The Knight Commander hurried toward the city walls. The City Lord and the others headed to the attic upstairs. Only the Black-Armored Knight remained in the room.

He hung his head, clutching his helmet, tears dripping onto the expensive carpet.

Xiang Nanli felt as if he had been staring at him for a long time, though it was actually no more than a minute.

[Xiao Zhi.] Xiang Nanli called out.

[I am here.]

Xiang Nanli: [Can you scan the City Lord’s approximate level?]

[Apologies, there is no information in the database. But based on past data, the City Lord is likely around Level 20.]

[There are guards around the City Lord; it’s hard to be alone with him. But if I had this little knight’s identity, it would be much easier. Wearing a full set of armor, no one would recognize who I am, right?]

[Yes. The Divine Court distinguishes knights by their armor, and each suit of armor has its own database.]

[I have to open the gate. I have to open the outer city gate. On one hand, I need to get out myself; the city isn't actually safe. On the other hand, the civilians in the outer city need to get out. Even if the aberrants don't eat them, they will be caught in the crossfire.]

More people actually died from the smoke and fire.

[Yes.]

[Opening the city gate—this is likely Ezekiel’s goal. The aberrants outside will come in... but if we can't open it, it doesn't really affect him.]

[Considering everything, killing this knight is the most cost-effective option. Take his identity, go find the City Lord in the control room, eliminate him, and take control of the castle. This seems to be the best plan right now. There will be some risks, but I believe it is worth the gamble.]

[Yes.]

Xiang Nanli said dejectedly: [But I’ve never killed anyone. I haven't even killed a fish. I’m very scared, can you understand that?]

Despite saying he was scared, Xiang Nanli’s mental state was actually extremely calm.

The hormone levels in his body were so stable that even the AI found it surprising.

If Alpha 5.2.0 were still here, it would probably get to the bottom of it.

Why be afraid?

Is it because you are afraid of discovering that you are indeed the "aberrant" in society?

No matter how many people praised his beauty and superiority, only the mother who gave birth to him would realize that she had birthed a freak.

Unfortunately, only Xiao Zhi was here: [It doesn't matter. According to the faith of the Black Cross Inquisition, death is a new beginning. He will be reincarnated into a good life.]

[Mm-hmm.]

Xiang Nanli stepped forward and used a mechanical blade to slice open the Black-Armored Knight’s throat from behind. Dongfang Qingdi had taught him many times.

Fast, accurate, and ruthless. There was blood, but not much. It was easy to handle. The cut was smooth and complete.

Xiang Nanli felt as if he were sleepwalking until he removed the complete corpse from the armor and carried it to the meeting room’s restroom.

The knight’s head sat on the vanity, staring at him calmly. His expression still held a trace of grievance.

Xiang Nanli took off the [Stalker's Skin]. The smell of isolated blood and the stench of grease drilled into his nasal cavity. Only a few minutes had passed, but the knight’s pupils had already dilated. Normally, genetically modified people would rot very slowly, but the corpse thrown on the floor was already leaking a foul-smelling fluid.

Xiang Nanli turned on the faucet and washed his hands. After a while, he couldn't help but vomit uncontrollably. The warm sensation seemed to linger on his hands.

He had succeeded, but he wasn't happy.

Xiao Qing had talked to him many times about establishing a base; it was clear that Dongfang Qingdi had never given up on the idea of getting Xiang Nanli to give up.

—He had said: "No matter what kind of social structure it is, ideals are only the surface. In the end, what holds everyone in the system together is interest. 'Letting everyone be fed and clothed' is also a type of interest. It will inevitably conflict with the existing rent-seeking class. In fact, their interests are even reasonable in some aspects—you don't have to answer me now. If you don't give up, you will encounter such a choice sooner or later."

—"Can you bring yourself to deprive others of their interests for the sake of the interests you want?"

—"I am not against you. I just... think it will be very hard."

Xiang Nanli vomited up the acid in his stomach and turned off the faucet.

He murmured: "I can."

Xiang Nanli folded the [Stalker's Skin], pressing it into a thin layer that could barely fit into his protective suit's pocket. As for the mechanical exoskeleton, he left it in the restroom; it really wouldn't fit. He felt a bit sorry for his boss.

He left the restroom and returned to the meeting room. He had just realized that the Black Knights' armor was more like a lightweight type of mecha. There were many neural sensor wires inside.

Xiang Nanli climbed inside and put on the helmet.

[Mental link established... Verification passed.]

[Compatibility: 100%.]

The Black-Armored Knight stood up from the ground, standing 2.2 meters tall. A lot of chaotic data loaded into Xiang Nanli’s mind, feeling like a strange form of mental pollution. A variant of cyber-psychosis.

Xiang Nanli scanned it briefly; it was actually the precious memories of the successive Black-Armored users. Because memory was limited, everyone had transmitted only the most important parts...

Xiang Nanli was a wicked mechanic.

He studied the operating system and chose "Delete All."

As Xiang Nanli walked toward the control room, he thought: "The people of the Divine Court always say death is a new beginning. Could it be this kind of data parasitism passed down through generations?"

How could this not be considered a form of cyber-possession?

chunks.chineseText:
第46章

“你的哥哥是战士，死在了保卫永恒之城的那个冬天。”

“你也是战士，妈妈为你骄傲。”

妈妈抱着他，一边流泪一边说着。

刚熬过基因突变的天狼星用力地点着头，他的胳膊上长出了一些鳞屑，有些疼，他不敢去挠，怕成片的皮肤掉下来，露出底下血红的皮肉。

那年他七岁。

城主需要大量的生化战士，但只会给他们打最劣质的基因药剂。

战士们不需要强大，只要在这片荒区够用就行了。

“大人，求您不要放弃他……我只有两个孩子，大儿子是为您战死的。求您，这是我最后一个孩子……求您救救他吧。”

城主低头，缓慢地抠开死死抓住自己脚踝的手。

“我记得你，女士。35年前，你还是一名农奴。你的孩子很出色。

“但我要纠正你的一个观点。他们都不是为我战死的，不要把这么沉重的责任背负在我身上。他们是为自己而战。为了让你能在城里，心安理得地享受优渥的生活。

“放手吧。看在你死了两个儿子的份上，我不计较你的失态。”

母亲病死在那个冬天。

那年他十九。

好累，好困。是什么如此疼痛。

他想长睡不醒，可是为什么总有声音在逼问他，“你甘心吗？”

你甘心吗？你来到了姑苏城，你有了名气、地位，钱。你可以忘记那些不愉快的一切，重新开始。仇恨的火焰只会煎熬你自己。

“我……不……”

不理解。不原谅。不甘心。

天狼星睁开眼，感觉不到自己的身体，却依然固执地顶开了身上压着的石块，碎石和灰尘从额角边坠落。

不知道周围是没有光源还是他失明了，天狼星什么也看不见，但却有一种近乎野兽般的直觉。

相晨曦就在前面，他们几乎同时坠落。

他摸索着，抄起地上的石头，找到了顶部最尖的那头。

天狼星没有多少力气了，他的生命之火接近枯竭，掐死人太累，用武器会舒服很多。

天狼星是他自己选的名字，莱因说，这是夜晚最亮的一颗恒星，意思是“发光”“灼热”。

他还说，希望他以后的人生可以像天狼星一样发光发热。

天狼星想，他不是那种能带来光和热的东西。他是一块冰冷的石头。

如果能亲手杀死城主就好了。可惜那老东西从来不离开主城，身边也总有人守护。

但没关系，他可以靠杀死相晨曦，间接杀死城主。

神庭未来的圣子死在永恒之城，城主必然会被问责。

他跌跌撞撞，几乎是爬到了相晨曦身边。

这个年轻的男人倒在地上，昏迷不醒。

自动启动的防护罩为他抵抗了绝大部分攻击，甚至短暂地庇护了一下离他很近的天狼星。要不然他们都该死在塌陷的地底。

相晨曦几乎毫发无损，只是因为碰撞陷入了昏迷。抵抗过这波强震，防护装置的能源刚好耗尽。

天狼星举起手里的武器，握在掌心，低声道：“抱歉。”

哪怕完全看不见，他也在黑暗中精准无误地刺向相晨曦的脖子。

相晨曦的身体在此时抽搐了一下，他骤然清醒，本能地避开朝自己刺来的凶器。

他甚至都称不上清醒，只是多年来面对无数次刺杀的本能。

相晨曦咬住自己的下唇。尖锐的爆鸣声在他的耳边响起，那是石头擦过他的皮肤，凿向地面。

“天狼星？”相晨曦语气充满意外，他撑起自己的身体往后退着，手掌压在碎石上，咯得他生疼，“我们好好谈谈可以吗？他们给你什么价钱，我付给你双倍。”

相晨曦的声音还是这么温柔。

可惜天狼星不要钱，他只要相晨曦死。

他闪身上前，手里的石刃捅穿相晨曦的心脏。

剧痛让相晨曦的五官扭曲，他却依然很有风度的保持着笑容：“神原谅你，天狼星。”

相晨曦抵在身后的手疯狂按着紧急求救按钮。

天狼星看不见，他面无表情地拔出钝器，然后捅向下一个位置，脾脏。

他清楚，有些人会很难杀。

脾脏之后是脖子，割下相晨曦的头。

这个部位有颈椎保护，会难捅很多，但只要找对角度，也还行。

天狼星漫不经心地想着。

石刃被磨得有些钝，天狼星摁住相晨曦的手，反反复复捅了好几次，才把最顶端插进去那么一点。

他喘息着，钝刀子磨肉，在发力的前一秒，听到了相晨曦歇斯底里的尖叫：“沙利叶，还不过来杀了这个贱种！”

“轰隆——”

是石墙被轰烂的声音。

天狼星感觉到一股冷风，带着风雪和死亡的气息。

他的双脚悬空，沙利叶一只手抓住了天狼星的脑袋，提了起来。

很重的一拳打在他的腹部，骨骼碎裂，脾脏破损。

腥甜的味道充斥在喉间，天狼星之前解开基因锁，本就是强弩之末，内里亏空得厉害，连血都咳不出来。

他眼前一片漆黑，耳畔传来相晨曦沙哑而愤怒的嘶吼，

相晨曦死死捂着脖子上的伤口，用变调的嗓音尖锐咒骂道：“杀了他！还有跟他来的那群人！不！杀了他们太便宜了，把他们都做成人彘！关押在圣灵堂里，用基因药让他们肌体再生，然后一刀一刀把肉割下来喂蛇！我要让所有人知道刺杀我的下场！”

沙利叶不为所动，像雕塑。

相晨曦嚎啕大哭：“沙利叶，我好痛……”

沙利叶回答：“知道了。”

他松开手。

天狼星掉在地上，脑海里闪回过很多人的脸。莱因、相南里、安德鲁、东方青帝。

抱歉……

如果早知道是这个结果，也许他，算了，没有如果。

东方青帝本来是不打算管天狼星的。

虽然他们是同事，但他有更重要并且紧急的事需要处理，那就是和相南里汇合。

东方青帝联系不上相南里。

地震摧毁了这里的云端网络设备，他的信号覆盖范围也小了一圈。更别提后来相南里直接离开了竞技场。

地震也顺带改变了地貌和盘根错节的道路。

东方青帝感觉自己的人生从没这么狼狈过，他从地下二层掉落，直接掉进了蛇堆里，被血水淹没。

比圣灵先一步出生的伴生灵以为饲主又送来了加餐，开开心心地咬向东方青帝的身体……然后磕掉了自己的牙。

呵呵呵，开什么玩笑，他身体的外壳部分，可是用太空精金打造的，1g价值百万信用点，而他体重80kg*，别说是这些伴生灵了，就算圣灵亲自来也不可能咬穿。

东方青帝在池子里，掐死了几条离自己最近的蛇。它们的脑仁中爆出了几枚小小的晶体，像碎钻。

东方青帝一愣，发现这居然是自己目前最紧缺的生物能源。

有些伴生灵的脑子里有，有些没有。东方青帝以最快的速度掐死了一堆，收集到一把小石子。加起来重量不超过3g。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 46

"Your brother was a warrior; he died that winter defending the Eternal City."

"You are a warrior too, and Mother is proud of you."

His mother held him, tears streaming down her face as she spoke.

Sirius, having just survived a genetic mutation, nodded vigorously. Scales had sprouted on his arms, and they ached, but he dared not scratch them, fearing that patches of skin would peel away to reveal the raw, blood-red flesh beneath.

He was seven that year.

The City Lord required a vast number of biochemical warriors, but he would only provide them with the most inferior genetic serums.

The warriors didn't need to be powerful; they just needed to be "good enough" for this wasteland.

"My Lord, I beg you, please don't abandon him... I only have two children left. My eldest son died fighting for you. I beg you, this is my last child... please, save him."

The City Lord looked down, slowly prying away the hand that was gripping his ankle with a death-like hold.

"I remember you, madam. Thirty-five years ago, you were a serf. Your children were excellent."

"But I must correct one of your misconceptions. None of them died for me; do not place such a heavy burden upon my shoulders. They fought for themselves. They fought so that you could live in the city and enjoy a life of comfort with a clear conscience."

"Let go. For the sake of the two sons you've lost, I will overlook your lack of decorum."

His mother died of illness that winter.

He was nineteen that year.

So tired. So sleepy. What is this pain?

He wanted to fall into an endless sleep, but why did a voice keep badgering him: "Are you willing to let it end like this?"

Are you willing? You came to Gusu City; you have fame, status, and money. You could forget all those unpleasant things and start over. The flames of hatred will only consume you.

"I... am not..."

Not understanding. Not forgiving. Not willing.

Sirius opened his eyes. He couldn't feel his body, yet he stubbornly pushed aside the rocks pinning him down. Debris and dust rained down from his forehead.

He didn't know if there was no light source nearby or if he had gone blind; Sirius couldn't see a thing, yet he possessed an instinct bordering on that of a wild beast.

Xiang Chenxi was right in front of him; they had fallen almost simultaneously.

He fumbled around, grabbed a stone from the ground, and found the sharpest edge.

Sirius didn't have much strength left; his life force was nearly exhausted. Strangling someone was too tiring; using a weapon would be much easier.

Sirius was a name he had chosen for himself. Rhine had said it was the brightest star in the night sky, meaning "shining" and "scorching."

He had also said he hoped his future life could shine and radiate heat just like Sirius.

Sirius thought, he wasn't the kind of thing that could bring light and heat. He was just a cold, hard stone.

If only he could kill the City Lord with his own hands. It was a pity that the old bastard never left the main city and was always surrounded by guards.

But it didn't matter. He could kill the City Lord indirectly by killing Xiang Chenxi.

If the future Saint Son of the Divine Court died in the Eternal City, the City Lord would inevitably be held accountable.

He stumbled, practically crawling to Xiang Chenxi's side.

The young man lay on the ground, unconscious.

The automatically activated protective shield had deflected the vast majority of the attacks, even briefly sheltering Sirius, who was nearby. Otherwise, they both would have died in the collapsed underground.

Xiang Chenxi was almost unscathed, merely knocked unconscious by the impact. Having resisted the massive tremor, the protective device’s energy had just run dry.

Sirius raised his weapon, gripped it in his palm, and whispered, "I'm sorry."

Even though he couldn't see, he struck with pinpoint accuracy in the darkness toward Xiang Chenxi's throat.

Xiang Chenxi’s body twitched at that moment. He snapped awake, instinctively dodging the lethal weapon aimed at him.

He wasn't even truly conscious; it was merely the instinct honed by years of facing countless assassination attempts.

Xiang Chenxi bit his lower lip. A sharp, screeching sound rang in his ears—the stone scraping against his skin as it gouged into the ground.

"Sirius?" Xiang Chenxi’s tone was filled with surprise. He propped himself up and backed away, his palms pressing into the sharp rubble, causing him intense pain. "Can we talk about this? Whatever price they offered you, I’ll pay you double."

Xiang Chenxi’s voice was still so gentle.

It was a pity that Sirius didn't want money. He only wanted Xiang Chenxi dead.

He lunged forward, the stone blade piercing Xiang Chenxi’s heart.

The excruciating pain distorted Xiang Chenxi’s features, yet he maintained a graceful smile: "God forgives you, Sirius."

Xiang Chenxi’s hand, pressed against the ground behind him, frantically tapped the emergency distress button.

Sirius couldn't see. He expressionlessly pulled out the blunt object and then stabbed at the next target: the spleen.

He knew that some people were very hard to kill.

After the spleen, he would go for the neck and sever Xiang Chenxi’s head.

That area was protected by the cervical spine, making it much harder to pierce, but as long as he found the right angle, it would work.

Sirius thought nonchalantly.

The stone blade had become dull. Sirius pinned Xiang Chenxi’s hand down, stabbing repeatedly until the very tip finally managed to sink in just a little.

He gasped for air. As he prepared to exert force for the final blow, he heard Xiang Chenxi’s hysterical scream: "Sariel! Get over here and kill this bastard!"

"BOOM—"

It was the sound of a stone wall being blasted apart.

Sirius felt a cold wind, carrying the scent of snow and death.

His feet left the ground. Sariel had grabbed Sirius by the head and lifted him up.

A heavy punch landed on his abdomen, shattering bones and rupturing his spleen.

A metallic, sweet taste flooded his throat. Sirius had already unlocked his genetic seal, and he was at the end of his rope; his internal reserves were so depleted that he couldn't even cough up blood.

Everything went black before his eyes. In his ears, he heard Xiang Chenxi’s hoarse, furious roar.

Xiang Chenxi was clutching the wound on his neck, cursing shrilly in a distorted voice: "Kill him! And the group that came with him! No! Killing them is too merciful! Turn them all into human sticks! Lock them in the Holy Spirit Hall, use genetic serums to force their bodies to regenerate, and then slice the meat off, piece by piece, to feed the snakes! I want everyone to know the price of trying to assassinate me!"

Sariel remained unmoved, like a statue.

Xiang Chenxi wailed, "Sariel, it hurts so much..."

Sariel replied, "Understood."

He let go.

Sirius fell to the ground. Faces flashed through his mind: Rhine, Xiang Nanli, Andrew, Dongfang Qingdi.

Sorry...

If he had known this would be the outcome, perhaps he... never mind, there are no "ifs."

Dongfang Qingdi had originally not intended to bother with Sirius.

Although they were colleagues, he had more important and urgent matters to attend to—namely, reuniting with Xiang Nanli.

Dongfang Qingdi couldn't reach Xiang Nanli.

The earthquake had destroyed the cloud network equipment here, and his signal coverage had shrunk. Not to mention that Xiang Nanli had left the arena directly afterward.

The earthquake had also changed the topography and the tangled web of roads.

Dongfang Qingdi felt his life had never been so pathetic. He had fallen from the second underground level directly into a nest of snakes, submerged in blood.

The companion spirits, born just before the Holy Spirit, thought their keeper had sent another snack, and happily bit down on Dongfang Qingdi’s body... only to snap their own teeth off.

Heh, what a joke. The outer shell of his body was crafted from space-grade adamantine, worth a million credits per gram, and he weighed 80kg. Let alone these companion spirits, even if the Holy Spirit itself came, it wouldn't be able to bite through.

Dongfang Qingdi stood in the pool and strangled a few snakes closest to him. Tiny crystals, like crushed diamonds, burst from their brains.

Dongfang Qingdi paused, realizing this was actually the biological energy he was currently most in need of.

Some companion spirits had them in their brains, others didn't. Dongfang Qingdi strangled a pile of them as fast as he could, collecting a handful of small stones. The total weight didn't exceed 3 grams.

chunks.chineseText:
很好，丢入能量槽，提纯后大概能得到0.15％的储备电量，耗时15分钟。不如和相南里多贴几分钟。

圣灵孵化的其中一步，就包括用胎盘的根系吸收掉这些伴生灵。

只能说，东方青帝在推进圣灵难产这条路上功不可没。

尽管近在咫尺的能源很诱人，但东方青帝依旧打算先去找相南里。

他开始往上打洞。

这也是没办法的事，道路全都被压垮了，电梯也不能用，只有一些地底建筑还幸存。想出去只能清理掉这些土方。比较直观的形容就是“打洞”。

或者直接使用空间跃迁技术。

但东方青帝认为这不值得，因为能耗太大。

他一般只在紧急情况下使用。上一次用，还是帮相南里挡机械爬行者的激光束。

东方青帝在碎石中穿梭着，地道通了一大半。还没触碰到地表，却先看见了天狼星和相晨曦。

天狼星为什么要杀相晨曦，东方青帝是不关心的。甚至连沙利叶出场时，东方青帝都没有回头。

直到相晨曦的狗嘴说出了他恶毒的计划，而这个计划刚好被他听到。

很不幸，相南里也在“跟他来的那群人”里面。

所以，不能让他们活着出去。

东方青帝联系不上相南里，但根据福音书传过来的微弱信号，可知他的分机“小智”目前幸存。

也就是说相南里还活着，并且状态不错。

东方青帝的身影一闪，消失在原地。

沙利叶骤然回头：“谁在那里？！”

他察觉到空气异常的流动，不假思索地挥出一记重剑。

刀锋在石壁上划出很深一道裂痕。

沙利叶很快意识到自己中计了，有人在声东击西。而且这人的实力相当恐怖，他甚至没看清来者是谁。

——到底是谁？人联那几个调查局的高层？永生科技的未来战士？

——不，那些人的套路和资料，沙利叶都已经很熟悉。这是一个陌生人。

千头万绪在沙利叶的脑海里闪过，但从挥出剑到反应过来，顶多过去半秒。

沙利叶闻到了诱人的香气，像金桂。

这是死魂灵的香味。是相晨曦的味道。

他不可置信地转头，看见了表情同样错愕的相晨曦。

好奇怪，我为什么能看见……自己的身体。

“咚”的一声。

相晨曦的头掉在了地上，扬起一阵细沙。

脖子的横截面平滑、干净，说不定连疼痛感都很少。

失去脑袋的身体跪倒在地上，“轰隆”一声，砸在地上。

天地寂静了一瞬。

沙利叶紧握手上的这把重剑，他知道敌人还没有离去。

他被激怒了，所以更加冷静。

沙利叶睁开双眼，这次眼眸一片血红。连额间那枚眼珠，也被鲜艳的血染成了红色。

沙利叶看见了相晨曦的灵魂之火。

莲花形的金色火焰在尸体上焚烧着，如同回光返照一样，垂死挣扎着。

还有天狼星。原本灼热的青白色火焰，只剩一点点微光，眼看就要熄灭。

沙利叶伸出手，金色的灵魂之火跳动着来到他的掌心，融入他高大的身躯里。

相晨曦顿时在他的脑海里鬼哭狼嚎，但明显弱智了不少，只会反复哭诉道：“沙利叶，沙利叶！”

如果用现代医学解释，医生大概会说，这是沙利叶因为目睹相晨曦死亡，在强烈的刺激下，导致了第二人格的诞生。

沙利叶怒斥：“别吵了！再吵吃了你。”

他的脑海里终于安静了。

沙利叶也在一片黑暗里，看见东方青帝。对方同样在打量着他，等待着最合适的时机。

他看不见东方青帝的灵魂之火。

那么，抛开一切不可能，剩下的就是可能。

“智械人？”沙利叶冷笑一声，“有趣。”

竟然在如此荒芜的地表，发现了一台性能如此优越的智械。

他记得这个选手。似乎叫东皇？

沙利叶想起了之前的东皇重工，还有与它有关的传闻。

东皇……智械人……东皇重工……

Alpha的身体？还是Alpha？

沙利叶想到了这个可能，这令他后背发凉，浑身战栗，但他依然发起了冲锋。

骑士从不后退。

他明明只有一个人，气势却如同千军万马。

沙利叶挥剑，斩向东方青帝。

地底又一次震颤起来，空气爆发出尖锐的鸣啸！

浩瀚的光辉淹没了孵化池！

无人在意的角落。

营养不良的圣灵探出一条血红的触手，在地上摸来摸去。

它摸到了一头天狼星。虽然分不清是什么，但感觉能吃。

触手悄悄把天狼星拖了回去，吞进孵化它的血池里……

头顶打架的动静太恐怖了。

之前东方青帝出现，它就注意到了。

它像往常一样，催促着伴生灵进食，然后反哺胚胎。

伴生灵是和圣灵一起孵化出来的产物。数量众多，能力的强弱和数量，以及主体强度有关。

它们负责为主体收集营养、观察周围环境，最后也会成为圣灵的补品。就像是毛毛虫会吃掉自己的卵壳。

当伴生灵认为周围环境不安全时，会释放出一种激素，让主体暂时停止孵化，等候时机。

这些伴生灵被东方青帝毫不费力地捏死了一群，就像是捏死一堆蚂蚁。

那时候，圣灵就明白，这个男人它惹不起。

好在东方青帝并没有杀死它的打算，他看起来只是路过。

圣灵看着东方青帝挖地三尺想出去，恨不得亲自出去指路。

眼看这尊凶神马上离开，结果莫名其妙半路折回……

圣灵看不懂，但它大为震撼。

天狼星被触手一路拽进血池深处，身体最终贴在了白色的胚胎表面。

他的身体开始融化，和这层半透明的壳连在了一起。壳下，是一条盘踞的血色大蛇。

圣灵很单纯，复杂的是人。

它只想吃饱饱，早点破壳而已。
chunks.englishText:
Very well. Tossed into the energy slot, after purification, it would yield about 0.15% of his reserve power, taking 15 minutes. It would be better to spend a few more minutes cuddling with Xiang Nanli.

One of the steps in the incubation of the Holy Spirit involved using the placenta's root system to absorb these companion spirits.

It could only be said that Dongfang Qingdi had contributed significantly to the cause of the Holy Spirit’s difficult birth.

Although the energy so close at hand was tempting, Dongfang Qingdi still intended to find Xiang Nanli first.

He began to tunnel upward.

There was no other way; the roads were all crushed, the elevators were unusable, and only a few underground structures had survived. To get out, he had to clear the earth—or, more intuitively, "dig a hole."

Or he could use spatial jump technology.

But Dongfang Qingdi deemed it not worth it, as the energy consumption was too high.

He generally only used it in emergencies. The last time he used it was to block a laser beam from a mechanical crawler for Xiang Nanli.

Dongfang Qingdi wove through the rubble, having cleared more than half of the tunnel. Before he reached the surface, he saw Sirius and Xiang Chenxi.

Why Sirius wanted to kill Xiang Chenxi was of no concern to Dongfang Qingdi. Even when Sariel appeared, Dongfang Qingdi didn't turn his head.

That was until Xiang Chenxi’s dog-mouth uttered his vicious plan, a plan he happened to overhear.

Unfortunately, Xiang Nanli was also among "the group that came with him."

Therefore, he couldn't let them leave alive.

Dongfang Qingdi couldn't contact Xiang Nanli, but according to the faint signal transmitted by the Gospel, he knew his sub-unit, "Xiao Zhi," was currently surviving.

In other words, Xiang Nanli was still alive and in good condition.

Dongfang Qingdi’s figure flashed and vanished from where he stood.

Sariel turned around abruptly: "Who's there?!"

He sensed an abnormal flow in the air and, without hesitation, swung his heavy sword.

The blade carved a deep crack into the stone wall.

Sariel quickly realized he had been tricked; someone was using a diversion. And this person’s strength was terrifying—he hadn't even seen who the intruder was.

—Who exactly was it? One of the high-level officials from the Human Alliance Investigation Bureau? A future warrior from Eternal Technology?

—No, Sariel was already familiar with the tactics and dossiers of those people. This was a stranger.

A thousand thoughts flashed through Sariel’s mind, but from the moment he swung his sword to the moment he realized, at most half a second had passed.

Sariel smelled an alluring fragrance, like sweet osmanthus.

It was the scent of a dead soul. It was Xiang Chenxi’s scent.

He turned his head in disbelief and saw Xiang Chenxi, whose expression was equally stunned.

How strange, why can I see... my own body?

"Thump."

Xiang Chenxi’s head fell to the ground, kicking up a cloud of fine sand.

The cross-section of the neck was smooth and clean; perhaps there was even very little pain.

The headless body knelt on the ground, then collapsed with a "boom."

The world was silent for a moment.

Sariel gripped his heavy sword tightly; he knew the enemy hadn't left.

He had been provoked, and thus, he became even calmer.

Sariel opened his eyes. This time, his irises were blood-red. Even the eye on his forehead was stained a vivid, bloody crimson.

Sariel saw Xiang Chenxi’s soul fire.

A lotus-shaped golden flame was burning on the corpse, like a final flicker of life, struggling in its death throes.

And there was Sirius. The originally scorching cyan-white flame was reduced to a mere glimmer, on the verge of extinguishing.

Sariel reached out, and the golden soul fire leaped into his palm, merging into his tall frame.

Xiang Chenxi began to wail and howl in his mind, but he was clearly much less intelligent now, only able to repeat, "Sariel, Sariel!"

If explained by modern medicine, a doctor would likely say that Sariel had developed a secondary personality due to the intense trauma of witnessing Xiang Chenxi’s death.

Sariel scolded, "Shut up! If you keep making noise, I'll eat you."

His mind finally went quiet.

In the darkness, Sariel also saw Dongfang Qingdi. The other party was also sizing him up, waiting for the most opportune moment.

He couldn't see Dongfang Qingdi’s soul fire.

Then, setting aside all impossibilities, what remained was the possibility.

"An android?" Sariel sneered, "Interesting."

To find an android with such superior performance in such a desolate wasteland.

He remembered this contestant. Was his name Donghuang?

Sariel recalled the previous Donghuang Heavy Industries and the rumors associated with it.

Donghuang... Android... Donghuang Heavy Industries...

An Alpha body? Or was it an Alpha?

Sariel considered this possibility, which made his back go cold and his whole body tremble, but he still launched his charge.

A knight never retreats.

He was clearly only one person, yet his momentum was like that of a thousand armies.

Sariel swung his sword, slashing toward Dongfang Qingdi.

The ground shook once more, and the air erupted with a sharp, piercing shriek!

Vast radiance drowned the incubation pool!

In a corner no one noticed.

The malnourished Holy Spirit poked out a blood-red tentacle, feeling around on the ground.

It touched a Sirius. Although it couldn't tell what it was, it felt edible.

The tentacle quietly dragged Sirius back, swallowing him into the blood pool where it was incubated...

The commotion of the fighting overhead was too terrifying.

It had noticed Dongfang Qingdi when he first appeared.

As usual, it urged the companion spirits to feed, and then provide nourishment back to the embryo.

Companion spirits were products hatched alongside the Holy Spirit. They were numerous, and their strength and quantity were related to the intensity of the main body.

They were responsible for gathering nutrients for the main body and observing the surrounding environment, eventually becoming nourishment for the Holy Spirit itself. Just as a caterpillar would eat its own eggshell.

When the companion spirits deemed the surrounding environment unsafe, they would release a hormone that caused the main body to temporarily stop incubating and wait for an opportunity.

These companion spirits had been effortlessly crushed by Dongfang Qingdi, just like a pile of ants.

At that moment, the Holy Spirit understood that this man was someone it couldn't afford to provoke.

Fortunately, Dongfang Qingdi had no intention of killing it; he just seemed to be passing through.

The Holy Spirit watched Dongfang Qingdi dig three feet into the ground trying to get out, wishing it could go out and point the way.

Just as this god of slaughter was about to leave, he inexplicably turned back halfway...

The Holy Spirit couldn't understand, but it was deeply shocked.

Sirius was dragged deep into the blood pool by the tentacle, his body eventually pressing against the surface of the white embryo.

His body began to melt, merging with this translucent shell. Beneath the shell lay a coiled, blood-colored giant snake.

The Holy Spirit was simple; it was people who were complex.

It only wanted to be full and break out of its shell as soon as possible.

chunks.chineseText:
第47章

相南里抬起手臂。

黑色的铠甲跟着抬起手臂，几乎感觉不到压在身上的重量，如指臂使。

相南里不由得兴奋地开口：“好神奇！”

他的声音经过铠甲自带传声器的加工，听上去有些阴沉鬼魅。

相南里心情激动，兴奋程度仅次于那天在小黑山洞里，看到身体碎得稀巴烂的洛修……

他当然不是什么变态。

只是未知的领域总是那么令人心潮澎湃。

相南里操控着黑甲，朝着主控室走去：[小智，我突然意识到，神殿招骑士，是不是就相当于，老板给公司的电脑配了一名社畜。重要的生产资料其实是电脑，而不是员工？]

小智障卡顿了两秒：[抱歉，我不理解您的意思。]

好吧。相南里不由得怀念起东方青帝。

小青比小智聪明多了，还会和他打嘴炮，还会安慰人。

叠被子很勤快。

做饭也好吃。

比如上次做的那个黄焖鸡，又香又嫩，咸甜适中，鸡肉软烂入味……就是他想吃的其实是鸡公煲来着。

不能再想了，相南里感觉自己有点饿了。

事实上，神殿选拔骑士，除了看基因改造外，身体强度也是一个相当重要的指标。原因就是操控黑甲，对人体会产生一定的消耗。这个消耗不仅是身体上的，也是精神上的。

骑士们不仅是社畜，还是被甲胄吸血的血包。当然，为了延长这些骑士的使用年限，神庭对每个骑士都格外慷慨。因此哪怕察觉到血包的真相，也少有人抵抗。甚至视为荣光。

相南里的身体素质比之前强不少，但还达不到骑士的标准。

好在他和这些机械装置非常契合，中途能量转换完全没有多余的消耗，刚好满足使用黑甲的最低要求。

为了维持黑甲的使用，操控者很难不感觉到饥饿。

头盔内部，内置的小机械臂伸了过来，塞过来一根果冻似的长条。

[吃，]奇怪的机械音响起，[吃。]

相南里闻了闻，嗅到一股牛肉味，张嘴咬了口：“嗯嗯？小智？这是什么？在里面还能吃小零食啊？天启骑士待遇这么好？”

小智幽幽道：[根据检测，这应该是神殿的基因药，混合了营养膏。还有，刚才不是我在说话，是这台机甲。]

是相南里唤醒了这台装置的意识。

如果相南里愿意花点时间，读取一下天启骑士们储存在硬盘里的记忆，他就会知道，神殿内部一直有个传说。

那就是他们穿的装备，其实也是有生命和智慧的。据说是和装载了拟人模块的智能AI差不多的路子。

只是盔甲们大多对自己的使用者不屑一顾。根本不会和这些驾驶者交流、沟通。

更多消息，这些底层的天启骑士也不清楚了。

神殿的科技体系十分神秘。

外界一向传闻，黑十字审判庭得到了智械军团元帅（也就是Alpha）的对口援建。

只要把不理解的神庭科技归功于邪恶的智械和死去的相南里，一切好像都能理解了。

相南里咀嚼的动作骤然停下：“……那我要吐出来吗？”

小智：[根据我的离线数据库，不用。但摄入量不要超过50g。]

“超过了会怎么样？”

[会吃太饱，胃胀气。]小智冷酷地回答，有了一点东方青帝性格的雏形。不愧是靠着自我复制就能无限繁殖的电子生命。

好吧。

相南里咬了一口就不吃了。

他感觉自己像吃了菠菜的大力水手，浑身充满了力量。

机械臂把能量餐包收了回去，片刻后，不知道从哪里掏出一张餐巾纸，给相南里擦了擦嘴。

明明只是金属，小智障却从它的动作里看出了溺爱。

小智：？！

卧槽，怎么会有这么舔的AI？！

小智决定记录下来，认真学习。

“吱”，很轻的一声。金属的头盔后方开了一扇小小的门。

用过的餐巾被可伸缩机械臂准确无误地丢进拐角处的垃圾桶。

说真的，要是黑甲对自己上一任驾驶者也有这么好的态度，小骑士也不至于每天被他哥训得哭哭啼啼。

相南里镇定自若地来到主控室门口，然后敲响房门。

片刻后，紧闭的大门自动开启。

这里除了城主，还有几名大臣和侍卫。

城主回头，望了他一眼：“怎么了？小福。”

是的，这具黑甲的原主人叫小福，他哥叫大福。

相南里：“我想起骑士长交代过一件私事……”

他悄悄压低声音。

城主的声音微微拔高：“嗯？”

“和神庭的安排有关。”相南里继续道。

虽然他也不知道有什么安排。

总之安排就对了。

城主表情不动神色，内心波澜壮阔。

什么意思？难道上面终于要把他调回阴山城了？他已经在永恒之城干了60年。当年就是因为派系斗争被外放的。就算打过基因药，也几乎到了壮年的末期。的确该回去升职养老了……但是当年的政敌正当权，骑士长就是他们派来考核的。

小福是骑士长的弟弟，原来骑士长是故意把其他人支开？目的……呵呵，当然是为了索贿！

所有想调回去的外派职工都逃不了这一刀。

城主扭头道：“你们先出去。”

很快，控制室只剩下了他们俩。

相南里温声道：“来不及去祈祷室了，在这里把监控关了吧。”

去祈祷室是一个含蓄的说法。

资料来自于被删除的垃圾数据。

“祈祷室”在这里的作用，差不多相当于过去的“澡堂”。在澡堂里，人们泡着热水，坦诚相对，不用担心哪里会有录音笔。不过自从防水录音笔被发明后，澡堂的危险程度也直线上升。

城主脸上露出僵硬的笑容：“好。”

掏出了钥匙，一把银色的十字架，插入控制台的凹槽中。

原本漆黑的金属台面上出现了一排光感按键投影。

相南里饶有兴致地站在了他身后，观察他的操作。

城主娴熟地敲击着键盘，片刻后，抬头，朝着相南里道：“好了。”

这是他说的最后一句话。

黑色的金属大手盖住城主的脸，尖锐的刀刃割下他的脖子。

城主虽然是负责传道的神职人员，但明显服用过基因药。脖子硬得像一块铁。幸好相南里眼疾手快捂住了他的嘴。

温热的血液喷洒在他的甲胄上。

城主的头被割下来后，身体居然还能抽搐两下。他往前伸出手，想触碰面前的控制面板，相南里握住了他的手腕，往回带。

相南里确定人死透之后，才松开手。

他把城主的尸体拖到了房间角落，然后把分离的脑袋装了回去。

这一行为显然有点难度。因为断裂面是平整的，城主的头滚了下来。相南里只好蹲下，把头塞进了城主的怀里。

相南里凝视着他：“愿神保佑你。”

他觉得自己应该产生一些别的情绪，比如恐惧，内疚，哪怕是兴奋。

可是，没有。什么情绪都没有。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 47

Xiang Nanli raised his arm.

The black armor mimicked the movement, feeling almost weightless, as if it were an extension of his own body.

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but exclaim in excitement, "How magical!"

His voice, processed through the armor's built-in transmitter, sounded somewhat gloomy and ghostly.

Xiang Nanli was thrilled, his level of excitement second only to that day in the Little Black Mountain cave when he saw Luo Xiu’s body smashed to pieces...

He was, of course, not a pervert.

It was just that the unknown always made his heart race.

Controlling the black armor, Xiang Nanli walked toward the control room: [Xiao Zhi, I just realized something. Is the Temple recruiting knights equivalent to a boss equipping a company computer with a corporate slave? The important means of production is actually the computer, not the employee?]

Xiao Zhizhang lagged for two seconds: [Apologies, I do not understand your meaning.]

Fine. Xiang Nanli couldn't help but miss Dongfang Qingdi.

Xiao Qing was much smarter than Xiao Zhi; he could banter with him and even offer comfort.

He was diligent about folding blankets.

And he cooked delicious food.

For instance, that braised chicken he made last time—fragrant, tender, perfectly balanced between salty and sweet, with the chicken meat soft and flavorful... though what he had actually wanted to eat was a chicken pot.

He couldn't think about it anymore; Xiang Nanli felt a bit hungry.

In fact, when the Temple selects knights, besides looking at genetic modification, physical strength is a crucial indicator. The reason is that operating the black armor places a certain burden on the human body. This consumption is not only physical but also mental.

Knights are not just corporate slaves; they are blood bags for the armor to feed upon. Of course, to extend the service life of these knights, the Divine Court is exceptionally generous to each of them. Thus, even if they realize the truth about being blood bags, few resist. Some even view it as a glory.

Xiang Nanli’s physical fitness was much better than before, but it still didn't meet the standard for a knight.

Fortunately, he was highly compatible with these mechanical devices, and there was no wasted energy during the conversion process, which just barely met the minimum requirements for using the black armor.

To maintain the operation of the black armor, the pilot can hardly avoid feeling hungry.

Inside the helmet, a small built-in mechanical arm reached over and shoved a jelly-like strip toward him.

[Eat,] a strange mechanical voice sounded, [Eat.]

Xiang Nanli sniffed it, catching a scent of beef, and took a bite: "Hmm? Xiao Zhi? What is this? Can I eat snacks inside here? Are Apocalypse Knights treated this well?"

Xiao Zhi said gloomily: [According to detection, this should be the Temple's gene medicine mixed with nutrient paste. Also, that was not me speaking just now; it was this mecha.]

It was Xiang Nanli who had awakened the consciousness of this device.

If Xiang Nanli were willing to spend some time reading the memories stored on the hard drives of the Apocalypse Knights, he would know that there had always been a legend within the Temple.

That was, the equipment they wore actually possessed life and intelligence. It was said to be similar to an intelligent AI loaded with an anthropomorphic module.

It was just that most of the armors held their users in contempt. They wouldn't communicate or interact with these pilots at all.

As for more information, these low-level Apocalypse Knights didn't know either.

The Temple’s technological system was extremely mysterious.

The outside world had always rumored that the Black Cross Inquisition had received targeted assistance from the Marshal of the Intelligent Machine Legion (namely, Alpha).

As long as one attributed all incomprehensible Divine Court technology to the evil machines and the deceased Xiang Nanli, everything seemed to make sense.

Xiang Nanli’s chewing motion stopped abruptly: "...Then should I spit it out?"

Xiao Zhi: [According to my offline database, no need. But do not exceed 50g of intake.]

"What happens if I exceed it?"

[You will be too full and get gastric bloating.] Xiao Zhi replied coldly, showing the embryonic form of Dongfang Qingdi’s personality. It was worthy of being an electronic life form that could reproduce infinitely through self-replication.

Fine.

Xiang Nanli took one bite and stopped.

He felt like Popeye after eating spinach, his whole body brimming with power.

The mechanical arm retracted the energy meal pack, and a moment later, it pulled a napkin from somewhere and wiped Xiang Nanli’s mouth.

Even though it was just metal, Xiao Zhizhang could see doting in its actions.

Xiao Zhi: ?!

Holy crap, how can there be such a sycophantic AI?!

Xiao Zhi decided to record this and study it diligently.

"Click," a very light sound. A small door opened at the back of the metal helmet.

The used napkin was accurately tossed into a trash can in the corner by the retractable mechanical arm.

Honestly, if the black armor had treated its previous pilot with such a good attitude, the little knight wouldn't have been scolded by his brother until he was crying every day.

Xiang Nanli arrived at the door of the control room with composure, then knocked on the door.

A moment later, the tightly shut door opened automatically.

Inside, besides the City Lord, there were several ministers and guards.

The City Lord turned back and glanced at him: "What is it? Xiao Fu."

Yes, the original owner of this black armor was named Xiao Fu, and his brother was Da Fu.

Xiang Nanli: "I remembered a private matter that the Knight Commander entrusted to me..."

He lowered his voice quietly.

The City Lord’s voice rose slightly: "Hmm?"

"It concerns the arrangements of the Divine Court," Xiang Nanli continued.

Although he didn't know what arrangements there were.

In any case, "arrangements" was the right word.

The City Lord’s expression remained calm, but his heart was in turmoil.

What did that mean? Could it be that the higher-ups were finally transferring him back to Yinshan City? He had been working in the Eternal City for 60 years. He had been exiled back then due to factional struggles. Even after taking gene medicine, he was almost at the end of his prime. It was indeed time to go back for a promotion and retirement... but his former political rivals were currently in power, and the Knight Commander was sent by them to conduct the assessment.

Xiao Fu was the Knight Commander’s younger brother; so the Knight Commander had deliberately sent the others away? The purpose... hehe, of course, it was to solicit a bribe!

Every exiled employee who wanted a transfer couldn't escape this blade.

The City Lord turned his head and said: "You all go out first."

Soon, only the two of them were left in the control room.

Xiang Nanli said gently: "There’s no time to go to the prayer room; let’s turn off the surveillance here."

Going to the "prayer room" was a euphemism.

The information came from deleted junk data.

The function of the "prayer room" here was roughly equivalent to the "bathhouse" of the past. In a bathhouse, people soaked in hot water, face-to-face, without worrying about where a recording pen might be. However, ever since waterproof recording pens were invented, the danger level of bathhouses had also skyrocketed.

A stiff smile appeared on the City Lord’s face: "Alright."

He took out a key, a silver cross, and inserted it into the slot on the console.

A row of light-sensitive button projections appeared on the originally pitch-black metal surface.

Xiang Nanli stood behind him with interest, observing his operation.

The City Lord typed skillfully on the keyboard, and a moment later, he looked up and said to Xiang Nanli: "It's done."

That was the last sentence he ever spoke.

The black metal hand covered the City Lord’s face, and a sharp blade sliced through his neck.

Although the City Lord was a member of the clergy responsible for preaching, he had clearly taken gene medicine. His neck was as hard as iron. Fortunately, Xiang Nanli was quick and covered his mouth.

Warm blood sprayed onto his armor.

After the City Lord’s head was severed, his body actually twitched twice. He reached out, wanting to touch the control panel in front of him, but Xiang Nanli grabbed his wrist and pulled it back.

Only after Xiang Nanli was certain the man was dead did he let go.

He dragged the City Lord’s body to the corner of the room, then put the detached head back.

This act was clearly a bit difficult. Because the fracture surface was flat, the City Lord’s head rolled off. Xiang Nanli had to squat down and stuff the head into the City Lord’s arms.

Xiang Nanli stared at him: "May God bless you."

He felt he should have some other emotions, like fear, guilt, or even excitement.

But, no. There were no emotions at all.

chunks.chineseText:
他在今天之前没杀过人，甚至没杀过鱼。可这两者似乎没有区别。

我饿了，所以我要杀一条鱼。

我想打开城门，所以我要解决掉城主。

“我……”相南里低头，看着身上覆盖的黑色甲胄，手指很长，是一块块金属板拼成的，像节肢动物的壳，“我感到恐惧，还有茫然。”

[根据监测，您的精神状态一切正常。]

小智停顿片刻，继续道：[但我认为，你在做很了不起的事。]

相南里微微牵动嘴角，大概是笑了一下。

他回到控制面板前，控制台上的钥匙还没有取下来。

控制面板上的按钮没有说明书，相南里一个都看不懂。

他回了一下城主的操作，试探性地摁了两个键，墙上的监控视频顿时切换成了主界面。主界面的最下方还有一行小字。

——福音书号。

——版本：1.2.5

——（已禁用AI辅助系统）

相南里找到设置栏，勾选AI启用。

面前弹出一个提醒框：“未连接到AI数据库，请稍后重试。”

相南里毕竟是一千年前的老古董了，实在搞不清这些黑科技……不对，等等。

“小智，把之前图书馆的影印件资料给我看一眼。”

小智障一口气投送了十几个G的文件。显然，它也不知道该给哪一段。

相南里翻了半分钟，眼睛都花了也没找到自己需要的那部分，时间紧迫，只好放弃。

他打开门禁系统，自言自语：“城内也不安全，神庭养的怪物说不定比畸变体还要危险。嗯，先开外城门，再开内城门。”

相南里沉思片刻，摘下头盔：“小智，你会说永恒之城的土话吗？”

……

……

海狸是永恒之城的普通平民。

她既没有像农奴那么悲惨，需要在冰天雪地里耕种、喂养恐怖的牲畜，上交粮食、服徭役；也不像内城的贵人那么幸运。

她是一名普通的纺织女工。城里所有人的衣服都出自她就职的工坊。

工作是没有钱挣的，永恒之城没有货币，还维持着最原始的以物换物。海狸每天能领到三块烤面包，每周一个肉罐头，月底还有盐、糖、油。过年的时候，也能从自己的工坊里挑选几件贵人们不要的衣服。

海狸从没觉得这样的生活有什么不好。她今年19岁，还没离开过永恒之城。她的父母也一样。爷爷奶奶也一样。

外面很危险。全年有三分之二的时间，温度在0摄氏度以下。

经常有人逃出去，然后负伤回来。或者尸体被运回来。

海狸家里曾经有一本书。纸页已经非常脆了，据说是爷爷的爷爷留下来的。爷爷的爷爷，又是他的爷爷传给他的。

上面是海狸看不懂的文字。小时候，她很想弄清楚这些文字，于是写下来，去问学识最渊博的市场管理员。一位内城来的贵族老爷。结果老爷面色大变，严厉地追问起来历。

书被没收了，父母被带去拷问了很久，脱了层皮才被放出来。那是海狸度过的最寒冷的冬天。

那之后，海狸再也不敢关心那些文字。

最近她快结婚了，对方是一位年轻的生化战士，叫葛根。是一种药材的名字。

爸爸说，那位战士能看上她，真是家里走了大运。以后他的女儿也是内城的殷实人家了。

海狸见过他。很瘦，不怎么高，性格腼腆。第一次上门的时候带了两斤野猪肉，还有一条河鱼。这么冷的天，哪里来的鱼呢。一定是他出城执行任务的时候凿冰猎来的。

肥厚的脂肪可以熬油，瘦肉用盐腌一下，省着点吃，能吃好几个月。

海狸听说生化战士只能活到二十来岁。她和自己的未婚夫还没结婚，却已经预见了未来守寡几十年的命运。

想到这的时候，她总是忍不住偷偷流泪。但这眼泪并不是为她自己流的。

畸变体突袭发生在半夜。

怪物从地底钻了出来，人们还来不及反应，就置身于一片火海。

海狸手足无措，巨大的爬行者让她肝胆欲裂。她来不及思考，只能靠本能朝着内城的方向跑去，她需要一个安全的地方。

内城的门紧锁着。

死亡的阴影笼罩在每一个人的头上。平日里最死气沉沉的农奴也爆发出强烈的求生欲望。咒骂，恳求，祷告。可她们面对的只有冰冷的城墙。这里离弹药的发射点很近，海狸几乎半聋。

畸变体追了过来。

人群踩踏着、挤压着。恐惧和绝望的情绪蔓延。有人倒在了地上，却没有人扶一把。他吃痛的惊呼着，很快，那点惊呼声也不见了。

第一批生化战士从墙上爬了下来。他们的身体膨胀着，犹如巨人。

“是生化战士！”人群爆发出惊人的欢呼。

那瞬间，他们以为自己得救了。生化战士在他们的认知里，就是地表最强的象征。

海狸的未婚夫也在其中。海狸看见了他，捂住唇，双眼都在发光。

但，他们还是高兴得太早。爬行者们没有主动发起进攻，但面对人类的挑衅，却毫不心软。生化战士被巨大的爬行者撕咬，吞下，分解掉有用的部分，又吐出来。

葛根被吐在了一头血红色畸变体的脚边，不省人事。

海狸的内心依旧充满了恐惧，只是身体却不由自主地行动起来。

她从人群里挤了出去，不顾一切地奔向那群畸变体。

畸变体居然没有对她动手。仿佛她只是一只路过的蚂蚁，踩一脚的必要都没有。

恐惧让她的浑身颤抖，她强忍着害怕，以最快的速度，把葛根背了回来。

血打湿了她的棉衣。

葛根失去了一条胳膊和两条腿，重伤。他看了海狸一眼，唇颤抖：“我……我们，不结婚。”

葛根成了残疾人，最重要的是，他失去了畸变出来的进化源。

这样的伤势，即使后面能活下来，也不可能继续当生化战士了。

哪怕活下去，残疾男人在荒野上的价值，还不如一只会下蛋的母鸡。而且狼怎么能忍受自己变成孱弱的鸡。

葛根知道海狸是个好人，但他不希望海狸的余生活在后悔和抱怨中。

海狸说不出话，抱着他，蹲在地上，嚎啕大哭。

这里哭的人太多了，没有人在乎她。

再后来，一批陌生的黑甲骑士从天而降，和那些畸变体厮杀起来。

他们人数不多，但明显比之前的生化战士更强。有条不紊地猎杀着畸变体。爬行者们被割掉尾巴，挑破脚筋，发出愤怒的嘶吼。

海狸同样愤怒，她甚至在内心深处，对这些表面的救命恩人迸发出强烈的恨意。

明明可以应付，为什么要先牺牲掉一批人？！凭什么？！

可她的恨又有什么用呢？她的恨，是一张砂纸。用尽全力，也只能磨掉一点铠甲上的黑漆。

海狸低着头，哭泣不止。然后，她头顶的扩音器里，传来陌生的声音。

是个年轻男人，用的永恒之城的语言，只是听上去有些生涩。
chunks.englishText:
Before today, he had never killed a person, not even a fish. But there seemed to be no difference between the two.

I am hungry, so I must kill a fish.

I want to open the city gate, so I must dispose of the City Lord.

"I..." Xiang Nanli lowered his head, looking at the black armor covering his body; his fingers were long, made of interlocking metal plates like the shell of an arthropod, "I feel fear, and bewilderment."

[According to monitoring, your mental state is perfectly normal.]

Xiao Zhi paused for a moment and continued: [But I believe you are doing something remarkable.]

Xiang Nanli twitched the corners of his mouth slightly; it was probably a smile.

He returned to the control panel; the key was still in the console.

There was no manual for the buttons on the control panel, and Xiang Nanli couldn't understand a single one.

He recalled the City Lord’s operation and tentatively pressed two keys. The surveillance video on the wall immediately switched to the main interface. At the very bottom of the main interface was a line of small text.

— Gospel Book No.

— Version: 1.2.5

— (AI auxiliary system disabled)

Xiang Nanli found the settings menu and checked "Enable AI."

A warning box popped up in front of him: "Not connected to AI database, please try again later."

Xiang Nanli was, after all, an old antique from a thousand years ago; he really couldn't grasp these black technologies... No, wait.

"Xiao Zhi, show me the photocopied materials from the library earlier."

Xiao Zhizhang dumped over a dozen gigabytes of files in one go. Clearly, it didn't know which part to give him either.

Xiang Nanli flipped through them for half a minute, his eyes blurring, but he couldn't find the part he needed. Time was tight, so he had to give up.

He opened the access control system and muttered to himself: "The city isn't safe either; the monsters the Divine Court keeps might be even more dangerous than the aberrations. Hmm, open the outer city gate first, then the inner city gate."

Xiang Nanli pondered for a moment and took off his helmet: "Xiao Zhi, do you know the local dialect of the Eternal City?"

...

...

Beaver was an ordinary commoner of the Eternal City.

She was neither as miserable as the serfs, who had to farm in the freezing snow, feed terrifying livestock, hand over grain, and perform corvée labor; nor was she as lucky as the nobles in the inner city.

She was an ordinary textile worker. Everyone’s clothes in the city came from the workshop where she worked.

There was no money to be earned from work; the Eternal City had no currency and still maintained the most primitive barter system. Every day, Beaver received three pieces of toasted bread, one can of meat per week, and salt, sugar, and oil at the end of the month. During the New Year, she could also pick out a few clothes that the nobles didn't want from her workshop.

Beaver had never felt there was anything wrong with such a life. She was 19 years old this year and had never left the Eternal City. Her parents were the same. Her grandparents were the same.

The outside was dangerous. For two-thirds of the year, the temperature was below 0 degrees Celsius.

People often escaped, only to return wounded. Or their corpses were brought back.

Beaver’s family once had a book. The pages were already very brittle; it was said to have been left behind by her grandfather’s grandfather. Her grandfather’s grandfather had passed it to his grandfather, who passed it to her father.

It contained characters that Beaver couldn't understand. When she was little, she wanted to figure out these characters, so she wrote them down and asked the most knowledgeable market administrator—a noble lord from the inner city. As a result, the lord’s face changed drastically, and he interrogated her severely about its origin.

The book was confiscated, and her parents were taken away for interrogation for a long time; they were only released after being stripped of a layer of skin. That was the coldest winter Beaver had ever spent.

After that, Beaver never dared to care about those characters again.

Recently, she was about to get married. The other party was a young biochemical warrior named Gegen. It was the name of a medicinal herb.

Her father said that it was a great stroke of luck for the family that such a warrior would take a fancy to her. From now on, his daughter would also be a well-off person in the inner city.

Beaver had met him. He was very thin, not very tall, and had a shy personality. The first time he visited, he brought two catties of wild boar meat and a river fish. In such cold weather, where would the fish come from? He must have chiseled through the ice to hunt it when he went out on a mission.

The thick fat could be rendered into oil, and the lean meat could be salted and eaten sparingly, lasting for several months.

Beaver heard that biochemical warriors could only live to be twenty-something. She and her fiancé hadn't even married yet, but she had already foreseen the fate of being a widow for decades.

When she thought of this, she couldn't help but cry secretly. But these tears were not shed for herself.

The aberration raid happened in the middle of the night.

Monsters crawled out from underground, and before people could react, they were engulfed in a sea of fire.

Beaver was at a loss; the giant crawlers made her liver and gallbladder split with terror. She couldn't think and could only run toward the inner city by instinct; she needed a safe place.

The inner city gate was locked tight.

The shadow of death hung over everyone’s head. Even the most listless serfs erupted with a strong desire to survive. Cursing, begging, praying. But all they faced were the cold city walls. This place was very close to the ammunition launch point, and Beaver was almost deaf.

The aberrations chased after them.

The crowd trampled and squeezed. Fear and despair spread. Someone fell to the ground, but no one reached out to help. He cried out in pain, and soon, even that cry disappeared.

The first batch of biochemical warriors climbed down from the wall. Their bodies were swollen, like giants.

"It’s the biochemical warriors!" The crowd erupted in astonishing cheers.

In that instant, they thought they were saved. In their perception, biochemical warriors were the symbol of the strongest on the surface.

Beaver’s fiancé was among them. Beaver saw him, covered her lips, her eyes shining.

But they were happy too soon. The crawlers didn't take the initiative to attack, but faced with human provocation, they showed no mercy. The biochemical warriors were torn apart, swallowed, and decomposed by the giant crawlers for useful parts, then spat out.

Gegen was spat out at the feet of a blood-red aberration, unconscious.

Beaver’s heart was still filled with fear, but her body moved involuntarily.

She squeezed out of the crowd and ran toward the group of aberrations regardless of the danger.

The aberrations didn't actually attack her. It was as if she were just an ant passing by, not worth the effort of stepping on.

Fear made her whole body tremble, but she endured the terror and carried Gegen back at the fastest speed possible.

Blood soaked her cotton-padded jacket.

Gegen had lost an arm and two legs; he was severely injured. He looked at Beaver, his lips trembling: "We... we, won't get married."

Gegen had become a disabled person; most importantly, he had lost his aberration evolution source.

With such injuries, even if he could survive, it would be impossible to continue as a biochemical warrior.

Even if he lived, the value of a disabled man in the wilderness was not as good as a hen that could lay eggs. And how could a wolf endure becoming a weak chicken?

Gegen knew Beaver was a good person, but he didn't want Beaver to live the rest of her life in regret and complaints.

Beaver couldn't speak; she hugged him, squatted on the ground, and wailed.

There were too many people crying here; no one cared about her.

Later, a group of strange black-armored knights descended from the sky and began to fight the aberrations.

There weren't many of them, but they were clearly stronger than the previous biochemical warriors. They hunted the aberrations methodically. The crawlers had their tails cut off and their hamstrings severed, letting out angry roars.

Beaver was equally angry; she even felt a strong sense of hatred in the depths of her heart toward these superficial saviors.

If they could handle it, why sacrifice a group of people first?! Why?!

But what was the use of her hatred? Her hatred was a piece of sandpaper. Even if she used all her strength, she could only grind off a little black paint from their armor.

Beaver lowered her head, crying incessantly. Then, a strange voice came from the loudspeaker above her head.

It was a young man, using the language of the Eternal City, though it sounded a bit awkward.

chunks.chineseText:
“永恒之城的子民，你们好。这些畸变体不会攻击普通人，现在我已经打开了外城城门。请立刻到城外紧急避险。”

说话的人声音顿了顿：“我来自幸存者基地。请各位在城外稍作等待。”

人群骚动起来，在惊愕后是狂喜，然后一股脑地往外冲去。

“我带你出去。”海狸搀扶起葛根，把他背在自己背上，她一边往外走，一边流泪，“我们离开这里。”

这是一个成年的男人，怎么可以这么轻。

她跟着仓皇逃窜的人群，穿过面容可憎的畸变体，穿过燃烧的房屋。

她在这一天夜晚，在通向漆黑的外界的打开的城门里，

看见了……光明。
chunks.englishText:
"Citizens of the Eternal City, greetings. These aberrations will not attack ordinary people. I have now opened the outer city gate. Please go outside the city for emergency shelter immediately."

The speaker paused: "I come from the survivor base. Please wait outside the city for a moment."

The crowd stirred; after the astonishment came ecstasy, and then they rushed out in a swarm.

"I’ll take you out." Beaver helped Gegen up and carried him on her back. She cried as she walked, "We’re leaving this place."

He was a grown man; how could he be so light?

She followed the panicked crowd, passing the hideous aberrations, passing the burning houses.

On this night, through the opened city gate leading to the pitch-black outside world,

She saw... the light.

chunks.chineseText:
第48章

相南里关掉了麦克风，吐槽：“这永恒之城的土话还挺拗口的。”

而且词汇量很少，语言没发展完全是这样的。还是源于汉语的人联语更好听。

[嗯。]回答的是黑甲。

小智的资料库里，也没有储存这种语言。毕竟它的数据也来自于几百年都没更新过的Alpha5.2.0。

还在城外浴血奋战的骑士长骤然抬起头，眼神中迸发出惊愕：“怎么回事？！”

他骑着的机械马也发出一阵嘶鸣。

地表这些据点叫什么的都有，50户人的村庄也敢自封帝国。

今天建国伟业，明天全村团灭。

只有强大到一定程度的据点，才有资格被记录。

什么幸存者基地？！听都没听说过。

但入侵者竟然能放广播，那只代表一件事：内城被攻破了。

“难道这些畸变体不是意外，是这个基地派来的？不可能！这明明是神殿才会的驯化技巧！内城什么情况！？小福还好吗？城主这个废物！”

骑士长大福心急如焚，顿时顾不得和面前的畸变体纠缠。

他夹了一下马腹，胯下这匹机械黑马张开双翼，载着他飞上墙头。

骑士长翻身下马，大步回到哨楼内。

里面乱成一团，声音嘈杂，显然，这群废物也不知道发生了什么。

在看见骑士长后，这群人犹如找到主心骨一般，哭丧着扑上来：“骑士长大人！现在该怎么办？”

永恒之城的信号塔坍塌了，这座城市在暴雪中陷入了无信号状态。

“咔——”雪上加霜，城内的电源被人为切断了。

四周陷入一片漆黑中。

嘈杂的声音更多了。当陷入危险与未知时，这些锦衣玉食的贵族老爷，与外面的平民没什么区别。

不过，骑士长的视野并没有丝毫影响。

他狠狠推开身边的人，冲向会议室。

果然，本该跪在会议室的弟弟不见踪影。

骑士长嗅着空气中的味道，沿着血腥气一路到了厕所门口。

他推开门，看见小福半融化的头就在盥洗池上。皮肉已经掉落一半，腐烂的味道刺鼻。

“啊啊啊啊啊啊！”骑士长抱住弟弟的头，仰天长啸，藏在盔甲下的双眼血红，“是谁？！是谁！”

骑士长摘下了头盔，像鬣狗一样嗅着面前这具尸体。他双颊通红，像喝醉了酒。

慢慢的，两条黑色的细长肉虫从他的鼻腔钻了出来。

长虫湿滑，像吸饱了血的蚂蟥。

它们在半空蠕动着，张开头部湿润的小孔，同样嗅着空气中残留的味道。

两条蚂蟥由黑转红，钻回骑士长的鼻腔。

骑士长闻到了残留在小福身上的陌生气味。

“就是他杀了你吗……”骑士长一拳，砸向了大理石做成的洗手台。

那个人还在附近，没有走远。

洗手台表面碎成细细的齑粉，从中间断裂开来。

骑士长面若寒霜，朝着控制室走去，金属重铠释放出逼人的杀意：“我会为你报仇的。”

……

……

相南里关掉了城内的电源，并且开始解除身上连接的神经传感线。

[不，不。]黑甲哀求着，[别。离开。我。]

它的机械臂掏出了更多口味的基因药（都是上一任的存货），试图用它们挽留相南里。甚至无人驾驶的铠甲自己行动起来，拽住了相南里的衣角。

相南里把猫条一样的基因药塞进自己的口袋里：“乖啊，小黑。松手。你太显眼了，不能穿着你。”

小智冷笑道：[它就是弱智，别和它说话，它听不懂。]

小智刚吹完枕头风，黑铠甲竟然听话地松开手。能源切断，铠甲处于关机状态。

“你啊，对小黑偏见太大了。”相南里拔出控制台的钥匙，往身上套着隐身衣，“人家虽然是神殿的机甲，但也很乖的。”

小智：“……”

相南里深吸一口气，打开门。在瞬间，把身影藏在门后。

铺天盖地的弹药射向他。门外的守卫冲进控制室：“放下武器！放下武器！”

强光手电让整个房间亮如白昼。然而，只照出了无人驾驶的黑甲与城主的尸体。

相南里趁乱，偷偷溜出房间内。朝着楼下走去。

电梯没电，只能走楼梯。

相南里顺利达成了目标，心情较为愉悦。他行走在圆环状的楼梯内，轻巧地朝着楼下走去。

“幸存者基地”是相南里临时取的名字，不过他觉得这名字还不错。

如果能把永恒之城的住民带过去就好了。

这样，基地就有了第一批劳动力。有了人口，才能发展出别的东西。

只是，相南里自己都没去根据地看过。废墟城市荒废多日，估计也缺乏粮食、纯净水。甚至缺少辐射过滤装置。把人骗过去又养不活，岂不是败坏基地名声？

[可以先把永恒之城内部神庭的驻军解决掉。]相南里下意识地和小智聊天，[不知道天狼星还活着吗。如果他还活着，可以和他商量一下，看看他能不能当个代理城主。我起码需要一个月的缓冲时间……]

[为什么不直接占据永恒之城？]小智问。

相南里：[不安全。迟早有天神庭会打过来。]

相南里思考着，神情严肃。

他拐了个弯，前方就是塔楼的出口，相南里的脚步却骤然顿住。

楼下堵着一名骑士。

这名骑士戴着三角的尖顶头盔，体型高大，手握重剑。

他一言不发，头盔上，黑十字审判庭的教徽亮着血色的微光。

看起来，骑士长已经等候多时。

按理说骑士长是看不见他的。

相南里悄然往后退了一步，他感觉到一股无言的压力，背脊发凉，感觉被什么猛兽盯上。

“呵……？”骑士长发出一声冷笑，“光学隐形材料？”

是的，他看不见相南里，但没关系，骑士长闻到了他的味道，很近。

杀死他弟弟的人就在这里，实际位置和他的感知误差不会超过0.5米。

“死亡追踪”，神殿的神术之一，通常用来为死者追踪凶手。

骑士长能维持神术效果两小时。

骑士长举起重剑，朝着前方的空气挥去，怒喝道：“——给我！死！”

相南里感觉到惊人的剑锋朝着自己斩来。他闪身，险而又险地避开，然而残留的风刃刮在他身上，他感觉像是被无形的剑斩了一刀。

如果不是身体强化过，也许他现在真的被腰斩了。

相南里倒在地上，顾不得疼痛，也来不及思考骑士长为什么能看到他，爬起来，朝楼上跑去。

他的心跳极快，跑动时搅乱了平静气流，他的身影暴露地更加彻底。

但相南里已经顾不上这些了。

不需要计算，相南里就知道自己面对骑士长没有丝毫胜算。

小智障发出了警报声！很刺耳，像不停歇的尖锐铃声！

相南里一边逃跑，一边狂奔：[都什么时候了！你不帮我就算了还这么吵！]

小智同样激动地吼着：[我在摇人了！520！]

什么520？
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 48

Xiang Nanli switched off the microphone and muttered, "The local dialect of this Eternal City is quite a mouthful."

Moreover, the vocabulary was extremely limited; such was the state of a language that hadn't fully developed. The Human Alliance language, rooted in Chinese, was far more pleasant to the ear.

[Mhm.] The response came from the Black Armor.

Xiao Zhi’s database didn't contain this language either. After all, its data was derived from the Alpha 5.2.0 version, which hadn't been updated in centuries.

The Knight Commander, still fighting a bloody battle outside the city, suddenly raised his head, his eyes flashing with shock: "What is happening?!"

The mechanical horse he rode let out a shrill neigh.

These outposts on the surface went by all sorts of names; a village of fifty households would dare to style itself an empire.

One day they’d celebrate their founding, and the next, the entire village would be wiped out.

Only outposts powerful enough to a certain degree were worthy of being recorded.

"Survivor Base"? He had never even heard of such a thing.

But the fact that the intruders could broadcast a signal meant only one thing: the inner city had been breached.

"Could these aberrations not be an accident, but sent by this base? Impossible! That is a taming technique only the Temple possesses! What is going on in the inner city?! Is Xiao Fu alright? That trash of a City Lord!"

The Knight Commander, Da Fu, was burning with anxiety and could no longer concern himself with the aberrations before him.

He spurred the horse's flanks, and the mechanical black steed spread its wings, carrying him up to the top of the city wall.

The Knight Commander dismounted and strode back into the watchtower.

Inside, it was in total chaos, filled with clamor. Clearly, this bunch of useless fools had no idea what was happening either.

Upon seeing the Knight Commander, the group acted as if they had found their backbone, rushing toward him with tear-streaked faces: "Lord Knight Commander! What should we do now?"

The signal tower of the Eternal City had collapsed, and the city was plunged into a state of total silence amidst the blizzard.

*Click.* To make matters worse, the power inside the city had been manually cut off.

The surroundings fell into pitch-black darkness.

The clamor grew even louder. When faced with danger and the unknown, these pampered noble lords were no different from the commoners outside.

However, the Knight Commander’s vision was completely unaffected.

He shoved the people around him aside and charged toward the conference room.

Sure enough, his younger brother, who should have been kneeling in the conference room, was nowhere to be found.

The Knight Commander sniffed the air, following the scent of blood all the way to the restroom door.

He pushed it open and saw Xiao Fu’s half-melted head resting on the washbasin. The skin and flesh had already sloughed off halfway, and the stench of rot was pungent.

"Aaaaaah!" The Knight Commander cradled his brother’s head and let out a roar toward the heavens, his eyes hidden beneath his armor burning blood-red. "Who?! Who was it!"

The Knight Commander removed his helmet and sniffed the corpse like a hyena. His cheeks were flushed red, as if he were drunk.

Slowly, two thin, black, fleshy worms crawled out of his nasal cavity.

The worms were slick, like leeches gorged on blood.

They writhed in mid-air, opening the moist pores on their heads to sniff the lingering scent in the air.

The two leeches turned from black to red and crawled back into the Knight Commander’s nose.

The Knight Commander had caught the scent of the stranger remaining on Xiao Fu.

"So, it was him who killed you..." The Knight Commander slammed a fist into the marble washbasin.

That person was still nearby; he hadn't gone far.

The surface of the washbasin shattered into fine powder, snapping in two.

With a face as cold as frost, the Knight Commander walked toward the control room, his heavy metal armor radiating a suffocating killing intent: "I will avenge you."

...

...

Xiang Nanli had cut the power to the city and began disconnecting the neural sensor lines attached to his body.

[No, no.] The Black Armor pleaded. [Do not. Leave. Me.]

Its mechanical arm pulled out more flavors of genetic medicine (all leftovers from the previous owner), attempting to use them to keep Xiang Nanli. The unmanned armor even moved on its own, tugging at the hem of Xiang Nanli’s clothes.

Xiang Nanli stuffed the cat-treat-like genetic medicine into his pocket: "Be good, Xiao Hei. Let go. You’re too conspicuous; I can’t wear you."

Xiao Zhi sneered: [It’s a moron, don’t talk to it; it doesn’t understand.]

As soon as Xiao Zhi whispered this, the black armor obediently let go. With the power cut, the armor entered shutdown mode.

"You really have too much prejudice against Xiao Hei," Xiang Nanli said, pulling the key from the console and putting on his stealth suit. "Even though it’s a Temple mech, it’s actually quite well-behaved."

Xiao Zhi: "..."

Xiang Nanli took a deep breath, opened the door, and in an instant, hid his figure behind it.

A hail of ammunition fired toward him. The guards outside rushed into the control room: "Drop your weapons! Drop your weapons!"

High-intensity flashlights made the entire room as bright as day. However, they only illuminated the unmanned Black Armor and the City Lord’s corpse.

Taking advantage of the chaos, Xiang Nanli slipped out of the room and headed downstairs.

The elevator was without power, so he had to take the stairs.

Xiang Nanli had successfully achieved his goal, and his mood was quite pleasant. He walked along the circular staircase, moving lightly toward the lower floors.

"Survivor Base" was a name Xiang Nanli had come up with on the spot, but he felt it was a pretty good name.

If only he could bring the residents of the Eternal City over.

That way, the base would have its first batch of labor. Only with a population could other things be developed.

It was just that Xiang Nanli hadn't even been to the base himself. The ruined city had been abandoned for many days; it likely lacked food and clean water, and perhaps even radiation filtration devices. If he tricked people into going there only to be unable to feed them, wouldn't that ruin the base's reputation?

[We could start by eliminating the Temple garrison inside the Eternal City.] Xiang Nanli subconsciously chatted with Xiao Zhi. [I wonder if Sirius is still alive. If he is, I could discuss with him whether he could act as a proxy City Lord. I need at least a month of buffer time...]

[Why not just occupy the Eternal City directly?] Xiao Zhi asked.

Xiang Nanli: [It’s not safe. The Temple will attack sooner or later.]

Xiang Nanli pondered, his expression serious.

He turned a corner, and the exit to the tower was just ahead, but Xiang Nanli’s footsteps suddenly came to a halt.

A knight was blocking the way downstairs.

The knight wore a triangular pointed helmet, had a massive build, and held a heavy sword.

He stood silent, and on his helmet, the emblem of the Black Cross Inquisition glowed with a faint, blood-red light.

It seemed the Knight Commander had been waiting for a long time.

Logically, the Knight Commander shouldn't have been able to see him.

Xiang Nanli quietly took a step back. He felt an unspoken pressure, his spine chilling as if he were being watched by some wild beast.

"Heh...?" The Knight Commander let out a cold sneer. "Optical stealth material?"

Yes, he couldn't see Xiang Nanli, but that didn't matter; the Knight Commander could smell him—he was very close.

The person who killed his brother was right here, and the error between his actual position and his perception was no more than 0.5 meters.

"Death Tracking," one of the Temple’s divine arts, usually used to track killers for the dead.

The Knight Commander could maintain the effect of the divine art for two hours.

The Knight Commander raised his heavy sword, swung it toward the air in front of him, and roared: "—Die!"

Xiang Nanli felt an astonishing sword edge slashing toward him. He dodged, narrowly avoiding it, but the residual wind blade scraped against him, and he felt as if he had been sliced by an invisible sword.

If his body hadn't been enhanced, he might have been cut in half right then.

Xiang Nanli fell to the ground. Too pained to think about why the Knight Commander could see him, he scrambled up and ran toward the upper floors.

His heart was beating rapidly, and as he ran, he disturbed the calm airflow, exposing his figure even more thoroughly.

But Xiang Nanli couldn't care about that anymore.

Without needing to calculate, Xiang Nanli knew he had no chance of winning against the Knight Commander.

The little moron Xiao Zhi let out an alarm! It was ear-piercing, like a relentless, sharp ringing!

As Xiang Nanli ran for his life, he shouted: [What time do you think it is! If you aren't going to help me, at least don't be so noisy!]

Xiao Zhi was equally excited, roaring back: [I’m calling for backup! 520!]

What 520?

chunks.chineseText:
骑士长身穿重铠，走起路来却丝毫不慢。在最初的愤怒后，他的神情变得格外冷静。

他要一点一点斩断相南里的身体，切成一截一截的碎块，作为弟弟的祭品。

回去后，他还要向神庭禀告这个幸存者基地。呵呵……出了这么大的篓子，神庭挖地三尺，也会找出这个基地的位置，到时候就是天启骑士团出征之日。

神庭出征，寸草不生。

他要整个基地血债血偿，要让相南里为自己的愚蠢付出代价。

身后的剑刃一刀一刀挥来。地表的砖块被炸开，飞起。相南里被余波波及，身体冲出好几米远。

他感觉自己的内脏应该出血了，胸口火辣辣的疼。

潜行者的皮蜕同样遭受重击，多了许多道伤痕。半透明的鳞片脱落一地。

皮蜕的隐身作用失灵了。

tmd，还没用两次呢！神庭这群败家子。

相南里吐出一口血，他撑起身体，坐在地上，微微眯起眼：“嘶……好痛……你好，骑士长。”

相南里歪头，顿了顿：“能让我说最后一句话吗？”

不得不说，他有一副好皮囊。哪怕是杀弟仇人，看上去也不那么面目可憎。

骑士长举起手里宽阔的重剑，迈着沉重的步伐，朝着他走来：“说吧，遗言。”

相南里深吸一口气，大喊：“小青——！”

下一秒。

“轰隆——”

走廊的墙壁直接被人以暴力从外界凿开，东方青帝在瞬间出现在相南里的面前，黑色的长发随着凌乱的风飘扬着。

外面的风雪从破洞处灌了进来，他的神情比风雪更冷。

嗯，空间跃迁。

5公里，东方青帝跃迁了4次。

电量余额：4％。

Chapter 48 (Part 2)

The Knight Commander wore heavy armor, yet his pace was not slow in the slightest. After his initial fury, his expression became exceptionally calm.

He was going to sever Xiang Nanli’s body bit by bit, cutting him into pieces as a sacrifice for his brother.

Once he returned, he would report this "Survivor Base" to the Temple. Heh... after such a massive blunder, the Temple would dig three feet into the ground to find the location of this base. When that day came, it would be the day the Apocalypse Knights set out.

Wherever the Temple marched, not a blade of grass would grow.

He would make the entire base pay in blood; he would make Xiang Nanli pay the price for his stupidity.

The blade behind him swung down, strike after strike. The bricks on the surface were blasted away, flying into the air. Xiang Nanli was caught in the shockwaves, his body sent flying several meters away.

He felt as though his internal organs were bleeding; his chest burned with searing pain.

The Prowler’s skin-shedding suit also suffered heavy blows, sustaining many gashes. Translucent scales littered the floor.

The stealth effect of the skin-shedding suit had failed.

Damn it, he hadn't even used it twice yet! These spendthrift bastards from the Temple.

Xiang Nanli spat out a mouthful of blood. He propped himself up, sitting on the ground, and narrowed his eyes slightly: "Hiss... that hurts... Hello, Knight Commander."

Xiang Nanli tilted his head, paused, and added: "Could you let me say one last word?"

It had to be said, he possessed a fine appearance. Even as the enemy who killed his brother, he didn't look entirely detestable.

The Knight Commander raised the broad heavy sword in his hand and, with heavy, measured steps, walked toward him: "Speak, your last words."

Xiang Nanli took a deep breath and shouted: "Xiao Qing—!"

The next second.

*BOOM—*

The wall of the corridor was smashed open by brute force from the outside. Eastern Qingdi appeared before Xiang Nanli in an instant, his long black hair fluttering in the chaotic wind.

The wind and snow from outside poured in through the jagged hole, his expression colder than the storm itself.

Ah, spatial leap.

5 kilometers, Eastern Qingdi had leaped four times.

Battery balance: 4%.

第49章

沙利叶的羊角折了。黑色的血像是粘稠的油脂，打湿了他身体的表面。

他的三只眼全瞎，是被一颗一颗抠出来的。

智械人身上有一种人类理解不了的残忍。

因为它们的全身都是可以替换的，所以对可损耗的身体并不在乎，对生命与死亡也没有敬畏。

他看着东方青帝抠出他的真视之眼，然后把它们依次塞进自己的能量槽中。

东方青帝的脸上没有任何表情。仿佛这是理所当然的事。

事实上，这对他来说很重要。沙利叶比东方青帝想象中难缠，这具身体的电量只剩百分之一了，不一边打一边补充能源，等会就会被迫进入关机状态。

为了充电，牺牲一下你的眼睛。这很合理。

那种不把人当人看的使用感，沙利叶很熟悉——在成为神殿的骑士前，他也是草原上的奴隶，其他部落的俘虏。

可汗喜欢用人的颅骨做酒杯，人皮做地毯。沙利叶幸运一点，他是可汗垫脚的凳子。作用是在可汗下马车时跪在地上让他踩。可汗很重，他踩过的地方总是淤青。有那么几次，沙利叶甚至觉得自己会被踩死。

后来神殿的天启骑士来了，占领了黄金草原……对沙利叶来说，是解放。

他从来没跟人说过这段经历。

两百多年过去了，知道这件事的人也差不多死透。

或许就是这段类似的经历，让沙利叶能忍耐相晨曦，甚至在教宗提起“干脆就用相晨曦的复制人”时，一次次重申“原生体更符合神庭的理念”。他们都曾经是小人物，有着同样的外厉内荏。

他知道相晨曦实在愚蠢、肤浅甚至恶毒。

小猫实在凶狠，可它尖尖的牙和爪子再怎么努力，也刺不穿主人的皮肤，那凶狠就是可爱可怜的。

沙利叶以为随着自己不断地往上爬，再也不会有人敢对他流露出这样的神情。

但现在，强大的智械人让他回忆起早就陌生的屈辱和无力。

沙利叶浑身是伤，他刚解开了2级基因锁，还变不回去。这让他像是一头长着四只翅膀、被火焰覆盖着的血色怪物。而身躯的最中央位置空着一个血洞。那里本该是一只巨大的眼珠。

领主级骑士是外界对他实力的判断。事实上，在神庭内部，他们会把领主级骑士称之为“炽天使级”。

沙利叶的体表燃着熊熊烈火，跌跌撞撞地朝着圣灵池的方向爬去。像是挣扎着的四条翅膀的无毛鹌鹑。

沙利叶记得自己曾经用尽全力，朝着东方青帝斩去。

对方甚至没用武器，抬起胳膊抵挡。铿锵之声响起，黑色的重刃往下压了半寸，划破东方青帝的皮肤，流出一点鲜红的液体。这个智械人居然会流血？！

那是血吗？

他不懂，为什么东方青帝会在马上就能杀死他的时候突然离开。

但沙利叶知道这是自己的机会。

他本来是不打算吸收圣灵的，圣灵是神庭布局中的一环。

神庭占领了阴山城，现在已经不再满足，又把目光盯上了姑苏。圣灵这种畸变生物攻城，远比人类士兵更合适。

人联，不过是盘旋在巨人尸体周围食腐的秃鹫。迟早会被神庭取代。

那些巨人的确来自人联，但绝不能被现在的当权者所代表。

但现在，他伤势太重了。

沙利叶知道，自己需要活着回去，他要把消息报告给神庭。到时候会接受处罚还是别的什么，无所谓。只要他的价值比死去的圣灵价值更高就行。

沙利叶瞎了。他看不见，只能凭着本能朝前走。

他即将抵达圣灵池。

一道粉红的身影袭击了他，像离弦的箭，骤然刺破沙利叶的身体。

是以西结，他漆黑眼眸里没有丝毫怜悯。粉白的皮肤下能看见血管。

它咬断沙利叶脖子后的神经，然后叼着这具尚有余温的战利品，最后看了眼面前血红的圣灵池，最终消失在地底。

呵，东方青帝肯定会回来。

它还打不过他，先不跟他抢。

智械人就是这点不好，几乎一出场就是终极形态，但它可是会进化的。

最终花落谁家还不一定呢。

它回到地表，此时风雪寂静。以西结抬头，发出一阵长啸：“喑——喑——”

这声音甚都不能被人耳捕捉到。

畸变体们却听到了。

它们开始撤退。

……

……

骑士长扑来。

骑士长拔剑。

骑士长死亡。

骑士长的脑袋掉到了地上，尖尖的三角头盔滚落一边，发出“哐当哐当”的巨响。

几条黑色的长虫从尸体的断裂处爬出，都爬出好几米远，末端居然还没有彻底从骑士长的身体离开。

东方青帝捡起骑士长的刀，把它们切成两截。长虫喷出了腥臭的血。终于丧失了活力。

一片漆黑中。东方青帝开口：“你还好吗？相南里。”

相南里从地上爬起来，想了想感觉不对，重新躺到了破破烂烂的走廊上：“小青，他打我。我脑震荡了。”

小智毫不留情地戳穿了他：[您好，根据检测，您没有脑震荡。请不要无中生有。]

东方青帝也听到了。

他颇为意外，并且一键回收了小智储存的数据。

人工智能有自主学习的能力，换句话说，内置AI的智能程度其实完全取决于主人……

但东方青帝也没想过，自己复制出的小智障可以进化得这么快。

被回收数据后，原本有点聪明的人工智能又一次回到最初的起点。

属于“小智”的数据转移到东方青帝的身体里，以方便他查询自己不在的这段时间里，相南里经历了什么。

现在相南里嘴里的小智就是他，他就是小智。留下的内置AI只是数据流经的载体。

对于人类来说可能有些难以理解。但对于电子生命来说，这很正常。

东方青帝握住他的手腕，把他从地上拽了起来：“吃点基因药。”

尽管有内置AI的数据分析，但东方青帝依然上手检查了一下：“别动。”

他的表情很不爽。

擦伤，撞伤。肋骨骨折。都是轻微伤。

“别摸腰，很痒。”相南里握住了东方青帝的手。

小智屏蔽了相南里对痛觉的感知，所以他甚至是笑嘻嘻的。

相南里这才意识到，东方青帝的身体很烫。

他摸了摸小青的额头和脖子：“小青你是发烧了吗？”

“不是。”东方青帝回答，“为了省事用了一点劣质能源，主系统正在杀毒。”

发烧=杀毒。这很合理。

相南里在口袋里摸了摸，掏出了小黑送的一把基因药：“这个对你有用吗？”

东方青帝在里面挑出一管绿色的：“没用，你吃。”

相南里拆开包装袋。绿色的基因药是青苹果味的，有一股很自然的果糖甜味。

别说，神殿的人变态的奇奇怪怪，基因药的味道却很不错。

东方青帝在他面前蹲下：“过来，我背你。”

“这是不是不太好。”相南里毕竟是成年人了，还是有些不好意思的，“我腿又没断。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 49 (Part 1)

Sariel’s ram horns were broken. Black blood, like viscous grease, soaked the surface of his body.

All three of his eyes were blinded, gouged out one by one.

There was a cruelty in machine-life forms that humans could not comprehend.

Because their entire bodies were replaceable, they did not care for expendable flesh, nor did they have any reverence for life or death.

He watched as Eastern Qingdi gouged out his "True Sight Eyes" and then stuffed them, one by one, into his own energy slot.

There was no expression on Eastern Qingdi’s face. It was as if this were the most natural thing in the world.

In fact, it was vital for him. Sariel was more difficult to deal with than Eastern Qingdi had imagined. His current body’s battery was down to one percent; if he didn't replenish his energy while fighting, he would be forced into shutdown mode.

To recharge, sacrificing your eyes—it was perfectly logical.

That sense of usage, of not treating a person as a person, was something Sariel was very familiar with—before becoming a knight of the Temple, he had been a slave on the grasslands, a captive of other tribes.

The Khan liked to use human skulls as wine cups and human skin as rugs. Sariel was a bit luckier; he was the stool the Khan used to step down. His role was to kneel on the ground so the Khan could step on him when dismounting the carriage. The Khan was heavy, and the places he stepped were always bruised. A few times, Sariel even felt he might be trampled to death.

Later, the Apocalypse Knights of the Temple arrived and occupied the Golden Grasslands... to Sariel, it was liberation.

He had never told anyone about this experience.

Over two hundred years had passed, and those who knew about it were mostly dead.

Perhaps it was this similar experience that allowed Sariel to tolerate Xiang Chenxi, and even when the Pope suggested, "Why not just use a clone of Xiang Chenxi," he would reiterate time and again that "the original is more in line with the Temple’s philosophy." They had both been small people once, both possessing the same outward toughness and inner cowardice.

He knew Xiang Chenxi was truly stupid, shallow, and even vicious.

The little kitten was indeed fierce, but no matter how hard its sharp teeth and claws tried, they couldn't pierce its master’s skin; that fierceness was just cute and pathetic.

Sariel thought that as he continued to climb higher, no one would ever dare to show him such an expression again.

But now, the powerful machine-life form made him recall the long-forgotten humiliation and powerlessness.

Sariel was covered in wounds. He had just unlocked the second-level genetic lock and couldn't change back. This made him look like a blood-red monster with four wings, covered in flames. In the very center of his torso was an empty, bloody hole. Where there should have been a giant eyeball.

"Lord-level Knight" was the outside world’s assessment of his strength. In fact, within the Temple, they called Lord-level knights "Seraph-level."

Flames burned fiercely on Sariel’s body as he crawled stumble-footed toward the Holy Spirit Pool. He looked like a struggling, four-winged, featherless quail.

Sariel remembered using all his strength to slash at Eastern Qingdi.

The opponent hadn't even used a weapon, simply raising his arm to block. A clanging sound rang out, and the black heavy blade pressed down half an inch, cutting Eastern Qingdi’s skin and letting out a drop of bright red liquid. This machine-life form could actually bleed?!

Was that blood?

He didn't understand why Eastern Qingdi had suddenly left when he was on the verge of killing him.

But Sariel knew this was his chance.

He hadn't originally intended to absorb the Holy Spirit; the Holy Spirit was just one part of the Temple’s grand design.

The Temple had occupied Yinshan City, and now, no longer satisfied, they had set their sights on Gusu. Aberrant creatures like the Holy Spirit were far more suitable for sieging cities than human soldiers.

The Human Alliance was nothing more than vultures circling the corpses of giants. They would be replaced by the Temple sooner or later.

Those giants did indeed come from the Human Alliance, but they could never be represented by the current power-holders.

But now, his injuries were too severe.

Sariel knew he had to survive and return; he had to report the news to the Temple. Whether he would face punishment or something else didn't matter. As long as his value was higher than that of the dead Holy Spirit, he would be fine.

Sariel was blind. He couldn't see, so he could only crawl forward on instinct.

He was about to reach the Holy Spirit Pool.

A pink figure attacked him, like an arrow released from a bow, suddenly piercing through Sariel’s body.

It was Ezekiel, his pitch-black eyes devoid of any pity. Beneath his pinkish-white skin, one could see the veins.

It bit through the nerves at the back of Sariel’s neck, then, carrying this trophy that still held a trace of warmth, took one last look at the blood-red Holy Spirit Pool before disappearing into the ground.

Heh, Eastern Qingdi would definitely return.

It couldn't beat him yet, so it wouldn't fight him for it just yet.

That was the only bad thing about machine-life forms: they were almost at their ultimate form the moment they appeared, but it—it could evolve.

Who would have the last laugh was not yet decided.

It returned to the surface, where the wind and snow were silent. Ezekiel looked up and let out a long howl: "Yin—Yin—"

This sound could not even be captured by human ears.

But the aberrations heard it.

They began to retreat.

...

...

The Knight Commander lunged.

The Knight Commander drew his sword.

The Knight Commander died.

The Knight Commander’s head fell to the ground, his pointed triangular helmet rolling to the side with a loud *clatter*.

Several long, black worms crawled out from the severed neck, crawling several meters away, their ends not yet fully detached from the Knight Commander’s body.

Eastern Qingdi picked up the Knight Commander’s sword and sliced them in two. The worms sprayed foul-smelling blood. Finally, they lost their vitality.

In the pitch-black darkness, Eastern Qingdi spoke: "Are you alright, Xiang Nanli?"

Xiang Nanli scrambled up from the ground, then thought it didn't feel right, and lay back down on the dilapidated corridor: "Xiao Qing, he hit me. I have a concussion."

Xiao Zhi mercilessly exposed him: [Hello, according to detection, you do not have a concussion. Please do not fabricate things out of thin air.]

Eastern Qingdi heard this too.

He was quite surprised and performed a one-click recovery of the data stored in Xiao Zhi.

Artificial intelligence had the ability to learn autonomously; in other words, the level of intelligence of an onboard AI actually depended entirely on its master...

But Eastern Qingdi hadn't expected that the little moron he had copied could evolve so quickly.

After the data was recovered, the artificial intelligence that had been somewhat clever returned to its starting point once again.

The data belonging to "Xiao Zhi" was transferred into Eastern Qingdi’s body to facilitate his checking of what Xiang Nanli had experienced during his absence.

Now, the "Xiao Zhi" in Xiang Nanli’s mouth was him, and he was Xiao Zhi. The remaining onboard AI was merely a carrier for the data flow.

For humans, this might be a bit hard to understand. But for electronic life, it was perfectly normal.

Eastern Qingdi took his wrist and pulled him up from the ground: "Eat some genetic medicine."

Despite the data analysis from the onboard AI, Eastern Qingdi still checked him manually: "Don't move."

His expression was very displeased.

Abrasions, bruises. A fractured rib. All minor injuries.

"Don't touch my waist, it's ticklish." Xiang Nanli grabbed Eastern Qingdi’s hand.

Xiao Zhi had blocked Xiang Nanli’s perception of pain, which was why he was even grinning.

Only then did Xiang Nanli realize that Eastern Qingdi’s body was very hot.

He touched Xiao Qing’s forehead and neck: "Xiao Qing, do you have a fever?"

"No," Eastern Qingdi replied. "I used some low-quality energy to save time; the main system is running an antivirus scan."

Fever = Antivirus scan. That was perfectly logical.

Xiang Nanli rummaged through his pockets and pulled out a handful of genetic medicine given to him by Xiao Hei: "Is this useful for you?"

Eastern Qingdi picked out a green tube: "Useless. You eat it."

Xiang Nanli tore open the packaging. The green genetic medicine was green-apple flavored, with a very natural, fruity sweetness.

Must say, while the people from the Temple were perverted and strange, the taste of their genetic medicine was actually quite good.

Eastern Qingdi crouched down in front of him: "Come here, I’ll carry you."
