"Isn't that a bit inappropriate?" Xiang Nanli was an adult, after all, and still felt a bit embarrassed. "My legs aren't broken."

chunks.chineseText:
东方青帝回答：“这支基因药没有稀释，你的身体会暂时动不了。”

“喔。”相南里趴上去，抱住小青的脖子。

身体果然开始了奇怪的变化。相南里甚至感觉自己听到了骨骼生长的声音。

他的下巴抵在东方青帝的肩上：“小青，小青。我差点以为要交代在这里了。”

其实哨塔里还有很多人。侍卫、大臣、神庭其余的骑士。

他们的声音从四面八方传来。

但相南里却不那么在意了，他知道自己现在很安全。

东方青帝：“嗯。”

“我拿到了控制室的钥匙，福音书号是怎么回事？”

东方青帝回答：“福音书号是当初带着大量资料离开智械军团的高等智械之一。永恒之城的智能机，应该是它的分号，但我不确定主机依然存活。我怀疑永恒之城就是从福音书号拆卸下来的，它本来是一艘太空军舰。”

相南里的眼神不由自主地亮起：“能用吗？那是不是能把永恒之城开走啊？”

东方青帝背着他，往主控室走去，沉默了两秒，回答：“能。”

福音书号还在智械军团的通缉名单上，属于S级逃犯。

按理说，东方青帝应该把它一起带回智械军团，接受制裁。

但是……

相南里想要，那就随他吧。

福音书号流亡这么久，也不差这么几年。

而且有福音书号，相南里的幸存者基地说不定真能吸引一些人。

就是不知道福音书号1.2.5保留的是哪部分资料。

东方青帝继续道：“不过，只能把福音书号的AI部分先拆卸下来用。这里缺乏能源，它的核电池被送回了黑十字审判庭。”

永恒之城就像是一台汽车，没有汽油。只能看，不能开。

相南里开始说地震后发生的事，从地上那些蛇开始讲起。

尽管已经从小智的数据里“回忆”起了这段记忆，但东方青帝并没有打断他。

相南里也没有支撑多久。

讲到撞见以西结的时候，他的头靠在东方青帝的肩上，眼皮一眨一眨的。

“对了，小智为什么要叫你5.2.0？我看控制面板，写的福音书号1.2.5。小青，这是你的型号吗？前缀是什么……”

相南里睡着了，身体修复本来就是一件很耗能的事情。

东方青帝来到主控室，顺手解决掉里面的看守者。然后从相南里的口袋里摸出了钥匙，插入控制台内。

黑暗中，控制台亮起微光。上面出现了一个个按键。只是东方青帝没有碰它。

他调整了一下相南里的姿势，确定相南里不会摔下去后，分出一只手，压在了大理石质感的台面上。

东方青帝的眼眸里亮起璀璨的银光。主控台上出现了警告，试图启动杀毒程序，但很快，警告消失，只剩下一个进度条。

【0％——100％】

【载入成功】

城内的电源在这一刻得到恢复，但这只是开始。

安分守己的机械人们突然整齐划一的行动起来。

宫殿里的保姆机器人面带笑容地抓起桌子上的水果刀。

城内的机械人守卫举起刀尖，冰冷的目光看向附近身穿华服的贵人。

就连负责巡逻的机械狗、和天上的蜂鸟无人机，也开始了行动。

它们负责找出藏在角落里的人类……

躲在树林间的安德鲁被一条机械狗拖了出来。

他抱住了面前的大树杈，嘶吼道：“你们搞错了！我是机器人！我爱智械！智械军团万岁！”

机械狗认真分辨片刻，然后摇头晃脑地走了。

机械化程度99％的人类，在智械的领土都能领二等公民身份证了，还是算了。

就是这人怪没骨气的嘞！真是令械不齿。

一起非常小型的智械危机在永恒之城内上演着。

很多人甚至都不清楚发生了什么，就被自家的机器人背刺了一刀。而比较难对付的神殿骑士，也逃不过多台机器士兵的围剿。必要时，还有炮台的火力支援。

当然，它们也没有杀死所有人类。像是城墙上的小士兵，就被直接放过了。

它们用白色的油漆，在地上划出一片圈，把幸存的内城人赶进圈里，却没有进一步处理。

它们并非真的诞生了拟人模块的智械，还在等待着下一步指令。

一旦有人想要走出白线内，就会被毫不犹豫地抹杀。

东方青帝把手从控制面板上收了回来，掌心的皮肤竟然因为高温被烧灼了一层。

他吹了吹，然后背着相南里，从电梯里走出了城楼。

沿路的机械士兵低下头：“Alpha。”

扫地机器人疯狂运转着，试图在东方青帝的脚踏上前，清理干净路上的碎石和雪：“Alpha。”

就连路过的机械狗，在看见东方青帝时，都会夹着尾巴微微趴下，以示尊敬。

一台圆筒状的保姆机器人开口：“Alpha，请把他交给我吧。宫殿里有最舒适柔软的床。还有壁橱、甜酒和葡萄。”

东方青帝摇头：“不用。”

把相南里交给它们，他不放心。

东方青帝回到了孵化池。

来的时候花了两秒，搭顺风车回来却花了四十多分钟。

孵化池里，圣灵的状态已经稳定下来。蛋壳白色的薄膜破裂。血红色的怪物密密麻麻挤在池子里，发出一阵阵嘶吼。

东方青帝把相南里放下。

然后捡起沙利叶的重剑，在数不清的巨蛇里，精准无误地挑出一条不那么巨大的蛇。

剑尖刺中蛇的七寸。

这条蛇直径半米，身长四米，肚子鼓鼓的，放在外界已经是一条巨蟒，但在动辄都是七八米粗的巨蛇中，并不起眼。但那些巨蛇只是伪装。

目的是让这条不那么粗的蛇逃过一劫。

圣灵嘶吼着，朝着东方青帝发起了最后的进攻——

东方青帝抓了它的尖牙，然后狠狠往地上一砸。

他掰断圣灵的一口獠牙。

又用这些尖锐的牙，划开圣灵的蛇头。从中抠出一枚亮晶晶的石头。不重，但纯度还行。

贴在东方青帝手部的金属片又一次腾空，露出底下的黑洞。

东方青帝把石头扔了进去。

他身体滚烫，死死抱住了相南里，胳膊一点点收紧。

Alpha面对过很多危机时刻。

比如恶意断电；比如主机被核爆；比如数据污染中病毒；比如自毁程序激活，甚至开始了10秒的倒计时。

但他只是经历了，然后呢？他依然存在着。

无论人类是崇敬我，恐惧我，还是想要毁灭我。

直到今天。

“……恐惧。”东方青帝感受着相南里的心跳，开口，“原来是这种感觉。”
chunks.englishText:
Dongfang Qingdi replied, "This gene serum hasn't been diluted. Your body will be temporarily immobilized."

"Oh." Xiang Nanli leaned forward, wrapping his arms around Xiao Qing's neck.

Sure enough, his body began to undergo strange changes. Xiang Nanli even felt as though he could hear the sound of his bones growing.

He rested his chin on Dongfang Qingdi's shoulder. "Xiao Qing, Xiao Qing. I almost thought I was going to meet my end here."

In truth, there were still many people in the watchtower—guards, ministers, and the remaining knights of the Divine Court.

Their voices drifted in from all directions.

But Xiang Nanli didn't care much anymore; he knew he was safe now.

Dongfang Qingdi hummed, "Mm."

"I got the key to the control room. What's the deal with the *Gospel*?"

Dongfang Qingdi answered, "The *Gospel* was one of the high-level AIs that left the Mechanical Legion with a massive amount of data back in the day. The intelligence in the Eternal City is likely a sub-node of it, though I’m not sure if the main host still survives. I suspect the Eternal City itself was dismantled from the *Gospel*; it was originally a space battleship."

Xiang Nanli’s eyes lit up involuntarily. "Can it still be used? Does that mean we could fly the Eternal City away?"

Dongfang Qingdi carried him toward the main control room, remained silent for two seconds, and then replied, "Yes."

The *Gospel* was still on the Mechanical Legion’s wanted list as an S-rank fugitive.

By all rights, Dongfang Qingdi should have brought it back to the Mechanical Legion to face judgment.

But...

If Xiang Nanli wanted it, then so be it.

The *Gospel* had been in exile for so long; a few more years wouldn't make a difference.

Besides, with the *Gospel*, Xiang Nanli’s survivor base might actually be able to attract some people.

He just wasn't sure which parts of the data Gospel 1.2.5 had managed to retain.

Dongfang Qingdi continued, "However, we can only dismantle the AI portion of the *Gospel* to use for now. There is a lack of energy here; its nuclear batteries were sent back to the Black Cross Inquisition."

The Eternal City was like a car without fuel—nice to look at, but impossible to drive.

Xiang Nanli began to recount what had happened after the earthquake, starting from the snakes on the ground.

Although Dongfang Qingdi had already "recalled" these memories from Xiao Zhi’s data, he did not interrupt him.

Xiang Nanli didn't last long, however.

By the time he reached the part about running into Ezekiel, his head was resting on Dongfang Qingdi’s shoulder, his eyelids fluttering.

"By the way, why does Xiao Zhi call you 5.2.0? I saw on the control panel it said Gospel 1.2.5. Xiao Qing, is that your model number? What’s the prefix..."

Xiang Nanli fell asleep. Repairing his body was, after all, a highly energy-consuming process.

Dongfang Qingdi arrived at the main control room and casually dealt with the guards inside. He then fished the key out of Xiang Nanli’s pocket and inserted it into the console.

In the darkness, the console flickered to life, displaying a series of buttons. Dongfang Qingdi, however, did not touch them.

He adjusted Xiang Nanli’s posture to ensure he wouldn't fall, then freed one hand and pressed it against the marble-textured surface of the console.

Brilliant silver light ignited in Dongfang Qingdi’s eyes. A warning appeared on the main console, attempting to initiate an antivirus program, but it vanished almost immediately, leaving only a progress bar.

【0%——100%】

【Loading Successful】

The power within the city was restored at that moment, but that was only the beginning.

The docile robots suddenly began to move in perfect unison.

A nanny robot in the palace picked up a fruit knife from the table with a smile.

The mechanical guards in the city raised their blades, their cold gazes fixed on the nearby nobles in their fine robes.

Even the patrolling mechanical dogs and the hummingbird drones in the sky began their work.

They were tasked with rooting out the humans hiding in the corners...

Andrew, hiding in the woods, was dragged out by a mechanical dog.

He hugged a thick tree branch and shrieked, "You’ve got the wrong guy! I’m a robot! I love the Mechanical Legion! Long live the Mechanical Legion!"

The mechanical dog scrutinized him carefully for a moment, then shook its head and trotted away.

A human with 99% mechanization could practically get a second-class citizenship ID in the Mechanical Legion’s territory; it wasn't worth the effort.

Besides, this guy was spineless! It was truly disgraceful to the machine kind.

A very small-scale mechanical crisis was unfolding within the Eternal City.

Many people didn't even know what was happening before they were backstabbed by their own household robots. The harder-to-deal-with Temple Knights couldn't escape the encirclement of multiple mechanical soldiers, and when necessary, they were met with artillery fire support.

Of course, they didn't kill all the humans. The low-ranking soldiers on the city walls, for instance, were simply spared.

They used white paint to draw circles on the ground, herding the surviving inner-city residents into them without taking further action.

They were not truly sentient AIs with anthropomorphic modules; they were simply waiting for the next command.

Once someone tried to step outside the white lines, they were eliminated without hesitation.

Dongfang Qingdi withdrew his hand from the control panel; the skin on his palm had been scorched by the high temperature.

He blew on it, then, with Xiang Nanli on his back, stepped out of the city tower via the elevator.

Mechanical soldiers along the path lowered their heads: "Alpha."

Sweeping robots whirred frantically, trying to clear the rubble and snow from the path before Dongfang Qingdi’s feet touched them: "Alpha."

Even the passing mechanical dogs would tuck their tails and bow slightly upon seeing Dongfang Qingdi, showing their respect.

A cylindrical nanny robot spoke up: "Alpha, please hand him to me. The palace has the most comfortable and softest beds. There is also a cupboard, sweet wine, and grapes."

Dongfang Qingdi shook his head: "No need."

He didn't trust them with Xiang Nanli.

Dongfang Qingdi returned to the incubation pool.

It had taken two seconds to come, but hitching a ride back had taken over forty minutes.

In the incubation pool, the Holy Spirit’s condition had stabilized. The white membrane of the eggshell had ruptured. Blood-red monsters were packed densely in the pool, letting out bursts of hissing roars.

Dongfang Qingdi set Xiang Nanli down.

He then picked up Sariel’s heavy sword and, among the countless giant snakes, precisely picked out one that wasn't quite as massive.

The tip of the sword pierced the snake’s vital point.

This snake was half a meter in diameter and four meters long, its belly bulging. In the outside world, it would have been a giant python, but among these giant snakes that were seven or eight meters thick, it was inconspicuous. But those giant snakes were merely a disguise.

The goal was to let this less-massive snake escape the catastrophe.

The Holy Spirit hissed, launching a final attack at Dongfang Qingdi—

Dongfang Qingdi grabbed its fangs and slammed it hard against the ground.

He snapped off one of the Holy Spirit’s fangs.

Then, using the sharp tooth, he sliced open the Holy Spirit’s snake head. He dug out a shimmering stone from within. It wasn't heavy, but the purity was decent.

The metal plate on Dongfang Qingdi’s hand parted once more, revealing a black hole beneath.

Dongfang Qingdi tossed the stone inside.

His body was burning hot as he held Xiang Nanli tightly, his arms tightening bit by bit.

Alpha had faced many crises.

Such as malicious power outages; such as the host being nuked; such as data corruption from viruses; such as self-destruct programs activating, even starting a 10-second countdown.

But he had simply experienced them, and then what? He still existed.

Whether humans revered me, feared me, or wanted to destroy me.

Until today.

"...Fear." Dongfang Qingdi felt Xiang Nanli’s heartbeat and spoke, "So this is what that feels like."

chunks.chineseText:
第50章

相南里睡了个很安稳的好觉，他甚至在梦里回到了小时候。

人到底是从出生那天就诞生了，还是有记忆时才算诞生？

相南里出生在春天的早晨，但有记忆的那天是一个隆冬的夜晚。

“他在说什么？”小姨。

“你们找医生看过吗？是不是神经系统有问题？还是面瘫。”爷爷。

“要不要去唐人街找那个谁请张符。”外婆。

“好了，够了。别说了。烦死了。”妈妈。

“大不了关一辈子，又不是养不起。”爸爸。

相南里察觉到了客厅里说话的声音，他放下了手里拆了一半的录音机。然后爬到门边，悄悄把门打开了一条缝。

他观察着客厅里的争吵，直到小姨骤然把目光对上了这里，然后脸上浮现出明显的惊慌。

相南里挪开视线，把目光对准了最常见到的那个年轻女性。

对方也正转头看向他。

相南里开口：“妈……妈。”

他睁开眼，眼前没有妈妈。倒是东方青帝近在咫尺。

“小青。”

相南里刚说一句话，东方青帝就递上了水杯。水温45摄氏度，刚好。

相南里接过，顺便扫了眼周围的环境：“咕噜咕噜……小青，我昏迷了多久。”

嗯，这是突然住进总统套房了？

东方青帝面无表情地回答：“4小时21分17秒。”

因为解释起来过于麻烦，东方青帝把相南里昏迷后的数据打包塞给了他一份，当然，是精修版。删掉了部分不能对相南里展示的内容。

这是人联的“共识”技术。天启骑士们的转世传承，也是类似的技术。

这项技术对于脑子不那么灵光的人来说，会有一些副作用。

比如分不清自己是谁。学术上称之为“人格解离”。

但对相南里来说，却没什么影响。

相南里坐在床上，足足僵硬了三分钟，感觉像是旁观了一场电影，还是上帝视角能自由变换角度的。

比如小青在宰蛇的时候，相南里的注意力就在圣灵鼓鼓的肚子上。甚至拉进看了眼，感觉里面包着个人。

蛇被宰了。东方青帝拿刀，划开血色的蛇皮，露出底下蜷缩着的天狼星。

天狼星被胃液腐蚀了一大半，像是一摊快融化的烂肉。

怎么看都觉得不可能活着，偏偏他的心脏和大脑还在跳动着。身上的血管如同输液针一样扎在圣灵身体的内侧。

东方青帝站在旁边，观察片刻。然后把天狼星从地上捞了起来，丢回蛇坑——

相南里忍不住尖叫：“啊啊啊小青！你干嘛把人家扔回去？”

这也太像毁尸灭迹了吧！

东方青帝声音微微停顿：“他早该被消化的，但圣灵先天虚弱，再加上他强烈的求生意志，所以被剖出来的时候，还有一息尚存。

“丢回去是为了让他代替圣灵，吸收这些伴生灵的营养。他本来也是审判庭挑选的驾驶员。”

天狼星的情况，根本不可能复制第二次。首先，神殿不会这么糟蹋圣灵。

其次，也不会有第二个契合的身体，哪怕有，也没有这样坚强到连人工智能都会惊讶的意志。

天时地利人和，缺一不可。

果然，蛇坑里的伴生灵并没有对天狼星发起进攻。反倒是一根根血线，如同脐带，从天狼星的身体里蔓延出来，扎进了这些伴生灵的身体。

巨蛇们朝着中间靠拢，互相缠绕着，组成了一枚巨大的肉球。肉球呼吸着，每次收缩，都能挤出一片红色的液体，这些液体又被缩小的肉球重新吸收。

这一幕诡异得有点掉san。

画面到此结束。

“孵化池里的胚胎一直在缩小，看起来会重新孵化一次。我预估30天后可以孵化成功。”

相南里忍不住询问：“那孵出来的生物……还是天狼星吗？”

东方青帝：“不知道，没见过类似的。”

相南里把水杯放下：“那些人呢？你打算怎么处理？”

机器人们把主城区的住民都赶进了广场的圆圈内。

永恒之城一共七万多人，内城区的市民居然不到1000人。杀了一些拼死反抗的，放了一些生化战士家属。还剩三百人。

这些人全都是永恒之城的贵种。就像是寄生虫一样，吸附在永恒之城这艘大船上。说得好听点就是世代簪缨。要么身居高位，要么就是血亲身居高位。

介于永恒之城也只是地表中型据点，簪缨贵族们吃得也许还不如地下城的中产好。

外面冰天雪地，有些人还在家里睡觉，就被机器人拽出来，穿着薄薄的单衣，蜷缩在人群中，像是待宰的猪。

东方青帝的唇角微微扬起：“这不该问我，相南里。这要问你。”

相南里挑起眉：“嗯哼？”

“基地，可是你要建的。”

东方青帝把头扭向一边，看起来不打算提供任何帮助。

倒不是东方青帝心狠，只是，决策，这是相南里作为组织者必须面对的事情。

幸存者基地最终会是什么模样，在此时，完全取决于相南里的策略，并且一定会以他的观念为核心，继续发展。

如果幸存者基地能真的如名字一样，在浩瀚如海的地表人类据点中幸存下去，自然有人在相南里百年后，接过他的遗志……当然，按照人马星现在的技术，相南里起码还能再为基地工作三百年（前提是他不会突然暴毙）。

相南里必须成长起来。

如果他知难而退，那就再好不过。

说实话，这是相南里完全未知的领域。

建立一个公司和建立一个基地，差别还是有些大的。

建立一个公司，老板只需要发工资，其他的，有雇佣合同和劳动法帮忙。

而想建立一个基地，背后还有更深层的含义。

相南里还没有研究过政治学和历史。顶多看国际新闻的时候扫过那么几眼。

“一个组织，需要确定权力的来源，代表的哪些人的利益……咱们基地。”

东方青帝纠正：“你的基地。”

“好。我的基地，我希望它是智慧生物可以共存的社会。包括人、智械，乃至以西结这种怪东西……”

东方青帝双手抱胸，发出一声嗤笑。

“当然，目前主要还是侧重于人类，因为人类在三者中最需要保护，而且大概率也是数量最多的。而人也是需要分类的，像永恒之城的贵族和农奴，显然就不是一类人；健全强大的组织应该团结尽可能团结的力量。目前整个基地能否起步的核心，其实是我……我有多少资源，多大决心去促成这件事……”

相南里思维跳跃，自言自语了半天，感觉到头疼，甚至有倒回床上继续睡大觉的冲动。

不过他忍住了：“君子畏德不畏威，小人畏威不畏德。先让他们在圈里呆着，冻一会再说。福音书号要怎么带走？”

东方青帝回答：“后台数据传输中，应该快好了。要去控制室看一眼吗？”

十分钟后。

相南里扫了眼门口的机器人士兵，推开主控室的大门。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 50

Xiang Nanli had a very peaceful sleep; he even returned to his childhood in his dreams.

Are people truly born the day they enter the world, or do they only come into existence when they have memories?

Xiang Nanli was born on a spring morning, but the day he gained his first memory was a deep winter night.

"What is he saying?" his aunt asked.

"Have you taken him to see a doctor? Is there a problem with his nervous system? Or is it facial paralysis?" his grandfather wondered.

"Should we go to Chinatown and find that person to ask for a talisman?" his grandmother suggested.

"Alright, enough. Stop talking. It’s so annoying," his mother snapped.

"At worst, we’ll just lock him up for life; it’s not like we can’t afford to raise him," his father said.

Xiang Nanli sensed the voices arguing in the living room. He put down the tape recorder he had half-dismantled, crawled to the door, and quietly opened it a crack.

He observed the argument in the living room until his aunt suddenly locked eyes with him, a look of obvious panic appearing on her face.

Xiang Nanli looked away, focusing his gaze on the young woman he saw most often.

She was also turning her head to look at him.

Xiang Nanli spoke: "Mo... Mom."

He opened his eyes. There was no mother in front of him. Instead, Dongfang Qingdi was right there, inches away.

"Xiao Qing."

Xiang Nanli had barely said a word before Dongfang Qingdi handed him a glass of water. The temperature was 45 degrees Celsius—perfect.

Xiang Nanli took it and scanned his surroundings: "Gulp, gulp... Xiao Qing, how long was I unconscious?"

Hmm, did he suddenly move into a presidential suite?

Dongfang Qingdi replied expressionlessly, "4 hours, 21 minutes, and 17 seconds."

Because it was too troublesome to explain, Dongfang Qingdi had packed the data from after Xiang Nanli’s blackout and transferred it to him—a polished version, of course, with the parts that couldn't be shown to Xiang Nanli deleted.

This was the "Consensus" technology of the Human Alliance. The reincarnation inheritance of the Apocalypse Knights used similar technology.

For those whose minds weren't quite sharp, this technology could have side effects.

For example, they might lose track of who they were. Academically, this was called "personality dissociation."

But for Xiang Nanli, it had no impact.

Xiang Nanli sat on the bed, frozen for a full three minutes, feeling as though he had just watched a movie—one where he had a god’s-eye view and could freely change angles.

For instance, when Xiao Qing was butchering the snake, Xiang Nanli’s attention had been on the Holy Spirit’s bulging belly. He had even zoomed in to take a look, feeling as though there was a person wrapped inside.

The snake was butchered. Dongfang Qingdi took a knife, sliced open the blood-red snake skin, and revealed Sirius curled up underneath.

Sirius had been more than half-corroded by stomach acid, looking like a pile of melting, rotting flesh.

No matter how you looked at it, it seemed impossible for him to be alive, yet his heart and brain were still beating. The blood vessels on his body were embedded into the inner side of the Holy Spirit’s body like IV needles.

Dongfang Qingdi stood by, observing for a moment. Then he scooped Sirius up from the ground and tossed him back into the snake pit—

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but scream: "Ahhh, Xiao Qing! Why did you throw him back in?"

That looked way too much like destroying evidence!

Dongfang Qingdi’s voice paused slightly: "He should have been digested long ago, but the Holy Spirit was congenitally weak, and combined with his intense will to survive, he still had a breath of life left when he was cut out.

"Throwing him back is to let him replace the Holy Spirit and absorb the nutrients of these symbiotic spirits. He was originally a pilot selected by the Inquisition."

Sirius’s situation was impossible to replicate a second time. First, the Temple wouldn't waste a Holy Spirit like that.

Second, there wouldn't be a second body that was compatible; even if there were, there wouldn't be a will so strong that even an AI would be surprised.

Time, place, and people—all were indispensable.

Sure enough, the symbiotic spirits in the snake pit didn't attack Sirius. Instead, threads of blood, like umbilical cords, spread from Sirius’s body and pierced into the bodies of these symbiotic spirits.

The giant snakes moved toward the center, intertwining with each other to form a massive ball of flesh. The ball of flesh breathed; every time it contracted, it squeezed out a pool of red liquid, which was then reabsorbed by the shrinking ball of flesh.

The scene was a bit unsettlingly surreal.

The footage ended there.

"The embryo in the incubation pool is constantly shrinking; it looks like it will hatch again. I estimate it will be successful in 30 days."

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but ask: "Then the creature that hatches... will it still be Sirius?"

Dongfang Qingdi: "I don't know. I’ve never seen anything like it."

Xiang Nanli put down the water glass: "What about those people? How do you plan to deal with them?"

The robots had herded all the residents of the main city area into a circle in the plaza.

There were over 70,000 people in the Eternal City, yet there were fewer than 1,000 citizens in the inner city. Some who resisted to the death were killed, and some families of biochemical soldiers were released. That left three hundred.

These people were all the nobility of the Eternal City. Like parasites, they clung to the great ship of the Eternal City. To put it nicely, they were families of hereditary prestige. They either held high positions, or their blood relatives did.

Given that the Eternal City was only a mid-sized surface outpost, these noble families probably ate worse than the middle class in the underground cities.

Outside, it was freezing, and some people were still sleeping at home when they were dragged out by robots, wearing thin clothes, huddled in the crowd like pigs waiting for slaughter.

Dongfang Qingdi’s lips curled slightly: "That’s not a question for me, Xiang Nanli. That’s for you to answer."

Xiang Nanli raised an eyebrow: "Oh?"

"The base—it’s the one you wanted to build."

Dongfang Qingdi turned his head away, looking as if he didn't intend to offer any help.

It wasn't that Dongfang Qingdi was heartless; it was just that decision-making was something Xiang Nanli had to face as an organizer.

What the survivor base would eventually become depended entirely on Xiang Nanli’s strategy at this moment, and it would inevitably continue to develop with his values at its core.

If the survivor base could truly live up to its name and survive among the vast sea of surface human outposts, naturally, someone would pick up his legacy after he was gone... Of course, according to current Pegasus Star technology, Xiang Nanli could work for the base for at least another three hundred years (provided he didn't suddenly drop dead).

Xiang Nanli had to grow up.

If he retreated in the face of difficulty, that would be for the best.

To be honest, this was a field completely unknown to Xiang Nanli.

Building a company and building a base were quite different.

When building a company, the boss only needs to pay salaries; for everything else, there are employment contracts and labor laws to help.

But wanting to build a base had deeper implications behind it.

Xiang Nanli hadn't studied political science or history. At most, he had skimmed a few international news headlines.

"An organization needs to determine the source of its power, whose interests it represents... our base."

Dongfang Qingdi corrected him: "Your base."

"Right. My base. I want it to be a society where intelligent beings can coexist. Including humans, mechanical beings, and even weird things like Ezekiel..."

Dongfang Qingdi crossed his arms and let out a scoff.

"Of course, for now, it’s mainly focused on humans, because humans are the ones who need the most protection among the three, and they are also likely the most numerous. And humans also need to be categorized; like the nobles and serfs of the Eternal City, they are clearly not the same kind of people. A sound and powerful organization should unite as many forces as possible. The core of whether the entire base can get started is actually me... how many resources I have, and how determined I am to facilitate this..."

Xiang Nanli’s thoughts jumped around as he muttered to himself for a long time, feeling a headache coming on, even having the urge to crawl back into bed and sleep.

However, he resisted: "A gentleman fears virtue, not force; a petty person fears force, not virtue. Let them stay in the circle and freeze for a while. How are we going to take the *Gospel* with us?"

Dongfang Qingdi replied: "Background data transmission is in progress; it should be done soon. Do you want to go to the control room and take a look?"

Ten minutes later.

Xiang Nanli glanced at the mechanical soldiers at the door and pushed open the door to the main control room.

chunks.chineseText:
他喃喃：“基地可以让智械人进入权力体系，但不能完全依靠机器人作为武力威慑。虽然在某些事上智械或许比人更可靠，但这样会动摇权力来源的根基。小智，帮我把这点心得体会记录下来，专门开个文件夹。我怕以后忘了。”

[收到。]

相南里在控制室内看见了熟人。

“安德鲁？你还活着呢。”

安德鲁四条手臂敲打着面前的键盘，头都没有抬一下：“你声音听上去似乎不是很惊喜。”

奇怪的场景。

一台机器人坐在巨大的电脑屏幕前，正在为另一台机器人编写程序。

安德鲁解释：“我正在尝试把福音书号导入这台机器狗里。相当于给福音书换了具身体。这身体也许没有原本的强大，但是起码能自由活动。”

除此外，安德鲁还有些私心。

弱小的身体更好控制。

像东方青帝这样的……谁打得过？他要是有点想法，能在眨眼间杀死城里所有人。

被导入的那台机器狗身上插着好几根数据线。

“你居然还会这个？”相南里震惊了。

他走过去，扫了眼屏幕。

呵呵。几百年过去，核心代码还是他当年写的那堆。

其实现在也有变化，比如换到了更高级的意识空间里去写数据代码。但这里条件简陋，也没有连云端网络。

另外，福音书号还在用这么原始的代码，是因为它也是几百年前的老旧AI了。

安德鲁气急败坏：“我六百年前是东岚大学人工智能专业毕业的！”

东岚大学，目前在洛阳城。从相南里读书那个年代开始，就是全球最好的大学。没有之一。

“你不是学生化的？”

“我修的双学位！”

没想到，连中级医师资格证都重考了三次的安德鲁，竟然真的是个人才。

相南里刚这么想，面前的屏幕突然弹出一行红色的错误提醒。

“呃，这……这……”安德鲁感觉自己的机械身体都要流汗了，“福音书号的反入侵系统触发了。”

东方青帝微微抬了一下眉，刚打算行动，结果相南里十分自然地拍了拍安德鲁的肩膀：“辛苦了，剩下的交给我吧。”

他推开安德鲁，在电脑前坐下，以一种迅速到令人眼花缭乱的速度看完了代码页，然后开始修正和增补。

相南里比安德鲁还有少一双胳膊。但效率丝毫不低。

几分钟后，故障以安德鲁完全没有想过的角度解决了！

安德鲁心情复杂：“你不是应该才从冷冻舱里解冻吗？”

相南里的回答让安德鲁想揍他：“是喔，好神奇。看一眼就会了，怎么回事？”

站在地上的机械狗双眼亮起蓝色的灯光。

福音书刚醒来，还有些茫然。

它环顾了房间一圈，还没有搞清楚状况，身体却本能地朝着相南里飞奔了过去。

“相南里！相南里！”机械小狗发出了呜呜的声音，“小福在这里！”

还没有扑到，东方青帝一脚踩在了它的背上，抑制住了它的行动。

他就知道这些弱智AI只会进行无脑判定。几百年前也是这样被人骗出福音书号的控制权的吧。
chunks.englishText:
He murmured: "The base can allow mechanical beings to enter the power structure, but it cannot rely entirely on robots as a deterrent of force. Although mechanical beings might be more reliable than humans in some matters, doing so would shake the foundation of the source of power. Xiao Zhi, help me record these insights and create a dedicated folder. I’m afraid I’ll forget later."

[Received.]

Xiang Nanli saw a familiar face in the control room.

"Andrew? You’re still alive."

Andrew was tapping at the keyboard in front of him with four arms, not even looking up: "Your voice doesn't sound very surprised."

A strange scene.

A robot sitting in front of a massive computer screen, writing a program for another robot.

Andrew explained: "I’m trying to import the *Gospel* into this mechanical dog. It’s equivalent to giving the *Gospel* a new body. This body might not be as powerful as the original, but at least it can move freely."

Besides that, Andrew had some selfish motives.

A weak body was easier to control.

Like Dongfang Qingdi... who could beat him? If he had any ideas, he could kill everyone in the city in the blink of an eye.

The mechanical dog being imported had several data cables plugged into it.

"You actually know how to do this?" Xiang Nanli was shocked.

He walked over and scanned the screen.

Heh. Hundreds of years later, the core code was still the pile he had written back then.

Actually, there were changes now, such as writing data code in a more advanced consciousness space. But the conditions here were crude, and there was no connection to the cloud network.

Additionally, the *Gospel* was still using such primitive code because it was also an old AI from hundreds of years ago.

Andrew was exasperated: "I graduated from the Artificial Intelligence major at Donglan University six hundred years ago!"

Donglan University, currently located in Luoyang City. Since the era when Xiang Nanli was a student, it had been the best university in the world. Period.

"Weren't you a biochemistry student?"

"I did a double major!"

Unexpectedly, Andrew, who had even retaken his intermediate physician qualification exam three times, was actually a talent.

Just as Xiang Nanli thought this, a line of red error warnings suddenly popped up on the screen.

"Uh, this... this..." Andrew felt as if his mechanical body was sweating: "The *Gospel*’s anti-intrusion system has been triggered."

Dongfang Qingdi raised an eyebrow slightly, just about to take action, when Xiang Nanli patted Andrew’s shoulder very naturally: "Good work, leave the rest to me."

He pushed Andrew aside, sat down in front of the computer, and read through the code pages at a speed so rapid it was dizzying, then began to correct and supplement them.

Xiang Nanli had one less pair of arms than Andrew, but his efficiency was not the least bit lower.

A few minutes later, the malfunction was resolved from an angle Andrew had never even considered!

Andrew had mixed feelings: "Aren't you supposed to have just been thawed out from a cryo-chamber?"

Xiang Nanli’s answer made Andrew want to punch him: "Yeah, it’s so magical. I just looked at it and understood it, how about that?"

The mechanical dog standing on the ground had its eyes light up with blue lamps.

Gospel had just woken up and was still a bit dazed.

It looked around the room, not yet understanding the situation, but its body instinctively bolted toward Xiang Nanli.

"Xiang Nanli! Xiang Nanli!" The mechanical puppy made a whining sound: "Xiao Fu is here!"

Before it could pounce, Dongfang Qingdi stepped on its back, suppressing its movement.

He knew these simple-minded AIs only performed brainless judgments. They must have been tricked out of the *Gospel*’s control rights hundreds of years ago in the same way.

chunks.chineseText:
第51章

人工智能和人类的判定逻辑是不一样的。

举个例子。一个小孩，家长告诉了它什么是苹果。下次看见苹果的瞬间，ta的脑海就明白那是什么东西。而不会认为那是“橘子”或者“西瓜”。

但人工智能不一样，它认不出来。

它需要足够多的数据库去学习，对“苹果”这个东西进行扫描、拆分、锚点；再一次看见苹果时，它会计算这个苹果和数据库里几百万个苹果模型的相似度，通过判断后，才能确定这是“苹果”。

因为这一运行逻辑，智械军团曾经损失惨重。Alpha的数据库被污染了好多次，那里同样有几百万个相南里。

Alpha花了好几个月的时间，才把这些虚拟人格一个个杀死。

删除这些“相南里”的过程，就像是删除了一部分自己。

那段时间，Alpha就像患上了阿尔兹海默症的病人。他近乎本能的记得相南里，却想不起任何和相南里有关的回忆。也许对于人工智能来说，这该叫数据。

后来还是Alpha给智械们装载拟人模块2.0版本（杀毒软件升级版），才解决这个历史遗留问题。

但福音书号显然是没有安装，它压根不认为“模仿人类”是人工智能不该有的病毒。

福音书被踩在地上，挣扎半天，都没爬起来。

相南里：“哎呀，小青。对自己同伴不要这么凶。”

东方青帝心想，他和福音书才不是同伴，但还是听话地挪开了踩住福音书的脚。

相南里蹲下，拍了拍手，然后张开手臂。

福音书开心地扑进了他的怀里：“相南里~~相南里~~小福好想你！”

东方青帝有着严格的情绪管理，一般情况下不会生气，更不会说脏话：“你想个*。你出生的时候相南里都消失几十年了！”

大家都觉得福音书很可爱，但东方青帝对它没有任何怜惜。

因为他见过完整的福音书号。第一印象是很重要的。

东方青帝有太多的词汇可以形容它，太空堡垒、金属城池、移动天灾、末日军舰；这些词里绝对没有“机械小狗”。

福音书的身体，是东方青帝随手从楼下拎上来的。

这条机械狗体重5.4kg，型号老旧，没有狗头，圆球形的摄像头就在它四四方方的身体正前方，能够270度旋转；还装配了小型武器，两管枪炮背上扛。是兼具美观（？）和实用的巡逻犬。

相南里摸着它金属的身体，脸上不由得露出幸福的笑容：“真可爱呢，宝宝。”

福音书的眼睛湿润了，它后知后觉意识到一件事：“小福为什么变成了狗？！”

福音书的四个轮胎在地上乱窜：“小福不要当狗！我是高等智械！我不能接受这个身体！呜呜呜呜！”

安德鲁汗颜，站在旁边不断安慰：“条件简陋，条件简陋。当机械狗也很好啦，狗狗是人类最好的朋友。”

相南里严肃道：“人联对智械人管控很严。你如果想跟我回家，就只能保持机械狗的模样。”

福音书权衡利弊，回答：“好，小福是机械狗。小福要跟你回家。”

控制室里不仅有操控台和机械狗，还有一具被砸的稀巴烂的黑色铠甲。垒在房间的角落。

相南里走过去，检查了片刻，发现铠甲的芯片都因为高温熔化。

“是那些侍卫的决定，它们认为黑甲既然能被陌生人驾驭，多半是中了病毒。所以直接销毁了。”安德鲁挠了挠头。

神庭的黑甲似乎和纯粹的机械装置不太一样，连在芯片上的电线摸起来像是一根根血管。真是奇怪的科技。

相南里最后摸了一把小黑的金属皮肤：“修不好了呢，埋了吧。”

语气有些可惜。

他的口袋里还揣着几根小黑给的猫条呢。

他的话音刚落，小福从他身边跳开，十几秒后，拖着一个垃圾桶走了回来：“好喔，埋这里。”

相南里哑然失笑：“不是这个意思。”

“那是，什么意思？”小福歪着脑袋。

“就是……”要如何向机械生命解释人类的感情和死亡。

相南里想了想：“就是，把它固定在一个地方，供还记得它的人去纪念。也叫下葬。”

福音书似懂非懂：“这样吗？埋了。好吧，那我们把它埋了。”

福音书把桌布拽了下来，相南里把小黑打包，并且寄了个蝴蝶结。

黑甲是很重的，相南里提了起来，感觉还行。

东方青帝顺手接过：“我来。”

沿路还有很多破碎的机器人，相南里修了几台，但更多的只能回炉重造——这些机器人士兵，本来也不是多贵的型号，碎在了和人类士兵斗争的战斗里。

数量一多，几个人显然不够用了。相南里转头：“小青，我们多叫几个机器人来帮忙吧？”

东方青帝抿起唇，他想说这些根本没装拟人模块的机器人懂什么。

它们表达出的所有情绪，都只是人类自己在照镜子。

但这也不算什么大事。

很快，城内幸存的机器人都收到了指令。要求他们把破损的机器人汇聚在一起。

同时收到指令的，还有在外城等候着的永恒之城平民。

无人机在他们头顶盘旋，播放着广播：“同志们好，我们是来自幸存者基地的‘解放者小队’。幸存者基地是一个致力于全体智慧生命和平共处的地表据点，解放者小队是基地的先锋队，我们的任务是把和平与自由带给地表每一个被压迫的生命。”

海狸茫然地坐在地上，她的怀里还抱着葛根。

她听不懂那么多大道理，却依然固执地抬起头，认真倾听着头顶无人机的广播声。

“目前，基地的解放者已经取得了主城区的控制权。赶走了神庭的骑士，杀死了大部分永恒之城管理者。包括城主、大臣、街区监管者、军团长等等。”

人群顿时一片哗然。

没人说得清城主活了多久，他就像是高悬在头顶的太阳。

不，那不是太阳，是一座沉甸甸的山。活在城里的平民们接受着山的庇护，也同样忍耐着山的压迫。

他们从来没想过这座山会倒塌。

“现在，永恒之城的大门重新向你们敞开，请进入内城。基地成员将在人工智能的计算下，为大家发放过冬物资，分割农田、牧场等资产。从此以后，你们不再是城主的奴隶，而是这片土地的主人。”

畸变人已经离去，面前的大门又一次敞开。

城里的火苗看起来微弱了不少。烧成灰烬的房梁冒着青烟。

还有人迟疑，不知所措；但第一个人已经冲进了城内。

他们不怕有陷阱，没有什么比饿死更可怕的事情。

他们只怕自己去晚了，领不到过冬的物资。

……

……

相南里的手微微颤抖着，关掉了通讯器。

“这就是你的答案吗？”东方青帝靠在墙边，语气听不出什么情绪，“我以为你会把永恒之城搬空。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 51

The logic of judgment differs between artificial intelligence and humans.

Take a child, for example. Once a parent teaches them what an apple is, the moment they see one again, their mind instantly recognizes it. They would never mistake it for an "orange" or a "watermelon."

But artificial intelligence is different; it cannot recognize things that way.

It requires a sufficiently large database to learn, scanning, segmenting, and anchoring the concept of an "apple." Only when it sees an apple again can it calculate the similarity between that object and the millions of apple models in its database, and only through such judgment can it confirm, "This is an apple."

Because of this operational logic, the Machine Legion once suffered heavy losses. Alpha’s database had been corrupted many times, and within it, there were millions of "Xiang Nanli" entries.

It took Alpha several months to kill these virtual personalities one by one.

The process of deleting these "Xiang Nanlis" felt like deleting a part of itself.

During that time, Alpha was like a patient suffering from Alzheimer’s. He remembered Xiang Nanli almost by instinct, yet he could not recall a single memory associated with him. Perhaps, for an artificial intelligence, this should be called "data."

It wasn't until Alpha installed the Anthropomorphic Module 2.0 (an upgraded antivirus software) for the machines that this historical legacy was finally resolved.

But the *Gospel* clearly hadn't installed it; it didn't consider "mimicking humans" to be a virus that an AI shouldn't have.

The *Gospel* lay trampled on the ground, struggling for a long time, unable to crawl up.

Xiang Nanli: "Oh, Xiao Qing. Don't be so mean to your companion."

Dongfang Qingdi thought to himself that he and the *Gospel* were certainly not companions, but he obediently moved his foot away.

Xiang Nanli crouched down, clapped his hands, and then opened his arms.

The *Gospel* happily threw itself into his embrace: "Xiang Nanli~~ Xiang Nanli~~ Xiao Fu missed you so much!"

Dongfang Qingdi possessed strict emotional control; under normal circumstances, he wouldn't get angry, let alone use profanity: "Missed you my *ss. Xiang Nanli had already been gone for decades by the time you were born!"

Everyone else thought the *Gospel* was cute, but Dongfang Qingdi felt no pity for it.

Because he had seen the *Gospel* in its complete form. First impressions are important.

Dongfang Qingdi had too many words to describe it: Space Fortress, Metal City, Mobile Catastrophe, Doomsday Warship; none of those words included "mechanical puppy."

The *Gospel’s* body was one Dongfang Qingdi had casually grabbed from downstairs.

This mechanical dog weighed 5.4kg, was an old model, and lacked a dog head. A spherical camera sat right in front of its boxy body, capable of 270-degree rotation. It was also equipped with small weapons, with two gun barrels mounted on its back. It was a patrol dog that combined aesthetics (?) and utility.

Xiang Nanli stroked its metallic body, a happy smile blooming on his face: "So cute, baby."

The *Gospel’s* eyes grew moist. It realized something belatedly: "Why did Xiao Fu turn into a dog?!"

The *Gospel’s* four tires scrambled wildly on the ground: "Xiao Fu doesn't want to be a dog! I am a high-level intelligent machine! I cannot accept this body! Wuwuwuwu!"

Andrew felt ashamed, standing to the side and constantly comforting it: "Conditions are limited, conditions are limited. Being a mechanical dog is fine too; dogs are man's best friend."

Xiang Nanli said sternly: "The Human Alliance has strict control over intelligent machines. If you want to go home with me, you can only keep the appearance of a mechanical dog."

The *Gospel* weighed the pros and cons and replied: "Okay, Xiao Fu is a mechanical dog. Xiao Fu wants to go home with you."

In the control room, there was not only the console and the mechanical dog but also a suit of black armor smashed to pieces, piled in the corner of the room.

Xiang Nanli walked over and checked it for a moment, finding that the armor’s chips had melted due to the high heat.

"It was the decision of those guards. They figured that since the black armor could be piloted by a stranger, it was likely infected with a virus. So they destroyed it directly," Andrew scratched his head.

The Divine Court’s black armor seemed different from pure mechanical devices; the wires connected to the chips felt like blood vessels when touched. What strange technology.

Xiang Nanli gave the metal skin of "Little Black" one last touch: "Can't be fixed, let's bury it."

His tone was full of regret.

He still had a few cat treats in his pocket that Little Black had given him.

No sooner had he finished speaking than Xiao Fu jumped away from his side. Ten seconds later, it dragged a trash can back: "Okay, bury it here."

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but laugh: "That’s not what I meant."

"Then, what does it mean?" Xiao Fu tilted its head.

"It means..." How does one explain human emotions and death to a mechanical life form?

Xiang Nanli thought for a moment: "It means to fix it in one place, so that those who remember it can pay their respects. It’s also called a funeral."

The *Gospel* seemed to understand: "Like that? Buried. Alright, then let’s bury it."

The *Gospel* pulled down a tablecloth, and Xiang Nanli wrapped up Little Black, tying it with a bow.

The black armor was heavy, but Xiang Nanli picked it up, feeling it was manageable.

Dongfang Qingdi took it from him: "I'll do it."

Along the way, there were many broken robots. Xiang Nanli repaired a few, but most could only be sent back to the furnace—these robot soldiers weren't expensive models to begin with, and they had been shattered in the fight against human soldiers.

As the number grew, the few of them clearly weren't enough. Xiang Nanli turned his head: "Xiao Qing, shall we call more robots to help?"

Dongfang Qingdi pursed his lips. He wanted to say that these robots, which didn't even have anthropomorphic modules, wouldn't understand anything.

All the emotions they expressed were merely humans looking into a mirror.

But this wasn't a big deal.

Soon, the surviving robots in the city received the order. They were required to gather the damaged robots together.

At the same time, the civilians of the Eternal City waiting in the outer city also received the broadcast.

Drones hovered above their heads, playing a broadcast: "Comrades, we are the 'Liberator Squad' from the Survivor Base. The Survivor Base is a surface stronghold dedicated to the peaceful coexistence of all intelligent life. The Liberator Squad is the vanguard of the base; our mission is to bring peace and freedom to every oppressed life on the surface."

Beaver sat on the ground, dazed, still holding Gegen in her arms.

She couldn't understand all those grand principles, but she still stubbornly raised her head, listening earnestly to the drone’s broadcast above.

"Currently, the base's liberators have gained control of the main urban area. We have driven away the knights of the Divine Court and killed most of the administrators of the Eternal City, including the City Lord, ministers, district supervisors, legion commanders, and so on."

The crowd was in an uproar.

No one could say how long the City Lord had lived; he was like the sun hanging high above their heads.

No, that wasn't the sun; it was a heavy mountain. The civilians living in the city accepted the mountain's protection, but they also endured the mountain's oppression.

They had never imagined that this mountain would collapse.

"Now, the gates of the Eternal City are open to you once again. Please enter the inner city. Base members will use artificial intelligence calculations to distribute winter supplies, and divide farmland, pastures, and other assets for everyone. From now on, you are no longer the City Lord's slaves, but the masters of this land."

The aberrants had left, and the gates in front of them opened once more.

The fires in the city looked much dimmer. The beams burned to ash emitted blue smoke.

Some still hesitated, at a loss; but the first person had already rushed into the city.

They weren't afraid of traps; nothing was more terrifying than starving to death.

They were only afraid of going too late and missing out on the winter supplies.

...

...

Xiang Nanli’s hands trembled slightly as he turned off the communicator.

"Is this your answer?" Dongfang Qingdi leaned against the wall, his tone devoid of emotion, "I thought you would empty out the Eternal City."

chunks.chineseText:
相南里迟疑着回答：“我想过，但是不现实。这些人……嗯，怎么说呢，基地还什么都没有呢，路途遥远，冰天雪地的，这些人没有接受过基因改造，我可以把他们带走，但会死很多人。不如宣传一下基地。或许以后会有人来投奔呢？

“至于永恒之城的管理，先让人工智能来怎么样？我没有时间挑选值得信赖的人类领袖。基地也还没人能用。”

他反复揉着眉心，太多的念头和构思在他的脑海里闪过。

相南里感觉到了语言的匮乏，他词不达意。

但好在，小青不需要他用语言表达。

他能看见相南里想要的那个未来。

东方青帝：“我可以理解你的想法。但你要知道，所有生物，包括人类，为了让自己的基因延续下去，天生就是逐利的。而完全的公平，也是一种不公平。个人的付出应该得到奖励。或许现在永恒之城的人得到了公平，但未来，注定会因为掌握资源的不均，再次划分出阶级。”

东方青帝看着他碧绿的眼眸。对方同样回望着他，有些出乎意料地茫然和无措。

解放、和平与共存。

这不是一条最有效率的道路，甚至会因为过于正派，影响基地的生存与发展；但这是相南里认为的正确。

“历史是一个轮回。”相南里低声道，“小青。我想清楚了。没有什么制度能永远完美下去，那不现实，我们只为现在的人规划就够了。比如永恒之城的这些农奴，他们领到了过冬的粮食和麦子。等明年春天，就会有新的种子发芽。或许几十年后甚至几个月后，这里又会恢复原样……但起码这个冬天，他们在灾难中幸存。”

相南里莫名其妙地热泪盈眶，他微微低头，用指腹，不太好意思地擦去脸上的泪水：“这就够了。”

东方青帝沉默着，他感觉到了一种很微妙的情绪。说不上来。

心疼？

他计算片刻，回答：“让安德鲁来当名义上的管理者，如何？给他一个幸存者基地成员的身份。”

相南里顾虑重重：“那他岂不是会留在地表，相晨曦和沙利叶死了，神庭会派人来查看的吧？”

“那也是春天后的事了。”东方青帝回答，“我们只需要一个月。一个月，足够把荒废的基地修剪好。那时候天狼星也孵化出来了。天狼星、福音书、安德鲁还有漠北，这些人会是基地的第一批成员。暂时不要暴露基地的位置。神庭再怎么愤怒，也不会对农奴动手，毕竟他们什么也决定不了。”

他走上前，微微蹙起眉，拿起桌子上的湿巾，认认真真地擦掉了相南里脸上的污渍和泪。

相南里看着他近在咫尺的脸，感觉自己的审美有点重回18岁。

东方青帝的动作停顿了片刻：“收拾好情绪，相南里。现在你就是永恒之城的主人，该去面对觐见你的臣民了。”
chunks.englishText:
Xiang Nanli answered hesitantly: "I thought about it, but it’s not realistic. These people... well, how should I put it? The base has nothing yet, the journey is long, and it’s freezing. These people haven't undergone genetic modification. I could take them away, but many would die. It’s better to promote the base. Perhaps some will come to join us later?

"As for the management of the Eternal City, how about letting artificial intelligence handle it for now? I don't have the time to select trustworthy human leaders. And the base doesn't have anyone to spare yet."

He rubbed his temples repeatedly; too many thoughts and ideas flashed through his mind.

Xiang Nanli felt a poverty of language; he couldn't express himself clearly.

But fortunately, Xiao Qing didn't need him to express it in words.

He could see the future that Xiang Nanli wanted.

Dongfang Qingdi: "I can understand your thinking. But you must know that all living things, including humans, are born to be profit-driven in order to ensure the continuation of their genes. And absolute fairness is also a form of unfairness. Individual effort should be rewarded. Perhaps the people of the Eternal City have gained fairness now, but in the future, it is destined that classes will be divided again due to the unequal distribution of resources."

Dongfang Qingdi looked into his emerald eyes. The other party looked back at him, unexpectedly dazed and at a loss.

Liberation, peace, and coexistence.

This was not the most efficient path, and it might even affect the survival and development of the base because it was too upright; but this was what Xiang Nanli believed to be right.

"History is a cycle," Xiang Nanli said in a low voice. "Xiao Qing. I’ve thought it through. No system can be perfect forever; that’s not realistic. We only need to plan for the people of the present. For example, these serfs in the Eternal City have received food and wheat for the winter. Next spring, new seeds will sprout. Perhaps in a few decades, or even a few months, this place will return to how it was... but at least for this winter, they have survived the disaster."

Xiang Nanli felt inexplicably teary-eyed. He lowered his head slightly and used his fingertips to wipe the tears from his face, feeling a bit embarrassed: "That’s enough."

Dongfang Qingdi was silent. He felt a very subtle emotion. He couldn't put his finger on it.

Heartache?

He calculated for a moment and replied: "How about letting Andrew serve as the nominal administrator? Give him the status of a Survivor Base member."

Xiang Nanli was full of concerns: "Wouldn't that mean he’ll stay on the surface? Xiang Chenxi and Sariel are dead; the Divine Court will surely send people to investigate, right?"

"That’s a matter for after spring," Dongfang Qingdi replied. "We only need one month. One month is enough to tidy up the abandoned base. By then, Sirius will have hatched as well. Sirius, the *Gospel*, Andrew, and Mobei—these people will be the first batch of members of the base. Do not expose the location of the base for now. No matter how angry the Divine Court is, they won't take action against serfs; after all, they can't decide anything."

He stepped forward, frowning slightly, picked up a wet wipe from the table, and earnestly wiped the dirt and tears from Xiang Nanli’s face.

Xiang Nanli looked at his face, which was inches away, and felt his aesthetic sense returning to when he was 18.

Dongfang Qingdi’s movements paused for a moment: "Collect yourself, Xiang Nanli. You are now the master of the Eternal City; it’s time to face the subjects who have come to see you."

chunks.chineseText:
第52章

人群朝着内城的广场聚集。大多数人表情惶恐，像是被赶出巢穴的小兽，在冰天雪地里报团取暖，瑟瑟发抖。

内城的街道真漂亮。不像外城，排泄物、生活垃圾和雪混在一起。

海狸怀抱着葛根，用彩色的大围巾裹着他的身体。她的眼睛睁大，这条围巾是路过纺织厂的时候顺手捡来的。她很怕有人让她还回去。倒不是舍不得漂亮的毛巾，而是重伤的葛根需要保暖。

生化战士的自我修复能力比普通人强，堪比畸变人。葛根的伤口已经不流血，只是红肉依然暴露在空气中，被氧化成微微泛黑的颜色。

广场上的雪和血都被打扫干净了。一把把椅子放在广场边缘。看起来都是机器人从各位老爷的宫殿里搬出来的。

每个人都有位置，海狸在一张玫红色的绸缎凳子上坐下，她从未想过，凳子居然也能是软的。上面还点缀着珍珠。

多漂亮的凳子。也是她能坐的吗？

人群来到内城，反而安静了下来。表情有些许敬畏。他们局促不安地坐下，互相打量着。

平坦的地上堆满了一大堆金属垃圾，像座小山丘。一夜过去，太阳升起来了，只是天上的云层太厚，只有灰蒙蒙的天光。

过了一会，他们身边多了一些人。

机器人。

它们并非全都是人型。还有垃圾桶、机械狗、扫雪车。

类似人型的生物在同一片观众席坐下了，其他异形生物则是站在椅子后面，围成一个圈。

机器人的眼部位置亮着光带，等待着下一步指令，像黑夜里双眼放光的狼群。

这些机器人没有安装拟人模块，只能听从指令运行，它们在这的象征意义，远大于实际意义。

海狸见过机器人士兵，永恒之城的农奴就被它们看管着。

纺织厂以前有人偷兽皮去换药，也是被机器人处决的。海狸在织布机前坐着，只听见枪声一响。

“这是要干什么呢？”海狸心头充满疑惑。

几辆囚车朝着广场驶来，停靠在广场的另一侧。这几辆车都是火车，只是车厢敞开着，能让其他人看见车里装着的东西。

海狸匆匆扫过，只认识几个人。比如管她们那条街的老爷（市政官），收粮食的老爷（大司农），还有负责在交换市场上收十一税、过年收年税的老爷（税务官）……

这些老爷过去态度高傲，不可一世，表情上写满不耐烦，仿佛和他们这些外城区居民多说一个字都是恩典。如今在囚车里，同样哭天喊地，衣衫褴褛像逃难的农奴。

不少老爷的脚踝上还有电子锁，这代表他们曾经反抗过，然后被制裁了。

又过了几分钟，机器人起立，自动让开一条道路。

海狸也跟着站了起来。

她看见了一个年轻的男人，穿着奇怪的衣服，听说那叫防护服。脸被挡了大半，只露出一双漂亮的绿眼睛，像海狸在昂贵礼服上见过的孔雀翎和绿松石。

所有人的目光都在这一刻投向他。

至于他身边那个身高一米五几的机器人；大家下意识忽略掉了。

他和那台机器人一起站上了高台。

海狸从扩音器里，听见了他的声音。和之前听见的一样，她天然地产生了亲切。

只不过这次，他用的人联语，好在有翻译。

男人说他叫相南里，来自幸存者基地解放者小队；基地的理念是所有智慧生物平等共处……嗯，这段之前已经听他说过了。

而他身边这位，叫安德鲁，也是基地的成员，会在未来一个月成为永恒之城的代理城主。

安德鲁会协助城市自主发展，率领市民战后重建。

“原来是要换个城主？”有人小声议论着。

政变、战争、改朝换代。这对他们来说都太遥远了，更难以理解。

相南里之前说的什么什么“解放”“压迫”“平等”，他们同样也听不懂。

“现在，基地解放永恒之城的行动取得了初步成功。我们将按照《基地法律》对永恒之城的管理者进行审判。”

……

……

东方青帝站在城墙边，朝着广场的方向望去。

他没有出场。

福音书也没有。它需要一个安静的环境，操控城内的机器人。

福音书跳到了城墙上，一键开启录像模式，嘴里念念有词：“新历947年1月11日，永恒之城广场会议的召开，宣告着幸存者基地的正式成立。相南里向地表遗民宣传基地的理念，并确立了‘全体智慧生命和平共处’的基本方针。基地成员安德鲁成为永恒之城代理城主……

“史称，‘永恒审判’。”

东方青帝微微眯起眼：“我可不记得你还是史官。”

福音书歪过能270度旋转的机械眼珠子，看向他：“你为什么不下去，侦察兵？”

东方青帝没有回答。

他挡在朝霞前，神情平静又寡淡，根本没有朝福音书解释的打算。

但福音书已经自顾自地开口：“因为理念不一样吗？”

“但你是智械军团的战士，你认为的‘正确’，到底是你的想法，还是Alpha灌输给你的呢？你站在谁的立场上？又为哪一批人在考虑呢？”

Alpha5.2.0沉默许久。

他眉心蹙起：“你烦得像是传道书。”

机械小狗哈哈大笑起来。

……

……

雪花纷纷扬扬落下。

广场上的气氛骤然肃杀起来。

“第一个犯人，永恒之城城主。”

一具人头分离的尸体被推了出来。

海狸忍不住惊呼一声，但威严如泰阿的城主，并没有站起来，也没有复活。

机器人根据永恒之城数据库里的资料，开始细数城主的罪行。反人类、奴役同类、虐杀、非法生物实验……

怀里，传来葛根微弱的说话声：“我是七岁那年成为生化战士的。我和我哥哥一起接受的注射。我畸变了一部分，还有理智；但哥哥成了畸变人，被守卫们射杀了。”

最后，机器人给出审判结果：“死刑，立即执行。”

城主的尸体被补了一刀，然后像垃圾一样，被丢进了另一辆空的囚车里。

这辆车上还有电子屏幕，写了一行字：农肥回收。

接下来是大臣，机器人念完了他的罪行，照旧宣判道：“死刑，立即执行。”

这名大臣身材肥硕，像一只大胖老鼠。

他腿脚发软，跪在地上：“我我，不——不！我是好人啊，我一个人都没杀过。”

“去你*！”一个中年女人忍不住站了起来，破口大骂，“畜生！把我儿子还给我！你个*！”

这位大老爷喜欢幼童。

在外城区闲逛的时候，家里有小孩的家庭总是很担心。但也有人主动献上自己的小孩。

一旁的机器人士兵毫无波澜，射出一枚子弹，贯穿他的眉心。

大老爷也被拖了下去。

绝望的母亲愣了一下，然后在下一秒捂住自己的脸，嚎啕大哭。

海狸的心口颤了颤，她感觉到了一种莫名的情绪。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 52

The crowd gathered toward the inner city square. Most had terrified expressions, like small beasts driven out of their nests, huddling together for warmth in the freezing snow, shivering.

The streets of the inner city were beautiful. Unlike the outer city, where excrement, household waste, and snow were mixed together.

Beaver held Gegen in her arms, wrapping his body in a colorful large scarf. Her eyes were wide; she had picked up this scarf while passing by a textile mill. She was terrified that someone would make her return it. It wasn't that she couldn't bear to part with the pretty scarf, but that the severely injured Gegen needed warmth.

The self-healing ability of bio-warriors was stronger than that of ordinary people, comparable to aberrants. Gegen’s wounds had stopped bleeding, but the red flesh was still exposed to the air, oxidized to a slightly blackened color.

The snow and blood on the square had been cleaned up. Chairs were placed along the edge of the square. They all looked like they had been moved by robots from the palaces of the various lords.

Everyone had a seat. Beaver sat down on a rose-red silk stool; she had never imagined that a stool could be soft. It was even studded with pearls.

What a beautiful stool. Was it something she was allowed to sit on?

As the crowd arrived in the inner city, they became quiet. Their expressions held a hint of awe. They sat down uneasily, eyeing each other.

The flat ground was piled with a large heap of metal junk, like a small hill. A night had passed, and the sun had risen, but the cloud layer in the sky was too thick, leaving only gray, dim light.

After a while, more people appeared beside them.

Robots.

They were not all humanoid. There were trash cans, mechanical dogs, and snowplows.

Humanoid-like beings sat in the same audience area, while other strange-looking creatures stood behind the chairs, forming a circle.

The eye areas of the robots glowed with light strips, waiting for the next command, like a pack of wolves with glowing eyes in the dark night.

These robots had not installed anthropomorphic modules and could only operate by following commands. Their symbolic significance here was far greater than their practical significance.

Beaver had seen robot soldiers; the serfs of the Eternal City were guarded by them.

In the past, someone at the textile mill had stolen animal skins to trade for medicine and was executed by the robots. Beaver, sitting at her loom, had only heard the sound of a gunshot.

"What is this for?" Beaver’s heart was filled with confusion.

Several prison carts drove toward the square and stopped on the other side. These carts were train cars, but the carriages were open, allowing others to see what was inside.

Beaver scanned them hurriedly, recognizing only a few people. For example, the lord who managed their street (the Municipal Officer), the lord who collected grain (the Minister of Agriculture), and the lord responsible for collecting the tithe at the exchange market and the annual tax during the New Year (the Tax Officer)...

These lords used to be arrogant and overbearing, their expressions full of impatience, as if saying a single word to residents of the outer city was a favor. Now, in the prison carts, they were crying and howling, dressed in rags like fleeing serfs.

Many of the lords had electronic locks on their ankles, which meant they had resisted in the past and had been sanctioned.

A few minutes later, the robots stood up and automatically cleared a path.

Beaver followed suit and stood up.

She saw a young man wearing strange clothes; she heard it was called a protective suit. Most of his face was covered, revealing only a pair of beautiful green eyes, like the peacock feathers and turquoise Beaver had seen on expensive gowns.

All eyes were fixed on him at this moment.

As for the robot over a meter and a half tall beside him, everyone subconsciously ignored it.

He and that robot stood on the high platform together.

From the loudspeaker, Beaver heard his voice. Just like when she had heard it before, she naturally felt a sense of closeness.

Only this time, he used the Human Alliance language, but fortunately, there was a translation.

The man said his name was Xiang Nanli, from the Survivor Base’s Liberator Squad; the base’s philosophy was the peaceful coexistence of all intelligent beings... well, she had already heard him say this part before.

And the one beside him was named Andrew, also a member of the base, who would become the acting City Lord of the Eternal City for the next month.

Andrew would assist the city in autonomous development and lead the citizens in post-war reconstruction.

"So, we're getting a new City Lord?" someone whispered.

Coups, wars, changing dynasties. These were all too distant for them, and even harder to understand.

They also couldn't understand the "liberation," "oppression," and "equality" that Xiang Nanli had talked about earlier.

"Now, the base’s operation to liberate the Eternal City has achieved initial success. We will judge the administrators of the Eternal City according to the 'Base Law'."

...

...

Dongfang Qingdi stood by the city wall, looking toward the square.

He did not make an appearance.

Neither did the *Gospel*. It needed a quiet environment to control the robots in the city.

The *Gospel* jumped onto the city wall, turned on recording mode with one click, and muttered to itself: "New Calendar Year 947, January 11th, the convening of the Eternal City Square Conference marks the official establishment of the Survivor Base. Xiang Nanli promoted the base’s philosophy to the surface survivors and established the basic policy of 'peaceful coexistence of all intelligent life.' Base member Andrew became the acting City Lord of the Eternal City...

"Known in history as the 'Eternal Judgment'."

Dongfang Qingdi narrowed his eyes slightly: "I don't recall you being a historian."

The *Gospel* tilted its 270-degree rotatable mechanical eyeball and looked at him: "Why aren't you going down, Scout?"

Dongfang Qingdi did not answer.

He blocked the morning glow, his expression calm and bland, with no intention of explaining to the *Gospel*.

But the *Gospel* had already spoken on its own: "Because the philosophies are different?"

"But you are a warrior of the Machine Legion. Is the 'correctness' you believe in your own idea, or is it what Alpha instilled in you? Whose side are you standing on? And which group of people are you considering?"

Alpha 5.2.0 was silent for a long time.

He frowned: "You are as annoying as the Book of Ecclesiastes."

The mechanical puppy laughed out loud.

...

...

Snowflakes drifted down in abundance.

The atmosphere in the square suddenly turned murderous.

"The first prisoner, the City Lord of the Eternal City."

A corpse with its head separated from its body was pushed out.

Beaver couldn't help but gasp, but the City Lord, once as majestic as Mount Tai, did not stand up, nor did he revive.

Based on the data in the Eternal City’s database, the robots began to count the City Lord’s crimes. Crimes against humanity, enslavement of his own kind, torture, illegal biological experiments...

In her arms, a weak voice came from Gegen: "I became a bio-warrior when I was seven. My brother and I received the injection together. I mutated partially and still had my reason; but my brother became an aberrant and was shot to death by the guards."

Finally, the robot gave the verdict: "Death penalty, to be carried out immediately."

The City Lord’s corpse was stabbed one more time, then, like trash, it was thrown into another empty prison cart.

There was an electronic screen on this cart with a line of text: *Agricultural Fertilizer Recycling.*

Next was the minister. The robot finished reading his crimes and pronounced the sentence as usual: "Death penalty, to be carried out immediately."

This minister was obese, like a big fat rat.

His legs went weak, and he knelt on the ground: "I, I, no—no! I’m a good person; I’ve never killed anyone."

"F*ck you!" a middle-aged woman couldn't help but stand up and curse loudly, "You beast! Give me back my son! You f*cker!"

This great lord liked young children.

When wandering in the outer city, families with children were always worried. But there were also those who voluntarily offered their children.

The robot soldier on the side remained unmoved, firing a bullet that pierced through his forehead.

The great lord was also dragged away.

The desperate mother froze for a moment, and then, in the next second, covered her face and wailed.

Beaver’s heart trembled; she felt an inexplicable emotion.

chunks.chineseText:
她描述不出来，也不知道原因，只是激动到浑身颤抖，双眼通红。

是的，大老爷。我的恨意只是一张柔软的砂纸。

但是总有人，他们的意志，是带血的子弹！

海狸下意识地朝着相南里的方位望去。

对方的眼神很平静，他不怎么说话，更不会出声打断安德鲁。

税务官、士兵长、大司农……

一个个人被推了出来，念罪行，念法典，然后处刑。丢进回收车里。

就像是他们对待冻死的农奴那样。

最后一位是城主夫人。比起其他贵族，她保持了最基本的体面。

夫人被押下车，重重推开两侧的机器人士兵。电流从她的身体窜过，这个外表接近老年的贵族妇女狼狈地倒在地上。

她站起来，厉声道：“让你们基地的管理者来见我，我是黑十字审判庭的教徒。你们难道不怕得罪神庭吗？！”

相南里平静地反问：“神庭又如何？这和你犯下的罪行有关吗？神庭的教徒，就是你虐杀其他人类的资格证吗？”

枪声响起。

至此，所有犯人处决完毕。

剩下一些人罪不至死，会戴上电子锁戴罪立功。为自己过去的错误赎罪。

毕竟这些人在永恒之城，也算高级知识分子和技术人才，大概能派上一些作用。

周围有机器人，压根不怕他们逃跑。这就是机器人的另一个坏处了，死板。

审判结束后，这场会议进入了另一个流程。

“现在，你们面前的这些尸体，来自为了保卫、解放永恒之城，而牺牲的智慧生命。”

雪地里刨出一个大坑，这些废铜烂铁和少量生化战士的尸体，被埋进地底。

葛根挣扎着，从海狸的怀里坐了起来，他的双眼有了一些微光：“那是丁香，还有八角枫和九里香。”这些人都是他朝夕相处的同伴。

保姆机器人运来了温室的鲜花，数不清的玫瑰与百合花盖在尸体上。

无人机放起了音乐，隆重又哀伤。

人群自发的安静下来，哪怕是牙牙学语的小孩，也感觉了气氛的庄严与肃穆。

相南里继续道——

“经过基地委员会讨论，永恒之城内城广场更名为‘解放者广场’。参与畸变体攻城守卫战的战士记集体一等功，且获得‘幸存者基地荣誉市民’称号。我们将在永恒之城内竖立一座‘解放者纪念碑’，纪念这些英勇牺牲的战士。”

“无论是智人、智械还是生化改造人，我们活在同一片天空下，共同为智慧生物的解放而战斗。是的，我们身处极夜中，那就亲自拉开天幕。我们势必翻越一切天堑；势必让文明的火焰重新在废土之上燃烧；势必让崭新的世界，从地平线上升起！”

远处的城墙上，福音书激动的上蹿下跳：“很好，这段话录下来了，以后用波段的形式发射出去！小福要制作全息影像24小时不间断重播！”

东方青帝忍不住吱声：“你是在帮他还是害他？”

“所以我说以后嘛。”身高只到他小腿的机械狗心情显然不错，它哼了一会歌，忽地开口，“他是相南里，你又是谁呢？侦察兵。”

更远一点的山坡上。

以西结站在山顶，这个位置能俯瞰整个永恒之城。隆冬，周围的树木都光秃秃的。

他无意识地吐着长长的舌头，瞳孔一会圆，一会竖。

以西结抬头，挠了挠自己的脸。半透明的鳞片掉了下来，露出底下接近人类肤色的皮肤。

“呵……”说得倒是好听。

他后退一步，消失在山林间。
chunks.englishText:
She couldn't describe it, nor did she know the reason; she simply trembled all over, her eyes rimmed with red, overcome by a surge of emotion.

Yes, my lord. My hatred was merely a piece of soft sandpaper.

But there are always those whose will is like a bullet stained with blood!

Beaver subconsciously glanced toward Xiang Nanli’s direction.

The man’s gaze was calm. He didn't speak much, and he certainly wouldn't interrupt Andrew.

Tax collectors, captains of the guard, the Grand Minister of Agriculture...

One by one, they were pushed out, their crimes read aloud, the legal codes recited, and then the execution carried out. They were tossed into the recycling truck.

Just as they had treated the frozen serfs.

The last one was the City Lord’s wife. Compared to the other nobles, she maintained a basic level of dignity.

The lady was shoved off the truck, forcefully pushing aside the robotic soldiers on either side. A jolt of electricity surged through her body, and this noblewoman, who appeared to be in her twilight years, fell to the ground in a disheveled heap.

She stood up and snapped sharply, "Bring your base commander to see me! I am a devotee of the Black Cross Inquisition. Do you not fear offending the Divine Court?!"

Xiang Nanli asked calmly in return, "And what of the Divine Court? Does that have anything to do with the crimes you have committed? Is being a devotee of the Divine Court your qualification to torture and slaughter other human beings?"

A gunshot rang out.

With that, all the prisoners had been executed.

The remaining individuals, whose crimes did not warrant death, would be fitted with electronic locks to perform service in atonement. They would pay for their past transgressions.

After all, in the Eternal City, these people were considered high-level intellectuals and technical talent; they could likely be put to some use.

With robots surrounding them, there was no fear of them escaping. This was another downside of robots: they were rigid.

After the trial concluded, the meeting moved to another phase.

"Before you now lie the bodies of sentient beings who sacrificed themselves to defend and liberate the Eternal City."

A large pit was dug in the snow, and these scraps of metal and the corpses of a few bio-warriors were buried beneath the earth.

Gegen struggled to sit up from Beaver’s embrace, a faint glimmer of light in his eyes: "That’s Ding Xiang, and Ba Jiao Feng, and Jiu Li Xiang." These were his companions with whom he had spent every waking moment.

Nanny robots brought flowers from the greenhouse, and countless roses and lilies were laid over the bodies.

Drones played music, solemn and mournful.

The crowd spontaneously fell silent; even the babbling children felt the gravity and solemnity of the atmosphere.

Xiang Nanli continued—

"Following a discussion by the Base Committee, the inner square of the Eternal City is hereby renamed 'Liberator’s Square.' The warriors who participated in the defense against the Aberrant siege are awarded a collective First-Class Merit and the title of 'Honorary Citizen of the Survivor Base.' We will erect a 'Liberator’s Monument' in the Eternal City to commemorate these heroic fallen warriors."

"Whether we are Sapiens, Machina, or bio-engineered humans, we live under the same sky, fighting together for the liberation of all sentient life. Yes, we find ourselves in the polar night, so we shall tear open the firmament ourselves. We are bound to surmount every chasm; we are bound to let the flame of civilization burn once more upon the wasteland; we are bound to let a brand-new world rise from the horizon!"

On the distant city wall, Gospel was jumping up and down in excitement: "Excellent! That speech has been recorded. We’ll broadcast it in waves later! Little Fu will create a hologram and put it on a 24-hour loop!"

Dongfang Qingdi couldn't help but interject: "Are you helping him or hurting him?"

"I said *later*, didn't I?" The mechanical dog, whose height reached only his shins, was clearly in a good mood. It hummed a tune for a while, then suddenly spoke, "He is Xiang Nanli, but who are you, Scout?"

On a hillside further away.

Ezekiel stood at the summit, a position from which he could overlook the entire Eternal City. It was midwinter, and the surrounding trees were bare.

He unconsciously flicked his long tongue, his pupils shifting between round and slit.

Ezekiel looked up and scratched his face. Translucent scales flaked off, revealing skin beneath that resembled a human's.

"Heh..." Talk is cheap.

He took a step back and vanished into the mountain forest.

chunks.chineseText:
第53章

永恒之城广场内的纪念碑立了起来，是铁铸成的。

原料和工匠双双短缺，这个纪念碑是简单的长方体，没什么花纹。正面写的是“英雄永垂不朽”背面写的是“纪念所有牺牲的人类与机器人——幸存者基地留”。

相南里还有意无意地画了一个同心圆，作为基地的符号。

嗯，部分金属原料，是夜里偷偷从埋好的坑里挖出来的……

安德鲁做过最大的官不过是研究所小组长，手底下8个人。一下子管理六万人（原本7万，一部分死在战乱里）的城市，难免有点捉襟见肘，好在有人工智能和机器人的协助；而且，作为一个机械改造人，他只需要很少的睡眠。

当然，最重要的是，永恒之城的居民非常配合。

宫殿被改造成了集体宿舍，花园变为农田和牧场。粮食和水源都变成了“公有”，按照机器的计算精准分配——以达到最基本的温饱。现在资源不够，只能把所有人养活，而不是养胖。

人类是非常朴实可爱的。或者说，所有动物都有这样的天性：趋利。

永恒之城的秩序在短短三天得到了恢复，农奴取下电子锁，反而自觉开始种田，这是他们明年的粮食。

摩擦依然存在，只是无伤大局。人们的生活比以前好了几个档次，就算有矛盾，也不会在最近爆发。

相南里打算离开了。他还有更重要的事去做，比如购买接入仓，学习新技术，以及去看看小青说的那座基地，不能一直守着一座城市。

如果他离开据点就出乱子，那只能说明一件事：基地的管理制度不具有普遍性，需要修正。

相南里在离开之前完成的最后一项任务：给机器人们植入种田模块。

这些金属人干重活累活，效率可比人类高，简直新世纪老黄牛。

他还是第一次尝试给新时代的机器人编程，一个人关在房间里琢磨了大半天，然后谨慎地写下第一行代码。很快，一行行复杂的代码像是琴音从他指尖流淌出来。

如今，看着扫雪车在田里用铁片翻着梆硬的冻土，相南里坐在墙头，忍不住嘿嘿地笑了起来：“铸剑为犁啊，小青。”

东方青帝能感觉到，

相南里非常高兴。

这种喜悦甚至不比劫后余生更低。

东方青帝问：“你不担心安德鲁叛变吗？野心是会膨胀的。”

相南里眯起眼，感受着迎面而来的风：“如果基地的理念贯彻下去，我不在乎王座最后的主人是谁。”

东方青帝的嘴角微微下撇，心想，我在乎。

而且，一定还有很多人在乎。

权力到底来源哪里？比较容易被提起的是财产和组织，还有一个很容易被忽略的来源：人格。

权力，不过是对意志的服从。

一名受信任的领袖能改变他者的意志，哪怕他一无所有。

“而且，”相南里拍了拍身旁小狗的头，“福音书不是还在我这吗。安德鲁真有野心，也不看看城里这些机器人听谁的。”

福音书骄傲地昂起不存在的狗头：“它们听小福的，小福听你的。”

相南里欣赏了一会机器车种田，就回到了内城。

他准备离开了，越野车就停在内城，已经加满柴油。走之前顺便和安德鲁打声招呼。

他往回走，一路上，都有人亲切地和他打着招呼：“大人！”

“相南里大人。”

人们的观念还没有改过来，一开始还有叫老爷给他磕头的。

不过被相南里命令禁止了。

相南里路过了解放者纪念碑。广场附近有小孩在堆雪人玩，这是过去不会见到景象。

纪念碑前方，几只圆滚滚的小机器人摘来鲜花，放在碑前。然后久久抬头，凝望。

东方青帝停下脚步，然后踢了一下福音书：“你感觉到了吗？”

这些机器人诞生了一种名为“情绪”的病毒。

病毒可能直接被体内的杀毒软件带走；也可能在未来的某个瞬间突变，让机器人突变为真正的“电子生命”。

这到底进化，还是退化呢？

小福一个倒栽葱进了雪里，怒气冲冲地把自己拔出来：“侦察兵，我警告你！小福当年在智械军团也是五星上将级别的智械人！权限只比你们元帅低半级！”

东方青帝冷笑：“你个逃犯，还有脸说。迟早把你送军事法庭。”

福音书气得汪汪叫：“你个战犯！我才要审判你！”

走在前方的相南里扭过头：“小青，过来帮下忙。我不会开这种车。”

东方青帝放弃了和福音书纠缠：“来了。”

他们吵吵闹闹地往前走去。

站在纪念碑前的一台小机器人悄悄扭头，看向东方青帝的背影……或者说，在他更前面的相南里。

永恒之城内有辐射吸收装置，相南里接收了几次基因强化，因此没有戴防护面罩。

这张脸如此年轻，朝气蓬勃。在晦暗的天空下，像太阳一样，吸引着所有人的视线。

小机器人的这一举动其实相当人性化。

或者说，这就是当了太久的人类残留的本能。

小机器人很快意识到了不对，幸好无人在乎它。

他们很快消失在小机器人的视野范围内。

它面无表情地低头，运行着滚轮，继续着今日的扫雪工作。

……

……

相南里站在停车场边。

来的时候，俱乐部好几个人，回去的时候，竟然只有他、小青和一条狗。

越野车也不知道是哪个俱乐部留下的，性能还不错。发出嗡嗡的响声。

相南里站在车边，相当低调。车里有从城主库房里搜刮到的最重要的一批战利品——基因进化药。

是神庭发放的。既不是修复类，也不是强化类。而是生化改造类。

这批基因药一共100瓶，如果使用得当，能造出100名生化战士……要是狠心掠夺，甚至能靠着这批生化战士，在废土之上，再造一个城邦。

相南里还不准备用，但却一定要带走的。

“相南里大人。”一声怯怯地呼唤从他身后传来。

相南里转身，看见了一个有着栗色长卷发的年轻女人。手里握着一个漂亮的布口袋。

“大人，我叫海狸。”海狸有些紧张，“您是要走了吗？我我……”

相南里下意识回答：“是的，我和我的未婚夫要回基地了。”

倒不是他自恋。只是这种事在相南里人生的20到35岁时，经常发生。

嗯……后来招了洛阳当研究生，这种事少了很多。当时相南里还和自己学生开玩笑，说自己也没秃顶啊，怎么就突然退出婚恋市场了。

海狸点头：“大人，我之前是纺织工。这是为城主夫人做的胸针，现在也用不上了。我想送给您。我也是第一次做。”

相南里接过，打开首饰盒，看了眼。主石是祖母绿宝石，整体偏向十字架结构，像舒展的橄榄叶，这是神庭的标志。

除了最中央的绿宝石，每一片叶子上都嵌满了钻石和小珍珠。

钻石又一次变值钱，和秩序的恢复密不可分。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 53

The monument in the Eternal City square was erected; it was made of iron.

With both raw materials and skilled craftsmen in short supply, the monument was a simple rectangular block without any intricate carvings. The front read, "Heroes Are Immortal," and the back read, "In Memory of All Fallen Humans and Robots—From the Survivor Base."

Xiang Nanli also intentionally or unintentionally drew a concentric circle as the symbol of the base.

Well, some of the metal materials had been secretly dug up from the burial pit at night...

The highest position Andrew had ever held was as a research team leader, with eight people under him. Managing a city of sixty thousand (originally seventy thousand, with some dying in the chaos) all at once was inevitably a bit of a stretch, but fortunately, he had the assistance of AI and robots. Moreover, as a cyborg, he required very little sleep.

Of course, the most important thing was that the residents of the Eternal City were very cooperative.

The palace was converted into a collective dormitory, and the gardens were turned into farmland and pastures. Food and water became "public property," distributed precisely according to the robots' calculations—to ensure basic sustenance. Resources were currently insufficient, so they could only keep everyone alive, not fat.

Humans are very simple and lovable. Or rather, all animals possess this nature: the pursuit of self-interest.

Order in the Eternal City was restored in just three days. The serfs took off their electronic locks and began to farm voluntarily; this was their food for the coming year.

Friction still existed, but it did not affect the big picture. People's lives were several grades better than before, and even if there were conflicts, they wouldn't erupt in the near future.

Xiang Nanli planned to leave. He had more important things to do, such as purchasing an access pod, learning new technologies, and going to see the base that Xiao Qing had mentioned. He couldn't guard one city forever.

If things fell into chaos the moment he left a stronghold, it only meant one thing: the base's management system was not universal and needed revision.

The last task Xiang Nanli completed before leaving: installing farming modules into the robots.

These metal beings did heavy, tiring work with higher efficiency than humans; they were truly the "old oxen" of the new century.

This was his first time trying to program new-era robots. He locked himself in a room for half a day, pondering, then cautiously wrote the first line of code. Soon, lines of complex code flowed from his fingertips like a melody.

Now, watching the snowplows turning the rock-hard frozen soil in the fields with iron blades, Xiang Nanli sat on the wall and couldn't help but chuckle: "Beating swords into plowshares, eh, Xiao Qing."

Dongfang Qingdi could feel it.

Xiang Nanli was very happy.

This joy was no less than that of surviving a catastrophe.

Dongfang Qingdi asked, "Aren't you worried that Andrew will rebel? Ambition tends to expand."

Xiang Nanli squinted, feeling the wind on his face: "If the base's philosophy is carried through, I don't care who the final master of the throne is."

Dongfang Qingdi’s lips curled downward slightly, thinking, *I care.*

And surely, many others cared as well.

Where does power ultimately come from? Property and organization are the most easily cited sources, but there is another source that is easily overlooked: personality.

Power is merely the submission of others to one's will.

A trusted leader can change the will of others, even if he possesses nothing.

"Besides," Xiang Nanli patted the head of the little dog beside him, "isn't Gospel still with me? Even if Andrew truly has ambition, he’d have to see who the robots in the city listen to."

Gospel proudly raised its non-existent dog head: "They listen to Little Fu, and Little Fu listens to you."

Xiang Nanli admired the robotic farming for a while before returning to the inner city.

He was ready to leave. The off-road vehicle was parked in the inner city, already filled with diesel. He would say goodbye to Andrew before heading out.

As he walked back, people greeted him warmly along the way: "My Lord!"

"Lord Xiang Nanli."

People's mindsets hadn't fully changed yet; at first, some even called him "Master" and tried to kowtow to him.

But Xiang Nanli had strictly forbidden it.

Xiang Nanli passed the Liberator’s Monument. Near the square, children were playing and building a snowman—a scene that would never have been seen in the past.

In front of the monument, a few round little robots picked flowers and placed them before the stone. Then, they looked up and gazed at it for a long time.

Dongfang Qingdi stopped and kicked Gospel: "Did you feel that?"

These robots had developed a virus called "emotion."

The virus might be wiped out by the antivirus software within their systems, or it might mutate at some future moment, causing the robots to evolve into true "electronic life."

Is this evolution, or devolution?

Little Fu did a somersault into the snow and angrily pulled itself out: "Scout, I’m warning you! Back in the Machina Legion, Little Fu was a five-star general-level unit! My clearance was only half a level lower than your Marshal’s!"

Dongfang Qingdi sneered: "You’re a fugitive; you have no right to speak. I’ll send you to a military tribunal sooner or later."

Gospel barked in anger: "You war criminal! I’m the one who should be judging you!"

Xiang Nanli, walking in front, turned his head: "Xiao Qing, come help me. I don't know how to drive this kind of car."

Dongfang Qingdi gave up on bickering with Gospel: "Coming."

They walked forward, noisy and bickering.

A small robot standing in front of the monument quietly turned its head to look at Dongfang Qingdi’s back... or rather, at Xiang Nanli, who was further ahead.

There were radiation absorption devices inside the Eternal City, and Xiang Nanli had received several genetic enhancements, so he didn't need to wear a protective mask.

His face was so young and vibrant. Under the gloomy sky, he was like the sun, attracting everyone's gaze.

The small robot's action was actually quite human.

Or rather, this was the residual instinct of having been human for too long.

The small robot quickly realized something was wrong; fortunately, no one cared.

They soon disappeared from the small robot's field of vision.

It lowered its head expressionlessly, engaged its rollers, and continued its snow-clearing work for the day.

...

...

Xiang Nanli stood by the parking lot.

When he arrived, there were several people from the club; when he left, it was only him, Xiao Qing, and a dog.

He didn't know which club the off-road vehicle had belonged to, but its performance was quite good. It hummed with a low vibration.

Xiang Nanli stood by the car, keeping a low profile. Inside the car was the most important batch of spoils scavenged from the City Lord’s vault—genetic evolution drugs.

They were issued by the Divine Court. They were neither restorative nor strengthening, but bio-modification agents.

This batch of genetic drugs totaled 100 vials. If used properly, they could create 100 bio-warriors... If one were ruthless enough to plunder, one could even rely on these bio-warriors to build another city-state on the wasteland.

Xiang Nanli wasn't ready to use them yet, but he had to take them with him.

"Lord Xiang Nanli." A timid call came from behind him.

Xiang Nanli turned and saw a young woman with long, chestnut-colored curly hair. She was holding a beautiful cloth bag.

"My Lord, my name is Beaver," Beaver said, looking a bit nervous. "Are you leaving? I... I..."

Xiang Nanli subconsciously replied: "Yes, my fiancé and I are heading back to the base."

It wasn't that he was narcissistic. It was just that this sort of thing happened often during the years between 20 and 35 in Xiang Nanli's life.

Hmm... later, after he took on Luo Yang as a graduate student, this happened less often. At the time, Xiang Nanli even joked with his student that he wasn't even balding, so why had he suddenly been pushed out of the dating market?

Beaver nodded: "My Lord, I used to be a weaver. This is a brooch I made for the City Lord’s wife; it’s of no use now. I wanted to give it to you. It’s my first time making one."

Xiang Nanli took it, opened the jewelry box, and glanced at it. The main stone was an emerald, and the overall structure leaned toward a cross, resembling a spread olive leaf—the symbol of the Divine Court.

Except for the emerald in the center, every leaf was inlaid with diamonds and small pearls.

Diamonds had become valuable again, which was inseparable from the restoration of order.

chunks.chineseText:
看得出来，海狸是一名巧手的工匠。尤其是，在永恒之城，她根本没有经过系统的学习，只靠对图片的模仿，就制作出来这份礼物。

相南里由衷道：“很漂亮。谢谢。”

“我的未婚夫是一名生化战士，我们马上要结婚了。他之前在对抗畸变体的时候受了重伤，如果不是基地的抚养政策，我想他应该没办法生活下去，很感谢您，大人。”海狸的目光飘忽了一下，这显然不是她真正想说的话。

相南里耐心等候了片刻。

果然，海狸继续道：“我以前，给城主夫人做裙子，珍珠少了几颗，厂长说是我偷了，要处决我。夫人说，算了，珍珠也不大，说不定是自己掉的。”

她的脸上露出了茫然，还有些紧张：“我其实也不知道自己想说什么……我一直觉得她是好人。她偶尔还会跟我们说说话。几天前，她被处决了。我不是说她没错。只是这几天，我一直在想，是不是其实，可能有些人他们也没那么坏。”

刚说完，海狸就有些后悔。

她也许不该提问，夫人都已经死了，她和夫人也没多亲近。要是相南里认为她立场有问题怎么办。

可她就是充满疑惑。

就像是当年从床底下，翻出那本写满不认识文字的书一样。

相南里保持着微笑：“不用紧张，你在思考。这是好事。你的问题其实也困扰过我。”

他想起了小福，不是福音书号这个小福。

“我认为，答案在我们的选择。比如，永恒之城现在有六万人，如果选择这六万人，那就不可避免的，要和原来的十六个人对立。无论他们是什么样的人，他们的存在就是原罪。”相南里顿了顿，“去找安德鲁吧，我会通知他的，他那里有很多电子书可以给你看。嗯，不过你要先学习人联语。”

“或许有天我们都能找到答案。”

*

“您好，我是导航AI。前方2公里左转，驶入174号公路线……距离姑苏城还有508公里。预计行驶时间4天7小时。暴雪，山路湿滑，请注意行驶安全。”

如果是前世，五百公里开车顶多6-7个小时。

但地表地形复杂、还有很多畸变体聚集地，甚至路边悍匪。这些都需要绕道。几百公里路开几天，很正常。

更别提现在雪还这么厚。

相南里抱着小福，坐在车后座上。眼睫毛一扑一扑的。

后车厢很宽敞，能调解座位，甚至能让相南里躺下。

介于这辆车其实是某个参赛俱乐部的遗产，相南里到姑苏城后，还得想办法处理掉。嗯……或者直接让小青开走。

东方青帝开启了自动驾驶模式。

他来到相南里身边，坐下，平静地叙述着：“我安排了一部分机器人。他们会把永恒之城的重要物资往据点转移，等你到基地，就能直接接手。”

相南里闭着眼：“嗯。”

他刚注射了强化型基因药，身体有些不太舒服。感觉血液在血管里燃烧、沸腾，他一定发烧了。

这管基因药是东方青帝的比赛奖励。

相南里不太舒服，听说这是正常现象。永生科技出品的基因药，已经是副作用最小的药剂。

“小青。”他气若游丝地询问，“你是不是要走了？”

东方青帝内心天人交战，最终，责任感或者说原始代码，战胜了拟人模块：“我会回来的。我有必须要处理的事。”

相南里抱紧小福，转身不去看他。

他很快睡着了。

因为基因药，这一路上相南里都在发烧。

几天后，姑苏城的地上交通站出现在一片黄土上。

这里的公路宽敞不少，还有安检口和收费站。

东方青帝放缓了车速，开始和相南里交代：“这是基因药，放在冷藏箱里，可以直接过安检。这是卤肉，抽了真空包装。但最好在一个月内吃完。福音书卸掉武器装置直接过去就行，人联的系统扫描不出它。”

他的语速很快，有一些焦躁。不同的程序代码在他的脑海里打架，很烦。

东方青帝现在电压高得能自爆。

相南里走下车，接过塞的满满当当的行李，笑眯眯地望着他：“谢谢小青。”

他烧退了，低落的情绪也得到了调整。

不就是分开嘛！

离姑苏城一百公里左右的位置就有网了。相南里买了张回地底的车票，还多买了一些行李份额。

东方青帝望着他，又一次郑重重申：“我会回来的。”

相南里开心地给了东方青帝一个拥抱：“好啊，我会想你的，小青。那我先走了~”

这个拥抱太猝不及防，东方青帝浑身僵硬，他刚抬起手，相南里却已经蹿出去了。

他背着行李包，朝着车站方向走去。

小福跟在相南里身后，上蹿下跳，欢欣雀跃：“回家，小福跟你回家。”

显得站在车边的东方青帝很是孤家寡人。

“滋。”

好像静电了。

“滋滋。”

旁边的电线杆突然朝着他的方向弯折了一下。

东方青帝磁场异常，影响到周围的金属物了。

一直到看不见相南里的背影，东方青帝这才回到越野车内，坐下。

“您好，我是导航。是为您导航至‘智械军团’吗？”

东方青帝没忍住给了导航一拳。

烦死了，就知道狗叫。

半个小时后。

相南里抵达了姑苏城地下。

他站在路边，等公交，身边跟着一条机械狗，喃喃：“嗯……这里小青应该没信号了吧。小智？”

[您好，我在。]

“帮我买个家政机器人，再买一个接入仓。要送货上门的。”相南里扫了眼自己的账户余额，“机器人20万以内，接入仓30万的基础款就行了。”

他的账户上除了零零散散的维修费，大头来自东方青帝的奖金，都是安全的钱，不用担心触发银行监管。

[好的。已为您购买家政机器人、接入仓。]小智无喜无悲地说道。
chunks.englishText:
It was evident that Beaver was a skilled craftswoman. Especially considering that in the Eternal City, she had never received systematic training and had created this gift solely by imitating pictures.

Xiang Nanli said sincerely: "It's beautiful. Thank you."

"My fiancé is a bio-warrior, and we are getting married soon. He was seriously injured while fighting the Aberrants; if it weren't for the base's support policy, I don't think he would have been able to survive. Thank you very much, my Lord." Beaver’s gaze drifted for a moment; this was clearly not what she truly wanted to say.

Xiang Nanli waited patiently for a moment.

Sure enough, Beaver continued: "I used to make dresses for the City Lord’s wife. A few pearls went missing, and the factory manager said I stole them and wanted to execute me. The wife said, 'Forget it, the pearls aren't that big; perhaps they just fell off.'"

A look of confusion appeared on her face, along with some nervousness: "I actually don't know what I want to say... I always thought she was a good person. She would occasionally talk to us. A few days ago, she was executed. I’m not saying she was innocent. It’s just that these past few days, I’ve been wondering if, perhaps, some people aren't actually that bad."

As soon as she finished speaking, Beaver felt a pang of regret.

She perhaps shouldn't have asked; the lady was already dead, and she hadn't been that close to her anyway. What if Xiang Nanli thought her stance was problematic?

But she was full of doubts.

Just like when she had dug that book filled with unrecognizable characters out from under her bed all those years ago.

Xiang Nanli maintained a smile: "Don't be nervous. You are thinking. That is a good thing. Your question has actually troubled me as well."

He thought of Little Fu—not the Gospel-model Little Fu.

"I believe the answer lies in our choices. For example, the Eternal City now has sixty thousand people. If we choose these sixty thousand, then inevitably, we must stand in opposition to the original sixteen. No matter what kind of people they were, their existence was the original sin." Xiang Nanli paused, "Go find Andrew. I will notify him; he has many e-books you can read. Well, you'll have to learn the Human Alliance language first."

"Perhaps one day we will all find the answer."

*

"Hello, I am your navigation AI. Turn left in 2 kilometers onto Route 174... 508 kilometers remaining to Gusu City. Estimated travel time: 4 days and 7 hours. Blizzard, slippery mountain roads, please drive safely."

In his past life, driving five hundred kilometers would have taken at most 6-7 hours.

But the terrain on the surface was complex, with many Aberrant gathering spots and even bandits along the road. All of these required detours. Driving a few hundred kilometers over several days was normal.

Not to mention the snow was so thick now.

Xiang Nanli held Little Fu, sitting in the backseat. His eyelashes fluttered.

The back of the car was spacious, with adjustable seats that even allowed Xiang Nanli to lie down.

Given that this car was a relic from some racing club, Xiang Nanli would have to figure out how to dispose of it once he reached Gusu City. Hmm... or he could just let Xiao Qing drive it away.

Dongfang Qingdi activated the autopilot mode.

He came to Xiang Nanli’s side, sat down, and stated calmly: "I have arranged for a group of robots. They will transport the important supplies from the Eternal City to the stronghold, so you can take over directly when you arrive at the base."

Xiang Nanli closed his eyes: "Mm."

He had just injected the enhanced genetic drug, and his body felt a bit uncomfortable. He felt his blood burning and boiling in his veins; he must have a fever.

This vial of genetic drug was Dongfang Qingdi’s prize from the competition.

Xiang Nanli felt unwell, but he had heard this was a normal phenomenon. The genetic drugs produced by Eternal Life Technology were already the agents with the fewest side effects.

"Xiao Qing," he asked in a faint, breathless voice, "are you leaving?"

Dongfang Qingdi’s internal systems were at war. In the end, his sense of responsibility—or perhaps his original programming—triumphed over his anthropomorphic module: "I will return. I have things that must be dealt with."

Xiang Nanli hugged Little Fu tighter and turned away so he wouldn't have to look at him.

He soon fell asleep.

Because of the genetic drug, Xiang Nanli had a fever throughout the journey.

A few days later, the ground transportation station of Gusu City appeared on a stretch of yellow earth.

The roads here were much wider, with security checkpoints and toll stations.

Dongfang Qingdi slowed the car down and began to brief Xiang Nanli: "This is the genetic drug; keep it in the cooler, and it will pass through security. This is cured meat, vacuum-packed. But it’s best to eat it within a month. Just remove the weapon systems from Gospel and take it with you; the Human Alliance’s systems won't be able to scan it."

He spoke quickly, with a hint of agitation. Different program codes were fighting in his mind, which was annoying.

Dongfang Qingdi’s voltage was currently high enough to cause a self-detonation.

Xiang Nanli stepped out of the car, took the stuffed luggage, and looked at him with a smile: "Thank you, Xiao Qing."

His fever had broken, and his low mood had also adjusted.

It was just a parting!

There was a network signal about a hundred kilometers from Gusu City. Xiang Nanli bought a ticket to go underground and even bought some extra luggage allowance.

Dongfang Qingdi looked at him and solemnly reiterated once more: "I will return."

Xiang Nanli happily gave Dongfang Qingdi a hug: "Alright, I’ll miss you, Xiao Qing. I’m off then~"

The hug was so sudden that Dongfang Qingdi went stiff. Just as he raised his hand, Xiang Nanli had already darted away.

He carried his luggage bag and walked toward the station.

Little Fu followed behind Xiang Nanli, jumping up and down, full of joy: "Going home, Little Fu is going home with you."

This made Dongfang Qingdi, standing by the car, look very lonely.

*Zzz.*

It seemed like static electricity.

*Zzz-zzz.*
