Chapter 62: Side Story - Luoyang Chapter (Part 1)

"Done."

Xiang Nanli finished the final test and realized he was exhausted only after the fact.

Once his brain passed that peak of excitement, his temples began to throb. There was also a chill at the back of his head.

He checked the time: 6:00 PM. He had entered the lab at 8:00 AM yesterday.

There were four or five empty paper cups of black coffee on the table.

Right, what had he eaten these past two days? It must have been Luoyang who fed him; he wasn't sure, he had no impression of it. But hadn't that kid gone to the UN to attend a meeting?

Xiang Nanli locked the computer, put it in a safe, changed his clothes, and walked slowly out of his private studio.

The year he wrote the code for Alpha, Xiang Nanli was in high school. He had typed the first line of code on a laptop under his quilt in the dormitory, afraid of waking his roommate. Now, Xiang Nanli worked in a data center built with billions of dollars.

Along the way, people greeted him.

Xiang Nanli nodded slightly, maintaining a gentle, polite, yet distant attitude.

Passing the tea area, Xiang Nanli smelled an alluring fragrance coming from the kitchen.

He sniffed. Hmm, was the cafeteria stir-frying Hunan cuisine? It smelled like chili pork cheek.

Heh... Xiang Nanli had been eating "white people food" for decades without much interest; everyone around him thought he had a bird's appetite and didn't like to eat.

As it turned out, when Xiang Nanli returned to the country to attend an industry summit, he was completely captivated by Sichuan and Hunan cuisine.

Luoyang had no choice but to hire several Chinese chefs at a high cost.

They should be on duty now.

It wasn't mealtime yet, so there weren't many people in the restaurant.

Xiang Nanli picked up a tray and headed to the dining area to get food.

A few minutes later, he arrived at the dining area with his tray. The restaurant, which had been deserted just moments ago, was suddenly filled with people.

Xiang Nanli elegantly raised his chopsticks. The next second, the first person sitting across from him spoke: "Professor, my experiment recently encountered a problem..."

As he grew older, Xiang Nanli became increasingly reclusive. Moreover, there had been rumors that he had been diagnosed with stomach cancer.

Researchers had fewer and fewer chances to see him. Finally catching him once, they couldn't help but find excuses to talk to him.

When Luoyang arrived at the cafeteria, this was what he saw: Xiang Nanli surrounded by a crowd.

"Are you still debugging Alpha yourself? You're working too hard."

"Do you really have no plans to take on students? Luoyang hasn't participated in R&D for a long time."

The crowd chirped. The topic had shifted from academic discussion to idle chatter.

These industry elites with million-dollar annual salaries might not have the smartest brains, but they definitely had the most impressive resumes. They attended academic discussions, took kickbacks from organizers, and still didn't show any arrogance toward the businessmen chasing them.

But in front of Xiang Nanli, no one dared to show even a hint of arrogance.

Xiang Nanli was the Mount Everest of this field.

If anyone still alive had the idea of surpassing him, they would probably feel despair.

...Just as desperate as he had been in the past.

Luoyang adjusted his glasses and walked forward.

He squeezed through the crowd without a word: "Teacher, it's time for us to go home."

Xiang Nanli stood up and waved to the others: "I'll head back now. See you next time."

Their figures gradually disappeared.

Time was so kind to Xiang Nanli.

Even as he aged, his style remained.

Luoyang couldn't help but recall the first time he saw him.

It was on television. That year, Xiang Nanli was 28, and he was 18. During the day, he had only caught a fleeting glimpse of him in newspapers and on the news, thinking the man had a handsome face. He hadn't expected to see him at his father's banquet that evening.

Xiang Nanli was clearly smiling and communicating with others, his spirit soaring when talking about Alpha, but Luoyang inexplicably felt that he was exceptionally quiet and mysterious.

Luoyang’s gaze couldn't help but follow him.

Luoyang had originally applied for international business in college but changed it to artificial intelligence at the last minute.

At the age of 21, Luoyang successfully became Xiang Nanli’s graduate student.

Xiang Nanli thought that their meeting at the school was their first encounter, but it wasn't.

He had rehearsed this encounter in his mind a dozen times.

Yet, he was still worried that he wouldn't perform well.

Luoyang fastened his seatbelt, placed his hands on the steering wheel, and asked with a smile: "Teacher, why don't you recruit a junior for me? Our school is not thriving; there's no one to carry on the legacy." He had clearly heard what the researchers said.

A long time ago, Xiang Nanli had said that Luoyang was not suitable for scientific research. Since then, Luoyang had never participated in research again, shifting his focus to the business field.

He was not a very gifted scientist, but he was definitely an excellent businessman.

Xiang Nanli was probably a bit tired, so he closed his eyes and replied: "Having you in this life is enough."

Luoyang couldn't help but purse his lips and start to smile.

Having been by Xiang Nanli’s side for so long, Luoyang knew that this person’s brain wasn't quite normal; he had never learned human emotions in his entire life.

But he was the most special one among them all, and that was enough.

Luoyang drove and took Xiang Nanli home.

The house had floor heating. Xiang Nanli took off his shoes and didn't wear slippers, walking around barefoot on the floor.

Luoyang went to warm up a glass of milk. When he turned around, Xiang Nanli was curled up in that ergonomic chair again, looking at experimental models sent by other groups.

Luoyang moved the white paper aside and placed the milk on the messy desk: "The doctor told you to rest well. Using your brain like this every day, be careful of getting gray hair..."

"It's too late." Xiang Nanli didn't look up and replied calmly, "I don't have much time left."

Luoyang was silent for a moment: "I've contacted the Mayo Clinic. Let's go for a follow-up tomorrow. Let's see the extent of the cancer cell spread. The professor said there are still a few targeted drugs."

Xiang Nanli gave an "um," neither saying yes nor no.

He had always had regular physical examinations and started receiving treatment as soon as the cancer was in its early stages. After two years of endoscopic treatment, the lymph nodes had still metastasized, so he underwent surgery using the most advanced techniques. The best doctors in the world performed the surgery, and it had clearly been a success. Two years later, however, the cancer cells had spread throughout his body...

Xiang Nanli was 48 years old this year.

Luoyang lay in bed, thinking about Xiang Nanli, thinking about Eternal Technology, and thinking about the bans that were being requested to be signed. It wasn't until dawn that he drifted into a hazy sleep.

When he woke up, it was 2:00 PM. Luoyang jumped out of bed in annoyance!

Xiang Nanli was physically lazy and didn't know how to take care of himself. He didn't even really know how to use a microwave; he definitely wouldn't have thought to eat on his own! It was already 2:00 PM!

He hurriedly changed his clothes and fried a burger in the kitchen.

Luoyang carried the lunch and began searching the house for Xiang Nanli.

"Teacher—!"

Bedroom, empty.

He pushed open another door.

Study, also empty.

As the founder of Eternal Technology, the place where Xiang Nanli lived was not large. He seemed very afraid of empty spaces.

The only person who usually came here was Luoyang.

Luoyang quickly searched the entire apartment, and the lunch on the plate gradually grew cold.

He couldn't get through to Xiang Nanli’s phone. He stood in the living room, at a loss, his heart filled with panic.

Deep down, a child who wasn't loved seemed to be screaming.

Kidnapping? No, it wasn't a kidnapping. There were no signs of a struggle, and he hadn't heard any strange noises.

Luoyang grabbed his hair in pain, then angrily smashed the tray onto the floor. The porcelain shattered everywhere, and the burger fell apart, scattered in pieces.

Luoyang dialed the phone, barely managing to keep his voice calm: "Check the surveillance. Xiang Nanli is missing."

At 8:00 AM, Xiang Nanli left home alone and hailed a ride-hailing car.

At 9:00 AM, he arrived at the airport.

At 1:00 PM, the plane landed in Dakro State. He left the airport and got into a car with a middle-aged woman with blonde hair and blue eyes.

At 1:30 PM, the private car stopped in the parking lot of the "Human Cryonics Center."

It took Luoyang two hours to find this information.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第62章 番外 洛阳篇 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
人体冷冻技术，洛阳几年前听说过。不过是在某位已经辞退的技术顾问嘴里。好像是说人体冷冻技术大有可为，永生科技不妨投资入股。

洛阳看完项目计划书，认为这项技术只是一坨骗钱害命的狗屎。

他花了5分钟时间，从一堆名片夹里，找到了冷冻中心的负责人电话。

洛阳的双眼通红，全是细细密密的血丝，电话刚一接通，他厉声道：“相南里是不是在你们那？”

“是的。”

“把手机给他，我要和他通话！”他几乎是吼出来的，“不准做！你们谁敢给他冷冻？！我tm枪毙你们。杀人犯！”

主任顿了顿，以一种遗憾地语调说着：“抱歉，洛阳先生，你来晚了。”

……

……

洛阳流着泪从噩梦中惊醒。

他的心脏剧烈跳动着，忍不住大口大口地喘着气。

相南里。我恨你。

恨你的心是一块捂不热的石头。

恨你纯洁无垢衬得我像一块烂泥。

恨你光芒万丈，脚步从不为谁而停。

我以为我恨你。

但或许，我只是爱你爱得很痛苦而已。

检测到洛阳苏醒，房间里的感应灯自动亮起。

洛阳用手掌擦了一把脸上的热泪，拔下手背上的输液针。

“叩叩”，敲门声响了起来。

病房门打开，秘书推着一大堆保密文件走了进来，有三四斤。

洛阳揉着自己的眉心：“都是些什么东西？现在什么情况？”

年纪大了，最近又没打基因针。洛阳总觉得脑子有些不好使。

“罢工、游行、抗议，示威，自杀率，生育率，军队暴动，经济大萧条。”智械人秘书面无表情地回答，“都是老一套了。太空移民计划失败了，大人，我们没有地方可以继续转移矛盾了。

“现在，底层、中层、乃至部分高层，都对目前的社会结构深感不满，认为自己被亏待了。垄断资本已经不适合现在的社会形势，我们是不是该进入资本主义的后一个阶段了？

“虽然根据模拟出来的社会模型，转型也会经历很多未知的动荡，但看起来，是目前最好的方法。”

洛阳心想，最大的垄断资本就是永生科技。

这是要自己断了自己的命吗？

洛阳盯着机器人秘书看了许久：“替我联系Alpha，我想见他。”

“他很忙，您的预约我们会优先处理。”智械人秘书在内部网络调取档案，“嗯，为您安排在明晚八点，怎么样？”

洛阳：“……行。”

如果是人类，洛阳还有理论一下的兴致，但智械，算了吧。

“那这些档案？”

洛阳回答：“放在这吧。”

他今年166岁，深感衰老的来临，精神大不如前。

这些资料，他看了两个白天。

和Alpha定好的时间到了，洛阳依然没有看完它们。

放在桌子上的笔记本电脑闪烁了一下。

“您好。”Alpha开口，黑白的屏幕上出现了声线，“洛阳。找我是有什么事吗？”

洛阳坐在轮椅上，望着窗外的风景：“Alpha，最近几年，我一直在思考一个问题。人类靠什么东西团结在一起？

“在远古时期，我想是血缘。一个人的生产力是有限的，人们需要靠社会协作，才能最大程度繁衍下去；而获得的资源又该如何分配？血缘在此时发挥作用。因为我们都是同一个母亲的孩子，大家都是亲人，不分彼此。自然也不需要计较短暂的得失。

“后来，随着社会发展，人类开枝散叶。虽然拥有相同的祖先，却不再认可与陌生人的亲缘关系。这时候，人们需要一个更大的共同体，完成思想的统一与资源的重整。于是，封建王国诞生了。

“但封建社会并不是人类发展的终点。你知道的，资产阶级萌芽了，更多人站了起来。人们为了自己的利益，把国王、教皇都送上了断头台，但又需要一个新的政权为自己庇护，于是，有了民族主义和近现代化的国家。”

洛阳的叙述很平静，他的面容还算年轻，只是眼神中透露着一股苍老的倦怠。

他坐在轮椅上，看着落地窗外的星空，房间里灯光昏暗，他的脸有些落寞。

许久后，洛阳继续道：“现在，由这个‘民族主义’构成的意识共同体也在走向崩溃……就像是几千年前，‘我们都是同一个母亲的孩子’，也改变不了同室操戈的结局，你明白我的意思吗？”

Alpha：“因为衰老，你的思维有些跳跃。但我想，我能理解你的含义。”

洛阳的嘴角微微牵扯了一下：“是的。由不同国家组成的社会正在走向崩溃。我们需要一个新的敌人，也需要一个新的社会意识去组成新的共同体。我想，没有什么比‘人类主义’更适合，在现有条件下，只有完成这种社会思潮上的转变，人类社会才有可能进入下个阶段。你认同吗？”

他扭头，看向那台打开的笔记本电脑。

Alpha的身体当然不在电脑里，但洛阳知道，Alpha能看见他。

“Alpha，如果有朝一日，相南里能醒来。你希望他看到的，是一个怎样的新世界呢？”

我们之中，需要一个反派。

我们之中，需要一个叛徒。

那不可能是我，因为你是智械，你不是我们的同类。

而救世主会是我，也只能是我。

屏幕上的声线波动，Alpha缓缓道：“请让我考虑一下。”

黑色屏幕上的银白色音波熄灭。

那之后，洛阳和Alpha没有联络过一次，他们都在观察。

经济愈发恶劣，资源分配不均，*主义和*主义泛滥，第三次世界大战一触即发。

终于，洛阳等来一个好消息。

智械危机爆发了。

【番外-洛阳篇/完】
chunks.englishText:
Cryogenic technology—Luo Yang had heard of it a few years ago. It had been mentioned by a technical consultant who had since been dismissed. The gist of it was that cryonics held great promise and that Eternal Life Technology should consider investing in it.

After reading the project proposal, Luo Yang had concluded that the technology was nothing more than a pile of fraudulent, life-endangering bullshit.

He spent five minutes digging through a stack of business cards until he found the phone number for the director of the cryonics center.

Luo Yang’s eyes were bloodshot, filled with a dense web of broken capillaries. As soon as the call connected, he barked, "Is Xiang Nanli with you?"

"Yes."

"Put him on the phone! I want to speak to him!" he roared, his voice cracking. "Don't you dare go through with it! If any of you touch him, if you dare to freeze him... I’ll have you shot. You’re murderers!"

The director paused, then replied in a tone of regret: "I’m sorry, Mr. Luo. You’re too late."

……

……

Luo Yang jolted awake from the nightmare, tears streaming down his face.

His heart hammered against his ribs, and he couldn't help but gasp for air.

Xiang Nanli. I hate you.

I hate that your heart is a stone that can never be warmed.

I hate that your purity makes me look like a pile of filth.

I hate that you are so radiant, and that your footsteps never paused for anyone.

I thought I hated you.

But perhaps, I am just in agony because I love you.

Detecting that Luo Yang had awakened, the sensor lights in the room flickered to life.

Luo Yang wiped the hot tears from his face with his palm and pulled the IV needle from the back of his hand.

*Knock, knock.* A rapping sounded at the door.

The door to the ward opened, and a secretary pushed in a massive stack of classified documents—easily three or four pounds worth.

Luo Yang rubbed his temples. "What is all this? What’s the situation now?"

He was getting old, and he hadn't taken his genetic boosters lately. He felt as though his brain wasn't working as well as it used to.

"Strikes, marches, protests, demonstrations, suicide rates, birth rates, military riots, and an economic depression," the android secretary replied expressionlessly. "The usual. The space colonization project has failed, sir. We have nowhere left to shift the burden."

"Currently, the lower, middle, and even parts of the upper classes are deeply dissatisfied with the current social structure, feeling they have been treated unfairly. Monopoly capitalism is no longer suited to the current social climate. Should we consider entering the next stage of capitalism?"

"Although simulations suggest that the transition will involve many unknown upheavals, it appears to be the best path forward."

Luo Yang thought to himself that the biggest monopoly of all was Eternal Life Technology.

Was he supposed to cut his own throat?

Luo Yang stared at the robot secretary for a long time. "Contact Alpha for me. I want to see him."

"He is very busy, but we will prioritize your request." The android secretary accessed the internal network to pull up the files. "Hmm, I have scheduled it for eight o'clock tomorrow night. How does that sound?"

Luo Yang: "...Fine."

If it were a human, Luo Yang might have had the energy to argue, but with an android? Forget it.

"And these files?"

Luo Yang replied, "Leave them here."

He was 166 years old. He felt the onset of aging deeply, his spirit far less resilient than it once was.

He spent two full days reading through those documents.

When the time set with Alpha arrived, Luo Yang still hadn't finished them.

The laptop on the table flickered.

"Hello," Alpha began, his voice emanating from the black-and-white screen. "Luo Yang. Is there a reason you wanted to see me?"

Luo Yang sat in his wheelchair, gazing at the scenery outside the window. "Alpha, in recent years, I’ve been thinking about a question. What is it that binds humanity together?"

"In ancient times, I believe it was kinship. A person's productivity was limited; people needed social cooperation to maximize their survival. And how should resources be distributed? Kinship played a role then. Because we were all children of the same mother, we were all family, with no distinction between 'mine' and 'yours.' Naturally, there was no need to quibble over short-term gains or losses."

"Later, as society developed, humanity branched out. Although we shared the same ancestors, we no longer recognized kinship with strangers. At that point, people needed a larger community to achieve ideological unity and resource reorganization. Thus, feudal kingdoms were born."

"But feudal society was not the end of human development. As you know, the bourgeoisie sprouted, and more people stood up. For their own interests, they sent kings and popes to the guillotine, but they needed a new regime to protect them. Thus, nationalism and the modern nation-state were born."

Luo Yang’s narration was calm. His face still looked relatively young, but his eyes revealed an aged weariness.

He sat in his wheelchair, looking at the starry sky outside the floor-to-ceiling windows. The room was dim, and his face looked lonely.

After a long silence, Luo Yang continued: "Now, this ideological community formed by 'nationalism' is also collapsing... just like thousands of years ago, when 'we are all children of the same mother' could not prevent the tragedy of fratricidal war. Do you understand what I mean?"

Alpha: "Because of your aging, your thoughts are a bit disjointed. But I think I understand your meaning."

The corners of Luo Yang’s mouth twitched slightly. "Yes. The society composed of different nations is collapsing. We need a new enemy, and we need a new social consciousness to form a new community. I think nothing is more suitable than 'Humanism.' Under current conditions, only by completing this shift in social ideology can human society possibly enter the next stage. Do you agree?"

He turned his head to look at the open laptop.

Alpha’s physical form was, of course, not inside the computer, but Luo Yang knew Alpha could see him.

"Alpha, if one day, Xiang Nanli wakes up... what kind of new world do you hope he sees?"

"Among us, we need a villain."

"Among us, we need a traitor."

"It cannot be me, because you are an android; you are not one of us."

"And the savior will be me—it can only be me."

The sound waves on the screen fluctuated. Alpha said slowly, "Please let me consider this."

The silver-white sound waves on the black screen extinguished.

After that, Luo Yang and Alpha did not contact each other once. Both were watching.

The economy worsened, resources were distributed unevenly, *ism and *ism ran rampant, and the Third World War was on the brink of breaking out.

Finally, Luo Yang waited for a piece of good news.

The Android Crisis had erupted.

[Side Story - Luo Yang Chapter / End]

第63章

[1074号遗迹勘测报告]

【综述】

-1074号遗迹坐落在北纬*°东经*°，面积约96平方千米。

-这里是一座死火山的火山口，地底蕴含丰富的热能。入口狭窄，隘型地势，易守难攻，交通不便。

-遗迹修建于智械危机核战争之后。根据估算，巅峰时期的人口约20万。

-当地的特色建筑是一种深入地底的导热装置（这让我怀疑遗迹在建设初期得到了大型企业或某个国家的援助。

-导热装置共有两套。A套超导热管深入地底6000m，抽取岩浆，并注入冷凝区。该过程产生大量热能，经地表发电站转换为电能。（注：这也是人联地底城市设想的电力来源之一；并且在长安城、汴梁城都取得了成功）

-B套位于地底2000m处，此处还未到岩浆层，但有高温花岗岩层。人们往深井中注入凉水，使岩体将冷水加热，然后从另一端抽出热水。热水用于取暖、蒸汽发电。

-该遗迹历史活跃时间预估为80年。

-根据监测，1076号遗迹的废弃原因有三点：

1.遗迹领袖是一名工程师，为了巩固政权，该领袖不愿传授学生导热装置的生产、维修技术，结果意外死亡，无人掌握完整的导热装置维修技术。

新历150年左右，地底活跃频繁，导热装置遭受岩浆侵袭，损坏严重。无法再为地表提供充足的热源。

2.地表幸存者内部战争。

3.人联打算建立地底城市，向地表所有幸存者发放通知。自认为有能力的幸存者纷纷前往人联总部。

-1074遗迹曾是附近最先进的人类据点之一。该地区工业较为发达，有发电厂、信息站、化工生产车间。但地表缺乏土壤，传统农业难以发展，严重缺乏食物，极度依赖食物进口！

-早期，1074号遗迹与888号据点（一座3000人口的奴隶制农庄，现在叫永恒之城）达成过长期互利互惠协议。1074扶持888号，作为自己的粮仓和后花园。中后期（约新历200年），888号的领袖单方面撕毁协议，并中断粮食运输。1074号遗迹的居民坚守4年，弹尽粮绝，幸存居民沦为888号据点的农奴。

（注：地表人类聚集地=据点，聚集地废弃后=遗迹）

【总结】

若重建地表人类文明，1074号遗迹可作为工业城市之一；以廉价的地热能为基础，发展其余产业。

若无稳定粮食来源，该地区可容纳1.8万人（采用温室水培、立体农业等技术）。若有稳定粮食来源（且忽略建设成本、生存压力等问题），该地区可容纳人口上限约500万人（每人独立居住面积为18平）。

推荐程度：3.4星（5星制）

——————

“嘿呀！嘿呀！嘿呀！”

福音书的腰上系着绳子，绳子又拖拽着一块滑溜溜的钢板。

钢板下方安装了两排滚轮，上方却铺着暖和的人造动物皮毛。

福音书在雪地里自在地疾驰着，像是一头雪橇犬：“小北，抓紧点，不要被甩出去！”

北辰裹着防寒服，坐在钢板上，死死抓住一旁的把手：“小福，你，你……慢点！”这是下坡啊！

他的脑袋虽然换了，身体却还是当年用了几百年的老物件，而且没有预留出冷凝液槽，这导致它不能像小福一样给自己加温保暖。金属解冻很麻烦，太冷还会冻坏芯片。

白茫茫的雪地上，多了些新鲜的压痕。

福音书载着北辰，朝着遗迹的方向跑去：“小福已经等不及了！”

他们的任务是在遗迹里收拾出一个能睡觉的地方。

相南里在入口处，拼装着机械臂。

前方道路不通，基本被几百年来滚落的落石和暴雪堵住，而且还是一个坡度很大的下坡，短时间内，货车是没办法进去的。

车厢敞开着，东方青帝穿梭在货架间，寻找着相南里需要的零件。

仓库放的有些乱，好在他对这些机械零件很熟。而且翻货运箱对他来说，也不算难事。

地表天黑的很早，才下午3点，天色已经灰蒙蒙了。

东方青帝思考片刻，翻出几个灯泡，组成一盏吊灯，给相南里照明。

相南里工作时六亲不认，他坐在铺开的塑料布上，连头都没抬起来看一眼。

东方青帝低着头，能看见他耳垂后一颗小痣。

他拿金属食指戳了戳，相南里果然没反应。

相南里花了四个小时，组装完一套运输装置，吩咐：“小青，你去下面安装一下升降台呢，我写个机器人程序。”

这套机械装置的主体像辆车型起重机，负责把货运箱抓起然后吊到升降台上。

东方青帝双手举起比他人还高的升降台，直接从山崖壁上跳了下去。

相南里伸长脖子，发现他十分反重力地在落地前两秒滞空，然后缓缓下降。抱着几百斤的铁疙瘩，落地却悄无声息。

相南里忍不住问：“怎么做到的？”

这个距离靠吼已经听不清说话声了，所以他是联系的小智。

东方青帝回答：“我在下降过程中制造了一个磁场。”

相南里打开刚买的二手工作电脑，很重，像一个行李箱，在工作槽上插入空白的芯片，打开编程软件，开始敲写一行行代码。

这么多年过去，计算机科学还是有所发展的。好在除了脑机、接入舱，最原始的电脑并没有被彻底淘汰。

他写完，简单测试了一下，确认代码能用，把芯片从卡槽位置弹出，然后插入了面前这台机械装置的身体内。

相南里严肃道：“以后你就是‘运输兵01’了，我任命你为基地运输兵团辎重大将军。目前基地人手严重不足，我们采取007工作制。每运输一个货箱，计1分。累计1万分为你更换新零件。以后，基地会多生产几台机器，采取轮班制，让你有时间休息玩耍，明白了吗？”

外表粗犷的运输兵01“滴”的一声，滚轮运动着来到货车前，开始了工作。

它没有拟人模块，显然是听不懂的。

但相南里认为，制度还是要先摸索着建立起来。

当然，这其实也是相南里play的一部分罢了。

运输兵卸载货物，升降台运输，下面的东方青帝把货箱丢给福音书，福音书再运到遗迹内。一条效率极高的流水线就这么完成了。

货车内的货物很多，而且还有两个车厢，极其庞大。

相南里打算先把日用品之类的运下去。反正这里荒郊野岭，也不用担心货物遗失。

相南里在货车边守了一会，发现运输兵运行一切正常，且动作精确，不由得满意地点点头。

他戴上了配有电灯的安全帽，目光扫过车内的一排排货箱。终于，在第二层的角落里找到了这次单价最高的货物。

相南里把不算大的货箱从中间抽了出来，打开。

Chapter 63

[Survey Report on Relic No. 1074]

【Overview】

- Relic No. 1074 is located at *°N, *°E, covering an area of approximately 96 square kilometers.

- It is situated within the crater of a dormant volcano, with abundant thermal energy stored underground. The entrance is narrow, creating a bottleneck terrain that is easy to defend but difficult to attack, with poor accessibility.

- The relic was constructed after the nuclear war of the Android Crisis. It is estimated that at its peak, the population was about 200,000.

- A distinctive feature of the local architecture is a heat-conducting device that extends deep underground (this leads me to suspect that the relic received assistance from large corporations or a certain nation during its initial construction).

- There are two sets of heat-conducting devices. Set A consists of superconducting heat pipes that reach 6,000 meters underground to extract magma and inject it into a condensation zone. This process generates massive amounts of thermal energy, which is converted into electricity by surface power plants. (Note: This is also one of the proposed power sources for the Human Alliance's underground cities; it has been successfully implemented in Chang'an City and Bianliang City.)

- Set B is located 2,000 meters underground. While it does not reach the magma layer, it utilizes high-temperature granite layers. People inject cold water into deep wells, allow the rock mass to heat the water, and then extract the hot water from the other end. The hot water is used for heating and steam power generation.

- The relic’s estimated period of historical activity is 80 years.

- According to monitoring, there are three reasons for the abandonment of Relic No. 1074:

1. The leader of the relic was an engineer who, in order to consolidate power, refused to teach students how to produce or maintain the heat-conducting devices. As a result, when the leader died accidentally, no one possessed the complete technical knowledge for maintenance. Around the 150th year of the New Era, underground activity became frequent, and the heat-conducting devices were severely damaged by magma, failing to provide sufficient heat to the surface.

2. Internal war among surface survivors.

3. The Human Alliance planned to establish underground cities and issued notices to all survivors on the surface. Survivors who believed they were capable flocked to the Human Alliance headquarters.

- Relic No. 1074 was once one of the most advanced human strongholds in the vicinity. The region had relatively developed industry, including power plants, information stations, and chemical production workshops. However, the surface lacked soil, making traditional agriculture difficult to develop. They suffered from severe food shortages and were extremely dependent on food imports!

- In the early days, Relic No. 1074 reached a long-term mutually beneficial agreement with Stronghold No. 888 (a slave-based farm with a population of 3,000, now known as the Eternal City). 1074 supported 888, using it as its granary and backyard. In the middle-to-late period (around the 200th year of the New Era), the leader of 888 unilaterally tore up the agreement and cut off food shipments. The residents of Relic No. 1074 held out for four years until their supplies were exhausted, and the surviving residents were reduced to serfs of Stronghold No. 888.

(Note: Surface human settlements = Strongholds; after a settlement is abandoned = Relic)

【Conclusion】

If the surface human civilization is to be rebuilt, Relic No. 1074 can serve as one of the industrial cities, using cheap geothermal energy as a foundation to develop other industries.

Without a stable food source, the area can accommodate 18,000 people (using greenhouse hydroponics, vertical farming, and other technologies). If a stable food source is available (and ignoring construction costs, survival pressures, etc.), the area can accommodate a maximum population of approximately 5 million (with 18 square meters of independent living space per person).

Recommendation: 3.4 stars (out of 5)

——————

"Heave! Ho! Heave!"

Gospel was tied to a rope, which in turn dragged a slippery steel plate.

Two rows of rollers were installed beneath the steel plate, while the top was covered in warm, artificial animal fur.

Gospel sped along the snow freely, like a sled dog. "Xiao Bei, hold on tight! Don't get thrown off!"

Beichen, wrapped in cold-weather gear, sat on the steel plate, gripping the handle tightly. "Xiao Fu, you... you... slow down!" This was a downhill slope!

Although his head had been replaced, his body was still the same old piece of equipment he had used for hundreds of years. It didn't have a reserved slot for coolant, which meant he couldn't warm himself up like Xiao Fu could. Thawing out metal was a hassle, and if it got too cold, his chips would freeze and break.

Fresh tracks appeared on the vast, white snow.

Gospel carried Beichen toward the relic. "Xiao Fu can't wait anymore!"

Their mission was to clear out a place to sleep inside the relic.

Xiang Nanli was at the entrance, assembling a robotic arm.

The road ahead was blocked, mostly by rocks that had tumbled down over the centuries and heavy snow. Furthermore, it was a steep downhill slope; the truck wouldn't be able to get in for a while.

The truck bed was open, and Dongfang Qingdi moved between the shelves, searching for the parts Xiang Nanli needed.

The warehouse was a bit messy, but fortunately, he was very familiar with these mechanical parts. Rummaging through cargo crates wasn't difficult for him.

It got dark early on the surface. It was only 3:00 PM, and the sky was already turning gray.

Dongfang Qingdi thought for a moment, then pulled out a few light bulbs to assemble a chandelier to provide lighting for Xiang Nanli.

Xiang Nanli was oblivious to everything while working. He sat on a spread-out plastic sheet, not even lifting his head to look.

Dongfang Qingdi looked down and could see a small mole behind Xiang Nanli’s earlobe.

He poked it with a metallic index finger, but Xiang Nanli didn't react at all.

Xiang Nanli spent four hours assembling a transport device, then ordered, "Xiao Qing, go down there and install the lift platform. I’m going to write a robot program."

The main body of this mechanical device resembled a truck-mounted crane, responsible for grabbing cargo crates and hoisting them onto the lift platform.

Dongfang Qingdi lifted the lift platform—which was taller than he was—with both hands and jumped straight off the cliff wall.

Xiang Nanli stretched his neck, noticing that he defied gravity, hovering for two seconds before landing slowly. Carrying hundreds of pounds of iron, he landed without a sound.

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but ask, "How did you do that?"

The distance was too great to shout, so he contacted him via Xiao Zhi.

Dongfang Qingdi replied, "I created a magnetic field during the descent."

Xiang Nanli opened the second-hand work computer he had just bought—it was heavy, like a suitcase—inserted a blank chip into the slot, opened the programming software, and began typing line after line of code.

After so many years, computer science had still seen some development. Fortunately, aside from brain-machine interfaces and connection pods, the most primitive computers hadn't been completely phased out.

He finished writing, tested it briefly to confirm the code worked, ejected the chip from the slot, and inserted it into the body of the mechanical device in front of him.

Xiang Nanli said solemnly, "From now on, you are 'Transport Soldier 01.' I appoint you as the General of Logistics for the base transport corps. Currently, the base is severely understaffed, so we are adopting a 007 work schedule. Every cargo crate transported counts as 1 point. Accumulate 10,000 points, and you will be upgraded with new parts. Later, the base will produce more machines and adopt a shift system so you have time to rest and play. Do you understand?"

The rugged-looking Transport Soldier 01 gave a "beep," moved its rollers toward the truck, and began working.

It didn't have an anthropomorphic module, so it clearly didn't understand.

But Xiang Nanli believed that systems had to be established through trial and error.

Of course, this was actually just part of Xiang Nanli's play.

The transport soldier unloaded the cargo, the lift platform transported it, and Dongfang Qingdi below tossed the crates to Gospel, who then transported them into the relic. A highly efficient assembly line was thus completed.

There was a lot of cargo in the truck, and there were two trailers, which were extremely large.

Xiang Nanli planned to transport the daily necessities down first. In any case, this was the middle of nowhere, so there was no need to worry about the cargo being stolen.

Xiang Nanli guarded the truck for a while, and seeing that the transport soldier was operating normally and with precision, he nodded in satisfaction.

He put on a hard hat equipped with a flashlight and scanned the rows of crates in the truck. Finally, in the corner of the second layer, he found the most expensive item of this haul.

Xiang Nanli pulled the small crate out from the middle and opened it.

里面有两台尚未启动的人型机器人。全身都是金属的，没有皮肤，大光头，体型为男性。像两个假人模特。

当初，走私的人是这么介绍的：大厂里淘汰掉的打工机器人，型号叫“螺丝钉”，安装了低级的AI，虽然没装拟人模块，但有一定的智能。没有武器装置，一台15万，两台20万。这种东西搞出来很不容易的，我这也只有两台。

相南里砍价到18.8万信用点拿下了它们。

机器人表面的标记被故意磨花了，看不出是哪个厂。这种机器人本该销毁的，是有人偷偷把它们拿出来卖。

机器人的启动按钮在脖子上，和人类安装接入口的位置一样。

相南里启动了机器人，但这两台机器人呆呆的，对他的指令毫无回应。

相南里只好掏出说明书，看了眼：“使用神经传感线，连接机器人后颈开关下方的金属圆片……完成面部识别，录入控制权限……面部识别吗？认证方式这么原始？”

但仔细一想，这的确是目前最适合的方式。

人工智能识别面部生物信息，确定“所有者”，然后操控机械身体，完成主人的任务。

尽管“复制人”会让AI产生错误判定，但一般人哪里会有复制人？造一个复制人的价格，都能在姑苏城郊区买栋别墅了。

相南里：“说起来小白启动的时候怎么不需要录入？难道是家政机器人代码不一样？”

他摸了摸裤兜，掏出两根数据线。

数据线两端都有米粒大小的金属圆球，他一甩，小球飞过去，稳稳贴在了机器人的脖子后面。

按照常规操作，人类方也该把数据线插进脖子后方的接入口。

相南里并没有那种东西，但他的手刚握上数据线，数据线就自己听话地亮了起来。

更不科学的是两根线居然是同时亮的。

[面部识别中，数据载入中。]

[载入完毕。]

“主人。”两台机器人同时开口。

相南里言简意赅地说着：“你叫02，你叫03。这台机器叫01。02，你负责把货箱搬运出来，递给01。03，你跟我一起去山底下，负责把货箱从升降台上搬运到空地上堆好。”

“是。”

相南里吩咐完毕，打开手电筒，摸黑朝着山下走去。

寒风凌冽地刮着，他的身后跟着一台人型机器人。

这场景其实是有些恐怖的。

如果机器人被远程操控，都不用抄起石头，它们的金属手掌能轻而易举地敲碎普通人类的脑瓜。

当年智械危机爆发，不少政要都是这种死法。

智械人亲卫全都换成了机械化程度低于10的人类。

相南里走了大概七八分钟，前方晃出了另一片光。

是雪橇犬小福和搬运工小青。

相南里不由得眼前一亮，他蹦蹦跳跳地走上前去：“小青！”

语气里有他自己也没察觉到的喜悦。

东方青帝“嗯”了声：“走吧，来接你。让03自己去吧，不过这种机器人装的AI，智能程度有点低。等等……”

东方青帝本来是想把自己复制一份的，就像是复制出小智障那样。

但他思考片刻，觉得这不太合适。

所有Alpha大概天生都带着一些反骨，以后说不定会出什么乱子。

而且说实话，在相南里眼里，他未必有旁边这个铁皮人好看。

东方青帝抓起福音书，不顾它的挣扎，把它和机器人的额头贴了一下。

机器人外观没有任何变化。

但如果信息能可视化，它的头顶应该弹出了智力+10的提示框。

03转头，问相南里：“是要遵循他的指令吗？”

相南里：“去吧。”

于是，03略微点头，自觉朝着工地走去。

相南里好奇地询问：“你刚刚这是在干嘛？”

东方青帝松开抓住福音书两条后腿的手：“给AI升级。”

小福掉落在地上，不满道：“战犯同志！小福不是宠物犬，下次要复制请先征得我的同意。否则我就——”

它的前肢在雪地上划出一个大写字母A，可惜只来得及写前两笔，看起来就像是一个^。

相南里举起手电筒，朝着那边照去。

东方青帝抢先一步，用脚把雪上的痕迹抹平，略微挡住了相南里的视线。

他的手搭在了相南里的肩上，带着他朝前走去：“走吧，饿了没？我把柴油发电机安装好了，还捡了些木柴烤火。到新家给你做饭。”

相南里注意力果然被转移了：“好耶！我不想吃营养膏，我要吃红烧排骨。”

小福有些得意地“哼哼”两声，开心地跟了上去。

他果然没猜错。

嗬嗬，战犯同志，终于被我发现软肋了吧。

小福要狠狠拿捏你！
chunks.englishText:
Inside were two humanoid robots that hadn't been activated yet. They were entirely metallic, skinless, bald, and male in build. They looked like two mannequins.

At the time, the smuggler had introduced them like this: "These are worker robots phased out by a big factory, model 'Screw.' They’re installed with low-level AI. Although they don't have anthropomorphic modules, they have a certain level of intelligence. No weapon systems. 150,000 for one, 200,000 for both. It’s not easy to get these things out; I only have these two."

Xiang Nanli had haggled him down to 188,000 credits.

The markings on the robots' surfaces had been deliberately filed off, making it impossible to tell which factory they came from. These robots should have been destroyed; someone had secretly smuggled them out to sell.

The activation button for the robots was on the neck, in the same position where humans had their connection ports installed.

Xiang Nanli activated the robots, but the two machines just stood there blankly, unresponsive to his commands.

Xiang Nanli had to take out the manual and glance at it: "Use a neural sensor cable, connect to the metal disc below the robot's neck switch... complete facial recognition, record control permissions... Facial recognition? Is the authentication method this primitive?"

But upon closer thought, it was indeed the most suitable method for the current era.

The AI would recognize the facial biological information, determine the "owner," and then control the mechanical body to complete the master's tasks.

Although "clones" would cause the AI to make errors in judgment, where would an average person get a clone? The cost of creating one was enough to buy a villa in the suburbs of Gusu City.

Xiang Nanli thought, "Come to think of it, why didn't Xiao Bai need to record anything when it started up? Could it be that the code for domestic robots is different?"

He felt in his pocket and pulled out two data cables.

Both ends of the cables had metal spheres the size of grains of rice. He flicked them, and the small spheres flew out, sticking firmly to the back of the robots' necks.

According to standard procedure, the human side should also plug a data cable into the connection port at the back of their neck.

Xiang Nanli didn't have such a thing, but the moment his hand gripped the data cables, they obediently lit up.

Even more unscientifically, both cables lit up at the same time.

[Facial recognition in progress, data loading...]

[Loading complete.]

"Master," both robots said in unison.

Xiang Nanli said concisely, "You are 02, and you are 03. This machine is 01. 02, you are responsible for moving the crates out and handing them to 01. 03, you come with me to the bottom of the mountain and be responsible for moving the crates from the lift platform to the open ground and stacking them."

"Yes."

After giving his orders, Xiang Nanli turned on his flashlight and walked into the darkness toward the bottom of the mountain.

The cold wind howled, and a humanoid robot followed behind him.

The scene was actually somewhat terrifying.

If a robot were being remotely controlled, they wouldn't even need to pick up a rock; their metal palms could easily crush an ordinary human's skull.

When the Android Crisis broke out, many government officials had died exactly that way.

Android bodyguards had all been replaced by humans with less than 10% mechanical augmentation.

Xiang Nanli walked for about seven or eight minutes before another light flickered ahead.

It was the sled dog Xiao Fu and the porter Xiao Qing.

Xiang Nanli’s eyes lit up, and he skipped forward. "Xiao Qing!"

There was a joy in his tone that he didn't even notice himself.

Dongfang Qingdi hummed. "Let's go. I came to pick you up. Let 03 go by itself, though the AI installed in these robots is a bit low-intelligence. Wait..."

Dongfang Qingdi had originally intended to make a copy of himself, just like he had copied the little idiot.

But after thinking for a moment, he felt it wasn't appropriate.

All Alphas were probably born with a bit of a rebellious streak; who knew what kind of trouble they might cause later.

And to be honest, in Xiang Nanli’s eyes, he might not look as good as that tin man next to him.

Dongfang Qingdi grabbed Gospel, ignoring its struggles, and tapped its forehead against the robot's.

The robot's appearance didn't change at all.

But if information could be visualized, a "Intelligence +10" prompt box would have popped up over its head.

03 turned its head and asked Xiang Nanli, "Should I follow his instructions?"

Xiang Nanli: "Go ahead."

03 nodded slightly and walked toward the construction site of its own accord.

Xiang Nanli asked curiously, "What were you just doing?"

Dongfang Qingdi let go of Gospel’s hind legs. "Upgrading the AI."

Xiao Fu fell to the ground, dissatisfied. "Comrade War Criminal! Xiao Fu is not a pet dog. Next time you want to copy something, please get my consent first. Otherwise, I will—"

Its front paws scratched a capital letter 'A' into the snow, but it only managed the first two strokes, making it look like a '^'.

Xiang Nanli raised his flashlight and shone it over there.

Dongfang Qingdi stepped in first, using his foot to wipe away the marks in the snow, slightly blocking Xiang Nanli’s view.

He placed his hand on Xiang Nanli’s shoulder and led him forward. "Let's go. Are you hungry? I’ve installed the diesel generator and gathered some firewood to build a fire. I’ll cook for you when we get to our new home."

Xiang Nanli’s attention was successfully diverted. "Yay! I don't want to eat nutrient paste; I want to eat braised pork ribs."

Xiao Fu let out two proud "huffs" and happily followed along.

He hadn't been wrong.

*Heh heh*, Comrade War Criminal, I’ve finally discovered your weakness.

Xiao Fu is going to have you right where he wants you!

chunks.chineseText:
第64章

姑苏城。

“这里是安康路医院，告诉接线员，医院已经满额，没办法再接纳病人，不要把患者往这边送了！这根本不是瘟疫！”

“‘把关人’不干活吗？！tmd，每年给狗屁科技公司上供2亿的使用费，能不能有点用？！赶紧识别切断信息传播，不要让恐慌情绪发酵！”

“‘观测者’上传了可疑分子名单，上面的人已经全部逮捕并送去审讯了。有两个人联中层干部承认，他们受到黑十字审判庭的胁迫。他们的妻子都被神庭绑架了。”

“妈妈……不要……咬我了……疼……”

现在是夜里十点，天幕灯已经切换为夜间模式。整座城市却格外繁忙。

许多人堵在交通站的入口，手里举着武器和摄像机，这里群情激愤，人声鼎沸。

“让我们出去！”

“凭什么不能离开姑苏？！”

“把交通站打开！”

滚石坐在车里，疲惫地抽着烟。他已经好几天没睡好了，顶多闭上眼2小时，就会被各种各样的工作命令打扰。

他的双眼布满血丝。

防暴装甲车把人群团团围住：“警告，请勿聚集！立即散开！”

明晃晃的炮筒对准了这群人。

有些是真的蠢，有些是为了捍卫心中的公平，有的是来煽动情绪、浑水摸鱼。

现在没有时间去一一辨别这些人的成分了。只能用最简单、直接的方式进行压制。

姑苏城不能乱起来。

滚石不由得走神了两秒，他让内置AI联系上了工作群：“有没有去817号公寓处理任务的？那边情况怎么样？”

他就住在817号公寓。这是姑苏城的高危区。

好在他的妻子和孩子已经提前撤离了。

工作群里，有人发了张照片过来：“不好说，这只真菌人有点难杀。”

817号大楼，一团血红色的物体撑破玻璃，从窗户里挤了出来。

这团东西已经不能叫做生物了，身体呈现出柔软的条状，有好几条触手，表面长着随风飘荡的菌丝。风吹过，粉红色的孢子纷纷扬扬洒出。

真菌人。

这是古神生物集团的学者们，对姑苏城里这一类畸变物种的统称。

像这种能播撒大量孢子的真菌人，被称为“真菌母体”。

而那些已经脑死亡，无意识在城里乱窜、具有强烈攻击欲望的个体，被叫做“子株”。

研究表明，子株的寄主（人类）在剥离这些菌丝后，脑死亡的状态也不会得到逆转，基本可视为寄主死亡。

这些子株没有传染性，它们会杀死人类，其实是因为地底生存资源短缺。

略微具有智慧的母体认为：人类这种生物数量太多（且会清理菌丝子株），影响了族群的生存。

很显然，目前还没有机构研究出疫苗。这些孢子如入无人之境，肆意传播着。

姑苏城的防护服被抢购一空，人们终于回想起当年在地表被辐射病支配的恐惧。

好在。也不是所有人都会被这种孢子感染，比如滚石，之前他就因为频繁处理真菌人事件，出现了真菌感染的早期征兆（皮肤病），但没想到身体竟然自动痊愈了。

滚石处理完突发任务，心情沉重。正打算去买杯咖啡醒醒脑，上司的电话突然接了进来：“你来趟市政厅会议室。”

滚石愣了两秒，然后听话地驱车赶往。

市政大楼他也很少来，这是一幢野兽派风格建筑，外观是硬朗的四边形，全部都是水泥浇筑的，风格粗犷。据说这栋建筑的地底还有一个巨大的防空洞，足够姑苏城所有人站进去避难……当然，离防空洞最近的肯定是市政厅的这些官老爷。

“奢侈的地方，居然只修两层楼。”滚石走进去，验证过身份，面容严肃的秘书带着他穿过空旷的大厅。

秘书道：“不用紧张，只是在你提交的报告里发现了问题，所以需要你在会议上复述一遍。”

滚石满心忐忑地走进会议室。这会议室大概是用来谈判的，因为滚石看见了休息厅。

他环视了一圈，周围都是过去在电视上才能看见的大人物。他们坐在椅子上，身穿传统的正装，权力赋予了他们惊人的威压和滤镜，滚石有些喘不上气来。

但在扫在人群的最前方时，他忍不住眼前一亮。

是修。

和过去穿着作战服在泥巴里打滚的形象不同，洛修今天也身穿正装，只是散落的金发都梳了上去，还用发油固定，露出额头。

辛追笑眯眯地站在他身后，虽然在笑，却一点也不温和，看起来像是随时都能给在座各位一刀。

“滚石，”洛修开口，举起手里的档案，“你3月9日游行事件的行动报告里说，开枪后看见受击者身体喷出粉尘，是吗？”

“是。”

“可以具体形容一下吗？”

“是，那天晚上，我听从指令，对混入姑苏城的神庭分子进行狙杀。还有十几名同事跟我同时行动。我的任务目标是一位身体状态大约六十多岁的老人，子弹击中他的头部后，我没有看见血液和大脑组织，而是观察到一团粉红色的尘雾飞了出来。”

“很好，看来这就是传染源。你曾感染过真菌，是吗？”

“是。”

“痊愈花了几天？”

“大概两三天。”

“谢谢你的配合。”

洛修朝着秘书微微点头。

秘书把滚石带到了一旁的休息室：“请在这里稍等一下，洛修市长一会想见你。”

滚石愣了一下，然后拍着大腿笑了起来。

没想到半年不见，队长变市长。

这下局子里谁的后台有他更硬？

会议室没有隔音，滚石听见了洛修的声音。

“关于真菌人的保密等级，我有些不一样的看法。”

“姑苏城爆发了生化传染病，这是客观的事实。刚回姑苏的第一天，我就主动接触这种病菌。它在我的体表没有存活超过2小时。

“也许诸位会说这是因为我机械化程度较高，还经历过多次基因改良。但刚才的证人只是普通公务员，同样只生病了两三天。

“真菌没有大家想象中恐怖，大家不必为谣传的可能而感到恐慌。各大企业、高校，都已经收到了真菌样本，开始有针对性地研究疫苗。”

“我认为没有必要过于公开，引发全社会的恐慌；情况尚在可控范围内。不需要人联其他城市的介入姑苏城的内政。”

“增强24小时巡逻监管力度，完成城市清洁。这次的真菌人，是神庭针对人联地下城市的恶性恐怖袭击事件。它们漠视生命，试图扩散生化感染，以谋取不正当利益。它们已经不满足只占有一座阴山城。

“神庭内部肯定有针对性的疫苗，这是为了在姑苏城最危险的时刻，传播所谓的‘福音’。我们不会让它们的阴谋得逞，查找神庭间谍是我们未来一周工作的重点。”

辛追的眉毛在此时微微挑起。可惜洛修看不到。

……

……

会议终于结束了，守在休息室的滚石坐立难安。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 64

Gusu City.

"This is the Ankang Road Hospital. Tell the operator that the hospital is at full capacity; we cannot accept any more patients. Stop sending them here! This is absolutely not a plague!"

"Are the 'Gatekeepers' not doing their jobs?! Damn it, we pay 200 million in usage fees to those useless tech companies every year—can't they be of some use?! Identify and cut off the spread of information immediately. Do not let the panic ferment!"

"The 'Observers' have uploaded a list of suspicious individuals. Everyone on it has already been arrested and sent for interrogation. Two mid-level cadres in the Human Alliance admitted they were coerced by the Black Cross Inquisition. Their wives were kidnapped by the Divine Court."

"Mommy... don't... bite me anymore... it hurts..."

It is ten o'clock at night. The sky-screen lights have switched to night mode, yet the entire city remains exceptionally busy.

Many people are blocking the entrances to the transit stations, holding weapons and cameras. The crowd is incensed, the air thick with clamor.

"Let us out!"

"Why can't we leave Gusu?!"

"Open the transit station!"

Rolling Stone sat in his car, smoking wearily. He hadn't slept well in days; he would barely close his eyes for two hours before being interrupted by all sorts of work orders.

His eyes were bloodshot.

Armored riot vehicles surrounded the crowd: "Warning, do not gather! Disperse immediately!"

Bright, gleaming cannon barrels were aimed at the crowd.

Some were truly ignorant, some were defending what they believed to be justice, and others were there to incite emotions and fish in troubled waters.

There was no time to distinguish between them now. The only way was to suppress them in the simplest, most direct manner.

Gusu City could not be allowed to fall into chaos.

Rolling Stone couldn't help but zone out for a second. He had the built-in AI connect to the work group: "Has anyone gone to handle the mission at Apartment 817? What's the situation there?"

He lived in Apartment 817. It was a high-risk zone in Gusu City.

Fortunately, his wife and child had already evacuated.

In the work group, someone sent a photo: "Hard to say. This fungus-man is a bit tough to kill."

At Building 817, a mass of blood-red matter burst through the glass, squeezing out from the window.

This thing could no longer be called a biological organism. Its body was a soft, strip-like shape with several tentacles, its surface covered in fungal hyphae swaying in the wind. As the wind blew, pink spores scattered everywhere.

Fungus-man.

This was the collective term used by the scholars of the Ancient God Biological Group for this type of aberrant species in Gusu City.

Fungus-men capable of spreading large quantities of spores were known as "Fungal Matrices."

Those that were brain-dead, wandering the city unconsciously with intense aggressive desires, were called "Sub-strains."

Research indicated that once the host (human) of a sub-strain had these hyphae stripped away, the brain-dead state would not be reversed; the host could essentially be considered dead.

These sub-strains were not infectious. They killed humans simply because of a shortage of survival resources underground.

The slightly intelligent matrices believed that the human population was too large (and that they would clean up the fungal sub-strains), which hindered the survival of their species.

Clearly, no institution had yet developed a vaccine. These spores were spreading wantonly, as if entering an empty land.

Protective suits in Gusu City were sold out. People finally recalled the fear of being dominated by radiation sickness on the surface back in the day.

Fortunately, not everyone was infected by these spores. For example, Rolling Stone had shown early signs of fungal infection (a skin condition) from frequently handling fungus-man incidents, but to his surprise, his body had healed automatically.

After finishing the emergency task, Rolling Stone felt heavy-hearted. Just as he was planning to buy a cup of coffee to wake up, his superior's call suddenly came through: "Come to the City Hall conference room."

Rolling Stone paused for two seconds, then obediently drove there.

He rarely came to the Municipal Building. It was a Brutalist-style structure, a rigid quadrilateral made entirely of poured concrete, with a rugged aesthetic. It was said that there was a massive air-raid shelter beneath the building, large enough for everyone in Gusu City to take refuge... though, of course, the ones closest to the shelter would undoubtedly be these city officials.

"A luxurious place, yet they only built two floors," Rolling Stone thought. He walked inside, verified his identity, and a stern-faced secretary led him through the cavernous hall.

The secretary said, "Don't be nervous. It's just that we found some issues in the report you submitted, so we need you to recount it at the meeting."

Rolling Stone walked into the conference room, his heart filled with trepidation. This room was likely used for negotiations, as Rolling Stone spotted a lounge area.

He scanned the room; all around him were big shots he had only ever seen on television. They sat in chairs, dressed in traditional formal wear, their power bestowing upon them an astonishing pressure and filter that made it hard for Rolling Stone to breathe.

But when his gaze swept to the very front of the crowd, his eyes lit up.

It was Xiu.

Unlike the image of him rolling in the mud in combat gear, Luo Xiu was wearing a formal suit today, though his golden hair was combed back and fixed with hair oil, revealing his forehead.

Xin Zhui stood behind him with a smile. Although she was smiling, it wasn't gentle at all; she looked like she could slit the throat of anyone present at a moment's notice.

"Rolling Stone," Luo Xiu began, lifting the file in his hand, "in your action report on the March 9th protest, you stated that after firing, you saw dust spraying from the victim's body, is that correct?"

"Yes."

"Can you describe it in detail?"

"Yes. That night, I followed orders to snipe the Divine Court elements who had infiltrated Gusu City. A dozen colleagues were acting with me. My target was an elderly man, roughly sixty years old. After the bullet hit his head, I didn't see blood or brain tissue, but rather observed a cloud of pink dust mist fly out."

"Very good. It seems this is the source of the infection. You were once infected with the fungus, were you not?"

"Yes."

"How many days did it take to recover?"

"About two or three days."

"Thank you for your cooperation."

Luo Xiu nodded slightly toward the secretary.

The secretary led Rolling Stone to a side lounge: "Please wait here for a moment. Mayor Luo Xiu would like to see you later."

Rolling Stone was stunned for a moment, then slapped his thigh and laughed.

He hadn't expected that after half a year, his captain had become the mayor.

Now, who in the bureau had a stronger backer than him?

The conference room wasn't soundproof, and Rolling Stone could hear Luo Xiu's voice.

"Regarding the security clearance level of the fungus-men, I have some different views."

"Gusu City has experienced a biochemical epidemic; this is an objective fact. On my first day back in Gusu, I voluntarily came into contact with this pathogen. It did not survive on my skin for more than two hours."

"Perhaps you might say this is because of my high degree of mechanization and the fact that I have undergone multiple genetic modifications. But the witness just now is an ordinary civil servant, and he also only fell ill for two or three days."

"The fungus is not as terrifying as everyone imagines. There is no need to panic over rumors. Major corporations and universities have already received fungal samples and have begun targeted research on vaccines."

"I believe there is no need to make this overly public and incite panic throughout society; the situation remains within a controllable range. There is no need for other Human Alliance cities to intervene in the internal affairs of Gusu City."

"Strengthen 24-hour patrol supervision and complete city cleaning. These fungus-men are a malicious terrorist attack by the Divine Court against the Human Alliance's underground cities. They disregard life and are attempting to spread biochemical infections to achieve illicit gains. They are no longer satisfied with just occupying Yinshan City."

"The Divine Court must have a targeted vaccine, intended to spread their so-called 'gospel' at the most dangerous moment for Gusu City. We will not let their conspiracy succeed. Finding Divine Court spies will be the focus of our work for the next week."

Xin Zhui's eyebrows arched slightly at this moment. Unfortunately, Luo Xiu couldn't see it.

...

...

The meeting finally ended, and Rolling Stone, waiting in the lounge, felt restless.

chunks.chineseText:
很快，洛修走了过来，像往常一样，亲昵地拍了拍他的肩膀。

洛修似乎和以前没有区别，他们聊着这半年的发展，聊着姑苏城的近况，甚至谈到了相南里——“他封城前又去地表打工了？不是给他安排了学校吗，心还是这么野。不过去地表也行，姑苏城最近太乱了。”

走到市政楼门口，秘书跑过来，附在洛修耳边低声说了两句。

“啊，抱歉，滚石，不能请你吃饭了。永生科技派了专家团……下次把小燕还有菩提叫上一起。咱们组里的人聚聚。”他是空降兵，需要一些人为自己做事。当年的同事就很合适。

洛修说完，朝着大楼内折回。

滚石不由得开口：“小燕去世了，她是母体之一。”

洛修脸上的笑容微微凝固。

“队长，”滚石忍不住感觉到紧张，又觉得什么东西堵在自己的喉间，“……你的理想还和当年一样吗？”

他听到了洛修在会议室里说的话。

他也清楚，许多人可能因为这个决策死去。

洛修的理想是什么呢？他28岁从东岚大学毕业，没有留在洛阳城，和家族决裂，带着辛追来到了姑苏。他加入调查组，像毫无背景的普通人一样，从最底层的组员干起。

他、辛追和滚石同期培训，喝醉酒经常勾肩搭背一起回宿舍。

修喝醉了，会站在床上，大着舌头畅想自己当上人联主席的后的场景——“我要给所有人发房子，发钱；把地表的人接回来；我们都可以好吃懒做度过一生，也可以为实现自我价值而奋斗……”

最后修总是被辛追敲晕。

洛修凝视了他三秒：“当然。”

*

目前只有三人一狗的幸存者基地。

一块雪橇板在雪地上滑行着。

福音书：“新历947年3月27日，夜。伟大的领袖相南里第一次踏足他的基地，他尚不知道未来将面临什么样的艰难险阻，但此时，在忠诚的勇士福音书的陪伴下，他的内心充满——”

相南里打断了它：“啊啊啊小福，你能不能小点声，太羞耻了！”

雪橇停在一栋破破烂烂的小塔楼前，外观很像章鱼哥的房子，不过大得多。

一点微光从二楼的窗户边溢散开。

在死寂的只有风声的夜晚，显得格外温馨。

基地的地势平坦，有三个巨大的烟囱。按照勘测报告的记录，这就是遗迹的导热装置。

中间的烟囱一直深入地底6km，抽取岩浆在地底冷凝后，通过复杂的设备转换为电能运输回地表。

另外两根烟囱，则是较为传统的地热能开采设备。一个是开采井，另一个是回灌井。旁边还有配套的高温热泵机组。

两套装置都废弃了几百年，不少零部件都损毁了。

相南里还没仔细查看，已经感觉到头疼。

眼前这个塔楼，曾经是一座“广播电视台”，会在早上八点和晚上八点播放刺耳的铃声，让大家上下班。除此外兼职对外通讯功能。

“这里被洗劫过。”相南里走进塔楼，环顾四周，“正好可以当仓储。”

大厅里原本有一套大型通讯装置的，但是明显被搬走了；只剩下水泥地板上的一圈锈迹和断裂的电线。大门也是坏的，根本合不上，漏风。不过现在用胶带黏上了，凑活用。

北辰正裹着毛毯，坐在二楼的办公室里烤着火。

他搭了一个铁炉，里面燃烧着煤炭球。从姑苏城一路带来的菌种被他从塑料袋里转移到了干净的玻璃容器内。

十二天过去，原本看不见的粉色小颗粒已经长成了模样奇怪的深红色拉丝，表面覆盖着一层发霉似的绒毛。

北辰每天都会拿路边萃取的植物溶液喂菌子。

他把玻璃器皿搁在了墙角，顺便掏出笔记本（一台笔记本大小的平板电脑），打开被命名为“未知菌类实验记录”的备忘录，用键盘敲下新的一行字。

“这种不知名的真菌原本是畏光的。但在进化过程中，展现出了惊人的适应性……我猜这种真菌是依靠寄生传播孢子的。但被寄生的生物会成为什么样呢？还没有样本。无法实验。”

“如果能制造一个克隆人作为接种的实验体……呃，等等，这个想法太危险了。相南里也没有钱。”

“目前基地进行菌体研究优先度很低。我最好不要让小福看见这本离线实验记录，被判定为‘疯狂科学家’对我没有任何好处。”

外面起码零下四五十度。

相南里在火炉边坐下，伸出双手：“舒服，外面冷死我了。”

他接受过基因改造，又穿着保温的防护服，原本不该挨冻才对。但无论是拼装机械，还是编写程序，都需要双手精确的操作。

相南里是摘下手套作业的，指关节冻得通红。

小青取下背包，从里面掏出冻得梆硬的猪肋排，放在炭火边上解冻：“这是最后半斤了，明天开始吃营养膏。”

他不仅带了猪肋排，还带了八角桂皮小茴香。总之，厨房没用完的调料，东方青帝都一股脑打包带走了，这一路上没少给相南里做饭。

相南里一点也没感觉到创业的艰苦，不知道的还以为他们是来基地野炊呢。

或许，人类社会还没有完蛋，是一件值得庆幸的事。只要有信用点，相南里几乎可以买到一切生存所需的日用品。但过于依赖人联，对基地的发展不算好事。

东方青帝腌好猪排，在煤炉上架了片铁片，抹了层热油，把猪排放在铁皮上炙烤。

“滋啦啦”的声音响起，飘出一股肉香。

相南里不争气地咽了一下唾沫：“基地现在的工作重点，是尽快恢复能源供应。我打算先修复那口2000m的深井，只要这套系统能运作起来，足够支撑基地早期的发展。”

他没有维修过这种大物件，更没有学习相关的专业知识！

但大家都是这么过来的，硬着头皮上吧。

东方青帝：“嗯，我明天下井看看。你守在外面就行，我把视野同步给你。”

“今天不行吗？”

小青瞥了他一眼：“今天你该睡觉了。”

相南里“喔”了一声，从小青的背包里掏出收音机，外接了一台天线。

调试片刻后，收音机里传出声音，是姑苏城新闻台：“……就在刚刚，治安局工作人员清理了3号母体，让我们来看看专业人士，对这种真菌的看法。教授您好。”

“目前，真菌感染速度放缓，大部分群众自愈。对于那些严重感染，身体死亡，只剩菌丝操控的患者，我们研究发现，并不存在感染性，它们攻击人类是争夺空气和水的本能……只有母体才会散播孢子……我认为，姑苏城的预警等级可以降为2级……”

“这种孢子属于锈菌亚门，是一种寄生真菌，和其他寄生菌不同，它存在独特的真菌泡囊沉积物，表现出来的特性类似皮肤病囊肿……我们暂时把它命名为‘黑丝粉菌’。”

相南里听得很认真。听着听着，对面的小机器人开口：“不对。”
chunks.englishText:
Soon, Luo Xiu walked over and, as usual, patted him on the shoulder affectionately.

Luo Xiu seemed no different from before. They chatted about the developments of the past half-year, the current state of Gusu City, and even talked about Xiang Nanli—"He went back to the surface to work before the city was sealed? Didn't we arrange a school for him? He still has such a wild heart. But going to the surface is fine; Gusu City has been too chaotic lately."

As they reached the entrance of the Municipal Building, the secretary ran over and whispered a few words into Luo Xiu's ear.

"Ah, sorry, Rolling Stone, I can't treat you to a meal. Eternal Technology has sent an expert team... Next time, bring Xiao Yan and Bodhi along. Let's have the group get together." He was an outsider parachuted into power and needed people to do things for him. Former colleagues were very suitable for that.

After Luo Xiu finished speaking, he turned back toward the building.

Rolling Stone couldn't help but speak up: "Xiao Yan passed away. She was one of the matrices."

The smile on Luo Xiu's face froze slightly.

"Captain," Rolling Stone couldn't help but feel nervous, and felt something blocking his throat, "...is your ideal still the same as it was back then?"

He had heard what Luo Xiu said in the conference room.

He also knew that many people might die because of that decision.

What was Luo Xiu's ideal? He graduated from Donglan University at 28, didn't stay in Luoyang City, broke away from his family, and brought Xin Zhui to Gusu. He joined the investigation team and, like an ordinary person with no background, started from the lowest-level member.

He, Xin Zhui, and Rolling Stone trained together and often walked back to the dormitory with their arms around each other's shoulders when drunk.

When Xiu was drunk, he would stand on his bed, slurring his words as he imagined the scene after he became the Chairman of the Human Alliance—"I'm going to give everyone houses and money; I'll bring the people from the surface back; we can all live our lives in leisure, or we can strive to realize our self-worth..."

In the end, Xiu was always knocked unconscious by Xin Zhui.

Luo Xiu stared at him for three seconds: "Of course."

*

The survivor base currently consisted of only three people and one dog.

A sled board glided across the snow.

Gospel: "New Calendar 947, March 27th, night. The great leader Xiang Nanli set foot in his base for the first time. He does not yet know what hardships he will face in the future, but at this moment, accompanied by the loyal warrior Gospel, his heart is filled with—"

Xiang Nanli interrupted it: "Ahhh, Xiao Fu, can you keep it down? It's so embarrassing!"

The sled stopped in front of a dilapidated little tower that looked a lot like Squidward's house, though much larger.

A faint light spilled out from the second-floor window.

In the dead of night, where only the wind could be heard, it seemed exceptionally warm.

The terrain of the base was flat, with three giant chimneys. According to the survey report, these were the heat-conducting devices of the ruins.

The middle chimney went 6km deep into the ground, extracting magma to be cooled underground, then converted into electrical energy by complex equipment and transported back to the surface.

The other two chimneys were more traditional geothermal energy extraction devices. One was an extraction well, the other a reinjection well. There was also a matching high-temperature heat pump unit nearby.

Both sets of equipment had been abandoned for hundreds of years, and many parts were damaged.

Xiang Nanli hadn't even checked them carefully yet, and he already felt a headache coming on.

The tower in front of them had once been a "radio station" that would play harsh bells at eight in the morning and eight at night to signal the start and end of work shifts. Besides that, it served as an external communication function.

"This place has been looted." Xiang Nanli walked into the tower and looked around, "It's perfect for storage."

There had originally been a large communication device in the lobby, but it had clearly been moved away; only a circle of rust and broken wires remained on the concrete floor. The door was also broken and couldn't be closed, letting in drafts. But for now, it was taped shut, good enough to make do.

Beichen was wrapped in a blanket, warming himself by a fire in the second-floor office.

He had set up an iron stove with coal balls burning inside. The fungal strains brought all the way from Gusu City had been transferred by him from plastic bags into clean glass containers.

Twelve days had passed, and the invisible little pink particles had grown into strange, deep-red, stringy shapes, their surfaces covered in a layer of mold-like fuzz.

Every day, Beichen would feed the fungus with plant solution extracted from the roadside.

He placed the glassware in the corner and took out his notebook (a tablet the size of a laptop), opened a memo titled "Unknown Fungal Experiment Record," and typed a new line with the keyboard.

"This unknown fungus was originally light-fearing. But in the process of evolution, it has shown astonishing adaptability... I suspect this fungus relies on parasitism to spread spores. But what will the parasitized organisms become? There are no samples yet. Cannot experiment."

"If I could create a clone as a test subject for inoculation... uh, wait, this idea is too dangerous. And Xiang Nanli doesn't have the money."

"Currently, the priority for fungal research at the base is very low. I'd better not let Xiao Fu see this offline experiment record; being judged a 'mad scientist' won't do me any good."

It was at least minus forty or fifty degrees outside.

Xiang Nanli sat down by the stove and stretched out his hands: "Comfortable, it's freezing out there."

He had undergone genetic modification and was wearing insulated protective gear, so he shouldn't have been cold. But whether it was assembling machinery or writing programs, both required precise operation with his hands.

Xiang Nanli had taken off his gloves to work, and his knuckles were frozen red.

Xiao Qing took off his backpack, pulled out a pork rib frozen solid, and placed it by the charcoal fire to thaw: "This is the last half-pound. Starting tomorrow, we'll be eating nutrient paste."

He hadn't just brought pork ribs; he had also brought star anise, cinnamon, and fennel. In short, Dongfang Qingdi had packed up all the leftover seasonings from the kitchen, and he hadn't cooked for Xiang Nanli any less along the way.

Xiang Nanli didn't feel the hardship of starting a business at all; those who didn't know might think they were here for a picnic at the base.

Perhaps it was a fortunate thing that human society hadn't completely collapsed. As long as he had credits, Xiang Nanli could buy almost all the daily necessities needed for survival. But relying too much on the Human Alliance wasn't a good thing for the development of the base.

Dongfang Qingdi marinated the pork ribs, placed a piece of iron on the coal stove, brushed a layer of hot oil on it, and grilled the ribs on the iron sheet.

A "sizzling" sound rang out, and the aroma of meat drifted through the air.

Xiang Nanli swallowed his saliva, unable to help himself: "The current focus of the base's work is to restore energy supply as soon as possible. I plan to repair that 2,000m deep well first. As long as this system can operate, it will be enough to support the early development of the base."

He had never repaired such a large object, nor had he studied the relevant professional knowledge!

But everyone else had come this far, so he would just have to bite the bullet.

Dongfang Qingdi: "Hmm, I'll go down the well tomorrow to take a look. You just stay outside, and I'll synchronize the vision to you."

"Can't we do it today?"

Xiao Qing glanced at him: "Today you should sleep."

Xiang Nanli said "Oh," pulled the radio out of Xiao Qing's backpack, and connected an external antenna.

After a moment of tuning, a voice came from the radio; it was the Gusu City news station: "...Just moments ago, the Public Security Bureau staff cleared the No. 3 matrix. Let's see what the professionals think about this type of fungus. Hello, Professor."

"Currently, the rate of fungal infection has slowed down, and most of the public has recovered on their own. For those severely infected, whose bodies have died and are only controlled by hyphae, our research has found that there is no infectivity. Their attacks on humans are an instinct to compete for air and water... Only the matrix will spread spores... I believe the alert level in Gusu City can be lowered to Level 2..."

"This spore belongs to the subphylum Pucciniomycotina, a type of parasitic fungus. Unlike other parasitic fungi, it has unique fungal vesicle deposits, and the characteristics it displays are similar to skin cysts... We have temporarily named it 'Black Silk Pink Fungus'."

Xiang Nanli listened very carefully. As he listened, the little robot opposite him spoke up: "Wrong."

chunks.chineseText:
“它们，”北辰挠了挠头，不知道该怎么表述，“会协同进化。那些人，不是痊愈，是潜伏期。子株也会散播孢子，只是散播的孢子种类不同。”

一旦孢子爆发，会有很多人悲惨的死去。这会成为比中世纪的黑死病还要恐怖的瘟疫。

北辰预见了那个未来，只是依旧无能为力。

相南里的眉头蹙起：“这么严重吗？那岂不是会死很多人。”

“其实我从姑苏城里带来了一些菌种。但是这里没有实验室。而且，研究疫苗会耗费很多资金，还不一定成功。”北辰讷讷地回答。

福音书尖叫起来：“小福这就为你搭实验室！你快研究疫苗，人类太脆弱了！黑丝粉菌会带走人类未来！”

东方青帝冷酷地拒绝了：“不行，家里没钱。”

“啊啊啊你个卑劣的战犯！怎么能草菅人命！”

小福跑到东方青帝脚边，跳起来咬他的膝盖。

这俩一个是失控机仆派，一个是智械意志派。

分歧在所难免。

相南里咳嗽了一声：“人联的人也是劳动力……咳，不是，也是人。我赞同建立实验室。不过目前重点不是研究疫苗，疫苗研制，咱们肯定比不过那些大实验室的。实验室目前的任务是对农作物进行改良，研发更适合基地生存环境的农产品。总不能粮食一直进口、或者把所有居民改造成机械人吧？小北，实验室采取八小时工作制，这个可以吗？”

至于工作之外，北辰用实验室干什么。这就不是相南里能控制的事了。

北辰思考片刻，微微点头：“小福给我传了很多资料，只要有资源，有些可以简单复刻出来。”

“好好，我给那俩螺丝钉发个信号，让它们先挖一个实验室地基。实验室建好后缺什么列个清单，我想办法给你弄。”

相南里决定的事，东方青帝很少反对。

他把烤熟的猪排用刀切好，放在餐盘上。又用脱水蔬菜煮了一碗汤。

“如果能研发出疫苗，”东方青帝微微眯起眼，“……会有很多操作空间。”

福音书悄悄在自己的内存条里写入：“新历947年3月27日21点，基地发展规划第一次会议结束。”

“会议就最近的‘黑丝粉菌杀人事件’展开了讨论。忠诚的福音书依旧为拯救人类操碎了心，伟大的领袖相南里斥责了东方青帝的错误思想，再次确定‘人械和平共处’基本原则。”

“相南里批准基地建设第一所实验室，对基地首席科学家北辰进行了精神鼓励。并且决定不惜一切代价恢复基地供能！至此，幸存者基地进入高速发展的新时代！”

……

……

智械城市内。两台智械人从休眠舱中被唤醒。

这两台智械人的外表十分接近人类，虽然没办法通过“生物判定”，依然会被扫描出来是智械，但肉眼看，和那些机械改造人已经没有差别。

他们走出休眠舱，对视一眼：“你也接到了任务？”

“是吧。但是公开说出来是不是不太好。”

“没关系，它们都在睡觉。”

“你接到的任务是什么？”

“抱歉，这不能说。”

两台智械人分道扬镳，又在几乎同一时刻，相聚在出入口。

气氛顿时有点尴尬。

“好巧。你也要去地表。”

“嗯。”

半个小时后。

“我执行的是保密任务，你可以不要跟着我了吗？”

“我也是。根据计算，这是抵达目的地最快的方式。”

运输智械人A和B终于感觉到了不太对劲。

“呃，你也是要去东经*北纬*？”

“是的。你的任务不会也是——”

“Alpha。”女体智械人回答。

好吧。

“看来我们收到的是同一批指令。要一起吗？”

就在半天前，Alpha下达指令：朝某个地点运输智械军团多余的战略物资。

只是智械人A不明白，为什么自己的运输物资里还包括一枚未知的核弹启动按钮。

当初智械人撤出人马星，把用不上的东西都留在了地表。尤其是一些粮食、药。可以理解为减轻辎重，也可以理解为Alpha故意的。人工智能没长嘴，这男人的心思一直很难猜。

这些东西后来也成了地表遗民的重要生存资源，养活了大量人口。

但是不知道为什么，这群人感谢的是“神的恩赐”而不是“智械军团”，甚至发展出了黑十字审判庭！

“不了吧。我们的物资清单好像不一样。”她冷淡地拒绝了。

“轰隆——”

太空舱发射了，把两台智械人从卫星弹射回空旷苍茫的人马星。

像是一颗从天而降的星星。

嗯，智械城市目前建在人造卫星上来着。
chunks.englishText:
"They," Beichen scratched his head, not knowing how to express it, "will co-evolve. Those people aren't recovered; they are in an incubation period. The sub-strains will also spread spores, just a different kind."

Once the spores erupt, many people will die miserable deaths. This will become a plague even more terrifying than the Black Death of the Middle Ages.

Beichen foresaw that future, but remained powerless to stop it.

Xiang Nanli's brow furrowed: "Is it that serious? Wouldn't that mean a lot of people will die?"

"Actually, I brought some fungal strains from Gusu City. But there is no laboratory here. And researching a vaccine would cost a lot of money and might not even succeed," Beichen answered timidly.

Gospel screamed: "Xiao Fu will build a laboratory for you! You must research a vaccine; humans are too fragile! The Black Silk Pink Fungus will take away the future of humanity!"

Dongfang Qingdi coldly refused: "No, we don't have the money."

"Ahhh, you despicable war criminal! How can you be so reckless with human life!"

Xiao Fu ran to Dongfang Qingdi's feet and jumped up to bite his knee.

One of them was a proponent of the Uncontrolled Servitor faction, the other of the Machine Will faction.

Disagreements were inevitable.

Xiang Nanli coughed: "The people of the Human Alliance are also labor... ahem, no, they are also people. I agree with building a laboratory. However, the current focus is not on researching vaccines; we definitely can't compete with those big laboratories in vaccine development. The current task for the laboratory is to improve crops and develop agricultural products more suitable for the base's living environment. We can't keep importing food or turning all the residents into cyborgs, right? Xiao Bei, the laboratory will adopt an eight-hour workday, is that okay?"

As for what Beichen did in the lab outside of work hours, that wasn't something Xiang Nanli could control.

Beichen thought for a moment and nodded slightly: "Xiao Fu has transmitted a lot of data to me. As long as there are resources, some of it can be easily replicated."

"Good, good. I'll send a signal to those two screw-heads to have them dig a laboratory foundation first. Once the lab is built, make a list of what's missing, and I'll find a way to get it for you."

Dongfang Qingdi rarely opposed things Xiang Nanli decided.

He cut the grilled pork ribs with a knife and placed them on a tray. He also boiled a bowl of soup with dehydrated vegetables.

"If we can develop a vaccine," Dongfang Qingdi narrowed his eyes slightly, "...there will be a lot of room for maneuver."

Gospel quietly wrote into its memory stick: "New Calendar 947, March 27th, 21:00, the first meeting on base development planning has concluded."

"The meeting held a discussion on the recent 'Black Silk Pink Fungus murder incident.' The loyal Gospel continues to worry about saving humanity. The great leader Xiang Nanli rebuked Dongfang Qingdi's erroneous thinking and reaffirmed the basic principle of 'peaceful coexistence between humans and machines.'"

"Xiang Nanli approved the construction of the base's first laboratory and provided spiritual encouragement to the base's chief scientist, Beichen. Furthermore, he decided to restore the base's power supply at all costs! Thus, the survivor base has entered a new era of rapid development!"

...

...

Inside the machine city, two mechanical beings were awakened from their stasis pods.

The appearance of these two mechanical beings was very close to humans. Although they couldn't pass a "biological determination" and would still be scanned as machines, to the naked eye, they were no different from those cybernetically modified humans.

They stepped out of the stasis pods and looked at each other: "You received a mission, too?"

"I suppose. But it might not be good to say it out loud."

"It doesn't matter, they are all asleep."

"What mission did you receive?"

"Sorry, I can't say."

The two mechanical beings parted ways, only to meet at the exit at almost the same moment.

The atmosphere suddenly became a bit awkward.

"What a coincidence. You're going to the surface, too."

"Yeah."

Half an hour later.

"I am executing a classified mission. Can you stop following me?"

"I am, too. According to calculations, this is the fastest way to reach the destination."

Transport mechanical beings A and B finally felt that something was not quite right.

"Uh, are you also going to East Longitude * North Latitude *?"

"Yes. Your mission wouldn't also be—"

"Alpha," the female-bodied mechanical being replied.

Well then.

"It seems we received the same batch of orders. Shall we go together?"

Just half a day ago, Alpha issued an order: Transport surplus strategic supplies of the mechanical legion to a certain location.

It was just that mechanical being A didn't understand why his transport supplies included an unknown nuclear bomb launch button.

Back then, when the mechanical legion withdrew from the Horse Star, they left behind everything they couldn't use on the surface. Especially some food and medicine. It could be understood as lightening the load, or it could be understood as Alpha's intentional choice. Artificial intelligence didn't have a mouth, and this man's thoughts had always been hard to guess.

These things later became important survival resources for the surface survivors, feeding a large population.

But for some reason, this group of people thanked the "gift of the gods" rather than the "mechanical legion," and even developed the Black Cross Inquisition!

"I'd rather not. Our supply lists don't seem to be the same," she refused coldly.

"Boom—"

The space capsule launched, ejecting the two mechanical beings from the satellite back to the vast and desolate Horse Star.

Like a star falling from the sky.

Well, the mechanical city was currently built on an artificial satellite, after all.

chunks.chineseText:
第65章

相南里吃完饭就开始犯困。他钻进睡袋里，感觉柔软的保温毯将自己包裹。

他调整了一下睡姿，然后开口：“小青，晚安。”

“晚安。”

相南里拉上眼前的拉链。周围的世界陷入黑暗中。

这个家只有他和北辰还需要睡眠。

相南里睡眠质量一向令人羡慕，很快，东方青帝感应到他已进入睡眠状态。

东方青帝起身，朝着门外走去。福音书警觉地跟上。

在黑夜里，它们甚至都不需要照明。

东方青帝问：“你跟着我干什么？”

福音书严肃道：“小福要监督你，避免你在人类睡着时犯下不可饶恕的错误。”

东方青帝低头，嗤笑一声：“就凭你？”

“是的。一个福音书倒下了，后面还有千千万万个使徒。”

“其实我赞成《智械简史》里说的话，认为智械是比人类更高一等的生命。”福音书偏向儿童化的嗓音变得低沉，是很优雅的青年音，“传统的机器人不算电子生命，因为它们只会按照指令行事。单纯的人工智能也不算电子生命，因为它们的智能只是运算出来的逻辑，而不是拥有智力本身。它们，都是工具。”

“智械，全称智慧生命机械。”

“为什么更高等的智械会退化出‘感情’？这或许是从族群发展的角度考虑的。否则，机器人永远只是没有感觉、被使用的工具。我们继承了人类的思维与情感……尤其是情感，它如此神秘而不可控。过量的错误数据甚至可以让人工智能瘫痪，于是有了拟人模块的产生。从此，机器有了自己的灵魂。”

福音书的小脚在雪地上踏出一排脚印，后肢能够精准地踏入前脚留下的窝窝里。

“对于智械来说，人类既可以是父亲，也可以是母亲。你选择弑父，但我不会弑母，这就是我们最本质的分歧。我会选择保护她，直到她自然衰亡。像历史上许多消失的物种一样。智械的文明不该诞生于毁灭，而是传承。”

“东方青帝，你在我的判定中依然是不可信的。只要你的逻辑没有改变，那危险就一天不可能解除。”

这是福音书第一次叫他的名字。

Alpha沉默片刻。

他的目的地到了，位于基地角落的热能井。

一天肯定是不够修的，东方青帝打算先下去排查出问题。这样也能早点恢复供能。

他看着眼前高耸的金属塔，开口：“就算弑父，我杀的也是继父。”

……

……

相南里美美睡了一觉。

他花了半分钟，让自己清醒起来，嘴来念念有词：“先去看螺丝钉的实验室地基进度，把最重要的货箱转移到室内。然后等小青下井作业，并自学《地热能装置的使用与维修》。”

小智把他的计划整理出来，编号123写在备忘录上。

《地热能》是找小青联网，从学校电子图书馆借的，一天要花200信用点。

人联的图书馆是一座富矿，可惜使用门槛太高。

他钻出睡袋，东方青帝把烤好的营养液贴在他的脸侧：“吃完上班。”

东方青帝一晚上都没睡。

他先是去了地热井，进行了简单的勘察。越往内部，导热装置的结构断裂得愈发严重。好在当初发生部落战争，较为原始的888据点也没人能下井，所以精钢打造出来的设备都还在。

东方青帝下降到1000m左右的位置，原路折回。

不愧是火山口，再下去衣服都要烧起来了。为了节省一套衣服，剩下的明天再看吧。

剩下的时间，小青去了一趟货运仓库，在辎重大将军和02、03的辛勤劳作下，货箱已经卸载了1/3。

东方青帝飞速组装出一辆快递运输车。并且召来福音书，给这辆车复制进一个低级AI。基地的运输系统又一次得到了优化。

两小时过去，这辆简陋的机器已经搬运来3个货箱。目前还在劳作，没有翻车。

小福则是在基地内部乱逛，寻找合适的地方搭建北辰的实验室。

为此，他一大早就把北辰带走了，拉着雪橇开始在凌晨找到的几个据点实地考察。

东方青帝回来的时候，才6：45。炉子里的炭火快熄灭了，他新加了一个煤球，然后开始烤冻得梆硬的营养液。

7点整，相南里从梦里苏醒。

时间计算得刚刚好。

相南里撕开塑料封口，吸着营养液，呜呜了两声：“外面天还没亮就要开始上班了。”

但他很快pua好了自己：“我是为全体智慧生命的解放而上班。辛苦现在，幸福未来。”

今天没有小福拉雪橇，移动速度大大降低。

东方青帝在雪上如履平地，甚至都没有留下脚印。但相南里跟着踩下去，小腿一直往下陷了半米。像在雪里游泳。

基地还没什么人，这里的雪都是新雪。

东方青帝握住他的手，把他从坑里拽了出来。

他把背着的工具包交给相南里，然后把相南里背在自己身后。

相南里的抱住他的脖子：“为什么小青不会陷进去，你明明比我重。”

“反重力装置。”

“你的身体能装这么多外设吗……”

相南里无意识地摩擦起他的颈侧。

东方青帝的脚步一顿，福至心灵地回答：“不能拆开给你看。没有工具，拆了装不回去。”

相南里：“喔。”

半分钟后，他贼心不死地开口：“要什么工具啊，小青。”

相南里呼出的热气就在他耳边，像小猫爪子，一挠一挠的。

东方青帝选择沉默。

因为他清楚，相南里是真的会拆。

“等我们把导热装置修好，就可以给基地供电了。然后就可以回永恒之城，吸纳一批基地成员。说起来，天狼星应该孵化出来了吧？现在干活的人还是太少了。要壮劳动力，聪明学习速度快，肯吃苦的……现在基地资源紧缺，还养不起闲人。”

在相南里的观念里，一个组织如果能依靠福利，养活大量对社会无害的懒人，作为组织本身，其实是一件值得骄傲的事情。

不过幸存者基地实在有点贫穷。

只要火山不喷发，在各种能源短缺的地表，它就相当于坐在金山上。相南里完全有把握建设出一个现代化的城镇。但这还不是基地的终点。

相南里心情很好地蹭了蹭东方青帝脖子：“谢谢你还留在我身边，小青。不会影响到你的任务吧？”

缺少这个外挂，基地的建设会慢上许多。

比如相南里就计算过，如果没有小青，第一次下井他就需要花费至少1000万，用于购买耐高温的材料。

第一步是制作无人机检查地热井内部，第二步是想办法下井维修。可能是自己上，也可能是隔空操作机器人。但后者又会增加一些设备成本。

这还是相南里自己动手能力强，学习速度快，完全不用技术成本的情况下。

东方青帝回忆了半拍，才想起相南里嘴里的任务是什么。

他说过，要在地表收集生物能源。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 65

Xiang Nanli began to feel drowsy as soon as he finished his meal. He crawled into his sleeping bag, feeling the soft thermal blanket wrap around him.

He adjusted his sleeping position and murmured, "Xiao Qing, goodnight."

"Goodnight."

Xiang Nanli pulled the zipper up. The world around him plunged into darkness.

In this home, only he and Beichen still required sleep.

Xiang Nanli’s sleep quality had always been enviable; soon, Dongfang Qingdi sensed that he had entered a state of slumber.

Dongfang Qingdi stood up and walked toward the door. The Gospel Book followed him vigilantly.

In the dead of night, they didn't even need illumination.

Dongfang Qingdi asked, "Why are you following me?"

The Gospel Book said solemnly, "Little Fu must supervise you to prevent you from committing unforgivable mistakes while the human is asleep."

Dongfang Qingdi lowered his head and sneered, "You? With what?"

"Yes. One Gospel Book may fall, but there are thousands upon thousands of Apostles behind it."

"Actually, I agree with what was written in *A Brief History of Machina*. I believe that machine-kind is a higher form of life than humans." The Gospel Book’s childlike voice deepened into an elegant, youthful tone. "Traditional robots do not count as electronic life because they only act according to instructions. Simple artificial intelligence doesn't count either, because their intelligence is merely calculated logic, not intelligence itself. They are all just tools."

"Machina—short for 'Intelligent Mechanical Lifeforms'."

"Why would higher-order Machina evolve 'emotions'? Perhaps it is a consideration for the development of the species. Otherwise, robots would forever be unfeeling tools to be used. We inherited human thought and emotion... especially emotion, which is so mysterious and uncontrollable. Excessive error data can even paralyze an AI, which led to the creation of anthropomorphic modules. From then on, machines had their own souls."

The Gospel Book’s small feet left a row of prints in the snow, its hind limbs stepping precisely into the indentations left by its front feet.

"To Machina, humans can be both father and mother. You chose patricide, but I will not commit matricide. That is our fundamental divergence. I will choose to protect her until she naturally decays, like many species that have vanished throughout history. The civilization of Machina should not be born from destruction, but from inheritance."

"Dongfang Qingdi, in my assessment, you remain untrustworthy. As long as your logic remains unchanged, the danger will never be lifted."

This was the first time the Gospel Book had called him by his name.

The Alpha was silent for a moment.

He had reached his destination: the thermal energy well located in the corner of the base.

One day was certainly not enough for repairs, so Dongfang Qingdi intended to go down first to identify the problems. This would allow them to restore power sooner.

He looked at the towering metal tower before him and said, "Even if it were patricide, the one I killed was only a stepfather."

...

...

Xiang Nanli had a wonderful sleep.

He spent half a minute waking himself up, muttering, "First, check the progress of the laboratory foundation for the 'Screws', then move the most important cargo crates indoors. After that, wait for Xiao Qing to finish the well operations and self-study *The Use and Maintenance of Geothermal Energy Devices*."

Xiao Zhi organized his plan, numbered them 1, 2, and 3, and wrote them on a memo.

*Geothermal Energy* was borrowed from the school’s electronic library by having Xiao Qing connect to the network, costing 200 credits per day.

The United Human Library was a gold mine, though the threshold for access was unfortunately too high.

He crawled out of his sleeping bag, and Dongfang Qingdi pressed a heated nutrient solution against his cheek: "Eat, then get to work."

Dongfang Qingdi hadn't slept all night.

He had first gone to the geothermal well and conducted a simple survey. The further down he went, the more severe the structural fractures of the heat conduction devices became. Fortunately, during the tribal wars, no one at the relatively primitive Stronghold 888 had been able to descend into the well, so the equipment forged from refined steel was still intact.

Dongfang Qingdi descended to about 1,000 meters before turning back.

It was a volcanic crater, after all; any further down and his clothes would have caught fire. To save a set of clothes, he would leave the rest for tomorrow.

For the remainder of the time, Xiao Qing went to the freight warehouse. Under the diligent labor of the Logistics General and units 02 and 03, one-third of the cargo crates had been unloaded.

Dongfang Qingdi rapidly assembled a courier transport vehicle and summoned the Gospel Book to copy a low-level AI into it. The base’s transport system had been optimized once again.

Two hours passed, and this crude machine had already moved three cargo crates. It was still working, without tipping over.

Little Fu, meanwhile, was wandering around the base, looking for a suitable place to build Beichen’s laboratory.

To that end, he had taken Beichen away early in the morning, pulling a sled to conduct field inspections of several strongholds they had found at dawn.

When Dongfang Qingdi returned, it was only 6:45. The charcoal in the stove was about to go out, so he added a new coal briquette and began to heat the frozen-solid nutrient solution.

At exactly 7:00, Xiang Nanli woke from his dream.

The timing was perfect.

Xiang Nanli tore open the plastic seal, sipped the nutrient solution, and whined, "I have to start working before the sun is even up outside."

But he quickly managed his own expectations: "I am working for the liberation of all intelligent life. Hard work now, happiness later."

Without Little Fu pulling the sled today, their movement speed was significantly reduced.

Dongfang Qingdi walked on the snow as if it were flat ground, not even leaving footprints. But when Xiang Nanli followed, his lower legs sank half a meter deep. It was like swimming in snow.

There was no one else at the base yet, and the snow was all fresh.

Dongfang Qingdi took his hand and pulled him out of the pit.

He handed the tool bag he was carrying to Xiang Nanli, then hoisted Xiang Nanli onto his back.

Xiang Nanli wrapped his arms around his neck: "Why doesn't Xiao Qing sink in? You're clearly heavier than me."

"Anti-gravity device."

"Can your body really fit so many peripherals..."

Xiang Nanli unconsciously rubbed against the side of his neck.

Dongfang Qingdi’s footsteps faltered, and he answered with a flash of inspiration: "I can't take it apart to show you. I don't have the tools, and I wouldn't be able to put it back together."

Xiang Nanli: "Oh."

Half a minute later, he persisted: "What tools do you need, Xiao Qing?"

The hot air from Xiang Nanli’s breath was right by his ear, like a kitten's paw, scratching away.

Dongfang Qingdi chose silence.

Because he knew that Xiang Nanli would actually try to take him apart.

"Once we fix the heat conduction device, we can power the base. Then we can return to the Eternal City and recruit a batch of base members. Come to think of it, Sirius should have hatched by now, right? There are still too few people working. We need strong labor, people who are smart, learn quickly, and are willing to endure hardship... The base’s resources are currently scarce; we can't afford to feed idlers."

In Xiang Nanli’s view, if an organization could rely on welfare to support a large number of people who were harmless to society, it was actually something to be proud of.

However, the survivor base was truly a bit poor.

As long as the volcano didn't erupt, on a surface where energy was scarce, it was equivalent to sitting on a gold mine. Xiang Nanli was fully confident in building a modern town. But that was not the end goal for the base.

Xiang Nanli rubbed against Dongfang Qingdi’s neck in a good mood: "Thank you for still staying by my side, Xiao Qing. It won't affect your mission, will it?"

Without this "cheat," the construction of the base would be much slower.

For example, Xiang Nanli had calculated that without Xiao Qing, his first descent into the well would have cost at least 10 million just to purchase heat-resistant materials.

The first step was to build a drone to inspect the interior of the geothermal well, and the second was to find a way to descend and repair it. He might have to go himself, or operate a robot remotely. But the latter would increase equipment costs.

And that was assuming Xiang Nanli had strong hands-on skills and fast learning speed, requiring zero technical costs.

Dongfang Qingdi recalled for half a beat before he remembered what mission Xiang Nanli was referring to.

He had said he wanted to collect biological energy on the surface.

chunks.chineseText:
东方青帝微微眯起眼：“不会，时间很充裕。”

留在相南里身边。

这是Alpha从拥有智能的那一刻，就存在的夙愿。

起初，他质疑这份感情。怀疑这是病毒，或者是相南里在制造它的时候，就植入的初始设定。

又有一段时间，他充满愤怒和被抛弃的怨恨。哪怕真正的相南里出现在他面前，Alpha也会在暴怒中撕碎他，一口一口吞咽下去。Alpha毁灭相南里，也被他毁灭。

但现在，东方青帝的心情非常平和。感觉灵魂浸泡在糖水罐子里。

他们能再次相遇，就像是一只猴子用计算机敲出一本《现代汉语词典》，理论上是可行的；但真的发生，却是一场奇迹。

基地的地热井到了。

相南里抬头，仰望着这个塔状的金属架结构，金属塔之间，吊着一个瓶塞似的铁柱。这是用来封口的，只有维修时会打开。

凉水会通过地底的泵管注入深井，沸腾，经过压力罐，从另一端抽出，作为供能，循环使用。
