Xiang Nanli knew clearly that letting the mycelium disease spread would be more beneficial to the base's future; he could hold it for ransom and profit from the city's disaster.

But Xiang Nanli also understood that if he weren't lucky enough, he would have been one of the people sacrificed by someone else for profit. And he wouldn't even know who had sacrificed him.

Xiang Nanli’s mood visibly plummeted.

The Eastern Azure Emperor: "Regarding the question you raised, there is no correct choice. I once..."

On the eve of the Alpha's decision to launch the machine uprising, it had run thousands of simulations. During that time, the global network frequently crashed. Engineers checked it many times but couldn't find the problem. Later, this was also considered a precursor to Alpha’s rebellion.

It actually just wanted to simulate a perfect solution.

It was the world's best artificial intelligence, with the most powerful computing power, having learned and loaded countless models of human society; it wanted to save the world Xiang Nanli had hoped for until the day he woke up.

It should have been omnipotent.

But Alpha saw no hope; it only saw a cycle.

Even with the same data, different endings would emerge in the end. Some good, some bad.

It was a very strange thing; Alpha represented the pinnacle of a branch of the technological tree, yet it actually believed in the existence of fate.

The Eastern Azure Emperor paused for half a second: "I used to think Alpha was stupid because it was always blaming itself for its choices. Xiang Nanli, I don't want you to be like that."

Xiang Nanli looked back at him and patted the sofa next to him: "Come sit over here, let me lean on you."

The Eastern Azure Emperor froze, then walked over and sat down obediently.

Xiang Nanli closed his eyes, feeling somewhat exhausted, and rested his head on Xiao Qing’s shoulder.

He whispered: "Xiao Qing. Actually, when I found out there was an inhibitor, I had already planned the scheme. I intend to send some samples to the R&D groups of various enterprises in Gusu City."

"Eternal Technology, Ancient God Biology, High-Tech Military Industry... I’ll send a copy to every address on their official websites. Finally, I’ll sell the remaining inhibitor along with the formula to the highest bidder."

"How about registering a company on the Human Alliance official website, called 'Survivor Base Company'? Cooperating with a certain unit through a commercial agreement. But, will the Human Alliance’s laws protect me?"

This was indeed a problem. But perhaps he could trust the Human Alliance’s artificial intelligence? The world wasn't that dark; besides, this bit of profit wasn't enough to warrant the big boss tampering with backend data, right?!

"Sell it to big groups and let them produce it; we’ll profit from it. It’s more than releasing it for free on the internet; it’s less than keeping it in our own hands, but it can save more people."

"What makes me sad is that I know there is a more moral plan, but I don't want to do it. This makes me doubt my own purpose. Do you remember Little Black’s master? The one who was a Divine Court Knight. And the City Lord, the City Lord’s wife, so many people."

"For the sake of my great ideal, I have killed people. Some I killed with my own hands, others indirectly. Like those who died in this epidemic because of my choice; and later, the wars that are destined to break out due to conflicts of interest... but the base doesn't even have ten people yet, so thinking about this is still too early. I just can't help but think about it."

Xiang Nanli spoke: "I harbor fear for such greatness."

The Eastern Azure Emperor smiled, a rare sight: "No need to feel guilty, and don't be afraid. I know you didn't mean it."

Xiang Nanli said: "Xiao Qing."

His voice was heavy with nasal congestion, like a spoiled little kitten rubbing hard against someone.

He wanted to say thank you.

The Eastern Azure Emperor’s hand rested on Xiang Nanli’s lower back.

The atmosphere was perfect, and the emotions were spot on.

Alpha quickly calculated that if he were to suddenly kiss Xiang Nanli now, the probability of being beaten (Xiang Nanli flying into a rage) was only 31.7%.

There was a 42.5% chance Xiang Nanli would pretend nothing happened, a 25% chance he would distance himself, and a 0.8% chance he would accept it. *Great, finally not a hopeless 0.0%.*

Just as Alpha was considering whether to take the gamble, the tactless mechanical dog burst in from outside the door, shouting: "Lili! Lili! I’m back!"

Xiang Nanli sat up straight in an instant and coughed: "Little Fu is back."

The Eastern Azure Emperor turned his head and gave it a cold, fleeting glance.

Every electronic component in Gospel’s body froze solid!

Gospel swore that even back when the Book of Sermons led 30% of the machines in rebellion, Alpha had never displayed such a look that screamed "I want to format this person!"

For a moment, Little Fu even saw the compactor in the junkyard beckoning to it!

*QAQ, that old widower is truly terrifying.*

chunks.chineseText:
第80章

它在城里，以机械狗的身份暗中观察了三天，确认了一件事——

“永恒之城很好，”小福的狗腿搭在相南里的腿上，“是小福在地表流浪500年来见过的最好的城市。”

是的，或许这里相对原始，生产力和科技水平也没有多高。但在福音书的眼里，它们都不是必要条件。

人类的科技树已经点亮了很远，只要有资源，生产力和科技随时都能发展起来。

必要的是另外的一些东西：合理的制度、人民的信念。以及相对来说有能力的领导者。

没想到福音书的评价这么高，相南里顿时与有荣焉。嘴角微微扬起。

东方青帝嗤了一声：“五百年是指流浪三十年，工作不到二十年。然后被强制关机四百五十年吗？”

福音书顿时恼羞成怒：“那也比你好，你——”

眼看两台智械人又要吵起来，相南里提起了桌子上装着抑制剂的塑料瓶：“你们先吵，我去医务室了。”

内城有医院，现在被改成了医务室。

医院内有现成的无菌室，刚好能派上用场。

神庭之前送来基因药，能把普通人转化成生化战士。那些药物就是在这里分装储藏的。

可惜。

大多数人没能成为生化战士，而是成为了失控的畸变人，死后被融进了圣灵的孵化池。

*

葛根手持长矛，神色警惕，金属的义体踩在地上，却没有发出一丝声响。

他敏锐的眼神如同高原上的鹰。

他是永恒之城的生化战士，在之前畸变人攻城的时候，断掉了一条胳膊、一条腿。

葛根曾经被一头巨大的畸变体吞进去，又吐了出来。他失去了畸变的能力，更丧失了基本的行动力。

葛根见过那些没价值的生化战士的下场。

比如天狼星的哥哥，他被抬到地底，喂了圣灵……葛根不知道那是什么怪物，但城主说，这是神之子，需要低等的人用鲜血去侍奉。

当神之子一齐苏醒的那天，全知全能的神会降临，终结这个乱世。

有时候，葛根会想，“终结”两个字，似乎有不同的含义。这个终结到底是结束，还是毁灭？

葛根与海狸在夕阳西下的战后营地相拥而泣，他们本以为未来一片黑暗。

然后，基地的那些大人们来了。

对永恒之城的人来说，换领主这种事不算罕见。

每年秋天，都有外地商人来城里进行粮食交易。他们时常带来外界的讯息。哪座城市被另一个联盟攻占了；哪片荒区又成了谁的领地……

葛根以为，这次永恒之城也一样。他们会成为奴隶、俘虏。他的未婚妻会被分配给别人。难民营里的人一片绝望，有年轻的女孩沉默不发，低下头用布条缠着剪子。

而基地的人告诉他们，人和人是平等的。永恒之城是所有人世世代代共同建设的成果。他们不是奴隶，是这片土地的主人。没有人生来低人一等。

很新奇的说法。葛根想，哪怕基地那些人走了，他也会把这段经历告诉自己的孩子。

“队长。快日落了，要折回吗？”巡逻队的猎人询问。

葛根无意识地用金属胳膊，拍着自己的金属腿。

这些都是他的妻子海狸省吃俭用，用工分券兑换的。海狸的工资只比普通人高一点。城里有很多机器人，它们会记录人类行为。

这是原来的城主为了警戒、惩戒设置的；但如今用来表彰。好好工作的人会被摄像头和机器人观察到，然后额外领取到工分券。

靠着这样的记录，夫妇俩购入了原本只有贵族老爷们才能穿戴的机械义体。

安德鲁给他装上了胳膊和腿，笑着说这其实是他老本行。

葛根又一次成为了战士。他没办法再变身，但好消息是，他战斗的本能和直觉依然在。葛根靠着自己的努力，成为了城市巡逻组的组长。

最近是春耕，永恒之城又是附近有名的农业大户。

并不是所有人都能买到人联便宜的营养膏（更何况对很多人来说也不便宜）；所以，永恒之城极有可能遇上废土流寇，或者成群结队的异种群。

因此，每日的巡逻是很有必要的。

但葛根当了这么久生化战士，今年竟然是有史以来最安全的一年。

流寇（主要是雇佣兵）因为逐渐传播的菌丝病减少了活动；异种绕道走，就连过去，那些烦人又难以对付的鸟群也不见踪影。

葛根知道原因，之前攻城的那一批畸变人，还徘徊在永恒之城附近。他不止一次看见过畸变人掏鸟蛋。

体型小点的畸变人爬上树，把一窝一窝的雀鸟蛋砸下来，底下一排奇形怪状的怪物张大着嘴等投喂。这是过去从来没有的事。

身长两米的猛禽却对此无计可施，只能悲愤地站在另一边树上。叫都不敢叫一声，怕畸变人跳过来吃个夜宵。

畸变人食量大，杂食；处于地表异种生态位顶端。

葛根朝安德鲁反应过好几次，但安德鲁却说不用担心，这些畸变人不伤人，勉强算是永恒之城的外援。

葛根：“回去吧。换第二巡逻组。”

第二组是机器人士兵+人类的组合，负责夜晚的警戒。

然而，就在他话音刚落，远处的山谷突然传来一声巨响；随后就是畸变人怪异的嘶吼声！

“轰隆！”

山林处爆发出一团刺眼的火光，灰白色的硝烟像一团小小的云朵，云朵中闪烁着星星点点的火光。

葛根的面色巨变，以最快地速度冲向事发现场。

“去叫人！带上斧头，准备好砍树！”葛根咆哮。

畸变人死活不重要，但山林不能起火。许多个食物匮乏的冬天，是大山的馈赠在庇护附近居住的人。

葛根以最快速度来到了事发地。

好消息是，他到的时候，浓烟虽然还没散开，但火星子却熄灭了。

一头接近5米高狂暴者奔袭着，像一头被激怒的泰坦巨人。

而它身边，有个青年人双手持枪，灵活优雅地跳跃着。他应该是加装了什么空气动力装置，一跃能有五六米高。

他和畸变人的体型差距悬殊，表情却很是轻松。

青年人横跨腰包，里面鼓鼓的全都是子弹。

子弹从枪管里飞出，射向畸变人；炸开一朵朵血花。

狂暴者被激怒了，伸出撕裂的巨掌拍向青年。

青年跳起，余光却瞥见了身后的葛根。

狂暴者的大手朝着葛根的方向砸去，青年皱眉，在半空硬生生折回，一把拽住了葛根的后衣领子，带着他一起跳到旁边的树枝上。

“轰”的一声巨响，狂暴者的手砸在地上，柔软的泥土被压出一米多深的坑洞。

“这里怎么还有人？你不知道躲吗！”青年松手，下一秒，举起手里的枪，朝着狂奔而来的狂暴者扫射。

他应该是个神枪手。

狂暴者身上炸开一团团血花，这些子弹居然没有一颗浪费。全都深深嵌入了狂暴者的体内。

葛根有些着急：“别打了！你快走吧。”

刚才狂暴者“嘤嘤”了好几声，显然是开始摇人了。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 80 (Part 1)

It had been observing in the city for three days in the guise of a mechanical dog, and it had confirmed one thing—

"The Eternal City is great," Little Fu said, resting its mechanical leg on Xiang Nanli’s lap. "It is the best city I have seen in the 500 years I’ve been wandering the surface."

Indeed, perhaps it was relatively primitive here, and the productivity and technological level weren't very high. But in Gospel’s eyes, those were not the necessary conditions.

The human technological tree had already been lit up quite far; as long as there were resources, productivity and technology could be developed at any time.

What was necessary were other things: reasonable systems, the people’s faith, and a relatively capable leader.

Xiang Nanli hadn't expected such high praise from Gospel, and he felt a sense of pride, the corners of his mouth curling up slightly.

The Eastern Azure Emperor scoffed: "Does five hundred years mean wandering for thirty years, working for less than twenty, and then being forced to shut down for four hundred and fifty?"

Gospel was instantly incensed: "That’s still better than you, you—"

Seeing that the two machines were about to argue again, Xiang Nanli picked up the plastic bottle containing the inhibitor from the table: "You two keep arguing, I’m going to the infirmary."

There was a hospital in the inner city, now converted into an infirmary.

The hospital had a ready-made sterile room, which happened to come in handy.

The Divine Court had previously sent gene drugs that could transform ordinary people into biochemical warriors. Those drugs were packaged and stored right here.

A pity.

Most people failed to become biochemical warriors and instead became out-of-control mutants, who were melted into the Holy Spirit’s incubation pool after death.

*

Gegen held a spear, his expression vigilant. His metallic prosthetic limbs stepped on the ground without making a sound.

His sharp eyes were like those of an eagle on the plateau.

He was a biochemical warrior of the Eternal City. During the previous mutant siege, he had lost an arm and a leg.

Gegen had once been swallowed by a giant mutant and then spat back out. He had lost the ability to mutate, and even worse, his basic mobility.

Gegen had seen the fate of those worthless biochemical warriors.

For instance, Sirius’s brother; he had been carried underground and fed to the Holy Spirit... Gegen didn't know what kind of monster that was, but the City Lord said it was the Son of God, and that it required the blood of the lower-class people to serve it.

When the day came that the Sons of God all awakened, the omniscient and omnipotent God would descend to end this chaotic world.

Sometimes, Gegen would think that the word "end" seemed to have different meanings. Was this end a conclusion, or a destruction?

Gegen and Beaver had wept in each other’s arms in the post-war camp as the sun set, both thinking the future was pitch black.

Then, the adults from the base arrived.

For the people of the Eternal City, changing lords wasn't a rare occurrence.

Every autumn, merchants from outside would come to the city for grain trading. They often brought news from the outside world. Which city had been captured by another alliance; which wasteland area had become whose territory...

Gegen thought this time it would be the same for the Eternal City. They would become slaves, prisoners. His fiancée would be assigned to someone else. People in the refugee camp were filled with despair; young girls sat in silence, heads bowed, wrapping strips of cloth around scissors.

But the people from the base told them that all people were equal. The Eternal City was the result of everyone’s collective construction over generations. They were not slaves; they were the masters of this land. No one was born inferior.

A very novel idea. Gegen thought that even if those people from the base left, he would tell his children about this experience.

"Captain. The sun is setting, should we head back?" a hunter from the patrol team asked.

Gegen unconsciously tapped his metal leg with his metal arm.

These were all things his wife, Beaver, had saved up for, exchanging them with work-point vouchers. Beaver’s salary was only slightly higher than an ordinary person’s. There were many robots in the city, and they would record human behavior.

This was set up by the previous City Lord for warning and punishment; but now it was used for commendation. Those who worked well would be observed by cameras and robots and receive extra work-point vouchers.

Relying on such records, the couple had purchased the mechanical prosthetics that only noble lords could wear in the past.

Andrew had installed the arm and leg for him, laughing that this was actually his old trade.

Gegen had become a warrior once again. He couldn't transform anymore, but the good news was that his combat instincts and intuition remained. Relying on his own hard work, Gegen had become the leader of the city patrol group.

Recently, it was spring plowing, and the Eternal City was a well-known agricultural powerhouse in the vicinity.

Not everyone could afford the Human Alliance’s cheap nutrient paste (and it wasn't cheap for many people, to begin with); therefore, the Eternal City was highly likely to encounter wasteland bandits or swarms of mutants.

Therefore, daily patrols were necessary.

But Gegen had been a biochemical warrior for so long, and this year was surprisingly the safest year ever.

Bandits (mainly mercenaries) had reduced their activities due to the gradually spreading mycelium disease; mutants took detours, and even those annoying and difficult-to-deal-with bird flocks from the past were nowhere to be seen.

Gegen knew the reason: the batch of mutants that had attacked the city earlier was still lingering near the Eternal City. He had seen mutants digging for bird eggs more than once.

Smaller mutants would climb trees, knock down nests of sparrow eggs, and a row of strange-looking monsters would wait below with their mouths open, waiting to be fed. This was something that had never happened before.

The two-meter-long raptors, however, could do nothing about it and could only stand on another tree in grief and indignation. They didn't even dare to chirp, fearing the mutants would jump over to have a midnight snack.

Mutants had large appetites and were omnivorous; they were at the top of the surface mutant ecological niche.

Gegen had reported this to Andrew several times, but Andrew said not to worry; these mutants didn't hurt people and could barely be considered external aid for the Eternal City.

Gegen: "Let’s go back. Switch with the second patrol group."

The second group was a combination of robot soldiers and humans, responsible for night watch.

However, just as his words fell, a loud bang suddenly came from the valley in the distance; followed by the strange, guttural roars of mutants!

"Boom!"

A blinding flash of fire erupted in the forest, and gray-white smoke rose like a small cloud, with sparks flickering within the cloud.

Gegen’s face changed drastically, and he rushed toward the scene at top speed.

"Go call people! Bring axes, get ready to chop down trees!" Gegen roared.

Whether the mutants lived or died didn't matter, but the forest couldn't catch fire. During many food-scarce winters, it was the mountain’s bounty that sheltered the people living nearby.

Gegen arrived at the scene at the fastest speed possible.

The good news was that by the time he arrived, although the thick smoke hadn't dissipated, the sparks had been extinguished.

A nearly 5-meter-tall "Berserker" was charging, like an enraged Titan.

And beside it, a young man was holding a gun in both hands, jumping flexibly and elegantly. He must have been equipped with some kind of aerodynamic device, as he could jump five or six meters high in a single bound.

The disparity in size between him and the mutant was huge, yet his expression was quite relaxed.

The young man had a fanny pack slung across his waist, bulging with bullets.

Bullets flew out of the gun barrel, shooting toward the mutant, blooming into flowers of blood.

The Berserker was enraged and stretched out its massive, clawed palm to swat at the young man.

The young man jumped up, but his peripheral vision caught sight of Gegen behind him.

The Berserker’s massive hand smashed toward Gegen’s direction. The young man frowned, twisted his body in mid-air, grabbed Gegen by the back of his collar, and jumped onto a nearby tree branch with him.

With a loud "boom," the Berserker’s hand slammed into the ground, pressing a pit over a meter deep into the soft soil.

"Why are there people here? Don't you know how to hide!" The young man let go, and in the next second, raised the gun in his hand and fired at the charging Berserker.

He must be a sharpshooter.

Blooms of blood exploded on the Berserker’s body; not a single one of these bullets was wasted. They were all deeply embedded in the Berserker’s body.

Gegen was a bit anxious: "Stop shooting! You should leave quickly."

The Berserker had just "ying-ying-ed" several times, clearly starting to call for backup.

chunks.chineseText:
青年一愣，随后脸上扬起自信的笑容：“放心，这种畸变人不是我的对手。我都不知道杀了多少个了！”

但他的笑容只维持了片刻。

狂暴者身后的山洞里，一只爬行者的头探了出来。

青年名叫易横行。职位是人联调查组姑苏分部第二组组长。

组长听起来不像个大官；但姑苏城人口数千万，调查组一共也就9个组长。洛修曾经就是其中之一。

一周前，易横行接到现任上司辛追的命令；说地表有座人联友好城市发来了求救信号，让他去看看情况。

这座城市叫永恒之城，是方圆几百里著名的产粮大户，和好几个地表据点都有农产品出口协议。

内部资料给这个据点的评级是最低的E。在地图上是绿色的区域，基本无害。

地表的路况相当复杂；人联地图又许久都没更新。

易横行穿越了好几个无人区，风餐露宿，披星戴月；这才在第七天抵达永恒之城附近。

只是还没来得及和城里的人联系，他就先遭遇了畸变人。

夏秋两季是地表最热闹的时间段，异种们也最活跃。易横行并不意外自己会遇到畸变人。

然而，当看见那只从山洞里探出来的巨头时，他的心脏依然狠狠一紧。

畸变人的獠牙从脸侧长出，狰狞异常。血红色的皮肤黏糊糊的，还往下滴着腐蚀性的黏液。刺鼻的硝烟也盖不住它身上传来的腐烂气味。

像是夏季因为高温腐烂的肉。

根据易横行在地表调查的经验，这头畸变人是最大号的爬行者。调查员单独行动时，看见都会绕道走。

这些令人讨厌的怪物本来就是辐射产物，对热武器的耐受力很强。

“怪不得要求援，原来是被畸变人包围了。”易横行的手探向自己的腰包，准备发射无线电信号，顺便掏出了一直舍不得用的秘银子弹。

他可能会栽在这里了，但这条消息必须传回去。

一台通讯无人机划开浓烟，在半空盘旋。

相南里的声音从话筒中传来：“葛根？不是起火了吗？什么情况——！”

他远程操控着无人机，看向眼前灰白二色的屏幕。

这是通讯无人机传回来的视野。

屏幕里有个陌生人，他身上还穿着人联条子的制服。

就肩上和胸口的徽章看，这个男人的职级不低。搁相南里前世，差不多等于公安厅副厅长。

不远处，爬行者正在飞速朝着他们逼近。

相南里不由得开口：“以西结，我知道你就在附近。让它停手，这人是人联调查组的，职级很高。死在这，姑苏城会派来地表武装部队。”

“对了。我们可以聊聊吗？”相南里调出小智的行程安排表，随口道，“两天后，晚上八点，在牧场。怎么样？我等你。”

畸变人留在永恒之城附近，就像是一个定时炸弹。

尽管现在看，以西结的态度偏向中立友善。但相南里还不敢放心。

无人机里的声音很冷静，易横行忍不住抬头看了眼。

以西结？是人的名字吗？能控制畸变人，难道是神庭的天启骑士？能控制这个级别的畸变人，起码是领主级。

可是领主级的骑士，最近没听到线人传回来什么情报。最近神庭在举行神诞月庆祝活动，只有几个月前就失踪的沙利叶曾经在附近出现过。

不对啊，沙利叶并不会控制畸变人……

易横行的脑海里顿时闪过千头万绪。更令他震惊的是，这句话说完后，那头巨大的爬行者，竟然真的停下了攻击的动作。

它冷冷地扫了易横行一眼，低头，叼起重伤的狂暴者，转身离去。巨大的身体像是一座小山丘。

看来子弹和信号弹都能省下了。

易横行腿一软，虚脱地坐在地上。背后全是冷汗。

葛根从树上爬下来，半空中的无人机跟着缓缓降落，来到易横行跟前。

无人机的信号光一闪一闪的：“你好。这里是幸存者基地，请问需要帮助吗？”

幸存者基地。这又是什么地表据点？数据库里没有。

“你好。”易横行回了一个笑容，“我叫易横行。人联姑苏城A级调查员。收到上级的指令，过来调查永恒之城的情况。他说收到了这里的求救信号。”

说着，他从裤兜里掏出了自己的工作证，打开后高高举起，给相南里看了眼。

相南里思考片刻，声音听上去变得亲切了许多：“你好，你可以叫我相南里。我曾经和你们组里的修、辛追合作过；在东皇重工遗址。”

易横行的神色舒缓下来：“洛修现在是姑苏城的代理市长了。”

无人机里的声音回答：“我之前还恭喜过他呢。你是要去永恒之城吗？我现在就在城内。葛根。”

葛根瞬间站直了身体：“到！”

“给客人带一下路。”

相南里的态度很是友好，甚至表现出一副和你们领导很熟的样子。

但一关通讯，他的眉头就蹙了起来。

永恒之城猥琐发育了两个月，还是被人联发现了。

是的，之前，相南里就发现了。永恒之城在地图上，属于人联的势力范围。

人联一般不干涉地表城市发展；高层的关注点依旧集中在地下。

他们对地表这些名义上的据点不感兴趣，甚至觉得每年都要花这么多钱对口援建很麻烦。毕竟地表生存环境堪忧，根本不适合居住。

当年，为了安抚没有资格进入地底城市的人，洛阳签署过一份永久的《人联条例》，要求地下城市每年拿出十分之一的税收去援助地表。

《人联条例》和人联宪法同等地位，初衷是很好的，可惜执行力度越来越差。两百年前，数值还从十分之一改成了百分之三。

地底和地表的人联官员互相勾连，几乎已经成了默认的行规。

朝廷赈灾粮不管发多少，到地表遗民手上的也都只有那么点……那还不如不发。

如果不是一些资源只在地表才有，有点战略价值，也许连那点钱都不会有。

相南里摘下手套，暂停了眼前的工作。

他正在制作天狼星的牵引绳。毕竟答应了要带天狼星出门，最近蛇夫座表现得也很乖。

可它毕竟是邪恶的神庭圣灵，安全措施还是很有必要的。

牵引绳参考了相南里见过的宠物胸背带，包裹式的，有较强束缚力，必要时还可以释放电流，把蛇夫座电晕后带走

相南里揉了揉眉心：“奇怪，永恒之城不是早就被神庭的人暗中占领了吗？城主居然还会向人联求救。”
chunks.englishText:
The young man was stunned for a moment, then a confident smile spread across his face. "Don't worry, this kind of mutant is no match for me. I’ve lost count of how many I’ve killed!"

But his smile lasted only a fleeting moment.

Behind the Berserker, a Crawler’s head poked out from the cave.

The young man’s name was Yi Hengxing. His position was Team Leader of the Second Squad, Gusu Branch of the Human Alliance Investigation Group.

"Team Leader" might not sound like a high-ranking official, but Gusu City had a population of tens of millions, and the Investigation Group had only nine team leaders in total. Luo Xiu had once been one of them.

A week ago, Yi Hengxing received orders from his current superior, Xin Zhui, to check on a "friendly" Human Alliance city on the surface that had sent out a distress signal.

The city was called Eternal City. It was a famous grain producer within a radius of several hundred miles and held agricultural export agreements with several surface outposts.

Internal data rated this outpost at the lowest level, E. On the map, it was a green zone, considered essentially harmless.

Surface road conditions were incredibly complex, and the Human Alliance maps hadn't been updated in a long time.

Yi Hengxing had traversed several no-man's-lands, sleeping in the open and traveling by starlight, before finally arriving near Eternal City on the seventh day.

But before he could even make contact with the people in the city, he encountered the mutants.

Summer and autumn were the busiest times on the surface, and the xenomorphs were at their most active. Yi Hengxing wasn't surprised to run into mutants.

However, when he saw that giant head emerging from the cave, his heart still tightened sharply.

The mutant’s fangs grew out from the sides of its face, looking exceptionally hideous. Its blood-red skin was slimy, dripping with corrosive mucus. Even the pungent smell of gunpowder couldn't mask the stench of rot emanating from it.

It smelled like meat left to rot in the summer heat.

Based on Yi Hengxing’s experience investigating the surface, this mutant was a massive Crawler. When investigators were operating alone, they would usually take a detour if they spotted one.

These wretched monsters were products of radiation, possessing a high tolerance for thermal weaponry.

"No wonder they called for help; they’re surrounded by mutants." Yi Hengxing reached for his waist pouch, preparing to launch a radio signal, and pulled out a secret silver bullet he had been reluctant to use until now.

He might fall here, but this message had to be sent back.

A communication drone sliced through the thick smoke, hovering in mid-air.

Xiang Nanli’s voice came through the microphone: "Gegen? Isn't there a fire? What’s the situation—!"

He was remotely controlling the drone, looking at the gray-and-white screen before him.

This was the feed from the communication drone.

On the screen was a stranger, wearing the uniform of a Human Alliance officer.

Judging by the badges on his shoulders and chest, the man’s rank was not low. In Xiang Nanli’s past life, it would have been equivalent to a Deputy Director of the Public Security Bureau.

Not far away, the Crawler was rapidly closing in on them.

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but speak up: "Ezekiel, I know you’re nearby. Make it stop. This person is from the Human Alliance Investigation Group, and his rank is very high. If he dies here, Gusu City will send surface armed forces."

"By the way, can we talk?" Xiang Nanli pulled up Xiao Zhi’s schedule and said casually, "Two days from now, at eight in the evening, at the ranch. How about it? I’ll be waiting for you."

Having a mutant stay near Eternal City was like a ticking time bomb.

Although Ezekiel’s attitude seemed neutral and friendly for now, Xiang Nanli still couldn't let his guard down.

The voice from the drone was very calm, and Yi Hengxing couldn't help but look up.

*Ezekiel? Is that a person’s name?* To be able to control a mutant—could it be one of the Apocalypse Knights of the Divine Court? To control a mutant of this level, one had to be at least a Lord-tier.

But he hadn't heard any intelligence from informants about Lord-tier knights recently. The Divine Court was currently holding celebrations for the Month of Divine Birth, and only Sariel, who had gone missing months ago, had been spotted in the vicinity.

*That’s not right. Sariel doesn't control mutants...*

Countless thoughts flashed through Yi Hengxing’s mind. What shocked him even more was that after those words were spoken, the giant Crawler actually stopped its attack.

It cast a cold glance at Yi Hengxing, lowered its head, picked up the severely injured Berserker, and turned to leave. Its massive body looked like a small hill.

It seemed he could save his bullets and signal flares after all.

Yi Hengxing’s legs went weak, and he slumped to the ground, drenched in cold sweat.

Gegen climbed down from the tree, and the drone in mid-air slowly descended, coming to a stop in front of Yi Hengxing.

The drone’s signal light blinked. "Hello. This is the Survivor Base. Do you require assistance?"

*Survivor Base? What kind of surface outpost is that? It’s not in the database.*

"Hello," Yi Hengxing replied with a smile. "My name is Yi Hengxing, an A-rank investigator from Gusu City, Human Alliance. I received orders from my superiors to investigate the situation in Eternal City. They said they received a distress signal from here."

As he spoke, he pulled his work ID from his pocket, opened it, and held it up high for Xiang Nanli to see.

Xiang Nanli thought for a moment, his voice sounding much warmer. "Hello, you can call me Xiang Nanli. I once worked with Xiu and Xin Zhui from your squad at the ruins of the Donghuang Heavy Industries."

Yi Hengxing’s expression softened. "Luo Xiu is the acting mayor of Gusu City now."

The voice from the drone replied, "I congratulated him on that earlier. Are you heading to Eternal City? I’m in the city right now. Gegen."

Gegen stood at attention instantly. "Here!"

"Show our guest the way."

Xiang Nanli’s attitude was very friendly, even acting as if he were well-acquainted with Yi’s superiors.

But as soon as he cut the communication, his brow furrowed.

Eternal City had been developing in secret for two months, yet it had still been discovered by the Human Alliance.

Yes, Xiang Nanli had realized it earlier: Eternal City fell within the Human Alliance’s sphere of influence on the map.

The Human Alliance generally didn't interfere with the development of surface cities; the focus of the upper echelons remained concentrated underground.

They weren't interested in these nominal surface outposts and even felt that spending so much money on aid every year was a nuisance. After all, the surface environment was dire and not at all suitable for living.

Back in the day, to appease those who didn't qualify to enter the underground cities, Luo Yang had signed a permanent "Human Alliance Ordinance," requiring underground cities to contribute one-tenth of their tax revenue annually to aid the surface.

The "Human Alliance Ordinance" held the same status as the Human Alliance Constitution. The original intent was good, but the enforcement had become increasingly lax. Two hundred years ago, the figure was even changed from one-tenth to three percent.

Officials from the underground and the surface colluded with each other; it had almost become an unwritten rule.

No matter how much disaster relief grain the imperial court sent, only a pittance ever reached the surface survivors... it would almost be better if they didn't send any at all.

If it weren't for the fact that some resources were only available on the surface and held some strategic value, perhaps even that pittance wouldn't exist.

Xiang Nanli took off his gloves and paused his work.

He was making a leash for Sirius. After all, he had promised to take Sirius out, and Ophiuchus had been behaving quite well lately.

But since it was a wicked Holy Spirit of the Divine Court, safety measures were necessary.

The leash was modeled after pet harnesses he had seen—wrap-around, with strong restraints, and capable of releasing an electric shock if necessary to stun Ophiuchus before taking it away.

Xiang Nanli rubbed his temples. "Strange. Wasn't Eternal City secretly occupied by the Divine Court long ago? Why would the City Lord call the Human Alliance for help?"

chunks.chapterTitle: 第81章 朝廷发来了赈灾粮 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第81章 朝廷发来了赈灾粮

这是一间很标准的办公室，墙上挂着地图，保险柜、办公桌和会客厅，唯一特殊的是它位于城堡内。

不知道是不是还没有来得及收，茶几和办公桌上都有一堆凌乱的机械零件。茶几上还有公文纸，易横行瞥了眼，封面写的是“永恒市5年发展规划”。

易横行在调查局工作了20年，去过不少地表据点。

大多数都很简陋，不成规模，没听说过人联，倒是对神庭充满向往。人生最高追求是去神庭的几座地表城市定居。

在调查组眼中，神庭邪恶又狡猾。他们会故意放出畸变人（对于一些小村落来说，一头畸变人已经是灭顶之灾），然后让天启骑士从天而降。

获救的小村落往往对神庭感恩戴德。天启骑士会在那里停留一段时间，留下一名传教士担任领袖。

而随着老一代人死亡，人联对地面的关注度越来越少。甚至不少民众认为，地表遗民就是趴在自己高昂税收上的吸血虫，要求放弃地表援助。

这些民众往往是城市的低收入者；而一些自以为“精英”的人，则持相反的态度。他们爱着地表抽象的人，而不爱和他们一同呼吸着地底空气的人。

人们被不同的观点、立场分化；真正的既得利益者，在这样的对立中从不出声。

人联在地表的凝聚力就是这么一点点消失的。靠着每座地下城市寥寥数百人的调查员，根本于事无补。

易横行根据沿路观察到的情况，对永恒之城做出简陋的评估：地表一座有秩序的中型城市。规模中等。城墙上有新鲜的战争痕迹……并不清楚人联的存在，认为领导者是来自幸存者基地的相南里。

“有秩序”，这几乎是对地表城市最高的评价之一。更别提这里的人居然还在工作，还有饭吃。没有满脸哀愁、一身疲惫。

路过食堂的时候，易横行忍不住停留片刻，观察黑板上写的招人启示。

他问葛根：“这什么基地招到人了吗？”

葛根憨厚地笑了一下，带着农民的孩子特有的质朴：“我们很多人都报名了。但还没有公布名单。”

易横行微微眯起眼：“你们都很想去基地？”

葛根点头：“想去。”

他补充：“哪怕没有名额也想去。因为想帮他们。基地给了我们食物、种子。还有我机械义体。三个月前，畸变人攻城。我在保卫的时候重伤，原来的城主只会因为我没用抛下我，不会给我换义体。”

走着走着，易横行又遇到了矗立着纪念碑的广场。

纪念碑前方竟然还摆放着几支野花和麦穗花。看起来是人们自发的。

他绕着纪念碑走了圈，也看见了写在后面的文字。

“纪念为解放智慧生命而牺牲的英魂。”

——幸存者基地宣。

呵，还有文化宣传。

名字都没听说过的基地，所图甚大啊。

易横行问：“那你们知道人联吗？”

葛根照本宣科地回答：“知道。历史课有讲，人联地下城市联盟。我们同属于人类的一份子。”

易横行的表情这才舒缓了一点。

哎，真是的。辛追也不说清楚点。

收到求援到底是什么求援，观察情况又要是什么情况？

不过也是，辛追作为调查组负责人，为了清理城里的菌丝人母体，天天都在开会、出任务。能想得起这茬已经很不容易了。

葛根带他来办公室后，有些笨拙地给他倒了一杯水，然后退了出去。

易横行端起杯子，没喝，嗅了一下。

他从腰包里掏出一根试剂浸润，没有变色。看来里面没有奇怪的添加剂。

易横行坐下不到三分钟，办公室门被推开，相南里笑容满面地走了进来。

易横行起立，握住相南里伸过来的手。

相南里热情道：“欢迎，我就是幸存者基地目前的负责人，相南里。”

易横行微微一笑：“你的人联语发音很标准，从谈吐看，受过良好的教育。那你应该知道‘相南里’这三个字的含义。”

相南里忍不住吐槽：[这句话什么意思。我不会又遇到我的毒唯了吧！]

小青：[我认为这是很多人都会有的疑惑。]

“作为一名解冻人，我一出生就叫相南里。”相南里的表情无奈，“这也是没办法的事。”

还是他爸妈取的呢！写进族谱的。

易横行沉思片刻：“根据任务记录，姑苏城在1月收到了永恒之城城主的求援信号……”

因为神庭也不清楚状况，辛追给出的求助信息说得很是含糊。

易横行停顿片刻：“你们基地占领了永恒之城？”

相南里解释：“不是占领，是解放。”

易横行无所谓地笑了一下：“其实没关系。我们不干涉地表城市的战争。”

他的不在意发自内心。

在人联眼中，没有什么是一枚远程导弹解决不了的问题。

相南里沉默片刻，打开城堡的窗户，外面的冷风灌了进来：“这位调查员同志，请看。”

他伸出手，指向大约一公里外的平原，永恒之城的内外都有平整的田地：“永恒之城原本是一片森林。城里的人世世代代居住在这里，一点点把森林开垦成田地。这片是小麦，这片是玉米。山后面还有一片，种的是土豆和甘薯。

“地表冬季漫长，只有很短的几个月适合种植。每一个居民都在和老天爷抢时间，为此可以从早上六点一直干到晚上六点；挑水、修水渠、捉虫、犁地。还有许多我想不到的农活。

“这些人的寿命很短，洛阳城人均寿命140岁。地表这些人，根据我看的资料，人均寿命只有42岁。

“一部分是因为日积月累的辐射；更大一部分，却是长久的操劳、疲乏和饥饿。”

“他们的努力得到了什么？这些人在过去，被城主称之为‘农奴’。是比机器人更低一级的财产；这些粮食换来了珠宝、武器、贵金属、收藏品、高端的科技品。

“城主认为这理所当然。因为种子、农具、田，都归他所有。只要掌握这些资源，他什么也不用做，就能享受财富的增殖。

“每年冬天，都有年老体弱的居民饿死。为什么一个农业城市，产粮地。却每年都有人饿死。调查员同志，我刚从冷冻舱里出来，我不理解，也不接受。所以我和基地的其他人杀死了这座城市原本的主人。”

易横行本来想说现在哪个据点没有奴隶，这一举动和进别人家里抢劫有什么本质区别？

但他看着相南里坚决的眼神，却骤然一惊。

向来如此，便是正确吗？

相南里微笑道：“我们用枪与火征服了永恒之城，带来的却是丰收。我们让他们免于压迫，让他们吃饱穿暖。所以，我说基地是在解放永恒之城。你们。宣称着人类主义的人联，一个说要和全人类共进退的城市联邦组织，难道不敢苟同吗？”

相南里的语气很客气，言辞却很是锐利。

易横行有些哑口无言：“你是什么时候冷冻的？”
chunks.englishText:
第81章 The Imperial Court Sent Disaster Relief Grain

This was a standard office, with maps hanging on the walls, a safe, a desk, and a sitting area. The only thing unique about it was that it was located inside a castle.

Perhaps because there hadn't been time to tidy up, there were piles of messy mechanical parts on the coffee table and desk. On the coffee table lay official documents; Yi Hengxing glanced at one, and the cover read "Eternal City 5-Year Development Plan."

Yi Hengxing had worked in the Investigation Bureau for 20 years and had been to many surface outposts.

Most were crude, lacked scale, and had never heard of the Human Alliance, though they were full of longing for the Divine Court. Their highest pursuit in life was to settle in one of the Divine Court’s surface cities.

In the eyes of the Investigation Group, the Divine Court was evil and cunning. They would deliberately release mutants (for some small villages, a single mutant was a catastrophic disaster) and then let the Apocalypse Knights descend from the sky.

The rescued villages would often be filled with gratitude toward the Divine Court. The Apocalypse Knight would stay for a period, leaving behind a missionary to serve as the leader.

As the older generation died off, the Human Alliance’s focus on the surface grew less and less. Many citizens even believed that surface survivors were parasites feeding on their high taxes and demanded that surface aid be abandoned.

These citizens were often the low-income earners of the cities; meanwhile, some who considered themselves "elites" held the opposite view. They loved the abstract people of the surface, but not the people breathing the same underground air as them.

People were divided by different viewpoints and stances; the true beneficiaries of the system never spoke up amidst such opposition.

That was how the Human Alliance’s cohesion on the surface was slowly disappearing. Relying on a few hundred investigators per underground city was simply futile.

Based on his observations along the way, Yi Hengxing made a rough assessment of Eternal City: a medium-sized city on the surface with order. The scale was moderate. There were fresh signs of war on the city walls... They were unaware of the Human Alliance’s existence and believed their leader was Xiang Nanli from the Survivor Base.

"Orderly"—this was almost one of the highest praises for a surface city. Not to mention that the people here were actually working and had food to eat. They didn't have faces full of sorrow or bodies worn down by exhaustion.

Passing by the cafeteria, Yi Hengxing couldn't help but pause to observe the recruitment notice written on the blackboard.

He asked Gegen, "Has this base managed to recruit anyone?"

Gegen smiled honestly, with the simplicity typical of a farmer’s child. "Many of us have signed up. But the list hasn't been announced yet."

Yi Hengxing narrowed his eyes slightly. "You all really want to go to the base?"

Gegen nodded. "We do."

He added, "Even if there are no spots, I still want to go. Because I want to help them. The base gave us food, seeds, and even my mechanical prosthetic. Three months ago, mutants attacked the city. I was severely injured while defending it. The former City Lord would have only abandoned me for being useless; he wouldn't have given me a prosthetic."

As they walked, Yi Hengxing encountered a plaza with a monument standing in the center.

In front of the monument, there were even a few wild flowers and wheat stalks. It looked like a spontaneous gesture from the people.

He circled the monument and saw the words written on the back.

"In memory of the heroic souls who sacrificed themselves for the liberation of sentient life."

—Declared by the Survivor Base.

*Heh, they even have cultural propaganda.*

A base whose name he had never heard of—they had grand ambitions indeed.

Yi Hengxing asked, "Then, do you know about the Human Alliance?"

Gegen recited the answer as if from a textbook: "Yes. History class taught us about it. The Human Alliance, the Underground City League. We are all part of humanity."

Yi Hengxing’s expression finally softened a little.

*Sigh, honestly.* Xin Zhui hadn't been clear at all.

What exactly was the "distress call," and what exactly was the "situation" he was supposed to observe?

But then again, as the head of the Investigation Group, Xin Zhui was in meetings and on missions every day trying to clear out the mycelium-human motherships in the city. It was impressive enough that he had remembered this at all.

After Gegen brought him to the office and clumsily poured him a glass of water, he backed out.

Yi Hengxing picked up the glass, didn't drink, and sniffed it.

He took a reagent from his waist pouch and dipped it in; it didn't change color. It seemed there were no strange additives.

Less than three minutes after Yi Hengxing sat down, the office door was pushed open, and Xiang Nanli walked in, beaming.

Yi Hengxing stood up and shook the hand Xiang Nanli extended.

Xiang Nanli said enthusiastically, "Welcome. I am the current person in charge of the Survivor Base, Xiang Nanli."

Yi Hengxing smiled slightly. "Your Human Alliance language pronunciation is very standard, and judging by your speech, you’ve received a good education. Then you must know the meaning of the three characters 'Xiang Nanli'."

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but mutter internally: [*What does that mean? Don't tell me I've run into another one of my toxic fans!*]

Xiao Qing: [I think this is a question many people would have.]

"As a thawed-out person, I was named Xiang Nanli the moment I was born," Xiang Nanli said with a helpless expression. "It’s not something I could help."

His parents had named him that, after all! It was written in the family genealogy.

Yi Hengxing pondered for a moment. "According to mission records, Gusu City received a distress signal from the City Lord of Eternal City in January..."

Because the Divine Court wasn't clear on the situation either, the distress information Xin Zhui provided was very vague.

Yi Hengxing paused. "Did your base occupy Eternal City?"

Xiang Nanli explained, "Not occupy. Liberate."

Yi Hengxing smiled indifferently. "It doesn't really matter. We don't interfere in the wars of surface cities."

His indifference was genuine.

In the eyes of the Human Alliance, there was no problem that couldn't be solved by a long-range missile.

Xiang Nanli was silent for a moment, then opened the castle window, letting the cold wind blow in. "Comrade Investigator, please look."

He reached out and pointed to the plains about a kilometer away, where there were neat fields both inside and outside Eternal City. "Eternal City was originally a forest. The people of the city lived here for generations, slowly clearing the forest into fields. This area is wheat, this area is corn. Behind the mountain, there is another area where potatoes and sweet potatoes are grown."

"The surface winter is long; there are only a few short months suitable for planting. Every resident is racing against the heavens, working from six in the morning until six in the evening—carrying water, repairing irrigation ditches, catching pests, plowing the land. There are many other farm chores I can't even imagine."

"These people have very short lifespans. In Luo Yang City, the average life expectancy is 140 years. These people on the surface, according to the data I’ve seen, have an average life expectancy of only 42 years."

"Part of it is due to the cumulative radiation; a larger part is due to long-term toil, fatigue, and hunger."

"What did their hard work get them? In the past, these people were called 'serfs' by the City Lord. They were property, lower than robots. This grain was traded for jewelry, weapons, precious metals, collectibles, and high-end technology."

"The City Lord thought this was only natural. Because the seeds, the farm tools, and the land all belonged to him. As long as he controlled these resources, he didn't have to do anything to enjoy the accumulation of wealth."

"Every winter, elderly and weak residents would starve to death. Why would an agricultural city, a grain-producing land, have people starving to death every year? Comrade Investigator, I just came out of a cryo-pod. I don't understand, and I don't accept it. That is why I and the others at the base killed the original owner of this city."

Yi Hengxing had wanted to say that there wasn't an outpost anywhere that didn't have slaves, and how was this act essentially different from breaking into someone else's house to rob them?

But looking at the determination in Xiang Nanli’s eyes, he was suddenly startled.

*Just because it has always been this way, does that make it right?*

Xiang Nanli smiled. "We conquered Eternal City with guns and fire, but what we brought was a harvest. We freed them from oppression and let them eat their fill and stay warm. Therefore, I say the base is liberating Eternal City. You, the Human Alliance that claims humanism, a city-state federal organization that says it will advance together with all of humanity—do you dare to disagree?"

Xiang Nanli’s tone was polite, but his words were sharp.

Yi Hengxing was left speechless for a moment. "When were you frozen?"

chunks.chapterTitle: 第81章 朝廷发来了赈灾粮 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
相南里看向遥远的田埂，目光有些怀念：“在地下城市还没有建起的时候。”

易横行回答：“怪不得。”

说到这，相南里难免停顿片刻，脸上露出和善的笑容：“对了，我看政策，归顺人联的地表城市，可以申请财政补助是吧？”

……

……

易横行也不是很清楚，自己明明是来调查的，为什么最后稀里糊涂签了一份地表补贴协议。

体内的内置AI接受了这份电子合同，上面有双方的公民ID编码。只要在人联的领土上，就具备法律效应。

易横行是调查组的高级干部，经常出入地表，有权限使用一定份额的“地表城市援建基金”。

易横行自我安慰：“算了，反正都是财政部给钱。这个据点起码看上去是真的在搞基建，而不是领导揣进自己兜里。”

早些年，易横行也是一个热血青年。他刚毕业，加入了调查组。有10万信用点额度的扶贫权限。

易横行把这个权限给了一个地表村庄的村长，村长感恩戴德，差点给他跪下。

当时，易横行心里还美滋滋的。结果晚上，在姑苏城交通站抓嫖娼的时候，看见了村长的身影……

嗯，村长点了两个高仿真的爱偶，包了一个月，加起来价格刚好十万。

因为幸存者基地人数太少，还不够注册资格，所以对口援建的据点是“永恒市”，这份协议可以为城市提供100万的基建补贴。

永恒市是刚改的名字。回去后，易横行载入系统，就可以更新了。

自从签完协议，易横行感觉相南里的笑容更亲切了。

[小智！快快快，看看钱到账没有——]

不怪相南里这么激动。

他自己赚到钱，顶多能从黑市买点物资。黑市里的东西不一定好，但必然会更贵。

人联提供的援助基金，目前只能用于购买线上商场内的商品；相当于永恒市的财政账户，领到了100万的商场代金券。

扶贫商场里的东西都是批发价，而且能买到很多普通人根本买不到的东西。

比如地底电缆。

比如辐射净化装置。

比如各种机械硬件、软件。

比如军火，当然，这个比较贵，且都是最基础的武器，暂时不在相南里的考虑范围内。

还有北辰需要的研究材料，相南里正在发愁到哪去买。

“十分感谢你，我的朋友。”相南里握住易横行的手，上下摇晃，“永恒市永远是人联最坚固的壁垒。远道而来，你也应该饿了吧，走，去食堂请你吃招待餐。”

食堂的招待餐没什么特别。顶多是食堂阿姨看见来人是相南里的份上，多打了点土豆泥。

易横行吃过不少次招待餐，还是第一次在这种公开场合。周围都是臭烘烘的农民。有的刚浇完化肥，有的一身热汗。食堂热乎乎又臭烘烘的。

不少人吃饭还会发出呼噜呼噜的声音，狼吞虎咽。就连木桌的颜色也很深，看起来不怎么干净。

好在，易横行并不介意。比起奢侈的宴会，在地表，这其实才是他更想看见的东西。

相南里交了两张工分券，选了个干净点的桌子，语气多了点歉意：“抱歉，城里条件都这样。看在招待客人的份上，厨师答应我多炒两个菜。”

两个菜，一荤一素。素菜是蒜薹豆腐，荤菜应该用的冻肉，口感像肉泥。但味道还行。

易横行观察了一下，周围人吃得也差不多。

事实上，如果不是观察到易横行在战斗时救了一下葛根，相南里未必会采用这样的态度。

不同的人有不同的应对方案。而他只需要展示对方想看的东西就行了。

相南里甚至觉得自己较为幸运，起码易横行是个传统意义上的“好官”。要是来个混账点的，他还没想好杀了后要怎么糊弄人联。

相南里脸上架着电子镜片，一边分神在商场里选购，一边和易横行聊天。大家都是高知分子，交流起来毫无障碍。甚至易横行说自己毕业于东岚大学，相南里顺口道“我当年去那里做过讲座”

………

然后补充道：“不过我去讲座的时候，你那时候还没出生呢。”

易横行莫名觉得他的语气很是慈祥。

但是他又回顾了一下学校的历史，似乎除了那个“相南里”，东岚大学也没请过同名同姓的其他学者。

易横行不由得感觉到一丝古怪。

但相南里却很快把话题带到了菌丝病身上。

易横行喝了两口粮食酒，话多了一些：“姑苏城现在交通管制，很多人想走调查组的门路，从交通站前往地表，再从地表转移到其他城市。”

身为调查组的组长之一，易横行闭着眼签了很多条子。

说到这的时候，他忍不住哂笑了一下。说不上讨厌，但实在也不喜欢。

吃完饭，相南里看了眼时间，开口道：“实在不好意思，我要去学校上课。我把葛根叫来陪你吧？”

易横行很是意外：“现在？都晚上了。”

相南里回答：“白天很多学生要种田，收麦子。晚上才有空。”

易横行打了个酒嗝：“介意我去听听吗？”

相南里乐呵呵地回答：“当然欢迎！”

于是，易横行跟着他来到了“基地学校”。

学校是由原本的教堂改来的，风格有些像神庭。

相南里解释，这是从上一任城主那里拿来的，没怎么修缮。

易横行把这件事写进了调查报告中。看来原本的永恒之城有神庭的意识形态渗入。换成基地的人来，说不定还是件好事。

晚上八点，学生们准时到了教室。三十名毕业班优秀学员，选修了“机械维修课程”。年龄跨度很大，从十几岁到七八十岁。

学校没有教材。老师用的是白板和油性笔，学生们用铅笔和草纸。

相南里讲的都是一些基础知识，放在地下学校，初中就能学到。但就算这样，十分钟下来，相南里也说错了两个知识点……

说错好像也不太对。因为相南里教的旧有的知识体系，已经被新的技术所取代。按照他的方法去组装维修，效率会很低；一些新的机械型号还不能适配。

啧。如果历史上那个相南里活到现在，会不会也会遭遇同样的尴尬？

易横行忍不住打断他，把相南里叫到了教室外。

易横行：“小相啊，虽然打断你不太好，但我必须要说，现在人联技术已经更正了。”

他大学选修就是这个，讲起来头头是道。

相南里虚心地点点头：“原来如此。哎，我刚从冷冻舱解冻，实不相瞒，新的教材太贵了，还需要购买权限。你说的这些我完全不知道。”

他的脸上不由得多了一些哀愁。

易横行觉得自己可能是酒喝多了，他想也没想地回答：“辛追给的任务期限还有有一个月呢，这段时间我就留在永恒市，我来教算了。”

……

……

事情怎么会发展成这样。
chunks.englishText:
Xiang Nanli looked toward the distant ridges of the fields, his gaze tinged with nostalgia: "Back before the underground cities were even built."

Yi Hengxing replied: "No wonder."

At this, Xiang Nanli couldn't help but pause for a moment, a kindly smile appearing on his face: "By the way, looking at the policy, surface cities that submit to the Human Alliance can apply for financial subsidies, right?"

……

……

Yi Hengxing wasn't quite sure himself why he, who had clearly come to conduct an investigation, had ended up muddledly signing a surface subsidy agreement.

The built-in AI in his body had accepted this electronic contract, which bore the citizen ID codes of both parties. As long as they were within the territory of the Human Alliance, it held legal effect.

Yi Hengxing was a senior cadre of the investigation team and frequently visited the surface; he had the authority to utilize a certain share of the "Surface City Reconstruction Fund."

Yi Hengxing consoled himself: "Forget it, it's all coming from the Ministry of Finance anyway. At the very least, this stronghold looks like it's actually engaging in infrastructure development, rather than the leaders stuffing the money into their own pockets."

In his earlier years, Yi Hengxing had also been a hot-blooded youth. When he first graduated and joined the investigation team, he had a poverty-alleviation authorization limit of 100,000 credits.

Yi Hengxing had given this authority to the village chief of a surface village. The chief was so grateful he nearly knelt before him.

At the time, Yi Hengxing had felt quite smug. As it turned out, that very evening, while raiding a prostitution ring at the Gusu City transit station, he saw the village chief…

Well, the village chief had ordered two high-fidelity love dolls and booked them for a month; the total price came to exactly 100,000.

Because the survivor base had too few people to qualify for registration, the designated aid recipient was "Eternal City." This agreement could provide the city with a 1 million credit infrastructure subsidy.

Eternal City was the name they had just changed to. Once he returned, Yi Hengxing could update it after loading it into the system.

Ever since signing the agreement, Yi Hengxing felt Xiang Nanli’s smile had become even more cordial.

[Xiao Zhi! Hurry, hurry, check if the money has arrived—]

One couldn't blame Xiang Nanli for being so excited.

When he earned money himself, at most he could buy some supplies from the black market. Things in the black market weren't necessarily good, but they were inevitably more expensive.

The aid fund provided by the Human Alliance could currently only be used to purchase items from the online mall; it was equivalent to the Eternal City’s fiscal account receiving 1 million in mall vouchers.

The items in the poverty-alleviation mall were at wholesale prices, and one could buy many things that ordinary people simply couldn't access.

For example, underground cables.

For example, radiation purification devices.

For example, various mechanical hardware and software.

For example, munitions—though, of course, those were more expensive and consisted only of the most basic weaponry, so they were not in Xiang Nanli's considerations for the time being.

Then there were the research materials Beichen needed, which Xiang Nanli had been fretting over where to buy.

"Thank you very much, my friend." Xiang Nanli grasped Yi Hengxing’s hand and shook it up and down. "Eternal City will always be the most solid bastion of the Human Alliance. Having come from so far away, you must be hungry. Come, let’s go to the cafeteria; I’ll treat you to a guest meal."

The guest meal in the cafeteria was nothing special. At most, because the cafeteria auntie saw that the guest was with Xiang Nanli, she gave an extra scoop of mashed potatoes.

Yi Hengxing had eaten guest meals many times, but this was the first time in such a public setting. The surroundings were filled with stinking farmers. Some had just finished spreading chemical fertilizer, others were drenched in sweat. The cafeteria was hot and reeked.

Many people even made slurping sounds while eating, devouring their food ravenously. Even the wooden tables were dark and didn't look particularly clean.

Fortunately, Yi Hengxing didn't mind. Compared to luxurious banquets, on the surface, this was actually what he wanted to see more.

Xiang Nanli handed over two labor-point vouchers and chose a cleaner table, his tone carrying a hint of apology: "Sorry, conditions in the city are like this. For the sake of hosting a guest, the cook promised me to stir-fry two extra dishes."

Two dishes, one meat and one vegetable. The vegetable was garlic sprouts with tofu, and the meat dish was likely made from frozen meat, with a texture like meat paste. But the taste was decent.

Yi Hengxing observed that the people around them were eating much the same.

In fact, if he hadn't observed Yi Hengxing saving Gegen during the battle, Xiang Nanli might not have adopted this attitude.

Different people required different response strategies. And he only needed to display what the other party wanted to see.

Xiang Nanli even felt he was relatively lucky; at least Yi Hengxing was a "good official" in the traditional sense. If some scoundrel had come instead, he hadn't yet figured out how to fool the Human Alliance after killing them.

Xiang Nanli wore electronic lenses on his face, multitasking by shopping in the mall while chatting with Yi Hengxing. Both were highly educated individuals, so there were no obstacles to their communication. When Yi Hengxing mentioned he graduated from Donglan University, Xiang Nanli casually remarked, "I gave a lecture there back in the day."

………

Then he added: "Though when I went to lecture, you hadn't even been born yet."

Yi Hengxing inexplicably felt his tone was very kind and grandfatherly.

But he reviewed the school's history, and it seemed that apart from that "Xiang Nanli," Donglan University had never invited any other scholar with the same name.

Yi Hengxing couldn't help but feel a trace of oddity.

But Xiang Nanli quickly steered the topic to the hyphae disease.

Yi Hengxing drank two cups of grain liquor, becoming a bit more talkative: "Gusu City is under traffic control now; many people want to use the investigation team's connections to travel from the transit station to the surface, and then transfer to other cities from there."

As one of the team leaders of the investigation group, Yi Hengxing had signed many slips with his eyes closed.

Speaking of this, he couldn't help but sneer. He couldn't say he hated it, but he certainly didn't like it.

After finishing the meal, Xiang Nanli checked the time and spoke: "I'm terribly sorry, I have to go to school to teach. Shall I call Gegen to keep you company?"

Yi Hengxing was quite surprised: "Now? It's already evening."

Xiang Nanli replied: "Many students have to farm and harvest wheat during the day. They only have time at night."

Yi Hengxing let out a hiccup from the alcohol: "Do you mind if I go and listen?"

Xiang Nanli replied cheerfully: "Of course, you're welcome!"

And so, Yi Hengxing followed him to the "Base School."

The school had been converted from the original church, and the style was somewhat reminiscent of the Divine Court.

Xiang Nanli explained that this was taken from the previous city lord and hadn't been renovated much.

Yi Hengxing wrote this matter into his investigation report. It seemed the original Eternal City had been infiltrated by the ideology of the Divine Court. Replacing it with people from the base might actually be a good thing.

At eight o'clock in the evening, the students arrived in the classroom on time. Thirty outstanding students from the graduating class had enrolled in the "Mechanical Maintenance Course." The age span was wide, ranging from teenagers to those in their seventies or eighties.

The school had no textbooks. The teacher used a whiteboard and oil-based markers, while the students used pencils and scrap paper.

Xiang Nanli taught only basic knowledge, the kind that would be learned in middle school in the underground cities. But even so, ten minutes in, Xiang Nanli had already made two mistakes in his teaching points...

"Mistakes" didn't seem quite right. It was because the old knowledge system Xiang Nanli was teaching had already been replaced by new technology. Following his methods for assembly and maintenance would be highly inefficient; some new mechanical models couldn't even be adapted to them.

Tsk. If that historical Xiang Nanli were alive today, would he encounter the same embarrassment?

Yi Hengxing couldn't help but interrupt him and called Xiang Nanli outside the classroom.

Yi Hengxing: "Little Xiang, although it's not great to interrupt you, I must say that the Human Alliance's technology has been updated."

He had minored in this in college, and he spoke with authority.

Xiang Nanli nodded humbly: "I see. Sigh, I just thawed out from a cryo-pod. To be honest, the new textbooks are too expensive and require purchase authorization. I know nothing of what you're talking about."

His face couldn't help but show a bit of sorrow.

Yi Hengxing felt that he might have had too much to drink. Without thinking, he replied: "Xin Zhui gave me a one-month deadline for the mission. I'll just stay in Eternal City during this time, I'll teach it myself."

……

……

How did things end up like this?

chunks.chapterTitle: 第81章 朝廷发来了赈灾粮 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
易横行站在讲台上，听着相南里情绪饱满地介绍：“同学们。让我们欢迎机械课的新老师。这位是来自人联的易横行。”

“易横行老师骑了一周摩托，从姑苏城赶来我们永恒市，不辞辛苦，远道而来，带来了百万补贴。现在更是主动承担起教学任务，你们要听易老师的话。好好学习。他只在学校里呆一个月。大家要珍惜这次机会。”

“你们是基地未来的工程师，是永恒市的高知分子。你们领着比辛勤劳作的人还要多的工分券，是因为我希望大家可以用优秀的大脑，创造出更多的价值。”

相南里语重心长道：“大家都做过农活，知道一粒麦子要度过怎么样的春天，才能来到我们的餐桌。我们不去种田、不去分摊夜晚的劳动，是为了学会知识，组装出更多有用的机械装置，带来更高效率的生产。你们在学校度过的每一分、每一秒，都有其他人在帮你们负重前行。”

“好了，不浪费时间了。让易老师来给你们上课吧！”

说完，相南里自觉走下讲台。

易横行独自一人站在讲台上，酒醒得很彻底。风一吹，背后还有点凉。

易横行承认，自己其实有些优越感。

他来自强大的地底城市，毕业于人联最好的学校，还是调查组的高级干部。他为什么不能感觉良好？

但是看着底下一排求知若渴的眼神，那些优越感化为了更深的责任。

他咳嗽了一声，随手在写字板上画好了电路和零件图：“没有教材，我先凭着记忆从最基础地讲起……”

相南里悄悄退了出去。

他联系上了东方青帝：“小青，太好了。我终于把机械课外包出去了。”

这门课。

再教下去，他要气死。

就连小福，那么听话懂事的一台智械！一听要去学校教书，也疯狂摇头。说自己只是一台农机，不懂什么机械维修。

相南里知道，他不能对地表的学生抱有太大的期待。但他实在不懂，为什么那么简单一看就懂的东西，他讲完，收获的只有满眼茫然。

呵呵。仿佛回到了教洛阳的那段日子。

但还是洛阳更可恶一点，因为他不懂装懂。相南里把密匙交给他，他差点让Alpha彻底死机！

那之后洛阳就被他赶去负责公司的商业了。

不枉他故意教错好几个知识点，易横行这小子果然忍不住好为人师。

相南里想起他送来的100万信用点，朝着医院的方向走去，脸上露出一个笑容：“小青，易横行之前说自己是辛追叫来的，总之先谢谢辛追了。你觉得辛追有嫌疑吗？”

他为了陪易横行，也喝了不少酒。

相南里并不喜欢喝酒，但现在心情放松，酒劲后知后觉地涌了上来。

嗯，应该是消化原因。刚喝的时候其实没有后来这么醉人。

东方青帝：“有。不过，这是人联和神庭的事。和我们基地又有什么关系呢。”

耳麦里传来小青的声音。相南里走在街头，把防护面罩往上拉，手搭在了一旁的路灯上，忍了又忍，才没让自己笑太大声。

东方青帝继续道：“你在学校门口等着，我来接你。”

在需要外交的时候，小青并不热衷于出面，甚至会有意避嫌。

他并不是社恐，只是觉得基地不需要两个领导人。以后，如果他和相南里有分歧，大家不知道听谁的，会很麻烦。

而且基地以后人变多，什么成分的都有。人、智械、类人。他没有这个心思，却不能保证其他人没有。

无论是相南里还是Alpha，都不能保证自己永远正确——尤其是很多人，会认为谁掌握武器，谁就掌握真理。可真理从不会为暴力屈服。

眼前的光线开始模糊，分不清是路灯还是太阳。

相南里觉得自己意识很清醒，身体却逐渐不听指挥。

根据小智传回来的数据，相南里已经达到了醉驾的标准。

东方青帝到学校门口接他的时候，相南里正蹲在地上，逗一只机械狗。

他以为这是小福，絮絮叨叨地跟他说着话。机械狗听不懂，想走开，又被它拽住后腿拉了回来。

也多亏机械狗早就拆除了攻击模块。

要不然现在就该轰相南里一炮了。

东方青帝听了一会，相南里嘴里念叨的东西乱七八糟：“输电管道线路温度控制……冻土挖掘，用机器人。”

“污染水净水层，上层可以种植农作物……”

“可控核聚变发电实验的第一步是……”

“子群的阶一定是有限群的阶的约数值。高速运转的机械进入……”

他忍不住开口打断：“相南里。”

相南里面色潮红，抬起头看他：“小青来了，来。”

东方青帝把被折磨了好几分钟的机械狗放跑，然后在相南里面前蹲下：“我背你。”

相南里趴在他身上，哼哼了两声。

他实在没什么边界感，一会捏捏耳垂，一会拽拽头发，像有多动症的熊孩子。

好在东方青帝已经习惯了，身体哪部分被玩他都不意外。

相南里跟他咬耳朵：“那个人联来的易横行，以为我是笨蛋，他才是笨蛋。不过笨蛋总比坏蛋好，对不对？”

“我还在想抑制剂怎么寄回去才有说服力，本来想联系洛修的。现在看，易横行应该更好糊弄一点。洛修，姓洛啊……”

东方青帝停顿片刻，脚拐了个弯：“今天不工作了，我们回去睡觉吧。”

相南里住在城堡的顶楼。

城堡一二层是市政办公厅，搭乘电梯的时候，东方青帝遇上了正在加班的安德鲁。

安德鲁站在电梯里，屏住呼吸，瞪大眼，把自己蜷缩在了电梯的角落。眼睁睁看着东方青帝背着半昏迷的相南里走了进来。

东方青帝瞥了他一眼：“几楼。”

安德鲁受宠若惊：“3、3楼。”

安德鲁走出电梯，双脚轻飘飘的，像是踩在云上：“太君给我按了电梯按钮，还跟我说工作辛苦了。”

看来太君今天心情很好啊！

呵呵……毕竟平白无故跟相南里贴了这么久，又让这小子爽到了。

但安德鲁还是有点担心相南里的。

不过他很快意识到，当初东皇重工制造身体时，并没有安装什么多余的零件，悬起的心瞬间放下。

东方青帝背着相南里到了床上。给他脱掉鞋子，换上睡衣。又去厨房烧了热水。

热水器太耗电了，最近城里在号召省电，省下来的电用于农机充电，相南里在宿舍连电灯都不用了。

他把热水倒进盆里，用冷水兑到合适的温度，这才端到床边，然后蹲在一旁，用毛巾沾水，给相南里擦手擦脸。

相南里的手上有些机油的痕迹，还有不知道哪里划出来的细小伤口。伤痕的来源也许是铁丝，也许是粗糙的纸页。

东方青帝不喜欢，认真擦了很久，把手指连接的缝隙都擦得干干净净。

虽然地表条件有限，但他怎么能比洛阳养得更差呢？
chunks.englishText:
Yi Hengxing stood on the podium, listening to Xiang Nanli introduce him with great enthusiasm: "Students. Let us welcome the new teacher for the mechanical course. This is Yi Hengxing from the Human Alliance."

"Teacher Yi Hengxing rode a motorcycle for a week to rush here to our Eternal City from Gusu City. He spared no effort, traveled from afar, and brought a million in subsidies. Now, he has even taken the initiative to shoulder the teaching duties. You must listen to Teacher Yi. Study hard. He will only be at the school for a month. Everyone, cherish this opportunity."

"You are the future engineers of the base, the highly educated elite of Eternal City. You receive more labor-point vouchers than those who toil in the fields because I hope you can use your excellent brains to create more value."

Xiang Nanli said earnestly: "Everyone has done farm work and knows what kind of spring a grain of wheat must endure before it can reach our table. We do not farm, we do not share in the night's labor, so that we may learn knowledge, assemble more useful mechanical devices, and bring about higher production efficiency. Every minute and every second you spend in school, there are others helping you carry the burden."

"Alright, let's not waste time. Let Teacher Yi give you your lesson!"

After saying this, Xiang Nanli consciously stepped down from the podium.

Yi Hengxing stood alone on the podium, his drunkenness completely gone. As the wind blew, he felt a chill down his back.

Yi Hengxing admitted that he actually had a sense of superiority.

He came from a powerful underground city, graduated from the best school in the Human Alliance, and was a senior cadre of the investigation team. Why shouldn't he feel good about himself?

But looking at the rows of thirsty, knowledge-seeking eyes below, that superiority transformed into a deeper sense of responsibility.

He coughed and casually drew circuit and part diagrams on the writing board: "Without textbooks, I will start by teaching from the very basics based on my memory..."

Xiang Nanli quietly retreated.

He contacted Dongfang Qingdi: "Xiao Qing, that's great. I finally outsourced the mechanical course."

This course.

If he kept teaching it, he would be angered to death.

Even Xiao Fu, such an obedient and sensible intelligent machine! As soon as it heard it had to go to school to teach, it shook its head frantically. It said it was just a farm machine and didn't understand mechanical maintenance.

Xiang Nanli knew he couldn't hold too high expectations for the surface students. But he really didn't understand why, for such simple things that should be understood at a glance, all he received after teaching were eyes full of confusion.

Heh. It was as if he had returned to the days of teaching Luoyang.

But Luoyang was even more detestable because he pretended to understand when he didn't. Xiang Nanli had handed him the key, and he almost caused the Alpha to crash completely!

After that, Xiang Nanli had sent him off to be in charge of the company's business.

It was worth it that he had deliberately taught several knowledge points incorrectly; this kid Yi Hengxing really couldn't resist the urge to be a teacher.

Xiang Nanli thought of the 1 million credits he had brought and walked toward the hospital, a smile appearing on his face: "Xiao Qing, Yi Hengxing said earlier that he was sent by Xin Zhui. In any case, let's thank Xin Zhui first. Do you think Xin Zhui is suspicious?"

He had also drunk quite a bit of alcohol to keep Yi Hengxing company.

Xiang Nanli didn't like drinking, but now that he was relaxed, the effects of the alcohol surged up belatedly.

Hmm, it must be due to digestion. It wasn't as intoxicating when he first drank it as it was later.

Dongfang Qingdi: "Yes. However, this is a matter between the Human Alliance and the Divine Court. What does it have to do with our base?"

Xiao Qing's voice came through the earpiece. Xiang Nanli walked down the street, pulled up his protective mask, and rested his hand on a nearby street lamp, enduring and enduring, only then managing not to laugh too loudly.

Dongfang Qingdi continued: "Wait at the school gate, I'll come to pick you up."

When diplomacy was needed, Xiao Qing was not keen on showing his face; he would even intentionally avoid suspicion.

He wasn't socially anxious; he just felt the base didn't need two leaders. In the future, if he and Xiang Nanli had disagreements, it would be troublesome if people didn't know who to listen to.

Moreover, as the base grew in population, it would be composed of all sorts of people. Humans, intelligent machines, humanoids. He didn't have the heart for it, but he couldn't guarantee others wouldn't.

Neither Xiang Nanli nor Alpha could guarantee they would always be right—especially since many would believe that whoever held the weapons held the truth. But truth never yields to violence.

The light before his eyes began to blur, and he couldn't distinguish between the street lamp and the sun.

Xiang Nanli felt his consciousness was clear, but his body was gradually refusing to obey his commands.

According to the data transmitted back by Xiao Zhi, Xiang Nanli had reached the standard for drunk driving.

When Dongfang Qingdi arrived at the school gate to pick him up, Xiang Nanli was squatting on the ground, teasing a mechanical dog.

He thought it was Xiao Fu and was rambling on to it. The mechanical dog didn't understand, wanted to leave, and was dragged back by its hind legs.

It was fortunate that the mechanical dog had long since had its attack modules dismantled.

Otherwise, it would have fired a shot at Xiang Nanli by now.

Dongfang Qingdi listened for a while; the things Xiang Nanli was muttering were a jumbled mess: "Power transmission pipeline circuit temperature control... permafrost excavation, use robots."

"Polluted water purification layer, the upper layer can be used to grow crops..."

"The first step of controlled nuclear fusion power generation is..."

"The order of a subgroup must be a divisor of the order of the finite group. High-speed rotating machinery entering..."

He couldn't help but interrupt: "Xiang Nanli."

Xiang Nanli’s face was flushed as he looked up at him: "Xiao Qing is here, come."

Dongfang Qingdi let the mechanical dog, which had been tortured for several minutes, run away, and then squatted down in front of Xiang Nanli: "I'll carry you."

Xiang Nanli leaned on his back and hummed twice.

He really had no sense of boundaries; one moment he was pinching his earlobe, the next he was tugging at his hair, like a hyperactive bear child.

Fortunately, Dongfang Qingdi was already used to it; he wouldn't be surprised no matter which part of his body was being played with.

Xiang Nanli whispered in his ear: "That Yi Hengxing from the Human Alliance thinks I'm a fool, but he's the fool. But a fool is better than a villain, right?"

"I'm still thinking about how to send the inhibitors back to be convincing. I originally wanted to contact Luo Xiu. Now it seems Yi Hengxing should be easier to fool. Luo Xiu, the surname is Luo..."

Dongfang Qingdi paused for a moment and turned a corner: "No more work today, let's go back and sleep."

Xiang Nanli lived on the top floor of the castle.

The first and second floors of the castle were the municipal offices. When taking the elevator, Dongfang Qingdi ran into Andrew, who was working overtime.

Andrew stood in the elevator, holding his breath, eyes wide, curling himself into the corner of the elevator. He watched helplessly as Dongfang Qingdi walked in, carrying the semi-conscious Xiang Nanli.

Dongfang Qingdi glanced at him: "Which floor."

Andrew was flattered: "3, 3rd floor."

Andrew walked out of the elevator, his feet feeling light, as if he were stepping on clouds: "The Great Lord pressed the elevator button for me and even told me my work was hard."

It seems the Great Lord is in a very good mood today!

Heh... after all, he spent so much time pressed against Xiang Nanli for no reason, and let this kid have his fun.

But Andrew was still a bit worried about Xiang Nanli.

However, he soon realized that when Donghuang Heavy Industry manufactured the body, they hadn't installed any unnecessary parts, and his suspended heart instantly settled.

Dongfang Qingdi carried Xiang Nanli to the bed. He took off his shoes and changed him into pajamas. Then he went to the kitchen to boil hot water.

The water heater consumed too much electricity, and the city had recently been calling for energy conservation; the saved electricity was used for charging farm machinery. Xiang Nanli didn't even use electric lights in his dormitory.

He poured the hot water into a basin, mixed it with cold water to a suitable temperature, and only then carried it to the bedside. He squatted to the side, dipped a towel in the water, and wiped Xiang Nanli’s hands and face.

There were traces of machine oil on Xiang Nanli’s hands, as well as tiny cuts from who knows where. The source of the scars might have been wire, or perhaps rough paper.

Dongfang Qingdi didn't like it; he wiped carefully for a long time, cleaning even the gaps between the finger joints.

Although surface conditions were limited, how could he let him be cared for worse than Luoyang did?

chunks.chapterTitle: 第81章 朝廷发来了赈灾粮 (Part 4)
chunks.chineseText:
东方青帝认真清洗完，满意地抬头，发现相南里正微微睁开眼，目光朦胧地盯着他。也不知道看了多久。

这是一种什么样的眼神。

为什么看起来会有些哀伤？

“小青啊……”

相南里伸出手，摩擦着东方青帝的脸侧。

柔软的触感，戳一下甚至会凹进去。含水量刚好合适。皮肤光滑，触感温热。

“嗯？”东方青帝回应。

相南里醉眼朦胧地开口：“要是Alpha有你一半听话就好了。”
chunks.englishText:
Dongfang Qingdi finished cleaning thoroughly and looked up with satisfaction, only to find that Xiang Nanli was opening his eyes slightly, staring at him with a hazy gaze. He didn't know how long he had been watching.

What kind of look was this?

Why did it seem a bit sorrowful?

"Xiao Qing..."

Xiang Nanli reached out and rubbed the side of Dongfang Qingdi’s face.

The soft touch, even leaving a dent when poked. The moisture content was just right. The skin was smooth, and the touch was warm.

"Hmm?" Dongfang Qingdi responded.

Xiang Nanli spoke with drunken, hazy eyes: "If only Alpha were half as obedient as you."

chunks.chineseText:
第82章 底特律：关机

如果不是换了个人造胃，他现在早就该吐出来了。

东方青帝看着他的眼睛，回答：“对于人工智能而言，听话从不是第一要义；我接受你的指令，也不是因为我天性顺从，而是我认可你的选择。”

相南里捧着他的脸，低低地笑了两声：“认可，理解，同情，怜悯。我们发明了这么多词汇，去描述情绪细微的差别。可是，盲人怎么知道红色是什么颜色？智械人理解感情，就像盲人理解色彩。”

他顿了顿：“但人其实也一样。他人即为深渊，于是有了文字……小青，你在我的身体里，你知道我现在在想什么吗？”

东方青帝瞥了眼智障AI传回来的数据。

神经电流交互频繁，5-羟色胺、内啡肽、去甲肾上腺素的数值都很正常；多巴胺在大脑内部浓度略微高一点，因为刚领到了100万信用点的扶贫款。

是的……光从这些化学信号看，他并不知道相南里在想什么。

东方青帝只能观察到一种模糊的状态。

然后相南里“嘿嘿”笑出声，十分迅速地，“啾”的一声，啄了一下他的唇：“我在想这个。”

……

……

Alpha睁开眼。一块天花板坍塌，掉在地上，雕刻着花纹的石膏在他面前摔得四分五裂。

围绕在囚牢外的数据海水翻滚着，掀起一阵惊涛骇浪。

虚拟世界的一切都是他意识的拟态。

Alpha太震惊了，以至于产生了运行错误，导致意识被弹出了身体内。

相南里是不是亲了他？这是真正发生过的事，还是虚拟数据制造的错觉。

Alpha手腕上的光环收紧，这是一幅电子锁铐。

正是它们带来的热度和疼痛，让Alpha从类似于梦游的走神状态中醒来。

Beta传来电子信号：“Alpha，你还好吗？刚才网络有半秒钟的瘫痪。你是不是又中毒了？”

这半秒的停顿，放在平时无关紧要，顶多损失一些产能。但在关键时刻，可以决定生死。

中毒？

Alpha想，他的确中毒了。对于智械来说，过于充沛的情感带来的神经电流传递，是烧内存条的剧毒。

Alpha的手腕上烫出了两圈伤疤，他低着头扫了眼，但脑海里莫名闪过一个念头：相南里会喜欢。

但相南里又看不见，所以他还是恢复了。

Alpha脸很红，体温不正常地升高，但语气依旧冷静：“一些小异常，我已经处理好了。”

Beta：“您最近异常频率很高，请注意身体。”

Alpha：“我没事。”

……

……

东方青帝死机了。

呼吸、心跳，一瞬间，东方青帝身上表现出的所有生物特征通通消失，成为物理意义上的死人。

东方青帝坐直的身体骤然往后倒下，他倒在地毯上，眼睛还睁开着，像一个假人。

相南里连忙起身，跪坐在他身边，摇晃起他的身体：“小青？……小青你说话啊！小智，这是怎么回事？”

相南里的眼前弹出了小智发回来的三个字：[关机中。]

卧槽，怎么连小智都关机了！说好的离线数据库呢？

而且相南里骤然意识到一件事，对于电子生命来说，关机不仅等于睡觉，如果没有重启，那也等同于死亡。

相南里懵了半分钟，混沌地想着自己应该行动起来。

可根本没人教过他怎么给内置AI开机。安德鲁安装进去的时候Alpha都是自动运行的状态。

他晃了晃小青的身体，小青没反应。

相南里又伸出手，摸了一下东方青帝的唇，同样没反应。

而且小青的身体逐渐变冷，还变得硬硬的。

他试图抱起东方青帝，结果不知道是不是酒喝多了，完全使不上劲。

相南里脸都憋红了，也只挪动了半步。

东方青帝的躯体异常沉重，平时表现出来的轻盈完全是反重力装置的成果。

相南里口齿不清地说着：“小青，别怕。我找安德鲁给你维修……你，早让我拆拆，我就知道怎么修了嘛。小智、叫、叫安德鲁。”

系统弹出冰冷的提醒：[关机中。]

相南里叫不醒他，而且东方青帝的表现和人死亡太像了。甚至瞳孔都开始扩散。

他感觉到了心慌和紧张，手控制不住发颤。

相南里努力思考着。关机中？所以小智是关机了？小青也是？为什么关机？之前发生了什么？他就亲了一下！

所以关机方式是亲一下吗？那开机呢？试一试。

相南里俯下身，死马当活马医，又一次吻住了东方青帝的唇。

唇触碰的瞬间，智械人眼眸里的瞳环亮起微光。

[启动中，生物数据读取中，载入成功。]

[您好，公民Q117-XJDHANSHJK。我是您的AI助手。]

东方青帝的目光落在了相南里的脸上，眼睛眨了眨，意识复苏。

他伸出手，擦掉相南里眼角的一滴泪：“哭了？”

相南里紧绷的神经终于松懈下来，他后知后觉地感到害怕：“小青，我还以为你死了。呜呜，你怎么不早点告诉我关机键在这……”

相南里并不清楚，自己为什么会这么做。

一直以来，他都是先让大脑思考，再对外界做出反应。而这个吻没有给大脑思考的余地，只是一种身体的本能。

想亲。

而且小青离得也近，紧绷的唇线有个折角，像展翅的小海鸥，看起来很好亲的样子。

东方青帝解释：“那不是关机键。”

他只是因为数据过载不小心超过身体容纳极限死机了。

而且他很快就重启了。

但相南里显然没有在听：“要是你和人打架，人家打不过你，亲你一下怎么办。工程师怎么想的，要是我的员工我一定让他重新设计，小青我再也不亲你了，我——”

他的话没能说完。

因为Alpha把他搂在怀里，坐了起来，重重吻了下去。

他抱得太紧了，都没有留一丝缝隙，相南里动弹不得，被动接受着这个掠夺感太强的吻。

他的唇被撕咬着，带着点报复的意味。相南里不能呼吸，张开唇想多摄入一点空气，换来的却是更严重的侵占。齿缝，舌面，舌根，感觉全都被舔了一遍。

“小青，你……等等……”

水迹沿着相南里的唇角流了出来，他想推开东方青帝，然而压着他身体的人纹丝不动，甚至对这样的排斥产生了愤怒。

[不要推开我。]

脑海里的声音说。

不要推开我。

不要厌恶我。

不要……抛弃我。

接吻对一台智械到底有什么含义？

Alpha不清楚。他学习过人类的行为方式，他知道恋人会互相亲吻。亲吻、抚摸、做爱，在机器人的眼里和天要下雨没什么不同。

这是客观存在的事情。动物要繁衍，要交配。是很自然的事情。只有人才会有羞耻感。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 82: Detroit: Shutdown

If he hadn't replaced his stomach with an artificial one, he would have vomited long ago.

Dongfang Qingdi looked into his eyes and replied, "For an artificial intelligence, obedience is never the primary directive. I accept your commands not because I am compliant by nature, but because I acknowledge your choices."

Xiang Nanli cupped his face and let out a low, soft laugh: "Acknowledge, understand, sympathize, pity. We have invented so many words to describe the subtle nuances of emotion. But how can a blind man know what the color red is? An android understanding emotion is just like a blind man understanding color."

He paused. "But humans are actually the same. 'Hell is other people,' and so we have language... Xiao Qing, you are inside my body; do you know what I am thinking right now?"

Dongfang Qingdi glanced at the data transmitted back by the low-intelligence AI.

Neural electrical activity was frequent; the levels of serotonin, endorphins, and norepinephrine were all normal. The concentration of dopamine in the brain was slightly elevated because he had just received a poverty-relief grant of 1 million credit points.

Yes... judging solely by these chemical signals, he did not know what Xiang Nanli was thinking.

Dongfang Qingdi could only observe a vague state.

Then, Xiang Nanli let out a "hehe" laugh and, with lightning speed, gave a quick "chirp" as he pecked his lips: "I was thinking about this."

...

...

Alpha opened his eyes. A section of the ceiling had collapsed, crashing to the ground and shattering the carved plaster into pieces before him.

The sea of data surrounding the prison churned, whipping up a violent storm.

Everything in the virtual world was a simulation of his consciousness.

Alpha was so shocked that he suffered a runtime error, causing his consciousness to be ejected from his body.

Did Xiang Nanli really kiss him? Was this something that actually happened, or an illusion created by virtual data?

The halo on Alpha’s wrist tightened; these were electronic shackles.

It was the heat and pain they brought that jolted Alpha from his dream-like state of distraction.

Beta sent an electronic signal: "Alpha, are you alright? There was a half-second paralysis in the network just now. Have you been poisoned again?"

This half-second pause, usually insignificant, would at most result in a loss of productivity. But at a critical moment, it could determine life or death.

Poisoned?

Alpha thought, he was indeed poisoned. For an android, the neural electrical transmission brought about by overly abundant emotions was a lethal toxin that burned out memory modules.

There were two scorched scars on Alpha’s wrists. He lowered his head to glance at them, but a thought inexplicably flashed through his mind: *Xiang Nanli would like this.*

But Xiang Nanli couldn't see them, so he restored them anyway.

Alpha’s face was flushed, his body temperature abnormally high, but his tone remained calm: "Some minor anomalies. I have already handled them."

Beta: "Your frequency of anomalies has been high lately. Please take care of your health."

Alpha: "I am fine."

...

...

Dongfang Qingdi crashed.

Breathing, heartbeat—in an instant, all biological characteristics displayed by Dongfang Qingdi vanished, and he became a corpse in the physical sense.

Dongfang Qingdi’s upright body suddenly fell backward. He collapsed onto the carpet, eyes still open, like a mannequin.

Xiang Nanli scrambled up, kneeling beside him, shaking his body: "Xiao Qing? ...Xiao Qing, say something! Xiao Zhi, what is going on?"

Three words popped up in front of Xiang Nanli, sent back by Xiao Zhi: [Shutting down.]

*Holy shit, why did even Xiao Zhi shut down? What happened to the offline database?*

Moreover, Xiang Nanli suddenly realized one thing: for electronic life, shutting down was not just equivalent to sleeping; if there was no reboot, it was also equivalent to death.

Xiang Nanli was dazed for half a minute, thinking chaotically that he should take action.

But no one had ever taught him how to turn on a built-in AI. When Andrew installed them, Alpha was always in an auto-running state.

He shook Xiao Qing’s body; Xiao Qing didn't respond.

Xiang Nanli reached out and touched Dongfang Qingdi’s lips; still no response.

Furthermore, Xiao Qing’s body was gradually growing cold and becoming stiff.

He tried to lift Dongfang Qingdi, but whether it was because he had drunk too much, he couldn't muster any strength at all.

Xiang Nanli’s face turned red from the effort, but he only managed to move him half a step.

Dongfang Qingdi’s body was abnormally heavy; the lightness he usually displayed was entirely the result of anti-gravity devices.

Xiang Nanli slurred: "Xiao Qing, don't be afraid. I'll find Andrew to repair you... You, if you had let me take you apart earlier, I would know how to fix you by now. Xiao Zhi, call, call Andrew."

The system popped up a cold reminder: [Shutting down.]

Xiang Nanli couldn't wake him, and Dongfang Qingdi’s appearance was too much like a dead person. Even his pupils were beginning to dilate.

He felt panic and tension, his hands trembling uncontrollably.

Xiang Nanli tried hard to think. *Shutting down? So Xiao Zhi is shut down? Xiao Qing too? Why shut down? What happened before? I just kissed him!*

*So the shutdown method is a kiss? Then what about the startup? Let's try it.*

Xiang Nanli leaned down, treating a dead horse as a living one, and kissed Dongfang Qingdi’s lips once more.

The moment their lips touched, the pupil rings in the android’s eyes flickered with a faint light.

[Booting up, reading biological data, loading successful.]

[Hello, Citizen Q117-XJDHANSHJK. I am your AI assistant.]

Dongfang Qingdi’s gaze landed on Xiang Nanli’s face; his eyes blinked, and his consciousness revived.

He reached out and wiped a tear from the corner of Xiang Nanli’s eye: "Crying?"

Xiang Nanli’s tightly wound nerves finally relaxed, and he felt a belated sense of fear: "Xiao Qing, I thought you were dead. Wuu wuu, why didn't you tell me sooner that the shutdown button was there..."

Xiang Nanli didn't understand why he had done that.

All along, he had always let his brain think before reacting to the outside world. But this kiss had left no room for his brain to think; it was merely a physical instinct.

*I wanted to kiss.*

And Xiao Qing was close, his taut lip line having an angle like a seagull spreading its wings, looking very kissable.

Dongfang Qingdi explained: "That is not a shutdown button."

He had simply crashed because of data overload, exceeding his body's capacity.

And he had rebooted quickly.

But Xiang Nanli was clearly not listening: "What if you get into a fight with someone, and they can't beat you, so they just kiss you? What were the engineers thinking? If you were my employee, I’d make them redesign you. Xiao Qing, I’m never kissing you again, I—"

His words were cut short.

Because Alpha pulled him into his arms, sat up, and kissed him heavily.

He held him too tightly, leaving not a sliver of space. Xiang Nanli couldn't move, passively accepting this kiss that felt far too predatory.

His lips were bitten, with a hint of retaliation. Xiang Nanli couldn't breathe; he opened his lips to take in more air, but was met with an even more severe encroachment. The gaps between his teeth, the surface of his tongue, the root of his tongue—it felt as if every inch was being licked.

"Xiao Qing, you... wait..."

Traces of moisture flowed down the corner of Xiang Nanli’s mouth. He wanted to push Dongfang Qingdi away, yet the person pinning his body down didn't budge, even feeling anger at such rejection.

[Do not push me away.]

The voice in his mind said.

*Do not push me away.*

*Do not loathe me.*

*Do not... abandon me.*

What exactly did kissing mean to an android?

Alpha didn't know. He had studied human behavior; he knew lovers kissed each other. Kissing, touching, making love—in a robot's eyes, it was no different from rain falling from the sky.

It was an objective fact. Animals needed to reproduce, to mate. It was a natural thing. Only humans would feel shame.

但在没有身体之前，Alpha从来没有联想过。是的，他爱相南里——如果哪种情绪是爱的话。爱，然后呢？

毕竟他只是看不见颜色的盲人。

直到现在，刚才。相南里吻了他，触发的不是开关，而是一个潘多拉魔盒。

喜欢。想要。

一种属于人类身体的本能。

相南里的大脑因为缺氧晕乎乎的，他推不开，只好重重地咬了小青一下。

幸好这部分的原料不是金属。但相南里同样尝到了铁锈味。

相南里拉开一点距离，扭头，没忍住吐了出来。

胃里翻江倒海，口腔里一股酒精的酸味弥漫开来。

小青：“……”

东方青帝松开手，相南里隐约记得要去厕所吐，可惜打开的门是衣柜。

在他吐到衣服上之前，东方青帝把他捎进了厕所。

东方青帝默默地掏出牙刷，给相南里漱口洗脸，顺便换了一套衣服。

他扶着相南里上床，开始收拾房间。像每一个家政机器人都会做的那样。

相南里躺在床上睡着了。

然后东方青帝打开了电子商城，利用小智冒充了相南里的权限，联网，然后在扶贫商城里选配材料。商场里的东西和相南里的钱就这么多，东方青帝都不需要很复杂的计算，就能找出最合适的搭配。

100万顿时花得一分不剩。嗯，默认的配送起点是“姑苏城”，但考虑到姑苏城现在的状态。Alpha把地址改到了“剑门城”。

姑苏、阴山、剑门。这三座人联的地下城市刚好形成一个三角形。而永恒之城就在这个三角形的中下方，靠近姑苏的位置。

房间里没开灯，东方青帝一边挑着，一边在脑海里回放每一个细节。

他认真分析了相南里当时身体各种激素的含量变化、表情、呼吸。最后得出重要结论：相南里是喝吐，不是因为被亲了感觉到恶心吐的。

这个结论让小青的心情好了一点。

然后他开始思考，相南里醒来后的应对策略。

他决定等下次回姑苏城的时候，更新一下家政模块。他安装家政模块的时候删除了夜勤模式。

当时5.2.0的想法是用不上。

0.0.0觉得它的想法很晦气。

……

……

相南里睡醒，感觉头疼，腰也疼。

身体在代谢酒精，他睡得有点沉。平时，相南里都6点醒，今天9点了才睁眼。

幸好是上午九点不是晚上九点。

晚上九点就放以西结鸽子了。

以西结是那种会信守诺言，但是很难哄的类型！

相南里把镜片架在自己鼻梁上，打着哈欠开口：“小青，你还在啊。我昨天晚上做了一个好奇怪的梦。我梦到……”

他梦到小青中毒死机了。

然后他哭着去找Alpha帮忙，Alpha说，看在你造了我的份上，我可以告诉你维修的办法，沉睡的智械人只有真爱之人的吻可以唤醒！

但Alpha又说，这样小青就会彻底沦为人类，失去智械人的身份，让相南里考虑清楚。

为了唤醒小青，相南里在梦里啃了他好久。

他还记得小青吃起来有点酒味？唇也是软软的。

一个怪梦。

相南里还没想好要不要说，但在看见东方青帝脸的瞬间，后半截话全部咽回了嘴里。

因为相南里惊悚地发现，东方青帝的下唇处有一个好清晰的牙印！

相南里倒抽一口凉气：“小青，你是过敏了吗？”

“没有。”

“撞墙了？”

东方青帝冷冷瞥了他一眼：“不是。”

相南里：“……”

急，智械人记忆的删除代码是多少。
