Chapter 82: Detroit: Shutdown (Part 2)

But before he had a body, Alpha had never made the connection. Yes, he loved Xiang Nanli—if that emotion was indeed love. Love, and then what?

After all, he was just a blind man who couldn't see color.

Until now, just a moment ago. Xiang Nanli had kissed him, and what it triggered wasn't a switch, but a Pandora’s box.

*Like. Want.*

An instinct belonging to a human body.

Xiang Nanli’s brain was dizzy from lack of oxygen. He couldn't push him away, so he had no choice but to bite Xiao Qing hard.

Fortunately, the material for this part wasn't metal. But Xiang Nanli still tasted the flavor of rust.

Xiang Nanli pulled back a little, turned his head, and couldn't help but vomit.

His stomach was churning, and the sour smell of alcohol permeated his mouth.

Xiao Qing: "..."

Dongfang Qingdi let go. Xiang Nanli vaguely remembered wanting to go to the bathroom to vomit, but unfortunately, the door he opened was the closet.

Before he could vomit on his clothes, Dongfang Qingdi carried him into the bathroom.

Dongfang Qingdi silently took out a toothbrush, helped Xiang Nanli rinse his mouth and wash his face, and incidentally changed his clothes.

He helped Xiang Nanli into bed and began to tidy up the room, just as every housekeeping robot would do.

Xiang Nanli fell asleep on the bed.

Then, Dongfang Qingdi opened the electronic mall, used Xiao Zhi to impersonate Xiang Nanli’s permissions, connected to the network, and selected materials in the poverty-relief mall. The items in the mall and Xiang Nanli’s money were limited; Dongfang Qingdi didn't even need complex calculations to find the most suitable combination.

The 1 million was spent in an instant. Hmm, the default delivery starting point was "Gusu City," but considering the current state of Gusu City, Alpha changed the address to "Jianmen City."

Gusu, Yinshan, and Jianmen. These three underground cities of the Human Alliance formed a triangle. And the Eternal City was located just below the center of this triangle, closer to Gusu.

The room was dark. As Dongfang Qingdi picked out items, he replayed every detail in his mind.

He carefully analyzed the changes in the content of various hormones in Xiang Nanli’s body at the time, his expressions, and his breathing. Finally, he reached an important conclusion: Xiang Nanli vomited because he was drunk, not because he felt disgusted by being kissed.

This conclusion made Xiao Qing’s mood improve slightly.

Then he began to think about the response strategy for when Xiang Nanli woke up.

He decided that the next time he returned to Gusu City, he would update his housekeeping module. When he installed the housekeeping module, he had deleted the night-shift mode.

At the time, 5.2.0 thought it wouldn't be needed.

0.0.0 felt its thinking was very ominous.

...

...

Xiang Nanli woke up feeling a headache and a sore waist.

His body was metabolizing alcohol, and he had slept quite soundly. Usually, Xiang Nanli woke up at 6:00, but today he didn't open his eyes until 9:00.

Fortunately, it was 9:00 AM and not 9:00 PM.

At 9:00 PM, he would have stood Ezekiel up.

Ezekiel was the type who kept his promises but was very hard to coax!

Xiang Nanli placed his lenses on the bridge of his nose and yawned: "Xiao Qing, you're still here. I had such a strange dream last night. I dreamed that..."

He dreamed that Xiao Qing was poisoned and crashed.

Then he cried and went to find Alpha for help. Alpha said, "In exchange for you building me, I can tell you the repair method. A sleeping android can only be awakened by the kiss of their true love!"

But Alpha also said that if he did, Xiao Qing would completely become human, losing his status as an android, and told Xiang Nanli to consider it carefully.

To wake Xiao Qing up, Xiang Nanli gnawed on him for a long time in his dream.

He even remembered that Xiao Qing tasted a bit like alcohol? His lips were soft, too.

A weird dream.

Xiang Nanli hadn't decided whether to tell him, but the moment he saw Dongfang Qingdi’s face, the second half of his words were swallowed back into his throat.

Because Xiang Nanli discovered, to his horror, that there was a very clear tooth mark on Dongfang Qingdi’s lower lip!

Xiang Nanli gasped: "Xiao Qing, are you having an allergic reaction?"

"No."

"Did you bump into a wall?"

Dongfang Qingdi glanced at him coldly: "No."

Xiang Nanli: "..."

*Urgent: What is the code to delete an android's memory?*

第83章 一头羊怎么还可以宰两次

他坐在床上，无意识的捏紧了被子，有点懵，还有点心虚。

相南里：“嗯，小青啊，碳基猴子就是会被酒精扰乱神经的……”

相南里喝多了，隐约记得一点。但具体是怎么发生的，中间又经历了什么流程，却完全没有记忆。

也不知道根据智械军团的法律，猥亵金属判几年。

东方青帝打量着他这幅不想负责的表情，从鼻腔里挤出来一声不知道是嘲讽还是幽怨的冷笑：“起床吃饭了。”

说完，他转身离开。

相南里盯着他的背影，发了一会呆。

他本来想问问小智“不小心亲了自己好兄弟”怎么办，但是转念一想，小智就是小青mini版，这和直接问小青有什么区别！

于是，相南里果然如同东方青帝预料的那样，选择了无事发生。

他换好衣服走出房门，发现小青居然没有像往日一样等着他，心里不由得一阵失落。

“小青怎么这么记仇。”相南里故意念得很大声，“我最讨厌小气的机器人了！”

[……]

[我在医务室。]

好吧，原来是去上班了。

相南里决定原谅他。

账户里的一百万信用点消费券归零了。

相南里打开后台看了眼，开支主要集中在北辰的实验室材料和基建耗材上。

100万信用点，两三次机械化改造，四五款中高档专门为高级打工仔推出的机械义体；五六平洛阳城的房子；能让一个人在地底相对宽绰的生活七八年，但用于一座城市的基建，实在有些杯水车薪。

相南里在食堂吃着饭，一边思索着，一边盯着同样正在吃糠咽菜的易横行，眼神里充满沉思。

易横行莫名其妙感觉到一阵恶寒，抬头时，相南里已经笑容满面地坐在了他身边。

“易老师。”相南里没有带镜片，一双碧绿的眼眸看起来格外温柔，“昨天晚上住的宿舍，还习惯吗？永恒市的条件不太好，但你是我们最尊贵的客人，有什么需求请尽管提。我会尽可能的满足你。”

易横行心想，条件确实够差的，大半夜宿舍连个电都没有，想看清路还要点蜡烛。信号也不好，完全连不上网。

他并不知道，为了防止外来者发现异常，永恒之城内部装了很强的信号屏蔽装置。小青也是趁着易横行睡着后，偷偷关了设备联的网。

易横行微笑着回答：“没事，地表的条件我一直很清楚。对了，我看课表，白天似乎没课？那我……”

易横行想自己转转。

他想起了之前看到的巨大型畸变人，这可不是一个好征兆。或许该向上级申请一下调令，畸变人离姑苏城也不算远。

相南里在此时微笑着打断了他：“易老师，您一定很好奇，为什么昨天那头畸变人会听我指挥吧？”

易横行一愣，随后有些不好意思地点头：“是有些。”

他是想偷偷调查的，但是没想到相南里居然直接把话说开了。

君子端方，这让易横行觉得自己有些过于小人。

“请跟我来。”

相南里来到车库，坐进了老头乐的驾驶舱。他把防护服递给了易横行：“穿上这个吧。”

易横行本来想说自己经过基因强化，身上也配备有辐射吸收器。但转念一想，防护这种事自然是越多越好，于是顺从地套好了防护服。

最近在修路，去牧场的路平整了不少。相南里开了一小时车，抵达了记忆中1号牧场的位置。

牧场位于一片山谷，像一个凹下去的盆地。它们在铁栅栏里无所事事地漫游着，撞上电线，会自己撤离。

易横行看着这些长满菌丝的血红色畜生，瞳孔剧烈收紧：“这是？！”

相南里没有带着易横行靠近，而是开口：“我收听过广播，这个就是姑苏城最近爆发的菌丝病吧。”

相南里沉重地叹息了一声：“我们在河谷地带处理瘟牛，本来是想自然腐烂后埋进土里。但我们算好时间过来埋的时候，却发现这群牛的尸体被黑丝粉菌寄生了……”

“我们很害怕，试图放火烧死这批牛，但黑丝粉菌活性极高，还有感染性，只要营养充足，第二天就能长出一大片。”

相南里指着那片牧场：“就在这时，永恒市的市长安德鲁意外发现，附近游荡的畸变人居然会吃这种真菌生物。我们为了防止畸变体吃人，只好拿菌牛去喂畸变人，畸变人吃饱后就不会攻击人类。渐渐的，附近的畸变人越来越多。就像是狼群一样，在市区附近的森林中聚集。”

“它们中的首领很聪明，每隔一段时间，就会率领其他畸变人来牧场吃掉这些菌牛。从某种程度讲，永恒市也算是在喂养它们。首领偶尔会听从我们的建议，当然，全看它心情……这就是我能让畸变人放弃攻击你的原因。”

易横行的关注点却在另一件事上：“你是说，它们能吃菌丝？”

菌丝病在姑苏城疯狂蔓延，隔离区都建设了好多个。然而病情依旧难以控制。越来越多的人真菌化。

尽管进行过基因改造的人还没有开始出现感染症状，然而，无论在哪一种社会里，普通人的数量都是最多的。

易横行接受过任务，在疫情七进七出，清理过大量感染体。也在难眠的夜晚为姑苏城的病况辗转反侧。

他有些激动：“如果放一些畸变人进地下城市……”

不，不对。

易横行骤然警惕过来，眯起的眼眸里闪过一丝精光。

在他的认知里，畸变人和菌丝病一样，也是神庭的造物！

如果放畸变人进城才是神庭的真实目的，那他不就引狼入室了吗？

事实上——

如果不是相南里意外攻占了永恒之城，俘获了圣灵，这确实是神庭原本的计划。

只不过他们想放进去的不是畸变人，谁都知道畸变人很危险。

神庭想放进地底的，是伪装后的圣灵。

神庭会用专门的药剂，把圣灵的外观改造成一种常见的无毒蛇。

等到姑苏城传染病到了相当严重的时刻，再让某位调查员意外发现，这种无毒蛇类可以吞食菌丝。

这时，一定会有人提出，引入这种黑蛇去控制菌丝传染。没有人站出来的话，还有辛追。

洛修高升，当了姑苏城的代理市长。辛追的地位也跟着水涨船高。这项提案极有可能被通过。

别小看他们的感情。从小到大，辛追起码拿命救过洛修三次。

这样，圣灵就可以避开安检，偷渡到地底城市。

伪装后的圣灵，可以肆无忌惮地吞噬菌丝，飞速进化。

这种怪物吃得越多，进化得越快，还可以分出伴生灵协助自己进食。到时候，整座姑苏城都会是圣灵的食堂。

姑苏城原本的居民大多心向人联，死了刚好。神庭在地表的信徒有一大批想要入住地下呢。

到最后，神庭可以兵不血刃地拿到一座空城。

至于人联的反应，那也是得到姑苏城之后的事了。

……这个计划看上去很完美。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 83: How Can a Sheep Be Slaughtered Twice?

He sat on the bed, unconsciously gripping the quilt, feeling a bit dazed and a bit guilty.

Xiang Nanli: "Um, Xiao Qing, carbon-based monkeys are easily disrupted by alcohol..."

Xiang Nanli had been drunk and vaguely remembered a little bit. But as for how it happened or what the process was in between, he had absolutely no memory.

He also didn't know how many years one would get for molesting metal according to the Android Legion’s laws.

Dongfang Qingdi observed his expression of not wanting to take responsibility and let out a cold snort from his nose that could have been mockery or resentment: "Get up and eat."

After saying that, he turned and left.

Xiang Nanli stared at his back, lost in thought for a while.

He had originally wanted to ask Xiao Zhi what to do if one "accidentally kissed their own good brother," but then he thought, Xiao Zhi was just a mini version of Xiao Qing—how was that any different from asking Xiao Qing directly!

Thus, as Dongfang Qingdi had expected, Xiang Nanli chose to act as if nothing had happened.

He changed his clothes and walked out of the room, only to find that Xiao Qing was not waiting for him as he usually did, and a sense of loss couldn't help but well up in his heart.

"Why is Xiao Qing holding such a grudge?" Xiang Nanli said loudly on purpose. "I hate petty robots the most!"

[...]

[I am in the infirmary.]

Fine, so he had gone to work.

Xiang Nanli decided to forgive him.

The 1 million credit point voucher in his account had hit zero.

Xiang Nanli opened the backend to check; expenses were mainly concentrated on Beichen’s laboratory materials and infrastructure supplies.

1 million credit points, two or three mechanical modifications, four or five mid-to-high-end mechanical prosthetics designed specifically for high-level wage slaves; five or six ping of housing in Luoyang City; enough for one person to live relatively comfortably underground for seven or eight years, but for the infrastructure of an entire city, it was truly a drop in the bucket.

Xiang Nanli was eating in the cafeteria, pondering while staring at Yi Hengxing, who was also eating coarse grains, his eyes filled with deep thought.

Yi Hengxing inexplicably felt a chill; when he looked up, Xiang Nanli was already sitting beside him with a beaming smile.

"Teacher Yi." Xiang Nanli wasn't wearing his lenses, and his pair of emerald eyes looked exceptionally gentle. "Are you getting used to the dormitory you stayed in last night? The conditions in Eternal City aren't great, but you are our most distinguished guest. If you have any needs, please feel free to ask. I will satisfy them as much as possible."

Yi Hengxing thought to himself, the conditions were indeed poor; there wasn't even electricity in the dormitory in the middle of the night, and he had to light a candle to see the road clearly. The signal was also bad, and he couldn't connect to the network at all.

He didn't know that to prevent outsiders from discovering anomalies, Eternal City had installed strong signal-jamming devices. Xiao Qing had also secretly turned off the equipment to connect to the network after Yi Hengxing fell asleep.

Yi Hengxing smiled and replied: "It's fine, I've always been clear about the conditions on the surface. By the way, I looked at the class schedule; there don't seem to be any classes during the day? Then I..."

Yi Hengxing wanted to look around on his own.

He remembered the giant aberrant human he had seen earlier; this was not a good sign. Perhaps he should apply to his superiors for a transfer order; the aberrants weren't that far from Gusu City.

At this moment, Xiang Nanli smiled and interrupted him: "Teacher Yi, you must be very curious why that aberrant human listened to my command yesterday, right?"

Yi Hengxing was stunned, then nodded somewhat embarrassedly: "I am a bit."

He had wanted to investigate secretly, but he hadn't expected Xiang Nanli to bring it up directly.

*A gentleman is upright and honorable.* This made Yi Hengxing feel that he was being a bit too much of a villain.

"Please follow me."

Xiang Nanli went to the garage and sat in the cockpit of the "Old Man's Joy" (a small, slow electric vehicle). He handed a protective suit to Yi Hengxing: "Put this on."

Yi Hengxing had originally wanted to say that he had undergone genetic enhancement and was equipped with a radiation absorber, but then he thought, one can never have too much protection, so he obediently put on the protective suit.

They were repairing the road recently, so the path to the pasture was much smoother. Xiang Nanli drove for an hour and arrived at the location of Pasture No. 1 in his memory.

The pasture was located in a valley, like a sunken basin. They wandered aimlessly inside the iron fence, bumping into electric wires and retreating on their own.

Yi Hengxing looked at these blood-red beasts covered in fungal hyphae, his pupils shrinking violently: "This is?!"

Xiang Nanli didn't take Yi Hengxing close, but said: "I’ve listened to the radio; this is the fungal hyphae disease that recently broke out in Gusu City, right?"

Xiang Nanli sighed heavily: "We were dealing with the plague cattle in the river valley area, originally intending to bury them in the soil after they naturally decomposed. But when we calculated the time and came to bury them, we found that the corpses of these cattle had been parasitized by black-silk powder fungi..."

"We were very afraid and tried to burn this batch of cattle to death, but the black-silk powder fungi had extremely high activity and were infectious. As long as there was sufficient nutrition, a large patch would grow the next day."

Xiang Nanli pointed to the pasture: "It was then that Andrew, the mayor of Eternal City, accidentally discovered that the aberrants wandering nearby would actually eat these fungal organisms. To prevent the aberrants from eating humans, we had to feed the fungal cattle to the aberrants; once the aberrants were full, they wouldn't attack humans. Gradually, more and more aberrants gathered nearby. Just like a wolf pack, they gathered in the forest near the city."

"Their leader is very smart. Every once in a while, it leads other aberrants to the pasture to eat these fungal cattle. To a certain extent, Eternal City can be considered to be feeding them. The leader occasionally listens to our suggestions, of course, it all depends on its mood... This is why I was able to make the aberrants stop attacking you."

Yi Hengxing’s focus, however, was on something else: "You mean, they can eat fungal hyphae?"

The fungal hyphae disease was spreading wildly in Gusu City, and many quarantine zones had been built. Yet, the situation remained difficult to control. More and more people were becoming fungalized.

Although those who had undergone genetic modification had not yet shown symptoms of infection, in any society, the number of ordinary people was the largest.

Yi Hengxing had accepted missions, entering and exiting the epidemic area seven times, and had cleaned up a large number of infected bodies. He had also tossed and turned on sleepless nights over the disease in Gusu City.

He was a bit excited: "If we put some aberrants into the underground city..."

No, that wasn't right.

Yi Hengxing suddenly became vigilant, a flash of sharp light appearing in his narrowed eyes.

In his understanding, aberrants, like the fungal hyphae disease, were creations of the Divine Court!

If letting aberrants into the city was the Divine Court’s true goal, wouldn't he be inviting a wolf into the house?

In fact—

If Xiang Nanli hadn't accidentally captured Eternal City and seized the Holy Spirit, this would indeed have been the Divine Court’s original plan.

However, what they wanted to put in wasn't aberrants; everyone knew aberrants were dangerous.

What the Divine Court wanted to put underground was a disguised Holy Spirit.

The Divine Court would use special potions to alter the appearance of the Holy Spirit into a common, non-venomous snake.

When the epidemic in Gusu City reached a sufficiently serious stage, they would have a certain investigator "accidentally" discover that this non-venomous snake could consume fungal hyphae.

At that point, someone would definitely propose introducing these black snakes to control the fungal hyphae infection. If no one stood up, there was still Xin Zhui.

Luo Xiu had been promoted to acting mayor of Gusu City. Xin Zhui’s status had risen accordingly. This proposal was highly likely to be passed.

Don't underestimate their bond. From childhood to adulthood, Xin Zhui had saved Luo Xiu’s life at least three times.

In this way, the Holy Spirit could bypass security checks and smuggle itself into the underground city.

The disguised Holy Spirit could devour fungal hyphae without restraint and evolve rapidly.

The more this monster ate, the faster it evolved, and it could even split off companion spirits to assist in its feeding. By then, the entire Gusu City would be the Holy Spirit’s cafeteria.

Most of the original residents of Gusu City were loyal to the Human Alliance; it was fine if they died. A large number of the Divine Court’s believers on the surface wanted to move underground.

In the end, the Divine Court could take an empty city without shedding a drop of blood.

As for the Human Alliance’s reaction, that would be a matter for after they had obtained Gusu City.

...This plan looked perfect.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第83章 一头羊怎么还可以宰两次 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
可惜从中杀出一个相南里，在完全不知情的状态下，把神庭的布局全盘打乱。

缺阴德是这样的，老天爷都不肯帮忙。

相南里温声道：“为什么要放畸变人进地下城呢？用‘进食’的方式来分解菌丝，效率非常低。想要看见效果，起码需要数百头畸变人。稍有不慎，就会给姑苏城带来巨大的安全隐患。”

相南里把易横行想到的都说完了。

从心理学的角度看，相南里起码打开了他的第二层心防。

相南里分析着他的表情，终于图穷匕见：“其实我带你来这，让你看我们的牧场，是想告诉你另一件事。我们从这些畸变人的胃容物里，提取出了一种能抑制菌丝生长的活性物质，并且研制出了一批菌丝病的抑制剂。”

故意告诉他一个错误的方向，是为了最大限度的对配方进行保密。

相南里在几天前就完成了心理建设，因此说起谎来毫无压力。他此时的语调，显得非常真诚和质朴。

易横行的呼吸不由得急促起来。他比任何人都明白，现在这个情况下，抑制剂的重要性。

“目前，这批药的剂量非常少。经过分装后，只有20瓶，每瓶1毫升。”

“你知道的，人类不总是团结的。尤其是在事关生死的时候。我希望这批抑制剂，能进入各个研究所，能发挥出最大的功效，而不是冷藏在某个私人仓库中，等待开封的那天。”相南里脸上的笑容缓缓收敛，神色也变得凝重，“易横行，我认为你是一个好人。请告诉我，我可以相信你吗？”

易横行的心头不由得微微一颤。

他是好人吗？易横行想，大多数人都自我感觉良好，从不认为自己是个坏蛋。

易横行进入调查组二十多年，从萌新混成了老油条。他做过好事，也为了继续做好事昧着良心干一些不道德的事……

易横行的脑海里闪过千头万绪，他郑重道：“请相信我。”

相南里脸上的笑容扩散开来，他重重拍着易横行的肩膀：“好兄弟。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 83: How Can a Sheep Be Slaughtered Twice? (Part 2)

Unfortunately, Xiang Nanli had cut in, and while completely unaware, he had completely disrupted the Divine Court’s layout.

*Lack of virtue is like this; even Heaven refuses to help.*

Xiang Nanli said gently: "Why put aberrants into the underground city? Using the 'feeding' method to decompose fungal hyphae is extremely inefficient. To see results, you would need at least hundreds of aberrants. A slight carelessness would bring huge safety hazards to Gusu City."

Xiang Nanli had said everything Yi Hengxing had thought of.

From a psychological perspective, Xiang Nanli had at least opened his second layer of mental defenses.

Xiang Nanli analyzed his expression and finally revealed his true intent: "Actually, I brought you here to show you our pasture because I wanted to tell you something else. We extracted an active substance from the stomach contents of these aberrants that can inhibit the growth of fungal hyphae, and we have developed a batch of inhibitors for the fungal hyphae disease."

Deliberately telling him a wrong direction was to keep the formula as secret as possible.

Xiang Nanli had completed his psychological preparation days ago, so he felt no pressure while lying. His tone at this moment sounded very sincere and simple.

Yi Hengxing’s breathing couldn't help but quicken. He understood better than anyone the importance of an inhibitor in the current situation.

"Currently, the dosage of this batch of medicine is very small. After being divided, there are only 20 bottles, 1 ml each."

"You know, humans aren't always united. Especially when it comes to life and death. I hope this batch of inhibitors can enter various research institutes and exert the greatest effect, rather than being refrigerated in some private warehouse, waiting for the day it's opened." The smile on Xiang Nanli’s face slowly faded, and his expression became solemn. "Yi Hengxing, I think you are a good person. Please tell me, can I trust you?"

Yi Hengxing’s heart couldn't help but tremble slightly.

Was he a good person? Yi Hengxing thought, most people feel good about themselves and never think they are villains.

Yi Hengxing had been in the investigation team for over twenty years, going from a rookie to an old hand. He had done good deeds, and he had also done immoral things against his conscience to continue doing good deeds...

Countless thoughts flashed through Yi Hengxing’s mind, and he said solemnly: "Please trust me."

The smile on Xiang Nanli’s face spread, and he patted Yi Hengxing’s shoulder heavily: "Good brother."

第84章 旧的不去

身高一米九二，黄金比例，再高会显得特别大一个，不够美观。

一张放在ABO世界也是铁血Alpha的酷哥脸，信息素不是雪松就是白兰地。

怎么看都是360度无死角的帅，不懂的物理性永别了。

这张脸上，唯一不太和谐的地方，就是唇下一点青紫的痕迹。

东方青帝已经收到通知，相南里正带着大怨种，在赶来的路上。

他用指腹擦过唇沟，手上留下一抹明显的红色。

呵呵……就说劣质的颜料不行吧，果然掉色了。

不过糊弄相南里，应该没什么问题。

这原本是城里画师用来描工分券的颜料，东方青帝去仓库征用了几毫升，稀释后涂在了下唇。

目的是为了提醒相南里，昨天对他做过什么。

可恶的坏男人！

相南里对感情有一种天真的残忍。不逼他一下，这小子能毫无心理负担地装一辈子鸵鸟。

小青对着镜子冷笑了一下，把颜色变浅的颜料又细致地涂了一次。随后站在了操作台边上，耐心等待。

对电子生命而言，时间并不是什么珍贵的东西。

他一直等待着，从有理智的那天起。他看着一棵树从发芽到成材，最后被战火吞噬；看着地表的城市建立又荒废，最后回到地底。看着河流改道，看着森林变成荒漠，荒漠中又长出绿洲。看着屏幕后的工程组换了一个又一个。

Alpha曾以为这样的等待是无止境的。

相南里的存在，让他终于对时间的流逝有了一些概念和期待。

……

相南里带着易横行，来到了城内唯一一家医院。

医院是两层楼的小洋房，围着一个斗兽场似的庭院。血迹长久地渗透进去，地面蒙着一层挥之不去的血腥味。

这家医院原本为城里的贵人们服务，也会定期带小孩进来，注射生化药剂，把健康的人类小孩改造成短命的生化战士。譬如葛根。

而不那么幸运，熬不过所谓“进化”的人，会变成一头头没有理智的畸变体。城主会下令把它们射杀，尸体则拿去喂养圣灵。

相南里想到这，不由得顺口道：[小智，以后要打黑十字审判庭的时候，可以这么进行思想宣传，“审判庭把人变鬼，基地把鬼变人！”，这条先记上。有新闻部门了再宣传葛根的事。]

自从打算建立基地，相南里的小本本上已经有了数百条笔记！

小智冷酷道：[恕我直言，以基地目前的体量，想和黑十字审判庭对打，这都不是您有生之年需要考虑的事。]

喂！还不准让人做做梦啊。

医院内部的软装已经大改过一次了，但细节处依然很有神庭的风格。

比如扶手上随处可见的宗教装饰……如果那些奇怪的眼眸、星辰、日月、翅膀也算是装饰的话。

比如头顶画着的一片扭曲星空，风格很抽象派。按照神庭的说法，星空深处，是神的墓地。

地表暗无天日，被厚重的核雾霾覆盖着。抬头，天空是一片灰暗的黄褐色。神庭便格外信仰星空，宣传唯一的神居住在99重天上。

这个神在地下，有999个化身，无处不在，无所不知，可能是任何形状。要求信仰者对周围的一切心存敬畏。

相南里是无神论者。

但各种文化都有自己内部的逻辑，包括神学。神庭这种略微扭曲、阴暗的风格，又是赐福又是恐吓，大概也契合着地表人民的精神需求。

相南里带着易横行来到医务室，本来想开开心心打个招呼，然而看见东方青帝的脸后，心头骤然一紧。

怎么回事！一上午过去，小青的下嘴唇不仅没有消肿，反而更红了。

慌。

相南里想说的词卡壳了一下。

他介绍：“易老师，这是我在基地的同事，你叫他东方就行。”

东方青帝微微颔首，莫名有一种国王接见臣民的气势：“你好。”

易横行果然没有察觉到，面前的人其实是一台智械。

“你好你好，我叫易横行。”易横行上前一步，想要礼貌地握住东方青帝的手，然而对方却在此时低头，开始整理实医务室的桌面。

易横行只好尴尬地把双手交叠，放在身前：“菌丝病在姑苏城泛滥很久了。如果这种抑制剂有效，能拯救的性命数以百万计。我代表姑苏城感谢你们。”

东方青帝态度冷淡：“抑制剂只是遏制感染者体内的真菌繁衍，并不能药到病除，最好别太乐观。”

易横行挠头：“实不相瞒，城里几十个实验室，经费用了十几个亿，一直到我离开姑苏，都没听到有什么成果。”

没什么用的论文倒是发了上百篇，还在抢注各种知识产权专利，专门用于糊弄各种领导。

说到这，易横行难免叹息一声：“这个抑制剂，已经是我迄今为止听到的最好的消息了。有没有用拿回去试试就知道了。”

北辰空运过来的抑制剂已经分装好了。

神殿的医务室有一批干净的试剂瓶，原本是用于装生化药剂的。

这些试剂瓶是双层玻璃结构，外面是试管，里层却是螺旋形的真空玻璃。

抑制剂就密封在试管的真空层内。透明的溶液里，漂浮着一粒粒细小的黄色水泡。

相南里把20瓶药剂装进药剂箱中，把箱子推到易横行面前：“你应该清楚，我们基地的成员都是解冻人。这些抑制剂，是基地的首席科学家北辰配制出来的，还不能量产。”

“基地的财力有限，目前所有的抑制剂都在这里，我把它交给你。你一定要把抑制剂安全送到姑苏城的各个研究所中。”

“另外，这里还有一样东西，麻烦你回到姑苏城后，一并交给各个研究所的负责人。”说着，相南里递过去一个小塑料盒，里面装着一个很原始的移动U盘。

易横行顿时深感责任之重大：“我会的。这个U盘是……？”

相南里微笑道：“是基地对实验过程的一些批注。”

并不是，里面其实是相南里开出的交易条件。抑制剂可以送点试用品，但真正的核心技术，依然掌控在基地手中。这是能换钱的重要资源。

东方青帝很有先见之明地把小福支开了。

他骗福音书，说要给它换具身体。

小福兴高采烈地来到操作室，然后主动关机开启了数据传输。起码三天都不用担心这颗电灯泡。

福音书再三叮嘱，希望自己这次能有一个人类身体。

东方青帝千挑万选，特地从仓库里找出了一台机械狮子。

嗯，这其实是辆运输车来着。但没关系，小福当了这么久的狗，当机械狮子应该也不在话下。

让福音书暂时关机很有必要。

Alpha对这些死板的程序设置太熟悉了。

不这么做，福音书那小子是真的可能在权衡再三后，偷偷把配方白给的！

[你就不担心易横行发现里面内容和他想的不一样，最后恼羞成怒？]
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 84: Out with the Old

He stood one meter ninety-two, a golden ratio; any taller and he would have appeared overly massive, lacking aesthetic grace.

He possessed the face of a cool guy who, even in an ABO world, would be considered a hardcore Alpha, with pheromones that smelled of either cedar or brandy.

He was handsome from every 360-degree angle; those who couldn't appreciate it were physically missing out.

The only discordant note on this face was a faint, purplish bruise beneath his lower lip.

Dongfang Qingdi had already received notice that Xiang Nanli was on his way, bringing the "big sucker" along with him.

He rubbed his thumb across his lip, leaving a smear of distinct red on his skin.

*Heh...* I knew that cheap pigment wouldn't hold up. It really did fade.

Still, it should be enough to fool Xiang Nanli.

This was originally pigment used by city painters to trace ration coupons. Dongfang Qingdi had requisitioned a few milliliters from the warehouse, diluted it, and applied it to his lower lip.

The goal was to remind Xiang Nanli of what he had done to him yesterday.

What a wretched, wicked man!

Xiang Nanli possessed a naive cruelty when it came to matters of the heart. If one didn't force him, this kid could play the ostrich his entire life without a shred of psychological burden.

Xiao Qing sneered at his reflection in the mirror, then meticulously reapplied the faded pigment. Afterward, he stood by the console, waiting patiently.

For an electronic lifeform, time was not a precious commodity.

He had been waiting ever since the day he gained sentience. He had watched a tree grow from a sprout to timber, only to be consumed by the flames of war; he had watched cities on the surface rise and fall into ruin, eventually returning to the earth. He had watched rivers change their course, forests turn into deserts, and oases bloom within those deserts. He had watched the engineering teams behind the screens cycle through one generation after another.

The Alpha had once believed such waiting was endless.

Xiang Nanli’s existence had finally given him a concept of—and something to look forward to—in the passage of time.

...

Xiang Nanli brought Yi Hengxing to the only hospital in the city.

The hospital was a two-story villa surrounded by a courtyard that resembled a gladiatorial arena. Blood had long since seeped into the ground, leaving a lingering, inescapable scent of iron.

This hospital originally served the city’s nobility and would periodically bring in children to inject them with biochemical agents, transforming healthy human children into short-lived biochemical soldiers. Someone like Ge Gen, for instance.

Those less fortunate, who couldn't survive the so-called "evolution," would turn into mindless aberrations. The City Lord would order them shot, and their corpses would be used to feed the Holy Spirits.

Thinking of this, Xiang Nanli couldn't help but mutter: [Xiao Zhi, when we eventually take on the Black Cross Inquisition, we can use this as propaganda: "The Inquisition turns men into ghosts, the Base turns ghosts into men!" Make a note of that. We can publicize Ge Gen’s story once we have a news department.]

Ever since he decided to establish the base, Xiang Nanli’s little notebook had been filled with hundreds of entries!

Xiao Zhi replied coldly: [With all due respect, given the current scale of the base, thinking about taking on the Black Cross Inquisition is not something you need to worry about in your lifetime.]

Hey! Can’t a guy dream?

The interior of the hospital had been renovated, but the details still retained a strong "Divine Court" style.

For instance, religious decorations were everywhere on the railings... if those strange eyes, stars, suns, moons, and wings could be considered decorations.

Or the ceiling, which featured a painting of a twisted starry sky in a very abstract style. According to the Divine Court, the depths of the starry sky were the graveyard of the gods.

The surface was pitch black, covered by thick nuclear smog. When one looked up, the sky was a dull, yellowish-brown. Thus, the Divine Court held the starry sky in high reverence, preaching that the one true God resided in the 99th heaven.

This God had 999 incarnations underground, omnipresent and omniscient, capable of taking any shape. They demanded that believers hold everything around them in awe.

Xiang Nanli was an atheist.

But every culture had its own internal logic, including theology. The Divine Court’s slightly twisted, gloomy style—a mix of blessings and threats—likely catered to the psychological needs of the surface dwellers.

Xiang Nanli brought Yi Hengxing to the infirmary, intending to offer a cheerful greeting, but his heart tightened the moment he saw Dongfang Qingdi’s face.

What was going on! A whole morning had passed, and Xiao Qing’s lower lip hadn't just failed to go down; it looked even redder.

Panic.

The words Xiang Nanli meant to say got stuck in his throat.

He introduced them: "Teacher Yi, this is my colleague at the base. You can just call him Dongfang."

Dongfang Qingdi gave a slight nod, exuding an inexplicable aura of a king receiving a subject: "Hello."

Yi Hengxing, as expected, didn't notice that the person before him was actually a sentient machine.

"Hello, hello, I’m Yi Hengxing." Yi Hengxing stepped forward, wanting to politely shake Dongfang Qingdi’s hand, but the latter lowered his head at that moment and began tidying the infirmary desk.

Yi Hengxing had to awkwardly fold his hands in front of him: "The mycelial disease has been rampant in Gusu City for a long time. If this inhibitor is effective, it could save millions of lives. On behalf of Gusu City, I thank you."

Dongfang Qingdi’s attitude was cold: "The inhibitor only suppresses the proliferation of fungi within the infected; it is not a miracle cure. It would be best not to be too optimistic."

Yi Hengxing scratched his head: "To be honest, there are dozens of laboratories in the city, and we’ve spent over a billion in funding, but until I left Gusu, I hadn't heard of any results."

They had published hundreds of useless papers and were busy registering various intellectual property patents, all specifically designed to fool the leadership.

At this, Yi Hengxing couldn't help but sigh: "This inhibitor is the best news I’ve heard so far. Whether it works or not, we’ll know once we take it back and test it."

The inhibitors flown in by Beichen had already been packaged.

The temple’s infirmary had a batch of clean reagent bottles, originally used for biochemical agents.

These bottles were double-layered glass structures: a test tube on the outside, with a spiral vacuum layer on the inside.

The inhibitor was sealed within the vacuum layer of the tube. Inside the transparent solution, tiny yellow bubbles floated.

Xiang Nanli packed 20 vials into a medical case and pushed it toward Yi Hengxing: "You should be aware that the members of our base are all 'unfrozen' people. These inhibitors were formulated by our Chief Scientist, Beichen, and cannot yet be mass-produced."

"The base’s financial resources are limited. All the inhibitors we have are here, and I am entrusting them to you. You must ensure they are safely delivered to the various research institutes in Gusu City."

"Also, there is one more thing here. Please, after you return to Gusu City, hand this to the heads of the research institutes as well." As he spoke, Xiang Nanli handed over a small plastic box containing a primitive USB flash drive.

Yi Hengxing immediately felt the weight of the responsibility: "I will. This flash drive is...?"

Xiang Nanli smiled: "It contains some annotations from the base regarding the experimental process."

That wasn't true. Inside were actually the terms of trade Xiang Nanli had set. He could give away some samples, but the true core technology remained in the hands of the base. This was a vital resource that could be traded for money.

Dongfang Qingdi had the foresight to send Xiao Fu away.

He had lied to the Gospel Book, telling it he wanted to help it change into a new body.

Xiao Fu had happily arrived at the operations room and then voluntarily shut down to initiate a data transfer. At least for three days, there was no need to worry about that "lightbulb."

The Gospel Book had repeatedly urged him, hoping that this time it would finally have a human body.

Dongfang Qingdi had carefully selected a mechanical lion from the warehouse.

Well, it was actually a transport vehicle. But that didn't matter; Xiao Fu had been a dog for so long, being a mechanical lion shouldn't be a problem.

It was necessary to have the Gospel Book shut down temporarily.

The Alpha was far too familiar with those rigid program settings.

If he didn't do this, that kid, the Gospel Book, might actually weigh the pros and cons and secretly give away the formula for free!

[Aren't you worried that Yi Hengxing will find the content isn't what he expected and fly into a rage?]

chunks.chineseText:
相南里：[易横行的态度，并不会影响最终的结果。我这么说也是为了暂时地符合人设。而且，我认为他不会看。]

易横行是君子。

对付不同的人，得用不同的方法。

简单来说，没钱的利诱，有钱的义诱。实在不行还有威逼。

每个人都有想得到、或者想要守护的东西。

嗯，比如世界按照相南里想的那样发展，他愿意立刻去死，在相南里的价值体系中，多犹豫一秒都是对人类未来的不尊重。

又比如，要保护小青的话，相南里愿意失去一条胳膊。

小智的话，相南里愿意失去一撮头发。

洛阳……洛阳骨灰都肥化了，他就不做假设了。

“交给易老师，我是很放心的。”相南里的语气充满肯定，随后有些不舍，“只是可惜了，学校里的课程才开始没多久，老师就要走了。”

易横行思考片刻，回答：“没事，我回姑苏安排一批大学生过来。地点定位我已经做好了，手续可以先斩后奏，速度快的话，一周就能到。”

这年头，大学的准入门槛很高，毕业更难，对普通人来说，属于严进严出。

毕业不仅看考试成绩、论文，还要看平时的绩点。

姑苏城一直有扶贫项目。只要给大学生们几个绩点指标，自然有一大把人愿意来地表支教……更何况永恒市的条件虽然艰苦，但完全不用担心生命危险。

再走他的关系，让地表发展基金会拨一些款，作为大学生的支教工资。

安排下来很妥当，没什么问题。

要是这点权力都没有，易横行这二十年在调查组也算是白混了。

相南里再度亲热道：“易老师，你是永恒市最好的人类朋友！”

除了最好的人类朋友。还有最好的智械朋友。最好的教徒朋友。最好的畸变人朋友……以后都可以来一遍！

东方青帝看着相南里上前，和易横行亲切握手。脑海里不合时宜地闪过把易横行手砍断的念头。

他当然不会这么做。只是智械的思维活跃，Alpha无时无刻都在处理着海量数据，有那么一点杂念也很正常。

易横行在天黑之前，背着医药箱，骑着他的摩托上路了。

相南里和他教过的一群学生，来到城门，为他送别。

非常符合易横行对地表人民的想象。淳朴又善良。

易横行戴上安全头盔，帅气地扭头，挥了挥手：“我一定会回来的！”

烧柴油的小摩托车呼啸着离开了。

易横行走在凹凸不平的、原始的路面上，心里冒出一个念头：“要是永恒市发展起来，也许能修一条从交通站到这里的公路呢。”

算了，想这么多干嘛。修路是另外的价钱。人口数百万级别的地表城市才有这种待遇。

……

……

相南里看着摩托车消失在视野中，长长舒了一口气：“终于送走了。”

倒不是累，就是觉得麻烦。

相南里更喜欢和没有生命的东西相处，比如金属和数据。

小青就太像人了。尤其是最近，总是让相南里感觉到紧张。

果然，下一秒——

东方青帝开口：“晚上想吃什么？”

意思是打算做饭。

周围的学生三三两两散去，准备去抢收田里的玉米。收了玉米，还有红薯、土豆、大白菜。农活是做不完的。广播的天气预报说半夜会下雨。

相南里不敢看他，心虚道：“小青不用给我做饭了。多麻烦！我吃袋营养膏，一会还要去牧场。”

东方青帝略微歪了一下头：“是吗？那我跟你一起。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 84: Out with the Old (Part 2)

Xiang Nanli: [Yi Hengxing’s attitude won't change the final outcome. I said that just to maintain the persona for now. Besides, I don't think he’ll look.]

Yi Hengxing was a gentleman.

To deal with different people, one must use different methods.

Simply put: for those without money, use temptation; for those with money, use moral appeal. If all else fails, there is always coercion.

Everyone has something they want to obtain or protect.

For example, if the world developed exactly as Xiang Nanli envisioned, he would be willing to die immediately; in Xiang Nanli’s value system, hesitating for even a second would be a disrespect to the future of humanity.

Or, for instance, to protect Xiao Qing, Xiang Nanli would be willing to lose an arm.

As for Xiao Zhi, Xiang Nanli would be willing to lose a lock of hair.

As for Luoyang... Luoyang’s ashes had already turned into fertilizer, so he wouldn't bother with hypotheticals.

"I am very relieved to entrust this to you, Teacher Yi." Xiang Nanli’s tone was full of affirmation, then he added with a hint of reluctance, "It’s just a pity; the courses at the school have only just begun, and you’re already leaving."

Yi Hengxing thought for a moment and replied: "It’s fine. When I return to Gusu, I’ll arrange for a batch of university students to come over. I’ve already set the location coordinates; we can handle the paperwork after the fact. If we’re fast, they can be here in a week."

In this day and age, the threshold for university admission was high, and graduating was even harder; for ordinary people, it was a case of "strict entry, strict exit."

Graduation didn't just depend on exam scores and theses; it also looked at cumulative GPAs.

Gusu City had always had poverty alleviation programs. As long as they offered a few GPA credits, there would naturally be plenty of students willing to come to the surface to teach... especially since, while Eternal City’s conditions were harsh, there was no need to worry about life-threatening danger.

He could also use his connections to have the Surface Development Foundation allocate some funds to serve as the students' teaching salaries.

The arrangement was sound; there were no issues.

If he didn't have even that much power, Yi Hengxing would have wasted his twenty years in the investigation unit.

Xiang Nanli said affectionately: "Teacher Yi, you are the best human friend Eternal City has!"

Besides the best human friend, there was also the best machine friend, the best believer friend, the best aberration friend... he could go through the whole list later!

Dongfang Qingdi watched Xiang Nanli step forward to shake hands with Yi Hengxing. An inappropriate thought flashed through his mind: the urge to chop off Yi Hengxing’s hand.

Of course, he wouldn't actually do it. It was just that a machine’s mind was active; the Alpha was processing massive amounts of data every second, so having a few stray thoughts was perfectly normal.

Before nightfall, Yi Hengxing, carrying his medical kit, got on his motorcycle and set off.

Xiang Nanli and a group of students he had been teaching went to the city gate to see him off.

It was perfectly in line with Yi Hengxing’s imagination of the surface people: simple and kind.

Yi Hengxing put on his helmet, turned his head with a cool air, and waved: "I will definitely be back!"

The diesel-powered motorcycle roared away.

As Yi Hengxing traveled along the uneven, primitive road, a thought popped into his head: "If Eternal City develops, maybe they could build a highway from the transport station to here."

Forget it, why think so much? Building roads cost extra. Only surface cities with populations in the millions got that kind of treatment.

...

...

Xiang Nanli watched the motorcycle disappear from view and let out a long sigh: "Finally, they’re gone."

It wasn't that he was tired; it was just that he found it troublesome.

Xiang Nanli preferred dealing with inanimate things, like metal and data.

Xiao Qing was too much like a human. Especially lately, he always made Xiang Nanli feel nervous.

Sure enough, the next second—

Dongfang Qingdi spoke: "What do you want for dinner?"

He meant he intended to cook.

The surrounding students dispersed in twos and threes, preparing to rush to harvest the corn in the fields. After the corn, there were sweet potatoes, potatoes, and cabbage. There was never an end to farm work. The radio weather forecast said it would rain in the middle of the night.

Xiang Nanli didn't dare look at him, feeling guilty: "Xiao Qing, you don't need to cook for me. It’s too much trouble! I’ll just have a bag of nutrient paste; I have to go to the ranch in a bit."

Dongfang Qingdi tilted his head slightly: "Is that so? Then I’ll go with you."

chunks.chineseText:
第85章 新的不来

东方青帝这头一歪，还挺像鬼的。

相南里转念一想，小青就算变成了机械鬼，也不会害他。刚提起的心缓缓放下。

奇怪，为什么会紧张。

好新奇的感觉。上一次有印象的紧张是什么时候？要在全世界面前开学术发布会，阐述不关闭Alpha的原因；还是睁着眼，看见注射器里的奥沙利铂缓缓推入静脉。

相南里想不出拒绝的理由：“本来也是要带你去的。”

他其实更想带蛇夫座去，好证明基地确实人和非人团结一家亲。

但想想，蛇夫座还没有完成社会化。而且牧场距离基地还是有点远，不方便。这才作罢。

东方青帝的嘴角不由得上扬了0.5度；但想起一会要去见以西结，又下降了1.5度。

三蹦子老头乐没有先进的无人驾驶系统，只能人工操作。相南里本来想开车的，但小青很自觉地钻进了驾驶位。

等抵达牧场时，天色已经是酱油似的浓黑，伸手不见五指。

空气中一股浓浓的菌子味儿。

相南里下车，感受着透过防护服浸润进来的寒意，心想这真是一个杀人越货抛尸的好地方。

他摸索着掏出手电筒，打开灯。

30000流明的户外手电筒照得附近几米亮如白昼。

菌牛恐怖的模样就在几米外。它们应该是刚被享用过，白骨森森。只有一点鲜红的菌丝挂在上面，像剁得细细的臊子。眼睛位置是空洞。还能看见正在生长的红色菌丝蠕动。像极了恐怖游戏的NPC。

这些菌牛根本不算动物，没有自主意识，不需要进食。目前看只需要水、阳光就能生长。它们在牧场内游荡着，安静如同幽灵。

相南里抵达的时候是七点四十，他习惯稍微提前一点。

东方青帝眼眸里，银色的瞳环像是野生动物一样亮着，有些奇特的反光。

他已经看见了以西结，在五六百米外的树上。

小体型的畸变人很喜欢爬树。以西结蹲在粗壮的树枝上，身后粗长的尾巴垂落，不耐烦地摇晃着。他的尾巴尖微微翘起了一个小勾。

东方青帝觉得他像一只没进化完备的猴子。

以西结穿的是神庭的礼服。是那种宫廷剧里会出现的打扮。白色衬衣配黑马甲，藕节袖的边缘还有一层橄榄叶形的蕾丝作为装饰。

应该是从神庭那里扒下来的吧，衣服料子一看就很贵。

可惜了。东方青帝赌五毛，相南里看见以西结这身打扮，唯一的想法是衣服上的铜扣能不能熔了当导电线。

以西结没有机械眼，不能扫描。

但今晚刮的是西北风，顺风。

风带来了淡淡的木质檀香，混着一点桂花的甜味，这是相南里的气味，很少见；还有一股讨厌的机油味。

他能闻出每个人不同的气味。当以西结还是畸变体的时候，身上每个鳞片都能闻到最细微的空气拂过的味道。

听说，每种生物的五感都是不一样的。

目的是为了分辨哪些能吃，哪些不能吃。

比如狮子能食腐，人就不能。远古时代，喜欢吃腐食的碳基猴子吃完烂肉死了，这种基因就被自然筛选了出去。活下来的都是不爱食腐的碳基猴子的后代。

以西结想，会闻出恶心的机油味，肯定是因为东方青帝不能吃。

也许这男人有毒。

尽管双方都提前到了，但以西结并没有早一点出现的打算。他在掐着时间，反正不能早到。当然，也不会迟到。

免得他像是很期待一样。

不过，以西结作为几百年前的畸变人，对人类目前掌控的黑科技还是了解太少。

比如他眼中，相南里和东方青帝没有任何交谈。而实际上——

[小青，你说以西结已经到了？]

[嗯，就在那。]

这俩在用科技偷偷作弊ovo！

镜片上调出了附近的地图，小青在上面用橙色标了一个点。

树下还趴着一只独眼的巨型畸变人，它的身体以一种奇怪的姿势扭曲着，这才能勉强挤入树和树的缝隙间。

小红对人类的敌意明显更明显一点，忍不住朝着相南里的方向龇牙咧嘴。

可惜牙刚露出来，就被一尾巴扇了回去。

[这么近。是不是你把人家吓到了？]

[哈？]

[你之前在地底，把人家同事杀掉了。]

[……]

晚上八点。准时。

以西结从阴影中走出。

相南里摊开手，示意自己没有任何武器，微笑着开口：“好久不见——”

他的声音略微停顿了半拍，“以西结。”

以西结这小子，进化得可真快。上次看还是个披着人皮的怪物，现在居然，长得还怪俊的。

就是外观有点邪性。以西结的眼白是黑色的，虹膜却是充血的红色。

以西结停在了十米外的位置，就不再靠近，一张脸刚好在光明的边缘。

以西结冷淡地回答：“嗯。”

相南里的语气没有丝毫的变化：“我给你带了一点礼物。”

相南里蹲下，从随身携带的挎包里掏出一台蜘蛛型机器人。这是他随手造的。

小蜘蛛端着一管玻璃试剂，来到以西结的脚边。

“生化战士药剂。也许对你有用。”

是神庭生产的，能制造生化战士。

相南里一直没用。给了北辰一瓶，作为实验室耗材。

以西结缓慢地弯腰，把试管举起，对着光线看了片刻，又打开瓶塞嗅了嗅，最后回答：“谢谢。”

相南里观察着以西结的表情：“听安德鲁说。你一直住在这附近。我还挺高兴的。要不要来城市里参观一下？”

以西结一边眉毛微微抬起，这代表他对这个提议很是轻蔑。

他是濒临灭绝的潜行者，一道城门压根挡不住他。

永恒市。以西结半夜偷偷溜进去看好多次了。

他还去偷吃过食堂的牛肉饼；结论是虽然美味，但营养价值极低。养人类是足够了，养畸变人不行。吃这个根本不够每天的能量消耗。

相南里：“我听葛根说，好几次遇到神庭的人，是畸变人把他们赶走的。无论你对人类的态度是什么，从客观角度上，你确实有帮到我，我一直心存感谢。”

“我知道城墙对你形同虚设，但你还没有以客人的身份来过吧？这个月月底，收完麦子后，城里会举行丰收节。你可以带着你的畸变人朋友一起来。就在城外，会有免费的米酒。”相南里温声道，“基地的理念是全体智慧生命共存，这个范围不止是人类、智械，也包括畸变人。”

“地表的生存条件恶劣，一直都是寒冬，但我们可以报团取暖。以西结，你是基地最好的畸变人朋友，无论你们来还是不来，牧场会一直为你们存在。”

相南里说的话三分真七分假。

相南里本人并不怎么温柔，说的漂亮话全是装出来的。

但他的心意却是真实的。

身体只是灵魂的容器。

如果一个怪物，它能和你沟通，有自己的思想。那么对相南里来说，这就是同类。

以西结思考着。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 85: Nothing New

The way Dongfang Qingdi tilted his head was actually quite ghost-like.

Xiang Nanli had a second thought: even if Xiao Qing had turned into a mechanical ghost, he wouldn't harm him. The heart that had just leaped into his throat slowly settled back down.

Strange, why was he nervous?

Such a novel feeling. When was the last time he remembered being nervous? Was it when he had to hold an academic press conference in front of the whole world to explain why he wouldn't shut down the Alpha? Or was it when he lay there with his eyes open, watching the oxaliplatin in the syringe being slowly pushed into his vein?

Xiang Nanli couldn't think of a reason to refuse: "I was going to take you anyway."

He actually wanted to take Ophiuchus to prove that the base was truly a place where humans and non-humans lived in harmony.

But then he thought, Ophiuchus hadn't completed its socialization yet. And the ranch was a bit far from the base, which wasn't convenient. So he dropped the idea.

The corners of Dongfang Qingdi’s mouth couldn't help but lift by 0.5 degrees; but remembering he had to meet Ezekiel in a moment, they dropped by 1.5 degrees.

The "three-wheeler" old-man-mobile didn't have an advanced autonomous driving system and had to be operated manually. Xiang Nanli had wanted to drive, but Xiao Qing had climbed into the driver’s seat quite naturally.

By the time they arrived at the ranch, the sky was a thick, soy-sauce black, so dark you couldn't see your own hand.

The air was filled with a pungent, fungal stench.

Xiang Nanli got out of the vehicle, feeling the chill seep through his protective suit, and thought that this was truly a perfect place for murder and body disposal.

He fumbled for his flashlight and clicked it on.

The 30,000-lumen outdoor flashlight illuminated the surroundings for several meters as if it were broad daylight.

The terrifying sight of the fungal cows was just a few meters away. They must have just been "enjoyed," leaving only white, skeletal bones. Only a few bits of bright red mycelium hung from them, like finely minced meat. Their eye sockets were empty holes. One could still see the red mycelium growing and writhing inside. They looked exactly like NPCs from a horror game.

These fungal cows weren't animals at all; they had no self-awareness and didn't need to eat. As far as anyone could tell, they only needed water and sunlight to grow. They wandered the ranch, as quiet as ghosts.

Xiang Nanli arrived at 7:40; he was in the habit of being a little early.

In Dongfang Qingdi’s eyes, the silver iris rings glowed like those of a wild animal, with a peculiar reflection.

He had already spotted Ezekiel, sitting in a tree five or six hundred meters away.

Small-sized aberrations loved climbing trees. Ezekiel was crouched on a thick branch, his long, thick tail dangling behind him, swaying impatiently. The tip of his tail was slightly curled into a small hook.

Dongfang Qingdi thought he looked like a monkey that hadn't finished evolving.

Ezekiel was wearing Divine Court formal wear. It was the kind of outfit one would see in a period drama: a white shirt with a black vest, and the cuffs of the puffed sleeves were decorated with a layer of olive-leaf-shaped lace.

He must have stripped it off someone from the Divine Court; the fabric looked expensive at a glance.

What a waste. Dongfang Qingdi would bet fifty cents that the only thought Xiang Nanli would have upon seeing Ezekiel’s outfit was whether the copper buttons could be melted down to use as electrical wiring.

Ezekiel didn't have mechanical eyes and couldn't scan.

But the wind was blowing from the northwest tonight—a tailwind.

The breeze brought a faint woody sandalwood scent, mixed with a hint of sweet osmanthus—this was Xiang Nanli’s scent, which was rare—and a disgusting smell of machine oil.

He could distinguish the unique scent of every person. When Ezekiel was still an aberration, he could smell the most minute air currents passing over every single one of his scales.

It was said that the five senses of every creature were different.

The purpose was to distinguish what could be eaten and what couldn't.

For example, lions could eat carrion, but humans couldn't. In ancient times, carbon-based monkeys that liked to eat rotten meat would die after eating it, so that gene was naturally selected out. Those who survived were the descendants of carbon-based monkeys that didn't like to eat carrion.

Ezekiel thought that the reason he could smell the disgusting machine oil was definitely because Dongfang Qingdi was inedible.

Perhaps this man was poisonous.

Even though both sides had arrived early, Ezekiel had no intention of appearing early. He was timing it; he wouldn't be early, but he wouldn't be late either.

He didn't want to look like he was looking forward to it.

However, as an aberration from several hundred years ago, Ezekiel knew far too little about the black technology currently controlled by humans.

For instance, in his eyes, Xiang Nanli and Dongfang Qingdi weren't talking at all. But in reality—

[Xiao Qing, you said Ezekiel is already here?]

[Mm, right there.]

The two of them were secretly cheating using technology!

A map of the vicinity was pulled up on the lens, and Xiao Qing had marked a point in orange.

Under the tree lay a one-eyed giant aberration, its body twisted in a strange posture to barely squeeze into the gap between the trees.

Xiao Hong’s hostility toward humans was more obvious; it couldn't help but bare its fangs in Xiang Nanli’s direction.

Unfortunately, the moment its teeth were exposed, it was swatted back by a tail.

[So close. Did you scare them?]

[Huh?]

[You killed their colleague when you were underground before.]

[...]

Eight o'clock at night. Sharp.

Ezekiel stepped out from the shadows.

Xiang Nanli spread his hands to show he had no weapons and smiled: "Long time no see—"

His voice paused for a split second, "Ezekiel."

This kid, Ezekiel, had evolved really fast. The last time he saw him, he was just a monster wearing human skin; now, he actually looked quite handsome.

It was just that his appearance was a bit sinister. Ezekiel’s sclera were black, while his irises were a blood-red.

Ezekiel stopped ten meters away and didn't come any closer, his face just at the edge of the light.

Ezekiel replied coldly: "Mm."

Xiang Nanli’s tone didn't change in the slightest: "I brought you a little gift."

Xiang Nanli crouched down and pulled a spider-like robot from his bag. He had built it on the fly.

The little spider carried a glass vial to Ezekiel’s feet.

"Biochemical soldier serum. It might be useful to you."

It was produced by the Divine Court, capable of creating biochemical soldiers.

Xiang Nanli had never used it. He had given one vial to Beichen as lab supplies.

Ezekiel slowly bent down, picked up the vial, held it up to the light for a moment, opened the stopper to sniff it, and finally replied: "Thank you."

Xiang Nanli observed Ezekiel’s expression: "I heard from Andrew that you’ve been living in this area. I’m quite happy about that. Would you like to come visit the city?"

Ezekiel raised one eyebrow slightly, which showed his disdain for the proposal.

He was an endangered "Stalker"; a city gate couldn't stop him at all.

Eternal City—he had snuck in to look around many times in the middle of the night.

He had even stolen beef patties from the cafeteria; his conclusion was that while they were delicious, their nutritional value was extremely low. It was enough to sustain humans, but not aberrations. Eating that wasn't enough to cover his daily energy expenditure.

Xiang Nanli: "I heard from Ge Gen that they’ve run into Divine Court people several times, and it was the aberrations who drove them away. Regardless of your attitude toward humans, from an objective perspective, you have indeed helped me, and I have always been grateful."

"I know the city walls are non-existent to you, but you haven't come as a guest yet, have you? At the end of this month, after the wheat is harvested, the city will hold a Harvest Festival. You can bring your aberration friends along. Just outside the city, there will be free rice wine." Xiang Nanli said gently, "The base’s philosophy is the coexistence of all intelligent life. This scope includes not just humans and machines, but also aberrations."

"Survival conditions on the surface are harsh; it’s always a cold winter, but we can huddle together for warmth. Ezekiel, you are the base’s best aberration friend. Whether you come or not, the ranch will always exist for you."

What Xiang Nanli said was three parts true and seven parts false.

Xiang Nanli himself wasn't particularly gentle, and all the pretty words he spoke were just a facade.

But his intent was real.

The body was merely a vessel for the soul.

If a monster could communicate with you and had its own thoughts, then to Xiang Nanli, it was a fellow being.

Ezekiel pondered.

chunks.chineseText:
他依旧面无表情，远处传来一阵“狺狺”声，是小红在问他为什么还没回来。

以西结扭头，叫了回去。声波高高低低，大概意思是在说别吵。

他自有安排。

小红是畸变人群体里的老二，身长二十三米，今年三十二岁。

人类最狡猾了！数量也多，明明小得一口都能嚼碎，却会用各种各样的工具。

每次在野外遇到，那些人虽然怕它，却依然会把它打得遍体鳞伤。

小红不喜欢人类。

它也不理解以西结为什么会亲近人类。

但以西结说，这是为了族群的发展。

当狼当然很好，但是狗在全世界却有几百亿条，数量远超狼群。它们失去了一些自由，得到的却是族群的繁盛。宠物狗的寿命和生活质量明显高于野生狼。

自然界淘汰掉的动物不计其数。然而肉眼可见，狗会和人类一起活到末日那天。

当然，举这个例子，并不是以西结想当狗。畸变人和普通人类根本不是一个量级的。不对等的状态很难带来尊重。

他想要的是人类的技术，让更多的畸变体可以变人，减少身体的疼痛。

是的，因为畸变人不会说话，基本没有人知道，畸变人活着的每一天，都在忍受着从身体内部传来的灼热痛感。

它们并不是天性暴躁残虐。

于是，以西结回答：“可以，考虑。”

他的声音有些沙哑。

相南里算是在东方青帝身上练出来了，面对这种沉默寡言的酷哥很有经验。

可以考虑=同意。

相南里抿唇，很轻地笑了一下：“那么我在城里等你。”

*

永恒市。机械装置储存仓库。

平坦的水泥地上，放着一大堆金属零件和机械装置。

这个看起来像是修车厂的杂乱仓库，正在源源不断地生产着城市建设需要的电子设备，效率不比任何一个高端工厂低。

相南里正心无旁骛地进行着计算工作，嘴里念念有词：“固定函数k，用kernel加权……引入参数……”

算着算着，他猛地惊醒，抬头：“现在几点了？小福是不是要好了？”

相南里丢下电子笔，怀着一种兴奋的心情，来到屏幕前，表情像是期待着新生儿降临的产房外的父亲：“小青！小青！快来看，小福要醒了！”

东方青帝“嗯”了一声，脱下手套，又拿出事先准备好的湿巾，擦着手上浸透手套的机油。

仓库基本成了相南里的工作间。除了睡觉，相南里都在这里干活。

偶尔，东方青帝也会来搭把手。

人工智能无所不知。

小青从不会主动找事做，但只要相南里要求，从摩托车维修到母猪的产后护理都不在话下。

也许是因为设备老化，数据转移时间比小青预估得要长。

福音书关机了四天。如今，屏幕上的进度终于到了百分之百。

……

……

小福一直都想拥有一具人类的身体。

当年。它拥有的第一具身体，就是移动困难的超级星舰。因为完整的躯体过于巨大，身体分散在不同的加工厂。

人类小小的，又很灵活，真可爱。手掌心还冰凉凉的！（福音书机体运行用的核能，能源核心始终维持在超高温状态，体内有七套液冷系统，在远离核心区域体表温度可控制在60度左右）

人给自己抹机油，刷防腐漆、温控涂层。

人好。

屑械打人，械坏。

但一直到主动把自己拆分成206块，这个心愿也没有达成过一次。

知道Alpha要给自己换一具身体，小福是这样嘱咐的：“小福要身高185的长腿帅哥。”

“好，去仓库里给你挑一个。”Alpha回答。

尽管在记忆里，永恒之城并没有185的帅哥机器人身体的库存，但小福还是选择了信任它。

毕竟这是Alpha嘛，也许能从其他地方搞来一点好东西呢？

福音书听话地关机了。

它感觉自己做了一个美滋滋的梦，梦里，它有好几次都想挣扎着醒过来。可惜数据传输还没有结束。

慢慢地，它恢复了一些听觉，或者说启动了声控系统。

“嗯，这就是小福的新身体吗？……好帅。”

是里里的声音！

里里说它帅！

至于东方青帝那声不轻不重的“嗯”，则被福音书下意识忽略了。

Alpha，之前真是错怪你了。没想到你竟然真的做到了！

福音书心情激动地睁开眼——

相南里摸着它流线型的金属身体，双眼闪闪发光：“好帅，这辆车。”

是相南里没见过的款式，一千年前根本没有这种技术。

这具身体的身高确实有185cm，但身长460cm。有相对巨型的橡胶轮胎，轮胎表面有复杂的花纹，增加了和地表的摩擦力。

小福鼻子的位置，还长着“高新军工”的车标，是叠在一起的4个菱形。屁股后面有个钩子，能连上运输车厢，完成运输工作。

这是一款无人驾驶车型，名字叫“雄狮号”，研发设计在600年前。如今早已停产。

这辆车没有配备操作舱，小福是实心的。但有个类似袋鼠育儿袋的设计，能够从前方打开，刚好能横着塞进一个冷冻舱。

雄狮号用的是合金，造价一点也不低。兼具实用和防爆功能。

在必要时，车辆的所有者甚至能把自己冷冻，然后把冷冻舱装进车内，躲避战火。

这也是当年高新军工宣传时的一大卖点。

这辆车估计已经用过一段时间了，半新不旧的。

车前灯在此时闪烁了一下。

相南里：“小福开机啦？”

小福看着自己，又看了眼面前的相南里，终于忍不住，“哇”的一声，哭了出来。

He remained expressionless. From the distance came a series of "whining" sounds—it was Xiao Hong, asking why he hadn't returned yet.

Ezekiel turned his head and barked back. The sound waves rose and fell, the general meaning being: *Stop making noise.*

He had his own arrangements.

Xiao Hong was the second-in-command among the Aberrant group, twenty-three meters long and thirty-two years old.

Humans were the most cunning creatures! They were numerous, and despite being so small that one could chew them to bits in a single bite, they knew how to use all sorts of tools.

Every time they encountered humans in the wild, those people would be terrified of it, yet they would still beat it until it was covered in wounds.

Xiao Hong did not like humans.

It also did not understand why Ezekiel would want to get close to them.

But Ezekiel said it was for the development of their kind.

Being a wolf was certainly fine, but there were tens of billions of dogs in the world, far outnumbering the wolf packs. They had lost some of their freedom, but in return, they had gained the prosperity of their species. The lifespan and quality of life for a pet dog were significantly higher than those of a wild wolf.

Countless animals had been eliminated by the natural world. Yet, it was plain to see that dogs would live alongside humans until the day the world ended.

Of course, using this example didn't mean Ezekiel wanted to be a dog. Aberrants and ordinary humans were simply not on the same level. An unequal status rarely brought respect.

What he wanted was human technology, to allow more Aberrants to become human and reduce the burning pain that radiated from within their bodies.

Yes, because Aberrants could not speak, almost no one knew that every day they lived, they were enduring a scorching, searing pain from deep within their own bodies.

They were not inherently irritable or cruel.

And so, Ezekiel replied, "Possible. Consider."

His voice was somewhat hoarse.

Xiang Nanli had essentially been "trained" by Dongfang Qingdi; he had plenty of experience dealing with such taciturn, cool-headed types.

*Possible to consider* = *Agreed.*

Xiang Nanli pursed his lips and smiled faintly. "Then I will wait for you in the city."

*

Eternal City. Mechanical Equipment Storage Warehouse.

On the flat concrete floor lay a massive pile of metal parts and mechanical devices.

This cluttered warehouse, which looked like an auto repair shop, was churning out the electronic equipment needed for the city's construction with an efficiency that rivaled any high-end factory.

Xiang Nanli was focused entirely on his calculations, muttering to himself: "Fixed function k, use kernel weighting... introduce parameter..."

In the middle of his calculations, he suddenly snapped to attention and looked up. "What time is it? Is Xiao Fu almost ready?"

Xiang Nanli tossed aside his electronic pen and, filled with excitement, walked to the screen. His expression was like that of a father outside a delivery room, anticipating the birth of a newborn. "Xiao Qing! Xiao Qing! Come look, Xiao Fu is about to wake up!"

Dongfang Qingdi gave a soft "Mm," took off his gloves, and pulled out a pre-prepared wet wipe to clean the machine oil that had soaked through his gloves.

The warehouse had basically become Xiang Nanli’s workshop. Aside from sleeping, Xiang Nanli worked here all the time.

Occasionally, Dongfang Qingdi would come to lend a hand.

Artificial intelligence was omniscient.

Xiao Qing never took the initiative to find things to do, but as long as Xiang Nanli requested it, everything from motorcycle repair to postpartum care for sows was well within its capabilities.

Perhaps because the equipment was aging, the data transfer time was longer than Xiao Qing had estimated.

The Gospel had been shut down for four days. Now, the progress on the screen had finally reached one hundred percent.

...

...

Xiao Fu had always wanted to possess a human body.

Back in the day, the first body it possessed was a super starship that had difficulty moving. Because the complete frame was too massive, its body had been scattered across different processing plants.

Humans were so small and so agile—truly cute. Their palms were even cool to the touch! (The nuclear energy used to run the Gospel’s chassis kept its energy core in a state of ultra-high temperature; there were seven liquid cooling systems inside, and the surface temperature far from the core area could be controlled to around 60 degrees Celsius.)

Humans applied machine oil to themselves, brushed on anti-corrosion paint, and temperature-control coatings.

Humans were good.

Scrap metal hit humans, and the metal broke.

But even until the point it voluntarily dismantled itself into 206 pieces, this wish had never been fulfilled once.

Knowing that Alpha was going to get it a new body, Xiao Fu had instructed: "Xiao Fu wants a long-legged handsome guy, 185cm tall."

"Fine, I’ll go pick one out in the warehouse," Alpha replied.

Although in its memory, the Eternal City did not have a stock of 185cm handsome robot bodies, Xiao Fu chose to trust him.

After all, this was Alpha. Maybe he could get some good stuff from somewhere else?

The Gospel obediently shut down.

It felt as if it had a wonderful dream, a dream where it tried to struggle to wake up several times. Unfortunately, the data transmission had not yet finished.

Slowly, it regained some hearing, or rather, activated its voice-control system.

"Mm, is this Xiao Fu’s new body? ...So handsome."

It was Lili’s voice!

Lili said it was handsome!

As for Dongfang Qingdi’s indifferent "Mm," the Gospel subconsciously ignored it.

Alpha, I really wronged you before. I didn't expect you to actually pull it off!

The Gospel opened its eyes in excitement—

Xiang Nanli was stroking its streamlined metal body, his eyes sparkling. "So handsome, this car."

It was a model Xiang Nanli had never seen before; this kind of technology didn't exist a thousand years ago.

This body was indeed 185cm tall, but it was 460cm long. It had relatively giant rubber tires with complex patterns on the surface to increase friction with the ground.

Where Xiao Fu’s nose should have been, there was a "High-Tech Military Industry" logo—four diamonds stacked together. There was a hook behind its rear that could connect to a transport carriage to complete hauling tasks.

This was an unmanned vehicle model called the "Lion," designed and developed 600 years ago. It had long since been discontinued.

This vehicle was not equipped with an operating cabin; Xiao Fu was solid. However, it had a design similar to a kangaroo’s pouch that could be opened from the front, just enough to fit a cryo-pod horizontally.

The Lion was made of alloy, and its production cost was not low at all. It combined practicality with blast-proof features.

In times of necessity, the vehicle’s owner could even freeze themselves, place the cryo-pod inside the vehicle, and hide from the flames of war.

This had been a major selling point in the advertisements for High-Tech Military Industry back in the day.

This vehicle had likely been used for a while; it was neither brand new nor completely worn out.

The headlights flickered at this moment.

Xiang Nanli: "Is Xiao Fu powered on?"

Xiao Fu looked at itself, then looked at Xiang Nanli in front of it, and finally couldn't help it—it let out a "waah" and started to cry.

chunks.chineseText:
第86章 基地很缺钱

原本是可爱的童音小狗，现在感觉随时能表演一个胸口碎大石。

从红孩儿变成了牛魔王。

“小福？”相南里的表情顿时充满疑惑，“怎么了，是哪里不舒服吗？”

小福和Alpha开始了智械人特有的脑电波信号交流。

[你怎么能骗我？可恶的战犯。你摧毁了我对你的信任！]

Alpha的风凉话一向不缺：[这车轮胎这么大，难道不是你要的185长腿帅哥？]

是啊。身高185，身长460。

小福再也不用思考相南里身上哪个位置最好靠了；也没办法在相南里上班的时候，窝在对方怀里，蹭他下巴了。更不用考虑相南里睡着的时候，趴在床尾，跟着一起睡觉了。

小福：[#@#%￥@￥#@#%……]

小福传回来一堆乱码，看起来确实气得不轻。

于是，Alpha只好坦白：[这个型号能装一个冷冻舱。]

[所以？]

[也许有天能用上。我们都是电子生命，身体只是可以更换的载具。但人类不一样。]

Alpha说的很简略，但福音书却听懂了他的言下之意。

[看来你对自己的能力没什么信心呢，竟然算到需要我带着相南里逃命。]

[我当然不希望有这么一天，但我不是万能的神。适当的保障是很有必要的。]Alpha平静地回答。

或许，在找不到相南里的漫长岁月中，学会正视自己的无能，是Alpha必修的一门课程。

痛苦吗？

当然。

但比起失去，还是承认自己的无能更舒服一点。

而且，跟在相南里身边这么久，Alpha别的没学会，画饼技术却日趋成熟：[福音书。你是一台正直、勇敢、守信的智械。尽管我不认同你的理念，但我相信你的品格。]

于是，福音书沉默了2kb的流量后：[好吧，我可以妥协。]

[但把我的声音还回来！]

在福音书停顿的3秒里，两台智械暗流涌动，但最终还是达成了认知上的一致。

*

姑苏城。

永生科技生物研究所。

李斯特的唇偏薄，颜色也很淡。他的下眼睑位置有一颗小痣，位于正中。眼眸狭长，显得有些薄情。

不知道为什么，李斯特总觉得镜子里的这张脸很陌生。

但他在网上搜过自己的信息，无论是视频还是新闻，甚至过去的学生证，上面都是这张脸——作为顶级学者，他留给外界的资料很少。

当然，不排除内容都被篡改的可能。

但这样未免代价太大。

而且李斯特也想不出修改的目的是什么。

李斯特还在行李箱里翻到了一些药物，是治疗精神分裂的。还有一份长达25年的病历，上面说他睡眠紊乱，偶尔会出现幻想。分不清梦境与现实。

而他醒来时，面前陌生的医生告诉他，说他接受了一次催眠治疗，可能会忘掉一些事。

另外，他之前在家关掉了安保系统，把独栋小别墅点燃想自杀。是安保组把他救回来的。

李斯特全身重度烧伤，放在数百年前属于不治之症。但现在，从基因药里出来的他光洁如新。

他的脸时不时会疼一下。有一种灼热的痛感。医生说，这是因为面部皮肤比较薄，修复后也会有些神经性损伤。是正常现象，让他不用在意。

原来我有神经病。

李斯特想。

有如此严重的精神疾病，可我依然是永生科技的首席科学家。

这种感觉让李斯特心情非常的微妙。

李斯特握着一罐高浓度的咖啡，走在通向自己工位的路上。他明明没怎么经过机械改造，走路时却悄无声息。

他路过工位，改造过的耳蜗不合时宜地听见了一点议论声。

“大魔王不是很好相处的样子……”

“倒也没有，他只是不喜欢说话，而且我们在他眼里，可能有些蠢吧……”

“不过，公司为什么要把大魔王外派到我们姑苏城。是不是上面那个位置要换人了？”

“这都不是我们这种月薪三十万的人该考虑的事。”

李斯特速度没有丝毫改变地路过，然后举起手里的罐装咖啡，小酌一口。

宛如中药的苦涩味道在口腔里弥漫开来。

李斯特推开实验室的门，周围人瞬间站起，微微低头，语气带着敬意：“主任。”

这是李斯特。第一位活着拿到人联最高科技奖的李斯特。

顺带一提，这个科技奖的第一任获奖者是相南里。不过那时候他已经去世许久。

李斯特朝着培育室走去：“进度。”

平日趾高气昂的教授捧着记录本，快速跟在他身后：“这里是1组，我们成功从自然成熟状态中的黑丝粉菌内部提取出活性物质。”

“2组。对照发现，这种菌丝对γ射线感知最敏锐，且在核辐射强度为*时活性最强，能吸收多种高能电磁波和粒子。”

……

一组组的实验记录被有条不紊地念出来。

其实这些资料，在昨天夜里十点半，就整理发到了李斯特的邮箱。不过他显然还没打开看过。

听说李斯特下班后从来不管实验进度，想来应该不是谣言。

终于，培育室到了。

血红色的菌丝交织成蛛网，挂在巨大的玻璃幕墙上。一根根细丝如同会呼吸的血肉，互相交织着。新长出的地方是柔软的粉色。但大多数地方，却是硬质的红色。

这个玻璃盒如此巨大。

助手屏住呼吸：“主任。你有听说那个消息吗……调查组的人从外面带回来一种药。说是地表的人研发的……？”

很多研究所都对此不屑一顾。地表，出了名的落后。能有什么好东西。说不定又是来骗经费的。在这些人眼中，哪怕世界毁灭，他们也有诺亚方舟的船票。就算外面洪水滔天，自己家也会是最后才被淹的。自然不够着急。

但也有一些研究所，不愿意放弃任何希望，加班加点的完成了对照实验与活体实验。

李斯特：“嗯？”

“是一种抑制剂。”助手继续道，“可以用来遏制体内菌丝的活性。减缓感染者的畸变速度。”

李斯特：“哦。”

助手：“我在桃源集团的同学传回来的消息，说效果还挺明显的。活性菌丝立刻停止了生长。不过这一情况还没来得及向外汇报。”

她也是李斯特来之前刚接收到的消息。

李斯特“嗯”了一声，没有任何反应。

助手有些尴尬道：“主任，这好像跟我们是同一个思路。”

科研，总是如此尴尬。

大家的目的是一样的，但每个实验室的想法和过程不尽相同。

而当有某个实验室先一步发现成果后，其他实验室的所有努力和投入都不再重要。都是竞争中的失败者。

从经济学的角度看，这是一场零和博弈。

他们的实验进度已经很快了，甚至只差最后一步。但这一步需要时间的沉淀。
chunks.englishText:
第86章 基地很缺钱 (Part 1)

It had been a cute, puppy-like child, but now it felt like it could perform a "smashing a boulder on the chest" act at any moment.

It had transformed from a Red Boy into the Bull Demon King.

"Xiao Fu?" Xiang Nanli’s expression was suddenly filled with confusion. "What’s wrong? Are you uncomfortable somewhere?"

Xiao Fu and Alpha began the brainwave signal exchange unique to intelligent machines.

[How could you lie to me? You detestable war criminal. You have destroyed my trust in you!]

Alpha’s snide remarks were never in short supply: [The tires on this vehicle are so big; isn't that the 185cm long-legged handsome guy you wanted?]

Yes, it was. 185cm tall, 460cm long.

Xiao Fu would never again have to think about which part of Xiang Nanli was the best to lean against; it couldn't curl up in his arms and rub against his chin while he was working. And there was no need to consider curling up at the foot of the bed to sleep with him when Xiang Nanli was asleep.

Xiao Fu: [#@#%￥@￥#@#%……]

Xiao Fu transmitted a bunch of garbled code; it clearly looked furious.

Alpha had no choice but to confess: [This model can fit a cryo-pod.]

[So?]

[Perhaps one day it will be useful. We are both electronic lifeforms; the body is just a replaceable vehicle. But humans are different.]

Alpha’s explanation was brief, but the Gospel understood the subtext.

[It seems you have little confidence in your own abilities, to have calculated that you might need me to carry Xiang Nanli to escape.]

[I certainly don't hope for such a day, but I am not an omnipotent god. Proper safeguards are essential,] Alpha replied calmly.

Perhaps, during the long years of not being able to find Xiang Nanli, learning to face his own incompetence had been a mandatory course for Alpha.

Was it painful?

Of course.

But admitting his own incompetence was more comfortable than the feeling of loss.

Moreover, having been by Xiang Nanli’s side for so long, Alpha hadn't learned much else, but his skill at "painting a pie in the sky" (making empty promises) had matured significantly: [Gospel. You are an upright, brave, and trustworthy machine. Although I do not agree with your philosophy, I believe in your character.]

And so, after 2kb of silence from the Gospel: [Fine, I can compromise.]

[But give me back my voice!]

In the three seconds of the Gospel’s pause, the two machines experienced an undercurrent of tension, but ultimately reached a consensus.

*

Gusu City.

Eternal Life Technology Biological Research Institute.

Lister’s lips were thin and pale. There was a small mole in the center of his lower eyelid. His eyes were long and narrow, giving him a somewhat cold and indifferent look.

For some reason, Lister always felt that the face in the mirror was a stranger.

But he had searched for his own information online; whether it was videos, news, or even his old student ID, they all showed this face—as a top-tier scholar, he had left very little information for the outside world.

Of course, the possibility that the content had been tampered with could not be ruled out.

But that would be too high a price to pay.

And Lister couldn't think of what the purpose of such a modification would be.

Lister also found some medication in his suitcase, meant for treating schizophrenia. There was also a medical record spanning 25 years, stating that he suffered from sleep disorders and occasionally experienced hallucinations, unable to distinguish between dreams and reality.

When he woke up, a strange doctor in front of him told him that he had undergone hypnotherapy and might have forgotten some things.

Additionally, he had previously turned off the security system at home and set his villa on fire in an attempt to commit suicide. It was the security team that had saved him.

Lister had suffered severe burns over his entire body, which would have been incurable a few hundred years ago. But now, having emerged from the genetic medicine, he was as smooth as new.

His face would ache from time to time. There was a scorching, burning sensation. The doctor said it was because the facial skin was relatively thin and there was some nerve damage after the repair. It was a normal phenomenon, and he shouldn't worry about it.

*So I am mentally ill.*

Lister thought.

*With such a severe mental illness, I am still the Chief Scientist of Eternal Life Technology.*

This feeling left Lister in a very subtle mood.

Lister held a can of high-concentration coffee, walking toward his workstation. Even though he hadn't undergone much mechanical modification, his footsteps were silent.

He passed by a workstation, and his modified cochlea caught a snippet of conversation that was quite out of place.

"The Great Demon King doesn't seem very easy to get along with..."

"Not really, he just doesn't like to talk, and in his eyes, we might be a bit stupid..."

"Still, why did the company send the Great Demon King to our Gusu City? Is the position above about to change hands?"

"That’s not something for people with a monthly salary of 300,000 to consider."

Lister passed by without changing his speed, then raised the canned coffee in his hand and took a small sip.

The bitterness, akin to traditional Chinese medicine, spread through his mouth.

Lister pushed open the laboratory door. Everyone around him stood up, lowered their heads slightly, and said with respect, "Director."

This was Lister. The first Lister to receive the United Humanity’s highest science and technology award while still alive.

Incidentally, the first recipient of this award had been Xiang Nanli. However, he had been dead for a long time by then.

Lister walked toward the cultivation room. "Progress."

The professor, who was usually arrogant, clutched a notebook and followed quickly behind him. "This is Group 1. We have successfully extracted the active substance from the black-silk powder fungus in its naturally mature state."

"Group 2. The control group found that this mycelium is most sensitive to gamma rays, and its activity is strongest when the nuclear radiation intensity is at *, capable of absorbing various high-energy electromagnetic waves and particles."

...

The experimental records of each group were read out in an orderly fashion.

In fact, this data had been organized and sent to Lister’s inbox at 10:30 last night. However, he clearly hadn't opened it yet.

It was rumored that Lister never cared about experimental progress after getting off work; it seemed that wasn't just a rumor.

Finally, they reached the cultivation room.

Blood-red mycelium was interwoven like a spider web, hanging on the massive glass curtain wall. Each thin thread looked like breathing flesh, intertwined with one another. The newly grown parts were a soft pink, but most of the area was a hard, red substance.

This glass box was enormous.

The assistant held her breath. "Director. Have you heard the news... the investigation team brought back a type of medicine from the outside. They say it was developed by people on the surface...?"

Many research institutes were disdainful of this. The surface was notoriously backward. What good things could they possibly have? Perhaps it was just another attempt to scam funding. In the eyes of these people, even if the world ended, they had tickets for Noah’s Ark. Even if the world outside was flooded, their own homes would be the last to be submerged. Naturally, they weren't worried.

But there were also some research institutes that were unwilling to give up any hope and worked overtime to complete control experiments and live-subject tests.

Lister: "Hm?"

"It’s an inhibitor," the assistant continued. "It can be used to suppress the activity of the mycelium in the body. It slows down the rate of aberration in infected individuals."

Lister: "Oh."

Assistant: "The news came back from my classmate at the Taoyuan Group, saying the effect is quite significant. The active mycelium stopped growing immediately. However, this situation hasn't been reported to the outside yet."

She had also just received the news shortly before Lister arrived.

Lister gave an "Mm," without any reaction.

The assistant said awkwardly, "Director, this seems to be the same approach as ours."

Scientific research was always so awkward.

Everyone’s goal was the same, but the ideas and processes of each laboratory were different.

And when one laboratory discovered the results first, all the efforts and investments of other laboratories no longer mattered. They were all losers in the competition.

From an economic perspective, this was a zero-sum game.

Their experimental progress was already very fast, even just one step away from the end. But this step required the accumulation of time.

chunks.chineseText:
和那些根本摸不着头脑的实验室相比，他们有天然的优势。起码得到样品，加以分析，或许能直接分析出配方。

但对李斯特来说，配方其实并不重要。因为他早就模拟出来了，他知道答案，只是不太清楚如何获得那样的原料。

助手小声道：“是地表的研究成果，说不定是邪庭那边的烟雾弹。要不然我们……抢注吧？”

抢注。抢先一步发论文或者抢先一步进行专利注册。是很常见的商业手段，尤其是在研究方向相同时。甚至都不算太肮脏。

这么做，是为了让这项研究的利益最大化。

一种药，或许成本只需要10信用点，但因为有专利，企业可以根据市场的需求，把它卖到几千、几万甚至更多。目前，人联的专利有效期是70年。

投资带来的回报如此迷人。

“我们是学者，不是商人。”李斯特回答，“成本、盈亏，这是投资方考虑事情。就算亏到破产，那也只是他们投资失败，和我们的研究没有任何关系。不要干这么龌龊的事情。比钱和名更贵重的，是作为学者的心境。”

这一心境，对每个人都有不同的含义。比如一往无前的勇气，相信自己必定会成功的信心。

助手想，那必然是因为李斯特不缺钱，才能说出这么漂亮好听的话。

但转念一想，自己也拿的死工资，顶多再加一些提成和补贴。于是也赞同地点了点头。

李斯特盯着面前的培养皿，许久后，开口：“样品你们用过了吗？”

“第七组去做了，我这就问问。”

资料很快传了回来。

这种不知名抑制剂的效果很好，起码原本在病床躺着等死的被试，体内的菌丝竟然真的停止了进一步生长。维持了一种奇妙的平衡。

第七组负责人微微低头：“送来的样品的剂量很少，我们是联系到其他研究所，进行不同方向的测试。共享研究报告的。”

“嗯。”李斯特回答。

几分钟后，他继续道：“那个调查员带来的资料发给我。”

李斯特提着那罐黑咖啡，坐在了办公室里。他打开工作邮箱，点进整理好的地表调查报告。

报告记录了一个叫永恒市的地表据点。说这个据点被一个叫做幸存者基地的成员占领。

而基地来源是六百年前，某一大型企业的冷冻项目。

调查员认为，这一城市的发展水平还较为原始；但的确掌握着不知名的生物科技。并且附上了菌牛的照片。

“基地成员态度友善，且明显知晓人联的存在，愿意归顺人联。威胁评价：E。发展潜力：A。永恒市宜居指数：3.9星。特批100万信用点作为资助。”

李斯特喃喃：“600年前……东皇重工吗？”

还记得这段历史的人已经不多。

考虑到姑苏城之前还发现了东皇重工的遗址，这一猜测竟然相当合理。

剩下的就是宝贵的抑制剂样本，和一个小程序。

报告里说，这是实验记录……？

嗯，根据清道夫的检测，这个程序很安全，大小就255字节。

李斯特迟疑地打开了这个小程序。

屏幕的蓝光反射到了他的镜片上。

这居然是一封信。

【尊敬的领导：】

【您好！】

【很高兴以这样的方式和你见面。】

【基地很缺钱，有意售卖抑制剂的制作方法。】

【可以不要任何署名权！也就是说你们对外宣称是自己研究的也没问题哦！当然，这是另外的价钱。】（注：这条是加粗的红色）

【报价请点这个链接：[链接]】

【请附上联系方式，报价通过后，我们会第一时间发来回复函。】

【幸存者基地·宣】

李斯特：“……”
chunks.englishText:
第86章 基地很缺钱 (Part 2)

Compared to those laboratories that were completely clueless, they had a natural advantage. At the very least, having obtained the sample and analyzing it might allow them to deduce the formula directly.

But for Lister, the formula wasn't actually important. Because he had already simulated it; he knew the answer, he just wasn't quite sure how to obtain those raw materials.

The assistant whispered, "It’s a research result from the surface; it might be a smokescreen from the Evil Court. Why don't we... preemptively register it?"

Preemptive registration. Registering a paper or a patent before others. It was a very common business tactic, especially when the research direction was the same. It wasn't even considered particularly dirty.

Doing so was to maximize the benefits of this research.

A medicine might only cost 10 credits to produce, but because of the patent, a company could sell it for thousands, tens of thousands, or even more, depending on market demand. Currently, the patent validity period for United Humanity was 70 years.

The returns brought by investment were so alluring.

"We are scholars, not merchants," Lister replied. "Costs, profits, and losses are things for investors to consider. Even if they go bankrupt, that’s just a failure of their investment and has nothing to do with our research. Do not do such sordid things. What is more precious than money and fame is the state of mind of a scholar."

This state of mind had different meanings for everyone. For example, the courage to forge ahead, or the confidence in believing one would surely succeed.

The assistant thought that it must be because Lister wasn't short of money that he could say such beautiful, pleasant-sounding things.

But then, she thought about her own fixed salary, plus some commissions and subsidies at most, and nodded in agreement.

Lister stared at the petri dish in front of him, and after a long time, he spoke: "Have you used the samples?"

"Group 7 went to do it; I’ll ask right now."

The data was transmitted back quickly.

The effect of this unknown inhibitor was very good; at least the test subjects who were lying in hospital beds waiting to die actually saw the mycelium in their bodies stop growing further. It maintained a wonderful balance.

The head of Group 7 lowered his head slightly: "The dose of the sample sent was very small. We contacted other research institutes to conduct tests in different directions. We are sharing the research reports."

"Mm," Lister replied.

A few minutes later, he continued: "Send me the information the investigator brought back."

Lister carried his can of black coffee and sat in his office. He opened his work email and clicked into the organized surface investigation report.

The report recorded a surface stronghold called Eternal City. It said that this stronghold had been occupied by members of something called the "Survivor Base."

And the base’s origin was a cryogenics project from a large corporation six hundred years ago.

The investigator believed that the development level of this city was still relatively primitive, but it did indeed possess unknown biological technology. It also attached photos of the "fungus cattle."

"Base members are friendly and clearly aware of the existence of United Humanity, willing to submit to United Humanity. Threat assessment: E. Development potential: A. Eternal City livability index: 3.9 stars. Specially approved 1 million credits as funding."

Lister muttered: "600 years ago... Donghuang Heavy Industries?"

There weren't many people left who remembered that period of history.

Considering that the ruins of Donghuang Heavy Industries had been discovered in Gusu City before, this guess was actually quite reasonable.

The rest were the precious inhibitor samples and a small program.

The report said this was experimental data...?

Hm, according to the Scavenger’s detection, this program was very safe, with a size of only 255 bytes.

Lister hesitated and opened the small program.

The blue light of the screen reflected onto his lenses.

This was actually a letter.

【Respected Leader:】

【Hello!】

【I am very happy to meet you in this way.】

【The base is very short on money and is interested in selling the production method for the inhibitor.】

【We don't need any authorship rights! In other words, it’s fine if you claim to the outside world that you researched it yourselves! Of course, that would be for an additional fee.】 (Note: This line is in bold red)

【Please click this link for a quote: [Link]】

【Please attach your contact information. Once the quote is approved, we will send a reply letter as soon as possible.】

【Survivor Base · Announcement】

Lister: "..."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第87章 崽卖爷田不心疼 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第87章 崽卖爷田不心疼

这件事很快在姑苏城各大研究所内部，掀起一阵轻微的涟漪。

易横行从地表带回来的抑制剂数量不多，一共就8家研究所分到了样品。

有意思的是，这8家刚好是人联排名前8的大型企业。每家都占据了人联相当大的商业版图与话语权。

这些大型企业还是每个普通人梦寐以求的好去处。

因为企业一般采取签终生雇佣制，从工作收入到子女教育到养老都由企业负责。能入职就等于拿到一张中产的门票。

终生雇佣本来是一种剥削制度。谁能想在新时代，竟然会成为令人趋之若鹜的福利。

各个群聊、私聊里，隐秘的信息传递着，暗潮涌动。

“你们实验室有报价吗？”

“嗯？”

“都这么多年老同学了，别装。”

“永生科技怎么说？”

“谁敢去问大魔王。”

有权限参与这件事的人不多，古神生物的姑苏城负责人群发消息：“没有一个人愿意摊开说，那就由我来说吧。姑苏城目前菌丝感染的情况非常严重，我们不能再拖了。再拖下去只会显得各个实验室无能。但关于报价，我劝大家慎重考虑。”

“因为，竞争是无止境的。而且只要样本足够，破解配方只是早晚的事。任何一家竞价都没有必要。我建议各大企业联合起来，宣称抑制剂为联合研发。这也会成为很好的宣传材料。”

看到这的时候，李斯特不由得推了推自己的镜框。

“没那么简单。”他在心里想着。

哪怕是他，也不敢保证一定能破译出来。

人如何去生产自己没见过的东西；他怀疑那种活性物质只存在于地表。甚至只存在于基地培育出的特殊菌体上……

毕竟就调查员传回来的资料，牧场里的那些菌丝生命体，和地底这些感染菌丝人，就有性状上的细微差异。

绕了这么大一圈，这位负责人终于图穷匕见：“姑苏人实在需要抑制剂，但我们不能纵容这种行为；这是对各大企业的挑衅。每家企业各出20万吧。加起来一共160万。”

他的话，得到了桃源牧业等多家生物科技集团的赞成。

在线上全息的会议室里，每个人都如此年轻、健康且衣冠楚楚。

“可是老王，万一有别人竞价比我们高怎么办？”

老王冷笑：“我们不买，那些小实验室也不敢买。它们要是真的高价买了，大可把事情捅出去，让这种不长眼的小企业名誉扫地。深陷舆论风波，股价怎么也得跌停几天。就看它们的决策者有没有这种和我们作对的勇气了。”

160万这个价格看起来不少。但仔细一想，其实挺侮辱人。

比如李斯特就知道，提出这条建议的古神生物PD，年薪就有880万。

李斯特年薪12万。但他有自家公司的股份分红，还有各种奖金补贴。每个月差不多拿八百万吧。

工资那么高干什么，还要交高税。

按照人联法律，年薪超过500万的部分要上交百分之50的个人所得税。股份分红只需要交百分之三的资产税。

而对于一家巨无霸垄断企业来说，160万就更不是钱了。

会议聊了一轮，老王把目光转向了李斯特：“李导觉得呢？”

虽然大家的学者职称都差不多，但李斯特在学术界的地位，比他们高好几个等级。更别提背后站着的还是永生科技。

人联发展的历史，永生科技起码参与了一半。大家顶多为争谁是老二打得头破血流，却从来没人敢去觊觎上面的位置。

李斯特目光涣散：“嗯。”

说了当没说。

“那么这件事，由我负责？请放心，我会让古神生物的律师团去沟通的。实在不行，还可以派安保组去一趟永恒市。”

很快，一份联合倡议书被送到了李斯特的面前。李斯特扫了眼，大概意思是共同购买专利，抵制恶性竞争，每家企业出价20万。

拿到制作方法后，药物销售各凭本事。

第一批当然是供给姑苏城官方，毕竟一半的研究启动资金都是姑苏城自掏腰包。但姑苏城那么多人——总有人轮不到官方药剂的。还有人想囤货居奇的。

最终，自由市场会让价格和供需走向平衡。

李斯特无所谓地签上了自己的电子ID码。

这种倡议书和正规的合同不是一个性质的，没什么法律效应。更何况，哪怕签了合同，也有得掰扯呢。

李斯特退出线上会议室。转身，进了实验室。

他想试试，能不能找到串联所有线索的最后一环。

转眼，时间又过了一周。

李斯特起床，穿上了防护服。

防护服的价格，在城内也炒得很高了。

原价三万多一套的衣服，现在炒到了七八万一套。

学校停学，超市停业。空气中因为菌丝浓度过高，在模拟日光的照射下，蒙上一层浅浅的粉色。

一些比较潮湿的地方，比如墙角、下水道。已经长出了这种黑丝粉菌。长出来的真菌像一条条血管。中空，底部粉白，顶端深红。还会随着风轻轻晃动。

李斯特开车，前往研究所。路上的行人寥寥无几，只剩机器环卫工在消杀。最近配备的消毒水对人都有一些轻微的毒性。

菌丝得到了一定程度的遏制，但很可惜，并不能完全杀死它。

每栋居民楼的灯都亮着，平时需要收费的奶头乐产业在此时通通免费。就怕这些人心情一个大崩溃然后去跳楼。

李斯特正这么想着，就看见街边有辆警车听着。自杀干预员有气无力地喊着：“你别想不开。想想你的老婆孩子，想想你的父母。”

楼顶的人大哭：“我老婆孩子都感染了，我父母一个月前就畸变了。”

就连他自己，皮肤底下也冒出了细细的菌丝。在皮肤表面长出一个个红色的小疙瘩。这是感染二期的症状，会表现地更像皮肤病。

小疙瘩溃烂后，红色的菌体会从里面冒出。听说很痛。

人会在这个阶段死亡。但死后，身体依然会在菌丝的操控下保持一定的活性。用于传染、攻击更多人。

“我知道你很痛苦，我也是。我们都是，但一定会好起来的……”说着说着，干预员自己也哭了起来。

讽刺的是，他们说这话的时候，大楼外立面的屏幕正在播放着古神生物实验室PD的采访。对，就是之前提议的王老头。

老王坐在演播室：“最近，各个研究所的实验进度喜人，我们已经发现了一种可以遏制菌丝生长的活性因子。”

他之前也是这么和人联官员解释的。所以被推了出来。

如果真的发现了，老王会是英雄。

如果没有。他的学术生涯大概到头了。

姑苏城目前的负责人是洛修，这个年轻人虽然好糊弄，但背后的洛家可不是好说话的人。

有句话叫“善战者无赫赫之功”。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 87: Selling Ancestral Land Without a Twinge of Heartache (Part 1)

This matter soon sent a subtle ripple through the major research institutes in Gusu City.

The quantity of inhibitor that Yi Hengxing had brought back from the surface was small; only eight research institutes had managed to secure samples.

Interestingly, these eight happened to be the top eight large-scale enterprises within the Human Alliance. Each occupied a significant portion of the Alliance’s commercial landscape and held considerable sway.

For the average person, these large enterprises were the dream destination for employment.

Because these companies generally implemented a lifetime employment system, they took responsibility for everything from work income and children’s education to retirement. Securing a position was effectively obtaining a ticket to the middle class.

Lifetime employment was originally a form of exploitative system. Who would have thought that in this new era, it would become a benefit that people would flock to?

In various group chats and private messages, secret information was being passed around, and undercurrents were surging.

"Did your lab get a quote?"

"Hm?"

"We’ve been old classmates for so many years, don't play dumb."

"What does Eternal Life Technology say?"

"Who would dare ask the Great Demon King?"
