There were few people with the authority to participate in this matter. The person in charge of the Gusu City branch of Ancient God Biology sent a mass message: "Since no one is willing to lay their cards on the table, I will do it. The mycelial infection in Gusu City is currently very serious; we cannot delay any longer. Any further delay will only make every lab look incompetent. However, regarding the quote, I advise everyone to consider it carefully."

"Because competition is endless. And as long as there are enough samples, cracking the formula is only a matter of time. There is no need for any one company to engage in a bidding war. I suggest that the major enterprises join forces and declare the inhibitor a joint research project. This will also serve as excellent promotional material."

Seeing this, Lister couldn't help but push up his glasses.

"It’s not that simple," he thought to himself.

Even he could not guarantee that he would definitely be able to decipher it.

How could humans produce something they had never seen before? He suspected that the active substance existed only on the surface, or perhaps only on the special fungal bodies cultivated by the base...

After all, according to the data sent back by the investigators, the mycelial life forms in the pastures had subtle phenotypic differences from the infected mycelial humans underground.

After circling around such a long way, this person in charge finally revealed his true intent: "The people of Gusu truly need the inhibitor, but we cannot indulge this kind of behavior; it is a provocation to the major enterprises. Let each company contribute 200,000. That adds up to 1.6 million in total."

His words were met with approval from Taoyuan Pastures and several other biotechnology groups.

In the online holographic conference room, everyone appeared so young, healthy, and impeccably dressed.

"But Old Wang, what if someone else bids higher than us?"

Old Wang sneered, "If we don't buy, those small labs won't dare to buy either. If they really do buy it at a high price, we can just leak the matter and let these short-sighted small enterprises have their reputations ruined. Once they are mired in a public opinion crisis, their stock prices will surely hit the limit down for days. It just depends on whether their decision-makers have the courage to go against us."

1.6 million seemed like a lot. But upon closer inspection, it was actually quite insulting.

For instance, Lister knew that the PD of Ancient God Biology who proposed this had an annual salary of 8.8 million.

Lister’s annual salary was 120,000. But he had dividends from his own company’s shares, along with various bonuses and subsidies. He brought in about 8 million a month.

Why have such a high salary? To pay high taxes.

According to Human Alliance law, the portion of an annual salary exceeding 5 million was subject to a 50% personal income tax. Share dividends only required a 3% asset tax.

And for a behemoth monopoly enterprise, 1.6 million was even less than pocket change.

The meeting went on for a round, and Old Wang turned his gaze to Lister: "What does Director Lister think?"

Although everyone’s academic titles were similar, Lister’s status in the academic world was several levels higher than theirs. Not to mention that behind him stood Eternal Life Technology.

In the history of the Human Alliance’s development, Eternal Life Technology had participated in at least half of it. Everyone else fought tooth and nail to be the runner-up, but no one dared to covet the position at the top.

Lister’s gaze was unfocused: "Hmm."

He said it as if he hadn't said anything at all.

"Then, shall I be responsible for this? Please rest assured, I will have Ancient God Biology’s legal team handle the communication. If that doesn't work, we can even send a security team to Eternal City."

Soon, a joint proposal was delivered to Lister. Lister scanned it; the general idea was to jointly purchase the patent, resist vicious competition, and have each company bid 200,000.

After obtaining the production method, drug sales would depend on each company's own ability.

The first batch would, of course, be supplied to the Gusu City authorities, as half of the research startup funds had come out of Gusu City’s own pocket. But there were so many people in Gusu City—there would always be those who couldn't get the official medicine. And there were those who wanted to hoard goods for speculation.

In the end, the free market would allow prices and supply and demand to reach an equilibrium.

Lister signed his electronic ID code without caring.

This kind of proposal was not the same as a formal contract and had no legal effect. Besides, even if a contract were signed, there would still be plenty to argue about.

Lister exited the online conference room. He turned and entered the laboratory.

He wanted to see if he could find the final link that would connect all the clues.

In the blink of an eye, another week passed.

Lister got up and put on his protective suit.

The price of protective suits had also been driven up very high within the city.

A suit that originally cost 30,000 now sold for 70,000 to 80,000.

Schools were closed, and supermarkets had ceased operations. Because the concentration of mycelium in the air was too high, it was veiled in a faint pink under the simulated sunlight.

In some damp places, such as wall corners and sewers, this black-silk pink fungus had already grown. The fungi that grew out looked like blood vessels—hollow, pinkish-white at the bottom, and deep red at the tips. They would sway gently with the wind.

Lister drove to the research institute. There were very few pedestrians on the road, leaving only robotic sanitation workers to perform disinfection. The recently equipped disinfectant was slightly toxic to humans.

The mycelium had been contained to a certain extent, but unfortunately, it could not be completely killed.

The lights in every residential building were on, and the "bread and circuses" entertainment industries that usually required payment were all free at this time. They were afraid that these people would have a total mental breakdown and jump off buildings.

As Lister was thinking this, he saw a police car parked on the side of the street. A suicide interventionist was shouting weakly: "Don't do anything rash. Think about your wife and children, think about your parents."

The person on the roof cried loudly: "My wife and children are all infected, and my parents mutated a month ago."

Even he himself had fine mycelium emerging from under his skin, growing into small red bumps on the surface. These were symptoms of the second stage of infection, which would manifest more like a skin disease.

After the small bumps ulcerated, red fungal bodies would emerge from within. It was said to be very painful.

People would die at this stage. But after death, the body would still maintain a certain level of activity under the control of the mycelium, used to infect and attack more people.

"I know you are in pain, I am too. We all are, but it will definitely get better..." As the interventionist spoke, he began to cry himself.

Ironically, while they were saying this, the screens on the building facades were playing an interview with the PD of the Ancient God Biology lab. Yes, the same Old Wang who had made the proposal earlier.

Old Wang sat in the studio: "Recently, the experimental progress of various research institutes has been gratifying. We have discovered an active factor that can inhibit the growth of mycelium."

He had explained it the same way to the Human Alliance officials earlier, which was why he had been pushed forward.

If it had truly been discovered, Old Wang would be a hero.

If not, his academic career was likely over.

The person currently in charge of Gusu City was Luo Xiu. Although this young man was easy to fool, the Luo family behind him was not a group to be trifled with.

There is a saying: "Those who are good at fighting have no illustrious achievements."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第87章 崽卖爷田不心疼 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
举个例子，洪水要来了，提前发现大坝有问题的人把大坝修好了，当地没有出事；而另一个地区的官员没有发现，大坝决堤了。领导亲赴前线抢险救灾。

得到表扬的一定是后面那个领导。

在李斯特眼里，洛修不是一个“善战者”。但或许就是因为这样，他在姑苏城的民意居然相当好。

毕竟永生科技的继承人之一都在和自己同甘共苦，一直在重灾区，夙兴夜寐地操劳。哪怕没什么效果，也足以令人感动。

挨骂比较多的是企业的学者，被骂饭桶、无能，尸位素餐。

也不知道是不是把关人舆论控制的结果。

屏幕里的采访正在继续：“那么，这种抑制剂什么时候可以投入生产呢？”

“最快月底。”老王转头，看向屏幕，“请大家再坚持一会！一定会好起来的！”

采访是五天前的。

站在天台上的男人说：“会好起来的。但跟我没有关系了。”

他从楼顶一跃而下。

一边的扫地机器人连忙暂停清洁，把尸块扫在了一起，然后熟练地掏出预备好的塑料薄膜，装在一起，抬进运输车内。

尸体得集中销毁，避免二次感染。如果男人有亲属，可以在网上付费，几天后会收到快递回来的骨灰盒。

李斯特收回视线，才意识到红绿灯已经过去了好几轮。好在他身后也没车。

到研究所，李斯特完成消毒，接过助手递来的生物膜手套，顺口问了一句：“抑制剂买到了吗？”

助手尴尬道：“老师，您是一点也不看群聊啊。”

当然没有。160万的价格发过去了，当天，基地的负责人只回了一句话：“有企业报价200万。”

王老头大发雷霆，问到底是谁不顾倡议书内容，私自报价200万！当然，各大实验室没有一个人承认。

王老头气得解散了群聊。

说到这，助手隐晦道：“因为军令状已经放出去了，到月底，这种抑制剂没有放出来，古神生物的股价，还有王导的前途都会受到一定程度的影响。所以，那边报价应该是最高的。但是具体多少，我也不太清楚了。”

呵呵，永生科技就从来不担心股价。

因为永生科技没上市。（在智械战争前是上市公司，人联建立后退出了证券市场）

又做了一周时间的研究，李斯特很确定一件事——抑制剂的关键是一种他们没有培育出来的特殊菌体。

生长环境的差异，造就了两边毒菌的不同表现。在地底是培育不出这种菌子的。至于地表……

李斯特委托调查员找回来一些样品，没有一个符合。这里面甚至包括空运过来的永恒市菌牛样本。

怪不得有底气寄样品；也有底气拿出来卖。

李斯特一边看着助手整理好的报告，按“A”表示否决、中止实验，按“K”表示认可并进入下一轮。

等清空了今天这轮报告，李斯特终于又一次点开了当初拷贝来的小程序。

他第一次点进了链接，然后发现里面居然是一个简陋的对话框程序。

聊天对象的名字为“幸存者基地”，状态是“在线”。

李斯特试探性地输入：在？

幸存者基地：在噢~亲亲。

幸存者基地：检测到您为新的ip登录，请告知您的姓名，公司。这里会帮您记录。下次登录时会自动载入信息。

“永生科技。李斯特。”

相南里不由得开心地朝着小青道：“小青~最后一条鱼也上钩了！”

老实说，相南里并不是一个对钱很敏感的人。

但他比其他人有一个很大的优势，那就是他真的赚到过钱。很多很多钱。

所以，什么东西是什么价格。相南里在心里会有自己的一套评估标准。

当看到报价160万的时候，相南里没忍住笑了。

有一种“带着枪的乞丐上门要饭，虽然他的枪马上可以毙了我，虽然我账上还有160亿，但拿160万打发乞丐也够了”的滑稽感。

相南里隔了几个小时，才回复，说的是有人报价200万，如果三小时内没收到更高的价格就卖给它了。

这个“有人”自然是虚空索敌，但是耐不住对方心虚又心急。

果然，还没到三小时。相南里就拿到了新的报价。

目前，最高的报价已经到了4700万。

相南里并不打算激怒各个企业，对四千多万的价格也相当满意。

再多，对方就要派安保组来了。

相南里虽然不怕它们；但基地还想发展，人联的支持是很有必要的。（尽管某一家企业不能代表人联）

基地还没有完整的工业体系。人联如果拒绝和基地交易，发展的成本和难度会直线上升。

如果永生科技一直没人来找他，那么，相南里也会在今晚同意4700万的报价。

“幸存者基地公司”已经在这段时间悄悄注册好了，有一个公司账户。开户用的是安德鲁的信息——毕竟这小子真的是东皇重工的前职员。

相南里觉得，安德鲁这地下城市怕是回不去了。可惜了他六十年的房贷，都快还完了喂！

为了补偿安德鲁，相南里说这次拿到钱会帮他换一个好点的金属身体。

李斯特：目前最高价多少。

幸存者基地：4700

省略了单位。

这个价格，对比背后可能产生的利润，在李斯特的眼里，依然相当廉价。

李斯特：你为什么不珍惜自己的科研成果？

他忍不住质问。

李斯特太明白，一个没背景的学者想出头，有多不容易了。

现在已经不是几百年前的时代。人联各个领域都死气沉沉，权力被焊死在了子宫上。

之前，王老头也质问过相南里。

他问的是：“你就为了钱，眼睁睁地看着这么多人去死？”

相南里给出的回答是：我不想。但是育种的母体就一份，所以亲你还要加钱吗？不加我就卖给别人了哈。

但李斯特的质问，似乎是有些不一样的。

他对抑制剂研发者的欣赏，远大于对人类命运共同体的追求。

相南里思考片刻，回答：对于没有感染的人来说，这种抑制剂的价值为0。我有抑制剂，但我没办法把它变成物资。而把这个东西卖出去，换回来的钱能用于基建、医疗，投入生产，让地表数万人免于冻馁与贫困。

幸存者基地：所以，我为什么要珍惜自己的科研成果？我做科研就是为了这个啊！

屏幕前的李斯特略微有些动容。

他陷入了回忆，他能察觉到这段话背后的无奈和酸辛。

幸存者基地：不过最主要是，这也不是我研究的/龇牙笑

崽卖爷田不心疼。

李斯特：“……”

他缓缓把输入框里的“我知道，我小时候也生活在地表”一个字一个字地删掉了。

李斯特：永生科技报价6000万，买断。

这个数额他都不需要上报董事会，李斯特自己就有权限。

对方也没有假惺惺地说什么再等一下其他人了。

幸存者基地：“成交。”
chunks.englishText:
For example, if a flood is coming, the person who discovers a problem with the dam in advance and repairs it ensures that no incident occurs locally; whereas an official in another region fails to discover the issue, and the dam bursts. The leader then personally goes to the front lines for disaster relief.

The leader who receives the praise will definitely be the latter.

In Lister’s eyes, Luo Xiu was not "good at fighting." But perhaps because of this, his public approval in Gusu City was actually quite high.

After all, one of the heirs of Eternal Life Technology was suffering alongside them, staying in the disaster zone, working tirelessly from dawn till dusk. Even if it didn't yield results, it was enough to be moving.

Those who were scolded more often were the corporate scholars, who were called "rice buckets," incompetent, and occupying positions without doing any work.

It was hard to tell if this was the result of the gatekeepers’ control over public opinion.

The interview on the screen continued: "So, when can this inhibitor be put into production?"

"By the end of the month at the earliest." Old Wang turned his head and looked at the screen, "Please hold on a little longer! Everything will get better!"

The interview had been five days ago.

The man standing on the rooftop said, "It will get better. But it has nothing to do with me anymore."

He leaped from the roof.

A sweeping robot nearby paused its cleaning, swept the body parts together, then skillfully took out a prepared plastic film, packed them up, and lifted them into a transport vehicle.

Bodies had to be destroyed in a centralized manner to avoid secondary infection. If the man had relatives, they could pay online, and a few days later, they would receive the ashes delivered by courier.

Lister withdrew his gaze, only realizing that the traffic light had changed several times. Fortunately, there were no cars behind him.

Upon arriving at the research institute, Lister finished disinfecting, took the bio-membrane gloves handed to him by his assistant, and asked casually: "Did you buy the inhibitor?"

The assistant said awkwardly: "Teacher, you really don't check the group chats at all, do you."

Of course not. The 1.6 million quote had been sent out, and that very day, the person in charge of the base had only replied with one sentence: "Another company has bid 2 million."

Old Wang was furious, demanding to know who had ignored the content of the proposal and bid 2 million privately! Naturally, not a single one of the major labs admitted to it.

Old Wang was so angry he disbanded the group chat.

Speaking of this, the assistant said obscurely: "Because the military pledge has already been issued, if this inhibitor isn't released by the end of the month, Ancient God Biology’s stock price and Director Wang’s future will be affected to a certain extent. So, the bid from that side should be the highest. But exactly how much, I’m not sure."

Heh, Eternal Life Technology never worried about stock prices.

Because Eternal Life Technology was not a publicly traded company. (It had been a listed company before the Intelligent Machine War, but withdrew from the stock market after the Human Alliance was established.)

After another week of research, Lister was certain of one thing—the key to the inhibitor was a special fungal body they had failed to cultivate.

The difference in growth environments created the different manifestations of the toxic fungi on both sides. This kind of fungus could not be cultivated underground. As for the surface...

Lister had commissioned investigators to bring back some samples, but none of them matched. This even included the fungal-cow samples from Eternal City that had been air-freighted over.

No wonder they had the confidence to send samples; they also had the confidence to put it up for sale.

Lister looked at the report organized by his assistant, pressing "A" to reject or terminate an experiment, and "K" to approve and move to the next round.

After clearing today’s round of reports, Lister finally clicked on the small program he had copied earlier.

He clicked the link for the first time and discovered it was actually a crude chat program.

The name of the chat partner was "Survivor Base," and the status was "Online."

Lister tentatively typed: Are you there?

Survivor Base: I'm here~ dear.

Survivor Base: New IP login detected. Please provide your name and company. We will record it for you here. Your information will be automatically loaded next time you log in.

"Eternal Life Technology. Lister."

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but happily say to Xiao Qing: "Xiao Qing~ the last fish has taken the bait!"

To be honest, Xiang Nanli was not a person who was particularly sensitive to money.

But he had a huge advantage over others: he had actually earned money before. A lot, a lot of money.

So, he had his own set of evaluation standards in his heart for what things were worth.

When he saw the 1.6 million bid, Xiang Nanli couldn't help but laugh.

There was a sense of absurdity, like "a beggar with a gun coming to my door to beg for food; even though his gun could kill me at any moment, and even though I have 16 billion in my account, tossing 1.6 million to dismiss the beggar is enough."

Xiang Nanli waited a few hours before replying, saying that someone had bid 2 million, and if he didn't receive a higher bid within three hours, he would sell it to them.

This "someone" was naturally a phantom enemy, but the other party couldn't help but feel guilty and anxious.

Sure enough, before three hours had even passed, Xiang Nanli received a new bid.

Currently, the highest bid had reached 47 million.

Xiang Nanli did not intend to anger the various enterprises, and he was quite satisfied with the price of over 40 million.

Any more, and the other party would send a security team.

Although Xiang Nanli wasn't afraid of them, the base still wanted to develop, and the support of the Human Alliance was very necessary. (Even though a single company could not represent the Human Alliance.)

The base did not yet have a complete industrial system. If the Human Alliance refused to trade with the base, the cost and difficulty of development would skyrocket.

If no one from Eternal Life Technology came to find him, Xiang Nanli would agree to the 47 million bid tonight.

"Survivor Base Company" had been quietly registered during this time and had a company account. The account was opened using Andrew’s information—after all, this kid was truly a former employee of Donghuang Heavy Industries.

Xiang Nanli felt that Andrew probably couldn't go back to that underground city anymore. It was a pity about his sixty-year mortgage; he was almost done paying it off!

To compensate Andrew, Xiang Nanli said that once he got the money, he would help him get a better metal body.

Lister: What is the current highest bid?

Survivor Base: 4700

The unit was omitted.

In Lister’s eyes, this price was still quite cheap compared to the potential profits behind it.

Lister: Why don't you cherish your own scientific research results?

He couldn't help but question him.

Lister understood all too well how difficult it was for a scholar without a background to get ahead.

It was no longer the era of several hundred years ago. Every field in the Human Alliance was stagnant, and power was welded shut to the womb.

Earlier, Old Wang had also questioned Xiang Nanli.

He had asked: "Are you just going to watch so many people die for the sake of money?"

Xiang Nanli’s answer was: I don't want to. But there is only one breeding mother-body, so dear, do you want to add more money? If you don't, I'm selling it to someone else.

But Lister’s questioning seemed somewhat different.

His appreciation for the developer of the inhibitor far outweighed his pursuit of a community of shared future for mankind.

Xiang Nanli thought for a moment and replied: For those who are not infected, the value of this inhibitor is 0. I have the inhibitor, but I have no way to turn it into supplies. Selling this thing and exchanging it for money can be used for infrastructure, medical care, and investment in production, allowing tens of thousands of people on the surface to be spared from hunger and poverty.

Survivor Base: So, why should I cherish my own scientific research results? I do scientific research for exactly this reason!

Lister, in front of the screen, was slightly moved.

He fell into memories; he could perceive the helplessness and bitterness behind these words.

Survivor Base: But most importantly, this isn't something I researched anyway /grin

Selling ancestral land without a twinge of heartache.

Lister: "..."

He slowly deleted the words "I know, I lived on the surface when I was a child" one by one from the input box.

Lister: Eternal Life Technology bids 60 million, buyout.

He didn't even need to report this amount to the board of directors; Lister had the authority himself.

The other party didn't hypocritically say anything about waiting for others.

Survivor Base: Deal.

chunks.chineseText:
第88章 大基建计划

永生科技开价高。而且其他家发现是大哥买去了，心里再怎么不爽，最终也只能偃旗息鼓。

六千万这个价格也很合适。

再多，相南里就担心人家就舍不得商业合作了，不如抢完直接灭口。

永生科技效率很高，合同是上午签的，钱是下午打的。

配方是晚上交出去的。

相南里给了一个地址，在姑苏城地表交通站的付费寄存点。

里面装着一个玻璃瓶，瓶子里的菌体是北辰从自己种的母体上切下来的。培育后提取的活性成分就是抑制剂最重要的原料。

安保组拿到后，第一时间交给了李斯特所在的实验室。又过了两小时，李斯特回了一个字：“收。”

表明他认可了这份菌种的经济效益。

至于之后怎么操作，那就不是相南里能操心的事了。

幸存者基地：好的喔，亲亲，有需求随时再联系~

想了想，相南里又补充了一句：你会让需要抑制剂的人买得起药的吧？

李斯特：你现在才考虑这种事吗？

李斯特：会。

相南里这才让小智断了网。

在地表想联网，只能到信号还行的地方，买专门的地表流量，网费贵得难以想象。

相南里从山顶摸黑往回走，嘀嘀咕咕：“六千万，交完企业所得税，到手就五千出头了，人联真小气。”

人联已经没有现金的概念了，每一笔交易都会记录在案，每一笔收入自动扣税，一个信用点能追溯到前面好几代的使用者。税是少交0.1个信用点都不可能。

[好了赶紧回来。]小青催促着。

相南里满口答应，小破自行车却拐了个弯，来到牧场。

季节到了秋天，最近开始下雪了，天也黑的更早了一些。

相南里打开路灯，悬挂在木杆上的灯泡亮起，灯光白且刺眼。

牧场里的牛果然又被啃的七零八落。最近温度变低，菌丝再生的速度明显慢了点。以西结有时候会带着体量不大的畸变体去周围狩猎。

于是永恒之城原本就很安定的环境变得更加安定了。以前秋天，往往会有一些异种袭击城市，比如食人猴、鹿、熊瞎子；现在连异种的脚印都没看见。森林里倒是多了很多骨头。

畸变人可以食腐。最近气温低，腐化慢，狩猎一次，畸变人可以七八天不出门。

相南里写了封信，把牧场的情况发给了北辰。小型运输无人机飞过去好几天了，还没收到回信。

相南里把自行车停在牧场边，从后面的保温箱里拿出一个用油纸包好的牛肉饼，拆掉包装后，往半空丢去，喊了声：“以西结。”

残影一闪而过，牛肉饼在半空消失了。下一秒，以西结十分轻巧地落在了牧场边缘的电线墙上。

这个墙是通电的，因为高压，靠近都有可能被电那么一下。

他覆盖着鳞片的手脚落在电线上，除了稍微把电线压弯了一点外，竟然没有任何反应。

以西结嘴里叼着牛肉饼，两三下囫囵咽了下去，一双血红的眼睛盯着相南里，远称不上温顺。

牛肉饼不在食堂的供给上，一个牛肉饼要两张工分券。皮薄薄的，肉馅很厚，汁水饱满，添加了野葱、黑胡椒这些地表罕见的香料。味道很香。

相南里的基础工资一天三张工分券，都用来自己吃饭了。

如今买牛肉饼，用的还是小青的工资呢！

小智幽幽开口：[你又拿东方青帝的工资养以西结。]

相南里觉得它这话说得怪怪的。

不过，相南里很快回答：“小智，记得偷偷把这段数据删了喔，不要让小青知道了。”

小智：[呵呵，知道了。]

虽然让小青知道也没什么，但总觉得有些不好意思。

买东西的时候，相南里也没和东方青帝商量。小青大概一直以为自己在赚钱养老婆吧。

可是小青是自己把工资上交的！而且小青又不吃饭，只吃什么生物能源……

相南里看着面前满嘴油的以西结，不禁陷入沉思：这算是小青的生物能源吗？

相南里并不是每天都来，这里离永恒市还有一个小时车程，天天来太浪费时间了。

以西结也不是每天都在。相南里在一边的树上打了个钉子，以西结不在的时候，他会把饼挂在树上。

相南里认为：和以西结搞好关系很有必要。

永恒市之前是神庭的地盘。神庭随时都可能派人过来。这些畸变人群体就是永恒市的第一道防线。

相南里又从自行车的后备箱里，掏出一个布团，丢了过去。

以西结伸手接住，拆开布条。里面装着的是牙刷、梳子和一个食堂洗碗用的钢丝球。

相南里跟他比划：“牙刷，漱口。梳子，梳头。剩下那个是洗澡用的。”

相南里翻过生物书，潜行者在秋季会蜕去体表的死皮，冬季长出新的鳞片。新生的鳞片会让它们在春、夏两季更有竞争力。无论是求偶还是狩猎。

畸变体皮糙肉厚的，普通的浴球洗澡根本没有感觉。还是钢丝球比较好使。能让脆化的鳞片更快脱落，方便长出新的。

相南里投喂完野生动物，挥了挥手，跨上自行车：“我先回家咯，下次再来看你。对了，丰收节要来玩吗？你要来的话，我让厨房准备一点你们吃的东西。”

以西结从鼻腔里发出一声气音，不知道是“嗯”还是“哼”。

他竖着大尾巴从电线上爬走了。

相南里骑着自行车，回到了永恒市。

城市大部分地方都是黑漆漆的，顶多在门前点个油灯。但学校的方向却灯火通明。

他走进城内。被初雪覆盖的路边，有一座马上要建好的信号塔。大半夜，依然有几个年轻的面孔打着手电筒干活。

易横行送来的这批大学生质量很好，一共五人，都是学校“调查社团”的，平时和调查组的关系也很好，这几乎是各个城市的调查员预备役。

而且，这个年代，能一路读上大学的，除了学习够好，家境就没有太差的。

人联的义务教育只有5年。

相南里翻过人联的教科书，义务教育的含金量，差不多等于他读书时，国内初一的水准。

之后想读中学、大学。每一年的学费都极其昂贵，只有成绩最好的那一批才能拿到奖学金，学费甚至是按月缴纳的。

唯一欣慰的是，因为学历没有注水，严进严出；哪怕只是中学毕业，在地底也能找到一份不错的工作。

永恒市管吃管住，但物质条件依然相当匮乏。

在相南里万万没想到的情况下，这批学生居然主动申请制造一台信号塔，估计是当什么社会实践作业了。当然，人工不要钱，材料费还是永恒市出的。

但实际上，这批大学生的内心是这样的：“……支教任务三个月，连个网都上不了，想鼠。”

白天，备课、帮永恒市修基站，偶尔会组团，在附近进行地表考察。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 88: The Great Infrastructure Plan

Eternal Life Technology offered a high price. Moreover, once the other companies realized that the "Big Brother" had bought it, no matter how disgruntled they felt, they had no choice but to back down.

Sixty million was a very reasonable price.

Any higher, and Xiang Nanli worried that the other party might lose interest in commercial cooperation and instead opt to simply kill them and take the goods.

Eternal Life Technology was highly efficient; the contract was signed in the morning, and the money was wired in the afternoon.

The formula was handed over that evening.

Xiang Nanli provided an address: a paid storage locker at the surface transportation hub in Gusu City.

Inside was a glass bottle containing fungal cultures that Beichen had harvested from his own cultivated parent strain. The active ingredients extracted after cultivation were the most critical raw materials for the inhibitor.

Once the security team received it, they immediately delivered it to the laboratory where Lister was based. Two hours later, Lister replied with a single word: "Received."

This indicated that he acknowledged the economic value of the fungal strain.

As for how it would be handled afterward, that was no longer something Xiang Nanli needed to worry about.

Survivor Base: "Got it, dear! Feel free to reach out if you have any more needs~"

After a moment's thought, Xiang Nanli added: "You will make sure that those who need the inhibitor can actually afford the medicine, right?"

Lister: "Are you only considering this now?"

Lister: "I will."

Only then did Xiang Nanli have Xiao Zhi disconnect from the network.

To get online on the surface, one had to go to a location with decent signal and purchase specialized surface data, which was unimaginably expensive.

Xiang Nanli walked back from the mountaintop in the dark, muttering to himself: "Sixty million. After corporate income tax, I’ll only see a little over fifty million. The Human Alliance is so stingy."

The Human Alliance no longer used cash; every transaction was recorded, and taxes were automatically deducted from every income. A single credit point could be traced back through several generations of users. It was impossible to underpay taxes by even 0.1 credit points.

[Alright, hurry back,] Xiao Qing urged.

Xiang Nanli agreed readily, but his beat-up bicycle took a turn toward the pasture.

Autumn had arrived, and it had recently started to snow; the days were growing shorter.

Xiang Nanli turned on the streetlights. The bulbs hanging from the wooden poles flickered to life, casting a harsh, white glare.

The cattle in the pasture had, as expected, been gnawed to pieces. With the temperature dropping, the regeneration speed of the mycelium had clearly slowed down. Sometimes, Ezekiel would take smaller aberrations out to hunt in the surrounding area.

As a result, the already stable environment of the Eternal City became even more tranquil. In previous autumns, the city was often attacked by xenomorphs—man-eating monkeys, deer, or black bears. Now, not even a footprint could be seen. Instead, the forest was littered with bones.

Aberrants could scavenge. With the low temperatures slowing down decomposition, a single hunt was enough to keep them fed for seven or eight days without needing to leave.

Xiang Nanli had written a letter detailing the situation at the pasture and sent it to Beichen. The small transport drone had flown off days ago, but he had yet to receive a reply.

Xiang Nanli parked his bike at the edge of the pasture, took a beef patty wrapped in oil paper from the insulated box on the back, unwrapped it, tossed it into the air, and called out, "Ezekiel."

A blur flashed by, and the beef patty vanished in mid-air. A second later, Ezekiel landed gracefully on the electrified wire fence surrounding the pasture.

The fence was live, and due to the high voltage, one risked a shock just by getting close.

His scale-covered hands and feet landed on the wire, and aside from slightly bending it, he showed no reaction at all.

Ezekiel chewed the beef patty, swallowing it in two or three gulps. His blood-red eyes stared at Xiang Nanli, looking far from docile.

The beef patties weren't on the cafeteria's standard menu; each one cost two work-point vouchers. The crust was thin, the filling thick and juicy, seasoned with wild onions and black pepper—spices rarely found on the surface. It tasted delicious.

Xiang Nanli’s base salary was three vouchers a day, all of which went toward his own meals.

Nowadays, he was buying beef patties with Xiao Qing's salary!

Xiao Zhi spoke up gloomily: [You’re using the Eastern Azure Emperor’s salary to feed Ezekiel again.]

Xiang Nanli felt that phrasing was a bit strange.

However, he quickly replied: "Xiao Zhi, remember to secretly delete this data, okay? Don't let Xiao Qing find out."

Xiao Zhi: [Heh, understood.]

Although it wouldn't be a big deal if Xiao Qing found out, he still felt a bit embarrassed.

When he bought the items, he hadn't consulted the Eastern Azure Emperor. Xiao Qing probably thought he was earning money to support his spouse.

But Xiao Qing was the one who handed over his salary! And Xiao Qing didn't even eat food, only some kind of biological energy...

Xiang Nanli looked at the grease-covered Ezekiel in front of him and fell into deep thought: Did this count as Xiao Qing's biological energy?

Xiang Nanli didn't come every day; it was an hour's drive from Eternal City, and coming daily was a waste of time.

Ezekiel wasn't always there, either. Xiang Nanli had driven a nail into a nearby tree; when Ezekiel wasn't around, he would hang the patty on the tree.

Xiang Nanli believed that maintaining a good relationship with Ezekiel was essential.

Eternal City used to be the territory of the Divine Court. They could send people at any time. These groups of aberrants were the first line of defense for Eternal City.

Xiang Nanli pulled a bundle of cloth from the bike's storage box and tossed it over.

Ezekiel caught it and unwrapped the cloth. Inside were a toothbrush, a comb, and a steel wool scouring pad used for washing dishes in the cafeteria.

Xiang Nanli gestured to him: "Toothbrush, for brushing teeth. Comb, for your hair. The last one is for bathing."

Xiang Nanli had read biology books; stalkers shed their dead skin in autumn and grew new scales in winter. The new scales made them more competitive in spring and summer, whether for mating or hunting.

Aberrants had thick, tough skin; ordinary bath sponges had no effect. Steel wool was much more effective. It helped the brittle scales fall off faster, making it easier for new ones to grow.

After feeding the wild animal, Xiang Nanli waved and hopped onto his bike: "I'm heading home now. I'll come see you next time. Oh, right, do you want to come play at the Harvest Festival? If you do, I'll have the kitchen prepare something for you to eat."

Ezekiel made a sound from his nasal cavity—it was unclear if it was an "um" or a "hmph."

He flicked his long tail and crawled away along the electric wire.

Xiang Nanli rode his bike back to Eternal City.

Most of the city was pitch black, with at most an oil lamp lit in front of doors. But the direction of the school was brightly lit.

He entered the city. By the side of the road, covered in the first snow of the season, stood a signal tower nearing completion. Even in the middle of the night, several young faces were working by flashlight.

The batch of university students sent by Yi Hengxing was of high quality. There were five of them, all from the school’s "Investigation Club," who usually had a good relationship with the investigation team. They were essentially reserve investigators for various cities.

Moreover, in this era, those who could make it all the way to university, aside from being academically gifted, usually didn't come from poor backgrounds.

The Human Alliance's compulsory education lasted only five years.

Xiang Nanli had flipped through the Human Alliance textbooks; the content of their compulsory education was roughly equivalent to the first year of middle school back in his time.

After that, middle school and university tuition fees were extremely expensive. Only the top students could receive scholarships, and tuition was often paid monthly.

The only consolation was that because the degrees weren't inflated and were difficult to earn, even a middle school graduate could find a decent job underground.

Eternal City provided food and housing, but material conditions remained quite scarce.

To Xiang Nanli's surprise, this group of students had voluntarily applied to build a signal tower, likely treating it as a social practice assignment. Of course, while the labor was free, the material costs were still covered by Eternal City.

In reality, however, the students were thinking: "...Three months of volunteer teaching, and we can't even get online. I want to die."

During the day, they prepared lessons, helped Eternal City repair base stations, and occasionally formed groups to conduct surface surveys nearby.

chunks.chineseText:
夜晚，上课。吃完饭从下午6点一直上到12点。涉及的课程包括人联语、数学、物理、通识课、机械维修等等。

相南里停车，打了个招呼：“小王，小周！都几点了，外面天冷。先回宿舍吧，白天再建吧。”

小王深沉地摇头：“不了相老师。我的游戏已经十五天没签到了，再登录不上公会就要把我踢了，你就别管了。今晚我必定要让城里能联网。”

小周：“我对在地表用废旧材料搭建一个可用的信号塔很感兴趣，等回到学校，这可以变成我的学分，也能成为毕业论文的论据之一。或许能帮助我拿到永生科技的实习资格。”

相南里觉得他们都很有追求。

可惜这么好用的壮劳力，只能用三个月。

基地发展欣欣向荣，相南里深感欣慰。

终于，自行车到了市政大楼的楼下。

相南里把车停好，直接来到了三楼的会议室。

他推开门，小青面无表情地把一件羽绒服披在了相南里的身上，顺手帮他拂去了发旋上的雪。

“其实不冷。”相南里裹紧了身上的羽绒服，小声回答。

他的身体经过基因药强化，这种程度冻不死。

东方青帝只是回答道：“小心感冒，城里缺药。”

同在会议室的海狸同志莫名觉得自己吃到一口狗粮。

会议室内的屏幕上写着一行字：“永恒市第一次三年发展计划会议”。

参会人员有相南里，东方青帝，安德鲁，福音书以及海狸。

在安德鲁回基地后，海狸会接任他在永恒市的工作。

她和她的丈夫都入选了第一批基地成员名录。

福音书目前体型巨大，因此用的是远程连线。它的座位上只有一台电脑。

海狸还是第一次参加这样的正式会议，表情相当紧张。她只会执行，很少决策。总害怕自己做的不够好。

相南里入座，微笑道：“久等了。基地对永恒市未来一年的财政补贴是三千万。等建设好两地通讯网络后，可以进行统一调控。”

虽然这次从永生科技那里捞了五千万，但基地自己也是要发展的。

科技就是第一生产力。相南里准备拨款500万作为实验室的发展储备金。

再预留500万，作为造反失败后东山再起的资本。

剩下四千万，永恒市人多，分三千万。基地人少，还没怎么开建，分一千万。

税收就不指望了。永恒城还没能用上自己的货币，收税也只能收收物资。至于基地自己的货币，相南里准备等通电后再考虑。

虽然分得挺细，但这些钱，目前都还在相南里的账上躺着。

“目前最要紧的还是基建。永恒市能源匮乏，缺电。基地主城区有地热电厂，电能富裕。要加紧建设两地的输电网络。这部分我咨询过易横行，地表电网建设有人联补贴，可以申请。一种是传统的超高压电网，一种是超能粒子电网。”

永恒市这纬度的日照条件，根本不用考虑太阳能。附近也没什么落差大的水能，或者风能。

“后者安全性高，造价低，能源损耗也低，但粒子输电容易扰乱磁场。所以我们还是选择传统的高压电吧。”

相南里说话不徐不疾，人联语的发音也很标准，听起来很舒服。

福音书无声地进行着会议记录：“新历947年9月30日。基地召开第一次三年发展会议，会议上，基地首席相南里提出，要加快对永恒市与基地的基础设施建设，满足人民生活的物质需求。电网建设成功后，基地将进一步发展轻工业，利用自己的技术优势，对周围地表据点形成贸易顺差，促进基地繁荣发展。”

“基地二把手东方青帝则指出，粮食保障也是城市发展必不可少的一环。需要建设城市公路、或安排飞行运输。以保证基地主城区的食物供应。”

“史称，大基建计划。”
chunks.englishText:
At night, they attended classes. After dinner, they studied from 6:00 PM until midnight. The subjects included Human Alliance language, mathematics, physics, general studies, mechanical maintenance, and more.

Xiang Nanli parked his bike and greeted them: "Xiao Wang, Xiao Zhou! What time is it? It's cold out here. Go back to the dorms; you can build it during the day."

Xiao Wang shook his head solemnly: "No, Teacher Xiang. My game hasn't been checked in for fifteen days. If I can't log in, the guild will kick me out. Don't worry about us. I’m determined to get the city online tonight."

Xiao Zhou added: "I’m very interested in building a functional signal tower on the surface using scrap materials. When I return to school, this can count toward my credits and serve as part of my graduation thesis. Perhaps it will help me secure an internship at Eternal Life Technology."

Xiang Nanli felt they were all very ambitious.

It was a pity that such excellent, hardworking labor could only be utilized for three months.

The base was developing in a flourishing manner, and Xiang Nanli felt deeply gratified.

Finally, the bicycle arrived at the foot of the Municipal Building.

Xiang Nanli parked the bike and went straight to the third-floor conference room.

As he pushed open the door, Xiao Qing, expressionless, draped a down jacket over Xiang Nanli’s shoulders and brushed the snow off the crown of his head.

"Actually, I'm not cold," Xiang Nanli replied softly, wrapping himself tighter in the jacket.

His body had been enhanced by genetic medicine; this level of cold wouldn't kill him.

The Eastern Azure Emperor simply replied: "Be careful of catching a cold. The city is short on medicine."

Comrade Beaver, who was also in the conference room, inexplicably felt like they had just been fed a mouthful of "dog food" (public displays of affection).

On the screen inside the conference room, a line of text read: "Eternal City First Three-Year Development Plan Meeting."

The attendees included Xiang Nanli, the Eastern Azure Emperor, Andrew, Gospel, and Beaver.

After Andrew returned to the base, Beaver would take over his work in Eternal City.

She and her husband had both been selected for the first list of base members.

Gospel was currently too large in size, so it was participating via remote connection. Its seat was occupied by a single computer.

This was Beaver's first time attending such a formal meeting, and she looked quite nervous. She was used to executing orders, rarely making decisions. She was always afraid of not doing a good enough job.

Xiang Nanli took his seat and smiled: "Sorry for the wait. The base’s financial subsidy for Eternal City for the coming year is thirty million. Once the communication network between the two locations is built, we can conduct unified regulation."

Although they had netted fifty million from Eternal Life Technology this time, the base itself also needed to develop.

Technology was the primary productive force. Xiang Nanli planned to allocate five million as a development reserve fund for the laboratory.

He would reserve another five million as capital for a comeback should their rebellion fail.

Of the remaining forty million, Eternal City had more people, so it would receive thirty million. The base had fewer people and hadn't started construction yet, so it would receive ten million.

He wasn't counting on tax revenue. Eternal City hadn't even been able to use its own currency yet, so taxes could only be collected in goods. As for the base's own currency, Xiang Nanli planned to consider that only after the power was turned on.

Although the allocation was detailed, all this money was currently sitting in Xiang Nanli's account.

"The most urgent task right now is infrastructure. Eternal City lacks energy and electricity. The base’s main urban area has a geothermal power plant with surplus energy. We must accelerate the construction of a power transmission network between the two locations. I’ve consulted Yi Hengxing about this; there are Human Alliance subsidies for surface power grid construction that we can apply for. One option is a traditional ultra-high-voltage grid, and the other is a super-energy particle grid."

Given the solar conditions at Eternal City's latitude, solar power was out of the question. There was no nearby water source with a significant drop for hydropower, nor was there much wind energy.

"The latter is safer, cheaper to build, and has lower energy loss, but particle transmission can easily disrupt magnetic fields. Therefore, we will choose the traditional high-voltage grid."

Xiang Nanli spoke at a measured pace, his pronunciation of the Human Alliance language standard and pleasant to the ear.

Gospel silently recorded the meeting minutes: "New Era, Year 947, September 30th. The base held its first three-year development meeting. During the meeting, base Chief Xiang Nanli proposed accelerating infrastructure construction for Eternal City and the base to meet the material needs of the people. Once the power grid is successfully built, the base will further develop light industry, utilizing its technological advantages to form a trade surplus with surrounding surface outposts, promoting the base's prosperity and development."

"Base second-in-command, the Eastern Azure Emperor, pointed out that food security is also an indispensable part of urban development. It is necessary to build city roads or arrange aerial transport to ensure food supply for the base's main urban area."

"History would come to call this: The Great Infrastructure Plan."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第89章 地表诈骗团伙 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第89章 地表诈骗团伙

他在冰天雪地里等了半分钟，在漫长的嘟嘟声后，电话被接通了。

“赵主任，您看，冬天马上就要到了。我们市的电能严重不足，以往夏天越热，冬天越冷。今年夏天气温有十几度，这个冬天很难熬啊。要是我们暖气供应不上……”

赵主任打着官腔，语气里却有那么一丝不耐：“傅明啊，就是，你也知道的。姑苏城的菌丝病，最近很严重的。你们要的电池，实在是没人送啊。这玩意一两千万一个，万一保护不足，让路匪截走了，谁也付不起这个责任不是？”

“可以让机器人送来吧？”

赵主任继续道：“诶呀，机器人就更不敢了。装了拟人模块的智械怕叛变，没装的，应付不了突发状况，问题就更多了。”

“那我的市里两万多人怎么办！”

“你们那边不是有山嘛，砍一下柴，烧柴不就好了？”

“光辉市附近的速成树林去年就砍完了，水土流失严重，今年还得育林。赵主任，你行行好吧……”傅明低声下气。

“这样吧，我再开会催一催，你也不要着急。周围这么多小据点，大家资源都紧缺。有消息一定马上告诉你。”

赵主任挂掉电话，肥硕的身体躺在人体工学椅上。

他的工位在姑苏城地表的办公室。

地表环境艰苦，但赵主任是很乐于“奉献”的。他姓“赵”，有个姓氏，代表他祖上也阔绰过。中学毕业后，赵主任没能考上大学，好在找主家的赵姓走了一下关系，终于当上了地表扶贫基金会的职工。

五六十年下来，赵主任靠着资历，成为姑苏城地表扶贫办的三位领导之一。

赵主任就倒卖一下扶贫物资，吃拿卡要，贱卖集体资产……如今妻儿在姑苏城上城区已经有了三套房，还在洛阳城买了一套18平的小公寓。

房子不大，加起来却和姑苏城三套房的价格差不多。万一姑苏城有什么变动，比如神庭打来了，或者被智械人炸了。主任可以迅速地带着妻儿前往全世界最安全的洛阳城。

光辉市需要的电池，赵主任早就低价卖出去了。

赵主任当然知道自己做的不道德。但他不这么干，有的是人这么干。便宜别人不如便宜自己。

电话一挂，赵主任摇头晃脑地把vr眼镜挂在脸上，露出痴痴的笑容：“嘿嘿，觅风~我的宝贝小蜜蜂。”

蜜蜂是最近新出现的个人虚拟主播，本名觅风。

他没有签公司，一出道就获得了超高人气，屡次投票都是第一。

觅风的崛起，在这个投票渠道被娱乐公司层层把关的年代格外不容易。

他迅速吸引了一批慕强粉、老公粉和事业粉。

对家曾在网上散布谣言，说觅风利用了投票系统漏洞，这才能在晋级中屡屡获胜！

简直无稽之谈！投票系统要是这么好攻破，网安部门都能集体下岗了。

总之，一番虐粉操作，大家变得更死忠了呢。

傅明挂掉电话，眼神里闪过压抑的怒火：“平日喝酒吃饭没少请客！人联有什么政策我们也照办，一到需要资源的时候就推三阻四！明明能源泵早就批下来了，却迟迟不给。早知道还不如投靠阴山城呢！”

起码神庭是真的饭管饱。

一旁面黄肌瘦的秘书道：“市长，慎言啊。神庭也不是什么好东西。”

“我知道……”

傅明长长地叹了一口气。

他从小生活在地表，家乡在人联和神庭的边境线交界处。

有一次，神庭的天启骑士团路过，嗅到他们的村庄藏了人联的伏兵。

傅明那天去外地买药，回家后，只看到一地被啃噬得不成人形的尸体。

傅明在书上看见过一句话，说权力只对其来源负责。

人联的权力，起码有那么一小部分，是来自他们这些地表遗民的祖先的。他们同是人类，参与了地下城市的建设。他们被人联抛弃。

而神庭的权力，来自神、教会和信徒。

所以傅明永远不会带着光辉市投靠神庭。

他不愿信仰神。

“森林再往里砍，就要到异种的栖息地了。如果惹怒异种，导致异种潮，以我们市的军备，根本无力抵抗。”傅明揉着自己的眉心，头发斑白，“让所有市民准备好过冬。准备好搬迁工作，等到数九天，都搬到地下防空洞里。人多，聚在一起暖和些。也能省点电。”

傅明顿了顿：“让小孩、孕妇坐中间。青年坐外面，老人最外面。”

这是一个残忍的决定。每年，老年人都是冻死数量最多的。但这也是没办法的事。

在地表，没有能力的仁慈，是一种愚蠢。

“市长！”办公室的门被敲响了，一个青年人走了进来，语气有些迟疑，“市长，我们缴获了一台小型机械装置。这台装置有播音功能。”

说缴获不太对。因为这玩意，是自己从天上飞下来的。

这台机器整体是个圆球形，头顶有一个竹蜻蜓似的飞行器，电动的。

有一种既高科技，又原始的感觉。

秘书不敢用手碰，怕爆炸。

他小心翼翼地用脚踢了一下。

圆球在办公室滚了一圈，撞上墙壁，刚好碰到播放键。

口音标准的人联语从这个球里播放出来：“光辉市的朋友，你们好。我是幸存者基地目前的司令，相南里。”

以下省略六百字的基地介绍，无非就是把糊弄人的那套说辞再说一遍。

人人都相信的谎言，迟早会成为真相。

最后，相南里道：“这个月月底，基地将会在辖区永恒市内开展丰收节。我们郑重邀请光辉市派出外交团，前来参加节日。”

“另外。我们基地的无线电编码为：*。如果您有无线电设备，呼叫此频段即可与我们联系。”

录音到此结束。

傅明思忖：“永恒市就是原来的永恒之城。那可是个中型据点，比我们这种小城强多了。居然被基地占领了？幸存者基地，这名字怎么听着有点耳熟……？”

秘书则是从抽屉里翻出一个文件袋，然后把拓印下来的图片摆在了傅明面前：“市长，您看！”

之前，有市民在郊区一棵树上，发现了这块宣传标语。是一个二维码，外加一段广告词。广告说，他们叫幸存者基地，有比人联更先进的科技。

傅明当时不屑一顾，认为这又是什么地表诈骗团伙的小花招，他是不会上当的。

但现在，这个不知名基地，却成了走投无路时唯一的希望。

傅明是原本市长的女婿。市长的几个儿子都死在了和异种的作战中，这才轮到傅明。诚然，地表大多数地方都混乱、肮脏、无序。

但总有那么一批人，初衷只是想好好过日子。

他们也许终身都没有去过地下城市，也没有见过那些高楼、脑机、机械义体。他们活在辐射病、贫困和异种威胁里，制造不了GDP、不识字、研究不了科技，可他们同样想活下去。

哪怕地表的白昼如此短促，哪怕生存的压力如此痛苦。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 89: Surface Scam Ring

He waited for half a minute in the freezing snow, and after a long series of beeps, the call was finally answered.

"Director Zhao, look, winter is almost here. Our city is severely short on electricity. In the past, the hotter the summer, the colder the winter. This summer, the temperature was over ten degrees, and this winter will be very hard to endure. If we can't keep up the heating supply..."

Director Zhao spoke in bureaucratic platitudes, his tone tinged with a hint of impatience: "Fu Ming, look, you know how it is. The fungal disease in Gusu City is very serious lately. There’s really no one to deliver the batteries you need. These things cost ten or twenty million each; if they aren't protected well and get intercepted by road bandits, who can take that responsibility?"

"Can't you have robots deliver them?"

Director Zhao continued: "Oh, robots are even more risky. Intelligent machines with anthropomorphic modules are afraid of rebellion, and those without them can't handle unexpected situations. There are even more problems."

"Then what am I supposed to do with the twenty thousand people in my city!"

"Don't you have mountains over there? Just chop some wood. Isn't burning wood fine?"

"The fast-growing forests near Glory City were all cut down last year, and soil erosion is severe. We have to cultivate the forest this year. Director Zhao, please, have some mercy..." Fu Ming pleaded humbly.

"How about this, I'll bring it up in a meeting and urge them again. You don't need to be so anxious. There are so many small outposts around, and everyone is short on resources. If there's any news, I'll definitely let you know immediately."

Director Zhao hung up the phone, his corpulent body reclining in an ergonomic chair.

His workstation was in an office on the surface of Gusu City.

The surface environment was harsh, but Director Zhao was very willing to "contribute." His surname was "Zhao," which meant his ancestors had once been wealthy. After graduating from middle school, Director Zhao hadn't been able to get into university, but fortunately, he had used his connections with the main Zhao family to finally become an employee of the Surface Poverty Alleviation Foundation.

Over the past fifty or sixty years, relying on his seniority, Director Zhao had become one of the three leaders of the Gusu City Surface Poverty Alleviation Office.

Director Zhao would resell poverty alleviation supplies, extort bribes, and sell off collective assets at bargain prices... Nowadays, his wife and children owned three apartments in the upper district of Gusu City, and he had even bought a small 18-square-meter apartment in Luoyang City.

The apartment wasn't big, but combined, it was worth about the same as the three apartments in Gusu City. In case something happened to Gusu City—like the Divine Court attacking or it being bombed by intelligent machines—the Director could quickly take his wife and children to the safest place in the world: Luoyang City.

As for the batteries Glory City needed, Director Zhao had already sold them off at a low price long ago.

Director Zhao certainly knew what he was doing was unethical. But if he didn't do it, plenty of others would. It was better to benefit himself than to benefit others.

Once the call ended, Director Zhao shook his head and put on his VR glasses, revealing a doting smile: "Hehe, Mifeng~ My precious little bee."

Mifeng was a recently emerged individual virtual streamer, whose real name was Mifeng.

He hadn't signed with any company, yet he had gained immense popularity as soon as he debuted, topping the polls time and again.

Mifeng's rise was particularly difficult in an era where voting channels were strictly controlled by entertainment companies.

He quickly attracted a group of fans who admired strength, "husband" fans, and career-focused fans.

Rival companies had once spread rumors online that Mifeng had exploited loopholes in the voting system to win repeatedly in the qualifiers!

What utter nonsense! If the voting system were that easy to hack, the cybersecurity department would all be out of a job.

In short, after some "fan-abuse" tactics, his followers became even more loyal.

Fu Ming hung up the phone, a flash of suppressed rage in his eyes: "I treat them to drinks and meals all the time! We follow every policy the Human Alliance sets, but when we need resources, they just give us the runaround! The energy pumps were approved long ago, yet they refuse to deliver them. If I had known, it would have been better to defect to Yinshan City!"

At least the Divine Court actually provided enough food.

Beside him, the sallow-faced secretary said: "Mayor, be careful with your words. The Divine Court isn't exactly a good thing either."

"I know..."

Fu Ming let out a long sigh.

He had lived on the surface since he was a child, and his hometown was on the border between the Human Alliance and the Divine Court.

Once, the Divine Court's Apocalypse Knights passed by, smelling that their village was hiding Human Alliance scouts.

Fu Ming had gone to another place to buy medicine that day. When he returned home, he only saw a field of corpses chewed into unrecognizable shapes.

Fu Ming had once read a sentence in a book saying that power is only responsible to its source.

The power of the Human Alliance, at least a small part of it, came from the ancestors of these surface survivors. They were fellow humans who had participated in the construction of the underground cities. They had been abandoned by the Human Alliance.

And the power of the Divine Court came from gods, the church, and believers.

Therefore, Fu Ming would never lead Glory City to defect to the Divine Court.

He did not want to worship a god.

"If we cut any deeper into the forest, we'll reach the habitat of the xenomorphs. If we provoke them and cause a xenomorph tide, our city's armaments won't be able to resist," Fu Ming rubbed his temples, his hair graying. "Tell all the citizens to prepare for winter. Prepare for relocation; when the coldest days arrive, move into the underground air-raid shelters. There are many people; huddling together will be warmer. It can also save some electricity."

Fu Ming paused: "Put the children and pregnant women in the middle. The young people on the outside, and the elderly on the outermost edge."

It was a cruel decision. Every year, the elderly suffered the highest number of deaths from freezing. But there was no other way.

On the surface, mercy without the ability to back it up was a form of stupidity.

"Mayor!" The office door was knocked, and a young man walked in, his tone hesitant. "Mayor, we captured a small mechanical device. This device has a broadcast function."

Calling it "captured" wasn't quite right, because this thing had flown down from the sky by itself.

The machine was spherical, with a bamboo-copter-like propeller on top, powered by electricity.

It had a feeling of being both high-tech and primitive.

The secretary didn't dare touch it with his hands, fearing it might explode.

He cautiously kicked it with his foot.

The sphere rolled across the office, hit the wall, and happened to trigger the play button.

A standard-accented Human Alliance voice played from the ball: "Friends of Glory City, hello. I am the current commander of the Survivor Base, Xiang Nanli."

(The following six hundred words of the base introduction were omitted; it was nothing more than repeating the same deceptive rhetoric.)

A lie that everyone believes will eventually become the truth.

Finally, Xiang Nanli said: "At the end of this month, the base will hold a Harvest Festival within our jurisdiction of Eternal City. We solemnly invite Glory City to send a diplomatic delegation to attend the festival."

"Also. Our base's radio code is: *. If you have radio equipment, call this frequency to contact us."

The recording ended there.

Fu Ming pondered: "Eternal City is the former Eternal City. That was a medium-sized outpost, much stronger than our small town. It was actually occupied by the base? Survivor Base... why does that name sound familiar...?"

The secretary rummaged through a file folder and placed a traced image in front of Fu Ming: "Mayor, look!"

Previously, a citizen had discovered this promotional slogan on a tree in the suburbs. It was a QR code, plus an advertisement. The ad claimed they were called the Survivor Base and possessed technology more advanced than the Human Alliance.

Fu Ming had dismissed it at the time, thinking it was just another trick by a surface scam ring, and he wouldn't be fooled.

But now, this unknown base had become his only hope when he was at his wit's end.

Fu Ming was the son-in-law of the former mayor. The mayor's sons had all died in battles against xenomorphs, which was why it was Fu Ming's turn. Admittedly, most places on the surface were chaotic, dirty, and disorderly.

But there was always a group of people whose original intention was just to live a good life.

They might never have been to an underground city in their lives, nor had they seen those high-rises, brain-computer interfaces, or mechanical prosthetics. They lived among radiation sickness, poverty, and the threat of xenomorphs; they couldn't generate GDP, were illiterate, and couldn't research technology, but they also wanted to survive.

Even if the daylight on the surface was so short, and even if the pressure of survival was so painful.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第89章 地表诈骗团伙 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
傅明怀着忐忑的心情拨打了基地的电话号码。

等待转接大概等了两分钟。

刚刚才在录音球里听见的声音传了过来：“您好，我是相南里。接线员说你找我，是有什么事吗？”

傅明之前已经介绍过身份了，他开门见山道：“相司令，我想问问你们那边有没有锂空气电池？”

相南里沉思片刻：“只要锂空气电池吗？”

傅明喃喃：“传统的大容积电池比能不足，恐怕做不到为城市持续供电。”

当然，更高级的电池是可控核聚变电池。但想想也知道不可能出现在地表。就算真有，基地也不可能卖给光辉市……哪怕前面的恶劣条件都克服了，100个光辉市加起来也买不起。

相南里有些失真的声音从电话那头传来：“嗯。我的意思是，基地有电站，可以供电，你们要买电吗？”

傅明的双眼瞪大，呼吸骤然急促起来。

……

……

永恒之城的二楼会议室。

相南里在地图上，用红笔画了一个圈。

“永恒市到基地主城一百余里，电网建设是一条直线。以此为轴，附近的据点都发送了外交邀请函。”

丰收节是相南里随口瞎诌的。节日当然是需要办的，大家辛苦劳作了这么久，需要一些庆祝。

而且，节日可以增加精神上的凝聚力。

基地也需要找个理由外交一下。

相南里在下很大一盘棋。

电网建设的成本，是很高的。

而基地，又是很穷的。

傅明的求助，给了他一个崭新的思路。

如果一个据点负责建设一截，那么平摊下来，成本就会少很多。

电网建设好之后，相南里打算给参与电网建设的人类据点一段时间的电费优惠。

相南里得到了电路，他们得到了电能。也算互利互惠了。

薅羊毛也得讲究可持续发展。

而且，这么做还有一个好处，可以用共同利益，把周围的小据点团结起来。

在没有利益冲突的情况下，永恒市的人和其他据点的人，在相南里眼中，都是一样的。

他希望更多人能得到帮扶，哪怕他和这些人素昧平生。

而且把人邀请过来，未尝没有展示肌肉的意思。

相南里转身，开始安排：“葛根。之前仓库里那些坏掉的炮，除一下锈放城墙上。丰收节期间的安保和巡逻由你一并负责。”

“海狸，做一下财政预算。丰收节期间，把仓库里那些没用的珠宝瓷器都拿来拍卖吧，放在仓库里也是占地方。”

这些贵金属是之前的大老爷们留下的。

“小福。你在主控室，操控一下城里的机器人。另外督促一下公路建设，起码在丰收节召开前，得把主干道修好。”

“安德鲁，你点几个学堂的学生。和你一起组成外交团，负责接待。这段时间我会多造几个广播机器人。”

相南里不仅邀请了附近据点的人，还派机器人姑苏城发了一下传单。

至于他们来不来，那就不是相南里要操心的事了。

相南里念了一圈名字，把工作都外包了出去，感觉毫无纰漏，这才满意地点点头：“就这样吧，散会。”

早在当年做科研的时候，相南里就清楚一件事：能交给别人做的工作，最好不要自己来，以免造成劳动力的浪费。

什么事都亲力亲为，他迟早会累死在岗位上！

嗯，至于为什么这堆人里没有东方青帝——

之前网购的扶贫材料到了，姑苏城扶贫基金会表示，之前的司机因为菌丝感染病逝了，还没有招新的。目前劳动力短缺，实在没空送货！

所以，小青被他派去拿快递了。
chunks.englishText:
Fu Ming dialed the base’s phone number with a heart full of trepidation.

He waited about two minutes for the call to be patched through.

The voice he had just heard through the recording orb came over the line: "Hello, this is Xiang Nanli. The operator said you were looking for me. Is there something you need?"

Fu Ming had already introduced himself previously, so he cut straight to the point: "Commander Xiang, I wanted to ask if you have any lithium-air batteries over there?"

Xiang Nanli pondered for a moment. "Is it only lithium-air batteries you need?"

Fu Ming murmured, "Traditional high-capacity batteries lack sufficient energy density; I’m afraid they won't be enough to provide continuous power to the city."

Of course, a more advanced option would be controlled nuclear fusion batteries. But he knew better than to think such things would appear on the surface. Even if they did exist, the base would never sell them to Radiant City... and even if they overcame all the preceding logistical nightmares, 100 Radiant Cities combined couldn't afford one.

Xiang Nanli’s slightly distorted voice came from the other end: "I see. What I meant was, the base has a power station that can supply electricity. Are you looking to buy power?"

Fu Ming’s eyes widened, his breathing suddenly quickening.

……

……

In the second-floor conference room of Eternal City.

Xiang Nanli drew a circle on the map with a red pen.

"It’s over a hundred miles from Eternal City to the base’s main hub, and the power grid construction will be a straight line. Using this as an axis, I’ve sent diplomatic invitations to all nearby outposts."

The "Harvest Festival" was something Xiang Nanli had just made up on the spot. Of course, a festival was necessary; everyone had been working hard for so long, and they needed a reason to celebrate.

Moreover, a festival could boost morale and cohesion.

The base also needed a pretext for diplomacy.

Xiang Nanli was playing a very big game.

The cost of building a power grid was astronomical.

And the base, as it stood, was quite poor.

Fu Ming’s plea for help had given him a brand-new line of thinking.

If each outpost took responsibility for building a section, the costs would be spread out and significantly reduced.

Once the grid was completed, Xiang Nanli planned to offer the human outposts that participated a period of discounted electricity rates.

Xiang Nanli would gain the circuitry, and they would gain the power. It was a mutually beneficial arrangement.

Even when "shearing the sheep," one had to practice sustainable development.

Furthermore, this had another benefit: it could use shared interests to unite the surrounding small outposts.

In the absence of conflicting interests, the people of Eternal City and the people of other outposts were all the same in Xiang Nanli’s eyes.

He hoped more people could receive support, even if he had never met them before.

Besides, inviting them over was also a way to flex some muscle.

Xiang Nanli turned around and began delegating: "Ge Gen, take those broken cannons from the warehouse, remove the rust, and place them on the city walls. You will be responsible for security and patrols during the Harvest Festival."

"Beaver, work on the fiscal budget. During the festival, take all those useless jewelry and porcelain pieces from the warehouse and auction them off. They’re just taking up space."

These precious metals had been left behind by the "big shots" of the past.

"Xiao Fu, you stay in the main control room and manage the city’s robots. Also, urge the road construction teams; we need the main thoroughfares finished at least before the festival begins."

"Andrew, pick a few students from the academy to form a diplomatic delegation with you. You’ll be responsible for hosting. I’ll build a few more broadcast robots during this time."

Xiang Nanli hadn't just invited people from nearby outposts; he had also sent robots to Gusu City to distribute flyers.

As for whether they would come or not, that wasn't something Xiang Nanli needed to worry about.

Xiang Nanli finished reciting the list of names, having outsourced all the work, and nodded with satisfaction, feeling that nothing had been overlooked. "That’s all. Meeting adjourned."

Back when he was doing scientific research, Xiang Nanli had understood one thing: work that could be handed off to others should never be done by oneself, lest it lead to a waste of labor.

If he insisted on doing everything himself, he would eventually drop dead at his post!

Oh, and as for why Dongfang Qingdi wasn't among this group—

The poverty-alleviation supplies he had ordered online had arrived. The Gusu City Poverty Alleviation Foundation had stated that their previous driver had passed away from a mycelium infection and they hadn't hired a replacement yet. There was a labor shortage, and they truly had no time to deliver the goods!

So, Xiao Qing had been sent to pick up the express delivery.

chunks.chineseText:
第90章 意外的物资

前方，已经出现姑苏城的影子。

他发了一个定位给相南里，然后撩起散落在眼前的长发，微微吐出一口呼吸。

车内没开空调，气温起码零下两三度。东方青帝吐出来的气息却没有氤氲的水汽。

在相南里不在的时候，小青是不那么想装人的。

之前几次来姑苏城，地表虽然比地下人少，但也有十几万人常驻，如今街上却冷冷清清，几乎看不见人影。

路边到处贴着防护标语，偶尔有几个人匆匆路过，身上也穿着厚厚的防护服。街道建筑的潮湿墙角，细细的菌斑冒了出来。

墙上正在播放永生科技的新广告。

抑制剂在第一时间内得到了推广，甚至没有进行太多临床实验。

因为来不及了。

广告上说，抑制剂是永生科技自主研发出来的药剂。

抑制剂使用方式为注射。价格150信用点/支。不算贵，普通人也负担得起。使用后效果明显，指标显著好转。

可惜不能药到病除，需要持续打针。有些病情严重的，一次性还得多打几针。

肆虐的菌丝病得到了一定程度的控制，给了大家一点喘息的时间。

网友们纷纷表示“还得是永生科技”。

但是具体是哪一位学者，却没有报告。

大家猜测是李斯特。

可李斯特在接受采访时，特地把这一条提出来，进行了否认。

不过，他也没有说出研发者的名字。

东方青帝开着皮卡车，来到导航给的地表扶贫基金会地址。

他给出电子码，说明来意。

门卫狐疑地打量着他，来回看了好几次，这才慢吞吞开口：“你等会，我去问问领导。”

说完，在键盘上摁了两下，含糊不清地“嗯嗯”两声，随后放下电话。

这一问，就过去了半个小时。

东方青帝在等到第5秒的时候，就有些不耐烦。但是想起离开前，相南里的嘱咐，这才没有当场翻脸。

相南里是这么嘱咐的：“小青，这次你一个人去领物资，代表的是我们基地的形象。多笑笑，不要让别人觉得我们基地没有礼貌。”

但无论从哪个角度看，等个30分钟，没礼貌的人都不是他。

东方青帝走过去，敲了敲玻璃：“好了吗？”

门卫不耐烦地蹙眉：“等着！赵主任还没上班。”

今天是工作日，现在是工作时。赵主任居然没上班。

东方青帝想，一拳头砸下去的暴力确实很美，但这会给相南里带来一些麻烦，而且也不能从根本上，解决问题。

门卫如果知道自己凶过Alpha，怕是会忍不住向人联申请三等英勇奖章。

他抬头，扫了眼员工墙上赵主任的照片，眼眸里亮起微光。

监控网络入侵。

进度，0——100。

搜索中，面孔识别中。

锁定。

东方青帝转身，离开基金会门口。去车上拿了面罩，扣在自己脸上。

他又路过医用自助贩卖机，淡淡地扫了眼，自动贩卖机紧张且自觉地吐出一双手套。

隔了会发现东方青帝竟然还没走，它试探性地吐出了自己货箱里最贵的东西——1管修复型的1级基因药。

东方青帝没拿，转身走了。

小AI庆幸中又有些失落。

……

……

东方青帝绕开监控，来到了赵主任的家。

赵主任正在地表的住宅里，搂着爱偶呼呼大睡。

随着技术发展，爱偶的价格大幅下降，价格恰好比普通人类贵两成，但质量更好，于是逐渐成为小财主的嫖娼首选。

东方青帝从口袋里掏出手套，戴好，这才一把薅住赵主任的头发，把他的脑袋提了起来。

赵主任显然还没从梦里苏醒，吃疼地叫出声：“谁？！干什么！啊啊……啊！好痛疼疼疼——”

他睁开眼，对上了一双毫无情绪的眼眸。

有瞳环，这是高等人造人。对方眼眸里的瞳环像是过于刺眼的日晕，下半张脸被黑色的獠牙面具覆盖。

赵主任虽然在地表横行无忌，吃拿卡要，但很清楚什么人惹得起，什么人惹不起。

他只会欺凌小人物。就是那种，被欺负了，一个关系都找不到，只会哭着说“我要找律师”的那种小人物。他确信自己没见过东方青帝，也不可能惹到拥有高等人造人的世家子弟。

赵主任心跳如擂鼓，说话都哆嗦：“您、您……是有什么事吗？我一定配合，配合。”

他并不觉得对方是来杀自己的。原因很简单，赵某从不觉得自己干过特别伤天害理的大案，顶多伤风败俗。

小青吐出四个字：“扶贫物资。”

赵主任冷汗直流：“啊，是交给黑哥的货有问题，还是嫌少。这位大哥，基金会也不止我一个主任啊，有领导发话了，面子还是要给的。有事好商量。”

人类的社会真复杂。小青想，要不是他在人联上过126年班，还真听不懂赵主任在讲什么。

东方青帝握着他头的手缓缓收紧：“不给？”

赵主任几乎听到了自己头骨咯咯作响的声音，剧痛和死亡的压力让他忍不住尖叫：“给！给！”

东方青帝这才松手。

他喊了声：“丹尼尔。”

丹尼尔是赵主任为了自身安全，花一百二十万购买的安保机器人。配备有武器装置，在过去十几年里，帮赵主任解决过许多麻烦。

它在赵主任震惊的目光下，回答：“在。”

“去厨房拿把刀。”

丹尼尔前往厨房，拿着刀回到了卧室。

东方青帝接过刀，用刀尖抵住了赵主任的头：“我不为难你。我只想要物资。如果你敢有别的动静，那么以后遇到的每一台机器人，你都要小心。明白吗？”

赵主任蹲在地上，刀尖刺破他的头皮，一缕鲜红的血顺着头顶滑下。

他颤抖着，疯狂点头。不明白连安保系统都能黑的势力为什么会盯上这么点扶贫物资。

半个小时后，穿戴整齐的赵主任和东方青帝一起来到了基金会的仓库。

门口有安保机器人，赵主任亮出权限后，大卡车很顺利地开进了重兵把守的仓储地。

仓库建在城区，两条街外就是警察局。

赵主任却没有丝毫报警的念头。毕竟这些物资也不是他出钱买的。更何况真调查起来，他也不怎么干净。

他还有大好生活，不能进局子。

仓储中心有16个大仓库，每扇门想打开，都需要双重权限。

第一重权限是基金会的，第二重则是贫困户那边的电子码。

赵主任不知走了什么门路，所有大门都能自由打开。

看来平时没少倒卖人联物资。

他咬牙道：“你别全部装走，得给我留着点。要不然我没办法交差。还有些是其他大人物安排的。就是箱子上有红圈标记的……你拿走我也是死！你要拿走，我只能和你鱼死网破了！”

东方青帝觉得，顶多鱼死，不会网破。
chunks.englishText:
The silhouette of Gusu City had already appeared on the horizon.

He sent his coordinates to Xiang Nanli, then brushed back the long hair falling over his eyes and let out a faint breath.

The car’s air conditioning wasn't on, and the temperature was at least two or three degrees below zero. Yet, the breath Dongfang Qingdi exhaled carried no misty water vapor.

When Xiang Nanli wasn't around, Xiao Qing didn't feel much like pretending to be human.

During his previous visits to Gusu City, although the surface had fewer people than the underground, there were still over a hundred thousand permanent residents. Now, however, the streets were desolate, with barely a soul in sight.

Protective slogans were plastered everywhere along the roadside, and the few people who hurried past were clad in thick hazmat suits. In the damp corners of the street buildings, fine patches of fungal mold were beginning to sprout.

On the walls, a new advertisement for Eternal Technology was playing.

Inhibitors had been promoted immediately, without even undergoing extensive clinical trials.

Because there was no time left.

The ad claimed that the inhibitor was a drug independently developed by Eternal Technology.

The method of administration was injection. The price was 150 credit points per dose. It wasn't considered expensive, and ordinary people could afford it. The effects were noticeable after use, with indicators showing significant improvement.

Unfortunately, it wasn't a cure-all; it required continuous injections. For those with severe conditions, multiple doses were needed at once.

The rampant mycelium disease had been brought under a certain degree of control, giving everyone a moment to breathe.

Netizens chimed in, saying, "Eternal Technology is still the best."

But as for which specific scholar had developed it, no report was made.

Everyone guessed it was Lister.

However, when Lister was interviewed, he specifically brought up this point to deny it.

Still, he didn't reveal the name of the developer.

Dongfang Qingdi drove the pickup truck to the address of the Surface Poverty Alleviation Foundation provided by the navigation.

He presented the electronic code and explained his purpose.

The guard eyed him suspiciously, looking him up and down several times before speaking slowly: "Wait here. I’ll go ask the director."

After saying that, he tapped the keyboard twice, muttered an indistinct "uh-huh," and hung up the phone.

That "ask" turned into a thirty-minute wait.

Dongfang Qingdi had grown impatient by the fifth second. But remembering Xiang Nanli’s instructions before he left, he refrained from losing his temper on the spot.

Xiang Nanli had instructed him thus: "Xiao Qing, this time you’re going to collect the supplies alone, and you represent the image of our base. Smile more; don't let others think our base lacks manners."

But no matter how you looked at it, waiting 30 minutes meant the person lacking manners wasn't him.

Dongfang Qingdi walked over and knocked on the glass: "Is it ready?"

The guard frowned impatiently: "Wait! Director Zhao hasn't started his shift yet."

Today was a workday, and it was currently working hours. Yet Director Zhao hadn't started his shift.

Dongfang Qingdi thought that the violence of smashing a fist down was indeed beautiful, but it would bring some trouble to Xiang Nanli, and it wouldn't solve the problem at its root.

If the guard knew he had been rude to an Alpha, he would probably be unable to resist applying to the Human Alliance for a Third-Class Medal of Valor.

He looked up, scanned the photo of Director Zhao on the employee wall, and a faint light flickered in his eyes.

Monitoring network intrusion.

Progress: 0—100.

Searching. Facial recognition in progress.

Locked.

Dongfang Qingdi turned and left the entrance of the foundation. He went to the car, retrieved a mask, and snapped it onto his face.

He passed by a medical vending machine, glanced at it coldly, and the machine, feeling nervous and self-aware, obediently spat out a pair of gloves.

After a while, noticing that Dongfang Qingdi still hadn't left, it tentatively spat out the most expensive item in its inventory—a single vial of Level 1 regenerative gene serum.

Dongfang Qingdi didn't take it and walked away.

The little AI felt a mix of relief and disappointment.

……

……

Dongfang Qingdi bypassed the surveillance and arrived at Director Zhao’s home.

Director Zhao was fast asleep in his surface residence, cuddling with a companion android.

With the development of technology, the price of companion androids had dropped significantly, costing just 20% more than an average human but offering better quality, thus becoming the preferred choice for petty rich men.

Dongfang Qingdi pulled the gloves from his pocket, put them on, and then grabbed Director Zhao by the hair, lifting his head up.

Director Zhao clearly hadn't woken from his dream yet and cried out in pain: "Who?! What are you doing! Ah... ah! It hurts, it hurts, it hurts—"

He opened his eyes and met a pair of emotionless pupils.

There were iris rings; this was a high-level android. The rings in the other party’s eyes looked like an overly blinding sun halo, and the lower half of his face was covered by a black fanged mask.

Although Director Zhao ran rampant on the surface, extorting and taking bribes, he knew very well who he could provoke and who he couldn't.

He only bullied small-time characters. The kind who, when bullied, couldn't find a single connection and would only cry, "I’m going to find a lawyer." He was certain he had never seen Dongfang Qingdi, and it was impossible for him to have offended a scion of a noble family who owned a high-level android.

Director Zhao’s heart hammered like a drum; he was trembling as he spoke: "D-do... do you have some business? I will definitely cooperate, cooperate."

He didn't think the other party was here to kill him. The reason was simple: Director Zhao never felt he had committed any particularly heinous crimes; at most, he was just morally corrupt.

Xiao Qing spat out four words: "Poverty alleviation supplies."

Director Zhao broke into a cold sweat: "Ah, is there a problem with the shipment for Brother Hei, or is it not enough? Big Brother, I’m not the only director at the foundation. The higher-ups have given orders, and we have to save face. We can talk things over."

Human society was truly complex. Xiao Qing thought that if he hadn't spent 126 years working for the Human Alliance, he wouldn't have understood a word of what Director Zhao was saying.

Dongfang Qingdi’s hand, gripping his hair, slowly tightened: "You won't give them?"

Director Zhao could almost hear his own skull creaking; the intense pain and the pressure of death made him scream: "I’ll give them! I’ll give them!"

Dongfang Qingdi then let go.

He called out: "Daniel."

Daniel was a security robot Director Zhao had purchased for 1.2 million to ensure his own safety. It was equipped with weapon systems and had helped Director Zhao solve many problems over the past decade.

Under Director Zhao’s shocked gaze, it replied: "Present."

"Go to the kitchen and get a knife."

Daniel went to the kitchen and returned to the bedroom with a knife.

Dongfang Qingdi took the knife and pressed the tip against Director Zhao’s head: "I won't make things difficult for you. I only want the supplies. If you dare to make any other moves, then you’d better be careful of every robot you encounter from now on. Understand?"

Director Zhao crouched on the ground, the knife tip piercing his scalp, a streak of bright red blood sliding down his head.

He trembled and nodded frantically. He didn't understand why a force capable of hacking even security systems would target such a small amount of poverty-alleviation supplies.

Half an hour later, a well-dressed Director Zhao and Dongfang Qingdi arrived at the foundation’s warehouse together.

There were security robots at the entrance, but after Director Zhao displayed his authorization, the large truck drove smoothly into the heavily guarded storage area.

The warehouse was built in the city center, just two streets away from the police station.

Yet, Director Zhao didn't have the slightest thought of calling the police. After all, he hadn't paid for these supplies himself. Moreover, if they really investigated, he wasn't exactly clean either.

He still had a great life to live; he couldn't afford to end up in the station.

The storage center had 16 large warehouses, and each door required dual authorization to open.

The first level of authorization belonged to the foundation, and the second was the electronic code from the impoverished households.

Director Zhao didn't know what backdoors he had used, but he could open all the gates freely.

It seemed he didn't shy away from reselling Human Alliance supplies.

He gritted his teeth and said: "Don't take it all; you have to leave some for me. Otherwise, I won't be able to report back. And some of these were arranged by other big shots. The ones with the red circle markings on the boxes... if you take those, I’m dead! If you take them, I’ll have no choice but to go down with you!"

Dongfang Qingdi felt that, at most, the fish would die, but the net wouldn't break.

chunks.chineseText:
他扫描了一下红圈标记里的东西，发现里面居然是一箱箱多巴胺片，还有一些较为落后的军用枪械，于是不感兴趣地收回了目光。

是的，一千年过去了，最赚钱的生意还是写在刑法里。

东方青帝在仓库里挑挑选选，如同在菜市场买菜，明显不怎么对头，但路过的机器人没一个有反应。

这就是程序的死板之处，人类保安早就上来问东问西了。

姑苏城的物资刚到，赵主任还没来得及倒卖。

小青把它们装进车厢里，又去别的仓库，挑挑拣拣了一些；像是在逛自助超市。

把车厢装满后，东方青帝想起相南里的嘱托，很有礼貌地开口：“谢谢。”

赵主任：“……？”

领物资又耽搁了一天。傍晚，东方青帝收到了相南里发来的消息。

里里：小青~东西领到了吗？

我：嗯，挺顺利的。

我：我马上回家。

“家”，这个字脱口而出的时候，东方青帝愣了一下。

然后他的嘴角不太明显地上扬了一点。

赵主任像送瘟神一样把他送走了。

*

基地忙起来，全城上下，连一条机械狗都有自己的每日工作计划。

更别提处于旋涡中心的相南里。

每当这时，相南里就格外怀念小青。

他们的意见总是如此一致。

小青办事，相南里是很放心的。

耳蜗里传来消息的提示音。

相南里打开，看了眼。

是李斯特又发来了一张图片，配以大段说明文字。

图片是实验分析数据图，外加相南里看不懂的生物影像权重图。

呵呵……如果是研究怎么设计网络采样程序，相南里也许还有点发言权。

李斯特：发给你们首席。

幸存者基地：好的~亲亲~我会帮忙转达的~

自从花了六千万购买专利后，李斯特时不时就会上线，要求售后服务。

这个售后就包括一起探讨后续实验进程。

相南里原本有些担心，北辰被卖了还帮人数钱。

但北辰坦言，李斯特的研究对他也很有启发，甚至帮忙排除了很多错误答案。非要说的话还是基地比较赚。

相南里这才放心下来。

“实验室资源不是很够，李斯特帮我们节省了一大笔开支呢。”北辰在电话里是这么说的。

嗯，至于他们为什么不绕开相南里直接对话……

那当然是因为基地没网，北辰只能和永恒市（准确来说是和相南里）通讯。

转述的效率会低很多。

基本要第二天，李斯特才能收到北辰的回复。

李斯特忍了又忍，终于到了耐心耗尽的边缘：你们首席是有保密协议吗？可以让他直接和我通讯吗？

如果说有保密协议，那他们最近互换的消息，已经涉及到核心机密了。

幸存者基地：不是喔~亲亲，是我们基地没有网~~~

李斯特：……

几分钟后。

李斯特：把你们基地地址发给我，我捐个通讯天线。

相南里：⊙▽⊙？！

还有这种好事？
chunks.englishText:
He scanned the items marked with red circles and discovered they were crates of dopamine tablets, along with some outdated military firearms. He lost interest and withdrew his gaze.

Yes, a thousand years had passed, and the most profitable businesses were still the ones written in the criminal code.

Dongfang Qingdi picked and chose in the warehouse as if he were shopping at a vegetable market. It was clearly not right, but none of the passing robots reacted.

This was the rigidity of programming; human security guards would have come up to ask questions long ago.

The supplies for Gusu City had just arrived, and Director Zhao hadn't had time to resell them yet.

Xiao Qing loaded them into the truck, then went to other warehouses, picking and choosing; it was like browsing a self-service supermarket.

After filling the truck, Dongfang Qingdi remembered Xiang Nanli’s instructions and said very politely: "Thank you."

Director Zhao: "...?"

Collecting the supplies had delayed him for another day. In the evening, Dongfang Qingdi received a message from Xiang Nanli.

Lili: Xiao Qing~ Did you get the stuff?

Me: Yes, it went quite smoothly.

Me: I’m coming home now.

When the word "home" slipped out, Dongfang Qingdi paused.

Then, the corners of his mouth lifted slightly, almost imperceptibly.

Director Zhao sent him off as if he were getting rid of a plague god.

*

The base was busy; everyone in the city, down to the mechanical dogs, had their own daily work schedule.

Not to mention Xiang Nanli, who was at the center of the vortex.

Whenever this happened, Xiang Nanli especially missed Xiao Qing.

Their opinions were always so consistent.

Xiang Nanli was very reassured by the way Xiao Qing handled things.

A notification sound came from his cochlear implant.

Xiang Nanli opened it and took a look.

It was Lister, who had sent another image accompanied by a long paragraph of explanatory text.

The image was an experimental data chart, plus some biological imaging weight maps that Xiang Nanli couldn't understand.

Heh... if it were about designing network sampling programs, Xiang Nanli might have had some say.

Lister: Send this to your Chief.

Survivor Base: Okay~ Dear~ I will pass it along for you~

Ever since spending sixty million to purchase the patent, Lister would go online from time to time to demand after-sales service.

This after-sales service included discussing the progress of subsequent experiments together.

Xiang Nanli had originally been worried that Beichen was being sold out and still helping the other party count the money.

But Beichen admitted that Lister’s research was also very inspiring to him and had even helped eliminate many wrong answers. If anything, the base was actually the one profiting.

Only then did Xiang Nanli feel relieved.

"Laboratory resources aren't quite enough; Lister is helping us save a huge amount of expenses," Beichen had said over the phone.

As for why they didn't bypass Xiang Nanli and communicate directly...

That was, of course, because the base had no internet, and Beichen could only communicate with Eternal City (or, more accurately, with Xiang Nanli).

The efficiency of relaying messages was much lower.

It would basically take until the next day for Lister to receive Beichen’s reply.

Lister endured and endured, finally reaching the edge of his patience: Does your Chief have a non-disclosure agreement? Can you let him communicate with me directly?

If there was a non-disclosure agreement, the messages they had been exchanging recently already involved core secrets.

Survivor Base: Not really~ Dear, it’s just that our base doesn't have internet~~~

Lister: ...

A few minutes later.

Lister: Send me your base’s address; I’ll donate a communication antenna.

Xiang Nanli: ⊙▽⊙?!

There was such a good thing?

chunks.chineseText:
第91章 遛蛇夫座

基地目前在地图上没有定位，他怕送货的找不到地方。

送到永恒市，到时候可以让小福一起拉回去。

相南里哼着歌，拧好了牵引绳护胸上的最后一颗小螺丝。

这是给天狼星制作的牵引绳，连体的。

人联发展这么久，什么傻逼衣服都有人做。相南里在网上找到了近似的图纸，然后按照自己的理解改了改。

左边是天狼星穿的，类似于马甲制服，完美地解决了天狼星上半身没穿衣服的问题。

右边是给蛇夫座的，是镂空的鱼骨环，整体是圆柱形。

两边都内置了导电装置。必要时能让圣灵同志体验一下什么叫做“以雷霆击碎黑暗”。

相南里对自己的设计还挺满意的。他扛着三十多斤重的金属，来到地下孵化池。

天狼星对他每天什么时候到已经很熟悉了。相南里刚走出楼梯口，畸形的蛇人共同体就从洞穴口缓缓爬了出来。

天狼星拿头蹭着相南里的胳膊，一边的蛇夫座很不情愿，但又无可奈何。

“好了，好了。”相南里把它往外推，“不要这么黏人。”

[黏人是因为你好吃。]小智幽幽地补充。

相南里在蛇夫座的嗅觉体系里，闻起来应该是香香的。

经过一段时间的喂养，圣灵的体格略有增加。

相南里粗略地量了一下，算上尾巴，蛇夫座现在有12米长。

相南里把桶里的糊状的饲料倒在了天狼星的食槽里。

饲料的主要成分：进口营养膏、异种动物内脏、异种肉、菌肉。

蛇夫座坚决不吃菌子，但相南里发现，把菌子和其他食材煮在一起，它根本认不出来，于是放心大胆地以次充好。

可怜的蛇夫座，被狡猾的人类玩弄于股掌之间。

两个脑袋都吃得呼噜呼噜的，相南里摸着蛇夫座的脑袋，若有所思：“野外养了只蜥尾吗喽，地底养了只冷血爬宠。所以我的真实职业应该是饲养员？”

小智：[饲养员指的是负责饲养动物和清洁居所，以及观察动物状态与行为，并及时报告的专业人员。您只负责投喂，连饲料都是食堂的厨子帮忙熬的。并没有履行饲养员的责任。]

[综上所述，我认为，你和天狼星、蛇夫座、以西结的关系更倾向于主人与散养的宠物；而不是饲养员与保护动物。]

相南里：“……”

分析得很好，下次别分析了。

有两个脑袋吃饭就是快，不到三分钟，食槽就见底了。

相南里把自制的胸背带穿在了双头蛇的身上，调整好尺寸，又在外面给它们分别套上了衣服。

相南里没做牵引绳。感觉那样太像遛狗了，不太尊重圣灵。

而且圣灵本体都十几米长了。上哪去找几十米长还轻巧、结实的绳子？没必要。

相南里对它的装扮很是满意：“刚好现在也是晚上。走吧，我们去地表逛逛。”

蛇夫座发出一阵“嘶嘶”的鸣叫。

天狼星这半边身体虽然无限接近于人型，但腹腔内部没有脏器。只是一团接近人类外观的肉块。

根据扫描，它唯一保留下来的人类器官是大脑。

相南里打开地窖的门，让天狼星顺着楼梯爬了出来。

它在地底关了大半年，还是第一次呼吸到地表带着淡淡辐射的新鲜空气，此时难免好奇地东张西望。

黑暗中，它的蛇瞳有些反光，蛇信子无意识地吐出。

相南里伸出手，感叹了一句：“下雪了呢。”

这里位于角斗场附近，离主城区还有一点距离。碎石铺成的道路人烟罕至，周围是稀疏的树木。

城墙上，一排炮筒对准了外界。

蛇夫座的传承记忆里有这个东西。

和菌子一样，它被类似外形的东西伤害过。

而且这些炮筒里射出来的豌豆不能吃。

天都黑了，葛根还在加班。为了呼应“丰收节”这个主题，葛根等人正在用麦穗装点城门和炮筒。

蛇夫座扫视一圈，对外界环境做出一个大概的判断。有一定的威胁，但似乎可以克服。

那个让它感觉恐惧的男人不在。

相南里今天也没有戴机械外骨骼。

蛇夫座的心思略微活络起来。

它安静地跟在相南里身后，庞大的躯体碾压过地上的石板，发出一阵令人牙酸的“咔咔”声。

“小夫，我们就绕着内城走一圈吧。这是你目前住的地方，叫永恒市，我跟你介绍一下喔~”

相南里就像是带着客人来自己家里参观一样，介绍了市里的学校、市政厅、公园、纪念碑广场，还有马上竣工的商业街！

商业街的规模不大。街口设置有保安亭，防止小偷以及商业纠纷。

街道两边，有一些水泥砌好的平台，都是市里统一安排的。

今年是永恒市第一次召开丰收节，这些摊位都没要租金。

市民填写好自己的经营类型，并且进行书面申请，审批通过后，就能领到小商铺的临时使用权。

商业街还没开业，但已经有摊主开始装点摊位了。招牌上系起彩色的丝带。又或者用颜料画上简笔画，告诉顾客自己店里卖的什么品类。

相南里手背在身后，一边闲逛，一边和天狼星畅想未来：“其实我是希望商业街的摊位可以常驻的，但永恒市自己的人流量不够。而且我们目前是集体经济，没有那么多物质需求。但想要富裕起来，商业是必不可少的。”

他想召开丰收节，当然不是钱多烧得慌，而是希望有其他据点的新鲜血液涌入。

用比较官方的话来说，丰收节可以提高市民的文化自信，并且宣传基地的优越性。

如果能达成目的，小亏一点，相南里也是愿意的。

“我让海狸多准备了很多工分券，暂时不用考虑通胀。等丰收节后，再提供一些人联的商品，用于回收市民手里的票据，平抑物价的同时可以让经济进一步繁荣……”

相南里开始自言自语，有一种不管蛇夫座死活的美。

蛇夫座盯着他的后背，瞳仁竖起。同样陷入了思考中。

有好几次，蛇夫座都想暴起，咬住相南里的后颈。

东方青帝不在，这也许是它离开的最佳时机。

它是尊贵的圣灵，不该像家畜一样，被关在暗无天日的地底。

相南里提供的食物，只能保证它不会饿死，蛇夫座一直处于三分饱虚弱状态中。

可是……

如果要离开，那就必然需要让相南里失去知觉。太轻相南里不会昏迷，太重脆弱的人类会死。

一想到以后闻不到相南里散发出来的那种淡淡的檀香，蛇夫座会觉得有些遗憾。

更重要的是，就算顺利逃走。伤到相南里，那个小气的男人一定会来复仇的。

蛇夫座的神色变幻莫测，好在它只是一颗蛇头。让蛇头表现出拟人化的情绪，还是太困难了一点。

它的腹部肌肉绷紧，这是蛇类准备捕猎的姿势；又放松。反复数次，一直到走回孵化池入口，它也没能做出决定。

算了。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 91: Walking the Ophiuchus

The base currently had no location marker on the map, and he was worried that delivery personnel wouldn't be able to find the place.

He would have them delivered to Eternal City, and then Xiao Fu could help haul them back together.

Xiang Nanli hummed a tune as he tightened the final small screw on the chest protector of the harness.

This was a custom-made, full-body harness for Sirius.

The Human Alliance had been developing for so long that people made all sorts of ridiculous clothing. Xiang Nanli had found a rough schematic online and modified it according to his own understanding.

The left side was for Sirius, resembling a tactical vest, which perfectly solved the problem of Sirius not wearing anything on its upper body.

The right side was for Ophiuchus, a hollowed-out fishbone ring, cylindrical in overall shape.

Both sides had built-in conductive devices. When necessary, he could let his Holy Spirit comrade experience what it meant to "shatter the darkness with thunder."

Xiang Nanli was quite satisfied with his design. Carrying over thirty pounds of metal, he headed down to the underground incubation pool.

Sirius was already very familiar with what time he arrived every day. As soon as Xiang Nanli stepped out of the stairwell, the deformed snake-human composite slowly crawled out from the cave entrance.

Sirius rubbed its head against Xiang Nanli’s arm, while Ophiuchus, on the other side, looked reluctant but helpless.

"Alright, alright," Xiang Nanli pushed it away. "Don't be so clingy."

[It's only clingy because you taste good,] Xiao Zhi added gloomily.

In Ophiuchus’s olfactory system, Xiang Nanli likely smelled delicious.

After a period of feeding, the Holy Spirit’s physique had grown slightly.

Xiang Nanli did a rough measurement; including the tail, Ophiuchus was now 12 meters long.

Xiang Nanli poured the pasty feed from the bucket into Sirius’s trough.

The main ingredients of the feed: imported nutritional paste, viscera of xenomorphic animals, xenomorphic meat, and fungal meat.

Ophiuchus adamantly refused to eat fungi, but Xiang Nanli discovered that if he cooked the fungi together with other ingredients, it couldn't tell the difference at all, so he boldly passed off the inferior goods as premium.

Poor Ophiuchus, played right into the palm of a cunning human.

Both heads ate with loud, rumbling sounds. Xiang Nanli stroked Ophiuchus’s head, lost in thought: "I’m raising a lizard-tailed monkey in the wild and a cold-blooded reptile underground. So, my true profession is actually a zookeeper?"

Xiao Zhi: [A zookeeper is a professional responsible for feeding animals, cleaning their habitats, and observing their status and behavior to report in a timely manner. You are only responsible for feeding; even the feed is prepared by the cafeteria cook. You have not fulfilled the responsibilities of a zookeeper.]

[In summary, I believe your relationship with Sirius, Ophiuchus, and Ezekiel is more akin to that of an owner and free-range pets, rather than a zookeeper and protected animals.]

Xiang Nanli: "..."

Great analysis. Don't analyze next time.

Having two heads meant eating fast; in less than three minutes, the trough was empty.

Xiang Nanli put the homemade harness on the two-headed snake, adjusted the size, and then put their respective clothes on over it.

Xiang Nanli didn't make a leash. It felt too much like walking a dog, which felt disrespectful to a Holy Spirit.

Besides, the Holy Spirit itself was over ten meters long. Where would he find a leash that was dozens of meters long, lightweight, and sturdy? It wasn't necessary.

Xiang Nanli was very satisfied with its attire: "It’s night time anyway. Let’s go, let’s go to the surface for a stroll."

Ophiuchus let out a series of "hissing" sounds.
