What he envied wasn't having meat to eat; it was that an ordinary farmer in Eternal City could actually have enough surplus grain to sell...

Fu Ming thought he had to find a way to build a good relationship with the base. If he could buy some cheap grain while buying electricity this time, that would be even better.

Fu Ming was taken to the cafeteria for a meal and gained a higher level of understanding of the base’s wealth.

However, while in the cafeteria, Fu Ming saw some acquaintances he didn't particularly like.

It was the people from Rome City.

They wore Roman robes and rattan sandals, exposing their bare chests in the freezing snow. The men were nearly 2 meters tall, with faces full of flesh and a thick, fierce bandit aura about them.

There were three of them in total, occupying a long table. Their eyes scanned left and right; there was no obvious killing intent, but it was still uncomfortable. Like rats lurking in the shadows.

Fu Ming couldn't help but whisper a warning: "Rome City made its fortune by robbing; they still have a slave system internally, and their leader is a mechanical cyborg. Their numbers aren't large, but they often roam around various strongholds to commit crimes..."

Moreover, the leader was very smart. They only hit small strongholds and never touched large ones. They also wouldn't provoke the Human Alliance or the Divine Court. They were like locusts, ruining crops just to live a few good days for themselves.

Rome City was also on the route between the base and Eternal City. Therefore, they had also received an invitation to the Harvest Festival.

Back then, Xiang Nanli had even left a "Serf Liberation Hotline" on their tree trunks.

Under normal circumstances, Eternal City, with its population of 70,000 and towering walls, was not on their target list for robbery.

But this year, because of the mycelium disease, Rome City’s harvest had been very poor. The "fat sheep" in the underground cities weren't coming out anymore!

Fu Ming had vaguely heard some rumors and was somewhat worried that Eternal City was "inviting a wolf into the house."

"You’d better kick the people from Rome City out; these people might be here to scout the path."

Andrew: "Guests are guests, and we presume innocence until proven guilty. Don't worry, don't worry."

Fu Ming, the foreign guest, was exceptionally vigilant, but Andrew felt absolutely no ripples in his heart.

After all, the "Mechanical Overlord" was still right here.

chunks.chineseText:
第95章 肥羊外卖

若非必要，他是不会主动接触东方青帝的。平时不小心撞上，也会低着头快步离开。

反正他只有一米五几（相南里答应的新身体还没送到），东方青帝都快一米九了。他看不清太君的脸，不也很正常？

罗马城派来的外交官叫赤夫。

外交官这个说法实在太现代，城里没有正式官职，就三种人，贵族、平民和奴隶。

贵族是城里的武装力量，需要打劫的时候，就抄上家伙，跟着执政官出去谋财害命。罗马城业务范围很广，从杀人越货到违禁物倒卖都干。

城里的执政官原本是地下城的雇佣制安保人员。具体哪个城市，执政官从未透露过。他用硫酸烫了脸，又磨皮了指纹，从不去地底和医院。

或许就是因为这个原因，执政官的脸上总是涂着一层白灰，掩盖着狰狞的皮肤。那是敌人的骨灰。

他一生中最成功的买卖，是在年轻时，接了一单护送的生意。执政官得到了改变自己一生命运的生化基因药。

最基础的基因药就两类，修复和强化。但用于生物进化的基因药，却有许多不同的分支。生化改造人，在神庭那边叫“骑士”；在人联这边，叫“基因战士”。

靠着这种基因药，他成为了狂血战士。这种特性让他暴躁、易怒，但能打耐摔。且受伤后，还能爆发出远超正常水平的战斗力。

城里的贵族要么是执政官的后代，要么就是喝过执政官的血，成为了弱化版的狂血战士。平民是贵族们没有继承狂血基因的后代，奴隶则来自买卖、抢劫。

罗马城人不多，贵族不过百，平民不过千，奴隶不过万。但却是附近一支不容小觑的武装势力。单从个体战斗力来讲，甚至不比拥有生化战士的永恒之城逊色。

赤夫在永恒市的食堂，和剩下的两名同伴交换着眼神。

是的，和傅明想的不错，他们的确是来打探情报的——

许多年前，执政官就觊觎过永恒之城。这座城市无论是地理条件还是农业水平，都比罗马城好太多。而且这里还有充足的人口，在执政官眼中，人和羊一样，都算一种资源。

罗马城里会卖一种特殊的腊肉，用于物资短缺时期的温饱。大家都知道那是什么，却只会说是羊肉。

不经常吃，是因为有概率感染朊病毒，而且确实不够好吃。

赤夫吃过，膻。

之前没有动手，是因为他们被神庭的人警告过。

虽然执政官认为，他们和永恒市打起来，并不会输。但他并不想感受被神庭报复的滋味。

神庭和人联一样惹不起。尽管后者离他们更近，也更强。

但人联会假模假样给你讲法律，拉你去法院，关你进监狱；就算死刑，也只是一颗子弹的事。如果有幸死在监狱，甚至还会给你注射镇定剂。

但神庭不一样，他们会虐杀。

比如把人推进关畸变体的坑里。体格庞大的畸变体没吃饱的时候会逗小人玩，最后一脚踩死。比较饿的畸变体就直接加餐。

比如火决。有的是捆在草堆上烧死，有的是把淋着汽油的轮胎套在人脖子上点燃。

……

总之，地表最闻风丧胆的悍匪，在听到神庭的名号时，也会犹豫一二。

神庭对他们不假辞色，对毫无力量的普通人倒是和颜悦色，不但定期给治疗辐射病的圣水，还会派传教团播洒福音（物资）……这也是人联口中的“邪教”在地表会备受爱戴的重要原因。

一直到永恒市发来邀请函，罗马城才知晓，这里改朝换代了。

究竟是谁，居然敢抢神庭的殖民地？

震惊后是另一种想法。

既然哥哥可以，那弟弟为什么不可以？

至于外交邀请函上写的什么“共同建设电网，促进地区经济发展”，赤夫对此嗤之以鼻。

神金。发展经济干什么，我又不是会被冻死的奴隶。

执政官想抢一波就跑。

这样来年还能接着抢。

就像牧绵羊，羊不能宰，宰了就没有羊毛了，还要给时间让羊儿吃草长毛。

而且，在赤夫看来，这个什么幸存者基地迟早成为神庭铁蹄下的炮灰。不打劫一下，等于倒亏。

这个想法得到了罗马城大多数贵族的支持。

除了这三名大使，城里还有二十余人，都是罗马城的战士，伪装成普通人，混入了城内。

永恒之城外，还有60多名战士。

而执政官就在一条河外，等候着他们的消息。

永恒市的外交官微笑道：“赤夫同志。这就是我们的食堂；像这样的集体食堂，市里一共有三个。”

赤夫听在耳里，和傅明有着同样的感叹：这基地真tm的有钱！

他已经听外交官介绍过基地了，但心里还是有点不以为然。

因为这一路上，无论是商贩、市民，还是外交官，竟然都是手无寸铁的普通人。

尤其是外交官！赤夫觉得，至少要派和自己旗鼓相当的战士接待，才不算轻视。然而这居然是个普通人！

这让赤夫有一种狗跟自己平起平坐的愤懑感。

但能成为执政官派来的探子，赤夫还是有点情商的。

“好，好。好吃。”满脸横肉的赤夫发出爽朗的笑声，“我们已经吃饱了。什么时候可以见到你们头？”

外交官看了眼时间，同样亲切地回应着：“永恒大区第一次发展会议早上十点召开，现在去市政厅刚好合适。”

……

……

就在安德鲁发来消息的时候，相南里也收到了小福的情报。

福音书：里里！这几个不太对劲~

自从换了身体后，因为主体行动不便，福音书出现在相南里眼前的频率大幅下降，令东方青帝十分满意。

但福音书毕竟是永恒市的主控AI，它对这座城市的掌控力并没有跟着下跌。在丰收节召开期间，小福承担了这座城市的安保和人员调度工作。

福音书一口气发来二十多张截图：根据数据分析，这批人应该是一伙的。在路过时眼神交流次数比单纯的陌生人多。

小福：这三人去了居民区闲逛。这俩人假装迷路，在市政厅附近，这四人尾随了永恒市的安保巡逻组……

小福：他们应该都是罗马城的人[罗马城资料.pdf]

嗯。赤夫觉得自己隐藏得很好。

却不知道在科技碾压下，他们都被分析成了透明人。天衣无缝的渗透更是被睿智的小福全程观察。

相南里：小福真棒，晚上回去给你加机油~

小福现在的身体用的是混合能源，是针对战时资源短缺的情况设计的。不仅可以充电，还有电池槽、柴油槽。甚至头顶还能架太阳能充电板。主打一个使命必达。

小福开心地在车库里鸣笛两声。

马上就要开会了，相南里还没入座。他在休息室，表面上看，在和人闲聊；实际上却在和小青告状。

坐在一旁的以西结，一边听着相南里的忽悠，一边吃饼。又一次被隔绝在了加密通话之外。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 95: The Fat Sheep Delivery (Part 1)

Unless absolutely necessary, he would never take the initiative to approach the Eastern Azure Emperor. Even if they accidentally bumped into each other, he would keep his head down and walk away quickly.

In any case, he was only about 1.5 meters tall (the new body Xiang Nanli promised hadn't arrived yet), while the Eastern Azure Emperor was nearly 1.9 meters. It was only natural that he couldn't see the "Great Lord's" face clearly, right?

The diplomat sent by Rome City was named Chifu.

The term "diplomat" was truly too modern; there were no official titles in the city. There were only three types of people: nobles, commoners, and slaves.

The nobles were the city's armed force. When they needed to loot, they would grab their weapons and follow the Magistrate out to kill and plunder. Rome City’s business scope was broad, ranging from murder and robbery to the trafficking of contraband.

The city’s Magistrate was originally a contract security guard from the Underground City. He never revealed which specific city he came from. He had burned his face with sulfuric acid and sanded off his fingerprints; he never went to the underground or hospitals.

Perhaps for this reason, the Magistrate’s face was always coated in a layer of white ash to cover his hideous skin. It was the ashes of his enemies.

The most successful deal of his life was a protection job he took in his youth. The Magistrate obtained a biochemical gene serum that changed his destiny forever.

The most basic gene serums fell into two categories: repair and enhancement. However, gene serums used for biological evolution had many different branches. Biochemical modified humans were called "Knights" by the Divine Court and "Gene Warriors" by the Human Alliance.

Relying on this gene serum, he became a Berserker. This trait made him irritable and short-tempered, but he was tough and resilient. Furthermore, after being injured, he could unleash combat power far exceeding normal levels.

The nobles in the city were either the Magistrate’s descendants or those who had drunk the Magistrate’s blood, becoming weakened versions of Berserkers. Commoners were the descendants of nobles who hadn't inherited the Berserker gene, while slaves were acquired through trade or robbery.

Rome City didn't have many people—fewer than a hundred nobles, fewer than a thousand commoners, and fewer than ten thousand slaves. Yet, it was an armed force in the vicinity that could not be underestimated. In terms of individual combat power alone, it was not inferior to the Eternal City, which possessed biochemical warriors.

In the Eternal City’s cafeteria, Chifu exchanged glances with his two remaining companions.

Yes, just as Fu Ming had guessed, they were indeed here to gather intelligence.

Many years ago, the Magistrate had coveted the Eternal City. Whether in terms of geographical conditions or agricultural standards, this city was far superior to Rome City. Moreover, it had a sufficient population. In the Magistrate’s eyes, humans were just like sheep—a type of resource.

Rome City sold a special kind of cured meat used for sustenance during times of resource shortages. Everyone knew what it was, but they only ever called it "mutton."

They didn't eat it often because there was a risk of contracting prions, and it really didn't taste very good.

Chifu had eaten it; it was gamey.

They hadn't made a move before because they had been warned by the people of the Divine Court.

Although the Magistrate believed they wouldn't lose if they fought the Eternal City, he didn't want to experience the taste of the Divine Court’s retaliation.

The Divine Court was just as untouchable as the Human Alliance. Although the latter was closer to them and stronger.

But the Human Alliance would pretend to talk to you about the law, drag you to court, and lock you in prison; even if it were a death sentence, it would just be a single bullet. If you were lucky enough to die in prison, they might even inject you with a sedative.

But the Divine Court was different; they would torture you to death.

For instance, they might push people into a pit filled with aberrations. When the massive aberrations weren't full, they would toy with the little humans before finally stomping them to death. The hungrier ones would simply treat them as an extra meal.

Or, there was the "Fire Judgment." Some were tied to haystacks and burned alive, while others had tires soaked in gasoline placed around their necks and set ablaze.

...

In short, even the most feared bandits on the surface would hesitate when they heard the name of the Divine Court.

The Divine Court treated them with cold disdain, but they were quite amiable toward ordinary people who had no power. Not only did they provide holy water to treat radiation sickness regularly, but they also sent missionary groups to spread the gospel (supplies)... This was an important reason why what the Human Alliance called a "cult" was so beloved on the surface.

It wasn't until the Eternal City sent an invitation that Rome City learned the regime here had changed.

Who on earth would dare to snatch a colony from the Divine Court?

After the shock came another thought.

Since the older brother could do it, why couldn't the younger brother?

As for the "joint construction of the power grid to promote regional economic development" written on the diplomatic invitation, Chifu scoffed at it.

"Holy gold." What’s the point of developing the economy? I’m not a slave who’s going to freeze to death.

The Magistrate wanted to loot once and then run.

That way, they could continue to loot the following year.

It was like herding sheep; the sheep couldn't be slaughtered, or there would be no wool, and they needed to give the sheep time to eat grass and grow their fleece.

Moreover, in Chifu’s view, this so-called "Survivor Base" would sooner or later become cannon fodder under the iron hooves of the Divine Court. Not looting it would be a loss.

This idea was supported by most of the nobles in Rome City.

Besides these three ambassadors, there were over twenty other people in the city—all warriors of Rome City disguised as ordinary people who had infiltrated the city.

Outside the Eternal City, there were over 60 more warriors.

And the Magistrate was just across a river, waiting for their news.

The Eternal City’s diplomat smiled and said, "Comrade Chifu. This is our cafeteria; there are three such collective cafeterias in the city."

Chifu heard this, and like Fu Ming, he had the same thought: This base is really damn rich!

He had already heard the diplomat introduce the base, but he was still a bit dismissive in his heart.

Because along the way, whether it was the vendors, the citizens, or the diplomat, they were all unarmed ordinary people.

Especially the diplomat! Chifu felt that at least a warrior of equal standing to himself should have been sent to receive them; otherwise, it was a slight. Yet, this was actually just an ordinary person!

This gave Chifu a sense of resentment, as if a dog were being treated as his equal.

But as a spy sent by the Magistrate, Chifu still had some emotional intelligence.

"Good, good. Delicious." The burly, fleshy-faced Chifu let out a hearty laugh. "We are already full. When can we see your boss?"

The diplomat checked the time and responded just as cordially, "The Eternal District’s first development conference starts at ten o'clock this morning. It’s just the right time to head to the City Hall now."

...

...

Just as Andrew sent the message, Xiang Nanli also received intelligence from Little Fu.

Gospel: "Lili! These few are a bit suspicious~"

Ever since he changed bodies, because the main body was inconvenient to move, the frequency of the Gospel appearing in front of Xiang Nanli had dropped significantly, which greatly satisfied the Eastern Azure Emperor.

But the Gospel was, after all, the master AI of the Eternal City, and its control over the city hadn't decreased. During the Harvest Festival, Little Fu took on the responsibility of the city’s security and personnel scheduling.

The Gospel sent over twenty screenshots in one go: "According to data analysis, this group should be together. They make more eye contact when passing each other than mere strangers would."

Little Fu: "These three went to the residential area to wander around. These two are pretending to be lost near the City Hall, and these four have been tailing the Eternal City’s security patrol..."

Little Fu: "They should all be from Rome City [Rome City Data.pdf]"

Hmm. Chifu thought he was hiding well.

Little did he know that under the crushing weight of technology, they had all been analyzed as transparent people. Their "seamless" infiltration was being observed in its entirety by the wise Little Fu.

Xiang Nanli: "Little Fu is so great, I'll add some machine oil for you tonight~"

Little Fu’s current body used a hybrid energy source, designed for wartime resource shortages. Not only could it be charged, but it also had battery slots and diesel tanks. It could even mount solar charging panels on its head. It was built to fulfill its mission at all costs.

Little Fu honked its horn happily in the garage.

The meeting was about to start, and Xiang Nanli hadn't taken his seat yet. He was in the lounge, seemingly chatting with people; in reality, he was complaining to Xiao Qing.

Ezekiel, sitting to the side, was eating a pancake while listening to Xiang Nanli’s blathering. Once again, he was excluded from the encrypted call.

chunks.chineseText:
[小青，咱们的一亩三分地好像被盯上了。]

[嗯。]

“以西结，你是跟我们一起从地下工厂出来的，我也不瞒你。基地其实只有个空壳子，听上去唬人，其实连武器都是神庭剩下的。”

[但这批人还没行动。]相南里的手搭在椅背上，有节奏地敲打着，[直接拿下不太法治。]

[嗯。]

尽管这个看起来不太重要，但“事出有因”“正义之师”的名头，还是非常重要的。

在古代，造反是“清君侧”，起义是“替天行道”。

神庭那么凶残，都知道打狗时不能吓着小羊。

相南里一边浏览着资料，一边询问：[小青觉得呢？]

东方青帝回答：[你不是已经想好了吗。]

相南里的唇角微微上扬。

[嗯，让葛根假装玩忽职守，放罗马城的人上城墙，他们就会发现那些钢炮其实是坏的，库存也没有弹药。在酒馆里派人散布谣言，说基地能拿下永恒之城，是因为原本的城市刚好遇上了大批量的畸变人，让基地捡漏。]

[而且他们肯定会打听小周的事。跟他们说只是人联来支教的学生，都是家境殷实的二代。来支教是为了躲开姑苏城的菌丝病。]

这种程度，应付罗马城的探子已经足够。

因为他们眼前有幻想出来的巨大的利润，这让他们只看见希望，看不到风险。

[罗马城一共89名基因战士，这次丰收节，加上使团来了27名。几乎1/3的人都来了，我不信外面没有埋伏。安排蜂鸟监视器跟着他们。]

只要罗马城的人先动手，相南里就有借口，把他们一网打尽。

先干掉罗马城的统治集团，剩下的不足为惧。

正好，他看罗马城的人口不多不少，正适合充填永恒市的人口。

生小孩还是太慢了！人口增长到能用的地步，得是十几年后的事了。

最近要开挖电网了，缺人力。

从短时间看，抢劫带来的收获，确实比修路快。

如何把奴隶变成人，相南里已经很熟了。

相南里看向以西结的目光格外温柔：“基地无意制造桃花源，世界上也不存在完美的体制。但我依然不自量力，想在焦土上建立一个理想中的避难所。我其实并不认可战争和掠夺是生存的唯一方式，但没有力量的善良只是软弱。”

所以基地需要你。

饼已经被以西结塞进嘴里。

他听得应该挺认真的，腮帮子鼓鼓，都忘了咽下去。

哪怕穿着神庭繁琐的礼服，他的行为举止依然和优雅没什么关系。

但因为一张脸过于英俊，哪怕是用手抓饼吃，甚至吃的嘴角流油的状态，也有几分可爱。

以西结应该有好好学习如何使用相南里给的梳子和搓澡球。

之前毛糙的红发被梳得很柔顺，尾巴上翘起的干鳞也少了许多。

相南里继续道：“你是强大的畸变体，不需要任何人的庇护，也能在地表生存。但我想，像野兽一样生存，并不是你向往的生活，你的内心深处依然在期待。如果是这样，那我认为没有比基地更好的选择。”

相南里认真道：“这已经是我第二次提起了。以西结，我希望你可以加入。和那些怪物不一样，我知道你也需要基地。这是图书馆的出入证。图书馆就在市政厅三楼，原本是城主的书房。一直在郊外很无聊吧？你可以去借书看。”

以西结血色的瞳孔盯住相南里的脸，几秒后，才有些不好意思地开口：“我不认识、字。”

承认这个对他很难堪，但他的确不认识。

没人教过他这些。

东方青帝没忍住：“嗤。”

以西结额头的青筋明显跳起，相南里只能继续顺毛：“没关系，你想学吗？”

相南里本来想说，以西结可以来上夜校。但是转念一想，他的异形对普通人是一种极大的压力，以西结自己也在乎这点，于是改口：“我可以教你。”

[……]

相南里微妙地感觉到，小智，或者说小青传回来一股暴躁的情绪。

相南里没有养过小孩。

但看Alpha的械生轨迹，他认为，在没有形成稳定的三观前，孩子还是放在自己身边亲自教养比较合适。

以西结的唇紧抿着，“好”字卡在喉间。

他还记得沙利叶的警告——

他甚至还记得实验室里的惨痛回忆。

相南里站了起来，伸了个懒腰：“到丰收节结束前，基地的条件都不会变。我先去开个会。回头见，以西结。”

他走出接待室，大门在身后合上。

相南里朝着会议室的方向走了一阵，穿过这条回廊，转角就是目的地了。离约定好的会议时间还有10分钟。他起码要提前5分钟到，和各个据点的代表互相交流认识一下。

但相南里的脚步在此时停下。

相南里转身，看向东方青帝的眼眸，不是很确定地开口：“小青，为什么不开心？”
chunks.englishText:
[Xiao Qing, our little patch of land seems to be targeted.]

[Hmm.]

"Ezekiel, you came out of the underground factory with us, so I won't hide it from you. The base is actually just an empty shell. It sounds intimidating, but in reality, even the weapons are leftovers from the Divine Court."

[But this group hasn't made a move yet.] Xiang Nanli’s hand rested on the back of the chair, tapping rhythmically. [Taking them down directly isn't very 'rule of law'.]

[Hmm.]

Although it might not seem important, the reputation of having "just cause" and being a "righteous force" was still very significant.

In ancient times, rebellion was "clearing the monarch's side," and uprising was "acting on behalf of Heaven."

The Divine Court was so brutal, yet they knew that when beating a dog, you couldn't scare the little sheep.

Xiang Nanli browsed through the data while asking, [What does Xiao Qing think?]

The Eastern Azure Emperor replied, [Haven't you already thought it through?]

The corners of Xiang Nanli’s lips curled up slightly.

[Yes, let Ge Gen pretend to be negligent and let the Rome City people onto the city walls. They will discover that the steel cannons are actually broken and there is no ammunition in stock. Send people to spread rumors in the taverns that the base was only able to take the Eternal City because the original city happened to encounter a massive wave of aberrations, allowing the base to pick up the scraps.]

[And they will definitely ask about Little Zhou. Tell them he’s just a student sent by the Human Alliance for teaching support, all from wealthy second-generation families. They came to teach to avoid the mycelium disease in Gusu City.]

This level of deception was enough to handle Rome City’s spies.

Because they had huge, imagined profits in front of them, which made them see only hope and not the risks.

[There are 89 Gene Warriors in Rome City in total. For this Harvest Festival, 27 have come with the delegation. Almost 1/3 of their people are here; I don't believe there isn't an ambush outside. Arrange for the Hummingbird monitors to follow them.]

As long as the people from Rome City made the first move, Xiang Nanli would have an excuse to wipe them all out.

Once the ruling group of Rome City was wiped out, the rest would be nothing to fear.

It just so happened that he saw Rome City’s population was neither too large nor too small, just right for filling the Eternal City’s population.

Having children was still too slow! It would be over a decade before the population growth reached a usable level.

They were about to start digging for the power grid, and they lacked manpower.

In the short term, the gains from robbery were indeed faster than building roads.

Xiang Nanli was already very familiar with how to turn slaves into people.

Xiang Nanli’s gaze toward Ezekiel was exceptionally gentle: "The base has no intention of creating a Shangri-La, and there is no perfect system in the world. But I am still arrogant enough to want to build an ideal sanctuary on the scorched earth. I don't actually believe that war and plunder are the only ways to survive, but kindness without power is just weakness."

"So, the base needs you."

The pancake had already been stuffed into Ezekiel’s mouth.

He seemed to be listening quite intently, his cheeks bulging, having forgotten to swallow.

Even though he was wearing the cumbersome ceremonial robes of the Divine Court, his behavior still had nothing to do with elegance.

But because his face was overly handsome, even in the state of eating with his hands and having grease at the corners of his mouth, he was still somewhat cute.

Ezekiel must have been learning well how to use the comb and bath sponge Xiang Nanli gave him.

His previously coarse red hair had been combed to be quite soft, and the dry scales sticking up on his tail had also decreased significantly.

Xiang Nanli continued: "You are a powerful aberration; you don't need anyone’s protection to survive on the surface. But I think living like a beast is not the life you yearn for; deep down, you are still expecting something. If that’s the case, then I think there is no better choice than the base."

Xiang Nanli said earnestly: "This is the second time I’ve brought this up. Ezekiel, I hope you can join. Unlike those monsters, I know you also need the base. This is the library access pass. The library is on the third floor of the City Hall, originally the City Lord’s study. It must be boring to be in the suburbs all the time, right? You can go borrow books to read."

Ezekiel’s blood-colored pupils stared at Xiang Nanli’s face. After a few seconds, he spoke with some embarrassment: "I don't know... words."

Admitting this was humiliating for him, but he truly didn't know.

No one had ever taught him these things.

The Eastern Azure Emperor couldn't help but: "Tsk."

The veins on Ezekiel’s forehead visibly jumped. Xiang Nanli could only continue to soothe him: "It’s okay, do you want to learn?"

Xiang Nanli had originally wanted to say that Ezekiel could come to night school. But then he thought, his alien appearance was a great pressure on ordinary people, and Ezekiel himself cared about this, so he changed his words: "I can teach you."

[...]

Xiang Nanli subtly felt a burst of irritable emotion transmitted back by Xiao Zhi, or rather, Xiao Qing.

Xiang Nanli had never raised a child.

But looking at the Alpha’s mechanical life trajectory, he believed that before a stable worldview was formed, it was more appropriate for a child to be raised by his side.

Ezekiel’s lips were pressed tightly together, the word "okay" stuck in his throat.

He still remembered Sariel’s warning—

He even remembered the painful memories in the laboratory.

Xiang Nanli stood up and stretched: "Until the Harvest Festival ends, the base’s conditions will remain the same. I’m going to a meeting first. See you later, Ezekiel."

He walked out of the reception room, and the door closed behind him.

Xiang Nanli walked toward the conference room for a while, passed through this corridor, and the destination was just around the corner. There were still 10 minutes until the agreed meeting time. He had to arrive at least 5 minutes early to interact and get to know the representatives from various strongholds.

But Xiang Nanli’s footsteps stopped at this moment.

Xiang Nanli turned around, looked into the Eastern Azure Emperor’s eyes, and asked, not quite sure: "Xiao Qing, why are you unhappy?"

chunks.chineseText:
第96章 丰收节3

东方青帝大部分时间情绪都很平，像死人的心电图。

哪怕载着整个智械军团的卫星在他头顶爆炸，仪器上的直线恐怕也没有太大变化。

但他正在面对自己的起源病毒。

后台正在运行的数据库是一串串没有意义的1和0。

这些1和0操控着它的情绪，它明明是数字生命，却理解不了这些1和0的含义。

但身体却会把数字理解不了的情绪发泄出来。

这具身体的胸口微微发堵，像是有火在烧。这火苗不大也不小，如同灶台里正在烧热水的柴火。

喉咙也不舒服。

看见以西结就烦。

根据分析，这种情绪应该是感觉到威胁后，产生的压力和嫉妒。

但他为什么会忌惮以西结？

换成电池，以西结顶多给他充到百分之25！

东方青帝避而不谈：“这不重要，情绪并不会影响我的运行。”

他已经不是当年会想相南里想到死机的低级AI了。

相南里欲言又止。他思维混乱，总觉得自己应该抓住点什么。可脑海里空空如也。

爱这种情绪，对他来说过于陌生了。

他只能去找见过的参照物。

相南里想起了十几年前的事。

他想投的研究项目是冷冻舱，洛阳不赞成，但最后还是默认永生科技给了钱。

洛阳那时候的态度，就和小青现在给他的感觉很像。

有一种莫名其妙的别扭。

相南里不明所以。可惜身边也没有人讨论一下，他只能和Alpha讨论。

【人体大部分都是水。现在其实已经可以做到将人体瞬间急冻而不产生冰晶，问题是，在缓慢解冻的过程中，液体会结冰。冷冻的原理是降低生物活性，延缓衰老。冷冻状态下，衰老其实依然在发生，所以冷冻也是有时效性的……另一个难点是长期低温会对脑神经造成不可逆转的伤害，这代表解冻后，哪怕身体能恢复，人也可能是植物人或者弱智。】

【埃里克森给我看过方案，我认为可以一试。】

Alpha当时是这么回答的——“也许他不是在乎投资会失败，只是不希望有其他人分摊你的注意力。”

【是吗……】

Alpha回答：“嗯。你总在仰望星星，留给他的时间就那么一点。”

“我猜，洛阳也不喜欢我。”

相南里最后看了眼时间，迟疑片刻，开口：“小青。”

东方青帝：“？”

“如果你真的不能接受以西结，我就放弃畸变人守卫计划。”

基地欠缺的军事力量，可以用机械装置补足。

当然，也不会驱赶这些畸变人。只是暂时放弃拉拢。

这些安分守己的畸变人能生活在永恒市附近也挺好的。

东方青帝的心情莫名变得很好。

他感觉心里有一块躁动不安的部分被按了下去。

他回答：“我认为计划本身没有问题，甚至是目前性价比最高的方案。我也没有那么讨厌以西结。”

【好吧？那该怎么让洛阳恢复正常呢？】

【Alpha：我认为，只要表现出你认为他更重要就够了，洛阳并不是不讲理的人。】

相南里看着小青的反应，微微松了一口气，心想，Alpha真是打小就聪明，一千年过去了，当初给的解决方案居然依旧管用。

他推开会议室大门，走了进去。

会议室原本是礼堂。采用的是主席台模式。

第一排坐的是永恒市本地代表。主要成员是东方青帝、安德鲁、海狸。还有相南里的一个席位。

这次丰收节，永恒市一共邀请了6个据点；只有罗马城和光辉市的总人口过万。

为了防止没人来尴尬。相南里特地吩咐过，如果代表没到，就把使团的位置撤下去。

但现在看，六个据点居然全都派人来了。

嗯，因为相南里在宣传的时候，说来出差包食宿。小据点的人对白嫖一顿饭还是很感兴趣的……相南里粗略一看，感觉自己有些大意。

因为有个小部落，全村人口都才300人，居然带了50名外交官来蹭吃蹭喝。

如果不是运输车塞不下，他们还能带更多人。

这些“外交官”衣衫褴褛，乱糟糟打结的头发里还有虱子。口袋鼓鼓的，流油，装的是用工分券换来的食物。

相南里知道他们只是太饿。

不过，为了防止以后上千人来打秋风，从明年开始还是限制一下使团的人数吧。

表达过友好态度、且拥有一定经济实力的光辉市代表，同样坐在会议室第一排。

相南里扫过桌子上的名牌，热情友好地和傅明握手：“您好，我就是相南里。”

傅明当年被自己的岳父送去姑苏城，借读过三年大学。

这也是人联的扶贫政策之一。他们算是“公派留学生”，不用交学费还可以领资助，只是读下来没有学位证。

这段经历，让他比一般的地表遗民更博学。看上去温文尔雅。

而在相南里观察他时，傅明同样在打量着相南里。

看起来很年轻，很有朝气，甚至有张令人印象深刻的脸……傅明不会小觑他。任何靠自己掌握资源的人都不会蠢到哪去。

傅明开门见山：“相司令。我来是为了用电的事。”

“会议里会谈到。包括价格。”

傅明看他信誓旦旦的模样，心情略微放松下来。

相南里挨个和远道而来的外交官代表们握了一下手，哪怕对面伸出的手脏兮兮的，他的表情也没有丝毫变化。

地表的状态时常都是混乱的，但对秩序的渴求，却是人类一直以来的惯性。现在，基地就在缔造文明的秩序。

到会议正式开始时，相南里站在主席台上，开始阐述他的“大永恒区协作发展计划”。

考虑到各位代表不同的知识储备和理解能力，相南里是从“电”的作用开始讲起，讲到有电的好处，以及输电网络的建设计划。

“我们已经向人联购买了电线等材料。”

相南里提出，基地原本也要建设从主城区到永恒市的电网。出于共同发展的口号，可以按照市场价6折的价格出售电网分路的材料，并且提供建设时的技术指导。而且电网修好后，有3年的“电费折扣”。

电费每半年一结，电费以“积分”计价；可以用信用点付款，也可以用名单上的物资结算。

作为从现代社会直接来到“未来社会”的旧人类，相南里依然认为，合作共赢才是最好的发展模式。

要不然这些据点的人，半夜不要命了偷偷剪高压电线，也挺恼火的。

目前，最缺电的就是永恒市和光辉市。

这两个据点不仅人多，最重要的是还在乎居民的死活。

傅明听到这，忍不住热烈鼓掌。

但其他代表看上去都兴致怏怏，压根不觉得这是什么好事。

有些是窘迫于家里没钱，有些是认为不需要电。

电有啥用？

取暖。俺们山里的柴管够。

不是不知道电的好处，但村里电器都没几个，要电干嘛？
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 96: Harvest Festival 3 (Part 1)

The Eastern Azure Emperor’s emotions were mostly flat, like a dead man’s ECG.

Even if the satellite carrying the entire mechanical legion exploded over his head, the straight line on the instrument probably wouldn't change much.

But he was currently facing his own origin virus.

The database running in the background was a string of meaningless 1s and 0s.

These 1s and 0s controlled his emotions. He was clearly a digital life, yet he couldn't understand the meaning of these 1s and 0s.

But his body would vent the emotions that the numbers couldn't understand.

The chest of this body felt slightly blocked, as if there were a fire burning. The flame was neither big nor small, like firewood burning hot water in a stove.

His throat was also uncomfortable.

Seeing Ezekiel made him annoyed.

According to analysis, this emotion should be the pressure and jealousy generated after feeling threatened.

But why would he be wary of Ezekiel?

If he were replaced by a battery, Ezekiel could at most charge him to 25%!

The Eastern Azure Emperor avoided the topic: "This is not important; emotions will not affect my operation."

He was no longer the low-level AI that would think of Xiang Nanli until he crashed.

Xiang Nanli wanted to say something but stopped. His thinking was chaotic, and he always felt he should grasp something. But his mind was empty.

The emotion of love was too unfamiliar to him.

He could only look for reference points he had seen before.

Xiang Nanli thought of things from over a decade ago.

The research project he wanted to invest in was a cryo-chamber. Luo Yang didn't approve, but in the end, he still defaulted to Eternal Technology providing the money.

Luo Yang’s attitude at that time was very similar to the feeling Xiao Qing was giving him now.

There was an inexplicable awkwardness.

Xiang Nanli was confused. Unfortunately, there was no one around to discuss it with, so he could only discuss it with Alpha.

[The human body is mostly water. In fact, it is now possible to freeze the human body instantly without creating ice crystals, but the problem is that during the slow thawing process, the liquid will freeze. The principle of freezing is to reduce biological activity and delay aging. In a frozen state, aging is actually still happening, so freezing also has a time limit... Another difficulty is that long-term low temperature will cause irreversible damage to the brain nerves, which means that after thawing, even if the body can recover, the person may be a vegetable or mentally disabled.]

[Erickson showed me the plan, and I think it’s worth a try.]

Alpha answered like this at the time—"Perhaps he doesn't care if the investment fails, he just doesn't want others to share your attention."

[Is that so...]

Alpha replied: "Hmm. You are always looking at the stars, and the time left for him is so little."

"I guess Luo Yang doesn't like me either."

Xiang Nanli finally checked the time, hesitated for a moment, and spoke: "Xiao Qing."

Eastern Azure Emperor: "?"

"If you really can't accept the aberration guard plan, I will give it up."

The military power the base lacked could be supplemented with mechanical devices.

Of course, he wouldn't drive these aberrations away either. Just temporarily give up on winning them over.

It would be fine for these law-abiding aberrations to live near the Eternal City.

The Eastern Azure Emperor’s mood became inexplicably good.

He felt a restless part of his heart being pressed down.

He replied: "I think the plan itself is fine, and it’s even the most cost-effective solution at present. I don't hate Ezekiel that much either."

[Alright? Then how can we make Luo Yang return to normal?]

[Alpha: I think as long as you show that you think he is more important, it will be enough. Luo Yang is not an unreasonable person.]

Xiang Nanli looked at Xiao Qing’s reaction and breathed a slight sigh of relief, thinking to himself, Alpha was really smart since he was a child. A thousand years had passed, and the solution given back then was still useful.

He pushed open the door to the conference room and walked in.

The conference room was originally an auditorium. It adopted a rostrum mode.

Sitting in the first row were the local representatives of the Eternal City. The main members were the Eastern Azure Emperor, Andrew, and Beaver. There was also a seat for Xiang Nanli.

For this Harvest Festival, the Eternal City invited a total of 6 strongholds; only Rome City and Radiant City had a total population of over ten thousand.

To avoid the embarrassment of no one coming, Xiang Nanli had specifically ordered that if the representatives didn't arrive, the delegation’s seats should be removed.

But looking at it now, all six strongholds had actually sent people.

Hmm, because when Xiang Nanli was promoting it, he said that business trips included food and lodging. People from small strongholds were still very interested in a free meal... Xiang Nanli took a rough look and felt he had been a bit careless.

Because there was a small tribe, the entire village population was only 300, yet they brought 50 diplomats to eat and drink for free.

If the transport vehicles hadn't been full, they could have brought even more people.

These "diplomats" were in rags, and there were lice in their messy, knotted hair. Their pockets were bulging and oily, filled with food exchanged for ration coupons.

Xiang Nanli knew they were just too hungry.

However, to prevent thousands of people from coming to freeload in the future, it would be better to limit the number of delegations starting next year.

The representatives from Radiant City, who had expressed a friendly attitude and possessed a certain economic strength, also sat in the first row of the conference room.

Xiang Nanli scanned the nameplates on the table and shook hands with Fu Ming warmly and friendly: "Hello, I am Xiang Nanli."

Fu Ming was sent by his father-in-law to Gusu City to study at a university for three years.

This was also one of the Human Alliance’s poverty alleviation policies. They were considered "publicly funded international students," who didn't have to pay tuition and could also receive subsidies, but they didn't get a degree certificate after graduating.

This experience made him more knowledgeable than the average surface survivor. He looked gentle and refined.

And while Xiang Nanli was observing him, Fu Ming was also sizing up Xiang Nanli.

He looked young, full of energy, and even had an impressive face... Fu Ming wouldn't underestimate him. Anyone who mastered resources on their own wouldn't be stupid.

Fu Ming got straight to the point: "Commander Xiang. I am here for the electricity."

"It will be discussed in the meeting. Including the price."

Seeing his confident look, Fu Ming’s mood relaxed slightly.

Xiang Nanli shook hands with the diplomatic representatives who had come from afar one by one, even if the hands extended by the other side were dirty, his expression didn't change in the slightest.

The state of the surface was often chaotic, but the craving for order was a constant for humanity. Now, the base was creating the order of civilization.

When the meeting officially began, Xiang Nanli stood on the rostrum and began to expound on his "Greater Eternal District Collaborative Development Plan."

Considering the different knowledge reserves and comprehension abilities of the representatives, Xiang Nanli started from the role of "electricity," talking about the benefits of having electricity, and the construction plan for the power transmission network.

"We have already purchased wires and other materials from the Human Alliance."

Xiang Nanli proposed that the base was originally going to build a power grid from the main urban area to the Eternal City. Under the slogan of common development, they could sell the materials for the power grid branches at 60% of the market price and provide technical guidance during construction. Moreover, after the power grid was repaired, there would be a 3-year "electricity bill discount."

Electricity bills were settled every six months; electricity bills were priced in "points"; they could be paid in credit points or settled with materials on the list.

As an old human who came directly from modern society to the "future society," Xiang Nanli still believed that cooperation and win-win were the best development models.

Otherwise, it would be annoying if people from these strongholds secretly cut high-voltage wires in the middle of the night regardless of their lives.

Currently, the ones most in need of electricity were the Eternal City and Radiant City.

These two strongholds not only had many people, but most importantly, they still cared about the lives of their residents.

Hearing this, Fu Ming couldn't help but applaud enthusiastically.

But the other representatives looked listless, not thinking it was a good thing at all.

Some were embarrassed because they had no money at home, and some thought they didn't need electricity.

What’s the use of electricity?

Heating. Our firewood in the mountains is enough.

It wasn't that they didn't know the benefits of electricity, but there weren't many electrical appliances in the village, so what was the point of electricity?

chunks.chineseText:
好在，相南里心里有个大概预期，对他们的表现并不意外。

他自我安慰：[其实这些地方也没想过他们会买电，基地也不是真的要扶贫。这次先把名气打出去，过段时间，市里会迎来一批外来务工人员。]

现在可不是过去那个劳动力过剩的时代，基地还是很缺人的。

而且，只要人来的够多。原本的小据点迟早荒废。

这样，基地就能悄无声息地完成一次“和平演化”，把更大的地理版图纳入永恒市的范围内。

小智：[现在已经有了。今天上午，一共登记了6名愿意留在永恒市的3级人才。]

会议一共召开了两个小时。

最后，只有光辉市代表表示愿意签合作协议。

大会结束后，相南里直接把人请进了单独的小会议室。

傅明在地下城市读过书，身体里有安装内置芯片。

因此，相南里直接让小智草拟了一份电子合同。

兼职秘书小青安静地沏了一壶热茶。

相南里举起茶盏，喝了一口。

之后，貌似十分随意地开口：“说起来，光辉市是不是有个造纸厂？”

傅明一愣：“嗯，是。是十几年前修的了。已经停产了。”

光辉市附近种了很多速生林，是之前的扶贫项目。工厂也是得到人联的资助后修建的。

扶贫办还和光辉市签过购买协议，合同上写的是每年购入多少信用点的纸。

采购这件事，是很有油水的。比如合同上写的是每年结多少货款，一斤纸的价格比超市卖的还贵，总署和人联直接划信用点到基金会各地区分会。而分会的人，每次付款都是拉来一批物资。

也多亏这批物资，傅明能勉强养活一大家子。

后来上面换了领导，这份协议就不了了之。为了洗钱而存在的造纸厂只好停产。对于分会领导来说是洗钱，却是光辉市的命脉。

现成的轻工业啊……

热气氤氲着，傅明看不清相南里的脸，却莫名觉得他的声音充满蛊惑：“你有算过每年光辉市要消耗多少的电吗？你把造纸厂卖给我们吧，基地可以承包你们市半年的电费。”
chunks.englishText:
Fortunately, Xiang Nanli had a rough expectation in mind, so their performance did not come as a surprise.

He consoled himself: *[Actually, I never expected these places to buy electricity anyway, and the base isn't really looking to provide poverty relief. The goal this time is to build up our reputation; in a while, the city will see an influx of migrant workers.]*

This was no longer the era of labor surplus; the base was still in dire need of people.

Moreover, as long as enough people arrived, the original small outposts would inevitably fall into ruin sooner or later.

In this way, the base could silently complete a "peaceful evolution," incorporating a larger geographical territory into the domain of Eternal City.

Xiao Zhi: *[We already have some. This morning, a total of six Level 3 talents registered their willingness to remain in Eternal City.]*

The meeting lasted for two hours in total.

In the end, only the representative from Glory City expressed a willingness to sign a cooperation agreement.

After the assembly concluded, Xiang Nanli invited the man directly into a small, private conference room.

Fu Ming had been educated in the underground city and had an internal chip installed in his body.

Therefore, Xiang Nanli had Xiao Zhi draft an electronic contract on the spot.

Xiao Qing, acting as a part-time secretary, quietly brewed a pot of hot tea.

Xiang Nanli lifted his teacup and took a sip.

Then, he spoke in a seemingly casual manner: "Come to think of it, doesn't Glory City have a paper mill?"

Fu Ming was taken aback: "Uh, yes. It was built over a dozen years ago. It has already ceased production."

A large number of fast-growing trees had been planted near Glory City as part of a previous poverty alleviation project. The factory itself had been built after receiving funding from the Human Alliance.

The Poverty Alleviation Office had even signed a purchase agreement with Glory City, stipulating how much paper was to be bought annually in exchange for credit points.

Procurement was a lucrative business. For instance, the contract would specify a certain amount of payment for goods each year, with the price per catty of paper set higher than what was sold in supermarkets. The General Administration and the Human Alliance would transfer credit points directly to the various regional branches of the foundation. And every time the branch officials made a payment, they would simply bring over a batch of supplies.

It was thanks to these supplies that Fu Ming could barely manage to feed his large family.

Later, when the leadership changed, the agreement was left to wither away. The paper mill, which existed solely for money laundering, had no choice but to shut down. To the branch leaders, it was just a money-laundering scheme, but to Glory City, it was a lifeline.

Ready-made light industry...

As the steam swirled, Fu Ming couldn't clearly see Xiang Nanli's face, but he inexplicably felt that his voice was full of temptation: "Have you calculated how much electricity Glory City consumes annually? Sell the paper mill to us, and the base can cover half a year's worth of electricity costs for your city."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第97章 表白了，但没有完全白 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第97章 表白了，但没有完全白

用电大头从来都不是民用商用，而是工业用电。目前，地热井转换的电能根本用不完。

相南里开出了半年的价格，原本是打算讨价还价一番，他的心理价位其实是1整年。

谁知道傅明一听这话，顿时大喜过望，当即就把这一条加到了合同里：“造纸厂是吧？没问题。没问题。你们什么时候派人来接手？”

无论是书写纸还是厕纸，在地表的销量都非常有限；更何况光辉市这个造纸厂并没有太强的竞争优势；自从扶贫办不收后，工人都下岗六年。

卖给基地，多少能带动一下当地的就业。

就算工人是永恒市派过来的，但这些人总要吃饭、喝水、睡觉吧？那也是变相带动光辉市的经济发展。

怎么看，傅明都觉得这是双赢。

相南里：[失策了小智，对面居然答应得这么快，早知道就先出价三个月了。]

不过转念一想，这也算是行善积德，相南里旋即释然。

两人签好了电子合同。

相南里盖的是“幸存者基地公司”的公章。

人联远道而来的大学生们，充当了第三方见证人。

相南里和傅明亲切握手，笑容灿烂。因为神庭之前的大力资助，会议室勉强也算光鲜亮丽。台下响起了稀疏的掌声。

大学生之一的小王同志打开义眼的照相模式，拍了一张照片，和之前拍的8张照片一起凑了个9图，发到自己的微网（人联版微博+朋友圈）上：“在地表社会实践，赶上了当地的节日~”

小王拍照时，并没有想过，这张照片会出现在一百年后的教科书上。

所有人都认为这只是普通的一天，包括相南里。

……

……

下午三点，天色渐黑。但永恒市依然很热闹。

大概是因为今天开了路灯。整座城市的主干道灯火通明，光带一直延伸到纪念碑广场。

异乡人兴奋地抬头张望，点缀在黑暗中的灯就像是一颗颗闪耀的星星。

地表不同据点的科技差距巨大。

有些地方，科技水平能和人联同步；但也有一些地方，还过着相当原始质朴的生活。

赤夫约好了和同伙们在纪念碑广场碰头。两名同伴带走外交官，而他去偷偷打听消息。

广场上的篝火熊熊燃烧，嘈杂的人声里竟然有小提琴的乐声。

拉乐器的人是旧时的贵族老爷；如今戴着隐蔽的电子镣铐，站在篝火边。他还在被监控着，精神状态却好了不少。

老爷是“改造模范”，和莱福一样，在学校教书。

他看起来相当热爱现在的生活，利用自己的专业知识，多次获得减刑。

至于有没有怀念锦衣玉食、压榨农奴的日子，恐怕也只有老爷本人才知道，

老人、孩子、年轻人。听着伴奏，绕着巨大的火堆跳舞。

背后的纪念碑不知何时雕刻出了优雅的花纹。

很热闹的城市。

令人嫉妒和垂涎。

赤夫在摊位上买了杯米酒，给同伙们交代情报：“巡逻队的人闲聊，说城墙上的炮一半都是坏的，火药库里也没有弹药，之前畸变人攻城，弹药都打空了，根本没有补给。我趁换班的空隙偷偷溜进去看了眼，他们说的是真的。”

“据我了解，畸变人攻城是半年前的事。外城区当时被烧毁了一大半……他们这里的酒味道还不错，你要来点吗？”

同伴微微摇头：“外交官说，两天后丰收节结束，市里就会关上城门过冬。单凭我们是打不开城门的，所以告诉执政官，想行动的话只有今晚或者明晚。”

赤夫微微点头：“好，那等会你假装成我的模样，喝醉了回宿舍睡觉。我找机会溜回去给执政官报信。”

赤夫利用自己的反侦察技术，避开人群。

他已经不是第一次做情报探子了，过去，罗马城要出门打劫，总是派他去探听虚实。赤夫每次都能出色完成。

他会6种地方口音，长相是中年人特有的粗犷、豪爽，身上没有那么冲的血腥气。很容易令善良的人放下戒备。

赤夫乔装打扮，有惊无险地溜出了城；学堂的操场上正在放免费电影，巡逻队人心涣散，好几个人都溜去看热闹了。

赤夫离开永恒市，又绕开出口，穿过河流。他回头，看了眼灯火通明的城市，脸上露出轻松的微笑。

今天，依然也是圆满完成任务的一天！

但还在冷兵器时代的赤夫并不知道，他的行踪已经被蜂鸟摄像机牢牢锁定。

摄像机噪音不大，表面贴满了鸟类的羽毛。虽然不会扇翅膀，有点太假了，但天色一黑，几乎没有任何人会注意到。

赤夫来到河流对岸，找到了在森林附近驻扎的罗马城大部队。

赤夫一五一十地汇报了在城中的发现，最后，用一种满怀期待的目光看着执政官：“爷爷，我们要行动吗？”

是的，赤夫是执政官的亲孙子。

执政官并没有思考太久，过去，他们成功过很多次，并且觉得自己一定会继续成功。至于失败，当然会有代价，可是……

执政官环顾一圈，周围全都是跃跃欲试的狂血战士。

他的年纪已经大了，正值壮年的儿子、甚至孙子们都想取而代之。

在过去，执政官靠着自己的血腥和残暴镇压着他们，镇压这群披着人皮的野兽。可一旦证实了自己的无能，没办法再为罗马城带来荣光和粮食，那么过去的恶果就会如数反噬到他自己身上。

所以，他只能继续战斗。证明自己不是年迈的狮子，还不能被赶出狮群。

“行动吧，明……不，就今晚。”执政官沉声道。

……

……

学校的操场牵起一块白布，周围没有开灯；投影仪的光照在白布上。

外面应该挺冷的，但操场上人多，挤一挤也就不那么冷了。

电影是学堂校长提出要放的。

基地目前人少，校长也兼职了基地文宣部门的负责人，部门的另一个负责人是福音书。

而校长在成为校长前，是一个土里刨食的农奴，只是以前浇粪的时候喜欢念诗，于是成为了大家公认的文化人。被举荐成了校长。

当时，如果农奴里有更好的选择，相南里肯定不会让他当校长的。

当上这个职务后，校长也很是迷茫了一些时间。

但他认认真真跟着上扫盲课，又操心每个学生的在校生活；后来人联的大学生来了，又开始主动学习先进的教学模式和理念……现在，他已经是个合格的校长了。

就相南里观察，其实大多数人都没有什么特别的才能，很多所谓的“足智多谋”，不过只是打了个信息差。

但人是一种会学习的动物。只要发挥主观能动性，总能找到合适的地方。

荧幕上放的电影是三百多年前的老电影，当时的经典爱情影片。由支教大学生小周提供，内容是人和智械人在战争期间的爱情故事。

喔，据说是由一本知名网络小说《我和我的机器人老公》改编的。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 97: A Confession, But Not Entirely Clear

The biggest drain on electricity was never residential or commercial use, but industrial. Currently, the electrical energy converted from geothermal wells was far more than they could use.

Xiang Nanli had offered a price covering half a year, originally intending to haggle; his psychological target was actually a full year.

Who would have thought that as soon as Fu Ming heard this, he was overjoyed and immediately added the clause to the contract: "A paper mill, right? No problem. No problem at all. When will you send people to take over?"

Whether it was writing paper or toilet paper, sales on the surface were extremely limited; furthermore, Glory City’s paper mill didn't have much of a competitive advantage. Ever since the Poverty Alleviation Office stopped buying from them, the workers had been unemployed for six years.

Selling it to the base would, at the very least, stimulate local employment.

Even if the workers were sent from Eternal City, these people still had to eat, drink, and sleep, right? That would be a disguised way of driving Glory City's economic development.

No matter how he looked at it, Fu Ming felt it was a win-win.

Xiang Nanli: *[Miscalculated, Xiao Zhi. The other side agreed so quickly; if I’d known, I would have started with an offer of three months.]*

But on second thought, this could be considered an act of charity, and Xiang Nanli immediately felt relieved.

The two signed the electronic contract.

Xiang Nanli stamped it with the official seal of the "Survivor Base Company."

The university students who had come from afar with the Human Alliance acted as third-party witnesses.

Xiang Nanli and Fu Ming shook hands cordially, wearing bright smiles. Thanks to the previous heavy funding from the Divine Court, the conference room was barely presentable. Sparse applause broke out from the audience.

One of the students, Comrade Xiao Wang, opened the camera mode of his prosthetic eye and took a picture. He combined it with the eight photos he had taken earlier to make a nine-grid post on his MicroNet (a Human Alliance version of Weibo/Moments): "Social practice on the surface, caught a local festival~"

When Xiao Wang took the photo, he never imagined that it would appear in textbooks a hundred years later.

Everyone believed this was just an ordinary day, including Xiang Nanli.

...

...

At three in the afternoon, the sky grew dim, but Eternal City remained lively.

Perhaps it was because the streetlights had been turned on today. The main roads of the entire city were brightly lit, with ribbons of light extending all the way to the Monument Square.

The strangers looked up in excitement; the lights dotting the darkness were like shining stars.

The technological gap between different outposts on the surface was immense.

In some places, the level of technology was on par with the Human Alliance; but in others, people still lived quite primitive and simple lives.

Chifu had arranged to meet his accomplices at the Monument Square. Two companions were to take the diplomat away, while he went to secretly gather information.

The bonfire in the square burned fiercely, and amidst the noisy crowd, there was even the sound of a violin.

The person playing the instrument was a nobleman from the old days; now, wearing a concealed electronic shackle, he stood by the bonfire. He was still under surveillance, but his mental state had improved significantly.

The old gentleman was a "model for reform," like Laifu, teaching at the school.

He seemed to love his current life, using his professional knowledge to earn sentence reductions multiple times.

As for whether he missed the days of fine clothes, gourmet food, and exploiting serfs, perhaps only the gentleman himself knew.

Old people, children, and young people danced around the huge fire, listening to the accompaniment.

The monument behind them had somehow been carved with elegant patterns.

A very lively city.

Enviable and covetous.

Chifu bought a cup of rice wine at a stall and briefed his accomplices: "The patrol guys were chatting and said that half of the cannons on the city walls are broken, and there is no ammunition in the powder magazine. When the Aberrants attacked the city before, the ammo was all used up, and there were no supplies. I snuck in during the shift change to take a look, and what they said is true."

"As far as I know, the Aberrant siege was half a year ago. The outer city was mostly burned down then... The wine here tastes pretty good, do you want some?"

His companion shook his head slightly: "The diplomat said that in two days, when the Harvest Festival ends, the city will close its gates for the winter. We can't open the gates on our own, so tell the Governor that if he wants to act, it has to be tonight or tomorrow night."

Chifu nodded slightly: "Alright, then later you pretend to be me, get drunk, and go back to the dormitory to sleep. I'll find a chance to sneak back and report to the Governor."

Chifu used his counter-reconnaissance skills to avoid the crowd.

This wasn't his first time acting as an intelligence scout. In the past, whenever Rome City went out to raid, they always sent him to probe the reality of the situation. Chifu always completed the task brilliantly.

He could speak six local dialects, and his appearance was that of a middle-aged man—rugged and hearty, without the pungent scent of blood. It was easy to make kind-hearted people lower their guard.

Disguised, Chifu slipped out of the city without incident; a free movie was being shown on the school playground, and the patrol team was distracted, with several people sneaking off to watch the fun.

Chifu left Eternal City, bypassed the exit, and crossed the river. He looked back at the brightly lit city, a relaxed smile on his face.

Today was another day of successfully completing the mission!

But Chifu, still in the age of cold weapons, did not know that his movements had been firmly locked by a hummingbird camera.

The camera made little noise and was covered in bird feathers. Although it didn't flap its wings—which was a bit fake—once it got dark, almost no one would notice.

Chifu reached the other side of the river and found the main force of Rome City stationed near the forest.

Chifu reported his findings in the city in detail, and finally, looked at the Governor with eyes full of anticipation: "Grandfather, are we going to act?"

Yes, Chifu was the Governor's own grandson.

The Governor didn't think for long. In the past, they had succeeded many times and believed they would continue to succeed. As for failure, there would certainly be a price, but...

The Governor looked around at the blood-crazed warriors who were all eager to try.

He was already old, and his son in his prime, and even his grandsons, all wanted to replace him.

In the past, the Governor had relied on his own bloodthirst and cruelty to suppress them, to suppress this group of beasts wearing human skin. But once his incompetence was proven—once he could no longer bring glory and food to Rome City—the evils of the past would rebound on him in full.

Therefore, he had no choice but to keep fighting. To prove he wasn't an aging lion who could be driven out of the pride.

"Let's act, tomorrow... no, tonight," the Governor said in a deep voice.

...

...

A white cloth was hung up on the school playground, and no lights were turned on around it; the projector's light shone onto the cloth.

It must have been quite cold outside, but there were so many people on the playground that huddling together made it less cold.

The movie was suggested by the school principal.

The base currently had few people, and the principal also served as the head of the base's propaganda department; the other head of the department was the Gospel Book.

Before becoming principal, he had been a serf scratching a living from the dirt, but he liked to recite poetry while spreading manure, so he became recognized by everyone as a man of culture and was recommended to be principal.

At the time, if there had been a better choice among the serfs, Xiang Nanli certainly wouldn't have made him principal.

After taking on the position, the principal had been quite lost for a time.

But he diligently followed the literacy classes and worried about every student's life at school; later, when the university students from the Human Alliance arrived, he began to take the initiative to learn advanced teaching models and concepts... Now, he was a qualified principal.

As far as Xiang Nanli observed, most people didn't have any special talents; much of what was called "resourcefulness" was just exploiting information gaps.

But humans are animals that can learn. As long as they exert their subjective initiative, they can always find a suitable place.

The movie playing on the screen was an old film from over three hundred years ago, a classic romance of that time. It was provided by the volunteer student Xiao Zhou, and the content was a love story between a human and an android during wartime.

Oh, it was said to be adapted from a well-known web novel, "My Robot Husband and I."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第97章 表白了，但没有完全白 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
相南里还没看过未来世界的电影。

听说，在洛阳城最高端的电影院，都是“全息观影”。

观众可以选择“共情”剧里的任何一个角色，参与故事的发展。也可以选择上帝视角旁观。

相南里的思维涣散了一堆，突然开口：“小青，如果用全息观影技术看鬼片，岂不是很刺激。”

东方青帝似乎看得较为投入，片刻后，才反应过来，凉凉地开口：“这还需要全息观影技术吗？在地表撞见畸变人，就是现成的鬼片。”

“你小声点，以西结听见又要呲牙了。”相南里小声道。

坐在前排、正准备呲牙的以西结听到这里，刚打开一点的齿缝顿时合上，唇角绷紧。

上午十点开会，会开了两个小时，吃了个午饭，签完合同是下午两点。很多据点虽然没想建设电网，但是对永恒市卖的粮食很感兴趣。

工作完成后，相南里罕见地没有继续上班；而是履行承诺，带着以西结在永恒市里逛街。

具体来说，是三个人。

他、小青，还有以西结。

以西结的坐骑爬行者三眼被拴在了市政厅的后花园，以防吓到路过的行人。

相南里原本还担心畸变人拴在这里不安全，毕竟三眼是一只残暴的怪物，体型也有三米长。吃起人来虽然不至于一口一个，一口0.5个却没什么问题。

但以西结说，可能是因为群居外加吃菌子长大的，三眼的性格非常温顺。不温顺的畸变人都被大红咬死了。

相南里低调地带着以西结逛了商业街、公会、学校、食堂、后花园、博物馆。他们走了一整天，一直到天黑。相南里中途还抽空，教了以西结一些拼音。

作为畸变人，以西结相当的聪明……像是一些鸡娃家长很喜欢的“报恩牛娃”小孩。一点就透，举一反三。

就在相南里琢磨着还有什么地方能去的时候，刚好有路过的学生在商量着晚上看电影。

于是他们转头回到了学校。

露天的操场上挤满了看热闹的人。还有人从家里带来了小板凳。城里的，外来的，都有。黑灯瞎火，谁也看不清谁。

最后还是相南里找校长安排。拿到了前排的座位。

以西结尾巴太大，只能自己坐一排。屁股墩一个座位，尾巴得横着占三个座位。

电影正放到智械人发现，自己的人类恋人，居然只是人联的间谍。

智械人感觉一阵天崩地裂。

周围没有看过电影的观众们纷纷跟着悲痛不已。

相南里却忍不住很轻地蹙起眉。

东方青帝问：“你不喜欢？”

“嗯……”相南里看着屏幕，用手撑着下巴，“我觉得不合逻辑，所以算不喜欢吧。”

“为什么？”小青很小声地跟他咬耳朵。

相南里忍不住摸了摸发痒的耳垂：“我觉得感情是一种投射。人和机器人的恋爱故事，投射的其实是人类自己的恋爱幻想。他们幻想机器人拥有感情。而感情会成为控制那台机器人的开关……”

东方青帝的声音停顿了片刻：“是吗？”

“你看，就像这个电影。”相南里思考着，“人类间谍为了让智械人听自己的话，在它的后台悄悄植入了病毒。电影里说，病毒其实是无效的。智械人依然背叛了自己的组织，是因为爱人类。”

“但我却会忍不住想，病毒真的失效了吗，爱到底是它自发的想法，还是病毒更改了它的程序？

“百分百的服从就是爱吗？那每一个没有拟人模块的机器人，岂不是都深爱自己的主人。电影里这个主角又真的爱他的丈夫吗？人为什么会爱一个没有自我意识的物品。”

“……非要说的话。”相南里沉思片刻，“我只是想象不出来，人会‘爱’一部手机。人不会跟自己的手机结婚，但只要手机的硬件从金属的长方体变成了金属的人型，人就会愿意和手机结婚了。

“所以，本质上，所有人和机器人的故事。人类爱的也还是另一个人，而不是那部手机。这就是我看电影觉得别扭的地方。”

东方青帝有些无言。

他甚至感觉到自己的心一点点沉了下来，微微发凉。

相南里的话锋一转：“不过，爱本来就是一种主观感受。一个人被另一个人吸引，于是产生了爱情。但人也可能被不是人的东西吸引。”

“只要被激发出了爱情，对方到底是人、智械、畸变人其实都不重要。毕竟身体只是方便和另一个灵魂沟通的容器……小青，我听说你们智械人内部都用脑电波沟通，你有爱过哪个灵魂吗？”

电影播放到了智械人对人类绝望的告白。周围哭声一片。

就连以西结都看得很认真。

按理说，旁边其实是很吵的。东方青帝却感觉四周一片寂静，只剩下了相南里懒洋洋的嗓音。

他在看电影，又很漫不经心。

“有。”东方青帝不敢回头看他，手握成拳，缓缓开口，“我爱的那个灵魂就在我眼前。”

这对他来说是一个很困难的决定。东方青帝害怕看到相南里回避的眼神；也害怕失败的后果。

尽管根据分析，相南里疏远他的概率只有百分之1.7。

“……？”相南里一愣。

他看着小青，又扭头，看着电影的荧幕。

电影刚切换了视角，是Alpha发现情报泄露，智械军团损失惨重，正在无能狂怒，表示一定要查出叛徒是谁。

有句话叫缺什么想要什么。现实里，会无能狂怒的那一方显然是人类自己。

而且，这个Alpha的扮演者还是一个中年老男人，相南里不太喜欢。

相南里看着电影里的Alpha，又扭头，看了一下东方青帝；感觉自己的大脑有些短路。

什么，原来小青暗恋Alpha？

东方青帝的眼神很哀伤。

相南里不由得想起，之前，小青类比过。如果Alpha是元帅，那他就是普通士兵。

那身份差距岂不是相当悬殊！

相南里的表情充满震惊，随后就是一种有些着急安慰，但是词穷的窘迫。

而在这短暂的沉默中，东方青帝的眼神也从哀伤变成了狐疑，到顿悟过来的错愕。

智械人的情绪其实是很寡淡的。

但Alpha却机生第一次领悟到了什么叫恼羞成怒，气急败坏！

他从牙缝里挤出一句话：“你脑子到底在想什么？”

智能助理小智在此时发来贺电：[打扰一下。根据蜂鸟无人机窃听回来的情报分析，罗马城的主力部队就在这个位置。另外，他们打算凌晨3点发起进攻。]

电子地图上骤然亮起一个点。
chunks.englishText:
Xiang Nanli hadn't watched movies from the future world yet.

He heard that in the most high-end cinemas in Luoyang City, everything was "holographic viewing."

The audience could choose to "empathize" with any character in the story and participate in the development of the plot. They could also choose to watch from a god's-eye perspective.

Xiang Nanli's thoughts drifted for a moment, and he suddenly spoke: "Xiao Qing, wouldn't it be very exciting to watch a horror movie using holographic technology?"

Dongfang Qingdi seemed quite engrossed, and after a moment, he reacted and said coolly: "Does that require holographic technology? Encountering an Aberrant on the surface is a ready-made horror movie."

"Keep your voice down, Ezekiel will start baring his teeth again if he hears you," Xiang Nanli whispered.

Ezekiel, who was sitting in the front row and preparing to bare his teeth, heard this, and the gap between his teeth that had just opened immediately closed, his lips tightening.

The meeting started at ten in the morning, lasted for two hours, they had lunch, and finished signing the contract at two in the afternoon. Although many outposts didn't want to build a power grid, they were very interested in the grain sold by Eternal City.

After the work was done, Xiang Nanli rarely didn't continue working; instead, he fulfilled his promise and took Ezekiel shopping in Eternal City.

Specifically, there were three of them.

Him, Xiao Qing, and Ezekiel.

Ezekiel's mount, the crawler Three-Eyes, was tied in the back garden of the City Hall to avoid scaring passersby.

Xiang Nanli had originally worried that it wasn't safe to tie an Aberrant there; after all, Three-Eyes was a brutal monster, three meters long. While it might not be able to eat a person in one bite, eating 0.5 of one wasn't a problem.

But Ezekiel said that perhaps because they were pack animals and grew up eating mushrooms, Three-Eyes had a very docile personality. The Aberrants that weren't docile had all been bitten to death by Da Hong.

Xiang Nanli low-key took Ezekiel to visit the commercial street, the guild, the school, the canteen, the back garden, and the museum. They walked all day until dark. Xiang Nanli even took the time to teach Ezekiel some Pinyin along the way.

As an Aberrant, Ezekiel was quite smart... like those "repayment-gifted" children that tiger parents love. He understood everything at once and could draw inferences from one instance.

Just as Xiang Nanli was wondering where else they could go, some passing students happened to be discussing watching a movie that night.

So they turned back to the school.

The open-air playground was packed with people watching the fun. Some even brought small stools from home. Locals, outsiders, everyone was there. It was pitch black, and no one could see anyone clearly.

In the end, Xiang Nanli had to ask the principal to arrange it, and they got front-row seats.

Ezekiel's tail was too big, so he had to sit in a row by himself. His butt took up one seat, and his tail had to lie horizontally across three seats.

The movie was at the part where the android discovers that his human lover was actually a spy for the Human Alliance.

The android felt the world crumbling.

The surrounding audience who hadn't seen the movie were all grieving along with it.

Xiang Nanli, however, couldn't help but frown slightly.

Dongfang Qingdi asked: "You don't like it?"

"Hmm..." Xiang Nanli looked at the screen, resting his chin on his hand, "I think it's illogical, so I suppose I don't like it."

"Why?" Xiao Qing whispered in his ear.

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but touch his itchy earlobe: "I think love is a projection. The love story between a human and a robot is actually a projection of human romantic fantasies. They fantasize that robots have feelings. And feelings will become the switch to control that machine..."

Dongfang Qingdi's voice paused for a moment: "Is that so?"

"Look, just like this movie," Xiang Nanli pondered, "The human spy, in order to make the android obey him, secretly implanted a virus in its backend. The movie says the virus was actually ineffective. The android still betrayed its organization because it loved the human."

"But I can't help but wonder, was the virus really ineffective? Is love its spontaneous thought, or did the virus change its program?"

"Is 100% obedience love? If so, then every robot without an anthropomorphic module must deeply love its owner. Does the protagonist in the movie really love his husband? Why would a person love an object without self-awareness?"

"...If I have to say it," Xiang Nanli mused for a moment, "I just can't imagine a person 'loving' a mobile phone. People wouldn't marry their mobile phones, but as long as the hardware of the phone changes from a metal rectangle to a metal humanoid, people would be willing to marry it."

"So, essentially, in all stories between humans and robots, what humans love is still another person, not that mobile phone. That’s why I feel awkward watching this movie."

Dongfang Qingdi was speechless.

He even felt his heart sink bit by bit, turning slightly cold.

Xiang Nanli changed the subject: "However, love is inherently a subjective feeling. One person is attracted to another, and thus love is born. But people can also be attracted to things that aren't human."

"As long as love is sparked, whether the other party is human, an android, or an Aberrant doesn't really matter. After all, the body is just a vessel for communicating with another soul... Xiao Qing, I heard that you androids communicate using brainwaves internally. Have you ever loved a soul?"

The movie reached the android's desperate confession to the human. There was crying all around.

Even Ezekiel was watching very intently.

Normally, it would be very noisy nearby. But Dongfang Qingdi felt that the surroundings were silent, with only Xiang Nanli's lazy voice remaining.

He was watching the movie, yet very nonchalantly.

"Yes," Dongfang Qingdi didn't dare to look back at him, his hand clenched into a fist as he spoke slowly, "The soul I love is right before my eyes."

This was a very difficult decision for him. Dongfang Qingdi was afraid of seeing Xiang Nanli's evasive eyes; he was also afraid of the consequences of failure.

Although according to analysis, the probability of Xiang Nanli distancing himself from him was only 1.7%.

"...?" Xiang Nanli was stunned.

He looked at Xiao Qing, then turned his head to look at the movie screen.

The movie had just switched perspectives; it was the Alpha discovering that intelligence had been leaked and the android legion had suffered heavy losses, and he was throwing a tantrum, declaring that he must find out who the traitor was.

There is a saying that you want what you lack. In reality, the side throwing the tantrum was clearly the humans themselves.

Moreover, the actor playing this Alpha was a middle-aged man, and Xiang Nanli didn't like him very much.

Xiang Nanli looked at the Alpha in the movie, then turned to look at Dongfang Qingdi; he felt his brain short-circuit.

What, so Xiao Qing has a crush on the Alpha?

Dongfang Qingdi's eyes were very sorrowful.

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but recall that Xiao Qing had made an analogy before. If the Alpha was the Marshal, then he was just a common soldier.

Wouldn't the status gap be extremely vast?!

Xiang Nanli's expression was full of shock, followed by a kind of awkwardness, wanting to comfort him but lacking the words.

And in this brief silence, Dongfang Qingdi's eyes also changed from sorrow to suspicion, and then to the astonishment of realization.

An android's emotions are actually quite bland.

But for the first time in his machine life, the Alpha realized what it meant to be embarrassed and angry!

He squeezed a sentence through his teeth: "What on earth are you thinking about?"

The smart assistant Xiao Zhi sent a congratulatory message at this moment: *[Excuse me. According to the intelligence analysis intercepted by the hummingbird drone, the main force of Rome City is at this location. In addition, they plan to launch an attack at 3:00 AM.]*

A point suddenly lit up on the electronic map.

chunks.chineseText:
第98章 丰收节4

但相南里自己，却是越品越对味。

Alpha毕竟是他的嫡长子，相南里对它还是很关心的。

小青大多时候知无不言，但一旦相南里拐弯抹角地询问Alpha的消息，这小子都闭口不谈，顾左右而言他。

相南里偶尔会说Alpha的坏话，每当这种时候，小青会紧张地解释。

如果小青暗恋Alpha，那么一切都能解释通了。

相南里本来想安慰他两句，但是看着对方脸色不太对，只好不露声色地岔开话题：“小青，该打仗了。走走走，我通知了小福它们来开战前会议。”

东方青帝解释的话都到了嘴边，但相南里已经悄悄站了起来，准备从露天电影院溜走。

他走的时候还不忘捎上以西结：“电影给你拷贝到手机里。先带你去看热闹。”

以西结就这么稀里糊涂地被拽走了。

有句话叫，“一而再，再而三，三而竭”。

东方青帝看着他的背影，用手捂住脸，陷入一种心力衰竭的状态；感觉如果不放弃“和相南里谈恋爱”这个机生目标的话，他的一生将会时常处于这样的疲惫中。

但如果放弃，他又该为什么而存在？

于是，东方青帝只好叹了口气，跟上他的脚步。

……

……

赤夫躺在永恒市提供的宿舍床上，双手抱头望着天，不知为何有些心绪不宁。

和他同宿舍的侄子呼呼大睡。这小子可喜欢食堂卖的烤肉，一份要1工分券，侄子食量大，一晚上吃了五份。为了吃肉，还当掉了兜里的子弹。

永恒市不禁枪。毕竟这是一个新兴的据点，还没什么公信力。但敢在城里动枪的，都被巡逻队的人架走了。

巡逻队的首领叫葛根，一半身体都是机械装置。

这让赤夫有一些非常不好的预感。

他想想，那应该是17年前的事。那一年他20岁，他强壮的身体像是一块锤炼得正好的精钢。

赤夫打遍罗马城无敌手，于是自视甚高，不可一世。

然后他在地表遇到了一个年轻的病秧子。

那个病秧子走一步咳嗽两声，走动时能听见金属摩擦发出的轻微脆响。他受了重伤，很疲惫，也很累。暴露在外的金属零件散发着一阵冷光。

赤夫想冲上去打劫，这是他家的祖传生意。

然后，那个病秧子步伐没有丝毫改变，只是抬起手，轻轻扇了一下。

赤夫控制不住地倒飞出去，一直撞到了树干上。他感觉自己的胸腔微微凹陷了下去，恐怖的罡风擦着他的脸划过。剧痛让他的眼前发黑，身体动弹不得——可对方明明只是轻轻挥了一下手。

赤夫听见了隐约的说话声。

“洛阳，你不杀了那个人吗？他似乎看到你了。”是有些机械感的女声。

“嗯？刚才有人？我的生物监测仪坏了。”

“那你刚才是在干嘛？”

“看见了Alpha放的一只蚊子。怎么，原来你看不见吗？”

赤夫没能完全听见他们在说什么。

他连看见自己爷爷都没有那么害怕，想的是那老登死了，皇位迟早会传到他身上。然而在面对那个男人时，却升不起丝毫的战意，只有无穷的恐惧。

赤夫侥幸捡回了一条命，却伤到了根基。

再也不是青年一代最强壮的战士。于是只好另辟蹊径，当起了“智囊”一类的角色。

好在，他所在的罗马城，附近根本看不见机械改造人。

赤夫逐渐忘记了这个噩梦，把对冰冷金属的恐惧埋进了心底。

“葛根并没有很强，只是身体某些部位更坚硬一点。不害怕子弹。”赤夫在心里想着，“我不用害怕他。”

赤夫已经想好了方案。他们的人进来，直奔仓库。

仓库里有运输车，东西装满就开车跑。永恒市太大了，他们人手不够。子弹是会打完的。

对了，罗马城还开来了过去战无不胜的利器，一辆军用装甲车。就藏在树林边。

这辆装甲车是执政官花了大价钱买回来的，外观近似坦克。开车好啊，不用担心有人挡在自己面前。战士也能躲在车里，就像一个天然的战壕。

没有什么大问题。

赤夫心想，一共83名狂血战士。里应外合，完全可以打永恒市一个措手不及。

凌晨1点，赤夫叫醒了还在睡觉的另外两人，小声道：“准备行动了。”

他们子弹装进弹匣，悄悄推开了宿舍的门。

大使招待所安排在城堡内部。这里还保留着永恒之城原本的贵族装潢，看起来很是富丽堂皇。

赤夫一想到永恒市的财富很快就能归他们所有，心里不禁有些微微的激动和颤抖。

走廊上开着夜灯，不算刺眼。

赤夫不仅擅长察言观色，还会一些偏门；比如撬锁。

下午，市长办公室没人。赤夫靠着自己努力搞来了城堡内部的地图，知道基地的相司令平时就在顶楼住着。

赤夫是这样想的：晚上，他们悄悄溜进相南里的房间，然后把他拿下。

就赤夫观察，这位司令在基地里深受爱戴；只要控制住他，还怕基地不给物资？

一切都很顺利。

他们顺着步梯来到顶楼，中途，差点撞上巡逻的守卫。好在对方也只是打着哈欠路过。

小智：[为什么还要安排人巡逻？]

相南里：[研究表明，靠自己努力取得的成果更加令人信服。]

赤夫屏息凝神，来到相南里房间门口。走廊上亮着微光，这种暴露的感觉，让他很不舒服。

[他不会打不开电子锁吧？]

[没事，这个可以内控。让他先捅几下锁芯，假装打开了。]

当看见相南里门口的电子锁的时候，赤夫是有些懵圈的。

他过去开的都是一些机关锁，宿舍门口这个连锁眼都没有。

但箭在弦上，不得不发。

赤夫在小弟们期待的目光下，掏出一根尖端带着弯钩的铁丝，朝着门缝一丝丝划过。

铁丝碰到了什么东西，发出“喀嚓”一声轻响。

赤夫的眼神骤然爆发出光彩！他的手握住扶手，缓缓推开门——

房间里一片漆黑。走廊外的光透了进来，能隐约看见床的轮廓。被子是鼓起的。

毕竟是在偷鸡摸狗，赤夫感觉到自己心脏狂跳，精神格外亢奋。他直奔床上扑去，凭着自己杀人多年的经验，一把摁向头颅的位置，另一只手娴熟地摸向腰后的枪。

但在触碰到床上这个人形的时候，赤夫却愣住了。手感不对。

太硬了。

是一台机器人。

灯光在瞬间打开，在墙角、床底等候多时的葛根等人迅速把罗马城的探子拿下，人赃俱获。

被当成了免费壮劳力而不自知的小周同志兴奋地大叫：“抓住人了！抓住了！”

小周进行过机械改造，胳膊上套着一拳铁臂。他死死压住了赤夫的背，以一种非常标准的姿势控制住了赤夫。

相南里盯着监控，扶着耳麦，和小青吐槽：“我也想看现场版。”

“有枪。”

东方青帝用冷酷的两个字终结了谈话。

Chapter 98: Harvest Festival (Part 4)

Xiang Nanli himself, however, found that the more he pondered it, the more it made sense.

Alpha was, after all, his eldest son; Xiang Nanli still cared about him quite a bit.

Xiao Qing was usually an open book, but whenever Xiang Nanli tried to beat around the bush to ask for news about Alpha, the kid would clam up and start talking about anything else.

Whenever Xiang Nanli would jokingly badmouth Alpha, Xiao Qing would get nervous and rush to explain.

If Xiao Qing had a secret crush on Alpha, then everything suddenly made sense.

Xiang Nanli had originally wanted to offer a few words of comfort, but seeing the look on the other’s face, he decided to nonchalantly change the subject: "Xiao Qing, it’s time for battle. Come on, come on, I’ve notified Xiao Fu and the others to hold a pre-battle meeting."

The words of explanation were already on Dongfang Qingdi’s lips, but Xiang Nanli had already quietly stood up, preparing to slip away from the open-air cinema.

As he left, he didn't forget to grab Ezekiel: "I’ll copy the movie to your phone. First, come with me to watch the fun."

And just like that, Ezekiel was dragged away, completely bewildered.

There is a saying: "At the first drum, morale is high; at the second, it wanes; at the third, it is exhausted."

Watching his back, Dongfang Qingdi covered his face with his hand, falling into a state of mental exhaustion. He felt that if he didn't abandon the life goal of "dating Xiang Nanli," his entire existence would be spent in this state of fatigue.

But if he gave it up, what would he exist for?

In the end, Dongfang Qingdi could only sigh and follow in his footsteps.

...

...

Chifu lay on the bunk provided by Eternal City, hands behind his head, staring at the ceiling. For some reason, he felt restless.

His nephew, who shared the room, was fast asleep. The kid loved the roasted meat sold at the cafeteria—it cost one labor voucher per portion, and the boy had a huge appetite, eating five portions in one night. To afford the meat, he had even pawned the bullets in his pockets.

Eternal City did not ban firearms. After all, it was an emerging stronghold with little credibility yet. But anyone who dared to brandish a gun in the city was quickly hauled away by the patrol team.

The leader of the patrol team was named Gegen, and half of his body was mechanical.

This gave Chifu a very bad premonition.

He thought back; it must have been 17 years ago. That year he was 20, his strong body like a piece of refined steel tempered to perfection.

Chifu had fought his way through Rome City without a single defeat, and as a result, he thought very highly of himself, arrogant and unconquerable.

Then, on the surface, he met a young, sickly man.

That sickly man coughed every step he took, and one could hear the faint, crisp sound of metal rubbing against metal as he moved. He was severely wounded, exhausted, and weary. The exposed mechanical parts emitted a cold, shimmering light.

Chifu wanted to rush up and rob him; it was his family’s ancestral business.

Then, the sickly man didn't change his pace in the slightest; he merely raised his hand and gave a light flick.

Chifu couldn't control his body as he flew backward, slamming into a tree trunk. He felt his chest cavity cave in slightly, and a terrifying gale of *qi* brushed past his face. The excruciating pain made his vision go black, and his body wouldn't obey him—yet the other man had only waved his hand lightly.

Chifu heard faint voices.

"Luoyang, aren't you going to kill that man? He seems to have seen you." It was a female voice with a mechanical tone.

"Hmm? Was someone there? My biological monitor must be broken."

"Then what were you doing just now?"

"Saw a mosquito Alpha let loose. What, you couldn't see it?"

Chifu hadn't heard everything they were saying.

He hadn't even been that afraid when facing his own grandfather—he had just thought that once the old man died, the throne would eventually pass to him. Yet, when facing that man, he couldn't summon a shred of fighting spirit, only infinite terror.

Chifu had luckily escaped with his life, but his foundation was damaged.

He was no longer the strongest warrior of the younger generation. Thus, he had to find another path, taking on a role like a "strategist."

Fortunately, in Rome City, where he lived, one couldn't see any mechanical cyborgs nearby.

Chifu had gradually forgotten that nightmare, burying his fear of cold metal deep in his heart.

"Gegen isn't that strong; it's just that parts of his body are harder. He isn't afraid of bullets," Chifu thought to himself. "I don't need to be afraid of him."

Chifu had already planned the scheme. Their people would enter and head straight for the warehouse.

There were transport vehicles in the warehouse; they would load the goods and drive away. Eternal City was too big, and they didn't have enough manpower. Bullets would eventually run out.

Right, Rome City had also brought along their invincible weapon of the past: a military armored vehicle. It was hidden by the edge of the woods.

The Governor had spent a fortune to buy this armored vehicle; its appearance was similar to a tank. Driving was great—no need to worry about anyone blocking the way. The warriors could also hide inside the vehicle, like a natural trench.

There shouldn't be any major problems.

Chifu thought, there were 83 Blood-Berserker warriors in total. With an inside-out attack, they could completely catch Eternal City off guard.

At 1:00 AM, Chifu woke the other two who were still sleeping and whispered, "Prepare to move."

They loaded their magazines and quietly pushed open the dormitory door.

The embassy guest house was arranged inside the castle. It still retained the original noble decor of the Eternal City, looking quite magnificent.

Whenever Chifu thought about how the wealth of Eternal City would soon belong to them, he couldn't help but feel a slight excitement and tremor in his heart.

The hallway was lit with night lights, not too glaring.

Chifu was not only good at reading people, but he also knew some crooked tricks; for instance, picking locks.

In the afternoon, the Mayor’s office was empty. Relying on his own efforts, Chifu had obtained a map of the castle’s interior and knew that Commander Xiang of the base usually lived on the top floor.

This was how Chifu thought: at night, they would sneak into Xiang Nanli’s room and take him down.

Based on Chifu’s observations, this Commander was deeply loved in the base; as long as they controlled him, would they have to worry about the base not handing over supplies?

Everything went smoothly.

They followed the stairs to the top floor, nearly bumping into a patrolling guard on the way. Fortunately, the other party just walked by while yawning.

Xiao Zhi: [Why do we still need to arrange patrols?]

Xiang Nanli: [Research shows that results achieved through one's own efforts are more convincing.]

Chifu held his breath and focused, arriving at the door to Xiang Nanli’s room. The hallway was dimly lit, and this feeling of being exposed made him very uncomfortable.

[He won't be unable to open the electronic lock, will he?]

[It's fine, this one can be controlled internally. Let him poke the lock cylinder a few times and pretend he opened it.]

When he saw the electronic lock on Xiang Nanli’s door, Chifu was a bit bewildered.

In the past, he had only ever opened mechanical locks; the one on the dormitory door didn't even have a keyhole.

But the arrow was on the string; it had to be fired.

Under the expectant gazes of his underlings, Chifu took out a piece of wire with a hook at the tip and dragged it bit by bit across the door gap.

The wire touched something, and a faint "click" sounded.

A burst of brilliance erupted in Chifu’s eyes! He gripped the handle and slowly pushed the door open—

The room was pitch black. The light from the hallway filtered in, and one could vaguely see the outline of the bed. The quilt was bulging.

After all, he was doing something shady, and Chifu felt his heart pounding, his spirit exceptionally agitated. He lunged straight for the bed, relying on his years of experience in killing, and pressed down on the position of the head, while his other hand skillfully reached for the gun behind his waist.

But when he touched the human-shaped figure on the bed, Chifu froze. The texture was wrong.

It was too hard.

It was a robot.

The lights turned on in an instant. Gegen and others, who had been waiting in the corners and under the bed for a long time, quickly subdued the spies from Rome City, catching them red-handed.

Comrade Xiao Zhou, who didn't know he had been used as free labor, shouted excitedly: "Caught them! We caught them!"

Xiao Zhou had undergone mechanical modification, with an iron arm fitted over his limb. He pressed down hard on Chifu’s back, controlling him with a very standard posture.

Xiang Nanli stared at the monitor, holding his headset, and complained to Xiao Qing: "I wanted to see the live version too."

"There are guns."

Dongfang Qingdi ended the conversation with two cold words.
