300 million credits: 100 million to pay the underground banks (to launder the money so the illicit funds would become legitimate and not be flagged by banks); 100 million to complete Alpha's mission; and the final 100 million for Mi Feng to use as a backup, so it wouldn't get stuck on the surface forever unable to finish its mission.

But Gabriel stopped it, or rather, offered a very reasonable suggestion: "Leviathan is right near Yinshan City; the place is crawling with the Divine Court's eyes and ears and military fortresses. Rather than paying, they would certainly choose more violent means to take me back. You had better move your hideout."

Huang Feng frowned: "Isn't the Divine Court afraid I'll kill the hostage?"

Then Gabriel demonstrated for Huang Feng. He took the mantis blade Huang Feng kept at its waist and gently drew it across his own neck—

No blood. Gabriel's head fell to the ground, as light as tufts of grass.

Huang Feng detected no vital signs, but just a few minutes later, Gabriel's body picked up its own head and reattached it to his neck.

"I can't die," Gabriel replied softly and weakly. "Killing the hostage is useless."

Huang Feng couldn't find a solution in its database, so it chose to send a distress signal to Alpha.

Alpha did not disappoint, replying three months later—"TD."

Although the signal was weak, Huang Feng detected that the source was near Eternal City. It happened to coincide with the mission target location.

So, Huang Feng brought Gabriel along to seek refuge with Alpha~ Of course, due to the confidentiality mechanism, it was the only one who knew about this.

But this hostage, Gabriel, was more delicate than Huang Feng had imagined.

Sunlight would cause a rash of red bumps on his fair skin; he could only accept mechanical transport (including bicycles and being carried on a robot's back), and he would vomit uncontrollably the moment he got on an energy-powered vehicle. Moreover, he was afraid of the cold and needed thick cotton quilts; he had to have 8 hours of sleep every day. And he had to eat delicious food, otherwise, he would cry and make a scene every day.

Even though it knew Gabriel couldn't die; even though Huang Feng was a damn machine-will-driven entity, the residual robotic instinct (to care for humans) made it unable to refuse—damn Alpha, didn't you say the bug in this anthropomorphic module had been fixed long ago?

Come to think of it, is Gabriel really human?

Huang Feng's suspicious gaze fell on Gabriel's face.

The other party sat on the bed, wrapped up like a round rice dumpling, and replied with sleepy eyes: "I'm awake."

Huang Feng said with a cold face: "Breakfast is on the table."

"Oh, thank you."

"Check-out is at 12:00 noon. I'm out of money. Don't walk around in the room; I'm going out to earn some money later." Huang Feng said with a calm expression. It didn't mention at all that its methods of earning money were almost entirely illegal.

It had no human sense of morality.

People here used two types of currency: one was physical labor vouchers; the other was called "Citizen Points," which was electronic currency.

Huang Feng had tried to crack the electronic currency here, but failed.

This must be Alpha's handiwork, right? You have to know that it was a super-intelligent machine that could even hack into the Divine Court's defense system (?).

"Oh... oh..." Gabriel paused, then asked in a slow, measured tone, "What about that rich relative of yours? Didn't you say they were in Eternal City?"

Huang Feng thought to itself that it wanted to know, too. It had sent signals until it was exhausted, but Alpha hadn't responded.

(Note: Signal coverage is 100km; while the straight-line distance from Eternal City to the base's main urban area is 167km.)

Huang Feng: "There was a bit of a problem."

"Heh, it's fine." A smile that could be described as joyful appeared on Gabriel's face. He pulled dozens of high-value labor vouchers from his bosom and waved them in front of Huang Feng. "I discovered that I also have a rich relative in Eternal City."

Huang Feng took the banknotes, counted them, and said in shock: "This money is enough to stay in a presidential suite for a month! Your relative is really rich!"

—Actually, under normal circumstances, Sariel wouldn't carry so much money on him.

But he was a high-quality talent who had seen the world and understood the laws of economic development.

Sariel was planning to buy a house in Eternal City!

He had saved a month's salary and, using his profession as a "Legion Instructor" as a guarantee, had taken out a loan from the bank. He was going to go to the housing authority to pay the down payment during his lunch break after work!

Currently, the base's real estate hadn't entered the free market. It was all built by the government, and residents filled out forms to purchase. Considering the current production level of Eternal City, the price was relatively affordable.

There weren't many people in Eternal City who could beat him. Sariel had originally thought that carrying cash was quite safe. Unfortunately, he had run into the wicked Gabriel.

Gabriel's thoughts drifted for a moment, then he smiled and replied: "Mmhmm."

Huang Feng: "Then you eat first, I'll go downstairs to extend the room. By the way, you've been missing for so long, isn't the Divine Court worried at all? If they don't know you've been kidnapped, how am I supposed to demand a ransom?"

chunks.chineseText:
加百列蹲在椅子上，不太熟练地用勺子舀起碗里的牛奶燕麦：“你要是着急，我可以给教皇写封信。”

说完，似乎觉得有些冻脚，脚背互相搓了搓。脚踝上的铁锁哐哐作响。

这个铁锁可不是黄枫装上的。

它一打开棺材，加百列身上就戴着。

“那信要给我过目。而且只能用纸和笔，不能用电子文档！”

黄枫担心有加密内容检测不出来。

加百列人畜无害地回答：“好。”

他目送着这台智械离开，捧起燕麦碗暖手，目光从清澈变得深沉，甚至有些阴郁。

“幸存者基地，东皇重工，黄枫；批次是智械危机后生产的雏蜂号智械。虽然是智械人，但会对神庭的精神控制类神术有明显反应……”

加百列一直在催眠黄枫，效果显著。

这台智械像是被加了降智buff，对他言听计从。

“失败的圣灵计划，失控的菌丝病，失去的永恒之城；还有重伤后融入了基地的沙利叶、死亡的相晨曦复制体。”

“基地的主人叫相南里？……好遥远的记忆。”

加百列抿了一口燕麦奶，抬头望着天花板：“脑子好乱，下次再想。”

大不了把他们都杀了。

以黄枫装配的武力，当然不可能在不惊动任何人的情况下劫持他。

甚至在黄枫第一次鬼鬼祟祟进入教堂时，加百列就发现了它。

加百列推波助澜，默许了一切的发生。

加百列需要这弥足珍贵的片刻自由。

他不想呆在神龛里，虽然他清楚，自己迟早要回去的。就像是人迟早会死。

好像也不能这么说。人联那边不是有个一直不肯死的老怪物吗？

加百列突然讽刺地笑了一下。

……“喀嚓”。

螺丝钉1号站在操作台前，又一次捏碎了玻璃瓶。

北辰抬起头，有些疑惑地看着它：“1号，怎么了？这是今天第三个了。”

“参数似乎有点问题。我调整一下。”

1号用毫无起伏的电子音回答道。实在不好意思回答是自己刚才莫名觉得鼻子很痒。

但这具身体他爹的没有呼吸系统。

事情还要从今天上午来上班的时候说起。

1号像往常一样，早早充好电，第一个来上班，照看实验室里的菌子们。

然后，他发现了令自己目眦欲裂的场景。

东方青帝。

抱着。

相南里。

在靠墙的沙发上。

睡觉。

重点是，相南里没有排斥，也没有醒。亲昵又自然地像是两人一起睡过。

螺丝钉1号差点因为承受不住洛阳灵魂上的暴躁直接炸掉。

他想和Alpha打一架，打到螺丝钉都从裂开的铁皮脑袋上飞出去。打到内心巨大的挫败、嫉妒被身体上的疼痛狠狠碾压。

可惜洛阳打不过Alpha。反正，这具身体是打不过的。

暴露他的存在，只会影响后续的计划。

所以，洛阳忍了。

但那瞬间的高温还是影响了他的微操系统，这才导致上午实验的频频失误。

北辰问：“小1啊，你是不是出故障了，要不我带你去相南里那儿修一下？”

1号沉默了两秒：“那么，麻烦您了。博士。”
chunks.englishText:
Gabriel crouched on the chair, unskillfully scooping up the milk oatmeal in the bowl with a spoon: "If you're in a hurry, I can write a letter to the Pope."

After saying this, he seemed to feel his feet were cold and rubbed the tops of his feet against each other. The iron shackles on his ankles clanked.

This iron shackle wasn't put on by Huang Feng.

The moment it opened the coffin, Gabriel was already wearing it.

"The letter has to be vetted by me. And it must be written with paper and pen, no electronic documents!"

Huang Feng was worried about encrypted content it couldn't detect.

Gabriel replied with an innocent look: "Okay."

He watched the intelligent machine leave, holding the oatmeal bowl to warm his hands, his gaze shifting from clear to deep, even somewhat gloomy.

"Survivor base, Donghuang Heavy Industry, Huang Feng; the batch is a 'Young Bee' series machine produced after the Machine Crisis. Although it's an intelligent machine, it shows a clear reaction to the Divine Court's mind-control arts..."

Gabriel had been hypnotizing Huang Feng the whole time, and the effect was significant.

This machine acted as if it had been hit with a "debuff to intelligence," obeying his every word.

"The failed Saint Spirit Project, the out-of-control mycelium disease, the lost Eternal City; and Sariel, who joined the base after being severely injured, and the dead Xiang Chenxi clone."

"The master of the base is called Xiang Nanli? ...What a distant memory."

Gabriel sipped the oatmeal milk and looked up at the ceiling: "My brain is so messy, I'll think about it next time."

At worst, he would just kill them all.

With the combat power Huang Feng was equipped with, it was, of course, impossible to kidnap him without alerting anyone.

In fact, the first time Huang Feng snuck into the cathedral, Gabriel had already discovered it.

Gabriel had pushed things along, tacitly allowing everything to happen.

Gabriel needed these precious moments of freedom.

He didn't want to stay in the shrine, although he knew he would eventually have to go back. Just as people would eventually die.

It seemed that couldn't be said either. Wasn't there an old monster on the Human Alliance side who refused to die?

Gabriel suddenly gave a sarcastic laugh.

... "Click."

Screw No. 1 stood in front of the operating table and crushed a glass bottle once again.

Beichen looked up, looking at it with some confusion: "No. 1, what's wrong? This is the third one today."

"The parameters seem to be a bit off. I'll adjust them."

No. 1 replied in a flat, emotionless electronic voice. It was truly embarrassed to admit that it had inexplicably felt its nose itching just now.

But this body, damn it, had no respiratory system.

The matter started when he came to work this morning.

No. 1, as usual, had charged up early and was the first to arrive at work to look after the fungi in the laboratory.

Then, he discovered a scene that made his eyes split with rage.

Eastern Azure Emperor.

Holding.

Xiang Nanli.

On the sofa against the wall.

Sleeping.

The point was, Xiang Nanli wasn't resisting, nor was he waking up. They looked as intimate and natural as if they had slept together many times.

Screw No. 1 almost exploded because he couldn't bear the violent rage in Luo Yang's soul.

He wanted to fight Alpha, fight until the screws flew out of his cracked iron-plated head. Fight until the immense frustration and jealousy in his heart were ruthlessly crushed by the pain in his body.

Unfortunately, Luo Yang couldn't beat Alpha. Anyway, this body couldn't beat him.

Exposing his existence would only affect the subsequent plan.

So, Luo Yang endured it.

But the high temperature at that moment still affected his micro-manipulation system, which led to the frequent mistakes in the morning's experiments.

Beichen asked: "Little 1, are you malfunctioning? Why don't I take you to Xiang Nanli to get you fixed?"

No. 1 was silent for two seconds: "Then, I will trouble you, Doctor."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第111章 螺丝钉1号的维修 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第111章 螺丝钉1号的维修

整间工作室都很乱，除了他面前的电子工作台。仓库似的房间里光线也不太强，这是因为很多电子零件是光敏性的。

“总之，事情就是这样。”北辰垫着脚，避免自己踩到电线，指了指身后站得笔直的机器人，“修理的事情就拜托了。这是研究所比较重要的生产资料，其他智械人没这么聪明。”

相南里百忙之中抬起头，扫了北辰带来的智械一眼：“放这吧。”

北辰带来的机器人自然是螺丝钉1号。

1号净身高一米八，整体呈人形，覆盖着一层银色的金属。体型相对于人类来说显得过于瘦削，可金属的身体和清晰的机械结构，让这具躯体有一种别样的工业美感。

呵呵，相南里从黑市买回来的时候，螺丝钉1号和2号其实都是灰扑扑的。身上很多磨损后的划痕。还有因机械力而凹陷、破损的地方。

是洛阳趁着充电的时候，偷偷给自己做了填充！抛了光！

他绝对是目前基地里（以相南里审美看）最好看的人型智械！

可惜相南里目前的注意力全在眼前的资料上，根本没心思看1号一眼。

他时而蹙眉，时而用笔在纸上写写画画，显然陷入了僵局中。

洛阳环顾了工作室一周。不由得有些不满。

八十平的地方，还是太小了。房间里没有开地暖，只有重要零件才放在恒温箱内。

条件堪称艰苦。

之前，相南里任职的研究中心，是永生科技全权负责打造的。更具体一点，研究中心绿化带的植物都是洛阳亲自挑的！

中心占地两千万平方英尺，不仅装配了最先进的设备，还有最专业的服务团队。

这些从世界各地挖来的高级餐厅厨师、健身教练、医生、理疗师、管家、家政能从生活的各个角度，把在中心内任职的宝贵大脑们照顾得骨软筋酥。

中心的造价和维护成本都极其高昂，让当时的洛阳在面对财政报表时会感觉到一些压力。

但他依然认为，一切都是值得的。

尤其是这些开销，对比相南里短暂生命中所创造出的价值，简直不值一提。

洛阳低头，看着脚边的废料。

他思考片刻，低头，开始整理脚边的金属垃圾。

[警告！警告。]脑海里的小智突然发出提醒，[北辰带来的智械正在接触你的实验器械。是否启动应急预案？]

声音刚落，墙角的高温激光安保装置已经自动亮起，对准了螺丝钉1号。

这是工作室内最高级别的热武器防御装置！

“啊？”相南里摘下电子镜片，转头，朝螺丝钉说，“1号？不用收拾。”

相南里仗着自己记性好，很少收拾东西。

对于普通人来说，收纳整理是为了提升工作效率，对于他来说，是浪费时间。

这件事，洛阳非常清楚。相南里能清楚地记得几年前随手放置的芯片位置，却记不住每天见面的人的名字。

这个人真奇怪。无机物记得这么清楚，对周围活人的记忆却总是很淡。

洛阳英文名是Eric，但是一直到毕业前，相南里偶尔还是会喊他Enoch。

Enoch是相南里邻居家的狗的名字。

螺丝钉1号回答：“请放心。我有分寸。北辰的实验室也是我整理的。”

是吗？可是北辰的实验室很乱诶。

螺丝钉1号动作没有停，相南里观察了一会，发现对方并没有改变核心区域物品的摆放，只是清扫灰尘、机油，处理废料，还会帮忙完成一些简单的机械装置拼接工作，这才放下心来。

等相南里结束工作，转头，看见的就是貌似没有变化，却焕然一新的工作室。

起码空气里若有若无的化学品气味淡了很多。

相南里看了眼时间，离晚饭还有一个半小时，修理一台智械人绰绰有余。

他打开角落里维修台的照射灯，往手术台似的金属平台上一拍：“北辰说，你是神经传感系统故障？坐这吧。”

螺丝钉1号没有说话，只是十分顺从地坐下。它走路时有轻微的机械音。

相南里下意识地抬眼，往1号脸的位置看去：“你的控制中枢在哪？”

他看见的只是一个金属的椭圆，下颌角位置模拟人类面部折叠的方向，呈现出一点倾斜的楔面。

电子音回答着：“在腹腔位置。”

相南里掏出维修工具，手指在螺丝钉1号的腹部摩擦着：“好，那我要先打开你的腹腔。”

螺丝钉1号胸前的指示光带闪了闪。

相南里用指尖摩擦着漆面，寻找着这台机器人控制中心的开口处，但手指传回来的奇特质感，引起他的深思。

“咦。”相南里摸了摸，又掏出小刀刮下一点，“这层银色的漆好像是永生科技的保密技术……型号RN-7的活性金属？”

“加百列”的存在极大程度的增加了相南里的危机感。

因此，在短暂权衡后，相南里通过了北辰的“超级母体”计划。

但相南里查阅无数资料，发现想要妥善保存并控制菌丝母体，“RN-7活性金属”是其中的关键材料。

这种材料曾用于永生科技部分实验机器人的身上（实验目的是智械的拟人化），作为躯体表面的涂料。

涂料的作用是让机器人拥有更仿真的触觉，无限接近于人的实感，只是极大程度地调低了痛觉。过去，智械伦理学家曾经试图以这样的方式，赋予智械“人权”。

但因为实用性太低，RN-7活性金属和永生科技拥有的无数“专利”一样，直接停产。自己不用，也不给别人用。

相南里看重的是这种金属的神经传导性以及极强的隔离效果。

就在刚刚，相南里还在为怎么获得这种金属而苦恼。甚至思考要不要厚着脸皮联系一下洛修。老是麻烦同一个人当然不太好，可是谁让他不认识其他姓洛的。

相南里的眼眸里骤然迸发出狂喜。

他眼神亮晶晶地望向螺丝钉1号：“1号，可以给你换个涂层吗？”

洛阳：“……嗯？”

但看着相南里期待的眼神，他实在没能说出拒绝的话：“可以。”

于是，相南里掏出刮刀，开始刮螺丝钉1号身体上的金属漆面。

“1号，你虽然是报废的机器人，但是当年肯定是很重要的实验体。这种漆面原料需要一点太空精金，还蛮贵的。”

相南里小心地把刮下来的活性金属收集到注满润滑液的容器内，生怕浪费一点。

洛阳：“……嗯。”

好吧，这个换涂层和洛阳想的有些不太一样。

他还以为相南里是想给他换个色。没想到是图螺丝钉1号身体表面的材料。

这件事放在人身上，相当于拿着金属刀刮蹭皮肤，又把磨得血肉模糊的皮肤组织收集起来。

但好在，这具身体对痛觉极其迟钝。

洛阳只觉得有些痒。

他突然意识到，相南里在抚摸他的身体。

温柔的、细致的、亲昵的，像是在对待最心爱的人。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 111: The Repair of Screw No. 1

The entire studio was in disarray, save for the electronic workbench in front of him. The warehouse-like room was dimly lit, a necessity since many electronic components were photosensitive.

"In short, that’s how it is." Bei Chen stood on tiptoe, avoiding the tangled wires, and pointed to the robot standing ramrod straight behind him. "I’ll have to leave the repairs to you. This is a vital piece of production equipment for the research institute; the other androids aren't nearly as intelligent."

Amidst his busy schedule, Xiang Nanli looked up and gave the android brought by Bei Chen a cursory glance. "Leave it there."

The robot Bei Chen had brought was, naturally, Screw No. 1.

No. 1 stood at a height of 1.8 meters, humanoid in form and covered in a layer of silver metal. Its frame was perhaps too slender by human standards, but the metallic body and clear mechanical structure gave it a unique industrial aesthetic.

Heh, when Xiang Nanli had first bought Screw No. 1 and No. 2 from the black market, they had both been dull and gray, covered in scratches from wear and tear, with dents and damage caused by mechanical stress.

It was Luo Yang who, during charging sessions, had secretly performed body filler work and polishing on himself!

In Xiang Nanli’s aesthetic judgment, he was absolutely the best-looking humanoid android in the base!

Unfortunately, Xiang Nanli’s attention was currently entirely focused on the data before him; he had no interest in sparing a second glance at No. 1.

He frowned from time to time, scribbling on paper with his pen, clearly stuck in a deadlock.

Luo Yang scanned the studio. He couldn't help but feel a bit dissatisfied.

Eighty square meters was simply too small. There was no floor heating in the room, and only the most critical components were kept in temperature-controlled boxes.

The conditions could only be described as arduous.

Previously, the research center where Xiang Nanli worked had been fully managed by Eternal Technology. To be more specific, even the plants in the center’s green belts had been personally selected by Luo Yang!

The center spanned twenty million square feet and was not only equipped with the most advanced gear but also supported by the most professional service teams.

The high-end restaurant chefs, fitness coaches, doctors, physical therapists, butlers, and housekeepers recruited from all over the world could pamper the precious brains working within the center from every conceivable angle, leaving them utterly relaxed and pampered.

The construction and maintenance costs of that center were astronomical, which had caused Luo Yang some stress when looking at financial statements back then.

Yet, he had always believed that everything was worth it.

Especially since those expenses were negligible compared to the value Xiang Nanli created during his short life.

Luo Yang lowered his head, looking at the scrap metal at his feet.

He pondered for a moment, then bent down to start organizing the metallic waste.

[Warning! Warning.] The AI "Xiao Zhi" in his mind suddenly issued an alert. [The android brought by Bei Chen is touching your experimental equipment. Shall I initiate emergency protocols?]

The voice had barely faded when the high-temperature laser security device in the corner automatically activated, aiming directly at Screw No. 1.

This was the studio’s highest-level thermal weapon defense system!

"Huh?" Xiang Nanli took off his electronic spectacles, turned his head, and said to the robot, "No. 1? No need to clean up."

Relying on his excellent memory, Xiang Nanli rarely tidied things up.

For ordinary people, organization was a way to improve efficiency; for him, it was a waste of time.

Luo Yang knew this very well. Xiang Nanli could clearly remember the location of a chip he had casually placed years ago, yet he couldn't remember the names of people he met every day.

This person was truly strange. He remembered inorganic matter so clearly, yet his memory of the living people around him was always so faint.

Luo Yang’s English name was Eric, but until graduation, Xiang Nanli would occasionally still call him Enoch.

Enoch was the name of the dog belonging to Xiang Nanli’s neighbor.

Screw No. 1 replied, "Please rest assured. I know my limits. I also organized Bei Chen’s laboratory."

Is that so? But Bei Chen’s laboratory is a mess.

Screw No. 1 did not stop its movements. Xiang Nanli observed for a while and found that the robot wasn't rearranging items in the core area; it was merely cleaning up dust and machine oil, disposing of waste, and helping with some simple mechanical assembly work. Only then did he set his mind at ease.

When Xiang Nanli finished his work and turned around, he saw a studio that looked seemingly unchanged, yet felt brand new.

At the very least, the faint, lingering smell of chemicals in the air had dissipated significantly.

Xiang Nanli checked the time; there was an hour and a half until dinner, more than enough time to repair an android.

He turned on the lamp at the repair station in the corner and patted the surgical-table-like metal platform. "Bei Chen said your neural sensor system is malfunctioning? Sit here."

Screw No. 1 didn't speak, simply sitting down with absolute obedience. There was a faint mechanical whirring as it moved.

Xiang Nanli instinctively looked up toward the robot's face. "Where is your control center?"

All he saw was a metallic oval, with the jawline angled into a slight wedge, simulating the folding direction of a human face.

The electronic voice replied, "In the abdominal cavity."

Xiang Nanli pulled out his repair tools, his fingers rubbing against Screw No. 1’s abdomen. "Alright, then I’ll need to open your abdominal cavity first."

The indicator light on Screw No. 1’s chest flickered.

Xiang Nanli rubbed his fingertips against the paint, searching for the opening to the robot's control center, but the peculiar texture transmitted back to his fingers gave him pause.

"Huh." Xiang Nanli felt it, then pulled out a small blade to scrape off a tiny bit. "This layer of silver paint... it looks like Eternal Technology’s classified technology... Model RN-7 active metal?"

The existence of "Gabriel" had greatly increased Xiang Nanli’s sense of crisis.

Therefore, after a brief deliberation, Xiang Nanli had approved Bei Chen’s "Super Matrix" project.

However, after consulting countless documents, Xiang Nanli discovered that "RN-7 active metal" was a key material required to properly preserve and control the mycelium matrix.

This material had once been used on certain experimental robots by Eternal Technology (with the goal of android anthropomorphism) as a coating for the body’s surface.

The purpose of the coating was to give robots more realistic tactile sensations, infinitely close to human reality, though it had significantly dampened pain receptors. In the past, android ethicists had attempted to use this method to grant androids "human rights."

But due to low practicality, RN-7 active metal, like countless other "patents" held by Eternal Technology, was discontinued. They wouldn't use it themselves, nor would they let others use it.

What Xiang Nanli valued was the material’s neural conductivity and its extreme isolation properties.

Just moments ago, Xiang Nanli had been agonizing over how to obtain this metal. He had even considered whether to swallow his pride and contact Luo Xiu. It was never good to keep bothering the same person, but who else did he know with the surname Luo?

Ecstasy suddenly erupted in Xiang Nanli’s eyes.

He looked at Screw No. 1 with sparkling eyes. "No. 1, can I change your coating?"

Luo Yang: "...Hmm?"

But looking at Xiang Nanli’s expectant gaze, he truly couldn't bring himself to refuse. "Yes."

And so, Xiang Nanli pulled out a scraper and began to scrape the metallic paint off Screw No. 1’s body.

"No. 1, even though you’re a scrapped robot, you must have been a very important experimental subject back in the day. This paint raw material requires a bit of space-grade refined gold; it’s quite expensive."

Xiang Nanli carefully collected the scraped-off active metal into a container filled with lubricant, terrified of wasting even a speck.

Luo Yang: "...Hmm."

Well, this "changing the coating" was a bit different from what Luo Yang had imagined.

He had thought Xiang Nanli wanted to change his color. He hadn't expected him to be after the material on Screw No. 1’s body surface.

If this were done to a human, it would be equivalent to using a metal knife to scrape the skin, then collecting the bloodied, mangled skin tissue.

But fortunately, this body was extremely dull to pain.

Luo Yang only felt a bit itchy.

He suddenly realized that Xiang Nanli was stroking his body.

Gently, meticulously, intimately—as if he were treating his most beloved person.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第111章 螺丝钉1号的维修 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
（因为涂层很薄，活性金属的提纯又很麻烦。只能从源头控制杂质含量。）

手指摸过他的脸侧，脖子，胸，腰。身体的每一寸。

意识到这一点，洛阳骤然颤抖起来。金属的身体表面因为大脑过载呈现出一阵高温。

这纯粹是大脑过度兴奋带来的生理反应。

相南里察觉了它的变化，轻声询问：“不舒服吗？需要我暂停一会吗？”

根据资料，拥有这种涂层的机器人会有和人类相近的触感系统。

洛阳的胳膊撑在维修台上，十分冷静地开口：“没关系，请继续。”

“可是你在发抖？”

尤其是碰到腹部的时候，可能这里离传感系统近吧。腰颤得厉害。

相比之下，小智显得很不冷静：[这台机器人要不先关机吧。]

相南里觉得小智说得蛮有道理的，关机还能防漏电呢。

于是，他直起腰，在螺丝钉1号的后脑勺一拍。

1号胸口的指示灯瞬间熄灭。

切断意识的洛阳回到了永生科技的虚拟空间。

他能感觉到自己血液上涌，脸侧通红。这种轻微的失控感令洛阳非常不满。

但是能控制的心动又算什么心动？

听说人终会被其年少不可得之物困扰一生，在无数个辗转反侧的梦境里，他总能在不同的故事里见到同一个相南里。

像梦魇，像诅咒。相南里死后，这个诅咒成为了一道美丽的伤疤，永远横贯在他的胸口。

“老师……老师。”洛阳喃喃着。

他揪住了自己胸口的衣襟，试图让过于强烈的痛觉平复。

电子生命是没有生理上的眼泪的。

……

……

东方青帝过来送饭时，看见的就是相南里正坐在一台丑机器人的跟前，戴着防毒面罩，手里拿着瓶金属喷漆。

螺丝钉1号银色表层刮掉后是黄铜色的。

东方青帝把保温盒饭放在了桌子上，开口：“过来吃饭。”

今天的晚饭是东方青帝亲手做的。

红酒炖牛肉配上焦糖烤苹果，主食是基地菜园子种的稻米。

车上没有调料和灶。一路上都没什么机会给相南里做饭。

吃得不好，相南里的肌肉重量都掉了百分之二！

相南里：“马上，我把这个漆喷完。”

东方青帝沉思片刻，选择一键读取小智的数据。

大约2秒后，东方青帝：“喷什么，防水层干还要好几天。直接跟它说黄铜色就是你换的新漆就行。”

这个提议性价比很高，相南里可耻的心动了。但是残存的道德感让他拒绝道：“这样敷衍1号不太好吧？”

“它的拟人模块是1.0版本。”

1.0版本，人联早期智械通用拟人模块。

特点是拥有人类的思维方式，但没什么情绪，主打一个服从。在智械军团内部，会被高级版本的智械被嘲笑为奴隶模块。

于是，相南里从善如流地丢下了手里的喷漆：“那听你的，小青~”
chunks.englishText:
(Because the coating was very thin, and the purification of active metal was quite troublesome. One could only control impurity content from the source.)

Fingers traced his face, neck, chest, and waist. Every inch of his body.

Realizing this, Luo Yang suddenly began to tremble. The surface of his metallic body reached a high temperature due to brain overload.

This was a purely physiological reaction brought on by excessive cerebral excitement.

Xiang Nanli noticed the change and asked softly, "Are you uncomfortable? Do you need me to pause for a moment?"

According to the data, robots with this coating would have tactile systems similar to humans.

Luo Yang rested his arms on the repair table and spoke very calmly, "It’s fine, please continue."

"But you’re shaking?"

Especially when he touched the abdomen—perhaps because it was close to the sensor system. The waist was trembling violently.

In contrast, Xiao Zhi seemed very uncalm: [Shouldn't we just shut this robot down first?]

Xiang Nanli felt that Xiao Zhi made a fair point; shutting it down could also prevent electrical leakage.

And so, he straightened his back and patted the back of Screw No. 1’s head.

The indicator light on No. 1’s chest instantly extinguished.

Luo Yang, having his consciousness severed, returned to the virtual space of Eternal Technology.

He could feel his blood rushing and his cheeks burning red. This slight sense of loss of control made Luo Yang very dissatisfied.

But what kind of heartbeat is it if it can be controlled?

It is said that people are haunted for a lifetime by what they could not obtain in their youth. In countless tossing and turning dreams, he always saw the same Xiang Nanli in different stories.

Like a nightmare, like a curse. After Xiang Nanli died, this curse became a beautiful scar, forever etched across his chest.

"Teacher... Teacher," Luo Yang murmured.

He clutched the collar of his shirt, trying to soothe the overly intense pain.

Electronic lifeforms do not have physiological tears.

...

...

When Dongfang Qingdi came to deliver dinner, he saw Xiang Nanli sitting in front of an ugly robot, wearing a gas mask and holding a bottle of metallic spray paint.

After the silver layer of Screw No. 1 was scraped off, it was brass-colored underneath.

Dongfang Qingdi placed the insulated food container on the table and said, "Come eat."

Today’s dinner was personally prepared by Dongfang Qingdi.

Red wine-braised beef paired with caramelized roasted apples, with rice grown in the base’s garden as the staple.

There were no seasonings or stoves on the road. Throughout the journey, there had been little opportunity to cook for Xiang Nanli.

Eating poorly had caused Xiang Nanli to lose two percent of his muscle mass!

Xiang Nanli: "Right away, let me finish spraying this paint."

Dongfang Qingdi pondered for a moment and chose to read Xiao Zhi’s data with one click.

About two seconds later, Dongfang Qingdi said, "Why spray it? It’ll take days for the waterproof layer to dry. Just tell it the brass color is the new paint you chose for it."

This suggestion was highly cost-effective, and Xiang Nanli was shamefully tempted. But his remaining sense of morality made him refuse: "Wouldn't it be a bit perfunctory to treat No. 1 like that?"

"Its anthropomorphic module is version 1.0."

Version 1.0, the universal anthropomorphic module for early Human Alliance androids.

Its characteristic was that it possessed human-like thinking patterns but lacked emotions, focusing entirely on obedience. Within the Android Legion, it would be mocked by higher-version androids as a "slave module."

And so, Xiang Nanli followed the advice and dropped the spray paint in his hand: "Then I’ll listen to you, Xiao Qing~"

chunks.chineseText:
第112章 眼前与远方

电子生命会有梦境吗？

相南里停下，回头，看向他。

两人中间隔着一扇玻璃门，看起来是打开的。

但洛阳清楚，他永远不能通过这扇门，走进相南里。

相南里的心是一片深海，往里面注入再多的水，也掀不起骇浪。而他偏要自不量力。

他追逐着。

他期待着。

他痛苦着。

都说爱会制造分离，而虐待产生忠诚。

如果相南里是无冕的帝王，他应该是王座下第一个生死相随的扈从。

相南里的脸上出现了短暂的苦恼，大概是觉得这句话会伤害到他唯一的学生：“BUG已经修复了，以后的测试我来就好。我给你换个实验室。”

言下之意，这里不需要洛阳，别动他的模型。

可有些话又不能不讲。相南里在乎自己的研究，胜过自己的生命。

洛阳感觉到了自己灵魂上的颤栗。

他张开口，想保持一份体面，可喉咙干涩地说不出话，最后只是吐出了两个字：“老师……”

他想说自己已经很努力了，他没有一刻松懈。每一个相关领域的新成就他都有了解，他每天全部的时间都花在了学习上。这当然很痛苦，但洛阳知道，一种更大的欲望支撑着他。

他想要被相南里认可。

相南里：“你很勤奋。”

但太平庸。努力只是让你比普通的天才好一点。而相南里需要的是耀眼到足够和自己同行的人。

他是没用的东西。

没用的东西会被抛弃。

恐惧感充斥着洛阳的脑海，他僵硬地说不出一句话。

“要不这样，”相南里灵光一闪，“你去运营永生科技吧！那些毛遂自荐的职业经理人我都不放心。”

随后，相南里大概是觉得这个安排很是不错，脸上露出了满意的笑容。

他转身，瘦削苍白的手里握着一杯巧克力拿铁，大步流星地朝着属于自己的实验室走去。

……

……

洛阳从这样的梦境里苏醒。

这具身体没有“眼睛”，但装配了成像系统。洛阳看见了相南里的脸，就在他的眼前。

碧绿的眼睛，脸上是和很多年前一样的笑容：“开机了。你的芯片并没有老化问题，是内部高温导致的电阻熔断。”

洛阳想，很可惜换了漆，这具身体失去了嗅觉，要不然凑这么近，他也许能闻到相南里身上淡淡的香味。

“对了，我还给你换了人联今年最流行的复古黄铜色。”说到这的时候，相南里难免有些心虚，于是很快补充道，“修理费用已经从你工资里扣除了。没什么事的话，回去上班吧，北辰的实验室也挺忙的。”

……要不是洛阳也是从人联那边过来的，他就信了。

他可疑地沉默了三秒：“谢谢。”

洛阳假装自己只是个普通机器人，十分坦荡地往东方青帝的方向扫去。

然后果不其然地感觉撞上了一堵墙。对方拒绝他的窥探，他也没有能力打破那层屏障。

洛阳并不担心自己的小动作会被注意到，毕竟他只是做出了所有普通智械都会做的事。

灵魂数据化是永生科技的最高机密，这项技术完全可以带来第五次科技革命，可惜全世界的知情者也不超过十人。

呵呵，Alpha又怎么样。他能看出这台机器里装着什么人的灵魂吗？

洛阳起身，一步步朝着门外走去。他关上门，黄铜色的皮肤锈迹斑斑。雪落在了他冰凉的手臂上。

相南里的声音隐约从门后传来：“小青。下次炖牛肉能不能用米酒，我不喜欢单宁的酸味。对了，来帮我看看这份设计图有没有问题……”再天赋异禀也是需要学习的，他还没有彻底掌握这个世界的新技术。

东方青帝：“知道了。”

洛阳又在门口停顿了两秒，然后朝着门外走去。

若是有眼眸，他的目光应该是渐渐冷却的。卸下回忆里的温情，他的心冷硬地像是冻土层不化的坚冰。

身为人联的领袖，洛阳很少意气用事。

“算算时间，也快上岸了。”

相南里和Alpha，以及他们建立的基地。洛阳能敏锐的察觉到，这是地表的不稳定因素。这个因素或许会在未来的某天，伤到人联的根基。

他感觉到了会让自己恐惧的东西……像是过去的资本家们惧怕着红色的幽灵。

哪怕基地现在弱小到像是脆纸，他也要用一把火，把危险扼杀在摇篮里。

Alpha必须死。

而相南里……

智械人没有五官，但洛阳必然是很温柔地笑着：“跟我回家吧，老师。”

你我都会永生，我愿和你平分我的荣耀。

*

九章驾驶着圆形的飞行器，行驶在队伍的最前方；和同伴们的飞行器呈现出大雁南飞似的“V”形阵。

它们大概在距离地表120m的高空。这个距离既能清楚看见地面情况，又能避开绝大部分风景和复杂路况。

深海里的智械部队驻扎了300年不上岸。如今有机会出门，很多智械都表现出了超乎正常水平的兴奋。

这次出门的智械人一共七台。

九章坐在飞行器内，它选择是一具男性的躯体。整具身体高挑而健壮，肌肉又不会过分夸张。黑色的头发梳成一个背头。穿着西装，系着金色的领带，配尖头皮鞋，很是商务风。

这是九章提取的信息中（主要是各种网络小说和漫画），一个较为接近“总裁”的人类形象。

嗯，他们都是智械军团驻地部队后勤系统的。

这次出门的目的，是为了给军团订购一款果味汽油饮料。

九章在这段时间拷贝了一份人联法律到自己的系统，并且制定好了最标准、精确的合同。只需要等相南里签字。

当然，他们不可能暴露驻地所在位置。也不会暴露自己的身份，因此，九章借用的是某个人联皮套金融公司的名头。而他的公民ID上的名字叫“秦九章”。

和远离地表的黄枫、觅风不一样。深海驻军需要对人联进行渗透，它们有的是钱和手段。

深海一共9支驻军，分布在人马星的不同海域。九章所在的这一支由Beta直属管辖，Alpha算是越级领导。

九章听着同伴们脑电波的叽叽喳喳：“哇~这就是地表啊~我还是第一次出门呢。”

这台智械从出厂起就在海底，一直都在上班，没休息过。

“根据扫描，刚刚飞去过的鸟类叫做‘雷龙鸟’，是光荣觉醒后出现的异种。身体的一部分和机械装置融合，能释放高压电流。会攻击移动物体，从生物进化的角度，这不可能是自然形成的东西。它们会不会和神庭在地表的生物智械实验有关？”

（注：人联将人类和智械的战争称为“智械危机”，智械方称之为“光荣觉醒”。）

“好喜欢公款旅游噢~你看~这是我刚刚从地上收集的苔藓~我要带回深海，送给艾丽~”

“地表的污染程度比我想象中轻一些。我还以为会寸草不生呢？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 112: The Present and the Distance

Do electronic lifeforms have dreams?

Xiang Nanli paused and looked back at him.

A glass door stood between the two of them, appearing to be open.

But Luo Yang knew that he could never pass through this door to walk into Xiang Nanli’s life.

Xiang Nanli’s heart was a deep ocean; no matter how much water one poured into it, it would never stir up a storm. And yet, he was foolish enough to try.

He chased.

He hoped.

He suffered.

They say love creates separation, and abuse breeds loyalty.

If Xiang Nanli were an uncrowned emperor, he should be the first attendant beneath the throne to follow him through life and death.

A brief look of distress appeared on Xiang Nanli’s face, likely because he felt this statement might hurt his only student: "The bug has been fixed. I’ll handle future tests myself. I’ll get you a different laboratory."

The implication was clear: Luo Yang was not needed here; stay away from his models.

Yet some things had to be said. Xiang Nanli cared more about his research than his own life.

Luo Yang felt a tremor in his soul.

He opened his mouth, wanting to maintain a shred of dignity, but his throat was too dry to speak. Finally, he only managed to utter two words: "Teacher..."

He wanted to say that he had already tried his best; he hadn't slacked off for a single moment. He had kept up with every new achievement in relevant fields, and he spent all his time every day studying. This was certainly painful, but Luo Yang knew that a greater desire sustained him.

He wanted to be recognized by Xiang Nanli.

Xiang Nanli: "You are very diligent."

But mediocre. Diligence only makes you slightly better than an average genius. And what Xiang Nanli needed was someone dazzling enough to walk alongside him.

He was a useless thing.

Useless things would be discarded.

Fear flooded Luo Yang’s mind, and he stood stiffly, unable to say another word.

"How about this," Xiang Nanli had a flash of inspiration, "you go manage Eternal Technology! I don't trust any of those professional managers who keep recommending themselves."

Then, perhaps feeling that this arrangement was quite good, a satisfied smile appeared on his face.

He turned around, holding a chocolate latte in his thin, pale hand, and strode toward his own laboratory.

...

...

Luo Yang awoke from such a dream.

This body had no "eyes," but it was equipped with an imaging system. Luo Yang saw Xiang Nanli’s face, right before his eyes.

Emerald green eyes, and on his face was the same smile from many years ago: "Rebooted. Your chip didn't have aging issues; it was a fuse blowout caused by internal high temperatures."

Luo Yang thought, it’s a pity that after the paint change, this body lost its sense of smell; otherwise, being this close, he might have been able to smell the faint fragrance on Xiang Nanli.

"By the way, I also gave you the retro brass color that’s most popular in the Human Alliance this year." When he said this, Xiang Nanli couldn't help but feel a bit guilty, so he quickly added, "The repair costs have already been deducted from your salary. If there’s nothing else, go back to work; Bei Chen’s lab is quite busy too."

...If Luo Yang hadn't also come from the Human Alliance, he might have actually believed that.

He was suspiciously silent for three seconds: "Thank you."

Luo Yang pretended to be an ordinary robot and swept his gaze toward Dongfang Qingdi with complete openness.

Then, as expected, he felt like he had hit a wall. The other party refused his probing, and he had no ability to break through that barrier.

Luo Yang wasn't worried that his small actions would be noticed; after all, he was only doing what all ordinary androids would do.

Soul digitization was the highest secret of Eternal Technology. This technology could completely trigger the Fifth Technological Revolution, but unfortunately, there were fewer than ten people in the world who knew about it.

Heh, so what if he’s an Alpha? Can he see what kind of soul is housed inside this machine?

Luo Yang stood up and walked toward the door step by step. He closed the door, his brass-colored skin covered in rust. Snow fell onto his cold arms.

Xiang Nanli’s voice drifted vaguely from behind the door: "Xiao Qing. Next time you braise the beef, can you use rice wine? I don't like the acidity of tannins. By the way, come help me see if there’s a problem with this design blueprint..." Even with innate talent, one still needs to learn; he hadn't fully mastered the new technologies of this world yet.

Dongfang Qingdi: "Understood."

Luo Yang paused at the door for two seconds, then walked away.

If he had eyes, his gaze would have been gradually cooling. Shedding the warmth of his memories, his heart became as cold and hard as the unmelting permafrost.

As the leader of the Human Alliance, Luo Yang rarely acted on impulse.

"Calculating the time, they should be coming ashore soon."

Xiang Nanli, the Alpha, and the base they had built. Luo Yang could keenly sense that this was an unstable factor on the surface. This factor might one day injure the foundations of the Human Alliance.

He felt something that would make him afraid... much like the capitalists of the past feared the red specter.

Even if the base was now as weak as brittle paper, he would use fire to strangle the danger in its cradle.

The Alpha must die.

And as for Xiang Nanli...

The android had no facial features, but Luo Yang was surely smiling very gently: "Come home with me, Teacher."

Both you and I will live forever; I am willing to share my glory with you.

*

Jiu Zhang piloted the circular aircraft, traveling at the forefront of the formation; the aircraft of its companions formed a "V" shape, like wild geese flying south.

They were at an altitude of about 120 meters above the surface. This distance allowed them to clearly see the situation on the ground while avoiding most of the scenery and complex traffic conditions.

The android troops in the deep sea had been stationed there for 300 years without coming ashore. Now that they had the chance to go out, many androids showed excitement beyond normal levels.

There were seven androids on this outing.

Jiu Zhang sat inside the aircraft, having chosen a male body. The entire frame was tall and robust, with muscles that weren't overly exaggerated. Its black hair was combed back. It wore a suit, a golden tie, and pointed leather shoes—a very business-like style.

This was a human image close to a "CEO," extracted from the information Jiu Zhang had (mainly various web novels and comics).

Mm, they were all from the logistics system of the Android Legion’s garrison.

The purpose of this trip was to order a fruit-flavored gasoline beverage for the Legion.

During this time, Jiu Zhang had copied a version of the Human Alliance’s laws into its system and had drafted the most standard, precise contract. It only needed Xiang Nanli’s signature.

Of course, they couldn't reveal the location of their garrison. Nor would they reveal their true identities; therefore, Jiu Zhang was using the name of a Human Alliance shell financial company. And the name on his citizen ID was "Qin Jiuzhang."

Unlike Huang Feng and Mi Feng, who were far from the surface, the deep-sea garrison needed to infiltrate the Human Alliance, and they had plenty of money and means.

There were nine deep-sea garrisons in total, distributed across different seas of the Horse Star. The unit Jiu Zhang belonged to was directly under the jurisdiction of the Beta, with the Alpha considered a superior-level leader.

Jiu Zhang listened to the chattering of its companions' brainwaves: "Wow~ so this is the surface~ It’s my first time out."

This android had been working in the deep sea since it left the factory, never once taking a break.

"According to the scan, the bird that just flew by is called a 'Thunder Dragon Bird,' a mutant species that appeared after the Glorious Awakening. Part of its body is fused with mechanical devices, capable of releasing high-voltage electricity. It attacks moving objects. From the perspective of biological evolution, this couldn't possibly be a natural formation. Could they be related to the Divine Court’s biological android experiments on the surface?"

(Note: The Human Alliance calls the war between humans and androids the "Android Crisis," while the android side calls it the "Glorious Awakening.")

"I love traveling on public funds~ Look~ this is the moss I just collected from the ground~ I’m going to take it back to the deep sea and give it to Ellie~"

"The surface pollution level is lighter than I imagined. I thought it would be completely barren?"

chunks.chineseText:
“那我们给Alpha发消息，让卫星上的军事部队再轰炸一次吧！”

九章：“……”

好吧，智械的观念确实和人类一样，也会随着接触的信息而改变。

新一代的意识形态都挺战犯的，他们很少接触人类，认为智械高级、人类低级，非常崇拜Alpha那种大手一挥（如果它有的话）全人类物理完蛋的感觉。

从集结、登陆、起飞，到现在已经过去了一周。

如果是行军，这个速度显然不太合格。但九章认为，这是一个难得的假期。也是让小智械了解地表的好机会。所以，走的像是老师带小孩郊游。

反正Alpha只说了在过年前订购一批……智械不过年，他说的应该是人类的新年。还有2个月呢，急什么？

飞行器停滞在了上方：“看这里，我们脚下的，是当年Alpha和人类战斗过后的遗迹。这条裂谷横贯了整个天马大陆。把完整的陆地一分为二。原本富饶的沿海平原一带被海水倒灌，裂成了无数岛国，叫‘东大陆’目前属于人联的强管制范围。而另一边的地表叫‘西大陆’，地表有草原、沙漠、高山。大部分都是神庭的领地。高原上的雪水从这里流入裂谷。”

小智械们小的只有几十岁，最大的也就两百来岁。尽管他们都选择了成年人的外表，在此时，看着窗外的景色，眼里也露出了兴奋和震惊。

这条裂缝太大了，一望无际，比起裂谷，更像是狭长的海，连表面的水都是漆黑的颜色。

“九章，”一台小智械怯怯道，“海下好像有东西在动？我感觉很危险。”

这台智械是“侦查兵”。装配的侦查系统远超别的智械，感知极其敏锐。

九章从不怀疑自己的同伴，更何况是侦察兵的判断。

“上升！”

他当机立断地调高了飞行距离。一直到了离地面五百米的高空。

也怪不得他这么小心，自从光荣觉醒后，地表多了许多怪东西。然而比起深海里的怪物，畸变人都只能算是小可爱。

有时候九章甚至会疑惑，Alpha派军团驻扎海底，还定期发任务让军团进行围剿，是不是在担心，海底的怪物跑到地上去……

当然，从那些海怪身上提取的原料，的确促进了智械科技的发展。

他们只是后勤。主体在海底基地内，进行的也不是什么危险任务，本身装配的武力值并不高。

还是小心点好。

飞行器维持在500m的高度，飞行了2天一夜，终于从海的这边到了另一边。

小飞行器在高空不够稳定，需要更多的时间穿越海峡。另一方面，是九章过于谨慎。

好在，一直到看到“西大陆”的大陆架，侦察兵说的危险也没有出现。

“穿过草原、山脉，就可以抵达任务列表上的目的地。”九章宣布，“我们在海上耽误了一些时间，这次要飞快点了，重要绕开装了对空防御系统的人类据点，整个行程需要105小时14分钟。大家可以在附近休整半个小时，补充点太阳能。中途我们就不停了。”

小智械们走出圆圆的飞行舱，高高兴兴地跑向峭壁、沙滩，甚至远一点的稀树草原。大量的内存用于录制视频。还有小智械选择拿出铲子与玻璃瓶，收集地表的植物与甲虫。

在它们行动的时候，圆形的飞行器就跟随在身边，像是一个个漂浮的大泡泡。

只有那只侦察兵，紧紧贴在九章身边。

它的目光时常会不安地投向平静的海面。

海浪浅浅地拍着沙滩，忽地，一阵风吹过，浪花骤然急促起来。

不需要侦察兵，多年的工作经验已经让九章察觉到了异常。

他发送电波，迅速召回了散落在四处的小智械。

“维持阵型！朝目标点行驶！”

无线信号突然变得极差，九章耳边全是杂乱的电流声。

“轰隆”，重重的一声。

九章回头，看见了一个巨大的黑影，正在从海平面钻出。

浅海的海水颜色没有那么深。所以九章捕捉到了这个怪物的轮廓。

像一条鲶鱼。

这条鱼巨大到根本不能在地表存活。要多强横的骨骼才能撑起这样的形态？

狂风呼啸着，惊涛骇浪。

怪物扑到了岸边，然后如同山岳崩塌一样，倒在地上。

它并没有死。而是分裂成了无数铁壳的甲虫。

黑色的甲虫浩浩汤汤、横无际涯，如同一条黑色的长河。

甲虫们钻进土壤中，有序前行着。堪比作风最严谨的军队。

它们正受到某种特殊电波的感召，于是不惜一切代价地朝着陆地进军。

“这？”

九章根本不知道这是什么东西，智械军团内部都没有这种生物的资料！他也分析不出成分！只能感觉到这种甲虫的外科似乎是某种金属物质。

他思考片刻，对其他人开口：“你们等我一会。”

他决定单独降落，在某只甲虫身上安装定位装置。

人类曾经把机械装置分为三个等级：荣耀智械、天灾智械、使徒智械。

在九章的感知里，这个从海底爬出来的怪物，武力值恐怕等同于“天灾智械”。简单来说，可以轻易毁灭好几座人类城市。

他实在没办法放任这样的怪物不管，虽然不知道怪物的目标是什么。

幸好，甲虫们似乎对自己的任务格外执着，九章俘获其中一只，其他甲虫只是停顿片刻，就选择了继续前进。

“它们在扫描我？”九章有一种微妙的体感，像是被生物电流扫过一遍。

甲虫们判定，面前的智械不好对付，想要杀死它，可能会造成更多伤亡，于是放弃营救自己的同伴。当然，如果九章表现出强烈攻击性，那它们也会选择拼死一战。

九章内心感觉到一阵荒谬：“这到底是生物还是机械？”

他给一只安装上了定位仪，另一只则是带回了自己飞行舱，想要解剖。

生物的本能让甲虫挣扎起来，它张开腹部的蹑足，控制住九章的胳膊，环状的腹部弯曲，咬住了他的手指。

“喀嚓”，清脆的响声。智械人没有痛觉，九章这具人类身体的食指被咬掉了一小块。很少，大概3g。

甲虫大口大口咀嚼起来。身体由黑转向灰白。

他的合金躯体在这只不起眼的黑色甲虫面前，居然脆弱的像是玻璃！

这可是子弹都不能穿透的合金！

这只甲虫不仅能吃，还能进化。

九章瞬间意识到了一件事：“这是专门针对智械人身体的‘清道夫’！——要把这个消息传回军团总部！”
chunks.englishText:
"Then let's send a message to Alpha and have the military units on the satellites bomb them again!"

Jiuzhang: "..."

Well, the ideology of the mechanical intelligences (MIs) was indeed just like that of humans; it changed based on the information they were exposed to.

The new generation of MIs were quite the war-mongers. Having had little contact with humans, they viewed MIs as superior and humans as inferior. They greatly admired the way Alpha could—if it had hands—simply wave them and bring about the physical annihilation of all humanity.

A week had passed since the assembly, landing, and takeoff.

If this were a military march, the pace would clearly be substandard. But Jiuzhang considered this a rare vacation—a perfect opportunity for the young MIs to learn about the surface. Thus, the journey felt more like a teacher taking children on a field trip.

Besides, Alpha had only said to order a batch before the New Year... MIs didn't celebrate the New Year, so he must have meant the human New Year. That was still two months away; what was the rush?

The aircraft hovered in place. "Look here. Beneath our feet lie the ruins of where Alpha and humanity once fought. This rift valley spans the entire Tianma Continent, cleaving the once-intact land in two. The formerly fertile coastal plains were flooded by the sea, shattering into countless island nations now called the 'Eastern Continent,' which is currently under the strict control of the Human Alliance. The surface on the other side is called the 'Western Continent,' featuring grasslands, deserts, and high mountains. Most of it is territory of the Divine Court. The snowmelt from the highlands flows into the rift valley from here."

The young MIs were only a few decades old, with the eldest barely two hundred. Although they had all chosen adult appearances, as they looked at the scenery outside the window, their eyes betrayed excitement and shock.

The rift was immense, stretching beyond the horizon. It looked less like a valley and more like a long, narrow sea, with even the surface water appearing pitch-black.

"Jiuzhang," a young MI said timidly, "there seems to be something moving under the sea. I feel like it's dangerous."

This MI was a "Scout." Its integrated reconnaissance system far surpassed that of the others, and its perception was extremely keen.

Jiuzhang never doubted his companions, especially not the judgment of a Scout.

"Ascend!"

He made a decisive call to increase their altitude, climbing until they were five hundred meters above the ground.

It was no wonder he was so cautious; since the "Glorious Awakening," the surface had become home to many strange things. Yet, compared to the monsters in the deep sea, the mutated humans were merely cute little pets.

Sometimes, Jiuzhang even wondered if Alpha stationing legions on the seabed and periodically issuing missions for them to conduct suppression campaigns was out of concern that the monsters from the deep might crawl onto the surface...

Of course, the raw materials extracted from those sea monsters had indeed accelerated the development of MI technology.

They were merely logistics personnel. The main body of the legion was in the undersea base, and they weren't performing dangerous tasks; their own combat power was not particularly high.

It was better to be safe.

The aircraft maintained an altitude of 500 meters, flying for two days and one night before finally crossing from one side of the sea to the other.

The small aircraft were not stable at high altitudes and required more time to traverse the strait. On the other hand, Jiuzhang was simply being overly cautious.

Fortunately, until they reached the continental shelf of the "Western Continent," the danger the Scout had mentioned never materialized.

"Once we cross the grasslands and mountains, we will reach the destination on our task list," Jiuzhang announced. "We lost some time at sea, so we need to fly faster this time. We must bypass human outposts equipped with anti-air defense systems. The entire journey will take 105 hours and 14 minutes. Everyone can take a half-hour break nearby to recharge via solar power. We won't be stopping again midway."

The young MIs stepped out of their round flight pods, happily running toward the cliffs, beaches, and even the distant savanna. A large amount of memory was dedicated to recording video. Some MIs even chose to take out shovels and glass bottles to collect surface plants and beetles.

As they moved, the round aircraft followed them like floating bubbles.

Only the Scout remained glued to Jiuzhang's side.

Its gaze frequently drifted uneasily toward the calm sea.

Waves lapped gently against the beach until, suddenly, a gust of wind blew, and the surf turned turbulent.

The Scout wasn't needed; years of work experience had already alerted Jiuzhang to the anomaly.

He sent a radio signal, swiftly recalling the young MIs scattered about.

"Maintain formation! Proceed toward the target point!"

The wireless signal suddenly became extremely poor, and Jiuzhang's ears were filled with chaotic static.

*Boom.* A heavy sound echoed.

Jiuzhang looked back and saw a massive black shadow emerging from the sea level.

The water in the shallows wasn't as dark, so Jiuzhang caught the silhouette of the monster.

It looked like a catfish.

The fish was so enormous that it shouldn't have been able to survive on the surface. What kind of formidable skeleton could support such a form?

Gale-force winds howled, and waves crashed violently.

The monster lunged onto the shore, then collapsed onto the ground like a crumbling mountain.

It didn't die. Instead, it split into countless iron-shelled beetles.

The black beetles were vast and boundless, like a long, dark river.

The beetles burrowed into the soil and moved forward in an orderly fashion, comparable to the most disciplined army.

They were being summoned by some special radio wave, and thus, they marched toward the land at any cost.

"This is...?"

Jiuzhang had no idea what these things were; the MI legion had no data on such creatures! He couldn't even analyze their composition! He could only sense that the shells of these beetles seemed to be made of some metallic substance.

He pondered for a moment and said to the others, "Wait for me for a moment."

He decided to land alone to install a tracking device on one of the beetles.

Humans had once divided mechanical devices into three levels: Glory MIs, Calamity MIs, and Apostle MIs.

In Jiuzhang's perception, the combat power of this monster crawling out of the seabed was likely equivalent to a "Calamity MI." Simply put, it could easily destroy several human cities.

He couldn't just leave such a monster alone, even if he didn't know what its target was.

Fortunately, the beetles seemed exceptionally dedicated to their mission. Jiuzhang captured one, and the others only paused for a moment before choosing to continue their advance.

"Are they scanning me?" Jiuzhang had a subtle sensation, as if he had been swept by bio-electricity.

The beetles determined that the MI in front of them was not easy to deal with and that killing it might cause more casualties, so they gave up on rescuing their companion. Of course, if Jiuzhang had shown strong aggression, they would have chosen to fight to the death.

Jiuzhang felt a sense of absurdity: "Is this a biological entity or a machine?"

He installed a tracker on one and brought another back to his flight pod, intending to dissect it.

Biological instinct caused the beetle to struggle. It opened the appendages on its abdomen, restrained Jiuzhang's arm, and its ring-shaped abdomen curled up, biting his finger.

*Click.* A crisp sound. MIs felt no pain, but a small piece of the index finger on Jiuzhang's human-like body was bitten off. It was very small, about 3 grams.

The beetle chewed greedily. Its body turned from black to grayish-white.

His alloy body was as fragile as glass in front of this inconspicuous black beetle!

And this was an alloy that even bullets couldn't penetrate!

This beetle could not only eat, but it could also evolve.

Jiuzhang instantly realized one thing: "This is a 'Scavenger' specifically targeting the bodies of MIs! I must transmit this news back to the Legion Headquarters!"

chunks.chapterTitle: 第113章 战争机器与论文 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第113章 战争机器与论文

天上的猎鸟盘旋着，迟疑地打量着这些正在上岸的怪物。

黑甲虫不在它们的食谱上。可是，在地表，食物对于人和动物来说，都格外珍贵。

于是，第一只猎鸟俯冲着扑向它们。一只甲虫被它吞进肚子里，很难吃，猎鸟怪叫着飞走。

可惜，只飞到一半，这只勇敢的猎鸟就径直往地面踉跄着坠落。

黑甲虫咬破了它的胸腔，从腹部钻了出来，“咕噜”一下，掉回地上。

一只猎鸟以生命的代价，证明了这种黑甲虫的强横。

九章心下凛然。

甲虫们一上岸就纷纷潜入地底，不太好抓。而且这种虫子似乎有自己的信息传导方式，在看见九章时匆忙躲避。

因此，他没能获得更多的实验品。

九章对手里唯一的黑甲虫尤其珍惜。

飞行舱按照既定路线自动驾驶。

九章拿出了飞行舱内部的人类救护应急装置（虽然不太懂为什么智械军团配的飞行器里有这个），把一条数据线连接到了黑甲虫的腹部。

先是电击，感觉到黑甲虫生命体征微弱后，记录数据，注射少许强效基因修复药救回；又火烤，嗯，黑甲虫的背部提纯出了一些液体。

根据分析，这种液体的主要成分是铁、钒、铬，还有微量的、只在外太空发现过的精金。

“原来体内含有精金？就是不知道是哪个矿场的。怪不得能咬碎合金。”

就像是蚊子的口器能刺穿人的皮肤一样，黑甲虫能咬下九章的身体，并非体内精金含量有多高，而是口器的切面格外窄而尖锐，头部还有两条辅助切割的虫足，形状像剪刀。切下来的金属能直接往嘴里送去。

黑甲虫气息奄奄，眼看快要被烧死。九章又注入了基因药，并且选择把黑甲虫放进水里。

这毕竟是从海里爬出来的怪物。

一入水，黑甲虫坚硬的壳变得柔软起来，偏向椭圆的身体也逐渐细长。像是一条蠕动的蛞蝓。

九章往盐水里添加了适量的生物碱。

适用于人的应急装置发出警告，意思是检测到神经传感线链接的“人类”传递出强烈痛苦且悲伤的情绪。

黑甲虫生命力极强，像极了地表人民曾经赖以生存的食物：地虾。（蟑螂）

九章的实验清单上还有浓硫酸、三氧化二砷、神经抑制剂等18种有害物质。除此外还有切割、冰冻等多种死法……

可惜进行到第3项的时候，无论它加大多少修复液的剂量，黑甲虫也没能抢救过来。

这让九章深感遗憾。

“这种生物，生命力还算顽强。而且很难杀，水陆两栖。最低成本的杀灭方式，是物理性刺破头部的神经中枢。但是黑甲虫过于小巧的体型让这种消杀方式效率很低。好在它自我修复能力不强。目前也不清楚繁殖模式。”

九章忧心忡忡地传回资料。

它内部权限高，携带的通讯设备质量也不错。几乎是下一秒，九章就收到了来自总部的回复——

*情报已收到，军区会保持对该物种的关注。尽管根据《和平协议》，智械和人联都不得以强制手段干预地表生态发育。

当然，两方私底下都有一些小动作。却一直否认是官方行为。

而智械因为采取机械化垂直高压管理，这种否认会更站不住脚。总之，把事情公开的话，双方面子上都会有些难堪。

《和平协议》撕毁之时，就是第二次人械战争爆发之日。两方的统治者目前都没有这个打算。

*不过，你为什么会去地表？

（from Beta）

九章是台老实智械，或者说，它们很少会有违反上级指令的想法，这属于系统故障，会被清理。

他如实回复：“Alpha的命令。”

*什么命令？

九章回答：“因为Alpha权限级别高于您，我无需透露任务内容。如果您想知道，我可以申请批示。”

数据端另一头的Beta略微沉吟，它确实比其他智械拥有更高水平的拟人模块，比如此刻内心竟然微微的恼怒。

*Alpha最近的状态有些不对，我们很担心它又被人联投放的病毒干扰了。

“可是？”九章同样感到费解，“如果你和Gamma都没有检查出病毒，跟我说又有什么用呢？我虽然擅长运算、统计之类的工作，但并没有学过高等智械维修。”

人类的大脑是非常精密的仪器，智械的核心程序也是，不是随随便便就能修的。

自古以来的计算机科学都流传着一句真理：还能跑的代码就不要动。

历史上有好多起惨痛教训。原本还能用的人工智能在打了补丁后彻底死机，让人怀疑所谓的检修只是无耻的阴谋。

九章完全有理由怀疑，Alpha的问题从在人联服役开始，就没有解决过。

或许只有历史上那个相南里死而复生，才能修好。

但谁能允许他复活？智械们对他的情绪如此复杂，人联那边也是。

他最好是个死人，他只能是个死人。

九章并没有读出Beta的言外之意。

果然，对智械人还是得打直球。

*我觉得它给你下达命令的行为很反常，我想在不惊动Alpha的情况下知道任务内容。

“你没有查阅权限。”但九章思考片刻，突然意识到Alpha发来任务时，给的保密等级居然是最高级，这确实不怎么正常，不过，它还是回复道，“Alpha吩咐的并不是什么坏事；也不是什么大事。请放心。”

九章只是简单地、带着自己的小同事们出来订购一批饮料而已。

嗯……莫非这其实不是饮料，而是什么不可被人察觉的机密新能源？九章突然不确定了起来。

*好的。

（from Beta）

接下来的几天，九章一边赶路，一边时刻关心着黑甲虫们的去向。

他有了一个胆战心惊的发现——虫群在地底的前进方向，竟然与他们商队前进的方向大体一致。

虫群走的直线，而九章会避开大型地表据点和一些敏感区域，避免被人类发现。

因为智械飞行的速度更快一点，地图上的线路图看起来犹如一头恐怖的野兽，在他们身后穷追猛赶。

“怎么回事？”九章非常霸总地揉了一下眉心，一缕发丝垂落在他光洁的额头上，“难道那只黑甲虫临死前释放了什么我没有提取到的信息物质，让虫群决定为它复仇？”

不过，九章很快发现，也许是自己多虑了。

因为九章可以改变了路线，但是惊讶的发现，虫群并没有追随。而是继续朝着原本的方向前进。

原来，它们真的只是顺路。

九章看着玻璃窗外的夜景，整合着数据库里的信息：“根据资料，很多畸变人会出现莫名的群聚现象。这是因为有强大的畸变人会在附近死亡，死之前散发出该物种独特的信息素，呼吁同伴前来食用自己的尸体。除此外，也有部分异种生物，为了繁殖后代，会在某个特定区域集合。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 113: War Machines and Research Papers

Hunting birds circled in the sky, hesitantly eyeing these monsters coming ashore.

Black beetles were not on their menu. However, on the surface, food was exceptionally precious for both humans and animals.

Thus, the first hunting bird dove toward them. It swallowed a beetle, but it tasted terrible, and the bird flew away with a strange cry.

Unfortunately, halfway through its flight, the brave bird stumbled and plummeted straight toward the ground.

The black beetle had bitten through its chest cavity, crawled out from its abdomen, and with a "plop," dropped back onto the ground.

A hunting bird had sacrificed its life to prove the ferocity of these black beetles.

Jiuzhang felt a chill in his heart.

Once the beetles reached the shore, they burrowed into the ground, making them difficult to catch. Moreover, these insects seemed to have their own method of information transmission; they hurriedly dodged whenever they saw Jiuzhang.

As a result, he failed to obtain more test subjects.

Jiuzhang cherished the only black beetle in his possession.

The flight pod was on autopilot, following the established route.

Jiuzhang took out the human emergency medical kit from inside the flight pod (though he didn't understand why the MI Legion's aircraft were equipped with such things) and connected a data cable to the beetle's abdomen.

First, he used electric shocks. Sensing the beetle's vital signs weakening, he recorded the data and injected a small amount of potent genetic repair serum to save it. Then, he used fire—well, some liquid was purified from the beetle's back.

According to the analysis, the main components of this liquid were iron, vanadium, chromium, and trace amounts of adamantine, which was only found in outer space.

"So it contains adamantine? I just don't know which mine it came from. No wonder it can bite through alloy."

Just as a mosquito's proboscis can pierce human skin, the black beetle's ability to bite off pieces of Jiuzhang's body wasn't due to a high concentration of adamantine, but because the cutting edge of its mouthparts was exceptionally narrow and sharp, with two auxiliary cutting insect-legs on its head shaped like scissors. The metal it cut off could be sent directly into its mouth.

The black beetle was on its last breath, nearly burned to death. Jiuzhang injected the genetic serum again and chose to put the beetle into water.

After all, this was a monster that had crawled out of the sea.

Once in the water, the beetle's hard shell became soft, and its oval-shaped body gradually elongated, looking like a wriggling slug.

Jiuzhang added an appropriate amount of alkaloids to the saltwater.

The emergency kit, designed for humans, issued a warning, indicating that the "human" connected to the neural sensor line was transmitting intense feelings of pain and sorrow.

The black beetle had incredible vitality, much like the food the surface people once relied on: ground shrimp (cockroaches).

Jiuzhang's experimental checklist still included 18 kinds of hazardous substances, such as concentrated sulfuric acid, arsenic trioxide, and neuro-inhibitors. Beyond that, there were various methods of death, including cutting and freezing...

Unfortunately, by the third attempt, no matter how much repair serum he added, the black beetle could not be saved.

This left Jiuzhang feeling deeply regretful.

"This creature has quite tenacious vitality. It's also hard to kill and is amphibious. The lowest-cost method of extermination is to physically pierce the neural center in its head. However, the black beetle's small size makes this method very inefficient. Fortunately, its self-repair ability is not strong. Its reproductive mode is currently unknown."

Jiuzhang transmitted the data back, filled with worry.

He had high internal clearance, and the communication equipment he carried was of good quality. Almost the next second, Jiuzhang received a reply from Headquarters—

*Intelligence received. The Military District will maintain focus on this species. Although, according to the "Peace Treaty," neither the MIs nor the Human Alliance are permitted to interfere with surface ecological development through forceful means.

Of course, both sides had some under-the-table maneuvers, yet they always denied them as official actions.

And because the MIs adopted mechanized, vertical, high-pressure management, such denials were even less convincing. In short, if the matter were made public, it would be embarrassing for both sides.

The day the "Peace Treaty" was torn up would be the day the Second Human-Machine War broke out. Neither side's rulers had any intention of doing that at the moment.

*However, why did you go to the surface?*

(from Beta)

Jiuzhang was an honest MI, or rather, they rarely had thoughts of violating superior orders; that would be considered a system malfunction and would result in being wiped.

He replied truthfully: "Alpha's order."

*What order?*

Jiuzhang replied: "Because Alpha's authorization level is higher than yours, I do not need to disclose the content of the mission. If you wish to know, I can apply for approval."

Beta, on the other end of the data link, pondered slightly. It did possess a higher level of anthropomorphic modules than other MIs, and at this moment, it actually felt a slight sense of annoyance.

*Alpha's state has been a bit off lately. We are worried that it has been interfered with by a virus released by the Human Alliance again.*

"But?" Jiuzhang was equally puzzled. "If neither you nor Gamma have detected a virus, what is the point of telling me? Although I am skilled in calculation, statistics, and similar work, I have not studied advanced MI maintenance."

The human brain was a very precise instrument, and so was the core program of an MI; they couldn't just be repaired casually.

Since ancient times, a truth had circulated in computer science: if the code still runs, don't touch it.

There had been many painful lessons in history. Artificial intelligences that were originally functional had crashed completely after being patched, leading people to suspect that so-called maintenance was just a shameless conspiracy.

Jiuzhang had every reason to suspect that Alpha's problem hadn't been solved since it was in service with the Human Alliance.

Perhaps only that Xiang Nanli from history, if he were to return from the dead, could fix it.

But who would allow him to be resurrected? The MIs had such complex feelings about him, as did the Human Alliance.

It was best if he were a dead man; he could only be a dead man.

Jiuzhang did not read between the lines of Beta's subtext.

Sure enough, one had to be direct with MIs.

*I feel that its act of giving you orders is very abnormal. I want to know the content of the mission without alerting Alpha.*

"You do not have the authorization to view it." But after thinking for a moment, Jiuzhang suddenly realized that when Alpha sent the mission, the security level given was the highest, which was indeed not very normal. However, he still replied, "What Alpha ordered is not a bad thing; nor is it a major event. Please rest assured."

Jiuzhang was simply taking his little colleagues out to order a batch of drinks.

Hmm... could it be that these weren't actually drinks, but some classified new energy source that couldn't be detected? Jiuzhang suddenly became uncertain.

*Understood.*

(from Beta)

Over the next few days, Jiuzhang continued his journey while keeping a close eye on the whereabouts of the black beetles.

He made a startling discovery—the direction in which the swarm was advancing underground was roughly consistent with the direction the caravan was heading.

The swarm moved in a straight line, while Jiuzhang would avoid large surface outposts and sensitive areas to prevent being discovered by humans.

Because the MIs flew faster, the route map looked like a terrifying beast chasing relentlessly behind them.

"What is going on?" Jiuzhang rubbed his brow in a very "boss-like" manner, a strand of hair falling over his smooth forehead. "Could it be that the black beetle released some information substance before it died that I didn't extract, causing the swarm to decide to avenge it?"

However, Jiuzhang soon realized that perhaps he was overthinking it.

Because even though Jiuzhang changed his route, he was surprised to find that the swarm did not follow. Instead, they continued in their original direction.

As it turned out, they were just going the same way.

Jiuzhang looked at the night view outside the glass window, integrating the information in his database: "According to data, many mutated humans exhibit inexplicable clustering phenomena. This is because a powerful mutated human dies nearby, and before dying, it emits a unique pheromone of the species, calling its companions to come and consume its corpse. Besides this, some alien creatures also gather in specific areas to breed offspring."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第113章 战争机器与论文 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
“Alpha派我到这个地方签订商务合同，这个方位和虫群前进方位一致。到底是巧合，还是他自有安排？只是购买果味饮料，Alpha会开出最高保密等级的指令吗？”

“更重要的是，这种登陆的海洋虫子食铁，物种不在数据库内，对机械生命有着明显的克制作用。”

“果然……Alpha是找借口把我调出来吧。”

当年因为和使徒关系亲近，在使徒背叛智械军团后，本该是军部明日之子的九章也遭受冷藏，从核心位置，被流放到了海底，管管军团驻地人员的后勤。偶尔还兼职幼儿园老师，帮忙带带程序（心智）不怎么成熟的小智械。

但九章并没有忘记自己的战争本能。

它是作为“军事指挥官”被生产、制造出来的智械。

他拥有的强大算法，不是为了计算海底的驻军一天消耗多少吨机油，而是为了模拟战争。他曾无数次在绝境中，模拟出那条唯一的、可行的生路。

如果不是那次“使徒事变”，他本该是智械军团内最耀眼的新星。

九章看着地图上那个写着“幸存者基地”的终点站，默然许久。

他想，也许到了那里，一切都会有答案。

或许会有一支精悍的智械军队，正在那里安静地等待着。而他会像很多年前一样，驾驶着使徒II默示录的本体，谈笑间摧毁无数座人类城市。

九章不喜欢战争。每次开战，都是对资源极大的浪费。

可我是战争机器。

九章想。

“九章。”就在九章热血沸腾地沉思时，一台小智械弱弱开口，打断了他的思路，“我们都在飞行器里呆了好久了，什么时候可以停下来放放风啊？刚才路过的是神庭大草原吗？那个红色的湖泊好漂亮。”

意思是好想下去拍照，顺便收集点标本~

“对呀。Gamma姐姐说，小智械太阳晒少了，以后神经系统会缺乏活跃度。运行会消耗更多内存。”

什么伪科学。

“我、我有点晕机油。”

九章：“……”

你他爹的机器人晕什么机油？

这就是他带的兵吗？

九章的目光突然迷茫了起来。

……

……

尚在和谐建设的基地，并不知道危险正在悄悄靠近。

就算知道……

相南里估计也会优先把手上的活处理完。再考虑该怎么办。

他在工作室里呆了三天，饿了吃小青做的饭，困了裹着睡袋睡地上，终于加班加点地赶制出了北辰实验室所需要的设备。

一台用于控制菌丝母体的机械装置。

把母体放在装置内，另一端连接控制人，可以通过脑电波控制母体，间接操控其余菌丝亚种。

核心材料是从螺丝钉1号身上提取出的RN-7活性金属，提纯后只有13g。远低于装置的需求量。

但基地就这个条件。

相南里压缩成本，采取了从教科书上学到的新技术，对活性金属板进行多孔穿透……总之，经过一系列相当复杂的操作，这套装置不仅能运行，转换率还比原本的装置高上百分之3。

如果是在地下城市，他甚至可以为此申请专利技术。

不过……

相南里让小智把过程整合了一下，直接发表到了全人联最大的知识网站：论文网。

这个网站大有来头，是人联早期的公益组织。取得技术资格证（包括机械师、人工智能开发者、医生、农林牧学家等等）的人，可以自由地在网站上发表文章，公开自己的学术成果。可以免费，也可以收费。

人联建设早期，大家还是很无私的，这里有着无数人类文明的结晶。

但现在，整个网站已经被学阀统治。之前一些免费的重要论文（譬如智械、高新武器的制造），也悄然下架。成为了只在上层流通的东西。

[确定要在网上发表吗？这似乎可以申请专利技术。]小智好心提醒。

相南里：“直接发吧。申请专利技术还要亲自去专利局登记，还要缴费、开答辩会，一套流程下来好几年。哪有那个闲工夫？”

“而且，”相南里推开工作室的大门，外面天是亮着的，空气里充斥着新鲜的雪的气息，他站在光里，“技术为什么不能被全人类共享？”

于是，小智在论文里详细记录了相南里的制作过程和结果，并选择了发表和免费。这消耗了它大概80mb的流量。

相南里有一个初级机械师的头衔。是录入职业学校系统一年后，学校自动发的证书。因此，达到了在网站上发表论文的最低门槛。

免费有一个好处，那就是不需要专家审核，只需要AI阅卷。

很快，一个标题为《RN-7活性金属高效利用操作方式》的论文，静静躺在了论文网浩瀚如海的数据库中。

作者：里（注：这个网站竟然不允许注册名称为相南里！）

身份认证：初级机械师

学历：姑苏城维修技术学院（大专）（二年级在读）

浏览：0。引用：0。

而此时，一名高新军工的科研狗，正在百无聊赖地摸鱼。

他的内置AI在此时提醒：“您关注的‘活性金属高效应用’领域有了新论文，是否查阅？”

科研狗顿时眼前一亮：“什么，这么热门的领域有人发论文了？快调出来给我看看！”

要知道，人联的学术机制，让大多数人更愿意申请专利，而不是发表论文。

毕竟，论文一发表，就代表着里面展示的内容可以被其他人查阅、利用。

这是一种相当无私的行为，无论那位发表者是否选择论文收费。

目前，还会在网上发表的论文主要分两种。

第一是大学生的毕业论文，每年稳定地给网站后台增加电子垃圾。

第二是偏向理论的论文。为了宣传自己的新概念或者彰显学术地位，用于谋取更多科研经费。

总之搞技术的那是恨不得往死里藏着掖着啊。只注册专利，没事发什么论文？

科研狗扫了眼标题，瞳孔地震，心情喜悦到反手抽了自己一巴掌——他是不是酒喝多了。出现了幻觉？

然后他又看到了作者的名字：不认识，莫非是什么前辈？

再看身份认证和学历。

毕业于长安大学（人联排名第4）的博士生瞬间沉默了起来。

呵呵……果然这种天上掉馅饼的好事，怎么会出现。

他对着屏幕，指着论文标题大骂：“你个大专生取个这么劲爆的论文标题做什么，你新闻学的？！”

科研狗当即把论文丢在一边，继续自己的工作。

晚上十点，科研狗满身疲惫地下班了。

今天，导师又因为一点小事大发雷霆，把他骂了个狗血淋头。

科研狗知道，自己老板只是压力太大。他们项目组想攻克的是活性金属应用领域的技术难题。这是老板的老板下达的任务。

总之，就是需要一种工业技术，让活性金属可以更小的体积、更高的效率，从而满足某台设备苛刻的需求……具体什么设备呢，又是保密的。
chunks.englishText:
"Alpha sent me to this location to sign a commercial contract, and this coordinate aligns perfectly with the swarm's path of advancement. Is it truly a coincidence, or does he have his own agenda? Would Alpha really issue a top-secret directive just to purchase fruit-flavored beverages?"

"More importantly, these amphibious insects that landed are iron-eaters. They aren't in the database, and they possess a clear, suppressive advantage against mechanical lifeforms."

"As I thought... Alpha was just looking for an excuse to pull me out."

Years ago, due to his close relationship with the Apostle, Jiu Zhang—who should have been the 'Star of Tomorrow' for the Military Department—was sidelined after the Apostle betrayed the Mechanical Legion. He was exiled from the core command to the seabed, relegated to managing logistics for the legion's garrison. Occasionally, he even moonlighted as a kindergarten teacher, helping to look after immature mechanical units whose programs (minds) had yet to fully develop.

But Jiu Zhang had not forgotten his war instincts.

He was a mechanical unit produced and manufactured to be a "Military Commander."

The powerful algorithms he possessed were not meant for calculating how many tons of machine oil the seabed garrison consumed daily, but for simulating war. Countless times, in desperate situations, he had simulated that one single, viable path to survival.

If not for that "Apostle Incident," he would have been the most dazzling rising star within the Mechanical Legion.

Jiu Zhang stared at the destination marked "Survivor Base" on the map, falling into a long, silent contemplation.

He thought that perhaps, once he arrived there, everything would have an answer.

Perhaps there would be a crack mechanical army waiting there in silence. And he, just like many years ago, would pilot the main body of the Apostle II Apocalypse, destroying countless human cities amidst lighthearted banter.

Jiu Zhang did not like war. Every time a war broke out, it was a massive waste of resources.

*But I am a war machine.*

Jiu Zhang thought.

"Jiu Zhang." Just as Jiu Zhang was lost in a blood-pumping reverie, a small mechanical unit spoke up weakly, interrupting his train of thought. "We've been in the aircraft for so long, when can we stop and get some air? Was that the Divine Court Prairie we just passed? That red lake was so beautiful."

The implication was: *I really want to go down and take pictures, and maybe collect some specimens~*

"Yeah! Sister Gamma said that if small mechanical units don't get enough sunlight, our nervous systems will lack vitality in the future. Running will consume more memory."

What kind of pseudoscience is that?

"I... I'm a little motion-sick from the machine oil."

Jiu Zhang: "..."

*What the hell are you talking about? Robots don't get motion-sick from machine oil!*

Are these the soldiers I'm leading?

Jiu Zhang's gaze suddenly became dazed.

...

...

The base, still in the midst of harmonious construction, had no idea that danger was quietly approaching.

Even if they did know...

Xiang Nanli would probably prioritize finishing the work at hand before considering what to do about it.

He had stayed in his studio for three days, eating meals made by Xiao Qing when hungry and wrapping himself in a sleeping bag on the floor when tired. Finally, through overtime, he managed to rush out the equipment needed by the Beichen Laboratory.

A mechanical device used to control the mycelium progenitor.

By placing the progenitor inside the device and connecting the other end to a controller, one could use brainwaves to control the progenitor, indirectly manipulating the remaining mycelium subspecies.

The core material was RN-7 active metal extracted from Screw No. 1. After purification, there was only 13g—far less than what the device required.

But these were the conditions of the base.

Xiang Nanli cut costs by adopting a new technique he learned from a textbook, performing porous penetration on the active metal plate... In short, after a series of highly complex operations, this set of equipment not only functioned but also achieved a conversion rate 3% higher than the original design.

If he were in an underground city, he could even apply for a patent for this technology.

However...

Xiang Nanli had Xiao Zhi integrate the process and published it directly on the largest knowledge website in the Human Alliance: *PaperNet*.

This website had a prestigious history, being an early public welfare organization of the Human Alliance. Those who held technical qualifications (including mechanics, AI developers, doctors, agricultural and forestry experts, etc.) could freely publish articles on the site and make their academic achievements public. They could choose to make them free or paid.

In the early days of the Alliance's construction, everyone was quite selfless, and the site held countless crystallizations of human civilization.

But now, the entire website had been taken over by academic cliques. Some important papers that were previously free (such as those on mechanics and the manufacturing of high-tech weapons) had been quietly removed, becoming things that circulated only among the upper echelons.

[Are you sure you want to publish this online? It seems you could apply for a patent for this technology.] Xiao Zhi reminded him kindly.

Xiang Nanli: "Just post it. Applying for a patent requires going to the patent office in person to register, paying fees, and holding defense meetings. The whole process takes years. Who has that kind of time?"

"Besides," Xiang Nanli pushed open the studio door. The sky outside was bright, and the air was filled with the scent of fresh snow. He stood in the light. "Why shouldn't technology be shared by all of humanity?"

Thus, Xiao Zhi recorded Xiang Nanli's production process and results in detail in the paper and chose to publish it for free. This consumed about 80MB of its data.

Xiang Nanli held a Junior Mechanic title—a certificate automatically issued by the vocational school system one year after enrollment. Therefore, he met the minimum threshold to publish papers on the site.

A benefit of making it free was that it didn't require expert review, only AI grading.

Soon, a paper titled "Operational Method for High-Efficiency Utilization of RN-7 Active Metal" lay quietly in the vast database of PaperNet.

Author: Li (Note: This website actually didn't allow registering the name 'Xiang Nanli'!)

Identity Verification: Junior Mechanic

Education: Gusu City Maintenance Technical College (Junior College) (Second-year student)

Views: 0. Citations: 0.

At this moment, a research drone for a high-tech military industrial firm was idly slacking off.

His built-in AI alerted him: "There is a new paper in the field of 'High-Efficiency Application of Active Metal' that you follow. Would you like to view it?"

The researcher's eyes lit up immediately: "What? Someone published a paper in such a hot field? Hurry, pull it up and let me see!"

One must know that the academic mechanism of the Human Alliance made most people more willing to apply for patents rather than publish papers.

After all, once a paper is published, it means the content displayed within can be viewed and utilized by others.

This is a rather selfless act, regardless of whether the publisher chooses to charge for the paper.

Currently, the papers still being published online mainly fall into two categories.

The first is undergraduate graduation theses, which steadily add electronic waste to the website's backend every year.

The second is theory-oriented papers, used to promote new concepts or assert academic status in order to secure more research funding.

In short, those working in technology are desperate to hide their findings. Why would they publish a paper if they could just register a patent?

The researcher scanned the title, his pupils shaking. He was so overjoyed that he backhanded himself—had he drunk too much? Was he hallucinating?

Then he saw the author's name: *Don't recognize it. Could it be some senior?*

He looked at the identity verification and education.

The PhD student who graduated from Chang'an University (ranked 4th in the Human Alliance) instantly fell silent.

*Heh... As expected, how could such a 'pie falling from the sky' happen.*

He pointed at the screen, cursing at the paper's title: "You junior college student, why are you using such a sensational title? Are you a journalism major?!"

The researcher immediately tossed the paper aside and continued his work.

At 10:00 PM, the researcher got off work, exhausted.

Today, his mentor had flown into a rage over a trivial matter and scolded him to pieces.

The researcher knew his boss was just under too much pressure. Their project team was trying to overcome a technical bottleneck in the field of active metal applications. This was a task assigned by the boss's boss.

In short, they needed an industrial technique that would allow active metal to function with smaller volume and higher efficiency, so as to meet the harsh requirements of a certain piece of equipment... As for what specific equipment, that was classified.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第113章 战争机器与论文 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
实验组已经在这里卡了半年。大老板下了最后通牒，做不出来就解散。换人来做。

高新军工和其他大型企业一样，采用的是终生雇佣制。

科研狗知道，自己不至于失业。但是被认定无能的他、同事，甚至包括他的导师，都会被调离技术部门，换去工资不高事也不少的岗位。

在等着公交车来的时候，科研狗抬头，望着远处的led广告，脑海里不受控制地浮现出下午看见的那篇论文。

科研狗不由得低头，嘲讽一笑。

他到底在期待什么。可是，他们已经走投无路了。

算了，反正那篇论文免费，不看白不看。

神使鬼差地，科研狗敲了一下戴着的电子目镜……
chunks.englishText:
The experimental team had been stuck here for half a year. The big boss had issued an ultimatum: if they couldn't do it, the team would be disbanded and replaced.

High-tech military industrial firms, like other large enterprises, employed a lifetime employment system.

The researcher knew he wouldn't necessarily be unemployed. But he, his colleagues, and even his mentor would be labeled incompetent and transferred out of the technical department to positions with lower pay and just as much work.

While waiting for the bus, the researcher looked up at the distant LED advertisements, and the paper he had seen that afternoon uncontrollably surfaced in his mind.

He couldn't help but lower his head and offer a mocking smile.

*What exactly am I expecting?* But they were already at a dead end.

*Forget it, the paper is free anyway, might as well look at it.*

Driven by a strange impulse, the researcher tapped the electronic eyepiece he was wearing...

chunks.chapterTitle: 第114章 装置实验和菌鸡销售 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第114章 装置实验和菌鸡销售

——当天，姑苏城某所大专校长的电话被打爆了。不少人提出希望让学校某位二年级的学生“里”去各大研究所进行操作指导。

更有学术大牛抢先一步，试图让相南里读自己的研究生，包食宿，包助学补贴，包转城市户口（人联不同地下城市的户口含金量不同），甚至包了毕业后的工作；条件优渥到让校长都心动。

而校长只能汗流浃背的猛翻学生资料，再三表示他们学校真的没有一个叫“里”的学生！——嗯，倒是有个叫相南里的，是市长（洛修）塞来的关系户，一天都没来过学校。

校长这天见到的学阀、财阀代理人，比过去几十年都多。

相南里带着装置，兴冲冲地来到了基地的生物实验室！

“北辰！装置做出来了！”

他到的时候，北辰正在进行菌种采集。一只高度接近7米的巨大菌丝生命体正在院子里无能狂怒，它的体型像随处可见的野草，只是癫狂舞动的枝叶展示出了强大的攻击性；令人分不清到底是动物还是植物。

唯一欣慰的大概是它还没有对周围发起进攻。

北辰就站在远处的平地上，周围是两名保镖，一台是螺丝钉1号，另一个是之前从永恒市过来的基因战士。皮肤黝黑，身上毛发也很多，看起来会更像是一头巨大的黑猩猩。

这株野草的根部连接着一块电子仪器。是相南里之前制作的半成品，看样子勉强能用。遥控器在北辰手中。

因为最近都在搞相关实验，空气里一股新鲜蘑菇的味道，有点土腥味。

相南里把背过来的工具包放在了地上：“使用说明书懒得写了。反正电不死人，你先试试。这台设施我录入了你的使用权限。”

说完，他就开始掏装备。

这台装备是佩戴式的，一个巨大的控制器，长得像是金属马甲，背着一个沉重的数据箱，还配备了专门的电子目镜。另外一个则是感应环，圆形，表面有由活性金属打造的尖刺，可以刺入母体的神经中枢，从而达到挟母体以令群菌的效果。

目前，全基地只有三个人拥有权限：相南里，东方青帝，北辰。

因为母体夸张的体型，整套装置重达60kg。

站在北辰身边的螺丝钉1号较为不满地开口：“这么重的仪器怎么能让你一个人背过来？东方青帝呢？”

至少，在洛阳的印象中，相南里从不干重活，别说扛60公斤的装备了，惯用的水杯装满咖啡都没有600g。

如今猛地看到，洛阳难免觉得有些刺眼，对Alpha也愈发不满起来。

这种小事都干不好。

如果是他在相南里身边，必定是用全世界最珍贵的东西娇养着。

至于“娇弱的花离开温室如何生存”，这种事并不在洛阳的考虑范围内。

因为整个人联都是他掌中的温室。

相南里有些奇怪地扫了黄澄澄的1号一眼：“不用了。”

至于小青去哪了，相南里大多时候并不会多管。兴许有智械军团的机密呢？

反正交给东方青帝的任务，他一向都完成的很好。

小青现在的职务是总参谋！是基地的二把手！

每天上班3小时（对他来说已经足够处理所有工作了），上到物资人力调配，下到水管维修（基地的地热装置偶尔会遇上管道老化问题，因为在地下几百米，所以基本都是小青处理）都很在行。

相南里也不打算把东方青帝的空隙时间榨干，那太黑心资本家了！

1号蹲下，开始帮忙卸货。手法很熟练，像是和相南里配合过千百次一样。

小智：[……]

不知道为什么很想把1号格式化。挺急的。

北辰很快佩戴好了控制装置。

他把调配好的麻药注射进了母体体内，母体温顺地佩戴上了控制仪器。躺在地上，身上的孢子有气无力地随着风轻轻摇摆。

整个操作系统异常简洁，北辰启动目镜，眼前出现了一张3d电子地图。

地图上，母体是红色，而母体所繁育出的子体是其他颜色，每种颜色代表着子体不同的分工。

负责繁衍的、收集营养的、生态占领的菌子各有各的形态。

就像是一个小型蜂巢。

北辰：“基地的黑丝粉菌，是结合了太空异种残骸的进化体。考虑到基地的安保需求，我们现在主要是增加负责生态占领的菌种。”

他在地图上画了几个圈，在基地的城墙外围、以及部分重要厂房。

“但是这样营养会跟不上。所以我还需要一笔资金，购买原料，调配营养液。”

其实还有一件事，因为觉得不是坏事，北辰下意识地省略了。

之前相南里还没回来，他就让放养的黑丝粉菌把基地周围的异种、游荡的小畸变人都吃掉了~毕竟营养不够，北辰只能创造条件，避免养的黑丝粉菌死掉。

所以基地方圆5公里都异常安全，这也间接地保护了基地的农田。

相南里眉头一皱，感觉事情并不简单：“要多少？”

“呃，”北辰扳着手指算了一下，“第一个月先300万吧，我会控制菌群的规模的。”

他说的，当然是人联的信用点，而不是基地的电子货币。

如果是以前，相南里是不会批这笔资金的。毕竟基地附近还算太平，罗马城和光辉市也纳入了辖区。

但“加百列”的出现，让相南里意识到，和平也许只是暂时的。

最近的地下城市姑苏城还在闹瘟疫，看网上的消息，疫情似乎平息了不少；可一直没有彻底开放。

而几百里外，就是阴山城的神庭驻军。按照沙利叶的说法，只需要几百人的天启骑士配上少许现代武器，就能把基地彻底摧毁。

这段时间，幸存者基地接手了不少从神庭大草原过来的难民。

他们讲述了被神庭占领后的下场——第一代子民，会成为地上神国的奴隶。只有极少数天之骄子，能被吸纳进神庭。

生于忧患，死于安乐。

尽管基地的经费已经非常紧张，但相南里在脑海内核算了一下数据，咬牙开口：“好。”

却是没有提第二个月要怎么办。

实验大获成功，相南里留下装备，开始朝自己办公室走去。

首先联系的是远在永恒市的福音书。

这台智械虽然有时候过于黏人显得不太靠谱，但它毕竟是携带丰富农业养殖技术的福音书。

“小福。”

相南里刚开口，屏幕上就出现了一长串的波浪号，这表示福音书的心情非常愉悦：“里里~~！你终于联系我了！”

福音书打开摄像模式：“你看，这是我们刚搭好的菌鸡繁育场。”

菌鸡虽然有个“鸡”字，但毕竟不是真的动物。

恒温的繁育场内，高高低低摆放着一个个大玻璃瓶。玻璃瓶里装满了北辰给出的营养液配方。

此时，一个个黄色的孢子正在里面分裂。就像是鸡蛋的蛋黄。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 114: Device Testing and Fungus-Chicken Sales

—That day, the phone of a certain junior college president in Gusu City was blown up. Many people expressed the hope of having a second-year student named "Li" from their school provide operational guidance at various research institutes.

Even academic titans stepped in first, attempting to get Xiang Nanli to enroll as their graduate student, promising full room and board, student subsidies, a transfer of urban household registration (the value of which varies between different underground cities in the Human Alliance), and even guaranteeing a job after graduation; the conditions were so generous that even the president was tempted.

The president could only sweat profusely as he frantically flipped through student records, repeatedly stating that their school really did not have a student named "Li"! —Well, there was one named Xiang Nanli, a "connection" shoved in by the Mayor (Luo Xiu), who hadn't shown up to school a single day.

The president saw more academic cliques and agents of financial conglomerates that day than he had in the past few decades.

Xiang Nanli, carrying the device, excitedly arrived at the base's biological laboratory!

"Beichen! The device is finished!"

When he arrived, Beichen was in the middle of collecting fungal strains. A massive mycelium lifeform, nearly 7 meters tall, was throwing a tantrum in the courtyard. Its body resembled common weeds, but the frantically dancing branches and leaves displayed powerful aggression; it was hard to tell if it was an animal or a plant.

The only relief was that it hadn't attacked the surroundings yet.

Beichen stood on the flat ground in the distance, flanked by two bodyguards: one was Screw No. 1, and the other was a gene warrior who had come from Eternal City. With dark skin and thick body hair, he looked more like a giant chimpanzee.

The roots of this weed were connected to an electronic instrument. It was a semi-finished product Xiang Nanli had made earlier, and it looked like it was barely functional. The remote control was in Beichen's hand.

Because of the recent experiments, the air smelled of fresh mushrooms, with a hint of earthy dampness.

Xiang Nanli placed the toolkit he had carried on the ground: "I was too lazy to write an instruction manual. Anyway, it won't electrocute anyone, so you try it first. I've entered your usage permissions into this facility."

After saying that, he began to pull out the equipment.

This gear was wearable: a huge controller that looked like a metal vest, carrying a heavy data box, and equipped with a specialized electronic eyepiece. The other part was a sensor ring—circular, with spikes made of active metal on the surface that could pierce the progenitor's central nervous system, thereby achieving the effect of "holding the progenitor hostage to command the swarm."

Currently, only three people in the entire base had permission: Xiang Nanli, Dongfang Qingdi, and Beichen.

Due to the progenitor's exaggerated size, the entire set of equipment weighed 60kg.

Screw No. 1, standing beside Beichen, spoke with some dissatisfaction: "How could you let yourself carry such heavy equipment alone? Where is Dongfang Qingdi?"

At the very least, in Luo Yang's impression, Xiang Nanli never did heavy work; let alone carrying 60kg of equipment, even his usual water cup, when filled with coffee, didn't weigh 600g.

Seeing this now, Luo Yang couldn't help but feel it was an eyesore, and his dissatisfaction with Alpha grew even stronger.

*He can't even handle such a small task.*

If he were by Xiang Nanli's side, he would definitely pamper him with the most precious things in the world.
