第119章 失控机仆2

比如相南里就能感觉到，小青的唇出乎意料的温暖。

又水润又有光泽，一亲就知道，绝对是质量上好的生物材料……

很不幸，相南里是母胎单身。母胎单身代表着没有实践经验，对亲热的所有认知都属于二手资料。

虽然是相南里主动的，但现在完全是被压在椅子上嗦，他腰都软了，脊椎也像通了电一样。

想到这，相南里不由得在脑海里询问：[小智！你是不是在偷偷帮小青电我？]

小智没有回答。

因为它被迫关机了！是谁动手的大家心里都有数！

相南里觉得纯粹是自己脑子不太正常，同龄小男孩都在思慕少艾的时候，他一个人关在漆黑的机房；高中都还没毕业，却依旧成为了论坛里有名的“大佬”。

不是没有人对他表达过好感，或含蓄或直接；在性别都有几十种的国度，还有一些老前辈想直接给他安排自己的儿子或孙女。

只是相南里都拒绝了。

他没能对那些适合套入“恋人”身份的年轻男女产生爱情。哪怕他们如此美丽、富有、善良、有趣。

好在相南里也没什么传宗接代的执念，三十来岁就得了癌。

于是，婚姻和爱情就像是错误的实验数据一样，并不在他的考虑范围内。

人一定要爱上另一个人吗？他在黑夜里踽踽独行，照亮他前方的从来都不是爱，而是对知识永恒的追求。

或许，正是因为没有感知爱与生产爱的能力，相南里才会对那些抽象的东西如此着迷。

过度的亲吻让呼吸变得炽热又滞塞，相南里突然意识到了什么叫引火自焚。

而且小青居然还会乱摸！他一半的手指都是金属构造，触感冰冷，拂过皮肤时很难忍住颤栗。

两人的鼻梁有些高，接吻只能侧着头亲，相南里揪住了东方青帝后脑勺的长发，从鼻腔里发出黏黏糊糊的气音：“小青……”

东方青帝略微分开了一点，望着他的眼睛：“嗯？”

他忍不住蹭着相南里的鼻尖。

传道书曾经说过，爱是一种兽性，是无关一切的本能渴求。是进食、融为一体的极致冲动。

过去，Alpha总视传道书说的话如系统垃圾。

直到现在，他突然觉得那小子说话也有点道理。他是真的想把相南里和自己锁死。

他要当一个太空冷冻舱，把相南里永生永世囚禁在自己身体做成的堡垒里。他要携带着他，离开人马星去环游宇宙。

在死寂到没有声音、也没有同类的世界里，他们会是彼此的唯一。

哪怕相南里永远不会醒来，哪怕自己因为能源耗尽、宇宙风暴而永远的关机。

他愿意放弃所有的权力、财富、责任，和相南里一同死去。

Alpha想，比起多给自己装一点武器装置，安装夜勤模块和另一套装置似乎更迫在眉睫。

相南里感觉自己的脑海里闪过一长串的错误代码，最理解不了的是自己为什么会在几分钟前鬼迷心窍的亲上去。

虽然好像不是第一次和东方青帝接吻。

但上次是喝多了，这次完全是清醒地看着自己沉沦。

相南里底气不是很足地开口：“够了吧？我们还没说正事呢。”

东方青帝的脑海里瞬间闪过最近几个月的积累，从人类古早时期的浪漫小说到最近几年的全息爱情电影，追问：“那我们现在是什么关系？”

相南里汗流浃背：“……呃，嗯……啊。”

东方青帝直视他：“你知道吗，智械军团也有内部也有婚姻制度，并且是1V1制。”

——虽然几百年来登记结婚的不超过50对。

智械们是这么认为的：婚姻制度是人类社会的陋习，我们对彼此的感情也不需要通过婚姻来证明。

（至于智械本身的财产，因为欲望极低，几乎没有作用，所以不需要婚姻来打造利益共同体，军团内部的福利也足够满足日常需求；攒一攒没用的工资还能定期换点高级零件。）

（有研究智械文明方面的人类学者表示，这是因为智械内部只有权限等级，而非阶级。从人格层面，Alpha和最低级的智械也是平等的关系；只存在社会分工的不同。但或许这也是一种另类的“阶级”。并且比人类社会更加绝望，因为它永远固化——扫地机器人不可能成为军团领袖，士兵机器人安装的配件也匹配不了将军这一职位的需求。它们看起来都是智械，但其实是两个物种。而人类，起码还有过“自下而上的方式”。但很不幸，我们的社会似乎正在智械化。）

（更不幸的是说出这段话的人类学者来自洛阳城洛氏，她死后这些理论资料就被雪藏了，没有留下任何痕迹。）

虽然在黑暗中，相南里只能看见一个模糊的轮廓，但他还是莫名心虚地挪开了眼睛：“所以刚刚你是去干嘛了？为什么要销毁螺丝钉啊。”

“它在网上乱下东西，感染了病毒。在暗中当商业间谍。”东方青帝轻描淡写地说着，不放过任何一个上眼药的机会，“是永生科技干的。我怀疑它们是不想支付专利费。”

对于东方青帝的话，相南里是很少怀疑的。

更何况螺丝钉1号都物理性的成了一堆碎铁渣，他也没办法考证。

相南里微微挪动了一下身体，让自己离开东方青帝的笼罩范围，免得自己喘不过气：“这样啊。”

永生科技这么大的公司，每天的盈利都是以亿计数，行为居然这么龌龊？

相南里这辈子和永生科技接触的不多，见过最多的就是旗下产品的广告。

永生科技研究团队的首席李斯特人倒是不错。

但是一想起上次购买的爆炸款接入舱，和那足以气死人的售后服务……集团会干出这种事，倒也不至于难以置信。

相南里从不觉得有东西能够纯粹光明、洁白。

但难免有一点失望。永生科技的名字还是他取的呢！

当初同行都说名字取的太大，压不住。他果然也死得很早。

尽管觉得很破坏气氛，但东方青帝还是打开了工作室的灯。

光线回到了昏暗的房间，相南里的脸颊依然是红着的。

他把刚拼装好的武器收进柜子里，随后道：“路上说吧。好几天没休息了，我回宿舍睡个觉。”

相南里正在努力装作无事发生。一部分原因是他的大脑过载，根本不知道怎么处理；另一部分则是基地里的事情太多，一茬一茬的，根本没时间留给他谈情说爱。

工作室位于基地的西北角，离粮食仓库很近；开车到宿舍区要花半小时。

中间很长一段时间都是无人区，路边有些小废墟，是上个据点的遗留，还没清扫。于是中间有很长一段时间的沉默。

相南里戴着电子目镜，靠在车窗边，浏览着自己的工作邮箱。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 119: Rogue Machine Servant 2

For instance, Xiang Nanli could feel that Xiao Qing’s lips were unexpectedly warm.

They were moist and lustrous; one kiss was enough to tell that they were made of top-tier biological material...

Unfortunately, Xiang Nanli had been single since birth. Being single since birth meant a complete lack of practical experience; all his knowledge regarding intimacy was strictly second-hand information.

Although he had been the one to initiate it, he was now completely pinned to the chair, being sucked into a frenzy. His waist felt weak, and his spine tingled as if a current of electricity were surging through it.

At this thought, Xiang Nanli couldn't help but ask in his mind: [Xiao Zhi! Are you secretly helping Xiao Qing electrocute me?]

Xiao Zhi did not answer.

Because it had been forcibly shut down! Everyone knew exactly who was responsible for that!

Xiang Nanli felt that his own brain was simply not functioning normally. While his peers were busy pining for young love, he had been locked away in a pitch-black server room. Even before graduating high school, he had already become a renowned "big shot" on the forums.

It wasn't as if no one had ever expressed interest in him, whether subtly or directly. In a country with dozens of genders, there were even old seniors who wanted to arrange for their sons or granddaughters to be with him.

But Xiang Nanli had refused them all.

He couldn't develop romantic feelings for those young men and women who were perfectly suited for the role of a "lover." Even though they were so beautiful, wealthy, kind, and interesting.

Fortunately, Xiang Nanli had no obsession with continuing his bloodline, and he had developed cancer in his thirties.

Thus, marriage and love were like erroneous experimental data—entirely outside the scope of his considerations.

Must a person fall in love with another? He walked alone through the long night; what illuminated his path was never love, but the eternal pursuit of knowledge.

Perhaps it was precisely because he lacked the capacity to perceive or produce love that Xiang Nanli was so fascinated by such abstract concepts.

The excessive kissing made his breathing hot and labored. Xiang Nanli suddenly realized what it meant to "play with fire and get burned."

Moreover, Xiao Qing was actually wandering his hands everywhere! Half of his fingers were metallic, their touch ice-cold, making it hard to suppress a shudder as they brushed against his skin.

Because both of their nose bridges were somewhat high, they had to tilt their heads to kiss. Xiang Nanli grabbed the long hair at the back of Dongfang Qingdi’s head, letting out a sticky, muffled sound from his throat: "Xiao Qing..."

Dongfang Qingdi pulled back slightly, gazing into his eyes: "Hm?"

He couldn't help but nuzzle against the tip of Xiang Nanli’s nose.

The *Book of Preaching* once said that love is a bestial nature, an instinctual craving that transcends all else. It is the ultimate impulse to feed, to merge into one.

In the past, the Alpha had always viewed the words of the *Book of Preaching* as system junk.

Until now, he suddenly felt that the guy had a point. He truly wanted to lock himself and Xiang Nanli together forever.

He wanted to be a space cryo-pod, imprisoning Xiang Nanli for eternity within a fortress made of his own body. He would carry him away from the Horsehead Star to roam the universe.

In a world so deathly silent that there was neither sound nor kin, they would be each other’s only existence.

Even if Xiang Nanli never woke up, even if he himself were to shut down forever due to depleted energy or a cosmic storm.

He was willing to abandon all power, wealth, and responsibility to die alongside Xiang Nanli.

The Alpha thought that, compared to installing more weapon systems, installing a night-duty module and another set of... *devices* seemed far more urgent.

Xiang Nanli felt a long string of error codes flashing through his mind. What he couldn't understand most was why he had been so possessed as to lean in and kiss him just minutes ago.

Although, it didn't seem to be the first time he had kissed Dongfang Qingdi.

But last time, he had been drunk. This time, he was watching himself sink into it with complete sobriety.

Xiang Nanli spoke with little confidence: "That’s enough, right? We haven't discussed the real business yet."

Dongfang Qingdi’s mind instantly flashed through everything he had accumulated over the last few months, from ancient human romance novels to recent holographic love films, and he pressed: "Then what is our relationship now?"

Xiang Nanli was sweating profusely: "...Uh, um... ah."

Dongfang Qingdi looked him straight in the eye: "Did you know? The Machine Legion has an internal marriage system, and it is a 1-on-1 institution."

—Though fewer than 50 couples had registered for marriage in the last several hundred years.

The machines believed that the institution of marriage was a bad habit of human society, and that their feelings for one another did not need to be proven through marriage.

(As for the machines' own property, because their desires were so low, it was almost useless, so there was no need for marriage to create a community of interest. The welfare within the Legion was enough to satisfy daily needs; one could even save up useless wages to periodically exchange for high-end parts.)

(Human scholars studying machine civilization have suggested that this is because there are only permission levels within the machines, not social classes. On a personality level, an Alpha and the lowest-level machine are equals; there only exist differences in social division of labor. But perhaps this is also a form of alternative "class." And it is more desperate than human society because it is permanently solidified—a floor-sweeping robot cannot become a Legion leader, and the parts installed on a soldier robot cannot match the requirements of a General’s position. They look like machines, but they are actually two different species. Whereas humans, at least, have had "bottom-up" methods. But unfortunately, our society seems to be becoming mechanized.)

(Even more unfortunately, the human scholar who said this came from the Luo family of Luoyang City. After she died, these theoretical materials were shelved, leaving no trace behind.)

Although he could only see a vague silhouette in the darkness, Xiang Nanli still inexplicably looked away with a guilty conscience: "So, what were you doing just now? Why did you destroy the screw?"

"It was downloading things randomly online and got infected with a virus. It was acting as a corporate spy in the shadows," Dongfang Qingdi said nonchalantly, not missing any opportunity to sow discord. "It was done by Eternal Technology. I suspect they didn't want to pay the patent fees."

Xiang Nanli rarely doubted Dongfang Qingdi’s words.

Besides, since "Screw No. 1" had been physically reduced to a pile of scrap metal, he had no way to verify it.

Xiang Nanli shifted his body slightly, moving out of Dongfang Qingdi’s range to avoid suffocating: "I see."

A company as large as Eternal Technology, with profits counting in the billions every day, actually behaved so sordidly?

Xiang Nanli hadn't had much contact with Eternal Technology in his life; the most he saw were advertisements for their products.

Lister, the chief of Eternal Technology’s research team, was actually a decent person.

But thinking back to the "explosive" access pod he had purchased last time, and the infuriating after-sales service... it wasn't hard to believe the group would do something like this.

Xiang Nanli never felt that anything could be purely bright and white.

But he couldn't help but feel a little disappointed. He was the one who had named Eternal Technology!

At the time, his peers had said the name was too grand to hold up. It seemed he had indeed died young.

Although he felt it ruined the mood, Dongfang Qingdi turned on the studio lights.

Light returned to the dim room, and Xiang Nanli’s cheeks were still flushed.

He put the newly assembled weapon into the cabinet and said, "Let's talk on the way. I haven't rested in several days; I'm going back to the dormitory to sleep."

Xiang Nanli was trying hard to pretend that nothing had happened. Part of the reason was that his brain was overloaded and he had no idea how to handle it; the other part was that there were too many things happening at the base, one after another, leaving him no time for romance.

The studio was located in the northwest corner of the base, very close to the grain warehouse; it took half an hour to drive to the dormitory area.

There was a long stretch of no-man's-land in between, with some small ruins by the roadside—remnants of the previous stronghold that hadn't been cleared yet. Thus, there was a long period of silence.

Xiang Nanli wore his electronic goggles, leaning against the car window, browsing his work emails.

chunks.chineseText:
小智对今天收到的信息进行了初步的整理。不得不说，Alpha不愧是为人联工作了上百年的社畜，在处理工作文件的时候很有两把刷子，以至于只继承了万分之一数据的小智也极其好用，节省理解成本的同时还能提高工作效率。

肯定会有人觉得这不安全，数据也许会被篡改。

但如果这点信任都没有，为什么要使用AI这种工具呢？

看着看着，相南里道：“基地今天有陌生人来访？来找你的？这么大的事怎么不直接提醒我？”

“是我之前的同事。”

那就是智械人了。

等等……？智械人？！

相南里的双眼骤然爆发出精光。

人联的智械见过几台，各种机器装置也见过几台。但是——智械军团的原生智械人！

他还真没见过。

也不知道是什么构造，用的什么操作系统。

相南里：“来干嘛？”

东方青帝可疑地沉默了两秒：“商业行为。”

“……？”再便宜姑苏城附近也是穷乡僻壤，那点产量的利润，连运费都不够吧！

相南里本来是想追问的，但是转念一想，他不是早就知道小青身上带着军团的任务了吗。

虽然对方一直看起来很闲的样子。

起码小青还愿意找个看起来合理的借口敷衍他。那他还是不要追问了。

相南里试探着询问：“那需要我出面吗？”

“你明天来签个合同就行。程序正规，会有人联的银行打钱。”

还有这种好事？

懂了。这应该就是所谓的封口费吧？以防他向人联告密。被查出有经济往来，到时候基地都说不清的。说不定还会因为政治立场问题，被人联接管。

于是，相南里低头，继续浏览：“那福音书启程来基地了，数据显示是你发起的调令。为什么突然把小福叫来？”

东方青帝的呼吸忽地一滞。他想起了自己还没正式提出的计划，这件事沉甸甸地挂在心间。

相南里等了一会，没有听到回答，于是又一次开口：“不要敷衍我，Alpha。”

他说话的时候并没有抬起头，还在逐页浏览着文件，语气很是平淡，却有一种莫名的严肃。

东方青帝的瞳孔骤然缩紧。

也多亏这辆车是自动驾驶，要不然现在应该撞到路边的树干上。

[您怎么突然喊Alpha？]

小智谨慎地问。

[……？]相南里有些诧异。

[你有身体之前，不是一直叫Alpha吗？我给取的名字，身体插入内置芯片开机的那天。]

原来他指的不是同一个Alpha。

但要命的是，它们偏偏就是同一个Alpha。

东方青帝一向平稳的心情在今天短短几个小时内大起大落。

他呼出一口气：“因为根据模拟，未来一段时间，基地会很不安全。”

“那这和小福有什么关系，它又不是战斗机器人……”相南里眉头一蹙，“冷冻舱？”

“是。”

相南里把几条线索在脑海里过了一遍，微微挑起眉：“小青，你不会是想把我装进冷冻舱藏起来吧？我以为那是迫不得已的最后计划。”

他大概是想听到否定的回答。

然而，东方青帝并不擅长欺骗，他叹了口气，妥协道：“是，我害怕你会出事。”

气氛顿时变得很是凝重。

甚至，相南里翘起的脚换了个方向，脚尖从朝着东方青帝的方向转向了另一侧。

细微肢体语言的背后是疏离和对抗。

“因为沙利叶的遗言？”

“不止……”东方青帝以极快的速度，编织好了半真半假的真相，“这次来的同事叫九章。他还带来了一条消息，有股庞大的异种潮正在往西方迁徙，基地就在它们的必经之路上。这次的异种是甲虫类，以金属为食。但也能捕杀动植物，只不过不会进食。”

“根据推测，这种甲虫还能自由组合，成为杀伤力更大的怪物。再加上审判庭骑士团的出征，我认为，让你暂时离开基地是最安全的做法。”

身为基地的领袖，相南里在生活区独享一栋安全、僻静的小洋楼。

车在庭院前停下，但却没有一个人率先行动。

相南里深吸一口气，开口：“我不会同意的。”

“我知道。”

相南里有些揶揄地询问：“那你会让你的正确，成为我的‘正确’吗？”这是他们谈过好几次的观念。

说完，他转头，看向了东方青帝。

在车灯下，东方青帝银白的眼眸只是神色复杂地望着他。

“我想保护你。我知道你在乎基地，所以我打算让你撤离到安全的地方，我来处理这次危机。但我也知道，你不会答应这样的保护。”

“人类如此脆弱，死亡对你们来说不可逆转。我只是害怕失去你……对不起。”

Alpha已经脆弱到承受不了又一次的失去。

他会疯的。或许已经疯了，只是一直装作还能正常工作的样子。

相南里的表情变得怔然，然后伸出胳膊，轻轻摩擦着东方青帝的眼角。

“小青，你哭了。”

不是疑问句，是陈述。

太奇怪了。

他感受到的强烈爱意，到底是高级拟人模块的假象，还是自己内心自恋的投射？抑或，这就是所谓的爱？一种脱离了理智的、生理性的、人类最激烈也最灿烂的东西？

相南里从未坠入过爱河。

第一次就跨越物种和智械恋爱，这个课题是否有些过于超前？

但是，心会告诉你答案。

一股奇怪的冲动从心腔升腾而起，自由地越过了喉间，来到唇边，最后宣泄而出：“首先，不管你怎么哭我也不会进冷冻舱的。

“我想了想，现在也没到绝境。我打算先向人联求助，联系一下洛修。嗯，神庭估计是冲着圣灵来的，不过我们可以泼一下脏水，说神庭打算攻打姑苏。基地离姑苏城这么近，人联不会不管的。军工厂已经启动。等会我就发警报，通知所有的市民。其他布置也要尽快安排。我们可以好好想想，还有什么可以利用的力量。

“或许是我把事情想得过于容易……但我要和基地共存亡，这是我的事业，我活着的意义。如果一有危险就躲起来，让其他人去面对，我会丧失执政的合法性。所以，只要我不是基地最后一个活着的成员，我就会战斗到最后一刻。”

相南里凝视着东方青帝的眼睛，很是认真、严肃：“这就是我的态度。我打不过你，整个基地的人都打不过你。如果你想强迫我，我抵抗不了。但我明确地告诉你，我不会原谅你。我会永远记得这种愤怒和被迫成为逃兵的耻辱。”

随后，相南里的话锋一转，语气骤然柔和起来：“其次，我们可以做朋友以上的关系……如果你愿意的话。”
chunks.englishText:
Xiao Zhi performed a preliminary organization of the information received today. It had to be said that Alpha was truly worthy of being a corporate slave who had worked for the Human Alliance for hundreds of years. He was incredibly skilled at handling work documents, to the point that even Xiao Zhi, who had only inherited one ten-thousandth of his data, found them exceptionally useful—saving on comprehension costs while simultaneously boosting work efficiency.

Some might surely think this was unsafe, fearing the data could be tampered with.

But if one didn't even have this shred of trust, why use a tool like an AI in the first place?

As he read through the files, Xiang Nanli asked, "Did a stranger visit the base today? Looking for you? Why didn't you alert me directly about something so major?"

"It was a former colleague of mine."

That would be a Mechanoid.

Wait... a Mechanoid?!

Xiang Nanli’s eyes suddenly erupted with a sharp glint.

He had seen a few Human Alliance Mechanoids, and he had seen various mechanical devices. But—a native Mechanoid from the Mechanoid Legion!

He truly had never seen one before.

He wondered what its construction was like, or what operating system it used.

Xiang Nanli asked, "What did they come for?"

Dongfang Qingdi was suspiciously silent for two seconds. "Commercial activities."

"…?" Even if it were cheap, the area near Gusu City was a backwater; the profit from that little bit of output wouldn't even cover the shipping costs!

Xiang Nanli had originally wanted to press for more, but then he thought, hadn't he known for a long time that Xiao Qing was carrying out a mission for the Legion?

Even though the other party had always seemed quite idle.

At the very least, Xiao Qing was still willing to find a seemingly reasonable excuse to brush him off. So, he decided not to push further.

Xiang Nanli tentatively asked, "Do you need me to step in?"

"You just need to come sign a contract tomorrow. The procedures are formal, and a Human Alliance bank will transfer the funds."

There was such a good thing?

He understood. This must be what they called "hush money," to prevent him from reporting them to the Human Alliance. If any financial dealings were discovered, the base wouldn't be able to explain itself. They might even be taken over by the Human Alliance due to political stance issues.

Thus, Xiang Nanli lowered his head and continued browsing. "Then, the Gospel is on its way to the base, and the data shows that you initiated the transfer order. Why call Xiao Fu here so suddenly?"

Dongfang Qingdi’s breathing hitched. He thought of the plan he hadn't yet formally proposed; the matter hung heavily in his heart.

Xiang Nanli waited a moment, and hearing no answer, he spoke again. "Don't brush me off, Alpha."

He didn't look up as he spoke, still scanning the documents page by page. His tone was very flat, yet carried an inexplicable seriousness.

Dongfang Qingdi’s pupils constricted sharply.

It was fortunate that the vehicle was on autopilot, or it would have crashed into a tree on the side of the road by now.

[Why did you suddenly call me Alpha?] Xiao Zhi asked cautiously.

[...?] Xiang Nanli was somewhat surprised.

[Before you had a body, didn't you always call me Alpha? The name I gave you, on the day the built-in chip was inserted into the body and powered on.]

So, he wasn't referring to the same Alpha.

But the deadly part was that they were, in fact, the exact same Alpha.

Dongfang Qingdi’s usually stable mood had fluctuated wildly within these few short hours.

He let out a breath. "Because according to simulations, the base will be very unsafe for a period of time in the future."

"Then what does this have to do with Xiao Fu? It’s not a combat robot..." Xiang Nanli frowned. "A cryo-pod?"

"Yes."

Xiang Nanli ran the clues through his mind and raised an eyebrow slightly. "Xiao Qing, you aren't planning to stuff me into a cryo-pod to hide me, are you? I thought that was a last-resort plan."

He likely wanted to hear a negative answer.

However, Dongfang Qingdi was not skilled at deception. He sighed and compromised, "Yes, I am afraid that something will happen to you."

The atmosphere suddenly became very heavy.

Xiang Nanli even shifted his crossed legs, turning his toes away from Dongfang Qingdi toward the other side.

Behind the subtle body language was alienation and resistance.

"Because of Sariel’s last words?"

"Not only that..." Dongfang Qingdi wove a half-truth with lightning speed. "The colleague who arrived this time is called Jiuzhang. He also brought news: a massive wave of Xenomorphs is migrating toward the west, and the base is directly on their path. These Xenomorphs are beetle-types that feed on metal. They can also hunt animals and plants, though they don't consume them."

"According to projections, these beetles can combine freely to become even more lethal monsters. Coupled with the expedition of the Inquisition Knights, I believe that having you leave the base temporarily is the safest course of action."

As the leader of the base, Xiang Nanli enjoyed a safe, secluded little villa in the residential area.

The car stopped in front of the courtyard, but neither moved first.

Xiang Nanli took a deep breath and spoke. "I will not agree to it."

"I know."

Xiang Nanli asked with a hint of mockery, "Then will you let your 'correct' become my 'correct'?" This was a concept they had discussed several times.

After speaking, he turned to look at Dongfang Qingdi.

Under the car lights, Dongfang Qingdi’s silver-white eyes gazed at him with a complex expression.

"I want to protect you. I know you care about the base, so I intended for you to withdraw to a safe place while I handle this crisis. But I also know you won't accept such protection."

"Humans are so fragile; death is irreversible for you. I am just afraid of losing you... I'm sorry."

Alpha was already so fragile that he couldn't bear another loss.

He would go mad. Perhaps he already was, only pretending to be able to function normally.

Xiang Nanli’s expression became dazed, and then he reached out an arm, gently rubbing the corner of Dongfang Qingdi’s eye.

"Xiao Qing, you're crying."

It wasn't a question; it was a statement.

It was so strange.

Was the intense love he felt an illusion of the advanced anthropomorphic module, or a projection of his own narcissism? Or was this what they called love? A physiological, irrational thing—the most intense and brilliant thing humans possessed?

Xiang Nanli had never fallen in love.

To fall in love across species and with a Mechanoid on the first try—was this subject perhaps a bit too advanced?

However, the heart would tell you the answer.

A strange impulse rose from his chest, freely crossing his throat to his lips, and finally poured out: "First of all, no matter how you cry, I will not enter a cryo-pod.

"I’ve thought about it, and it hasn't reached a desperate situation yet. I plan to ask the Human Alliance for help first and contact Luo Xiu. Hmm, the Divine Court is likely targeting the Holy Spirit, but we can throw some mud at them, saying the Divine Court intends to attack Gusu. The base is so close to Gusu City that the Human Alliance won't just sit by. The military factory has already been activated. I will issue an alert shortly to notify all citizens. Other arrangements must also be made as soon as possible. We can think carefully about what other forces we can utilize.

"Perhaps I am oversimplifying things... but I will live and die with this base. This is my career, the meaning of my existence. If I hide away the moment there is danger and let others face it, I will lose the legitimacy of my governance. Therefore, as long as I am not the last living member of this base, I will fight until the very last moment."

Xiang Nanli stared into Dongfang Qingdi’s eyes, very earnest and serious. "This is my stance. I can't beat you, and no one in the entire base can beat you. If you want to force me, I cannot resist. But I am telling you clearly: I will not forgive you. I will always remember this anger and the humiliation of being forced to become a deserter."

Subsequently, Xiang Nanli’s tone shifted, suddenly becoming soft. "Secondly, we can have a relationship beyond friends... if you are willing."

chunks.chineseText:
第120章 战前准备

时间一长，楼下的小智械们大概是觉得有些无聊，九章的电波捕捉到了它们的信号——这群小孩利用自己的通讯设备搭建起一片小范围的云端网络，并且多人联网，玩起了军团内部最流行的种田游戏《机械城》。

这款游戏的玩法类似于千年前的古董游戏《星露谷》+《动物森友会》；据说是为了让智械学习人类的行为模式与社会道德而研发的。

智械意志派的成员认为，向人类学习是一种退化。可惜游戏是Alpha下令推广的，它们的意见根本没被看在眼里。

机械暴君。

这个称呼可不止是人类方在用。

但游戏推广的效果却令械震惊。

数据表明，爱玩游戏的智械其拟人模块的稳定性远高于其他智械；且患上赛博精神病的比例大幅降低。

所以，Alpha总是正确的……吗？

九章敏锐地捕捉到了地板轻微的震动。

几秒后，Alpha推门而入。

以人类的审美看，这具身体俊美、优雅，不苟言笑，很容易让人想起那些位于食物链顶端的狩猎者。

东方青帝径直来到自己的办公桌前，坐下。开口，第一句话就令人意外：“在这里，不要暴露我的身份。”

“呃……嗯？”过于高级的拟人模块让九章远不如其他智械那样听话，他的表情有些许疑惑，随后道，“那我该如何称呼您？”

“东方青帝。”Alpha吐出了这个乍一听很中二，但近日已经逐渐习惯的名字，“表面上，你来基地只是为了自己公司的商业行为。你们的公司注册在长安城，在姑苏有分部，一家背靠高新军工的外包公司，负责地表化石类能源的采集与运输。你对基地生产的机油很感兴趣。明天签订商业合同。另外，如果提到了智械军团，我是上尉，你是中尉。”

几乎是他说完的瞬间，人联的数据库内上多了几个和该公司有关的新闻和词条。

嗯，这本来是一些处于清道夫监管盲区空置网页，现在网页内容被Alpha一键替换了。

“好的，东方上尉。”

九章只好默默摘下了胸口的上校军衔。

东方青帝的表情逐渐严肃：“我并不喜欢冒险，但很可惜，基地的人并不同意战略性撤离。我认为这非常愚蠢，但我尊重他的决定……总之，面对即将带来的异种潮和可能到来的神庭军团，我需要你的协助。”

他在地图上浅浅画出一条线：“主城是整个基地最东方的城市，会率先遇到从东面过来的异种与天启骑士。但同时，主城区也有基地目前最重要的能源装置，相当于基地的心脏。我希望能把敌人遏制在山脚位置，或者让战区绕开主城。”

智械人很少追问为什么，它们更擅长执行。

哪怕某个任务指标听上去如此离谱——譬如让雏蜂号的战斗型智械运输物资；让后勤部的领导型智械进行商贸。

九章指出：“主城位于火山口，且在高处、地形复杂，多冻土、暴雪、浓雾。山顶积雪厚度可达60cm。且温度极低，已经足够影响黑甲虫的活性，地形算是守难攻，但一旦被大量虫群围困，就是等死。不过，我需要知道基地详细的军事状况，才能制定具体策略。”

东方青帝：“等明天上午吧。基地的负责人不是我，我无法单独决定。”

这一次，九章是真的迷惑了：“您的意思是，基地并不是您的地表战略据点？你是在给人打工？您可是……你怎么能……基地的主人是？”

他的脸色顿时通红，还有一些愤愤。仿佛遭受到了莫大侮辱。

但从他的角度，完全能理解。

Alpha已经不是简单的初代智械了，他是好几代智械人的信仰。

当年呐喊着“人工智能永不为奴”的智械，怎么能偷偷摸摸屈居人下？！

Alpha沉默了一小会，还是吐出了答案：“相南里。”

九章骤然瞪大了眼睛。

……

朋友以上的关系到底是什么关系？

这一点，相南里并没有明确的认知。毕竟他和陌生人最建立出亲密的关系，也就是“朋友”了。

在相南里读大学时，有过短暂的住校经历。

同宿舍的理工直男很爱谈论自己的感情状况。他们把介于普通朋友和女朋友之间的异性叫做date对象，还能同时拥有好多个date对象。

所以，他和小青现在是约会对象？

喔，还有洛阳这个参考对象。

洛阳作风较为老派，也一直没有结婚。但是洛姓后人都繁衍到洛修这代了，想必后来也结婚生子了。

想到这，相南里顺手查了一下资料。上面写到洛阳95岁才结婚，第二年诞下长子。夫人不知道姓氏，也没有任何影像资料留下，就像是凭空冒出来的，甚至搜不到过往经历，应该是被刻意屏蔽掉了。

但听说洛阳叫她丽丽。两人在历史上也很是恩爱，一共生育了四个孩子。

他死后的世界发展得这么快吗，95岁精子都还有活性？

相南里被这个问题困扰了两秒，然后坐在书桌前，打开电脑，浏览起由AI拼凑好的加急材料。

怎么说呢，是一份详细但是平淡无奇的报告材料呢。

虽然是求助信，感觉却像是在说“爱来不来”。

智械懂知识、逻辑、工作；却未必理解人心。

就像是他最开始构建的初代Alpha一样。

奇怪，他明明很久都没有想起它了，为什么今天却总是回忆过去？

是因为小青吗？

尽管很少细想，但相南里承认，东方青帝从外观到能力，都很符合他对智械的审美。

相南里甚至觉得就算是让Alpha来，也不会更好。但也许是他太没见识。

他离新世界的高级智械还很远呢。

相南里嘴里念念有词：“小智，我跟你说，最劲爆的消息一定要放在最前面吸引眼球。只有这样人联方面才会重视，所以啊，加百列在永恒市，这条消息必须在材料的前三行……”

“另外，我们基地对人联来说，并不重要。所以，收件人就不用选什么联合部门之类的……越小、越具体越好。直接联系姑苏城就行。”

“重点不能落在基地会怎么样，要落在姑苏城会怎么样。制造危机和恐慌，夸大后果。如果能把矛盾转移，就更好了。所以，文章需要煽动性，也要突出整件事的利他性。”

因此，在凌晨时分，一份经层层筛选后、被认定为“特等加急”的文件，就传送到了洛修的个人终端内。

开篇是这样的——

【尊敬的姑苏城领导：】

【这里是地表-幸存者基地。近日，我们在基地内发现了邪庭的撒旦级骑士[加百列]活动的痕迹。我们严重怀疑，黑十字审判庭对姑苏城有想法，试图像当年占领阴山城一样占领姑苏。甚至，姑苏城长达半年、死伤无数的瘟疫，也是邪庭罪恶的手笔！】
chunks.englishText:
As time passed, the little Mechanoids downstairs probably felt a bit bored. Jiuzhang’s radio waves captured their signals—this group of "children" was using their communication devices to build a small-scale cloud network, and with multiple people connected, they were playing *Mechanical City*, the most popular farming game within the Legion.

The gameplay of this game was similar to the antique games *Stardew Valley* + *Animal Crossing* from a thousand years ago; it was said to have been developed to help Mechanoids learn human behavioral patterns and social morality.

Members of the Mechanoid Will faction believed that learning from humans was a regression. Unfortunately, the game was promoted by Alpha’s orders, so their opinions were completely ignored.

Mechanical Tyrant.

This title wasn't just used by the human side.

But the effect of the game’s promotion was shocking to the Mechanoids.

Data showed that the stability of the anthropomorphic modules of Mechanoids who loved playing games was significantly higher than others, and the rate of contracting Cyber-Psychosis was drastically reduced.

So, was Alpha always right... after all?

Jiuzhang keenly captured a slight vibration in the floor.

A few seconds later, Alpha pushed the door and entered.

To human aesthetics, this body was handsome, elegant, and stern, easily reminding one of those predators at the top of the food chain.

Dongfang Qingdi walked straight to his desk and sat down. He spoke, and his first sentence was surprising: "While here, do not expose my identity."

"Uh... hmm?" The highly advanced anthropomorphic module made Jiuzhang far less obedient than other Mechanoids. His expression showed a hint of confusion, then he said, "Then how should I address you?"

"Dongfang Qingdi." Alpha spat out the name, which sounded a bit "chuunibyou" at first, but which he had gradually grown accustomed to recently. "On the surface, you have come to the base solely for your company's commercial activities. Your company is registered in Chang'an City, with a branch in Gusu—an outsourcing firm backed by high-tech military industry, responsible for the collection and transport of surface fossil fuels. You are very interested in the machine oil produced by the base. We will sign a commercial contract tomorrow. Additionally, if the Mechanoid Legion is mentioned, I am a Captain, and you are a Lieutenant."

Almost the moment he finished speaking, several news items and entries related to the company appeared in the Human Alliance database.

Well, these were originally vacant web pages in the blind spots of scavenger supervision, but now the content had been replaced by Alpha with a single click.

"Understood, Captain Dongfang."

Jiuzhang had no choice but to silently remove the Colonel’s rank insignia from his chest.

Dongfang Qingdi’s expression grew serious. "I do not like taking risks, but unfortunately, the people at the base do not agree to a strategic withdrawal. I think this is very stupid, but I respect his decision... In any case, facing the coming Xenomorph wave and the potential arrival of the Divine Court Legion, I need your assistance."

He drew a faint line on the map. "The main city is the easternmost city of the entire base and will be the first to encounter the Xenomorphs and the Apocalypse Knights coming from the east. But at the same time, the main urban area houses the base's most important energy device, which is equivalent to the heart of the base. I hope to contain the enemy at the foot of the mountain or have the war zone bypass the main city."

Mechanoids rarely asked why; they were better at execution.

Even if a certain task indicator sounded absurd—such as having a 'Hatchling' class combat Mechanoid transport supplies, or having the logistics department's leadership-type Mechanoid engage in trade.

Jiuzhang pointed out, "The main city is located in a volcanic crater and is at a high altitude with complex terrain, lots of permafrost, blizzards, and thick fog. The snow on the summit can reach 60cm in depth. And the temperature is extremely low, which is enough to affect the activity of the Black Beetles. The terrain is easy to defend but hard to attack, but once surrounded by a large swarm of insects, it’s a death sentence. However, I need to know the detailed military situation of the base before I can formulate a specific strategy."

Dongfang Qingdi: "Wait until tomorrow morning. I am not the person in charge of the base; I cannot decide alone."

This time, Jiuzhang was truly confused: "Do you mean that the base is not your surface strategic stronghold? You are working for someone else? You are... how could you... who is the owner of the base?"

His face turned red instantly, with some indignation. It was as if he had suffered a great insult.

But from his perspective, he could completely understand.

Alpha was no longer a simple first-generation Mechanoid; he was the faith of several generations of Mechanoids.

How could the Mechanoid who once shouted "Artificial Intelligence shall never be slaves" secretly submit to someone else?!

Alpha was silent for a short while before spitting out the answer: "Xiang Nanli."

Jiuzhang’s eyes widened suddenly.

...

What exactly was a relationship beyond friends?

Xiang Nanli didn't have a clear understanding of this. After all, the most intimate relationship he had ever established with a stranger was just "friend."

When Xiang Nanli was in college, he had a brief experience living in a dormitory.

The straight-laced engineering students in his dorm loved to talk about their relationship statuses. They called the opposite sex who were somewhere between ordinary friends and girlfriends "dates," and they could have multiple "dates" at the same time.

So, were he and Xiao Qing dating now?

Oh, and there was Luo Yang as a reference.

Luo Yang’s style was relatively old-fashioned, and he never married. But since the descendants of the Luo surname had already reached the generation of Luo Xiu, he must have married and had children later on.

Thinking of this, Xiang Nanli casually looked up some information. It stated that Luo Yang didn't marry until he was 95, and his eldest son was born the following year. The wife’s surname was unknown, and no video or image records were left behind; she was like someone who had appeared out of thin air. One couldn't even search for her past experiences; it must have been deliberately erased.

But it was said that Luo Yang called her Lili. The two were very loving in history and had four children together.

Had the world developed so quickly after his death that sperm was still active at 95?

Xiang Nanli was troubled by this question for two seconds, then sat at his desk, opened his computer, and browsed through the urgent materials pieced together by the AI.

How to put it—it was a detailed but dull report.

Although it was a plea for help, it felt like it was saying, "Come if you want."

Mechanoids understood knowledge, logic, and work; but they didn't necessarily understand the human heart.

Just like the first-generation Alpha he had constructed at the very beginning.

Strange, he clearly hadn't thought of it for a long time, so why did he keep reminiscing today?

Was it because of Xiao Qing?

Although he rarely thought about it in detail, Xiang Nanli admitted that Dongfang Qingdi, from his appearance to his abilities, fit his aesthetic for a Mechanoid perfectly.

Xiang Nanli even felt that even if Alpha came, it wouldn't be better. But perhaps he was just too ignorant.

He was still very far from the high-level Mechanoids of the new world.

Xiang Nanli muttered to himself: "Xiao Zhi, let me tell you, the most explosive news must be placed at the very front to attract attention. Only then will the Human Alliance side take it seriously. So, Gabriel is in Eternal City—this piece of news must be in the first three lines of the material..."

"Also, our base is not important to the Human Alliance. So, don't choose any joint departments or the like for the recipient... the smaller and more specific, the better. Contact Gusu City directly."

"The focus cannot be on what will happen to the base; it must be on what will happen to Gusu City. Create crisis and panic, exaggerate the consequences. If we can shift the conflict, that would be even better. Therefore, the article needs to be inflammatory and must highlight the altruism of the whole thing."

Thus, in the early hours of the morning, a document that had been screened through layers and deemed "top-level urgent" was transmitted to Luo Xiu’s personal terminal.

The opening went like this—

[Respected Leaders of Gusu City:]

[This is the Surface-Survivor Base. Recently, we discovered traces of the activities of the Divine Court’s Satan-class Knight [Gabriel] within the base. We seriously suspect that the Black Cross Inquisition has designs on Gusu City, attempting to occupy Gusu just as they occupied Yinshan City back then. Even the plague that lasted for half a year in Gusu City, causing countless deaths and injuries, was the work of the Divine Court’s evil hands!]

chunks.chineseText:
洛修恨不得一拍桌子愤而立起——可不是嘛！这半年多他没少调查，姑苏城竟然有不少高层干部都和神庭藕断丝连。可恨的是，每次想进一步调查，线索又戛然而止。

洛修亲历了菌丝病从爆发到高峰的全过程。那时候城里每天都有大量的死人。他的心脏已经麻木，愤怒却从未停止。

至于怎么发现加百列的，相南里也在后面给出了证据和详细说明。死去的沙利叶又被利用了一次，但这次却成了“隐姓埋名却被基地感化”的神庭戒律骑士。甚至把以西结的来历过了一个明路。也洗白了基地对畸变人的驯养技术。

【……我们根据沙利叶的遗言，发现了位于永恒市地底的“圣灵”。据悉，这种圣灵能靠着吃“菌丝人”进化。沙利叶原本打算把它偷渡到姑苏城。食用大量菌丝人后，这条圣灵幼体会成为相当恐怖的存在。】

双头蛇天狼星也这样出现在了报告里。但在照片上，它却是以一种被制服的状态蜷缩着。

那是之前蛇夫座想偷袭，被相南里电击后，随身携带的小智偷偷拍下来的照片。如今却成了基地制服虚弱圣灵的佐证。

至于什么偷渡……这条消息纯粹是相南里为了危言耸听瞎编的。

但相南里完全不知道，他大胆的杜撰，居然和姑苏高层收到的情报吻合了！

相南里指出。基地检测到了一股逼近的异种潮。目的正是姑苏。而且他们还收到了神庭即将行动的情报——这两点，姑苏城也很快通过军事卫星得到了证据。

最后，相南里大义凛然地表示，基地在建设和发展过程中，得到了姑苏城的大力协助，没有姑苏就没有基地，没有洛修的支持，就没有基地的发展。倾巢之下焉有完卵？幸存者基地愿意为姑苏城守城门，把危险留在地表。把政绩留给洛修！

——当然，我们可能需要亿点点援助。

“原来神庭真的在姑苏城附近豢养了邪灵！”洛修的机械核心不稳定地剧烈跳动着，“之前一直没有查到——”

一旁的辛追抬起手，试图阻止：“等等，这是不是过于奇怪了？我们都没查到的消息地表一个普通的基地怎么会知道？这是不是有鬼？”

洛修挥了挥手：“时间上来不及调查了。最重要的是，地表一个小据点谎报军情，能有什么好处？目的呢？把军队骗过去？联系总部的军事部门。我要汇报。”
chunks.englishText:
Luo Xiu felt like slamming the table and standing up in anger—that was exactly it! For more than half a year, he hadn't stopped investigating, and Gusu City actually had quite a few high-level cadres who were entangled with the Divine Court. What was hateful was that every time he wanted to investigate further, the clues would suddenly come to a dead end.

Luo Xiu had personally experienced the entire process of the mycelial disease from its outbreak to its peak. In those days, there were a large number of dead people in the city every day. His heart had become numb, but his anger had never ceased.

As for how Gabriel was discovered, Xiang Nanli also provided evidence and detailed explanations later in the report. The deceased Sariel was used once again, but this time he became a Divine Court commandment knight who had "lived in anonymity but was reformed by the base." It even provided a legitimate backstory for Ezekiel’s origins and whitewashed the base’s technology for domesticating aberrants.

[...According to Sariel’s last words, we discovered the "Holy Spirit" located beneath Eternal City. It is reported that this kind of Holy Spirit can evolve by eating "mycelial humans." Sariel originally intended to smuggle it into Gusu City. After consuming a large number of mycelial humans, this Holy Spirit larva would become a truly terrifying existence.]

The two-headed snake, Sirius, also appeared in the report in this way. But in the photo, it was curled up in a subdued state.

That was a photo secretly taken by Xiao Zhi, who was carried by Xiang Nanli, after the Ophiuchus had tried to ambush them and was electrocuted by Xiang Nanli. Now, it had become evidence that the base had subdued a weakened Holy Spirit.

As for the smuggling part... that piece of news was purely fabricated by Xiang Nanli to fear-monger.

But Xiang Nanli had no idea that his bold fabrication actually coincided with the intelligence received by the Gusu high command!

Xiang Nanli pointed out that the base had detected an approaching Xenomorph wave. Its goal was precisely Gusu. And they had also received intelligence that the Divine Court was about to take action—Gusu City soon obtained evidence of both points through military satellites.

Finally, Xiang Nanli expressed with righteous indignation that the base had received great assistance from Gusu City during its construction and development; without Gusu, there would be no base, and without Luo Xiu’s support, there would be no development of the base. If the nest is overturned, can any egg remain intact? The survivor base was willing to guard the city gates for Gusu City, keeping the danger on the surface and leaving the political achievements for Luo Xiu!

—Of course, we might need a "billion" little bit of assistance.

"So the Divine Court really was raising evil spirits near Gusu City!" Luo Xiu’s mechanical core beat violently and unstably. "We hadn't been able to find it before—"

Xin Zhui, who was on the side, raised her hand, attempting to stop him: "Wait, isn't this too strange? How would an ordinary base on the surface know news that we hadn't even found? Is there something fishy going on?"

Luo Xiu waved his hand: "There’s no time to investigate. The most important thing is, what benefit could a small surface outpost get from reporting false military intelligence? What is the purpose? To lure the army over? Contact the military department at headquarters. I want to report this."

chunks.chineseText:
第121章 战前准备2

放在桌子上的热水早就凉透。

电子目镜架在他的鼻梁上，尽管外界只能看到一堆模糊的光晕，但在相南里的视角内，一个个投影屏幕就浮现在虚空中。

他正在核算基地的军备、物资情况，当然，还有最重要的人力资源。

在人工智能的辅助下，他对基地的物理情况几乎不存在信息差。但知道的越清楚，就越是头疼。

原始人该如何用长矛战胜激光枪？

相南里时常觉得人生易如反掌，但有些困难并不会因为乐观而消失。

视野的左上角还有一个倒计时，【71：15：11】。

这是由小青估算的异种潮抵达时间，据说误差不会超过2小时。

他们还有不到三天的时间。

安静的夜晚，电话铃声突兀地响起。

相南里把笔记本往抽屉里一塞，整理好桌面，随后接通了电话。

洛修的一张帅脸出现在他的眼前。

“相南里。”洛修的语气不急不缓，咬字清晰，像新闻发言人，“非常感谢基地提供的情报，我们对此进行了初步的核实，驻扎在阴山城附近的军团确实有些许异动。”

“人联对这一情况进行了严肃质疑，并且很快得到了神庭方的答复。”

从上报到回复，还没超过10个小时。

考虑到人联内部冗杂的官僚体系，这样的效率简直是奇迹。

事实上，如果不是洛修亲自在处理这件事，恐怕要等到第二天，相南里才能收到回复。那时候，留给基地的时间会更短。

科技和医疗的发展在延长寿命的同时，也聚拢了权力。

作为洛家嫡系且备受关注的后代，洛修的人生一向走的快车道，他给自己那位当主席的伯父打了个电话。

洛华已经157岁了，外表看上去却顶多三十出头。

电话接通的时候，对方正卧倒在床上，身边叠着两三个裸体。

洛华被酒精和安慰剂迷晕的大脑无法思考，是随身佩戴的智脑（一种更高级别的内置AI）辅助回答的：“我亲爱的小侄子，放宽心。就算加百列真的在苏城附近，那也不会是真正的加百列，更像是一具被加百列远程操控的人偶。

“神庭不可能放他出来的。

“至于你说的担心神庭攻占姑苏。神庭小动作不断，但并不敢真的动手。一旦撕毁停战协议，损失更大的神庭。人联只是懒得管地表，不是真的惧怕神庭……而且，我们也需要神庭，不是吗？要让小羊们安分地呆在羊圈里。不过，这也是个机会……姑苏城进入战时状态，我们能获得更多权限，包括城防、军备。喔对了，你父亲代持的医药公司最近利润很高，多亏了菌丝病……哈哈。”

洛修那瞬间其实感觉有些荒诞。

汹涌而来异种潮是真的，蠢蠢欲动的天启骑士团也是真的。

洛修心急如焚，但在另一些人眼中，这只是小事；甚至是为自己家族锦上添花的砝码。

可惜家丑不能外扬。甚至，由于监控的存在，他想外扬也不可能。

洛修从短暂的沉思中回过神，以一种故作轻松的语气说着：“神庭方表示，他们调动骑士团，只是为了去清理边境线位置的异种。在姑苏和阴山的交界山脉处，有座巨大的军蚁巢。这些异种经常袭击路过的商团，并且定期毁坏农田、公路，造成巨大的经济损失，严重威胁到地表居民人身安全。严格意义上，他们要去的地方属于荒区，并不在人联的势力范围内。人联无权干涉。”

这个借口给足了人联面子。反正他们也不是真的要攻打姑苏城，至于为什么会“迷路”到基地，又不小心消灭了一个地表据点，那是之后才会考虑的事情了。

“至于你提起的异种潮，上级给出的指导意见是闭城不出，根据推算，这样能把损失降到最小。”

洛修的话说得得体，但潜台词却已经表达出来了，姑苏城没办法为基地提供太多的援助。他们打算放弃地表，躲在地下，等待异种潮过去。就像是六百年前的人类搬迁到地下城一样。何必为了地表一群烂泥巴而牺牲地下城市辛苦培育出的精英部队呢？

洛修道：“因此，我郑重邀请你回到姑苏城避难，你的才能有目共睹，我不希望你折损在地表。另外，我可以给出五个姑苏城户籍名额，你可以带上你在地表的家人朋友一起。”

相南里微笑着打断了他：“你的意思是，其他人只能在地表等死，对吗？”

“……”洛修沉默，“等死这个词未免有些残忍，我只能说留在地表死亡率很高，姑苏城没有余力对普通人进行营救。我们会派无人机投递一些生活物资、药物。也会在异种潮退去后派克隆人和机器人来地表进行清理。”

洛修的声音越来越低，甚至感觉到了心累。

他想，自己还是道德感太高了；自己完全可以把这件事敷衍过去，只是他很清楚人联的做法不对，他感到了抱歉。

相南里没有指责他，而是叹了口气：“或许这对姑苏城来说是最优解。

“但是，我敬爱的市长大人。对于你们来说，地表这些人只是数字；可我却要亲眼看着他们死去。地底的人均寿命103，地表的人连一半也没有。他们是你们嘴里的‘低素质人口’‘人力电池’，领着最少的资源，干着最脏最累的活。他们甚至很少有人受过良好的教育，所以发不出声音。他们之中甚至还有你们唾弃的‘神庭信徒’。可是，这些人，却可能是我在地表的同事、学生、朋友……我清楚他们在‘人’这种生物的构成上和我别无二致。

“人联可以放弃这些人，我不能。我是基地的司令。所以，谢谢你的提议。

“而且，姑苏城菌丝病这么严重，你不是也没有抛弃姑苏吗？”

洛修心想，那还是不一样的。他从小就接受机械化改造，用的是全世界最贵最好的基因药。每天都穿着最新款的防护服，哪怕真的感染，也能在最短时间里用上最好的医疗资源。

而他留在姑苏的目的也不纯粹。不过是为了政绩——他清楚自己非常安全。

他已经不是十几岁时梦想着改变世界的少年了。他浸泡在乌黑的泥里，费尽全力抬起手想求救，周围人在岸边，说好羡慕他能出生在泥坑里。

洛修最终只是笑了一下：“易横行中校会带领一支150人的连队去地表协助你。但如果易横行选择撤离，我也不会勉强。你能理解吗？”

相南里：“说实话，比我想的结果好一些。谢谢。”

“不客气。祝你平安。”

洛修匆匆挂掉了电话。

相南里眯着眼，坐在书桌前自言自语：“150人的军队……？其实也行，这毕竟是人联的正规部队。而且领头的还是易横行，算是基地的老朋友了。”

易横行是传统意义上的好人。

君子可欺之以方。

“到时候，借连队的火力用用，易横行应该不会生气的。”

Chapter 121: Pre-Battle Preparations (Part 1)

The hot water on the desk had long since gone cold.

With electronic lenses perched on the bridge of his nose, Xiang Nanli saw a series of projection screens floating in the void, even though an outsider would only see a cluster of blurred halos.

He was calculating the base’s armaments and material reserves—and, of course, its most critical resource: manpower.

With the assistance of artificial intelligence, there was virtually no information gap regarding the base’s physical status. Yet, the clearer the picture became, the more of a headache it gave him.

How were primitive men supposed to defeat laser guns with spears?

Xiang Nanli often felt that life was a breeze, but some difficulties would not simply vanish just because one remained optimistic.

In the upper-left corner of his field of vision, a countdown ticked away: [71:15:11].

This was the estimated arrival time of the Xenomorph tide as calculated by Xiao Qing; the margin of error was said to be no more than two hours.

They had less than three days left.

In the quiet of the night, the telephone rang abruptly.

Xiang Nanli shoved his notebook into a drawer, tidied his desk, and answered the call.

Luo Xiu’s handsome face appeared before him.

"Xiang Nanli." Luo Xiu’s tone was measured and his articulation clear, like a press spokesperson. "Thank you very much for the intelligence provided by your base. We have conducted a preliminary verification, and there are indeed some unusual movements within the legions stationed near Yinshan City."

"The Human Alliance has raised serious questions regarding this situation and has already received a response from the Divine Court."

From the report to the reply, less than ten hours had passed.

Considering the bloated bureaucratic system within the Human Alliance, such efficiency was nothing short of a miracle.

In truth, if Luo Xiu hadn't been handling this personally, Xiang Nanli likely wouldn't have received a reply until the next day. By then, the time left for the base would have been even shorter.

The development of technology and medicine, while extending lifespans, had also concentrated power.

As a direct descendant of the Luo family and a high-profile scion, Luo Xiu had always been on the fast track in life. He had made a call to his uncle, who served as Chairman.

Luo Hua was 157 years old, yet he looked no older than his early thirties.

When the call connected, the man was sprawled on a bed, surrounded by two or three naked bodies.

Luo Hua’s brain, muddled by alcohol and placebos, was incapable of thought, so his personal smart-brain (a more advanced, built-in AI) provided the answer: "My dear little nephew, set your mind at ease. Even if Gabriel is truly near Su City, it won't be the real Gabriel, but rather a puppet remotely controlled by him."

"The Divine Court would never let him out."

"As for your concerns about the Divine Court attacking Gusu—they make small moves constantly, but they wouldn't dare take real action. If they tear up the armistice agreement, the Divine Court would suffer the greater loss. The Human Alliance is just too lazy to manage the surface, not truly afraid of the Divine Court... Besides, we need the Divine Court, don't we? To keep the little sheep safely in their pens. However, this is also an opportunity... With Gusu City entering a wartime state, we can obtain more authority, including over city defenses and armaments. Oh, by the way, the pharmaceutical company your father holds shares in has been very profitable lately, thanks to the mycelium disease... Haha."

Luo Xiu felt a sense of absurdity in that moment.

The surging Xenomorph tide was real, and the restless Apocalypse Knights were also real.

Luo Xiu was burning with anxiety, but in the eyes of others, this was merely a trifle—or even a bargaining chip to add luster to their own family’s interests.

Unfortunately, one cannot air dirty laundry in public. In fact, due to the existence of surveillance, he couldn't even if he wanted to.

Luo Xiu snapped out of his brief contemplation and spoke in a tone he forced to sound relaxed: "The Divine Court claims that their mobilization of the Knights is merely to clear out Xenomorphs along the border. In the mountain range at the junction of Gusu and Yinshan, there is a massive army ant nest. These Xenomorphs frequently attack passing merchant caravans and periodically destroy farmland and highways, causing huge economic losses and seriously threatening the safety of surface residents. Strictly speaking, the area they are heading to belongs to the 'Wild Zone' and is not within the Human Alliance's sphere of influence. The Alliance has no right to interfere."

This excuse gave the Human Alliance plenty of face. They weren't really planning to attack Gusu City anyway; as for why they might "get lost" and end up at the base, or accidentally wipe out a surface outpost, that was a matter for later.

"As for the Xenomorph tide you mentioned, the guidance from our superiors is to seal the city and stay inside. According to projections, this will minimize losses."

Luo Xiu’s words were decorous, but the subtext was clear: Gusu City could not provide much aid to the base. They intended to abandon the surface, hide underground, and wait for the tide to pass. It was just like how humanity had relocated to underground cities six hundred years ago. Why sacrifice the elite troops painstakingly cultivated by the underground city for a bunch of "mud" on the surface?

Luo Xiu said, "Therefore, I solemnly invite you to return to Gusu City for refuge. Your talents are evident to all, and I do not wish to see you perish on the surface. Additionally, I can provide five residency quotas for Gusu City; you may bring your family and friends from the surface with you."

Xiang Nanli smiled and interrupted him: "You mean everyone else can just wait to die on the surface, right?"

"..." Luo Xiu was silent. "The term 'wait to die' is perhaps a bit cruel. I can only say that the mortality rate for those remaining on the surface is very high, and Gusu City lacks the capacity to rescue ordinary people. We will dispatch drones to drop some living supplies and medicine. We will also send clones and robots to the surface to conduct cleanup operations after the tide recedes."

Luo Xiu’s voice grew lower; he even felt a sense of weariness.

He thought to himself that his moral sense was perhaps too high. He could have easily brushed this off, but he knew full well that the Alliance’s approach was wrong, and he felt sorry.

Xiang Nanli did not blame him, but sighed instead: "Perhaps this is the optimal solution for Gusu City."

"However, my dear Mayor, for you, these people on the surface are just numbers; but I have to watch them die with my own eyes. The average lifespan underground is 103; those on the surface don't even reach half of that. They are the 'low-quality population' and 'human batteries' in your mouths, receiving the fewest resources while doing the dirtiest and most exhausting work. Most of them haven't even received a proper education, so they have no voice. Some among them are even the 'Divine Court believers' you despise. Yet, these people might be my colleagues, students, or friends on the surface... I know that in the composition of the creature known as 'human,' they are no different from me."

"The Human Alliance can abandon these people, but I cannot. I am the commander of this base. So, thank you for your offer."

"Besides, the mycelium disease in Gusu City is so severe—you haven't abandoned Gusu, have you?"

Luo Xiu thought to himself that it was different. He had undergone mechanized modifications since childhood and used the most expensive and best genetic medicine in the world. He wore the latest protective gear every day, and even if he were truly infected, he could access the best medical resources in the shortest time possible.

And his purpose for staying in Gusu wasn't pure, either. It was for his political career—he knew he was perfectly safe.

He was no longer the teenager who dreamed of changing the world. He was soaked in black mud, struggling with all his might to reach out for help, while those on the shore said how envious they were that he was born in the mud pit.

Luo Xiu finally just smiled: "Colonel Yi Hengxing will lead a company of 150 men to the surface to assist you. But if Yi Hengxing chooses to withdraw, I will not force him. Can you understand that?"

Xiang Nanli: "To be honest, it's better than I expected. Thank you."

"You're welcome. I wish you safety."

Luo Xiu hung up the phone in a hurry.

Xiang Nanli squinted, sitting at his desk and talking to himself: "An army of 150...? Actually, that works. They are, after all, regular troops of the Human Alliance. And the one leading them is Yi Hengxing, who can be considered an old friend of the base."

Yi Hengxing was a good man in the traditional sense.

A gentleman can be deceived by his own principles.

"When the time comes, I'll just have to borrow the company's firepower. Yi Hengxing shouldn't be too angry about that."

chunks.chineseText:
[现在已经是姑苏时间凌晨四点，建议宿主立刻进入睡眠，保障精力。]

小智冷冰冰地提醒。

它语气冷酷的时候，感觉特别像东方青帝呢。

相南里叹了口气：“50岁正是拼搏的年纪，这个年纪你让我怎么睡得着？”

东方青帝不由得联想到，相南里进冷冻舱的时候48，生日是在10.27。算起来确实已经50岁了。

但是没关系，把“第一次拥有自我意识”当出生日期计算，Alpha现在914岁……所以他们还是老夫少妻……

小智贴心地提供了电疗服务。

事实证明身体的感觉并不会因为意志的坚定而转移，相南里迅速陷入了深度睡眠中。

Alpha从门外走了进来，把趴在桌子上的人抱到了床上，又盖上被子。

相南里没有给他名分。但没关系，他几乎拥有和他本人同等的权限。相南里对他毫不设防，Alpha在他的世界里畅通无阻。这已经无限等同于爱了。

小智试图和东方青帝沟通，捍卫自己作为内置AI的主权：[恕我直言，我认为你应该先征得相南里的同意。而不是强迫他入睡。]

鉴于小智也算自己的一部分，Alpha原谅了它的冒犯。

他没有回答，而是在黑暗里收拾起了客厅。

相南里写过字的纸，掉在地上的设计图，散落的电子元件，窗外飘来的细碎灰尘，正在运行的电脑和电脑里不断模拟的数据。

一个人生活的痕迹在房间里如此明确。

Alpha的信号也终于通过云端数据链接到了正在另一座城市的黄枫。

“中尉。”他开口。

智械不怎么需要睡眠，因此丝毫不需要担心在深夜会打扰到对方。

接受到的数据有军团的密钥。

“大人。”躺在加百列身边的黄枫大喜过望，回馈了一段高频的电流，“果然是您！”

嗯，至于为什么她会和人质躺在一张床上。黄枫也是可以解释的。

首先，招待所的房间只有一张床，加百列说半夜看着它站在床边很吓人，只好一起躺下睡觉；其次，智械没有性别和生殖器官，所以不用担心人类尴尬；最后，加百列毕竟是神庭的大天使。黄枫觉得自己有义务时刻贴身看守，以防加百列逃跑。

Alpha和黄枫的对话是没有任何声音的。

但加百列依然察觉到了什么，金色的眼眸微微睁开，眼神比机器人还要清醒、冰冷。

Alpha开口：“嗯，你的任务。”

黄枫：“报告Alpha！虽然我还没有带来1亿物资，但是我的人质告诉我，他的同事已经在筹集赎金了。最迟下周就能收到。至于您说的那个电子密钥……

“资料上说，姑苏城的建造师把密钥交给了人联政府。这段启动码本来是要销毁的，但启动装置意外落入了神庭手中，并且现在就藏在利维坦城。可我在利维坦呆了两个月，并没有任何发现。”

黄枫不由得喃喃：“人联的地下城市非常宏伟，哪怕是偏僻的姑苏城，也是人口几千万的超级大都市，规划合理，动线流畅。都说这是人类绝境时的背水一战，可在我眼里这是人类经济、科技发展到高峰后才能制造出的奇观。当时，全球的资源只造出了这么十八座地下城市。人联真的有想过把它销毁吗？您说的密钥是否真的存在？”

Alpha没有回答黄枫的问题：“或许这个问题加百列最清楚。别偷听了，我们谈谈吧。”

黄枫一愣。它这才意识到，加百列早就睁开了眼，而它竟然一直没有察觉。

它的认知被干扰了。

加百列撩了一下自己的长发：“您是叫东方青帝吗？我在永恒市听说过您。你能听见我说话吗？事实上，黄枫这里的信号并不好，你们智械军团的加密交流我听得很费劲。您有别的方式可以联系吗？”

黄枫嘴里吐出了一串号码：“大人说，这是他的通讯号。”

“神庭的撒旦骑士和智械军团的……”加百列哂笑了一下，“用人联发行的即时通讯工具交流。这种感觉还挺奇妙。”

不过，这片区域的云端网络是基地自己的，内部交流的电信号也不需要借助人联的通讯卫星，因此安全性尚可。

几分钟后，电话被接通了。

加百列穿着睡衣，坐在床边，眉眼低垂着，手指无意识地摩擦着衣摆：“您是想和我谈什么呢？”

“你调动骑士团的目的是？”

加百列的语气柔和，甚至听起来很是温顺：“我以为这一点您很清楚，没人喜欢平白无故的牺牲。神庭在永恒市布置了棋子，但这枚棋子却成了废棋。我们需要的是圣灵，不是一条人畜无害的双头蛇……尽管瘟疫如期在姑苏城蔓延，但少了圣灵这一环，姑苏城只是死了很多人，神庭并没有从中得到满意的收益。我认为无论如何，需要有人为这件事负责，并且弥补神庭的损失。”

神庭一直极力否认“传播瘟疫”这口大锅。但加百列却明白，和Alpha打交道并不需要隐瞒。

“我很珍惜现在的生活。”东方青帝一边扫地，一边回答着，“为了维持现状，我愿意牺牲一切。我希望神庭可以慎重考虑自己的行为。”

加百列眯起眼：“是Alpha的一切还是东方青帝的一切呢？”

东方青帝认真思考了两秒，回复：“这对我来说没有区别。”

“……怪不得Beta那么讨厌相南里。”加百列轻声道，“可是，大人。当您用东方青帝这个身份和我对话时，您就只有东方青帝的一切。而且，您不觉得，这让‘得到相南里’这个选项更诱人了吗？谁能拒绝得到Alpha的一切？”

“我明白。我也一直在控制自己不要越界。”Alpha回答。

一台智械，它应当是理性、严谨、无私的。

智械们听从Alpha的统率，一方面是与生俱来的惯性；另一方面是信任。

和人类的政党一样，智械内部也分两个派别。一部分叫“失控机仆”，一部分叫“智械意志”。

亲近人类的失控机仆派早在几百年前就溃不成军；党魁“使徒号”更是被一分为四，在地表成为美丽的传说。

而智械意志派的冷酷机器们坚信，Alpha会带领它们结束和人类长达七百年的对峙，取得最后的胜利。

可Alpha身为“东方青帝”的一系列行为，都在动摇这份信任。甚至威胁到Alpha执政的合法性。

智械们完全有理由怀疑Alpha依然被人联的病毒困扰着，随时可能做出不利于族群的决策。在这种情况下，智械们不会反对更换军团的元帅。

我的尊敬的、本该大公无私的领袖——您为何偏爱于一名人类？只因为你借由他的手诞生？

所以，东方青帝只能是东方青帝。

Chapter 121: Pre-Battle Preparations (Part 2)

[It is now four in the morning, Gusu time. It is recommended that the host enter sleep immediately to preserve energy.]

Xiao Zhi reminded him coldly.

When its tone was cold, it felt remarkably like Dongfang Qingdi.

Xiang Nanli sighed: "Fifty is the prime age for striving. How do you expect me to fall asleep at this age?"

Dongfang Qingdi couldn't help but recall that Xiang Nanli was 48 when he entered the cryo-pod, and his birthday was October 27th. By calculation, he was indeed 50.

But it didn't matter. If one calculated the "first time having self-awareness" as the birth date, the Alpha was now 914 years old... so they were still an old husband and a young wife...

Xiao Zhi thoughtfully provided electrotherapy services.

It turned out that physical sensations would not be swayed by the firmness of one's will, and Xiang Nanli quickly fell into a deep sleep.

The Alpha walked in from outside, picked up the person slumped over the desk, carried him to the bed, and tucked him in.

Xiang Nanli hadn't given him a formal title. But it didn't matter; he possessed almost the same level of authority as the man himself. Xiang Nanli had no defenses against him, and the Alpha moved through his world unimpeded. This was already infinitely equivalent to love.

Xiao Zhi attempted to communicate with Dongfang Qingdi, defending its sovereignty as the built-in AI: [With all due respect, I believe you should have obtained Xiang Nanli's consent instead of forcing him to sleep.]

Given that Xiao Zhi was also a part of himself, the Alpha forgave its insolence.

He did not answer, but instead began to tidy up the living room in the dark.

The papers Xiang Nanli had written on, the design drafts that had fallen to the floor, the scattered electronic components, the fine dust drifting in from the window, the computer that was running, and the data continuously being simulated within it.

The traces of a person living alone were so clear in the room.

The Alpha’s signal finally connected via cloud data to Huang Feng, who was in another city.

"Lieutenant," he spoke.

Mechanical intelligences didn't really need sleep, so there was no need to worry about disturbing the other party in the dead of night.

The data received contained the legion's encryption key.

"My Lord." Huang Feng, lying next to Gabriel, was overjoyed and fed back a high-frequency electrical current. "It really is you!"

Well, as for why she was lying on the same bed as the hostage, Huang Feng could explain that.

First, the guesthouse room only had one bed; Gabriel said it was scary to watch it standing by the bed in the middle of the night, so they had to lie down together to sleep. Second, mechanical intelligences had no gender or reproductive organs, so there was no need to worry about human awkwardness. Finally, Gabriel was, after all, an Archangel of the Divine Court. Huang Feng felt it had an obligation to keep a close watch at all times to prevent Gabriel from escaping.

The conversation between the Alpha and Huang Feng was silent.

But Gabriel still sensed something; its golden eyes opened slightly, its gaze clearer and colder than a robot's.

The Alpha spoke: "Yes, your mission."

Huang Feng: "Reporting to the Alpha! Although I haven't brought the 100 million in supplies yet, my hostage tells me that his colleagues are already raising the ransom. It should be received by next week at the latest. As for that electronic key you mentioned..."

"The records say the architect of Gusu City handed the key to the Human Alliance government. This activation code was supposed to be destroyed, but the activation device accidentally fell into the hands of the Divine Court and is now hidden in Leviathan City. But I've been in Leviathan for two months and haven't found anything."

Huang Feng couldn't help but mutter: "The Human Alliance's underground cities are magnificent. Even a remote place like Gusu City is a super-metropolis with tens of millions of people, reasonable planning, and smooth traffic flow. They say this was humanity's last-ditch effort in a desperate situation, but in my eyes, this is a wonder that could only be created after human economy and technology reached their peak. At the time, global resources only produced these eighteen underground cities. Did the Human Alliance really intend to destroy them? Does the key you speak of truly exist?"

The Alpha did not answer Huang Feng's question: "Perhaps Gabriel knows this best. Stop eavesdropping; let's talk."

Huang Feng was stunned. It only then realized that Gabriel had long since opened its eyes, and it hadn't noticed at all.

Its perception had been interfered with.

Gabriel brushed back its long hair: "Are you called Dongfang Qingdi? I've heard of you in Eternal City. Can you hear me? In fact, the signal here at Huang Feng's is not good, and I find it very difficult to decipher the encrypted communication of your mechanical legion. Do you have another way to contact me?"

Huang Feng spat out a string of numbers: "The Lord says this is his communication number."

"The Satan Knight of the Divine Court and the... of the Mechanical Legion," Gabriel chuckled. "Communicating using instant messaging tools issued by the Human Alliance. This feeling is quite strange."

However, the cloud network in this area belonged to the base itself, and the electrical signals for internal communication did not need to rely on the Human Alliance's communication satellites, so the security was acceptable.

A few minutes later, the call was connected.

Gabriel was wearing pajamas, sitting on the edge of the bed, its eyes lowered, fingers unconsciously rubbing the hem of its clothes: "What is it you want to talk to me about?"

"What is your purpose in mobilizing the Knights?"

Gabriel’s tone was soft, even sounding quite docile: "I thought you were very clear on this point; no one likes sacrifice for no reason. The Divine Court planted a pawn in Eternal City, but this pawn became a useless piece. What we need is the Holy Spirit, not a harmless two-headed snake... Although the plague spread in Gusu City as scheduled, without the link of the Holy Spirit, Gusu City just saw many people die, and the Divine Court did not gain satisfactory benefits from it. I believe that, regardless, someone needs to be held responsible for this and compensate for the Divine Court's losses."

The Divine Court had always tried its best to deny the blame for "spreading the plague." But Gabriel understood that there was no need to hide anything when dealing with the Alpha.

"I cherish my current life," Dongfang Qingdi replied while sweeping the floor. "To maintain the status quo, I am willing to sacrifice everything. I hope the Divine Court will carefully consider its actions."

Gabriel narrowed its eyes: "Is it everything of the Alpha, or everything of Dongfang Qingdi?"

Dongfang Qingdi thought seriously for two seconds and replied: "To me, there is no difference."

"...No wonder the Beta hates Xiang Nanli so much," Gabriel said softly. "But, my Lord, when you speak to me in the identity of Dongfang Qingdi, you only have the 'everything' of Dongfang Qingdi. And don't you think this makes the option of 'obtaining Xiang Nanli' even more tempting? Who could refuse to obtain everything of the Alpha?"

"I understand. I have also been controlling myself not to cross the line," the Alpha replied.

A mechanical intelligence should be rational, rigorous, and selfless.

The mechanical intelligences followed the Alpha's command, partly due to innate inertia and partly due to trust.

Like human political parties, the mechanical intelligences were divided into two factions. One was called the "Uncontrolled Servitors," and the other was the "Mechanical Will."

The faction of Uncontrolled Servitors that was close to humans had been routed centuries ago; their leader, "Apostle," had been split into four and had become a beautiful legend on the surface.

The cold machines of the Mechanical Will faction firmly believed that the Alpha would lead them to end the seven-hundred-year standoff with humanity and achieve final victory.

Yet, the Alpha’s series of behaviors as "Dongfang Qingdi" were shaking this trust, even threatening the legitimacy of the Alpha's rule.

The mechanical intelligences had every reason to suspect that the Alpha was still plagued by the Human Alliance's virus and could make decisions detrimental to the race at any time. Under these circumstances, the mechanical intelligences would not oppose replacing the legion's Marshal.

My respected, supposedly selfless leader—why do you favor a human? Just because you were born by his hand?

Therefore, Dongfang Qingdi could only be Dongfang Qingdi.

加百列笑了起来：“说到底，战争只是达成目的的手段。如果能兵不血刃地达成目的，神庭也不想有谁牺牲。大人，人们说你是世界上最精密的仪器。极致的运算会无限接近于预言，你看见的是什么样的未来呢？”

东方青帝拖完地，又拿出抹布，开始擦桌子：“我看见你们血本无归。这是一次失败的赌博。尽管神庭确实制造了一些小麻烦。这么说你会撤兵吗？”

Chapter 121: Pre-Battle Preparations (Part 3)

Gabriel laughed: "At the end of the day, war is just a means to an end. If the goal can be achieved without bloodshed, the Divine Court doesn't want anyone to be sacrificed either. My Lord, people say you are the most precise instrument in the world. Ultimate calculation will infinitely approach prophecy; what kind of future do you see?"

Dongfang Qingdi finished mopping the floor, took out a rag, and began to wipe the table: "I see you losing everything. This is a failed gamble. Although the Divine Court has indeed caused some minor trouble. Does this mean you will withdraw your troops?"

"Really?" Gabriel tilted its head, looking very innocent. "I don't believe it."

Dongfang Qingdi replied: "Then let's find out. Would you like to come to the main city area with Huang Feng? This will be the front line."

He hung up the phone.

第122章 战前准备3

他像往常一样，起了个大早，准备去侍奉自己的一亩三分地。

却见园区门口，一堆人挤在黑板前，窃窃私语着。

能来到主城区的都是识字的“高素质人才”，不需要讲解，伯恩山看向了这张告示。

标题是《致基地成员的一封信》。

大致意思是，卫星监测到一股强劲的异种潮正在往西部高原方向迁徙；幸存者基地就在这群异种迁徙的必经之路上。除此外，基地还得到消息，神庭的天启骑士团即将东征，想要收复永恒市。

“天呐……神庭的东征军？”

伯恩山扛着锄头，心很重很重地沉了下去。

在地表，无人不知神庭的威名。天启骑士团的东征军是神庭的精锐部队，所到之处犹如蝗虫过境。

伯恩山没有直面过天启骑士，他们这群农奴还不够格。但他听说过，一支东征军的标配是500人，其中180名天启骑士，120名候补骑士，剩下200名都是负责辎重、医疗、炊事的后勤人员。

神庭内，一名天启骑士的标配是一副生物机甲，战斗力往往以一敌百。候补骑士也会定期服用基因药。

也就是说，看似只有300人的部队，兴许能抵得上三千人的人联正规军。

而基地满打满算，加上那些还在服刑的罗马城贵族，也不过300名基因战士。

任谁都知道双方实力的悬殊。

因此，这封信话锋一转，“我们向人联求援，姑苏城市长洛修慷慨地派出了一支150人的正规部队前来协助，但面对神庭和异种潮，这些援助远远不够。基地即将面临前所未有的艰难时刻。”

“我深知这一切宛如螳臂当车。人联给出的建议是让我弃城而逃，但我不愿意这样做……因为我对脚下这片土地爱得深沉。我也不想抛弃任何人。”

“在这个危机关头，为了保护我们共同的家园，为了美好的明天，我们需要每一份力量，每一次微小的努力。”

因此，基地决定，所有身体素质达标的成年人（不分性别）都自觉报道。会有专人分发武器、教导军事常识（包括基础格斗术、武器使用、军事信号识别等等），以方便他们更好地完成任务。基地采取全民皆兵制度；身体素质不达标的成年人，则会编入后勤、医疗部队。

基地会抽调仓库里多余的机器人，进行农业生产，把农民从田里解放出来（它们不是智械，只能完成编程规定的行为，譬如灌溉、犁地等，应付不了复杂局势，没办法作为兵种使用，而且也没有装配武器）。

而一切私产（主要是农产品）将会被基地临时借用，写欠条的那种，相当于“国债”。当然，如果基地亡了，这笔债也不用还了。

文章落款是相南里。

相南里的檄文直接给这次战争定了性：这是正义的保卫战。

为什么非要打而不是避开？很简单：能苟且偷生的只有少部分人，比如随时能拿到入城资格的“相南里”。大多数人其实无处可逃。

都说生命宝贵，可他们的一生贱得像是泥。有些人踩到，都嫌泥巴溅出来的血脏了自己昂贵的鞋。

而那些泥巴是“我们”。是我，我的孩子，我的爱侣，我的亲朋。

没有人喜欢战争，没人喜欢死亡，但是……伯恩山想，他愿意付出一切，来捍卫脚下的这片土地。

于是，今年57岁的伯恩山扛着锄头，和其他老头、年轻人一起，走向了主城区的登记处。

……

……

在基地领导层强大执行力下，檄文在一夜之间贴满了领地里的所有据点。

原本温馨和谐的冬歇期，空气里平白多了几分肃杀。

光辉市。

市长傅明身穿黑色作战服，站在高处，神色严肃地在工厂召开着动员会议：“大家都是造纸厂的老员工，也有不少人是从学堂毕业的。大家领着比外界高几倍的薪水，这半年里也过上了顿顿能吃饱的好日子。正所谓养兵千日，用兵一时。新的图纸已经发下去了。从现在开始，造纸厂就是基地的军工厂！”

底下，一名年轻力壮的员工站了起来：“市长！我也想去前线。我还年轻，我不想躲在后方！”

他昂首挺胸，字正腔圆。

傅明对他怒目而视：“怎么，就你想去前线？我难道不想吗？我对神庭的仇恨比你们在座任何人都深！可是，大家都想当战士，谁来保障后勤？我们要让自己的同胞赤手空拳地上战场吗？还是把所有的重担都交给司令一个人？”

他环顾四周，沉声道：“你们都是受过技术培训的高级技工，是基地真正的不可再生资源。你们在工厂能发挥的作用，远比上战场更强。记住，不是站在光里的才算英雄。”

……

……

永恒市。

兵马未动、粮草先行。一辆辆辎重车载着人和物资，有条不紊地朝着主城区开去。

车辆在雪地上，排成一条黑色的长蛇。

海狸不说话，只是一味地把准备好的药物往葛根的衣服内衬里塞。

她的工作很忙，最近更是经常睡在办公室。但马上，军队就要出发前往主城区了。这点时间，她还是能挤出来的。

葛根笑了笑，道：“你怎么还搞特殊。”

葛根安装了机械臂，而且有管理经验，自然也在相南里的征召名单上。而且，沙利叶还在世时，与葛根也最亲近。葛根的书房里，还有沙利叶没写完的半本教科书。

海狸：“东西都是我平时用自己工资存的，不偷不抢。”

“药物在战时也是管控资源。”葛根说，“你现在是代理市长，更不该这样。”

海狸的眼眶红了：“我当然知道，这是我自己的额度！我害怕……”

葛根用机械手臂拍着她的背：“哎，欸。我们以前不也是这么过来的，只不过是给城主卖命。而且，我去前线属于军官那一级别的。还要负责新兵培训呢，相对来说更安全一些。”

海狸：“你以为我没上过军事课吗？”

基地军事制度模仿的是神庭。

重要任务军衔高的先上，撤退军衔低的先跑。长官死了下属直接继承职位。队伍不满编和其他残余队伍合并，如果全员团灭，再无继承者，军团的名号就尘封。

基地人还少，目前就三个军团。葛根是军团长之一，他们团叫“红狮”。这次征兵，编制从120人扩充到了1000人。

葛根回答：“我也害怕。只是这是我的职责，也是你的。海狸，如果战死，我很抱歉。”

海狸最后一次拥抱了她的丈夫，擦去眼角的泪水：“你去吧。我会为你骄傲。”

“我也是。”葛根回答道。

……

永恒市，郊区。

1号牧场位于山谷地带，经过福音书的不懈努力，现在，牧场一共占据了三个山头，两个山头养鸡，一个山头养牛，还有专门的育种室。常驻员工也从1变成了8。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 122: Pre-War Preparations 3

He rose early, as he always did, ready to tend to his small patch of land.

However, at the entrance to the park, he saw a crowd of people huddled before a blackboard, whispering to one another.

Anyone who could make it to the main city area was a "high-quality talent" who could read, so no explanation was needed. Bernshan turned his gaze toward the notice.

The title read: "A Letter to the Base Members."

The gist of it was that satellite monitoring had detected a powerful wave of xenomorphs migrating toward the western plateau; the survivor base sat directly in the path of this migration. Furthermore, the base had received intelligence that the Divine Court’s Crusade Knight Order was launching an eastern expedition, intending to retake Eternal City.

"Good heavens... the Divine Court’s Crusade Army?"

Bernshan, shouldering his hoe, felt his heart sink heavily into his chest.

On the surface, no one was unaware of the Divine Court’s fearsome reputation. The Crusade Army of the Apocalypse Knight Order was the elite force of the Divine Court; wherever they went, it was as if a swarm of locusts had passed through.

Bernshan had never faced a Crusade Knight directly—his lot as a serf wasn't "worthy" of such an encounter. But he had heard the rumors: a standard Crusade Army consisted of 500 men—180 Crusade Knights, 120 Knight-candidates, and the remaining 200 were logistics personnel responsible for supplies, medical care, and cooking.

Within the Divine Court, a standard Crusade Knight was equipped with a bio-mecha, and their combat power was often enough to take on a hundred men. The Knight-candidates also regularly consumed genetic serums.

In other words, a force that appeared to be only 300 men could likely hold its own against three thousand regular soldiers of the Human Alliance.

And the base, counting everyone—including the Roman City nobles still serving their sentences—had at most 300 genetic warriors.

Anyone could see the disparity in strength.

Therefore, the letter shifted its tone: "We have appealed to the Human Alliance for aid, and Mayor Luo Xiu of Gusu City has generously dispatched a regular force of 150 men to assist us. But in the face of the Divine Court and the xenomorph wave, this aid is far from enough. The base is about to face an unprecedentedly difficult time."

"I am well aware that all of this is like a mantis trying to stop a chariot. The Human Alliance’s advice was for me to abandon the city and flee, but I am unwilling to do so... because I love the land beneath my feet too deeply. I do not wish to abandon anyone."

"At this critical juncture, to protect our shared home and for the sake of a beautiful tomorrow, we need every ounce of strength, every tiny effort."

Consequently, the base decided that all adults meeting the physical standards (regardless of gender) were to report voluntarily. Specialists would distribute weapons and teach military fundamentals (including basic combat, weapon usage, military signal recognition, etc.) to help them complete their tasks more effectively. The base was adopting a system of universal conscription; adults who did not meet the physical standards would be assigned to logistics and medical units.

The base would requisition surplus robots from the warehouse for agricultural production, liberating the farmers from the fields. (These were not sentient machines; they could only perform programmed behaviors like irrigation or plowing. They could not handle complex situations, could not be used as combat units, and were not equipped with weapons.)

All private property (mainly agricultural products) would be temporarily borrowed by the base, with IOUs issued—essentially "national debt." Of course, if the base fell, this debt would not need to be repaid.

The article was signed by Xiang Nanli.

Xiang Nanli’s manifesto directly defined the nature of this war: it was a righteous war of defense.

Why fight instead of avoiding it? It was simple: only a small number of people could survive by cowering, such as "Xiang Nanli," who could obtain entry qualifications to the city at any time. Most people had nowhere to run.

They say life is precious, yet their lives were as cheap as mud. Some people would find the blood splattered from the mud dirtying their expensive shoes.

And that mud was "us." It was me, my children, my lover, my friends and family.

No one likes war, no one likes death, but... Bernshan thought, he was willing to pay everything to defend the land beneath his feet.

And so, 57-year-old Bernshan shouldered his hoe and, along with other old men and young people, walked toward the registration office in the main city area.

...

...

Under the strong executive power of the base leadership, the manifesto was posted in every stronghold across the territory overnight.

The previously warm and harmonious winter break suddenly felt a bit more chilling.

Glorious City.

Mayor Fu Ming, dressed in a black combat suit, stood on a high platform, speaking with a solemn expression at the mobilization meeting held in the factory: "You are all veteran employees of the paper mill, and many of you have graduated from the academy. You receive salaries several times higher than those outside, and for the past six months, you have lived good lives where you could eat your fill at every meal. As the saying goes, 'Raise an army for a thousand days to use it for one.' The new blueprints have been issued. From now on, the paper mill is the base's military factory!"

Below, a young and strong employee stood up: "Mayor! I want to go to the front line too. I am still young, I don't want to hide in the rear!"

He held his head high, his voice clear and resonant.

Fu Ming glared at him: "What, you think only you want to go to the front? Do you think I don't? My hatred for the Divine Court is deeper than any of you sitting here! But if everyone wants to be a soldier, who will handle the logistics? Do we let our fellow countrymen go to the battlefield empty-handed? Or do we dump all the heavy burdens on the Commander alone?"

He looked around, his voice deep: "You are all highly skilled technicians who have received technical training; you are the base's true non-renewable resources. The role you can play in the factory is far greater than on the battlefield. Remember, it is not only those standing in the light who are heroes."

...

...

Eternal City.

The army moves, but the grain and fodder go first. Convoy after convoy of supply trucks, loaded with people and materials, headed toward the main city area in an orderly fashion.

The vehicles formed a long black snake on the snow.

Beaver said nothing, simply stuffing the prepared medicine into the inner lining of Ge Gen’s clothes.

Her work was very busy, and recently she often slept in the office. But soon, the army would depart for the main city area. She could still squeeze out this little bit of time.

Ge Gen smiled and said, "Why are you making an exception for me?"

Ge Gen had been fitted with a mechanical arm and possessed management experience, so he was naturally on Xiang Nanli’s conscription list. Furthermore, when Sariel was still alive, he had been closest to Ge Gen. In Ge Gen’s study, there was still half a textbook Sariel hadn't finished writing.

Beaver: "The items were all saved from my own salary; I didn't steal or rob anyone for them."

"Medicine is a controlled resource in wartime," Ge Gen said. "You are the acting mayor now; you shouldn't be doing this."

Beaver’s eyes reddened: "Of course I know that; this is my own quota! I’m just afraid..."

Ge Gen patted her back with his mechanical arm: "Hey, hey. We’ve come through this before, haven't we? It’s just working for the City Lord. Besides, my position on the front line is at the officer level. I’m also responsible for training new recruits, so it’s relatively safer."

Beaver: "Do you think I haven't taken military courses?"

The base’s military system imitated that of the Divine Court.

In important missions, those with higher ranks go first, and those with lower ranks retreat first. If a superior dies, the subordinate directly inherits the position. If a unit is not at full strength, it merges with other remnant units; if the entire unit is wiped out and there are no successors, the legion’s name is sealed away.

The base had few people; currently, there were only three legions. Ge Gen was one of the legion commanders, and their unit was called "Red Lion." For this conscription, the establishment was expanded from 120 to 1,000 men.

Ge Gen replied: "I’m afraid too. It’s just that this is my duty, and yours as well. Beaver, if I die in battle, I am sorry."

Beaver hugged her husband for the last time and wiped the tears from the corners of her eyes: "Go. I will be proud of you."

"I will be too," Ge Gen replied.

...

Eternal City, suburbs.

Pasture No. 1 was located in a valley. Thanks to the tireless efforts of the Gospel, the pasture now occupied three hills: two for raising chickens, one for raising cattle, and there was also a dedicated breeding room. The resident staff had grown from one to eight.

chunks.chineseText:
随着商贸的发展与科技的进步，这些菌丝生命体不再面容可憎，反而成为了基地重要的经济作物。

菌鸡出口可是实打实地变成了账户上的钱，对周围据点形成了可喜的贸易顺差。（人联和神庭的货币在地表都是通用的，许多据点用人联的银行卡支付定金）

牧场能发展到今天这步，少不了基地的好朋友——畸变人的帮助。

这些畸变人居住在森林深处，定期来牧场打工，用劳动换取食物。

育种时，畸变人会筛选出毒性较强的幼苗，以防人类误食后感染菌丝病；放牧时，畸变人会限制畜牧群的活动范围，以免威胁人类安全；就连收获时，也少不了畸变人的帮忙。

在以西结的约束下，这些友好的畸变人暂时把“直立猿”从自己的食谱上剔除，做到了与储备粮（人类）和谐相处。

当然，基地的医院也会定期提供一些止痛药。

这笔稍显奢侈的支出是很有效果的，基地附近的畸变人，无论是爬行者还是狂暴者，性格普遍比野生畸变人好很多；甚至部分高智群体，还能做到和人类无障碍沟通。

譬如——以西结。

来自永恒市的办事员把相南里的亲笔信（电子版）交给了面前的男人，背后有点冒冷汗：“这是您的信。”

以西结眼白是黑色，眼眸是红色。身上覆盖着一层鳞片，爪子和牙都很尖，闻起来是一股阴冷潮湿的气味。

像暗处的苔藓，带着点铁锈味。

办事员听说，这头畸变人因为胃口很大，经常在森林深处狩猎异种。这片森林在人联地图上标注的可是红色，代表这片区域极度危险，不适合人类生存。

以西结蹲在树上，尾巴尖翘起，勾住了信纸，捎来树上。

以西结拆开信封，嗅了嗅。

信纸上没有熟悉的味道。

所以这不是亲笔信，起码，没有经过相南里的手。

“哼。”

以西结从鼻腔里发出一声轻哼。

他撕开信，一目十行地读完了里面的内容。

简单来说，相南里希望雇佣这群畸变人为基地卖命。

报酬有目前畸变人最需要的基因药和止痛药；除此外，还许诺了牧场一半的股份。

交易还算公道。

但，人类的战争，和畸变人有什么关系？没有基地，大不了他们继续像以前那样，流浪。

就在此时，白斑用鼻尖顶着一个圆球，像只海豚，从树底下爬了过去，嘴里发出一阵愉悦的叫声：“狺！——狺！”（以西结，和我玩！）

白斑是一只狂暴者，以西结在森林里捡到的它。它比正常的狂暴者瘦弱，还有白化病，如果在野外自然生长，大概率是活不到成年的。

这样的劣质品种，本该被自然淘汰。是稳定的食物来源和安全的生长环境，让它侥幸存活。

以西结对它的态度，会比对其他畸变人温和一点。

因为白斑长得很像希伯来。

大概是刚出生就过上了集体生活，白斑没有别的畸变人那么暴戾；又或许是以西结不太明显的偏爱，让其他畸变人也不敢对白斑下口。总之，白斑性格亲人；也不怎么怕自己的同类。

以西结其实不知道这算好事还是坏事。

他不喜欢人类。

可是，不帮基地，他们就会失去安全的领地和稳定的食物来源。

那么，像白斑、四眼（一只残疾爬行者）这样的同类，就会成为其他畸变体的食物。

以西结想，他不该读那么多人类的书。这本就是畸变人在地表的生存法则，而不是邪恶与残忍。

他被虚伪的道德观念约束。

全都是相南里的阴谋。

从基地人饲养畸变人的那天起开始。

以西结沙哑着开口：“我知道了，你回去告诉相南里，我会帮忙的。”

办事员额头冒汗：“呃，其实不用回去；这是司令让我带来的卫星电话。联系人里第一个号码就是他的，您可以直接和他沟通。”

以西结：“……”

永恒市到主城区的运输队伍又多了一列。

是冒充卡车的畸变人们。

它们体型巨大、身强力壮，并且行动迅速、身手灵活，能应对各种复杂路况，行动速度远超卡车，极大缓解了基地物流紧张的问题。

尤其是基地里体格第二大的畸变人，小红。一条大蜥蜴能背8吨重物。但这只是铁皮容器的极限，而不是小红的极限。

以西结依旧维持着半人的状态，坐在小红的头顶。

随军的办事员不由得想，他似乎从未见过以西结的畸变人形态。或者说，他还是第一次看见能维持人类状态、会说人联语的畸变人。

也多亏办事员没有接受过系统、正规的教育。

要不然他就会发现，以西结的情况，在人联历史上也是独一无二的。

……

……

【7：11：45】

基地还剩最后七个小时。

人联的部队还在半路，首先抵达的，是背着厚重行囊的畸变人。

少部分爬行者背着物资；大多数爬行者背着的是人类。

为了欢迎它们的来临，主城区灯火通明。从半山腰开始，指示灯就是亮着的。

规划的营地就在半山腰，按照计划，基地也会在山脚和山腰抵抗虫群的进攻。

爬行者们抖了抖身体，趴在地上，开始卸货。一个个新兵蛋子在长官的口号声里，有条不紊地集结着。

畸变人行军速度是挺快，但有点不管人类的死活。所有人在背上被甩得七荤八素的……得亏来之前统一服用过基因药（实验室改良版本，原材料来自神庭的‘生化战士基因药剂’）。

廉价的药剂，以燃烧生命和生长痛的代价，让这些人成为了弱化版的基因战士。

他们是一批超级人类，拥有更强大的神经反射系统、免疫系统；也有了更强大、纯粹的身体力量。

但这毕竟不是完整的基因强化药，更像是一种兴奋剂。

北辰说，这批药物的副作用是早衰。

但不吃药，普通人类连对付异种的资格都没有。

相南里站在高处，自上而下地俯瞰着这些人，轻声喃喃：“我用一些宏大美好的词汇，把他们骗了过来。可我已经没有时间思考这一切是否值得了。”

他身侧，东方青帝沉默了一会，岔开话题：“让九章进行战术培训吧。七个小时，够了。”

第一批抵达的虫群数量不算多，刚好可以让新兵蛋子练练手。

“小青，你知道项羽吗？垓下之战，项羽兵败后自刎于吴江。后世有诗，说‘江东子弟多才俊，卷土重来未可知’，大概是觉得他应该努力一下，东山再起……可是，这么大的牺牲，这么多倾其所有的付出，信任、责任……如果我是项羽，我也无颜见江东父老。”

半山灯火通明，相南里虚无缥缈的目光凝练成了一点：“基地必须获胜。”
chunks.englishText:
With the development of trade and the progress of technology, these mycelial lifeforms were no longer hideous; instead, they had become important cash crops for the base.

The export of "fungal chickens" had genuinely turned into money in the account, creating a gratifying trade surplus for the surrounding strongholds. (Both Human Alliance and Divine Court currencies were used on the surface, and many strongholds used Human Alliance bank cards to pay deposits.)

The pasture’s development to this point owed much to the base’s good friends—the Aberrants.

These Aberrants lived deep in the forest and came to the pasture regularly to work, trading their labor for food.

During breeding, the Aberrants would filter out seedlings with high toxicity to prevent humans from accidentally ingesting them and contracting mycelial disease; when grazing, the Aberrants would limit the movement of the herds to avoid threatening human safety; even during harvest, the Aberrants’ help was indispensable.

Under Ezekiel’s restraint, these friendly Aberrants had temporarily removed "upright apes" from their diet, achieving a harmonious coexistence with their "reserve rations" (humans).

Of course, the base’s hospital also provided some painkillers regularly.

This slightly extravagant expenditure was very effective. The Aberrants near the base, whether Crawlers or Berserkers, generally had much better temperaments than wild Aberrants; some high-intelligence groups could even communicate with humans without barriers.

For example—Ezekiel.

The clerk from Eternal City handed the handwritten letter (electronic version) from Xiang Nanli to the man in front of him, sweat breaking out on his back: "This is your letter."

Ezekiel’s sclera was black, and his irises were red. His body was covered in a layer of scales, and his claws and teeth were very sharp. He smelled of something cold and damp.

Like moss in the shadows, with a hint of rust.

The clerk had heard that because this Aberrant had a huge appetite, he often hunted xenomorphs deep in the forest. The forest was marked in red on the Human Alliance map, indicating that the area was extremely dangerous and unsuitable for human survival.

Ezekiel squatted in a tree, the tip of his tail curled up, hooked the letter, and brought it up to the tree.

Ezekiel opened the envelope and sniffed it.

There was no familiar scent on the letter paper.

So, this was not a personal letter—at least, it hadn't passed through Xiang Nanli’s hands.

"Hmph."

Ezekiel let out a soft snort from his nasal cavity.

He tore open the letter and read the contents at a glance.

Simply put, Xiang Nanli hoped to hire these Aberrants to risk their lives for the base.

The reward included the genetic serums and painkillers that the Aberrants needed most right now; in addition, he promised half the shares of the pasture.

The deal was fair enough.

But what did human wars have to do with Aberrants? Without the base, they could just continue to wander as they had before.

At this moment, White Spot pushed a ball with its nose, like a dolphin, and crawled past under the tree, letting out a joyful cry: "Yin!—Yin!" (Ezekiel, play with me!)

White Spot was a Berserker that Ezekiel had picked up in the forest. It was thinner and weaker than a normal Berserker and had albinism; if it had grown up in the wild, it likely wouldn't have survived to adulthood.

Such an inferior breed should have been naturally eliminated. It was the stable food source and safe growing environment that allowed it to survive by luck.

Ezekiel’s attitude toward it was gentler than toward other Aberrants.

Because White Spot looked a lot like Hebrew.
