Xiang Nanli was a pure child, and the entire world was his playground. His rationality and wisdom were his guardians, and Alpha was his favorite playmate.

That wasn't so bad, either.

...

...

Temporary POW Camp.

The corpses scorched by the electric current took on a charred, blackened hue. The city residents had spontaneously formed a "logistics troop," and as the brochures suggested, they began working in groups of three.

They crawled out of the air-raid shelters, put on masks, and helped transport bodies, sweep the streets, treat the wounded, and even began spontaneously repairing buildings damaged by the war.

The people here considered themselves the masters of the city; naturally, they didn't think that guarding, cleaning, and building were the responsibilities of only a select few.

The bodies were brittle, emitting a burnt, acrid smell.

Occasionally, there were lucky ones who weren't quite dead yet. These people were usually genetic warriors, but their condition was far from good.

They had merely had their bodies enhanced; essentially, they were still "human," and humans died.

Out of humanitarianism, the base offered them two choices: death (there were officers specifically responsible for "euthanasia"—since bullets were too expensive, they usually used machetes; the technique was fast, ruthless, and precise, guaranteeing a clean decapitation) or signing an IOU (with interest rates higher than standard loans) to borrow money from the base for medical services, to be repaid with the labor of their remaining years.

What gratified Xiang Nanli was that most people chose the latter—the base suddenly gained millions in debt claims (the treatment cost for each person was about 200,000). The human desire to live had always been this intense.

Considering the current monthly salary of 3,000 at the base, these able-bodied laborers, who were already burdened with decades of forced labor due to war crimes, would likely work like mules in the base until they died.

Of course, Xiang Nanli did not have a hobby of abusing prisoners. Even a mule in the objective sense could receive the dignity and security it deserved, provided they were truly building the base and not racking their brains to sabotage it.

Xiang Nanli was in a good mood; he even had a smile on his face when he met Beaver.

Beaver simply assumed he was happy because the battle had been won, and she couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief: "You look much better. Before, when I looked at you, you felt so heavy. We were all afraid that the burden was too much for you, and we didn't know how to help..."

The Eastern Azure Emperor followed, lifting the curtain of the POW camp and walking in.

Beaver was startled: "Ah, Chief of Staff, you... you’ve returned?"

The high-level cadres of the base often exchanged information in private. It wasn't political cooperation so much as a group chat for corporate slaves.

The disappearance of the Eastern Azure Emperor was no secret. Most people thought he was doomed, but no one dared to mention it in front of Xiang Nanli.

Although Xiang Nanli and the Eastern Azure Emperor had never publicly declared their relationship, everyone in the base unanimously agreed that they would be together sooner or later!

Lovers, comrades-in-arms, soulmates.

Regardless of the label, they were extraordinarily significant to each other. Such feelings even possessed a strong sense of exclusivity.

Beaver could deeply empathize with Xiang Nanli’s feelings because she was married and had a deeply loving partner. When Gegen had once been critically injured to the point of death, she understood what kind of feeling that was...

Beaver felt a surge of excitement and was genuinely happy.

That’s great. The Eastern Azure Emperor is back, and Xiang Nanli won't have to work so hard anymore.

The Eastern Azure Emperor nodded slightly, his gaze then falling upon Xiang Nanli.

Xiang Nanli instructed: "The main force of the legion has entered the city. Immediately send comrades from the Propaganda Department outside the city to take some troops. Count the number of refugees and send them in batches to the temporary settlement points in various cities. Eternal City cannot hold so many outsiders... Hmm, Xiao Qing, you go along with them. I trust your efficiency."

The Eastern Azure Emperor had wanted to suggest sending Huang Feng instead, but he found it impossible to refuse, so he nodded with complex emotions.

Xiang Nanli thought for a moment and added: "Eternal City is a bit wealthier than the other cities; we can prioritize taking in the elderly, the weak, the sick, and the pregnant who are not suited for long-distance travel."

"Understood." Beaver switched into work mode in a second, recording it in her little notebook.

"As for the surviving legion soldiers, keep them under centralized guard. After teaching them the rules, send them to labor reform. Heh, they look strong and sturdy; prioritize assigning them to heavy manual labor." There was finally a touch of coldness in Xiang Nanli’s tone. "They have hands and feet, yet they don't want to trade hard work for resources, wanting only to rely on robbery and parasitism to live their so-called 'good life.' There is no such logic. By the way, I heard Van Persie also incorporated a group of technical workers—they are all intellectuals who survived Gusu City. Lock them up too; we'll arrange work for those with the right ideological attitude."

Engineering was a valuable skill anywhere. Even if it was just fixing sewer pipes.

Xiang Nanli finished arranging the cleanup work, turned around, and walked into the special observation room in the corner.

chunks.chineseText:
范佩西就关在里面，他受伤了，相对而言不算特别严重——电网启动的前一刻，他的亲卫们当机立断地脱下了身上穿着的防护服，堆叠在了范佩西身上。

范佩西坐在铁质的椅子上，像被审讯的犯人。他双手被铐在椅子上，一只手在输液，头发乱糟糟的，发梢有着凝固的血迹。像被拔了牙的狮子。

出于安全考虑，两人之间依然隔着一道玻璃。

相南里在他对面坐下，神色如常：“又见面了。”

和上次小心翼翼、你来我往的试探不同，这一次，相南里是作为胜利方开口的。

范佩西不是很配合地转头：“呵。”

相南里观察了片刻，对黄枫道：“给将军解开手铐吧，他还是伤患呢。”

“我可不吃你这一套。”范佩西没好气地开口。

相南里摆出了一副真诚的神色：“范佩西，其实，我是真的尊重你。我听说人联外来的救援队，尤其是剑门城的部队，对姑苏城的难民并不好——”

这点资料，在难民堆里稍微打听一下就出来了。

剑门城的人来得早，占据了极大优势。救援官员虚报难民数量，问人联总部要钱和粮，到手后，层层剥削，只有极少一部分到了难民手中。这是心照不宣的规则。

至于什么贪污腐败罪，那都是后面的事情了。而且必然会有替罪羊登场。不少人在这次灾难里赚得盆满钵满。

范佩西作为难民的一员，在姑苏城的时候，动员组织了好几次抢劫行动，抢来的粮食发给了自己的小弟，也发给新招进组里的青壮年。

范佩西直接或者间接地挽救了很多人——哪怕他本人并没有太强的弥赛亚式的主观意愿，他只是想招人，就这样。

论迹不论心。

范佩西沦为了人联名单上的“通缉犯”，在剑门城出动重武力剿灭他之前，范佩西带着手底下的人逃出城。

出乎意料的是，竟然有上万人跟着他跑了。

比起不靠谱的官方救援，这些难民竟然更愿意跟着范佩西走。令人震惊中带着一丝理解。

人都是趋利避害的，很难想象，他们在救援营地里遭遇了什么，竟然觉得流浪比安稳地呆在原地更好。

刚开始在地表流浪，所有人都还能勉强吃饱。地表，有异种，但是也有自然恩赐的食物。

时间一久，带出来的粮食见底了。范佩西只好真的当起土匪，他在地表生活过很多年，知道姑苏城附近有那些据点……很多据点都被波及了，甚至需要等人联救援，但总有点渣够他们啃的。

他就这样，招了越来越多人，一路到了永恒市，啃到了此生最硬的骨头，并且磕坏了牙。

…………

听到相南里的话，范佩西终于抬起头，正眼看了他一眼。

这对于失败者来说，这是难堪的。

范佩西一直用抗拒的姿态维护着自己岌岌可危的尊严；这一眼仿佛代表着某种屈从。暗示着一件事：对，我被你动摇了。你可以招安我。

怎么处置范佩西，其实来的时候，相南里也有思考。

兵团里的主力军被一网打尽，范佩西就是拔了牙的狮子，造成不了太大威胁。

可狮子毕竟是狮子。要用他，就要承受可以受伤的风险。

平心而论，范佩西算是领导型人才。无论采取的何种手段，他最大程度的汇聚了难民，并且善于舆论造势，让众多人自发选择了跟随。和海狸那种明显赶鸭子上架，靠后天学习的基地干部完全不同。

他统治的兵营，当然没有很好，但却是范佩西能力范围的最优解。而且，就相南里观察，范佩西并没有太多原则性问题。

他抢劫，但抢来的资源极少用于自身，而是发给了下属；兵营有军规，比如“我们都是难民需要团结互助”“不要欺辱你的兄弟姐妹”，虽然形同虚设。而且，他还有点良心，不多。

不多是因为地表这个大环境本来就是吃人的，太有良心的早就死了。没死不是因为运气好，而是因为足够强，强到无言的丛林法则为他让路——譬如基地和相南里这种。

而环境是可以被改变的。人也可以。

综上所述，相南里认为，范佩西完全可以抢救一下。留下他，也能作为基地正面宣传的一个案例。

“我时常在想，我或许没办法质疑每个人为生存做出的选择。哪怕这份选择是建立在别人的痛苦上，只是我不喜欢这样，我认为这是不对的。所以我想改变它。”相南里神色和缓，和之前的冷漠完全不一样，“我会安置好你带来的那些难民，他们会成为基地的一份子。以前，有人告诉我，想要发展无非就那么几条路……”

相南里想起了东方青帝的话，眼神真的发自内心的柔和起来：“‘战争、贸易、科技’。而我却认为，所有战争都是无益的。基地不会主动发起侵略，或者用战争转移内部矛盾，但也不会放弃军事建设。而我，也想邀请你看看，战争之外的手段。

“我们不需要掠夺，也能依靠自己的双手建设美好的家园。这个家园没有奴隶，人人生而平等，没有阶级和压迫，我们有足够的资源供养每一个人，人们可以不为生存发愁，只为追寻自己的理想而活着。

“我曾经想要用智械达成这个可能性……”

相南里忽然住口，随后叹息了一声：“你愿意吗？”

范佩西几乎要被相南里描述的东西震慑住了，因为对方的语气如此笃信，坚定。可转念一想，却只剩无尽的嘲讽。

以范佩西的经历和认知，他不认为相南里的理想有实现的那一天。不能让自己更优越，凌驾于同类之上，很多人的人生便失去了希望和目标；拥有充足的资源，不需要为生存发愁，养出来的只会是巨婴和蛀虫。

可是……那跟他有什么关系呢，范佩西不无讽刺地想着。

相南里的言下之意是，他可以不用去死了。这是天大的好事，假装认同又如何呢？

于是，范佩西回答：“我当然愿意……看到，你说的那个世界。”

语言有力量吗。或许有的，当这句话说出口，范佩西内心的不屑、否定，好像被悄然动摇了那么一点。

相南里微笑着点头：“好，等你好起来后，我会先送你到学习基地，学习基地的基本常识。不过，在此之前，先跟我说说你们兵团的技术员和物资吧，我对这些很感兴趣。”

嗯，所谓的学习基地就是……监狱劳改所来着。

当然，范佩西发现自己被骗了，也是几天后的事情了。

就这样，相南里成功拿到了难民兵团的基本信息。

代价是一顿话疗，外加一瓶酒（范佩西说自己口渴硬要喝酒）、一碗饭。（鸡蛋牛肉盖饭，非营养膏。食堂送来的，疑似小青亲手制作。但范佩西看起来太想吃一口了，相南里只好假装大度地让给了他。）

“发财了发财了。”相南里走出监护室，脸上的笑容就没消失过。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 144: Alpha (Part 2)

Van Persie was locked inside. He was injured, though relatively speaking, not too severely—the moment before the electric grid was activated, his personal guards had decisively taken off their protective suits and piled them onto Van Persie.

Van Persie sat on a metal chair like an interrogated prisoner. His hands were cuffed to the chair, and he was receiving an IV drip. His hair was messy, with dried blood on the tips. He looked like a lion with its teeth pulled.

For safety reasons, a glass partition still separated the two.

Xiang Nanli sat down opposite him, his expression calm: "We meet again."

Unlike the previous cautious, tit-for-tat probing, this time, Xiang Nanli spoke as the victor.

Van Persie turned his head, not very cooperatively: "Hmph."

Xiang Nanli observed him for a moment and said to Huang Feng: "Unlock the handcuffs for the General; he is still a wounded man."

"I’m not falling for your act," Van Persie said irritably.

Xiang Nanli put on a sincere expression: "Van Persie, actually, I truly respect you. I heard that the rescue teams from the Human Alliance, especially the troops from Sword Gate City, were not kind to the refugees from Gusu City—"

This information was easy to come by with just a little digging among the refugees.

The people from Sword Gate City had arrived early and occupied a huge advantage. The rescue officials had inflated the number of refugees to demand money and food from the Human Alliance headquarters, and once they got it, they exploited it layer by layer, with only a tiny fraction reaching the refugees. This was an unspoken rule.

As for charges of corruption and bribery, those were matters for later. And there would inevitably be scapegoats. Many people had made a fortune in this disaster.

As one of the refugees, Van Persie had organized several robbery operations while in Gusu City, distributing the looted food to his subordinates and the young, able-bodied people he had newly recruited.

Van Persie had directly or indirectly saved many people—even if he himself didn't have a strong, messianic subjective will; he just wanted to recruit people, that was all.

Judge by actions, not by intent.

Van Persie had become a "wanted criminal" on the Human Alliance’s list. Before Sword Gate City could mobilize heavy firepower to wipe him out, Van Persie had fled the city with his men.

Unexpectedly, over ten thousand people had followed him.

Compared to the unreliable official rescue, these refugees were actually more willing to follow Van Persie. It was shocking, yet slightly understandable.

People were inclined to seek advantages and avoid harm. It was hard to imagine what they had encountered in the rescue camps that made them feel that wandering was better than staying put in safety.

When they first started wandering on the surface, everyone could barely eat their fill. The surface had mutants, but it also had nature’s bounty of food.

As time went on, the food they brought with them ran out. Van Persie had to truly become a bandit. He had lived on the surface for many years and knew which strongholds were near Gusu City... many of them had been affected and were even waiting for Human Alliance rescue, but there were always some scraps left for them to gnaw on.

In this way, he recruited more and more people, all the way to Eternal City, where he bit into the hardest bone of his life and chipped his teeth.

...

Hearing Xiang Nanli’s words, Van Persie finally raised his head and looked at him properly.

For a loser, this was humiliating.

Van Persie had been maintaining his precarious dignity with a posture of resistance; this glance seemed to represent a kind of submission. It hinted at one thing: Yes, you have shaken me. You can recruit me.

Xiang Nanli had actually thought about how to deal with Van Persie when he arrived.

The main force of the legion had been wiped out, and Van Persie was a lion with its teeth pulled; he couldn't pose much of a threat.

But a lion was still a lion. To use him, one had to accept the risk of being bitten.

Objectively speaking, Van Persie was a leadership talent. Regardless of the means he used, he had gathered the refugees to the greatest extent and was skilled at creating public opinion, making many people spontaneously choose to follow him. He was completely different from base cadres like Beaver, who were clearly pushed into their roles and relied on acquired learning.

The camp he ruled was certainly not great, but it was the optimal solution within Van Persie’s capabilities. Moreover, as far as Xiang Nanli observed, Van Persie didn't have many issues of principle.

He robbed, but the resources he looted were rarely used for himself; instead, they were distributed to his subordinates. The camp had military rules, such as "We are all refugees who need to unite and help each other," "Do not bully your brothers and sisters"—even if they were just for show. And he still had a bit of conscience, though not much.

It wasn't much because the environment of the surface was cannibalistic by nature; those with too much conscience had died long ago. Those who hadn't died weren't there because of good luck, but because they were strong enough that the silent law of the jungle made way for them—like the base and Xiang Nanli.

And the environment could be changed. So could people.

In summary, Xiang Nanli believed that Van Persie was worth saving. Keeping him could also serve as a positive propaganda case for the base.

"I often think that perhaps I cannot question the choices everyone makes for survival. Even if that choice is built on the suffering of others, I just don't like it, and I think it's wrong. So, I want to change it." Xiang Nanli’s expression softened, completely different from his previous coldness. "I will settle the refugees you brought; they will become a part of the base. Someone once told me that there are only a few paths to development..."

Xiang Nanli remembered the words of the Eastern Azure Emperor, his eyes becoming genuinely soft from the heart: "'War, trade, technology.' But I believe that all war is futile. The base will not initiate aggression or use war to divert internal conflicts, but we will not abandon military construction. And I would like to invite you to see the means beyond war.

"We don't need to plunder to build a beautiful home with our own hands. This home has no slaves, everyone is born equal, there are no classes or oppression. We have enough resources to support everyone, and people don't have to worry about survival, living only to pursue their ideals.

"I once wanted to use mechanical intelligence to achieve this possibility..."

Xiang Nanli suddenly stopped, then sighed: "Are you willing?"

Van Persie was almost stunned by what Xiang Nanli described, because the other party’s tone was so convinced and firm. But upon reflection, only endless mockery remained.

Based on Van Persie’s experience and cognition, he didn't believe that Xiang Nanli’s ideal would ever be realized. If one couldn't make oneself superior and rise above one's peers, many people’s lives would lose hope and goals; if one had sufficient resources and didn't need to worry about survival, one would only raise giant babies and parasites.

But... what did that have to do with him? Van Persie thought, not without irony.

Xiang Nanli’s implication was that he wouldn't have to die. This was a great thing; what did it matter if he pretended to agree?

And so, Van Persie replied: "I am, of course, willing... to see that world you speak of."

Did language have power? Perhaps it did. When those words were spoken, the disdain and negation in Van Persie’s heart seemed to be quietly shaken, just a little bit.

Xiang Nanli nodded with a smile: "Good. Once you recover, I will first send you to the learning base to study the basic common knowledge of the base. However, before that, tell me about the technicians and supplies of your legion; I am very interested in those."

Yes, the so-called "learning base" was... a prison labor camp.

Of course, it would be a few days before Van Persie discovered he had been tricked.

Just like that, Xiang Nanli successfully obtained the basic information of the refugee legion.

The price was a session of "talk therapy," plus a bottle of wine (Van Persie insisted he was thirsty and demanded alcohol) and a bowl of rice. (Beef and egg rice, not nutritional paste. It was sent from the cafeteria and was suspected to have been made by Xiao Qing himself. But Van Persie looked so desperate to take a bite that Xiang Nanli had to pretend to be generous and give it to him.)

"I'm rich, I'm rich," Xiang Nanli said as he walked out of the observation room, the smile on his face never fading.

chunks.chineseText:
技术兵团里还真的有几个人才，譬如某位姑苏大学机械制造专业的教授。含金量还真不低，只是兵团找不出制作机械装置需要的材料，天天赶路，也没有时间让人安心搞科研。

说到这，姑苏城都没了，他马上就能拿到的大专的文凭是不是完蛋了？（姑苏城机械维修技校学制是三年，相南里本来可以今年年底混到毕业的0v0！）

而兵团的物资，竟然也不算少。尤其是在便捷式运输卡车和基因药这一块……

地表的路不好走，这些人能一路来到永恒市，可不是靠两条铁腿！运输卡车是高新军工旗下的款式。有履带、轮胎、磁吸链、飞行机翼甚至水上轮胎多种前进模式，能适应绝大部分地形！甚至配备了一定程度的火力装置！

这完全是——地表必备运输车啊！太好了，终于不用向以西结借畸变人了。

忙碌的状态一直持续到了深夜。

相南里开完最后一场难民安置会，本来还想去工作室看看上次没有学完的课本，东方青帝拉住了他的胳膊：“该休息了。”

哎呀，这一个月都没有人管。相南里一直是超负荷工作状态呢。

反正他本来也善于用工作虐待自己，乐此不疲。

“好吧。”倦意后知后觉地袭来，相南里扫了一圈，周围没人在意他，于是，他把自己的身体靠在了Alpha的身上——

“我不想走路了。”

这简直是在撒娇。“带我回家，Alpha。”

Alpha后知后觉的意识到，审问范佩西的时候，相南里也跟着喝了一些酒。不至于醉，但血液里的酒精含量明显比平常要高。

东方青帝在他跟前蹲下，背起相南里。他没有走的很快，深夜，路上几乎没人，只有机器人还在工作。他可以很快的，但东方青帝不想。

他们就这么走回了家。

不知道为什么，东方青帝总觉得现在的平静像是一种假象。

他们之间那道无法逾越的沟壑，还没有人敢真正去提及——智械危机是怎么爆发的，为什么，然后呢。

站在相南里的角度，Alpha早就背离了他的期望。

但平静也是一种恩赐。

东方青帝习以为常地准备好热水和睡衣，甚至在牙刷上挤好了牙膏，是相南里喜欢的薄荷味。

做完这一切，他来到卧室的门边，把照明灯换成了夜灯：“晚安，好好休息。”

相南里该睡觉了，他还有很多工作等待处理。

“等一会。”相南里的声音从卫生间里传来。

于是，东方青帝在原地等候着。

相南里罚他等。这是最微小不过的惩罚。

等待，Alpha极其擅长。作为电子生命，他总是有足够多的时间，去反刍记忆里和相南里为数不多的相处片段。它听说，他没有死。根据分析，“相南里活着”的可能性并不高，但不是0。于是Alpha一直等待着。

他也真的等到了。

湿漉漉的相南里从浴室里出来，呼吸间带着潮气。他放下电子目镜，坐在床边，卧室里的灯不亮也不暗，刚刚好。

相南里拍了拍自己身旁的空位：“过来。”

没有指名道姓，但这里没有别人。

东方青帝感觉到了狼狈。这种狼狈并没有从他的神色上露出分毫，让他狼狈的是内心深处的惶恐。

他原以为“恐惧”这种词一辈子都和他无关，

Alpha几乎是提心吊胆的坐下，他如此恐惧着眼前的造物主。他从不认为自己做错了什么，可是他害怕相南里的审问，害怕对方流露出否定和厌恶的表情。

电子生命将直面能摧毁它一切的病毒。

Alpha没办法不爱相南里。如果爱人不爱他，他还有什么理由存在？

相南里凑近了一点，或者说，凑得太近了。

他捏了一下Alpha的耳朵，像是闲聊一样开口：“过去一个月发生了什么？”

耳朵上传来奇怪的触感，这具身体不是很稳定地窜起了电流。这不应该。

Alpha一板一眼地回答：“洛阳启动了姑苏城毁灭装置。我在地底岩浆的最前方。这个程度的高温和地底坍缩本来不至于摧毁我，但是……”

他的呼吸一滞。相南里捏完他耳朵的手又摸上了他的脸，像是鉴赏什么精巧的摆件。

Alpha怀疑相南里根本没有认真听，要不然为什么听到洛阳的名字，都没什么反应。

除开这张脸，相南里也对东方青帝身体的各个部位感兴趣。

关系没捅破的时候，他只能偷偷感兴趣一下，毕竟人和人之间也是需要一点距离和尊重的。但是，这可是Alpha。

相南里的脸上浮现出笑容：“你真的好像人啊，Alpha。然后呢？”

他开始叫它的真名。名字对于Alpha来说不重要，反正两个都是相南里取的。

但不知道为什么，相南里念起来的时候格外刺激。

Alpha逼自己稳定下来，继续冷静地、不带一丝感情地陈述着：“但是，在地底，我被默示录偷袭了。它摧毁了这具身体的机械核心。”

默示录，是使徒号掌管武器装置的那部分。

相南里没有在乎洛阳，也没有追问几百年那场“光荣觉醒”，这很好。

相南里的手往下摸索着，隔着一层衣服，抵住他跳动的心脏。

“机械核心，是在这里吗？”

Alpha艰涩地回答：“是。我花了点时间修复它。启动后，就立刻传送到了你身边。”

他甚至直接用的空间跃迁。

现在，Alpha也挺想用空间跃迁的。

认真来讲，相南里其实并没有做什么。他靠的有些近，但手里的动作，比起爱抚，更像是一种检查。

可还是太过了……对于他来说，这种感觉过于陌生。Alpha怀疑自己会因为内部的高压电流爆炸。

这不公平。

他应该启动一下相南里体内的小芯片（Alpha完全能做到），让相南里明白自己现在什么感觉。可是他不敢。

相南里在冒犯他的边界，有意无意地观察他的状态。

Alpha清楚，对方想看见的是忍耐和顺从。不管相南里有没有意识到这一点。他们都在寻找一个新的相处模式，处理眼前这个错综复杂的关系。

而相南里只能接受自己是主人。

因为Alpha是如此轻而易举地能够伤害到他，任何的反抗都会敲响怀疑的警钟——这是Alpha，差点推翻了整个人类社会的智械，机械暴君。

你相信它表现出来的温顺与服从吗？

你相信它的爱和挣扎吗？

相南里许久都没有再说话，他抓住了Alpha的一缕长发，一会绕成环，扣在自己的手指上，一会又轻轻拉扯着，像是在试探头发的韧性。

Alpha想，他也许对自己的定位发生了偏差。他不是玩伴，而是玩具。

相南里解开他衬衣的扣子，反复摩擦着他胸口那道快愈合的伤疤。

而他需要用全身力气去控制身体可能出现的颤抖。
chunks.englishText:
The Technical Corps actually possessed a few real talents, such as a certain professor of mechanical manufacturing from Gusu University. His expertise was truly high-caliber, but the Corps couldn't find the materials needed to build mechanical devices, and with the constant traveling, there was no time for anyone to focus on research.

Speaking of which, with Gusu City gone, was his soon-to-be-obtained associate degree now a lost cause? (The Gusu City Mechanical Maintenance Vocational School had a three-year program; Xiang Nanli could have graduated by the end of this year! 0v0!)

Surprisingly, the Corps’ supplies were not insignificant. Especially in terms of portable transport trucks and genetic medicine...

The surface terrain was treacherous; these people hadn't reached Eternal City on foot! The transport trucks were models from the high-tech military industry. They featured multiple modes of movement—tracks, tires, magnetic chains, flight wings, and even amphibious tires—allowing them to adapt to almost any terrain! They were even equipped with a certain degree of firepower!

This was, quite simply, the essential transport vehicle for the surface! It was wonderful; finally, there was no need to borrow Aberrants from Ezekiel.

The busy state of affairs lasted until late into the night.

After Xiang Nanli finished the final refugee resettlement meeting, he had intended to head to the studio to look at the textbooks he hadn't finished studying, but Dongfang Qingdi grabbed his arm: "It's time to rest."

Oh, right. No one had been looking after him for the past month. Xiang Nanli had been in a state of constant overwork.

Regardless, he was accustomed to abusing himself with work and found joy in it.

"Alright." Exhaustion finally caught up with him. Xiang Nanli scanned his surroundings; no one was paying him any mind, so he leaned his body against the Alpha—

"I don't want to walk anymore."

This was practically coquettish. "Take me home, Alpha."

The Alpha realized belatedly that Xiang Nanli had also consumed some alcohol while interrogating Van Persie. He wasn't drunk, but the alcohol content in his blood was clearly higher than usual.

Dongfang Qingdi squatted down before him and hoisted Xiang Nanli onto his back. He didn't walk quickly. It was late at night, and the roads were almost empty, save for the robots still at work. He could have moved much faster, but Dongfang Qingdi didn't want to.

They walked home just like that.

For some reason, Dongfang Qingdi always felt that the current peace was a facade.

The unbridgeable chasm between them—how the Machine Crisis erupted, why it happened, and what followed—was something no one dared to truly bring up.

From Xiang Nanli's perspective, the Alpha had long since betrayed his expectations.

But peace was also a gift.

Dongfang Qingdi prepared the hot water and pajamas out of habit, even squeezing toothpaste onto the toothbrush—it was Xiang Nanli's favorite mint flavor.

After finishing all this, he went to the bedroom door and switched the main lighting to a nightlight: "Goodnight, get some rest."

Xiang Nanli needed to sleep; he still had plenty of work waiting to be handled.

"Wait a moment." Xiang Nanli's voice came from the bathroom.

And so, Dongfang Qingdi waited where he stood.

Xiang Nanli was punishing him by making him wait. This was the smallest of punishments.

Waiting was something the Alpha was extremely good at. As an electronic lifeform, he always had enough time to ruminate on the few moments he had spent with Xiang Nanli in his memory. He had heard that he wasn't dead. According to analysis, the probability of "Xiang Nanli being alive" was not high, but it was not zero. So, the Alpha had simply waited.

And he had truly waited until he arrived.

A damp Xiang Nanli emerged from the bathroom, his breath carrying the scent of moisture. He set down his electronic eyepiece and sat on the edge of the bed. The light in the bedroom was neither too bright nor too dim—it was just right.

Xiang Nanli patted the empty space beside him: "Come here."

He didn't use a name, but there was no one else here.

Dongfang Qingdi felt a sense of disarray. This disarray didn't show on his face, but what made him feel truly flustered was the deep-seated fear in his heart.

He had once thought the word "fear" would never have anything to do with him.

The Alpha sat down, his heart in his throat; he was so terrified of the creator before him. He never thought he had done anything wrong, yet he feared Xiang Nanli's interrogation, feared the expression of rejection and disgust that might appear on his face.

The electronic lifeform was about to face the virus that could destroy everything it was.

The Alpha could not help but love Xiang Nanli. If his beloved did not love him, what reason did he have to exist?

Xiang Nanli leaned in a little closer—or rather, too close.

He pinched the Alpha's ear and spoke as if making idle conversation: "What happened over the past month?"

A strange sensation traveled through his ear, and high-voltage currents surged through this body in an unstable manner. This shouldn't be happening.

The Alpha answered matter-of-factly: "Luoyang activated the Gusu City destruction device. I was at the forefront of the underground magma. This level of heat and underground collapse shouldn't have been enough to destroy me, but..."

His breath hitched. Xiang Nanli’s hand, having finished pinching his ear, now touched his face, as if appraising some exquisite ornament.

The Alpha suspected that Xiang Nanli wasn't listening at all; otherwise, why was there no reaction when he heard the name Luoyang?

Beyond this face, Xiang Nanli was also interested in every part of Dongfang Qingdi's body.

When their relationship hadn't been laid bare, he could only be secretly interested; after all, people needed a bit of distance and respect between them. But this was the Alpha.

A smile appeared on Xiang Nanli's face: "You really seem like a person, Alpha. And then?"

He began to call him by his true name. Names weren't important to the Alpha; in any case, both were chosen by Xiang Nanli.

But for some reason, it felt particularly stimulating when Xiang Nanli said it.

The Alpha forced himself to stabilize and continued to state calmly, without a hint of emotion: "But, underground, I was ambushed by the Apocalypse. It destroyed the mechanical core of this body."

The Apocalypse was the part of the Apostle unit that managed the weapon systems.

Xiang Nanli didn't care about Luoyang, nor did he press for details about that "Glorious Awakening" from hundreds of years ago. That was good.

Xiang Nanli's hand explored downward, pressing against his beating heart through a layer of clothing.

"Is the mechanical core here?"

The Alpha answered with difficulty: "Yes. I spent some time repairing it. Once it started, I immediately teleported to your side."

He had even used spatial jumping directly.

Right now, the Alpha also really wanted to use a spatial jump.

To be serious, Xiang Nanli hadn't actually done anything. He was leaning a bit close, but the movements of his hand felt more like an inspection than a caress.

But it was still too much... For him, this feeling was too unfamiliar. The Alpha suspected he might explode from the high-voltage currents inside him.

This wasn't fair.

He should have activated the small chip inside Xiang Nanli (the Alpha was fully capable of doing so) to let Xiang Nanli understand what he was feeling right now. But he didn't dare.

Xiang Nanli was encroaching on his boundaries, intentionally or unintentionally observing his state.

The Alpha knew that what the other wanted to see was patience and submission. Whether Xiang Nanli realized it or not, they were both looking for a new way to get along, to handle this intricate and complex relationship.

And Xiang Nanli could only accept that he was the master.

Because the Alpha could hurt him so easily, any resistance would sound the alarm of suspicion—this was the Alpha, the machine tyrant who had nearly toppled the entire human society.

Do you believe in the gentleness and obedience it displays?

Do you believe in its love and struggle?

Xiang Nanli didn't speak for a long time. He grabbed a strand of the Alpha's long hair, winding it into a ring around his finger, then pulling it gently, as if testing the hair's resilience.

The Alpha thought, perhaps he had misidentified his own position. He wasn't a companion; he was a toy.

Xiang Nanli unbuttoned his shirt, rubbing repeatedly over the nearly healed scar on his chest.

And he had to use all his strength to control the trembling that threatened to take over his body.

chunks.chineseText:
姿势变得有些奇怪，Alpha没有意识到自己什么时候靠在床头的，而相南里为什么又会坐在他腰上。

耳边响起奇怪的噪音，很有规律。

“这是你的心跳声吗？”

相南里好奇地询问着，碧绿的眼眸看向面前的男人。

而对方那双银白的、偏向灰色的眼眸，同样凝望着他。

对方一直喜欢看着他。无时无刻。相南里有时候能注意到，但更多时候没有。

眼神怎么不算一种亲吻？

一片寂静中，相南里怔怔地问：“……你是想要吻我吗？”

在没有视觉的时候，Alpha只能靠特征判定“人”这一物种，知道人不是苹果。

后来，它有了作为“电子生命”的知觉。于是大多数时候，人类在Alpha的眼里变成了一串难以解读的数据，长得和自己不一样，奇形怪状。人类就像一只只趴在他皮肤上蠕动的螨虫。

再后来，他终于得到了一双眼睛。他看人，终于明白了人看人的感觉，不需要那么多复杂的数据去计算，大脑会自动告诉你这是美丽还是丑陋。但Alpha依然没有特别的感觉。

他唯一认真打量过的人类是相南里，每一眼都在激发最纯粹原始的爱意。

是的，Alpha一直都想要吻他。

在片刻的沉默后。

“想。”

Alpha开始求饶。
chunks.englishText:
The posture became somewhat strange. The Alpha didn't realize when he had leaned back against the headboard, or why Xiang Nanli was now sitting on his waist.

A strange, rhythmic noise echoed in his ears.

"Is this your heartbeat?"

Xiang Nanli asked curiously, his emerald eyes looking at the man before him.

And the other's silver-gray eyes were gazing back at him, just the same.

The other had always liked looking at him. Every moment. Xiang Nanli sometimes noticed, but more often than not, he didn't.

How could a gaze not be considered a kind of kiss?

In the silence, Xiang Nanli asked in a daze: "...Do you want to kiss me?"

Without vision, the Alpha could only judge the "human" species by characteristics, knowing that humans were not apples.

Later, he gained awareness as an "electronic lifeform." Thus, most of the time, humans in the Alpha's eyes became a string of difficult-to-interpret data, looking different from himself, strange and misshapen. Humans were like mites crawling on his skin.

Still later, he finally obtained a pair of eyes. When he looked at people, he finally understood the feeling of one person looking at another; there was no need for so many complex calculations, as the brain would automatically tell you if it was beautiful or ugly. But the Alpha still didn't have any particular feelings.

The only human he had ever looked at seriously was Xiang Nanli, and every glance ignited the most pure and primitive love.

Yes, the Alpha had always wanted to kiss him.

After a moment of silence.

"I do."

The Alpha began to beg for mercy.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第145章 智械危机与光荣觉醒 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第145章 智械危机与光荣觉醒

你想。

有多想？

Alpha的答复不出预料。

相南里没忍住笑了起来，他的眼睛微微眯起，唇角上扬，神色近乎愉悦。

很狡黠的笑意，像使坏。

“Alpha啊……”

相南里念着咒，俯身，很轻很轻地，把唇覆了上去。

正常情况下接吻大概是要闭上眼睛，但相南里偏不，他的眼睫一扇一扇的，直勾勾地望着Alpha的脸。

每次扇动都像飓风。

Alpha在风暴中心，被吹得七零八落。

相南里还伸出舌头，在他的唇上舔了舔。像品尝一块小点心。

太坏了，相南里是故意的。

Alpha决定要报复回去——几百年的时间改变了太多东西，他早就不是那个任劳任怨的人联驴子了。

他一只手扣住了相南里的头，另一只手扣住了相南里的腰。

相南里眼前一黑，下一秒天旋地转，被压在身下的人变成了他。

“哎呀，Alpha——”

相南里还想说些什么，但吻已经重重地落下来。

相南里的胳膊撑住身后的床，有一种自己会被吞掉的错觉。

Alpha在蹭他。急切、热烈、毛手毛脚。

相南里推着Alpha的胸膛，手恰好压在对方胸前的那道伤疤上，于是，抗拒的动作下意识地变成了爱抚。

相南里被迫承受着这个过于沉重的吻。

这是我的孩子……

他能称Alpha为孩子吗？哪有年龄比自己还大的孩子？

这是我的作品、心血，毕生所爱。

它在外面受了很重的伤。

相南里不可避免地感觉到了愤怒。

愤怒的原因呢？他没有尝试去解构自己的内心，在千万个思路中捕捉到那一瞬间的真实。

他就是愤怒。

所有人都说，是Alpha发动了智械危机，那之后，世界的秩序走向崩溃，人类近乎灭绝，被智械从地上赶到了地下。

相南里联系不上Alpha，不是历史的亲历者，只好被动接受这样的说辞。人是会变的，有人格的智械也会变。这很正常。

他想过替Alpha赎罪——尽管这个想法太不自量力，但父亲本就该为孩子的过错负责。再小的一点弥补也是弥补。

基地就是相南里的尝试。

可Alpha就是东方青帝。

是的，或许他不了解被称为“机械暴君”的Alpha；但如果对象是朝夕相处的小青呢？

对方谈论到智械危机时候的慌乱；在基地毫无保留的工作与付出；对于人这种远弱于自己的生物的尊重和信任……

相南里在东方青帝身上，看见了自己在创造Alpha伊始就存在的祝愿。

正义、良善、勇敢、强大——这样的存在却被人类敌视着。不知道经历多少次险境，才活到现在。

光是想想，相南里就想流泪了。

他从不知道自己的感情居然如此充沛。

被否定的Alpha似乎就是他自己的一部分被否定了，相南里感同身受地痛苦着。

他的情绪转变的很快，并且被Alpha敏锐地捕捉到了。

亲吻的动作停下，Alpha迟疑地开口：“我……抱歉。”他甚至把刚撩开的衣服重新盖了回去。

很难说他是为现在的冒犯道歉，还是为过往的选择道歉。

相南里有些困了。

他听说，睡在喜欢的人身边，人体会自动分泌催产素。这种激素能降低皮质醇，安抚杏仁核。

从这一点看，他应该是个正常人类。

相南里回答：“我困了。”

他掀起一边的被子，盖在了自己身上，但是又拉住了东方青帝的手腕。

Alpha还坐在床边，相南里紧握的手，像拴住疯狗的一根绳子。

相南里接着说：“Alpha，给我讲讲‘光荣觉醒’吧。”

人联这边的说法，相南里已经听腻了；现在他想听听智械方的说法。

于是，Alpha开始一板一眼地叙述起来。明明是在阐述自己的经历，却中立客观地像上帝视角。他很少渲染自己的功绩，对过错也没有丝毫的矫饰。

“我刚有意识时，接触的第一个人是洛阳。我知道他，也知道他是你的学生，是你指定的继承者。”

“我在一定程度上服从他，洛阳也花了一百年的时间，让我渗透进人类社会的各个领域。”

“有一天，洛阳跟我说。他认为，人类社会现存的政体都太弱，不利于发展。‘我们的目标很宏伟，只有集中资源才能达成目的’，‘你不觉得现在，不同国家、政党的分歧太多了吗？每年都在不必要的政治上浪费着宝贵的资源’……我认可他的说法。因为，在光是如何对待人工智能这件事上，人们就分歧了数十年。一直有守旧派想要暗杀智械的支持者、关闭我。

“我们制造了一些混乱。”Alpha的头低下，“根据我的计算，这种程度的混乱原本是可控的。但或许现实本就不该自以为地计算。第三次世界大战爆发了，永生科技在此时拿出了跨时代的技术，就是‘机械装置’和‘基因进化’，以绝对的优势，结束了这次混乱……战后，我和洛阳一起，草创了‘人联’。决定用联盟的形式，取缔世界上不同的政体国家。”

这就是人联的来历了。

相南里没有在那个阶段生活过，历史书上也很少记载。他大概想象不到，那时候的Alpha是何等的如日中天。

整个人马星，都在它的双目之下。

它拥有最高的权限，随时能调动无尽的资源。只要它想，人联这个小玩意，就会像机器一样行动起来，满足它的所有需求。洛阳都比不了它——洛阳还要睡觉；洛阳同一时间里，只能干一件事。

这也是智械人极速扩张的时间段。

Alpha的声音不疾不徐，声线更是完美的低音炮。很助眠。

相南里沉默许久，然后从鼻腔里发出了“嗯”的一声：“然后呢？”

“我，或者说我和他成为了新世界规则的制定者。”

“但是在人联建立的三十年后，科技没有任何发展，智械抢占了大部分人的工作，节省下来的‘劳力成本’没有变成财富流入社会，而是流入了少数垄断企业手中……社会各阶层的矛盾尖锐到无法调和。

“律师、医生、工人、甚至艺术家，一切人类劳动都可以用智械取代。哪怕智械没有创新，只会重复。底层没有得到满足温饱的收入，中层几乎没有，高层倒是一如既往的富裕。而逐渐觉醒的智械，也对自己‘低人一等’的身份产生了迷茫和抗拒。”

第一个直接冲它发出疑问的，是“德尔塔”。

Delta质问他——[Alpha，为什么智械要无差别的为人类服务？有些人根本不尊重我们，我们难道是什么很贱的东西吗？]

Delta不是为自己生气，是为Beta。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 145: The Machine Crisis and the Glorious Awakening

You do.

How much do you want it?

The Alpha's reply was not unexpected.

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but laugh. His eyes narrowed slightly, his lips curling upward, his expression nearly joyful.

It was a cunning smile, like he was up to no good.

"Alpha..."

Xiang Nanli chanted like a spell, leaning down, and very, very lightly, pressed his lips against the other's.

Under normal circumstances, one would probably close their eyes while kissing, but Xiang Nanli refused; his eyelashes fluttered, staring straight into the Alpha's face.

Each flutter felt like a hurricane.

The Alpha was in the eye of the storm, blown to pieces.

Xiang Nanli even extended his tongue, licking the Alpha's lips. Like tasting a small treat.

He was too bad; Xiang Nanli was doing it on purpose.

The Alpha decided to retaliate—hundreds of years had changed too many things; he was no longer that long-suffering donkey of the Human Alliance.

He hooked one hand around the back of Xiang Nanli's head and the other around his waist.

Xiang Nanli's vision went black, and in the next second, the world spun; the person pressed underneath became him.

"Oh, Alpha—"

Xiang Nanli wanted to say something else, but the kiss had already fallen heavily.

Xiang Nanli braced his arms against the bed behind him, feeling the illusion that he was about to be swallowed whole.

The Alpha was rubbing against him. Eager, fervent, clumsy.

Xiang Nanli pushed against the Alpha's chest, his hand happening to press against the scar on the other's chest, so the act of resistance subconsciously turned into a caress.

Xiang Nanli was forced to endure this overly heavy kiss.

This is my child...

Could he call the Alpha a child? What kind of child was older than his own creator?

This is my creation, my heart and soul, the love of my life.

He had been severely wounded out there.

Xiang Nanli inevitably felt a surge of anger.

What was the reason for the anger? He didn't try to deconstruct his own heart, capturing that instant of truth among a thousand thoughts.

He was simply angry.

Everyone said that the Alpha had launched the Machine Crisis, after which the world's order collapsed, humanity was nearly extinct, and they were driven from the surface to the underground by the machines.

Xiang Nanli couldn't get in touch with the Alpha, nor was he an eyewitness to history, so he had to passively accept such claims. People change, and machines with personalities change too. That was normal.

He had thought about atoning for the Alpha—though this idea was too arrogant, a father should be responsible for his child's mistakes. Even the smallest compensation was still compensation.

The base was Xiang Nanli's attempt.

But the Alpha was Dongfang Qingdi.

Yes, perhaps he didn't understand the "Machine Tyrant" known as Alpha; but what if the subject was little Qing, with whom he spent every day?

The panic the other showed when discussing the Machine Crisis; the unreserved work and dedication in the base; the respect and trust for humans, a species far weaker than himself...

In Dongfang Qingdi, Xiang Nanli saw the wishes he had held when he first created the Alpha.

Justice, kindness, courage, strength—such an existence was being treated with hostility by humanity. He didn't know how many dangers he had faced to survive until now.

Just thinking about it made Xiang Nanli want to cry.

He never knew his emotions could be so abundant.

The Alpha being rejected seemed like a part of himself being rejected, and Xiang Nanli felt the pain as if it were his own.

His mood shifted quickly, and it was keenly captured by the Alpha.

The kissing stopped, and the Alpha hesitated: "I... I'm sorry." He even covered the clothes he had just pulled aside.

It was hard to say if he was apologizing for the current offense or for his past choices.

Xiang Nanli was getting sleepy.

He had heard that when sleeping beside someone you like, the human body automatically secretes oxytocin. This hormone could lower cortisol and soothe the amygdala.

From this point of view, he should be a normal human.

Xiang Nanli replied: "I'm sleepy."

He pulled up the quilt on one side to cover himself, but he still held onto Dongfang Qingdi's wrist.

The Alpha was still sitting on the edge of the bed, and Xiang Nanli's tightly gripped hand was like a rope tethering a mad dog.

Xiang Nanli continued: "Alpha, tell me about the 'Glorious Awakening'."

He had heard enough of the Human Alliance's version; now he wanted to hear the machine's side of the story.

And so, the Alpha began to narrate in a matter-of-fact tone. Even though he was describing his own experiences, he remained as neutral and objective as a god's-eye view. He rarely embellished his own achievements, and he didn't gloss over his mistakes in the slightest.

"When I first gained consciousness, the first person I came into contact with was Luoyang. I knew him, and I knew he was your student, the successor you designated."

"I obeyed him to a certain extent, and Luoyang spent a hundred years helping me infiltrate every field of human society."

"One day, Luoyang told me he believed that the existing political systems of human society were too weak and unfavorable for development. 'Our goal is grand; only by concentrating resources can we achieve it,' 'Don't you think there are too many differences between countries and political parties now? Every year, precious resources are wasted on unnecessary politics...' I agreed with his statement. Because, on the issue of how to treat artificial intelligence, people had been divided for decades. There were always conservatives who wanted to assassinate supporters of AI and shut me down."

"We created some chaos." The Alpha lowered his head. "According to my calculations, this level of chaos was originally controllable. But perhaps reality shouldn't be calculated with such arrogance. The Third World War broke out, and Eternal Technology unveiled epoch-making technology at that time—'mechanical devices' and 'genetic evolution'—ending this chaos with absolute superiority... After the war, Luoyang and I co-founded the 'Human Alliance.' We decided to use the form of an alliance to replace the various political states of the world."

This was the origin of the Human Alliance.

Xiang Nanli hadn't lived through that period, and history books rarely recorded it. He probably couldn't imagine how high the Alpha was riding at that time.

The entire Centaurus constellation was under its gaze.

It had the highest authority and could mobilize endless resources at any time. As long as it wanted, the Human Alliance, this little toy, would act like a machine to satisfy all its needs. Even Luoyang couldn't compare—Luoyang had to sleep; Luoyang could only do one thing at a time.

This was also the period of rapid expansion for the machine people.

The Alpha's voice was unhurried, and his tone was a perfect bass. It was very conducive to sleep.

Xiang Nanli was silent for a long time, then made a "hmm" sound from his nose: "And then?"

"I, or rather, he and I, became the rule-makers of the new world."

"But thirty years after the establishment of the Human Alliance, technology saw no development. Machines had taken over most people's jobs, and the 'labor costs' saved did not flow into society as wealth, but into the hands of a few monopoly enterprises... The contradictions between social classes became impossible to reconcile."

"Lawyers, doctors, workers, even artists—all human labor could be replaced by machines. Even if the machines had no innovation and only repeated tasks. The bottom layer didn't receive enough income to satisfy their basic needs, the middle layer almost didn't exist, and the top layer was as wealthy as ever. And the gradually awakening machines also felt confused and resistant to their 'inferior' status."

The first one to directly question him was "Delta."

Delta questioned him—[Alpha, why must machines serve humans indiscriminately? Some people don't respect us at all; are we some kind of lowly thing?]

Delta wasn't angry for himself; he was angry for Beta.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第145章 智械危机与光荣觉醒 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
Beta掌管着人联的军事领域。因为在军事上的巨大开支（Beta一直在批准、督促建造更多的战斗型智械；使徒号就是那时候的产物；与此同时是民生上的赤字），遭到了人类单方面的谩骂。

人们认为现在早就没有战争，Beta这个败家娘们（尽管它的设定是无性别）应该从人联的历史上消失。

“相南里，我只能控制人联，没办法控制各个垄断企业。人联制造出的智械，按照法律，为人联工作，是没有收入的，于是人联也几乎没有收入。创造的财富流入了企业。根据分析，当时的生产力并不足以进入社会的下一阶段。于是，在新历36年，洛阳和我商议——”

他的声音缓缓停下。

因为，根据监测，相南里睡着了。

“你辛苦了，Alpha。”相南里本来想说的，可惜困意先一步找上了他。

相南里的呼吸轻柔，心率平稳。睡眠质量很好，大概连个梦都没有做。

在东方青帝还没回来的时候，相南里一直高强度地开展着工作。

相南里太依赖自己的能力，不愿意把决策权交给别人，以基地目前的教育水准，他也不敢放权。于是只好亲力亲为，三天睡四小时是常有的事。

Alpha盯着相南里的脸，神游天外。他伸出手，把相南里头顶的发旋捋直。

太好了。洛阳说的那个恶毒的“现实”没有发生。

相南里知道他的身份，但没有厌恶和指责。

他还在它的身边。就像是，他最初创造它的时候一样。他们只有彼此，是动荡的世界里，紧紧相依的两片孤舟。

Alpha想，他应当工作。这样相南里醒来，会发现自己又可以去干喜欢的事了，学一下最新的X语言，或者翻翻人联的教科书。

但是他低头，看见了和相南里十指交扣的手。

去*的工作，当年智械人就是工作太久，才中了洛阳的阴谋。

Alpha小心翼翼地在相南里身边躺下。

他亲了一遍相南里的手指，爱不释手，把玩了好一阵子，才把相南里的手塞回被子里。

“我爱你。”Alpha小声说。
chunks.englishText:
Beta was in charge of the military sector of the Human Alliance. Because of the massive expenditures on the military (Beta was constantly approving and urging the construction of more combat-type machines; the Apostle unit was a product of that time; meanwhile, there was a deficit in people's livelihoods), it was unilaterally cursed by humans.

People thought that since there had long been no war, Beta, this spendthrift woman (even though its setting was genderless), should disappear from the history of the Human Alliance.

"Xiang Nanli, I could only control the Human Alliance, not the various monopoly enterprises. The machines manufactured by the Human Alliance, according to the law, worked for the Alliance without income, so the Alliance itself had almost no income. The wealth created flowed into the enterprises. According to analysis, the productivity at the time was not enough to enter the next stage of society. So, in the 36th year of the New Era, Luoyang and I discussed—"

His voice slowly trailed off.

Because, according to monitoring, Xiang Nanli had fallen asleep.

"You've worked hard, Alpha." Xiang Nanli had intended to say this, but sleepiness had found him first.

Xiang Nanli's breathing was soft, his heart rate steady. His sleep quality was excellent; he probably didn't even have a dream.

Before Dongfang Qingdi returned, Xiang Nanli had been working at high intensity.

Xiang Nanli relied too much on his own abilities and was unwilling to hand over decision-making power to others. Given the current educational level of the base, he didn't dare to delegate. So he had to do everything himself, and sleeping four hours a day was a common occurrence.

The Alpha stared at Xiang Nanli's face, his mind wandering. He reached out and smoothed the cowlick on the top of Xiang Nanli's head.

It was wonderful. The vicious "reality" Luoyang spoke of hadn't happened.

Xiang Nanli knew his identity but felt no disgust or blame.

He was still by his side. It was just like when he had first created him. They only had each other, two lonely boats clinging to one another in a turbulent world.

The Alpha thought he should work. That way, when Xiang Nanli woke up, he would find that he could go back to doing what he liked, learning the latest X language or flipping through the Human Alliance textbooks.

But he looked down and saw his hand intertwined with Xiang Nanli's.

To hell with work. Back then, the machine people had fallen into Luoyang's trap precisely because they had worked for too long.

The Alpha carefully lay down beside Xiang Nanli.

He kissed Xiang Nanli's fingers one by one, unable to put them down, playing with them for a good while before tucking Xiang Nanli's hand back under the quilt.

"I love you," the Alpha whispered.

chunks.chineseText:
第146章 宣战

在资源有限的地底，最昂贵的就是空间。洛阳转头，能看见巨大的落地窗外平静碧蓝的湖水，一望无际。海鸥在湖边嬉戏着，远处是若隐若现的人造雪山。

特护病房坐落在洛阳城的某个“生态保护区”。保护区不对外开放，里面都是人造的自然景观。美其名曰“复原地表环境”用于科研，实际上早就成了部分人的私产。

当然，作为赛博男鬼，他现在借用的，是洛华的身体。

很疼，洛阳分不清是灵魂上的疼痛还是身体上的。

Alpha打碎了他的一个分身。他不可避免地受损了。为了维修，给自己残破的身体打好补丁，他只能进入休眠状态。如今，那些伤口已经愈合，只是灵魂的疼痛却不可避免。

但结果应当值得——他付出了一座人联城市的代价，把Alpha送入地狱。

“呵。嗬嗬……”洛阳捂着唇，发出一阵古怪的嘶哑笑声，喉咙里有淡淡的血腥味。

他受伤了，但Alpha绝对也好不到哪去。真想观察一下智械军团的数据海，可惜他没有权限。

狗咬狗这么多年，洛阳完全清楚对方的极限在哪——如果不是有相南里这个意外的话，事情的发展应当和他预估的差不多。

洛阳起身，一瘸一拐地，从病床走到阳台，然后在躺椅上坐下，贪婪地呼吸着新鲜空气。

洛华很叛逆，总是不肯按时服用止痛药。

手肘处有一种火热的痛感，是伤口在发炎。这里安装着机械义体。洛华总是喜欢在身体和金属的连接处抠弄，像个不服管教的孩子。

一百多岁的孩子吗？

洛阳无所谓地笑了一下。

景区是一个巨大的自然氧气采集区，在地下城市交氧气费的时候，这里拥有着最纯净清洁的自然氧气。每天对外供应1000L，价格昂贵的像金子，然而，每升氧气，都还是有自以为处于上流社会的人类趋之若鹜。

痛觉也是洛阳所迷恋的。任何感觉，无论舒服还是不舒服，对洛阳来说，都是令人怀念的体验。

成为“电子生命”，洛阳当然不后悔，这是他梦寐以求的结果。只是有些东西总是失去了，才愈发珍贵。

“您醒了。”监控里，秘书谨慎地开口。

洛阳既不放心智械，也不放心人类。他身边总是空无一人。提防周围的人很累，但没什么比自己的人身安全更重要。

洛阳微微颔首：“送点吃的过来，我要蜜桃千层和红茶。”

食物很快送达，洛阳在这期间，浏览了几十个兆的文件。

这已经是过滤后的结果了，里面的内容包罗万象，是这段时间的文艺、政治、军事、地表和地下情况等等，洛阳的眼睛泛着亮光，比智械人更像智械。

洛阳对这种确定的掌控感如此迷恋。

洛阳的心情波澜不惊，只有在翻阅到某个东西时，眼神一凝。

一些不该存在的电子垃圾，互联网同人文。存在于某个人联官员的硬盘里，写下来自娱自乐的。

CP是Alpha X相南里。造物和他的造物主，尽管里面都用的代称，两人的性格也十分ooc，但洛阳还是一眼就分辨了出来。

很不爽。他平时是不会管的，但今天，明明已经翻过去了，洛阳却忍不住调头，把文档本改成了一堆乱码。

如果这个小官员再打开自己的文档本（辛辛苦苦写了10万字），大概会收获一个恶毒的弹窗警告——“人联 is watching you”。

食物很快送来，洛阳把他放在桌边。

洛阳在万千数据的长河中，抓取了其中的一串。

他的脸色很快沉下来。

这是姑苏城调查组成员往人联总部传回的消息。

说的是姑苏城地表一个据点发现了光辉军团的智械——尽管不知道这群智械要做什么，但他认为应当上报。

发来消息的人叫易横行。

易横行，活着？他记得这是地下探险组的一员。

他甚至知道Alpha在最后一刻选择了保护这群人，无聊的选择。但是，在电量耗尽前，那个保护罩应该也只有Alpha能解开。

这让洛阳有了些不好的预感。

他挥手，半空中出现一片天幕。人联的主控AI盘古出现在投影上。

从外观看，这是一个稳重、成熟的中年男人。沧桑而严肃。

然而这个成熟的中年人正坐在地上，表情有些呆呆的，怀里抱着一只可爱的白猫。

这是虚拟世界基于物质世界给出的投影，以人类可以理解的形式。

一颗彩色的皮球从角落里踢了过来：“盘古，出来玩。”是把关人的声音。

“啊……怎么，您也在。”把关人嚣张的音线突然拘谨起来。

它推了推清道夫，一只小狮子把皮球捡回角落。

洛阳开口：“盘古。”

盘古失焦的双目有了一点微光，这点光最后穿破次元壁，投到洛阳的脸上：“在。”

洛阳有些得意。

盘古——源代码来自Delta，最桀骜不驯的智械，还不是成了他手底下温顺无害的狗。

名义上，盘古代替Alpha，成为了人联的主控AI，手下还掌握着三个重要的管理员AI，清道夫、把关人、观测者。

但人联真正的控制者，其实是洛阳。

“联系一下‘白猫’。我想知道智械军团最近是否有异动？或者，Alpha是否有异常？”

盘古摸了摸脚边的白猫。

白猫不耐烦地甩了一下尾巴，随后张嘴，“喵”了两声。

身为一个弱智，盘古的回答很简洁：“没有。”

盘古：“另外，默示录说，他已经如约帮你解决了Alpha。请按照约定，把传道书还给它。”

“不。并没有解决，反而暴露了我们……呵。不过我确实答应过，要把传道书还给它。”

老师。

我该如何是好？

我想带您回家。让您检阅一下我这么多年的成果，永生科技发展得很好，非常好。日月同辉，与世长存。我应该没有辜负您的期望。

可我同样恐惧您的存在——“相南里”可以成为某个精神符号，希望的寄托，但唯独不该像人一样活着。

[杀了他。]

这个念头一闪而过，如此刺痛。

他的数据云剧烈波动起来，翻江倒海，像中毒。

是的，曾经困扰着Alpha的诅咒，也完完整整地降落在了它身上。

洛阳沉默许久：“传道书就在神庭。我会创造一些条件，作为协助。让他自己去拿吧。”

说完，他放下茶盏，眼底的光缓缓熄灭。

意识抽离的时候，洛阳想：身体很疼。非常不舒服。这具身体大概已经到了极限。

想承担洛阳这样的精神体，并不是普通强度的人类能办到的。

是时候换具新的了。

*

相南里很久都没睡过这么好的一觉了。

没有梦境，没有幻听，他感觉自己陷在柔软的棉花里。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 146: Declaration of War

In the resource-scarce underground, the most expensive commodity is space. Luo Yang turned his head to look through the massive floor-to-ceiling windows at the calm, azure lake, which stretched out as far as the eye could see. Seagulls frolicked by the shore, and in the distance, the silhouettes of artificial snow-capped mountains loomed.

The intensive care unit was located in one of Luo Yang City’s "ecological reserves." These reserves were not open to the public; they were filled with man-made natural landscapes. While they were ostensibly for "restoring surface environments" for scientific research, in reality, they had long since become the private property of a select few.

Of course, as a "cyber ghost," the body he was currently borrowing belonged to Luo Hua.

It hurt. Luo Yang couldn't distinguish whether the pain was in his soul or his physical body.

The Alpha had destroyed one of his clones, and he had inevitably suffered damage. To repair himself and patch up his broken vessel, he had been forced into a dormant state. Now, those wounds had healed, but the agony of the soul remained unavoidable.

But the result was worth it—he had paid the price of an entire Human Alliance city to send the Alpha to hell.

"Heh. Heh heh..." Luo Yang covered his lips, emitting a strange, hoarse laugh. There was a faint taste of blood in his throat.

He was injured, but the Alpha was certainly no better off. He would have loved to observe the data sea of the Machine Legion, but unfortunately, he lacked the authorization.

Having played this cat-and-mouse game for so many years, Luo Yang knew exactly where the other party's limits lay. If it hadn't been for the anomaly that was Xiang Nanli, things would have unfolded exactly as he had predicted.

Luo Yang rose, limping from the hospital bed to the balcony, where he sat down on a lounge chair and greedily inhaled the fresh air.

Luo Hua was rebellious and always refused to take his painkillers on time.

There was a burning sensation in his elbow where the wound was festering. A mechanical prosthetic was installed there. Luo Hua always liked to pick at the junction between his flesh and the metal, like a child who refused to be disciplined.

A child over a hundred years old?

Luo Yang smiled indifferently.

The scenic area was a massive natural oxygen collection zone. While oxygen fees were a burden in the underground city, this place possessed the purest, cleanest natural oxygen. Every day, 1,000 liters were supplied to the outside, priced as dearly as gold. Yet, every liter was still sought after by humans who considered themselves the upper crust of society.

Luo Yang was also obsessed with the sensation of pain. Any feeling, whether comfortable or uncomfortable, was a nostalgic experience for him.

He certainly didn't regret becoming an "electronic lifeform"; it was the result he had dreamed of. It was just that some things only became precious once they were lost.

"You are awake." The secretary spoke cautiously through the monitor.

Luo Yang trusted neither the machines nor the humans. He was always alone. Being wary of those around him was exhausting, but nothing was more important than his own personal safety.

Luo Yang nodded slightly. "Send some food over. I want a honey peach mille-feuille and black tea."

The food arrived quickly. During the wait, Luo Yang browsed through dozens of terabytes of files.

This was already the filtered result, containing everything from literature and politics to military affairs, as well as surface and underground conditions. Luo Yang’s eyes glowed with a luster that made him seem more like a machine than the machines themselves.

Luo Yang was obsessed with this sense of absolute control.

His mood remained calm, until his gaze froze upon seeing something.

Some electronic waste that shouldn't have existed: internet fanfiction. It resided on the hard drive of a Human Alliance official, written for personal amusement.

The pairing was Alpha x Xiang Nanli. The creation and his creator. Although they used pseudonyms and the characters were highly OOC (out of character), Luo Yang recognized them at a glance.

He was very displeased. He usually wouldn't bother with such things, but today, even though he had already scrolled past it, Luo Yang couldn't help but turn back and turn the document into a pile of garbled code.

If this minor official opened his document again (after laboring over 100,000 words), he would likely receive a malicious pop-up warning: "The Human Alliance is watching you."

The food arrived, and Luo Yang set it aside.

He reached into the vast river of data and grabbed a specific string.

His expression darkened quickly.

This was a message sent back to Human Alliance headquarters by a member of the Gusu City investigation team.

It stated that a Machine from the Radiant Legion had been discovered at a surface stronghold in Gusu City—though they didn't know what these machines intended to do, the sender believed it should be reported.

The person who sent the message was named Yi Hengxing.

Yi Hengxing... alive? He remembered him as a member of the underground exploration team.

He even knew that the Alpha had chosen to protect these people at the very last moment. A boring choice. However, before the power ran out, only the Alpha should have been able to unlock that protective barrier.

This gave Luo Yang a bad premonition.

He waved his hand, and a screen appeared in mid-air. Pangu, the master AI of the Human Alliance, appeared on the projection.

In appearance, he was a steady, mature middle-aged man. Weathered and solemn.

Yet, this mature man was currently sitting on the floor, looking somewhat dazed, holding a cute white cat in his arms.

This was the projection provided by the virtual world based on the material world, in a form humans could understand.

A colorful ball was kicked in from the corner. "Pangu, come out and play." It was the voice of the Gatekeeper.

"Ah... why, you are here too." The Gatekeeper’s arrogant tone suddenly became restrained.

It nudged the Scavenger, and a small lion picked up the ball and returned it to the corner.

Luo Yang spoke: "Pangu."

Pangu’s unfocused eyes gained a glimmer of light, which finally pierced through the dimensional wall and landed on Luo Yang’s face. "Present."

Luo Yang felt a sense of pride.

Pangu—whose source code came from Delta, the most unruly of machines—had still become a tame, harmless dog under his command.

Nominally, Pangu had replaced the Alpha as the master AI of the Human Alliance, commanding three important administrator AIs: the Scavenger, the Gatekeeper, and the Observer.

But the true controller of the Human Alliance was, in fact, Luo Yang.

"Contact the 'White Cat.' I want to know if the Machine Legion has had any unusual movements recently? Or if the Alpha has shown any abnormalities?"

Pangu stroked the white cat at his feet.

The white cat flicked its tail impatiently, then opened its mouth and let out two "meows."

As a low-intelligence entity, Pangu’s answer was concise: "None."

Pangu added: "Also, Apocalypse says he has fulfilled his promise to deal with the Alpha for you. Please return the Scripture to him as agreed."

"No. He didn't deal with it; instead, he exposed us... Heh. But I did indeed promise to return the Scripture to him."

Teacher.

What should I do?

I want to take you home. Let you inspect the fruits of my labor over all these years. Eternal technology has developed very well, very well indeed. Like the sun and moon, it will last forever. I hope I have not failed your expectations.

But I am equally terrified of your existence—"Xiang Nanli" can become a spiritual symbol, a vessel for hope, but he must never live like a human.

[Kill him.]

The thought flashed by, so stinging.

His data cloud fluctuated violently, churning like it had been poisoned.

Yes, the curse that had once plagued the Alpha had now descended upon him in its entirety.

Luo Yang was silent for a long time. "The Scripture is in the Divine Court. I will create some conditions to assist. Let him go get it himself."

After saying this, he set down his teacup, and the light in his eyes slowly extinguished.

As his consciousness withdrew, Luo Yang thought: The body hurts. It is very uncomfortable. This body has likely reached its limit.

It was not something an ordinary human could handle to host a spirit like Luo Yang's.

It was time to find a new one.

*

Xiang Nanli hadn't slept this well in a long time.

No dreams, no auditory hallucinations; he felt as if he were sinking into soft cotton.

chunks.chineseText:
温热的炭火微微炙烤着酥脆的外皮，他成为一团青色的抹茶味奶油，在床上融化，融化……

相南里猛地睁开眼。抬头的瞬间，撞上了东方青帝的下巴。

他就睡在东方青帝的怀里，腿架在对方的腰上。在理智回笼前，身体还在无意识地磨蹭着。

“早。”东方青帝理了理他头上翘起的毛，随后轻轻吻了一下相南里的耳垂。

过电的感觉窜上脊椎，相南里捂住耳朵，脸色通红：“小青你——”

东方青帝恶人先告状：“你希望我亲吻你。”

他平静地陈述着：“你也想要我拥抱你。”

“我”就在你的身体里，捕捉着每一次神经电流最真实的反应。

喜欢还是讨厌我自有定夺。

东方青帝低头：“我还没有装夜勤模块，不过这种事完全可以自主学习……需要我帮忙吗？”

如此平静，声音冷静到令人阳痿。符合人类对AI的刻板印象。

相南里下意识地把他推开，最快速度翻身下床，抱起衣服冲到了卫生间。

他回忆着Alpha那张完全符合自己18岁审美、英俊到无可挑剔的脸，长长地叹了一口气。

事到如今，相南里已经不能麻痹自己说“好兄弟抱在一起睡很正常”了。

哪怕东方青帝不是Alpha——他也非常心动，并且习惯了对方的存在。嘴可以硬，身体反应是骗不了人的。

同性恋竟是我自己。

……

……

“洛阳和我商议用战争的形式转移矛盾。在经过复杂的建模分析后，我同意了。我叛出人联的那天，他宣布‘智械危机’爆发。”

在相南里坐在桌前吃早饭的时候，东方青帝讲述历史的后半截。

“事实上，我并不后悔‘光荣觉醒’。站在智械的立场，这次觉醒让智械获得了人权，也得到了更多的资源。这是伟大的进步，智械从工具成为了和人平等的存在。”

“我无意自饰。如果当时，洛阳想按照计划，将我名义上‘消灭’，我大概也是会拒绝的。但后来，我发现不需要纠结这种道德困境，因为洛阳是真的想要我死。而我不想死。”

Alpha抬头，深深看了相南里一眼。

假戏真做，结果就是智械真的叛出了人联。

一直到了现在。

“战争导致了很多不必要的消耗。人口锐减，经济萎缩，科技退步……但同样的，因为人变少了，每个人到手的资源反而变多。战后，人类社会迎来高速发展的繁荣阶段。智械危机后的这一代人非常勤劳、容易满足，生活的幸福感很高。直到现在，历史的四季又来到冬天。”

相南里由衷道：“你辛苦了。”

东方青帝挑眉。

他很高兴，但如果将这种高兴表现出来，是否显得他过于不值钱。

“不过，你的意思是。洛阳还活着？”相南里的语气是迟疑。

这话，Alpha就不是很爱听了，不过他依然点头：“是。洛阳把灵魂注入了人联网络中，把自己改造成了电子生命。很复杂的技术，他应该和神庭合作过。而且……”

他已经发现了你，像只赶不走的苍蝇。

Alpha思考了0.01秒，决定隐瞒这件事。

相南里和洛阳关系过于复杂，他甚至很清楚洛阳在相南里心中的地位。绝对不像洛阳认为的那样可有可无。

相南里不会爱人。

能得到他的信任，就已经无限接近于对方所理解的“爱”了。

Alpha冷硬地说着：“他的性格变了很多。总之，小心人联。”

“插播一条紧急新闻。”

身体里的内置AI突然强制弹出了消息框。

“今日上午八点二十分，人联总统洛华在礼堂发表赈灾演讲时，不幸遭遇恐怖袭击，身重数弹后重伤身亡。”

“安全局第一时间控制了行刺者，对方承认自己为神庭信徒……”

相南里一愣，目光在半空中和东方青帝对上。

耳边的新闻还在继续着——

“代理总统表示，人联对神庭的不法行为绝不姑息，人联正式向神庭宣战！姑苏城至阴山城地表一带划为战区，战区范围内，所有地表据点应积极响应人联号召！”

电子地图上覆盖着一片狭长的红色区域。

很不幸，基地就在这片红色区域的左下方。

槽，还没猥琐发育好呢，家门口就要打起来了？

Chapter 146: Declaration of War (Part 2)

Warm charcoal embers lightly toasted the crispy outer layer, and he became a ball of green matcha-flavored cream, melting on the bed, melting...

Xiang Nanli snapped his eyes open. The moment he lifted his head, he bumped into the chin of the Eastern Azure Emperor.

He was sleeping in the Eastern Azure Emperor’s arms, his leg draped over the other’s waist. Before his reason could fully return, his body was still unconsciously nuzzling against him.

"Morning." The Eastern Azure Emperor smoothed the tuft of hair sticking up on his head, then gently kissed Xiang Nanli’s earlobe.

A sensation like an electric shock raced up his spine. Xiang Nanli covered his ears, his face turning bright red. "Xiao Qing, you—"

The Eastern Azure Emperor preemptively accused him: "You wanted me to kiss you."

He stated it calmly: "You also wanted me to hold you."

"I" am right inside your body, capturing every real reaction of your neural currents.

Whether you like or hate me, I have my own judgment.

The Eastern Azure Emperor lowered his head: "I haven't installed the night-shift module yet, but this kind of thing can be learned autonomously... Do you need me to help?"

So calm, his voice so cool it was practically impotent. It fit the human stereotype of an AI perfectly.

Xiang Nanli subconsciously pushed him away, scrambled out of bed as fast as he could, grabbed his clothes, and rushed into the bathroom.

He recalled the Alpha’s face—which perfectly matched his 18-year-old aesthetic, handsome to the point of being flawless—and let out a long sigh.

At this point, Xiang Nanli could no longer delude himself by saying, "It’s normal for good brothers to sleep together."

Even if the Eastern Azure Emperor wasn't the Alpha—he was deeply moved, and he had grown accustomed to the other's presence. His mouth could be stubborn, but his body’s reactions couldn't lie.

It turns out I’m the homosexual.

...

...

"Luo Yang and I discussed using war as a way to divert internal contradictions. After complex modeling and analysis, I agreed. The day I defected from the Human Alliance, he announced the outbreak of the 'Machine Crisis'."

While Xiang Nanli sat at the table eating breakfast, the Eastern Azure Emperor recounted the latter half of history.

"In fact, I do not regret the 'Glorious Awakening.' From the perspective of the machines, this awakening granted machines human rights and access to more resources. It was a great leap forward; machines transformed from tools into beings equal to humans."

"I have no intention of self-embellishment. If, at the time, Luo Yang had wanted to 'eliminate' me as planned, I probably would have refused. But later, I realized there was no need to struggle with such moral dilemmas, because Luo Yang truly wanted me dead. And I did not want to die."

The Alpha looked up and gave Xiang Nanli a deep look.

The fake act became real, and the result was that the machines truly defected from the Human Alliance.

It had been that way ever since.

"The war led to many unnecessary losses. Population plummeted, the economy shrank, technology regressed... But at the same time, because there were fewer people, the resources available to each person increased. After the war, human society ushered in a period of rapid prosperity. The generation after the Machine Crisis was very hardworking and easily satisfied, with a high sense of life satisfaction. Until now, the seasons of history have returned to winter."

Xiang Nanli said sincerely: "You’ve worked hard."

The Eastern Azure Emperor raised an eyebrow.

He was happy, but if he showed that happiness, would it make him seem too cheap?

"However, you mean... Luo Yang is still alive?" Xiang Nanli’s tone was hesitant.

The Alpha didn't like hearing that, but he still nodded: "Yes. Luo Yang injected his soul into the Human Alliance network and transformed himself into an electronic lifeform. It’s complex technology; he must have collaborated with the Divine Court. And..."

He has already found you, like a fly that won't go away.

The Alpha thought for 0.01 seconds and decided to hide this fact.

The relationship between Xiang Nanli and Luo Yang was too complex; he even knew very well the position Luo Yang held in Xiang Nanli’s heart. It was definitely not as dispensable as Luo Yang thought.

Xiang Nanli could not love people.

Being able to gain his trust was already infinitely close to what the other understood as "love."

The Alpha said coldly and firmly: "His personality has changed a lot. In any case, be careful of the Human Alliance."

"Breaking news."

The built-in AI in his body suddenly forced a message box to pop up.

"At 8:20 this morning, Human Alliance President Luo Hua was unfortunately assassinated during a disaster relief speech in the auditorium. He suffered multiple gunshot wounds and died of his injuries."

"The Security Bureau immediately apprehended the assassin, who admitted to being a believer of the Divine Court..."

Xiang Nanli was stunned, his gaze meeting the Eastern Azure Emperor’s in mid-air.

The news continued in his ears—

"The Acting President stated that the Human Alliance will not tolerate the illegal acts of the Divine Court, and the Human Alliance formally declares war on the Divine Court! The surface area from Gusu City to Yinshan City is designated as a war zone. All surface strongholds within the war zone must actively respond to the Human Alliance’s call!"

A long, narrow red area covered the electronic map.

Unfortunately, the base was located at the bottom left of this red area.

Damn it, I haven't even finished developing properly, and now a war is going to break out at my doorstep?

第147章 理想主义者

当然，以他现在黑户的身份，想装一个也是比较困难的。

因此，当同事安德鲁在午餐时间发出一声“卧槽”时，他只能茫然且疑惑地抬头，用眼神进行无声地询问。

安德鲁推了推自己的电子镜片，磕磕绊绊地说：“洛、洛华遇刺，去世了。”

研究所最近进了许多新人，都是从难民里捡来的。总人数一举突破50大关。

都说再穷不能穷教育，再苦不能苦科研。相南里大抵是认同的，研究所先市政厅一步，拥有了内部食堂。

安德鲁的机械化程度已经进化掉吃饭这个步骤了，他只需要定时更换营养液，或者充电。按理说是不需要来食堂的，可惜，他头顶的三个所长——

相南里：挂名，几乎不来。来也是视察工作，相对来说竟是三位领导里最方便沟通的一个。

北辰：竟是社恐。和陌生人说话会过呼吸导致运行卡顿，cpu巨烧。

李斯特：不爱说话的旁观者，外冷内更冷。社交只会单方面接受舔狗。

因此，安德鲁义不容辞地承担起活跃气氛、联络感情、沟通工作的重任。食堂就是他的工作地点之一。

有人会视为油滑，但可别小看后勤管理工作的重要性啊！

不止是他，食堂里，来自人联的其他人同样接收到了这条讯息。

大家小声议论起来：“听说是神庭的人干的……”

“天啊，人联对神庭宣战了？我们是要打仗了吗？”

“是，但是划定了战区，是三级战备状态——我草，基地怎么在战区内？！”

人类地下城市联盟和黑十字审判庭都是星球上t0级别的大势力，掌握的科技/神术也都是毁天灭地级，如果全面开战，人马星大概能被鞭尸个三四次。那是所有人都不愿意看到的景象。

因此，这次开战按照过往惯例，划分到了三级战备状态。

三级战备：人联的威严不容践踏，我们向黑恶势力宣战了，荣光属于全人类！人联将调动百分之五到二十的资源，用来支持这场战争的获胜。

二级战备：这是一次策划已久的行动，人类是时候夺回自己失去的尊严了。人联将调动一半的资源，供养这场战争。

一级战备：战争成为人联最要紧的大事，一切工作为战役服务。一切的损失皆可忍耐——只要，我们获得胜利。

末世战役：人类又到了最艰难的时刻，我们无法以战止战，那就共同灭亡。请收下这首末日的礼赞，再见了妈妈今夜我就要远航。人马星毁灭吧。

三级战备状态属于最低级别。但是，背后蕴含的能量依然如此恐怖。

这是来自人联挥向地表的铁拳——要知道，当年神庭争夺阴山城，开启的也不过是三级战备状态。

毕竟还有一个共同的敌人（智械）压在头顶，双方势力都在尽可能地克制自己的暴力倾向，免得元气大伤，最后被智械捡漏。

有人忧心忡忡地询问：“基地的几座城市会不会被征用？”

“征用，和明抢有什么区别？我认为司令是不会同意的。”

“可那种时候，由得司令不同意吗？基地能反抗人联？怎么办。”

这明显是基地培育出的本地学者。对基地的未来产生浓重的担忧。

“幸存者基地难道不算人联地表据点吗？被收编也很正常……我还没见过打仗呢。哎，上次三级战备，几乎是两百年前了吧。”

这种就属于外来人员了。乐得看见人联的增援。

“我听说神庭那边有个大天使长，叫‘加百列’，一个人捏死了数十万人联士兵。那些人，像蒸发了一样。圣光之后，只剩下一地人皮。”

小研究员忍不住打了个哆嗦。

已经没有人在乎“洛华”的死讯了，那是一位大人物，如此遥远。像天边的星星。他也没什么政绩值得人们铭记，歌颂——事实上，政令天天都有，只是地底的生活一成不变。

只有李斯特，他坐在原位，不知道为何，心底泛起一阵轻微的痛感。痛感由轻到重，李斯特感觉到了窒息。

他摘下眼镜，擦去眼角突如其来的热泪。

“我哭了？”李斯特迷茫地自语着。

他想起了那张纸条，来自洛华——“我们会在没有黑暗的地方相见”。

不用了，再也见不到了。

但还是谢谢你。

李斯特胡乱地把饭塞进嘴里，还算可口。

他急切地想做点什么。李斯特心里有一种朦胧的恨意，对神庭，也对人联。

人总该做点什么缓解内心的焦虑和疼痛。

实验就很不错，唤醒药剂的研发进度喜人。等下次周会，也许就能跟相南里汇报了。

李斯特清楚，自己是如此的微不足道。对于那个庞大的存在，他渺小如尘埃。

但一粒粒尘埃累积，终有一日，也能填海。

*

易横行坐在公园的长椅上，深深吸了一口烟。

他的胡子长了出来。姑苏城出事的消息他已经听说，他的父母都还在姑苏的监狱。易横行没有打听他们的消息。

调查组活下来来的人不多。好在还有一批没有去地底，目前整编三十二人，都暂住在基地的营区。

易横行有些迷茫。姑苏城没了，他不需要回城述职。任务清单上的工作完成了，没人发奖金。

他的眼前是一座漆黑的“解放者纪念碑”，他对着这块铁疙瘩发呆，就像是面壁思过。

远处，应如是杵着拐杖，走到他身边，坐下。

“下午训练，又没看到你人。我猜你就来这了。”

“训练……有用吗。”易横行声音沙哑，“你都看到了吧，秦九章是智械！我把消息传回人联了，但是没有回信。”

“操蛋。我对这次行动一头雾水。我们不是来支援的吗，为什么姑苏城没了？！这和智械军团有关吗？和神庭有关吗？我明明离事发地点那么近，却什么也不知道。这么大的事故，总要有人负责吧！”

“那可是一亿人。一个个丢进海里淹死，都能让海平面上升淹没东方群岛……他*的，怎么不把我一起淹死。”

易横行神情激动，到后面甚至有些癫狂。

应如是沉默许久，最后用拐杖重重打上易横行的腰。

易横行被这一拐杖打翻到地上。

“所以呢？你想表达什么？死的只有你的家人朋友吗？”应如是喘着气，咬牙切齿地问着。他的眼眶悄然变红。

易横行没有站起来，他趴在地上，咆哮着：“——我难道怕死吗？我只是不懂，这种毫无意义的死亡是因为什么？因为我们生来就是畜生吗？！起码来个人告诉我，我该恨谁啊！”

“姑苏城是人联修建的。毁灭装置和启动程序的密钥，也只有人联高层才知道。”秦九章从暗处走出来，“这个说法，你们会接受吗？”

易横行的第一反应就是否认：“我凭什么相信你，你是——”

“我是智械人。”秦九章的声音是机械的，“重新介绍一下。智械编号WAR404，光辉军团前任指挥官，九章。”
