Its political philosophy was at odds with the base's, or rather, almost no outpost shared the same philosophy as the base.

Sooner or later, the two sides would fall out due to contradictions. The base needed its own industrial system!

Currently, the base's four cities had a population of 740,000. It was time to develop light industry. They couldn't just keep focusing on military production; in terms of weapon manufacturing, even if the base developed for another hundred years, it wouldn't be able to surpass the Alliance in technological level... The high ground of technology and resources had already been occupied.

Eastern Azure Emperor: "It's being built in Roma City, still half a month away from completion. The first batch of products will be ready by the end of next month. Being built alongside it are the Eternal City food plant, the main urban steel mill, and the Second Research Institute's genetic engineering wing."

The base was thriving. Xiang Nanli nodded with satisfaction and asked: "Where are the transport trucks?"

The Eastern Azure Emperor glanced at the real-time data in the background: "They have already passed Mount Tiantai and should arrive in Eternal City in about an hour."

Disaster relief supplies sent from other cities would be centrally allocated to the Gusu City Post-Disaster Reconstruction Committee, and then transshipped to various disaster areas by stationed Alliance officials.

He heard that the Artificial Intelligence was monitoring this very closely. Several people had actually been dismissed for embezzling supplies, and for a time, everyone was in a state of panic.

Xiang Nanli recalled how difficult it had been to ask the Alliance for supplies last time, thinking that the change in leadership really made a difference—the Alliance had actually turned over a new leaf and started cracking down on corruption...

But after checking in with the leaders of other surviving outposts, Xiang Nanli realized he was still a bit naive.

There are policies from above, and countermeasures from below.

Gusu City has surveillance, right? Other places surely don't.

The configuration of an Alliance supply transport team consisted of three Alliance officials, plus a group of Mechanical Intelligence workers who didn't need a salary.

The officials would first drive up two or three transport trucks, claiming the rest were still on the way. They would also repeatedly hint that the journey had been long and exhausting.

If one wasn't "sensible" enough at this point and didn't offer a kickback, then it was very likely that the remaining transport trucks would "accidentally" encounter "avalanches," "slippery roads causing rollovers," or other such accidents.

The kickback was usually one-tenth of the total value of the goods.

In the past, when more people were involved in the process, they would swallow three-tenths. It wasn't unheard of for them to swallow the whole lot and deliver empty crates.

While straightening his appearance in the mirror, Xiang Nanli gritted his teeth and complained: "Doesn't anyone report them?"

Eastern Azure Emperor: "This is the unspoken rule of the surface. There is a huge difference between theory and reality.

"You can certainly report them, but then the supplies will arrive even slower. The process involves investigation, approval, handling the personnel involved, and finally re-transporting the supplies. The fast ones take a month to finish, the slow ones drag on for several years. But if the system doesn't change, the re-transported supplies might be extorted by new officials all over again.

"The base is slightly wealthier; at least agriculture is guaranteed, and we have our own power plant, so we can wait. But other immature small outposts, with only a few thousand or tens of thousands of people, can't even purify clean drinking water without Alliance aid."

chunks.chineseText:
“所以，这种潜规则再不公平，也是前人用血换来的教训。”

但东方青帝顿了顿，接着道：“不过，我们已经有谈条件的资本了。他们对小据点嚣张跋扈，是因为有恃无恐，知道小据点拿他们没办法。基地不一样。他们不敢翻脸的，毕竟来的只是三名人联官员。不是三十万人联军队。”

相南里的语气是淡淡的嘲讽：“这次物资花了我五千万；当个狗脚官，就想要走五百万？”

肃然的杀气在他脸上一闪而过，但很快，就换成人畜无害的笑容。

“走吧小青，到城门迎接‘钦差’。”

永恒市还在扩建。原本的城墙已经成为了“内城”；绕着这面城墙，人们修起了新的学校、农社、安置房，还有仓库。

城外难免坑坑洼洼，路上还全是泥浆。相南里开车走到半路，停下，然后冲黄枫说了句：“你去学院请易横行，让他也来。”

要见人联的官员，易横行这种姑苏城前任中层领导，兴许有些用处。能让对方投鼠忌器，也是好事。

易横行最近在军校里上军事课。不指望所有人都能做将军，起码要让基层军官们把军队通用的口号、军阵学会。还有科学的训练方法。基地这种草班队伍，要操心的事可太多了。

前些天，葛根还在跟他抱怨，说新来的雇佣兵不好管教。

目前基地的军队没有饷银，只管吃穿住行。这对地表的良家子已经是不小的诱惑了，但对于原本的人联雇佣兵（范佩西带来的那批），和服徭役没什么区别。

脑海里想到这些事，相南里又忍不住给海狸打了通电话：“之前战死的基地士兵，抚恤工作做完了吗？”

死人的事，一向是做给活人看的。

无非就是把名字刻在纪念碑上，再给还活着的家属发点荣誉和补贴。免得家里的壮劳力死了，孤儿寡母/父没有保障。

海狸虚弱道：“永恒市的已经完备。其他市的我让人汇总一下……司令，你不觉得我现在的事有点太多了吗？什么时候招人？”

以前永恒市才几万人，相南里喜欢把杂事都丢给她，海狸还能应付。

现在基地扩大了好多倍，相南里的毛病还没改过来。

搁古代，她军、政、财、税、户一手抓，多少也得是个诸侯王，等相南里驾崩，就能黄袍加身。

相南里有个毛病，纯粹是被洛阳和东方青帝惯出来的。就是遇到问题喜欢逮着一只羊薅毛。

海狸在电话里一通抱怨，强烈谴责皇帝的懒政行为。

相南里只好装作四处看风景：“知道了。这不马上就公务员考试了。”

他在自己的备忘录里加了一条：以法律形式确定基地组织架构、人事任免流程等等；民主选举……

后面一条刚加上，相南里就摇摇头，自己划掉了。

以后再选吧。生产力这才发展到哪跟哪。

现在都给我考公！

其他事，等他要死了再操心吧。

相南里又把脑海里有印象的人名列了出来，最后在“方差”这个名字上圈了一笔。

这是秦九章带来的小智械人，似乎是台侦察兵，经过几个月时间大数据学习，表现出了还算不错的管理天赋，也很有责任心。

毕竟方差的数学好啊！

相南里给它发去消息：“你收拾收拾。来永恒市给海狸市长当秘书。手续后面给你补上。”

已经在基地义务打工（且没有工资）的小智械人挠了挠头，想起之前九章说的“一切服从相南里安排”，于是回答道：“好。”

哎。人类社会好麻烦，好想回深海。

在军团内工作，方差每天只需要工作六小时。

在基地是18小时！剩下6小时可以自行安排。这六小时，方差往往用于充电以及收集地表的各种小玩意。

他的飞行舱内，已经装满了老鼠、蟑螂、灰麻雀、四叶草等等动植物标本了！等回到军团，其他智械一定会羡慕它的~生活在海底的智械并不需要生态圈。这些地表生物，它们只在数据库里见过呢。

终于，在冷风中等候半小时后，一辆印着人联标志的运输货车，远远出现在相南里的视野中。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 151: Policies from Above (Part 2)

"So, as unfair as this unspoken rule is, it's a lesson paid for in blood by our predecessors."

But the Eastern Azure Emperor paused and continued: "However, we already have the capital to negotiate. They are arrogant and domineering toward small outposts because they have nothing to fear, knowing those outposts can't do anything to them. The base is different. They won't dare to flip the table; after all, only three Alliance officials have come. Not three hundred thousand Alliance troops."

Xiang Nanli's tone was one of faint mockery: "These supplies cost me fifty million; and just for being a dog-legged official, they want to walk away with five million?"

A stern, murderous aura flashed across his face, but it was quickly replaced by an innocent smile.

"Let's go, Xiao Qing, to the city gate to welcome the 'imperial envoys'."

Eternal City was still expanding. The original city wall had become the "inner city"; around this wall, people had built new schools, agricultural cooperatives, housing, and warehouses.

The area outside the city was inevitably full of potholes, and the road was thick with mud. Halfway there, Xiang Nanli stopped the car and said to Huang Feng: "Go to the academy and ask Yi Hengxing to come as well."

To meet with Alliance officials, someone like Yi Hengxing, a former mid-level leader in Gusu City, might be useful. It would be a good thing to make the other party hesitate.

Yi Hengxing had been taking military courses at the military academy recently. He didn't expect everyone to become a general, but at the very least, he needed the grassroots officers to learn the common slogans and formations of the army, as well as scientific training methods. A grassroots team like the base had too many things to worry about.

A few days ago, Ge Gen was still complaining to him that the new mercenaries were hard to discipline.

Currently, the base's army received no pay, only food, clothing, and shelter. This was a significant temptation for the honest folks of the surface, but for the original Alliance mercenaries (the batch brought by Van Persie), it was no different from forced labor.

Thinking of these things in his mind, Xiang Nanli couldn't help but make a call to Beaver: "Has the pension work for the base soldiers who died in battle been completed?"

The business of the dead was always done for the sake of the living.

It was nothing more than carving names on a monument and issuing some honors and subsidies to the surviving families. This was to ensure that if the strong laborers in the family died, the orphans and widows/widowers would not be left without support.

Beaver said weakly: "The ones for Eternal City are complete. I'm having the others summarized... Commander, don't you think I have a bit too much to do now? When are we hiring more people?"

In the past, Eternal City only had a few tens of thousands of people, and Xiang Nanli liked to dump all the miscellaneous tasks on her, which Beaver could handle.

Now that the base had expanded many times over, Xiang Nanli still hadn't changed his bad habits.

In ancient times, if she held military, political, financial, tax, and household registration powers in her hands, she would at least be a feudal prince; once Xiang Nanli passed away, she could have donned the yellow robe herself.

Xiang Nanli had a bad habit, purely spoiled by Luoyang and the Eastern Azure Emperor: whenever he encountered a problem, he liked to pluck the wool off the same sheep.

Beaver complained on the phone, strongly condemning the Emperor's lazy governance.

Xiang Nanli had no choice but to pretend to look at the scenery: "Got it. The civil service exam is coming up soon."

He added a note to his memo: Formalize the base's organizational structure, personnel appointment and removal processes, etc., through law; democratic elections...

As soon as he added the last item, Xiang Nanli shook his head and crossed it out.

Let's elect later. Productivity hasn't developed that far yet.

For now, everyone just take the civil service exam!

As for other things, he'd worry about them when he was dying.

Xiang Nanli listed the names he had an impression of in his mind, and finally circled the name "Variance."

This was a small Mechanical Intelligence unit brought by Qin Jiuzhang. It seemed to be a scout, and after several months of big data learning, it had shown quite good management talent and a strong sense of responsibility.

After all, Variance was good at math!

Xiang Nanli sent it a message: "Pack your things. Come to Eternal City to be Mayor Beaver's secretary. We'll handle the paperwork later."

The small Mechanical Intelligence unit, which had been working for the base voluntarily (and without pay), scratched its head. Remembering what Jiuzhang had said before about "obeying all of Xiang Nanli's arrangements," it replied: "Okay."

Sigh. Human society is so troublesome. I want to go back to the deep sea.

Working in the Legion, Variance only needed to work six hours a day.

At the base, it was 18 hours! The remaining 6 hours could be arranged as it pleased. During these six hours, Variance often used them for charging and collecting various little trinkets from the surface.

Its flight cabin was already filled with specimens of mice, cockroaches, gray sparrows, four-leaf clovers, and other plants and animals! When it returned to the Legion, other Mechanical Intelligence units would definitely be envious of it~ The Mechanical Intelligence units living on the seabed didn't need an ecosystem. They had only seen these surface creatures in their databases.

Finally, after waiting in the cold wind for half an hour, a transport truck bearing the Alliance logo appeared in Xiang Nanli's field of vision in the distance.

chunks.chineseText:
第152章 下有对策

他喜欢抽古神生物牌子下的烟，甘草味的，提神醒脑的效果比其他几家好。

运货车启动了“智能巡航”模式，常凯和同事坐在略宽敞的车厢里，一边聊天，一边打牌。

其实一共有三个人。他们俩是先锋，还有一人，守着剩下的货车，等通知。

沙发原本是大红色，现在是脏兮兮的暗红。头顶的车灯随着崎岖的地面摇摇晃晃。常凯有些头晕。

“这个幸存者基地，我以前怎么没听说过。”

“才成立两三年。”同事不以为然地回答，“内部等级倒是挺高的，快赶上奥丁城了。”

奥丁城是姑苏的老牌殖民地了，每年上缴的油水都很丰厚。听说这次灾难里，叔叔夺了侄子的继承权。侄子向姑苏求救过，姑苏没搭理。

常凯想到这，感叹道：“好羡慕去奥丁城的。那边新的统治者得国不正，为了得到人联法律上的承认，肯定会花不少钱行贿。”

“基地也不差啊。30辆车。赶得上其他好几个据点加起来了。就是不知道运的什么……”

老王撇了一下嘴：“没权限，打不开。我猜粮食、棉衣之类的吧。看基地之前的购买记录，都是些不值钱的玩意。”

“我看资料，基地领导叫相南里。”

“只要他胆子大，叫洛阳都跟我们没关系。”

历史上那位相南里，没有子嗣，没有基金会、慈善会、纪念馆，没有为他设置的纪念日，除了教科书上的三言两语和《智械简史》的扉页，其余什么也没留下。

他应当是璀璨且耀眼的吧？毕竟创造了Alpha（在官方宣传中，Alpha是永生科技多人合作的成果，最初的领头人是相南里）；又是人联首位总统洛阳的老师。

可惜，留下的东西太少了。人走茶凉，人死如灯灭。

话题很快转到了这次赚到的物资怎么倒卖身上。

老王表示，还是之前爽快，人联官员的权限比较大，不需要辛苦运两趟。

“让相南里直接转账吧，要我说，现在粮食也挺值钱的。”

烟雾缭绕的空气中顿时充满了快活的笑声。

常凯也跟着笑。

你什么家庭，什么背景？你正义地揭发了同事，一时之间没啥问题，几年后看看是升官还是开除。人联的工资就那么点，好多年没涨过。物价又那么疯。你自己吃饱全家不愁，别人还有配偶父母和孩子的呢？不贪？怎么活。

当清流？沽名钓誉，你也配？

这政绩和名声啊，得是有背景的人才能吃下。

常凯心想，得亏当时他退出了调查局。要不然到现在，自己那微薄的良知与更微薄的工资，还在脑海里左右互搏。

人工智能的声音从喇叭里传来：“工蜂号运输车即将抵达目的地。小蜜蜂提醒您：户外气温4℃。污染度轻微。以防万一，请您穿好防护服再下车……”

永恒市到了。

刚经历过一场恶战，城墙还没怎么修，看起来很破。城外，还有一些骨瘦嶙峋的难民（战犯），正光着膀子搭钢筋。

地表的据点不修墙是不行的，现在又不是什么和平年代。

常凯三人走下车，只见路边，一名身穿制服的年轻人热情地迎了上来：“人联的领导们好，我是幸存者基地的司令，远道而来辛苦了。”

他身后还站着十几个人。常凯扫了眼，都很瘦，估计是营养不良，符合他对地表的刻板印象。

相南里很上道的往他们手里塞着一包烟。

常凯有点烟瘾，他抽出一根，含在嘴边，手还在摸着外套的口袋，

相南里已经凑过来，笑眯眯地替他点上。

凑近看，这位相司令好标致的一张脸。

常凯心想，得亏来的不是老李，老李喜欢男的。性贿赂也是地表司空见惯的事。

“领导，外面风大。要不要进城里坐坐，我准备了一桌宴席。不过小门小户的，没什么好招待。多亏还挖出了几只地虾……”

地虾，即变异大蟑螂，地表热门食材。

长得是有些恶心，但既然能叫“虾”，味道自然不差。地虾要不是继承了自家祖宗的繁殖能力，差点被地表人民吃绝种。

老王咳嗽一声：“我们还有其他公务，招待就不必了。”

一道疑惑的声音从背后传来：“常凯……？”

常凯下意识地回过头，看见易横行的瞬间，手里夹着的烟掉在了泥泞的地上。

“易队。”他下意识地站直了身体，然而心里却不是久别重逢的喜悦，反而大脑一片空白，“你怎么在这？”

易横行：“出来执行任务。”

他的手背在背后，绕着他，转了圈，像狮子打量薮猫：“身上这套装备挺贵的，日子过得不错啊。”

常凯开始冒冷汗。

“你们认识？”老王的表情疑惑。

常凯逼自己冷静，易横行并不可怕，可怕的是他内心里突如其来的虚弱感。

他简略地回答：“这是我还在调查局工作时候的领导。”

老王听到调查局三个字，心里咯噔了一下：“噢，那感情好啊。易队，要一起回去不？”

挤眉弄眼的，意思是分你点。

调查局三个字，还是有点威慑力的。

“我副队还在养伤，等他身体好了，我们会自己回去。”易横行冷着脸，“就一箱货？其他的呢？”

话回得很硬。也不知道是情商低还是假正经。

老王看常凯眼神躲闪不搭腔，心想这人怎么这么窝囊。调查局再怎么牛逼，也不能代管救援指挥部门的工作吧！

老王开口道：“都在路上。”

说完，只是双手搭在一起，站在原地，一动不动地等着相南里的反应。

拉着调查局的人给自己站台？远水解不了近渴，他就是不给呢！

怎么，你要杀人联官员吗。这可是重罪。披着这层皮，他们的行为再恶心，那也只能让人联自查，不能被外人侵犯的！

而相南里明显是一位上道的好同志，他连忙把易横行拉走，随后赔笑道：“领导，按照规矩，是该给你们车马费。但是基地的情况，你们也看到了，我凑不出现钱，也没储备黄金。”

他咬牙道，像做了一个极其艰难的决定：“您留七成给基地就行。剩下三成，劳烦你们自己费心。”

意思是拉去卖吧，他不管了。

“那开箱的……”密钥。

老王做了个手势。

相南里掏出一张纸，连忙说着：“我现在写给你。”

人联发来的邮件，附上了每车的编号和密钥，只有他这个司令知道。救援部门自己都没权限解开。

但还是那句话，上有政策，下有对策。

老王把纸收好，这才满意点头：“相司令，剩下的货一周后到，我会安排自动驾驶送过来，基地的好日子还在后头呢。卸货吧。”

相南里输入密码，打开车厢，身后的十几个人这才行动起来。像工蚁一样，把一箱箱的物资搬了下来。

救援队是满车来的，空车走的。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 152: Countermeasures from Below (Part 1)

He liked to smoke cigarettes under the Ancient God brand; they were licorice-flavored, and their effect on refreshing the mind was better than those of the other companies.

The transport truck had engaged "intelligent cruise" mode. Chang Kai and his colleague sat in the slightly spacious cabin, chatting and playing cards.

In fact, there were three of them in total. The two of them were the vanguard, and there was one more guarding the remaining trucks, waiting for notification.

The sofa had originally been bright red, but now it was a filthy dark red. The overhead lights swayed with the rugged terrain. Chang Kai felt a bit dizzy.

"I've never heard of this survivor base before."

"It's only been established for two or three years," his colleague replied dismissively. "The internal hierarchy is quite high, though; it's almost catching up to Odin City."

Odin City was an old colony of Gusu, and the oil it paid in tribute every year was very generous. He heard that in this disaster, the uncle had usurped his nephew's right of inheritance. The nephew had asked Gusu for help, but Gusu hadn't bothered to respond.

Thinking of this, Chang Kai sighed: "I envy those who went to Odin City. The new ruler there didn't gain power legitimately; to get legal recognition from the Alliance, they must have spent a lot of money on bribes."

"The base isn't bad either. 30 trucks. That's enough to match several other outposts combined. Just don't know what they're carrying..."

Old Wang curled his lip: "No authorization, can't open it. I guess grain, cotton clothes, and the like. Looking at the base's previous purchase records, they're all cheap junk."

"I saw in the files that the base leader is named Xiang Nanli."

"As long as he's bold enough, even if he were named Luoyang, it wouldn't have anything to do with us."

The historical Xiang Nanli had no descendants, no foundations, charities, or memorials; there was no memorial day set for him. Apart from a few words in textbooks and the frontispiece of *A Brief History of Mechanical Intelligence*, he left nothing else behind.

He must have been brilliant and dazzling, right? After all, he created Alpha (in official propaganda, Alpha was the result of a multi-person collaboration at Eternal Technology, and the initial leader was Xiang Nanli); and he was the teacher of the Alliance's first president, Luoyang.

Unfortunately, what he left behind was too little. When people leave, the tea goes cold; when people die, the lamp goes out.

The topic soon turned to how to resell the supplies earned this time.

Old Wang expressed that it was more satisfying before; Alliance officials had greater authority, and they didn't need to work hard to make two trips.

"Let Xiang Nanli transfer the money directly. If you ask me, grain is quite valuable right now."

The smoke-filled air was suddenly filled with happy laughter.

Chang Kai laughed along.

What kind of family do you have, what kind of background? You righteously expose your colleagues—there might be no problem for a moment, but check back in a few years to see if you've been promoted or fired. The Alliance's salary is only so much, and it hasn't been raised in years. Prices are going crazy. You might be full and have no worries, but others have spouses, parents, and children. Don't take bribes? How are you supposed to live?

Be a "clear stream"? Seeking fame and reputation—do you even deserve it?

This political achievement and reputation stuff—only those with a background can digest it.

Chang Kai thought to himself that it was fortunate he had quit the Investigation Bureau back then. Otherwise, his meager conscience and even meagerer salary would still be fighting each other in his mind.

The artificial intelligence's voice came from the speaker: "Worker Bee transport truck is about to arrive at its destination. Little Bee reminds you: outdoor temperature is 4°C. Pollution level is mild. Just in case, please put on your protective suit before getting off..."

Eternal City had arrived.

Having just experienced a fierce battle, the city walls hadn't been repaired much and looked quite dilapidated. Outside the city, some emaciated refugees (war criminals) were shirtless, assembling steel bars.

Outposts on the surface couldn't survive without walls; this wasn't exactly a peaceful era.

Chang Kai and the other two stepped off the truck, and they saw a young man in a uniform warmly greeting them from the roadside: "Greetings, Alliance leaders. I am the commander of the survivor base. Thank you for your hard work in coming from afar."

There were a dozen people standing behind him. Chang Kai scanned them; they were all very thin, likely malnourished, which matched his stereotype of the surface.

Xiang Nanli very sensibly stuffed a pack of cigarettes into their hands.

Chang Kai had a bit of a smoking addiction. He pulled one out, held it in his mouth, and was still feeling his jacket pocket when—

Xiang Nanli had already leaned in, smiling as he lit it for him.

Looking closely, this Commander Xiang had quite a handsome face.

Chang Kai thought to himself, it's a good thing it wasn't Old Li who came; Old Li liked men. Sexual bribery was also a common occurrence on the surface.

"Leaders, the wind is strong outside. Would you like to come into the city and sit for a while? I've prepared a banquet. It's a humble home, so there's nothing much to entertain you with. Fortunately, we managed to dig up a few ground shrimp..."

Ground shrimp, i.e., mutated giant cockroaches, were a popular ingredient on the surface.

They looked a bit disgusting, but since they could be called "shrimp," the taste was naturally not bad. If ground shrimp hadn't inherited their ancestors' reproductive ability, they would have almost been eaten to extinction by the people on the surface.

Old Wang coughed: "We have other official business, so there's no need for a banquet."

A puzzled voice came from behind: "Chang Kai...?"

Chang Kai subconsciously turned his head. The moment he saw Yi Hengxing, the cigarette he was holding dropped into the muddy ground.

"Team Leader Yi." He stood at attention instinctively, but his heart wasn't filled with the joy of a long-awaited reunion; instead, his mind went blank. "Why are you here?"

Yi Hengxing: "Out on a mission."

His hands were behind his back as he circled him like a lion sizing up a serval: "The gear you're wearing is quite expensive. You're living quite well, aren't you?"

Chang Kai started to break into a cold sweat.

"You know each other?" Old Wang's expression was puzzled.

Chang Kai forced himself to stay calm. Yi Hengxing wasn't scary; what was scary was the sudden sense of weakness in his heart.

He answered briefly: "This was my leader when I was still working at the Investigation Bureau."

When Old Wang heard the words "Investigation Bureau," his heart skipped a beat: "Oh, that's great then. Team Leader Yi, want to go back with us?"

He winked, meaning he would give him a share.

The words "Investigation Bureau" still had some deterrent power.

"My deputy is still recovering from his injuries. When he's better, we'll go back ourselves." Yi Hengxing said with a cold face. "Just one crate of goods? Where are the others?"

The response was very hard-line. He didn't know if it was low emotional intelligence or just fake righteousness.

Seeing Chang Kai's shifty eyes and lack of response, Old Wang thought, why is this guy such a coward? No matter how awesome the Investigation Bureau is, they can't manage the work of the rescue command department!

Old Wang spoke up: "They're all on the way."

After saying this, he simply stood there with his hands folded, waiting for Xiang Nanli's reaction.

Dragging someone from the Investigation Bureau to stand up for him? Distant water can't quench immediate thirst; he just wouldn't give it to them!

What, are you going to kill Alliance officials? That's a serious crime. Wearing this skin, no matter how disgusting their behavior was, it could only be investigated by the Alliance itself; it couldn't be infringed upon by outsiders!

And Xiang Nanli was clearly a sensible comrade. He quickly pulled Yi Hengxing away and then apologized with a smile: "Leader, according to the rules, I should give you travel expenses. But as you can see the situation of the base, I can't scrape together cash, nor do I have gold reserves."

He gritted his teeth, as if he had made an extremely difficult decision: "Just leave seventy percent for the base. As for the remaining thirty percent, I'll trouble you to handle it yourselves."

Meaning, take it and sell it; he didn't care anymore.

"And the... key to open the crates?"

Old Wang made a gesture.

Xiang Nanli took out a piece of paper and said quickly: "I'll write it down for you now."

The email sent by the Alliance included the serial number and key for each truck, and only he, the commander, knew them. The rescue department itself didn't have the authorization to unlock them.

But as the saying goes, there are policies from above, and countermeasures from below.

Old Wang took the paper and nodded with satisfaction: "Commander Xiang, the remaining goods will arrive in a week. I will arrange for them to be sent via autopilot. The base's good days are still ahead. Unload."

Xiang Nanli entered the password and opened the cargo hold. Only then did the dozen people behind him take action. Like worker ants, they moved the crates of supplies down.

The rescue team arrived with a full truck and left with an empty one.

chunks.chineseText:
工蜂号运输车在空载时，能把后面的车架折叠起来，垒在车头上。这样，就能从笨重的卡车变成轻巧的二层巴士。

更重要的是，负载减轻后，工蜂号能收起轮胎，一排排气流喷管从底盘下方探出来。

工蜂号直接从一辆陆运车自动改装成空气悬浮车，速度翻了不知道多少倍！

运输车拐个弯，消失在相南里的视野中。

他上扬的嘴角终于塌了下去。

易横行表情很难看：“你这么能忍？”你背后的智械军团呢？吃白饭的？

相南里心想，当然不是。递过去的烟盒里有隐蔽的定位器。他怕这俩人会聪明到丢烟，凑过去点烟时，还顺便在常凯的衣领上贴了个。

现在要紧的，是赶紧拿到物资。

相南里当然可以一声令下，把这两人抓起来，然后拷问物资藏匿的地点。

但是对方很可能在瞬间就传回信号，让自己同伙销毁物资。得不到就毁掉。

上报人联时，咬定是翻车，总比说自己索贿好。

物资花了他五千万信用点，相南里不能赌。实验室的耗材、基地未来的运势、战前的准备、战后的修养，都寄托在这一车车物资里呢！

杀人越货……不对，拿快递这种事。自然还是安排东方青帝去做。

知道地点后，这几个人就没用了。

小青会处理好的。相南里相信他。

不过，这些考量，他是不会和易横行说的。

相南里的脸上露出苦涩：“一直这样，我又有什么办法呢。难道要拿基地这么多人的生活去赌吗？我弯腰，不是给这两个不入流的货色服软，是对人联的强权弯腰，是为基地的普通人也能有条生路弯腰……”

人只要演技够好，完全可以把自己骗到。更何况他说的话也有几分真心。

相南里发出一声沉重地叹息：“易队，这就是你效忠的人联，几百年来已经臃肿、走形得不成样子。这种事，不是杀一两个人就能解决的。”

他要对抗的是一个利维坦。需要团结一切可以团结的力量。

给我狠狠变节！

相南里似乎有些累了，他挥手，货物被装上小车运往仓库。

易横行站在原地，低头，手握成拳，许久后，狠狠朝着空气打去。

他没用力，地表却出现一个不大不小的坑。如果挥到人身上，恐怕早就死了。

这就是人联培育的基因战士。

……

……

常凯有些心绪不宁。或许是因为见到了易横行的缘故。

易横行曾经是他的直系领导，那是六十年前，还是七十年前。毕业后，包分配。他进了姑苏城的调查组，成为了一名光荣的调查员，队长就是易横行。

新兵蛋子不懂事。易横行肩上曾经有道疤，吃过几轮基因药，也许早就没了。那是为了从爬行者嘴里救他留下的。

递出转岗申请的时候，易横行很诧异，很生气。还有点心灰意懒。

常凯只是艰难地回答：“我有难处。”

生活如此困难。

易队，你做了那么多事，能力本事都不差，为什么还是险象环生，好几次差点死在地表；为什么一直不得晋升，每次都是表现优秀到无法忽略，才能得到三瓜两枣。为什么每次最难、最累、付出收入严重不对等的活，都要轮到我们组。你是好样的，可我……

我已经不相信那些空洞的口号了。我们都不信了。

我只想好好活着。过安稳、清闲且富裕的生活。哪怕这种幸福是建立在别人的痛苦上。但错的不是我。明白吗？

终于，4小时后，工蜂号在一处隐蔽的山谷停下。

这里荒无人烟，附近也没有特殊标志。如果不是导航，想在绵延的山区里找到这个窝点，无异于大海捞针。

常凯揉着眼睛，解开安全带：“哎，做了个怪梦。梦到有怪物跟在我们车后。我一直跑啊一直跑，就是逃不掉。”

他又忍不住去摸兜里的烟。

老王哈哈大笑：“想什么呢？这可是高新军工为救援队特批的工蜂号运输车！一台售价要三百万……是人联向企业借的，不是买的。这速度，智械都追不上吧。为了打压永生科技的风头，高新军工这次也是下血本了。好了，赶紧下车吧。老李该等急了……”

说完，他率先推开门。

生活如此艰难，并且充满了意外。

这段对话也是他们的遗言。

东方青帝不爽地摁着自己的指骨关节。这三个人死法相当一致，全都是被巨力拧断了脖子。

什么破车，开这么慢。急死他了。

他和相南里已经分开了4个多小时了！Alpha陷入了难以控制的分离焦虑中。

他不是控制狂，也没有神经病。智械人怎么可能有那种东西！他只是忍不住思念。

这让Alpha不得不分心处理数据库后台的无来源病毒。好在这么多年，他都习惯了。就是最近发病的次数尤其多。

工蜂号可以自动驾驶，但启动需要权限。

东方青帝翻出老王的工牌，黑进系统里，批量复制了一轮，启动的权限还差个生物认证，但问题不大。

银光在他的眼里一闪而过。几分钟后，满载货物的工蜂号排着队，朝着基地的方向疾驰。

高新军工的防盗系统，是比永生科技的要简陋一点。

东方青帝不仅破译了驾驶权限，还顺便摧毁了配套的卫星定位系统。这下三十辆工蜂号彻底沦为黑车。还是不用担心被工程师找回的抢手货。

人都死了。

车就不用还了吧。

老王说的话，Alpha一律当电子垃圾过滤掉的。但他承认，对方起码有一句话没说错——

基地的好日子还在后头呢。
chunks.englishText:
The Worker Bee transport vehicle, when empty, can fold its rear chassis and stack it onto the cab. This allows it to transform from a bulky truck into a compact double-decker bus.

More importantly, once the load is lightened, the Worker Bee can retract its tires, revealing rows of air-jet nozzles extending from beneath the chassis.

The Worker Bee automatically converts from a land transport vehicle into an air-cushion vehicle, its speed increasing by an immeasurable factor!

The transport vehicle took a turn and vanished from Xiang Nanli’s field of vision.

The corners of his mouth, which had been curled upward, finally collapsed.

Yi Hengxing’s expression was grim. "You can endure this much?" he asked. "What about the smart-mech legion behind you? Are they just freeloading?"

Xiang Nanli thought to himself, *Of course not.* The cigarette case he had handed over contained a concealed tracker. Fearing that these two might be clever enough to discard the cigarettes, he had even surreptitiously stuck one onto Chang Kai’s collar while leaning in to light them.

What mattered now was securing the supplies.

Xiang Nanli could, of course, give a single command to have these two arrested and then interrogate them on the location of the hidden supplies.

However, the other party would likely transmit a signal the instant they were caught, ordering their accomplices to destroy the goods. If they couldn't have them, they would destroy them.

When reporting to the Human Alliance, insisting it was a traffic accident was far better than admitting he had solicited a bribe.

The supplies had cost him fifty million credits; Xiang Nanli could not gamble with that. The laboratory consumables, the future momentum of the base, pre-war preparations, and post-war recovery—all of it was pinned on these shipments!

Murder and looting... no, that wasn't right. Dealing with "express delivery" was naturally a job to be arranged for Dongfang Qingdi.

Once the location was known, these few people would be useless.

Xiao Qing would handle it well. Xiang Nanli trusted him.

However, he would not share these considerations with Yi Hengxing.

A bitter look appeared on Xiang Nanli’s face. "Living like this, what other choice do I have? Should I gamble with the livelihoods of so many people in the base? When I bow my head, it is not to submit to these two low-life scoundrels; it is to bow to the tyranny of the Human Alliance, to ensure that the ordinary people of the base might have a path to survive..."

As long as one’s acting is good enough, one can even deceive oneself. Not to mention, there was a grain of truth in what he said.

Xiang Nanli let out a heavy sigh. "Captain Yi, this is the Human Alliance you are loyal to—bloated and deformed beyond recognition over the past few hundred years. This kind of thing cannot be solved by killing one or two people."

He was fighting a Leviathan. He needed to unite all forces that could be united.

*Defect, and do it thoroughly!*

Xiang Nanli seemed tired. He waved his hand, and the cargo was loaded onto small carts to be transported to the warehouse.

Yi Hengxing stood where he was, head bowed, his hands clenched into fists. After a long while, he struck out fiercely at the empty air.

He hadn't used his full strength, yet a sizable crater appeared in the ground. Had that blow landed on a person, they would have been dead long ago.

Such is the power of the gene-warriors cultivated by the Human Alliance.

...

...

Chang Kai felt somewhat uneasy. Perhaps it was because he had seen Yi Hengxing.

Yi Hengxing had once been his direct superior, sixty or seventy years ago. After graduation, assignments were guaranteed. He had joined the Suzhou City investigation team and became a proud investigator, with Yi Hengxing as his captain.

A green recruit knows nothing. Yi Hengxing once had a scar on his shoulder—he had taken a few rounds of gene serum, so perhaps it was long gone. That scar had been left behind while saving him from the jaws of a Crawler.

When he submitted his transfer application, Yi Hengxing had been surprised, angry, and a bit disheartened.

Chang Kai had only replied with difficulty: "I have my hardships."

Life is so difficult.

*Captain Yi, you’ve done so much, your abilities and skills are not lacking, so why are you still constantly in danger, nearly dying on the surface several times? Why have you never been promoted, only receiving scraps after performing so well that it couldn't be ignored? Why does our team always get the most difficult, most exhausting, and most unrewarding jobs? You are a good man, but I...*

*I no longer believe in those hollow slogans. None of us do.*

*I just want to live well. To live a stable, leisurely, and wealthy life. Even if this happiness is built upon the suffering of others. But I am not the one in the wrong. Do you understand?*

Finally, four hours later, the Worker Bee stopped in a hidden valley.

This place was desolate, with no special landmarks nearby. If not for the navigation, finding this den in the sprawling mountains would be like looking for a needle in a haystack.

Chang Kai rubbed his eyes and unbuckled his seatbelt. "Man, I had a weird dream. Dreamed there was a monster following our car. I kept running and running, but I just couldn't escape."

He couldn't help but reach for the cigarettes in his pocket.

Old Wang laughed heartily. "What are you thinking about? This is a Worker Bee transport vehicle specially approved by High-Tech Military Industry for rescue teams! Each one costs three million... the Alliance borrowed them from the company, not bought them. At this speed, even smart-mechs couldn't catch us. To suppress the momentum of Eternal Technology, High-Tech Military Industry really bled for this one. Alright, hurry up and get out. Old Li must be getting impatient..."

With that, he pushed the door open first.

Life is so difficult, and full of surprises.

This conversation was also their last words.

Dongfang Qingdi cracked his knuckles, feeling annoyed. The three men had died in exactly the same way—all had their necks snapped by immense force.

What a piece of junk vehicle, driving so slowly. It was driving him crazy.

He and Xiang Nanli had been separated for over four hours! The Alpha was sinking into uncontrollable separation anxiety.

He wasn't a control freak, nor was he mentally ill. How could a smart-mech have such things! He just couldn't help but miss him.

This forced the Alpha to divert his attention to deal with a source-less virus in the database background. Fortunately, he had been used to it for so many years. It was just that the frequency of the "outbreaks" had been particularly high lately.

The Worker Bee could drive automatically, but starting it required authorization.

Dongfang Qingdi fished out Old Wang’s ID badge, hacked into the system, and batch-copied the permissions. The startup still required biometric authentication, but that wasn't a big problem.

A silver light flashed in his eyes. A few minutes later, the fully loaded Worker Bees were lined up, speeding toward the base.

High-Tech Military Industry’s anti-theft system was a bit cruder than Eternal Technology’s.

Dongfang Qingdi not only cracked the driving permissions but also destroyed the accompanying satellite positioning system while he was at it. Now, the thirty Worker Bees had completely become "black market" vehicles. They were hot commodities that no engineer would ever be able to track down.

After all, the people were dead.

There was no need to return the cars, right?

As for what Old Wang had said, the Alpha filtered it all out as electronic waste. But he had to admit, at least one thing the man said was right—

The good days for the base were still ahead.

chunks.chineseText:
第153章 贪污案

笑话，什么货值得他看着运？

他回来后，像是什么都没发生过一样，自觉去厨房做饭。

东方青帝挑剔的目光在冰箱里打量一圈，挺好的，农业部送来了不要钱的新鲜食材。

这算贿赂吗？Alpha思考片刻，觉得这算保证相南里人身安全中的一环。他大笔一挥，给基地所有的高级干部都加上了每天30积分的食材配额。他和相南里的算一块，一天能有60。

哎呀，特供！

相南里做事还有小智出言提醒。

但Alpha是真没人管。

东方青帝没提，相南里也没问。大家很有默契地闭口不谈，那三个人联官员如同水一样，从人马星上蒸发了。

至于人联是否会派人来调查，那也是之后的问题了。

这是一笔坏账。

坏账的意思就是，追究成本过高，得不偿失。不如不追。

这次从人联订购的物资，一大半都是基地无法生产的工业品，或者虽然可以生产，但造条产业线成本过高，不如进口的小宗商品。譬如锅碗瓢盆之类的。

剩下则是生活必需品。比如糖和盐。这不仅是调味料，还是工业生产中必不可少的原料。

相南里清点货物到这，打开地图，画了个圈，然后发给葛根：“这里有个小盐湖。之前地震刚结束，基地就派了13支救援队伍，去询问我们的友邻是否需要协助。”

小盐湖，意思是不够大，人联看不上。但又确实产盐。

因为卖盐，底下的盐奴穷困潦倒、骨瘦嶙峋，但据点的主人却富庶到流油，世代都是奴隶主。还举族之力，托举出几个有出息的后代，进了扶贫办的“地表教育支援计划”，毕业后在姑苏城市政厅当了小公务员。

很不幸，小盐湖的后台全都死在了地底。

相南里的唇角勾起：“这次天灾，盐村遇到了不小的危机。基地协助义不容辞。你们红狮军团派两个兵团过去，接管一下。”

说的这么含蓄，当然是为了名义上好听。基地的正义性是在地表蔓延的“势”和“望”，基地要和其他地表侵略集团区分开来，成为众望所归的王者之师！

相南里补充：“留下个听话的主理人就行。盐湖充公，你和部队就留在小盐湖。聘请之前的盐奴当工人，给工资。工资用基地的‘积分券’发，但是可以折成粮。另外，也收私盐，按基地的市价略低一点收购。如果是大地主，就只发积分，不发实物。让他们自己来基地换粮。”

总之，并不是完全镇杀。而是杀一批，分化一批，安抚一批。

这是历史书给出的参考答案。

这次，基地一共派出了“13支救援队”呢，不能让其他待解放区域过于警惕！

“以后我打算在那里设个‘盐城’。有需要支援、拿不定主意的，直接向我汇报。”相南里做出最后批注。

头上传来轰隆的响声，相南里抬头，几架印着人联徽纹的无人机低空飞过。丝毫不掩盖自己的行迹，像在自家领地里耀武扬威的狮子。

相南里想起今天早上听的新闻，微微眯起眼：“看来，人联那边开始选军事驻地了。”

而这种好事，果然是轮不到基地的。

当天晚上，相南里就收到了通知。军事基地建在奥丁城附近。那里也会成为这次军事战役的指挥中心。而新建的城市就叫“姑苏军事基地”，简称姑苏。这大概是GDP常年倒数第一、无任何大企业驻扎的姑苏城留下的最后一点政治遗产。

除此外，还有一则内部消息，说姑苏城的前任市长洛修，调到汴梁城当副市长。此次战事，或许会随军到前线开展督战工作。

相南里把局势在脑海里过了一遍，却没有心情发表任何看法。

罗马市传回了战亡士兵抚恤工作的汇报。传上来的数据表要过两道手续，一道是基地财务部门的核查，一道是AI的清算。

第一道手续过了，第二道没过。

简单来说，账不对。

基地，在成立的第三个年头，大多数人还在贫困线上挣扎，高层却出现了第一起贪污案。

相南里在市长办公室里，罕见地大发雷霆：“我在前面，拼命找场子。这群人在后面，扯我裤衩子！”

中间夹杂着一两句脏话。

什么样的人说什么样的话。相南里受过高等教育，大多时候自持身份，说话很书面，很官方。

但天天在地表混，哪能什么都不懂。

罗马城之前是神血战士占领的土匪团，后来收归进基地，大清扫了一轮。考虑到当时无人可用的情况，让永恒市刚从学堂毕业的生化战士上任了。

这也是相南里最不解的地方。淋过雨的人率先把伞撕烂了。

罗马的人口、农业比不过永恒市；工业比不过光辉市。政治地位比不过主城区。是基地四座城市里存在感最弱的一座。祖上成分不好，GDP也不怎么好看。

相南里也是考虑到了这种情况，才把基地的轻工业厂往罗马转移。

如果只在乎收益，工厂应该继续开在光辉市。

相南里心情波动剧烈，血压飙升：“查！最近三年的账都查清楚！”

去年年底才核算了一次，那时候没有查出问题。那么贪污必然是今年开始的。

不过，东方青帝明白，这时候劝相南里冷静没什么用。他太需要把脑海里的愤怒和委屈宣泄出来了。

相南里为了自己的理想国付出太多。比起来自外部的军事压力，他更难接受内部的思想背叛。

如果不是基地，他大概已经进了某个大企业的研究所，继续在科研这条路上发光发热。

相南里只是聪明。可学识上的智慧和管理上的智慧，完全是两回事。

现实世界不是游戏模型，输入某个数据就能得到固定的结果。

大概几分钟后，相南里恢复了平静。他面无表情地捡起了刚刚散落一地的文件。

门口，刚得到消息，进来汇报的海狸战战兢兢：“司令。我们第一次核对的时候确实没有发现……”

人力和算力，完全不是同一层次、同一时代的东西。

相南里微微抬起手，打断她的话。

“让赤夫把山姜控制住，我们去罗马市一趟。”他低声吩咐，“先不要打草惊蛇。”

山姜是罗马现任市长。在永恒市解放前，和葛根一样，是城主手下的基因战士。

目前驻扎在罗马城的军团长官是赤夫。上次对神庭作战，他表现突出，因此刚升了军职。赤夫就是罗马城的人，但基地现在能用的人不多，顾不上回避。

基地目前军事最高负责人是相南里，往下是东方青帝。再往下是四名军团长，葛根（驻永恒市）、赤夫（驻罗马市）、秦九章（驻光辉市，刚上任），以西结（编外人员，管理名义上属于基地的畸变人部队，干不干活看心情）

基地日益壮大。葛根有残疾，论武力值，完全不是后面两人的对手。

胜在来的早，业务熟练，思想端正。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 153: The Corruption Case

What a joke. What kind of cargo was worth him watching over?

After he returned, as if nothing had happened, he went to the kitchen to cook.

Dongfang Qingdi’s discerning gaze scanned the refrigerator. It was quite good; the Ministry of Agriculture had sent over fresh, free ingredients.

Did this count as bribery? The Alpha pondered for a moment and decided it was part of ensuring Xiang Nanli’s personal safety. With a flourish, he added a daily quota of 30 points worth of ingredients for all senior cadres in the base. His and Xiang Nanli’s were combined, totaling 60 per day.

Ah, special supplies!

Xiang Nanli had Xiao Zhi to remind him when doing things.

But the Alpha truly had no one to manage him.

Dongfang Qingdi didn't mention it, and Xiang Nanli didn't ask. Everyone had a tacit understanding to keep silent; those three Human Alliance officials had evaporated from the Horsehead Nebula like water.

As for whether the Human Alliance would send people to investigate, that was a problem for later.

This was a bad debt.

A bad debt means the cost of pursuing it is too high, and the loss outweighs the gain. It is better not to pursue it.

Most of the supplies ordered from the Human Alliance this time were industrial goods that the base could not produce, or small-batch items that, while producible, would cost too much to set up an entire production line for—like pots, bowls, and ladles.

The rest were daily necessities, such as sugar and salt. These were not just seasonings, but essential raw materials for industrial production.

As Xiang Nanli tallied the goods, he opened a map, drew a circle, and sent it to Gegen: "There is a small salt lake here. Right after the earthquake ended, the base sent 13 rescue teams to ask our friendly neighbors if they needed assistance."

A "small" salt lake meant it wasn't big enough for the Human Alliance to care about, but it did indeed produce salt.

Because of the salt trade, the salt slaves beneath were impoverished and skeletal, while the master of the stronghold was wealthy beyond measure, a slave owner for generations. They had even used the strength of the entire clan to lift up a few promising descendants, who entered the "Surface Education Support Plan" of the poverty alleviation office and became junior civil servants in the Suzhou City Hall after graduation.

Unfortunately, the backers of the small salt lake had all died underground.

Xiang Nanli’s lips curled. "This natural disaster has brought a significant crisis to the salt village. It is the base's duty to assist. Your Red Lion Legion should send two regiments over to take over."

Speaking so tactfully was, of course, to make the name sound better. The legitimacy of the base was the "momentum" and "prestige" spreading across the surface; the base had to distinguish itself from other surface aggressor groups and become the kingly army that everyone yearned for!

Xiang Nanli added: "Just leave behind a compliant manager. Confiscate the salt lake, and you and the troops will remain at the small salt lake. Hire the former salt slaves as workers and pay them wages. Pay the wages in the base’s 'point vouchers,' but they can be exchanged for grain. Also, buy private salt at a price slightly lower than the base’s market price. If it’s a big landlord, only pay in points, not in kind. Let them come to the base to exchange for grain themselves."

In short, it was not a total slaughter. It was about killing a batch, dividing a batch, and pacifying a batch.

This was the reference answer provided by history books.

This time, the base had sent out a total of "13 rescue teams," so they couldn't let other areas waiting to be liberated become too vigilant!

"In the future, I plan to establish a 'Salt City' there. If you need support or are unsure of what to do, report directly to me," Xiang Nanli noted in his final instructions.

A rumbling sound came from above. Xiang Nanli looked up to see several drones bearing the Human Alliance emblem flying at low altitude. They made no attempt to hide their tracks, like lions showing off their power in their own territory.

Xiang Nanli recalled the news he had heard that morning and narrowed his eyes slightly. "It seems the Human Alliance has started selecting military stationing sites."

And such a good thing, naturally, would not fall to the base.

That evening, Xiang Nanli received a notification. The military base would be built near Odin City. That location would also become the command center for this military campaign. The newly built city would be called "Suzhou Military Base," or "Suzhou" for short. This was likely the last bit of political legacy left by Suzhou City, which had ranked last in GDP for years and had no major enterprises stationed there.

Besides this, there was internal news that the former mayor of Suzhou City, Luo Xiu, had been transferred to Bianliang City as deputy mayor. During this war, he might follow the army to the front lines to oversee the battle.

Xiang Nanli ran the situation through his mind, but he had no mood to express any opinion.

A report on the pension work for fallen soldiers had been sent back from Rome City. The submitted data table had to go through two procedures: one was the audit by the base's finance department, and the other was the AI's liquidation.

The first procedure passed, but the second did not.

Simply put, the accounts didn't match.

In the third year of the base's founding, while most people were still struggling at the poverty line, the first corruption case had appeared among the high-level officials.

In the mayor's office, Xiang Nanli was uncharacteristically furious: "I’m out there in the front, desperately trying to build a future, and these people are back here pulling down my pants!"

Interspersed were a few swear words.

People speak according to who they are. Xiang Nanli was highly educated and usually maintained his composure, speaking in a very formal, official manner.

But having spent every day on the surface, how could he not understand anything?

Rome City had previously been a bandit group occupied by God-Blood warriors, which was later incorporated into the base and underwent a major purge. Considering the lack of available personnel at the time, biochemical warriors who had just graduated from the academy in Eternal City were appointed to the positions.

This was also what Xiang Nanli found most baffling. Those who had been caught in the rain were the first to tear the umbrella to shreds.

Rome’s population and agriculture couldn't compare to Eternal City; its industry couldn't compare to Glory City; its political status couldn't compare to the main urban area. It was the city with the weakest presence among the four cities of the base. Its ancestral background wasn't great, and its GDP didn't look very good either.

Xiang Nanli had considered this situation, which was why he had transferred the base's light industry factories to Rome.

If he only cared about profit, the factories should have continued to operate in Glory City.

Xiang Nanli’s emotions fluctuated violently, his blood pressure soaring. "Investigate! Audit all the accounts for the last three years!"

They had audited at the end of last year, and no problems were found then. Therefore, the corruption must have started this year.

However, Dongfang Qingdi understood that trying to persuade Xiang Nanli to calm down at this moment was useless. He needed to vent the anger and grievance in his mind.

Xiang Nanli had sacrificed too much for his ideal kingdom. Compared to external military pressure, he found internal ideological betrayal much harder to accept.

If not for the base, he would probably have already entered a research institute of some large corporation, continuing to shine and generate heat on the path of scientific research.

Xiang Nanli was merely smart. But academic wisdom and managerial wisdom were two completely different things.

The real world is not a game model where you input certain data and get a fixed result.

About a few minutes later, Xiang Nanli regained his calm. He expressionlessly picked up the documents that had just scattered all over the floor.

At the door, Beaver, who had just received the news and came in to report, said tremblingly, "Commander. When we checked the first time, we really didn't find..."

Human effort and computational power were simply not things of the same level or era.

Xiang Nanli raised his hand slightly, interrupting her.

"Have Chifu detain Shanjian, and we will take a trip to Rome City," he ordered in a low voice. "Don't alert the enemy for now."

Shanjian was the current mayor of Rome. Before the liberation of Eternal City, he, like Gegen, was a gene-warrior under the city lord.

The current military commander stationed in Rome City was Chifu. During the last battle against the Divine Court, he had performed outstandingly and had therefore just been promoted. Chifu was from Rome City, but the base didn't have many people to use right now and couldn't afford to avoid him.

The current highest military official of the base was Xiang Nanli, followed by Dongfang Qingdi. Below them were the four legion commanders: Gegen (stationed in Eternal City), Chifu (stationed in Rome City), Qin Jiuzhang (stationed in Glory City, just appointed), and Ezekiel (an external personnel who managed the base's nominal mutant troops; whether he worked or not depended on his mood).

The base was growing stronger by the day. Gegen had a disability, and in terms of combat power, he was no match for the latter two.

His strength lay in the fact that he arrived early, was skilled in his duties, and had a correct ideology.

chunks.chineseText:
都说世界是个大的草台班子，葛根还在任职，却老是感觉到力不从心。他的经验条增长速度完全赶不上基地的发展，外加他的妻子也是基地实权人物，半年下来，跟相南里递过好几次辞呈。

只不过相南里还没答应。他不介意卸磨杀驴，可惜这只驴下岗，完全没有别的驴能顶上去！

相南里心中最属意的军团长是易横行，范佩西勉强。

但这两人目前都不能用。

相南里借走方差的飞行舱（对方刚开着飞机，从主城区赶来永恒市上任），问Alpha要了份驾驶飞行舱的技能书（能直接读取的那种），在第二天清晨，载着东方青帝抵达了罗马城。

城墙是用石块围出来的，入口处有设卡。罗马城地形不够平坦，高低起伏的小土丘上，搭着一个又一个棚子。像极了相南里曾经在摄影照片上看见的非洲贫民窟。相南里需要费老大劲，才能从这堆棚户房里，找出医院、学校等公立机构。

除此外，还有集装箱垒起的商场；开在货车上的小卖部、维修站。城里唯一算得上“豪华”的建筑，是市政厅；这是由罗马城原本的城主私宅改的，旁边是治安局。

比起城市，罗马城更像一座零散的村落。空气里甚至有股奇怪的臭味……相南里猜是市政厅的卫生工作没做好。

果然，他眼尖地捕捉到，远处小山坡，有位妇人打着哈欠提着木桶出来，毫不在意地把里面装着的有机肥往地上简陋的排水沟泼去。肥水顺着土坡往下流淌，滴到了下面住户的棚顶。

相南里默默在自己的备忘录上添了一行：在罗马市各个街道修建公共化粪池，沤制农家肥。

人在上面时，是很难有空低头，去看清下面的东西的。

相南里经常呆着的两座城市，几乎都是基地自己重建的。城市草图由人工智能设计，不但预留了发展空间，也照顾到地下管道、路面硬化等等细节。尤其是主城区，几乎有了现代城市的雏形。

罗马城是相南里第一次来。这里的落后和贫瘠，让相南里感觉到了刺痛和碍眼。

飞行舱停在郊外，两人交了点过路费，成功混进城内。

罗马城外来人口不多，一路上，都有人打量他们。

相南里穿着防护服，把自己遮挡的严严实实。他还没把自己的行踪通知罗马城市政厅。

于是，这座城市残忍地向他展示着最真实的样子。

城里不至于饿殍遍野，但路上的人难免看上去面黄肌瘦。

超市里的价格还算正常，甚至还在用早就被淘汰掉的“工分券”。不少工分券早就磨损了，却依然在城市里流通着。

相南里脑海里闪过一个念头，打开傅明的联系方式：“查查造纸厂，尤其是罗马市的订单，我怀疑有人倒卖。”

路上偶尔能看到几个小孩，明显在基地规定的“义务教育阶段”，相南里叫住他，往他手里塞了块糖，问他怎么没去上学。

小孩舔了舔，一口气地把糖吞下，摇着头飞快跑走了：“上什么学，又不给我工钱。上学有什么用~”

小孩口音很重。相南里反应了几秒，才意识到他说了些什么。

相南里气得抓狂：“我推广义务教育花的钱都能再造个几个实验室了，居然有人跟我说上学没用——”

东方青帝只好给他顺毛：“短视和贫穷总是相辅相成。他们的处境只能允许自己去追逐马上就能兑现的好处。读书却需要长期投资……得有第一批受益人大范围出现，才能达到移风易俗的效果。”

地表几百年来，哪有人在朝不保夕的小据点开过学堂！

大清早，城里最热闹的不是食堂和学校，而是实际上是赌场的地下酒馆。

兜里有点闲钱的，在酒馆里打牌。昏暗的光线混着烟味；没钱的，就露天打牌。棚户围着的小院，一群人蹲在一块，在那翻牌子。

博彩，是罗马城的老传统了。只是那时候牌桌上的，全是贵族老爷神血战士，哪轮得到普通人。

这片土地的娱乐太少，冬天，不用耕地，手上又有点闲钱，再加上有意引导，罗马城的居民很难不掉进赌博的深渊。

相南里盯着看了会，缓缓退出酒馆。在备忘录上记下了另外一笔：开设巡回露天影院，增强市民精神文化建设。严厉打击非法娱乐场所。

他继续顺着土坡往上走，前面，是红狮军团的驻地。

相南里骤然停下，咬牙道：“我要杀了山姜。”
chunks.englishText:
They say the world is just one big amateur stage; Gegen was still in office, but he often felt overwhelmed. His experience bar growth rate couldn't keep up with the development of the base, and plus, his wife was also an influential figure in the base. Over the past six months, he had submitted his resignation to Xiang Nanli several times.

It was just that Xiang Nanli hadn't agreed yet. He didn't mind getting rid of the donkey once it had finished grinding the grain, but unfortunately, if this donkey stepped down, there was absolutely no other donkey to fill the gap!

The legion commander Xiang Nanli favored most was Yi Hengxing, with Van Persie being a distant second.

But neither of these two could be used at the moment.

Xiang Nanli borrowed Fang Cha’s flight pod (the man had just flown in from the main urban area to take up his post in Eternal City) and asked the Alpha for a skill book on piloting flight pods (the kind that could be read directly). The next morning, he arrived in Rome City with Dongfang Qingdi.

The city walls were made of piled stones, and there were checkpoints at the entrance. The terrain of Rome City was not flat enough; one shed after another was built on the undulating small hills. It looked exactly like the African slums Xiang Nanli had once seen in photographs. It took a great deal of effort for Xiang Nanli to find public institutions like hospitals and schools among this pile of shanties.

Besides that, there were shopping malls made of stacked shipping containers; convenience stores and repair stations opened in trucks. The only building in the city that could be considered "luxurious" was the City Hall; it had been converted from the private residence of Rome City's original lord, with the Public Security Bureau next door.

Compared to a city, Rome City was more like a scattered village. There was even a strange stench in the air... Xiang Nanli guessed that the sanitation work at the City Hall hadn't been done well.

Sure enough, his sharp eyes caught a woman on a distant hillside yawning as she carried a wooden bucket out, nonchalantly splashing the organic fertilizer inside into a crude drainage ditch on the ground. The fertilizer water flowed down the dirt slope, dripping onto the roofs of the shanties below.

Xiang Nanli silently added a line to his memo: Build public septic tanks in every street of Rome City to compost farm fertilizer.

When a person is at the top, it is very difficult to find the time to look down and see things clearly.

The two cities where Xiang Nanli spent most of his time were almost entirely rebuilt by the base itself. The city blueprints were designed by artificial intelligence, which not only reserved space for development but also took into account details like underground pipes, road paving, and so on. Especially the main urban area, which had almost taken the shape of a modern city.

This was Xiang Nanli’s first time in Rome City. The backwardness and poverty here made Xiang Nanli feel a stinging sensation and an eyesore.

The flight pod landed in the suburbs, and the two paid a small toll to successfully blend into the city.

There weren't many outsiders in Rome City, and all along the way, people were sizing them up.

Xiang Nanli was wearing a protective suit, covering himself tightly. He hadn't notified the Rome City Hall of his arrival yet.

And so, this city cruelly showed him its most authentic side.

The city wasn't exactly filled with starving people, but the people on the road inevitably looked sallow and thin.

The prices in the supermarket were still considered normal, and they were even still using "work-point vouchers" that had long been phased out. Many of the vouchers were already worn out, yet they were still circulating in the city.

A thought flashed through Xiang Nanli’s mind, and he opened Fu Ming’s contact information: "Check the paper mill, especially the orders from Rome City. I suspect someone is reselling them."

Occasionally, he would see a few children on the road who were clearly in the "compulsory education stage" stipulated by the base. Xiang Nanli stopped one, stuffed a piece of candy into his hand, and asked why he wasn't in school.

The child licked it, swallowed the candy in one gulp, shook his head, and ran away quickly: "What school? They don't pay me wages. What's the use of school~"

The child had a heavy accent. It took Xiang Nanli a few seconds to realize what he had said.

Xiang Nanli was so angry he felt like going crazy: "The money I spent promoting compulsory education could have built several more laboratories, and yet someone is telling me that school is useless—"

Dongfang Qingdi had to soothe him: "Short-sightedness and poverty always go hand in hand. Their situation only allows them to pursue benefits that can be realized immediately. Education, however, requires long-term investment... You need the first batch of beneficiaries to appear on a large scale before you can achieve the effect of changing social customs."

For hundreds of years on the surface, no one had ever opened a school in a small stronghold where life was precarious!

Early in the morning, the liveliest places in the city were not the canteens or schools, but the underground taverns that were actually casinos.

Those with a little spare money in their pockets played cards in the taverns; the dim light was mixed with the smell of smoke. Those without money played cards in the open air. In the courtyards surrounded by shanties, a group of people would squat together, flipping cards.

Gambling was an old tradition in Rome City. Only, back then, the people at the card tables were all noble lords and God-Blood warriors; how could it ever be the turn of ordinary people?

There was too little entertainment in this land. In winter, when there was no need to farm, and they had a little spare money in their hands, plus intentional guidance, it was hard for the residents of Rome City not to fall into the abyss of gambling.

Xiang Nanli stared for a while and slowly backed out of the tavern. He recorded another item in his memo: Open mobile open-air cinemas to enhance the spiritual and cultural construction of citizens. Crack down severely on illegal entertainment venues.

He continued to walk up the dirt slope. Ahead was the station of the Red Lion Legion.

Xiang Nanli stopped abruptly, gritting his teeth: "I am going to kill Shanjian."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第154章 贪污案的处置 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第154章 贪污案的处置

但别人反省，想的是“对不起我错了”；相南里想的是，我早该明白，世界上除我之外的同类都很平庸，而我选择把部分工作托付给这样的人，就应当承受可能的后果。

所以，在当年Alpha差点被洛阳调试成智障时，相南里没有骂洛阳，只是默默打发他去上班，自己闷在研究所，花了几天几夜把心爱的Alpha抢救了回来。

但这一次，相南里不想反省了。

他非常愤怒。

这种愤怒，在来到营地时，抵达巅峰。又在来到地牢，打开审讯室大门，见到山姜本人后，逐渐回落。

和相南里想象中不太一样，山姜外表精瘦，皮肤粗糙泛着黑色，让人想起那幅名字叫《父亲》的油画。他竟然有着典型的劳动人民长相。

山姜是基因战士，他的手和脚都被电子镣铐锁住，而手铐的另一侧固定在墙壁上。避免他暴起伤人。

军团的牢房在地窖。罗马城基建不好，没有铺设电路。

地下用的是很原始、古老的煤油灯。

这里原本就是罗马城的地牢，已经用了数十年。浑浊的空气不怎么好闻，是蛋白质变性混合着油垢的味道。

相南里抿唇，在几米外的空地上坐下，打量着对方。

山姜的手指轻微颤抖着，但是逻辑还算清晰，语气也很平静：“司令，您来了。”

山姜是在昨天下午突然被赤夫逮捕的。

他清楚自己东窗事发，果然，关在牢里被审讯了一夜。

山姜此时的平静，既可以说是认命，也可以说是“死猪不怕开水烫”。比起那些崩溃大哭的、推卸责任的，这种冷静的贪官反倒是更难应付。或许山姜压根就不觉得自己有罪，只是倒霉，运气不好，被查到了。

相南里没有第一时间回复，而是低头，翻起赤夫整理的资料。

山姜，没人记得他的出生年月，大约三十岁。他出生在永恒之城。祖上和神庭沾点关系，但这点关系轮到山姜这一代，早就忽略不计。

母亲生了六个孩子，死了三个，家里穷，小孩养不活。于是，十岁的山姜进了城主府，服用基因药，成为一名生化战士。靠着山姜微薄的补贴，家里的情况终于得到了改善。起码不用担心饿死。

这之后，山姜一直在护卫队里勤恳工作。在成为罗马城市长之前，山姜在城主府已经就职了二十余年，熬死了一个又一个同事。

他的亲人还在永恒市。哥哥进了农业部，负责照看蔬菜园；妻子在大食堂帮佣；唯一的孩子进了学堂，成绩不好，态度不怎么端正，经常迟到早退。弟弟在罗马开酒馆。

相南里继续往下翻，还翻到了山姜给学校老师送礼的清单。就山姜自己交代的，有工分券、布料、鸡蛋。东西都不贵，但加起来数额不小。

日子好起来后，山姜家里推平原本的土房，修建起两层高的小平房。周围人都在重修房子，他的家并不起眼。

另外，山姜还向基地申请了一套单位房，在永恒市核心地段，有60平。而他自己在罗马市，有一套带厕所的员工宿舍，30平。

这就是他明面上的所有财产了。

除此外，罗马城开设赌场，山姜当然没有蠢到直接出面。

酒馆的老板是他弟，赚的钱进了自家人口袋。并且，明面上，酒馆是正规营生。如果不是相南里暗中走访，大概也猜不到这里一半以上的青壮年都热衷赌博。

更可恶的是，这些人赌博用的钱，还是家人的抚恤金或者拆迁费。

大多数赃款，都被山姜用来购买了人联的信用点，或神庭的赎罪券。

神庭的赎罪券还好，起码有实物。是纯度极高的银币和金币，掺了一些特殊生物材料。是地表的通用货币。

而人联几乎没有实体货币，只有电子货币。因此，山姜从外地人手中，额外购买了一个黑市账户。信用点几乎都是用物资从难民手里买的。

相南里翻完口供，无语到极点后反而笑了。

赤夫低声道：“司令，山姜这次做假账，实际上是想要堵之前的窟窿，好应付年底的查账。”

山姜的想法是好的，可惜没怎么学过数学，手法过于粗糙。

相南里的身体往后仰，上半身隐没在阴影中，语气却像是在拉家常：“你贪的钱，不少都拿去送礼了。看来孩子成绩很愁人啊。”

山姜的目光闪了闪：“给老师的礼是我婆娘干的，她说娃儿读不走，想请老师多照顾一下。”

相南里继续道：“你弟弟在罗马开的赌场，生意也挺不错的。”

山姜的心一沉。

他坐在审讯椅上，手握成拳，腿焦躁地抖来抖去：“司令，酒馆是我弟弟开的，我也不清楚他在搞啥子。”

相南里起身，把手里的口供本重重往山姜脸上砸去。

他厉声道：“你当我是傻子吗？还是觉得你的说辞很高明？！坏事全是家里人瞒着你做的？你自己不觉得可笑吗？”

在Alpha的感知里，相南里的心率很奇怪。

他是在发完脾气后，血压飙升的。感觉像是大脑提醒身体该生气了，于是身体慢吞吞地给出反应。

潦草的手写纸散落一地。

山姜在一阵颤抖后，整个人如同泄了气的皮球，耷拉下来。

他的勇气在和相南里的短暂对峙中用尽。

山姜能和赤夫周旋，因为对方充其量不过是他的平级，甚至下属。可他无法面对亲手打造了整个基地的相南里。

在山姜心里，他和过去的“城主”同样威严。不同的是，城主的威严来自血腥；相南里的威严，来自于……某种高尚、甚至可以称得上伟大的东西。

山姜只读完了基地的中学，想不出恰当的词汇去描述。

他的大脑空白一片，几乎是本能地招供：“司令。我，我确实忍不住拿了点……但是真没多少。换成信用点就七万不到。另外还有几百张银券，一张金券都没有……我退赃！”

“当时基地在打仗，我是真的害怕啊……看不到未来在哪。就想存点钱，那个叫什么来着，外汇，对，外汇。”

当时，基地要和神庭的天启骑士团开战的消息传出来，罗马城一片唉声。

基地都建设三年了，罗马城还是这幅穷困潦倒的样子，好在城里没了贵族老爷，奴隶也能吃上补助粮。

市民们拥护基地，但却很难坚定地相信，基地可以战胜神庭。

山姜只是想给自己的家庭一些保障。他声泪俱下地回忆起童年时饿死的三个姐妹，讲到自己刚上任时的豪情壮志，以及对自己罪行的忏悔。地下监狱里全是他心碎凄惨的哭声。

一开始是表演，想要推脱责任，但后来，山姜却是实打实地感觉到了后悔：“司令，我错了！我真的知道错了。再给我一次机会吧，司令——”

是啊，他的生活，其实早就比相南里来之前好太多。基地的所有人都是。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 154: Handling the Corruption Case

When others reflect on their mistakes, they think, "I am sorry, I was wrong." When Xiang Nanli reflects, he thinks: *I should have realized sooner that everyone in this world besides me is mediocre. Since I chose to entrust part of my work to such people, I must bear the potential consequences.*

That was why, back when his Alpha was nearly turned into a simpleton by Luo Yang’s tinkering, Xiang Nanli didn’t scold him. He simply sent him off to work in silence, then shut himself in the laboratory for days and nights, salvaging his beloved Alpha.

But this time, Xiang Nanli did not want to reflect.

He was furious.

This fury reached its peak when he arrived at the camp, and then gradually subsided as he reached the dungeon, opened the interrogation room door, and saw Shanjian in the flesh.

He was not quite what Xiang Nanli had imagined. Shanjian was lean and wiry, with rough, dark skin that recalled the famous oil painting titled *Father*. He possessed the quintessential look of a working-class man.

Shanjian was a gene-warrior. His hands and feet were locked in electronic shackles, the other ends of which were bolted to the wall to prevent him from lashing out.

The legion’s prison was located in the cellar. The infrastructure of Rome City was poor, and no electrical wiring had been laid.

They used primitive, ancient kerosene lamps underground.

This had been the dungeon of Rome City for decades. The stagnant air was unpleasant, smelling of denatured proteins mixed with grease.

Xiang Nanli pursed his lips and sat down on the empty ground a few meters away, observing the man.

Shanjian’s fingers trembled slightly, but his logic remained clear, and his tone was calm: "Commander, you have come."

Shanjian had been suddenly arrested by Chifu yesterday afternoon.

He knew his schemes had been exposed; sure enough, he had been interrogated in the cell all night.

Shanjian’s current calm could be interpreted as resignation, or perhaps the attitude of a "dead pig that fears no boiling water." Compared to those who broke down in tears or shifted blame, this kind of composed corrupt official was even harder to deal with. Perhaps Shanjian didn't feel guilty at all; he simply felt unlucky—that he had been caught.

Xiang Nanli did not reply immediately. Instead, he lowered his head and flipped through the documents Chifu had compiled.

Shanjian: no one remembered his exact date of birth, but he was roughly thirty. He was born in the Eternal City. His ancestors had some connection to the Divine Court, but by Shanjian’s generation, that connection was negligible.

His mother had given birth to six children, three of whom had died; the family was poor, and they couldn't afford to raise them all. Thus, at ten years old, Shanjian entered the City Lord’s mansion, took gene medicine, and became a biochemical warrior. Thanks to Shanjian’s meager subsidies, the family’s situation finally improved. At the very least, they no longer had to worry about starving to death.

Since then, Shanjian had worked diligently in the guard force. Before becoming the Mayor of Rome City, he had served in the City Lord’s mansion for over twenty years, outlasting colleague after colleague.

His relatives were still in the Eternal City. His older brother had joined the Ministry of Agriculture, responsible for tending the vegetable gardens; his wife worked as a maid in the public canteen; his only child had entered school, though his grades were poor, his attitude was lackluster, and he was frequently late or left early. His younger brother ran a tavern in Rome.

Xiang Nanli continued flipping down the page and found a list of gifts Shanjian had sent to his child’s teachers. According to Shanjian’s own confession, these included work-point vouchers, fabric, and eggs. None of the items were expensive, but the total amount was not insignificant.

After life improved, Shanjian’s family had leveled their original mud hut and built a two-story bungalow. Everyone around them was rebuilding their homes, so his house did not stand out.

Additionally, Shanjian had applied for a unit apartment from the base in a core area of the Eternal City, measuring 60 square meters. He himself had a 30-square-meter staff dormitory in Rome City that included a toilet.

This was all of his property on paper.

Beyond that, Shanjian was certainly not stupid enough to openly run the casinos that had opened in Rome City.

The tavern owner was his younger brother, and the money earned went into their own pockets. Furthermore, on the surface, the tavern was a legitimate business. If not for Xiang Nanli’s secret investigations, he probably wouldn't have guessed that more than half of the young, able-bodied men there were addicted to gambling.

What was even more detestable was that the money these people used for gambling came from their families' pension funds or relocation compensation.

Most of the illicit money was used by Shanjian to purchase Human Alliance credits or Divine Court indulgences.

The Divine Court’s indulgences were better, at least they had physical value. They were silver and gold coins of extremely high purity, mixed with some special biological materials. They were the common currency on the surface.

The Human Alliance, however, had almost no physical currency, only electronic currency. Therefore, Shanjian had purchased an extra black-market account from outsiders. The credits were almost entirely bought from refugees using supplies.

After finishing the confession, Xiang Nanli was so speechless that he actually laughed.

Chifu whispered, "Commander, Shanjian’s falsification of the accounts this time was actually an attempt to plug previous holes to pass the year-end audit."

Shanjian’s intentions were good, but unfortunately, he hadn't studied much mathematics, and his methods were too crude.

Xiang Nanli leaned back, his upper body swallowed by the shadows, but his tone was as casual as chatting about daily life: "A lot of the money you embezzled was spent on gifts. It seems your child’s grades are quite a headache."

Shanjian’s eyes flickered: "The gifts for the teachers were my wife’s doing. She said the kid couldn't keep up with his studies and wanted to ask the teachers to take extra care of him."

Xiang Nanli continued: "The casino your brother runs in Rome is also doing quite well."

Shanjian’s heart sank.

He sat in the interrogation chair, his hands balled into fists, his legs shaking anxiously: "Commander, the tavern is run by my brother. I don't know what he’s doing."

Xiang Nanli stood up and slammed the confession file in his hand hard against Shanjian’s face.

He shouted sternly: "Do you take me for a fool? Or do you think your excuses are clever?! Everything bad was done by your family behind your back? Don't you find that ridiculous?"

In the Alpha’s perception, Xiang Nanli’s heart rate was strange.

His blood pressure had spiked only after he finished losing his temper. It was as if his brain had reminded his body that it should be angry, so his body had slowly provided the reaction.

The messy, handwritten papers scattered across the floor.

After a bout of trembling, Shanjian slumped down like a deflated balloon.

His courage had been exhausted in the brief confrontation with Xiang Nanli.

Shanjian could spar with Chifu because the latter was, at best, his equal or even his subordinate. But he could not face Xiang Nanli, the man who had built the entire base with his own hands.

In Shanjian’s heart, he was as imposing as the "City Lord" of the past. The difference was that the City Lord’s authority came from bloodshed; Xiang Nanli’s authority came from... something noble, something that could even be called great.

Shanjian had only finished middle school at the base and could not think of the right words to describe it.

His mind went blank, and he confessed almost instinctively: "Commander. I... I really couldn't help but take a little... but it really wasn't much. It’s less than seventy thousand in credits. Plus a few hundred silver vouchers, not a single gold voucher... I’ll return the stolen money!"

"The base was at war at the time, and I was truly afraid... I couldn't see where the future lay. I just wanted to save some money, that thing called... foreign exchange, yes, foreign exchange."

At the time, news had leaked that the base was going to war with the Divine Court’s Apocalypse Knights, and Rome City was filled with wailing.

The base had been under construction for three years, yet Rome City remained in such a state of poverty. The only good thing was that there were no more noble masters in the city, and slaves could eat subsidized grain.

The citizens supported the base, but it was hard for them to firmly believe that the base could defeat the Divine Court.

Shanjian just wanted to provide some security for his family. He recalled, with tears and snot, the three sisters who had starved to death in his childhood, spoke of his grand ambitions when he first took office, and confessed his remorse for his crimes. The underground prison was filled with his heartbreaking, miserable cries.

At first, it was a performance, an attempt to shirk responsibility, but later, Shanjian truly felt regret: "Commander, I was wrong! I really know I was wrong. Give me another chance, Commander—"

Yes, his life was actually much better than it had been before Xiang Nanli arrived. Everyone in the base’s life was.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第154章 贪污案的处置 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
如果不是相南里来了，罗马城的大多数人，只能度过一个忍饥挨饿的冬天。更别提什么学校、医院、集市……

他的妻子孩子笑容比过去十几年都多。

可人啊，总是贪婪地抬头仰望。很少看自己的脚下和身后。

相南里揉了揉眉心，声音愈发冷冽，指着他的鼻子骂道：“首先，你这个不叫退赃，叫没收非法所得。其次，你用虚造的工分券代替物资，发给城里其他人作为工资和战亡抚恤金，贪下来的物资又低价卖出，导致罗马城物价居高不下！你侵吞的国有资产是你赃款的数十倍！”

他*的，想到就来气。造假币就算了，这人为了洗钱，竟然直接倒卖其他城区运过来的扶贫物资！

这件事发生的时候，相南里在前线，又是打仗，又是赈灾；东方青帝在地底超长待机。这才让山姜钻了空子。

这些物资少部分来自基地工厂自生产，大部分来自于人联进口。

进口都要占配额的！运输过来又要被剥削一遍。相南里自己都舍不得用，眼巴巴送过来造厂造楼。

而山姜竟然转手倒卖给其他据点，用来赚外汇？！

毫无疑问，山姜是聪明的。他只用两个月就学完了其他人一年的课程；没有任何阅历，却无师自通地学会了造假账、造jia币、洗钱。

但因为无知和短视，作为罗马市一把手，山姜的聪明反而造就了更大的恶果。

“我可以告诉你，你的案子，是基地的第一起贪污案，我一定会重罚。我会判处你死刑。执行过程公开，录像。正好，罗马城的断头铡还在。你名下的所有资产没收，你的家人还可以留在基地，但百年内，不得担任基地的任何公职。包括市政厅各部门、食堂、学校、军队、农场等等。”这意味着山姜的哥哥和妻子都会被开除。

是的，这就是连坐。乱世用重典。

相南里原本想的是三代内不准考公。然而，基地目前还没有婚姻法。如果十三四岁结婚，十五岁生子，不出五十年，山姜的家族又能东山再起。历史上甚至真的有这样的先例，这才改口到了百年。

山姜在瞬间面如死灰。

相南里不愿再浪费时间，他转身，就打算离去。然而背后，山姜却剧烈挣扎起来，他没能撼动镣铐，连人带椅子一起倒在地上，不停朝着相南里的方向蠕动着。

“司令——司令！”山姜的叫声可谓凄厉。

东方青帝忍不住蹙起眉，心想要不干脆先电晕算了。扭扭捏捏地实在难看。

赤夫上前，拽住山姜的铁链子，准备把他往小黑屋里关去。

“司令，我还、我还有话要说！”

相南里俯视着他：“说。”

山姜就这样挪到了相南里的脚边。

他大口喘着气，短短几米的距离浑身湿透：“司令。”

山姜本来想说，自己可以交代造纸厂和他交易的工人名单，但相南里眼神的却在告诉他，“我不需要这个”。

他会自己查。

山姜陆陆续续道：“司令，我在罗马城干了两年半。这里学风不好，城里的人喜欢让细伢（小孩）进工厂、农场赚钱，如果可以，以后最好限制一下细伢的工作年龄，赚不到钱，自然就送去上免费的学了。

“罗马城附近都是沙土，水土流失严重，我看书上说，可以开梯田……

“赌博问题确实很严重，酒馆端了后，给他们找点事做。踢球啊、冬泳啊、修房子啊，什么都行……不要让他们闲着。

“城里的服装厂可以多招点女工。女工能挣钱，就不用去卖，也不至于因家庭地位低，被丈夫打骂。

“另外，城里很需要医生，还有净水厂。

“我当时在学堂读的工科，城市改良的图纸在我办公室第二层抽屉里。罗马的地图都是我自己一步一步用脚丈量的……人联地图上找不到罗马城，司令……”大滴大滴的眼泪落在石板地上。

相南里心情复杂地沉默片刻，回答：“我知道了，会组织人开会商量的。”

山姜得到了承诺，整个人像是被抽走魂魄一样，瘫在地上，只剩喘气的劲儿。

基地的法律还不怎么健全，因为没时间和实际想结合，几乎全部照搬人联。

人联对贪污的定罪是很宽松的。

相南里对山姜的处置，会越过人联律法，成为基地处理贪污案的定例。

在基地范围内，他手握王爵，口含天宪。

果不其然，当天下午，基地的内部报纸就刊登了这则讯息。

对山姜的处罚，还做成了大字报，贴在基地四座城市的通知墙上。大多数人都不认识山姜，但却因为“死刑”两个字，感到一丝敬畏。

福音书在自己的日记本里尽职记录着：“新历948年10月21日，基地总司令相南里就‘罗马市长山姜贪污一案’，做出重要指示。他指出，基地正是高速发展的时期，但许多干部还停留在过去的‘农奴阶段’，只考虑短期利益，不考虑长期发展。基地干部的思想必须端正，要把基地当家，把市民当家人。未来，基地将加强干部精神、作风建设。对贪污腐败、勾结黑社会等行为一律0容忍！除此外，更要健全内部法制体系，限制权力的无序扩张。相南里表示，没有信仰和凝聚力的组织，是不会长久的。基地不仅要注重物质上的成长，也要注重精神上的成长！”

山姜执行死刑的第二周。

罗马城开始按照他留下的图纸重建。
chunks.englishText:
If not for Xiang Nanli’s arrival, most people in Rome City would only have spent the winter starving. Not to mention schools, hospitals, or markets...

His wife and children had smiled more in the last few years than in the previous decade.

But people are always greedily looking upward. They rarely look at their own feet or behind them.

Xiang Nanli rubbed his temples, his voice growing colder as he pointed at Shanjian’s nose and scolded: "First of all, this isn't called 'returning stolen goods,' it’s called confiscating illegal gains. Secondly, you used forged work-point vouchers instead of supplies to pay wages and war pensions to others in the city, and then sold the embezzled supplies at low prices, causing the cost of living in Rome City to skyrocket! The state assets you embezzled are dozens of times the amount of your illicit gains!"

Damn it, just thinking about it made him angry. Forging currency was one thing, but to launder money, this man had actually gone as far as reselling poverty-alleviation supplies shipped in from other districts!

When this happened, Xiang Nanli was on the front lines, fighting wars and providing disaster relief; Dongfang Qingdi was in long-term standby mode underground. That was how Shanjian had found his opening.

A small portion of these supplies came from the base’s own factories, but most were imported from the Human Alliance.

Imports required quotas! And they were exploited again during transport. Xiang Nanli himself couldn't bear to use them, watching them eagerly as they were sent to build factories and buildings.

And Shanjian had actually turned around and resold them to other outposts to earn foreign exchange?!

Undoubtedly, Shanjian was smart. He had learned in two months what others took a year to master; without any experience, he had self-taught the skills to falsify accounts, forge currency, and launder money.

But because of his ignorance and shortsightedness, as the top leader of Rome City, Shanjian’s intelligence had only created greater evil.

"I can tell you this: your case is the first corruption case at the base, and I will punish you severely. I will sentence you to death. The execution process will be public and recorded. As it happens, the guillotine in Rome City is still there. All assets under your name will be confiscated. Your family may remain at the base, but for the next hundred years, they are forbidden from holding any public office at the base. This includes municipal departments, canteens, schools, the military, farms, and so on." This meant Shanjian’s brother and wife would be fired.

Yes, this was collective punishment. In troubled times, one must use heavy codes.

Xiang Nanli had originally thought about banning them from taking civil service exams for three generations. However, the base did not yet have a marriage law. If they married at thirteen or fourteen and had children at fifteen, within fifty years, Shanjian’s family could rise again. There were even historical precedents for this, which was why he changed it to a hundred years.

Shanjian’s face turned ashen in an instant.

Xiang Nanli did not want to waste any more time; he turned to leave. However, behind him, Shanjian began to struggle violently. Unable to shake the shackles, he fell to the ground with his chair, crawling incessantly toward Xiang Nanli.

"Commander—Commander!" Shanjian’s cries were truly piercing.

Dongfang Qingdi couldn't help but frown, thinking it might be better to just electrocute him into unconsciousness. This squirming was truly unsightly.

Chifu stepped forward, grabbed Shanjian’s chains, and prepared to drag him into the dark cell.

"Commander, I still, I still have something to say!"

Xiang Nanli looked down at him: "Speak."

Shanjian crawled to Xiang Nanli’s feet.

He gasped for air, his body soaked with sweat after just a few meters: "Commander."

Shanjian had intended to say that he could provide a list of workers at the paper mill who had traded with him, but Xiang Nanli’s eyes told him, "I don't need that."

He would investigate it himself.

Shanjian spoke intermittently: "Commander, I’ve worked in Rome City for two and a half years. The academic atmosphere here is poor; people in the city like to send their *xidai* (children) into factories and farms to earn money. If possible, it would be best to restrict the working age of children in the future. If they can't earn money, they will naturally be sent to free school."

"The area around Rome City is all sandy soil, and soil erosion is severe. I read in a book that we could build terraced fields..."

"The gambling problem is indeed very serious. After the tavern is shut down, find them something to do. Playing soccer, winter swimming, repairing houses, anything... don't let them be idle."

"The clothing factory in the city could hire more female workers. If female workers can earn money, they won't have to sell themselves, and they won't be beaten or scolded by their husbands due to low family status."

"Also, the city is in great need of doctors, and a water purification plant."

"I studied engineering at the school; the blueprints for urban improvements are in the second drawer of my office desk. The map of Rome was measured by my own feet, step by step... You can't find Rome City on the Human Alliance map, Commander..." Large, heavy tears fell onto the stone floor.

Xiang Nanli was silent for a moment, his mood complex, before replying: "I know. I will organize a meeting to discuss it."

Having received the promise, Shanjian seemed to have his soul drained away, collapsing on the ground with only enough strength left to breathe.

The base’s laws were not yet sound, as there had been no time to combine them with reality, so they had almost entirely copied the Human Alliance.

The Human Alliance’s sentencing for corruption was very lenient.

Xiang Nanli’s handling of Shanjian would bypass Human Alliance law and become the precedent for how the base handled corruption cases.

Within the territory of the base, he held the power of a prince, his words carrying the weight of law.

Sure enough, that afternoon, the base’s internal newspaper published the news.

The punishment for Shanjian was also made into a big-character poster and posted on the notice walls of the base’s four cities. Most people didn't know Shanjian, but they felt a sense of awe because of the words "death penalty."

The Gospel recorded faithfully in its diary: "New Calendar Year 948, October 21st. Base Commander-in-Chief Xiang Nanli issued important instructions regarding the 'Shanjian Corruption Case of Rome City.' He pointed out that the base is in a period of rapid development, but many cadres remain stuck in the 'serf stage' of the past, considering only short-term interests rather than long-term development. The ideology of the base’s cadres must be corrected; they must treat the base as their home and the citizens as their family. In the future, the base will strengthen the spiritual and conduct development of its cadres. There will be zero tolerance for corruption, bribery, and collusion with organized crime! Furthermore, the internal legal system must be improved to limit the disorderly expansion of power. Xiang Nanli stated that an organization without faith and cohesion will not last long. The base must focus not only on material growth but also on spiritual growth!"

The second week after Shanjian’s execution.

Rome City began to rebuild according to the blueprints he had left behind.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第155章 强大的友军、敌军与炮灰的我
chunks.chineseText:
第155章 强大的友军、敌军与炮灰的我

这是方圆百里的最高峰，爬山太浪费时间，因此，他是让东方青帝抱着自己飞上来的。
　　相南里举着望眼镜，往罗马城的方向望去——
　　那里正在进行旧城改造。附近两座城池的工程兵和劳改犯都来了，加上罗马城本地居民，干得热火朝天。
　　想要富，先修路。这次主要进行的是下水管道改造、电网铺设还有路面硬化。
　　罗马城的住民们能忍受到处流肥水的中世纪大农村，因为他们原本就生活在这样的世界里，甚至这个中世纪大农村，已经算是人生里难得的安稳；但相南里忍受不了。
　　他有一种到处给人当爹的感觉。
　　建材几乎都是从人联进口，沥青倒是就地取材，原地开设简陋化工厂露天冶炼。城建的人工费用可以忽略不计，但就算这样，这次改造的开销依旧抽空了罗马城未来三年的税收。相当于罗马市政厅向总部借了钱。
　　“咱们现在的货币体系，是基于仓库里储存的物资。如果不收取改建费用，就相当于无限制印钞，基地很快会恶性通货膨胀。”相南里用自己刚学的财经知识解释着，“对吧？小青。”
　　东方青帝对“咱们”这个词甚是喜爱，当即录音，收进了自己的硬盘里。
　　现在他硬盘里，名字叫“LeeGarcia”的隐藏文件夹已经有137个G了。里面的内容很有规划地分成了“图片”“录像”“录音”“数据记录”四个文件夹。
　　其中，录像里的某段AVI，更是在短短半个月时间里被东方青帝反复观赏了117次。
　　小青面容严肃地点头：“按照仓库现在的盈余，我们还能花三千四百万。”
　　基地刚从人联进口几千万物资。也就是说，基地之前一直是亏损状态来着……
　　相南里又如法炮制地看了眼永恒市和光辉市。主城区位置隐蔽，看不见。
　　白茫茫的雪地，除了这三座城市，其他地方都荒无人烟。这里本就不适合人类生存，是残酷的战争毁掉了新历前的聚居地。
　　城与城之间的道路是一条条毛细血管；属于人联的“工蜂号”运输车是流动的血液，在公路上疾驰着。
　　相南里没有问这些工蜂运输车哪来的，为什么能用。
　　他只是带着几名技术人员，连夜给工蜂号换了涂层。
　　相南里开始强人所难：“小青，我想看看人联建的军事基地~”
　　他的话音刚落，电子望远镜里的图像瞬间发生了变化。
　　巨大的工具车举着金属臂，抓起一个个方块，往地上盖去。这些长方形的盒子用的仿卯榫结构，不出半小时，一幢二十米的高楼拔地而起。机械臂大手一挥，人联、剑门城、汴梁城的徽章就印在了金属的外立面上。
　　这是在建军事指挥部。
　　军事基地的半空还在修浮空轨道。另外，生活区的宿舍楼、商场都已完工，甚至还规划出一片区域修建公园。部分区域已经能看到有人居住。人虽然多，但在军队的规划下，却显得井然有序。
　　一台台机器人不分白天黑夜地工作着，几乎是相南里一眨眼，城市的进度条就能+1。
　　相南里咋舌：“好高的效率。”
　　而且建的完全是现代化城市！
　　相比之下，罗马城的改造就像是小孩子在沙滩上玩泥巴。
　　东方青帝听出了他语气里的羡慕，安慰道：“人联是想撤军后把这里当姑苏城遗址，安置幸存的姑苏人。”
　　相南里也听到了新闻，就在前几日，地表终于成功打通了前往地底的通道。
　　据说地下的岩浆仍在烧着，宛如人间炼狱。但仍有大约两百万人，在这次灾难中幸存。
　　百分之九十五都是青壮年。龟缩在还没有被岩浆淹没的高地。
　　当人口的死亡率超过一半时，社会秩序就开始崩溃。尤其是姑苏高层的领导班子几乎全面脱逃，地底完全是无政府状态。在相南里眼里，临阵脱逃的高层官员都该治罪。
　　可惜，治罪是没有的。
　　灾难面前，逃跑是本能，面对是必须承担的责任。
　　人不能只靠本能生存。那和在大草原上当猴子有什么区别？
　　很难想象，姑苏城里的这群人是怎么活下来的，肯定经受了难以想象的磨难。比起物质支援，也许他们更需要心理医生。
　　目前，这批人正在有序向地表转移。
　　相南里调转望远镜的方向，问：“那神庭呢？”
　　于是，他的眼前又出现了陌生的地图。
　　相南里正在俯瞰一座建造在荒漠上的城市。
　　东方青帝解释着：“这是利维坦，加百列的封地。靠近阴山城。人联就是想要攻下它。”
　　利维坦是神庭的八座地上神国之一。
　　城墙是朴素的黄色，墙上刻着密密麻麻的神纹。
　　每天，都有狂信徒面朝高墙跪拜，家徒四壁还要献上所有的财富。没有财富，那就用自己的血肉去涂抹台阶。
　　整座城市呈现出偌大的圆形，蛮横无理地占据着沙漠上最好的绿洲。
　　城里遍布着大小不一的泉眼和湖泊，还有一条长达37公里的地上悬河。
　　四百年前，神庭用神术抽调了方圆1000公里的地下水，建出这座天国。代价是所有小部落全都淹没在了历史的尘埃中。只剩利维坦伫立于黄沙之上，愈发神圣、巍峨。
　　“加百列刚死。人联想攻破利维坦，倒不是毫无可能。”东方青帝谨慎地评价着，“只是利维坦的信仰非常牢固，和生存必要的水资源挂钩，每个人都是狂信徒。就算人联获胜，想安稳驻扎也需要进行血腥的屠城。战略和政治意义远大于人联能实际获得的好处。”
　　神庭也在调集军队。沙漠上，一条看不见尽头的行军队伍正在不断涌入利维坦。
　　他们的装备看上去很原始：车、马、炮。
　　但相南里调整焦距，往队伍中扫了眼。全都是整装满编制的天启骑士，它们的头盔是尖锐的三角形，每个人都是远超正常人类的高大。随着军队一起运输的马车和枪炮上，全都雕刻着神秘的符文。
　　更奇特的是，这只队伍运输的货物。
　　竟然是一口口深黑色的棺材。棺椁被厚重的锁链缠绕着，有些棺材开了一条缝，不停往下滴着粘稠的黑色血液。
　　黑色的血液刚滴落，一旁护送的天启骑士就会翻身下马，小心翼翼地跪在地上，以一种虔诚地姿态，把这滴血液装进特制的瓶子里。
　　这么庞大的队伍，行走起来居然是寂静无声的。
　　相南里还想继续观察，东方青帝却突然夺走了他手里的望远镜。
　　相南里茫然地望着他。
　　东方青帝的眉微微蹙起：“神庭这次派出的总指挥是米迦勒。他对视线的感知很敏锐，还能发起精神攻击，刚才我捕捉到了频率奇怪的音波。”
　　前方就是利维坦。米迦勒坐在华丽的辇车上，兴致勃勃地挑选着今天要佩戴的饰品。
　　头饰可以选择的余地很多，他随意缠绕着丝带、贝壳和宝石。
　　耳饰挑选的某个时代人联战场指挥官的头骨磨成的耳钉。
　　一般来说，同样的材料米迦勒只会做一件饰品。但出于尊敬，这款耳钉一共有7个。
　　米迦勒侧过头，金发垂落在地上，给自己佩戴着耳饰。
　　他忽地抬头，朝远方看了眼，然后，意味不明地“呵”了一声。
　　神庭的大天使，无论本体到底是什么东西，样貌都不差。加百列已经漂亮的像个玩偶了，身为大天使长的米迦勒没那么阴柔，却更耀眼夺目。
　　你直视他的脸，甚至会觉得看见了一团圣光。看完后记不住五官，只能回想起那种震撼人心的感觉。
　　米迦勒目光深沉：“哪只人联的老鼠在偷窥我？”
　　相南里只好收起了望远镜，长长地叹了一口气。
　　双方看上去都如此强劲。
　　真打起来，位于战区的基地就像个炮灰。
　　相南里转身，对着Alpha张开了双臂：“走吧，该吃饭了。”
　　Alpha十分上道地把人拦腰抱起，手护住了相南里的脸；然后321跳。
　　相南里感觉自己在玩蹦极。耳边是呼啸的风声。很解压。
　　事已至此，先吃饭吧。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 155: Powerful Allies, Enemies, and Me, the Cannon Fodder

This was the highest peak for a hundred miles around. Climbing it would be a waste of time, so he had let Dongfang Qingdi carry him up.

Xiang Nanli held up his binoculars, peering toward the direction of Rome City.

A massive urban renewal project was underway there. Engineering corps and convicts from two neighboring cities had been brought in, and combined with the local residents of Rome City, the place was buzzing with feverish activity.

If you want to get rich, build roads first. The primary focus this time was the renovation of sewage systems, the installation of power grids, and the hardening of road surfaces.

The residents of Rome City could tolerate living in a medieval rural backwater filled with flowing filth because that was the world they had always known—in fact, this medieval backwater was already a rare moment of stability in their lives. But Xiang Nanli could not stand it.

He felt like he was playing "daddy" to everyone.

Construction materials were almost entirely imported from the Human Alliance, though the asphalt was sourced locally, with crude chemical plants set up on-site for open-air refining. While the labor costs for urban construction were negligible, the expenses for this renovation had still drained Rome City’s tax revenue for the next three years. It was effectively the Rome City Hall taking out a loan from headquarters.

"Our current monetary system is based on the supplies stored in our warehouses. If we don't charge for the renovation, it would be equivalent to printing money without limit, and the base would soon suffer from hyperinflation," Xiang Nanli explained, using the financial knowledge he had just learned. "Right, Xiao Qing?"
