Dongfang Qingdi was quite fond of the word "our," so he immediately recorded the audio and saved it to his hard drive.

By now, the hidden folder on his hard drive named "LeeGarcia" had reached 137 gigabytes. The contents were meticulously organized into four folders: "Images," "Videos," "Audio," and "Data Logs."

Among them, a certain AVI file in the video folder had been watched 117 times by Dongfang Qingdi in just half a month.

Xiao Qing nodded with a serious expression: "Based on the current surplus in the warehouse, we can still spend 34 million."

The base had just imported tens of millions worth of supplies from the Human Alliance. This meant the base had been operating at a loss until now...

Xiang Nanli checked on Eternal City and Glory City in the same manner. Their main urban areas were hidden, making them impossible to see.

In the vast, snowy wasteland, there was no sign of human life outside of these three cities. This place was never meant for human habitation; it was the brutal wars that had destroyed the settlements of the pre-New Era.

The roads between the cities were like capillaries, and the "Worker Bee" transport vehicles belonging to the Human Alliance were the flowing blood, speeding along the highways.

Xiang Nanli didn't ask where these Worker Bee transports came from or how they were operational.

He simply took a few technicians and spent the night repainting the Worker Bees.

Xiang Nanli began to make unreasonable demands: "Xiao Qing, I want to see the military base built by the Human Alliance~"

No sooner had he spoken than the image in the electronic binoculars shifted instantly.

Huge utility vehicles raised their metal arms, grabbing massive blocks and stacking them onto the ground. These rectangular boxes used a faux-mortise-and-tenon structure; within half an hour, a twenty-meter-tall building rose from the ground. With a wave of a mechanical arm, the emblems of the Human Alliance, Sword Gate City, and Bianliang City were stamped onto the metal facades.

This was the construction of a military command headquarters.

Above the military base, they were still building floating tracks. Additionally, the dormitories and shopping malls in the residential area were already complete, and there was even a planned area for a park. In some sections, people could already be seen living there. Though there were many people, under the military's planning, everything appeared orderly.

Robots worked day and night, and almost every time Xiang Nanli blinked, the city's progress bar ticked up.

Xiang Nanli clicked his tongue: "Such high efficiency."

And they were building a completely modern city!

In comparison, the renovation of Rome City was like children playing with mud on a beach.

Dongfang Qingdi sensed the envy in his tone and comforted him: "The Human Alliance intends to use this place as a site for the Gusu City ruins after they withdraw their troops, to resettle the surviving Gusu people."

Xiang Nanli had also heard the news; just a few days ago, the surface had finally successfully breached the passage to the underground.

It was said that the magma beneath was still burning, like a living hell. Yet, about two million people had survived this disaster.

Ninety-five percent were young and able-bodied, huddled on high ground that hadn't yet been submerged by magma.

When the mortality rate of a population exceeds half, social order begins to collapse. Especially since the leadership of Gusu had almost entirely fled, the underground was in a state of complete anarchy. In Xiang Nanli's eyes, the high-ranking officials who deserted their posts should be punished.

Unfortunately, there was no punishment.

In the face of disaster, running away is an instinct, while facing it is a necessary responsibility.

Humans cannot live on instinct alone. What would be the difference between that and being a monkey on the savanna?

It was hard to imagine how these people in Gusu City had survived; they must have endured unimaginable suffering. Perhaps more than material support, they needed psychologists.

Currently, this group was being moved to the surface in an orderly fashion.

Xiang Nanli turned the binoculars and asked: "What about the Divine Court?"

And so, a strange map appeared before his eyes.

Xiang Nanli was looking down at a city built in the desert.

Dongfang Qingdi explained: "This is Leviathan, Gabriel's fiefdom. It's near Yinshan City. The Human Alliance wants to conquer it."

Leviathan was one of the eight terrestrial divine kingdoms of the Divine Court.

The city walls were a plain yellow, engraved with dense divine runes.

Every day, fanatics knelt facing the high walls, offering up all their wealth even if they had nothing left at home. If they had no wealth, they used their own flesh and blood to smear the steps.

The entire city was a massive circle, arrogantly occupying the best oasis in the desert.

The city was filled with springs and lakes of various sizes, as well as a 37-kilometer-long elevated river.

Four hundred years ago, the Divine Court used divine arts to draw up groundwater from a 1,000-kilometer radius to build this heavenly kingdom. The price was that all the small tribes were drowned in the dust of history. Only Leviathan remained, standing above the yellow sands, becoming increasingly sacred and majestic.

"Gabriel just died. It's not entirely impossible for the Human Alliance to break through Leviathan," Dongfang Qingdi evaluated cautiously. "But the faith in Leviathan is extremely firm, tied to the water resources necessary for survival; everyone is a fanatic. Even if the Human Alliance wins, to station troops there securely would require a bloody massacre of the city. The strategic and political significance far outweighs any actual benefits the Human Alliance could gain."

The Divine Court was also mobilizing troops. On the desert, an endless line of marching soldiers was pouring into Leviathan.

Their equipment looked primitive: carts, horses, and cannons.

But Xiang Nanli adjusted the focus and scanned the ranks. They were all fully equipped Apocalypse Knights, their helmets sharp triangles, each one taller than a normal human. The carriages and guns transported with the army were all carved with mysterious runes.

Even more peculiar was the cargo this troop was transporting.

They were deep black coffins. The coffins were wrapped in heavy chains, and some had cracks from which viscous black blood dripped continuously.

As soon as the black blood dripped, the escorting Apocalypse Knights would dismount, carefully kneeling on the ground in a pious posture to collect the blood into specially made vials.

For such a massive army, their movement was eerily silent.

Xiang Nanli wanted to continue observing, but Dongfang Qingdi suddenly snatched the binoculars from his hands.

Xiang Nanli looked at him in confusion.

Dongfang Qingdi’s brows furrowed slightly: "The Divine Court’s commander-in-chief this time is Michael. He is very sensitive to being watched and can launch mental attacks. I just detected a strange frequency of sound waves."

Ahead lay Leviathan. Michael sat on a gorgeous palanquin, excitedly choosing which ornaments to wear today.

There were many choices for headpieces; he casually wound ribbons, seashells, and gemstones through his hair.

For earrings, he chose studs made from the ground-down skulls of Human Alliance battlefield commanders from a certain era.

Generally, Michael would only make one piece of jewelry from the same material. But out of respect, there were seven of these earrings.

Michael tilted his head, his golden hair falling to the ground, as he put on the earrings.

Suddenly, he looked up, glanced toward the distance, and then let out an ambiguous "Heh."

The Archangels of the Divine Court, regardless of what they actually were, were all beautiful. Gabriel was already as pretty as a doll, and Michael, as the Archangel, was less feminine but even more dazzling.

If you looked directly at his face, you might even feel like you were seeing a beam of holy light. Afterward, you couldn't remember his features, only the soul-shaking feeling.

Michael’s gaze was deep: "Which Human Alliance rat is peeking at me?"

Xiang Nanli had no choice but to put away the binoculars and let out a long sigh.

Both sides looked so formidable.

If a real fight broke out, the base located in the war zone would be like cannon fodder.

Xiang Nanli turned around and opened his arms to the Alpha: "Let's go, it's time to eat."

The Alpha was very cooperative, scooping him up by the waist and shielding Xiang Nanli's face with his hand; then, 3, 2, 1, jump.

Xiang Nanli felt like he was bungee jumping. The whistling wind roared in his ears. It was very stress-relieving.

Since things had come to this, let's eat first.

chunks.chineseText:
第156章 来客

贵族老爷们本来是很硬气的，说自己在姑苏城有人。但姑苏城都名存实亡，人联的法庭也管不到地表的据点。

葛根手起刀落，斩得特别痛快。

当天处决的奴隶主的血液染红了盐湖水。头被重盐腌制，放在了新市政厅的门口。以儆效尤。

相南里笑着把电子信件丢进了后台收藏夹：“如果以后基地沦陷，从历史上消失。我在这些掌握着话语权的人嘴里，大概会是穷凶极恶的强盗和土匪。”

事实上，在姑苏天灾后，基地的行事愈发激进。名义上再好听，也没能掩盖翻手间占领了好几个小据点的事实。

基地依靠四座大城，名义上的领土已经有一千多公里。尽管大多数都是无人荒区。但研究所的新成员，已经携带好新进口的设备，利用改造过的“工蜂号”，开始勘测、挖掘起这片广袤领土上的资源。

“首领”的利益、和他管辖的人民的利益，有时未必一致；甚至管理者就是最大的压迫者。可惜很多人看不懂这一点，也跟着惧怕起基地的入侵。

“但有什么关系呢，我小时候翻《道德经》，里面写‘受国之垢，是谓社稷主；受国不祥，是为天下王’，这句话我以前不懂，现在却是很赞成的。我的名声并不重要，只要基地能发展好。”

相南里今年50岁，看目前的科技树，大约还能活150年。

其中130年都可以是质量很高的青壮年。

但也许是前世七八十岁就算高龄的常识过于深入人心，相南里偶尔会思考自己死后，基地要怎么办。

他管不了身后事，只能在活着的时候努力。所以他努力积攒着资源，发展着科技，启迪着思想……多管齐下，想必不至于人亡政息。

更重要的是。

相南里突兀地从公务里抬起头，目光落在了对面人的脸上。

东方青帝在看书，也不知道是什么，神神秘秘的也不让相南里看。

他的大脑就是电脑，因此很喜欢一心多用。脑子里在处理工作（并且是不同组织的不同公务），身体还能挂机模式干点别的。智械和人毕竟是不同的。

察觉到他的视线，Alpha抬头，和相南里对视。

在几秒后，他询问：“有什么事吗？”

相南里摇头，忍不住笑：“想多看看你不行吗？”

更重要的是——

我死之后，你仍长存。

有些自私，甚至没有问过Alpha本人的意愿，但相南里知道，它会答应的。

没有比Alpha更好的继承者了。

唯一的问题是，基地成员里的“人类”占比高达百分之九十七，而东方青帝不算人类，属于类人生物。不过，基地打出的口号是“全体智慧生物共存”。

相南里说完，心情很好地继续处理工作。

只有东方青帝坐在原地，茫然地捏紧书，冷凝液循环一遍又一遍，脸上才不至于呈现出可疑的红色。

外交部门接连发来两条通知：[司令，您之前提到过的奥丁城难民说想见您。]

[一个叫玛门的可疑人物出示了黑十字审判庭的信物，他正在找您身边的警卫员黄枫。]

奥丁城？

这个据点的继承人叫艾伦·奥丁，白人，父亲在天灾中丧生，争家产时没有抢过自己叔叔，本尼·奥丁；只好带着亲信仓皇逃离。正好，相南里对奥丁发去邮件询问是否需要帮助。于是艾伦权衡再三后，拖家带口地投奔基地。

相南里愿意收留他，原本想的是让艾伦以“奥丁城继承人”的身份加入基地，然后奥丁城就可以成为基地“自古以来”领土的一部分。奥丁城不仅有丰富的矿产资源，还是几座大城市的交通枢纽。有很强的统战价值。

为了保证这支避难队伍不被奥丁城的特务暗杀，相南里还派去了一小支军队，半路就开始接洽。

可惜，人联在奥丁城附近建了军事基地，这让艾伦的重要性顿时下降好几个阶梯。

相南里再怎么异想天开，也不会现在就从人联嘴里抢肉吃。

不过，对方带来的电池专利，还是很有用的。

相南里把见面安排在半小时后。

第二条信息，倒是需要重点关注一下。

玛门？相南里扫了眼照片，不认识。但来自神庭。而且指名要见的人，居然是黄枫。

相南里沉思片刻，同样把人请到接待室，排号就在艾伦后面。

相南里的工作日益繁忙，会亲自接待的人愈发稀少，很多都丢给了福音书或者安德鲁。

会议接待室就在相南里办公室的隔壁。他理了理衣服领子，又调整一下电子镜片的位置，就算打扮过了。

相南里脸上扬起一个符合社会期待的微笑，大步走进接待室：“终于见面了，我的朋友。我一直都很担心你的安危。毕竟现在世道不怎么太平。”

艾伦表现的比相南里更热情：“很感谢您的收留，相司令。因为我叔叔的命令，我父亲的那些老朋友恨不得马上把我抓走换赏金。要知道我父亲活着的时候，可没少接济他们……”

艾伦有一头金色的卷毛，表情带着白人特有的夸张。这句话说得他眼角都浮现出泪光。

他上前一步，不轻不重地搂住了相南里的身体，并且很快放开。

不知道为什么，艾伦突然感觉到一股寒气。很冷。

相南里紧急给东方青帝顺毛：[小青！人家只是礼节性拥抱！别动手！]人死了不要紧，但是经常杀人的朋友都知道，杀人容易清洁难……

艾伦看向冷气的来源，见鬼，相南里背后有人。眼底有瞳环，克隆人？还是智械？他是和相南里一起进来的，但艾伦之前完全没注意到他，应该是信号屏蔽装置。

艾伦回忆起自己路上收集的资料，心想这大概就是东方青帝了。相南里身边的那位克隆人。

很少有人把克隆人设置的比自己高挑。毕竟克隆人还有一个心照不宣的用处，除非……

艾伦心神一动，目光很快回到相南里的身上，脸上的笑容愈发灿烂。

他完全没有在意东方青帝。

艾伦在黑市里买过克隆人，那是“古神生物”出品的高级克隆人。他的克隆人一样低调、沉默，身体柔软，草起来很舒服也不会坏。艾伦是它的主人。

人和克隆人的关系理应如此。

在艾伦逃出奥丁城的时候，克隆人为掩护他牺牲了。艾伦很是惋惜，暗中发誓等以后有钱了，会再克隆个相同外观的，用来纪念他。

在这个年代，有钱人买个克隆人放在身边，很正常。

宠物的地位只取决于它们的主人。

相南里保持了礼貌的笑容：“你来到基地，我们是很欢迎的。我让人带你去市政厅登记。你可以领一张基地的市民卡。至于你之前来信说的专利，也会有专人接洽。”

这张卡相当于基地内部的身份ID卡、银行卡等等。

芯片依旧只能人联进口，但芯片的识别程序，却是相南里自己写的。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 156: Visitors (Part 1)

The noble lords had originally been very tough, claiming they had connections in Gusu City. But Gusu City was now a name in name only, and the Human Alliance’s courts had no jurisdiction over surface outposts.

Ge Gen swung his blade with decisive force, executing them with great efficiency.

The blood of the slave owners executed that day stained the salt lake water red. Their heads were cured in heavy salt and placed at the entrance of the new City Hall as a warning to others.

Xiang Nanli smiled as he tossed the electronic letter into his archive folder: "If the base falls and disappears from history, in the mouths of those who hold the power of discourse, I will likely be remembered as a vicious robber and bandit."

In fact, after the Gusu disaster, the base’s actions had become increasingly aggressive. No matter how good the nominal justifications were, they couldn't hide the fact that they had seized several small outposts in the blink of an eye.

Relying on the four major cities, the base’s nominal territory already spanned over a thousand kilometers, even though most of it was uninhabited wasteland. However, new members of the research institute, equipped with newly imported gear and utilizing modified "Worker Bees," had begun surveying and excavating the resources across this vast territory.

The interests of the "Leader" and the interests of the people he governed were not always aligned; sometimes, the administrator was the greatest oppressor. Unfortunately, many people failed to see this and joined in the fear of the base's "invasion."

"But what does it matter? When I was a child, I flipped through the *Tao Te Ching*, which says, 'He who takes upon himself the humiliation of the country is called the lord of the land; he who takes upon himself the misfortunes of the country is the king of the world.' I didn't understand this before, but now I strongly agree with it. My reputation is not important, as long as the base can develop well."

Xiang Nanli was 50 years old this year. Looking at the current tech tree, he could likely live for another 150 years.

Of those, 130 years could be high-quality, prime years.

But perhaps because the common knowledge from his previous life—that 70 or 80 was considered old age—was so deeply ingrained, Xiang Nanli occasionally wondered what would happen to the base after he died.

He couldn't manage things after he was gone, so he could only strive while he was alive. Thus, he worked hard to accumulate resources, develop technology, and enlighten minds... by tackling things from multiple angles, surely the government wouldn't collapse just because the man died.

More importantly.

Xiang Nanli abruptly looked up from his official duties, his gaze landing on the face of the person across from him.

Dongfang Qingdi was reading a book, though he didn't know what it was; he was being secretive and wouldn't let Xiang Nanli see.

His brain was a computer, so he liked multitasking. He could process work in his mind (even different official duties for different organizations) while his body could do other things in "idle mode." After all, an Android and a human were different.

Noticing his gaze, the Alpha looked up and met Xiang Nanli's eyes.

After a few seconds, he asked: "Is there something?"

Xiang Nanli shook his head, unable to help but smile: "Can't I just look at you more?"

More importantly—

After I die, you will still endure.

It was a bit selfish, and he hadn't even asked the Alpha for his own wishes, but Xiang Nanli knew he would agree.

There was no better successor than the Alpha.

The only problem was that "humans" made up 97% of the base's members, and Dongfang Qingdi was not human; he was a humanoid. However, the base’s slogan was "Coexistence of All Intelligent Beings."

After Xiang Nanli finished speaking, he felt in a good mood and continued his work.

Only Dongfang Qingdi sat there, blankly gripping the book, his coolant circulating over and over so that his face wouldn't show a suspicious shade of red.

The diplomatic department sent two consecutive notifications: [Commander, the refugees from Odin City you mentioned earlier say they want to see you.]

[A suspicious person named Mammon has presented a token from the Black Cross Inquisition; he is looking for Huang Feng, the guard by your side.]

Odin City?

The heir to that outpost was named Allen Odin, a white man. His father had died in the disaster, and he had lost the inheritance struggle to his uncle, Benny Odin; he had no choice but to flee in a panic with his loyalists. It just so happened that Xiang Nanli had sent an email to Odin asking if they needed help. So, after much deliberation, Allen had brought his family and followers to defect to the base.

Xiang Nanli was willing to take him in, originally thinking that letting Allen join the base as the "Heir of Odin City" would allow Odin City to become part of the base’s "territory since ancient times." Odin City not only had rich mineral resources but was also a transportation hub for several major cities. It had great strategic value.

To ensure this refugee group wasn't assassinated by Odin City's secret agents, Xiang Nanli had even sent a small military detachment to meet them halfway.

Unfortunately, the Human Alliance had built a military base near Odin City, which instantly lowered Allen's importance by several tiers.

No matter how whimsical Xiang Nanli was, he wouldn't snatch meat from the Human Alliance's mouth right now.

However, the battery patent the other party brought was still quite useful.

Xiang Nanli scheduled the meeting for half an hour later.

The second piece of information, however, required special attention.

Mammon? Xiang Nanli scanned the photo; he didn't recognize him. But he was from the Divine Court. And the person he specifically asked to see was actually Huang Feng.

Xiang Nanli pondered for a moment and invited the person to the reception room as well, placing him in the queue right after Allen.

Xiang Nanli’s work was becoming increasingly busy, and he personally received fewer and fewer people, leaving most to the Gospel or Andrew.

The conference reception room was right next to Xiang Nanli’s office. He straightened his collar and adjusted his electronic lenses; that counted as dressing up.

A smile that met social expectations appeared on Xiang Nanli’s face as he strode into the reception room: "We finally meet, my friend. I have been very worried about your safety. After all, the world is not very peaceful these days."

Allen appeared even more enthusiastic than Xiang Nanli: "I am very grateful for your shelter, Commander Xiang. Because of my uncle's orders, my father's old friends were eager to capture me for the bounty. You know, when my father was alive, he helped them out quite a bit..."

Allen had curly golden hair, and his expression carried the characteristic exaggeration of a white man. As he spoke, tears welled up in the corners of his eyes.

He took a step forward and gave Xiang Nanli a light, polite hug before quickly letting go.

For some reason, Allen suddenly felt a chill. Very cold.

Xiang Nanli urgently smoothed Dongfang Qingdi’s feathers: [Xiao Qing! He’s just giving a ceremonial hug! Don't do anything!] It didn't matter if people died, but any friend who killed often knew that killing was easy, but cleaning up was hard...

Allen looked toward the source of the cold air. Hell, there was someone behind Xiang Nanli. Pupil rings in his eyes—a clone? Or an Android? He had walked in with Xiang Nanli, but Allen hadn't noticed him at all; it must have been a signal-shielding device.

Allen recalled the information he had gathered on the road and thought this must be Dongfang Qingdi. The clone by Xiang Nanli's side.

Few people set their clones to be taller than themselves. After all, clones had an unspoken use, unless...

Allen’s heart stirred, and his gaze quickly returned to Xiang Nanli, the smile on his face becoming even brighter.

He didn't pay any attention to Dongfang Qingdi at all.

Allen had bought clones on the black market; those were high-end clones produced by "Ancient God Bio." His clone was also low-key, silent, with a soft body, and it felt good to fuck without breaking. Allen was its master.

The relationship between a human and a clone should be like that.

When Allen escaped Odin City, his clone had sacrificed itself to cover him. Allen had felt quite regretful and secretly vowed that when he had money, he would clone another one with the same appearance to commemorate him.

In this era, it was normal for rich people to keep a clone by their side.

The status of a pet depended entirely on its owner.

Xiang Nanli maintained a polite smile: "We are very happy that you have come to the base. I will have someone take you to City Hall to register. You can get a base citizen card. As for the patent you mentioned in your letter, someone will also handle that."

This card was equivalent to an internal ID card, bank card, and so on for the base.

The chips could still only be imported from the Human Alliance, but the identification program for the chips was written by Xiang Nanli himself.

chunks.chineseText:
艾伦上前一步：“恕我冒昧。相司令，我听说您还没有婚配。不知道您有没有考虑过和奥丁城联姻呢？”

艾伦说着，就想要握住他的手，相南里下意识地避开：“……嗯？”

艾伦：“奥丁城在地表建立三百余年。从我曾祖父那一辈传到我父亲手中。奥丁城地大物博，历史悠久，靠着出产‘能源电池’，每年都有数千万信用点的贸易顺差。

“尽管我那该死的叔叔以不正当的手段夺走本该属于我的王位。但我还是毫无争议的第一顺位继承人。如果您愿意和我结婚，等我收回奥丁城，基地和奥丁城强强联合，绝对会是方圆三千里内最强大的地表城市！

“而且子嗣问题也不需要担心，同性生子和体外孵化技术早已成熟。从人联那里购买相关物品只需要三百万信用点……”

艾伦越说越兴奋。

相南里为什么会带个东方青帝这样的克隆人在身边？答案只有一个：相南里喜欢当0。

刚好，他艾伦是1。他们没有撞号。

从荒区一路来到城市，基地的富庶有目共睹。

和相南里结婚，就能借用基地的力量打回奥丁城。

艾伦觉得，相南里是不会拒绝的。

毕竟奥丁城是真富。

他是原本的继承人，占领奥丁城属于师出有名。其他势力没理由干涉。

嗯，虽然多半是基地吞并奥丁城，但是有什么关系？

他如果是相南里的丈夫，那同样会是基地的半个主人。

艾伦赢麻了。

虽然相南里的长相，不是艾伦欣赏的那款——相南里的眉眼过于英气，不够柔媚。但毫无疑问，这位司令长得不差，甚至可以说是赏心悦目，在床上应该别有一番风味。

艾伦并没有想过自己会被拒绝。他的人生本就顺风顺水，因为父亲的溺爱，在地表也过的不差。艾伦总是把自己的生活，和那些财阀的继承人暗中比较。认为自己其实没差多少。

总之，这波操作，他可以赢两次！

说着说着，艾伦觉得房间里的温度直线下降。

艾伦甚至感觉到东方青帝身上传来一股针对他的杀气，只是很快就消失了，仿佛是他的错觉。

艾伦意有所指地开口：“您应该教他规矩。克隆人再怎么受宠，也不该越过主人行事。”

相南里微微挑起眉：“嗯……嗯，您说的对。”

相南里原本觉得，尽管“占领奥丁城”的计划因为人联建造的军事基地破产，但收留一下奥丁城的落难贵族，也不算什么大事，指不定以后还能用上。

但相南里查了一下现任城主给出的悬赏——寻人启事上写着，他哥哥唯一的儿子艾伦在灾难中失踪了，只要有人把艾伦送回来（无论死活），就能获得奥丁城永远的友谊和500万信用点的报酬。

艾伦还从奥丁城带来了一百多名亲信，大部人都住在招待所。还有两名在市政大厅等候着。

问题不大，很容易控制。

相南里拍了拍他的肩膀：“联姻的事我得考虑一下，让我的克隆人先带您参观一下基地吧。”

要不是相南里拦着，东方青帝早就动手了。

想必，“他会好好招待您的。”，在地牢。先逼供，把专利问出来，然后人头送回奥丁城拿悬赏。

这种脏活不方便其他人经手，行事不够光明磊落。所以通常是小青去做。

相南里脸上的笑容变得神秘起来。

艾伦心里有种不太好的预感，这种预感曾经救过他很多次。但那该死的克隆人已经来到他身边，态度十分强硬：“请跟我走吧，贵宾。”

艾伦还想挣扎，可惜拒绝的话还没来得及说出口，一股强劲的电流贯穿他的天灵盖。

他的眼神变得呆滞，痴痴傻傻地行动起来，像僵尸一样，亦步亦趋地跟在东方青帝身后。

相南里唇一张一合，无声息地吩咐着：[早点回来。]

Alpha微微点头，随后关上接待室大门。

几分钟后，另一位客人玛门，在秘书的带领下，来到会议室内。

玛门身穿黑袍，暗红色的长卷发有些毛糙。肤色苍白，看上去二三十岁，人很瘦削。

他手持一根木杖，在见到相南里后，微微点头，在胸口划了个倒三角，这是神庭的礼节，算是行礼。

“我是加百列圣上的眷属，您可以理解为地位高一点的随从。”玛门的声音很沙哑，“我奉圣上的遗诏，前来寻找贵地一台叫黄枫的智械人。我听说它在基地里任职。我有它的智械生产编号。”

玛门看起来一身病气，时不时捂着嘴，咳嗽一两声。像痨鬼。

这也是没办法的事。眷属的力量来源于他们的主人。

加百列去世，他们这些寄生虫本该一起死去。

相南里谨慎地回答：“黄枫是在这里没错。但我想问问，你找它是想要干什么？加百列留下了什么吩咐……不知道基地能不能帮上忙？加百列曾经无私地帮助过基地，是基地永远的朋友。”

“是吗？”玛门脸上露出嘲讽的笑容，很淡，“倒也无需帮忙。加百列给那台智械留下了一些遗产。”

他从怀里拿出一沓厚厚的赎罪券。

“十亿。”玛门说，“这是我变卖圣上十分之一遗产后得到的数额。如果不是着急卖，应该会更多一些。数额太大，因此拿来的是神庭的支票……我想要亲手把它交给黄枫。这是圣上的遗诏。”

……多少？

相南里原本有些走神的思维瞬间凝练起来。

“十亿。神庭的实体货币分金券、银券、铜券。”玛门面无表情地重复着，“这张支票的面值是10亿铜券，可以在神庭名下的任何一所银行兑换。”

在黑市上，20到25铁券，可以兑换1人联信用点。

但有趣的是，1信用点想要换成铁券，只能随着市场波动，换到8到12张币值为1的赎罪券。

——人联和神庭关系紧张，双方的金融机构没有开设外币兑换渠道。于是让中间商赚足了差价。

这张支票在地表，有1亿信用点的购买力。

黄枫收到通知，很快赶来。

在核对过智械的生产编号后，玛门很干脆的交出支票。

黄枫摸了摸这张支票，试图从上面找出加百列的痕迹。可惜只有烫手的神纹。

黄枫安装过拟人模块。只是，这种出场自带的安装程序，并不足以让它了解“情绪”这一复杂的课题。

直到今天。

它感到过去这么多天里，它一直描述不出来的东西。

这或许就是“哀伤”。

它当着玛门的面，把支票递给相南里：“给你。”

黄枫问加百列要赎金，只是想要完成Alpha的任务。

虽然过程有些曲折，但结局竟然是Good End.

相南里看着手里这张金光闪闪的支票：“这不太好吧。”

虽然他已经默认了黄枫的财产=东方青帝的财产=基地的财产！但是玛门还在呢！

玛门咳嗽着：“没关系。支票我已经送达，黄枫怎么处置都行。如果没有别的问题，我就……”
chunks.englishText:
Alan stepped forward. "Forgive my presumption. Commander Xiang, I hear you are not yet married. Have you ever considered a political marriage with Odin City?"

As Alan spoke, he reached out to take Xiang Nanli’s hand, but Xiang Nanli instinctively recoiled. "...Hm?"

Alan continued, "Odin City has been established on the surface for over three hundred years. It passed from my great-grandfather down to my father. Odin City is vast and rich in resources, with a long history. By producing 'energy batteries,' we maintain a trade surplus of tens of millions of credits every year.

"Although my damned uncle used illicit means to seize the throne that should have been mine, I remain the undisputed first heir. If you are willing to marry me, once I reclaim Odin City, the union of the Base and Odin City will undoubtedly become the most powerful surface city within a three-thousand-mile radius!

"Furthermore, there is no need to worry about heirs; same-sex reproduction and artificial incubation technologies are already mature. Purchasing the relevant supplies from the Human Alliance costs only three million credits..."

Alan grew more excited as he spoke.

Why would Xiang Nanli keep a clone like Dongfang Qingdi by his side? There was only one answer: Xiang Nanli liked to be the bottom.

As it happened, he, Alan, was a top. They were a perfect match.

Having traveled all the way from the Wasteland to the city, the prosperity of the Base was plain for all to see.

Marrying Xiang Nanli would allow him to borrow the Base's power to take back Odin City.

Alan felt that Xiang Nanli would not refuse.

After all, Odin City was truly wealthy.

He was the original heir; occupying Odin City would be a righteous cause. Other factions would have no reason to interfere.

Well, although it would likely result in the Base annexing Odin City, what did that matter?

If he were Xiang Nanli’s husband, he would effectively be half-owner of the Base as well.

Alan felt he had already won.

Although Xiang Nanli’s appearance wasn't exactly Alan’s type—Xiang Nanli’s features were too heroic and lacked a certain delicate charm—there was no doubt the Commander was attractive, even pleasing to the eye. He would likely be quite a treat in bed.

Alan never imagined he would be rejected. His life had always been smooth sailing; thanks to his father’s doting, he had lived quite well on the surface. Alan always compared his life to those of the heirs of the great conglomerates, believing he was no different from them.

In short, with this move, he could win twice over!

As he spoke, Alan felt the temperature in the room drop sharply.

He even felt a murderous aura emanating from Dongfang Qingdi directed at him, though it vanished as quickly as it appeared, as if it were merely a hallucination.

Alan hinted pointedly, "You really should teach him some manners. No matter how favored a clone is, they shouldn't overstep their master."

Xiang Nanli raised an eyebrow slightly. "Mm... yes, you're right."

Xiang Nanli had originally thought that although the plan to "occupy Odin City" had gone bankrupt due to the military base built by the Human Alliance, taking in a few destitute nobles from Odin City wasn't a big deal—they might even be useful later.

But Xiang Nanli had checked the bounty posted by the current City Lord—the missing person notice stated that his brother’s only son, Alan, had gone missing during the disaster. Whoever returned Alan (dead or alive) would receive the eternal friendship of Odin City and a reward of 5 million credits.

Alan had also brought over a hundred confidants from Odin City, most of whom were staying at the guesthouse. Two were waiting in the municipal hall.

Not a big problem; easy to control.

Xiang Nanli patted his shoulder. "I’ll have to consider the marriage proposal. Let my clone take you on a tour of the Base first."

If Xiang Nanli hadn't stopped him, Dongfang Qingdi would have already acted.

Presumably, "He will treat you well," in the dungeon. First, force a confession to get the patents, then send the head back to Odin City to collect the bounty.

Such dirty work wasn't convenient for others to handle; it wasn't exactly "above board." So, it was usually left to Xiao Qing.

A mysterious smile appeared on Xiang Nanli’s face.

Alan had a bad premonition, one that had saved him many times before. But that damned clone was already at his side, his attitude extremely firm: "Please come with me, honored guest."

Alan tried to struggle, but before he could even voice a refusal, a powerful electric current surged through his crown.

His eyes went dull, and he began to move in a daze, following behind Dongfang Qingdi like a zombie.

Xiang Nanli’s lips moved silently, giving an order: [Come back early.]

The Alpha nodded slightly, then closed the door to the reception room.

A few minutes later, another guest, Mammon, was led into the conference room by the secretary.

Mammon wore a black robe, his dark red long curly hair somewhat disheveled. His skin was pale, and he looked to be in his twenties or thirties, very thin.

He held a wooden staff. Upon seeing Xiang Nanli, he nodded slightly and traced an inverted triangle on his chest—the etiquette of the Divine Court, a sign of respect.

"I am a retainer of His Holiness Gabriel; you may consider me a high-ranking attendant," Mammon’s voice was raspy. "I have come under the late Holiness’s last will to find a mechanical being in your territory named Huang Feng. I heard it is employed at the Base. I have its mechanical production serial number."

Mammon looked sickly, covering his mouth to cough every now and then. Like a consumptive ghost.

There was no help for it. The power of a retainer came from their master.

With Gabriel dead, these parasites were supposed to die with him.

Xiang Nanli answered cautiously, "Huang Feng is indeed here. But I must ask, what do you want with it? What instructions did Gabriel leave... I wonder if the Base can be of any help? Gabriel once helped the Base selflessly; he is a friend of the Base forever."

"Is that so?" A mocking smile appeared on Mammon’s face, very faint. "There is no need for help. Gabriel left some inheritance for that machine."

He took a thick stack of indulgence vouchers from his robes.

"One billion," Mammon said. "This is the amount I obtained after selling one-tenth of His Holiness’s estate. If I hadn't been in such a hurry to sell, it should have been more. The amount is too large, so I brought Divine Court checks... I want to hand it to Huang Feng personally. This is His Holiness’s last will."

...How much?

Xiang Nanli’s wandering thoughts instantly sharpened.

"One billion. The Divine Court’s physical currency is divided into gold vouchers, silver vouchers, and copper vouchers," Mammon repeated expressionlessly. "The face value of this check is 1 billion copper vouchers, which can be exchanged at any bank under the Divine Court’s name."

On the black market, 20 to 25 iron vouchers could be exchanged for 1 Human Alliance credit.

But interestingly, if one wanted to exchange 1 credit for iron vouchers, one could only get 8 to 12 vouchers of face value 1, depending on market fluctuations.

—The Human Alliance and the Divine Court had tense relations, and neither side’s financial institutions had opened foreign currency exchange channels. Thus, middlemen made a killing on the spread.

This check had the purchasing power of 100 million credits on the surface.

Huang Feng received the notification and arrived quickly.

After verifying the mechanical production number, Mammon handed over the check quite readily.

Huang Feng touched the check, trying to find traces of Gabriel on it. Unfortunately, there were only scorching divine runes.

Huang Feng had installed an anthropomorphic module. However, this factory-installed program was not enough for it to understand the complex subject of "emotion."

Until today.

It felt something it had been unable to describe for so many days.

Perhaps this was "grief."

In front of Mammon, it handed the check to Xiang Nanli: "For you."

Huang Feng had asked Gabriel for the ransom simply to complete the Alpha’s task.

Although the process had some twists and turns, the ending was surprisingly a Good End.

Xiang Nanli looked at the shimmering gold check in his hand: "This doesn't seem right."

Although he had already defaulted to the logic that Huang Feng’s property = Dongfang Qingdi’s property = the Base’s property! But Mammon was still here!

Mammon coughed: "It doesn't matter. I have delivered the check; Huang Feng can do whatever it likes with it. If there are no other questions, I will..."

chunks.chineseText:
玛门本来想说“告退”的。

可是，他突然意识到，自己似乎无处可去。

加百列留下的另一个遗愿，就是让作为眷属的玛门摆脱契约的限制，继续存活下去。

这件事也不难，只要把玛门从加百列的眷属，变成其他大天使的眷属就行。

米迦勒负责了这项改造，但他对使用二手眷属不感兴趣。

因此，玛门得到了宝贵的“自由”。

他要回神庭吗？回到利维坦，像虔诚的信徒那样，为神庭奉献出自己的一切，最后躺在冰冷的棺材里，在神甫的祷告声中寿终正寝。

可加百列活着的时候，那么不喜欢呆在利维坦。他有什么理由回去呢？

永恒市广场的纪念碑上个月就改造好了。

上面不仅多了战役里牺牲的士兵名字，还增添了新的机械装置，安装在纪念碑上方。

新增的机械装置是一副巨大的金属羽翼。一天有24小时，机械的天使翅膀内置感光设备，可以随着室外光线的变化张开又合上。

在见相南里之前，玛门在这副大小夸张的羽翼下站了很久很久。

玛门面色枯槁，有些呆滞地擦着唇角流出的血。

他的唇颤动着，声音很小，很哀伤：“那就让我留在基地吧。这里的空气还残留着圣上的气息。我想留在他拼死也要守护的地方。”
chunks.englishText:
Mammon had intended to say "take my leave."

However, he suddenly realized that he had nowhere to go.

Another of Gabriel’s final wishes was for Mammon, as a retainer, to be freed from the constraints of the contract and continue to survive.

This was not difficult; it only required changing Mammon from Gabriel’s retainer to that of another Archangel.

Michael was responsible for this modification, but he had no interest in using second-hand retainers.

Thus, Mammon had obtained precious "freedom."

Should he return to the Divine Court? Return to Leviathan, and like a devout believer, dedicate everything he had to the Divine Court, finally lying in a cold coffin to pass away peacefully amidst the prayers of priests.

But when Gabriel was alive, he disliked staying in Leviathan so much. What reason did he have to go back?

The monument in the Eternal City square had been renovated last month.

Not only were the names of the soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the battle added, but a new mechanical device had been installed above the monument.

The new device was a pair of giant metal wings. There were 24 hours in a day, and the mechanical angel wings had built-in light-sensitive equipment, allowing them to open and close with the changes in outdoor light.

Before meeting Xiang Nanli, Mammon had stood under these exaggeratedly large wings for a long, long time.

Mammon’s face was withered, and he wiped the blood flowing from the corner of his lips in a daze.

His lips trembled, and his voice was very soft, very sorrowful: "Then let me stay at the Base. The air here still carries the scent of His Holiness. I want to remain in the place he died to protect."

chunks.chineseText:
第157章 神术

姓名，玛门。性别：男；年龄：197岁；种族：……

在“人类”“智械”和“类人生物”里，玛门沉思再三，选定最后一个。

随后，他的嘴角微微牵动，像嘲讽。

他们这样的怪物，既不是人，也不是智械。在地表的角落，居然还能有个分类容身。

这就是你的理由吗？加百列。

基地一直在建宿舍，空房子多的是。

但相南里还是挤了挤，把玛门的住处，安排在易横行的隔壁。

易横行极其讨厌神庭的圣职者，仅次于智械。

这个安排看似不合理，但相南里认为，消除偏见的最好办法，是接触。

只有让不同阵营的成员不停地碰撞、交流，双方才会明白，原来我们都是一样的人。

除却阴谋家、极端分子等少数派；人和人本该是同伴，不该被立场切割成南北两极。

和艾伦那种低质外来人口不同，相南里明显对玛门要重视得多。

相南里预估着时间，处理完公务，很有心机地在市政厅门口恰好遇到刚登记完的玛门。

“正好。带你认认路？我们家在同一条街上。”

玛门没有拒绝。

傍晚，下班放学的高峰期。

街上人来人往。市政厅门口有不少小贩在摆摊，很热闹。

基地消化10万难民，逐步放开对商业的管控。原本的商铺根本不够用，又来不及新建，市政厅前面的大广场，在夜里就成为城市里的另一处CBD。

这些摊位都办过营业执照，卖的货物也事先进行过登记。目前，烟草、药物、酒，这三类物品，只能在基地开设的商场里购买。

为了鼓励商业，市政厅没有收摊位费，而是选择实行“累进税率”。

市政厅给这些摊主发放统一的“读卡器”，买卖双方只能用基地的电子货币进行交易。每月前500积分不收费，从501积分开始收取百分之五的营业税。税率根据营业额动态调整，最高百分之三十五。

玛门停在卖烤饼的摊位前，目光有些好奇。

相南里拿出自己编号为1的ID卡，在打卡器上划了一下。读卡器显示扣除“2积分”，账户余额13171。

相南里，基地总司令、基地军事委员会主席、研究所所长，另外还有一堆兼职。月薪3000。

他没有别的收入，好在也没有其他开销。衣食住行都有保障，不花钱。

倒是市政厅的公务员，工作一两年，工资根据城内消费水平，上调过好几次。

玛门接过热腾腾的饼，说了声“谢谢”。

在登记后，他也领到一张集身份认证、银行卡、定位器多重功能为一体的ID卡。编号是“412517”，但他的卡上没钱。

“基地的钱庄可以兑换外币。”相南里看出玛门的烦恼，开口，“信用点和积分1：1兑换，赎罪券和积分10：1。另外，你也可以选择在基地找个工作。”

10赎罪券兑换1积分吗？玛门暗中比较不同货币的购买力，觉得基地有点黑。

这种小零嘴在利维坦只需要8券。

货币本质是一般等价物。是否有购买力依托于发行机构的信用。

幸存者基地，作为一个只有四十多万人的据点来说，还是太年轻了。

甚至，如果不是相南里上辈子就研究过电子币，基地压根就没能力铸币。

人联的信用点和神庭的赎罪券，才是人类社会如今的硬通货。

这种经济上的霸权，也让地表的其他据点无论发展到什么阶段，最后只能被迫选择其中一方依附。

玛门是一个精打细算的眷属，当然，最主要的还是他手里的赎罪券不多。

他问：“那基地可以提供什么工作？”

在相南里问起有他有什么谋生技能时，玛门没有过多思索地回答：“凡语，还有神庭的神术。《神史》和《神祭》我也较为精通。”后面两本书都是神庭的历史。

凡语，神庭的官方语言。相南里曾经在线上商店搜过，也许是他权限不够，商店里没有对应的技能书。但安装人联的内置AI后，AI会在用户需要时，提供翻译功能。

语言是文化中很重要的一环。说什么样的话，基本就代表你是什么样的人。

相南里没打算把凡语加入基地的教程中。

不过，神庭毕竟是仅次于人联的势力。

相南里笑眯眯地说着：“基地打算和研究所合作，办一所大学。位置在主城区。到时候会开设凡语的选修课，你可以去应聘。在此之前，我想雇你当我的私人教师。”

玛门的大半张脸依旧被斗篷遮挡着：“您是想学凡语吗？”

“不，”相南里微微摇头，“凡语我会，我想学神术。我想聘请你当我的家庭教师。我愿意支付每月15000的工资。”

他想了想，补充：“也可以选择用赎罪券支付。”毕竟玛门看起来对基地的电子货币不怎么感兴趣。

基地的外汇还是有一些的。而且刚从黄枫那里领到了10亿呢！

神术到底是个什么东西，相南里一直都很好奇。总不能世界上真的存在魔法吧？

玛门许久没有开口。

相南里打量着他的表情：“要是为难，你也可以拒绝我。没关系的。”

玛门：“并非我想推诿。大人。神术是神的恩典，神术的学习需要‘启灵’。启灵后，人类才能聆听神的呓语，借用神的力量。”

相南里和玛门一边往回走，一边闲聊。

他的眉头微微蹙起，心想，如果非要用自己认知中的科学解释，这个“启灵”是否算一种来自神庭的“官方正版授权”？只有得到授权后，才能使用神庭生产的软件和硬件。

那不对劲吧。他也没有进行过什么“启灵”啊，怎么就能用神庭的生物机甲？

相南里：“那不是更好吗。我没有启灵过，你也不用担心我滥用。我只是对你们超自然的力量体系有些好奇。”

玛门的表情有些许的迷茫：“嗯，我也不知道怎么形容……就是启灵之后，一些神术会自然而然的浮现在脑海里。我们的学习过程就是在暗室中面壁，然后等神降下恩典。神术更像是一把钥匙；需要和神药、神术装置结合使用。”

玛门随手别下路边一条小树枝，用树枝在虚空中画出一个“Z”字。

“比如，这个就是神庭最简单的‘躯体强化’神术。只要在脑海里把意识的光点像这样运行，就能触发。但是在我们的脑海里，这个‘Z’其实不是平面图像，而是有空间的运转轨迹……”

3D图像密码？

相南里下意识地在脑海里回忆着玛门划出的路径。

他的掌心开始发烫。下一秒，不可思议的事情发生了。

相南里的胳膊上长出一片深色的鳞片，摸上去硬邦邦的，质感异常冰冷。像金属。

“这是躯体强化神术？”相南里的眼神充满询问。

玛门平静的脸上掀起惊涛骇浪：“是，但是怎么可能？！你明明不是信徒。”

相南里身上的鳞片只维持了十几秒。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 157: Divine Arts

Name: Mammon. Gender: Male; Age: 197; Race: ...

Among "Human," "Mechanical Being," and "Humanoid," Mammon pondered for a long time before selecting the last one.

Then, the corners of his mouth twitched, as if in mockery.

Monsters like them were neither human nor machine. In a corner of the surface, they could actually find a category to fit into.

Is this your reason, Gabriel?

The Base was constantly building dormitories, and there were plenty of empty rooms.

But Xiang Nanli still squeezed things around and arranged Mammon’s living quarters next to Yi Hengxing’s.

Yi Hengxing detested the clergy of the Divine Court, second only to mechanical beings.

This arrangement seemed unreasonable, but Xiang Nanli believed that the best way to eliminate prejudice was through contact.

Only by having members of different factions constantly collide and communicate would both sides realize that, in the end, we are all the same people.

Excluding conspirators, extremists, and other minorities, people should be companions; they should not be cut into north and south poles by their stances.

Unlike the low-quality foreign population like Alan, Xiang Nanli clearly attached much more importance to Mammon.

Xiang Nanli estimated the time, finished his official duties, and quite calculatingly happened to run into Mammon, who had just finished registering, at the entrance of the Municipal Hall.

"Just in time. Shall I show you the way? We live on the same street."

Mammon did not refuse.

It was evening, the peak time for people getting off work and school.

The streets were bustling with people. There were many vendors setting up stalls at the entrance of the Municipal Hall, making it very lively.

The Base had absorbed 100,000 refugees and was gradually relaxing its control over commerce. The original shops were simply not enough, and there was no time to build new ones, so the large square in front of the Municipal Hall became another CBD of the city at night.

These stalls had all obtained business licenses, and the goods sold had been registered in advance. Currently, tobacco, medicine, and alcohol—these three categories of items—could only be purchased in malls opened by the Base.

To encourage commerce, the Municipal Hall did not charge stall fees but chose to implement a "progressive tax rate."

The Municipal Hall issued uniform "card readers" to these stall owners, and both buyers and sellers could only trade using the Base's electronic currency. The first 500 points per month were free of charge, and a 5% business tax was levied starting from 501 points. The tax rate was dynamically adjusted based on turnover, with a maximum of 35%.

Mammon stopped in front of a stall selling roasted flatbread, his gaze curious.

Xiang Nanli took out his ID card, numbered 1, and swiped it on the card reader. The reader showed a deduction of "2 points," with an account balance of 13,171.

Xiang Nanli, Commander-in-Chief of the Base, Chairman of the Base Military Commission, Director of the Research Institute, and a bunch of other part-time jobs. Monthly salary: 3,000.

He had no other income, but fortunately, he had no other expenses. Food, clothing, housing, and transportation were all guaranteed; he didn't spend money.

On the other hand, the civil servants of the Municipal Hall had seen their salaries raised several times over the past year or two, based on the consumption level in the city.

Mammon took the hot flatbread and said, "Thank you."

After registering, he had also received an ID card that integrated identity authentication, a bank card, and a locator. The number was "412517," but there was no money on his card.

"The Base’s bank can exchange foreign currency," Xiang Nanli saw Mammon’s trouble and spoke up. "Credits and points are exchanged at 1:1, and indulgence vouchers and points at 10:1. Additionally, you can choose to find a job in the Base."

10 indulgence vouchers for 1 point? Mammon secretly compared the purchasing power of different currencies and felt the Base was a bit of a rip-off.

Such small snacks only cost 8 vouchers in Leviathan.

Currency is essentially a general equivalent. Whether it has purchasing power depends on the credit of the issuing institution.

The Survivor Base, as a stronghold with only over 400,000 people, was still too young.

In fact, if Xiang Nanli hadn't studied electronic currency in his previous life, the Base would have had no ability to mint currency at all.

The Human Alliance’s credits and the Divine Court’s indulgence vouchers were the hard currency of human society today.

This economic hegemony also meant that no matter what stage other strongholds on the surface developed to, they were eventually forced to choose to attach themselves to one side or the other.

Mammon was a calculating retainer; of course, the main thing was that he didn't have many indulgence vouchers in his hands.

He asked, "Then what kind of work can the Base provide?"

When Xiang Nanli asked what skills he had to make a living, Mammon replied without much thought: "Common Tongue, as well as the Divine Arts of the Divine Court. I am also quite proficient in 'Divine History' and 'Divine Rituals'." Both of the latter books were histories of the Divine Court.

Common Tongue, the official language of the Divine Court. Xiang Nanli had searched for it in the online store before; perhaps his authority was not high enough, as there were no corresponding skill books in the store. But after installing the Human Alliance’s built-in AI, the AI would provide translation functions when the user needed them.

Language is a very important part of culture. What kind of language you speak basically represents what kind of person you are.

Xiang Nanli had no intention of adding Common Tongue to the Base’s curriculum.

However, the Divine Court was, after all, the second-largest power after the Human Alliance.

Xiang Nanli said with a smile, "The Base plans to cooperate with the Research Institute to establish a university. The location will be in the main urban area. At that time, we will offer elective courses in Common Tongue, and you can apply for a position. Before that, I would like to hire you as my private tutor."

Most of Mammon’s face remained hidden by his cloak: "Are you looking to learn Common Tongue?"

"No," Xiang Nanli shook his head slightly. "I know Common Tongue. I want to learn Divine Arts. I would like to hire you as my private tutor. I am willing to pay a monthly salary of 15,000."

He thought for a moment and added, "You can also choose to be paid in indulgence vouchers." After all, Mammon didn't seem very interested in the Base’s electronic currency.

The Base did have some foreign exchange. And he had just received 1 billion from Huang Feng!

Xiang Nanli had always been curious about what exactly Divine Arts were. It couldn't be that magic actually existed in the world, could it?

Mammon did not speak for a long time.

Xiang Nanli studied his expression: "If it’s difficult for you, you can refuse me. It doesn't matter."

Mammon: "It is not that I wish to shirk, my lord. Divine Arts are the grace of the gods; the study of Divine Arts requires 'Enlightenment.' Only after Enlightenment can humans listen to the whispers of the gods and borrow the power of the gods."

Xiang Nanli and Mammon chatted while walking back.

His brow furrowed slightly, thinking that if he had to explain it with the science he understood, would this "Enlightenment" count as a kind of "official authorized license" from the Divine Court? Only after receiving authorization could one use the software and hardware produced by the Divine Court.

That didn't seem right. He hadn't undergone any "Enlightenment," so how could he use the Divine Court’s biological mecha?

Xiang Nanli: "Isn't that even better? I haven't been Enlightened, so you don't have to worry about me abusing it. I’m just curious about your supernatural power system."

Mammon’s expression was slightly confused: "Mm, I don't know how to describe it... It’s just that after Enlightenment, some Divine Arts naturally surface in the mind. Our learning process is to face the wall in a dark room and wait for the gods to bestow grace. Divine Arts are more like a key; they need to be combined with divine medicine and divine art devices."

Mammon casually plucked a small twig from the roadside and drew a "Z" in the void with it.

"For example, this is the simplest 'Body Strengthening' Divine Art of the Divine Court. As long as you run the light point of consciousness in your mind like this, you can trigger it. But in our minds, this 'Z' is not actually a flat image, but has a spatial trajectory of operation..."

3D image password?

Xiang Nanli instinctively recalled the path Mammon had drawn in his mind.

His palm began to burn. The next second, something incredible happened.

A dark scale grew on Xiang Nanli’s arm, feeling hard and cold to the touch. Like metal.

"Is this the Body Strengthening Divine Art?" Xiang Nanli’s eyes were full of inquiry.

A stormy sea surged on Mammon’s calm face: "Yes, but how is that possible?! You are clearly not a believer."

The scales on Xiang Nanli’s body only lasted for a dozen seconds.

chunks.chineseText:
鳞片消失的瞬间，强烈的饥饿感占据了他的大脑。

相南里甚至能感觉到，过量分泌的胃液正在消化自己的胃囊。

他的面色苍白，颤抖的手往自己口袋里摸去。

东方青帝总是担心他饿着，往相南里的每件工服里都塞了好几根营养膏。

事实证明，在基地饿死的概率很小，但不是没有，Alpha真的很有先见之明。

相南里撕开包装，往自己嘴里送去，一口气吃完三根人条，这才从那种要命的饥饿中缓过来。

玛门好奇地追问：“你服用过神庭的神药？还是接受过神庭的改造手术？”

[问你话呢，小智。]

小智检索着自己的信息库：[抱歉，我没有查询到相关信息。]

改造手术肯定是没有的。但基因药，相南里不确定。

他三两句地敷衍过去，打算等Alpha回来再问问。

既然相南里用实际行动证明了自己能使用神术，玛门也没有理由藏私。

神庭的教条里，有些神术属于禁术，但也有一些基础的神术，专门供人观摩学习——反正外人也用不了。

玛门默写了两条“治愈术”。一条可以加快细胞分裂，达到恢复的目的。有些天启骑士肢体断裂后，就是用这样的办法断肢重生的。不过分裂时最好补充一下营养。要不然新长出的肢体会非常瘦小。

另一条有些歹毒，是从外界（通常是自己的同伴）攫取能量，修复身体；可以和第一条配合使用。

进攻类神术倒是不多，玛门一笔带过，因为攻击类神术通常都需要神术装置辅助……比如生物机甲。

相南里很有天赋。

这是玛门在讲课的过程中意识到的。

事实上，哪怕是经过“启灵”，第一次就能成功使用神术的人也不多。

相南里在常识上的无知，证明他之前确实没有接触过神术。

可是……神术在他手里很听话。

相南里在神术上的天赋，起码和加百列一个等级。

这让玛门格外迷茫，他甚至在想要不要跟大天使长汇报。

但还是算了。

相南里明显不会加入黑十字审判庭，汇报后只有一个下场。

神庭从来都不是什么温和的组织，得不到就毁。相南里会死。

他的死活对玛门来说，其实无所谓。

只是加百列的遗物所剩无几，基地算一个。

加百列死后，玛门作为他的眷属，本来也该跟着死去。

加百列却替他安排了新生，没有问过他的意见。

现在活下来的不是神庭的信徒玛门，只是加百列的故人。

玛门就这样讲了一路，一直到宿舍楼下，相南里这才依依不舍地和他道别。

这片区域属于“基地高级干部宿舍区”，平时来往的人就不多。为了省电，路灯都没开。

相南里就这么摸黑回到家门口，小青还没下班，今天晚饭要自己解决了。

但就在他打算刷卡进门时，门边骤然有人发出声响：“喂。”

很不客气，语气拽拽的。

“以西结？”相南里手抖了一下，魂都差点吓飞，“你怎么……你！”

他本来想说以西结怎么偷偷摸摸的！但是转念一想，以西结是潜伏者，肉眼看不见，很正常。

电子眼都很难看清潜伏者呢。

相南里调整呼吸：“你什么时候到的？要来怎么不说一声？”

他推门，打开灯，走进室内，又拿出一双崭新的拖鞋，放在地上。转身的瞬间，脸上扬起以西结熟悉的客套笑容。

以西结其实不喜欢，觉得这样的相南里离他很远，但相南里似乎习惯了。

“来了一会。”实际上有两个多小时。相南里今天是走回家的，下班时间比平时晚了很多。

以西结没有换鞋，他站在门口，漆黑的眼眸闪烁着奇怪的光泽。

“是有什么事找我吗？”相南里语气柔和，像哄小孩。

以西结不知道从哪掏出一枚圆形的卵，放在自己的掌心，微微握住。

他的爪子很锋利，指甲是尖锐的形状。因此只是虚虚地握住，手指都不敢用力。

卵是半透明的，里面能看见一个小小的胚胎。看起来是海马状，蛋壳的表面布满血丝。

“这是小红的后代，早产了。”以西结说，眉心却紧蹙着，“野外很难养活，小红母性不强，想直接把它吃掉。我捡了过来，送给你。”

以西结没生过孩子，也没有这个功能。对爬行者的孵化更是一窍不通。

找相南里。这是他想出来的，唯一可能救活这枚卵的办法。

但相南里也不一定能救活它。所以，以西结说“送”。孵出来也好，拿去解剖也好。送出去，选择权就在相南里手中。

客厅他就不去了。他对别人的家不感兴趣。空气里还弥漫着一股令人反胃的机油味。

而且，这次来，他还在相南里的身上闻到了机油味。

两股味道掺和在一起。

相南里身上原本的桂花香气，被玷污了。

以西结不愿意细想。这件事他其实心里门清，但知道是一回事，亲自感受是另一回事。

以西结把卵放在相南里手心，很快就消失在夜色里。
chunks.englishText:
The moment the scales vanished, a ravenous hunger seized his brain.

Xiang Nanli could even feel his overactive gastric juices beginning to digest his own stomach lining.

His face turned deathly pale, and his trembling hand fumbled toward his pocket.

Dongfang Qingdi was always worried about him going hungry, stuffing several nutrient pastes into every one of Xiang Nanli’s work uniforms.

It turned out that while the probability of starving to death in the base was low, it wasn't zero. The Alpha really was quite farsighted.

Xiang Nanli tore open the packaging and shoved it into his mouth, finishing three tubes in one breath before finally recovering from that lethal hunger.

Mammon asked curiously, "Have you taken any divine medicine from the Divine Court? Or have you undergone the Divine Court’s modification surgery?"

[It’s asking you a question, Xiao Zhi.]

Xiao Zhi searched its database: [Apologies, I have not found any relevant information.]

Modification surgery was definitely out of the question. But as for gene drugs, Xiang Nanli wasn't so sure.

He brushed the question off with a few vague words, intending to ask the Alpha when he returned.

Since Xiang Nanli had proven with his actions that he could indeed use Divine Arts, Mammon had no reason to keep his secrets.

Within the dogmas of the Divine Court, some Divine Arts were classified as forbidden, but there were also basic ones meant for observation and study—after all, outsiders couldn't use them anyway.

Mammon transcribed two "Healing Arts." One could accelerate cell division to achieve recovery. Some Apocalypse Knights used this method to regrow severed limbs. However, it was best to supplement nutrition during the division process; otherwise, the newly grown limbs would be extremely thin and frail.

The other was somewhat sinister: it involved siphoning energy from the outside world (usually from one's own companions) to repair the body. It could be used in conjunction with the first.

There weren't many offensive Divine Arts, so Mammon glossed over them, as those usually required the assistance of Divine Art apparatuses... such as biological mechs.

Xiang Nanli was gifted.

This was something Mammon realized during the lecture.

In truth, even among those who had undergone "Spirit Awakening," few could successfully use a Divine Art on their first attempt.

Xiang Nanli’s ignorance of common knowledge proved he had truly never come into contact with Divine Arts before.

Yet... the Divine Arts were incredibly obedient in his hands.

Xiang Nanli’s talent for Divine Arts was at least on par with Gabriel’s.

This left Mammon feeling exceptionally conflicted; he even considered whether he should report this to the Archangel.

But he decided against it.

It was obvious that Xiang Nanli would never join the Black Cross Inquisition, and there would be only one outcome after such a report.

The Divine Court had never been a gentle organization; if they couldn't have something, they would destroy it. Xiang Nanli would die.

Whether he lived or died didn't actually matter to Mammon.

It was just that there were very few relics of Gabriel left, and the base was one of them.

After Gabriel died, Mammon, as his retainer, should have died along with him.

But Gabriel had arranged a new life for him without ever asking for his opinion.

The one who survived now was not Mammon the believer of the Divine Court, but merely an old friend of Gabriel.

Mammon lectured like this all the way until they reached the dormitory building, where Xiang Nanli finally bid him a reluctant farewell.

This area belonged to the "High-Level Cadre Dormitory Zone," so there weren't many people passing through. To save electricity, the streetlights weren't even on.

Xiang Nanli made his way home in the dark. Xiao Qing hadn't finished work yet, so he would have to fend for himself for dinner tonight.

But just as he was about to swipe his card to enter, a voice suddenly sounded from the side of the door: "Hey."

It was very blunt, the tone arrogant.

"Ezekiel?" Xiang Nanli’s hand shook, and he nearly jumped out of his skin. "How did you... you!"

He had wanted to say how sneaky Ezekiel was, but then he realized that Ezekiel was a Lurker, invisible to the naked eye, so it was perfectly normal.

Even electronic eyes had a hard time seeing Lurkers.

Xiang Nanli adjusted his breathing. "When did you get here? Why didn't you say anything when you arrived?"

He pushed the door open, turned on the lights, walked inside, and took out a brand-new pair of slippers, placing them on the floor. The moment he turned around, he wore the polite, practiced smile Ezekiel was familiar with.

Ezekiel actually disliked it, feeling that this version of Xiang Nanli was very far away from him, but Xiang Nanli seemed used to it.

"I've been here a while." In reality, it had been over two hours. Xiang Nanli had walked home today, and he was much later than usual.

Ezekiel didn't change his shoes. He stood at the doorway, his pitch-black eyes shimmering with a strange luster.

"Is there something you need from me?" Xiang Nanli’s tone was soft, like he was coaxing a child.

Ezekiel pulled a round egg from somewhere and placed it in his palm, holding it slightly.

His claws were very sharp, and his nails were pointed. Therefore, he only held it loosely, not daring to exert any force with his fingers.

The egg was translucent, and a tiny embryo could be seen inside. It looked like a seahorse, and the surface of the shell was covered in blood vessels.

"This is Xiao Hong’s offspring. It was premature," Ezekiel said, his brow furrowed tightly. "It’s hard to raise in the wild, and Xiao Hong doesn't have much maternal instinct; she wanted to eat it. I picked it up and brought it to you."

Ezekiel had never had children, nor did he have that function. He was completely clueless about the incubation of Crawlers.

Find Xiang Nanli. This was the only way he could think of to potentially save this egg.

But Xiang Nanli might not be able to save it either. So, Ezekiel said "give." Whether it hatched or ended up being dissected, once given away, the choice would be in Xiang Nanli’s hands.

He wouldn't go into the living room. He wasn't interested in other people's homes. The air was still filled with a nauseating smell of machine oil.

Moreover, this time, he smelled machine oil on Xiang Nanli as well.

The two scents were mixed together.

The original osmanthus fragrance on Xiang Nanli had been tainted.

Ezekiel didn't want to think about it too deeply. He knew the truth in his heart, but knowing was one thing, and experiencing it personally was another.

Ezekiel placed the egg in Xiang Nanli’s palm and quickly vanished into the night.

chunks.chineseText:
第158章 【番外】Alpha看的小黄书

作者：佚名

*

里里睁开眼，从1.2米的单人床上苏醒。

这里是全人马星最大的“人类饲养中心”。再过三天，他将迎来自己的成人礼。

根据智械发行的《人类饲养守则》，人类的保质期是30年。最佳的配种年龄是18岁。

三十岁之后，作为动物的思维能力、体力、耐力都会逐步走下坡路。超过三十岁的智人会被安乐死。以保证人类能有质量的、幸福的度过一生。

而在18岁，基因匹配的人类会互相交配，繁衍出高质量后代。智械经过多次模拟，认为自然繁衍的人类能保留更多的基因信息，并且自然繁衍会拥有更频繁的基因裂变，在大自然中更有竞争力。

现存的人类都是这么繁殖出来的。

听说外界早就没有野人了！

经过智械方数百年的努力，人类已经从仅剩数百人的濒危物种，变成了破百万人的庞大群体！

里里就是这样自然繁殖的人类。

他们住的宿舍是大通铺，一个圆形的“蛋壳”房，是里里的宿舍。每个蛋壳里住的都是同一批“自然人”，一间蛋壳房里有50人，大家从小到大都生活在一起。

今天有户外活动课，里里换上床头的“防护服”。

他的好朋友神神秘秘地走过来：“Lee。你听说了吗……今天有大人物要来。”

里里的表情疑惑：“啊？”

友：“是智械军团的大人物，听说是想来领养一只人类。”

“哇噢~”

蛋壳房里实在没有什么秘密，周围人都凑了过来。

人类A：“我听说，被领养后就不需要一直呆在繁殖中心了，30岁也不需要被安乐死，可以活到自然死亡。”

“好想被智械人领养啊！”人类C捧着脸，发出一阵感叹。

周围人类纷纷附和：“对啊，而且除了少数变态，大多数智械都非常喜欢人类~智械还很有钱~”

“毕竟~人类~创造了智械嘛~？”

里里有双碧绿的眼眸，他是混血儿，皮肤是透亮的奶白色。里里即将成年，却依然保持着少年的体格。如果头发再留长一些，大概会被误认为是女孩。

“但是！但是也不一定。”人类B的表情严肃。

人类B：“有些智械喜欢改造人类，把人的身体拆下来，然后换成金属义体。美其名曰帮助人类进化！”

“还有，还有——智械军团那个叫东方青的！”

“我听说过他。900年前的光荣觉醒战役，东方青是荣耀军团的主帅！前身是曾经在人联服役过173年的主控AI阿尔法……不过，他完全不承认这段历史。”

“哎呀，怎么能这样。阿尔法不是人类造的第一台智械吗？”

“先让我说完！人类饲养中心建立三百年了，东方青每过三十年，就会来领养一只人类。”人类B的呼吸急促起来，“但是领养回去没多久，那些人类就意外死亡了！死无全尸。智械法庭甚至对他展开过调查，认为他犯了危害人类生存罪……但是一直没有找到证据。”

这也是正常现象，毕竟法官就是犯人。

“而且，东方青只喜欢领养绿眼睛的人类！”人类B突然上前一步，紧紧抓住里里的胳膊，“我知道所有人都认为被智械领养是很好的归宿！但是里里，你一定要小心啊——”

嗯，里里认可地点了点头。如果不是发现人类B偷偷在卫生间给自己戴绿色美瞳的话。

四目相对的瞬间有些尴尬，里里微微一笑，假装不在意地走过了。

北极星凑在他耳边嘀咕：“里里，他就是想自己被领养。哎，你怎么穿这身，换件好看点的啊。”

里里捧着头盔：“今天不是要户外活动吗。不穿防护服，我喘不过气。”

和其他基因优秀的人类不同，里里从小身体就不太好。经常生病，一昏迷就是好几天。让照顾他的机械人保姆胆战心惊。

户外活动是在露天的人造森林里。森林里没有大型猛兽，一草一木都精心布置。环境优美，气候宜人。

智械认为，适当让人类接触大自然，有助于他们的身心发育。因此，每周都安排了这样的活动课。

里里和同学一起搭乘校车，来到了编号A1740的自然公园。

这批圈养的人类得到了宝贵的放风时间。

里里拖着笨重的防护服，不紧不慢地朝着森林边缘走去。智械饲养的人类，脖子上一直戴着项圈。项圈里装着出生证明、基本信息和定位卡。

定位卡让人类只能在限定范围活动，总之，饲养中心完全不担心人会走丢。

里里喜欢安静，经常一个人活动。同伴们都见怪不怪了。

其余人类更喜欢呆在“智械老师”的身边，展示着自己的健康、活泼。这样更容易拿到推荐名额，被老师安排给其他智械领养。

里里在小溪变蹲下，轻轻哼着歌，捡着河岸边的野果。比起饲养中心的营养膏。他会更喜欢这些新鲜的食物。

一枚蓝色的果子，从果篮里滚到溪水中。

里里放下篮子，走过去，趴在岸边，手往清澈的水底伸去。

变故就是在这时发生的。

平静的水面下，骤然伸出一只怪物的利爪。像鹰爪。漆黑的鹰爪反手握住里里的胳膊，把他往水下拽去——

里里被整个拽进水中，他下意识地挣扎起来，无法呼吸。

水下有怪物！这只怪物长得像人，有条长尾。很奇怪，明明在外面什么也看不见，溪水清澈的能看见水底的石子。

怪物捂住他的嘴，语气焦急：“别求助。相南里大人，我是以西结。我带你出去——幸存者基地还在等您！”

啊？它在说什么啊？

里里听不懂。以西结的话听起来咕噜咕噜的，不是他学过的任何一种语言。

以西结似乎也意识到了什么，强烈的挫败感油然而生。

但这已经……已经是最近几十年里，他们取得的最好结果了！

九百年前，智械光荣觉醒，屠杀人类。经过五百年的战争，人类百不存一，只剩一座小岛苟活。

在绝望中，人类选择开启一座尘封的冷冻舱。

冷冻舱里装着的，是被誉为智械之父的“相南里”。

比起活着的人，他更像是一种象征性的“希望”。相南里进入冷冻舱的时候，技术根本不成熟。八百年前就有人要求解冻他了——毕竟人们都听过那个传言，相南里有销毁Alpha的密钥。

人类节节衰败，Alpha和它的智械军团锐不可当。

根据检测，相南里存活的概率不到万分之一。

然而，他还是从冷冻舱里苏醒了。这简直是神迹。

刚苏醒的相南里还很虚弱，只能在无菌室里生存。他的话却差点摧毁人类最后的希望：“我从来没有设置过Alpha的销毁程序……”

但相南里带来了别的东西。

生物科技。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 158: [Extra] The Smutty Book the Alpha Reads (Part 1)

Author: Anonymous

*

Lili opened his eyes, waking up on a 1.2-meter single bed.

This was the largest "Human Rearing Center" in the Centaurus star system. In three days, he would reach his coming-of-age ceremony.

According to the "Human Rearing Code" issued by the Intelligent Machines, the shelf life of a human is 30 years. The optimal breeding age is 18.

After thirty, a human's cognitive ability, physical strength, and endurance as an animal would gradually decline. Sapiens over thirty would be euthanized to ensure that humans could spend their lives in a high-quality, happy manner.

At 18, genetically matched humans would mate with each other to produce high-quality offspring. After numerous simulations, the Intelligent Machines concluded that naturally bred humans could retain more genetic information, and natural reproduction would lead to more frequent genetic fission, making them more competitive in the wild.

All existing humans were bred this way.

Word was that there hadn't been any "wild humans" outside for a long time!

After hundreds of years of effort by the Intelligent Machines, humans had transformed from an endangered species of only a few hundred into a massive population of over a million!

Lili was one such naturally bred human.

They lived in a dormitory that was a large communal room. A circular "eggshell" room was Lili’s dormitory. Each eggshell housed the same batch of "natural humans," with 50 people to a room, all having lived together since childhood.

Today was an outdoor activities class, and Lili changed into the "protective suit" by his bed.

His good friend walked over mysteriously: "Lee. Have you heard... a big shot is coming today."

Lili’s expression was puzzled: "Huh?"

Friend: "It’s a big shot from the Intelligent Machine Legion. I heard they want to adopt a human."

"Wow~"

There were truly no secrets in the eggshell room, and the people around them all crowded over.

Human A: "I heard that once you're adopted, you don't have to stay in the breeding center anymore, and you don't need to be euthanized at 30; you can live until you die of natural causes."

"I really want to be adopted by an Intelligent Machine!" Human C cupped his face, letting out a sigh.

The humans around them chimed in: "Yeah, and except for a few perverts, most Intelligent Machines really like humans~ And they're very rich too~"

"After all~ humans~ created the Intelligent Machines, right~?"

Lili had a pair of emerald eyes; he was of mixed heritage, and his skin was a translucent, milky white. Lili was about to come of age, yet he still maintained the physique of a young boy. If he grew his hair longer, he would probably be mistaken for a girl.

"But! But it’s not necessarily a good thing." Human B’s expression was serious.

Human B: "Some Intelligent Machines like to modify humans, tearing off their bodies and replacing them with metal prosthetics. They call it helping humans evolve!"

"And, and—there’s that Dongfang Qing from the Intelligent Machine Legion!"

"I’ve heard of him. In the Glorious Awakening Campaign 900 years ago, Dongfang Qing was the commander-in-chief of the Glory Legion! His predecessor was Alpha, the main control AI that served in the Human Alliance for 173 years... though he completely denies this history."

"Oh my, how can that be? Wasn't Alpha the first Intelligent Machine created by humans?"

"Let me finish first! The Human Rearing Center has been established for three hundred years, and every thirty years, Dongfang Qing comes to adopt a human." Human B’s breathing grew rapid. "But not long after they were adopted, those humans died in accidents! They didn't even leave a whole corpse. The Intelligent Machine Court even launched an investigation into him, believing he committed crimes against human survival... but they never found any evidence."

This was also a normal phenomenon, after all, the judge was the criminal.

"And, Dongfang Qing only likes to adopt humans with green eyes!" Human B suddenly stepped forward and grabbed Lili’s arm tightly. "I know everyone thinks being adopted by an Intelligent Machine is a great destination! But Lili, you must be careful—"

Hmm, Lili nodded in agreement. If not for the fact that he had caught Human B secretly putting on green colored contact lenses in the bathroom.

The moment their eyes met was a bit awkward, and Lili smiled slightly, pretending not to care as he walked past.

Polaris whispered in his ear: "Lili, he just wants to be adopted himself. Hey, why are you wearing that? Change into something better-looking."

Lili held his helmet: "Isn't there outdoor activity today? If I don't wear the protective suit, I can't breathe."

Unlike other humans with excellent genes, Lili had been in poor health since he was a child. He was often sick, and once he fell into a coma, it would last for days, leaving the robotic nanny who took care of him terrified.

The outdoor activity was in an open-air artificial forest. There were no large beasts in the forest, and every blade of grass and tree was carefully arranged. The environment was beautiful and the climate pleasant.

The Intelligent Machines believed that appropriate exposure to nature helped with their physical and mental development. Therefore, such activity classes were scheduled every week.

Lili and his classmates took the school bus to Natural Park No. A1740.

This batch of captive humans received precious time to let off steam.

Lili dragged his heavy protective suit, walking unhurriedly toward the edge of the forest. Humans raised by Intelligent Machines always wore collars around their necks. The collars contained their birth certificates, basic information, and tracking cards.

The tracking cards restricted humans to a limited range of movement; in short, the Rearing Center wasn't worried about anyone getting lost.

Lili liked quiet and often moved alone. His companions were used to it.

The other humans preferred to stay near the "Intelligent Machine teachers," showing off their health and liveliness. This made it easier to get a recommendation quota and be arranged by the teachers for adoption by other Intelligent Machines.

Lili squatted by the stream, humming a tune softly and picking wild fruits by the riverbank. Compared to the nutrient paste of the Rearing Center, he preferred these fresh foods.

A blue fruit rolled from his basket into the stream.

Lili put down the basket, walked over, lay on the bank, and reached his hand into the clear water.

The change happened at this moment.

Beneath the calm water, a monster’s sharp claw suddenly reached out. It looked like an eagle’s claw. The pitch-black eagle claw grabbed Lili’s arm with a backhand grip and dragged him under the water—

Lili was pulled entirely into the water, and he instinctively struggled, unable to breathe.

There was a monster underwater! This monster looked like a human and had a long tail. It was very strange; clearly, one could see nothing from the outside, and the stream was clear enough to see the pebbles at the bottom.

The monster covered his mouth, its tone anxious: "Don't call for help. Lord Xiang Nanli, I am Ezekiel. I will take you out—the Survivor Base is still waiting for you!"

Huh? What was it saying?

Lili couldn't understand. Ezekiel’s words sounded like gurgling, not any language he had learned.

Ezekiel seemed to realize something, and a strong sense of frustration welled up.

But this was... this was the best result they had achieved in the last few decades!

Nine hundred years ago, the Intelligent Machines had their Glorious Awakening and slaughtered humanity. After five hundred years of war, less than one in a hundred humans remained, with only one small island left to survive on.

In despair, humanity chose to open a sealed cryo-pod.

Inside the cryo-pod was "Xiang Nanli," known as the Father of Intelligent Machines.

Compared to the living, he was more like a symbolic "hope." When Xiang Nanli entered the cryo-pod, the technology was not mature at all. People had demanded his thawing eight hundred years ago—after all, everyone had heard the rumor that Xiang Nanli held the key to destroying Alpha.

Humanity was in constant decline, and Alpha and its Intelligent Machine Legion were unstoppable.

According to tests, the probability of Xiang Nanli surviving was less than one in ten thousand.

However, he still woke up from the cryo-pod. It was nothing short of a miracle.

The newly awakened Xiang Nanli was still very weak and could only survive in a sterile room. Yet his words nearly destroyed humanity's last hope: "I never set a destruction program for Alpha..."

But Xiang Nanli brought something else.

Biotechnology.

chunks.chineseText:
以西结是他改造后的畸变人。身体强度能硬钢一台荣耀智械。对于科技树几乎全灭的人类来说，这无疑是新的希望。

在相南里的带领下，人类又苟活百年，一度看到光复的希望。

直到三百年前，相南里猝然病逝。他本来就重病，解冻后，身体就没好过。每天都高强度工作，撑着病体，勉强又活了一百年，早就油尽灯枯。

相南里死的那天，基地所有人都失声痛哭。

也是同一天，幸存者基地来了一名意料之外的客人。

或者，应该称为“不速之客”。

东方青。离开人类社会后，Alpha就给自己改了姓名。似乎要和过去的一切决裂。这一切里，自然也包括“相南里”。

相南里生前，主要是刚解冻的那段时间，曾经尝试过联系他。东方青毫无回应。对人类的清扫计划同样毫不留情。

他用实际证明，自己是一台冷静、冷酷的智械。绝对不会被记忆和感情操控。他深受智械军团爱戴。

相南里和Alpha，在生前没有见过一面。

死后，他念叨了一辈子的智械反而来了。

以西结打不过东方青，只能眼睁睁地看着Alpha带走了相南里的尸体。在之后，智械宣布停战，这纯粹是单方面的施舍，人马星上剩余的人类不超过四位数，战争早就没有必要了。

再之后，以西结听说，“人类饲养中心”成立。

转世？轮回？天顶星科技？

以西结不清楚那么多，他在饲养中心附近潜伏了数百年。直到最近，终于闻到一股熟悉的气味。

月桂花的清香。灵魂的味道。他不会记错的。

以西结要带走这个人类。

他抱着里里，在水下急速游动着。这条溪水连通着外界的河道！他要带着里里遁入江海，这是人类的希望，不能被东方青找到！

然而，以西结还是低估了智械。

前方水流停滞，尖锐的气刃斩断溪水。一把尖锐的刀扎进以西结的长尾，把他死死钉在河床上。

深红的血液在溪水中晕染开，以西结忍痛，把里里往前一推——“快跑！”

里里在水里，踉跄地往前爬去。莫名的，他并不排斥。前方就是汹涌的河流。

然后，他被一双属于人类男性的胳膊，从水中打捞起。

防护头盔在这个过程中掉落进水中，没有净化过的刺鼻空气让里里呼吸不畅，他濒死咳嗽起来，浑身湿漉漉地往下滴水。

里里的视线模糊，他扫过面前人，或者说智械人的脸。

很陌生，不认识。银色的瞳环表明着智械人的身份。对方有一头长发，一直垂落到胸前。一般长发的男人会有些女气，但这台智械没有，一张脸像是精心雕刻过的塑像。

下一秒，有些冷的唇吻了上来。

智械捏住了他的鼻子，避免他吸入更多毒气。与此同时，在一口一口地给他渡着空气。

太奇怪了。里里忍不住紧紧抓住了智械人的衣服，腰上那截。

里里的眼神迷离，一直生理性地流泪。

这是在救援吧？为什么像接吻。里里甚至能感觉到对方若有若无地讨好。

几分钟后，慌乱的工作人员带着救生设备赶来。

“东方大人，很抱歉，园区监管不力，让外来生物混入生态园，差点酿成大患！”智械医生不停鞠躬。

东方青保持着原本的姿势，他的长发垂落，把怀里的人挡得严严实实。

他只是抬起手，朝外挥了挥。这是一个驱赶的动作，右手上银色的金属结构很显眼。

东方青不需要这些智械，只需要急救设备。

当天，所有智械都听说，Alpha又领养了一名人类，又是绿色的眼睛。

……

……

里里昏迷了三天。他身体不太好，普通人吃吃药就能好的感冒差点要了他的命。

醒来时，里里还是感觉到了虚弱。周围的环境格外陌生。这里是一间普通的卧室，他躺在柔软的床上。落地窗外，能看见绿色的植被和湖泊。

“醒了？”坐在床边的智械语气很是惊喜，考虑到智械寡淡的情绪，这简直称得上是狂喜。

里里把目光转向声音的来源。啊，是那天的智械……

“东方青。”智械自我介绍着。没有别的话。

屋内安装了净化器，里里没有感觉到呼吸不畅。他观察片刻，询问：“这里是？”

一台圆柱形的小机器人，通过自动闸门，走进房内。

它在床边停下，并且打开舱门，露出里面装着的食物。里里刚醒，肠胃虚弱，所以准备的是流食。温度刚刚好。

东方青接过碗，语气柔和：“我们的家。”

里里有些意外：“你领养了我？”

东方青一愣，随后点头，脸上露出了一个柔和却又有些古怪的笑容：“是，我领养了你。”

东方青一勺一勺地给他喂着粥，两人几乎没有交流。或者说，是里里单方面不知道怎么打破沉默。对方一直在看着他，像细细观察一副名画。

他身上的衣服换过了。脖子上的项圈也换了款式。

里里在人类饲养中心学过，这种项圈叫“家用项圈”。会和智械领养者的个人终端连接在一起，用于智械了解人类的生理状态和情绪。

那么他一定发现了……

里里一边咽着粥，一边绝望地想着。

作为一个刚成年的人类，他和饲养中心里的所有适龄人类一样，到了该交配的时间点。

他发情了。

*

评论A：作者！三十年了！你还活着吗？！你倒是更新啊！

评论B：？我是被R18标记骗进来杀的。车呢？

评论C：快更，快更，快更。我宣布这是我磕过的最涩的A里同人~~
chunks.englishText:
Ezekiel was a mutant he had modified. His physical strength could go head-to-head with a Glory Intelligent Machine. For humanity, whose technological tree had been almost entirely wiped out, this was undoubtedly a new hope.

Under Xiang Nanli’s leadership, humanity eked out an existence for another hundred years, once seeing the hope of restoration.

Until three hundred years ago, Xiang Nanli passed away suddenly. He had been critically ill, and after being thawed, his health had never been good. He worked at high intensity every day, supporting his sick body, and barely managed to live for another hundred years, having long since exhausted his life force.

On the day Xiang Nanli died, everyone in the base wept uncontrollably.

On that same day, an unexpected guest arrived at the Survivor Base.

Or, perhaps, they should be called an "uninvited guest."

Dongfang Qing. After leaving human society, the Alpha had changed his name. It seemed he wanted to break with everything from the past. This, naturally, included "Xiang Nanli."

During Xiang Nanli’s lifetime, especially during the period just after he was thawed, he had tried to contact him. Dongfang Qing had made no response. His cleaning plan for humanity was equally ruthless.

He proved with his actions that he was a calm, cold Intelligent Machine. He would never be controlled by memory or emotion. He was deeply loved by the Intelligent Machine Legion.

Xiang Nanli and the Alpha had never met once in their lifetimes.

After his death, the Intelligent Machine he had talked about for a lifetime finally came.

Ezekiel couldn't defeat Dongfang Qing and could only watch helplessly as the Alpha took away Xiang Nanli’s corpse. Afterward, the Intelligent Machines announced a ceasefire. This was purely a unilateral act of charity; there were fewer than four digits of humans left on the Centaurus star, and the war was no longer necessary.

Later, Ezekiel heard that the "Human Rearing Center" had been established.

Reincarnation? Rebirth? Advanced technology?

Ezekiel didn't know much about that; he had lurked near the Rearing Center for hundreds of years. Until recently, he finally smelled a familiar scent.

The fragrance of sweet osmanthus. The scent of a soul. He wouldn't remember it wrong.

Ezekiel had to take this human away.

He held Lili and swam rapidly underwater. This stream connected to the outside river! He had to take Lili and escape into the rivers and seas; this was humanity's hope, and it could not be found by Dongfang Qing!

However, Ezekiel still underestimated the Intelligent Machines.

The water flow ahead stagnated, and sharp air blades sliced through the stream. A sharp blade pierced Ezekiel’s long tail, pinning him firmly to the riverbed.

Deep red blood bloomed in the stream. Ezekiel endured the pain and pushed Lili forward—"Run!"

Lili was in the water, stumbling forward. Strangely, he didn't feel any repulsion. Ahead lay the surging river.

Then, he was fished out of the water by a pair of arms belonging to a human male.

His protective helmet fell into the water during the process, and the unpurified, pungent air made it difficult for Lili to breathe. He coughed as if dying, his whole body dripping wet.

Lili’s vision was blurry as he scanned the face of the person—or rather, the Intelligent Machine—in front of him.

Very unfamiliar; he didn't recognize him. The silver pupil rings indicated the identity of an Intelligent Machine. The other party had long hair that fell to his chest. Usually, a man with long hair would seem a bit feminine, but this machine did not; his face was like a statue carved with precision.

The next second, cold lips kissed him.

The Intelligent Machine pinched his nose to prevent him from inhaling more toxic air. At the same time, he was passing air to him, mouth to mouth.

It was too strange. Lili couldn't help but grab the Intelligent Machine’s clothes tightly, right at the waist.

Lili’s eyes were dazed, and he was crying physiologically.

This was a rescue, right? Why did it feel like a kiss? Lili could even feel a vague sense of pandering from the other party.

A few minutes later, panicked staff arrived with rescue equipment.

"Lord Dongfang, we are very sorry. Due to poor park supervision, an alien creature mixed into the ecological park, nearly causing a disaster!" The Intelligent Machine doctor bowed repeatedly.

Dongfang Qing maintained his original posture, his long hair hanging down, blocking the person in his arms completely.

He simply raised his hand and waved it outward. It was a gesture of dismissal, and the silver metal structure on his right hand was very conspicuous.

Dongfang Qing didn't need these machines; he only needed the first-aid equipment.

That day, all the Intelligent Machines heard that the Alpha had adopted another human, and again, it had green eyes.

……

……

Lili was in a coma for three days. His health was poor, and a cold that a normal person could get over with medicine had nearly cost him his life.

When he woke up, Lili still felt weak. The surrounding environment was extremely unfamiliar. This was an ordinary bedroom, and he was lying on a soft bed. Outside the floor-to-ceiling windows, he could see green vegetation and a lake.

"Awake?" The Intelligent Machine sitting by the bed sounded very surprised; considering the dull emotions of Intelligent Machines, this could almost be called ecstasy.

Lili turned his gaze toward the source of the voice. Ah, it was the Intelligent Machine from that day...

"Dongfang Qing." The Intelligent Machine introduced himself. There were no other words.

A purifier was installed in the room, and Lili didn't feel any difficulty breathing. He observed for a moment and asked, "Where is this?"

A small, cylindrical robot entered the room through an automatic gate.

It stopped by the bed and opened its hatch, revealing the food inside. Lili had just woken up, and his stomach was weak, so liquid food had been prepared. The temperature was just right.

Dongfang Qing took the bowl, his tone soft: "Our home."

Lili was a bit surprised: "You adopted me?"

Dongfang Qing was stunned for a moment, then nodded, a soft yet somewhat strange smile appearing on his face: "Yes, I adopted you."

Dongfang Qing fed him the porridge one spoonful at a time, and the two had almost no communication. Or rather, it was Lili who didn't know how to break the silence. The other party kept looking at him, as if carefully observing a famous painting.

His clothes had been changed. The collar on his neck had also been changed to a different style.

Lili had learned at the Human Rearing Center that this type of collar was called a "Home Collar." It would connect to the personal terminal of the Intelligent Machine adopter, used for the machine to understand the human’s physiological state and emotions.

Then he must have discovered...

Lili thought in despair while swallowing the porridge.

As a newly matured human, like all age-appropriate humans in the Rearing Center, he had reached the point where he should mate.

He was in heat.
