chunks.chapterTitle: 第159章 祝你踏过千层浪 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第159章 祝你踏过千层浪

这双手是这具身体最像智械的部分。

东方青帝的手腕上能看见明显的机械装置，手指呈现出金属的色泽，自带的能源环像一枚枚戒指。

审讯室里只剩下艾伦的尸体。没有刑具，东方青帝喜欢用手。

他的手很稳。打断肋骨和挖眼珠子都不在话下。

东方青帝朝着黄枫吩咐：“割下他的头，用盐腌制好，秘密送往奥丁城。他带来的人一并处理掉。”

Alpha的死忠智械黄枫低头，回复铿锵有力：“是。大人。”

这当然很残忍，但有什么关系？

大多时候，东方青帝并不在乎人类社会的道德。看上去，黄枫这种智械也不在乎。

他在盥洗室里清洁好自己的身体。这具身体不会分泌油脂和废物，因此只需要最简单的擦拭。东方青帝穿戴整齐，又很心机地往耳后喷上淡香水。

很好，现在可以回家见相南里了。

现在是晚上九点半，东方青帝不抱希望地路过菜市场，发现这里果然关门了。他还想买点新鲜的鸡蛋，明天早上给相南里做玉子烧。相南里喜欢甜口的，可以在蛋液里加点奶油。

Alpha不会爱人。但观察人类，有超过一半的人类，认为自己能在配偶、父母、子女的家务劳动中感觉到爱意。所以，照顾相南里，是Alpha爱的表达。

另外，还有超过八成的人类表示，他们在交配时，对伴侣的爱意达到巅峰。

Alpha开始思考要如何与相南里交配。

这个问题过于复杂，并且可能导致不同的世界线分支。Alpha计算了一路，感觉CPU有点烧。

终于，他回到家门口。

东方青帝站在门前停下，有些不悦地蹙眉。

有外人来过。

东方青帝不像以西结那样天赋异禀，能靠着嗅觉闻出好几天前短暂停留过的人。那分明是狗的技能。

但他在家附近设置过最严密的安保系统，东方青帝当即调取数据，并且从一片漆黑里，艰难检索出以西结的形状。

呵，不愧是潜行者。

偷偷摸摸、见不得光的东西。有什么事非得大半夜趁他不在家的时候来找相南里？

Alpha认为这很危险，并且坚决不承认自己有些吃醋。

他和以西结中间起码隔着10个洛阳的咖位。他怎么可能把以西结放在眼里……

东方青帝正常打开家门，制造出微小的动静。

“小青，你回来啦~”相南里的声音很快从卧室里传来，随后是拖鞋在地上“哒哒哒”的响声。

像小企鹅在冰川上走路。

东方青帝的嘴角不由得上扬2度。

穿着睡衣的相南里捧着一枚圆圆的蛋，小跑过来：“你看，以西结今天送了一枚蛋给我。”

说完，他把蛋高高举起，凑到了Alpha的眼前。

东方青帝嘴角的笑容不变，机械核心却闪过几道低压电流。

好吧，或许有时候“情敌”这种东西和咖位无关，只看相南里喜不喜欢。

东方青帝扫了眼：“那很好啊，刚好冰箱里没鸡蛋了。”

这枚卵显然不是普通的鸡蛋。

Alpha在数据库里搜索着，搜出来的结果让他窝火。

畸变人的卵？

什么意思？

有时候，不想抚育后代的畸变体母方，会把蛋交给父方。

总不能是以西结下的蛋吧？

相南里并不知道他脑海里的百转千回，谨慎地把蛋收回：“这是小红的孩子，不可以吃。”

Alpha关门，等着他后面的话：“嗯？”

“以西结说，这枚卵发育不良。送给我了。小青，我想看看能不能孵出来。你有办法吗？”

Alpha很想说没有，但很可惜，他并没有安装过“拒绝相南里”的程序设定。

得到Alpha肯定的答复后，相南里欢欣雀跃地把畸变人卵放置在温水中。这是在模拟畸变人的体内温度。

相南里晚上十点半睡觉，睡觉前还必须要看书。他会一边看书，一边处理不那么紧急、但是重要的公务。

相南里患有成人ADHD，在做自己不那么感兴趣的事情时，注意力总是相当分散。

东方青帝就坐在一边，听着他的絮絮叨叨：“小青，李斯特发来消息，说研究有阶段性突破，可以尝试给冷冻人局部解冻，注入营养液，帮助冰里的生物缓慢恢复……这算好事吗？冰块里的复兴委员会成员，那还是人类吗？我有些不安。或许在局部解冻后，可以先尝试和里面的生物沟通。”

“北辰也发来电报。基地自主研发的‘生命一号’基因药正在进行临床实验。如果实验成功，基地就能以极低成本，获得一批性状稳定的基因战士。

“上次战役，我就发现了，普通人在这个年代，根本没有上战场的资格。没有防护服，正常人类的身体素质应付不了复杂恶劣的环境，只能充当勤务兵和炮灰。

“但是养一名基因战士，耗费又是普通士兵的好多倍。

“什么时候才能不打仗呢？……我觉得资源用在这上面，对人类整体的发展来说，属于可悲的浪费。”

相南里叫着他的名字，但东方青帝明白，他其实并没有叫任何人，只是自言自语。

如果东方青帝在此时回复他，相南里甚至需要反应几秒，才能意识到自己刚刚说过什么。

Alpha想，这就是他的恋人。

相南里突然想起一件事，相对清醒的目光转向东方青帝的脸：“对了，小青，我之前服用的基因药，是神庭的吗？”

相南里谈到了玛门和神术，他伸出胳膊，撩起衣袖：“玛门说神术使用需要启灵，可我只是把意识按照他说的轨迹运行，胳膊上就长出了鳞片。”

因为很难控制自己的思想，在说这句话时，相南里的胳膊上甚至又冒起一片细鳞。

一天用两次神术，哪怕是最初级的“躯体强化”，也让相南里的面色变得苍白起来。

东方青帝握住他的手腕，打断施法。还没彻底冒出头的鳞片缓缓收回。

东方青帝感觉到强烈的不安。

身体的本能正在报警，大脑告诉他，让相南里继续学习神术，是一件非常危险的事情——

就像是这件事曾经发生过，并且带来过灾难一样。

智械的逻辑需要证据，可这条推论毫无道理。更像是某种错误的情绪。

东方青帝压抑着内心奇怪的不安，相对冷静地开口：“之前给你用过神庭的基因药，‘高等生命选拔赛’的战利品；另外，少量的生物机甲‘沙利叶’残留在你的身体里。这也许是你能使用神术的原因。”

前者算“神药”，后者算“神术装置”。

相南里虚弱地靠在他的肩上，微微喘着气，显然没有在听：“小青，饿……”

于是Alpha放弃了接下来想说的话，拿出藏在床头柜的营养液，插入吸管，递给相南里。

他看着相南里含在嘴里，贪婪地吮吸，然后吞咽着。他吃得太急，多余的粘稠液体从唇角边滑落。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 159: May You Traverse the Thousand-Fold Waves (Part 1)

These hands were the part of this body that most resembled a machine.

On Dongfang Qingdi’s wrists, one could see distinct mechanical apparatuses; his fingers possessed a metallic luster, and the integrated energy rings resembled rows of rings.

Only Allen’s corpse remained in the interrogation room. There were no torture devices; Dongfang Qingdi preferred to use his hands.

His hands were steady. Breaking ribs or gouging out eyeballs was effortless for him.

Dongfang Qingdi gave an order to Huang Feng: "Sever his head, cure it with salt, and send it secretly to Odin City. Deal with the people he brought along as well."

Huang Feng, the loyal machine of the Alpha, bowed his head and replied with a sonorous, metallic voice: "Yes, My Lord."

This was, of course, cruel, but what did it matter?

Most of the time, Dongfang Qingdi did not care about the morality of human society. It seemed that a machine like Huang Feng didn't care either.

He cleaned his body in the washroom. This body did not secrete oils or waste, so it only required a simple wipe-down. Dongfang Qingdi dressed neatly and, with calculated intent, sprayed a light perfume behind his ears.

Very well, now he could go home to see Xiang Nanli.

It was 9:30 PM. Dongfang Qingdi passed by the vegetable market without much hope, only to find it had indeed closed. He had wanted to buy some fresh eggs to make tamagoyaki for Xiang Nanli in the morning. Xiang Nanli liked sweet things, so he could add a little cream to the egg mixture.

An Alpha does not know how to love. But observing humans, more than half of them believe they can feel love through the domestic chores performed for their spouses, parents, or children. Therefore, taking care of Xiang Nanli was the Alpha’s expression of love.

Additionally, over eighty percent of humans stated that their love for their partner reached its peak during mating.

The Alpha began to ponder how to mate with Xiang Nanli.

This question was overly complex and could potentially lead to various branching timelines. The Alpha calculated the entire way home, feeling his CPU beginning to overheat.

Finally, he arrived at his front door.

Dongfang Qingdi stopped before the door, frowning with slight displeasure.

An outsider had been here.

Dongfang Qingdi was not gifted like Ezekiel, who could rely on his sense of smell to detect someone who had stayed briefly several days ago. That was clearly a dog’s skill.

However, he had installed the most rigorous security system around his home. Dongfang Qingdi immediately retrieved the data and, with great difficulty, extracted the shape of Ezekiel from the pitch-black footage.

*Heh*, as expected of a lurker.

Something sneaky and hidden in the shadows. What business could he possibly have that required him to come find Xiang Nanli in the middle of the night while he was away?

The Alpha deemed this dangerous and firmly refused to admit that he was somewhat jealous.

There were at least ten "Luoyang-level" status gaps between him and Ezekiel. How could he possibly take Ezekiel seriously...

Dongfang Qingdi opened the door normally, making a slight sound.

"Xiao Qing, you're back~" Xiang Nanli’s voice came quickly from the bedroom, followed by the *tap-tap-tap* sound of slippers on the floor.

Like a little penguin walking on a glacier.

The corners of Dongfang Qingdi’s mouth couldn't help but lift by two degrees.

Xiang Nanli, wearing pajamas, held a round egg and trotted over: "Look, Ezekiel gave me an egg today."

After saying this, he held the egg high, bringing it right before the Alpha’s eyes.

The smile on Dongfang Qingdi’s face remained, but several low-voltage currents flashed through his mechanical core.

Well, perhaps sometimes "love rivals" have nothing to do with status; it only depends on whether Xiang Nanli likes them.

Dongfang Qingdi glanced at it: "That’s great, just in time, the fridge is out of eggs."

This egg was clearly not an ordinary chicken egg.

The Alpha searched his database, and the results made him seethe.

A mutant’s egg?

What was the meaning of this?

Sometimes, a mutant mother who does not wish to raise her offspring will hand the egg over to the father.

It couldn't possibly be an egg laid by Ezekiel, could it?

Xiang Nanli did not know about the thousand thoughts racing through his mind and cautiously took the egg back: "This is Xiao Hong’s child, we can't eat it."

The Alpha closed the door, waiting for what he had to say next: "Hmm?"

"Ezekiel said this egg is underdeveloped. He gave it to me. Xiao Qing, I want to see if I can hatch it. Do you have a way?"

The Alpha really wanted to say no, but unfortunately, he had never installed a "refuse Xiang Nanli" program setting.

After receiving the Alpha’s affirmative reply, Xiang Nanli joyfully placed the mutant egg in warm water. This was to simulate the temperature inside a mutant’s body.

Xiang Nanli went to bed at 10:30 PM and had to read before sleeping. He would read while handling non-urgent but important official business.

Xiang Nanli suffered from adult ADHD; when doing things he wasn't particularly interested in, his attention was always quite scattered.

Dongfang Qingdi sat to one side, listening to his rambling: "Xiao Qing, Li Si sent a message saying the research has had a phased breakthrough. We can try to partially thaw the cryogenically frozen people, inject nutrient solution, and help the organisms in the ice slowly recover... Is this a good thing? Are the members of the Revival Committee in the ice still human? I feel a bit uneasy. Perhaps after partial thawing, we can try to communicate with the creatures inside first."

"Bei Chen also sent a telegram. The base’s self-developed 'Life No. 1' gene medicine is undergoing clinical trials. If the experiment succeeds, the base can obtain a batch of genetically stable warriors at a very low cost."

"During the last battle, I realized that ordinary people in this era simply aren't qualified to go to the battlefield. Without protective suits, the physical fitness of normal humans cannot cope with complex and harsh environments; they can only serve as orderlies and cannon fodder."

"But raising a gene warrior costs many times more than an ordinary soldier."

"When will we stop fighting? ...I feel that using resources on this is a tragic waste for the overall development of humanity."

Xiang Nanli called his name, but Dongfang Qingdi understood that he wasn't actually calling anyone; he was just talking to himself.

If Dongfang Qingdi replied at this moment, Xiang Nanli would even need a few seconds to realize what he had just said.

The Alpha thought, this is his lover.

Xiang Nanli suddenly remembered something, his relatively clear gaze turning to Dongfang Qingdi’s face: "By the way, Xiao Qing, was the gene medicine I took before from the Divine Court?"

Xiang Nanli spoke of Mammon and divine arts. He stretched out his arm and rolled up his sleeve: "Mammon said that using divine arts requires spiritual enlightenment, but I just ran my consciousness along the path he described, and scales grew on my arm."

Because it was difficult to control his thoughts, as he said this, a patch of fine scales even emerged on Xiang Nanli’s arm again.

Using divine arts twice in one day, even the most basic "Body Strengthening," made Xiang Nanli’s complexion turn pale.

Dongfang Qingdi gripped his wrist, interrupting the casting. The scales that hadn't fully emerged slowly receded.

Dongfang Qingdi felt a strong sense of unease.

His body’s instincts were sounding an alarm, and his brain told him that letting Xiang Nanli continue to learn divine arts was a very dangerous thing—

It was as if this had happened before and had brought about a catastrophe.

A machine’s logic required evidence, but this inference made no sense. It was more like some kind of erroneous emotion.

Dongfang Qingdi suppressed the strange unease in his heart and spoke relatively calmly: "I used the Divine Court’s gene medicine on you before; it was a trophy from the 'Higher Life Selection Tournament.' Additionally, a small amount of the biological mecha 'Sariel' remains in your body. This may be the reason you can use divine arts."

The former counted as "divine medicine," the latter as a "divine art device."

Xiang Nanli leaned weakly against his shoulder, panting slightly, clearly not listening: "Xiao Qing, hungry..."

So the Alpha gave up on what he wanted to say next, took out the nutrient solution hidden in the nightstand, inserted a straw, and handed it to Xiang Nanli.

He watched Xiang Nanli hold it in his mouth, sucking greedily, then swallowing. He ate too quickly, and the excess viscous liquid slid down the corner of his lips.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第159章 祝你踏过千层浪 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
食物流经喉管，相南里的喉结滚动。东方青帝也跟着想要吞咽。

智械也会有食欲吗。

[很显然……你已经憋到感官错位了。]小智幽幽开口。

哪怕这属于“自问自答”，但Alpha依然觉得小智很烦，并且又一次清空它的数据。

他抽了张纸巾，擦干净相南里的唇角。

相南里一口气喝光两管营养液。胃里终于不再火烧火燎的疼痛。

Alpha决定下次再准备一些基因药。

相南里已经懒得询问他在家里藏了多少营养液了……东方青帝也许有什么囤物癖。

晚上十点半，东方青帝准时抽走相南里手中的教科书，然后关掉床头灯。

“睡觉吧，晚安。”他说。

说过晚安，东方青帝却并没有离去。

他就坐在枕边，轻轻抚摸着相南里的脑袋，像给慵懒的猫猫顺毛。

相南里或许不理解什么是爱，但他会对人产生依赖。

Alpha很有耐心。

身边的人呼吸逐渐变轻，活跃的脑电波变得稳定而有节奏。这是闭眼后放松状态下的阿尔法脑波；陷入睡眠后，阿尔法波消失，大量塞尔塔波出现，脑电波图像会更加平缓、迟钝，

东方青帝就这么兴致勃勃地观察着相南里的脑电波图。很无聊的东西，他却看得津津有味。

这是他要用一生研究的课题。

许久后，代表深度睡眠的“德尔塔波”出现；东方青帝弯腰，撩开相南里的刘海，轻吻他的额头。

很平静，也很幸福。

Alpha想，他已经过上了曾经最想要的生活。

留在爱人的身边。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 159: May You Traverse the Thousand-Fold Waves (Part 2)

As the food flowed down his throat, Xiang Nanli’s Adam’s apple bobbed. Dongfang Qingdi felt an urge to swallow as well.

Do machines have appetites too?

[Obviously... you’ve been holding back until your senses are misaligned.] Xiao Zhi spoke gloomily.

Even though this was a case of "self-questioning," the Alpha still felt that Xiao Zhi was annoying and cleared its data once again.

He pulled out a tissue and wiped the corner of Xiang Nanli’s mouth clean.

Xiang Nanli drank two tubes of nutrient solution in one breath. The burning pain in his stomach finally subsided.

The Alpha decided to prepare some more gene medicine next time.

Xiang Nanli couldn't be bothered to ask how much nutrient solution he had hidden in the house anymore... Dongfang Qingdi might have some kind of hoarding disorder.

At 10:30 PM, Dongfang Qingdi punctually took the textbook from Xiang Nanli’s hand and turned off the bedside lamp.

"Sleep now, goodnight," he said.

After saying goodnight, Dongfang Qingdi did not leave.

He sat by the bedside, gently stroking Xiang Nanli’s head, like smoothing the fur of a lazy cat.

Xiang Nanli might not understand what love is, but he would develop a dependency on people.

The Alpha was very patient.

The breathing of the person beside him gradually became lighter, and his active brainwaves became stable and rhythmic. These were alpha waves in a relaxed state after closing his eyes; after falling into sleep, the alpha waves disappeared, and a large number of theta waves appeared, making the brainwave image flatter and slower.

Dongfang Qingdi watched Xiang Nanli’s brainwave chart with great interest. It was a very boring thing, yet he watched it with relish.

This was a subject he would spend his entire life studying.

A long time later, the "delta waves" representing deep sleep appeared; Dongfang Qingdi leaned over, brushed aside Xiang Nanli’s bangs, and kissed his forehead lightly.

It was very peaceful, and very happy.

The Alpha thought that he had already lived the life he had once wanted most.

To stay by his lover’s side.

chunks.chineseText:
第160章 开会

不远处，是永恒市驻城军团的秋训。易横行站在高台上，面无表情地用人联的训练方案，操练着这批来自地表的民兵。

“都给我跑起来，没跑完的不准吃饭！”

易横行戴着扩音器，嗓门极大。还算英俊的脸表情凶神恶煞，看上去跟这些士兵有仇。

好在，这些基地选出来的青年兵，身体素质不详，信念感却尤其强烈。哪怕易横行的命令再过分，也会拼命完成。

他们不怕易横行的鞭子，怕浪费基地人民的粮食。

目前基地的军队结构是这样的——

两支中央军团，由基地总司令（相南里）直接调配。

名字分别叫红狮和红鹰。一共三万人。

现在这两支中央军团的主要任务是开荒。

一部分人在盐湖市，镇压旧贵族并且修路修房；另一些在扫荡其他小型据点，扩展基地的版图。

对于据点原本的主人来说，这是可恶的趁火打劫、无妄之灾；但对于据点的底层人民来说，这是他们第一次感受到“神”的福音。

有趣的是，发展到后来，小据点的领主一听基地的军团来了，有些选择拖家带口地逃跑，有些却会直接投降，放弃自己的管辖权，加入基地。算是带资进组。

相南里照盘全收，来者不拒。

他已经不是刚出象牙塔、眼里容不得沙子的小男孩了。

不接受这群人的投降，结果就是更多的据点领主拼死反抗，两败俱伤。不如给旧世界的“贵种”们留个位置和念想。

思想可以日后改造，当务之急是扩张。

扩张后，基地能更好的整合资源，协同发展，在未来的生存战役中，掌握更大的话语权。

更何况，加入基地后，人怎么安排，还不是上面一句话的事。

基地扩张太快。相南里不看地图，已经叫不出那些新增村镇的名字。

福音书在这些小据点里来回晃悠，向劳动人民传授着农业技巧和基地思想。

饭要一口一口吃，地也要一点一点种。

中央军团之外，就是不同城市的驻城军团了。一共有四支，满编制10万人（但目前顶多也就两万），盐城军还在筹备中。

这么多军团都在筹建，基地自然是很缺人的；尤其缺具有军事素质的将领。

易横行第一批收到征召令。

易横行半推半就地任职了，名头是“指导员”，意思是人联派来督战的高级官员。但实际上干的活和其他牛马将帅差不多。从训练到扫盲到精神建设，都在操心。

范佩西一直在等着自己被启用。望眼欲穿。

他在基建队掏了两个月下水道，原本的小弟一个个被调走，只剩他，还在局子里蹲着当战犯。

范佩西的心态，早就没有之前的镇定自若。

基地有军官学院，一直在选拔根正苗红的本地人，努力把他们培育成需要的军事人才。这代表着，范佩西掌握的知识，或许不再稀缺。

而他原本的部队，也被揉散，发配到各地，改造成了基地的形状。

范佩西清楚，他的军团几乎都是利益驱动的；和基地这种靠“信仰”凝聚的军队有着本质区别。

范佩西没有利益可以分给这些人。而这些雇佣兵加入基地后，尽管总收入比之前少，生活水平却并没有太差。那么背叛是理所当然的事。

两个月下来，范佩西最死忠的几名近卫，在脱离苦海后，探望他的频率也在逐渐降低。

话术更是从“那个姓相的留着老大你肯定有用”，变成“司令自有安排，我们会帮你的老范……等之后风头过了，一定把你从局子里放出来”。

范佩西焦虑，无奈，抑郁。但是他早就没有谈判的资本。

同为劳改犯的小王端着两杯水，乐呵呵地走过来：“老大！发水了，里面加了盐和糖！”

基建队里的劳改犯来自五湖四海。有些是战犯，有些是经济犯，有些是杀人犯，还有政治犯……刑期短的就半个月，长的有数百年。

劳改犯身上安装电子锁，里面有定位器和高压电流，杜绝逃跑的可能。

盐和糖都是地表的重要物资，用在劳改犯身上，无疑是种浪费。在过去，地表的奴隶主们甚至也不舍得给自己的生产工具（奴隶）用。而他们这些劳改犯，严格意义上，属于犯了事的“囚犯”。

基地偶尔展现的这种人道主义关怀，令范佩西感觉到不适。

就像是阴暗处畏光的老鼠，突然被强光照射的那种不适。

这道强光不仅照在范佩西身上，也照在所有外来者身上。难民、新收编的地表人、投降贵族……在基地呆久了，他们慢慢意识到：原来人还可以这么活着。

或者说，人本就应该这样活着。

任何伟大的口号，对要饿死的人来说，都比不上发到手里、摸得着的两个馒头。

范佩西坐在自己亲手挖的下水道边上，慢吞吞地喝着掺了盐的热糖水，一股暖意从胃里升腾上来。

小王又掏出两个馒头，塞给范佩西一个：“老大，这是小李省的军粮。他们军队里的，一顿能分四个。啧啧，这军饷比我们之前的高多了。”难民兵团上层还能吃肉，中层喝汤，下层就只有吃土了。

范佩西是军团领袖，是吃肉的。可他同样是底层军官出身，有过吃土的日子。

他的这些亲卫，也都是跟着他，从吃土一路走过来的。他们理论上过上了好日子，实际上，什么也没改变。只是从受害者变成了加害者。

范佩西有些想哭，不是因为感动。是对未来的绝望和释然。

绝望是他无望东山再起，释然是因为……

范佩西发自内心的认为，基地的制度和理念，比他见过的所有地表据点都要优越。他衷心地希望这样的平和能继续维持下去。

不远处的山地，士兵还在来来回回练着青蛙跳。忽得，原本整齐的队伍小范围骚乱起来，说司令来军营视察工作。是临时起意的。

这群训练有素的官兵冒着被训斥的风险，也想要见相南里一面。

见一面没有任何实际意义，但真能见一次，他们恐怕在临终前也要念念不忘地对子孙炫耀。

范佩西隔着铁网，看着一辆防弹车开进军营。随后。那位年轻人笑着走下车，朝周围挥了挥手——

欢呼声顿时海啸一样，震得范佩西耳膜生疼。

好耀眼啊。

相南里走的是一条最艰难，却也最正确的路。

他得到的尊敬和爱戴，是对他坚持与付出的奖赏。

范佩西不敢再看，仓皇逃窜。

包工头在叫他名字了。

范佩西小跑着来到包工头跟前：“牛队，叫我什么事。”

牛队个子不高，肤色黝黑，但很壮实。明面上，他是这些劳改犯的监工；私底下，他们是军队退役下来的“荣誉市民”，充当着基地最小的眼睛。

他拍了拍范佩西的肩，意味深长地说道：“上头来人了，有你调令。去盐城的，葛根军团长迟早要回永恒市……你去那边，好好表现啊。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 160: Meeting (Part 1)

Not far away, the Eternal City Garrison Legion was conducting autumn training. Yi Hengxing stood on a high platform, expressionless, drilling this batch of militia from the surface using the Human Alliance’s training manual.

"Get moving, all of you! No food for anyone who hasn't finished running!"

Yi Hengxing wore a megaphone, his voice booming. His otherwise handsome face wore a fierce expression, as if he held a grudge against these soldiers.

Fortunately, these young soldiers selected by the base had unknown physical fitness but possessed exceptionally strong conviction. Even if Yi Hengxing’s orders were excessive, they would complete them with all their might.

They weren't afraid of Yi Hengxing’s whip; they were afraid of wasting the base people’s food.

The current military structure of the base was as follows:

Two central legions, directly deployed by the Base Commander-in-Chief (Xiang Nanli).

They were named Red Lion and Red Eagle, totaling thirty thousand troops.

Currently, the main task of these two central legions was land reclamation.

Some were in Salt Lake City, suppressing the old nobility and building roads and houses; others were sweeping through smaller outposts, expanding the base’s territory.

To the original masters of the outposts, this was hateful opportunism and an unprovoked disaster; but to the people at the bottom of the outposts, this was the first time they felt the gospel of "God."

Interestingly, as things developed, when the lords of small outposts heard that the base’s legions were coming, some chose to flee with their families, while others would surrender directly, abandoning their jurisdiction and joining the base. It counted as joining with assets.

Xiang Nanli accepted everything, turning no one away.

He was no longer the young boy who had just left the ivory tower and couldn't tolerate any sand in his eyes.

If he didn't accept the surrender of these people, the result would be more outpost lords resisting to the death, leading to mutual destruction. It was better to leave a position and a glimmer of hope for the "noble seeds" of the old world.

Ideology could be reformed later; the urgent priority was expansion.

After expansion, the base could better integrate resources, coordinate development, and gain a greater say in future survival battles.

Moreover, after joining the base, how people were arranged was entirely up to those at the top.

The base was expanding too fast. Xiang Nanli didn't look at the map anymore; he couldn't even name the newly added villages and towns.

The Gospel was wandering back and forth in these small outposts, teaching the working people agricultural techniques and the base’s ideology.

One must eat a meal one bite at a time, and crops must be planted one by one.

Outside the central legions were the garrison legions of different cities. There were four in total, with a full establishment of 100,000 (though currently at most twenty thousand), and the Salt City Garrison was still in preparation.

With so many legions being built, the base was naturally short of people; especially short of generals with military qualifications.

Yi Hengxing was in the first batch to receive the conscription order.

Yi Hengxing accepted the position half-willingly, with the title of "Instructor," meaning a high-level official sent by the Human Alliance to supervise the battle. But in reality, the work he did was no different from other beasts of burden and generals. From training to literacy to spiritual construction, he worried about everything.

Van Persie had been waiting to be enabled. He was yearning for it.

He had been digging sewers in the infrastructure team for two months. His original subordinates were transferred away one by one, leaving only him, still squatting in the bureau as a war criminal.

Van Persie’s mentality was no longer as calm and composed as before.

The base had a military academy that was constantly selecting local people with "clean roots," striving to cultivate them into the military talent they needed. This meant that the knowledge Van Persie possessed might no longer be scarce.

And his original troops had been broken up, distributed to various places, and reshaped into the mold of the base.

Van Persie knew that his legion was almost entirely driven by profit; it was fundamentally different from an army like the base’s, which was held together by "faith."

Van Persie had no profits to distribute to these people. And after these mercenaries joined the base, although their total income was less than before, their standard of living was not much worse. So, betrayal was a matter of course.

Over the past two months, the frequency with which his most loyal guards visited him after escaping the sea of misery had gradually decreased.

Their rhetoric had even changed from "That guy surnamed Xiang must have a use for you, Boss," to "The Commander has his own arrangements, we will help you, Old Fan... wait until the wind blows over, we will definitely get you out of the bureau."

Van Persie was anxious, helpless, and depressed. But he had long since lost the capital to negotiate.

Xiao Wang, a fellow convict, walked over happily carrying two cups of water: "Boss! Water is served, with salt and sugar added!"

The convicts in the infrastructure team came from all over. Some were war criminals, some were economic criminals, some were murderers, and some were political prisoners... Those with short sentences served half a month, while those with long sentences served hundreds of years.

The convicts wore electronic locks containing trackers and high-voltage currents, eliminating any possibility of escape.

Salt and sugar were important supplies on the surface; using them on convicts was undoubtedly a waste. In the past, the slave owners on the surface wouldn't even bear to give them to their production tools (slaves). And they, these convicts, strictly speaking, belonged to "prisoners" who had committed crimes.

The humanitarian care that the base occasionally displayed made Van Persie feel uncomfortable.

It was the kind of discomfort a rat that feared light in the shadows felt when suddenly illuminated by a strong light.

This strong light shone not only on Van Persie but also on all outsiders. Refugees, newly incorporated surface dwellers, surrendered nobles... After staying in the base for a long time, they slowly realized: So, this is how people can live.

Or rather, this is how people should live.

Any great slogan, to those who are starving, cannot compare to two steamed buns held in their hands that they can actually touch.

Van Persie sat by the sewer he had dug himself, slowly drinking the hot, salty, and sweet water, a warmth rising from his stomach.

Xiao Wang took out two more steamed buns and shoved one to Van Persie: "Boss, this is the military ration saved by Xiao Li. In their army, they get four per meal. Tsk tsk, this military pay is much higher than what we had before." The upper echelons of the refugee legions could still eat meat, the middle drank soup, and the lower levels only ate dirt.

Van Persie was a legion leader; he was one of those who ate meat. But he was also from the lower-level officer ranks and had had days of eating dirt.

His guards had also followed him, coming up from eating dirt. Theoretically, they were living a good life, but in reality, nothing had changed. They had just gone from being victims to perpetrators.

Van Persie wanted to cry, not because of being moved. It was despair and relief for the future.

The despair was that he had no hope of making a comeback, and the relief was because...

Van Persie sincerely believed that the base’s system and philosophy were superior to any surface outpost he had ever seen. He sincerely hoped that such peace could continue to be maintained.

On the nearby hillside, the soldiers were still practicing frog jumps back and forth. Suddenly, the originally orderly team became chaotic in a small area, saying the Commander had come to inspect the work in the barracks. It was a spur-of-the-moment decision.

This group of well-trained officers and soldiers risked being reprimanded just to see Xiang Nanli once.

Seeing him had no practical significance, but if they could really see him once, they would probably boast about it to their descendants until their dying day.

Van Persie watched through the iron fence as a bulletproof car drove into the barracks. Then, that young man stepped out of the car with a smile and waved to the surroundings—

The cheers were like a tsunami, shaking Van Persie’s eardrums until they hurt.

How dazzling.

Xiang Nanli was walking the most difficult, yet also the most correct, path.

The respect and love he received were the rewards for his persistence and dedication.

Van Persie dared not look anymore and fled in a panic.

The foreman was calling his name.

Van Persie trotted up to the foreman: "Team Niu, what do you need me for?"

Team Niu was not tall, his skin was dark, but he was very sturdy. On the surface, he was the supervisor of these convicts; privately, they were "honorary citizens" retired from the military, acting as the base’s smallest eyes.

He patted Van Persie on the shoulder and said meaningfully: "Someone from above is here, there’s a transfer order for you. You're going to Salt City; Legion Commander Ge Gen will return to Eternal City sooner or later... You go there, and perform well."

chunks.chineseText:
范佩西的心头骤然一颤，短暂的迷茫后是狂喜：“是！”

……

……

相南里从军营回来。一看就看到了办公室里新增的孵化装置，就搁在书桌上。

他把外套挂在衣架上，抖了抖鞋子上的积雪。大步流星地走到桌前，弯腰，观察起来。

孵化装置像一个保温箱，只是里面灌满了粘稠的半透明黄色液体。这是研究所调配的营养液，空运过来的。

爱来自相南里，配方来自东方青帝。

卵壳里，小爬行者一颤一颤的呼吸着。表层的壳裂开一条浅浅的缝，营养液和废气靠着这条缝隙交换。

相南里：“小青~它好像长大了一圈！”

东方青帝淡淡地扫过：“嗯啊。”

嗯，原本要死的胚胎二次发育。鸡蛋大小的卵现在有鸭蛋大了。

相南里给这枚卵取了名字，叫“雀雀”。

东方青帝对相南里突如其来的热情很不习惯，还有点嫉妒。

但转念一想，不过是爬宠罢了。

以西结是爬宠。

雀雀也是。

东方青帝不是。

东方青帝是智械。和人类平级。

身高一米九二，很帅，是相南里欲望投射的对象。

Alpha在内心这样做好了区分。

相南里并不知道，在自己观察雀雀的三十秒里，一边的东方青帝内心是多么的百转千回。

相南里重视这枚蛋并非心血来潮。

以西结已经证明过了，畸变人能够拥有和人相似的智力水准。

可惜，基地里的其他畸变人，只能达到“动物”的程度。族群里第二聪明的小红能从1数到8，智力和比格犬差不多。

相南里想起了猩猩实验。书上说，有名科学家尝试把一头黑猩猩当人来养，它比其他同类聪明许多，甚至产生和人类一样的情感和道德观念。

相南里决定在雀雀身上实践一下。

他还记得自己的承诺。如果可能，他更希望在其他人眼里，畸变人是同伴，而不是动物伙伴。

相南里坐在办公桌前，开始处理今天的公文。

他打开后台，加粗加亮的人联邮件就这样占据着视野正中央。

[官方通知]

致：幸存者基地（相南里）

根据[人类地下城市联盟-战争指挥部]最新战略部署，现正式通知您，务必于本通知送达之日起、 7日内抵达姑苏军事基地[定位]，参与人联地表作战计划第一次联席会议。

因故缺席或拒不出席者，一律按叛国罪处理。

人类地下城市联盟参议院副议长

战争指挥部总指挥

方敬之

签发日期：新历948年11月24日
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 160: Meeting (Part 2)

Van Persie’s heart trembled suddenly, and after a brief moment of confusion, it was followed by ecstasy: "Yes!"

...

...

Xiang Nanli returned from the barracks. As soon as he looked, he saw the new incubation device in the office, sitting right on the desk.

He hung his coat on the rack and shook the snow off his shoes. He strode to the desk, bent down, and observed it.

The incubation device looked like an incubator, only it was filled with viscous, translucent yellow liquid. This was the nutrient solution prepared by the research institute and flown in.

The love came from Xiang Nanli, the formula from Dongfang Qingdi.

Inside the eggshell, the little crawler breathed with a trembling motion. A shallow crack had opened on the surface of the shell, and nutrient solution and waste gas were exchanged through this gap.

Xiang Nanli: "Xiao Qing~ it seems to have grown a size!"

Dongfang Qingdi swept a glance over it indifferently: "Mm-hmm."

Yes, a dying embryo was undergoing secondary development. The egg, which was the size of a chicken egg, was now as big as a duck egg.

Xiang Nanli had given this egg a name: "Que Que."

Dongfang Qingdi was not used to Xiang Nanli’s sudden enthusiasm, and he was even a little jealous.

But on second thought, it was just a crawling pet.

Ezekiel was a crawling pet.

Que Que was one too.

Dongfang Qingdi was not.

Dongfang Qingdi was a machine. On par with humans.

One meter ninety-two tall, very handsome, the object of Xiang Nanli’s projection of desire.

The Alpha made this distinction in his heart.

Xiang Nanli did not know how many thoughts had raced through Dongfang Qingdi’s mind during the thirty seconds he spent observing Que Que.

Xiang Nanli’s valuing of this egg was not a whim.

Ezekiel had already proven that mutants could possess intelligence levels similar to humans.

Unfortunately, the other mutants in the base could only reach the level of "animals." Xiao Hong, the second smartest in the tribe, could count from 1 to 8, with intelligence similar to a Beagle.

Xiang Nanli remembered the chimpanzee experiment. The book said that a scientist tried to raise a chimpanzee as a human; it was much smarter than its peers and even developed emotions and moral concepts similar to humans.

Xiang Nanli decided to put this into practice with Que Que.

He still remembered his promise. If possible, he hoped that in the eyes of others, mutants would be companions, not animal pets.

Xiang Nanli sat at the desk and began to process the day’s official documents.

He opened the backend, and the bolded, highlighted Human Alliance email occupied the very center of his field of vision.

[Official Notice]

To: Survivor Base (Xiang Nanli)

According to the latest strategic deployment of the [Human Underground City Alliance - War Command], you are hereby formally notified to arrive at the Gusu Military Base [Location] within 7 days from the date of delivery of this notice to participate in the first joint meeting of the Human Alliance surface combat plan.

Those who are absent or refuse to attend for any reason will be treated as guilty of treason.

Vice Chairman of the Human Underground City Alliance Senate

Commander-in-Chief of the War Command

Fang Jingzhi

Date of Issuance: November 24, New Calendar Year 948

chunks.chapterTitle: 第161章 平平无奇相南里 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第161章 平平无奇相南里

相南里采用最朴素的方法调查起这位大佬的资料。

他打开人联的搜索引擎，输入姓名。

一张高清照片率先跳出来，更新时间是46年前。

这个男人……居然是个帅气的覆面系！

方敬之上半张脸被精巧的机械装置遮挡，外观传统复古的镜片取代他的双眼，完美隐藏所有情绪。瘦削的颏部覆盖着金属贴片，是有些旧的黄铜色。风格很蒸汽朋克。

他有一头灰白相间的头发，长度到肩，唇角紧绷。这样重工的一张脸，放在普通人身上很难不感到违和；但放在方敬之身上却没有任何不适，仿佛他贵重得理所应当。

方敬之今年131岁，出身财阀，早个七八十年，网上都调侃他是高新军工的少东家。

现在倒是没人说了。因为高新军工的董事会人员名单里早就写上他的名字。

相南里忍不住评价：“这照片放的，面具一摘都不知道是谁吧？”

“他佩戴的是嵌入式义体。”东方青帝回答，“通常情况下摘不下来。看资料，方敬之年轻时毁容过，但没有选择修复。”

察觉到相南里眼神里流露出的欣赏，东方青帝不动声色地叉掉了照片。

再翻几页，能搜到方敬之在最近十年提出的议案。

很笼统、很官方。无非是提高社会福利、居民幸福感之类的套话，能彻底实施的不多。

最新一条和他有关的新闻，由人联发布。任命方敬之为此次对神庭军事行动的总指挥，要求各大地下城市和地表据点配合。

相南里拖着腮，非常不解：“这种人级别很高，怎么就找上基地了？”

东方青帝的眼眸亮起，几秒后，回复：“群发的。”

嗯，所有位于战区的大型地表据点领袖，都收到了类似的邮件。全文只有收信人不同。

蚊子腿再小也是肉。人联不打算放过一切可利用资源。过去吃了人联那么多补助，是时候吐出来了。

战时，最好不要挑衅人联那根敏感又紧绷的神经。更何况，拿了人家的资源，的确受限于人。

相南里保证，不听话的地表据点绝对会被这位职位很多的大佬拿去立威。他可不想基地在七天后收到几发空投的快递。

不过，这也未尝不是机会。

相南里坐在椅子上舔着牛奶雪糕，突然眼前一亮。

他起身：“小青，既然这次会议战区的据点领导都会出席，那岂不是正好推销基地的农产品？！”

基地一向注重农业发展。

在研究所的多次改良下，基地动植物产量显著提升。速成菌鸡（在相南里眼中相当于变异白羽鸡）、青麦（一个月一收，除了难吃没有毛病）都有富余。另外，新品种菌笋也在水培试育中。

人联肯定是不缺粮的。但是地表其他据点就不好说了。

不是所有据点都有农业之神福音书在的。

更何况，就相南里了解。人联卖给地表的粮食，可是很贵的！

相南里认真调查过，大概是人联建立初期，大家还在盯着高精尖科技，和智械打得头破血流时，桃源牧业开始大量在地表、地底城市屯田。

智械人不需要粮食，人马星的人口又因为战争锐减。当时，尽管有人意识到粮食的重要性，却来不及让巨大而僵化的企业调转龙头。

桃源牧业出售原始股，进行社会融资，疯狂且高价地购买一切能种田的土地，又以极低的价格亏本出售营养膏、米糊，抢占食品市场；地表其他农业据点要么因为粮食卖不上价破产，要么被桃源牧业收购。

等到基本完成垄断后，桃源牧业的收割开始了。

如今，人联每年财政预算的百分之7，都会用于购买桃源牧业旗下农场生产的农作物。进行粮食战略储备，避免因自然灾害导致的饥荒。

桃源牧业总说商品卖给人联不挣钱，但每年股价都在飙升。市值比第二大企高新军工还要稳。

桃源牧业几乎不直接和地表据点交易，一方面是地表据点很分散，交易成本高；另一方面，是怕人联某一任总统突然狗急跳墙，非要来个反垄断调查，不如卖给人联，让人联官方当这个二道贩子。这样大家都能吃上肉。

卖给人联的粮食，人联再高价卖给地表。

等到地表人吃上搀着砂砾的营养膏，一场收割就完成了。

基地一直在偷偷挖人联墙角，粮食出口早就是赚外汇的重要渠道。但地表的路况，你们也是知道的.JPG；因此，没有特殊曝光，依然只在小范围流通着。

说干就干，相南里找上农业部的福音书和财务部的海狸，根据仓储和对未来粮食的预计，花一下午时间，制作出一份电子宣传册。

宣传册前面是基地的介绍，农田、牧场、农产品实验田的概述，后面就是电子订购信息。能通过宣传册小程序一键下单。

“如果要赚钱，其实最暴利的，还是生命一号基因药。”晚上，相南里检查着电子宣传册，头靠在东方青帝的肩膀上，发出一声叹息，“按照各大企业商场的价格，一瓶能协助普通人打开基因锁、成为基因战士的药剂，售价在10万信用点左右。有些宣传自己副作用小、效果好的药剂，更是能卖到上百万。”

“但是这种基因药毕竟是垄断产品。神庭那边流通的‘神药’，在人联内属于违禁药。基地也不能拿去卖，除非我想吃子弹。”

相南里随手拿起一瓶“生命一号”。

它装在简陋的玻璃安瓿瓶里，一瓶15ml。注射用。液体是有些浓郁的红色，每管药剂里，能看见一根暗红色的菌丝，缓缓旋转着。像从人体内剥下来的血管。

生命一号比起它之前的几代实验品，副作用小得多。北辰说，这是目前性价比最高的方案；再降低毒性、强化药性，付出十倍的成本，也只能提高一成的药效。

易横行观察比较过，认为这种基因药培育出的战士，能达到调查组最低等级的入职考核标准。

相南里突发奇想：“小青，你说我这种喝过基因药的，再喝生命一号有用吗？”

Alpha的目光落在他的脸上。

相南里服用过基因药，人联制造。是东方青帝赢来的战利品。

但很可惜，大量基因药只是增强了相南里的身体素质，并没有把他催熟成一名基因战士。如果是在解冻前，相南里甚至能去参加奥运会，破纪录拿几块金牌。

相南里没有感觉到身体里“基因锁”的存在。更别提什么“解开基因锁，成为新人类”。

毕竟是“基因”战士，能不能成为战士，还要看基因合不合适。

人联的基因药适配百分之九十九的人类，但总有百分之一的少数派。

如果相南里出生在大家族，并且有一对父母位高权重，那么会有专门的科研团队，不计代价地为他定制基因药。

### Chapter 161: The Unremarkable Xiang Nanli (Part 1)

Xiang Nanli employed the most rudimentary method to investigate the background of this big shot.

He opened the Human Alliance’s search engine and typed in the name.

A high-definition photo popped up first, last updated 46 years ago.

This man... was actually a handsome masked type!

Fang Jingzhi’s upper face was obscured by an intricate mechanical device, with traditional, retro-style lenses replacing his eyes, perfectly concealing all emotion. His lean chin was covered by metal plating in a somewhat aged brass color. The style was quite steampunk.

He had gray and white hair reaching his shoulders, his lips pressed into a tight line. Such a heavy-industrial face would look jarring on an ordinary person, yet on Fang Jingzhi, it felt entirely natural, as if his preciousness were a matter of course.

Fang Jingzhi was 131 years old and hailed from a conglomerate family. Seventy or eighty years ago, people online used to joke that he was the young master of Gaoxin Military Industry.

No one said that anymore, though, because his name had long since been inscribed on the board of directors at Gaoxin Military Industry.

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but comment, "With a photo like this, if he took off the mask, would anyone even know who he is?"

"He is wearing embedded prosthetics," Dongfang Qingdi replied. "Under normal circumstances, they cannot be removed. According to the records, Fang Jingzhi was disfigured in his youth but chose not to undergo repairs."

Noticing the flicker of admiration in Xiang Nanli’s eyes, Dongfang Qingdi calmly closed the photo.

Flipping through a few more pages, one could find the motions Fang Jingzhi had proposed over the last decade.

They were very general, very official—nothing more than empty rhetoric about improving social welfare and resident happiness, with little that could be thoroughly implemented.

The latest news concerning him was released by the Human Alliance: appointing Fang Jingzhi as the commander-in-chief for the current military operation against the Divine Court, requiring all major underground cities and surface strongholds to cooperate.

Xiang Nanli rested his chin on his hand, deeply puzzled: "A person of this level—why would he reach out to our base?"

Dongfang Qingdi’s eyes lit up, and a few seconds later, he replied, "It was a mass mailing."

Indeed, all leaders of large surface strongholds located in the war zone had received similar emails. The entire text was identical, save for the recipient's name.

Even a mosquito's leg has meat on it. The Human Alliance didn't intend to let any usable resource go to waste. Having consumed so many subsidies from the Alliance in the past, it was time to cough them up.

During wartime, it was best not to provoke the sensitive and taut nerves of the Human Alliance. Moreover, having taken their resources, one was indeed beholden to them.

Xiang Nanli could guarantee that any disobedient surface stronghold would definitely be used by this high-ranking big shot to make an example of them. He certainly didn't want the base to receive a few "air-dropped packages" seven days later.

However, this was not necessarily a bad opportunity.

Sitting in his chair and licking a milk popsicle, Xiang Nanli’s eyes suddenly brightened.

He stood up: "Xiao Qing, since the leaders of all the strongholds in the war zone will be attending this meeting, wouldn't that be the perfect time to promote our base's agricultural products?!"

The base had always prioritized agricultural development.

Under the repeated improvements of the research institute, the base’s plant and animal yields had increased significantly. There was a surplus of fast-growing fungus-chickens (which, in Xiang Nanli’s eyes, were equivalent to mutated white-feathered chickens) and green wheat (harvested once a month, with no flaws other than tasting terrible). Additionally, a new variety of fungus-bamboo shoots was also in the trial stage of hydroponic cultivation.

The Human Alliance certainly wasn't short on food, but the same couldn't be said for other surface strongholds.

Not every stronghold had the *Gospel of the God of Agriculture*.

Moreover, as far as Xiang Nanli knew, the grain the Human Alliance sold to the surface was very expensive!

Xiang Nanli had investigated it thoroughly. Around the time the Human Alliance was founded, while everyone else was fixated on high-end technology and fighting tooth and nail against the Intelligent Machines, Taoyuan Animal Husbandry began mass-cultivating land in surface and underground cities.

Intelligent Machines didn't need food, and the population of the Centaur star system had plummeted due to the war. At the time, even though some realized the importance of food, they couldn't get the massive, rigid corporations to pivot.

Taoyuan Animal Husbandry sold original shares, conducted social financing, and frantically bought up every piece of land that could be farmed at high prices. Then, they sold nutrient paste and rice flour at extremely low, loss-making prices to seize the food market. Other agricultural strongholds on the surface either went bankrupt because they couldn't sell their grain at a profit, or were acquired by Taoyuan.

Once the monopoly was basically complete, Taoyuan’s harvest began.

Today, seven percent of the Human Alliance’s annual fiscal budget was spent on purchasing crops produced by Taoyuan’s farms for strategic grain reserves, to avoid famine caused by natural disasters.

Taoyuan always claimed that selling goods to the Alliance wasn't profitable, yet their stock price soared every year. Their market value was even more stable than the second-largest enterprise, Gaoxin Military Industry.

Taoyuan rarely traded directly with surface strongholds. On one hand, surface strongholds were scattered, making transaction costs high; on the other, they feared that some future president of the Alliance might suddenly get desperate and insist on an anti-monopoly investigation. It was better to sell to the Alliance and let the official government act as the middleman. That way, everyone could have meat to eat.

The grain sold to the Alliance was then sold by the Alliance to the surface at a high price.

By the time the people on the surface ate nutrient paste mixed with grit, the harvest was complete.

The base had been secretly undermining the Alliance for a long time, and grain exports had long been an important channel for earning foreign currency. But as for the road conditions on the surface, well, you know... .JPG; therefore, without special exposure, it still only circulated in small circles.

Action followed thought. Xiang Nanli sought out the *Gospel* from the Ministry of Agriculture and Beaver from the Finance Department. Based on storage and future grain projections, they spent an afternoon creating an electronic brochure.

The front of the brochure was an introduction to the base, an overview of the farmlands, pastures, and experimental fields, and the back contained electronic ordering information. One could place an order with a single click via the brochure’s mini-program.

"If we want to make money, the most profitable thing is actually the 'Life No. 1' genetic medicine," Xiang Nanli said that evening, checking the electronic brochure while resting his head on Dongfang Qingdi’s shoulder with a sigh. "According to the prices in major corporate malls, a single vial of medicine that helps ordinary people unlock their genetic locks and become genetic warriors sells for about 100,000 credits. Some medicines that claim to have fewer side effects and better results can even sell for millions."

"But this kind of genetic medicine is a monopoly product. The 'divine medicine' circulating in the Divine Court is considered contraband within the Alliance. The base can't sell it either, unless I want to eat bullets."

Xiang Nanli picked up a vial of "Life No. 1."

It was packed in a crude glass ampoule, 15ml per vial, for injection. The liquid was a somewhat rich red, and in each tube, one could see a dark red mycelium slowly rotating, like a blood vessel stripped from a human body.

Compared to its previous generations of experimental products, Life No. 1 had much milder side effects. Beichen said this was currently the most cost-effective solution; to further reduce toxicity and strengthen the medicinal effect would cost ten times as much, yet only increase efficacy by ten percent.

Yi Hengxing had observed and compared them, believing that warriors cultivated with this genetic medicine could reach the minimum entry-level assessment standards for the investigation team.

Xiang Nanli had a sudden whim: "Xiao Qing, do you think it would be useful for someone like me, who has already taken genetic medicine, to take Life No. 1?"

The Alpha’s gaze fell on his face.

Xiang Nanli had taken genetic medicine—manufactured by the Human Alliance. It was a trophy Dongfang Qingdi had won.

But unfortunately, the large amount of genetic medicine only enhanced Xiang Nanli’s physical fitness; it did not ripen him into a genetic warrior. If it were before the thaw, Xiang Nanli could have even participated in the Olympics and broken records to win a few gold medals.

Xiang Nanli did not feel the existence of a "genetic lock" in his body, let alone anything about "unlocking the genetic lock to become a new human."

After all, they were "genetic" warriors; whether one could become a warrior depended on whether the genes were compatible.

The Alliance’s genetic medicine was compatible with 99% of humans, but there was always that 1% minority.

If Xiang Nanli had been born into a great family with parents in high positions, there would have been a dedicated research team to customize genetic medicine for him at any cost.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第161章 平平无奇相南里 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
Alpha也能给他定制，一句话的事。反正军团研发部的智械因为科技树停滞，不是在休眠就是改行当特工（试图潜入人类社会学习新知识，盗取人联企业最新研究成果、充实自身数据库），已经很久没活干了。

然而话到嘴边，东方青帝却缓缓咽回去。

又来了。奇怪的不安感。

为什么，是担心相南里强大后，脱离自己的掌控吗？还是担心相南里的基因泄露，在实验室里孵出一个又一个相似的半成品？

Alpha试图分析这股情绪的来源，在后台得到一长串的“error”。

相南里会有这种焦虑吗？

他会像我担心他一样担心我吗？

Alpha：“你不用执着于成为基因战士。每次解开基因锁都是对本体的巨大消耗，我认为没有必要执着于基因锁。你看葛根还有赤夫这些人，他们寿命注定不会太长。你的身体强度已经足够驾驭现有的机械装置。”

然而在他说话的时候，相南里已经敲开一个安瓿瓶。

相南里拿出注射器，和东方青帝对视。眼神并不严厉，也不是在安抚，很清澈，也很无辜。

相南里并不知道他的忧虑，他有自己的考量，并且很少因为外人而改变。

他需要力量。尤其是在战时。

“小青~”相南里说话，尾调上扬，鼻音也很明显，“我问过玛门。如果没有这一步，很多‘神术’无法使用。而且马上要去姑苏军事基地。我认为，哪怕只是销售农产品，不够强大的领主也会让人轻视。”

气氛略显冷酷。

两人的目光在半空对视。相南里的眼神很平静。

他并没有在征求东方青帝同意，而是通知。Alpha大可以拿出更好的方案，让他放弃这个决策。但改变的只有过程，相南里不会放弃最终的目标。

最终，Alpha选择屈服。

东方青帝接过注射器，抽取、消毒、找到相南里手腕上的动脉、注射；动作行云流水、一气呵成。

他看着暗红的液体缓缓推入相南里的体内，愤愤的心情在说出口的瞬间变成无奈：“有时候我怀疑你在虐待我。”

相南里忍不住笑，却没有对这句话作出任何的回应和解读。

药效很快发生作用。

灼热感从手臂向着躯干蔓延，注射进体内的菌丝存在感异常强烈。

它像活物似的，顺着动脉在相南里的体内游动。想为自己寻找着一个合适的栖息地……

但是。

菌丝游动的速度越来越慢，还算饱满的身体逐步萎缩……

生命1号培育基因战士的逻辑，是寄生。

安瓿瓶里的菌丝提取自母体，能把宿主改造成有轻微变异的“菌丝人”，从而获得强大的生命力。

一般情况是母体寄生。作为畸变生物，它在进化上的优先级，是人类的好几倍。但是，菌丝进入相南里体内，却像是某种营养物质一样，被消化分解了。

他妈的，相南里有毒。

相南里并不知道基因药在身体内的奇妙变化，他的体温略微升高，很快困得睁不开眼，甚至没有等到平时的入睡时间，就昏昏沉沉地睡去。

醒来，相南里只觉得神清气爽，除此外，他的身体没有任何变化。

看来他是当不了菌丝人了。生命一号覆盖的基因范围，也在人联基因药的百分之九十九以内。不知道能不能通过玛门，走私一瓶神庭的基因药。

难道他这辈子注定当个不能进化的普通人类？！

不过，相南里对未来还算乐观。不能进化就不能吧，反正现在也不弱。他还有一颗堪比天灾机械的大脑！

相南里活力满满地起床。又一次确认没有重要东西忘带后，他在清晨，坐上开往姑苏军事基地的电车。

和东方青帝一起。
