### Chapter 161: The Unremarkable Xiang Nanli (Part 2)

An Alpha could also customize it for him; it would be a matter of a single word. In any case, the Intelligent Machines in the Legion’s R&D department, due to the stagnation of their tech tree, were either in hibernation or had changed careers to become secret agents (attempting to infiltrate human society to learn new knowledge, steal the latest research results from Alliance enterprises, and enrich their own databases). They hadn't had real work in a long time.

However, the words reached the tip of his tongue, and Dongfang Qingdi slowly swallowed them back.

There it was again. That strange sense of unease.

Why? Was it fear that once Xiang Nanli became powerful, he would slip out of his control? Or was it fear that Xiang Nanli’s genetic information would leak, leading to the incubation of one similar semi-finished product after another in a laboratory?

The Alpha attempted to analyze the source of this emotion, only to receive a long string of "errors" in the background.

Would Xiang Nanli have this kind of anxiety?

Would he worry about me the way I worry about him?

Alpha: "You don't need to be obsessed with becoming a genetic warrior. Every time a genetic lock is unlocked, it is a huge drain on the body. I don't think there is any need to be fixated on it. Look at people like Gegen and Chifu; their lifespans are destined to be short. Your physical strength is already sufficient to handle existing mechanical devices."

However, while he was speaking, Xiang Nanli had already cracked open an ampoule.

Xiang Nanli took out the syringe and met Dongfang Qingdi’s eyes. His gaze wasn't stern, nor was it meant to soothe; it was very clear and very innocent.

Xiang Nanli didn't know about his worries. He had his own considerations, and he rarely changed them because of outsiders.

He needed power. Especially in wartime.

"Xiao Qing~" Xiang Nanli said, the tail of his voice rising, his nasal tone quite distinct. "I’ve asked Mammon. Without this step, many 'divine arts' cannot be used. And we are going to the Gusu Military Base soon. I believe that even if it's just to sell agricultural products, a leader who isn't strong enough will be looked down upon."

The atmosphere turned slightly cold.

The two pairs of eyes met in mid-air. Xiang Nanli’s gaze was very calm.

He wasn't asking for Dongfang Qingdi’s consent; he was informing him. The Alpha could have come up with a better plan to make him abandon this decision, but only the process would change; Xiang Nanli would not abandon the final goal.

In the end, the Alpha chose to yield.

Dongfang Qingdi took the syringe, drew the liquid, sterilized the area, found the artery on Xiang Nanli’s wrist, and injected it; his movements were fluid and completed in one go.

He watched the dark red liquid slowly push into Xiang Nanli’s body, his indignant mood turning into helplessness the moment he spoke: "Sometimes I suspect you are abusing me."

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but laugh, though he didn't respond or interpret the remark.

The medicinal effect took hold quickly.

A burning sensation spread from his arm toward his torso, and the mycelium injected into his body had an unusually strong presence.

It was like a living creature, swimming through Xiang Nanli’s body along the arteries, trying to find a suitable habitat for itself...

But.

The speed of the mycelium’s movement grew slower and slower, and its once-plump body gradually withered...

The logic behind Life No. 1 cultivating genetic warriors was parasitism.

The mycelium in the ampoule was extracted from a host, capable of transforming the subject into a slightly mutated "mycelium-human," thereby gaining powerful vitality.

Under normal circumstances, the host would parasitize the subject. As an aberrant organism, its priority in evolution was several times higher than that of a human. However, as the mycelium entered Xiang Nanli’s body, it was digested and broken down as if it were some sort of nutrient.

Damn it, Xiang Nanli was toxic.

Xiang Nanli didn't know about the miraculous changes the genetic medicine was undergoing in his body. His body temperature rose slightly, and soon he was too sleepy to keep his eyes open. He didn't even wait for his usual bedtime before falling into a deep, drowsy slumber.

When he woke up, Xiang Nanli only felt refreshed; other than that, there were no changes to his body.

It seemed he wasn't destined to be a mycelium-human. The genetic range covered by Life No. 1 was also within the 99% covered by the Alliance’s genetic medicine. He wondered if he could smuggle a vial of the Divine Court’s genetic medicine through Mammon.

Was he destined to be an ordinary human who couldn't evolve for the rest of his life?!

However, Xiang Nanli was still optimistic about the future. If he couldn't evolve, so be it; he wasn't weak as it was. He still had a brain comparable to a disaster-level machine!

Xiang Nanli got up full of energy. After confirming once more that he hadn't forgotten anything important, he boarded the electric train to the Gusu Military Base in the early morning.

Together with Dongfang Qingdi.

chunks.chineseText:
第162章 主人的任务

相南里说出发去姑苏，那就是嘴皮子上下一张；剩下全是小青在操持，十分贤夫良父。

都说一个家里没有丈夫，就像是鱼没有自行车。

坏了，相南里看着在家里忙前忙后的Alpha，心想，我成自行车了。

一辆小小的SUV，硬是被改造成双层结构。车顶装着可能会用到的工具，譬如炉子、千斤顶、帐篷；后备箱里是相南里的衣服、工具、常备药，以及路上做饭会用的食材和佐料。不知道的还以为是新婚夫妻出去露营。

“咱们路上还会停下来看风景？”相南里看着帐篷，乐了，“要不要带个鱼竿啊，看地图，路上还有几条河呢。”

东方青帝神色严肃：“以防万一。”这些物资能保证车即使突然爆炸，相南里也能在野外有质量地存活下去。

倒不是他有被害妄想症。主要是不知道明天和洛阳谁先到来。

地表的冬天又来了，动辄零下四十度的天气，不知道要冻死多少人和动物。

车外在下雪。暴雪。

行驶到半夜，轮胎换成了喷气式的。氢气燃烧时幽幽的蓝光在夜里亮着。

极端天气，附近又没有大型据点和信号塔。相南里过上了解冻以来难得的悠闲假期。

可惜他是个闲不住的，没网也要看看电子书，上一本《神经网络接入虚拟空间原理详解（教程）》已经看完了，相南里想起自己炸了的接入舱，心想等到姑苏改天给自己做一个得了。

这钱，不想让永生科技赚了。它家的客服是真烂啊，一股傲慢的味道。

虽然它家就是我家。不过，现在已经是洛阳家的了。

洛阳……

洛阳的事，相南里没有细问。

他们朝夕相处了二十年。可以说，在上一世，洛阳在他心里的地位远超自己父母，在父母去世后，几乎是他在人类社会里唯一的亲密关系。

而且洛阳性格好到离谱，几乎和宠物一样温顺，长得好看，又爱笑。他实在没办法把洛阳和Alpha嘴里的人联系在一起。

就像他当初也不愿意相信Alpha就是人联描述中的那个“机械暴君”一样。

但情商再低。相南里也隐约明白，他不能在Alpha面前流露出自己的真实想法。

说了会怎么样呢？委屈到流眼泪吗。

相南里被自己的想法逗笑了。

相南里舒舒服服地躺在后车厢，很宽敞。单人床边的小餐桌上摆着小青泡的红茶。被窝里很暖和，四下无人，恐怖的暴风雪中，白天也伸手不见五指，周围寂静得像世界末日。

世界末日。但是他和最喜欢的Alpha一起流浪。

相南里被这个念头浪漫到了，可惜他是理工直男，擅长行动，匮乏语言。

他去勾小青戴着能源环的食指，光环套在Alpha手上，像戒指。

东方青帝睁开眼，目光看向他，睫毛长得能架火柴。这台智械从骨相到皮相，没有一点瑕疵，简直完美。按照他最喜欢的样子长的。

相南里顺着他的手往上捏。手腕，胳膊，脖子。最后几乎骑到Alpha身上。

好想……

相南里感觉自己心里痒痒的。

好想拆卸他啊。

他们对视，东方青帝看见了他眼神里的渴望。如此热烈，简直像开了窍。

Alpha也很渴望，但是他们渴望的似乎不是同一个东西。

东方青帝捏了捏他的耳朵：“不能拆。”

“噢。”相南里很失望。

“没有工具。”东方青帝补充，“我会坏掉的。里里。”

然后Alpha就察觉到相南里身体上的一点变化。

畜生啊。怎么还硬了。

相南里总算知道为什么农耕社会，女性大比例地在冬天怀孕了。

天气不好，外出不便又没田种；只能在家玩对象。

玩到第三天，离姑苏还差80公里，相南里憋不住，推了推东方青帝的胳膊：“小青，我想上网。”

全世界都可能断网，但Alpha不会。

Alpha掉线的概率和人马星自爆概率差不多大。

相南里希望他能打开热点，他已经三天没有上班了！很急。

东方青帝既不同意也不反对：“我知道，你是嫌和我呆在一起无聊了。”

相南里：“……”

见鬼，Alpha怎么越来越像人了。

他是不可能知道Alpha看了一整晚《下堂智械夫》的！

（注：人联300年前爆火的情景短剧，讲的是地表人在垃圾场捡到一台智械后的虐恋故事，智械为主角付出最后一个零件后自毁身亡，留下主角在300平的洛阳城大平层里抱着替身智械痛哭。疑似人类廉价营养膏中毒后的最终幻想。）

智械的程序如此稳定；人类又如此喜新厌旧。

小青冷不丁地蹦出一句：“你昨晚还看了永生科技最新款爱偶机器人的离线广告三十秒。就在我进入待机模式后。当然，我不是说你不能看，毕竟你想买什么是你的自由，我也不是要限制你，你不喜欢控制欲太强的人我知道。只是我认为现在工作的重心是生存。”

那款爱偶机器人用的是人联最近爆火的一个虚拟偶像的外观。

叫什么觅风来着。外观很可爱。

挺耳熟的。这个念头在东方青帝脑海里划过，很快就忘记了。

毕竟这只是他们play里的一环。

相南里一个激灵：“那是APP的摇一摇广告！我没会员，屏蔽不了。”

东方青帝低着头看他，眼眸在不亮瞳环时是银灰色的。像玻璃珠子，幽幽的，很冷。有股非人感，不是机械质地的非人感，像鬼。

“亲我一下。”Alpha说，“给你开。”

相南里承认，他被Alpha的小花招勾引到了。

他轻轻碰了一下东方青帝的脸侧，Alpha问：“我们不是恋人吗？为什么不亲嘴。”

相南里又去吻他，东方青帝低头配合他，像引颈受戮。

唇贴在一起，又分开。

“够了吗？”

“不够。”

相南里又去亲他，撬开唇，交换津液。

正常来说智械没有唾液，但相南里尝到了带着甜味的液体，味道很熟悉，似乎是营养液？也不知道是怎么来的。

以后偷偷换成药相南里都察觉不到。

相南里脸红透了，尤其是看见唇分开时，黏黏糊糊的银丝在舌尖拉扯很长，半响才断开。

他问：“够了吗……？”

东方青帝没有回答，而是抬起手，擦干净相南里的唇角。比起擦拭，更像是用拇指把水迹抹匀。

我要你像我爱你一样爱我。

但我知道这不可能，所以永远不够。

但是Alpha还是把网打开了。毕竟这是主♂人的任♂务。

*

姑苏军事基地。

这是一座高度现代化的城市。不分白天黑夜的灯火通明。军事基地建在高低起伏的山区。运输轨道像一把把钢刀，切割着天空；巨大的铁匣子就挂在半空，负责运输物资和人。无人机也在其中穿梭着。
chunks.englishText:
### Chapter 162: The Master's Task (Part 1)

When Xiang Nanli said they were setting off for Gusu, it was just a flick of his lips; everything else was handled by Xiao Qing, who was a very virtuous husband and father.

They say a home without a husband is like a fish without a bicycle.

Oh no, Xiang Nanli thought, watching the Alpha bustling about the house, I’ve become the bicycle.

A small SUV had been forcibly modified into a two-story structure. The roof was loaded with tools that might be needed, such as a stove, a jack, and a tent; the trunk contained Xiang Nanli’s clothes, tools, common medicines, and the ingredients and seasonings for cooking on the road. Anyone who didn't know better would think it was a newlywed couple going camping.

"Are we going to stop and look at the scenery on the way?" Xiang Nanli looked at the tent and chuckled. "Should we bring a fishing rod? Looking at the map, there are a few rivers on the way."

Dongfang Qingdi’s expression was serious: "Just in case." These supplies could ensure that even if the car suddenly exploded, Xiang Nanli could still survive with quality in the wilderness.

It wasn't that he had persecution mania. It was mainly because he didn't know whether tomorrow or Luoyang would arrive first.

Winter on the surface had returned, with temperatures frequently hitting minus forty degrees; no one knew how many people and animals would freeze to death.

It was snowing outside the car. A blizzard.

By midnight, the tires had been switched to jet-powered ones. The faint blue light of burning hydrogen glowed in the night.

In the extreme weather, with no large strongholds or signal towers nearby, Xiang Nanli enjoyed a rare, leisurely vacation since the thaw.

It was a pity that he was someone who couldn't stay idle. Even without internet, he had to read e-books. He had already finished *Detailed Explanation of Neural Network Access to Virtual Space Principles (Tutorial)*, and Xiang Nanli remembered his exploded access pod, thinking he might as well make one for himself when he got to Gusu.

He didn't want to let Eternal Technology earn this money. Their customer service was truly rotten, with a distinct air of arrogance.

Although their company was technically his company. But now, it was Luoyang’s.

Luoyang...

Xiang Nanli didn't ask for details about Luoyang.

They had spent twenty years together, day and night. It could be said that in his previous life, Luoyang’s status in his heart far exceeded that of his own parents. After his parents passed away, he was almost the only intimate relationship he had in human society.

Moreover, Luoyang’s personality was ridiculously good; he was almost as docile as a pet, good-looking, and loved to smile. He really couldn't connect Luoyang with the person the Alpha described.

Just as he hadn't been willing to believe that the Alpha was the "Mechanical Tyrant" described by the Human Alliance back then.

But no matter how low his emotional intelligence was, Xiang Nanli vaguely understood that he couldn't reveal his true thoughts in front of the Alpha.

What would happen if he said it? Would he be so aggrieved he’d cry?

Xiang Nanli was amused by his own thought.

Xiang Nanli lay comfortably in the back of the car; it was very spacious. On the small dining table beside the single bed sat the black tea Xiao Qing had brewed. It was warm under the covers, and with no one around, in the terrifying blizzard, even during the day, one couldn't see their own fingers. The surroundings were as silent as the end of the world.

The end of the world. But he was wandering with his favorite Alpha.

Xiang Nanli was romanticized by this thought, but unfortunately, he was a straight-laced STEM major—proficient in action, but lacking in language.

He went to hook the index finger of Xiao Qing’s hand, which wore an energy ring. The halo on the Alpha’s hand looked like a ring.

Dongfang Qingdi opened his eyes and looked at him, his eyelashes long enough to hold a matchstick. From bone structure to skin, this Intelligent Machine had no flaws; he was simply perfect. He had grown into the exact image he liked most.

Xiang Nanli followed his hand and pinched upward. Wrist, arm, neck. Finally, he was almost riding on top of the Alpha.

I want to...

Xiang Nanli felt an itch in his heart.

I really want to dismantle him.

They looked at each other, and Dongfang Qingdi saw the longing in his eyes. It was so intense, it was as if he had suddenly figured something out.

The Alpha was also longing, but they didn't seem to be longing for the same thing.

Dongfang Qingdi pinched his ear: "Can't dismantle."

"Oh." Xiang Nanli was very disappointed.

"No tools," Dongfang Qingdi added. "I will break. Lili."

Then the Alpha noticed a slight change in Xiang Nanli’s body.

What a beast. How was he already hard?

Xiang Nanli finally understood why, in agricultural societies, women had a high percentage of pregnancies in the winter.

The weather was bad, it was inconvenient to go out, and there were no fields to farm; they could only play with their partners at home.

By the third day, with 80 kilometers left to Gusu, Xiang Nanli couldn't hold back anymore. He pushed Dongfang Qingdi’s arm: "Xiao Qing, I want to go online."

The whole world might lose internet, but the Alpha wouldn't.

The probability of the Alpha going offline was about the same as the probability of the Centaur star system self-destructing.

Xiang Nanli hoped he could turn on a hotspot; he hadn't been to work for three days! It was urgent.

Dongfang Qingdi neither agreed nor disagreed: "I know, you’re bored of staying with me."

Xiang Nanli: "..."

Damn it, how was the Alpha becoming more and more like a human?

There was no way he could know that the Alpha had spent the whole night watching *The Cast-off Intelligent Machine Husband*!

(Note: A hit short drama from 300 years ago in the Human Alliance, telling a tragic love story about a surface dweller who picked up an Intelligent Machine in a junkyard. The Intelligent Machine self-destructed after giving his last part to the protagonist, leaving the protagonist to weep while clutching a substitute machine in a 300-square-meter luxury apartment in Luoyang City. Suspected to be a hallucination after consuming cheap human nutrient paste.)

The Intelligent Machine’s programming was so stable; humans were so fickle.

Xiao Qing suddenly blurted out: "You also watched thirty seconds of an offline ad for Eternal Technology’s latest 'Love Doll' robot last night. Right after I entered standby mode. Of course, I’m not saying you can’t watch it; after all, it’s your freedom to buy what you want, and I’m not trying to restrict you. I know you don't like people with too much desire for control. I just think the focus of our work right now is survival."

That "Love Doll" robot used the appearance of a virtual idol who had recently become a hit in the Alliance.

What was her name? Mifeng? She looked very cute.

It sounded familiar. This thought flashed through Dongfang Qingdi’s mind, but he quickly forgot it.

After all, it was just a part of their play.

Xiang Nanli was startled: "That was an 'app shake' ad! I don't have a membership, I can't block it."

Dongfang Qingdi looked down at him. His eyes were silver-gray when the pupil ring wasn't lit. They were like glass beads, eerie and cold. There was a sense of the non-human—not a mechanical non-human, but like a ghost.

"Kiss me," the Alpha said. "I’ll turn it on for you."

Xiang Nanli admitted he was seduced by the Alpha’s little tricks.

He lightly touched the side of Dongfang Qingdi’s face, and the Alpha asked: "Aren't we lovers? Why don't we kiss on the lips?"

Xiang Nanli went to kiss him again, and Dongfang Qingdi lowered his head to cooperate, like a neck offered to the blade.

Lips pressed together, then parted.

"Is that enough?"

"Not enough."

Xiang Nanli kissed him again, prying his lips open to exchange saliva.

Normally, Intelligent Machines didn't have saliva, but Xiang Nanli tasted a sweet liquid. The taste was very familiar; it seemed to be nutrient solution? He didn't know where it came from.

If he secretly switched it to medicine in the future, Xiang Nanli wouldn't even notice.

Xiang Nanli’s face was flushed red, especially when he saw the sticky silver thread stretching long between their tongues as their lips parted, only breaking after a long moment.

He asked: "Is it enough...?"

Dongfang Qingdi didn't answer, but instead raised his hand and wiped the corner of Xiang Nanli’s mouth. Rather than wiping, it was more like using his thumb to smooth out the moisture.

I want you to love me as much as I love you.

But I know that’s impossible, so it will never be enough.

However, the Alpha still turned on the internet. After all, this was the master's task.

*

Gusu Military Base.

This was a highly modernized city, brightly lit regardless of day or night. The military base was built in the undulating mountains. Transport tracks cut through the sky like steel blades; huge iron boxes hung in mid-air, responsible for transporting supplies and people. Drones also shuttled among them.

chunks.chineseText:
地上还有一口口漂亮的人造湖。听说一口气造了36个。姑苏城天灾中幸存的居民，也在这里成功安家。（注：房子还是需要自己买，但有人联银行特批的低息贷款）。

很难想象，就在三个月前，这里还是一片荒地。

更难想象，就在三百公里外，那里的住民还过着刀耕火种看天吃饭的原始农耕生活。

哪怕解冻三年，人联的科技和财力还是超乎相南里的想象。或许是因为他大半时间都在地表的缘故。

“奥丁城……”相南里从车里探出头，幽幽道，“离这里只有20公里，地价该涨飞了吧。”可恶，这种好事，果然没有轮到基地！

军事基地笼罩在一片半透明的光罩下。是最近才打开的屏蔽装置。原理不详，作用类似于互联网防火墙和物理保护罩。

相南里跟着车流，排队进城。安检入口是一扇巨大的铁门，没有看见人类，上面有标签，贴着“18”，一排排激光瞄准枪对准着他们这些外地人；姑苏军事基地一共有23个入口。

排了四十分钟，终于轮到他。

相南里把车开进安检口，里面是黑匣子一样的密闭空间，入口的门在背后关上。感觉像进了没有光的电梯。

察觉到相南里的不安，东方青帝在黑暗中握紧相南里的手。

头顶响起电子音：“扫描中，请稍等。请确定内置AI处于开机状态。”

“身份确认中。公民IDQ117-XJDHANSHJK。认证通过，欢迎来到姑苏军事基地，相南里。”

“检测到您的外交通行证，已免除入城税5000信用点，呼吸费享8折折扣。您的临时住址为姑苏宾馆311室，请勿在军事基地内随意走动，等待会议通知。”

等等？怎么又有呼吸费了？！

相南里已经不是当初一穷二白的解冻人了！

但是看着每秒-0.016的呼吸费，还是感觉到肉疼。

一个定位点塞进相南里的脑海，甚至都不需要他本人同意。

理论上，他用的是人联的内置AI，人联才享有最高权限，而不是AI的主人。

但他的内置AI属于被智械军团的木马控制了。

木马病毒还是Alpha本人。

检测通过后，铁门前方打开。姑苏军事基地的内部，就这样出现在相南里面前。

基地内部比外面看起来还要气派。尽管是新城，路上却有不少机器人和人。

机器人充当着清洁工、防卫军、交通警察。大多数只是仿人类结构，没有真正的血肉。身上刻着不同公司的标记。

根据相南里观察。路上，至少有七成的机器人，都是高新军工产的。剩下三成来自永生科技。

相南里猜测，这是因为姑苏目前的最高统帅，是高新军工董事。方敬之嘛。

高新军工在这次战争里，肯定也出力最多。就是不知道能不能如愿发一笔战争财。

那是另一个层面的扳手腕了，不是相南里该考虑的事。

他来到导航定位的姑苏宾馆，办理入住。这里专门接待外宾，占地面积很大，简直是一个生态公园。旁边就是姑苏临时政府大楼。

人联派来的高级干部也住在这。但和他们不在同一栋楼。

相南里第六天晚上才到。他怀疑是Alpha故意拖延，但没证据。

第七天，联合战略会议还没开，一条战时新闻先投递到他的电子设备里。

说的是战区一个地表据点，叫“丹林谷”，人口两百万，那里的领导人和神庭勾结。

所以军事基地空投了一枚小导弹，把丹林谷炸了。

相南里早起，喝着宾馆餐厅的咖啡，忍不住摸了摸后脖颈。

“立威啊……”

杀鸡给猴看，幸亏他不是那只鸡。
chunks.englishText:
There were also beautiful artificial lakes scattered across the ground. It was said that thirty-six of them had been constructed in one go. The survivors of the Gusu City natural disaster had also successfully settled down here. (Note: They still had to purchase their own homes, though the United Federation Bank had granted special low-interest loans.)

It was hard to imagine that just three months ago, this place had been nothing but a wasteland.

It was even harder to imagine that just three hundred kilometers away, the inhabitants were still living a primitive, agrarian life, relying on slash-and-burn farming and the whims of the weather.

Even after three years of thawing, the technology and financial resources of the United Federation still exceeded Xiang Nanli’s imagination. Perhaps it was because he had spent most of his time on the surface.

"Odin City..." Xiang Nanli leaned out of the vehicle, his voice drifting. "It’s only 20 kilometers away from here; the land prices must have skyrocketed." Damn it, such a good opportunity, and it really hadn't fallen to his base!

The military base was shrouded under a translucent energy shield. It was a jamming device that had only been activated recently. Its principles were unknown, but its function was similar to an internet firewall combined with a physical protective barrier.

Xiang Nanli followed the flow of traffic, queuing to enter the city. The security checkpoint was a massive iron gate. He saw no humans; instead, there were labels marked "18," and rows of laser-targeting guns were aimed at them—the outsiders. The Gusu Military Base had a total of 23 such entrances.

After waiting for forty minutes, it was finally his turn.

Xiang Nanli drove into the checkpoint. Inside was a sealed space like a black box, and the entrance gate closed behind him. It felt like stepping into an elevator without lights.

Sensing Xiang Nanli’s unease, Dongfang Qingdi gripped his hand tightly in the darkness.

An electronic voice sounded overhead: "Scanning, please wait. Please confirm that your built-in AI is powered on."

"Identity verification in progress. Citizen ID Q117-XJDHANSHJK. Authentication passed. Welcome to Gusu Military Base, Xiang Nanli."

"Detected your diplomatic pass. Entry tax of 5,000 credits has been waived, and you are entitled to a 20% discount on air-breathing fees. Your temporary address is Room 311 of the Gusu Hotel. Please do not wander around the military base at will; await further notification regarding the meeting."

Wait? Why was there an air-breathing fee again?!

Xiang Nanli was no longer the penniless, newly-thawed person he once was!

But looking at the -0.016 credits per second for the breathing fee, he still felt a sting in his heart.

A location marker was shoved into Xiang Nanli’s mind, without even requiring his consent.

Theoretically, he was using the United Federation’s built-in AI, so the Federation held the highest authority, not the AI’s master.

However, his built-in AI belonged to the one controlled by the Trojan horse of the Mechanical Legion.

And that Trojan virus was Alpha himself.

After the check passed, the iron gate in front opened. The interior of the Gusu Military Base thus appeared before Xiang Nanli.

The inside of the base looked even more impressive than the outside. Despite being a new city, there were many robots and people on the streets.

Robots served as cleaners, defense forces, and traffic police. Most were merely humanoid in structure, lacking true flesh and blood, with the markings of different companies engraved on their bodies.

According to Xiang Nanli’s observations, at least 70% of the robots on the road were products of Gaoxin Military Industry. The remaining 30% came from Eternal Technology.

Xiang Nanli guessed this was because the current supreme commander of Gusu was a director of Gaoxin Military Industry—Fang Jingzhi, after all.

Gaoxin Military Industry must have contributed the most during this war. He just didn't know if they would be able to make a fortune from the war as they hoped.

That was an arm-wrestling match on another level; it wasn't something Xiang Nanli needed to consider.

He arrived at the Gusu Hotel as navigated, and checked in. This place was specifically for hosting foreign guests and covered a large area, essentially an ecological park. Right next to it was the Gusu Provisional Government building.

The high-ranking officials sent by the United Federation also stayed here, though not in the same building.

Xiang Nanli didn't arrive until the evening of the sixth day. He suspected Alpha had intentionally delayed them, but he had no proof.

On the seventh day, before the joint strategic meeting had even begun, a piece of wartime news was delivered to his electronic device.

It stated that a surface stronghold in the war zone called "Danlin Valley," with a population of two million, had its leaders colluding with the Divine Court.

Consequently, the military base had air-dropped a small missile and leveled Danlin Valley.

Xiang Nanli woke up early, sipping coffee in the hotel restaurant, and couldn't help but touch the back of his neck.

"Making an example of them..."

Killing the chicken to scare the monkeys. Fortunately, he wasn't that chicken.

chunks.chineseText:
第163章 开会2

“哒”，很轻微的一声。琥珀色的粘稠液体滴入培养皿，里面海马模样的小怪物舒张着自己的四肢，长尾是白色的，能看见半透明血肉下红到发黑的血管。

一串小气泡浮上水面，相南里盖好玻璃盖，食指贴在容器表面。

小畸变人如有所感，在水底艰难地翻身，然后伸出自己细长的小爪子，和相南里隔着容器壁贴贴。

不知道是否是错觉，相南里耳边响起一声很低的吟叫，像鲸鱼。

他翡翠色的眼眸忍不住微微弯起，浑身上下洋溢着一种颇具人性的光辉。

“小青，它好像快孵出来了~”

“嗯。”

东方青帝从背后抱住相南里的腰，锥子一样的下巴抵在相南里的肩上，心想，很好，讨厌以西结的理由又多了一个。

相南里把小爬行者孵出来，肯定会随时带在身边。带在身边，就会想到这卵是以西结送的。以西结其心可诛。

但表面上，Alpha还是很大度的：“听说战区这些据点的人到齐了。会议时间在晚上。”

人马星是一颗巨大的行星。

很多年前，天文学家在遥远的银河系观测到另一个生命星球，取名为天蓝星；根据计算，人马星的体积是天蓝星的十倍。

因此，哪怕只是地图上很小的一块战区，占地面积也有25万平方公里；至于里面人口过百万的中大型据点，一共39个。大多数，相南里都只听过名字，没去过。

基地目前五个市，人口还差点破百万，只是在前几次报告中表现亮眼，因此也获得与会资格。

虽然相南里一点也不觉得荣幸就是了。

现在，这些据点的首领，都住在同一宾馆，同一层楼。

如何宣传基地的农产品呢？

相南里采用了最原始朴素的商战手法，往人家客房的门缝里塞电子卡片。

电子卡片背后有基地的徽章：同心圆图案。整体是金属的，风格简约大气。

只要在一定范围内检测到内置AI，就会向AI主人提交申请，请求录入基地的广告册。当然，也可以拒绝。

咳咳……严格意义上，这是个小木马病毒，类似于互联网早期的弹窗广告。

为了破解内置AI自带的杀毒软件的限制，可是废了相南里好大工夫！在车上研究了三四天呢。

相南里和东方青帝一左一右，从走廊两侧往中间塞小广告。小青大概是觉得有点丢人，竟罕见地戴上面罩。

相南里一路塞到336号房间，很不幸，门从里面打开了。

他和336号房的客人撞了个正着。

客人有张瘦削且严肃的脸，高挑，看起来是白种人。有些病恹恹的。四十来岁。他低垂着眼眸，看着面前相对年轻的男人。

相南里鲜少感觉到尴尬，他笑着开口：“你好，我是幸存者基地的相南里。这是我们基地的农产品电子广告册。如果有需要，可以联系我！我们基地是一座农业城市。”

客人打量着他，沉默地接过电子卡牌：“洛基。奥丁城。”

洛基是名字的音译，和遥远的洛家没有关系。那几乎是人联隐秘的皇族。不会让直系后代沦落到地表讨生活。

相南里一愣：“噢，您就是艾伦的叔叔。”

“是我。”洛基回答，“感谢你们帮我找回那个不听话的侄子。”

虽然送回来的，是一具稀巴烂的尸体。

“钱已经打过去了。”洛基补充。

见鬼，小卡片不仅发弹窗广告，里面竟然还有一个群聊链接。

群名：AAA菌鸡青麦批发_幸存者基地

相南里语气很是诚恳：“奥丁城人口众多，因为采矿水土流失严重，且土壤多为砂石地，不适合农业种植。过去，一直在购买附近据点和人联的粮食。我想基地的新作物能解决您的燃眉之急。无论如何，奥丁城都是基地重要的战略合作伙伴。朋友之间互相帮助是应该的。”

洛基一边嘴角勾起，笑容很古怪：“艾伦身上有审讯后的痕迹；看来过不了多久，基地就不需要从奥丁城进口电池了。”

相南里想，那不一定。毕竟基地还是挺缺煤矿的。

不过，洛基并没有特别在乎。翻过去的账本，基地从城里订购的电池数量也相当有限。

洛基用极短的时间翻阅完广告册，并下单100万只菌鸡和3000吨青麦，占目前基地产能的一半；分半年交货。

艾伦没有骗人，奥丁城确实是一个富裕的地表据点。

洛基的胳膊搭在门把手上，意味深长地提醒：“你们最好向人联多申请购买一些军火。战时，买这些东西，比其他时候容易得多……”

他看不上这点收益；但其他据点，可就不一定了。

-

相南里显然是把洛基的话听进去了的。

发完电子传单，回到自己的小房间，他就打开人联线上商城，浏览起里面的货物。

最基础的枪支弹药，基地完全可以自己生产。质量还不赖……金属资源来自上次杀死的黑甲虫。那只虫子是真的大，捡回来的尸体把基地的仓库都塞满了两个。能用好一阵子。

但更高级的装置，譬如追踪武器、生化武器、中大型导弹还有在相南里眼中非常不科学的电磁炮、激光枪、空气弹；基地目前是没办法自己生产的。

而如果找人联进口？

他看了眼购物车里的商品价格，眼睛闭上，又睁开：“原来不是我的幻觉。”

基地绝对不算穷。只计算流动资金，账户里差不多有三亿信用点。一亿人联补贴，一亿加百列遗产；剩下一亿是基地的财政收入，包括税收、外贸。

但就算放弃城市基建，把三亿信用点都拿来买军火；也顶多能武装出一个满编制的营。

更何况从人联、到地表官僚处、再到基地，中间不知道要经过多少双手。幸存者基地这种没背景的据点，真拿到淘汰下来的残次品破烂货，也是哑巴吃黄连。

要不问智械军团买算了。这个念头在相南里脑海里闪过，随后很快摒弃。

基地的位置在内陆，如何不惊动人联、神庭，让军团把大型装置送过来，就是一个大问题。更何况，这一举动严重违反两百年前签订的《人械和平共处协议》。

Alpha作为东方青帝呆在基地，那就只享有“东方青帝”的权限。

他还是不要强人所难了。

相南里关掉购物车，决定再想想办法。人联给的价格实在下不去手。但其他渠道又很难买到……

相南里翻着联系人列表，目光在“洛修”这个ID上停留数秒。

说起来，洛修现在也在姑苏军事基地。

他是汴梁城副市长，身兼汴梁集团军副军长的职位。在人联军事体系里，军衔中将。负责给方敬之打下手。

最重要的是，通过洛修，能联系上他背后的永生科技。同样的武器装置，永生科技的售价大概是人联商场里的2/3。

“虽然一两亿对永生科技来说太少……但有钱不至于不赚吧？”相南里不是很确定地想着。
chunks.englishText:
"Tap." A very faint sound. A drop of viscous, amber-colored liquid dripped into the petri dish. Inside, a small, seahorse-like monster stretched its limbs; its long tail was white, and one could see veins turning from red to black beneath its translucent flesh.

A string of tiny bubbles floated to the surface. Xiang Nanli covered it with the glass lid and pressed his index finger against the surface of the container.

The little aberrant seemed to sense it; it struggled to roll over at the bottom of the water, then extended its slender little claws to press against the container wall, meeting Xiang Nanli’s finger.

He didn't know if it was an illusion, but a very low, whale-like moan echoed in his ears.

His emerald eyes couldn't help but curve slightly, his entire being radiating a kind of humane brilliance.

"Xiao Qing, it looks like it’s about to hatch~"

"Mm."

Dongfang Qingdi hugged Xiang Nanli’s waist from behind, resting his awl-like chin on Xiang Nanli’s shoulder, thinking to himself: *Very good, I have one more reason to hate Ezekiel.*

If Xiang Nanli hatched the little crawler, he would surely keep it by his side at all times. And if he kept it by his side, he would think of the fact that this egg was a gift from Ezekiel. Ezekiel’s intentions were truly malicious.

But on the surface, the Alpha remained magnanimous: "I heard that the people from these strongholds in the war zone have all arrived. The meeting is scheduled for tonight."

Centaurus was a massive planet.

Many years ago, astronomers observed another life-bearing planet in the distant Milky Way and named it Sky Blue Star. According to calculations, Centaurus was ten times the volume of Sky Blue Star.

Therefore, even a small war zone on the map covered an area of 250,000 square kilometers. As for the medium-to-large strongholds with populations over a million within it, there were 39 in total. Xiang Nanli had only heard the names of most of them and had never visited.

The base currently had five districts, and while its population was just shy of a million, it had performed brilliantly in previous reports, thus earning the qualification to attend the meeting.

Though Xiang Nanli didn't feel honored in the slightest.

Now, the leaders of these strongholds were all staying in the same hotel, on the same floor.

How could he promote the base's agricultural products?

Xiang Nanli adopted the most primitive and simple business tactic: stuffing electronic cards into the gaps of people's guest room doors.

On the back of the electronic card was the base’s emblem: a concentric circle pattern. It was metallic, with a minimalist and grand style.

As long as a built-in AI was detected within a certain range, it would submit a request to the AI’s owner to record the base’s advertising brochure. Of course, one could also refuse.

*Cough, cough...* Strictly speaking, this was a small Trojan virus, similar to pop-up ads from the early days of the internet.

It had taken Xiang Nanli a great deal of effort to crack the restrictions of the built-in AI’s antivirus software! He had spent three or four days studying it in the car.

Xiang Nanli and Dongfang Qingdi worked from both sides of the corridor toward the middle, stuffing the flyers. Xiao Qing probably felt it was a bit embarrassing, as he had uncharacteristically put on a mask.

Xiang Nanli stuffed one into Room 336, but unfortunately, the door opened from the inside.

He bumped straight into the guest of Room 336.

The guest had a gaunt and stern face, was tall, and appeared to be Caucasian. He looked somewhat sickly and was in his forties. He lowered his eyes, looking at the relatively young man in front of him.

Xiang Nanli rarely felt awkward; he smiled and said, "Hello, I am Xiang Nanli from the Survivor Base. This is our base’s electronic brochure for agricultural products. If you have any needs, please contact me! Our base is an agricultural city."

The guest sized him up and silently took the electronic card: "Loki. Odin City."

"Loki" was a transliteration of the name and had nothing to do with the distant Luo family. That was practically the secret royalty of the United Federation; they would never let their direct descendants end up on the surface to scrape a living.

Xiang Nanli was stunned: "Oh, so you are Alan’s uncle."

"I am," Loki replied. "Thank you for helping me retrieve that disobedient nephew of mine."

Even though what was returned was a mangled corpse.

"The money has already been transferred," Loki added.

Damn it, the little card didn't just send pop-up ads; it actually contained a group chat link.

Group name: AAA_Mushroom_Chicken_Green_Wheat_Wholesale_Survivor_Base

Xiang Nanli’s tone was very sincere: "Odin City has a large population. Due to mining, soil erosion is severe, and the soil is mostly sandy, making it unsuitable for agriculture. In the past, you have always purchased grain from nearby strongholds and the Federation. I believe our base’s new crops can solve your urgent needs. In any case, Odin City is an important strategic partner for our base. Friends should help each other."

One corner of Loki’s mouth curled up in a strange smile: "There are traces of interrogation on Alan’s body; it seems that before long, the base won't need to import batteries from Odin City anymore."

Xiang Nanli thought that wasn't necessarily true. After all, the base was still quite short on coal mines.

However, Loki didn't particularly care. Looking at the past ledgers, the number of batteries the base had ordered from the city was quite limited.

Loki finished flipping through the brochure in a very short time and placed an order for 1 million mushroom chickens and 3,000 tons of green wheat, accounting for half of the base’s current production capacity, to be delivered over six months.

Alan hadn't lied; Odin City was indeed a wealthy surface stronghold.

Loki rested his arm on the door handle and gave a meaningful reminder: "You had better apply to the Federation to purchase more munitions. During wartime, it is much easier to buy these things than at other times..."

He didn't care for this small profit, but other strongholds might not be the same.

-

Xiang Nanli had clearly taken Loki’s words to heart.

After sending out the electronic flyers and returning to his small room, he opened the United Federation’s online store and browsed the goods.

The base could produce basic firearms and ammunition entirely on its own. The quality wasn't bad... the metal resources came from the black beetles they had killed last time. That bug was truly massive; the corpse they brought back had filled two of the base’s warehouses. It would last for quite a while.

But more advanced equipment—such as tracking weapons, biochemical weapons, medium-to-large missiles, and things that seemed very unscientific in Xiang Nanli’s eyes, like electromagnetic cannons, laser guns, and air-pressure shells—the base currently had no way to produce itself.

And if he imported them from the Federation?

He looked at the prices of the items in his shopping cart, closed his eyes, and opened them again: "So it wasn't my hallucination."

The base was definitely not poor. Just counting liquid assets, there were nearly 300 million credits in the account. 100 million from Federation subsidies, 100 million from Gabriel’s inheritance; the remaining 100 million was the base’s fiscal revenue, including taxes and foreign trade.

But even if they abandoned city infrastructure and spent all 300 million credits on munitions, they could at most arm one full-strength battalion.

Not to mention that from the Federation to the surface bureaucrats and then to the base, no one knew how many hands it had to pass through. For a stronghold without a background like the Survivor Base, even if they did get the discarded, defective junk, they would have to swallow their grievances.

*Should I just buy from the Mechanical Legion?* The thought flashed through Xiang Nanli’s mind, then was quickly discarded.

The base was located inland. How to get the Legion to send large equipment without alerting the Federation or the Divine Court was a huge problem. Furthermore, this move would be a serious violation of the "Human-Machine Peaceful Coexistence Agreement" signed two hundred years ago.

As Alpha was staying in the base as "Dongfang Qingdi," he only enjoyed the authority of "Dongfang Qingdi."

He shouldn't make things difficult for him.

Xiang Nanli closed the shopping cart and decided to think of another way. The prices the Federation gave were truly unaffordable. But it was hard to buy from other channels...

Xiang Nanli flipped through his contact list, his gaze lingering on the ID "Luo Xiu" for a few seconds.

Speaking of which, Luo Xiu was also at the Gusu Military Base now.

He was the Deputy Mayor of Bianliang City and held the position of Deputy Corps Commander of the Bianliang Group Army. In the Federation’s military system, he held the rank of Lieutenant General, responsible for assisting Fang Jingzhi.

Most importantly, through Luo Xiu, one could reach the Eternal Technology behind him. For the same weapon equipment, Eternal Technology’s selling price was about 2/3 of that in the Federation store.

"Although one or two hundred million is too little for Eternal Technology... they wouldn't refuse to make money, right?" Xiang Nanli thought, not very sure.

chunks.chineseText:
不过，编辑好的话在对话框停留片刻，相南里通通删除。

他最后给洛修发去的信息是这样的：好久不见。先恭喜你平调到汴梁。你很年轻，又是空降，我听说很多本土将领都不怎么服你。需要业绩吗？

相南里微微眯起眼，蛊惑道：我这里有一个天启骑士团的人头，还有一名领主级天启骑士的尸体。

-

会议大厅是圆形的。主席台位置在中央；四周，都有呈扇形展开的座位。

会议室整体洁白，上方圆环状的光带提供着充足的照明；设计里有一股不近人情的冷意。

以主席台为中心，相对的两面扇形都坐满了人。地表城市和地底城市就这样被强硬地糅合在同一间会议室。

人联方，与会人员的穿衣风格很统一，全是人联制服。

相南里在第一排的位置，看见洛修，以及坐在他身边的辛追。

多少年过去了，洛修和他的人造人还在一起。

而另一侧的地表据点方，穿着服饰就千奇百怪了。

相南里甚至看见了一名穿兽皮裙、手持骨杖的黑皮首领。身高两米三，身上筋肉扎实，血气旺盛，一看就知道是强大的基因战士。

幸存者基地只是刚有资格上桌吃饭的小虾米。因此，相南里和东方青帝的座位在最后一排。不知道是否是人联的刻意安排，据点与据点之间，都空着一两个位置。想偷偷讲话，很不方便。

好在，他们背着人联有群。

嗯，就是那个AAA菌鸡青麦批发群。

虽然不一定会买货物，但是，被人联叫来干活的据点领袖们，还是很需要一个沟通交流渠道的！可惜一直没人行动。

第一：不是所有据点都发展了通讯科技。

第二：缺乏契机。

在察觉到这一市场需求后，相南里贴心地把群聊设置为“匿名”。无非就是多加几个插件的事。

[兽人永不为奴：我听说这次人联把俺们叫来，是想搞个先行野战部队。]

[真没钱了：驱虎吞狼？]

[假面骑士：笑死，你什么水平啊，你是虎吗？驱鼠吞狼还差不多，先用不要钱的炮灰消耗神庭，再让自己的部队上。这招可不新鲜了。]

人联在地表作战时，没少干这种事。

[兽人永不为奴：俺家在边境线上，对付神庭也算有点经验。但是最近几十年，人联补贴越来越少，问就是财政紧张。凭啥让我打工啊？]

相南里默默看着这条消息。心想，人联和神庭，在不少地表人的眼里，同样危险。

一方是虎，一方是狼。而他们，是在地表自然生长的羊。

会议室大门打开，又关上。在一群武装人员的护送下，只在照片上见过的男人优雅登场。

是的，优雅。

相南里隔着很远，只能看到一个丁点大的背影，都能感觉到他身上那股莫名的气场。

他思考片刻，上一次有这种感觉，还是神庭那位死装的圣子……

方敬之同样穿着人联的制服，只是有些许改动，让整体风格和他自带的机械改造装置更统一。他身上的服装是长款，穿着同样金属材质的靴子，还是高跟。

“好像《数码宝贝》里的天使兽。”相南里小声和一边的智械吐槽，“小青，你知道什么是天使兽吗？”

因为智械危机，人类社会几乎毁灭过一次。别说动漫影视作品了，新历前的历史、哲学、社科等等重要文献，都十不存一。

东方青帝觉得耳朵有些痒，那是相南里的鼻息。

“知道。”东方青帝仔细打量，“不像。”

方敬之开始说话，发言不怎么官方：“感谢各位不远千里来到姑苏，参加人联地表作战第一次联席会议。我是这次军事行动总指挥，你们的顶头上司，方敬之。”

他一百多岁，声音却很年轻。说话时，身后有个东西若隐若现。

相南里努力瞪大眼，发现不是自己的错觉。

方敬之的脑勺后有个悬浮的大光圈！
chunks.englishText:
However, after the edited words lingered in the dialogue box for a moment, Xiang Nanli deleted them all.

The message he finally sent to Luo Xiu was: *Long time no see. First, congratulations on your lateral transfer to Bianliang. You are very young and were parachuted in; I hear many local generals don't really respect you. Do you need some achievements?*

Xiang Nanli narrowed his eyes slightly and tempted him: *I have the head of a member of the Apocalypse Knights here, as well as the corpse of a Lord-level Apocalypse Knight.*

-

The conference hall was circular. The podium was in the center; seats were arranged in a fan shape all around.

The conference room was entirely white, with circular light strips above providing ample illumination; the design carried an unfeeling coldness.

With the podium as the center, the two opposing fan-shaped sections were full of people. Surface cities and underground cities were thus forcefully blended into the same conference room.

On the Federation side, the attendees’ clothing style was uniform—all in Federation uniforms.

In the front row, Xiang Nanli saw Luo Xiu, as well as Xin Zhui sitting beside him.

How many years had passed? Luo Xiu and his android were still together.

On the other side, the surface stronghold representatives wore all sorts of bizarre attire.

Xiang Nanli even saw a dark-skinned leader wearing a beast-skin skirt and holding a bone staff. He was 2.3 meters tall, with solid muscles and vigorous blood energy; one look and you knew he was a powerful genetic warrior.

The Survivor Base was just a small shrimp that had only just qualified to sit at the table. Therefore, Xiang Nanli and Dongfang Qingdi’s seats were in the last row. He didn't know if it was the Federation’s deliberate arrangement, but there were one or two empty seats between each stronghold. It was very inconvenient to try and talk secretly.

Fortunately, they had a group chat behind the Federation’s back.

Yes, that "AAA Mushroom Chicken Green Wheat Wholesale" group.

Although they might not necessarily buy goods, the stronghold leaders called here by the Federation still really needed a communication channel! Unfortunately, no one had taken the initiative until now.

First: Not all strongholds had developed communication technology.

Second: There was a lack of opportunity.

After realizing this market demand, Xiang Nanli thoughtfully set the group chat to "anonymous." It was nothing more than adding a few plugins.

[Orcs Never Slaves: I heard the Federation called us here this time because they want to set up a vanguard field unit.]

[Really Broke: Driving tigers to swallow wolves?]

[Masked Rider: LOL, what level are you? Are you a tiger? It’s more like driving mice to swallow wolves. First, use the free cannon fodder to exhaust the Divine Court, then send in their own troops. This trick isn't new.]

The Federation had done this kind of thing more than once when fighting on the surface.

[Orcs Never Slaves: My home is on the border, so I have some experience dealing with the Divine Court. But in the last few decades, the Federation’s subsidies have become less and less. When asked, they just say the budget is tight. Why should I work for them?]

Xiang Nanli watched this message silently. He thought that to many surface dwellers, the Federation and the Divine Court were equally dangerous.

One side was a tiger, the other a wolf. And they were the sheep growing naturally on the surface.

The conference hall doors opened and then closed. Escorted by a group of armed personnel, the man they had only seen in photos made an elegant entrance.

Yes, elegant.

Xiang Nanli was far away and could only see a tiny silhouette, yet he could still feel the inexplicable aura emanating from him.

He thought for a moment; the last time he had felt this way was when he saw that pretentious Saint Son of the Divine Court...

Fang Jingzhi was also wearing a Federation uniform, but with slight modifications to make the overall style more consistent with the mechanical modification devices he carried. His clothing was long-cut, and he wore boots made of the same metallic material—with high heels.

"He looks like Angemon from *Digimon*," Xiang Nanli whispered to the mechanical intelligence beside him. "Xiao Qing, do you know what Angemon is?"

Because of the Mechanical Crisis, human society had been nearly destroyed once. Not to mention anime and film works, even important literature from before the New Calendar—history, philosophy, social sciences, etc.—less than one in ten remained.

Dongfang Qingdi felt his ear tickle; it was Xiang Nanli’s breath.

"I know," Dongfang Qingdi observed carefully. "He doesn't look like it."

Fang Jingzhi began to speak, and his opening remarks were not very official: "Thank you all for coming from thousands of miles away to Gusu to attend the first joint meeting on surface operations of the United Federation. I am the commander-in-chief of this military operation, your direct superior, Fang Jingzhi."

He was over a hundred years old, yet his voice was very young. As he spoke, something flickered in and out of existence behind him.

Xiang Nanli tried hard to widen his eyes, only to discover it wasn't his imagination.

There was a large, floating halo of light behind the back of Fang Jingzhi’s head!

第164章 人联画饼

相南里神神秘秘地发出电波。

[他脑袋后面有个光圈欸。]

东方青帝抬眼，把方敬之上下扫描一遍。雄性智人，机械化程度37，性别男，身高187.3，加上义体222.8斤；看不清脸，但显然是个帅哥。

东方青帝：[是吗？]观察这么仔细。

他没有看见那种东西。

相南里：“？”

东方青帝思考片刻，给出一个相对合理的解释：[我听说，部分学过神术的人，五感会和普通人不太一样。]

就像加百列能看见“魂魄”，沙利叶可以闻到灵魂的“味道”；米迦勒更是在千里之外就对陌生的目光有所察觉。

[那这个光圈代表什么？]

东方青帝在自己的数据库里搜索许久，一向面无表情的脸上出现很淡的懊恼。

他没搜到。

这会不会显得太没用了。

黑十字审判庭有特殊的精神沟通方式，全教上下都不爱联网。很多重要资料都是纸质的。

东方青帝知道原因。纸质资料记录少，方便篡改。历史的解释权，最终会握在某些人手上。

他的脑海里闪过一段录像，画质不怎么清晰。灰白两色，画面上还有很多因为电磁干扰产生的雪花。

画面的主角穿着神座的衮冕。很瘦，几乎看不到血肉，身上的衮服都挂不稳。他在暗室，点着一盏人油灯。

这应该是神庭历史上某一任神座。

神座手里拿着一把锉刀，桌子上铺着张摊开的人皮纸。

一摞一摞的人皮纸叠在一起，像本厚重的书。

他就借着昏暗的光，一点点把纸上原本的字迹抹掉。

随后用蘸着血的指尖，在纸上写下新的记录。

删掉的什么？

许久，老人停下笔；雪花信号遮挡的脸上，浮现出如释重负的笑容。

……

[小青？]

面前的智械出现可疑的卡顿。

东方青帝回过神：“这可能是神庭高阶天使的标志。根据记录，少部分虔诚的信徒会得到神的恩赐，强化五感。你的症状挺像的。”

相南里：“……？”

他迄今都是无神论者。他承认，神术有点动摇他的世界观。但相南里坚信，迟早有天，人类能用一套完整的科学理论，去解释神庭这些未知科技。

对于几千年前的人类来说，现代人可以飞天遁地、呼风唤雨；同样宛如神明。

台上，方敬之正在不疾不徐地念着开场白。

现在的人类有内置AI辅助，许多人联官员上台前都不背稿，直接载入数据。

方敬之却十分敬业，起码他念的稿，都是自己亲自审核过的。文采斐然，声情并茂。

台上正阐述着神庭发展这么多年来，对地表的迫害。包括但不限于种族屠杀、生化实验、反人类病毒投放……罪孽深重，手段残忍。

还有什么，比一个共同的敌人更能激发人们的凝聚力呢？

相南里听着，难免有些走神。对于不怎么感兴趣的东西（尤其是政治！），他一向难以集中精神。

他和Alpha在脑内交流：[我怎么觉得，神庭做的这些，人联自己也做过？像什么畸变人技术，最早就是人联开始研究的吧。还有基因锁和基因战士，早期不知道死了多少人，这和神庭的天启骑士改造有什么区别吗……？屠杀倒是没怎么听说的，是没记录还是不存在？我倾向于人类其实是相似的。]

[不过，这还是和群体氛围有关吧。如果人联不再把地表人当同类，杀人和杀异种，也许没什么区别。我之前看了一本小说……小青，好像是从你办公桌上拿的，翻了几页。]

这件事东方青帝完全不知情！

出于尊重，他并不会利用小智对相南里进行远程监督。那太变态了，他敢有这种想法，相南里第二天就能把内置芯片从自己身体里抠出来。

只有小智算法里判定需要“我”知情的信息，才会反馈过来。小智没有脑子，只是他留在相南里“脑机”里的一段程序。

没有人比东方青帝更清楚，会出现在他办公桌上的小说，里面到底写了什么东西了。

嗯。他喜欢婚恋文，其次是狗血虐恋，还得是带颜色的没被净网的版本。这些教♂材的确给Alpha打开了新世界的大门。像什么认知修改、机械、异形、产卵……咳。Alpha的意思是，他不喜欢，只是知道有这种PLAY存在。

有时候他对人类也挺肃然起敬的。

Alpha的心略微绷紧，表情上却看不出分毫，依旧从容冷静。

相南里：[讲的是一个人联研究员做实验。上面说是在战争中俘获的‘天启骑士’，饮毛茹血的怪物；中间过程还挺血腥的。两方语言不通，研究员坚信自己在解剖怪物。怪物死的时候笑着流泪，他没什么感觉。后来研究员在自己身上实验新药，也成了‘怪物’。他被转运到了另一个实验室，躺在同样的解剖台上。研究员意识到了什么，他没有哭；当自己身体被手术刀划开时，他吐了。]

Alpha想，幸好他看完后会随手把电子书修改成绿色版。

相南里：[虽然只是小说，但我觉得，历史上说不定真的发生过这样的事。]

相较于人联和神庭各自记录的历史，智械方的记载更加客观。

它们没有义务为人类掩饰什么。

[人联早期和神庭的关系很好。]

Alpha言尽于此。

在他们闲聊的时候，方敬之的演讲已经到了下一个阶段。

主要内容是在鼓舞士气，表示人联作为文明、进步的一方，他们绝对不会向血腥残忍的神庭屈服。

神庭的做法已经触碰到人联的底线，有良知的人类（指人联和地表据点）应该团结起来，用血与火，让神庭为自己的罪行付出代价。

【AAA菌鸡青麦批发】

[兽人永不为奴：他们当年也是这么对俺爷说的。]

[匿名：然后呢？]

[兽人永不为奴：人联的物资让俺们部落吃饱、穿暖。]

坐在前面的野蛮人挠了挠脏兮兮的头发：[还带来了药和电。还有老师来支教。俺大爷很尊重人联，我也很尊重，但是年轻这一辈不怎么喜欢。我觉得挺闹腾的。也不知道我死后怎么办。]

他的部落就叫“野人部落”，一直是边境线上对抗神庭的精锐势力。

相南里的基地发展三年了，人联援助款也就两个亿；和野人部落一个季度的补贴持平。

在首领成长的时候，他们部落欣欣向荣，不断壮大；但是到年轻的这一批，部落已经很久没有新的突破，新一批小孩出生时什么样，长大后，环境还是那样。甚至因为时间流逝，条件显得更加艰苦。于是对人联的控制产生许多不满。

这是必然的，地表扶贫办再怎么好心，也会把地表据点限制在可控范围内。

人联不可能真的让一个据点发展起来。

**Chapter 164: The Human Alliance’s Empty Promises (Part 1)**

Xiang Nanli sent a telepathic signal, his tone filled with mystery.

[There’s a halo behind his head.]

Dongfang Qingdi raised his eyes, scanning Fang Jingzhi from head to toe. *Male Homo sapiens. Mechanization level: 37%. Gender: Male. Height: 187.3 cm. Weight including prosthetics: 111.4 kg. Face obscured, but clearly a handsome man.*

Dongfang Qingdi: [Is that so?] *Observant as always.*

He could not see any such thing.

Xiang Nanli: “?”

Dongfang Qingdi pondered for a moment before offering a relatively logical explanation: [I have heard that some individuals who have studied divine arts possess senses that differ from those of ordinary people.]

Just as Gabriel could see “souls,” Sariel could smell the “scent” of a spirit; Michael, meanwhile, could detect a strange gaze from thousands of miles away.

[Then what does this halo represent?]

Dongfang Qingdi searched his database for a long time, a faint trace of frustration appearing on his usually expressionless face.

He found nothing.

*Does this make me seem useless?*

The Black Cross Inquisition utilized a specialized method of mental communication; the entire order detested being connected to the network. Much of their important documentation was kept on paper.

Dongfang Qingdi knew the reason why. Paper records were sparse and easy to tamper with. The power to interpret history would ultimately remain in the hands of a select few.

A video clip flashed through his mind, though the quality was poor. It was in grayscale, filled with static from electromagnetic interference.

The protagonist of the footage wore the ceremonial robes of the God’s Throne. He was so thin that his flesh was barely visible, and his robes hung loosely on his frame. He was in a dark room, lighting a lamp fueled by human oil.

This must have been one of the God’s Thrones from the history of the Divine Court.

The God’s Throne held a file in his hand, and a sheet of human-skin parchment was spread out on the table.

Stacks of human-skin parchment were piled together, resembling a thick, heavy book.

By the dim light, he slowly erased the original handwriting on the paper.

Then, with fingertips dipped in blood, he wrote down new records.

*What was deleted?*

After a long while, the old man stopped his pen. On his face, obscured by the static of the recording, a look of relief emerged.

……

[Xiao Qing?]

The android in front of him experienced a suspicious stutter.

Dongfang Qingdi regained his focus: “This might be a mark of a high-ranking angel of the Divine Court. According to records, a small number of devout believers receive divine gifts that enhance their senses. Your symptoms are quite similar.”

Xiang Nanli: “...?”

He had been an atheist his entire life. He admitted that divine arts had shaken his worldview, but Xiang Nanli firmly believed that one day, humanity would be able to explain the unknown technology of the Divine Court using a complete set of scientific theories.

To humans from thousands of years ago, modern people—who could fly through the sky, burrow into the earth, and summon wind and rain—would also appear as gods.

On the stage, Fang Jingzhi was delivering his opening remarks in a measured, unhurried tone.

Modern humans had built-in AI assistance, so many Human Alliance officials didn't bother memorizing scripts before taking the stage; they simply loaded the data.

Fang Jingzhi, however, was highly professional. At the very least, the script he read had been personally vetted by him. It was eloquent and filled with emotion.

On stage, he was currently detailing the persecution the surface had suffered at the hands of the Divine Court for so many years. This included, but was not limited to, genocide, biochemical experiments, the deployment of anti-human viruses... the sins were grave, and the methods were cruel.

After all, what could better inspire unity among people than a common enemy?

Listening to this, Xiang Nanli couldn't help but lose focus. He always found it difficult to concentrate on things he wasn't interested in (especially politics!).

He communicated with the Alpha in his mind: [Why do I feel like the Human Alliance has done the same things the Divine Court has? Like the Aberrant technology—that was researched by the Human Alliance first, right? And the gene locks and gene warriors; who knows how many people died in the early stages? How is that any different from the Divine Court’s transformation of the Apocalypse Knights...? I haven't heard much about genocide, though. Is it not recorded, or does it not exist? I’m inclined to think that humans are actually quite similar.]

[Still, this has to do with group atmosphere, right? If the Human Alliance no longer considers surface dwellers as their own kind, maybe there’s no difference between killing humans and killing aliens. I read a novel before... Xiao Qing, I think I took it from your desk. I flipped through a few pages.]

Dongfang Qingdi was completely unaware of this!

Out of respect, he would never use Xiao Zhi to remotely monitor Xiang Nanli. That would be too perverted. If he even dared to have such a thought, Xiang Nanli would dig the built-in chip out of his own body the very next day.

Only information that the Xiao Zhi algorithm determined "I" needed to know would be fed back. Xiao Zhi had no brain; it was merely a program he had left in Xiang Nanli’s “brain-machine interface.”

No one knew better than Dongfang Qingdi what kind of novels would appear on his desk.

*Hmm.* He liked romance novels, followed by melodramatic, tragic love stories—and they had to be the uncensored versions that hadn't been scrubbed by the internet. These “textbooks” had indeed opened a new world for the Alpha. Things like cognitive modification, machinery, xenomorphs, oviposition... *cough.* The Alpha meant that he didn't like them; he was merely aware that such “play” existed.

Sometimes, he actually felt a sense of awe toward humans.

The Alpha’s heart tightened slightly, but his expression remained unchanged, calm and composed.

Xiang Nanli: [It was about a Human Alliance researcher conducting experiments. The higher-ups said the subjects were ‘Apocalypse Knights’ captured in war, monsters that drank blood and ate raw flesh. The process in the middle was quite bloody. The two sides couldn't communicate, and the researcher was convinced he was dissecting monsters. When the monster died, it smiled while crying, and he felt nothing. Later, the researcher experimented with a new drug on himself and also became a ‘monster.’ He was transferred to another laboratory and lay on the same dissection table. The researcher realized something. He didn't cry; when his own body was cut open by the scalpel, he vomited.]

The Alpha thought, *It’s a good thing I modify the e-books to the ‘green’ version after reading them.*

Xiang Nanli: [Although it’s just a novel, I feel like something like that might have actually happened in history.]

Compared to the histories recorded by the Human Alliance and the Divine Court, the records of the androids were more objective.

They had no obligation to cover anything up for humanity.

[The Human Alliance and the Divine Court had a very good relationship in the early days.]

The Alpha left it at that.

While they were chatting, Fang Jingzhi’s speech had moved to the next phase.

The main content was about boosting morale, stating that as the civilized and progressive side, the Human Alliance would never bow to the bloody and cruel Divine Court.

The Divine Court’s actions had touched the bottom line of the Human Alliance. Conscientious humans (referring to the Human Alliance and surface strongholds) should unite and use blood and fire to make the Divine Court pay for its crimes.

【AAA Mushroom Chicken Green Wheat Wholesale】

[Orcs Never Slaves: They said the same thing to my grandpa back then.]

[Anonymous: And then?]

[Orcs Never Slaves: The Human Alliance’s supplies let our tribe eat their fill and stay warm.]

The barbarian sitting in front scratched his dirty hair: [They also brought medicine and electricity. And teachers came to volunteer. My grandpa respected the Human Alliance, and I do too, but the younger generation doesn't like them much. I think it’s quite noisy. I don’t know what will happen after I die.]

His tribe was called the “Savage Tribe,” and they had always been an elite force on the border fighting against the Divine Court.

Xiang Nanli’s base had been developing for three years, and the Human Alliance’s aid amounted to only 200 million—on par with the quarterly subsidy of the Savage Tribe.

When the leader was growing up, their tribe was thriving and constantly expanding; but by the younger generation, the tribe hadn't had any new breakthroughs for a long time. The environment was the same as it was when the new batch of children were born. Because of the passage of time, conditions even seemed more arduous. Thus, much dissatisfaction arose regarding the Human Alliance’s control.

This was inevitable. No matter how kind the Surface Poverty Alleviation Office was, they would always keep the surface strongholds within a controllable range.

The Human Alliance could never truly let a stronghold develop.

chunks.chineseText:
他们的援助，从某种角度上，是一种投资。在公司早期，资本大批量低价购入原始股。一批据点死透，总有一批艰难强壮地存活下去，能让投资方盈利。

据点能发展起来，杰出的首领功不可没。

当这位领袖开始跳出自己的阶层，为领地内所有“子民”考虑时，地表据点就不可避免地和人联走向对立。

结果就是，人联觉得自己养出一堆白眼狼；某些地表据点的叙述中，人联是只邪恶的吸血鬼、僵化而贪婪的蜈蚣。

神庭或许是人联扶持出来的，最成功的地表据点。

地上九座神城，原本来自九个不同的大型地表据点。利维坦（加百列封地）、翡冷翠、枫叶丹（米迦勒封地）、圣城……

数百年来，这些据点通过战争、贸易、文化交流等各种方式融合，又以共同信仰为纽带，组成现在的黑十字审判庭。

相南里天生对政治不怎么感冒，还非常抗洗脑。他自己心里有一杆秤，目前，还没有别的势力值得他献上自己的忠诚和理想。

所以他自己造了个，发展势头还不错。

这是他的理想国。他愿意牺牲和捍卫的东西。相南里从不觉得自己崇高，追求的不过是自己意气自平。

不管对方敬之传达的理念是否感冒，这些被叫来开会的地表小领导，都识相地开始鼓掌，表达自己的赞同，以及对神庭的仇视。

当所有人都赞同时，赞美得不够激烈，就会成原罪。

方敬之环顾着台下的人，目光在相南里脸上极其短暂地停留，随后移开：“这次军事行动，人联准备了丰厚的补贴。”

和刚开会时，农贸批发群里讨论的一样；方敬之打算让地表这些据点充当先锋，扰阵疲敌；在大战略上听人联指挥，小方向上自己行动，削弱神庭的有生力量，从四方分散神庭的兵力。

同时，人联自己的集团军也有重要任务。

“神庭的生物机甲是有限的。”这位总指挥的语气如此笃信，“我们所有牺牲都会有意义。”

方敬之手一挥，在背后的光幕上，列出一张表。

分别是歼灭神庭一个编制的营（50）、团（200）、连（3000）能获得的奖赏。有信用点、物资、专利等等内容！

到团级，就能免费从人联内部获得一个“B级”专利！

C级专利就两千万信用点了。

B级专利，基本都是亿为单位起跳。

这次人联是真的下血本了。虽然对于人联来说，共享专利属于无本买卖。但当初研发可是没少花钱。

这次，是真·人联百亿补贴了。

再往上，神庭的编制其实还有“师”，但官方显然不认为有地表据点能歼灭神庭一个师；压根没写上去。

另外，“如果能杀死或者俘获神庭有封号的‘天启骑士’，也能获得额外奖励。”

天启骑士一旦到领主级别，就开始有封号了。

他们会有自己专属的生物机甲和继承的“教名”。

同样是神庭的封号骑士，内部质量却良莠不齐。

加百列、米迦勒都是封号，位于“撒旦级”，是神庭重要的战略资产，几乎能决定一场战争的胜败。

沙利叶是比较强大的“领主级”。

往下，乌列尔、尤利耶、哈尼亚、卡麦尔这些听上去还算耳熟。

剩下还有一堆不出名的封号，和音译的人名没什么区别。如果对神庭历史不够了解，恐怕遇上也认不出来是谁。

人联这次没有偷懒，制作了一份电子花名册，把这次参与战役的封号骑士都编写进去，附上画像和能力描述。

后面还给出杀死这些封号骑士所对应的奖励。

只是等级越高的天启骑士，资料越少。

相南里翻开第一页，“米迦勒”三个字赫然纸上，然而，关于他的资料，只有短短一行字。

[神庭天使长，善战，擅用火。]

“火”这个字用的是特殊的共感技术。

相南里的意识扫过，感觉身体有一瞬正在被烈焰炙烤，他的血肉似乎在呼吸间被蒸腾成水汽，消散在天地间。

而这只是米迦勒的一个烙印。

“好强大的力量。”相南里很难不对此心生敬畏。

这种级别的大天使就别想了。

就算小青愿意给他捞，基地也不能当这个出头鸟啊！

相南里直接翻到最后一页，从后往前浏览起来。

这些封号骑士，战力大概和解开第一层基因锁的人差不多……嗯，就像是上次遇到的那个新的沙利叶。也许还要弱一些。

“封号萨沙，领主级骑士。”

外观像一名绿巨人，启动生物机甲后更像。血肉质地像果冻。

东方青帝概括：[生物能源。]

战绩是一口气手撕三头爬行者。很强，但还没有到热武器轰不死的程度。

人联给出的报酬是600万信用点（可兑换物资）和一个自选D级专利。

越往前，报酬越丰厚。不过，和之前那张表格一样，到某个级别后，备注的赏金就不见了。

毕竟。人联再强的AI都难以给出答复——天使长米迦勒的一条命，到底价值几何？

先是总指挥发言，随后是下面各个部门。譬如汴梁城军方，就派的洛修上去讲话。大概讲的是如果有需要，军方会援助你们。另外，在战争初期，人联会发放一些免费的装备……

会议召开六个小时，外面天都黑了，里面的发言竟然还在继续。

人联画的大饼，让不少地表首领神色激动。

明明还没开始打仗，相南里已经吃饱了。

**Chapter 164: The Human Alliance’s Empty Promises (Part 2)**

Their aid, from a certain perspective, was an investment. In the early days of a company, capital purchases large quantities of original shares at low prices. If a batch of strongholds dies out, there will always be a batch that struggles and survives, allowing the investors to profit.

If a stronghold can develop, the outstanding leader deserves the credit.

When this leader begins to step out of their own class and consider all the “subjects” within their territory, the surface stronghold inevitably moves toward a confrontation with the Human Alliance.

The result is that the Human Alliance feels it has raised a bunch of ingrates; in the narratives of certain surface strongholds, the Human Alliance is an evil vampire, a rigid and greedy centipede.

The Divine Court might be the most successful surface stronghold ever fostered by the Human Alliance.

The nine divine cities on the ground originally came from nine different large surface strongholds. Leviathan (Gabriel’s fief), Florence, Maple Leaf Dan (Michael’s fief), the Holy City...

For hundreds of years, these strongholds merged through war, trade, cultural exchange, and other means, and then, using a common faith as a bond, formed the current Black Cross Inquisition.

Xiang Nanli was born with a lack of interest in politics and was highly resistant to brainwashing. He had his own scale in his heart; at present, no other force was worth him offering his loyalty and ideals.

So, he built his own, and the momentum of its development was quite good.

This was his utopia. It was something he was willing to sacrifice for and defend. Xiang Nanli never felt he was noble; he was merely pursuing his own peace of mind.

Regardless of whether they were interested in the philosophy Fang Jingzhi was conveying, these small surface leaders called to the meeting all sensibly began to applaud, expressing their agreement and their hatred for the Divine Court.

When everyone agrees, failing to praise enthusiastically becomes an original sin.

Fang Jingzhi looked around at the people below the stage, his gaze lingering on Xiang Nanli’s face for a fleeting moment before moving away: “For this military operation, the Human Alliance has prepared generous subsidies.”

Just as discussed in the agricultural wholesale group when the meeting started, Fang Jingzhi intended to let these surface strongholds act as the vanguard to harass and exhaust the enemy. They were to follow the Human Alliance’s command in grand strategy, while acting on their own in minor directions, weakening the Divine Court’s vital forces and dispersing the Divine Court’s troops from all sides.

At the same time, the Human Alliance’s own army groups had important tasks.

“The Divine Court’s biological mechs are limited.” The commander-in-chief’s tone was so certain, “All of our sacrifices will have meaning.”

Fang Jingzhi waved his hand, and a table appeared on the light screen behind him.

It listed the rewards for annihilating a battalion (50), regiment (200), or company (3,000) of the Divine Court’s establishment. There were credit points, supplies, patents, and so on!

Reaching the regiment level, one could obtain a “B-level” patent from within the Human Alliance for free!

A C-level patent was already worth 20 million credits.

B-level patents basically started in the hundreds of millions.

This time, the Human Alliance was truly bleeding for the cause. Although for the Human Alliance, sharing patents was a cost-free business, the original research had cost a fortune.

This time, it was a true “Human Alliance 10-billion subsidy.”

Further up, the Divine Court’s establishment actually had “divisions,” but the official side clearly didn't think any surface stronghold could annihilate a division of the Divine Court; they didn't even write it down.

In addition, “If you can kill or capture a ‘titled Apocalypse Knight’ of the Divine Court, you can also receive additional rewards.”

Once an Apocalypse Knight reached the Lord level, they began to have titles.

They would have their own exclusive biological mechs and inherited “religious names.”

Although they were all titled knights of the Divine Court, the quality within was uneven.

Gabriel and Michael were both titled, located at the “Satan level,” and were important strategic assets of the Divine Court that could almost determine the outcome of a war.

Sariel was a relatively powerful “Lord level.”

Below that, Uriel, Jophiel, Hania, and Camael sounded somewhat familiar.

The rest were a bunch of unknown titles, no different from transliterated names. If one wasn't familiar with the history of the Divine Court, they probably wouldn't recognize who they were even if they encountered them.

The Human Alliance didn't slack off this time; they produced an electronic roster, compiling all the titled knights participating in this campaign, attached with portraits and ability descriptions.

They also provided the corresponding rewards for killing these titled knights.

It was just that the higher the level of the Apocalypse Knight, the less information there was.

Xiang Nanli opened the first page. The three characters “Michael” were prominently displayed on the paper. However, regarding his information, there was only one short line of text.

[Divine Court Archangel, skilled in battle, adept at using fire.]

The word “fire” used a special empathy technology.

Xiang Nanli’s consciousness swept over it, and he felt as if his body was being scorched by flames for an instant. His flesh and blood seemed to be evaporated into water vapor in the blink of an eye, dissipating between heaven and earth.

And this was merely a brand left by Michael.

“Such powerful strength.” It was hard for Xiang Nanli not to feel awe.

Don't even think about this level of archangel.

Even if Xiao Qing was willing to fish him out, the base couldn't be the one to stick its neck out!

Xiang Nanli flipped directly to the last page and browsed from back to front.

These titled knights had combat power roughly equivalent to someone who had unlocked the first gene lock... hmm, just like that new Sariel he encountered last time. Perhaps even weaker.

“Titled Sasha, Lord-level knight.”

The appearance was like a Hulk, and even more so after activating the biological mech. The texture of the flesh was like jelly.

Dongfang Qingdi summarized: [Biological energy.]

The battle record was tearing three crawlers apart in one go. Very strong, but not yet to the point where they couldn't be blown up by thermal weapons.

The reward offered by the Human Alliance was 6 million credits (exchangeable for supplies) and a self-selected D-level patent.

The further forward, the more generous the reward. However, like the previous table, after a certain level, the bounty notes disappeared.

After all, even the strongest AI of the Human Alliance found it difficult to give an answer—how much was the life of the Archangel Michael actually worth?

First, the commander-in-chief spoke, followed by various departments below. For example, the Bianliang City military sent Luo Xiu up to speak. He mainly talked about how the military would assist them if needed. In addition, at the beginning of the war, the Human Alliance would distribute some free equipment...

The meeting lasted for six hours, and it was dark outside, yet the speeches inside were still continuing.

The empty promises painted by the Human Alliance made many surface leaders look excited.

Even though the fighting hadn't started yet, Xiang Nanli already felt full.

第165章 战区新政

“累啊。”

凌晨两点，相南里生物钟被迫紊乱。

能来这里开会的人，多少接受过改造，别说熬个通宵了，三天三夜看起来也不在话下。

相南里的困顿显得不合时宜。

为了融入集体，相南里只好强撑着精神，瞪大自己的绿色眼睛，假装有在认真听讲。

大脑没办法思考，相南里依稀听到几个关键词，比如“战区新政”“战时电子货币政策”。

前者太长，只能拜托小智记在备忘录上。

后者倒是明白，说在战区使用的是新版人联信用点，这些新币会加上特别的编码，不进入人联内部区域流通。

相南里也是认真研读过几本《经济学原理》的男人了。

他近乎敏锐地察觉到人联的意图：在战区发新币，方便印钱。

这里的通货膨胀再严重，只要新币不进入地下城市流通，就不会影响人联内部的稳定。

果然，和经济有关的第二条政策，就是没收他们这些战区据点的信用点——当然没有这么粗暴，说的是“兑换”，人联信用点：战区信用点比例是1：1.2。

表面上看，人联血亏。

“这是福利政策。”姑苏的财政部长站在台上，衣冠楚楚，“你们能用原本的电子货币换到更多货物。”

嗯，但是只能在战区消费。

现在一切还算正常，但战争的消耗是无比巨大的。

人联在战区，掌握着不用担心通货膨胀的铸币权，于是，可以无限制地印新钞充当军饷。

最后，受剥削的一定是手握权力最少的底层人。

相南里害怕那个可能的未来。

他害怕500信用点一袋的营养膏、800信用点一瓶的纯净水，而生活在这里的人对此毫无办法；毕竟这是物资、交通都受到管控的战区。只希望人联不会真的把他们这些地表遗民当神庭信徒来整。

相南里感觉到失望，这让他更困了。

群里，这些据点的领袖大部分都是好评，竟然认为人联真的在让利，干了一件良心事。

相南里无意当唱反调的报丧鸟。可倾巢之下，基地如何苟活？

相南里把头靠在Alpha肩上，不停打着哈欠：“我想睡觉。”

相南里感觉自己走路都能昏过去，Alpha又不准他嗑药。

人联的精英阶层喜欢服用药剂优化自己的生理状态，并形成风俗；Alpha认为弊大于利，有足够的数据证明它们的微量毒性和成瘾性，他推崇原生人类学派。

Alpha的手贴在他的头上，像给猫顺毛：“马上就好。”

“我不想走路了，你抱我……”相南里把头靠在他的肩膀上。

Alpha拼尽全力控制嘴角上扬弧度，避免自己笑得过于明显。

好想变成一台冷冻舱，把相南里装进自己身体里。

如果人注定要死亡，那么请在我的怀里腐烂。

很不幸，Alpha带相南里回家的愿望没有达成。

一名穿着颇具科技感的工作人员快步走来，掏出自己的工作证件：“请稍等，总指挥希望您在会议后留下，还有一个短会。”

东方青帝：“我去开。”

考虑到长会有十几个小时，他合理怀疑，所谓的短会也得开到天亮。

“抱歉，指挥点名要见相南里。”

东方青帝的眉微微挑起，感到一股微妙的不爽。

相南里拍了拍Alpha的手，以示安抚。完全是下意识的行为，东方青帝大多时候面无表情，可相南里就是能分辨出那些微妙的变化。

也许这就是知子莫若父吧。

相南里感觉自己正牵着一条杀伤力很强的机械狗，正在努力让它别乱咬人。

Alpha不爱说话，情绪波动却不少。也许这就是会咬人的狗不叫吧。

小会议室就在大会议室的后方走廊，穿过走廊，推开门，好几个陌生的面孔在这正襟危坐。

相南里把他们的脸和背后的势力对上号，敏锐地发现这群人都来自“前线”。

可幸存者基地在战地西南方，靠后，处于第二梯队。

相南里自觉找了个角落坐下。

会议室里很安静，门外，方敬之缓缓到来的脚步声格外清晰。

金属质感的鞋子踏在冷冰冰的地面上，间奏不差分毫，步伐整齐划一。

相南里猜他有强迫症。

方敬之很高，身形颀长，穿上鞋后目测能有两米，这让他看谁都像在俯视。

姑苏显然是他的主场，方敬之昂首挺胸，优雅地在会议桌的最上方坐下。有个年轻人跟在他身边，安静又沉默。这是方敬之的秘书，高等人造人，瞳环是温暖的橙红。

所有人的目光都焦距在方敬之身上，等候他发号施令。

如果不是场合不对，相南里觉得自己会像是刘邦看嬴政那样，感叹一句“大丈夫当如是”。

“辛苦各位远道而来。”这位政客说话十分客气，没有财阀的高傲，优雅且陌生的发音，佐证着他高贵的出身。

这些财阀子弟的人联语自成一派，只有祖上阔过，才能在芯片内安装这套语言系统。

相南里面无表情，但周围这些首领，却表现出相当程度的受宠若惊，甚至有些诚惶诚恐。

[天呐！大人私下也这么礼貌温柔，好感动。]

[已路人转粉。]

[这么想，咱们战区还是很幸运的，派来的总指挥是方敬之，要是来的别人，估计只有冰冷冷的系统通知，强制分派的任务。不听话的还要顺便成为友军的战绩。]

这个观点得到群友的广泛认可，给相南里的心灵造成了极大的震撼。

方敬之只是在呼吸，其他人却觉得他如此纡尊降贵。

相南里再次意识到一件事——人联的阶级隔离，比他前世严重百倍。单是“软件权限”这个壁垒，就没办法靠着普通人的奋斗和努力去抹平。

相南里又想叹气了。

方敬之：“我长话短说。你们是人联面对神庭的第一战线。替后方承担着巨大的压力。人联会尽可能地给予你们支援。但只有一点，思想必须坚定。不能今天为了物资，把自己当人联的兵；明天就倒戈向黑十字审判庭。我更希望，我们的弹药可以打到敌人身上。”

最后一句，近乎明晃晃的威胁。

相南里在心里想着，那他这种位于后方的怎么说？白捡人联补给包？

然后，人联的补给包清单，就甩到了他电子设备上。

出乎意料的，上面没有任何武器、食物，有的是药物。

少部分人联生产的正规基因药，黑市上价格能翻倍；以及大量的“安非片”。

安非片，相南里查询资料，显示里面的有效成分是“甲基\安非\他命”和极其微量的“芬太尼”；除此外是无意义的淀粉。

这两者都可以用于医疗镇痛、麻醉；但在前世，相南里知道这两种药物成分，都是被严格管控的实验室毒品……比市面上流通的大部分成瘾物都要致命。

很显然，随着人类身体被基因药强化，这些流通药物的药效，也变得更加危险。
