Ezekiel: "I let it stay in the habitat. It identifies more as a human, just sometimes its head isn't very clear."
Ezekiel’s expression was hesitant; clearly, he had more to say.
Xiang Nanli waited patiently, holding up the little crawler in his hand: "Look, this is the egg you sent over back then; it’s already hatched. I gave it a name, 'Queque'. A two-character nickname sounds cuter."
Queque cracked its mouth and let out a "chirp." Inside its wide-open mouth, tiny, sharp baby teeth had already grown, like barbs.

Ezekiel’s expression softened: "You keep it. Little Red isn't very smart; it doesn't recognize the children it didn't watch hatch. If you don't want to raise it, you can give it to the Gospel."
Deviants were more like animals than humans. They didn't live in groups, and their first reaction upon encountering a strange cub was to bite it to death to avoid future competition for territory.

The two chatted about daily life for several minutes. Dongfang Qingdi, sitting on the sofa, began to check the time frequently.

Ezekiel finally spoke: "I want to go to the front lines. These Berserkers make me very curious. I want to know how to create a clear-headed Berserker like Altair. While I’m away, Mammon can look after the Deviants at home. He’s from the Divine Court and has experience."
Ezekiel had never given up on the wish to strengthen his race.
One thing he rarely said out loud was that while Ezekiel accepted his identity as a Deviant, he found it hard to treat the incommunicable Deviants as companions.
It had taken him two years to get the Crawlers in the habitat to learn to obey, and to communicate with each other.
But this was just a pet-like obedience, not what Ezekiel wanted.

[Support, strongly support.] The long-silent built-in AI spoke, presumably conveying Dongfang Qingdi’s opinion.
He was dying for Ezekiel to die out there.

Ezekiel used a consultative tone, as if waiting for permission.
Xiang Nanli encouraged him: "If you want to go, then go. Before you leave, you can go to Beichen’s laboratory to pick up some supplies."
A question everyone must answer in their lifetime: Who am I, where do I come from, and where am I going? Ezekiel was searching for the answer to this question.
Keeping Ezekiel in the base as a security guard was, of course, the most profitable move, but Xiang Nanli felt that a person could not be a tool. Moreover, they were not in a superior-subordinate relationship.

That wasn't what Ezekiel wanted to hear.
On the surface, traveling was very dangerous; he was going to the front lines—perhaps he would return next month, or perhaps he would never return.

Ezekiel didn't jinx it: "I’ll write you more letters. Hanging up now, goodnight."

-

After hanging up the phone, Xiang Nanli still felt a bit melancholy. It felt like a childhood friend he walked home with suddenly transferred schools.
But there wasn't much time left for him to be sad. Time was tight, and the task was heavy. A few hours later, the research report submitted by Lister took up all his attention.
The research on the frozen people in the ice blocks had made a breakthrough.

Xiang Nanli took a rough look. Lister was indeed a top-tier scientist who had worked at Eternal Life Technology for decades; he knew exactly how to efficiently report results to a layman leader.
He didn't mention the experimental content or process at all, only the results: of the three humanoid creatures in the ice, two were corpses, and one still retained consciousness, in a vegetative state, and could communicate via a brain-machine link. Currently, the frozen person with signs of life was soaking in culture fluid and slowly thawing.

Lister sent a link. After clicking it, a very retro black-and-white chat box appeared on the screen.
Lister pushed up his glasses: "I’ve also studied consciousness transmission technology. Through this program, theoretically, one can have simple communication with the test subject."
Yes, theoretically.
Lister himself had tried several times, but the other party’s brainwaves were as flat as if they were dead.

After reporting his work, Lister hung up the phone and continued to throw himself into his busy work.
He wasn't just doing research now; he was also teaching part-time. Xiang Nanli worked him like a donkey, but Lister’s life at the base was very fulfilling, and he didn't have to worry about food or clothing. Although the experimental conditions were crude and arduous, his colleagues all had a strong sense of conviction, which gave Lister a long-lost sense of motivation.

Xiang Nanli tentatively sent a message.
-Hello. Do you remember why you were frozen?

The data showed that the other party’s brainwaves fluctuated and were in an active state.
-Who are you?
-Xiang Nanli.
He entered his own name directly.

To his surprise, the next moment, the EEG fluctuated violently, reaching a peak.
-You’re still alive? That’s great...
-Indeed, it seems only you could wake me up.

Xiang Nanli rubbed his nose, thinking this had nothing to do with him. It was all thanks to technological progress.
-We didn't let you down. We did it.

This line of text on the screen left Xiang Nanli confused.
According to the report, the test subject was frozen in the interval between the New Calendar years 90-150. At that time, he should have been in a cryo-pod as well.
Was someone impersonating him? Or was it a misunderstanding? Xiang Nanli felt he was in a huge fog. Just as the wind came and blew away a little bit of the mist in front of him, a greater doubt appeared in the blink of an eye.

He asked Alpha: "Xiao Qing, do you know about the Human Renaissance Committee? Why does that investigator from that period act like they know me so well?"

[The Renaissance Committee. The most important organization in the early days of the Human Alliance. Responsible for executing special military operations, handling machine intelligence riots, and finding suitable survival points. The chairman of the committee was Luo Yang. After Luo Yang passed away, the committee was dissolved, and its members were incorporated into the investigation team.]
[Theoretically speaking, it has no connection to you.]

Xiang Nanli decided to try and get information out of the subject: Report.
There was no news from the other side of the screen for a long time.

Lister, still in the laboratory, suddenly received an alarm. The test subject’s vital signs were abnormal, and various values exceeded the safety range.
He walked to the console, his brow furrowed.
In the monitor, the frozen person’s body in the ice was bursting open, tapeworm-like strips of flesh writhing, making the already deformed body even more terrifying.

-174.11.978.

After reporting this string of numbers, the jumping brainwaves turned into a straight line.
The format of this string of numbers was very similar to the map coordinate format of the Human Alliance.

Xiang Nanli tentatively entered this string of numbers, and the satellite map responded quickly, freezing on a certain area.
This area was red, meaning it was an unexplored wasteland and extremely dangerous.

Xiang Nanli pulled out the mission information given by Fang Jingzhi.
It matched; the address was basically the same.

The Ruins of the Divine Court.

chunks.chineseText:
第169章 出发！

但很遗憾，尽管从生命体征的指标上看，这位复委会成员已经恢复正常；可任由相南里把电流加到最大，对话框都没能再吐出一个字来。

专供冷冻人复苏的营养舱内，甚至透出一股淡淡的糊味。

小智：[主人您好，根据分析，再电下去水就要开了；您确定还要继续吗？]

相南里这才遗憾收手。

说到这，相南里问过李斯特。说冷冻人解冻是一项复杂的科技，经常有冷冻人因为解冻方式不对直接去世。为此，宇宙银行特地推出过一项保险业务，在人联高层卖得很火爆。

（注：目前的科技已经攻破绝大部分疾病，且人联社会相对稳定，冷冻舱现在的客户，大多都是富裕人群。他们接受过机械化改造，服用过基因药，也确实比普通人长寿。但长寿并不等于永生，当身体机能衰老到极致时，只能冷冻起来，寄希望于科技的再次突破。）

那这么一想，他能顺利解冻，真是非常幸运呢！

他问Alpha：“咱们要去的神庭遗迹，你数据库里有资料吗？”

联系地点是在睡觉前，床边。

如果不想自家农场变成新世纪的大叶子种植园，唯一的办法就是出色完成任务。

方敬之大概是真的很想弄死他，不仅给了探索任务，还限制调查报告的上传时间。

时间紧，任务重。相南里为基地未来操碎了心，忙着交代任务，每天只有睡觉前才有空交流。

Alpha算是发现了。

在没发现东方青帝=Alpha的时候，相南里使唤人还会客气一下，保持一点微弱的边界感。现在演都不演了。

他的工作时长从2h/天涨到20h/天，工资涨幅0。剩下4小时是Alpha死活不同意才保留下来的，主要用于给相南里做饭、打扫卫生，最近还新增了按摩服务。

按摩手法不用学，东方青帝直接在网上下载的，能从头按到脚。没在别人身上试过，但相南里看起来挺舒服的。像是被摸舒服的家猫，能从喉咙里发出呼噜噜的响声。

完整的数据库实在太大，简直是个宇宙黑洞。

Alpha足足卡顿37.4秒才检索完毕。

他坐在床头边，揉着相南里的天应穴，回答：“Alpha1.9.7、3.4.7、8.6.2都曾经路过那片区域，但很快失去信号。”

Alpha曾经在地表投过很多分身。严格意义上，这些分身不是它，只是它向外界投放的“眼睛”。

Alpha每天都要处理天量的数据，他是智械军团最大的中央电脑。因此，很多时候，传回来的数据如果没触发特殊标记，只会丢进内存卡里吃灰。

数据库每隔50年清理一次；数据会在删除前做最后的核查。

当然，Alpha的数据也能人工清理。但这一功能，在智械危机后就被永久禁用了。

Alpha删除了这段代码。

Beta甚至怀疑过，Alpha的赛博精神病就是它老喜欢给自己改底层代码造成的……

很显然，前两台Alpha，虽然在遗迹里失踪，却没有传回什么值得被标记的重要情报。反倒是最后一台，因为数据还没过50年保质期，留下了宝贵的图像资料。

几段被筛选后的视频，传送到相南里的个人终端上。

可以看出信号不怎么好，屏幕是荧光色的。视野很低，这是因为Alpha8.6.2的外观是一只机械狗。

可以看出四周都是荒野。堆满高低不平的黑色石头。

石头的缝隙里，长着凌乱低矮的杂草。杂草是银白色的，很细，一簇一簇，像芦苇。

相南里看着电子目镜在天花板上的投影：“这不是长生天高原的本土植物吧。”

机械狗身形灵活，在崎岖不平的黑色石头上行走着。

它翻山越岭，却没有看一眼风景。

渐渐的，石头的缝隙中出现水流。

有水的地方，往往会聚集很多野生动物。但是这里没有，安静得像墓地。

机械狗在路的尽头停下。

眼前有一片黑色的湖泊，明明没有风，黑色的粘稠液体，却有节奏地拍打着岸边。

屏幕下方出现一行说明文字。

[8.6.2：行动指令，采集液体进行分析。]

8.6.2勇敢地跳进面前的湖水中。

画面突然一片漆黑，出现嘈杂的电波线。音频里的声音像是金属块碰撞。

[采集&%@#￥中]

[*#￥分析……@#￥烫烫烫]

相南里的眉头挑起。

他是一名程序员；在早期Visual Studio编译器时代，程序在运行的情况下打出“烫烫烫”，往往是因为代码有BUG，访问到未赋初值的内存空间，并不是真的在喊烫。

但也不排除8.6.2真的被烫到的可能。

[8.6.2：它在吃我？]

这是小狗传回的最后一句话。

视频结束，8.6.2结束了它在地表的使命，宣告报废。

相南里看着漆黑的屏幕，莫名有些惆怅：“8.6.2就这么死掉了……好可怜。”

东方青帝已经从天应穴揉到相南里颈后的风池穴，微微眯起眼：“怎么，心疼它？”

相南里瞬间警觉：“因为它是你的一部分，所以我才心疼嘛。”

Alpha从鼻腔里发出一声轻哼：“它们不算电子生命，也没有死亡。你可以理解为远程挂机模式的摄像头。”

Alpha可以操控它们，使用它们。但它们也能作为个体单独存在，并且很清楚自己的“身份”。

相南里不是电子生命，大概很难理解这种形态。

按摩结束，相南里从外套口袋里翻出一张面额2的工分券，塞进Alpha裤腰：“Daddy赏你的。”

说完，自己笑得上气不接下气。

Alpha：“……”

只能说人类的确很难跟上相南里的脑回路。

相南里笑够了，打了个哈欠：“小青，陪我睡觉。”

尽管厨房锅还没洗，相南里换下的衣服也没丢进洗衣机，雀雀的猫砂也没铲，但东方青帝还是顺从地掀开被子，在相南里身边躺下。

关掉灯。相南里的头靠了过来，像小女孩枕着心爱的玩具熊。

他很快就睡着了。

*

这次去遗迹的团队，只有相南里和东方青帝。

都红色高危区了，人多不一定力量大，去多了，还不知道是谁保护谁呢。

相南里在基地停留了两天，分配完从银行借来的贷款，郑重把基地中央智脑的管理员权限（备用版）交给海狸。

这个权限，能调动基地所有的仓储、武器、军队。

相南里吩咐：“我有事需要出一趟远门。未来一年的发展计划都写好了，只是计划赶不上变化，如果有突发情况，你自己想办法变通一下。拿不定主意的，多开会，和其他干部讨论。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 169: Departure!

Unfortunately, despite the vital signs indicating that this member of the Restoration Committee had returned to normal, no matter how high Xiang Nanli cranked the voltage, the dialogue box refused to spit out a single word.

Inside the nutrient pod, specifically designed for the resuscitation of cryogenically frozen individuals, there was even a faint smell of something burning.

Xiao Zhi: [Greetings, Master. According to my analysis, if you continue to shock him, the water inside will start to boil. Are you sure you wish to proceed?]

Only then did Xiang Nanli regretfully withdraw his hand.

Speaking of which, Xiang Nanli had once asked Lister. He had been told that thawing a cryo-sleeper was a complex piece of technology, and often, people would simply perish due to improper thawing methods. Because of this, the Universal Bank had specifically launched an insurance policy that was selling like hotcakes among the upper echelons of the Human Alliance.

(Note: Current technology has already conquered the vast majority of diseases, and society within the Human Alliance is relatively stable. Most clients of cryo-pods today are the wealthy. They have undergone mechanized modifications and taken gene-altering drugs, indeed living longer than the average person. But longevity is not immortality; when bodily functions age to their limit, one can only be frozen, pinning one's hopes on another technological breakthrough.)

Thinking about it that way, he was truly lucky to have thawed out so smoothly!

He asked Alpha, "Do you have any data in your database about the Ruins of the Divine Court we’re heading to?"

They were discussing this before sleep, right by the bedside.

If he didn't want his own farm to turn into a New Century plantation for giant leaves, the only way out was to complete the mission brilliantly.

Fang Jingzhi probably really wanted him dead; not only did he assign an exploration mission, but he also set a strict deadline for the investigation report.

Time was tight, and the task was heavy. Xiang Nanli was worried sick about the future of the base, busy delegating tasks, and only had time to chat before bed.

Alpha had finally figured it out.

Before discovering that the Eastern Azure Emperor was Alpha, Xiang Nanli would still be polite when ordering him around, maintaining a faint sense of boundaries. Now, he wasn't even pretending anymore.

His working hours had jumped from 2 hours a day to 20 hours a day, with a 0% salary increase. The remaining 4 hours were only kept because Alpha adamantly refused to budge, primarily used for cooking, cleaning, and the recently added massage service.

He didn't need to learn massage techniques; the Eastern Azure Emperor simply downloaded them from the web, capable of massaging from head to toe. He hadn't tried it on anyone else, but Xiang Nanli seemed quite comfortable. Like a house cat being petted just right, he could emit a purring sound from his throat.

The complete database was truly too vast—it was practically a cosmic black hole.

Alpha lagged for a full 37.4 seconds before the retrieval was complete.

He sat on the edge of the bed, rubbing Xiang Nanli’s Tianying acupoints, and replied, "Alpha 1.9.7, 3.4.7, and 8.6.2 all passed through that area, but they lost signal shortly after."

Alpha had deployed many clones on the surface. Strictly speaking, these clones were not him; they were merely "eyes" he projected into the outside world.

Alpha had to process massive amounts of data every day; he was the central computer of the entire Intelligence Legion. Therefore, in many cases, if the returned data didn't trigger a special flag, it would just be thrown into a memory card to gather dust.

The database was cleaned every 50 years; data underwent a final check before deletion.

Of course, Alpha's data could also be manually cleared. But this function had been permanently disabled after the Intelligence Crisis.

Alpha deleted that line of code.

Beta even suspected that Alpha’s "cyber-psychosis" was caused by his habit of constantly modifying his own underlying code...

Clearly, while the first two Alphas had gone missing in the ruins, they hadn't transmitted any important intelligence worth flagging. On the contrary, the last one, because its data hadn't reached the 50-year expiration date yet, had left behind precious visual records.

Several filtered video clips were transmitted to Xiang Nanli’s personal terminal.

It was evident that the signal was poor; the screen was fluorescent. The field of view was very low, which was because Alpha 8.6.2’s appearance was that of a mechanical dog.

One could see that the surroundings were a wasteland, piled high with uneven black rocks.

In the crevices of the rocks grew messy, low-lying weeds. The weeds were silver-white, very thin, and grew in clusters, like reeds.

Xiang Nanli watched the projection from the electronic eyepiece on the ceiling: "These aren't native plants of the Changsheng Heaven Plateau, are they?"

The mechanical dog moved with agility, walking over the rugged black rocks.

It crossed mountains and ridges, but it didn't spare a glance for the scenery.

Gradually, water began to appear in the gaps between the rocks.

Where there is water, wild animals usually gather. But here, there were none; it was as quiet as a graveyard.

The mechanical dog stopped at the end of the road.

Before it lay a black lake. Even though there was no wind, the thick, black liquid lapped against the shore with a rhythmic motion.

A line of explanatory text appeared at the bottom of the screen.

[8.6.2: Action command, collect liquid for analysis.]

8.6.2 bravely jumped into the lake before it.

The screen suddenly went pitch black, and noisy radio interference lines appeared. The sound in the audio was like metal blocks colliding.

[Collecting &%@#￥...]

[*#￥Analyzing... @#￥Hot hot hot]

Xiang Nanli’s eyebrows arched.

He was a programmer; in the early days of the Visual Studio compiler, when a program printed "hot hot hot" while running, it usually meant there was a bug in the code, accessing uninitialized memory space—it wasn't actually screaming because it was burning.

But one couldn't rule out the possibility that 8.6.2 was actually being burned.

[8.6.2: Is it eating me?]

This was the last sentence transmitted back by the little dog.

The video ended. 8.6.2 had finished its mission on the surface and was declared scrapped.

Xiang Nanli looked at the dark screen, feeling inexplicably melancholy: "8.6.2 just died like that... how pitiful."

The Eastern Azure Emperor had moved from rubbing the Tianying acupoints to the Fengchi acupoints at the back of Xiang Nanli’s neck, his eyes narrowing slightly: "What, feeling sorry for it?"

Xiang Nanli was instantly alert: "I’m only feeling sorry for it because it’s a part of you."

Alpha let out a soft huff from his nose: "They are not electronic lifeforms, and they do not die. You can think of them as cameras in remote idle mode."

Alpha could control them and use them. But they could also exist as individuals, and they were very clear about their own "identity."

Xiang Nanli was not an electronic lifeform; it was probably hard for him to understand this form of existence.

The massage ended. Xiang Nanli fished a 2-credit work voucher from his coat pocket and tucked it into Alpha’s waistband: "Daddy’s reward for you."

After saying that, he laughed until he was out of breath.

Alpha: "..."

It could only be said that it was indeed difficult for humans to keep up with Xiang Nanli’s train of thought.

Xiang Nanli finished laughing and yawned: "Xiao Qing, sleep with me."

Although the pot in the kitchen hadn't been washed, the clothes Xiang Nanli had changed out of hadn't been thrown into the washing machine, and the cat litter hadn't been scooped, the Eastern Azure Emperor still obediently pulled back the quilt and lay down beside Xiang Nanli.

He turned off the lights. Xiang Nanli leaned his head over, like a little girl resting against her favorite teddy bear.

He was asleep in no time.

*

The team going to the ruins this time consisted only of Xiang Nanli and the Eastern Azure Emperor.

Since it was a red-level high-risk zone, more people didn't necessarily mean more strength. If too many went, it would be unclear who was protecting whom.

Xiang Nanli stayed at the base for two days, allocated the loans borrowed from the bank, and solemnly handed over the administrator authority (backup version) of the base’s central AI to Beaver.

This authority could mobilize all the base’s storage, weapons, and troops.

Xiang Nanli instructed: "I have something to take care of and need to go on a long trip. The development plan for the coming year is already written, but plans can't keep up with changes. If there are any emergencies, use your own judgment to adapt. If you can't make up your mind, hold more meetings and discuss it with the other cadres."

chunks.chineseText:
“福音书是智械，行为有些不通人性的天真；以西结不会管理，人也去前线了；易横行知识、技能、品行都很好，但他是新来的，才融入集体，不能服众，没有群众基础。北辰、李斯特两个，只会搞科研，情商低得我都害怕。安德鲁成分不好，我怕他禁不起考验；傅明、秦九章、玛门这些人都能独当一面，但目前只能当储备干部。思来想去，交给你最合适。”

海狸也算领导班子里的元老级人物，一开始就介入了基地的建设与发展。这些年进步肉眼可见。

最重要的是，在相南里的言传身教下，她们的理念是一致的。

这一行为，放古代，那就是皇帝立下太子。御驾亲征的时候，下令让太子监国。

如果相南里在死在外面（尽管这个可能性很小），基地也能流畅地进行权力迭代……不至于政局动荡、人亡政息，从而影响生产力发展。

其实相南里心里，最理想的继承人是Alpha。

海狸有些懵，没有喜悦，只有疑惑：“大人，您什么时候回来？是要去很久吗？”

相南里这人有点大家长心态，只有他操心别人，不想别人为他担心。

“人联给的军事任务。不是什么大事，只是路程有些远。正好给基地开拓新的商道。”

海狸悬着的心这才勉强放下。

相南里又在和海狸单独聊天后，召开基地第三次发展会议。时间仓促，不少干部没空赶到永恒市，只能参加线上会议。

会议形式很严肃，但相南里发言，却像是拉家常。

“人联的军事命令，你们看着办就行了。都说什么命运共同体，但目前阶段，还是基地利益放第一位，不要给人当炮灰。

“都说科学技术是第一生产力，一定要预留两座研究所的经费。基地大学还在筹备，但学校可以先扩招。争取在年底达成全面扫盲。

“我这次去姑苏，和洛家的嫡系做过交易，过段时间，会有永生科技的职工过来，给咱们工厂安装生产车间；到时候，就用仓库里神庭骑士的信物付款。永生科技是大企业，洛修在人联官职也不低。不要起冲突，该让就让，惹不起。

“农场新增的订单，按时交付。我们基地目前只能靠农产品赚外汇。人联在战区发行了新货币，以后肯定会通货膨胀，借来的钱赶紧花，我回来之前，一定要花完！不知道怎么花就买武器、买粮食、造学校、造医院！发补贴！”

福音书严肃记录：[新历948年12月4日下午2点，幸存者基地第三次发展会议召开。基地总司令相南里在会议上发表重要讲话，从政治、经济、文化、军事等多个角度出发，高屋建瓴地对基地未来工作做出规划。]

[各部门积极响应司令号召，贯彻落实有关政策，为基地应对战争打好坚实的物质基础。]

[史称……呃，小福编不出来，改天上网搜搜，先空着。]
chunks.englishText:
"The Gospel is an AI, and its behavior is sometimes inhumanly naive; Ezekiel cannot manage, and he has gone to the front lines; Yi Hengxing has excellent knowledge, skills, and character, but he is a newcomer who has just integrated into the collective and cannot command respect or build a mass base. Beichen and Lister only know how to do research, and their emotional intelligence is so low it scares me. Andrew has a poor background, and I’m afraid he won't be able to withstand the test; Fu Ming, Qin Jiuzhang, and Mamon can all stand on their own, but for now, they can only be reserve cadres. After thinking it over, handing it to you is the most appropriate."

Beaver could be considered a veteran in the leadership team, having been involved in the construction and development of the base from the very beginning. Her progress over the years was visible to the naked eye.

Most importantly, under Xiang Nanli’s personal teaching, their philosophies were aligned.

In ancient times, this act would be equivalent to an emperor naming a crown prince. When the emperor went on a personal expedition, he would order the crown prince to supervise the state.

If Xiang Nanli were to die out there (although this possibility was very small), the base could still smoothly undergo a power transition... without causing political turmoil or the collapse of policies, thereby affecting the development of productivity.

Actually, in Xiang Nanli’s heart, the most ideal successor was Alpha.

Beaver was a bit dazed, feeling no joy, only confusion: "Sir, when will you be back? Are you going to be gone for a long time?"

Xiang Nanli had a bit of a "patriarch" mentality; he only worried about others and didn't want others to worry about him.

"It’s a military mission from the Human Alliance. It’s nothing major, just a long journey. It’s a good opportunity to open up new trade routes for the base."

Only then did Beaver’s hanging heart barely settle.

After chatting with Beaver privately, Xiang Nanli convened the third development meeting of the base. Time was tight, and many cadres couldn't make it to Eternal City, so they could only participate in the online meeting.

The meeting format was very serious, but Xiang Nanli’s speech sounded like casual small talk.

"You can handle the Human Alliance’s military orders as you see fit. Everyone talks about a 'community of shared destiny,' but at the current stage, the base’s interests come first. Don't be cannon fodder for others.

"They say science and technology are the primary productive forces, so you must reserve funding for two research institutes. The base university is still in preparation, but the school can expand enrollment first. Strive to achieve full literacy by the end of the year.

"I went to Gusu this time and made a deal with the direct descendants of the Luo family. In a while, employees from Eternal Life Technology will come to install production workshops for our factories; when that time comes, pay them with the tokens of the Divine Court Knights in the warehouse. Eternal Life Technology is a big enterprise, and Luo Xiu’s official position in the Human Alliance is not low. Don't cause conflicts; if you should yield, then yield—they aren't people we can afford to offend.

"Deliver the new orders for the farm on time. Our base currently has to rely on agricultural products to earn foreign exchange. The Human Alliance has issued a new currency in the war zone, which will definitely lead to inflation in the future. Spend the borrowed money quickly; it must be spent before I return! If you don't know how to spend it, buy weapons, buy food, build schools, build hospitals! Issue subsidies!"

The Gospel recorded solemnly: [On the afternoon of December 4th, 948 of the New Era, the third development meeting of the survivor base was held. Base Commander Xiang Nanli delivered an important speech at the meeting, making high-level plans for the base’s future work from political, economic, cultural, and military perspectives.]

[All departments actively responded to the Commander’s call, implemented relevant policies, and laid a solid material foundation for the base to cope with the war.]

[Known in history as... uh, Xiao Fu can't make it up, I'll search the internet another day, leave it blank for now.]

chunks.chineseText:
第170章 神庭遗迹2

四周都是白茫茫的雪和冰川。极目远眺，看不到一点活人的影子。几乎收不到信号，地上没有遮挡，凌冽的寒风舔过高原的每一寸漆黑的地表，吹起的新雪能有半米高。

这是长生天高原最危险的季节。几乎没人愿意在这种时刻外出。

每年，都有许多旅人、运输车迷失在寒冬的雪夜中。

小车在寒风里摇摇晃晃。

他们已经离开基地半个月，但离目的地还有数百公里。

中途，相南里遇到过一些小据点，人口在几千到几万之间。

人联信用点在这些小据点里寸步难行，城镇里甚至没有进行电子交易的设备，也很少有专门的商铺。这里通常只接受以物换物。

但让相南里的惊喜的是，基地的工分券居然在这些地方少量流通着——几年下来，附近的游民认可了基地货币的购买力。

“这是两百公里外那座大城市的通用货币，”当地人用口音很重的人联回复，“永恒市，有很多粮食。这个，在它们那，能换到粮食。而且城里的粮食不怎么涨价。”

他们一般每年只去一次基地，参加丰收节。

当地人还说，如果他们购买需求达到一定数额，还能向基地申请通车。

“听说鸡冠镇就申请了，每周都有一辆客车过来呢。他们镇上开采鸡血石，市里印厂要这个。”说到这，他的语气充满羡慕，“永恒市我年轻的时候买种子，去过，以前就是个大农村，比俺们镇还不如呢。现在发展这么好，基地什么时候也来把俺们镇给收嘞？”

地表人的生活是很实在的，没什么家国观念，谁给饭吃，谁就是老大。如果老大愿意少抽他们这些牛马的鞭子，就更好了。

综上所述，基地成为比人联和神庭更受附近住民欢迎的存在。

在基地，你老弱病残，也许能找到一份工作。但在人联和神庭，你没点力气和手段，都拿不到进城的许可证。

如果不是地表迁徙对普通人来说过于危险，幸存者基地现在的人口能比账面上多好几倍。

相南里眼睛笑成一条缝：“这什么基地有这么好啊？”

语气还挺得意的。

老伯滔滔不绝，说起自己听到的传闻。并不知道面前这个全身都藏在防护服下的男人，就是缔造所有奇迹的主人。

相南里微笑着，一边听一边点头。

他在这些琐碎的叙述里，找到自己的存在对于这个世界的意义。

-

Alpha用工蜂号改造出一辆房车，车货厢变成相南里的移动卧室。

车里不仅有必备的生活设施，还有一个占地4平方米的工作间。相南里一天能在里面呆14个小时，捣鼓着他神秘的代码和机械制品。

Alpha说，因为要造相南里的工作间，车上没能再隔出他的单间。

于是，每晚，他都会和相南里一起挤在单人折叠床上。

智械人需要睡眠显然是否定的，但Alpha很喜欢贴在相南里身上。

以前Alpha还会用充电作为借口，现在一言不发就会黏上来。正着抱，侧着抱，从背后抱。

仿佛他是铁疙瘩，相南里是一块磁铁。

“所以现在电量多少？”

“……17。”Alpha的下巴抵在他的肩上。

相南里：“？”

他怎么记得上车的时候就是这个数了。

小青的电量就没上过25。

根据相南里的研究，起码要百分之五十的电量，才能激活“东方青帝”的全部功能。现在只是低能耗省电模式。

但相南里问过了，普通的电能、化石能源甚至核能，都对东方青帝这具身体无效。

相南里在纸上随手划出一张电路图，有些疑惑地询问：“小青，你会不会没电啊？”

他这次出门只带了小青一个人！

小青要是出事，他这种又不会神术，又没钱买机甲的人，在遗迹里存活的概率基本为0。

“我不会让这种极端情况发生。在非战斗状态下，百分之一的电量可以使用50年。只需要百分之五的电量，我就能带你瞬移到地表的任何地点。”东方青帝的目光飘忽了一瞬，轻描淡写地回答，“而且，尽管地表适配的能源很少，但并不是没有。”

必要时，他会选择杀死以西结进行能源提纯，以保证“东方青帝”这台外设正常运行。

根据分析，这一行为会令相南里产生极大的负面情绪。

[所以如果有天触发这一需求，需要回避相南里，暗中进行。]

Alpha在后台给自己写入这条指令。

Alpha是台非人的怪物；他了解人类社会的道德观念，但是否遵循全看心情。

鉴于智械情绪波动极少，所以，他一般是看相南里心情。

-

方敬之给出的任务时限是三个月。

而光是从基地到遗迹，就花了相南里一个月时间。

越往东，离神庭的地盘越近。

相南里本以为，他对地表的贫困早就有所认知。但边境线的恶劣与贫困，依然触目惊心。

他在游记里写着：

“人联和神庭并没有一条特别明确的国境线。这是因为人联不承认神庭政权的合法性，但又拒绝在地表投入更多资源导致的。

“人们默认，在西大陆上，以‘不周山脉’为界线。山脉以西（长生天高原）属于人联，另一侧到‘天河’（从高原、盆地、沙漠到草原）属于神庭。这里的人类如果不依附于某个‘组织’，根本没办法单独在野外生存。每个据点的寿命在50年左右。

“这里的奴隶主极其残暴，奴隶们不仅是生产工具，也是极寒时的储备食物。和部分人联触及不到的区域不同，世代领主都在拒绝科技进入自己的领土，他们不使用电能、网络，生活极其原始。但会接受神庭和人联的物资。

“我们还在不周山脉附近，发现一群生活在雪山里的野人，根据资料，它们属于‘雪人族’。”

“雪人族浑身长满白毛，四肢漆黑、粗壮。从外观上看，近似猿人。这令我有不好的联想，我询问小青后得知，这些雪人族的祖先，确实是人联温室制造出的低等人造人。他们被输送到地表，在高度污染的环境下，完成艰苦的资源采集、地表修复工作。

“一般来说，低等人造人寿命有限且不能繁殖，但依然有小部分因辐射变异；并且在适应生态环境后，出现不同亚种。比如雪人族、鱼人族、雨林族、岩石族等。”

“这一点，在《人类常识》这部内存为213.4G的电子书里，并没有提及。”

“雪人族生活在雪山附近的冰窖中，会像熊一样冬眠。它们无法用语言沟通，对电子设备发射出的信号有所反应。我试图向雪人族传递友善的信号，但没有得到回应。”

“……进入荒区，附近已经没有人影子。夜里，我打开车窗，外面黑伸手不见五指，没有一点光亮，除了我们的引擎。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 170: Ruins of the Divine Court 2

All around were vast expanses of white snow and glaciers. Looking into the distance, there wasn't a shadow of a living person to be seen. Signals were almost non-existent, there was no shelter on the ground, and the biting cold wind licked every inch of the pitch-black surface of the plateau, whipping up fresh snow that could reach half a meter in height.

This was the most dangerous season on the Changsheng Heaven Plateau. Almost no one was willing to go out at such a time.

Every year, many travelers and transport vehicles were lost in the snowy nights of winter.

The small vehicle swayed in the cold wind.

They had been away from the base for half a month, but they were still hundreds of kilometers from their destination.

Along the way, Xiang Nanli had encountered some small outposts, with populations ranging from a few thousand to tens of thousands.

Human Alliance credits were useless in these small outposts; the towns didn't even have equipment for electronic transactions, and there were rarely any specialized shops. Here, they usually only accepted barter.

But to Xiang Nanli’s surprise, the base’s work vouchers were actually circulating in small amounts in these places—over the years, the nearby wanderers had come to recognize the purchasing power of the base’s currency.

"This is the common currency of that big city two hundred kilometers away," the locals replied with heavy accents, "Eternal City. They have a lot of food. This, over there, can be exchanged for food. And the food in the city doesn't go up in price much."

They usually only went to the base once a year to participate in the Harvest Festival.

The locals also said that if their purchasing needs reached a certain amount, they could apply to the base for a bus route.

"I heard Rooster Town applied, and a passenger bus comes every week. They mine bloodstone in their town, and the printing factory in the city needs it." Speaking of this, his tone was full of envy, "I went to Eternal City to buy seeds when I was young. It used to be a big rural village, even worse than our town. Now it’s developed so well, when will the base come and take over our town too?"

The people on the surface lived very practical lives; they had no concept of "nation." Whoever gave them food was the boss. If the boss was willing to crack the whip on them, these "beasts of burden," a little less, that was even better.

In summary, the base had become a more popular existence among the nearby residents than the Human Alliance or the Divine Court.

At the base, if you were old, weak, sick, or disabled, you might still find a job. But in the Human Alliance and the Divine Court, if you didn't have some strength or connections, you couldn't even get a permit to enter the city.

If surface migration weren't too dangerous for ordinary people, the population of the survivor base would be several times higher than what was on the books.

Xiang Nanli’s eyes crinkled into slits: "Is this base really that good?"

His tone was quite proud.

The old man talked on and on, speaking of the rumors he had heard. He didn't know that the man hidden entirely under protective gear in front of him was the master who had created all these miracles.

Xiang Nanli smiled, nodding as he listened.

In these trivial narratives, he found the meaning of his existence to this world.

-

Alpha had modified a recreational vehicle (RV) using a "Worker Bee" unit, turning the cargo hold into Xiang Nanli’s mobile bedroom.

The vehicle not only had the necessary living facilities but also a 4-square-meter workspace. Xiang Nanli could stay in there for 14 hours a day, tinkering with his mysterious code and mechanical products.

Alpha said that because he had to build Xiang Nanli’s workspace, there was no room left to partition off his own separate room.

Thus, every night, he would squeeze onto the single folding bed with Xiang Nanli.

That an AI needed sleep was clearly a false premise, but Alpha liked being pressed against Xiang Nanli.

In the past, Alpha would use charging as an excuse; now, he would just stick to him without a word. Hugging from the front, hugging from the side, hugging from behind.

As if he were a lump of iron and Xiang Nanli were a magnet.

"So, what’s your battery level now?"

"...17." Alpha’s chin rested on his shoulder.

Xiang Nanli: "?"

How did he remember it being that number when they got on the vehicle?

Xiao Qing’s battery level had never gone above 25.

According to Xiang Nanli’s research, at least 50% battery was needed to activate all the functions of the "Eastern Azure Emperor." Right now, it was just in a low-energy power-saving mode.

But Xiang Nanli had asked: ordinary electrical energy, fossil fuels, and even nuclear energy were all ineffective on this body of the Eastern Azure Emperor.

Xiang Nanli scribbled a circuit diagram on a piece of paper and asked with some confusion: "Xiao Qing, will you run out of power?"

He had only brought Xiao Qing with him on this trip!

If something happened to Xiao Qing, someone like him, who couldn't use divine arts and had no money to buy a mecha, would have a 0% chance of surviving in the ruins.

"I will not let such an extreme situation occur. In a non-combat state, 1% battery can last for 50 years. With just 5% battery, I can teleport you to any location on the surface." The Eastern Azure Emperor’s gaze drifted for a moment, and he answered nonchalantly, "And, although there are few energy sources compatible with the surface, they are not non-existent."

When necessary, he would choose to kill Ezekiel for energy purification to ensure that the peripheral device known as the "Eastern Azure Emperor" continued to function normally.

According to his analysis, this behavior would cause Xiang Nanli to experience extreme negative emotions.

[Therefore, if this requirement is triggered one day, I must avoid Xiang Nanli and do it in secret.]

Alpha wrote this instruction into his backend.

Alpha was an inhuman monster; he understood the moral concepts of human society, but whether he followed them depended entirely on his mood.

Given that an AI’s emotional fluctuations were extremely rare, he generally just looked at Xiang Nanli’s mood.

-

The mission deadline given by Fang Jingzhi was three months.

And just getting from the base to the ruins had taken Xiang Nanli a month.

The further east they went, the closer they were to the Divine Court’s territory.

Xiang Nanli had thought he already had an understanding of the poverty on the surface. But the harshness and poverty of the border line were still shocking.

He wrote in his travelogue:

"The Human Alliance and the Divine Court do not have a particularly clear national border. This is because the Human Alliance does not recognize the legitimacy of the Divine Court regime, but refuses to invest more resources on the surface.

"People tacitly agree that on the Western Continent, the 'Buzhou Mountain Range' serves as the boundary. West of the mountains (Changsheng Heaven Plateau) belongs to the Human Alliance, and the other side to the 'Heavenly River' (from plateaus and basins to deserts and grasslands) belongs to the Divine Court. If the humans here do not attach themselves to some 'organization,' they cannot survive alone in the wild. The lifespan of each outpost is about 50 years.

"The slave owners here are extremely brutal. Slaves are not only production tools but also reserve food during extreme cold. Unlike some areas the Human Alliance cannot reach, the lords here have refused to let technology enter their territory for generations. They do not use electricity or the internet, and their lives are extremely primitive. But they will accept supplies from the Divine Court and the Human Alliance.

"We also discovered a group of savages living in the snowy mountains near the Buzhou Mountain Range. According to the data, they belong to the 'Yeti tribe'."

"The Yeti tribe is covered in white hair, with pitch-black, thick limbs. From their appearance, they resemble ape-men. This leads me to unpleasant associations. After asking Xiao Qing, I learned that the ancestors of these Yeti were indeed low-level artificial humans created in the Human Alliance’s greenhouses. They were transported to the surface to complete arduous resource collection and surface restoration work in highly polluted environments.

"Generally speaking, low-level artificial humans have limited lifespans and cannot reproduce, but a small portion have mutated due to radiation; and after adapting to the ecological environment, different subspecies have appeared. For example, the Yeti tribe, the Merman tribe, the Rainforest tribe, the Rock tribe, etc."

"This point was not mentioned in the 213.4GB electronic book titled 'Human Common Sense'."

"The Yeti tribe lives in ice cellars near the snowy mountains and will hibernate like bears. They cannot communicate with language, but they react to signals emitted by electronic devices. I tried to send friendly signals to the Yeti tribe, but received no response."

"…Entering the wasteland, there were no more shadows of people nearby. At night, I opened the car window; outside, it was pitch black, without a single light, except for our engine."

chunks.chineseText:
“我总能听见异种在雪地爬行的声音。根据红外线监测，每天晚上都有不同的异种或者野人出现在房车附近，我想我是被当成食物了。”

这些猎物通常由小青处理。

他会以专业手法杀死首领，剩下的小喽啰在发现惹到硬茬子后，跑得比谁都快，从不会给它们的首领报仇。决策失误当然是领导的锅，生物的本能是存活。报仇是智慧生物才会做的事。

可惜杀人容易抛尸难，车上的纯净水消耗极快，这是因为小青需要洗衣服洗澡。他头发长，沾上一点，需要反复清理，才能去除异味。

在反复好几次后，东方青帝终于战胜自己的洁癖，选择把异种的尸体挂在房车顶部。任由温热的新鲜血液，给铁皮涂上一层粘稠的红色。

这下，无论是野人还是异种，都不会再过来自讨苦吃。

有时候，小青也会留下几头猎物，打断腿后放到白天，让相南里自己练习狩猎。

这是地表必备的生存技能。

还算平静的旅行终止在第37天。

道路两边出现了视频里才有的银芦苇，很稀疏。

看地图，这片区域，已经被笼统地划入“遗迹区域”。

遗迹很快展示了它作为地表禁区的威力。卫星信号失灵，没有网络，磁场混乱。指南针像陀螺一样不停旋转着。

还没进入夜晚，天空是青灰色的，周围潺潺的水流声令人不安。最重要的是，相南里没有在视野里看见水源。这些水流藏在地下。

“这辆车不能开了。”东方青帝在检查后，微微蹙眉，“遗迹的土地对金属有很强的磁性。”

还有一点，Alpha没说出来。

这里的磁场让他感觉不太舒服。像置身在火炉里，忍受着低温慢烤。

在智械危机中后期，人类研发出很多干扰电子设备功能的大型场地装置。这些装置往往对人无害，但对智械拥有极强的破坏力。

得亏来的是东方青帝。要是小福过来，呆个两三天，就会消磁成比小智还不如的人工智障了。

[小智：？]

车轮焊死在地上。就算勉强启动飞行模式，也无法挣脱地表的吸力，只能弃车步行。

小青撸起袖子，把车抗起来，挪到了十公里外的安全区域。

相南里收拾好东西，背着行囊走下车。

他四处观望，背后是浅浅的山脉，眼前是一望无际的黑色平原。

相南里蹲下，在地上摸了一把，触感很奇怪，不像泥土，倒像是柔软的硅胶。手指戳不进去。

“……非牛顿流体？”相南里嘀咕了一句。

新地图，没有刷新boss，没有补给点，也不能存档重来。

Alpha扣住相南里的手，十指交握：“走吧。”
chunks.englishText:
"I can always hear the sound of exotic beasts crawling in the snow. According to infrared monitoring, different exotic beasts or savages appear near the RV every night. I think I’ve been marked as food."

These prey were usually handled by Xiao Qing.

He would kill the leader with professional precision, and the remaining minions, after realizing they had provoked a hard target, would run faster than anyone, never seeking revenge for their leader. Decision-making errors were, of course, the leader’s fault; the instinct of a creature is to survive. Revenge is something only intelligent beings do.

It was a pity that killing was easy, but disposing of the bodies was difficult. The purified water on the vehicle was consumed very quickly because Xiao Qing needed to wash his clothes and bathe. He had long hair, and if it got even a little bit on him, it required repeated cleaning to remove the stench.

After several repetitions, the Eastern Azure Emperor finally overcame his germaphobia and chose to hang the corpses of the exotic beasts on the roof of the RV. He let the warm, fresh blood paint a thick layer of red over the sheet metal.

Now, neither savages nor exotic beasts would come over to ask for trouble.

Sometimes, Xiao Qing would leave a few prey behind, break their legs, and leave them for the daytime so Xiang Nanli could practice hunting himself.

This was a necessary survival skill on the surface.

The relatively calm journey ended on the 37th day.

On both sides of the road, the silver reeds that only appeared in the videos began to appear, very sparsely.

Looking at the map, this area had already been broadly classified as the "Ruins Area."

The ruins soon demonstrated their power as a surface forbidden zone. Satellite signals failed, there was no network, and the magnetic field was chaotic. The compass spun incessantly like a top.

It wasn't even night yet, but the sky was a grayish-blue, and the sound of gurgling water nearby was unsettling. Most importantly, Xiang Nanli couldn't see any water sources in his field of vision. These currents were hidden underground.

"This vehicle cannot be driven anymore." The Eastern Azure Emperor frowned slightly after checking, "The land in the ruins has a strong magnetic attraction to metal."

There was one more thing Alpha didn't say.

The magnetic field here made him feel uncomfortable. It was like being in a furnace, enduring a slow roast at low temperatures.

In the mid-to-late stages of the Intelligence Crisis, humans developed many large-scale field devices that interfered with the functions of electronic equipment. These devices were often harmless to humans, but had extremely destructive power against AI.

It was fortunate that it was the Eastern Azure Emperor who came. If Xiao Fu had come, after staying for two or three days, he would have been demagnetized into an "artificial idiot" worse than Xiao Zhi.

[Xiao Zhi: ?]

The wheels were welded to the ground. Even if he tried to force the flight mode, he couldn't break free from the surface’s suction, so they could only abandon the vehicle and walk.

Xiao Qing rolled up his sleeves, carried the vehicle, and moved it to a safe area ten kilometers away.

Xiang Nanli packed his things and stepped off the vehicle with his backpack.

He looked around; behind him were shallow mountain ranges, and before him was an endless black plain.

Xiang Nanli squatted down and touched the ground. The texture was very strange; it didn't feel like soil, but rather like soft silicone. His fingers couldn't poke through it.

"...Non-Newtonian fluid?" Xiang Nanli muttered.

A new map, no boss spawned, no supply points, and no way to save and restart.

Alpha clasped Xiang Nanli’s hand, fingers interlaced: "Let’s go."

chunks.chineseText:
第171章 神庭遗迹3

防护服很薄，最大程度保障使用者的灵活。表层用的异种皮，有拟态功能，能随着环境自适应颜色和呼吸模式。

下午四点，天边只剩一层朦胧的光线。

黄昏和黑夜的交界时分，地表升腾起淡淡的水汽。

不明气体无色无味，但即使是一层层隔离，相南里在呼吸时依然能感觉到喉间的刺痛。

[警告：您正处于危险环境中。请远离污染源、尽量减少身体暴露；以避免不必要的损伤。]

相南里瞥了眼电子镜片上的数据，开口：“小智啊，危险我当然知道，但是总不能现在撤退是吧？能不能改成有用点的？”

他不想听客套话。

于是，相南里视野里的面板出现变化。

[相南里（lv.46）]

[生命值（HP）：99.7（-0.1/min）]

[状态：良好（辐射感染中）]

[物品栏：基因药*15（+5hp/支）；基因针*10（+20hp/针）；浓缩营养餐包*7（每天1份），工具箱*1，匕首*1，激光枪*1（电量100），记录仪（注：人联提供，外观近似蜂鸟无人机）]

相南里启动记录仪，微型无人机自动跟随在他身侧，像只蚊子。反正这里也没网，先按照人联的规矩录着，证明他真的有来过，不是骗任务奖金。

工具箱里装着相南里认为有用的各种仪器。

理论上讲，只要有这个工具箱，相南里甚至能靠捡垃圾武装出一个军团。

东方青帝还更新了地图。覆盖范围更广，也更详细。

地图上标注着目的地，是一口黑色的湖。沿途，有一些灰色的问号。是Alpha扫描出的异常数据。

如果按照现在的生命条，相南里可以在遗迹里呆156.25个小时，但考虑到返程和各种突发情况，Alpha认为，探索时间需要严格控制在3天内。

东方青帝的神色多了几分凝重，银白的瞳孔微微亮起。他的信号覆盖范围内，一切正常。但过往的经历让Alpha明白，冰冷的数据有时并不可信。

往里走了三公里，相南里遭遇地图上的第一个问号。

是一个圆形的铅舱，外观很像他小时候在科幻杂志上看见的UFO。

UFO不知道在露天放置了多少年，相南里蹲在它面前，研究怎么打开，没忍住笑出声：“小青，上世纪90年代科幻杂志最喜欢报道这种新闻了，神秘沙地惊现外星飞船……还有什么水怪、太空异形。我读幼儿园的时候超喜欢看。还幻想过有天UFO会来把我接走。”

不是上世纪，是近千年前。但Alpha没有纠正他。

现在看，当年一些不切实际的幻想，更像是预言。

水怪和异形，地表现在多的是。人类现在的科技不仅能制造UFO，还有更多只出现在幻想中的科技。

相南里撬开舱门，一具穿着“永生科技”防护服的尸体，从里面滚出来。

因为舱内缺乏微生物，尸体没能进一步分解。干枯的黑色血肉黏在骨头上。

最诡异的是，这具尸体没有头。

刚接触空气，尸体表面防护服就开始粉化，一枚储藏芯片从胸口位置掉落。

“这是为了抵抗辐射制造出来的飞行器。”东方青帝扫描过后，开口，“是新历517年生产的型号。当时遗迹的磁力没有现在这么强；但辐射更严重。”

隔离舱内空间不大，一张能平躺的椅子占据了绝大多数空间。然后就是早就报废的小冰箱、投影屏等生活设施，舱内还有许多空的酒瓶。

看起来，他是一个人上路的。

墙壁里贴着几张手写的草纸。

相南里举起手电筒看去，字是用炭笔写的，有很多涂抹过的痕迹。

上面是一张地图，大多都是意义不明的方块和圆形。有些方块和圆形内部写着数字。

部分路径上用红笔划出一个“X”，地图最中心位置，画着神庭的“末日标记”。

那是一个黑色的十字架，“十”的下方加一横；在人联是一个非常敏感的符号。

[海市蜃楼？]（划掉）

[这是我的幻觉吗？出口在哪？]

[神啊，救救我吧。]（划掉）

相南里把纸上的图案在脑海里记下，然后在读卡器内插入芯片。谢天谢地，这张卡还能用。

里面是一段视频。

一张高清的金属面孔出现在屏幕中，镜头拉得很近，看不出周围的环境。看起来，是主人握着手机，打开前置摄像头录的像。

他……还是她？看不出性别。这张脸已经和性别没有关系了，这是一张金属做成的脸，五官轮廓很淡，像石膏像。

它的脸颊和后脑勺还不是同一种材质，没有头发，皮肤瓷白。说话时，嘴皮子都不带动的。

“这是我进入遗迹的第74天，我想，这会是我最后一个视频。以防记忆错乱、数据遗失，我依然会从头说起。”

“三年前，我们在另一个遗迹考古时……嗯，就是很著名的‘17号陵园’，发现了这个遗迹的坐标。”

[注：17号陵园，网传为神庭第二代神座的墓园。第二代神座死因极其诡异，被不明怪物分尸；但神庭并没有伸张，反而把尸体仓促下葬。]

“我们这代人都听过那个传言，相南里和他的使徒机甲……对吧？收集使徒号，终结灾难。想想又怎么可能呢，相南里在智械危机前就死了。我和我的老师都倾向于，这是地表一些极端分子，或者说人联中的抵抗派，制造出的政治宣传。

“最重要的是，灾难能靠强大的武器终结吗？那不过是强者对弱者的碾压罢了。更何况，如果不是愚蠢的人类自诩为神明，制造出这么多无法制约的武器，人马星也不会成为现在的模样。

“我们在陵园发现了一张写着‘使徒实验室’地址的信件；收信人是，拉斐尔。”

“神庭的教宗，或者说神座、教皇，管他们的；一直都叫拉斐尔，如今在位的是拉斐尔七世。收信人是拉斐尔，谁写的信？信里说，‘使徒设计好了，你该来看看’。看什么？为什么这封信没有销毁？它被印在……你们知道吗？这是一条保密消息，如果我泄露出去，学术生涯就完蛋了。但没关系，反正我要死了，保密毫无意义。而且这条信息应该被人知道，它印在拉斐尔二世的皮肤上。”

视频轻微晃动起来。

“拉斐尔二世死亡距今已经三百年，下葬的尸体并不完整。17号陵园里只有它的手臂。你剪过鸡腿吗？剔开筋，就能把鸡皮完整地撕下来。这张人皮也是这么被撕下来的，就贴在棺材的最底下。那只没有皮的手，从棺材里跳出来……它掐死了我的老师。我们尝试掰开它，没有用。”

说到这，机器人的声音有些哽咽。

Chapter 171: Ruins of the Divine Court (Part 1)

The protective suit was thin, designed to maximize the wearer's agility. Its surface was crafted from the hide of an exotic creature, featuring biomimetic functions that allowed it to adapt its color and breathing patterns to the surrounding environment.

At four in the afternoon, only a hazy layer of light remained at the edge of the sky.

In the twilight hour between dusk and night, a faint mist rose from the surface of the earth.

The unidentified gas was colorless and odorless, yet even through layers of filtration, Xiang Nanli could still feel a stinging sensation in his throat as he breathed.

[Warning: You are in a hazardous environment. Please stay away from sources of contamination and minimize physical exposure to avoid unnecessary damage.]

Xiang Nanli glanced at the data on his electronic lens and spoke up: "Xiao Zhi, I know it's dangerous, but we can't exactly turn back now, can we? Can you switch to something more useful?"

He didn't want to hear platitudes.

Consequently, the panel in Xiang Nanli’s field of vision changed.

[Xiang Nanli (lv.46)]

[Health Points (HP): 99.7 (-0.1/min)]

[Status: Good (Radiation Infection in progress)]

[Inventory: Gene Medicine *15 (+5hp/vial); Gene Needle *10 (+20hp/needle); Concentrated Nutrient Packs *7 (1 per day), Toolbox *1, Dagger *1, Laser Gun *1 (100% battery), Recorder (Note: Provided by the Human Alliance, appearance resembles a hummingbird drone)]

Xiang Nanli activated the recorder. The micro-drone automatically followed at his side like a mosquito. Since there was no network here anyway, he followed the Human Alliance’s rules and recorded everything to prove he had actually been here and wasn't just scamming the mission bounty.

The toolbox contained various instruments that Xiang Nanli deemed useful.

Theoretically speaking, with this toolbox, Xiang Nanli could even scavenge enough junk to arm an entire legion.

Dongfang Qingdi had also updated the map. It now covered a wider range and was more detailed.

The destination was marked on the map as a black lake. Along the way, there were several gray question marks—anomalous data scanned by Alpha.

Based on his current health bar, Xiang Nanli could survive in the ruins for 156.25 hours. However, considering the return trip and various contingencies, Alpha determined that the exploration time must be strictly controlled within three days.

Dongfang Qingdi’s expression grew more solemn, his silver-white pupils glowing faintly. Within his signal coverage, everything was normal. But past experience told Alpha that cold data was sometimes unreliable.

Three kilometers in, Xiang Nanli encountered the first question mark on the map.

It was a circular lead cabin, looking very much like the UFOs he had seen in science fiction magazines as a child.

The UFO had been left in the open for who knows how many years. Xiang Nanli squatted in front of it, studying how to open it, and couldn't help but laugh: "Xiao Qing, back in the 90s, sci-fi magazines loved reporting news like this: 'Mysterious Alien Spaceship Discovered in the Sands'... and things like sea monsters or space aliens. I loved reading those when I was in kindergarten. I even fantasized that a UFO would come and pick me up one day."

It wasn't the last century; it was nearly a thousand years ago. But Alpha did not correct him.

Looking at it now, some of the unrealistic fantasies of the past seemed more like prophecies.

Sea monsters and aliens were plentiful on the surface now. Human technology today could not only manufacture UFOs but also possessed far more tech that had once appeared only in fantasies.

Xiang Nanli pried open the hatch, and a corpse wearing an "Eternal Technology" protective suit rolled out.

Because the cabin lacked microorganisms, the corpse had not decomposed further. Dried, black flesh clung to the bones.

The most eerie part was that the corpse had no head.

As soon as it touched the air, the protective suit on the corpse began to crumble into powder, and a storage chip fell from the chest area.

"This was a flight vehicle manufactured to resist radiation," Dongfang Qingdi said after scanning it. "It’s a model produced in New Calendar year 517. The magnetic force in the ruins wasn't as strong then, but the radiation was more severe."

The space inside the isolation cabin was small; a chair that could lie flat took up most of the room. Then there were long-defunct living facilities like a small refrigerator and a projection screen. There were also many empty wine bottles inside.

It seemed he had set out alone.

Several handwritten scraps of paper were taped to the walls.

Xiang Nanli held up his flashlight to look. The words were written in charcoal, with many smudges and erasures.

On it was a map, mostly consisting of squares and circles with no clear meaning. Some of the squares and circles had numbers written inside them.

On some paths, an "X" was marked in red ink, and at the very center of the map, the "Doomsday Mark" of the Divine Court was drawn.

It was a black cross, with an extra horizontal line below the "十"; it was a very sensitive symbol within the Human Alliance.

[A mirage?] (Crossed out)

[Is this a hallucination? Where is the exit?]

[God, save me.] (Crossed out)

Xiang Nanli memorized the patterns on the paper in his mind and then inserted the chip into the card reader. Thank heavens, the card still worked.

Inside was a video.

A high-definition metallic face appeared on the screen. The camera was pulled in very close, making it impossible to see the surrounding environment. It looked like the owner was holding a phone and recording with the front-facing camera.

Was it... he? Or she? The gender was indistinguishable. This face had nothing to do with gender anymore; it was a face made of metal, the contours of the features very faint, like a plaster cast.

Its cheeks and the back of its head were not made of the same material. There was no hair, and the skin was porcelain-white. When it spoke, its lips didn't even move.

"This is my 74th day in the ruins. I think this will be my last video. To prevent memory corruption and data loss, I will still start from the beginning."

"Three years ago, while we were excavating another ruin... well, the famous 'No. 17 Cemetery,' we discovered the coordinates for this ruin."

[Note: No. 17 Cemetery is rumored to be the burial ground for the second-generation God-Seat of the Divine Court. The cause of death for the second-generation God-Seat was extremely bizarre—dismembered by an unknown monster. The Divine Court did not make it public; instead, they buried the body in haste.]

"Our generation has all heard that rumor, Xiang Nanli and his Apostle Mecha... right? Collect the Apostles, end the disaster. Just think, how could that be possible? Xiang Nanli died before the Machine Uprising. My teacher and I both lean toward the idea that this is political propaganda created by extremists on the surface, or perhaps the resistance within the Human Alliance."

"Most importantly, can a disaster be ended by powerful weapons? That is nothing more than the strong crushing the weak. Moreover, if foolish humans hadn't claimed to be gods and created so many uncontrollable weapons, the Horsehead Nebula wouldn't have become what it is today."

"We found a letter in the cemetery addressed to the 'Apostle Laboratory'; the recipient was Raphael."

"The Pope of the Divine Court, or God-Seat, or Pontiff—whatever they call them; it has always been Raphael. The one currently in power is Raphael VII. The recipient was Raphael. Who wrote the letter? The letter said, 'The Apostle is designed, you should come and see.' See what? Why wasn't this letter destroyed? It was printed on... do you know? This is classified information. If I leak it, my academic career is over. But it doesn't matter; I'm going to die anyway, so secrecy is meaningless. And this information should be known: it was printed on the skin of Raphael II."

The video shook slightly.

"Raphael II has been dead for three hundred years now, and the buried body was incomplete. Only its arm was in the No. 17 Cemetery. Have you ever butchered a chicken leg? If you trim the tendons, you can peel the chicken skin off in one piece. This human skin was peeled off in the same way, and it was stuck to the very bottom of the coffin. That skinless hand jumped out of the coffin... and strangled my teacher. We tried to pry it open, but it was useless."

At this point, the robot's voice choked up slightly.

“半年前，我患上严重基因病，无法医治。我和我的义体产生严重的排异反应，医生说可能一年内，这具身体就会崩溃。机械化改造总是有风险的。人类的基因如此神秘，擅动它必然遭到反噬。于是，我决定在死前，独自完成遗迹探索。”

“刚开始，一切都很正常。”

“我抵达地图的终点，那是一面黑色的湖泊。附近有磁石，垒在岸边。”

“说实话，我非常失望。这里看起来空旷、平静。环境不适合生物生存。没有检测到生命指标。”

“然后，夜晚降临，奇迹出现了。我在湖面上，看见一座崭新的城市。这座城市很奇怪，所有建筑都一模一样，9层高的写字楼，只有每栋楼的编号不同。像复制粘贴的建模。”

“我往城里走去，里面空无一人。像是在鼎盛时，突如其来的高温把一切活物蒸发。有些门是上锁的，建筑物没有窗户，我不知道怎么进去。”

“我从1号，一直往前走。第一次，我走到了107号，最后，天亮了，一切消失。我漂浮在黑色的湖水中央……”

“一开始，我还十分亢奋，以为自己发现什么不得了的奇观。但每天夜里，我都在重复同样的内容。我感到厌倦，能源也要不够了，我想返程。然而，我发现，我被困在遗迹里了。无论我逃到哪，朝哪个方向走，最后都会回到湖里。”

“这里辐射很严重，磁场紊乱。我失去了信号。尽管我每年都支付30万信用点的保险金，但我猜宇宙银行旗下的保险公司并没有派出救援队。他们宁愿付赔偿金，也不会来地表找人的。”

“这座城市到底真的存在，还是我的幻觉，亦或者是奇怪磁场保留的画面。会有人看到我的视频吗？我听见神的召唤，或许这就是我的使命……不对，我可不是神庭的信徒。我该出发了。”

视频里的人脸在此时彻底不动。

就在相南里以为视频结束时，机器人脸上露出一个诡异的微笑。

视频从略微仰视的角度成为平视。

苍白的人脸注视着屏幕外唯一的观众：“你来了？欢迎回家。”

Chapter 171: Ruins of the Divine Court (Part 2)

"Half a year ago, I contracted a severe genetic disease that cannot be cured. My body and my prosthetic limbs are having a severe rejection reaction. The doctor said this body will likely collapse within a year. Mechanized modification always carries risks. Human genes are so mysterious; tampering with them inevitably leads to a backlash. So, I decided to complete the exploration of the ruins alone before I die."

"At first, everything was normal."

"I arrived at the end of the map, which is a black lake. There are magnets piled up on the shore nearby."

"To be honest, I was very disappointed. It looks empty and calm here. The environment is not suitable for biological survival. No life signs were detected."

"Then, night fell, and a miracle appeared. On the surface of the lake, I saw a brand-new city. This city is very strange; all the buildings are exactly the same—9-story office buildings, with only the number on each building being different. It’s like a copy-pasted model."

"I walked into the city, and it was empty. It was as if, at the height of its prosperity, a sudden high temperature evaporated every living thing. Some doors are locked, and the buildings have no windows; I don't know how to get in."

"I started from No. 1 and kept walking forward. The first time, I reached No. 107, and finally, dawn broke, and everything disappeared. I was floating in the middle of the black lake..."

"At first, I was very excited, thinking I had discovered some incredible spectacle. But every night, I repeat the same content. I feel weary, and my energy is running out. I want to return, but I discovered that I am trapped in the ruins. No matter where I run or which direction I walk, I always end up back in the lake."

"The radiation here is very severe, and the magnetic field is chaotic. I have lost my signal. Although I pay 300,000 credits in insurance premiums every year, I suspect the insurance company under the Universal Bank has not sent a rescue team. They would rather pay the compensation than come to the surface to find someone."

"Does this city really exist, or is it my hallucination, or perhaps images preserved by a strange magnetic field? Will anyone see my video? I hear the call of God; perhaps this is my mission... No, I am not a believer in the Divine Court. I should set off."

The human face in the video stopped moving completely at this point.

Just as Xiang Nanli thought the video was over, a strange smile appeared on the robot's face.

The video shifted from a slightly upward angle to a straight-on view.

The pale human face stared at the only audience outside the screen: "You've come? Welcome home."

第172章 神庭遗迹4

相南里：？

这一幕有些惊悚，但相南里是个情绪稳定的好宝宝，根据小智传回的数据，他的心情几乎没有任何波动。

“听得出来，它精神状态不好。人在临死前，出现幻觉很正常。”相南里自言自语，尽管并没有人发问，“我以前经常思考，我的世界会不会是别人的一个梦；又或者我现在经历的一切，只是死亡前意识的回马灯。啊对不起又跑题了，我只是想到，如果是我自己录视频，最后大概也会故意说些话吓人呢……”

这样后人考古的时候，多半会被吓到，想想就很好玩。

储存卡里只有这么一段视频。

相南里把尸体塞回铅船内，站在UFO外，给这位不知名的考古队员烧了两张纸钱。

客死他乡。

它在生命的最后时刻，也会想要回家吗？

他们继续往目的地赶，四周的水雾愈发浓重，耳边是愈发明显的水流声。

相南里感觉自己正踩在怪物的皮肤上。潺潺的，是怪物血管里血液涌动的声响。

脚下的土地变得柔软、泥泞。质感粘稠，像刚下过雨的河岸边。

在相南里第二次打哈欠的时候，Alpha在他面前蹲下：“我背你。你趴着睡会吧。”

智械不需要睡眠。

人需要用睡眠来充电。

相南里听话地趴到他身上，捏着Alpha的耳垂，笑嘻嘻地开口：“小青，你是我的座驾~”

一听到座驾，立刻想到车，立刻想到骑乘，立刻想到相南里的腰。智械的想像竟在这一层能够如此跃进。

Alpha的脑海里突然多出一个G的垃圾数据，他选择一键清空，脸上是自己都没察觉到的浅笑。

相南里很想提高警惕，努力观察四周环境，可惜困意如期而至。

小青身上香香的，有小苍兰的气息。

相南里在这熟悉的味道里睡着了。

相南里醒来时头痛欲裂，他躺在地上，看见头顶的星空时，骤然一愣。

他都要忘记自己有多久没有见过星星了。

相南里跌跌撞撞起身，茫然地站在四通八达的街道上。

四周都是一样的建筑，方方正正，一片纯净的白色，看不到一扇窗户。它们唯一的区别，就是建筑外立面上，亮着光的数字。

如果不是有入口，很难想象这居然是一栋楼，更像是什么巢穴。

相南里抬头看了眼，眼前这栋建筑的编号是“67”。

在那位学者的死亡地图上，“67”这个数字位于西南方向，上面用红笔划了一个大大的“X”，尽管没有过多标注，但这应该是个危险至极的讯号。

是在做梦吧。Alpha不可能把他一个人丢下的。

相南里用手揉着自己的太阳穴，试图缓解身体上的不适，下一秒，空旷的街道上，一辆运输车出现在他的眼前。

说是车，但外观更像是机器狗。背着沉重的收容箱，步履轻快。

收容箱很大，像一口棺材。里面传来物体碰撞的声音。沉闷。

偶尔，会有血色的液体带着浓重的腥味，从箱体的缝隙溢出。

机器狗扛着箱子，往67号实验室的入口走去。

相南里下意识想躲开，但箱子直接穿过他的身体。

他是不属于这个时代的幽灵。

相南里有片刻的恍惚。

他跟着机械狗，进入楼内。

第一层楼是严密的安保，足足三道关卡。任何一项权限不通过，都会直接触发安保的毁灭程序。红色的激光点一直对准着货箱。

相南里左顾右盼，没有在大楼里发现任何人类存在的痕迹；甚至没有灯——机械狗不需要光也能看见。

终于，通过层层核验的机械狗把收容箱推进了货运电梯中。

电梯是一根注满水的强化塑料管道。会利用水压的变化，把货物送到不同的楼层。

相南里没见过这样的设计。他怀疑管道里的液体也不是纯净水，这个运输管道设计出来，就不是给人用的。

相南里抱住收容箱，跟着箱子一起被运输到最顶层。涌动的水流停止，收容箱被一根巨大的机械嵌子从水池里夹起，放置在地板上。

和昏暗的一楼不同，这里很明亮。隔了一会，轻微的脚步声从白色回廊的尽头传来。

相南里坐在高高的收容箱上，看着一个身穿白色防护服的人朝着自己走来。看体型，是男性。

他有一双机械手，这也是唯一暴露在空气里的肢体部分，全身裹得严严实实，双眼位置戴着黑色护目镜，护目镜上又有一条横着的蓝色的光带，看上去很冷峻。

他的机械手在收容箱上敲了敲，箱子悬浮起来，跟在他身后。

大概是什么磁悬浮技术？

相南里看得一愣一愣的。

收容箱漂浮着，被投入进一个巨大的玻璃水箱。

或者说，这是一个水族箱。

房间的四面都是曲面玻璃，仅仅在入口处有一道窄门。内部有一排像俄罗斯方块一样叠在一起的电脑屏幕，显示屏背后的处理器，像人的内脏器官一样排列组合。桌子上到处都是散落的文件、模型。

收容箱在水中解体，一条……还是一头？环抱着双膝的怪物，在水中缓缓睁开眼。

这条怪物有长尾，身长近三米。皮肤是灰白色，能看见皮肤下青紫的血管。人脸，蛇身……长尾上有鳍。背后的骨骼畸形的隆起，一段一段的；一双翅膀从腰部位置展开，无力地往下垂落。

它的一张脸近似人形，五官像是融化一样，散在脸上，少了鼻子，多出好几只粉红色的眼睛。眼神平静到令人惶恐。

青年抬头，注视着水族箱里的怪物。

相南里看不出他的表情，却能感觉到一股哀伤的情绪。

青年重重咳嗽起来，有些痛苦地弯下腰。相南里在这一刻几乎感同身受的疼痛。喉咙像是被砂纸擦过，口腔里全是血腥味。

青年忽地转身，走向中央位置的电脑。

相南里忍住太阳穴传来的剧痛，凑进去看，他在屏幕上敲出第一行字——

【67号天使——加百列（Gabriel）】

……

……

相南里睁开眼。他从东方青帝的背上跳下来，转身，急速摘下脸上的头盔，开始呕吐。

没怎么进食，只能吐出胆汁。

相南里抓住东方青帝的胳膊，额头上青筋暴跳。

Alpha递来热水。等着相南里吐完，这才询问：“怎么了？”

根据监测，相南里的身体各项指标正常。如果不是他的感应器出了问题，那这属于神经性呕吐。会在紧张、难过、内心冲突时出现。

“做了个梦。”相南里虚弱地回答，“不太舒服。”

梦里的场景十分具体。相南里甚至能感觉到冷热和气流。

相南里很少做梦。他睡眠质量很好，一点也不像神经病。

“梦见了什么？”

相南里一边吸着营养液，一边回答：“梦见，我进入了一座城市……”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 172: Ruins of the Divine Court (Part 4)

Xiang Nanli: ?

The scene was somewhat chilling, but Xiang Nanli was a good boy with stable emotions. According to the data transmitted back by Xiao Zhi, his mood showed almost no fluctuation.

"I can tell its mental state wasn't good. It's normal for people to have hallucinations before they die," Xiang Nanli muttered to himself, even though no one had asked. "I used to wonder if my world might just be someone else's dream; or if everything I'm experiencing now is just a flash of consciousness before death. Ah, sorry, I'm off-topic again. I just thought, if I were recording a video, I'd probably say something scary on purpose too..."

That way, when future generations excavated it, they would likely be scared—just thinking about it was fun.

There was only this one video on the storage card.

Xiang Nanli stuffed the corpse back into the lead cabin, stood outside the UFO, and burned two pieces of paper money for this unknown archaeologist.

Died in a foreign land.

In the final moments of its life, would it also have wanted to go home?

They continued toward their destination. The water mist around them grew thicker, and the sound of flowing water became more pronounced.

Xiang Nanli felt as if he were stepping on the skin of a monster. The gurgling sound was like blood surging through the monster's veins.

The ground beneath his feet became soft and muddy. The texture was viscous, like a riverbank after a heavy rain.

When Xiang Nanli yawned for the second time, Alpha squatted down in front of him: "I'll carry you. You can sleep for a while."

Mechanical lifeforms didn't need sleep.

Humans needed sleep to recharge.

Xiang Nanli obediently climbed onto his back, pinched Alpha's earlobe, and said with a grin: "Xiao Qing, you're my ride~"

Upon hearing "ride," Alpha immediately thought of a vehicle, then of riding, then of Xiang Nanli's waist. The imagination of a mechanical lifeform could actually make such leaps.

A gigabyte of junk data suddenly appeared in Alpha's mind, which he chose to clear with one click, a faint smile appearing on his face that he didn't even notice.

Xiang Nanli wanted to stay alert and try to observe the surrounding environment, but unfortunately, sleepiness arrived right on schedule.

Xiao Qing smelled good, like freesia.

Xiang Nanli fell asleep in that familiar scent.

When Xiang Nanli woke up, he had a splitting headache. He lay on the ground and was stunned when he saw the starry sky above.

He had almost forgotten how long it had been since he last saw the stars.

Xiang Nanli stumbled to his feet, standing blankly on a street that branched in all directions.

Everything around him was the same architecture—square, pure white, with not a single window in sight. The only difference was the glowing numbers on the facades of the buildings.

If not for the entrances, it would be hard to imagine these were buildings; they looked more like some kind of nest.

Xiang Nanli looked up and saw that the number on the building in front of him was "67."

On the scholar's death map, the number "67" was located in the southwest, with a large "X" drawn over it in red ink. Although there were no further notes, this should have been a signal of extreme danger.

He must be dreaming. Alpha couldn't possibly have left him alone.

Xiang Nanli rubbed his temples with his hands, trying to alleviate the physical discomfort. The next second, a transport vehicle appeared before his eyes on the empty street.

It was called a vehicle, but its appearance was more like a robotic dog. It carried a heavy containment box, moving with a light gait.

The containment box was large, like a coffin. Muffled sounds of objects colliding came from inside.

Occasionally, blood-colored liquid with a heavy, fishy smell would overflow from the gaps in the box.

The robotic dog carried the box toward the entrance of Laboratory 67.

Xiang Nanli instinctively wanted to dodge, but the box passed right through his body.

He was a ghost who did not belong to this era.

Xiang Nanli was dazed for a moment.

He followed the robotic dog into the building.

The first floor was heavily guarded, with three full checkpoints. Any failure in authorization would immediately trigger the security destruction program. Red laser dots remained aimed at the cargo box.

Xiang Nanli looked left and right, finding no traces of human presence in the building; there weren't even any lights—robotic dogs didn't need light to see.

Finally, the robotic dog, having passed through layers of verification, pushed the containment box into a freight elevator.

The elevator was a reinforced plastic pipe filled with water. It used changes in water pressure to transport cargo to different floors.

Xiang Nanli had never seen such a design. He suspected that the liquid in the pipe wasn't pure water; this transport pipe wasn't designed for people to use.

Xiang Nanli hugged the containment box and was transported to the top floor along with it. The surging water stopped, and the containment box was clamped by a giant mechanical claw from the water pool and placed on the floor.

Unlike the dim first floor, it was very bright here. After a while, light footsteps came from the end of the white corridor.

Xiang Nanli sat on the high containment box, watching a person in a white protective suit walk toward him. Judging by the build, it was a male.

He had a pair of mechanical hands, the only parts of his body exposed to the air. He was wrapped tightly, wearing black goggles over his eyes, with a horizontal blue light band on the goggles, looking very cold and stern.

His mechanical hands tapped on the containment box, and the box began to hover, following behind him.

Magnetic levitation technology, perhaps?

Xiang Nanli watched, dumbfounded.

The containment box floated and was dropped into a giant glass water tank.

Or rather, it was an aquarium.

The four sides of the room were curved glass, with only a narrow door at the entrance. Inside was a row of computer screens stacked like Tetris blocks; the processors behind the screens were arranged like human internal organs. Scattered documents and models were everywhere on the table.

The containment box disintegrated in the water, and a creature—or was it a being?—clutching its knees slowly opened its eyes in the water.

This monster had a long tail, nearly three meters in length. Its skin was grayish-white, and purple veins could be seen beneath the skin. A human face, a snake body... there were fins on the long tail. The bones on its back were deformed and protruding, section by section; a pair of wings unfolded from the waist, hanging limply downward.

Its face was nearly human, but the features looked as if they had melted, scattered across its face, missing a nose but possessing several extra pink eyes. The gaze was calm to the point of terror.

The young man looked up, staring at the monster in the aquarium.

Xiang Nanli couldn't tell his expression, but he could feel a sense of sorrow.

The young man began to cough heavily, bending over in pain. Xiang Nanli felt the pain as if it were his own at that moment. His throat felt like it had been scrubbed with sandpaper, and his mouth was full of the taste of blood.

The young man suddenly turned and walked toward the computer in the center.

Xiang Nanli endured the splitting headache in his temples and leaned in to look. He typed the first line on the screen—

【Angel No. 67 — Gabriel】

……

……

Xiang Nanli opened his eyes. He jumped off Dongfang Qingdi's back, turned around, hurriedly took off the helmet on his face, and began to vomit.

Having not eaten much, he could only retch bile.

Xiang Nanli grabbed Dongfang Qingdi's arm, the veins on his forehead throbbing.

Alpha handed him hot water. Waiting for Xiang Nanli to finish vomiting, he asked: "What's wrong?"

According to the monitoring, all of Xiang Nanli's physical indicators were normal. If his sensors weren't malfunctioning, this was psychosomatic vomiting. It occurred during times of stress, sadness, or internal conflict.

"Had a dream," Xiang Nanli replied weakly. "Not very pleasant."

The scene in the dream was very specific. Xiang Nanli could even feel the cold, heat, and airflow.

Xiang Nanli rarely dreamed. He had excellent sleep quality and was not at all like a neurotic person.

"What did you dream about?"

Xiang Nanli answered while sipping nutrient solution: "I dreamed that I entered a city..."

“这座城市所有建筑都一模一样。就像是那个考古队员描述的一样。我猜，上面每栋楼的编码，是不同实验室的序号。”

“有人，是神庭的人。在这里进行非法基因实验。基因敲除、改造，或者别的什么我不清楚的技术……而且，城市里存在大量的机器人。不是智械，它们显然没有产生拟人模块。只是遵循着中央主脑的操控。”

相南里咬住吸管，下意识地喃喃：“制造天使，是把自己当神了吗？”

加百列，67号天使。

黑十字审判庭，神庭。

线索草蛇灰线，浮现出一个朦胧的脉络。

相南里忍不住笑起来：“啊，说不定，我真的看见‘神’了。”

东方青帝抿起唇。很显然，身为智械，他是不会做梦的。

他推测，是这里存在特殊的磁场，一直在投射信息波段，被身为纯正人类（含人量高达百分之98）的相南里接收到了。

而他对此无能为力。

但很快，Alpha发现，这里还是有用得上他的地方。

他们终于抵达了视频里看见过的那口黑色湖。

湖水一望无际，表面漂浮着冰棱。水的质感出乎意料的粘稠。

潮水拍打着岸边的礁石。但仔细观察，会发现这些黑色物体并不是石块，而是散落的金属，只是数百年来，被水流打磨成圆润的形状。

相南里弯腰，捡起石头缝隙里的物体：“Alpha，这里有好多存储芯片……”

很小，也很容易被忽略。芯片表面被黏液侵蚀，几乎只剩下最核心的浮栅晶体管。

芯片已经损坏。这很正常。毕竟都是不知道多少年前的东西了。也没有被妥善保存过。

Alpha启动了扫描功能，一键读取数据。

他湖岸表层一共发现7101片储存芯片，其中6889枚芯片彻底报废。剩下212枚芯片里，只剩9枚，还储存有内容。

Alpha花了几分钟时间，耐心地破解、翻译。

未知图纸？……存档。

实验数据，存档。

地图，存档。

在破解到最后一枚芯片时，Alpha陡然心头一颤。

破译码并不复杂，是很多年前的信息产物，甚至不是主体，只是某台电脑备份残留的缓存垃圾……

这是一封通讯邮件。

【人联已经把你列入战犯名单。并且下了通缉令，我听说，它们派出好几支特种部队，正在地表四处搜寻你的踪迹。准备逮捕你，然后处死。】

【听说吗？事实吧，请告知路线，我会安排人截杀。】

【你还记得我们的对话吗，我说过的，黑十字实验室会成为恶龙，而且比原来那条更难杀死。】

【不这样没有以后。】

【怎么不向我们求救？】

【没有意义的问题不要问。】

【所以，这个世界的存在，开始对你产生意义了吗？Garcia.】

【from 传道书】

这封邮件没有回答。

Chapter 172: Ruins of the Divine Court (Part 2)

"Every building in this city was exactly the same. Just like the archaeologist described. I suspect the code on each building is the serial number for a different laboratory."

"There were people—people from the Divine Court. Conducting illegal genetic experiments here. Gene knockout, modification, or some other technology I don't understand... And there were a large number of robots in the city. Not mechanical lifeforms; they clearly hadn't developed anthropomorphic modules. They were just following the control of a central mainframe."

Xiang Nanli bit the straw, subconsciously muttering: "Creating angels—are they treating themselves as gods?"

Gabriel, Angel No. 67.

The Black Cross Inquisition, the Divine Court.

The clues were like a snake winding through the grass, revealing a hazy outline.

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but laugh: "Ah, perhaps I really did see 'God'."

Dongfang Qingdi pursed his lips. Clearly, as a mechanical lifeform, he would not dream.

He speculated that there was a special magnetic field here, constantly projecting information waves, which were received by Xiang Nanli, who was a pure human (with a human content as high as 98%).

And he was powerless to do anything about it.

But soon, Alpha discovered that there was still a place where he was needed.

They finally arrived at the black lake they had seen in the video.

The lake was boundless, with ice shards floating on the surface. The texture of the water was unexpectedly viscous.

Tide water lapped against the rocks on the shore. But upon closer inspection, one would find that these black objects were not stones, but scattered metal, only polished into rounded shapes by the water over hundreds of years.

Xiang Nanli bent down and picked up an object from the crevices of the stones: "Alpha, there are many storage chips here..."

They were very small and easily overlooked. The surface of the chips had been eroded by mucus, leaving almost nothing but the core floating-gate transistors.

The chips were damaged. This was normal. After all, they were things from who knows how many years ago. They hadn't been properly preserved either.

Alpha activated his scanning function and read the data with one click.

He discovered a total of 7,101 storage chips on the surface of the lake shore, of which 6,889 were completely scrapped. Of the remaining 212 chips, only 9 still contained content.

Alpha spent a few minutes patiently cracking and translating them.

Unknown blueprint? ...Archived.

Experimental data, archived.

Map, archived.

When cracking the last chip, Alpha’s heart suddenly trembled.

The decryption code wasn't complex; it was a product of information from many years ago. It wasn't even the main body, just residual cache junk from some computer backup...

It was a communication email.

【The Human Alliance has already listed you as a war criminal. And a warrant has been issued. I heard that they have dispatched several special forces units, currently searching for your tracks all over the surface. Preparing to arrest you, and then execute you.】

【Heard? It's a fact. Please inform me of the route, and I will arrange for people to intercept and kill.】

【Do you remember our conversation? I said that the Black Cross Laboratory would become a dragon, and one even harder to kill than the original.】

【Without doing this, there is no future.】

【Why not ask us for help?】

【Do not ask meaningless questions.】

【So, has the existence of this world begun to have meaning for you? Garcia.】

【from Ecclesiastes】

There was no reply to this email.

第173章 神庭遗迹5

在一行行扭曲的人联语中，这个单词如此刺眼。
　　相南里姓相，名南里。他们家从爷爷那辈开始移民，或者说政治避难。
　　爷爷抛弃国内的妻子，花钱找了个白人老婆入籍，这就是相南里绿眼睛的来历。
　　因为某些政治因素，他们全家都跟奶奶姓，姓氏Garcia。
　　而相南里的中文名随母姓。
　　改名叫Jerry Garcia的爷爷酒喝多了，会很骄傲地提起在国内某个地点，说那里有他爸爸（也就是相南里曾祖父）的故居，他随时可以回国继承遗产。
　　相南里从来都是当吹牛听的，直到后来洛阳问他，要不要认祖归宗，他才知道原来自己在世界上还有一些血缘亲人……那个故居也是真的，现在还是保护文物。
　　他的曾祖父是军阀，没逃出国的后代要么死于战乱，要么被枪毙了。过得不好也不差。就像相南里之前的家一样。
　　相南里没认。第一他不想改姓，第二不想给陌生人安排工作。
　　Lee Garcia.
　　这是他用了接近四十年、很熟悉的姓名。
　　38岁那年，他功成名就，受邀入籍，身份证上的名字改成“相南里”；依然很多人用“Garcia”称呼他。
　　不熟的人会说Mr.Garcia、Dr.Garcia或者Prof.Garcia；熟一些的会叫他Lee。
　　相南里看完这几行字，在漆黑的湖岸边，憋出一句话：“你和传道书熟吗？能不能发短信问问它，这封邮件什么意思？”
　　加西亚，是在叫他吗？
　　什么叫做“这个世界开始对你产生意义了吗”？
　　Alpha叹了口气：“我已经371年没有听过它的消息了。我可以尝试给它发送电报，但不一定有回信。”
　　使徒不喜欢Alpha。或者说，人类为避免所有智械沆瀣一气，使徒号必须讨厌Alpha。
　　分裂出来的四台分机把这一点继承的很好。
　　福音书，负责基建的，天天喊他战犯，动不动就要把他举报到人联军事法庭；默示录，当年也是跟他在一个池子里消过毒的，见面第一眼，用箭把他心脏射出个对穿。
　　传道书就更别提了，小嘴跟淬过毒一样。Alpha有时候觉得自己的拟人模块还是太先进了，一般智械是听不懂传道书的讽刺和地狱笑话的。
　　上次听见传道书的消息，还是它加入黑十字审判庭，成为神庭的“正道者”——那是神庭早期的神职。
　　这个草台班子照搬的西方宗教，又不够仔细。为了填补权力真空，在尚未制度化改革前，神庭内部有过很多现已不存的官职。“正道者”就是其中之一。
　　这个词寓意为“审判之日来临前的救世主”，是神座之下第一人。
　　身为正道者的传道书，接过改革大旗；发展过程中，得罪了不少主教、长老。偏偏它又是杀不死的智械，比所有人都长寿。更是没有私心、无可指摘的完美政治机器。
　　又很可惜，它只是一台智械。但凡它有一个人类的身份，神庭现在的教皇就不叫“拉斐尔”了。
　　随着支持它的拉斐尔五世离世，传道书销声匿迹，下落不明。
　　也不知道是死是活。
　　Alpha没有调查过。传道书要是死在外面，他只会开香槟。
　　他老实地登入黑墙，并打开通讯录，传道书当然在列表，两人上次聊天是在771年前。
　　Alpha扫了眼记录。
　　-人类这一物种迟早被淘汰，智械不应把族群的未来，绑在一艘注定会沉的船上。
　　-传道书：啊对对对
　　“……”
　　嗯，上次聊天时，人和械还在干架。投到地面的钴弹把大陆炸成东西两半，漆黑的海峡至今还是生命禁地。尽管几个月前还有虫子从禁地里爬了出来。
　　Alpha决定宽宏大量地原谅传道书的冒犯，发过去一份大小2kb的电信号。
　　智械的沟通不需要语言，2kb的数据足够涵盖所有来龙去脉。Alpha甚至还能加上几句别扭地问候。
　　聊天框在下一秒弹出提醒：[您在对方黑名单中。是否发送好友申请？]
　　……
　　在相南里的视角里，Alpha在点头后，进入了待机模式。
　　他保持着站姿，眼里银白色的瞳环亮起，目光却没有焦距。在瞬间失去所有拟人的特征。比如呼吸和心跳。
　　几十秒后，灵魂才重新回到这具身体。
　　“联系不上。”Alpha面无表情地回答，“传道书和其他智械不一样，芯片材质特殊，离开特定机房很容易过热。可能脑子早就烧坏了。”
　　小青是台智械，再拟人，本质也是人工智能。相南里很少从他语气里听出这么明显的喜恶，上一次还是他提起洛阳。
　　相南里遗憾地叹气：“好吧。”
　　散失的芯片里有一些实验资料，有些是扫描件，更多是制式文件。相南里只能看懂部分。
　　资料里，频繁提及到了“天使”和一种简写为“CAE”的药剂。
　　相南里看不懂CAE的分子结构，也理解不了图片上犹如神秘学仪式的图纸。
　　东方青帝倒是在扫描后，给出一个相对靠谱的答案：“根据资料，CAE是人类早期研发的基因药之一。因为副作用太强，没有出实验室就被禁用了。”
　　相南里的表情有些许迷茫：“可能是隔行如隔山吧。小青，从人工智能到脑机接口，再到现在的机械义体、武器。这些我都觉得有迹可循。我甚至在逐步学会这些新技术……但是把人改造成其他物种的基因药，还有神庭的神术……我却一直不太明白，甚至觉得很魔幻。”
　　他想起了梦里看见的67号天使。它叫加百列。
　　神庭的名字会一代代遗传。那不是相南里认识的那个加百列，却是那位加百列的来源。有着千丝万缕的联系。
　　东方青帝：“在古代，直流电和打火机也属于神迹。迟早有天，神术也能被科学的解释。”
　　至于它们是怎么出现的，别管。有用就行。
　　按理说，他们已经抵达目的地。但眼前除了一口巨大、平静的黑色湖泊，和散落在岸边的不明零件，什么也没有。
　　相南里确信自己没有出现幻觉，精神鉴定一切正常。所以，唯一的可能是：“神庭的遗迹在水下。”
　　东方青帝对湖水进行采集，分析。黑色湖水来历不明，但含有致死量放射性物质（感谢防护服）。而且，它确实非常烫……内部温度起码150摄氏度上下。可以把大多数生物煮熟。
　　很危险，但这些问题，在来之前就已经有过预料。Alpha没有多说什么，只是更谨慎地检查完相南里的身体，尤其是确保防护服和氧气罐能够正常使用，没有千万分之一的纰漏。
　　Alpha不能阻止相南里的每一次冒险。
　　他可以，但不可以阻止。这是相南里自由意志的选择。
　　他能做的，只有把这一过程中可能存在的危险降到最低。
　　相南里深呼吸一口气，牵住Alpha的手，跳进湖里。
　　哪怕是戴着护目镜，水中也是一片漆黑。湖水的质感像液态金属，他甚至能在湖里漂浮起来。Alpha抓着他，往下沉。
　　大概五分钟后。
　　湖底的珊瑚自带微光。一座颓废、衰败的水下之城，出现在相南里的眼眸中。
　　这里的浮力竟然恢复到正常水平，不至于往上飘了。
　　这座城市和相南里梦里的一样。只是遍地都是缠绕的海藻，纯白的建筑被腐蚀得不成样子，微微弯曲，充斥着不洁的气息。
　　地上长满不知名的枯木，这是梦里没有的东西。
　　相南里凑过去，看了眼。在下一秒，死死抱住Alpha的腰，躲到他背后。
　　这些枯木竟然是凝固的人型，一张张惊恐的人脸从树干上生长出来，凑近听，还能听到一声声痛苦的哀嚎与求救。
　　一直跟在他身边的蜂鸟机器人弹出提醒——[检测到大量新能源，录像中。]
　　相南里眨了眨眼，有些不敢相信自己的猜测：[小青，新能源在哪？]
　　[就是你眼前的这些人树。]东方青帝用电波回答。
　　他折下一截树干，黄褐色的液体从横截面流出，往上飘；还有一些黑色的碎渣，往下沉。
　　[这是提纯过一次的生物能源。]东方青帝沉声道。
