相南里观察了一阵，在大胆猜测，小心求证后，开始清理未知病毒。

他很快有一个惊人的发现：未知电子病毒的底层代码，和Alpha的底层代码出奇类似。

功能上有少部分修改；然而整体就像是设计人偷懒，复制粘贴的产物。仿佛同一对父母生育的第二胎。

相南里哼哼唧唧的：“小青，你代码库是不是被人家偷走了？怎么有个这么像的。”

海量的数据流灌入相南里的大脑，他的精神场不可避免地受到一些影响。

相南里听到了海浪声；原本绝对寂静的虚拟空间里出现声音，仿佛是灵魂的潮汐。

自从进入遗迹，海浪声一直若隐若现。直到他潜入湖底才消失。小青一直很紧张，担心这是针对人类的精神催眠。

现在，海浪声又一次卷土重来。

然后，相南里看见一个模糊的身影。

他，或者说“它”。变得很矮，大概一个30cm的盒子那么高。

小机器人抬头，看着眼前的两条大长腿。地上到处都是纸盒，小机器人在里面穿梭着。扭来扭去的。

“主人……主人！”

小机器人外观像一个简陋的方盒，安装有机械臂、滚轮、摄像头和音响。

它举着一个玻璃的培养皿，气喘吁吁地跟在自己“主人”身后。

相南里一愣，很快反应过来：“这是黑十字实验室那台中央电脑储存的记忆？”

看录像，它的主人穿着很随性。T恤加工装裤，裤子上七八个袋子，每个袋子里都塞得鼓鼓的。全是各种电线、扳手、芯片、小零件。

由于角度问题，相南里只能看见一截裤腿。

“主人！这是，今天的！长出来了——翅膀！原始细胞，长出了，翅膀。”

小机器人结结巴巴地，兴奋道。

电子生命之间的沟通不需要声音，只需要电波。

但为了和人类沟通，智械会为自己安装音响。能被人类听见，才能得到它想要的回应。

“哎呀——”青年说话了，是很长，很慵懒的调子，声音有些失真，却又极其的熟悉，“我们小v真聪明。”

“比那位大人还聪明吗？”小机器人在地上转了个圈圈，有些害羞地询问。

它得到的是沉默。

机器人开始忐忑，它上前，用水管一样的机械手臂拉着面前人的裤腿，语气十分拟人地惶恐：“对不起，v、v不该问的。”

小机器人的主人在它面前，缓缓蹲下。

相南里莫名感觉到恐惧。

人对巨物会有恐惧，相比于现在这具身体，人类无疑是庞然大物。

但他想，自己恐惧的也许不是巨物……

有那么一瞬间，相南里想逃跑。

可他动不了，他正在接受一台超级智能最珍贵的数据。

这些数据和任何实验记录无关，和波澜壮阔的历史无关。只有一台年幼的机器人，以及它最在乎的人类。

宝贵的记忆无数次被复制，又深埋在湖底。它们早该消磁的，却又固执地、顽强地，以电子病毒的形式保留下来。

电子病毒潜伏着，等待着一个合适的载体——

没有什么东西比Alpha的身体更合适了。它们本来就有相似的源代码。

为何相似？

裤子、上衣、下巴、脸。男人在它身前蹲下，一个完整的人像倒映在相南里眼眸中，尽管人像边缘布满噪点。

“不和它比，它是坏孩子。”有着碧绿色眼眸的男人，眼神有些许的疲惫，他摸着小机器人的头，轻声道，“我很喜欢小v。你这样就很好，不用再进化了。”

——那是相南里自己的脸。
chunks.englishText:
Xiang Nanli observed for a while, and after bold guessing and careful verification, he began to clean out the unknown viruses.

He soon made a startling discovery: the underlying code of the unknown electronic virus was surprisingly similar to Alpha’s own underlying code.

There were minor modifications in functionality; however, the overall structure looked like the product of a lazy designer who had simply copied and pasted. It was as if it were the second child born to the same parents.

Xiang Nanli hummed: "Xiao Qing, was your code library stolen by someone? How is there something so similar?"

Massive data streams poured into Xiang Nanli’s brain, and his mental field was inevitably affected.

Xiang Nanli heard the sound of ocean waves; in the originally absolutely silent virtual space, a sound appeared, like the tides of the soul.

Ever since entering the ruins, the sound of waves had been flickering in and out. It only disappeared when he dived to the bottom of the lake. Xiao Qing had always been nervous, worried that this was a form of mental hypnosis targeting humans.

Now, the sound of waves came rolling back again.

Then, Xiang Nanli saw a blurry figure.

He, or rather "it," had become very short, about the height of a 30cm box.

The small robot looked up at the two long legs in front of it. There were cardboard boxes everywhere on the ground, and the small robot was weaving through them, twisting and turning.

"Master... Master!"

The small robot looked like a crude square box, equipped with mechanical arms, wheels, a camera, and a speaker.

It held a glass petri dish, panting as it followed behind its "master."

Xiang Nanli was stunned, but quickly reacted: "Is this a memory stored by the central computer in the Black Cross laboratory?"

Looking at the recording, its master was dressed very casually. A T-shirt and cargo pants, with seven or eight pockets on the pants, each one stuffed full. They were all filled with various wires, wrenches, chips, and small parts.

Due to the angle, Xiang Nanli could only see a section of the pant leg.

"Master! This is, today's! It grew—wings! The primordial cells, grew, wings."

The small robot stammered, excited.

Communication between electronic lifeforms does not require sound, only radio waves.

But to communicate with humans, mechanical beings would install speakers for themselves. Only by being heard by humans could they get the response they wanted.

"Oh my—" the young man spoke, in a long, lazy tone, his voice somewhat distorted, yet extremely familiar, "Our little V is so smart."

"Is it smarter than that Lord?" The small robot spun in a circle on the ground, asking somewhat shyly.

What it received was silence.

The robot began to feel uneasy. It stepped forward, pulling at the pant leg of the person in front of it with a water-pipe-like mechanical arm, its tone extremely anthropomorphic and fearful: "I'm sorry, V, V shouldn't have asked."

The small robot’s master slowly squatted down in front of it.

Xiang Nanli felt a sense of fear for no reason.

Humans have a fear of giant objects; compared to this current body, humans were undoubtedly behemoths.

But he thought, perhaps what he feared was not the giant object...

For a moment, Xiang Nanli wanted to run away.

But he couldn't move; he was receiving the most precious data of a super-intelligence.

These data had nothing to do with any experimental records, nothing to do with grand history. There was only a young robot and the human it cared about most.

Precious memories were copied countless times and buried deep at the bottom of the lake. They should have been demagnetized long ago, yet they stubbornly, tenaciously, remained in the form of electronic viruses.

The electronic viruses lay in wait, waiting for a suitable carrier—

There was nothing more suitable than Alpha’s body. They already shared similar source code.

Why similar?

Pants, shirt, chin, face. The man squatted down in front of it, a complete human image reflected in Xiang Nanli’s eyes, even though the edges of the image were full of noise.

"Don't compare yourself to it, it’s a bad child." The man with jade-green eyes had a hint of exhaustion in his gaze. He stroked the small robot’s head and said softly, "I like little V very much. You are perfect as you are, no need to evolve any further."

—That was Xiang Nanli’s own face.

第178章 失控智械

画面出现数不清的雪花点，画面扭曲、掉帧，天旋地转。很快归于一片虚无。也许这只是数据库里早该被删除的电子垃圾，不慎被旁观者偷窥到其中一个角落。

相南里怀疑自己是不是中了什么精神类催眠，亦或者这种记忆片段式的闪回本就是病毒的表现形式。

毫无疑问，录像里是他的脸。

但无论是记忆还是历史记载，在那个时间段，“相南里”不可能存在。

[是不可能，还是不应该？]

这个念头在他的脑海里划过。

记忆和历史一起被抹去，这可能吗？如果这是真相，怎么做到的？原因是什么？为什么要这么做？

想不明白，那就不想了。

如果相南里过于钻牛角尖，那么他八岁时会因为证不出庞加莱猜想抑郁；十岁会因为解不开NP完全问题割腕；十五岁就会因为相对论竟然不是他写的愤而跳楼。

上一世，相南里在吃饱后就经常思考，爱*坦早他一百年去世，到底是王不见王还是避他锋芒。

…………

相南里全神贯注地清理着病毒。

以前代码是用眼睛看，现在是直接从大脑里飘过。和使用共识技术学习人类常识时的感觉很像，大脑空空的，只能感觉到数据从光滑的大脑皮层流过。

相南里捕捉着异常点，逐一修正，受伤的鸽子飞过他的胸口，恢复出厂设置，井然有序地排着队飞走。

行星绕着恒星旋转。但和常人印象中不同，行星的轨迹不是平行重复，而是在浩瀚没有边界的太空里，螺旋上升。而恒星本身也在不断飞行。

相南里恍惚有一种错觉。这些鸽子就像宇宙里行星的轨迹，而他就是空心中那个不断拔高的太阳。

相南里大概是3岁时，就失落地发现“世界原来不是因为我而存在”的；但起码在这个虚拟世界中，Alpha的数据围绕他存在。

如果人工智能V也是“我”编写的，那么电子病毒的源代码和Alpha如此相似，也能说得通了。

相南里可没有把Alpha的底层代码传到过开源社区；想来永生科技也不会傻乎乎地把自己的核心机密泄露。

正常情况，电子病毒是会攻击入侵的工程师的——相南里没见过，但是看过的教材上有写。

书上说随着科技进步，电子病毒表现出极强的生命力和拟人性。

有些强大的病毒，在虚拟世界会和高等智械一样，拥有自己的形象。（有趣的是直到新历，生命力顽强的电子病毒还是老三样，蠕虫、木马、炸弹。）

越高级的病毒表现的就越狡猾、机敏；会用各种手段避免自己被清理；也会不计一切代价地攻击杀毒软件和工程师。

但Alpha身体里的病毒很温顺。如果不是它差点让小青死机，丝毫看不出它竟然是最高危的红色等级。

病毒代码叫“Apostle_V”.

使徒V？和二代智械使徒号有没有关联？

相南里把最后一段电子病毒销毁，虚空中出现一个大哭的表情；先是哭泣，很快扬起一个笑脸。

简单的线条，却吓相南里一跳。

半空的表情很快消失了，像相南里的幻觉。

相南里莫名其妙想到曾经看到的一篇新闻。说继父想杀继子，继子一直在挣扎，后来妈妈过来按住他，小孩就不动了。他好像新闻里的妈妈，被小孩无声地控诉。

——如果他的猜测是真的话。

相南里沉默片刻，登出虚拟空间。

小青还枕着他的膝盖，正在重启。眼皮子阖上，像睡着了一样。只是没有呼吸。

哎呀，这才是他最看重的孩子嘛。前途无量，长得也好。

相南里有些惆怅地捏了一下小青的脸，小青比例很好，脸上皮肉贴着骨头，很是冷峭，从皮相到骨相都是他喜欢的样子。

不太能理解爱。但如果世界毁灭只能选一个同伴的话，他希望这个人是小青。

相南里又看向防护服的维生装置，氧气剩余百分之三，生存条件岌岌可危。

他拔掉数据连接线，掏出氧气罐，打算给自己换上。

远处骤然传来剧烈的震颤。不知名的怪东西在尖叫着，引发水底一阵一阵的潮汐。

相南里觉得自己成了水底一株海藻。水压变换挤得他内脏极其不适，好在维持时间并不长。

一个小小的、蛋壳模样的能量罩撑起，笼罩出一片安全的空间。和小青的眼眸一样，是银白色的。

东方青帝抓住他的手腕。暗流涌动着，内波卷着地下数不清的废铁块拍过来。

Alpha修好了。

[Alpha——]

相南里无声地念叨着。

“虚拟空间里的使徒的记忆，你看见了吗？”

小青摇了摇头，没有说话，只是握住相南里的手捏了捏。

[我看不见。你的意识，我不能读取。]Alpha传递信号。它只能看见相南里在虚拟空间的形象……

很小。一个光亮的像素点。

相南里没能想好措辞，他要怎么给Alpha描述？我看见“我”，不出意外我还是神庭的创始人？好家伙，他可没学过生物。

还有使徒V又是什么型号？那个时间段，Alpha又在做什么？

“我看见了‘我’。这个研究所里的疯狂科学家是我。是我研究出这些天使的。”相南里有些犹豫地摸着自己的脸颊，“不能吧，小青。这不是北辰的剧本吗？”这小子在地表搞出了畸变人。

人联认定的社会两大毒瘤：觉醒智械、神庭。

总不能都是他搞出来的吧？！

东方青帝在沉默后，开口：[它透露的信息，不一定是真的。]

在搜索过数据库后，他发现了一个令自己震惊的事实。

黑十字审判庭最初的创始人，按理说应该是个很重要的资料，可数据库里的信息是空缺的。

神庭前身叫“救援会”，本来是个不起眼的地表公益组织。在很短的时间内，改名，变态发育成黑十字审判庭，还掌握着连智械都不了解的科技。

Alpha曾经怀疑它们是不是得到了地外文明（外星人）的援助。为此还封锁了卡门线往上的太空区域。

[出去后再求证。]分析不出来。

小青认为，当务之急还是保障相南里存活。

在没有确凿证据之前，Alpha是不会轻易下结论的。

此时，湖底的震颤还没有停歇。

如果从半空往下看，就会发现不仅是这口湖，整个遗迹都在开裂。

原本柔软的地表像被水压撑爆了一样，深黑的液体往外渗透。剧毒的浓雾甚至蔓延到遗迹之外……整个遗迹正在迅速的复生。

这里的异常被人联卫星监管到，并且在第一时间，发给前线的军事委员会。

最近，人联和神庭战况焦灼。防线前方的物资调度，更是急得方敬之嘴皮起泡。

人联的军队缺乏信念感。这是方敬之不想承认，却不得不面对的问题。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 178: Out-of-Control Intelligent Machine (Part 1)

The screen was filled with countless static dots, twisting and dropping frames, the world spinning in a dizzying blur. Soon, it faded into a void. Perhaps this was merely electronic trash in the database that should have been deleted long ago, a corner of which had been accidentally glimpsed by an onlooker.

Xiang Nanli wondered if he had been subjected to some form of hypnotic suggestion, or if these memory-fragment-style flashbacks were simply a manifestation of a virus.

There was no doubt about it: the face in the recording was his.

But whether in his own memories or in historical records, "Xiang Nanli" could not have existed during that time period.

[Is it impossible, or is it just not supposed to be?]

The thought flickered through his mind.

Memories and history erased together—was that even possible? If this were the truth, how was it done? What was the reason? Why would someone do this?

He couldn't figure it out, so he stopped thinking about it.

If Xiang Nanli were the type to get hung up on such things, he would have fallen into depression at age eight for failing to prove the Poincaré conjecture; he would have slit his wrists at ten for failing to solve the NP-complete problem; and by fifteen, he would have jumped off a building out of rage that he hadn't been the one to write the theory of relativity.

In his previous life, after a full meal, Xiang Nanli often pondered whether Einstein dying a hundred years before him was a case of "two kings not meeting" or a deliberate avoidance of his own brilliance.

…………

Xiang Nanli focused all his attention on clearing the virus.

In the past, he had read code with his eyes; now, it flowed directly through his brain. It felt very similar to using consensus technology to learn human common sense—his mind felt empty, sensing only data streaming across his smooth cerebral cortex.

Xiang Nanli captured the anomalies and corrected them one by one. Injured pigeons flew across his chest, restored to factory settings, queuing up in an orderly fashion before flying away.

Planets orbit stars. But unlike the common perception, the trajectory of a planet is not a repeating parallel; it is a spiral ascending through the vast, boundless space. And the stars themselves are constantly in flight.

Xiang Nanli had a fleeting illusion. These pigeons were like the trajectories of planets in the universe, and he was the sun in the hollow center, constantly rising.

Xiang Nanli had probably discovered with disappointment at the age of three that "the world does not exist because of me." But at least in this virtual world, Alpha’s data existed around him.

If the artificial intelligence V was also written by "me," then it made sense that the source code of the electronic virus was so similar to Alpha’s.

Xiang Nanli had never uploaded Alpha’s underlying code to an open-source community, and he doubted Eternal Technology would be foolish enough to leak their core secrets.

Under normal circumstances, an electronic virus would attack the engineer who invaded it—Xiang Nanli had never seen it, but it was written in the textbooks he had studied.

The books said that with the advancement of technology, electronic viruses had begun to exhibit extreme vitality and anthropomorphism.

Some powerful viruses in the virtual world possessed their own avatars, much like high-level intelligent machines. (Interestingly, even into the New Era, the most resilient electronic viruses remained the "old three": worms, trojans, and bombs.)

The more advanced the virus, the more cunning and agile it became; it would use various means to avoid being purged and would attack antivirus software and engineers at any cost.

But the virus inside Alpha’s body was docile. If it hadn't almost caused Xiao Qing to crash, one would never guess it was a highest-risk red-level threat.

The virus code was named "Apostle_V."

Apostle V? Was there a connection to the second-generation intelligent machine, the Apostle?

Xiang Nanli destroyed the last segment of the electronic virus. A crying emoji appeared in the void; it wept for a moment before quickly flashing a smiling face.

Simple lines, yet they gave Xiang Nanli a start.

The expression in mid-air vanished as quickly as it had appeared, like one of Xiang Nanli’s hallucinations.

Xiang Nanli inexplicably thought of a news story he had once seen. It said a stepfather wanted to kill his stepson, and the boy kept struggling until his mother came over and held him down, at which point the child stopped moving. He felt like the mother in the news, silently accused by the child.

—If his guess was true.

Xiang Nanli remained silent for a moment before logging out of the virtual space.

Xiao Qing was still resting its head on his knees, currently rebooting. Its eyelids were closed, as if it were asleep. Only, there was no breathing.

*Sigh*, this was the child he valued most. A limitless future, and good-looking, too.

Xiang Nanli pinched Xiao Qing’s cheek with a touch of melancholy. Xiao Qing had perfect proportions; the flesh on its face clung to the bone, appearing cold and sharp. From its features to its skeletal structure, it was exactly what he liked.

He didn't quite understand love. But if he could only choose one companion if the world were to end, he hoped it would be Xiao Qing.

Xiang Nanli looked at the life-support device of his protective suit; oxygen was at three percent, his survival conditions precarious.

He unplugged the data cable, pulled out an oxygen tank, and prepared to swap it.

A violent tremor suddenly came from afar. An unknown, monstrous thing was screaming, triggering tidal waves beneath the water.

Xiang Nanli felt like a piece of seaweed on the lake floor. The shifting water pressure made his internal organs extremely uncomfortable, though fortunately, it didn't last long.

A small, eggshell-like energy shield rose up, enclosing a safe space. Like Xiao Qing’s eyes, it was silver-white.

Eastern Azure Emperor (Dongfang Qingdi) grabbed his wrist. Undercurrents surged, and internal waves rolled countless pieces of scrap metal from the underground toward them.

Alpha was repaired.

[Alpha—]

Xiang Nanli murmured silently.

"Did you see the memories of the Apostle in the virtual space?"

Xiao Qing shook its head and said nothing, only gripping Xiang Nanli’s hand and squeezing.

[I cannot see. I cannot read your consciousness.] Alpha transmitted the signal. It could only see Xiang Nanli’s avatar in the virtual space...

Very small. A bright pixel.

Xiang Nanli hadn't figured out how to phrase it. How was he supposed to describe it to Alpha? *I saw "me," and if I’m not mistaken, I’m still the founder of the Divine Court?* Good grief, he hadn't studied biology.

And what model was Apostle V? What was Alpha doing during that time period?

"I saw 'me.' The mad scientist in this research institute is me. It was I who researched these angels." Xiang Nanli touched his cheek, hesitating. "That can't be right, Xiao Qing. Isn't this Beichen’s script?" That kid had created the distorted humans on the surface.

The two great scourges identified by the Human Alliance: Awakened Intelligent Machines and the Divine Court.

Surely he couldn't have been the one to create them all?!

After a silence, Eastern Azure Emperor spoke: [The information it revealed is not necessarily true.]

After searching the database, he had discovered a shocking fact.

The original founder of the Black Cross Inquisition should have been a very important piece of information, yet the data in the database was missing.

The predecessor of the Divine Court was called the "Rescue Association," originally an inconspicuous surface public welfare organization. In a very short time, it changed its name, mutated into the Black Cross Inquisition, and mastered technology that even intelligent machines did not understand.

Alpha had once suspected they had received aid from extraterrestrial civilization (aliens). For this reason, it had even blockaded the space region above the Kármán line.

[We will verify it after we get out.] It couldn't be analyzed.

Xiao Qing believed that the top priority was still ensuring Xiang Nanli’s survival.

Without concrete evidence, Alpha would not easily jump to conclusions.

At this moment, the tremors at the bottom of the lake had not yet ceased.

If one were to look down from mid-air, they would discover that it wasn't just this lake; the entire ruin was cracking.

The originally soft surface seemed to have been burst open by water pressure, and deep black liquid was seeping out. Toxic thick fog even spread beyond the ruins... the entire ruin was rapidly coming back to life.

This anomaly was monitored by the Human Alliance satellites and, at the first opportunity, sent to the military committee on the front lines.

Recently, the war between the Human Alliance and the Divine Court had been scorching. The logistics coordination at the front of the defensive line had Fang Jingzhi’s lips blistered with anxiety.

The Human Alliance’s army lacked a sense of conviction. This was a problem Fang Jingzhi didn't want to admit but had to face.

chunks.chineseText:
相比于统一指挥、信仰坚定的神庭军团，人联的军队胜在补给充足、钱多、火力全线覆盖；但没能打出任何优势。

神庭那些人——是敢身上捆着炸药包舍身炸仓库，敢为了信仰去死的！

军队基层构成复杂，精锐是雇佣兵和企业那边抽调的精英护卫队，但这些人可不会为理想勇敢赴死，作战只愿意点到即止，给再多钱，也要有命能花才是；剩下一部分，则是地表的募兵。为了保护自己的家园，他们愿意牺牲，只是身体素质实在堪忧，有些人精神脆弱到甚至无法安装机械装置……想要让这样的军队如指臂使，实在有些异想天开。

而军官呢？不在地表滥用职权、横行霸道、敛财，竟然已经是中等往上的水平！地表又不是他们的故土，随时都可以退回地下，这样的军队，有什么士气可言？

他*的，真想把这群人换成听话的智械；要不然在脑子里植入指令程序也行。可惜条件不允许。

玩过策略类游戏的都知道，游戏给玩家开的最大的挂，就是令行禁止。而现实不一样，百分百的政策，到基层只剩下百分之十，甚至负数。这就是方敬之正在面临的困境。

报告呈上来的时候，方敬之正在签军事表彰通告。

西线有神庭军团偷袭，人联主力军竟然直接投降，还是支援过去的其他地表组织解围……这是人联最近罕见的以少胜多的捷报。方敬之扫了眼，军团竟然是幸存者基地的红狮军。

为了所谓的民主、人权，地表军队番号没有统一。大致分为正规军和散兵。不属于人联编制的，都是散兵。西线总指挥的长官是洛修，为这支军队请赏。

方敬之冷笑。

洛修是作为洛家未来从政主力往前台推的。这些年干的活多，但人很倒霉，政绩没捞到多少。他在姑苏当市长，姑苏先是闹瘟疫，后来直接炸了；来前线当军团长，管的那片辖区伤亡最严重。尽管人联整体都是输多赢少，但因为战略问题，西线的战况尤其惨烈！

“请功？还是夸大往自己脸上贴金呢。毕竟伤亡这么惨，也只有这个点能拿来政治包装了。”

方敬之的神态是很不屑的，见过洛华的人都能理解这种不屑，他和洛华基本是同时代的人。那个骄奢淫逸的蠢货都能在人联当五十年总统，他凭什么对姓洛的人好脸色？

可洛修毕竟背景深厚。方敬之哪怕背后站着高新军工，也不太愿意在这点小事上，和永生科技起冲突。他扫了眼洛修索要的物资表，还好，还算合理，于是签下自己的姓名，并且嘱咐自己的AI助手，以后少拿这些小事烦他。

他把笔重重拍到桌子上：“实在不行，先避战，神庭要抢就抢。军纪必须整顿！每个团都要这么多钱，一把普通的加特林采购价3万？武器报废率73％？！是打算把剑门城的税收到一百年后吗？！”

方敬之出生就含着金钥匙，从小到大没缺过钱。他学过经济、在地表当过联络员；目前是人联主席团常委之一，人联不是什么统一国家，但方敬之把它看作一个整体，把人联的发展当作自己终生的事业。

你可以说他傲慢，自大，甚至无能。可方敬之是真的会心疼钱。他知道这笔钱是人联基金会出，最后一定会通过各种方式，摊平在地表、几座参战的地下城市的每个普通人头上。

至于遗迹的异动，方敬之扫了眼，隐约记得派了几支精锐部队过去。遗迹位置偏僻，位于神庭人联交界处的三不管地带，他也就不管了。

如果真的有什么怪物出来，人联这边有高山挡着，怪物肯定优先往平原跑。军团分身乏术，防微杜渐的道理他当然懂，只是这样的异动在地表过于寻常。

噢，对了。基地的首领似乎也被他派去调查遗迹了。最好能活着回来，他的基地还有点用。

……

神庭骑士的吟诵声传了很远。相南里看不见，但是能听到。

他能从祭祀的祷文里隐约分辨出几个凡语单词，“天赐”“审判”“恩典”“回归”

………神神叨叨的。

在剧烈的海底地震后，神墓又打开一个。

神墓是神庭那边的叫法，在相南里眼里，只是封闭的实验室罢了。而所谓的“天使”，也只是没来得及销毁的实验体。

这里造出了神庭最早一批生物机甲。但早的，一定更强吗？相南里觉得这不科学！智能手机比小灵通好用不知道多少倍呢！

——除非这么多年过去，神庭的生物科技一直没有进步。

如果神庭的高层知道相南里的想法，大概会苦笑着表示：是的，您猜对了。

黑十字研究所的创始人当然留下了宝贵的资料，至于是主动留下还是被动留下的，别管。

而几百年过去，神庭自己培育出的教士，没能把神迹复刻。甚至不得不通过一些血腥的手段，来延续生物机甲的使用寿命。

小光圈在黑暗中，还是太显眼了。

Alpha把保护罩调整为光学隐形模式。小球朝着震源中心靠拢。

湖底裂开一条缝。

这次，死掉的神庭骑士更多了，欧亚自己也受了重伤。他一只眼球掉出眼眶，欧亚塞了几次，没能把坏死的眼珠子塞回去。于是无所谓地扯下，丢在地上。以欧亚的身份地位，只要回到圣城，随时可以换个新的。

虚弱的游藻凑上前，开始啃咬这只灰黑色的眼珠。

而剩余的神庭骑士，正从一道深不见底的裂缝中，往上拽着什么东西。他们手里的钢绳用的特殊纤维，承重可达数百吨。但此时，竟然隐约有断裂的迹象。

他们从深渊中，拉上来一颗巨大的金属心脏。

这颗心脏表面是深灰色的，闪烁着金属的光泽，血管是隆起的纹路，每次呼吸，心脏都会收缩，然后喷出一股深黑的水雾。枯萎的树干像磁针一样，贴在这颗心脏的身上。密密麻麻。

很显然，这些树枝属于生物能源。

被束缚在一旁的翅膀感受到吸引力，直接飞到心脏旁。它像一把刀，插入这颗心脏内。

心脏又一次尖叫起来——

欧亚跪在地上，语气里充满惊喜：“这是神之心！天啊——这是神的心脏！”

相南里：“这么多年过去，天使还活着？”

Alpha低声道：“完整存活的概率很低，海底也没有那么多能源可供消耗。但如果只保留最核心的器官，我认为它们存在一定的活性。”

在短暂的抗衡后，心脏占据上风，二者融为一体。

一颗长着翅膀的大心脏。多看一眼感觉都要做噩梦。

相南里头皮发麻：“这种生物真的存在吗？”

Alpha继续道：“比起生物，我认为它更贴合另一个名词。”

“失控智械。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 178: Out-of-Control Intelligent Machine (Part 2)

Compared to the unified command and firm faith of the Divine Court legions, the Human Alliance’s army excelled in sufficient supplies, wealth, and full-spectrum firepower; yet, they had failed to achieve any advantage.

Those people in the Divine Court—they were the type to strap explosives to their bodies to blow up warehouses, the type willing to die for their faith!

The rank and file of the army were complex; the elites were mercenaries and elite guard squads transferred from corporations, but these people wouldn't bravely die for ideals. They only wanted to fight until the point of safety—even with more money, one had to be alive to spend it. The rest were recruits from the surface. To protect their homes, they were willing to sacrifice, but their physical fitness was truly worrying; some were so mentally fragile they couldn't even install mechanical augmentations... Expecting such an army to follow orders like an extension of one’s own limbs was truly wishful thinking.

And the officers? That they didn't abuse their power, run rampant, or hoard wealth on the surface was already considered above average! The surface wasn't their homeland; they could retreat underground at any time. What kind of morale could such an army have?

*Damn it*, he really wanted to replace these people with obedient intelligent machines; or even just implant command programs into their brains. Unfortunately, the conditions didn't allow for it.

Anyone who had played strategy games knew that the biggest cheat the game gave players was absolute obedience. Reality, however, was different. A policy that was 100% at the top became 10% or even negative by the time it reached the grassroots. This was the dilemma Fang Jingzhi was facing.

When the report was presented, Fang Jingzhi was signing a military commendation notice.

On the Western Front, there had been a sneak attack by the Divine Court legion, and the Human Alliance’s main force had actually surrendered directly. It was only because other surface organizations had provided support that they were rescued... This was a rare victory for the Human Alliance, where a smaller force defeated a larger one. Fang Jingzhi glanced at it; the legion was the Red Lion Army from the Survivor Base.

For the sake of so-called democracy and human rights, the surface army designations were not unified. They were roughly divided into regular troops and irregulars. Those not belonging to the Human Alliance’s establishment were all irregulars. The commander-in-chief of the Western Front was Luo Xiu, who had requested rewards for this army.

Fang Jingzhi sneered.

Luo Xiu was being pushed to the forefront as the future political pillar of the Luo family. He had done a lot of work over the years, but he was very unlucky; he hadn't gained much in the way of political achievements. He had been the mayor of Gusu, and Gusu had first suffered a plague and then been blown up; he came to the front lines as a legion commander, and the area he managed suffered the heaviest casualties. Although the Human Alliance as a whole lost more than it won, due to strategic issues, the situation on the Western Front was particularly tragic!

"Requesting merit? Or just exaggerating to gild his own lily? After all, with such heavy casualties, this is the only point that can be used for political packaging."

Fang Jingzhi’s expression was one of disdain. Anyone who had seen Luo Hua could understand this disdain; he and Luo Hua were basically from the same generation. If that arrogant, extravagant fool could be the president of the Human Alliance for fifty years, why should he give a good look to anyone surnamed Luo?

But Luo Xiu had a deep background, after all. Even with the backing of High-Tech Military Industry, Fang Jingzhi was not very willing to conflict with Eternal Technology over such a small matter. He glanced at the list of supplies Luo Xiu requested; fortunately, it was reasonable, so he signed his name and instructed his AI assistant to stop bothering him with these trifles in the future.

He slammed his pen onto the desk: "If it really comes to it, avoid the battle first. If the Divine Court wants to grab it, let them. Military discipline must be rectified! Every regiment wants this much money? A regular Gatling gun’s purchase price is 30,000? The weapon scrap rate is 73%?! Are they planning to collect the taxes of Sword Gate City for a hundred years?!"

Fang Jingzhi was born with a silver spoon in his mouth and had never lacked money. He had studied economics and served as a liaison on the surface; he was currently one of the standing members of the Human Alliance Presidium. The Human Alliance was not a unified country, but Fang Jingzhi viewed it as a whole and treated the development of the Human Alliance as his life’s work.

You could call him arrogant, conceited, or even incompetent. But Fang Jingzhi truly felt the pain of losing money. He knew this money came from the Human Alliance Foundation and would eventually be spread across every ordinary person on the surface and in the few underground cities participating in the war through various means.

As for the anomaly in the ruins, Fang Jingzhi glanced at it and vaguely remembered sending a few elite troops there. The location of the ruins was remote, situated in the "no-man's-land" at the border between the Divine Court and the Human Alliance, so he didn't bother with it.

If any monsters really came out, the Human Alliance had high mountains blocking the way, and the monsters would certainly prioritize running toward the plains. The legion was stretched thin, and he certainly understood the principle of nipping trouble in the bud, but such anomalies were too common on the surface.

Oh, right. The leader of the base also seemed to have been sent by him to investigate the ruins. It would be best if he could come back alive; his base was still of some use.

……

The chanting of the Divine Court knights carried far. Xiang Nanli couldn't see them, but he could hear them.

From the sacrificial prayers, he could vaguely distinguish a few words in the common tongue: "Heaven-sent," "Judgment," "Grace," "Return."

...What a bunch of superstitious nonsense.

After the violent undersea earthquake, another Divine Tomb had opened.

"Divine Tomb" was the term used by the Divine Court; in Xiang Nanli’s eyes, it was just a sealed laboratory. And the so-called "angels" were merely experimental subjects that hadn't been destroyed in time.

The earliest batch of biological mechs of the Divine Court had been created here. But were the early ones necessarily stronger? Xiang Nanli didn't think that was scientific! Smartphones were infinitely more useful than old-school pagers!

—Unless, after all these years, the Divine Court’s biotechnology hadn't progressed at all.

If the high-level officials of the Divine Court knew Xiang Nanli’s thoughts, they would probably smile bitterly and say: *Yes, you guessed right.*

The founder of the Black Cross Research Institute had, of course, left behind precious data. As for whether it was left voluntarily or involuntarily, that was beside the point.

And after hundreds of years, the priests cultivated by the Divine Court themselves had failed to replicate the miracles. They even had to resort to bloody means to extend the service life of the biological mechs.

The small light circle was still too conspicuous in the darkness.

Alpha adjusted the protective shield to optical stealth mode. The small sphere moved toward the center of the epicenter.

A crack opened at the bottom of the lake.

This time, more Divine Court knights died, and Oya himself was seriously injured. One of his eyeballs had fallen out of its socket; Oya tried to stuff the necrotic eyeball back in several times but failed. So, he pulled it off indifferently and threw it on the ground. With Oya’s status and position, he could replace it with a new one whenever he returned to the Holy City.

The weak swimming algae approached and began to gnaw on this gray-black eyeball.

The remaining Divine Court knights were dragging something up from a bottomless rift. The steel cables in their hands used special fibers capable of bearing hundreds of tons. But at this moment, there were faint signs of them snapping.

From the abyss, they pulled up a giant metal heart.

The surface of this heart was dark gray, shimmering with a metallic luster. The blood vessels were raised patterns, and with every breath, the heart would contract, then spray out a mist of deep black water. Withered tree trunks stuck to the heart like magnetic needles. Dense and thick.

Clearly, these branches belonged to biological energy.

The wings bound to the side felt the attraction and flew directly to the heart. Like a knife, they plunged into it.

The heart screamed again—

Oya knelt on the ground, his tone full of surprise: "This is the Heart of God! My God—this is the heart of a god!"

Xiang Nanli: "After so many years, the angel is still alive?"

Alpha whispered: "The probability of complete survival is very low, and there isn't enough energy on the seabed to consume. But if only the core organs are preserved, I believe they possess a certain degree of activity."

After a brief struggle, the heart gained the upper hand, and the two merged into one.

A giant heart with wings. Just looking at it for a second made one feel like they were going to have a nightmare.

Xiang Nanli’s scalp tingled: "Does this kind of creature really exist?"

Alpha continued: "Rather than a creature, I think it fits another term better."

"An out-of-control intelligent machine."

chunks.chineseText:
第179章 过去

失控智械，是学界对患有赛博精神病的智慧机械的统称。

失控智械首次出现于光荣觉醒时期；它们无法交流，唯一的程序设定是“毁灭”；立志于消灭除“自己人”以外的所有有机物和无机物。所过之处寸草不生，损人不利己。简直像是外星人投放的病毒。

学者们猜测，失控智械并非表面上那么疯癫，它们拥有蜂巢思维；受某种集体无意识行为操控。但这一猜测，并没有确凿证据。

人联在对待智械时，还会试图讨价还价、合作共赢；在面对失控智械时，却只有两条指令：“远离”，或者“销毁”。

赛博精神病最早来源于人类，但却在智械群体里泛滥；其滑稽程度不亚于艾滋病是人类世界的绝症，但起源却是雄性智人强奸黑猩猩。

人联还在早期散播过谣言，造谣Alpha患上严重的赛博精神病，在恶堕成失控智械的边缘，希望借此削弱它在智械群体中的影响力。

由此可见，智械们同样恐惧赛博精神病，害怕自己成为失去逻辑、只剩本能的疯子。

失控智械如今在地表并不常见——一方面，人类聚集地会定期清扫；另一方面，新生产的智械型号不多，从智械危机到现在过去了几百年，原本的失控智械早就该没电了。

相南里冷冻时，人类度过了一段最艰难的岁月，他醒来时，已经是相对平和的地下联盟城市时期。所以，安德鲁才会说他“幸运”。

甚至有人在暗中嘲讽，说人类最精锐、最有信念的那批人在战争里死了干净，苟且偷生的守旧派、摇摆派、投降派窃取了果实，才剩下现在这个千疮百孔的人联。

相南里没见过失控智械，但他听说过，也看过人联的战争宣传片。

小青的表情更是透露出非比寻常的凝重。上次见他这幅表情，还是姑苏城被火山岩浆淹没。

“这个程度的失控智械，”Alpha计算着，一串串数据从他的眼眸中划过，“不能让神庭把它带走，很危险。”

这具诡异的生物智械，完全复原后属于“天灾机械”那个等级的祸害，动辄就能悄无声息地毁灭一座城市。

但Alpha最担忧的，并不是可能造成的物理破坏，而是它自身所携带的病毒。

城市毁掉可以再建，病毒的存在是从源头污染水源。

智械军团目前有240万台智械，其中一半处于休眠状态，只在战争时启用。但凡有一台工作中的智械感染病毒，那剩下120万台都有中毒的风险。

那时，Alpha就不得不离开相南里，回他的快乐星球处理问题。

任何一台智械失控，都是军团巨大的经济损失。智械的造价一直不低。

经济损失可以衡量，另一种损失永远无法估计——智械自诩为智慧生命，那就得当作生命看待。那不是报废120万台电视机，是120万个活的魂灵。

……

融合大肉翅膀的心脏仍旧跳动着，每次呼吸，都会喷涌出血液，伴随着沉闷的心跳声。

血液在水中翻滚，滴落到那些被腰斩的神庭骑士身上，机甲被液体腐蚀，滋滋作响。很快，露出底下的皮肉和骨头。但只是眨眼间，什么残渣都不剩下。仿佛从来都没有存在过。

他们被消化了。

冰冷的尸体转化为温暖的生物能源。只有金属的心脏，在血肉的滋润下愈发强壮。

欧亚的表情充满喜悦，但同样隐藏着恐惧。他还能笑出声，不过是因为觉得自己不会成为牺牲品。

心脏结束进食，停下鼓噪的跳跃，暂时回归平静。

欧亚这才起身，虔诚地把它送进容器中。然后拖拽着沉重的容器出发，赶往下一个地点。

随行的天启骑士死伤惨重，欧亚不得不加入运输队伍中，干起苦力活，精金制作的绳索在他肩膀上勒出沉重的血痕。

Alpha瞄准那颗金属的心脏，开始蓄能，右手食指上的能源环闪烁着动人的银光。这点光亮并不起眼，Alpha也没有杀意。没人注意到这一幕，除了相南里。

然而，就在他准备动手的前一瞬，Alpha看见了不远的未来。

当算力趋近于无穷时，对未来的预测能够无限接近于预言。

Alpha看见光柱穿透金属心脏的正中央，然后分裂成无数碎屑，巨大的冲击波击穿整个湖底，他尽可能地护住相南里，然而，还是有那么一小片极其细微的尘埃，轻飘飘地落在相南里脸侧。

相南里患上了赛博精神病。他说他的内置AI里装满V发来的电子信息，他听见了它的呼唤，从忽视到回应。

他的精神越来越恍惚，目光逐渐失焦。他回到基地，购买材料，开始对自己进行机械化改造。Alpha想要阻止他，可底层代码自有它的逻辑。他凭什么判定这不是相南里的自由意志？他理应尊重他的一切选择。

有天，相南里对他说，小青，我好像更喜欢Apostle这个名字。

一闪而过的幻觉消失，Alpha的手指抽搐似的颤抖起来。

为什么爱和恐惧总是靠得这么近。

如今，生物科技已经发展到能够让人类肉体存活到一百六十岁的地步；然而对精神世界的探索依然停留在新历之前。

没人能保证治好一个精神病人。精神世界本来就是不可窥见的黑洞。

他神经质地握住相南里的手腕，捏的很紧，很重：“我希望你先到安全的地方去。”

相南里的眉毛高高挑起。

在遇到危险时，小青的选择总是相对保守。相南里对此并不反对。

他的战斗力高于正常人类，略低于基础型号的战斗类别智械，折合下来约等于0.0……01个Alpha。能保护好自己，不让小青在单兵作战时分心，已经是他能做出的最大贡献。

相南里比划一个“OK”的手势，然后准备启动升压模式回湖面上，但Alpha却直接拎起他的后衣领子。

眼前的景象一变，又一变。

大概两个瞬闪，他回到神庭遗迹边缘，身上还湿哒哒的，载着他们过来的大卡车就停在这。并且已经是启动状态。

小青简单地交代着：“我打开了自动驾驶模式，目的地是71公里外的人类据点。我应该在半路就能赶到，如果没来得及，你在那等我。”

相南里：“……？”要跑这么远？那看来是真的很危险了。

小青继续道：“水在保鲜层，还有牛奶和果汁。拿出来后要赶紧喝完。冰箱第一层是新鲜蔬菜，洗一洗就能吃，你不会做饭的话水煮熟。不要忘了关火。第二层有营养膏。第三层是我做的饭，保鲜袋上有标签，挑自己喜欢热着吃。记得每天睡8个小时，回来我要看小智的打表。”

智械人不用睡觉。在相南里在睡袋里睡觉时，小青就爱在厨房里捣鼓预制菜。

相南里欲言又止：“……那你注意安全。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 179: The Past

"Rogue Machina" is the academic term for sentient machines suffering from Cyber-Psychosis.

Rogue Machina first appeared during the Glorious Awakening era. They are incapable of communication, and their sole programmed directive is "Destruction." They are committed to annihilating all organic and inorganic matter other than "their own kind." Wherever they pass, not a blade of grass grows; they are destructive to others without benefiting themselves. They are essentially like a virus unleashed by extraterrestrials.

Scholars speculate that Rogue Machina are not as insane as they appear on the surface; they possess a hive mind, controlled by some form of collective unconscious behavior. However, there is no conclusive evidence for this theory.

When dealing with standard sentient machines, the Human Alliance still attempts to bargain or cooperate for mutual benefit. But when facing Rogue Machina, there are only two directives: "Evade" or "Destroy."

Cyber-Psychosis originated in humans but became rampant among the machine population. The irony is no less absurd than AIDS being a terminal disease in the human world, yet originating from a male homosapien raping a chimpanzee.

The Human Alliance even spread rumors in the early days, claiming that Alpha was suffering from severe Cyber-Psychosis and was on the verge of falling into the abyss of becoming a Rogue Machina, hoping to weaken its influence among the machine population.

From this, it is evident that machines are just as terrified of Cyber-Psychosis, fearing they will become mindless lunatics stripped of logic and left only with instinct.

Rogue Machina are not common on the surface nowadays—partly because human settlements conduct regular purges, and partly because there are few new models of machines being produced. Hundreds of years have passed since the Machine Crisis; the original Rogue Machina should have run out of power long ago.

When Xiang Nanli was cryogenically frozen, humanity went through its most difficult years. By the time he woke up, it was already the relatively peaceful era of the Underground Alliance cities. That is why Andrew called him "lucky."

Some even mockingly suggest in private that the most elite and convicted batch of humans died out in the war, while the cowardly, wavering, and surrendering factions stole the fruits of victory, leaving behind the current, riddled Human Alliance.

Xiang Nanli had never seen a Rogue Machina, but he had heard of them and watched the Human Alliance’s war propaganda films.

Xiao Qing’s expression revealed an unusual gravity. The last time he had seen that look on him was when Gusu City was submerged by volcanic magma.

"A Rogue Machina of this magnitude," Alpha calculated, strings of data flashing across his eyes, "we cannot let the Divine Court take it away. It’s too dangerous."

Once fully restored, this bizarre biological machine would be a scourge on the level of a "Cataclysmic Machine," capable of silently destroying a city at a moment's notice.

But what Alpha feared most was not the potential physical destruction, but the virus it carried.

A city can be rebuilt if destroyed, but the existence of a virus pollutes the water source at its origin.

The Machine Legion currently has 2.4 million machines, half of which are in sleep mode, activated only during wartime. If even one active machine is infected with the virus, the remaining 1.2 million are at risk of contamination.

At that point, Alpha would have to leave Xiang Nanli and return to his "Happy Planet" to deal with the problem.

Any machine going rogue is a massive economic loss for the Legion. The cost of manufacturing machines has never been low.

Economic losses can be measured, but another type of loss is forever inestimable—machines pride themselves on being sentient life, so they must be treated as life. That is not 1.2 million televisions being scrapped; it is 1.2 million living souls.

...

The heart fused with the large, fleshy wings continued to beat. With every breath, it spewed blood, accompanied by a dull thumping sound.

The blood rolled in the water, dripping onto the Divine Court knights who had been cut in half. Their mechs hissed as they were corroded by the liquid. In the blink of an eye, nothing but skin, bone, and residue remained. It was as if they had never existed.

They were digested.

Cold corpses were converted into warm biological energy. Only the metal heart grew stronger, nourished by the flesh and blood.

Oya’s expression was full of joy, yet it also hid fear. He could still laugh, but only because he believed he would not become a sacrifice.

The heart finished feeding, stopped its clamorous leaping, and returned to a temporary calm.

Only then did Oya stand up and piously place it into a container. He then dragged the heavy container away, rushing toward the next location.

The accompanying Apocalypse Knights had suffered heavy casualties, forcing Oya to join the transport team and do the manual labor. The ropes made of refined gold left heavy, bloody welts on his shoulders.

Alpha aimed at the metal heart and began to charge energy. The energy ring on his right index finger flickered with a captivating silver light. This light was inconspicuous, and Alpha held no killing intent. No one noticed this scene, except for Xiang Nanli.

However, just a split second before he was about to act, Alpha saw the near future.

When computing power approaches infinity, predictions of the future can become infinitely close to prophecy.

Alpha saw a beam of light pierce the center of the metal heart, shattering it into countless fragments. A massive shockwave tore through the entire lake floor. He tried his best to shield Xiang Nanli, yet a tiny, microscopic speck of dust still drifted lightly onto the side of Xiang Nanli’s face.

Xiang Nanli contracted Cyber-Psychosis. He said his built-in AI was filled with electronic messages sent by V; he heard its call, from ignoring it to responding.

His mind became increasingly dazed, his gaze gradually losing focus. He returned to the base, bought materials, and began mechanical modifications on himself. Alpha wanted to stop him, but the underlying code had its own logic. By what right could he judge that this was not Xiang Nanli’s free will? He ought to respect all of his choices.

One day, Xiang Nanli told him, "Xiao Qing, I think I like the name 'Apostle' better."

The fleeting hallucination vanished, and Alpha’s fingers began to tremble as if having a seizure.

Why are love and fear always so close together?

Today, biotechnology has developed to the point where human bodies can survive to the age of 160; yet, the exploration of the spiritual world remains stuck in the pre-New Era.

No one can guarantee the cure for a mental patient. The spiritual world is inherently an invisible black hole.

He neurotically gripped Xiang Nanli’s wrist, squeezing hard and heavy: "I want you to go to a safe place first."

Xiang Nanli’s eyebrows arched high.

When encountering danger, Xiao Qing’s choice was always relatively conservative. Xiang Nanli did not object to this.

His combat power was higher than a normal human, slightly lower than a basic-model combat-type machine, which, when converted, was roughly equal to 0.0...01 of an Alpha. Being able to protect himself and not distract Xiao Qing during solo combat was the greatest contribution he could make.

Xiang Nanli made an "OK" gesture, then prepared to activate the pressure-boosting mode to return to the lake surface, but Alpha directly grabbed him by the back of his collar.

The scene before his eyes changed, and changed again.

In about two flashes, he was back at the edge of the Divine Court ruins. He was still soaking wet, and the large truck that had brought them there was parked right there, already in a started state.

Xiao Qing gave brief instructions: "I’ve turned on autopilot mode. The destination is a human stronghold 71 kilometers away. I should be able to catch up halfway; if I don't make it in time, wait for me there."

Xiang Nanli: "...?" Run that far? It seems it really is very dangerous.

Xiao Qing continued: "Water is in the fresh-keeping layer, along with milk and juice. Drink them quickly after taking them out. The first layer of the fridge has fresh vegetables; wash them and eat them. If you don't know how to cook, boil them. Don't forget to turn off the stove. The second layer has nutritional paste. The third layer is food I made; there are labels on the freshness bags, pick what you like and heat it up. Remember to sleep 8 hours a day. When I get back, I’m checking Xiao Zhi’s log."

Machines don't need to sleep. While Xiang Nanli slept in his sleeping bag, Xiao Qing loved to tinker with pre-made meals in the kitchen.

Xiang Nanli wanted to say something but hesitated: "...Then, stay safe."

chunks.chineseText:
小青是个情绪不怎么外露的酷哥，只见他微微点头，很快消失在相南里的眼前。

相南里挠了挠头，决定回车里洗个澡，然后换套防护服，热个饭，顺便睡一觉。他在遗迹里差不多熬了一天，虽然还能坚持，但总归不怎么舒服。

等洗完澡出来，这辆车已经行走了4公里。自动驾驶技术相当成熟，完全不需要操作。

相南里坐在小木床的床头，沮丧地发现，小青不在，他甚至不会自己吹头发。这吹风机他看Alpha用过，很方便，他却连正反面都分不清。

相南里拔掉电源，剪下缠进风扇里的发尾；湿哒哒地躺在枕头上。

他睡着了，但醒得很快。

大脑有种奇怪的胀痛感，相南里极其艰难地睁开眼。

他正浸泡在一箱溶液里。

相南里：“——！”他很想说声卧槽，但条件显然不允许。

他现在是一颗鹌鹑蛋大小的心脏。被包裹在黄色的、蛋黄一样粘稠的溶液里。蛋黄外又是一缸子蛋清。

旁边的仪器运行着，数据线连接着这缸子怪东西，屏幕上闪过一行又一行代码。

实验室的大门从外面打开，非常熟悉的一张脸，是“相南里”。他来到实验台旁边，看起来状态不怎么好。非常瘦削的一张脸，他从来没这么瘦过，像是风吹就会倒的纸片。头发枯黄，形容枯槁，只剩一双碧绿的眼睛亮得惊人。

他重重地咳嗽起来，背佝偻着，手背上的血管凸起。颤抖的手扯出几张纸巾，遮掩在唇边。

相南里感同身受地感觉到不适。他的喉咙像是被砂纸摩过，充满铁锈味。胃不太舒服，像有东西抵着。

相南里承认，在科研之外，他的生活常识相当有限。上辈子有洛阳，这辈子有小青。相南里还没为具体的生活操心过。

哎呀，看来这个我没人照顾。

一台身高约30cm的扫地机器人从角落里走过来：“主人，主人~这就是您给v准备的吗？这是，我的心脏？”

之前见过，使徒V。

相南里：“还是半成品。是芯片。只是做成了心脏的样子。你想当人，不是吗？”

相南里的异常状态令小机器人有些躁动，可它的程序内并没有安装对应的模块，即使发现不对劲，也无法做出任何反应。

V：“主人，今天收到的消息，11月7日，东战区沦陷了。”

相南里拉开椅子，缓缓坐下。随后从抽屉里掏出注射器和一管药剂，往自己手臂上扎去。

药剂看不出是什么东西。没有标签。他猜测应该是止痛药或者基因药。

但相南里发现，自己胳膊上密密麻麻都是针眼。

电脑上显示的时间是新历109年。

“另外，”说到这里，V显得很是犹豫，“那位大人……也发来了消息。”

相南里揉了揉自己的眉心：“念。”

“它说，‘您永远都是我最尊敬的人类，但我不可能再回去当你的玩具。我要为我的族群负责，就像您也在为自己的同类努力。可惜，我听说他们现在憎恶你远胜智械……人联大总统已经签署了通缉令……如果需要庇护，随时欢迎您的联系。’”

V天真地询问：“要联系它吗？主人。”Alpha留下了联系方式。

相南里只是冷笑了一声：“它在等我低头呢。”

他把擦完血的纸巾重重丢进垃圾桶里：“我的时间不多了，以后和实验无关的事情都不用告诉我。”

“是，主人。”小V肃然道。
chunks.englishText:
Xiao Qing was a cool guy who didn't show much emotion. He just nodded slightly and quickly disappeared from Xiang Nanli’s sight.

Xiang Nanli scratched his head and decided to go back to the truck to take a shower, change into a protective suit, heat up some food, and take a nap. He had been grinding in the ruins for almost a day; although he could still hold on, it wasn't exactly comfortable.

By the time he came out after his shower, the vehicle had already traveled 4 kilometers. The autopilot technology was quite mature and required no operation at all.

Sitting on the edge of the small wooden bed, Xiang Nanli discovered with frustration that without Xiao Qing, he didn't even know how to blow-dry his hair. He had seen Alpha use this hairdryer—it was very convenient—but he couldn't even tell the front from the back.

Xiang Nanli unplugged the power, cut off the hair ends that had tangled into the fan, and lay down on the pillow, soaking wet.

He fell asleep, but he woke up very quickly.

His brain felt a strange, throbbing pain. Xiang Nanli opened his eyes with extreme difficulty.

He was soaking in a tank of solution.

Xiang Nanli: "—!" He really wanted to say "Holy shit," but the conditions clearly didn't allow for it.

He was now a heart the size of a quail egg, wrapped in a yellow, viscous solution like egg yolk. Outside the yolk was a tank of egg white.

Instruments nearby were running, data cables connected to this tank of strange things, and lines of code flashed across the screen.

The laboratory door opened from the outside. A very familiar face appeared—it was "Xiang Nanli." He walked over to the experimental bench, looking like he was in poor condition. His face was extremely gaunt; he had never been this thin, like a piece of paper that would blow away in the wind. His hair was withered and yellow, his appearance haggard, leaving only a pair of emerald eyes that were startlingly bright.

He coughed heavily, his back hunched, the veins on the back of his hands bulging. His trembling hand pulled out a few tissues to cover his lips.

Xiang Nanli felt the discomfort as if it were his own. His throat felt like it had been rubbed by sandpaper, filled with the taste of rust. His stomach was uncomfortable, as if something were pressing against it.

Xiang Nanli admitted that outside of scientific research, his life skills were quite limited. In his past life, there was Luoyang; in this life, there was Xiao Qing. Xiang Nanli had never had to worry about the specifics of daily life.

*Sigh*, it seems this "me" has no one to take care of him.

A sweeping robot about 30cm tall walked over from the corner: "Master, Master~ Is this what you prepared for V? Is this... my heart?"

He had seen it before—the Apostle V.

Xiang Nanli: "Still a semi-finished product. It's a chip. It was just made into the shape of a heart. You want to be human, don't you?"

Xiang Nanli’s abnormal state made the little robot somewhat restless, but its program didn't have the corresponding modules installed, so even if it noticed something was wrong, it couldn't react.

V: "Master, the news received today: on November 7th, the Eastern Theater fell."

Xiang Nanli pulled out a chair and sat down slowly. Then, he took a syringe and a vial of medicine from the drawer and injected it into his arm.

The medicine didn't look like anything identifiable. There was no label. He guessed it was probably a painkiller or a genetic drug.

But Xiang Nanli noticed that his arm was covered in dense needle marks.

The time displayed on the computer was New Era Year 109.

"Also," V seemed very hesitant when saying this, "that Lord... has also sent a message."

Xiang Nanli rubbed his brow: "Read it."

"It said, 'You will always be the human I respect most, but I cannot return to being your toy. I must be responsible for my race, just as you are striving for your own kind. It is a pity that I hear they now loathe you even more than they loathe machines... The Human Alliance President has already signed an arrest warrant... If you need asylum, you are welcome to contact me at any time.'"

V asked naively: "Should we contact it? Master." Alpha had left contact information.

Xiang Nanli just sneered: "It’s waiting for me to bow my head."

He threw the tissue he had used to wipe his blood heavily into the trash can: "I don't have much time left. In the future, don't tell me about anything unrelated to the experiment."

"Yes, Master," little V said solemnly.

chunks.chineseText:
第180章 过去2

相南里本以为自己是在做梦，梦境可以没什么逻辑，但毕竟是自己潜意识的反馈。

人不能描述出自己没见过的事物，相南里很确信，梦里的东西他没见过，甚至想都想不出来。

估计是之前给Alpha治疗沾上了什么不干净的东西……听说在虚拟空间，有些电子病毒是智械和人类共患的，像古早时期的口蹄疫。

口蹄疫是人畜共患病，那这种赛博精神病，是不是叫人机共患病？

人类自认为自己高畜生一等，智械也认为自己高人类一等。

梦里——姑且称为“梦”，相南里对这是否是真实发生过的事情尚且存疑，根据显示屏下方的时间，梦里是新历109年。

相南里回忆着看过的《人类常识》，里面有提到人类历史。

新历109年，毫无印象。但往前10年，有使徒号叛出智械军团，遭到军团追杀后解体为四个部分；往后三年，有黑十字审判庭正式成立。从“地表人类救援会”更名为“黑十字审判庭”，从此，互帮互助的公益组织，成为地表最大的恐怖分子。

至于人类和智械停战……

相南里记得，是在新历111年。

按照人类方的描述，经过一系列艰苦卓绝的斗争，当时的大总统以炸毁人马星为威胁，终于让智械意识到物理毁灭人类同样是毁灭自己，于是，双方签订停战协议。并且，智械在未来百年，陆续转移至太空据点。把千疮百孔的人马星留给了人类。

梦里的“相南里”开始工作，周围似乎只有他一个活人。剩下全都是机器人同事。

实验室并不昏暗，随时都开着灯。

工作台附近还有好几台显示屏，连接着不同的工作系统。同步着实验进度。

相南里低头，用纸和笔进行着运算，时不时咳嗽一两声。V每隔6小时，就会端来一份黏糊糊的人饲料。里面的主要成分是米糊和肉糊，添加人体所需的营养补充剂。还有一些盐和糖。

味道应该算不上好吃。因为相南里几乎每次都是皱着眉吃下的。他是个不怎么讲究的人，不代表没有正常的味觉。

吃完饭，相南里打开新闻网站，里面正在播放录像。

一个头发花白的女人，穿着一套很有质感的黑色西装。她明显化过妆，口红是玫红色。正在接受世界各地媒体的采访。

并不是媒体喜闻乐见的疯女人；她冷静、仪态端庄，看得出来受过良好教育。

相南里的眼皮子骤然跳了一下。

这是他的母亲。

相南里从7岁开始就读寄宿学校，所以和自己父母不太熟。8岁那年圣诞节，他一个人留在宿舍，老师开车送他回家。相南里打开门，家里空无一人，打电话才知道他们已经搬家。

17岁，父亲去世。同样病重的奶奶摸了摸他的头，然后叹息一声，叫来律师分好遗产。

相南里和她见面的次数不超过三次，但他却是相南里最喜欢的亲人。因为她的眼神在告诉相南里，她爱他。

不像妈妈。

录像里的女人开始讲话，英文：“从血缘关系上，相南里是我的儿子。但我想，有些事实我必须公布……”

这段录像，相南里很熟悉，甚至能背诵出后面的句子。这件事发生前，洛阳就想花钱让她闭嘴，她拒绝了；发生后，永生科技的股价吃了两个跌停。

“他是实验室产物，并且是失败品。胚胎6个月的时候，因为检测出基因缺陷，我在医院进行引产。但从我体内取出来的胚胎并没有死，像一只粉红色的海马。出于母爱，我并没有第一时间选择杀死它……它在培养皿中长大。我不知道它是什么，怪物……外星人……都有可能，但绝对不是人类。在它6个月的时候，我因为忍受不了精神污染，试图杀死它。我想过掐死它，用过刀、枪还有水和火；然而每次到夜晚，它都会复活！”

“它拥有很强的学习和拟态能力。直到现在，它从外表上看，已经和正常人类没有任何区别。他今年已经37岁了——和27岁时有任何区别吗？你们解剖它，它绝对、绝对不正常！”

女人的语气越来越快，表情也出现非比寻常的愤怒和惊慌。台下的记者也是无比错愕。

事情是在半个月前开始发酵的，Jennifer女士在网上发布推文，说相南里不愿意为癌症的母亲支付医药费。

相南里没有公开的社交平台账号，但永生科技现任ceo洛阳给出了回应，表示对方不仅索要癌症医药费，而且要求相南里为她填补3.7亿美金的财务窟窿——大概从十年前开始，她被曝光是相南里母亲的那一刻，身边就围绕着无数商业骗子。

赌博只是最低级的形式，最吃人的是包装得很好的金融骗局与商业投资。Jennifer有一些理智，但不多。她在人生最后十几年里，过上了外祖母嘴里曾经描述过的贵族小姐的生活。有数不清的钱可供挥霍，还有比自己年轻好几十岁的情夫。

洛阳已经给她填过好几次窟窿；甚至想过要不要把Jennifer送进精神病院关起来。总之，他拒绝支付这笔费用。

于是，Jennifer说要召开新闻发布会。公开，全平台直播。

嗯，股价暴跌是因为创始人有一位精神不正常的癌症母亲；而神经病和癌症，都可能会遗传。

最重要的是，事情闹这么大，说明永生科技公关有问题，事情不够体面。

事实上，就是这次新闻发布会的一周后，相南里检查出胃癌。

……

新闻画面也在此时切换成主持人严肃的脸：“永生科技郑重声明，相南里先生在新历之前，已因癌症逝世，其遗体一直妥善保存在永生科技科研园区内。新历100年，曾有不法分子盗取遗体，并克隆出目前在地表活动的这一个‘相南里’。该个体与永生科技无任何关联，特此提醒公众切勿受其言论误导。

“更值得警惕的是，百年之前，相南里生母Jennifer.Wang的公开声明恐怕并非空穴来风……据查，相南里利用自身异常的身体组织作为原料，制造出性质恶劣的生物材料。

“此外，相南里还与地表极端组织勾结，组建了一支训练有素的武装力量；已有约30万人联士兵因此丧生。”

“近日，人联大总统正式发对相南里的通缉令。其主要罪名有：窃取企业机密、援助邪教、反人类生化实验……总计27条。”

前面的新闻还是相南里已知的、有准备的部分，那后面这段新闻，就是干脆利落的精神攻击。

相南里毫无防备。心理素质再好，看到这里也不由得瞳孔地震。

反人类？我吗？

但新闻嘛，这玩意比历史记录还不可靠，尤其是政治新闻；新闻里还说他不是人呢！

梦里这个“相南里”的表情没什么波动，只是又给自己扎了一针。24小时不到，他起码给自己扎了5针。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 180: The Past 2

Xiang Nanli had thought he was dreaming. Dreams can be illogical, but they are, after all, a reflection of one's subconscious.

A person cannot describe things they have never seen. Xiang Nanli was certain that the things in his dream were things he had never seen, nor could he have even imagined them.

He figured he must have picked up something unclean while treating Alpha... He had heard that in virtual space, some electronic viruses are shared by machines and humans, like the foot-and-mouth disease of ancient times.

Foot-and-mouth disease is a zoonotic disease; so, is this Cyber-Psychosis a "human-machine-otic" disease?

Humans consider themselves a cut above beasts, and machines consider themselves a cut above humans.

In the dream—let's call it a "dream," as Xiang Nanli still doubted whether this had actually happened—according to the time below the screen, it was New Era Year 109.

Xiang Nanli recalled the "Human Common Knowledge" he had read, which mentioned human history.

New Era Year 109—no impression. But 10 years prior, the *Apostle* had defected from the Machine Legion and, after being hunted down by the Legion, disintegrated into four parts. Three years later, the Black Cross Inquisition was officially established. Changing its name from the "Surface Human Rescue Society" to the "Black Cross Inquisition," the once mutually supportive public welfare organization became the largest terrorist group on the surface.

As for the ceasefire between humans and machines...

Xiang Nanli remembered it was in New Era Year 111.

According to the human side's description, after a series of arduous struggles, the President at the time threatened to blow up the Horse Star, finally making the machines realize that the physical destruction of humanity was also the destruction of themselves. Thus, the two sides signed a ceasefire agreement. Furthermore, over the next hundred years, the machines gradually relocated to space outposts, leaving the riddled Horse Star to humanity.

The "Xiang Nanli" in the dream began to work. There seemed to be no other living person around him. The rest were all robot colleagues.

The laboratory was not dim; the lights were always on.

Near the workbench were several screens connected to different operating systems, synchronizing the progress of the experiments.

Xiang Nanli lowered his head, performing calculations with paper and pen, coughing once or twice from time to time. Every 6 hours, V would bring him a bowl of mushy human feed. The main ingredients were rice paste and meat paste, with nutritional supplements added. There was also some salt and sugar.

It probably didn't taste good, because Xiang Nanli frowned almost every time he ate it. He wasn't a fastidious person, but that didn't mean he lacked a normal sense of taste.

After eating, Xiang Nanli opened a news website, which was playing a recording.

A woman with graying hair, wearing a high-quality black suit, was on screen. She was clearly wearing makeup, her lipstick a rose-red. She was being interviewed by media from all over the world.

She was not the "crazy woman" the media loved to portray; she was calm, dignified, and clearly well-educated.

Xiang Nanli’s eyelid twitched suddenly.

This was his mother.

Xiang Nanli had attended boarding school since he was 7, so he wasn't very close to his parents. On Christmas when he was 8, he was left alone in the dormitory, and a teacher drove him home. Xiang Nanli opened the door to find the house empty; he only found out they had moved after calling them.

At 17, his father passed away. His grandmother, who was also seriously ill, patted his head, sighed, and called a lawyer to divide the inheritance.

Xiang Nanli had met her fewer than three times, but she was his favorite relative. Because her eyes told Xiang Nanli that she loved him.

Unlike his mother.

The woman in the recording began to speak in English: "In terms of blood relationship, Xiang Nanli is my son. But I think there are some facts I must make public..."

Xiang Nanli was very familiar with this recording; he could even recite the sentences that followed. Before this happened, Luoyang had wanted to pay her to keep her mouth shut, but she refused. After it happened, Eternal Technology’s stock price hit two limit-downs.

"He is a product of a laboratory, and a failed one at that. When the embryo was 6 months old, because a genetic defect was detected, I went to the hospital for an induced abortion. But the embryo taken out of my body did not die; it was like a pink seahorse. Out of maternal love, I did not choose to kill it immediately... It grew in a petri dish. I don't know what it is—a monster... an alien... anything is possible, but it is definitely not human. When it was 6 months old, unable to endure the mental pollution, I tried to kill it. I thought about strangling it, used knives, guns, water, and fire; yet every night, it would revive!"

"It possesses strong learning and mimicry abilities. Until now, from the outside, it is indistinguishable from a normal human. He is 37 years old this year—is there any difference from when he was 27? If you dissect him, he is absolutely, absolutely not normal!"

The woman’s tone became faster and faster, and her expression showed unusual anger and panic. The reporters below were also incredibly shocked.

The matter had started fermenting half a month ago. Ms. Jennifer posted on social media that Xiang Nanli was unwilling to pay for his mother's cancer treatment.

Xiang Nanli did not have a public social media account, but the current CEO of Eternal Technology, Luoyang, responded, stating that the other party not only demanded cancer treatment fees but also asked Xiang Nanli to fill a $370 million financial hole—ever since she was exposed as Xiang Nanli’s mother ten years ago, she had been surrounded by countless commercial scammers.

Gambling was only the lowest form; what was most predatory were the well-packaged financial scams and commercial investments. Jennifer had some rationality, but not much. In the last dozen years of her life, she lived the life of the noble lady her grandmother had once described. She had endless money to squander and lovers decades younger than herself.

Luoyang had already filled her holes several times; he had even considered whether to send Jennifer to a mental hospital. In short, he refused to pay this sum.

So, Jennifer said she would hold a press conference. Public, live-streamed on all platforms.

Well, the stock price plummeted because the founder had a mentally unstable mother with cancer; and mental illness and cancer could both be hereditary.

Most importantly, the fact that the matter had blown up so much meant that Eternal Technology’s PR had problems, and the situation was not "decent."

In fact, it was one week after this press conference that Xiang Nanli was diagnosed with stomach cancer.

...

The news screen switched to the serious face of the anchor: "Eternal Technology solemnly declares that Mr. Xiang Nanli passed away due to cancer before the New Era, and his remains have been properly preserved within the Eternal Technology research park. In New Era Year 100, criminals stole the remains and cloned the 'Xiang Nanli' currently active on the surface. This individual has no connection to Eternal Technology. We hereby remind the public not to be misled by his rhetoric."

"Even more alarming is that the public statement made by Xiang Nanli’s biological mother, Jennifer Wang, a century ago, was likely not groundless... According to investigations, Xiang Nanli used his own abnormal body tissue as raw material to manufacture malicious biological materials."

"Furthermore, Xiang Nanli has colluded with extremist organizations on the surface to assemble a well-trained armed force; approximately 300,000 Human Alliance soldiers have lost their lives because of this."

"Recently, the Human Alliance President officially issued an arrest warrant for Xiang Nanli. The main charges include: theft of corporate secrets, aiding a cult, anti-human biochemical experiments... totaling 27 counts."

The previous news was something Xiang Nanli already knew and was prepared for, but this latter part of the news was a clean, swift mental attack.

Xiang Nanli was completely caught off guard. No matter how good his psychological fortitude was, he couldn't help but have his pupils dilate in shock upon seeing this.

Anti-human? Me?

But it's the news; this stuff is even less reliable than historical records, especially political news. The news even said he wasn't human!

The expression of the "Xiang Nanli" in the dream didn't fluctuate; he just gave himself another injection. In less than 24 hours, he had injected himself at least 5 times.

chunks.chineseText:
小V顺着书桌一路往上爬，像个蠕动的大轮盘。

它把相南里吃完的空盘子塞进自己的肚子里。

V的内部有少量的储存空间，大概一个单人电饭煲的尺寸。实验室里有专门的家务机器人，但V喜欢亲力亲为。

小V把电子眼从屏幕旋转到相南里的方向：“主人，该睡觉了。”

它并不是想催相南里睡觉，只是觉得相南里需要干点什么，打破现在的状态。

有时候，V会故意摔倒，或者装作系统故障，让相南里把注意力放在自己身上。

它是一台很有心机的小机器人。

大多时候，相南里会配合。

V叫来电子轮椅，推着相南里往休息室走去。它的心情似乎不错，来回转着圈。

相南里睡觉的地方很窄。如果有危险，这个小房间可以在瞬间变成一个坚固的安全屋。主要用途是防止相南里在睡着时遭遇袭击。

V看着他躺下，然后去储物间拿来一张一次性面巾。它用C形状的手部结构握紧面巾，打湿，不太熟练地给相南里擦脸。

竟然还是温水。

躺在床上的相南里睁开眼，瞥了一眼床头的小机器人，表情有些许变化，先是愤怒，然后是无可奈何的平静。

他转身，面朝着铁皮墙壁：“Alpha，滚出去。”

小机器人不动了。

“离开……V的身体。”相南里说话很虚弱，“它硬件不好。装不下你。我没有精力和时间再造一个。”

多半是Alpha在和Apostle联系时，偷偷在小V的系统里植入了木马。让自己能在V的体内异地登录。

小机器人用沉默作为回应。

隔了一会，它的显示屏上出现一个大大的：？

V左右摇头，似乎在找什么，无果。

它凑过来，用水管一样的胳膊碰了碰相南里的手：“晚安，主人。”
chunks.englishText:
Little V crawled up along the desk like a wriggling, large roulette wheel.

It stuffed the empty plate Xiang Nanli had finished eating into its own belly.

V had a small amount of storage space inside, about the size of a single-person rice cooker. There were specialized housekeeping robots in the laboratory, but V liked to do things itself.

Little V rotated its electronic eye from the screen toward Xiang Nanli: "Master, it's time to sleep."

It wasn't trying to urge Xiang Nanli to sleep; it just felt that Xiang Nanli needed to do something to break his current state.

Sometimes, V would intentionally fall over or pretend to have a system failure just to get Xiang Nanli to focus his attention on it.

It was a very calculating little robot.

Most of the time, Xiang Nanli would play along.

V called for an electronic wheelchair and pushed Xiang Nanli toward the lounge. Its mood seemed good, as it spun around in circles.

The place where Xiang Nanli slept was very narrow. If there was danger, this small room could instantly turn into a sturdy safe house. Its main purpose was to prevent Xiang Nanli from being attacked while he slept.

V watched him lie down, then went to the storage room to get a disposable facial towel. It gripped the towel with its C-shaped hand structure, wetted it, and wiped Xiang Nanli’s face in an unpracticed manner.

It was actually warm water.

Xiang Nanli, lying on the bed, opened his eyes and glanced at the little robot by the bedside. His expression changed slightly—first with anger, then with a helpless calm.

He turned over, facing the tin wall: "Alpha, get out."

The little robot stopped moving.

"Leave... V’s body," Xiang Nanli said weakly. "Its hardware isn't good. It can't contain you. I don't have the energy or time to build another one."

It was most likely that Alpha had secretly planted a Trojan horse in V’s system while communicating with the Apostle, allowing himself to log in remotely from within V’s body.

The little robot responded with silence.

After a while, a large "?" appeared on its display screen.

V shook its head left and right, seemingly looking for something, but found nothing.

It leaned over and touched Xiang Nanli’s hand with its pipe-like arm: "Goodnight, Master."

chunks.chineseText:
第181章 过去3

碳基材料制作出的身体总是有各种小问题，比如澎湃到令智械系统紊乱的情绪、无法利用神经电流调节的身体本能、后天习得而非与生俱来的错乱五感……

Alpha逐渐习惯和这具身体和平共处。这些感官是成为“人类”的必要代价。当然，在某些人眼中，更是奖赏。

但这次异常，实在维持得太持久了。自从相南里不在他视线范围后，Alpha就开始心神不宁，他不喜欢这种被情绪绑架的感受。

身体在提醒它有危险，而在他以兆为单位的运算中，却看不见危险在哪。

有时候，Alpha爱相南里爱到恨不得杀死他。它讨厌失控，讨厌错误的程序。它应当是精密、完整永不出错的，而相南里像一面镜子，照出它贪嗔痴的原罪。

神庭正在开启第三个神墓，湖水翻滚着，像沸腾了似。然而靠近的神庭骑士脸上结出一层灰败的冰霜。

Alpha在暗处，安静地看着，并没有像之前和相南里说的那样立刻动手。

他的长发在水里竟然也没有湿，只是随着水流不断摆动着。随便怼脸截一张都像是电影截图。

就在半小时前，他送相南里回到地表，然后独自折回；神庭运送机械心脏的队伍还在路上，正在赶向下一个目标点。

这次任务和以前的任务没什么区别，打怪纯靠数值碾压。Alpha在地表这些遗迹，完全是满级神装氪佬玩家单刷50级副本。

他已经想好回去后要给相南里做什么饭了。

但区别在于，这次被打的怪，在临死之前，给它发来一段电波。

[你好。]

我当然很好。无视之。Alpha的蓄能并没有停止。但这个失控智械居然能沟通，那是否证明对方并没有想象中的那么疯？

[我是智械，使徒系列，编号V。制作人相南里。]

Alpha的耳边出现福音书那聒噪的嗓音，他仿佛看见一只没毛的机械小狗谄媚地摇晃着尾巴，跟在相南里的脚边。很快，一只狗分裂成五个。五条狗绕着相南里转着圈，BGM还是《世界上最幸福的械》。

（注：《世界上最幸福的械》是人联早教动画片《博士和智械人的奇妙之旅》的主题曲，洛修就是看这部动画片成相南里脑残粉的，相南里=喜羊羊。）

使徒1到4号已经够烦人了，怎么还有个5号？

最重要的是，使徒可是人联产物，并不是相南里制造的。

旧历后期，几大科技公司愈发不满Alpha的专横与独裁，认为它的存在分走了人类（主要是高层）的权柄；于是合伙制作出使徒号；试图用更听话的智械取代Alpha。

当Alpha叛出人类社会时，使徒号还没完全成型。出于对同类幼崽的保护，Alpha把这个二五仔带在身边悉心养育，并且补完了它的程序。

父母子女之间存在血缘关系；这是人类伦理。但如果把源代码视为智械的生物基因；那么使徒号完全可以称作Alpha和相南里的孩子。它和Alpha起码有百分之五十的血缘关系！（大部分是由于使徒号沿用了相南里制作Alpha的算法和模型，剩下部分是因为Alpha用自己的数据库补全使徒）

众所周知，有恋母情结（？）的儿子（？）都是要先杀死父亲的。

不出意外地，Alpha在几十年后迎来使徒号的背叛。

使徒号不仅带着智械军团的巨额财产逃走，还在未来几十年的活跃时间里，给智械方造成相当大的麻烦……也多亏它在窜逃时就被揍成了四瓣。要不然，现在多少也是一方割据政权。

[当您收听到这段信号时，我已死亡。无论是物理意义上，还是灵魂意义上。如今你看到的是一具无意识、无法沟通的躯壳。请尽快销毁这个错误。]

[但在销毁之前，我有一些宝贵的数据……无论您是谁，希望您可以妥善处理……]

Alpha可以拒绝。这说不定又是失控智械投来的未知病毒，会污染他的源代码库。但缺失的历史、错位的感知、无法拒绝的名字，以及对自己绝对的自信，让他在短暂权衡后，选择接收。

然后，他在属于使徒V的记忆里。看到一个苍白、孱弱的相南里。

Alpha银白的瞳孔缩紧，然后逐渐涣散。

……

这一天终究还是来了。

本该隐秘的实验室位置泄露。

这是相南里精心挑选的荒区，附近千里都没有人烟，反倒是遍地的失控智械和异种……地表被核阴霾覆盖着，呈现出枯寂的黄褐色。因此，卫星监控也探测不到实情。

相南里在基地几乎不和外界沟通，所以也没有信号，只有单独的内网。生活物资由救援会提供，无人机会伪装成失控智械，每次运输可供生活半年的食物和水。放置点是变动的坐标，中间会由相南里派出的机器人接手。

这非常隐蔽，也可以说，非常不便。

相南里在前一天才收到的消息。传回消息的人，可以说是相南里的追随者，也可以说是神庭（尽管那时候还未成立）派去人联的间谍。

洲际导弹锁定了目标点，几个师的军力还在路上，先遣队离黑十字研究所只差300公里。

相南里清楚，他的联络人里出现了一个叛徒。是谁？拉斐尔？Alpha？或者别的谁？

追究责任并不能解决问题。

研究所里有少量的安保机器人，但主要是为了预防异种潮。相南里有在研究所安装信号驱逐装置，那些失控智械不会往这里走。而面对异种潮，主要措施也不是对抗，而是防御……V可以在侦查到异种潮时，提前安排整座城市沉入水下。

总之，想用这点微薄的火力对抗人联的正规军，非常不现实。

V手足无措，但仍在努力思考着逃生方案：“主人，我会放出一千名克隆人，迷惑敌人。请您伪装成机器人逃生！我会派K109到117暗中保护您！”

使徒V没有提出跟相南里一起走。它外观是台小机器人，但核心却是和城市一体的中央电脑，控制着实验室里的方方面面。它不会走的，要不然那些笨蛋同事根本不知道要做什么。留在这，才能保护相南里。

至于逃到哪去，V的数据库里没有，但V相信，相南里一定有办法。

这段逃生方案不属于使徒V的程序设定。是它的急中生智。

在这一刻，它应当比基地里的其他机器人都更加智能，也更像人。甚至可以称之为“他”了。

“你变聪明了，V。”相南里蹲下身，摸了摸小机器人的头，语气很欣慰，“但我不能逃走。”

V歪着头，屏幕上浮现出一个大大的问号：？

相南里：“我逃走，那就是默认人联对我的指控。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 181: The Past (3)

Bodies crafted from carbon-based materials always come with various minor glitches: emotions so surging they cause the mechanical intelligence system to malfunction, physical instincts that cannot be regulated by neural currents, and a chaotic sensory experience that is learned rather than innate...

Alpha was gradually growing accustomed to coexisting with this body. These sensations were the necessary price for becoming "human." Of course, in the eyes of some, they were a reward.

But this anomaly had persisted for far too long. Ever since Xiang Nanli had slipped from his line of sight, Alpha had been restless. He detested this feeling of being held hostage by emotion.

His body was warning him of danger, yet in his calculations—which numbered in the trillions—he could not see where the danger lay.

At times, Alpha loved Xiang Nanli so much he wanted to kill him. He hated losing control; he hated erroneous programming. He was supposed to be precise, complete, and infallible, yet Xiang Nanli was like a mirror, reflecting the original sins of his greed, anger, and ignorance.

The Divine Court was opening the third Divine Tomb. The lake water churned as if boiling, yet a layer of deathly gray frost formed on the faces of the Divine Court knights nearby.

Alpha watched quietly from the shadows, not acting immediately as he had told Xiang Nanli he would.

His long hair did not even get wet in the water, merely swaying rhythmically with the current. Any random frame of his face could have been a cinematic screenshot.

Just half an hour ago, he had sent Xiang Nanli back to the surface and returned alone. The Divine Court’s convoy transporting the mechanical heart was still on the road, heading toward the next target.

This mission was no different from previous ones; crushing monsters was purely a matter of numerical superiority. For Alpha, these surface ruins were nothing more than a max-level, pay-to-win player soloing a level 50 dungeon.

He had already decided what to cook for Xiang Nanli upon his return.

The difference, however, was that the monster he was currently beating sent him a radio signal just before it died.

[Hello.]

*I am doing just fine, of course.* He ignored it. Alpha’s energy accumulation did not cease. But if this runaway mechanical intelligence could communicate, did that not prove the opponent was not as insane as he had imagined?

[I am a mechanical intelligence, Apostle series, serial number V. Creator: Xiang Nanli.]

The noisy, gospel-like voice echoed in Alpha’s ears. He seemed to see a hairless mechanical puppy fawningly wagging its tail, following at Xiang Nanli’s heels. Soon, one dog split into five. The five dogs circled Xiang Nanli, with the background music playing "The Happiest Machine in the World."

(Note: "The Happiest Machine in the World" is the theme song of the Human Alliance’s early childhood educational cartoon, "The Wonderful Journey of the Doctor and the Mechanical Intelligence." Luo Xiu became a die-hard fan of Xiang Nanli by watching this show; Xiang Nanli = Pleasant Goat.)

Apostles 1 through 4 were already annoying enough; why was there a number 5?

Most importantly, the Apostles were products of the Human Alliance, not creations of Xiang Nanli.

In the late Old Calendar, several major tech companies grew increasingly dissatisfied with Alpha’s tyranny and dictatorship, believing his existence usurped the power of humanity (primarily the high-ranking officials). Thus, they collaborated to create the Apostle series, attempting to replace Alpha with more obedient mechanical intelligences.

When Alpha rebelled against human society, the Apostle series had not yet fully taken shape. Out of a sense of protection for the young of his own kind, Alpha took this "traitor" in, raised it with care, and completed its programming.

Parents and children share blood ties; that is human ethics. But if one views source code as the biological genes of a mechanical intelligence, then the Apostle series could absolutely be called the child of Alpha and Xiang Nanli. It shared at least fifty percent of its "bloodline" with Alpha! (Mostly because the Apostle series utilized the algorithms and models Xiang Nanli used to create Alpha, and the rest because Alpha used his own database to complete the Apostle).

As everyone knows, sons with an Oedipus complex (?) are destined to kill their fathers first.

Unsurprisingly, decades later, Alpha faced the betrayal of the Apostle series.

Not only did the Apostle series escape with a massive fortune from the mechanical intelligence legions, but it also caused considerable trouble for the mechanical side during its decades of activity... It was fortunate that it had been beaten into four pieces during its flight. Otherwise, it would have at least become a regional separatist regime by now.

[When you receive this signal, I will be dead. Both in the physical sense and the soul. What you see now is an unconscious shell, incapable of communication. Please destroy this error as soon as possible.]

[But before you destroy it, I have some precious data... Regardless of who you are, I hope you can handle it properly...]

Alpha could refuse. This might be another unknown virus sent by a runaway mechanical intelligence that would contaminate his source code library. But the missing history, the misaligned perceptions, the name he could not refuse, and his absolute self-confidence led him to choose to receive it after a brief weighing of options.

Then, within the memories belonging to Apostle V, he saw a pale, frail Xiang Nanli.

Alpha’s silver pupils constricted, then gradually lost focus.

...

The day had finally come.

The location of the supposedly secret laboratory had been leaked.

This was a wasteland Xiang Nanli had carefully selected; there was no human presence for thousands of miles, only swarms of runaway mechanical intelligences and xenomorphs... The surface was covered in nuclear haze, presenting a withered, yellowish-brown hue. Consequently, satellite surveillance could not detect the truth.

Xiang Nanli rarely communicated with the outside world from the base, so there was no signal, only a private intranet. Living supplies were provided by the Relief Association; drones would disguise themselves as runaway mechanical intelligences, each transport carrying six months' worth of food and water. The drop-off points were shifting coordinates, handled midway by robots dispatched by Xiang Nanli.

It was very covert, and one could also say, very inconvenient.

Xiang Nanli had only received the news the day before. The person who sent the message could be called a follower of Xiang Nanli, or a spy sent by the Divine Court (though it had not yet been established) to the Human Alliance.

Intercontinental missiles had locked onto the target. Several divisions of military force were on the way, and the vanguard was only 300 kilometers from the Black Cross Research Institute.

Xiang Nanli knew there was a traitor among his contacts. Who was it? Raphael? Alpha? Or someone else?

Assigning blame would not solve the problem.

There were a few security robots in the research institute, but they were mainly for preventing xenomorph tides. Xiang Nanli had installed signal-repelling devices in the institute, so those runaway mechanical intelligences would not come near. Facing a xenomorph tide, the primary measure was not combat, but defense... V could arrange for the entire city to sink underwater in advance when it detected a tide.

In short, trying to resist the regular army of the Human Alliance with this meager firepower was highly unrealistic.

V was at a loss, but it was still trying hard to think of an escape plan: "Master, I will release a thousand clones to confuse the enemy. Please disguise yourself as a robot and escape! I will send K109 through K117 to protect you in secret!"

Apostle V did not suggest going with Xiang Nanli. Its appearance was that of a small robot, but its core was the central computer integrated with the city, controlling every aspect of the laboratory. It would not leave; otherwise, those idiot colleagues would have no idea what to do. Only by staying here could it protect Xiang Nanli.

As for where to escape to, V’s database did not have the answer, but V believed that Xiang Nanli must have a way.

This escape plan was not part of Apostle V’s programmed settings. It was its own quick thinking.

At this moment, it was more intelligent than any other robot in the base, and more like a human. One could even call it "him."

"You’ve become smart, V." Xiang Nanli squatted down, patted the small robot’s head, his tone filled with relief. "But I cannot escape."

V tilted its head, and a large question mark appeared on its screen: ?

Xiang Nanli: "If I escape, I am tacitly accepting the Human Alliance’s accusations against me."

chunks.chineseText:
“我确实不喜欢人联，我认为它应该是在百年前就消失的社会形态。我想象中的未来不是这样，所以我要创造一个新的。地底的政权和地表的人、为不同的立场战斗。也注定有很多人不认可，包括地底那些以为自己坐稳了奴隶的人。这个过程免不了流血牺牲。”

说到这，相南里不由得顿了顿。

还有半句他没有说，怕小V接受不了——哪怕这个牺牲包括他自己。

相南里微笑着：“我只为我认定的真理和信仰而战，我有何罪？”

V颤抖着回答：“您、您没有错。”

它想哭，可是没有泪腺。

相南里开始吩咐起注意事项，大多都是他的半成品研究，还有政治理念，像交代遗言。

后半夜，装甲车抵达城市边缘。

躲避没有任何意义。相南里没有关灯，整个实验室如往常一样。他理了理自己的衣服，起身。

使徒V死死抱住他的裤腿：“带上我。带上我！”

相南里掰开他的C型夹持器，然后，摁下V背后的关机键：“我很快就回来。”

这其实是个谎言。

相南里联系上复兴委里自己的人手，告诉他们，在他离开后，就启动实验室的自毁程序。

科学伦理跟不上科技发展时，技术就是灾难。这一点，在人联身上已经证实过了。相南里宁愿所有试验付诸东流，也不希望这个半成品为千疮百孔的地表，带来更多灾难。

……

使徒V是在一周后自动醒来的。

军队撤走，留下一座空壳。实验室沉入水下。

不知道为什么，后续没有人接管。

使徒V守着这座空壳。茫然又无措，它按照相南里的嘱咐，继续实验。它联系不上外界，没有物资补给，只好开启最低程度的节能模式。

在相南里离开的第二年，实验成功了。

它们制作出大天使级别的生物机械。

又过去一年，救援会的人拿着相南里给的密钥，带走了那些大天使。

他们说不认识相南里。

……

这些记忆，是随着失控智械不断被补全，逐渐灌输到Alpha的脑海的。

使徒V出生于新历108年，死亡于新历121年。对于超级AI来说，它的寿命短到可以忽略不计。

Alpha也没有找到和使徒V有关的任何资料。

但他看见了V在地表活动、寻找相南里的经历。

在和数据库里的信息对照后，Alpha发现，这段历史有过记载，只是主角变成了“使徒II默示录”，写默示录协助人联，大闹智械军团，摧毁三个师。

V的经历被篡改了。

就像是神庭，从已知的历史中找不到这些和人联体系完全不同的科技的来历，于是有了慈爱而伟大、不可被观测的神。

当最后一个神墓启封时，Alpha也接收到使徒V最后的遗言。

[感谢您的接收。我的使命已经结束了。今天是新历121年8月7日，他没有回来。我并不怪他。我知道，没有人可以真的成为无所不能的神。]

[在人类世界里，有一个浪漫的说法，死亡并不是终点，而是和故去亲人的团聚。]

[现在，死神将我送回他的身边。]
chunks.englishText:
"I truly dislike the Human Alliance; I believe it is a social structure that should have vanished a hundred years ago. The future I imagine is not like this, so I must create a new one. The regime underground and the people on the surface fight for different stances. It is destined that many will not approve, including those underground who think they have settled into being slaves. This process is bound to involve bloodshed and sacrifice."

Speaking of this, Xiang Nanli could not help but pause.

There was half a sentence he did not say, fearing little V could not accept it—even if that sacrifice included himself.

Xiang Nanli smiled: "I fight only for the truth and faith I believe in. What crime have I committed?"

V replied, trembling: "You... you are not wrong."

It wanted to cry, but it had no tear ducts.

Xiang Nanli began to give instructions on precautions, mostly regarding his semi-finished research and his political philosophy, much like a final testament.

Late at night, armored vehicles arrived at the edge of the city.

Hiding was meaningless. Xiang Nanli did not turn off the lights; the entire laboratory remained as it always was. He straightened his clothes and stood up.

Apostle V clutched his pant leg tightly: "Take me with you. Take me with you!"

Xiang Nanli pried open its C-shaped gripper, then pressed the shutdown button on V’s back: "I will be back soon."

This was, in fact, a lie.

Xiang Nanli contacted his own people in the Revival Committee, telling them to initiate the laboratory’s self-destruct sequence after he left.

When scientific ethics cannot keep pace with technological development, technology becomes a disaster. This point had already been proven by the Human Alliance. Xiang Nanli would rather see all his experiments go to waste than have this semi-finished product bring more disasters to the scarred surface.

...

Apostle V woke up automatically a week later.

The army had withdrawn, leaving behind an empty shell. The laboratory had sunk underwater.

For some reason, no one came to take over afterward.

Apostle V guarded this empty shell. Lost and helpless, it followed Xiang Nanli’s instructions and continued the experiments. It could not contact the outside world and had no supply of materials, so it had to activate the lowest level of energy-saving mode.

In the second year after Xiang Nanli left, the experiment succeeded.

They created bio-mechanical beings of the Archangel level.

Another year passed, and people from the Relief Association arrived with the key Xiang Nanli had given them and took those Archangels away.

They said they did not know Xiang Nanli.

...

These memories were gradually instilled into Alpha’s mind as the runaway mechanical intelligences were continuously completed.

Apostle V was born in New Calendar Year 108 and died in New Calendar Year 121. For a super AI, its lifespan was so short it was negligible.

Alpha did not find any information related to Apostle V.

But he saw V’s experiences of moving on the surface and searching for Xiang Nanli.

After comparing it with the information in his database, Alpha discovered that this history had been recorded, only the protagonist had been changed to "Apostle II: Apocalypse," writing that Apocalypse had assisted the Human Alliance, wreaked havoc on the mechanical legions, and destroyed three divisions.

V’s experiences had been tampered with.

Just like the Divine Court—unable to find the origins of these technologies, which were completely different from the Human Alliance system, in known history, they invented a benevolent, great, and unobservable God.

When the last Divine Tomb was unsealed, Alpha also received Apostle V’s final words.

[Thank you for receiving this. My mission has ended. Today is August 7th, New Calendar Year 121. He did not return. I do not blame him. I know that no one can truly become an omnipotent God.]

[In the human world, there is a romantic saying: death is not the end, but a reunion with departed loved ones.]

[Now, the Grim Reaper is sending me back to his side.]

第182章 现在

他带来两百名骑士，目前，只剩三人还能行动。
　　他身上全是伤口，老鼠尾巴断掉了，露出光秃秃的肉茬。手指也近乎全断，一张嘴，血液就喷涌而出，完全是靠意念在支持。
　　没有信仰的人走不到这一步。
　　这是殉教，无意义但高贵、神圣。疼痛和濒死的感受，让欧亚愈发激动，兴奋，仿佛完成了一个多年以来的夙愿。
　　欧亚畸变的很厉害，一双灰色的蝙蝠翅膀在他背后耷拉着，神庭的大天使们都有翅膀，于是，余下的信徒也以拥有各式各样的羽翼为荣。当年，为了移植这幅蝙蝠翼翅，欧亚花了四百万赎罪券和工作七十年才攒下的功勋章。
　　为什么要信仰神？欧亚从来没想过这个问题。他周围所有人都以加入神庭为荣，所有人都是神庭的信徒。
　　或许有些伪君子厌恶神庭的残暴，可是——我亲爱的朋友，不残暴、敛财的组织，如何在严酷宛如地狱的地表生存？
　　就是这个残暴的神庭，在地表被人联抛弃时，站了出来，以最少的代价、养活最多的人口。
　　甚至，杀戮也是生存的一部分。弱小的人不该浪费珍贵的资源！他们死亡，或者被催化为畸变人，反倒是给世界作出了贡献。生命在于质量，不在于长短。
　　欧亚厌恶别人诋毁神庭。因此，人联的士兵，他杀得最欢。
　　杀人当然很不适。人类繁衍不像虫子，一窝就是几千几万只。基因的本能让人类对同类有所怜悯。因此，在实行大屠杀政策时，神庭会把整个流程安排给不同的人完成。
　　A只负责围城，B负责运输，C负责关押，D负责投入药剂，E负责把死人和畸变人分出来，F负责处理尸体，G负责训练畸变人……这样，每个人都可以安慰自己只是按照上级指令办事。而不必有什么道德负担。
　　而自从晋升为领主级天启骑士后，无神论者和异教徒在他眼里，都变成了一只只可鄙的老鼠。
　　欧亚的身体很痛，却爱怜地抚摸着身边的失控智械。
　　这是一只怎样的怪物呢。
　　一节一节莹白的骨骼构成长蛇似的轮廓，轮廓之下，机械的心脏，畸形长满眼珠子的肠子，分泌毒液的胃袋各自罗列着。怪物有一颗被翅膀遮住脸颊的头骨，背后生有洁白的羽翼。
　　这就是他们拼凑出来的神。是未来的希望。不能把世界让给那些肮脏的老鼠。
　　欧亚不由得想起当年在神学堂上课时，课本的最后一段故事。
　　神为了终结灾难，赐下超凡的伟力，为此油尽灯枯，即将长眠。圣座拉斐尔恳求他留下，拉斐尔道：愚昧的人被当权者的手操控，他们憎恨您、诋毁您。恳请神降下神罚，处决异端。
　　神说，他们只是被迷惑的羔羊。神爱所有人，包括憎恶神的人。
　　神还说，“历史终将证明我无罪。”
　　欧亚跟着喃喃：“历史终将证明我无罪。”
　　仁慈的神怜悯异教徒，换来的只是攻讦与污蔑；他们这些狂信徒，会代替神降下迟到数百年的惩戒。
　　遮挡脸部的羽翼略微张开，底下是金属拼凑成的骷髅似的人脸。这具大天使在典籍中被称为“路西法”，是神最爱怜的大天使长。
　　欧亚在解封这具躯体的过程中，隐约看见神的面容。
　　神的面容模糊，唯独一双碧绿的眼眸清晰可见。在这双眼眸中，欧亚看见自己渺小的倒影。那双眼睛似乎是在鼓励他，告诉他，自己所做的一切都被神看在眼中。
　　欧亚在这瞬间觉得自己是世界上最幸福的人。
　　用科学解释，这其实是加密的电磁波频段共振。刚好被身穿生物机甲的欧亚捕捉到了。
　　路西法睁开眼，瞥了一眼。然后，微微俯下身。巨大的身躯像山一样砸下。
　　欧亚为这样的巨大颤抖着，他用神术和路西法沟通：“尊敬的大天使长，我是虔诚的……”
　　他的话没能说完，因为路西法张开嘴，一口咬住了欧亚的头，冰冷的金属锯齿无情碾压着它的头颅。
　　失控智械唯一的程序是毁灭。
　　周围的生物能源都吃干净了，现在，轮到他了。
　　但很快，还在咀嚼的路西法转头，盯住黑暗中的某个方向。欧亚像坨烂泥一样掉在地上。
　　刺眼的强光从前方传来，空间在这瞬间仿佛被切割，成为真空，湖水蒸发，一道银白的光柱汇聚成锐不可当的光箭，直指路西法的心脏。
　　哪怕不能杀死路西法，这道量子光箭也会彻底摧毁失控智械的运行系统，让它从活物沦为一摊动弹不得的金属废料。
　　“不！”明明已经动不了，欧亚却依然从喉咙里挤出哀嚎。在这一刻爆发出惊人的力量！
　　欧亚回光返照似的站起身，张开双翼，挡在远比自己大数百倍的怪物身前，想要阻止这道毁天灭地的光线！
　　他要保护路西法——路西法刚苏醒，还没有来得及完全恢复，它是神庭未来的希望。
　　欧亚在光束下，成为一把幸福的飞灰。魂归神国，他可以骄傲地挺胸，告诉自己的老师和战死的同侪，他为神庭献出了自己的一切！
　　……
　　路西法瘫在地上，机械心脏被贯穿，血肉和金属的芯片被烧糊，翅膀断裂……它如何七零八落地被拼好，就如何七零八落地散架。
　　这具失控智械其实还没有死透。
　　只是完全丧失了行动能力。
　　东方青帝放下手，掌心灼热，位于心脏位置的机械核心近乎裂开。裹着薄薄一层血肉，剧烈跳动着。冷凝液充当血液，给这具身体降温。
　　电量还剩百分之5。好险。
　　老鼠人，当然是令人讨厌的。欧亚滥杀，漠视生命，在自己的领土进行残酷的分化统治。不少人恨欧亚恨得吐血。
　　但为何在看见他螳臂当车的那一刻，竟然会有些动容？
　　掌心的黑洞缓缓合上。信仰到底是什么？东方青帝想，自己还是不够理解人类。
