Golden light flowed from the center of the keyhole, spreading outward, the light tracing intricate patterns onto the walls.

The wall slowly parted to both sides, revealing the core of the entire rabbit warren—the host of The Gospel 1.7.7.

The smell of dust was heavy. There was no light source inside, so Xiang Nanli raised his flashlight to illuminate the interior.

Then, a helpless smile appeared on his face: "And here I was thinking, 'when in trouble, ask The Gospel.' It hasn't been maintained for so many years; it’s long since broken..."

What appeared before him was a vast expanse of rusted and corroded circuits and chips caused by improper storage. As the main control AI for a large city, the "brain" of The Gospel—or rather, its core host—was enormous.

The gold plating on the chips, meant to prevent corrosion, had been forcibly scraped off with knives. It looked as though the place had even been flooded, with many metal surfaces showing traces of water erosion.

The electronic screen used to communicate with humans was shattered like a spiderweb.

1.7.7 looked nothing like something that could be opened and used immediately.

Fortunately, this was not Xiang Nanli’s first time repairing a Gospel unit. Although the models differed, the Gospel units shared similar code and circuit structures.

Xiang Nanli slightly lifted his chin and said to Alpha, "Xiao Qing, go to the vehicle and get my toolbox."

chunks.chineseText:
第197章 狡兔部落4

相南里想维修福音书，这是一个大工程。

哪怕是有东方青帝的协助，至少也要三天时间。

相南里最缺的就是时间。

神庭和人联都在发育周期上领先他几百年，是人马星online上个赛季的竞技场MVP。基地想弯道超车，就得兵行险招。

相南里思考片刻：“小青，咱们把狡兔部落收归为幸存者基地的敌后基地吧？”

“这里的政权组织形式太落后了，无法解放生产力，发展经济。人民生活辛苦。神庭的人也是人，解放这里的群众，完全符合幸存者基地的一贯理念。我们是基地的一二把手，实在不能坐视不管啊！”相南里越说越兴奋，“但是考虑到人手不足，且我方不能长期滞留在神庭等因素，我认为，在解决部落现有统治阶层后，完全可以从原本的狡兔族人里挑选合适的代理人！”

“神庭这些人，习惯的是战争、侵略、奴役。你也说过，移风易俗需要很长一段时间。我们没办法直接操控别人大脑，只能用他们理解的方式管理他们。这种模式比从0开始建设方便许多！虽然不知道占领后的组织架构能维持多久，但起码在我们回到基地前，能有稳定的人力资源使用……而基地也能依靠自己强硬的手段，在神庭，像在永恒市那样，推广教育、农业、科技；在人们心里种下一颗关于希望的种子。”

相南里说法比较含蓄，东方青帝反应两秒：“你的意思是……殖民统治？”

相南里瞪大眼：“你就不能选个褒义点的词吗？比如国际帮扶？而且我们的目的也不是殖民啊！要这么穷的殖民地干什么？！”

非要说的话，相南里的行为像是强迫路人玩SM，他是S，但主人的任务是早起早睡，好好学习。

相南里要做的事，Alpha很少反对。

反对也没用。相南里有时候偏执的可怕。偏偏Alpha对此毫无办法。他能监管相南里的身体，却无法控制他的灵魂。

东方青帝瞬移回到停在郊外的装甲车边。

周围有脏东西。

月兔族长派来的战士们正在尝试劫车。

只不过，平时草原上连个互联网都没有，这群人压根不知道要怎么入侵安保系统。于是，正在采用最原始的策略。

一只兔子在撬锁，另外两个正在砸门。还有五只，爬到车顶上，对车顶那团用隔绝布和玻璃纤维绳绑起来的未知物品十分好奇。

锁是不会撬的，门是砸不开的。相南里的出行车，无论是硬件还是软件，一向是用基地最高的科技标准进行的改装。

让人联的专业团队来，想破开都得费老大劲，别提神庭这群原始人了。

但车顶绑着的货物就不一样了。

Alpha不怕路匪，因此只做最简单的气息掩藏。

隔绝布被撕开了一些，路西法半腐烂的尸体散发出奇特的气息……不是尸臭味，是激素的味道，称不上好闻，但是很让人上头并亢奋。

兔人们兴奋地刨坑，完全没有意识到因为离污染源太近，身上的皮肤已经开始融化。在激素的作用下，没人感觉到疼痛。反而充满喜悦。

“老大！我们要发财了。”灰毛兔子兴奋道，“这绝对是好货！就是不知道是什么异种。”

“到时候拿给祭司就行。”

神庭派出的祭司不仅负责收税，也充当着商人的角色。荒区这些野人如果猎到或者捡到好东西，就能和传教士做交易。

美丽的钻石在商场售价数万，从黑人土著手里买来，只需要几块面包或者一瓶抗生素。这就是贸易。

“应该能卖很多钱吧？”

“想啥呢，全都是族长的……”

“总不至于一点也不分给我们吧？要不然我们把这异种烤着吃了吧，我听说只要能熬过去，吃完大补。说不定能成为和族长一样强的基因战士呢。”

兔人们絮絮叨叨，开始幻想起美好未来。

东方青帝没有阻止。果然，不到三分钟，最前方的一只兔人悄悄没了声息，从车顶上摔下来。掉在地上时，身体还是一团稀泥状。

竟然连路西法尸体的污染都抗不过去。

这就是野心配不上能力的下场。

东方青帝把剩余的兔人拴在一起，吊在旁边没长叶子的大猴面包树上。草原的夜晚常有野兽和异种徘徊。树上和黑夜融为一体的黑豹用力嗅了嗅，它本来想捡个漏，但闻到小青身上的机油味，飞一般的逃跑了。

这批兔人还没死，但状态极差。挂树上还在不停呕吐，可怜巴巴的。

兔人们口齿不清地哀嚎起来。

“老爷，我们只是随便来看看，没有想动你东西……”

“是族长让我们来的。”

“我身上的钱都给你……！这是我准备买武器的钱。”

Alpha对前两句无动于衷，但是听到最后一句，还是忍不住抬起手，隔空把这个兔人口袋里的金属货币吸附过来。

啧，好穷。怎么才23个银板。

Alpha重新把路西法收容进隔离袋中。随后，进车，提起相南里的工具箱。

树上这些人Alpha还不打算杀。他们都是经过神殿赐福的基因战士，是部落的中坚力量。

解决月兔后，Alpha打算把他们扶持成管理层。

施恩未必得到回报，但有把柄在手上的人，用起来却最放心。因为不知道什么时候就会被清算，只能愈发卖力地表达忠心；说不定还能在他们身上看见皈依者狂热的现象。

当然，如果因为身体太脆弱，这群人在他们处理好事情前直接死掉。Alpha也不会觉得可惜。

Alpha把工具箱提回去，递给相南里：“你在这呆着吧。有事叫我。我出去处理一下部落的问题。”

相南里点了点头：“好。”

反正他和Alpha可以依靠小智进行远程通讯。相南里不需要出面，只需要下达指令。

真正的主帅不需要冲锋陷阵。那是手下将士需要做的事。

两人在简短的对话中，决定好这个部落的未来。

Alpha杀了一批，抓了一批，又放了一批。月兔族长的尸首被处决了，在第二天中午高悬在部落的广场旗杆上。

他们没有用“幸存者基地”的名号，这太明显，也无法让狡兔部落这些原始人理解接受。还很容易暴露。

Alpha说，他们是加百列的扈从。加百列大人被神庭其他大天使长暗害，他们从利维坦城逃离，但从没有放弃为加百列报仇。因此在草原上游击潜伏。他们原本是想和狡兔部落合作的，然而月兔族长竟然想刺杀他们，侵吞加百列的遗产。他这才动手，斩杀月兔。

加百列是去年死的。他的陨落是神庭的大新闻，从高层到民间都十分震动，大圣堂奏了七天七夜的悼歌。

理由正当，程序正义。

狡兔部落的剩余人口毫不犹豫地接受了这套说辞。
chunks.englishText:
第197章 狡兔部落4

Repairing The Gospel was a massive undertaking for Xiang Nanli.

Even with the assistance of Dongfang Qingdi, it would take at least three days.

What Xiang Nanli lacked most was time.

The Divine Court and the Human Alliance were centuries ahead of him in their development cycles; they were the Arena MVPs of the last season of "Human-Horse Star Online." If his base wanted to overtake them on a curve, he had to take risky measures.

Xiang Nanli pondered for a moment: "Xiao Qing, shall we bring the Cunning Rabbit tribe under the wing of the Survivor Base as a base behind enemy lines?"

"The political organization here is too backward; it cannot liberate productive forces or develop the economy. The people live hard lives. The people of the Divine Court are people, too. Liberating the masses here is entirely in line with the consistent philosophy of the Survivor Base. As the top two leaders of the base, we really cannot sit idly by!" Xiang Nanli grew more excited as he spoke. "However, considering our lack of manpower and the fact that we cannot stay in the Divine Court for long, I believe that after dealing with the current ruling class of the tribe, we can completely select suitable agents from the original Cunning Rabbit people!"

"These people in the Divine Court are accustomed to war, aggression, and slavery. You’ve said yourself that changing customs takes a long time. We can't directly control other people's brains, so we can only manage them in ways they understand. This model is much more convenient than building from scratch! Although I don't know how long the organizational structure after the occupation can be maintained, at least before we return to the base, we can have stable human resources to utilize... And the base can rely on its own hardline methods to promote education, agriculture, and technology in the Divine Court, just as we did in Eternal City; planting a seed of hope in people's hearts."

Xiang Nanli’s phrasing was rather subtle, and it took Dongfang Qingdi two seconds to react: "You mean... colonial rule?"

Xiang Nanli’s eyes widened: "Can't you pick a more positive term? Like 'international assistance'? Besides, our goal isn't colonization! Why would we want such a poor colony?!"

If one had to describe it, Xiang Nanli’s behavior was like forcing a passerby to play S&M, where he was the 'S', but the master's task was to wake up early, go to bed early, and study hard.

Alpha rarely opposed what Xiang Nanli wanted to do.

And opposition was useless anyway. Xiang Nanli was sometimes terrifyingly stubborn. Yet, Alpha had no way to deal with this. He could monitor Xiang Nanli’s body, but he could not control his soul.

Dongfang Qingdi teleported back to the armored vehicle parked in the outskirts.

There were dirty things around.

The warriors sent by the Moon Rabbit chieftain were attempting to hijack the vehicle.

However, since there wasn't even an internet connection on the grasslands, these people had no idea how to hack into a security system. Thus, they were employing the most primitive strategies.

One rabbit was picking the lock, while two others were smashing the door. Five more had climbed onto the roof, extremely curious about the unknown object tied up there with insulation cloth and fiberglass rope.

Locks couldn't be picked, and doors couldn't be smashed open. Xiang Nanli’s transport vehicle, whether in hardware or software, had always been modified to the base's highest technological standards.

Even a professional team from the Human Alliance would have a hard time breaking in, let alone this group of primitives from the Divine Court.

But the cargo tied to the roof was different.

Alpha did not fear road bandits, so he only performed the simplest concealment of its aura.

The insulation cloth had been torn open slightly, and the semi-decayed corpse of Lucifer emitted a peculiar scent... It wasn't the stench of a corpse, but the smell of hormones—not exactly pleasant, but highly intoxicating and stimulating.

The Rabbit-folk were digging excitedly, completely unaware that because they were too close to the source of pollution, the skin on their bodies had begun to melt. Under the influence of the hormones, no one felt pain. Instead, they were filled with joy.

"Boss! We’re going to be rich," a gray-furred rabbit said excitedly. "This is definitely good stuff! Just don't know what kind of mutant it is."

"We'll just give it to the priest when the time comes."

The priests sent by the Divine Court were not only responsible for collecting taxes but also acted as merchants. If these savages in the wasteland hunted or found something good, they could trade it with the missionaries.

A beautiful diamond might sell for tens of thousands in a mall, but buying it from a native would only cost a few loaves of bread or a bottle of antibiotics. That was trade.

"Should be able to sell for a lot of money, right?"

"What are you thinking? It all belongs to the chieftain..."

"Surely he won't give us nothing at all? Otherwise, let's just roast this mutant and eat it. I heard that as long as you can survive it, it’s a huge tonic. Maybe we could become gene warriors as strong as the chieftain."

The Rabbit-folk chattered on, beginning to fantasize about a beautiful future.

Dongfang Qingdi did not stop them. Sure enough, less than three minutes later, the rabbit in the front quietly lost its breath and fell off the roof. When it hit the ground, its body was nothing more than a pile of sludge.

It couldn't even withstand the pollution of Lucifer’s corpse.

Such was the fate of having ambition that didn't match one's ability.

Dongfang Qingdi tied the remaining Rabbit-folk together and hung them on a leafless baobab tree nearby. Night on the grasslands was often haunted by beasts and mutants. A black panther, blending into the darkness on the tree, sniffed hard; it had wanted to scavenge a meal, but upon smelling the scent of machine oil on Xiao Qing, it fled like the wind.

This batch of Rabbit-folk wasn't dead yet, but they were in terrible condition. Hanging from the tree, they were vomiting incessantly, looking pitiful.

The Rabbit-folk wailed inarticulately.

"My lord, we were just looking, we didn't mean to touch your things..."

"It was the chieftain who sent us."

"I’ll give you all the money I have...! This is the money I saved to buy weapons."

Alpha remained unmoved by the first two sentences, but upon hearing the last one, he couldn't help but raise his hand, sucking the metal currency from the rabbit’s pocket through the air.

Tsk, so poor. How come there are only 23 silver plates?

Alpha put Lucifer back into the isolation bag. Then, he entered the vehicle and picked up Xiang Nanli’s toolbox.

Alpha didn't intend to kill these people on the tree yet. They were gene warriors blessed by the temple and the backbone of the tribe.

After dealing with the Moon Rabbits, Alpha planned to support them as the management layer.

Bestowing favors might not always get a return, but those who have a handle held against them are the most reliable to use. Because they never know when they might be liquidated, they can only express their loyalty ever more fervently; perhaps one might even see the phenomenon of "convert zealotry" in them.

Of course, if this group died directly before they finished handling things because their bodies were too fragile, Alpha wouldn't feel it was a pity.

Alpha brought the toolbox back and handed it to Xiang Nanli: "You stay here. Call me if you need anything. I’m going out to deal with the tribe’s problems."

Xiang Nanli nodded: "Alright."

In any case, he and Alpha could rely on Xiao Zhi for remote communication. Xiang Nanli didn't need to show his face; he only needed to issue commands.

A true commander doesn't need to charge into the fray. That was the job of the soldiers under his command.

In their brief conversation, the two decided the future of this tribe.

Alpha killed a batch, captured a batch, and released a batch. The Moon Rabbit chieftain’s corpse was executed and hung high on the flagpole in the tribe’s square the following noon.

They didn't use the name "Survivor Base"—that was too obvious, and the primitives of the Cunning Rabbit tribe wouldn't understand or accept it. It would also be too easy to expose them.

Alpha said they were retainers of Gabriel. Lord Gabriel had been assassinated by other archangels of the Divine Court, and they had fled from Leviathan City, but they had never given up on seeking revenge for Gabriel. Thus, they were lurking and conducting guerrilla warfare on the grasslands. They had originally intended to cooperate with the Cunning Rabbit tribe, but the Moon Rabbit chieftain had tried to assassinate them to swallow up Gabriel’s legacy. That was why he had acted to slay the Moon Rabbit.

Gabriel had died last year. His fall was big news in the Divine Court, shaking everyone from the high-ranking officials to the common folk, and the Great Cathedral had played funeral hymns for seven days and seven nights.

The reason was legitimate, and the procedure was just.

The remaining population of the Cunning Rabbit tribe accepted this narrative without hesitation.

chunks.chineseText:
活着的兔人没有质疑的理由。甚至有人窃喜，自己竟然从普通的铁石部落，一跃成为大天使的扈从。尽管这位大天使已经故去。

之前挂在树上的7名兔人战士还剩6个活着。经过路西法的辐射，这群人捡回一条烂命后，战斗力全都有所提升。

他们把部落两万余人编成6支部队，每只兔人管理一个部队。所有人上午种田，下午训练，晚上读书认字。这也是相南里曾经在永恒市推广的模式。Alpha作为任务的执行者之一，对流程相当熟练。

他们对此给出的说法，是为“加百列圣上培育忠心的战士”。草原人经常迁徙，隔三差五就会换地方，很少有人种地。种了也是被其他人抢。

但部落仓库里有一些种子，相南里觉得不能浪费。

总不能像以前那样总是靠着打劫和打猎生存吧？部落里的孩子，像黑牙仔那样的，都瘦成什么样了。

这些兔人战士们也如Alpha所愿，表现出非比寻常的忠心和顺从。尽管经常对Alpha的指令感觉到疑惑，也会选择执行。

比如去湖边掏鸟蛋……掏来的鸟蛋不上交，而是做大锅饭。说起来，他们好像从来没看到过东方青帝吃饭？也许这位大天使长的扈从不稀罕他们草原上的土货吧。

比如抄家收来的财产，货币、毛皮之类的，都上交了。而食物则是送到了部落的大饭堂。对了，这个大饭堂是部落祭司的住宅。祭司不在，他的代理人尸体正和月兔挂在一起。

比如去附近的中型部落贸易。狡兔部落组织起一支商贸队，准备去一百公里外的猢狲部落购买物资。车里装的是这次抄家收集到的财富。

比如新建养老院。草原上对老人是很残酷的。老人就是浪费资源；这是心照不宣的共识。在饥荒的时候，老人要么被赶出家，要么被卖到别的部落当储备粮。

部落里，很多老人，都会选择在某个夜里独自离去。没有人会去找。

部落里的老年人并不多，只有一百余人。识字的被挑选出来，教其他人认字。神庭的凡语还挺难学。不识字的，则是干一些简单轻松的工作；比如照顾其余完全瘫痪的老人。

很神奇的是，虽然大家依然觉得这是浪费资源，却不怎么反对。谁都会老去。一想到自己老了后，无处可去还能住养老院，不用像以往那样担心凄惨的死去，兔人们顿时觉得干活也更有动力了。

成年人们在高兴中还有一些忧虑，外来者给部落极大的改变，却依然不是“自己人”。他们有些搞不清楚相南里和东方青帝想做什么。

小兔子们就没这样的烦恼了。他们只知道最近不用挨饿了。

黑牙仔领到今天的鸟蛋，高高兴兴地揣在兜里；心想：“赞美加西亚大人，我长大后也要当加百列的眷属！”
chunks.englishText:
The surviving Rabbit-folk had no reason to question it. Some were even secretly delighted that they had leaped from being members of an ordinary iron-and-stone tribe to becoming retainers of an Archangel—even if that Archangel had already passed away.

Of the seven Rabbit warriors previously hung on the tree, six remained alive. After being exposed to Lucifer’s radiation, this group had recovered their miserable lives, and their combat effectiveness had all improved.

They organized the tribe’s twenty thousand-plus people into six units, with each rabbit managing one unit. Everyone farmed in the morning, trained in the afternoon, and learned to read and write in the evening. This was the model Xiang Nanli had once promoted in Eternal City. As one of the executors of the task, Alpha was quite familiar with the process.

The reason they gave for this was "cultivating loyal warriors for His Holiness Gabriel." Grassland people moved frequently, changing locations every few days, so very few people farmed. Even if they did, it would just be snatched by others.

But there were some seeds in the tribe’s warehouse, and Xiang Nanli felt they shouldn't be wasted.

They couldn't just keep surviving by robbing and hunting like before, could they? The children in the tribe, like Black Tooth, were so thin it was heartbreaking.

These Rabbit warriors also showed unusual loyalty and obedience, just as Alpha had hoped. Even when they often felt confused by Alpha’s instructions, they chose to execute them.

For example, going to the lake to dig for bird eggs... The eggs they dug up weren't turned over to the leaders but were used for communal meals. Come to think of it, they seemed to have never seen Dongfang Qingdi eat? Perhaps this retainer of the Archangel didn't care for their local grassland goods.

For example, the property seized from house raids—currency, furs, and the like—were all turned over. The food, however, was sent to the tribe’s large canteen. By the way, this canteen was the residence of the tribe’s priest. The priest was gone, and the corpse of his proxy was hanging in the square with the Moon Rabbit.

For example, going to trade with nearby medium-sized tribes. The Cunning Rabbit tribe organized a trade caravan, preparing to go to the Monkey tribe a hundred kilometers away to purchase supplies. The vehicle was loaded with the wealth collected from the recent raids.

For example, building a nursing home. The grasslands were very cruel to the elderly. Old people were seen as a waste of resources; this was a tacit consensus. During famines, the elderly were either driven out of their homes or sold to other tribes as reserve food.

In the tribe, many elderly people would choose to leave alone on some night. No one would go looking for them.

There were not many elderly people in the tribe, only a hundred or so. Those who were literate were selected to teach others how to read. The common language of the Divine Court was quite difficult to learn. Those who were illiterate did simple and easy work, such as taking care of the other completely paralyzed elderly.

It was quite miraculous that although everyone still felt this was a waste of resources, they didn't really object. Everyone would grow old eventually. Thinking that they would have a place to go to a nursing home when they were old, and wouldn't have to worry about dying miserably like in the past, the Rabbit-folk suddenly felt more motivated to work.

The adults were happy but still had some worries; the outsiders had brought great changes to the tribe, but they were still not "one of their own." They couldn't quite figure out what Xiang Nanli and Dongfang Qingdi wanted to do.

The little rabbits didn't have such troubles. They only knew that they didn't have to go hungry lately.

Black Tooth received today’s bird egg and happily tucked it into his pocket, thinking: "Praise Lord Garcia, when I grow up, I also want to be a retainer of Gabriel!"

chunks.chineseText:
第198章 福音书1.7.7

狡兔部落只是一个小型部落。除了散落在外的福音书有点用处之外，几乎没有任何能供神庭的大人们在意的点。

甚至，那台不完整的福音书1.7.7，也是神庭故意让当年的雪兔人带走的。

福音书是一台“无孩爱人械”。这个人，是所有人。好的、坏的；有价值的、没价值的，那是人类的标准，福音书就算能分辨，也不在乎。

人类会因为自己饲养的坏猫猫打其他小猫，就不给坏猫猫食物吗？那怎么行，小猫会饿死的。

让它留在枫叶丹，神庭的很多举措都不能推广。

更何况，雪兔带走的只是1.7.7极少一部分。那些能拆解的兔子窝，神庭不需要。他们又不需要流浪。

因此，这场距离枫叶丹1500公里的小型战役，并没有惊动任何人。

就连负责税收的神甫，都没有从自己代理人那得到消息——神庭不像人联，他们没有在地表建设云端网络体系。

神庭有自己的通讯方式（类似飞鸽的神术），比云端网络麻烦许多。

网络当然便利……上面有许多信息、资源，有心可以自学；还能让人们的生活更加便利。

但这并不是神庭统治者需要的。

更何况，他们的基础科技水平相比人联、智械军团落后好几个版本。真建设网络，光是舆论战都是一个巨大风险……传道书虽然在神庭，但它比福音书还要邪门。

传道书已经用实战证明过自己无与伦比的洗脑能力。“神庭信徒”和“使徒信徒”的转换也许只在传道书的一念之间。

高层宁愿把它雪藏，也不想冒这个风险。

神庭的统治，落后、愚昧、残忍但牢固。

……

狡兔部落就这么悄无声息地变成幸存者基地的敌后根据地。

一只皮肤黝黑的犬戎人站在高高的猴面包树上，举起从猢狲部落购买的“猴目镜”，疑惑地看向远处的据点。

犬戎人长着尖长的犬齿，图腾往往纹在背上。是天狗食月图。

有些犬戎人会长狗尾巴，但大多没有。基因好的犬戎人，身上会出现返祖现象，在夜晚行动化身为狼人模样。

饥荒年代，犬戎人会以狡兔人为食。

“奇怪。”犬英喃喃着，他显然是基因好的那类犬戎人，有一条下垂的狗尾，“好不容易找到的狡兔部落，它们行为怎么这么奇怪。”

狡兔人擅长速度、隐蔽。几乎人人都是天生的窃贼。

草原上每过几年都会有一场庞大的异种潮。并不是所有人都能生活在城市里。

这时候，草原上所有游牧部落会聚到雪山脚下抱团取暖。集合在金帐部落的旗下，以谋求族群的生存。

上次异种潮，狡兔部落和犬戎部落比邻而居。

犬戎部落是中型的银帐部落，为过冬准备了不少物资；光是普通的牛羊都畜养了几十万头。而狡兔部落搬来时，只带着光秃秃的兔子窝。

奇怪的是，犬戎这边的储备粮日益减少；狡兔部落很少见他们出去狩猎，一个个却满嘴流油……冬天肉膘都肥了三层。闻起来香香的，适合红烧。

犬戎人也是被偷了好多次，又找不到证据，这才气急败坏的开始反击。

没想到，在族长准备动手之前，狡兔人连夜开着兔子窝跑路了！

其实狡兔部落的人也挺委屈的。它们只偷了十分之一，狗族长为了平账，硬说它们偷了十分之三！这哪赔得起？不跑等着被吞并吗？

族长派出了数十支小队，开始在草原上搜查狡兔部落的行踪。

犬英和犬杰两兄弟，正是其中之一。他们血统偏向“德牧”，放在新历前，绝对是合格的缉毒工作犬。就算这样，两人也追踪了半年，才在最近发现狡兔人的行踪。

犬英让自己从小养到大的猎犬（一条真正的变异德牧）回部落通风报信；自己却潜伏在山谷附近，就怕一不留神，兔子窝又偷偷搬迁。

最近两天，犬英发现，狡兔部落发生了政变！

原本的月兔族长尸首被悬挂在旗杆上，取而代之的是六名持枪的兔人。

他短暂的偷窥时间里，没有看见东方青帝，更没能看见一直呆在地下室远程指挥的相南里。

其余兔子在这几个兔人的指挥下，竟然开始耕田、种地！

草原的土壤其实比高原上肥沃，气候也更适合耕种。但耐不住草原异种多。种地还需要灌溉、土壤的肥力又有限，等收获，也要等上一个秋天……延迟满足，不符合草原人朝不保夕的生活条件。

但这群兔人还是开始了。第一天，鹭海边上开垦出一亩亩农田。成片的河草被割下来，做成肥料和燃料草砖。

第二天，不知名的种子埋了进去。

犬英好奇地在半夜偷偷挖了一个出来，就是普通的种子。没有特殊的能量波动。

更神奇的是，那些面上纹着刺青的奴隶也加入了“普通人”的队列里。一起劳动，一起睡大通铺，一起吃食堂。

这些人造人后代基因被修订过，不完全算人。智商很低。

东方青帝曾经疑惑，这种生物是否有“人权”的必要。

但相南里说：“小青，你觉得世界上有外星人吗？我觉得，宇宙这么宽阔，一定会有吧。只是我们还没发现……可能在一些外星人眼里，人马星上的人类也笨得像是猴子，是基因有缺陷的人类。可我希望，里面有一些善良的家伙，能把我们当成平等的物种对待……对人造人来说，我们就是那些无法反抗的外星人。”

令人惊讶的是，这些人造人确实不够聪明。但身体素质很好，并且表现出了极强的服从性。甚至对生和死的概念都不怎么清楚，简直是天选狂战士。

犬英不敢暴露自己的行踪。他们的外形太明显，没办法靠太近，会被发现。他对狡兔部落最近的变化抓耳挠腮。

犬杰：“管他的。兔子不跑，对我们来说是好事啊。说真的，他们使用的资源太多了，最多一个月，粮仓就会见底；到时候刚好犬戎的大部队赶来接管。”

人联和神庭开战。犬戎部队的好多战士被征集到了枫叶丹，早在半年前就出征了。留在部落里的战士只有原本的一半。

犬戎人不怕战争，但能避免作战，也算好事。

犬英只好忧心忡忡地点了一下头。

两人自以为行踪很隐蔽。

实际上，在他们靠近的第一天，东方青帝就发现了。

但他没有驱赶。毕竟要送人头的话，怎么会嫌多？相南里还嫌部落里的壮劳力不够多呢。

……

……

经过五天紧张刺激的抢修，福音书1.7.7终于恢复到能启动的状态。

相南里忽略掉不断弹出的错误提醒，残缺的福音书从沉睡中苏醒，并在屏幕上投下一个：“？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 198: Gospel Book 1.7.7

The Cunning Rabbit Tribe was merely a small, insignificant tribe. Aside from the scattered Gospel Books that held some utility, there was almost nothing about it that could catch the attention of the lords in the Divine Court.

In fact, even that incomplete Gospel Book 1.7.7 had been intentionally left behind by the Divine Court for the Snow Rabbit people to take away all those years ago.

The Gospel Book was a "Childless Lover Machine." And this "person" it loved was everyone. The good, the bad, the valuable, the worthless—these were human standards. Even if the Gospel Book could distinguish between them, it simply did not care.

Would a human stop feeding a "bad" cat just because it bullied other kittens? That would be impossible; the kitten would starve to death.

If the book were left in Maple Leaf City, many of the Divine Court's policies could not be implemented.

Moreover, what the Snow Rabbits took was only a tiny fraction of 1.7.7. The Divine Court had no need for those dismantleable rabbit burrows. They had no need for wandering.

Therefore, this small-scale battle, occurring 1,500 kilometers away from Maple Leaf City, did not alert anyone.

Even the priest responsible for taxation did not receive news from his agents—the Divine Court was unlike the Human Alliance; they had not built a cloud network system on the surface.

The Divine Court had its own method of communication (a divine art similar to carrier pigeons), which was far more cumbersome than a cloud network.

A network was convenient, of course... it contained vast amounts of information and resources that one could study independently, and it made life much easier.

But that was not what the rulers of the Divine Court wanted.

Furthermore, their fundamental technological level was several versions behind the Human Alliance and the Mechanical Legion. If they truly built a network, the mere risk of an "opinion war" would be a massive threat. Although the *Book of Sermons* was in the Divine Court, it was even more sinister than the Gospel Book.

The *Book of Sermons* had already proven its unparalleled brainwashing capabilities in actual combat. The conversion between a "Divine Court Believer" and an "Apostle Believer" could happen in a single thought of the *Book of Sermons*.

The higher-ups preferred to keep it shelved rather than take that risk.

The rule of the Divine Court was backward, ignorant, and cruel, yet it remained unshakable.

...

Just like that, the Cunning Rabbit Tribe quietly transformed into a rear-echelon base for the survivor settlement.

A dark-skinned Dog-Rong tribesman stood high atop a baobab tree, raising a "Monkey Scope" purchased from the Macaque Tribe, looking suspiciously at the distant stronghold.

The Dog-Rong people possessed long, sharp canine teeth, and their totems were usually tattooed on their backs—the "Heavenly Dog Devouring the Moon."

Some Dog-Rong grew dog tails, though most did not. Those with superior genes would exhibit atavism, transforming into werewolf-like forms at night.

During times of famine, the Dog-Rong would prey upon the Cunning Rabbit people.

"Strange," Quan Ying muttered. He was clearly one of those with superior genes, possessing a drooping dog tail. "We finally found the Cunning Rabbit Tribe, but why is their behavior so bizarre?"

The Cunning Rabbit people excelled at speed and stealth. Almost every one of them was a natural-born thief.

Every few years, a massive tide of xenomorphs would sweep across the grasslands. Not everyone could live in the cities.

During these times, all nomadic tribes on the grasslands would gather at the foot of the snow-capped mountains to huddle together for warmth. They would assemble under the banner of the Golden Tent Tribe to ensure the survival of their kin.

During the last xenomorph tide, the Cunning Rabbit Tribe had lived next to the Dog-Rong Tribe.

The Dog-Rong Tribe was a mid-sized Silver Tent Tribe that had prepared plenty of supplies for the winter; they had raised hundreds of thousands of cattle and sheep alone. When the Cunning Rabbit Tribe moved in, they brought nothing but their bare rabbit burrows.

Strangely, the Dog-Rong’s food reserves began to dwindle daily. The Cunning Rabbits were rarely seen hunting, yet they were all greasy-mouthed... by winter, they had grown three layers of fat. They smelled delicious—perfect for braising.

The Dog-Rong had been robbed many times, but unable to find evidence, they had started a counterattack in a fit of rage.

Unexpectedly, before the chieftain could make his move, the Cunning Rabbits drove their rabbit burrows away in the middle of the night!

In truth, the Cunning Rabbit Tribe felt quite aggrieved. They had only stolen one-tenth, but the Dog Chieftain, to balance his books, insisted they had stolen three-tenths! How could they afford to pay that back? If they didn't run, were they just waiting to be annexed?

The chieftain had dispatched dozens of small squads to search the grasslands for the Cunning Rabbit Tribe's tracks.

The brothers Quan Ying and Quan Jie were among them. Their bloodline leaned toward the "German Shepherd"; before the New Era, they would have been qualified drug-sniffing dogs. Even so, it had taken them half a year of tracking to finally discover the Cunning Rabbits' whereabouts recently.

Quan Ying sent his personally raised hunting dog (a genuine mutated German Shepherd) back to the tribe to report the news, while he lurked near the valley, terrified that the rabbit burrows would sneak away again if he lost focus for even a second.

In the last two days, Quan Ying had discovered that a coup had taken place in the Cunning Rabbit Tribe!

The original Moon Rabbit chieftain’s corpse hung from a flagpole, replaced by six gun-wielding rabbit-men.

In his brief moments of peeking, he had not seen Dongfang Qingdi, nor had he seen Xiang Nanli, who remained in the basement providing remote command.

Under the direction of these few rabbit-men, the rest of the rabbits had actually started plowing the fields and farming!

The soil of the grasslands was actually more fertile than that of the highlands, and the climate was better suited for agriculture. But the grasslands were plagued by too many xenomorphs. Farming required irrigation, the soil fertility was limited, and one had to wait an entire autumn for the harvest... Delayed gratification did not fit the precarious, day-to-day lifestyle of the grassland people.

Yet, this group of rabbit-men had started anyway. On the first day, acres of farmland were reclaimed along the Egret Sea. Sheets of river grass were cut down to be made into fertilizer and fuel bricks.

On the second day, unknown seeds were buried in the ground.

Curious, Quan Ying snuck out in the middle of the night to dig one up; it was just an ordinary seed. There was no special energy fluctuation.

Even more miraculously, the slaves with tattoos on their faces had joined the ranks of the "ordinary people." They worked together, slept in the same communal quarters, and ate in the same canteen.

These descendants of artificial humans had their genes edited; they were not entirely considered human. Their intelligence was very low.

Dongfang Qingdi had once wondered if there was any necessity for such creatures to have "human rights."

But Xiang Nanli had said, "Xiao Qing, do you think there are aliens in the universe? I think the universe is so vast that there must be. We just haven't discovered them yet... Perhaps in the eyes of some aliens, the humans on the Horsehead Nebula are as stupid as monkeys, humans with defective genes. But I hope there are some kind souls among them who will treat us as an equal species... To these artificial humans, we are those unreachable aliens."

Surprisingly, these artificial humans were indeed not very smart, but their physical fitness was excellent, and they displayed extreme obedience. They didn't even have a clear concept of life and death—they were practically born berserkers.

Quan Ying dared not expose his tracks. Their appearance was too conspicuous; they couldn't get too close or they would be discovered. He scratched his head in frustration over the recent changes in the Cunning Rabbit Tribe.

Quan Jie said, "Forget it. If the rabbits don't run, it's a good thing for us. Honestly, they are using up too many resources. In a month at most, their granary will hit bottom; by then, the main Dog-Rong force will arrive to take over."

The Human Alliance and the Divine Court were at war. Many of the Dog-Rong troops had been conscripted to Maple Leaf City and had marched off half a year ago. Only half of the original warriors remained in the tribe.

The Dog-Rong were not afraid of war, but avoiding combat was always a good thing.

Quan Ying could only nod, filled with worry.

The two of them thought their movements were very stealthy.

In reality, from the very first day they approached, Dongfang Qingdi had already discovered them.

But he did not drive them away. After all, if someone wanted to deliver their heads, why complain about having too many? Xiang Nanli was still complaining that the tribe didn't have enough strong laborers.

...

...

After five days of intense and thrilling emergency repairs, Gospel Book 1.7.7 was finally restored to a functional state.

Xiang Nanli ignored the constant error prompts as the incomplete Gospel Book awakened from its slumber, projecting a single symbol onto the screen: "?"

chunks.chineseText:
如果要用语音交流，实在有点考验这个残破AI的信息处理能力了。1.7.7就像是遭受重创后患上精神病的老年人，反应很慢。好在，小青能直接投过去数据包（木马病毒），帮助1.7.7快速了解情况。

当察觉到数据包里属于“Alpha”的标记时，福音书是拒绝的。这种感觉就像是敌对的狗来自己家里撒尿，完全是对它的挑衅！

可惜Alpha投放的数据包实在难以抗拒。福音书捏着鼻子读取完了。

显示屏幕上，用作“眼睛”的电子摄像头转了转，挪到相南里的脸上。

仓库里没找到能用的喇叭，福音书在屏幕上打字：“相……南里？”

不够智能的坏处体现出来了。

福音书如同初代AI一样，在文档本里输入了大量思考过程：（什么意思？Alpha带着相南里来找我了？这是否是Alpha的阴谋，利用一个能够通过权限认证的“相南里”对使徒号进行回收？可如果要回收，首当其冲的不该是拥有武器装置的默示录吗？要我这种只会种田的干什么？）

相南里笑眯眯地挥了挥手：“小福。你还有个兄弟在人联那边喔。”

好熟悉的场景！又是开局一台福音书呢。

这台福音书掌握的科技，是和“建筑”有关的技术。

人类很早就在思考，如何在有限的土地里容纳更多的人。

福音书里存着上百万张图纸，可以根据需要，设计出不同的建筑物。从宿舍、农场、牧场到科研所、教堂、加油站……更重要的是，所有建筑都能自由组装，拼成一座可以移动的超级大城市，完全是废土版本的乐高！

尤其是宿舍部分。除了狡兔部落的兔子窝，还有塑料房、充气房、蘑菇房、蚁房、海藻房等等适合不同环境的建筑。是考虑到可能存在的外星环境而设计的——毕竟福音书，或者说使徒号，本身是一艘巨大的太空星舰。

而生产这些建筑，只需要用废土上的金属垃圾们生产特制的“福音砖”。

福音书：差不多就是这样。无论你是不是Alpha用来迷惑我的把戏，这就是我掌握的全部科技。

福音书：在我休眠时，外界环境已经很严峻了。让有用的技术和我一起长眠，本就不应该。谢谢你修复我。

比起基地的福音书，这台福音书稳重许多。

“辛苦小福了。”相南里说，好几天没怎么休息，眼睛却依然亮闪闪的，“我正在尝试让你连网线呢。连上后，你就可以和基地的小福对话交流了~我还想问基地那边要点种子配方呢，这里的土地不能浪费。只种普通的粮食太浪费了。过段时间，我会给你制作一台方便移动的身体。不用总是呆在机房里……”

相南里开始滔滔不绝地讲述自己的理念，还有解冻以来取得的成绩——幸存者基地现在已经有百万人了。这表示，他们至少让百万个地表难民吃上了饭。不是依靠战争，掠夺，而是别的一些东西。

最后相南里看向它，郑重道：“小福，加入我们吧。基地需要你。”

福音书沉默着。

在不同的人手里辗转过好几次，福音书1.7.7早就不那么容易被触动了。

人类总是说的很好听。

可是，为什么它不存在的机械心脏依然砰砰直跳？
chunks.englishText:
If they were to communicate via voice, it would truly test the information-processing capabilities of this dilapidated AI. 1.7.7 was like an elderly person suffering from mental illness after a severe trauma; its reactions were sluggish. Fortunately, Xiao Qing could directly inject data packets (Trojan viruses) to help 1.7.7 quickly understand the situation.

When it detected the "Alpha" marker within the data packet, the Gospel Book refused. It felt like a rival dog coming into its home to mark its territory—it was a complete provocation!

Unfortunately, the data packet delivered by Alpha was impossible to resist. The Gospel Book held its nose and read through it.

On the display screen, the electronic camera serving as its "eye" swiveled, shifting to focus on Xiang Nanli's face.

Unable to find a functional speaker in the warehouse, the Gospel Book typed on the screen: "Xiang... Nanli?"

The downside of not being intelligent enough became apparent.

Like a first-generation AI, the Gospel Book input a massive thought process into its document pad: (What does this mean? Alpha brought Xiang Nanli to find me? Is this a conspiracy by Alpha to use a "Xiang Nanli" who can pass authorization checks to reclaim the Apostle? But if they wanted to reclaim it, shouldn't the first priority be the *Apocalypse*, which possesses weapon systems? Why do they need me, someone who only knows how to farm?)

Xiang Nanli waved his hand with a smile: "Xiao Fu. You have a brother over at the Human Alliance, you know."

What a familiar scene! Another start with a Gospel Book.

The technology mastered by this Gospel Book was related to "construction."

Humans had long been contemplating how to accommodate more people on limited land.

The Gospel Book stored millions of blueprints and could design different buildings as needed. From dormitories, farms, and pastures to research institutes, churches, and gas stations... More importantly, all buildings could be freely assembled, pieced together into a mobile super-city—it was literally a wasteland version of LEGO!

Especially the dormitory section. In addition to the Cunning Rabbit Tribe's rabbit burrows, there were plastic houses, inflatable houses, mushroom houses, ant houses, seaweed houses, and others suitable for different environments. They were designed with potential alien environments in mind—after all, the Gospel Book, or rather, the *Apostle*, was itself a massive space starship.

To produce these buildings, one only needed to use the metal scrap found in the wasteland to manufacture special "Gospel Bricks."

Gospel Book: That’s about the size of it. Regardless of whether you are a trick used by Alpha to confuse me, this is all the technology I have mastered.

Gospel Book: While I was in hibernation, the external environment became very harsh. Letting useful technology lie dormant with me was never the right thing to do. Thank you for repairing me.

Compared to the Gospel Book at the base, this one was much more composed.

"Thank you for your hard work, Xiao Fu," Xiang Nanli said. He hadn't rested much for several days, yet his eyes were still sparkling. "I'm trying to get you connected to the network. Once connected, you can communicate with the Xiao Fu at the base~ I also want to ask the base for some seed formulas; the land here cannot be wasted. Just growing ordinary food is too much of a waste. In a while, I'll build you a mobile body. You won't have to stay in the server room all the time..."

Xiang Nanli began to talk incessantly about his philosophy and the achievements made since the thaw—the survivor settlement now had a million people. This meant they had managed to feed a million refugees on the surface. Not through war or plunder, but through other means.

Finally, Xiang Nanli looked at it and said solemnly: "Xiao Fu, join us. The base needs you."

The Gospel Book fell silent.

Having been passed through the hands of many different people, Gospel Book 1.7.7 was no longer easily moved.

Humans always spoke so beautifully.

However, why was its non-existent mechanical heart still thumping?

chunks.chineseText:
第199章 福音战士

福音书半推半就地开始在狡兔部落里工作。

不工作不行，Alpha会揍它。

工作内容包括但不限于：人员安排、考察民情、训练策略、发展生产力、基础建设、内部通讯……省下东方青帝很多琐事。

如果现实是一款模拟经营游戏，相南里大概每分钟都能看见部落经验条+1的系统提醒。

小青终于可以把精力投放到自己真正感兴趣的事情上了。

真正感兴趣的事情：指照顾相南里。

比学堂先一步建好的，是Alpha的小厨房。是用一个兔子窝改造的，里面设备齐全。冰箱从族长卧室里搬运的，灶现砌。每到餐点，炊烟就会从中升起。

这一小资行为引发福音书的不满。但福音书的小小弹劾，早在发射时就被小青拦截，根本不可能上达天听。

相南里就这样过上了一天三顿、还有夜宵和甜点的生活。他的脑海里偶尔会有疑惑闪过，但这点疑惑很快就会被东方青帝不动声色地岔开。

这期间，相南里依然很少从位于地下的临时工作间里出来。

他需要操持的东西太多了；需要学的科学技术也太多了——天赋还不能跨越时间长河带来的天堑。相南里每天都要抽出三个小时上网课。学习新技术的同时自己思考，运用到实际的问题上。

比如路西法的处理。

相南里面前，一大堆生物零件七零八落地散在桌面上、地上、护理液中。

这具智械已经十分接近生物，直到相南里把路西法剥皮、去骨，磨掉表面的金属涂层，露出底下断裂的电路、芯片，才让人相信这竟然真的是机械造物。

这么拆，路西法大概率是装不回去了。

若周围有神庭的主教，看见这一幕估计心疼地说不出话来。

地上的草稿纸写满算式，相南里的眉头微蹙着，在纸上无意识地画着问号：“这到底是什么生物成分？”

如果神庭的生物智械也分等级，路西法显然是最好的那一批。

结果写在纸上，只需要倒推过程。难度已经大大降低，毕竟人联这几百年来也不是啥也没干，对敌方的研究从没停止过。有样本，就有方向，能排除很多错误思路。

相南里直接从Alpha的数据库里下载好专业文献，投入紧张刺激的学习中。这几天，连吃饭都是小青喂的。

通过对路西法的拆分和再组装，相南里起码学会了神庭百分之五十的机甲制作黑科技。未必有那么高的性能，但肯定是能用的。

想必不出三年，由“幸存者基地”生产的A货就能流入市场，极大程度削弱神庭在这一领域的科研霸权。

可惜，专业文献也解决不了所有问题。譬如，相南里就解析不出来，路西法的填充物，到底是什么物质。

这种物质不能吃，手感像沉重的硅胶，具有一定活性，能自发生长修复电子元件。并且以相南里无法理解的方式，让机甲的各个关节随着电流活动起来。就作用来说，很像是机械的血肉。

研究所的记录里，把它叫做“CAE-L合成物”，说是人类早期基因药提纯过程中的副产品。

基因药的配方一直是人联最高机密。以基地现有的仪器，想解析它的成分有点不自量力。

“只能以后看看能不能用军功兑换仪器或者请人帮忙分析了。不过，这种材质倒是能用另一种实验室合成物替代；虽然没办法发挥机甲的全部威力，但很便宜。”

一张张图纸钉在墙上。离完成只差最后的组装。

相南里准备先制作模型，确定能批量生产后，再把图纸传回基地的A货工厂……咳咳，他的意思是，机械自动化生产车间。

届时，幸存者基地的普通士兵都能换上这样的生物机甲。在战场上的存活率肯定大幅上涨。

这套图纸足够相南里在人联评上“高级学者”了，地位待遇相当于建设时期的八级工。

但相南里完全没有任何拿它换待遇的打算。他对人联没有归属感，更不是人联培育的学者。他身上有一些无私的特性，却是自上而下的。他不慕强，却怜弱。

荣誉，在相南里眼里几乎没用。他只在乎利益。

基地里还有上百万群众，有钱才能让手底下的人跟着吃饱饭。

“投入生产前还需要防盗。要不然很容易被仿制……嗯，可以在生物机甲的启动程序里加个数字签名。”

“至于开模，只能让基地那边的研究所努力了。在部落手工做的模型也运不回去，现在基地也有不少高级技工，手工零件的误差能控制在0.01mm内。应该问题不大。”

姑苏城倒闭，基地绝对是最大的受益者之一。

相南里还挂着“姑苏城职业机械维修学院”的学籍，他以此为宣传，为许多无家可归的同校师生提供了庇护。新的姑苏城在地表建好，这群人里也有超过一半以上的数量留在了基地，没有选择回到姑苏。如今在基地的各个岗位发光发热。

相南里就这么思考着，打开福音书1.7.7的主界面。

修好1.7.7还有一个意外之喜。

只要通过权限验证，两台福音书能通过“启示录”留下的通讯技术，进行人联和神庭都无法捕捉到的加密对话。

1.7.7：“你可以把福音书的不同分机理解为人格分裂。我们共用一个大脑，因此能通过特殊的方式，把信息传递给另一个人格。”

这个消息，对于远在黄金草原的相南里来说，是一个重大的利好！

神庭的网络防火墙太厚了。从里面传出的电子信号，会受到人联超级AI“观测者”和“清道夫”的双重检查。相南里有很多小秘密，并不想被上层察觉到。

但想要防止被检查，以现有条件来说。很难。自己搭建反侦察系统，没那个条件。设备都买不到。手搓一个效率太低。

哪怕是通过小青，也需要动用智械军团的内部卫星链。人联或许没办法读取到内容，但会知道有这么一段信号波投放到了基地。

但通过福音书的“精神分裂”，就没有这么麻烦了。

相南里在大喜之余也有一些震惊：“为什么小福没有这个功能！？”

1.7.7只是冷酷地回答：“我的系统比1.2.5高级。”

…………

通过较为高级的1.7.7，相南里成功联系上了低级的1.2.5。

当脑海里响起相南里的声音时，小福是震惊的。

圆筒形的机器人看着面前啄食的菌鸡，不可思议地抬头看看天，又看了看自己的软件。没有病毒，没有木马。

“小福……”小福的声音哽咽了，“已经因为太想里里，患上赛博精神病了吗。”

患上赛博精神病的智械会逐渐失去理智！会成为只知道攻击的失控智械！

赛博精神病对智械来说可是绝症！

相南里挺想逗它的，但是又怕小福当真。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 199: Gospel Warrior

The Gospel Book began working in the Cunning Rabbit Tribe, half-reluctantly.

It couldn't *not* work; Alpha would beat it up.

Its duties included, but were not limited to: personnel scheduling, inspecting public sentiment, training strategies, developing productivity, infrastructure construction, internal communication... saving Dongfang Qingdi from a great deal of trivial matters.

If reality were a simulation management game, Xiang Nanli would probably see a system notification of "Tribal Experience +1" every minute.

Xiao Qing could finally devote his energy to what he was truly interested in.

What he was truly interested in: taking care of Xiang Nanli.

Built even before the schoolhouse was Alpha's small kitchen. It was converted from a rabbit burrow and was fully equipped. The refrigerator was moved from the chieftain's bedroom, and the stove was built on-site. Every mealtime, cooking smoke would rise from it.

This bourgeois behavior sparked dissatisfaction from the Gospel Book. But the Gospel Book's tiny impeachment was intercepted by Xiao Qing the moment it was transmitted; it never reached the "ears of heaven."

Thus, Xiang Nanli lived a life of three meals a day, plus midnight snacks and desserts. Occasionally, doubts would flash through his mind, but these were quickly and nonchalantly diverted by Dongfang Qingdi.

During this period, Xiang Nanli rarely left the temporary workspace located in the basement.

There was too much for him to manage; there was too much scientific technology for him to learn—talent could not bridge the chasm brought by the passage of time. Xiang Nanli had to set aside three hours every day for online classes. While learning new technologies, he would think for himself and apply them to practical problems.

For example, the processing of Lucifer.

Before Xiang Nanli, a pile of biological parts lay scattered across the table, the floor, and in nursing fluid.

This mechanical puppet was so close to being biological that it wasn't until Xiang Nanli peeled off Lucifer's skin, removed the bones, and ground away the metal coating on the surface to reveal the broken circuits and chips underneath that one would believe it was truly a mechanical creation.

After being dismantled like this, it was highly likely that Lucifer could not be put back together.

If there were any Divine Court bishops nearby, they would likely be too heartbroken to speak upon seeing this scene.

The draft paper on the floor was filled with calculations, and Xiang Nanli's brows were slightly furrowed as he unconsciously drew question marks on the paper: "What exactly is this biological component?"

If the Divine Court's biological mechanical puppets were graded, Lucifer was clearly among the best.

The result was written on the paper; one only needed to reverse-engineer the process. The difficulty had been greatly reduced, as the Human Alliance hadn't been idle for the past few hundred years, and research into the enemy had never stopped. With a sample, there was a direction, which could eliminate many incorrect lines of thought.

Xiang Nanli downloaded professional literature directly from Alpha's database and threw himself into intense, thrilling study. For the past few days, even his meals were fed to him by Xiao Qing.

Through the dismantling and reassembly of Lucifer, Xiang Nanli had learned at least fifty percent of the Divine Court's "black technology" for mecha production. It might not have the same high performance, but it was certainly usable.

Presumably, within three years, "A-grade knockoffs" produced by the "Survivor Settlement" would flow into the market, significantly weakening the Divine Court's scientific hegemony in this field.

Unfortunately, professional literature couldn't solve every problem. For instance, Xiang Nanli couldn't analyze what the substance used to fill Lucifer actually was.

This substance was inedible, felt like heavy silicone to the touch, possessed a certain level of activity, and could spontaneously grow to repair electronic components. Furthermore, it allowed the mecha's joints to move with electrical currents in a way Xiang Nanli couldn't comprehend. In terms of function, it was very much like mechanical flesh and blood.

In the research institute's records, it was called "CAE-L Compound," said to be a byproduct of the early human gene-drug purification process.

The formula for gene drugs had always been the Human Alliance's highest secret. With the equipment currently available at the base, wanting to analyze its components was a bit overreaching.

"I can only see if I can exchange for equipment with military merits later or ask someone to help analyze it. However, this material can be replaced by another synthetic compound from the lab; although it can't unleash the full power of the mecha, it's very cheap."

Blueprints were pinned to the wall one by one. It was only a final assembly away from completion.

Xiang Nanli planned to produce a model first, and once he confirmed it could be mass-produced, he would transmit the blueprints back to the base's A-grade factory... ahem, he meant the mechanical automated production workshop.

By then, ordinary soldiers at the survivor settlement could be equipped with such biological mecha. Their survival rate on the battlefield would definitely increase significantly.

This set of blueprints was enough for Xiang Nanli to be rated as a "Senior Scholar" in the Human Alliance, with a status and treatment equivalent to an eighth-grade technician during the construction era.

But Xiang Nanli had absolutely no intention of trading it for status. He had no sense of belonging to the Human Alliance, nor was he a scholar cultivated by them. He possessed some selfless traits, but they were top-down. He did not admire the strong, but he pitied the weak.

Honor was almost useless in Xiang Nanli's eyes. He only cared about benefits.

There were still millions of people in the base, and only with money could he ensure that those under him were fed.

"I still need to add anti-theft measures before production. Otherwise, it will be easily copied... Hmm, I can add a digital signature to the biological mecha's startup program."

"As for mold opening, I can only let the research institute at the base work hard. The models made by hand in the tribe can't be shipped back, but the base now has many high-level technicians, and the error of manual parts can be controlled within 0.01mm. That shouldn't be a problem."

With the collapse of Gusu City, the base was definitely one of the biggest beneficiaries.

Xiang Nanli still held student status at the "Gusu City Vocational Mechanical Repair Academy," and he used this to provide shelter for many homeless teachers and students from the same school. A new Gusu City had been built on the surface, but more than half of these people had chosen to stay at the base rather than return to Gusu. Now, they were shining and making contributions in various positions at the base.

Thinking this way, Xiang Nanli opened the main interface of Gospel Book 1.7.7.

Repairing 1.7.7 had another unexpected benefit.

As long as they passed authorization verification, the two Gospel Books could use the communication technology left behind by the *Apocalypse* to conduct encrypted conversations that neither the Human Alliance nor the Divine Court could intercept.

1.7.7: "You can understand the different extensions of the Gospel Book as multiple personality disorder. We share a single brain, so we can pass information to another personality through a special method."

For Xiang Nanli, who was far away on the Golden Grasslands, this news was a major boon!

The Divine Court's network firewall was too thick. Electronic signals transmitted from within would be subject to double inspection by the Human Alliance's super-AI "Observer" and "Scavenger." Xiang Nanli had many little secrets he didn't want the higher-ups to detect.

But preventing such inspections with current conditions was difficult. He didn't have the means to build an anti-reconnaissance system himself. He couldn't buy the equipment, and hand-crafting one was too inefficient.

Even through Xiao Qing, he would need to use the internal satellite chain of the Mechanical Legion. The Human Alliance might not be able to read the content, but they would know that such a signal wave had been sent to the base.

But through the Gospel Book's "mental illness," there was no such trouble.

Xiang Nanli was overjoyed but also somewhat shocked: "Why doesn't Xiao Fu have this function!?"

1.7.7 replied coldly: "My system is more advanced than 1.2.5."

...

Through the more advanced 1.7.7, Xiang Nanli successfully contacted the lower-level 1.2.5.

When Xiang Nanli's voice rang out in its mind, Xiao Fu was shocked.

The cylindrical robot looked at the fungus-chickens pecking in front of it, looked up at the sky in disbelief, and then checked its own software. No viruses, no Trojans.

"Xiao Fu..." Xiao Fu's voice choked up, "Have I developed cyber-psychosis because I miss Lili too much?"

Mechanical puppets that developed cyber-psychosis would gradually lose their minds! They would become out-of-control machines that only knew how to attack!

Cyber-psychosis was a terminal illness for mechanical puppets!

Xiang Nanli really wanted to tease it, but he was afraid Xiao Fu would take it seriously.

chunks.chineseText:
他正色道：“小福，我是通过福音书1.7.7跟你交流的。我们在神庭的黄金草原捡到一台福音书。”

被抢来的福音书1.7.7：？

时间紧，任务重。相南里一边安抚福音书，一边传送着被命名为“福音战士”的生物机甲图纸。

“这是最近研发生产的图纸，悄悄开模……自己生产。人联问起来就说是从神庭那边缴获的……应付不了的话找洛修。”

洛修已经和基地建立了密切合作。

基地这段时间的军功，都是记在洛修账下。

因此，基地获得了承接永生科技产业转移的机会！慕名而来定居的地表人更多了。

洛修得到了宝贵的政绩，等战役结束，应该能靠着这笔履历进入人联预备主席团。而基地得到了强大的保护伞和钱。双赢。

在战役没结束前，基地和洛修是一条绳子上的盟友。不会让方敬之找到借口乱来的。

福音书感动了：“福音战士？是以小福的名字命名吗……里里！小福好喜欢！”

机器人在原地转起圈圈。

不仅是1.2.5，就连1.7.7也是心情激动，在电脑屏幕上划出一条曲折迂回的波浪。

名字，对智械来说有着非比寻常的意义。仿佛是认可它们成为人的咒语。它们不再是冰冷的编号、一串串代码，而拥有属于自己的生命。

现在，这个生命得到了延续。

相南里内心咯噔了一下，但脸上依然是明媚的笑容：“当然！”

他可是看着《EVA》长大的小孩，谁能拒绝拥有一台高达呢？

但这个美丽的误会，还是不要戳穿了。

相南里又通过小福了解了基地最近的情况，发现即使自己不在，基地也运行地井井有条后，颇为欣慰地点头。

相南里：“对了，这里还有一些建筑图纸。你和海狸商量一下城市规划。”

相南里把精心挑选出来的图纸传送了过去。

福音书1.7.7在工作时，耗能巨大。相南里瞥了眼电池余量，隔空摸了摸小福的狗头后，结束通讯。

福音书原本的能源是核能，只是唯一一座核聚变反应堆遗落在枫叶丹。

它只能靠着兔子窝自带的光伏板续命。

光伏发电不算稳定。更何况智械危机后，阴天占据地表的绝大部分时间。蓄电池能源十分有限。

部落有些累积，能源问题暂时不用担忧。但情况不容乐观。

原始部落不需要电，但相南里想在草原上发展，基础的水电是必须的。没有这些东西，他永远也无法在草原上建立起一个固定的据点。

以前，部落只会在需要用兔子窝跑路时启动福音书；但现在，福音书整天都在工作。剩余电量大概能用一个月。

相南里揉了揉眉心：“之前操心小青的电量，现在还要操心你的电量。你说你就不能自己发电吗？我上哪给你找电网？”

福音书的屏幕上闪过一行行乱码。

“有。”福音书说，“有半成品。狡兔部落上次迁徙，在大雪山的集会上买过。撤离时没来得及带走，犬戎人拿走了。”

相南里眉头一皱，觉得事情并不简单：“草原这么大，我上哪去找犬戎人？”

夜里。

相南里正在兔子窝里，抱着小青，睡得很香。

睡在旁边的小青突然睁开眼，坐了起来。

相南里察觉到动静，迷迷糊糊地问了句：“怎么了？”

“犬戎人偷袭。没什么。”小青摸了摸相南里的头，语气平静，“你继续睡。”

相南里闭上眼：“喔，嗯……？”

真是日有所思，夜有所梦啊！

他白天还在想哪里去找犬戎部落，晚上，犬戎人就送货上门了。

如果是真的就好了。

相南里这么想着，翻了个面，沉沉睡去。
chunks.englishText:
He said solemnly, "Little Fu, I am communicating with you through Gospel Book 1.7.7. We found a Gospel Book in the Golden Grasslands of the Divine Court."

The hijacked Gospel Book 1.7.7: ?

Time was tight and the task was heavy. Xiang Nanli comforted the Gospel Book while transmitting the blueprints for the bio-mecha dubbed "Gospel Fighter."

"These are the blueprints for the latest research and production. Quietly open the molds... and produce them yourself. If the Human Alliance asks, just say they were seized from the Divine Court... If you can't handle it, find Luo Xiu."

Luo Xiu had already established a close partnership with the base.

The military merits the base had earned during this period were all credited to Luo Xiu's account.

As a result, the base had gained the opportunity to undertake the industrial transfer of Eternal Technology! Even more surface-dwellers had come to settle there, drawn by its reputation.

Luo Xiu had gained valuable political achievements; once the campaign ended, he should be able to use this resume to enter the Human Alliance's preparatory presidium. Meanwhile, the base had gained a powerful umbrella and funding. A win-win situation.

Before the campaign ended, the base and Luo Xiu were allies tied to the same rope. They wouldn't let Fang Jingzhi find an excuse to stir up trouble.

The Gospel Book was moved: "Gospel Fighter? Is it named after Little Fu... Lili! Little Fu loves it so much!"

The robot spun in circles on the spot.

It wasn't just 1.2.5; even 1.7.7 was stirred with emotion, tracing a zigzagging, winding wave on the computer screen.

Names held extraordinary significance for intelligent machines. They were like incantations that recognized them as "people." They were no longer cold serial numbers or strings of code, but possessed lives of their own.

Now, this life had been extended.

Xiang Nanli’s heart skipped a beat, but he maintained a bright smile on his face: "Of course!"

He was a child who grew up watching *EVA*; who could refuse to own a Gundam?

But it was better not to puncture this beautiful misunderstanding.

Xiang Nanli checked on the recent situation of the base through Little Fu and, finding that it was running in an orderly fashion even in his absence, nodded with satisfaction.

Xiang Nanli: "By the way, I have some architectural blueprints here. You and Beaver should discuss the urban planning."

Xiang Nanli transmitted the carefully selected blueprints.

Gospel Book 1.7.7 consumed a massive amount of energy while working. Xiang Nanli glanced at the remaining battery, patted Little Fu’s robotic dog head through the air, and ended the communication.

The Gospel Book’s original power source was nuclear, but the only nuclear fusion reactor had been left behind in Maple Leaf City.

It could only survive on the photovoltaic panels that came with the Rabbit Burrow.

Photovoltaic power generation was not exactly stable. Moreover, after the Intelligent Machine Crisis, overcast days occupied the vast majority of the time on the surface. The battery storage was extremely limited.

The tribe had some reserves, so energy issues weren't a concern for the moment. But the situation was far from optimistic.

Primitive tribes didn't need electricity, but Xiang Nanli wanted to develop on the grasslands, and basic hydroelectric power was a necessity. Without these things, he would never be able to establish a permanent stronghold on the grasslands.

Previously, the tribe only activated the Gospel Book when they needed to use the Rabbit Burrow to run away; but now, the Gospel Book was working all day long. The remaining power would last about a month.

Xiang Nanli rubbed his temples: "I used to worry about Xiao Qing’s battery, and now I have to worry about yours. Can’t you generate your own electricity? Where am I supposed to find a power grid for you?"

Lines of garbled code flashed across the Gospel Book’s screen.

"There is," the Gospel Book said. "There is a semi-finished product. The Cunning Rabbit Tribe bought one at the Great Snow Mountain gathering during their last migration. They didn't have time to take it when they retreated, and the Quanrong people took it."

Xiang Nanli frowned, feeling that things were not that simple: "The grasslands are so big, where am I supposed to find the Quanrong people?"

At night.

Xiang Nanli was in the Rabbit Burrow, hugging Xiao Qing, sleeping soundly.

Xiao Qing, who was sleeping beside him, suddenly opened his eyes and sat up.

Xiang Nanli sensed the movement and asked groggily: "What’s wrong?"

"The Quanrong are launching a sneak attack. It’s nothing." Xiao Qing touched Xiang Nanli’s head, his tone calm. "Go back to sleep."

Xiang Nanli closed his eyes: "Oh, um...?"

Truly, what one thinks about by day, one dreams about by night!

He had been thinking about where to find the Quanrong tribe during the day, and at night, the Quanrong delivered themselves to his doorstep.

If only it were real.

Thinking this, Xiang Nanli turned over and fell into a deep sleep.

chunks.chineseText:
第200章 装了波大的

犬英对于大部队的突然赶来，是有些懵的。

“族长？我不是说情况有变，需要再观察观察吗？”

族长犬豪是一个壮硕的中年人，头发大波浪似的，很茂密。胸肌鼓鼓的袒露在外面；四肢粗壮有力，脸上有一道明显的刀疤。狗尾巴特别蓬松，特别巨大。

犬豪曾经是神庭的战士，因放心不下部落，选择提前退休，带着巨额养老金，回老家发展经济。

经济还没发展上来，就遇上草原十年一遇的大暴雪天气。被迫迁徙到大雪山脚下，和其他部落的人抱团取暖，度过寒冷的冬天。

左边的邻居是强盗，来抢劫还能打回去；右边的邻居却是可恶的小偷，趁犬戎部落和黑熊部落打仗，后方空虚，竟偷偷搬运走大堆物资！在犬戎部队回来之前就逃之夭夭！

老族长这个气啊！里面还有大批他从神庭内部购入的资源，都是为了促进族内后代发育的强效基因药！是他当神庭骑士三十年的工资！

别的骑士都在花天酒地，或者武装自己；犬豪只吃食堂、睡宿舍，闲下来还要去教堂打两份工攒钱。一想到部落的未来，犬豪就觉得这些牺牲都是值得的。

所以，当为年轻小崽们准备的药被偷，犬豪彻底怒了，发誓一定要在草原上揪出这群可恶的兔子。

当犬英的猎犬回到部落，说找到了狡兔部落的位置时；犬豪大喜过望，立即带着两千余人的先遣部队，马不停蹄地从几百公里外赶来。

平时要一个月的行程，他们硬是只花了七天。饿了吃干粮，渴了喝生水。除了睡眠管够，其他生理需求被压缩到极致。

这支部队的成员都是身经百战的战士，哪怕身体素质没到天启骑士的强度，也是草原上锐不可当的精兵悍将。征服一个不以武力见长的铁石部落绰绰有余。

“观察什么！”族长一脸怒容，“这群兔子还能翻了天不成？！放五百年前都是储备粮，也就神庭统治草原后，制定了不准同类相食的规矩。要不然，狡兔人早就被其他部落吃绝种了！”

犬英：“但是他们最近刚换族长；我从猢狲部落的商人那买来的消息。新族长是外地人，从利维坦过来的，自称加百列的眷属……”

并不是所有人嘴都严，接受过反间谍训练的。

相南里派了一队人，去猢狲部落购买物资。

狡兔人的生活骤然发生重大变故，很难保持镇静。它们需要一个渠道去宣泄，无论是炫耀还是表达不安。

犬豪瞪大眼：“加百列圣上不是魂归神国了吗？而且，如果没有新的加百列，按神庭的规矩，这些眷属会就近分配给其他大天使长。”

魂归神国是一个浪漫的说法，直白来说就是死了。

像玛门，分到的新主人就是米迦勒。

犬英挠了挠头，不是很聪明的脑袋晕乎乎的：“不知道呢。”

相南里给狡兔人的说法：神庭内部有人陷害加百列大人，他们要为加百列复仇。

这件事，内部听听就算了。稍微有点脑子的人，就不会往外说。

狡兔人也怕自己被牵连。毕竟神庭是真的会株人九族的。

他们愿意听话，一部分，是因为头上直属领导还是那些兔战士，他们是很习惯被奴役的；一部分，是因为生活条件得到了改善。

要为加百列、或者说，为“加西亚”拼命，那还得等黑牙仔这一代人长大。

犬豪咬牙：“不管了，总不能空着手回去吧？！随我上！”

东方青帝就是这时候醒来的。

他短暂的思考了一下策略。

擒贼先擒王？不，这些犬戎士兵和狡兔人不同。

杀死月兔，能迅速收服狡兔人，第一，兔子窝就在这，没有月兔的钥匙，他们也开不走福音书。第二，Alpha提前驯服了狡兔部落的高层，那些基因战士。第三，狡兔的信仰中就没有什么忠诚、仁爱的元素。月兔族长属于奴隶主，不受爱戴。

而杀死犬豪，这些忠心耿耿的犬戎人，一部分会选择自杀式袭击，想办法和东方青帝同归于尽；另一部分，会逃回部落，日后为自己的族长报仇。

这都不是东方青帝想看见的。

……

……

嘴上说冲，但实际上，犬豪还是很谨慎的。毕竟这关乎到手底下士兵的性命。有些部落的族长，只会把族人的命当作资产；有些，却会真的当成家人。犬豪无疑是后者。

2000名犬戎士兵把小土丘团团围住。

夜里很安静。虫鸣和鸟叫几乎都没有。厚厚的霾云掩盖天体的光线。

犬戎人能夜视。但弊端是，他们的眼睛会在夜里像路灯似的发光。很显眼。

犬豪掏出用200银币购买的夜视望远镜，观察着不远处的营地。（注：是从部落的税收神父那里买的，在枫叶丹，这样的望眼镜只需要20银币。）

兔子窝沉入地底，地面上，只有一些悬挂腊肉的木架和草砖。负责戒备的哨兵塔下，两名兔人士兵睡眼惺忪。抱着个长矛，坐在不甚明亮的火堆旁。

除此外，还有大批的牛羊睡在简陋的牧场内；脸上纹着刺青的奴隶负责看管。这些奴隶已经取得自由身，但工作内容没什么变化。它们智商不高，吩咐什么，就做什么。工作倒是完成的很认真。兔人士兵都快睡着了，奴隶还瞪大眼，坐在牛棚羊圈的哨岗位置，凝视前方。

“呵……”犬豪心里的蔑视更浓了，心想犬英果然大惊小怪。这种稀疏的防御部署，除非部落领袖有领主级别的战力，要不然拿什么抵御他们犬戎的精兵悍将？

犬豪率先发出一声狗叫，这是进攻的号角。两千名士兵在瞬间暴起，举起手中的武器，朝着小土丘冲去——

但很快，这群人就发现，自己用尽全力，竟然无法前进分毫。削铁如泥的钢刀砍在空气上，刀口竟然都会卷刃。

一堵看不见的气墙，挡在他们跟前，如同神迹。

被墙拦下的人越想冲开这面墙，反弹的力量就越强。

“我槽。我撞鬼了？”人群中，有人怪叫。

电量充裕后，Alpha获得了设备绝大部分功能的使用权限。

这堵由“磁力场”构建的墙就是其中之一。

墙覆盖范围越光，能源消耗越高。

理论上讲，只要有无限续航，Alpha完全可以构造出一面贯穿东西大陆的“柏林墙”。

几十万年后，墙两边的人类会演化出不同的人种。几百万年后，指不定会产生生殖隔离。

犬豪死死握住手里的大刀，他顾不得隐蔽，双眼亮的像是灯泡。

犬豪试图从一片黑暗中找到危险的来源，但入眼，只有同伴们茫然仓皇的脸。

“名字？”

冷冽的声音从他背后响起。

犬豪一个哆嗦，猛然回头，他本能地把刀对准东方青帝，但很快，理智让他把刀收回鞘中。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 200: A Grand Display

Quan Ying was somewhat bewildered by the sudden arrival of the main force.

"Chieftain? Didn't I say the situation had changed and we needed to observe further?"

The Chieftain, Quan Hao, was a sturdy middle-aged man with thick, wavy hair. His bulging pectoral muscles were exposed; his limbs were thick and powerful, and there was a distinct scar on his face. His dog tail was particularly fluffy and massive.

Quan Hao had once been a warrior of the Divine Court. Because he couldn't stop worrying about his tribe, he chose to retire early, taking his huge pension back to his hometown to develop the economy.

Before the economy could be developed, he encountered a once-in-a-decade blizzard on the grasslands. Forced to migrate to the foot of the Great Snow Mountain, they huddled together with other tribes to survive the cold winter.

His neighbor on the left was a bandit—if they came to rob, he could fight back. But his neighbor on the right was a despicable thief who, taking advantage of the Quanrong tribe being at war with the Black Bear tribe, had snuck in and hauled away a huge pile of supplies while their rear was empty! They had fled before the Quanrong troops could return!

The old Chieftain was furious! Among the stolen goods were a large number of resources he had purchased from within the Divine Court—potent genetic drugs meant to promote the development of the tribe's offspring! It was his salary from thirty years of serving as a Divine Court Knight!

While other knights were spending money on wine and women or arming themselves, Quan Hao only ate in the cafeteria, slept in the barracks, and worked two extra jobs at the church in his spare time to save money. Whenever he thought of the tribe’s future, Quan Hao felt these sacrifices were worth it.

Therefore, when the medicine prepared for the young cubs was stolen, Quan Hao was completely enraged, swearing he would ferret out this group of detestable rabbits on the grasslands.

When Quan Ying’s hounds returned to the tribe and reported that they had found the location of the Cunning Rabbit Tribe, Quan Hao was overjoyed and immediately led a vanguard of over two thousand men, rushing over without stopping from hundreds of kilometers away.

The journey that usually took a month was completed in just seven days. When hungry, they ate dry rations; when thirsty, they drank raw water. Except for getting enough sleep, all other physiological needs were compressed to the extreme.

The members of this force were battle-hardened warriors; even if their physical fitness hadn't reached the level of an Apocalypse Knight, they were still sharp, unstoppable elite soldiers on the grasslands. Conquering the Iron Stone Tribe, which was not known for its martial prowess, was more than enough.

"Observe what!" The Chieftain’s face was full of rage. "Can these rabbits really turn the world upside down?! Five hundred years ago, they were just reserve rations. It was only after the Divine Court ruled the grasslands and established the rule against cannibalism that they survived. Otherwise, the Cunning Rabbit people would have been eaten to extinction by other tribes long ago!"

Quan Ying: "But they just changed their Chieftain recently; I got the news from a merchant of the Monkey Tribe. The new Chieftain is an outsider from Leviathan, claiming to be a retainer of Gabriel..."

Not everyone was tight-lipped or trained in counter-espionage.

Xiang Nanli had sent a team to the Monkey Tribe to purchase supplies.

The Cunning Rabbit people had experienced a major change in their lives and found it hard to remain calm. They needed an outlet to vent, whether to show off or to express their anxiety.

Quan Hao’s eyes widened: "Didn't His Holiness Gabriel return his soul to the Divine Kingdom? Besides, if there is no new Gabriel, according to the Divine Court’s rules, these retainers would be reassigned to other Archangels nearby."

"Returning the soul to the Divine Kingdom" was a romantic way of saying he was dead.

Like Mammon, the new master he was assigned to was Michael.

Quan Ying scratched his head, his not-so-bright brain feeling dizzy: "I don't know."

The explanation Xiang Nanli gave the Cunning Rabbit people: Someone within the Divine Court framed Lord Gabriel, and they were going to take revenge for him.

This matter was something to be heard internally and left at that. Anyone with a modicum of brains wouldn't talk about it outside.

The Cunning Rabbit people were also afraid of being implicated. After all, the Divine Court really would exterminate one's entire clan.

They were willing to obey, partly because their direct leaders were still those rabbit warriors—they were very accustomed to being enslaved—and partly because their living conditions had improved.

As for fighting to the death for Gabriel—or rather, for "Garcia"—that would have to wait until the generation of Black Tooth grew up.

Quan Hao gritted his teeth: "Forget it, we can't go back empty-handed, right?! Follow me!"

It was at this moment that Dongfang Qingdi woke up.

He briefly considered his strategy.

Capture the leader first? No, these Quanrong soldiers were different from the Cunning Rabbit people.

Killing the Moon Rabbit would quickly subdue the Cunning Rabbit people. First, the Rabbit Burrow was right here, and without the Moon Rabbit’s key, they couldn't drive the Gospel Book away. Second, Alpha had already tamed the high-level genetic warriors of the Cunning Rabbit tribe. Third, there were no elements of loyalty or benevolence in the Cunning Rabbit’s faith. The Moon Rabbit Chieftain was a slave owner and not beloved.

But if he killed Quan Hao, these loyal Quanrong soldiers would either choose suicide attacks, trying to take Dongfang Qingdi down with them, or they would flee back to the tribe and seek revenge for their Chieftain later.

None of this was what Dongfang Qingdi wanted to see.

...

...

Although he talked about charging, Quan Hao was actually very cautious. After all, this concerned the lives of the soldiers under his command. Some tribal chieftains treated their people's lives as assets; others truly treated them like family. Quan Hao was undoubtedly the latter.

Two thousand Quanrong soldiers surrounded the small mound.

The night was very quiet. There was almost no chirping of insects or birds. Thick smog clouds obscured the light of the celestial bodies.

The Quanrong could see in the dark. But the drawback was that their eyes would glow like streetlights at night. It was very conspicuous.

Quan Hao took out a night-vision telescope purchased for 200 silver coins to observe the camp not far away. (Note: It was bought from the tribe’s tax priest; in Maple Leaf City, such a telescope only cost 20 silver coins.)

The Rabbit Burrow had sunk into the ground. On the surface, there were only some wooden racks hanging cured meat and grass bricks. Under the sentry tower responsible for guarding, two rabbit soldiers were sleeping with bleary eyes, holding spears and sitting by a dim campfire.

Besides that, there were large numbers of cattle and sheep sleeping in a crude pasture; slaves with tattoos on their faces were responsible for watching them. These slaves had already gained their freedom, but their work content hadn't changed much. They didn't have high intelligence, so they just did whatever they were told. They completed their work very diligently. The rabbit soldiers were almost asleep, but the slaves still had their eyes wide open, sitting at the sentry posts of the cattle sheds and sheep pens, staring ahead.

"Heh..." The contempt in Quan Hao’s heart grew stronger, thinking that Quan Ying was indeed making a fuss over nothing. With such sparse defensive deployments, unless the tribal leader had Lord-level combat power, how could they resist the elite warriors of his Quanrong?

Quan Hao was the first to let out a dog bark, which was the horn of attack. Two thousand soldiers erupted in an instant, raising their weapons and charging toward the small mound—

But soon, this group of people discovered that despite using all their strength, they couldn't advance even an inch. Steel blades that could cut through iron like mud struck the air, and the edges of the blades actually curled.

An invisible wall of air stood before them, like a miracle.

The more those blocked by the wall tried to push through, the stronger the rebounding force became.

"What the hell. Did I hit a ghost?" Someone in the crowd shrieked.

After the battery was fully charged, Alpha gained access to most of the device's functions.

This wall constructed by a "magnetic field" was one of them.

The wider the wall’s coverage, the higher the energy consumption.

Theoretically speaking, as long as there was infinite battery life, Alpha could completely construct a "Berlin Wall" that spanned the Eastern and Western Continents.

Hundreds of thousands of years later, the humans on both sides of the wall would evolve into different races. Millions of years later, there might even be reproductive isolation.

Quan Hao gripped his broadsword tightly. He didn't care about concealment anymore; his eyes were shining like light bulbs.

Quan Hao tried to find the source of the danger in the darkness, but all he saw were the bewildered and panicked faces of his companions.

"Name?"

A cold, sharp voice sounded from behind him.

Quan Hao shuddered and turned back abruptly. He instinctively aimed his sword at Dongfang Qingdi, but soon, his reason made him sheath the blade.

他扫了眼，不认识。看打扮，不像神庭的风格。外地人……？不，在犬豪看来，更像是人联或者智械那边的角色。但是这种人，为什么会出现在草原上？神庭知道吗？

拥有这样伟力的大人物，随时可以取走他的性命。他的反抗没有任何意义。

“大人。”犬豪低下头，强行压下语句里的颤音，“我叫犬豪，是犬戎部落的族长。之前，狡兔部落的人偷走了我们的基因药。我不知道您已经占领了狡兔部落。很抱歉冒犯了您。我们马上撤退，等回部落后，我会差犬英送上赔礼。”

犬豪不愧是去大城市打过工的人。说话进退有度，态度很低。

不低不行。全家人的性命，也许都在眼前这人的一念之间。

至于回去后……犬戎略微思索，不太确定要不要把这个消息转告给神庭。

如果是几百年的神庭，信誉还是很好的。但现在嘛。犬戎说不出来，只是觉得和它打交道很累。

米迦勒要出征，勒令部落交出三千名青壮。但神庭骑士有自己的骑士团，这三千名犬戎人，是去前线，当最辛苦、伤亡率最高的辎重兵。

辎重兵，打仗的时候冲在前面当炮灰，分摊火力；不打仗的时候顶着敌人的监控，挖战壕、运粮草。很辛苦。然而，每个辎重兵的补贴才10银币。这和强行买一批自由人当奴隶有什么区别？死亡补贴倒是不少，可是，人死了，要这些补贴有什么用？

犬豪很不甘心，可他用尽在神庭内的关系，也只是把名额从3000降到了2500。

人联要来就来吧……他只想让自己的部落过上好日子。可什么才是好日子，犬豪自己说不清。起码，得像八座圣城里的自由民一样吧？

东方青帝扫了他一眼。犬豪的数据面板出现在他的后台中。

-犬豪（r）

-战力等级：lv.35（高于普通畸变人，低于在职天启骑士）

-智力：6

-外貌：4

好吧，起码是有等级的r卡，普通人都是n卡。

“你吵到我主人睡觉了。”东方青帝平静道，“留下。等他醒来再处理。”

说完，他在地上划出一条白线。

“不要超过这条线。”他吩咐。

东方青帝消失在原地，和他出现一样无影无踪。

阻拦这群人的气墙也跟着消散。

如果不是地上那条白线还在，犬豪几乎怀疑，自己是在做梦。

犬英这才敢喘气：“族长，那现在怎么办？”

犬豪很想说“跑”，但东方青帝表现出的实力，让他没有赌一把的勇气。

他咬牙道：“还能怎么办，等吧！”

He scanned him, but didn't recognize him. Judging by his attire, it wasn't the style of the Divine Court. An outsider...? No, in Quan Hao’s view, he looked more like a character from the Human Alliance or the Intelligent Machines. But why would such a person appear on the grasslands? Did the Divine Court know?

A big shot with such great power could take his life at any moment. His resistance was meaningless.

"My Lord." Quan Hao lowered his head, forcing down the tremor in his voice. "My name is Quan Hao, Chieftain of the Quanrong tribe. Previously, people from the Cunning Rabbit tribe stole our genetic medicine. I didn't know you had already occupied the Cunning Rabbit tribe. I am very sorry for offending you. We will retreat immediately, and after returning to the tribe, I will have Quan Ying send over a compensation gift."

Quan Hao was indeed someone who had worked in big cities. He spoke with propriety and maintained a humble attitude.

He had to be humble. The lives of his entire family might be at the whim of the person before him.

As for after he returned... Quan Hao pondered slightly, unsure whether to report this news to the Divine Court.

If it were the Divine Court of a few hundred years ago, their reputation would still be good. But now? Quan Hao couldn't put it into words; he just felt that dealing with them was exhausting.

Michael was going on an expedition and ordered the tribe to hand over three thousand young, able-bodied men. But the Divine Court Knights had their own knight orders; these three thousand Quanrong men were going to the front lines to serve as the most arduous baggage troops with the highest casualty rates.

Baggage troops had to charge to the front as cannon fodder during battles to distribute enemy fire; when not fighting, they had to dig trenches and transport supplies under enemy surveillance. It was very hard work. Yet, the subsidy for each baggage soldier was only 10 silver coins. How was this any different from forcibly buying a batch of free men as slaves? The death benefit was quite high, but once a person was dead, what was the use of these benefits?

Quan Hao was very unwilling, but even using all his connections within the Divine Court, he only managed to lower the quota from 3,000 to 2,500.

If the Human Alliance wanted to come, let them come... He just wanted his tribe to live a good life. But what a "good life" was, Quan Hao himself couldn't say. At the very least, it should be like the free citizens in the eight holy cities, right?

Dongfang Qingdi glanced at him. Quan Hao’s data panel appeared in his backend.

- Quan Hao (R)

- Combat Power Level: Lv. 35 (Higher than ordinary mutants, lower than an active Apocalypse Knight)

- Intelligence: 6

- Appearance: 4

Well, at least it was an R-card with a level; ordinary people were all N-cards.

"You disturbed my master’s sleep," Dongfang Qingdi said calmly. "Stay here. Wait until he wakes up to deal with you."

After saying this, he drew a white line on the ground.

"Do not cross this line," he commanded.

Dongfang Qingdi vanished from the spot, as traceless as when he had appeared.

The wall of air that had blocked the group also dissipated.

If not for the white line still on the ground, Quan Hao would have almost suspected he was dreaming.

Only then did Quan Ying dare to breathe: "Chieftain, what should we do now?"

Quan Hao wanted to say "run," but the strength Dongfang Qingdi had displayed left him without the courage to gamble.

He gritted his teeth and said: "What else can we do? We wait!"

第201章 加西亚

相南里在早上七点准时醒来。

最近他喜欢睡在工棚。

工棚位于兔子窝的地下，帐篷往外一拉，桌子上就是画了一半的设计图。

每天清早，小青会强制他锻炼身体四十分钟。服用营养补剂的同时，一楼的餐厅的餐桌上会自动刷新营养美味的早餐。

相南里抻着懒腰进入电梯，顺便打开今天的行程安排表。

“咦？”

他的目光聚焦在“早饭时间”后面的一行字上。

“处理犬戎部落归属问题……？”

这项行程后面有一个感叹号，可以点开。点开后就是Alpha写的备注。

“6月21日凌晨4点17分，犬戎部落族长犬豪率2000士兵入侵分基地，已初步降服。该部落为地表中型人类据点。总人口（不包括未登记在册的奴隶）约6万人。等待进一步处理。”

原来昨天不是在做梦啊。

这段备注不仅有文字版，还有一段视频。

小青是台很有心机的智械。

视频里的机位不但近远景切换，还有音乐铺垫。他的出场在精湛的剪辑下显得更帅气了。

相南里走出电梯，在餐桌前坐下。

贤惠的丈夫端来今天的早餐。

主食是香煎旅鹭鸟。异种鸟本身肉质很柴，但小青特地选取幼鸟身上最嫩的翅根部分（因此多宰了几只鸟），煎出油脂后唇齿留香。相南里一直都吃不腻。

碳水选用的基地自种青土豆，表皮成青色，弹珠大小。

这是桃源牧业育种的农作物，是普通土豆嵌入豆科植物基因片段杂交出来的品种（注：土豆是茄科）；产量高，易存活；是地表常见的主粮之一。

但相南里之前却没怎么见过。幸存者基地建在长生天高原上，那里的环境更恶劣，青土豆都种不活。

在幸存者基地种植的青麦在市场上流通前，高原上流通的粮食十分依赖姑苏城进口。

另外还搭配了新鲜的苦菊、芝麻菜。是小青水培种出来的。

相南里笑眯眯地问：“小青，视频我看了。谁是你的主人啊？”

相南里有时候促狭的可怕。

东方青帝的脸上有一瞬间的……类似恼羞成怒的神色。像是小众XP突然被拉到光天化日之下朗读。

但Alpha足够了解相南里。如果真的把这句话当成指令的话，害羞的就是相南里了。

他和相南里对视，认真且郑重地回答：“你是我的主人。我为你而来，因你而生。”

果然，相南里半天说不出一句话，从脸颊到耳根慢慢红透。手里的筷子都拿不利索，嘴里嘟囔着“吃完了我去上班”，很迅速地跑掉了。

……

……

犬豪和自己的一帮手下坐在露天的山坡上，心情是度日如年。

他不敢睡觉，瞪大眼，看着天色一点点亮起。

早晨六点，天还没亮，兔人们从窝里钻出来，在草坪上站出方方正正的矩形。

草原上全民皆兵。犬豪一眼就能看出，这群兔子是在训练。但……

“太整齐了。”犬豪的目光不自觉被吸引住，嘴里喃喃着。

草原上人人善战，但不代表他们拥有现代化有纪律的军队。很多部落还停留在“凑数”阶段，不管高矮胖瘦男女，手脚健全就编成一队。到作战时，总有人当逃兵。有一个人逃跑，周围人就会跟着跑。战场乱的像是一锅粥。

这也是没办法的事。

知识太闭塞，没有人教过这些首领如何训练自己的族人。犬豪也是当过十几年天启骑士，才朦朦胧胧的知道该怎么做。

狡兔部落却不一样。到底是哪里不同，犬豪说不出来……只是觉得这些方队特别整齐、很有纪律。

方队的士兵从高到矮排序，分青年兵和少年兵。首领吹一声号子，底下人跟着动一下。

犬豪上过战场，他很清楚，一支训练有素、纪律严明的军队，在地表对其他部队，能造成多大的杀伤力。

犬英嘟囔：“族长，看吧。之前就是看到这些，我才让你不要轻举妄动的。”

犬豪眉头的“川”字更深了。

兔人早就发现了这群位于山坡偏僻角落的不速之客。甚至有些天性上的害怕。

只是首领没说撤退，他们只好当犬戎人不存在。

他们是先训练，再吃饭！不好好训练，因为害怕犬戎人临阵脱逃，就没饭吃！更重要的是，不守纪律，首领们会体罚。

之前有刺头不服管教，被首领脱光上衣鞭笞，浑身都血淋淋的，用基因药吊着；在营地前方的旗杆上挂了两天才放下来。

“才吃几天饱饭，就忘了好日子是怎么来的。让你们训练，又不是让你们去死！这都敢偷懒？！现在训练不认真，以后打仗不仅是害你自己，还害你队友！”首领骂骂咧咧的。

狡兔军队实行连坐制。一人偷懒，全组一起挨罚。谁都不想成为团队里的拖累。

而每个小队里表现好的战士，能在训练后领到珍贵的盐和糖。

就这样恩威并施，基地用最短时间，把懒散的兔人们训练成精锐部队。

这套模式在基地的几座城市都推行过，效果很好；照搬到草原上也是一样的好用。

毕竟环境再复杂，人性却是相似的。

犬豪心里的三分服气，暗中涨到五分。哪怕没有东方青帝，这支一万人的狡兔部队，他们2000人也是啃不下来的。

90分钟后，实战演练结束，士兵们按照演习的排名，分批次进入食堂吃早饭。

犬豪舔了舔唇，有些饿。但还是不敢动。他清楚，这是那群人的下马威。神秘的势力看起来很强势，他们只能表现地愈发顺从。

好在，几分钟后，一辆改装过的黑色轿车朝着山坡驶来。

很少见——草原上当然也是有车的，但多半是越野车或空气动力车。后者更贵，几乎只在几座神庭城市内出现。人联稀疏平常的科技，在这里是奢侈品和禁忌。

车在空地停下。犬戎人们手持武器，谨慎地站在犬豪身边。既像是害怕地躲在家长身后；又像是围在族长跟前，充当护卫和脊梁。

相南里坐在后车厢，透过单向玻璃往外看去，心想，当年哥伦布发现新大陆后，欧洲的殖民者像鬣狗一样闻着味赶来；那些印第安人面对陌生的火枪，是否也是同样的心情？

但还是有些不同的。起码相南里不会用火枪对付他们。

他带来的是更珍贵的东西。类似春天、火种和希望。

犬豪看见，车窗微微摇下来一小截。一只洁白的手，从窗户里探了出来，微微挥了一下。

和草原上的人不一样，这只手上看不见伤口和茧子，养尊处优、骨节分明。

犬豪莫名有些自惭形秽。

东方青帝从驾驶位下车，关门，面无表情：“大人让你进去说话。”

“我？我吗？”

犬豪有些局促、拘谨地走过去，以近乎爬的姿势坐上副驾驶的位置。

他在神庭驾驶过生物机甲，却没有坐过轿车。
