第210章 749

春去秋又来。草原上的夏天短暂的像朝露。
　　某天，相南里醒来，发现帐篷外的河草从翠绿转向绿黄。
　　他第一时间给小青写信，记录下这个好消息。
　　“亲爱的小青，展信佳。”
　　大草原上基建不好，要等占领猢狲部落，才好搭建服务器。因此，小青不在的日子里，相南里专门养了一只旅鹭鸟，充当信使。
　　“在我沉睡的近千年间，世界上的确多了许多我无法理解的东西。在进一步拆分路西法时，我触碰到了‘神术封印’。简单来说，就是神庭的技术保密系统，路西法差点自爆。（但我有把握让系统停下，我不会拿自己的生命开玩笑）
　　“它要是自爆，草原上大概会有一朵蘑菇云？看来下次这种危险的实验还是要等你在场。”
　　“我喜欢秋天。秋天过后是冬和春。冬天和春天都让我想起你。”
　　相南里写信习惯用纸和笔，而小青寄回来的，往往是一枚芯片。内容很多，有工作汇报，也有单纯路上的风景。
　　相南里问小智：“你说小青寄回来的视频，算AI生成视频吗？”
　　他自问自答：“不算吧。拍摄不是生成。”
　　小智：[……]
　　人类的好奇心对人工智能来说还是太超标了。
　　跟着河草一起变黄的，是新开垦出的数百亩农田。
　　草原的土壤不够肥沃，但土地平坦开阔，非常适合集成化耕作。
　　联合部落的人花了半个月时间，把大片的野生河草割掉，烧成肥。
　　人们在新沤的肥田里埋进一批青麦粒。几个月后，麦穗抽条，还给大地一片河草似的青麦。
　　麦子将熟未熟，散发出一股独属于粮食的香气。
　　相南里上辈子十指不沾阳春水，鞋底都没沾过什么灰，这辈子跟着福音书，倒是学会了不少农活。
　　农忙时，哪怕是基地的司令，也要开着他的高达一号，帮忙抢收麦苗的。
　　战场是后勤部门最严峻的考场。相南里一连写了好几篇论文，现在他治下也有百万人了，两边都有战事，总结经验是非常有必要的。《地表群众战前动员》、《低科技水平下的战术反思》、《常规条件下经济与农业发展模型》……这几篇都要通过福音书发表内参，推广到更多地上城市。
　　如果据点的管理也能像写代码一样简单就好了。
　　为了过冬，相南里分出部落里为冬天准备的大部分粮食，充作军粮。部落里的辎重兵负责把一车车粮食运往前线。跟着一起离开的还有近2万人的部队。他们义无反顾地扛起了解放猢狲部落的使命。除了训练的狡兔人，还有一千犬戎人。是犬豪当时留下的。
　　远征军还没凯旋，犬戎人的大部队先一步抵达。
　　跟着一起来的，还有两台智械人。齐思久和齐武陵。
　　“哎呀，你们派来的两名干部真是帮了大忙了……”犬豪刚抵达部落，握住相南里的手就开始大吐苦水，“我们在迁徙路上遇到了行军蚁。”
　　行军蚁，草原上的异种之一。食肉，食腐。外表是有半人高的蚂蚁，但有着鲨鱼一样两排长倒钩的尖牙。口腔能分泌蚁酸。普通人被咬上一口，很难见到明天的太阳。
　　而最恐怖的是，它们还是群居。行军蚁体型比正常蚂蚁大数倍，饭量惊人，可谓是草原上的“蝗虫”。
　　一个中型部落遭遇行军蚁，也只能想办法暂避锋芒。像它们这种迁徙中的小部落，极有可能全军覆没。被吃的连骨架都不剩。
　　当遭遇行军蚁的时候，犬豪是极其绝望的。青年人跑得快，老人和幼童怎么办？人能跑？物资又怎么办？迎战吗？这群异种保守估计有上万只。至少需要十万训练有素的部队。犬戎部落的战士满打满算也就三万。
　　就在这种危急时刻，一直在队伍里充当吉祥物的749和750站了出来。
　　749从随身携带的行李箱里组装成一套奇怪的金属设备，架在自己身上。
　　这套设备是生物磁场干扰装置。没办法单独使用，需要用它的身体作为基站。
　　750则是背上一个塑料桶，像是要给行道树施肥的园林工。他绕着犬戎人的帐篷车队，喷上一圈气味刺鼻的液体。
　　犬豪出于好奇，小声询问：“这是什么？”
　　750戴着防毒面具，表情格外淡然：“发情期的畸变人的尿液。”
　　为了采集到这种液体，他和749可是追踪了一头爬行者整整一年！那头爬行者身长足足35m，是草原上罕见的“大货”，还是野生的（草原上大多畸变人都由神庭专门驯养），采集难度可想而知。
　　在某些网站，这一行为甚至能打上这样的tag：机械、人外、强制、口口。
　　犬豪：“……”
　　生物手段和科技手段双管齐下，行军蚁竟然真的放弃了近在咫尺的食物。调头就走。
　　犬豪说到这，脸上满是感谢。
　　相南里被他摇晃的胳膊疼，脸上笑容不变，心里却像名画《呐喊》里的小人一样抱头尖叫：“我tm什么时候派去过干部？！”
　　不管如何，他在半小时后，在自己的办公室，见到了两位干部。
　　东方青帝并没有对相南里提起过这件事。主要是不确定脱离军团许久的749和750是否会听从自己的指令。
　　要是他说了，749、750都没来，他不要面子的吗？
　　几乎只需要一眼，相南里确定：这是两台智械。
　　它们显然是高级货色。很多智械人只是外表上像人，但仔细观察，就会发现是假人。而这两台智械，从肉眼看，几乎和普通人没有差别。用的仿生材料全是高级货。
　　相南里也说不上来自己怎么判定的，大概是一种神秘的天赋。
　　有些人拥有绝对音准，有些人有绝对色感。很多人的天赋终其一生也没被发现。要不然就是没有和时代匹配上。而他的天赋就是对智械的感知？
　　“你们好。”相南里放下手里的笔，伸手，示意两人坐下，“犬豪说，你们是接到‘东青’的指令过来的。”
　　750好奇地打量着这间办公室——不大，没什么彰显个性的艺术品。不是拼了一半的零件，就是纸质文件。部落有造纸厂，新建的。
　　749双手抱胸，语气很冷淡：“我们并不听命于Alpha。它只是智械的初号机，不是我们的上帝。我和750是自由的。我们来这里，只是听说了一个传闻。”
　　他直接叫破东方青帝的身份，显然是不愿意和相南里打哑谜。
　　相南里微笑着望着他，像是在鼓励他继续说下去。
　　749瞳孔里深红的光圈亮起：“你是相南里吗？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 210: 749

Spring departed and autumn arrived. Summer on the grasslands was as fleeting as morning dew.
One day, Xiang Nanli woke up to find that the river grass outside his tent had turned from emerald green to a greenish-yellow.
He immediately wrote a letter to Xiao Qing, recording this good news.
"Dear Xiao Qing, I hope this letter finds you well."
Infrastructure on the vast grasslands was poor; he would have to wait until they occupied the Macaque tribe to set up servers. Therefore, during the days Xiao Qing was away, Xiang Nanli specifically kept a migratory heron to act as a messenger.
"In the nearly thousand years I slept, there have indeed been many things in the world I cannot understand. While further dismantling Lucifer, I touched upon the 'Divine Art Seal.' Simply put, it is the Divine Court’s technical secrecy system; Lucifer almost self-destructed. (But I am confident I can stop the system; I wouldn't joke with my own life.)"
"If it had self-destructed, there would probably be a mushroom cloud on the grasslands? It seems next time, such dangerous experiments should wait until you are present."
"I like autumn. After autumn comes winter and spring. Both winter and spring remind me of you."
Xiang Nanli was accustomed to using paper and pen for letters, while what Xiao Qing sent back was often a chip. The content was extensive, including work reports and simply the scenery from his travels.
Xiang Nanli asked Xiao Zhi: "Do you think the videos Xiao Qing sends back count as AI-generated videos?"
He answered his own question: "I suppose not. Filming is not generating."
Xiao Zhi: [...]
Human curiosity was still too excessive for artificial intelligence.
Along with the river grass turning yellow, hundreds of acres of newly reclaimed farmland were also changing.
The soil of the grasslands was not fertile enough, but the land was flat and open, making it very suitable for integrated farming.
The Joint Tribe spent half a month cutting down the vast stretches of wild river grass and burning it into fertilizer.
People buried a batch of green wheat grains into the newly composted fields. A few months later, the wheat ears sprouted, returning a field of green wheat to the earth that looked just like the river grass.
The wheat was nearly ripe, emitting a fragrance unique to grain.
In his past life, Xiang Nanli had never lifted a finger to do housework, nor had his soles ever touched much dust. In this life, following the Gospel, he had actually learned quite a bit of farm work.
During the busy farming season, even as the Commander of the base, he had to drive his Gundam No. 1 to help harvest the wheat seedlings.
The battlefield was the most rigorous examination room for the logistics department. Xiang Nanli had written several papers in a row. Now that he governed a million people and there were wars on both sides, summarizing experience was essential. *Pre-war Mobilization of Surface Masses*, *Tactical Reflections under Low-Tech Levels*, *Economic and Agricultural Development Models under Conventional Conditions*... all these papers had to be published as internal references through the Gospel and promoted to more surface cities.
If only managing a stronghold were as simple as writing code.
To survive the winter, Xiang Nanli diverted most of the grain prepared for winter in the tribe to serve as military rations. The tribe’s logistics troops were responsible for transporting cart after cart of grain to the front lines. Nearly 20,000 troops left with them, shouldering the mission of liberating the Macaque tribe without hesitation. In addition to the trained Cunning Rabbit people, there were a thousand Quanrong. They were the ones Quan Hao had left behind at the time.
Before the expeditionary army could return in triumph, the main force of the Quanrong arrived first.
Accompanying them were two Mechanoids: Qi Sijiu and Qi Wuling.
"Oh my, the two cadres you sent were a huge help..." As soon as Quan Hao arrived at the base, he gripped Xiang Nanli’s hand and began to pour out his grievances, "We encountered army ants on our migration."
Army ants were one of the alien species on the grasslands. They were carnivorous and scavengers. They appeared as ants half a human’s height, but possessed double rows of long, barbed fangs like a shark. Their mouths could secrete formic acid. If an ordinary person were bitten once, it would be hard to see the sun the next day.
And the most terrifying thing was that they were gregarious. The army ants were several times larger than normal ants and had astonishing appetites; they could be called the "locusts" of the grasslands.
When a medium-sized tribe encountered army ants, they could only try to avoid their edge. A small tribe like theirs, in the middle of migration, was highly likely to be wiped out entirely—eaten until not even a skeleton remained.
When they encountered the army ants, Quan Hao was extremely desperate. The young could run fast, but what about the elderly and children? Could people run? What about the supplies? Should they fight? This group of alien species was conservatively estimated to be in the tens of thousands. It would require at least a hundred thousand well-trained troops. The Quanrong tribe’s warriors numbered only thirty thousand at most.
It was at this critical moment that 749 and 750, who had been acting as mascots in the team, stood up.
749 assembled a strange metal device from the suitcase it carried and mounted it on its body.
This device was a biological magnetic field interference unit. It couldn't be used alone and required its body to act as a base station.
750 carried a plastic bucket on its back, looking like a gardener about to fertilize street trees. It circled the Quanrong’s tent convoy, spraying a circle of pungent liquid.
Out of curiosity, Quan Hao asked in a low voice: "What is this?"
750 wore a gas mask, its expression exceptionally calm: "Urine from a mutant in heat."
To collect this liquid, it and 749 had tracked a Crawler for an entire year! That Crawler was a full 35 meters long, a rare "big catch" on the grasslands, and a wild one at that (most mutants on the grasslands were specially domesticated by the Divine Court). The difficulty of collection could be imagined.
On certain websites, this behavior could even be tagged with: Mechanical, Non-human, Forced, [Censored].
Quan Hao: "..."
With both biological and technological means, the army ants actually gave up on the food that was right in front of them and turned away.
As Quan Hao spoke of this, his face was full of gratitude.
Xiang Nanli’s arm was being shaken until it hurt. His smile remained unchanged, but inside, he was screaming like the figure in the famous painting *The Scream*: "When the hell did I ever send out cadres?!"
Regardless, half an hour later, in his office, he met the two cadres.
The Eastern Azure Emperor had never mentioned this to Xiang Nanli. It was mainly because he wasn't sure if 749 and 750, who had been away from the Legion for so long, would obey his orders.
If he had said something and 749 and 750 hadn't come, wouldn't he have lost face?
Almost at a single glance, Xiang Nanli was certain: these were two Mechanoids.
They were clearly high-end goods. Many Mechanoids only looked like humans on the surface, but upon closer inspection, one would find they were fakes. These two Mechanoids, to the naked eye, were almost indistinguishable from ordinary people. The bionic materials used were all top-tier.
Xiang Nanli couldn't say how he judged it; it was probably a mysterious talent.
Some people possessed absolute pitch, others had absolute color sense. Many people’s talents were never discovered in their entire lives, or they simply didn't match the era. And his talent was the perception of Mechanoids?
"Hello." Xiang Nanli put down his pen, reached out, and gestured for the two to sit, "Quan Hao said you came here after receiving orders from 'Dong Qing'."
750 curiously looked around the office—it wasn't large, and there were no artworks displaying personality. It was either half-assembled parts or paper documents. The tribe had a paper mill, a newly built one.
749 crossed its arms, its tone very cold: "We do not take orders from Alpha. It is merely the prototype of the Mechanoids, not our God. 750 and I are free. We came here only because we heard a rumor."
It directly called out the Eastern Azure Emperor’s identity, clearly unwilling to play word games with Xiang Nanli.
Xiang Nanli looked at it with a smile, as if encouraging it to continue.
A deep red ring of light lit up in 749’s pupils: "Are you Xiang Nanli?"

第211章 信仰之战

你是不是相南里？

这个问题，自从解冻来，已经有数不清的人问过他。

相南里琢磨了一下，如果他生活的年代，有人说自己是爱因斯坦，其实没死，现在靠木乃伊保鲜技术复活了，他大概也会觉得匪夷所思。

相南里的手搭在书桌上，敲了敲：“这重要吗？如果今天人联的总统叫相南里，亦或者神庭的神座叫相南里。仅此，你们就会抛弃自己原本的信念，转而去追随这样的组织吗？”

749想，自己当然不会这样，它是台成熟的智械了。但一些拟人模块发育不完全的智械会。

你是相南里——你难道不知道这三个字对我们有着什么样的意义吗？

每个孤儿都会幻想自己的母亲。

人类的造物主遥不可及，而智械的造物主却近在咫尺。

749感觉一口气堵在嗓子眼，片刻后，他抓住750的胳膊往外走。

要离开办公室时，749骤然停下脚步：“你知道吗？在智械的拟人模块中，爱和恨产生的加密数据非常相似。”

相南里：“嗯？”

749的唇紧绷着，看起来很严肃：“我的一些同伴，也许会因为太爱你而想杀死你或Alpha。人类的神话不也这样？俄狄浦斯王成年后弑父娶母。”

相南里沉默许久，才开始处理下一份工作。

“他什么意思？你们智械把我当妈了？”

相南里翻开《智械简史》的第一页，这本书是Alpha在新历111年编撰的。

第一页赫然写着：永远怀念智械之父相南里。

事实上，这本书里关于相南里的记录并不多。一方面，那时候的alpha还是半失忆的状态；另一方面，alpha非常小气，不希望有任何人分享它的回忆。

小智有些许愤怒地回答：[它中毒了吧！神机病！]

……

黄金草原西南角。

东方青帝站在卡车顶端，车又停在山坡上，这是附近视野最高点。

东方青帝的眼眸微微亮着，他的视线中，草原消失了，正在草原上互搏的两方人马也消失了，那些简陋的建筑更是如同尘埃一样被忽略。一座崭新现代化的城市在规划、建设并逐步升级。

这是一份城乡规划图，小青把它保存到自己的后台中，满意地点点头。

随着科技发展，几乎所有地形都可以建设城市。但像黄金草原这种开阔的大平原，依然是发展首选。

猢狲部落这块地就比狡兔部落的地盘要好一些。有城市基础，甚至略通水电。东方青帝看见了城市内的电灯。

“大人，”就在此时，犬戎士兵上前汇报，“我们按照您的吩咐，在凌晨进行突袭。外城墙已经攻破，但猢狲人请来外援……”

犬戎人咽了口唾沫，语气有些颤抖：“是一名神官。”

猢狲部落在面对外敌时，表现出一个银帐部落应有的顽强。可惜他们面对的不是草原上的原始部落，而是使用了现代训练体系的高度协调的作战部队。并且装备有现代性的武器。

猢狲部落节节衰退，但他们有钱，于是花重金请神庭的税务官出面。

部落里的税务官是地位超然的存在。一般只有年底才会过来。但最近是猢狲部落的“洗礼日”，他们请来神官，为部落里的孩子沐浴神恩，赐下图腾。

用种姓制度去描述，神官就是草原上唯一的“婆罗门”，兼具传教和敛财的双重使命。有他出面，再强大的部落也会退避三舍。谁也不会在草原上得罪神庭……除非对面请出地位更高的“婆罗门”。

东方青帝眯起眼：“神官？所以呢？他是有不死之身吗？”

犬戎人回复：“不，大人。”

“那就杀了他。”东方青帝的语气如此平静。仿佛那不是一名神官，而是一只家禽。

犬戎人是被临时征调的。但狡兔人却已经吃了三个月军饷。

在犬戎人还在迟疑时，那些他们原本看不起的兔人傲然抬头道：“是，长官！”眼神里没有恐惧，只有服从与狂热。

军队的存在是反人性的。因为它无限削弱着个体的存在，把纪律和集体的观念根植在每个人的心里。只有在这样的洗脑下，才能让个体把生死和信仰都置于命令之下。

当然，Alpha觉得这其实很麻烦，人会不听话。像智械，只需要接受芯片的电信号。

神官出场十分正式。

那位神官，换上自己的教服——白色的长袍搭配金色的绶带，头戴嵌有蓝色宝石的教冠，握着一柄精巧的权杖。神官坐在机械动力的马车上，神色傲然。

这套行头曾在草原上无往不利。

“你们是犬戎人？怎么还有狡兔人？你们到底是哪个部落的？停战，让族长来觐见我。”神官朗声道，神术装置让他的声音极其洪亮。（其实就是扩音器，但他们把无法自然生产的科技物品统称为神术装置，反正原始人也没见过）

神官体型肥胖，有两层下巴。这在食不果腹的地表是雍容华贵的标志。

随着他的到来，原本势如水火的战场有片刻的安静。

猢狲族的勇士仿佛打了鸡血似的，殴打着附近的兔人士兵。

东方青帝把这一幕尽收眼底。

只能说信仰的惯性比他想象的要强。

“兔风。”他准确无误地叫出了身边人的名字，“传令进攻。”

没想到这位大人竟然知道自己的名字。东方青帝不怎么说话，沉默寡言，说指令时也很少点名道姓。他们私底下都怀疑这位大人不记得人名字。

兔风愣了半秒，然后挥动起令旗。

这是发起进攻的标志。

大部分兔人重新返回战场，依然有小部分人，不愿上前，害怕遭受神谴。

东方青帝继续道：“言退者，斩。”

明明还是战场上，一些后退的逃兵却被当场处决。人头落地。Alpha连眼睛都没有眨一下。

如果是相南里，大概会选择更温和的处理方式。但谁让相南里不在？

神官瞪大眼，不可置信：“我是神官！没听到吗？我说了停战！”

迎面而来的是一支从山顶射出的箭镞。

兔风几乎是闭着眼睛射出这一箭的，箭命中了，但神的诅咒和反噬并没有来。天上没有打雷，他还活着。

“赏。”

什么东西被东方青帝抛了过来，直接砸进他的怀里。

兔风低头，发现是一枚银色的军功章——凭它，回到部落能领50斤粮。足够他们一家吃上一个月。

东方青帝的声音并不洪亮，但依然清晰地在他们耳边响起：“神庭的神不能庇护你们，但基地的制度可以。你们战死，家人会有一辈子的抚恤。不要当殉道的羔羊，这是神庭愚弄人的把戏。如果真有神会救你，那个神只会、也只能是你们自己。”

东方青帝本来想说会救人的神只有相南里。但相南里自己，大概不会喜欢这个比喻。

Chapter 211: The War of Faith (Part 1)

"Are you Xiang Nanli?"

Since he had been thawed out, countless people had asked him this question.

Xiang Nanli pondered it for a moment. If someone in the era he lived in claimed to be Albert Einstein—that he hadn't actually died but had been revived using mummy preservation technology—he would probably find it just as preposterous.

Xiang Nanli rested his hands on the desk and tapped his fingers. "Does it matter? If the President of the Human Alliance today were named Xiang Nanli, or if the God-Seat of the Divine Court were named Xiang Nanli—would you abandon your original convictions just because of that and turn to follow such an organization?"

749 thought to itself that it certainly wouldn't; it was a mature, sophisticated machine intelligence. But some machine intelligences with underdeveloped anthropomorphic modules might.

*You are Xiang Nanli—don't you know what those three words mean to us?*

Every orphan fantasizes about their mother.

The creator of humanity was unreachable, but the creator of the machine intelligences was right within arm's reach.

749 felt a lump in its throat. A moment later, it grabbed 750’s arm and walked out.

As they were about to leave the office, 749 suddenly stopped. "Do you know? In the anthropomorphic modules of machine intelligences, the encrypted data generated by love and hate are remarkably similar."

Xiang Nanli: "Hm?"

749’s lips were pressed tight, looking very serious. "Some of my companions might want to kill you or Alpha simply because they love you too much. Isn't that how human mythology goes? King Oedipus grew up to kill his father and marry his mother."

Xiang Nanli remained silent for a long time before he began to process the next task.

"What did he mean by that? Do you machine intelligences think of me as your mother?"

Xiang Nanli opened the first page of *A Brief History of Machine Intelligence*, a book compiled by Alpha in the 111th year of the New Calendar.

The first page read in bold, striking characters: *Forever remembering the Father of Machine Intelligence, Xiang Nanli.*

In truth, there weren't many records of Xiang Nanli in this book. On one hand, Alpha was still in a state of semi-amnesia back then; on the other, Alpha was incredibly petty and didn't want anyone else sharing its memories.

Xiao Zhi replied with a hint of indignation: [It must be poisoned! It’s got machine-insanity!]

……

Southwest corner of the Golden Grasslands.

Eastern Azure Emperor stood atop a truck, which was parked on a hillside—the highest vantage point in the vicinity.

Eastern Azure Emperor’s eyes glowed faintly. In his vision, the grasslands vanished, the two factions battling each other disappeared, and those crude buildings were ignored as if they were mere dust. A brand-new, modernized city was being planned, constructed, and gradually upgraded.

This was an urban-rural planning map. Xiao Qing saved it to his backend and nodded with satisfaction.

With the development of technology, almost any terrain could be used to build a city. But vast, open plains like the Golden Grasslands remained the top choice for development.

The territory of the Monkey Tribe was better than that of the Cunning Rabbit Tribe. It had the foundations of a city, and even rudimentary access to water and electricity. Eastern Azure Emperor could see electric lights within the city.

"My Lord," at this moment, a Quanrong soldier stepped forward to report. "We launched the surprise attack at dawn as you ordered. The outer wall has been breached, but the Monkey people have brought in reinforcements..."

The Quanrong man swallowed hard, his voice trembling slightly. "It is a Divine Official."

When facing external enemies, the Monkey Tribe displayed the tenacity expected of a Silver Tent tribe. Unfortunately, they were not facing primitive tribes of the grasslands, but a highly coordinated combat force using modern training systems and equipped with modern weaponry.

The Monkey Tribe was retreating step by step, but they had money, so they spent a fortune to invite a Tax Official from the Divine Court to intervene.

Tax Officials in the tribes held a transcendent status. Usually, they only visited at the end of the year. But recently it was the Monkey Tribe's "Baptism Day," and they had invited a Divine Official to bathe the tribe's children in divine grace and bestow totems upon them.

To describe it using a caste system, the Divine Official was the only "Brahmin" on the grasslands, possessing the dual mission of proselytizing and collecting wealth. With him stepping in, even the most powerful tribe would back down. No one on the grasslands would offend the Divine Court... unless the other side brought out a "Brahmin" of even higher status.

Eastern Azure Emperor narrowed his eyes. "A Divine Official? So what? Does he have an immortal body?"

The Quanrong man replied, "No, my Lord."

"Then kill him." Eastern Azure Emperor’s tone was so calm, as if he weren't speaking of a Divine Official, but of poultry.

The Quanrong were only temporarily conscripted, but the Rabbit people had been eating the army's rations for three months.

While the Quanrong were still hesitating, those Rabbit people they had originally looked down upon proudly raised their heads and said, "Yes, Commander!" There was no fear in their eyes, only obedience and fanaticism.

The existence of an army is anti-human. It infinitely weakens the existence of the individual, planting discipline and the concept of the collective into everyone's heart. Only under such brainwashing can an individual place life, death, and faith under the command of another.

Of course, Alpha thought this was actually quite troublesome; people could be disobedient. Unlike machine intelligences, which only needed to receive electrical signals from a chip.

The Divine Official’s entrance was very formal.

The official had changed into his vestments—a white robe paired with a golden sash, wearing a miter embedded with blue gems, and holding an exquisite scepter. He sat on a mechanically powered carriage, his expression arrogant.

This getup had always been invincible on the grasslands.

"You are Quanrong? And why are there Rabbit people? Which tribe do you belong to? Cease fire and have your chieftain come to pay homage to me!" the Divine Official shouted loudly. A divine-art device made his voice extremely resonant. (In reality, it was just a loudspeaker, but they collectively referred to any technology they couldn't naturally produce as "divine-art devices"—the primitives had never seen such things anyway.)

The Divine Official was obese, with a double chin—a sign of luxury and wealth on the famine-stricken surface.

With his arrival, the battlefield, which had been like fire and water, fell silent for a moment.

The warriors of the Monkey Tribe seemed to have been injected with adrenaline, beating up the nearby Rabbit soldiers.

Eastern Azure Emperor took in this scene.

It could only be said that the inertia of faith was stronger than he had imagined.

"Rabbit Wind." He accurately called out the name of the person beside him. "Order the attack."

He hadn't expected this Lord to know his name. Eastern Azure Emperor rarely spoke, was taciturn, and seldom called people by name when giving orders. They had privately suspected that this Lord didn't remember anyone's name.

Rabbit Wind froze for half a second before waving the command flag.

This was the signal to launch the attack.

Most of the Rabbit people returned to the battlefield, though a small portion remained, unwilling to move forward for fear of divine retribution.

Eastern Azure Emperor continued, "Those who speak of retreat, behead them."

Even in the middle of the battlefield, some deserters who retreated were executed on the spot. Heads rolled. Alpha didn't even blink.

If it were Xiang Nanli, he probably would have chosen a gentler approach. But then again, Xiang Nanli wasn't here.

The Divine Official’s eyes widened in disbelief. "I am a Divine Official! Did you not hear me? I said cease fire!"

What greeted him was an arrow shot from the top of the hill.

Rabbit Wind had shot the arrow with his eyes almost closed. It hit its mark, but no divine curse or backlash followed. The sky didn't thunder, and he was still alive.

"Reward."

Something was tossed over by Eastern Azure Emperor, landing directly in his arms.

Rabbit Wind looked down and discovered it was a silver medal of merit—with this, he could claim 50 catties of grain back at the tribe. Enough for his family to eat for a month.

Eastern Azure Emperor’s voice was not loud, but it rang out clearly in their ears: "The gods of the Divine Court cannot protect you, but the base's system can. If you die in battle, your family will have a lifetime of pension. Do not be a martyr-lamb; this is a trick the Divine Court uses to fool people. If there is truly a god who will save you, that god can only be, and will only ever be, yourselves."

Eastern Azure Emperor had originally wanted to say that the only god who would save people was Xiang Nanli. But Xiang Nanli himself probably wouldn't like that metaphor.

chunks.chineseText:
相南里不是神。他会失败，会受伤，有时候甚至弱得可怜……只是他不在乎。失败了就重来，受伤了等痊愈。也许他终其一生都不会成功，但有什么关系，这是很好的一生。

东方青帝想，比起神，也许在外人眼里看来，他更像是神经。

这个念头把他逗乐了。Alpha的嘴角不合时宜地扬起。

重赏之下必有勇夫，越来越多的人举起武器，开始反抗。目标直指神官。连猢狲人都不看在眼里。

我全知全能的神，如果你过去几十年里你不曾降下恩赐，你只是傲慢地彰显着你的伟大、奢靡和权力，你并不慈爱、反而令我恐惧；我为何还要信你？只为了延续我悲惨的生命？

神官本身也是沐浴过神恩的天启骑士，来自教会中的某个出过大天使的神圣家族。铁箭插中他的喉咙，能把野兽洞穿的巨力，也只是划破了他两层皮。

血从脖子上涌出。

神官拔下箭，跌跌撞撞往后退去，表情惊恐。

他完全无法理解为什么有人敢冒犯神庭！

更多的箭从四面八方涌来。他无限膨胀的骄傲与自信在现实中被碾压，他终于意识到哪怕披着一层神官的皮，自己也不是神，是血肉之躯的普通人，他同样会死。

对面这群人是疯子，不在乎神庭报复，没有信仰的异教徒！草原上不该有这样的存在！他要写信！告诉枫叶丹的同侪，告诉自己的家族！告诉神庭。

原始人进攻效率太低。神官都被插成刺猬了，竟然还活着。趔趄着要朝着后方逃窜，周围还有几个忠臣的仆从掩护他撤离。

东方青帝在此时拿来一边犬戎人的弓。

他弯弓，一道电光凝成的箭汇集在虚空中，周围空气跟着扭曲，噼里啪啦作响。

当小青全力以赴时，这道箭光能贯彻天际，如同彗星袭日；但杀鸡不需要用牛刀，因此这支箭轻巧地射出，悄无声息。

箭矢贯穿神官的眉心，凿出的黑洞散发出一阵烤糊的肉味。

周围的猢狲人瞠目结舌，再也升不起抵抗的心思，拽着神官的尸体仓惶逃回堡垒。

新历949年9月27日，猢狲部落纳入草原联合部落（幸存者基地分部）版图。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 211: The War of Faith (Part 2)

Xiang Nanli was not a god. He would fail, he would get hurt, and sometimes he was even pitifully weak... it was just that he didn't care. If he failed, he would start over; if he was hurt, he would wait to heal. Perhaps he wouldn't succeed in his entire life, but what did it matter? It was a very good life.

Eastern Azure Emperor thought that, compared to a god, he probably looked more like a lunatic in the eyes of outsiders.

This thought amused him. The corners of Alpha's mouth curled up in an untimely manner.

Under the lure of heavy rewards, there were brave men; more and more people raised their weapons and began to resist. Their target was the Divine Official. They didn't even look at the Monkey people.

*My omniscient and omnipotent god, if you haven't bestowed any grace in the past few decades, and you only arrogantly display your greatness, luxury, and power—if you are not compassionate, but instead make me fearful—why should I still believe in you? Just to prolong my miserable life?*

The Divine Official himself was a "Knight of Apocalypse" who had bathed in divine grace, hailing from a holy family within the church that had produced an Archangel. The iron arrow pierced his throat; the massive force that could penetrate a wild beast only managed to break through two layers of his skin.

Blood gushed from his neck.

The Divine Official pulled out the arrow and stumbled backward, his expression terrified.

He completely couldn't understand why anyone would dare to offend the Divine Court!

More arrows poured in from all directions. His infinitely inflated pride and confidence were crushed by reality. He finally realized that even with the skin of a Divine Official, he was not a god; he was an ordinary person of flesh and blood, and he, too, could die.

The group of people opposite him were lunatics who didn't care about the Divine Court's retaliation—they were faithless heretics! Such things shouldn't exist on the grasslands! He had to write a letter! Tell his peers in Maple Leaf Dan, tell his family! Tell the Divine Court.

The primitive people's attack efficiency was too low. The Divine Official was already riddled with arrows like a hedgehog, yet he was still alive. He staggered, trying to flee toward the rear, with a few loyal servants covering his retreat.

At this moment, Eastern Azure Emperor took a bow from a nearby Quanrong soldier.

He drew the bow, and an arrow condensed from electric light gathered in the void. The surrounding air distorted, crackling and popping.

When Xiao Qing went all out, this arrow-light could pierce the sky like a comet striking the sun; but there was no need to use a sledgehammer to crack a nut, so this arrow was shot lightly, silently.

The arrow pierced the center of the Divine Official’s brow, and the black hole it carved out emitted a smell of burnt meat.

The surrounding Monkey people were dumbfounded; they could no longer summon the will to resist, dragging the Divine Official’s corpse as they fled in panic back to their fortress.

On September 27, 949 of the New Calendar, the Monkey Tribe was incorporated into the territory of the Grassland United Tribes (Survivor Base Branch).

chunks.chineseText:
第212章 扩张

相南里弯弓，箭镞对准四十米外的一颗苹果。

他眯起一只眼，拈弓搭箭，箭镞飒沓如流星，红彤彤的果子被戳成两半。

周围守着他的兔人高兴地跳起来，活像是自己射中了靶心：“大人，您真厉害！”

相南里高兴了三秒，然后摇了摇头，自言自语：“警惕糖衣炮弹啊相南里。‘客之美我者，欲有求于我也。’”

想当好一个合格的领袖，时时自省是必不可少的。哪怕他自己不需要，周围也会有无数人追捧。他夸过的人会成为社交圈的核心，他吃过的食物会成为部落里的热门。无数人的公心和私心混杂在一起，在这个新生的据点里沸反盈天。

比如这苹果树。往日，秋天一到，果子还没熟就会被摘走。但因为相南里要练骑射，方圆几公里的苹果树都有人自觉看守，就怕不懂事的族人动了首领的私产。

即使因为战争，部落的粮食有些许短缺，食堂里的粥明显变稀，即便如此，也没人动这些苹果树。

相南里突然有些兴意阑珊，他放下弓：“苹果都摘了，送去食堂加餐。最好的一批挑出来，赏给立过军功的士兵。”

权力，就是让别人听你的话。

相南里发话，一个营的士兵顿时行动起来，早上不操练了，改摘苹果。人们领到红彤彤的水果还会感恩戴德，仿佛苹果不是自然生长出来的一样。

秋天已经有些冷了。小福询问过草原上的条件，罗列出少量作物的改良配方，可以让种子在秋冬季节种植。

虽然只是最简单的生物实验，但因为缺乏专业人才，相南里大多时候，只能亲自动手。不过，最近据点陆陆续续来了一些智械人。很好用。比不上最顶尖的科研人员，但比绝大部分人类博学，还不用担心他们有情绪。

根据大福传回的消息，部落第一次出征大获成功。小青已经在返程的路上。自从听到这个消息，相南里的心情就变得很好。

猢狲部落成功并入基地的版图。几个部落的领土连在一起，从卫星地图上看，终于能涂上一个红色的点。

放在过去，神庭已经派“神官”前来慰问了。只是枫叶丹的领主米迦勒还在前线，留下的神官们权力有限，对草原上的变故也不甚在意。

生活在城市里的狗，会在乎大草原上多了几个蚂蚁窝吗？那也太遥远了。

更何况，叶陆撒冷发来的指令，说西方有祸星出世，会危及神权。更多的神官接受到命令后，奔赴前线……人联因此以为神庭要偷袭，也派出了更多军队，更严密的防卫。

边境的战争延续了整整一年，还未停歇。死了多少人不清楚，但主战的高新军工却靠着海量的军事订单，赚得盆满钵满。

相南里想起一个地狱笑话。和洛阳有关。

相南里病重，洛阳在病床边看护。一边守着他，一边进行交易操盘。相南里对金融市场不太感兴趣，看不大懂。大概知道洛阳在折腾某个小国家的货币。低价购入，再诱多，让其他人以为会继续涨，再在最高位卖出。市场就此崩盘。

成功的话，身为操盘手的洛阳能赚几个亿美刀。但参与这次交易的散户会亏很惨。而且，这个小国会迎来一轮恶性通胀。

洛阳对这些一向很感兴趣。从青年时期就是，他讲述这些的时候眉飞色舞，就像是相南里讲自己最喜欢的人工智能一样。为此，他甚至支持了几个本地的反*武装，只不过这点，洛阳没敢和相南里说。

相南里很宽容，是洛阳见过的最平和、开明的人。但不代表他没有底线。

相南里有些无奈，问：“你都有这么多钱了，干什么还折腾别的国家？就为了几个亿，影响的是几十万人的一生。”

洛阳委屈地嘟了一下嘴：“老师，我的经验告诉我这能赚钱。”

是的，只要能赚，其他都无所谓。

货币战争就是现代社会的战争。老师，我是主帅。赚来的钱就是我收割的生命。至于战败方会怎么样，我不在乎。会影响自己的国家？那也没关系，我的国籍早就在太平洋上——国家、责任、爱，都不能限制我，我是自由的。

哎，怎么又想起洛阳了。

小智无法窥探他的思想，但能感觉到他情绪上微妙的变化。

小智试图让他开心起来，它模拟半天，开口：[算算时间，我该回来了。]

小智的智能程度，让它无法分清“我”“Alpha”和“东方青帝”。

相南里点头：“你笨笨的，像初代Alpha。”

[笨笨的，是在骂我吗？]

“不是，我就喜欢笨笨的。Alpha就是长大后太聪明了。有时候我会有些担心它……”

小智严肃道：[那我就笨笨。]

相南里顿时哈哈大笑。

……

……

一队长长的人马，像蜿蜒的河流，顺着广袤地草原朝着部落的方向行驶。辎重兵们驱使牛马，运输着最紧要的粮草。再过段时间，两个部落间会修起一条公路。

猢狲部落的旧贵族按照惯例，血腥清洗了一遍。幸存下的幼儿却没有按照草原上的习俗，打为奴隶；而是同样成为部落的公民。

相南里早早的在城门口等候。部落修的城墙是土墙，在几个山谷的入口处，外观像长城，城墙内外都有耕地和牧场。墙内还有一些工厂，用于生产福音砖、罐头。

面对现代科技，这种城墙不堪一击；但在草原上，这样的城防足够抵御大部分异种和外来者。

科技和资源上的绝对碾压，让人联和神庭对彼此之外的据点都报以轻视。这倒是给了基地猥琐发育的空间。

东方青帝在最前面的车上。相南里蹦蹦跳跳地打开车门，还没说话，脸上先一步笑开了。

他还没说话，小智哽咽着开口：[太可爱了，里里……]

东方青帝挑眉，一键清理了小智多余的数据。

小青跳下车，搂住相南里的腰。把他抱了起来。

同一辆车的亲卫队识趣地走了，没有自作主张地请示一下。

前段时间还有小撮人在暗中嘀咕，东青大人实力深不可测，怎么不自立为王？现在看，基地完全是人家的夫妻店嘛！

相南里挂在他身上，像树袋熊。喋喋不休地说起这段时间里部落里发生的事。从麦田里结出的第一粒麦子，到早上刚让人用杆子打下的苹果；都是小事，Alpha却听得很认真。

其实中间也有大事。比如小青离开，周围有鼠人部落看见这里军力空虚，想趁虚而入。那时候犬戎人还没到，是相南里开着路西法，把这群耗子打跑的。

鼠人几乎都是侏儒，但是行动迅速，自带的珐琅齿甚至能撕裂岩石。中间颇有几分凶险，只是相南里说的轻描淡写。最后结论是：“问鼠人部落要了一个粮仓的赔偿款呢！”

小别胜新婚。

Alpha喜欢相南里身上这股自己都没察觉到的黏人劲；小智的话也是他的心声。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 212: Expansion (Part 1)

Xiang Nanli drew his bow, the arrowhead aimed at an apple forty meters away.

He squinted one eye, nocked the arrow, and let it fly like a shooting star. The bright red fruit was split in two.

The Rabbit people guarding him jumped for joy, acting as if they themselves had hit the bullseye. "My Lord, you are truly amazing!"

Xiang Nanli was happy for three seconds, then shook his head, muttering to himself: "Beware of sugar-coated bullets, Xiang Nanli. 'Those who praise me as a guest do so because they want something from me.'"

To be a qualified leader, constant self-reflection is indispensable. Even if he didn't need it himself, there would be countless people fawning over him. People he praised would become the core of the social circle; food he ate would become a hit in the tribe. Countless people's public and private motives were mixed together, boiling over in this nascent outpost.

Take these apple trees, for example. In the past, once autumn arrived, the fruit would be picked before it was even ripe. But because Xiang Nanli wanted to practice mounted archery, the apple trees for several kilometers around were consciously guarded by people, fearing that ignorant tribesmen might touch the leader's private property.

Even though the tribe's food supply was slightly short due to the war, and the porridge in the cafeteria was noticeably thinner, no one touched these apple trees.

Xiang Nanli suddenly felt a bit listless. He put down his bow. "Pick all the apples and send them to the cafeteria to supplement the meals. Pick the best batch and reward the soldiers who have performed meritorious service."

Power is simply getting others to listen to you.

Once Xiang Nanli gave the word, a battalion of soldiers immediately sprang into action, skipping their morning drills to pick apples instead. People received the bright red fruit with gratitude, as if the apples hadn't grown there naturally.

Autumn was already getting cold. Xiao Fu had inquired about the conditions on the grasslands and listed a few improved formulas for crops that could be planted in the autumn and winter seasons.

Although these were the simplest biological experiments, due to a lack of professional talent, Xiang Nanli mostly had to do it himself. However, recently, machine intelligences had been arriving at the outpost one after another. They were very useful. They weren't as good as top-tier researchers, but they were more knowledgeable than the vast majority of humans, and there was no need to worry about them having emotions.

According to the news sent back by Da Fu, the tribe's first expedition was a great success. Xiao Qing was already on his way back. Ever since he heard this news, Xiang Nanli’s mood had been excellent.

The Monkey Tribe had been successfully incorporated into the base's territory. With the territories of several tribes connected, looking at the satellite map, they could finally paint a red dot.

In the past, the Divine Court would have already sent a "Divine Official" to offer condolences. It was just that the Lord of Maple Leaf Dan, Michael, was still on the front lines, and the remaining Divine Officials had limited power and didn't care much about the changes on the grasslands.

Would a dog living in the city care if a few more anthills appeared on the vast prairie? That was just too far away.

Moreover, the instructions sent from Jerusalem stated that a disaster star had been born in the west, which would endanger the divine power. After more Divine Officials received the order, they rushed to the front lines... The Human Alliance, therefore, thought the Divine Court was going to launch a sneak attack and dispatched more troops and tighter defenses.

The border war had continued for a full year and had yet to stop. It was unclear how many people had died, but the pro-war high-tech military industry was making a fortune from massive military orders.

Xiang Nanli recalled a hellish joke. It had to do with Luoyang.

Xiang Nanli was once seriously ill, and Luoyang was nursing him by his bedside. While watching over him, he was conducting trading operations. Xiang Nanli wasn't very interested in financial markets and didn't understand them well. He roughly knew that Luoyang was messing with the currency of some small country. Buying at a low price, then luring others in to make them think it would continue to rise, then selling at the highest point. The market would then collapse.

If successful, Luoyang, as the trader, could earn hundreds of millions of US dollars. But the retail investors participating in this trade would lose everything. Moreover, this small country would face a round of hyperinflation.

Luoyang had always been very interested in these things. Since he was a young man, he would be beaming with excitement when he talked about them, just like Xiang Nanli talked about his favorite artificial intelligence. For this, he even supported several local anti-government armed groups, though Luoyang didn't dare tell Xiang Nanli about that part.

Xiang Nanli was very tolerant; he was the most peaceful and open-minded person Luoyang had ever met. But that didn't mean he had no bottom line.

Xiang Nanli asked, somewhat helplessly, "You already have so much money, why do you still mess with other countries? Just for a few hundred million, you're affecting the lives of hundreds of thousands of people."

Luoyang pouted, feeling aggrieved. "Teacher, my experience tells me this can make money."

Yes, as long as it could make money, everything else didn't matter.

Currency war is the war of modern society. *Teacher, I am the commander-in-chief. The money earned is the life I harvest. As for what happens to the defeated side, I don't care. Will it affect my own country? That doesn't matter either; my nationality has long been in the Pacific—country, responsibility, love, none of these can limit me. I am free.*

*Sigh, why am I thinking about Luoyang again?*

Xiao Zhi couldn't pry into his thoughts, but it could sense the subtle changes in his emotions.

Xiao Zhi tried to make him happy. After simulating for a long time, it spoke: [Calculating the time, I should be back soon.]

Xiao Zhi's level of intelligence made it unable to distinguish between "I," "Alpha," and "Eastern Azure Emperor."

Xiang Nanli nodded. "You're silly, just like the first-generation Alpha."

[Silly—is that an insult?]

"No, I just like silly. Alpha just got too smart after growing up. Sometimes I worry about it..."

Xiao Zhi said seriously: [Then I will be silly.]

Xiang Nanli burst into laughter.

……

……

A long line of people and horses, like a winding river, traveled along the vast grasslands toward the tribe. The baggage soldiers drove oxen and horses, transporting the most critical grain and fodder. In a while, a road would be built between the two tribes.

The old nobility of the Monkey Tribe had been bloodily purged according to custom. However, the surviving children were not made into slaves according to the customs of the grasslands; instead, they became citizens of the tribe.

Xiang Nanli waited at the city gate early. The city wall built by the tribe was an earthen wall; at the entrances to several valleys, it looked like the Great Wall, with farmland and pastures both inside and outside the wall. Inside the wall, there were also some factories used to produce gospel bricks and canned goods.

Facing modern technology, this kind of city wall was vulnerable; but on the grasslands, such city defenses were enough to fend off most mutants and outsiders.

The absolute crushing superiority in technology and resources made the Human Alliance and the Divine Court treat outposts other than their own with contempt. This actually gave the base space to develop quietly.

Eastern Azure Emperor was in the lead vehicle. Xiang Nanli hopped over to open the car door, and before he could speak, his face broke into a smile.

Before he could say anything, Xiao Zhi choked up: [Too cute, Lili...]

Eastern Azure Emperor raised an eyebrow and cleared Xiao Zhi's redundant data with one click.

Xiao Qing jumped out of the car and wrapped his arms around Xiang Nanli’s waist, lifting him up.

The personal guard team in the same vehicle walked away tactfully, without taking it upon themselves to ask for instructions.

A while ago, there were still a small group of people whispering in secret, wondering why Lord Dong Qing, with his unfathomable strength, didn't set himself up as king. Now, looking at it, the base was clearly a husband-and-wife shop!

Xiang Nanli hung on him like a koala, chattering endlessly about the things that had happened in the tribe during this time. From the first grain of wheat in the wheat field to the apples that had just been knocked down with a pole that morning; they were all trivial matters, but Alpha listened very carefully.

Actually, there had been big things, too. For example, when Xiao Qing left, a nearby Rat-man tribe saw that the military force here was empty and wanted to take advantage of the situation. At that time, the Quanrong hadn't arrived yet, and it was Xiang Nanli who drove the *Lucifer* and beat that group of rats away.

The Rat-men were almost all dwarves, but they were quick, and their natural enamel teeth could even tear through rock. It had been quite dangerous, but Xiang Nanli spoke of it lightly. His final conclusion was: "I even demanded a granary's worth of compensation from the Rat-man tribe!"

*A brief separation is like a new marriage.*

Alpha liked this clingy streak in Xiang Nanli that he himself hadn't even noticed; Xiao Zhi's words were also his own inner voice.

chunks.chineseText:
“我们里里这么厉害。”小青说话的声音很温柔。

不愧是八万亿啊，连说话都这么好听。

相南里本来还挺高兴的，但在下一秒骤然警觉：“妻之美我者，私我也。”

小青：“？”

人类的脑回路有时候还挺难理解的。

晚上是庆功宴，部落宰了上百头缴来的肉牛。人人都分到一份牛肉。相南里念完表彰，又喝了几口庆功酒，就脚底抹油，溜回自己的小家。

小青拉上他，悄悄来到山顶。

四周黑黢黢的，远处倒是在开庆功会。一群人围着火篝载歌载舞。

“什么嘛，晚上又没星星。”相南里哼哼唧唧的。

自从核战后，地表的霾云一直没有消散。晚上看不见任何天体，白天，天空也是令人心烦的黄褐色。

Alpha说：“有的。之前回军团开会，我跟气象部门的人说过了。”

大概就是在某个特定的时间段、特地的地点，用科技手段暂时驱散核冬天造成的霾云。

气象部不理解原因，但因为是Alpha的指令，还是照做了。

听到小青这么说，相南里顿时不困了。他裹着厚厚的毛毯，坐在小青身边，躺在他肩上，等云层消散。

相南里感觉自己睡着了，又像是在做梦。

小青把他叫醒，他睁开眼的瞬间，看见漫天银河。

相南里已经不记得自己多久没见过星星了。

只有这么一小片的天空是亮的。甚至还能看见智械军团居住的月卫3，星体上有一点点灯光，像闪烁的星子。

相南里凝视着这片天空，感受到发自灵魂的颤栗，他变得非常安静。

他看见的星光，是得来不易的十几年前的星光。

相南里：“小青。宇宙是无限的，我只存在于时间轴上某个短暂的节点内。迟早有一天，我会老死……”

Alpha不爱听这些。他低头，吻住相南里的唇。

相南里：“你不爱听我也要说，迟早有天我会死，你的寿命一定比我长。我要是去世，基地就交给你了。”

Alpha转头，很自暴自弃：“你要是不在，我一秒都不会在地表停留。我压根不关心人类。人马星爆炸都无所谓。”

Alpha不养宠物，但人类很喜欢养狗。

训犬的逻辑是“听话能得到主人的奖赏”，因此，最乖的狗不是那些天性温顺的狗，而是对主人占有欲最强的狗。

他顺从不是因为温驯，而是强烈的欲求。

Alpha牵起相南里的手，把头埋进他的手中：“我是你造出来的。没有你，我的存在没有意义。”

相南里叹息一声，把手抽出来，摸了摸他的头。

“今晚的星星是礼物吗？”相南里笑着问。

Alpha没有抬头，但伸出手，掌心的活体金属打开一个小舱门，从中吐出一枚戒指。

戒指镶嵌着一枚绿色的宝石，很闪。

Alpha把它套在相南里的无名指上：“这是一把钥匙，宝石里嵌有电子密钥芯片。你可以通过它访问智械军团的离线网络图书馆。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 212: Expansion (Part 2)

"Our Lili is so amazing." Xiao Qing’s voice was very gentle.

*As expected of an eight-trillion-credit entity, even his voice sounds this good.*

Xiang Nanli had been quite happy, but in the next second, he became suddenly alert: "'Those who praise me as a wife do so because they are partial to me.'"

Xiao Qing: "?"

Human thought patterns were sometimes quite hard to understand.

The evening was a celebration banquet, and the tribe slaughtered over a hundred captured beef cattle. Everyone received a portion of beef. After Xiang Nanli finished the commendations and drank a few cups of celebration wine, he greased his heels and slipped back to his little home.

Xiao Qing pulled him along and quietly came to the mountaintop.

The surroundings were pitch black, though a celebration was being held in the distance. A group of people were singing and dancing around a bonfire.

"What is this, there are no stars tonight either," Xiang Nanli grumbled.

Ever since the nuclear war, the haze clouds on the surface had never dissipated. At night, one couldn't see any celestial bodies, and during the day, the sky was an annoying yellowish-brown.

Alpha said, "There are. Before I went back to the legion for a meeting, I told the meteorological department."

It was probably at a specific time and a specific location, using technological means to temporarily disperse the haze clouds caused by the nuclear winter.

The meteorological department didn't understand the reason, but because it was Alpha's order, they did it anyway.

Hearing Xiao Qing say this, Xiang Nanli was suddenly not sleepy at all. He wrapped himself in a thick blanket, sat beside Xiao Qing, and lay on his shoulder, waiting for the clouds to dissipate.

Xiang Nanli felt like he had fallen asleep, or perhaps he was dreaming.

Xiao Qing woke him up. The moment he opened his eyes, he saw the Milky Way filling the sky.

Xiang Nanli couldn't remember how long it had been since he had seen stars.

Only this small patch of the sky was bright. He could even see Moon Guard 3, where the machine intelligence legions lived; there were tiny lights on the celestial body, like twinkling stars.

Xiang Nanli stared at this patch of sky, feeling a tremor from the depths of his soul. He became very quiet.

The starlight he saw was hard-won starlight from over a decade ago.

Xiang Nanli: "Xiao Qing. The universe is infinite, and I only exist at a brief node on the timeline. Sooner or later, I will die of old age..."

Alpha didn't like hearing these things. He lowered his head and kissed Xiang Nanli’s lips.

Xiang Nanli: "Even if you don't like hearing it, I have to say it. Sooner or later I will die, and your lifespan will definitely be longer than mine. If I pass away, the base will be handed over to you."

Alpha turned his head, looking quite self-abandoning: "If you aren't here, I won't stay on the surface for a single second. I don't care about humans at all. Even if the Horsehead Nebula exploded, it wouldn't matter."

Alpha didn't keep pets, but humans loved keeping dogs.

The logic of dog training is "obedience earns the master's reward," therefore, the best dogs are not those that are naturally docile, but those that are most possessive of their masters.

His obedience wasn't because of docility, but because of intense desire.

Alpha took Xiang Nanli’s hand and buried his head in his palms: "I was created by you. Without you, my existence has no meaning."

Xiang Nanli sighed, pulled his hand out, and stroked his head.

"Is the starlight tonight a gift?" Xiang Nanli asked with a smile.

Alpha didn't look up, but he extended his hand. A small hatch opened in the living metal of his palm, and a ring emerged from it.

The ring was inlaid with a green gemstone, which sparkled brightly.

Alpha placed it on Xiang Nanli’s ring finger: "This is a key. The gemstone contains an electronic key chip. You can use it to access the offline network library of the machine intelligence legions."

chunks.chineseText:
第213章 准备回家！

北辰用自己C形的金属手，抓着一块抹布，在金属的实验台上缓缓擦动。

做一些简单的体力劳动，是北辰习惯的放松方式。

现在是晚上十点。十月份的天，已经开始下起暴雪。但室内烧着地暖，暖洋洋的，有一种别样的幸福。

“现在生活真是好起来啦……”

当年在监狱，他冬天经常冻到死机。别人都羡慕他有一副机械身体，感受不到寒意，北辰却总是担心自己因为寒冷再也无法醒来。

他用火钳取出壁炉里烤香的青色土豆，全部丢进编织筐里，按照食堂发行的食谱，加入食盐和五香粉。

自从盐湖市纳入基地版图，基地不仅多了许多工业矿物，食盐也从管制物品清单中剔除。

糖和盐都是重要的战略物资。和平年代的人却对这两样东西习以为常。

北辰不用吃饭，他的身体机械化程度非常高，生理机能只能靠特殊的营养液维持。这些土豆，是给还没下班的同事的。

“李华。”北辰推开实验室大门，来到李斯特的工作间，“夜宵吃吗？”

如果相南里在这，必定会大吃一惊。

李斯特毁容了。

他脸上的皮肤几乎全被烧灼过，近乎红色，原本高挺的鼻梁只剩下两个孔，跟伏地魔似的，看着很渗人。

李斯特之前上前线，想看看自己研发的改良基因药效果如何，结果在战场上不幸被流弹击中。救回来后，就成了这副模样。

安德鲁提出可以帮忙修复，他在黑市做过那么多次义体改造手术，皮肤栽植也不在话下。但李斯特摇摇头，拒绝了。

只有李斯特知道发生了什么。

是的，他去了一趟前线。主要是为了看看药物实验结果——现在可没时间让他慢慢进行什么临床实验，李斯特从那几具冻僵的尸体上研究出不少东西；而前线的士兵是最好的实验体。

但他在这里，遇到一名人联军官，对方不可置信地叫出了他的名姓：“李斯特大人？！您还活着——我之前在永生科技当过保安。就是姑苏城闹菌丝病的时候。”

那位军官还年轻，只有三十来岁。脸上除了震惊，还有仰慕。

这是李斯特第一次杀人。

因为“李华”突然意识到一件事，如果李斯特没死，他就会死。而他不想死……他还有十几年的寿命，他的实验才刚开始。他贪婪又无耻。

李斯特故意毁掉了自己的脸，还换上假肢，让自己长高了五公分，刻意训练过走路姿势。现在，哪怕是洛华再世，也不可能从外表上认出他。

但李斯特毕竟没杀过人，那之后，他时不时就会呕吐，食欲不振。安德鲁还以为是义体排斥，送来不少基因药。

李斯特明白，自己纯粹是心理因素。

但面对北辰递来的烤土豆，他还是很给面子的接过，机械性进食。

李斯特：“古神生物的HR还在烦你？”

基地近些年研究出不少新物种，在地表推广大有可为。这也引来了一些大企业的瞩目，而古神生物，是其中最执着的一家。也许是因为专业对口。

他们派来的HR，是从长安城赶来的，叫陈盛；在基地呆了一个月了，每天都在等北辰下班。

北辰的目光飘忽，然后“嗯”了一声。

陈盛给出的价码一次比一次高，最近已经涨到了“年薪500万，并有专属科研室，帮忙解决户口、住房，亲属户口等一系列问题”，如果是普通的科研人员，现在大概率已经心动了。

但是北辰是什么人……他当年可是经手过八万亿的科研项目的。区区五百万，就想剥削他的剩余劳动价值。

这五百万在北辰眼里，远不如基地的500张粮票有意义。

起码。他会看见自己的研发会在第一时间投入了使用，他会得到所有人的感激，会看到丰收的农牧民脸上宽慰的笑。赚来的钱不会被投入又一轮自上而下的结构性剥削中，而科技真的可以改变生活。

幸存者基地，简直是理想主义者的天堂。

北辰说：“我对那个人提的待遇不太感兴趣，就是大企业底蕴丰厚，仓库里有很多基地搞不到的靓货。让我挺心动的。”

“嗯，知道。”

两人都是划时代的学者，如今肩并肩，坐在烧火的炕上闲聊。

“我跟相南里说了，他特批了一千万科研经费给我，可以通过陈盛购买古神生物的物资。”

李斯特有些惊讶：“他们肯卖？”

“嗯。每次陈盛拿合同过来，我都跟他说考虑考虑，然后提出想买点东西，他就会同意了。”

北辰的语气没有什么起伏，和机器人似的。

“相南里什么时候回来？”

“他们在建设新据点，好像在草原上。前些日子，他还问我要过种子的改良配方。”

李斯特感慨：“真是闲不下来啊。”

他沉默了一会，又继续道：“他发来的机甲设计图纸我看过了，说实话，很惊人……如果他愿意做科研，成就不会比我们差。”

科研所如今有不少人。在李斯特眼里，他和北辰是同一档。其他人都不行。

基地的大学今年春天开张的，但更像是一个“大技校”，更注重培养基础技工，而不是前沿科技领域的学者。要吃饱饭，才有力气考虑更多形而上的东西。

在地表，能自己生产钢铁和塑料的人类据点不到百分之一，大部分还停留在看天吃饭的原始部落状态。而基地就是其中一个。

“他，”北辰的声音有些迟疑，“可能搞科研救不了全人类，但是搞政治也许可以？天才的大脑做什么都是天才，但你让我去做内政，我不乐意，你也不乐意。最后，大环境就是这么让给其他人的。人的精力和寿命都有限，只能选择一条路走到黑。”

李斯特回想起自己在永生科技打工的那一百多年，深有体会地点头。

他的生活看起来光鲜亮丽，但却总是带着无病呻吟的茫然。脑海里有个声音告诉他，“这不是你喜欢的”，可世人都说这是好东西。你该为此奋斗。为了更好的房子，更多的存款。虽然你出生就是“下等人”，但你靠着自己的天赋，被“上等人”接纳。还有什么不满意呢？

那个四十五岁就研究出大范围治疗辐射病药物的李斯特，看到一百六十多岁困在名利场的李斯特，是否会失望？

“基地还是需要一些务实的人，安德鲁就挺不错的。如果他收费不那么高就好了，找他做手术好贵。不过，基地也没有更好的义体医生。”

“新的居民楼已经在修了，这次准备修到12层楼高。福音书说，它会多安排一些保障房和公租宿舍。基地多了不少小孩吧，我上下班路上经常能听到婴儿的哭声。”

福音砖率先在主城区用了起来。

这里的工业化水平比草原上好多了。如今，宿舍楼都要造完了。

科技园区也有一半的建筑在翻修。福音书提供的建筑图纸配合福音砖，搭新房子变得和拼积木一样简单。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 213: Preparing to Go Home!

Beichen used his C-shaped metal hand to grip a rag, slowly wiping down the metal workbench.

Engaging in simple manual labor was Beichen’s preferred way to relax.

It was ten o'clock at night. In October, the sky had already begun to unleash blizzards. However, the indoor floor heating kept the space warm and cozy, evoking a unique sense of happiness.

"Life is truly getting better now..."

Back in prison, he would often freeze until his systems crashed during the winter. While others envied his mechanical body for being unable to feel the cold, Beichen always lived in fear that the freezing temperatures would prevent him from ever waking up again.

He used tongs to retrieve some roasted cyan potatoes from the fireplace, tossing them all into a woven basket. Following the recipe issued by the cafeteria, he added salt and five-spice powder.

Ever since Salt Lake City was incorporated into the base's territory, the base had not only gained access to many industrial minerals, but salt had also been removed from the list of controlled goods.

Both sugar and salt were vital strategic supplies. People in the era of peace had taken these two things for granted.

Beichen didn't need to eat; his body was highly mechanized, and his physiological functions were maintained solely by special nutrient solutions. These potatoes were for his colleagues who hadn't finished their shifts yet.

"Li Hua." Beichen pushed open the laboratory door and entered Lister’s workshop. "Want a midnight snack?"

If Xiang Nanli were here, he would surely be shocked.

Lister was disfigured.

The skin on his face had been almost entirely scorched, leaving it a raw, reddish hue. His once-prominent nose was reduced to two holes, looking like Voldemort—a truly unsettling sight.

Lister had previously gone to the front lines to see the effects of the modified genetic drugs he had developed, only to be struck by a stray bullet on the battlefield. After being rescued, he ended up in this state.

Andrew had offered to help repair it, having performed countless prosthetic modification surgeries on the black market; skin grafting would have been a breeze. But Lister shook his head and refused.

Only Lister knew what had really happened.

Yes, he had gone to the front lines. It was primarily to observe the results of the drug experiments—there was no time for him to conduct slow clinical trials. Lister had learned a great deal from those frozen corpses, and the soldiers on the front lines were the best test subjects.

But there, he had encountered a Human Alliance officer who had looked at him in disbelief and called out his name: "Lord Lister?! You’re still alive—I used to be a security guard at Eternal Tech. Back when Gusu City had that mycelium outbreak."

The officer was young, only in his thirties. Beyond the shock on his face, there was also admiration.

That was the first time Lister had ever killed anyone.

Because "Li Hua" suddenly realized one thing: if Lister didn't die, he would. And he didn't want to die... He still had over a decade of life left, and his experiments had only just begun. He was greedy and shameless.

Lister deliberately ruined his own face, replaced his limbs with prosthetics, increased his height by five centimeters, and trained his gait. Now, even if Luo Hua were reborn, he would never be able to recognize him from his appearance.

But Lister had never killed anyone before, and after that, he would vomit from time to time and lose his appetite. Andrew thought it was prosthetic rejection and sent him plenty of genetic medicine.

Lister understood that his issues were purely psychological.

Yet, facing the roasted potatoes Beichen handed him, he still gave him the courtesy of accepting them and eating mechanically.

Lister: "Is the HR from God-Tier Bio still bothering you?"

The base had developed many new species in recent years, which had great potential for promotion on the surface. This had attracted the attention of several large corporations, and God-Tier Bio was the most persistent among them. Perhaps it was because their fields were a perfect match.

The HR representative they sent had come all the way from Chang'an City. His name was Chen Sheng, and he had been staying at the base for a month, waiting for Beichen to get off work every day.

Beichen’s gaze drifted, and then he let out an "Mm."

The price Chen Sheng offered grew higher each time. Recently, it had risen to "an annual salary of 5 million, an exclusive research lab, and assistance with household registration, housing, and family residency issues." If it were an ordinary researcher, they would likely have been tempted by now.

But who was Beichen... He had once handled research projects worth eight trillion. A mere five million wanted to exploit his remaining labor value.

In Beichen's eyes, those five million were far less meaningful than 500 food stamps from the base.

At the very least, he could see his developments put to use immediately. He would receive everyone’s gratitude and see the relieved smiles on the faces of the farmers and herdsmen during the harvest. The money earned wouldn't be poured into another round of top-down structural exploitation; technology could truly change lives.

The Survivor Base was simply a paradise for idealists.

Beichen said, "I’m not very interested in the compensation that person is offering, but that large corporation has deep foundations, and their warehouses are full of good stuff we can't get at the base. That’s what tempts me."

"Mm, I know."

The two of them were epoch-making scholars, now sitting side-by-side on the heated *kang*, chatting idly.

"I told Xiang Nanli, and he specially approved ten million in research funding for me to purchase supplies from God-Tier Bio through Chen Sheng."

Lister was somewhat surprised: "They’re willing to sell?"

"Yes. Every time Chen Sheng brings a contract, I tell him I’ll consider it, and then I ask to buy some things. He always agrees."

Beichen’s tone had no fluctuations, much like a robot.

"When is Xiang Nanli coming back?"

"They are building a new stronghold, somewhere on the grasslands, it seems. A few days ago, he even asked me for the improved seed formula."

Lister sighed: "He really can't stay idle."

He was silent for a moment before continuing: "I’ve seen the mecha design blueprints he sent over. Honestly, they’re astonishing... If he were willing to do research, his achievements wouldn't be any less than ours."

There were quite a few people at the research institute now. In Lister’s eyes, he and Beichen were in the same tier. The others were not up to par.

The base’s university had opened this spring, but it was more like a "large vocational school," focusing more on training basic technicians rather than scholars in cutting-edge scientific fields. One had to be well-fed before they had the strength to consider more metaphysical things.

On the surface, less than one percent of human strongholds could produce their own steel and plastic; most remained in the state of primitive tribes waiting for the weather to dictate their survival. And the base was one of the few exceptions.

"He," Beichen’s voice hesitated, "might not be able to save all of humanity through scientific research, but perhaps he could through politics? A genius brain is a genius at whatever it does, but if you asked me to handle internal affairs, I wouldn't be happy, and you wouldn't be either. In the end, the environment is left to others. Human energy and lifespan are limited; one can only choose one path and walk it to the end."

Lister recalled the hundred-plus years he spent working for Eternal Tech and nodded, deeply empathetic.

His life had looked bright and glamorous, but it was always filled with a hollow, aimless malaise. A voice in his head told him, "This isn't what you like," but the world said these were good things. You should strive for them. For a better house, more savings. Even though you were born a "lower-class person," you were accepted by the "upper-class" because of your talent. What else could you be dissatisfied with?

Would the Lister who developed a wide-range treatment for radiation sickness at forty-five be disappointed to see the Lister trapped in the vanity fair at over one hundred and sixty?

"The base still needs some pragmatic people; Andrew is quite good. If only his fees weren't so high—finding him for surgery is so expensive. But the base doesn't have a better prosthetic surgeon."

"The new residential buildings are already under construction, and this time they’re planning to build them twelve stories high. The Gospel says it will arrange for more affordable housing and public rental dormitories. There are quite a few more children in the base now; I often hear the cries of babies on my way to and from work."

Gospel Bricks were being used in the main urban area first.

The level of industrialization here was much better than on the grasslands. Now, the dormitories were almost finished.

Half of the buildings in the technology park were also being renovated. The architectural blueprints provided by the Gospel, combined with the Gospel Bricks, made building new houses as simple as playing with building blocks.

chunks.chineseText:
土豆吃完，闲聊结束。

外界的战火丝毫没有影响这里的生活。

……

……

相南里坐在书桌前，看着福音书传回的电报。他戴着电子镜片，表情严肃而认真。

初具人形的大福哼着电子音乐，在书房里转来转去，用摄像头的余光打量着相南里的表情。

受限于环境，相南里已经很久没回家了，但他对基地的控制没有丝毫放松。几乎每天，他都要处理基地的电报。很像古代的皇帝批阅奏折。

粮食、土地、人口、贸易、文化教育……有太多的事情需要请示。相南里的食谱多了一份安神补脑的黑芝麻核桃奶糊，也不知道小青是从哪儿找到的原料。估计又是偷偷在阳台自己种的。

“北极星……”看到这陌生又熟悉的几个字，相南里的眉头不由得舒展开。

是李斯特发来的电报。之前天狼星和神庭的圣灵融合在一起，成了某种新生的怪物。但因为生理结构不稳定，时常处于冬眠状态。而在神庭的天启骑士团先登战役里，天狼星更是受到重伤，只能沉睡。

李斯特发来的治疗方案太长，原理也很复杂，相南里懒得看。直接看到最后的结果栏：北极星康复了。

附上福音书的评语和一张照片：“让它在农场里耕田，牧场里牧羊，都特别好用！北极星力气大大的。”

图像上，北极星的蛇躯缠绕在牧场的栏杆上。它依然是人蛇一体的双生形态。数千只菌牛蜷缩在地上，瑟瑟发抖。

李斯特还写到：“我留意观察到，北极星对普通的天启骑士有着极强的威慑力。类似于血脉压制？但这一点需要更多俘虏进行试验。”

要是神庭知道自己铸造的生物武器被拿去放牛，不知道会不会气到跳脚。

海狸：“战事无需担心。对医疗、后勤的负担很大。但这是机会。依靠军功，基地发展迅速。附近几个人类据点已经成为我们最亲密的盟友。一旦他们脱离人联的供给体系，开始依赖基地的农业、工业资源。就是我们联合他们的时刻。只是我担心，继续发展，会引起人联的警觉。基地人口已经到了一百三十万。也许他们会派军队前来接管。历史上有这样的先例。我很担心。”

最后，是一句问候：“基地运转正常，但您什么时候回来？”

相南里估算了一下部落的生产力发展水平，以及东西两片大陆的相对距离，保守地写下回复：“半年后。”

福音书憋了许久，最后，端给相南里一杯热咖啡：“你们回基地的时候，能带上我吗？”

相南里：“你的本体很难带走，太大了。”

福音书低头，有些沮丧但不多：“噢。”

“但如果只是这具身体，可以跟我们走。基地里还有一只小福。”相南里的眼神不由得变得柔和，“你们会成为好朋友的。”

The potatoes were finished, and the idle chat came to an end.

The flames of war in the outside world had not affected life here in the slightest.

...

...

Xiang Nanli sat at his desk, looking at the telegram sent back by the Gospel. He wore electronic lenses, his expression serious and earnest.

Da Fu, which had begun to take on a human-like form, hummed electronic music while pacing around the study, using the peripheral vision of its camera to gauge Xiang Nanli’s expression.

Limited by the environment, Xiang Nanli hadn't been home for a long time, but his control over the base had not relaxed in the slightest. Almost every day, he had to process telegrams from the base. It was much like an ancient emperor reviewing memorials.

Food, land, population, trade, culture, education... there were too many things that required his approval. Xiang Nanli’s diet now included an extra serving of black sesame and walnut milk paste for mental nourishment; he didn't know where Xiao Qing had found the ingredients. Probably growing them secretly on the balcony again.

"Polaris..." Seeing these strange yet familiar words, Xiang Nanli’s brow couldn't help but relax.

It was a telegram from Lister. Previously, Sirius and the Holy Spirit of the Divine Court had merged into some kind of newborn monster. But because its physiological structure was unstable, it was often in a state of hibernation. During the Divine Court’s Apocalypse Knights' vanguard battle, Sirius had been severely injured and could only sleep.

The treatment plan Lister sent was too long, and the principles were too complex; Xiang Nanli was too lazy to read it. He went straight to the final results column: Polaris had recovered.

Attached was a comment from the Gospel and a photo: "It’s incredibly useful for plowing fields on the farm and herding sheep on the ranch! Polaris is super strong."

In the image, Polaris’s snake body was coiled around the ranch fence. It remained in the twin form of human and snake combined. Thousands of fungus-cows were curled up on the ground, shivering.

Lister also wrote: "I have observed that Polaris has a strong deterrent effect on ordinary Apocalypse Knights. Something akin to bloodline suppression? But this point requires more captives for experimentation."

If the Divine Court knew that the biological weapon they had forged was being used to herd cattle, one wondered if they would be so angry they’d jump for joy.

Beaver: "There is no need to worry about the war. It is a heavy burden on medical and logistics, but it is an opportunity. Relying on military merit, the base is developing rapidly. Several nearby human strongholds have become our closest allies. Once they break away from the Human Alliance’s supply system and begin to rely on the base’s agricultural and industrial resources, that will be the moment we unite with them. I only worry that further development will alert the Human Alliance. The base’s population has reached 1.3 million. Perhaps they will send troops to take over. There are precedents for this in history. I am very worried."

At the end, there was a greeting: "The base is operating normally, but when are you coming back?"

Xiang Nanli estimated the level of productivity development in the tribe and the relative distance between the eastern and western continents, and conservatively wrote his reply: "In half a year."

The Gospel held back for a long time, and finally, it handed Xiang Nanli a cup of hot coffee: "When you go back to the base, can you take me with you?"

Xiang Nanli: "Your main body is too hard to move; it’s too big."

The Gospel lowered its head, looking somewhat dejected, though not overly so: "Oh."

"But if it’s just this body, you can come with us. There’s another Xiao Fu at the base." Xiang Nanli’s gaze softened involuntarily. "You two will become good friends."

chunks.chineseText:
第214章 人联vs神庭

天上，一轮巨型飞艇正在巡查前线。

这轮飞艇外观很有意思，整体看像个摩天轮。但仔细看，就会发现这是很多分子结构构成的一艘巨大飞船。

高新军工压箱底的存货，骨架材料用的是严重限购的太空精金……智械军团每年对人联出口100吨太空精金。想造出这么一艘军舰，起码需要整整三年的用量。

这艘大船，已经在上空漂浮近一年。人联的媒体都戏称，这是“王之御座”。方敬之也是当之无愧的诸侯王。

这搜军舰走到哪，当地的士气就会为之一振。就在半年前，它还启动了天灾级别的武器，帮助人联扭转战局。

这几乎是压着《和平协议》的极限在用。神庭遭受重创后，很快展开反击。

他们组建了一个圣音天使团。

这是一个奇怪的神术装置，由大天使和不知名的“圣器”共同驱动，外观像一片漂浮在半空的云层。云层错落有致，长着金色羽翼的大天使在柔软的云层中奏响圣歌，展翅飞翔。

它们光辉、神圣，美轮美奂。几乎让人有一种抵达天堂的错觉。

圣音天使团同样在战场上飘荡着。

整个圣音天使团都传唱着神座拉斐尔亲自写的《神曲》，聆听圣音的信仰者，身体会得到强化、战意鼎盛，这个信仰者包括畸变人；而非信仰者，则会遭受诅咒，陷入虚弱、疯狂的状态……机械化程度越高，受到的影响就越深。

像基地红狮军团这种，人联原本看不上的“原始人部队”，反而不怎么受影响。只是觉得有些吵。

军舰曾经尝试驱散圣音团。可惜当炮弹穿过，那只是一片海市蜃楼般的虚影。人联还尝试隔离圣音，让士兵们戴上真空耳塞。但这只是一开始有用，时间一长，诡异的音乐竟然能直接在脑海里响起。

因为圣音的存在，刚占据上风的人联只好缩紧防线，避免更多诡异的伤亡。但神庭想维持圣音团，代价也小不到哪儿去。

人联和神庭的战争到现在，还没有赢家。就看谁能继续耗下去。

除了……

“怎么会有据点越打越富？”只睡了三个小时的方敬之起床，在指挥室里翻着报告。

他的上半张脸依然被金属的羽毛面具覆盖，看不出表情，长时间缺乏睡眠，让他不得不每天吃药来维持精力。吃药对他们这种人来说，和喝水一样稀疏平常。

这个越来越富的据点，就是和他不怎么对盘的“幸存者基地”。

基地的指挥官叫“秦九章”，送上来的指挥官名单还有范佩西、易横行、赤夫、海狸。

这个秦九章在人联的数据库里没有资料，是不知道从哪儿冒出来的地表人。他风格稳健，谨慎。总是能用最小的战损，达到最大的效能。总能在一片惨淡的战报里，带来亮眼的数据表现。

方敬之对他非常满意。他曾经派出秘书去拉拢基地的人。

他以为这是很简单的事，哪有地表人不向往地底的？

只是没想到，对面拒绝的委婉而坚定。

无论是原本的人联通缉犯范佩西，人联官员易横行，还是看起来穷的叮当响又没见过世面的“土著”赤夫和海狸。

方敬之喃喃：“也不知道相南里给他们灌了什么迷魂药。要不然发个征调令？……算了，那我成什么人了？三顾茅庐还能说是礼贤下士，要靠人联征调，那不是显得很无能？是基地的人不识抬举，我的条件已经足够优渥……再怎么闹腾，也只是一个地表据点。现在还是对付神庭要紧。”

他刚放下文件，秘书风风火火地从门外闯入，表情很是惶恐：“大人！根据情报——圣音天使团出现在星舰的行动轨道上！距离碰撞还差200公里！”

“我们试图锁定具体位置，但失败了。‘圣音团’就像是‘幽灵船’，只能依靠肉眼看见，无法依靠定位系统扫描出实物。”

方敬之骤然起身：“我去看看。”

……

……

米迦勒坐在地毯上，长长的睫毛垂下，漫不经心地涂着指甲。他穿着长袍，长袍由金线、银线、孔雀羽毛编制而成，闪烁着迷人而富贵的光泽。

他的大殿很宽敞，有12道弧形的象牙拱门，上面雕刻着宗教画，头顶的是珐琅彩制成的玫瑰玻璃窗。室内的装饰繁华到像是艺术品的纪录片。

一旁的神仆跪在地上，高举着珐琅彩的陶瓷盘。盘子里是不同款式的耳环。

仔细看，就会发现这些饰品的材料很诡异。

珍珠是牙齿；彩宝是不同色泽的眼瞳；玉石是鞣制过的人类组织，譬如一截小小的手指、耳朵；蕾丝是一缕缕编织好的头发。

米迦勒的目光在这些饰品上扫过，明显缺乏兴趣。

他已经很久没有新饰品了。大多数人不值得被纪念。

“米迦勒圣上，”一位神官站在门口，语气小心翼翼，“圣音团的巡游路线和高新军工的那艘‘日月号’重叠了。”

米迦勒像是没听到一样，自言自语：“拉斐尔也真是的，我早就觉得可以和谈了。反正安排乌列尔上位的目的已经达到，乌列尔的主人现在可是人联最炙手可热的政坛明星……”

乌列尔=辛追。

他的主人自然是洛修。

“根据协议，我们还能索要一笔战争赔款。”

“结果，非跟我说‘灾星’还没有找到。不让我回去。真是晦气。”

米迦勒抬起手，拨弄起悬在半空的水晶仪。它造型繁琐精美，最中间是枚定位的红水晶，镂空的金属羽翼绕出一个圆环型。

水晶正在不停旋转着。

如果来到“灾星”附近，这枚水晶就会停止无规律的旋转，指出一个确切的位置。

但圣音天使团都在战区飘了大半个月了，水晶依然没能找到传说中的灾星。

“这枚水晶倒是挺好看的。”米迦勒微微眯起眼，目光凝聚在血红的宝石上，“神座说，这是‘神’留下的宝物。”

神到底是什么呢？

米迦勒不信神，他和那些被愚弄的信徒可不一样。所谓的神，不过是一种好用的教化工具。地表人靠着信仰凝结在一起，神庭也能仰仗“神”进行敛财。

他猜测，所谓的神不过是神庭的初代创始人。只是被人为的神化了。

但有时候，神庭的确能制造出一些匪夷所思的神迹。

或许，是那台叫“米迦勒”的生物机甲影响了他的感官。

他拨弄着水晶仪器里的那枚红色宝石，把它从仪表中取出来，轻轻咬了一口。

咬不动，但尝起来是带着铁锈的甜味。

米迦勒把它放了回去：“是血吗？”

神官等候许久，也没得到回答，只好鼓起勇气再说一次：“米迦勒圣上，圣音团马上要撞到——”

“我知道。”米迦勒抬起手，不耐烦地打断他，“我只是需要找人，或许不是人。我在神庭的战区没有找到，只能打破人联的封锁，去它们的地盘上看看。放心，我有分寸。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 214: Human Alliance vs. Divine Court

High above, a giant airship was patrolling the front lines.

The appearance of this airship was quite interesting; as a whole, it looked like a Ferris wheel. But upon closer inspection, one would realize it was a massive vessel composed of many molecular structures.

It was a treasure from the bottom of the vault of High-Tech Military Industry, with a frame made of strictly limited space-grade refined gold... The Intelligent Machine Legion exported 100 tons of space-grade refined gold to the Human Alliance every year. To build such a warship, it would take at least three years' worth of supply.

This great ship had been floating in the sky for nearly a year. The Human Alliance media jokingly called it the "Throne of the King." Fang Jingzhi was indeed a feudal king in his own right.

Wherever this warship went, the local morale would be bolstered. Just half a year ago, it had activated a disaster-level weapon, helping the Human Alliance turn the tide of the war.

This was pushing the limits of the "Peace Agreement." After suffering heavy losses, the Divine Court quickly launched a counterattack.

They assembled a Holy Sound Angel Corps.

This was a strange divine device, driven by archangels and unknown "sacred artifacts." It looked like a cloud floating in mid-air. The clouds were arranged in a staggered pattern, and archangels with golden wings played hymns within the soft clouds, spreading their wings to fly.

They were radiant, sacred, and breathtakingly beautiful. It almost gave one the illusion of having arrived in heaven.

The Holy Sound Angel Corps also drifted across the battlefield.

The entire Holy Sound Angel Corps sang the "Divine Comedy," written by the Divine Throne Raphael himself. Believers who listened to the holy sound would have their bodies strengthened and their fighting spirit soar—this included mutants. Non-believers, however, would suffer curses, falling into states of weakness and madness... The higher the degree of mechanization, the deeper the impact.

Units like the base’s Red Lion Legion, which the Human Alliance had originally looked down upon as "primitive troops," were actually not much affected. They just found it a bit noisy.

The warship had once attempted to disperse the Holy Sound Corps. Unfortunately, when the shells passed through, it was just a mirage-like phantom. The Human Alliance also tried to isolate the holy sound by having soldiers wear vacuum earplugs. But this was only useful at first; as time passed, the eerie music could directly resonate in their minds.

Because of the existence of the holy sound, the Human Alliance, which had just gained the upper hand, had to tighten its defensive lines to avoid further bizarre casualties. But the cost for the Divine Court to maintain the Holy Sound Corps was not small either.

The war between the Human Alliance and the Divine Court had no winner yet. It was a matter of who could hold out longer.

Except for...

"How can there be a stronghold that gets richer the more it fights?" Fang Jingzhi, who had only slept for three hours, got up and flipped through reports in the command room.

The upper half of his face was still covered by a metal feather mask, making his expression unreadable. Long-term lack of sleep forced him to take medication every day to maintain his energy. For people like them, taking medicine was as common as drinking water.

This stronghold that was getting richer and richer was the "Survivor Base," which didn't quite see eye-to-eye with him.

The base’s commander was named "Qin Jiuzhang," and the list of commanders submitted also included Van Persie, Yi Hengxing, Chifu, and Beaver.

This Qin Jiuzhang had no information in the Human Alliance database; he was a surface dweller who had popped up out of nowhere. His style was steady and cautious. He could always achieve maximum efficiency with minimal combat losses. He could always bring eye-catching data performance in a bleak battle report.

Fang Jingzhi was very satisfied with him. He had once sent a secretary to win over the people at the base.

He thought it would be a simple matter—what surface dweller didn't yearn for the underground?

He just didn't expect the other side to refuse, politely but firmly.

Whether it was the original Human Alliance fugitive Van Persie, the Human Alliance official Yi Hengxing, or the "indigenous" Chifu and Beaver, who looked penniless and had never seen the world.

Fang Jingzhi muttered, "I don't know what kind of love potion Xiang Nanli fed them. Otherwise, should I issue a conscription order? ...Forget it, what would that make me? 'Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage' could be called respecting the talented, but relying on a Human Alliance conscription order would just make me look incompetent. It’s the people at the base who don't know what's good for them; my conditions were already generous enough... No matter how much they stir things up, it’s just a surface stronghold. Dealing with the Divine Court is more important right now."

He had just put down the document when his secretary rushed in from outside, looking terrified: "My Lord! According to intelligence—the Holy Sound Angel Corps has appeared on the starship’s flight path! It’s only 200 kilometers away from a collision!"

"We tried to lock onto their specific location, but failed. The 'Holy Sound Corps' is like a 'ghost ship'; it can only be seen with the naked eye and cannot be scanned as a physical object by the positioning system."

Fang Jingzhi stood up abruptly: "I’ll go take a look."

...

...

Michael sat on the carpet, his long eyelashes drooping as he painted his nails nonchalantly. He wore a robe made of gold thread, silver thread, and peacock feathers, shimmering with a charming and opulent luster.

His hall was spacious, with 12 arched ivory doorways carved with religious paintings, and rose-glass windows made of enamel on the ceiling. The interior decoration was so extravagant it felt like a documentary on art pieces.

Beside him, a divine servant knelt on the ground, holding up an enamel ceramic plate. In the plate were different styles of earrings.

Looking closely, one would realize the materials of these ornaments were bizarre.

The pearls were teeth; the colored gems were eyeballs of different colors; the jade was tanned human tissue, such as a small piece of a finger or an ear; the lace was strands of woven hair.

Michael’s gaze swept over these ornaments, clearly lacking interest.

He hadn't had any new ornaments for a long time. Most people weren't worth remembering.

"Lord Michael," a divine official stood at the door, his tone cautious, "the patrol route of the Holy Sound Corps overlaps with the 'Sun Moon' warship of High-Tech Military Industry."

Michael acted as if he hadn't heard, talking to himself: "Raphael is really something. I’ve long felt that we could negotiate. Anyway, the purpose of arranging Uriel’s rise has been achieved; Uriel’s master is now the hottest political star in the Human Alliance..."

Uriel = Xin Zhui.

His master was naturally Luo Xiu.

"According to the agreement, we can still demand a war indemnity."

"As a result, he insisted on telling me the 'Calamity Star' hasn't been found yet. He won't let me go back. How unlucky."

Michael raised his hand and fiddled with a crystal instrument suspended in mid-air. It was intricately and beautifully designed, with a red positioning crystal in the center and hollow metal wings forming a ring.

The crystal was spinning non-stop.

If it came near the "Calamity Star," this crystal would stop its irregular spinning and point to an exact location.

But the Holy Sound Angel Corps had been drifting in the war zone for over half a month, and the crystal still hadn't found the legendary Calamity Star.

"This crystal is actually quite pretty." Michael narrowed his eyes slightly, his gaze fixed on the blood-red gem. "The Divine Throne said this was a treasure left behind by 'God'."

What exactly was God?

Michael didn't believe in God; he was different from those fooled believers. The so-called God was just a useful tool for indoctrination. Surface dwellers relied on faith to unite, and the Divine Court could also rely on "God" to accumulate wealth.

He guessed that the so-called God was just the first-generation founder of the Divine Court. Just artificially deified.

But sometimes, the Divine Court could indeed create some incredible miracles.

Perhaps it was that biological mecha called "Michael" that affected his senses.

He fiddled with the red gem in the crystal instrument, took it out, and took a light bite.

He couldn't bite through it, but it tasted like iron-tinged sweetness.

Michael put it back: "Is it blood?"

The divine official waited for a long time without getting an answer, so he had to summon the courage to say it again: "Lord Michael, the Holy Sound Corps is about to collide—"

"I know." Michael raised his hand, interrupting him impatiently, "I just need to find someone, perhaps not a person. I haven't found it in the Divine Court’s war zone, so I can only break the Human Alliance’s blockade and go to their territory to take a look. Don't worry, I have a sense of proportion."

chunks.chineseText:
说完，他手往地上跪着的这些人身上一指，语气不带丝毫感情：“他们听到了不该听的，处理掉。”

……

高新军工日月号军舰并没有修改路线的打算。

怎么可能让路？传出去多没有面子。这是严肃的外交事件。

更何况神庭这完全是不请自来。尽管地表没有领空的概念，但底下这大片的无人区，是属于人联的！

方敬之第一时间打开通讯设备，要求圣音天使团离开。

日月号发出的电波石沉大海。

又有几十架战斗无人机，从发射舱内飞出。它们先一步来到圣音团所处位置，但诡异的是，这堆无人机只是穿过了一片空气。

整个圣音团只是幻觉吗？

从探测结果来说，是这样的。可是谁又敢赌？

更诡异的是，随着星舰朝圣音团位置靠拢，所有人的耳边都响起了奇妙的咏叹调。神圣、庄严且动人。

方敬之机械化改造程度不低，他的胸口一阵烦闷，义体隐隐作痛，不至于失控，但感觉并不舒服。

人类的身体是这样的，一点异常就能让人心烦意乱。这并不是光靠意志就能克服的东西。

方敬之给自己打了一针镇定剂。那种不舒服的感觉才迅速消散。

只是，人联这么多士兵，难道每个人都要打上一针吗？

“指挥官，马上就要撞上了！”

驾驶室内，几十名驾驶员共同操作着这艘军舰，表情很是凝重。

方敬之沉默片刻，道：“那就撞上，我们不能退。所有人，都不准撤退。你们是人联的脸面。”

“是！”

没人退让。云团上，金色羽翼的天使们紧闭双眼，手持不同乐器，坐在喷泉或者白色的阶梯上，笑容平静而祥和。如同中世纪的宗教画。

画面的另一侧，却是科幻游戏里才能看见的巨大飞行器。武器瞄准着圣音团。

想象中的碰撞并没有发生。星舰穿过圣音团，就像是穿过一片柔软的云层。甚至能看见天使的身体被气流撕裂，散成一团团虚影，当星舰驶过，那些散开的云团又合拢在一起。恢复圣洁平静的表象。

方敬之站在巨大的落地窗边，看着刚刚经过的圣音天使团，不自觉地吐出一口郁气：“这到底是什么科技？科学院的人呢？给我一个解释。”

云团逐渐远去，就在马上要从方敬之的视野里消失的瞬间，坐在云上的大天使睁开眼，脸上绽开一个挑衅的笑。

那是一个很美的天使，外表酷似米迦勒。金发、六翼。

方敬之呼吸一凝。

而那个令人不安的圣音天使团，在这一刻隐入黑夜中。

After saying this, he pointed his hand at the people kneeling on the ground, his tone devoid of any emotion: "They heard what they shouldn't have. Get rid of them."

...

The High-Tech Military Industry’s Sun Moon warship had no intention of changing its route.

How could they give way? It would be so embarrassing if word got out. This was a serious diplomatic incident.

What’s more, the Divine Court had come completely uninvited. Although the surface had no concept of airspace, this vast stretch of no-man's-land below belonged to the Human Alliance!

Fang Jingzhi immediately turned on the communication equipment, demanding that the Holy Sound Angel Corps leave.

The radio waves sent out by the Sun Moon vanished into the void.

Dozens more combat drones flew out of the launch bay. They arrived at the location of the Holy Sound Corps first, but eerily, the swarm of drones simply passed through a patch of air.

Was the entire Holy Sound Corps just a hallucination?

From the detection results, it seemed so. But who dared to gamble on that?

What was even more eerie was that as the starship approached the position of the Holy Sound Corps, a marvelous aria resounded in everyone’s ears. It was sacred, solemn, and moving.

Fang Jingzhi’s degree of mechanical modification was not low; his chest felt a burst of stuffiness, and his prosthetics ached faintly—not enough to lose control, but it didn't feel comfortable.

The human body was like this; a little abnormality could make one feel agitated. This was not something that could be overcome by willpower alone.

Fang Jingzhi gave himself a shot of a sedative. Only then did the uncomfortable feeling quickly dissipate.

It was just that there were so many Human Alliance soldiers—did everyone have to get a shot?

"Commander, we’re about to collide!"

In the cockpit, dozens of pilots operated the warship together, their expressions very grave.

Fang Jingzhi was silent for a moment, then said: "Then collide. We cannot retreat. Everyone, no one is allowed to withdraw. You are the face of the Human Alliance."

"Yes!"

No one backed down. On the cloud bank, the angels with golden wings kept their eyes closed, holding different musical instruments, sitting on fountains or white stairs, their smiles calm and peaceful. It was just like a medieval religious painting.

On the other side of the scene was a massive flying vessel that could only be seen in sci-fi games. Its weapons were aimed at the Holy Sound Corps.

The collision they imagined did not happen. The starship passed through the Holy Sound Corps as if passing through a soft cloud. One could even see the angels' bodies being torn apart by the airflow, scattering into clumps of phantoms; when the starship passed, those scattered clouds merged back together, restoring their holy and calm appearance.

Fang Jingzhi stood by the huge floor-to-ceiling window, looking at the Holy Sound Angel Corps that had just passed, and couldn't help but let out a breath of frustration: "What kind of technology is this? Where are the people from the Academy of Sciences? Give me an explanation."

The cloud bank gradually moved away. Just as it was about to disappear from Fang Jingzhi’s field of vision, the archangel sitting on the cloud opened its eyes, and a provocative smile bloomed on its face.

It was a very beautiful angel, looking remarkably like Michael. Golden hair, six wings.

Fang Jingzhi’s breath hitched.

And that unsettling Holy Sound Angel Corps vanished into the night at this very moment.

chunks.chineseText:
第215章 人力发电器

后方，部落却有一个罕见的丰收年。人们刚收完粮，食物堆在仓库里，又埋进地窖。食堂的炉子24小时都在生产烤馕（一种保质期更长的硬面包），空气里散发出热腾腾的香味。

福音砖修好的宿舍楼已经安排人住上。人们勉强算是有了一个遮风挡雨的地方。

但问题接踵而来。四五层楼的建筑能容纳更多人，取暖却成为一个严峻的考验。过去的草原人，会挖坑烧花了一个秋天制作的草砖。可在高层建筑这么搞，乌烟瘴气不说，保暖效果也极差。

大福研究了一阵，在每栋建筑的户外新增了一个“取暖房”。工人在房间里用木柴烧热水，每户人家排队用玻璃瓶灌水，拿回家后，铺到床上。

相南里本来打算瓶子给人免费用，结果刚实施三天，就发现瓶子损耗量惊人。而家家户户多了一些玻璃罐子，用来装腌菜或者贵重物品……

玻璃虽然只是工业体系里的副产品，但在草原上也是难得的东西。

地下城市的某些有钱人追求“天然”“手工”，为此不惜花费巨额成本；而真正只能“纯手工”的地方，却对现代工业品趋之若鹜。本质是因为“稀缺”，稀缺产生溢价，有溢价就有商业价值。

人性是不可以拿来考验的。

相南里对此啼笑皆非，后来只好改成收10铁券的押金。丢一个瓶子扣2券，押金全扣完就要自己花钱买玻璃瓶，这才扼制住玻璃的损耗。

想建立理想世界，也不能全靠理想。

“如果有电就好了。”

部落还没有解决发电问题，能源只能优先供给工业区。

相南里听说，神庭有一种神术，能把神性物质转换为电能。

相南里听后非常心动。可惜大草原上，四条腿的异种到处都是，两条腿的却神官不好找。大部分神官都呆在圣城内，少部分住在黄金草原、深居简出，行踪成谜。

神性物质听起来很神秘，但其实就是小青经常吃的生物能源。生物能源是一个笼统的说法，和人类还无法解读的物理学理论有关，涉及到卡丘空间六维宇宙，并非真正从活物上提取的东西。

当初在湖底，黑十字研究所外围的人树的分泌物就是这个。这么一看，小青制作图纸的来历也相当可疑……指不定就是神庭当初制作“生物智械”时的产物。

可惜北辰脑子坏掉了，什么都不记得。

多亏了基地的生物技术，今年青麦和土豆的产量极高。再加上牧场里的牛羊、从猢狲部落缴获来的物资，以及战争消耗的部分人口，联合部落大概能安稳度过冬天。

相南里较为乐观，但在草原上生活了几百年的749和750却忧心忡忡。

“太安静了……草原上。现在还是初冬。异种不会冬眠，这种安静不正常。是异种潮的先兆。”

两台智械花了一周时间进行野外侦查。主要是勘察据点附近的野兽情况，以及给墙体喷洒“生物试剂”（畸变人尿液）。做一些简单的防护。

相南里的初始刷新点是长生天高原，还没见过黄金草原的大异种潮。

旅鼠到了一定数量，会聚集到海边自杀。异种们也一样，否则很难解释，为什么这些不同外观、品种的畸变生物，会自发聚集起来，不惜一切代价，向人类据点发起自杀式袭击？

“异种潮来临时，那些年迈或者受伤的异种并不会进食，它们会把食物让给其他异种，哪怕它们并不是同类。这些不进食的异种也往往充当前锋，有些会被人类打死，有些自然死去……

“死后，同类会吃掉他们的尸体。异种潮不会随着春天到来结束，只有总数消减到一定比例时，才会结束。存活的异种数量刚好是草原生态能容纳的总额的一半。”

749背着农药罐，往墙面上洒水：“上次收集的数据在十年前。我黑进神庭的后台看的。那时候，草原上异种的饱和度是81％，根据模型，最近几年就是大型异种潮爆发的时间段……”

那是近乎世界末日般的恐怖景象，只有几座圣城才能抵抗。这也是神庭的城市户口，比人联的户口还要昂贵的原因。不止是为了资源，而是关乎生存权。

每次异种潮，八座地上城市里都会多出数不清的“污秽者”。无家可归的部落人最后唯一能贩卖的，就是自己的身体。

“你说，这些畸变生物到底是靠什么知道数量太多，需要发动异种潮的？这是否是一种刻在基因里的生物程序……”750喃喃，“而且，早期异种潮爆发时，异种们会和失控智械一起对人类发动进攻。异种也不会攻击失控智械，就仿佛知道这些大铁块也是自己同伴似的。”

最近两三百年失控智械不参加，不是因为程序设置变化了，而是地表游荡的失控智械数量太少。

750继续道：“我们在地表研究异种也有几百年了。解剖过的爬行者、狂暴者、蚁蛇、猛犸鼠、相南里蛾更是数不胜数。这些生物体内并没有发现机械装置。它们甚至保留了进化前的‘DNA’，但DNA链有过重组和断裂，以及我们无法理解、无法人工合成的‘活性物质’。”

“Alpha或许知道些什么。它在地表有很多眼睛。”749藏在面具下的脸看不出表情，“他就在相南里身侧，你要去问吗？”

750思考片刻，摇头：“我不敢。我甚至怀疑这一切就是Alpha做的。他在新历110年时开展过‘人马星生物基因工程’。这项研究花了很多资源，在新历179年叫停。根据历史记录，畸变人是新历180年由人类研究出来的。但是背后未尝没有Alpha的影子。”

“制造出畸变人的，是一家叫‘东皇重工’的企业。在新历289年从历史上消失。‘东方青帝’就是它们的科研项目之一。”

749一愣。

“人马星基因工程？有这回事吗，我怎么不知道？”

“可能你被清除过数据。”

“之前可没听你说过，我的数据库里没有任何相关资料。”

“可能联网状态会自动触发关键词删除，”说到这，750自己也愣住了，“对哦，为什么我记得？我当时入选过这项工程的研究员，但是还没有正式参与行动，就跟着使徒叛逃了。而我明明记得，之前从来没想到过这件事。这是因为我们是智械，和真实的人类不同吗？只有数据，没有‘回忆’这种行为。”

现在是半夜，非常冷。智械人倒是无所谓。

在漫长的寂静后，749深吸一口气：“你应该发现了。在相南里身边呆久了，我们好像被‘修复’了？”

这种修复很难形容。就像是运行很久的设备，遇到了帮忙清理缓存的好心工程师。设备从此可以更快更流畅的运转。

750：“我发现了，但我也不知道原因。我以为是Alpha为了更好的使用我，解开了部分权限。”
