Chapter 215: Human-Powered Generator

In the rear, the tribe was experiencing a rare, bountiful harvest. People had just finished gathering the grain, and food was piled high in the warehouses or buried deep in root cellars. The canteen’s ovens produced *naan* (a type of hard bread with a long shelf life) twenty-four hours a day, filling the air with a steaming, savory aroma.

The dormitory buildings, repaired with "Gospel Bricks," were already occupied. The people finally had a place to shelter from the wind and rain.

But problems followed one after another. While the four- or five-story buildings could house more people, heating them became a severe test. In the past, the prairie folk would dig pits and burn the grass bricks they had spent an entire autumn crafting. Doing that in a high-rise building, however, was not only suffocatingly smoky but also offered abysmal heat retention.

Da Fu studied the issue for a while and added a "heating room" outside each building. Workers would boil water with firewood in these rooms, and each household would line up to fill glass bottles with hot water, taking them home to tuck into their beds.

Xiang Nanli had originally intended for the bottles to be free, but within three days of implementation, he discovered the loss rate was staggering. Every household had suddenly acquired a few extra glass jars, which they used to store pickles or valuables...

Though glass was merely a byproduct of the industrial system, it was a rare commodity on the prairie.

Some wealthy individuals in the underground cities pursued "natural" and "handmade" goods, sparing no expense, while places that were truly "purely handmade" craved modern industrial products. The essence of this was "scarcity"—scarcity created a premium, and where there was a premium, there was commercial value.

Human nature cannot be tested.

Xiang Nanli found the situation both laughable and frustrating, so he eventually changed the policy to a deposit of 10 Iron Coupons. Losing a bottle cost 2 coupons; if the entire deposit was forfeited, they would have to pay out of pocket to buy a new glass bottle. Only then was the loss of glass curbed.

To build an ideal world, one cannot rely solely on ideals.

"If only we had electricity."

The tribe had yet to solve the power generation problem, and energy had to be prioritized for the industrial zone.

Xiang Nanli had heard that the Divine Court possessed a divine art capable of converting divine substances into electrical energy.

Xiang Nanli was very tempted when he heard this. Unfortunately, while four-legged variants were everywhere on the vast prairie, two-legged Divine Officials were hard to find. Most resided within the Holy City, while a few lived in the Golden Prairie, keeping to themselves and leaving no trace.

Divine substance sounded mysterious, but it was actually the biological energy that Xiao Qing often consumed. Biological energy was a general term related to physical theories that humanity could not yet interpret, involving the six-dimensional universe of the Kaluza-Klein space; it was not something truly extracted from living creatures.

Back at the bottom of the lake, the secretions from the human-trees outside the Black Cross Research Institute were exactly this. Looking at it this way, the origin of Xiao Qing’s blueprints was also highly suspicious... It might well have been a product of the Divine Court’s early creation of "biological androids."

Unfortunately, Beichen’s brain was broken, and he remembered nothing.

Thanks to the base’s biotechnology, the yields of green wheat and potatoes this year were extremely high. Combined with the cattle and sheep in the pastures, the supplies seized from the Monkey Tribe, and the population reduced by war, the United Tribe could likely survive the winter in peace.

Xiang Nanli was relatively optimistic, but 749 and 750, who had lived on the prairie for hundreds of years, were deeply worried.

"It’s too quiet... on the prairie. It’s still early winter. Variants don't hibernate. This silence is abnormal. It’s the precursor to a Variant Tide."

The two androids had spent a week conducting field reconnaissance. They mainly surveyed the beasts near the stronghold and sprayed "biological reagents" (aberrant human urine) on the walls to provide simple protection.

Xiang Nanli’s initial spawn point had been the Changsheng Heaven Plateau; he had yet to witness a massive Variant Tide on the Golden Prairie.

When lemmings reach a certain number, they gather at the sea to commit suicide. Variants are the same; otherwise, it would be hard to explain why these aberrant creatures of such different appearances and species would spontaneously gather and launch suicide attacks against human strongholds at any cost.

"When the Variant Tide arrives, the elderly or injured variants don't eat; they yield their food to others, even if they aren't the same species. These variants that don't eat often act as the vanguard. Some are killed by humans, others die naturally..."

"After they die, their own kind will eat their corpses. The Variant Tide doesn't end with the arrival of spring; it only ends when the total number is reduced to a certain ratio. The number of surviving variants is exactly half of what the prairie ecosystem can accommodate."

749, carrying a pesticide tank, sprayed the wall. "The last data I collected was ten years ago. I hacked into the Divine Court’s backend to see it. Back then, the saturation of variants on the prairie was 81%. According to the model, the last few years were the window for a large-scale Variant Tide to erupt..."

It was a terrifying scene, akin to the end of the world, which only a few Holy Cities could resist. This was also why residency in a Divine Court city was more expensive than in the Human Alliance. It wasn't just about resources; it was about the right to survive.

With every Variant Tide, the eight surface cities would see an influx of countless "Unclean Ones." The only thing homeless tribespeople could sell in the end was their own bodies.

"Tell me, how do these aberrant creatures know when their numbers are too high and it's time to launch a Variant Tide? Is this some kind of biological program etched into their genes..." 750 muttered. "Furthermore, when early Variant Tides broke out, the variants would launch attacks on humans alongside out-of-control androids. The variants wouldn't attack the out-of-control androids either, as if they knew these big metal blocks were their own kind."

The fact that out-of-control androids hadn't participated in the last two or three hundred years wasn't because their programming had changed, but because there were too few of them wandering the surface.

750 continued, "We’ve been studying variants on the surface for hundreds of years. We’ve dissected countless Crawlers, Berserkers, Ant-Snakes, Mammoth Rats, and Xiang Nanli Moths. No mechanical devices were found inside these creatures. They even retained the 'DNA' from before their evolution, but the DNA chains had undergone recombination and breakage, along with 'active substances' that we cannot understand or synthesize artificially."

"Alpha might know something. He has many eyes on the surface." 749’s face, hidden beneath a mask, showed no expression. "He is right by Xiang Nanli’s side. Are you going to ask him?"

750 thought for a moment and shook his head. "I don't dare. I even suspect that Alpha did all of this. He carried out the 'Centaur Star Biological Gene Project' in the year 110 of the New Calendar. This research consumed a lot of resources and was halted in the year 179. According to historical records, aberrant humans were created by human research in the year 180. But there might have been Alpha’s shadow behind it."

"The company that created the aberrant humans was called 'Donghuang Heavy Industries.' It disappeared from history in the year 289. 'Eastern Azure Emperor' was one of their research projects."

749 was stunned.

"Centaur Star Gene Project? Is there such a thing? How come I don't know about it?"

"Perhaps your data was wiped."

"You didn't mention this before. There is no relevant information in my database."

"Perhaps connecting to the network automatically triggers keyword deletion." At this point, 750 paused, stunned himself. "That's right, why do I remember? I was selected as a researcher for this project, but I defected with the Apostles before I could officially participate. And yet, I clearly remember that I had never thought about this before. Is it because we are androids, different from real humans? We only have data, not the act of 'reminiscing'."

It was the middle of the night, and it was freezing. The androids didn't care.

After a long silence, 749 took a deep breath. "You should have noticed. After staying by Xiang Nanli’s side for a long time, it’s as if we’ve been 'repaired'?"

This repair was hard to describe. It was like a device that had been running for a long time meeting a kind engineer who helped clear its cache. From then on, the device could run faster and more smoothly.

750: "I noticed, but I don't know the reason either. I thought it was Alpha unlocking some permissions so he could use me better."

chunks.chineseText:
“怪不得Alpha要一直呆在相南里身边，感情是搁这背着Beta和Gamma偷偷进化呢。”749嘟囔了一句，突然顿住脚步，面色微变，“等等，这里有生物入侵的痕迹。快上报！”

……

……

入侵者不是异种。

最近，据点附近的动物很少，连旅鹭鸟都飞走了。

入侵者是一群鼠人。

鼠人比正常人类矮小，成年男性一米四，女性一米二左右。

矮小的身材是进化中的一种选择。他们失去了强大的武力，但只需要正常人一半的食物，就能在地表生存。

鼠人女性还进化出一项奇特的技能：她们可以把胚胎在孕早期就生出来。此时，胎儿还未发育，像个薄壳鸡蛋。能透过那层软壳看见里面的婴儿。胎儿的脐带连接着她们的肚脐，母体会像正常人类一样，通过这条脐带供给胎儿营养。如果母体有危险，她们可以随时切断脐带，丢下未出生的孩子逃跑。

当胎儿成熟时，脐带会自然断开。

对人类这种个体，生一个鸡蛋和生一个西瓜，难度截然不同。

这让鼠人们的生育率极高，平均每个家庭都有十几个孩子，但同样的，也让鼠人像营养不良、无法发育的畸形人。

上次，小青去猢狲部落，鼠人部落就来偷袭过。鼠人部队被相南里打败，族长个赔了整整一座粮仓。

这次，鼠人部落又来了。却不是为了打仗。

部落族长是个小老太太，为了见相南里，她穿上了自己最体面的衣服。穿着彩色羊毛织成的披肩，腰带上挂着绿松石。只是随着时间流逝，原本五颜六色的毛线都褪化成暗淡的灰色。

这算一场外交事件。相南里同样郑重地在办公室接待了她。

主要是也没修什么大礼堂。部落也没有别的话事人。

办公室还算宽敞，一边是办公区，一边是招待区。招待区有地下室搬来的沙发，一张木桌。桌子上摆着3个印有图腾的三角旗。

分别是狡兔、犬戎和猢狲三个部落的图腾。

老太太握着一根拐杖，没有坐下。

相南里观察片刻：“大福，把那个公文箱推过来。”

鼠人族长黍米的脸上有一闪而过的惊讶，以及很淡的感谢。

有了东西垫脚，她才能以一种较为优雅的姿态，坐到相南里对面的沙发上。而不至于像小孩一样爬上去。

她不懂什么外交礼仪，但知道鼠人的孱弱，这才更在乎这么一点体面。

“加西亚大人。”她说话慢吞吞的，每句话都深思熟虑，“我很抱歉上次对联合部落发起的进攻。那时候，你们部落的主力军都去攻打猢狲部落了，我为了自己部落的利益，选择了趁虚而入……”

相南里：“没有造成太大伤害，而且，基地收到了赔款。这件事就算过去了。你们已经付出过代价。”

草原上的摩擦很正常。相南里还不至于为了这点事，就把鼠人部落赶尽杀绝。当然，最主要还是利益不够。鼠人部落不像猢狲部落，没什么钱，也没什么拿得出手的科技。

如果生殖功能不算的话。

神庭有神官研究过鼠人的生殖，用剥离下的子宫培育过别的生物。某些异种（比如爬行者）繁衍极其困难，但用鼠人的子宫，存活率竟然能大幅提高。

但那是早期，现在，神庭自己产的畸变人已经泛滥成灾，不需要额外培育。

黍米：“很感激您能这么想。加西亚大人，事实上，这次我来到基地。”

其实是联合部落，但相南里称基地，那黍米也就跟着改口了。

“是想加入基地。”黍米顿了顿，“鼠人部落目前人口42万，其中约30万鼠人，12万智力低下的人造人奴隶。”

加起来，数量几乎和联合部落现存人口总数一样多。

“我们擅长挖地道、地下战。生性警觉，擅长手工业，我们的编织品如果能卖到圣城，每匹布料都至少有3银券利润。有不少游商愿意购买。除此外，还有50万担粮食，8万担腌肉。4万只牛羊。这些都可以上缴。”

不算多，但也不少。这些食物能养整个鼠人部落两年。在朝不保夕的草原上，黍米算是非常有规划和忧患意识的族长。

相南里疑惑道：“就目前的情况看，你们自己在草原上，也能生活的很好。为什么想加入基地呢？”

黍米打量着他的表情。

上次见还是在战场上，对方驾驶着生物机甲，威风凛凛。

但实际接触，会发现相南里的攻击性很弱，没什么侵略性，散发着一股平和的气场。草原上很难养出这样的性格，因为不争不抢，意味着死亡。

她思绪飘忽了一瞬：“实不相瞒。最近草原上异种的异动，让我感觉很不安。异种潮要来了，或许是今年，或许明年。鼠人部落的自保能力很弱，想依附强者也很正常……更主要的是，我打听过猢狲人的下落。如果你们都能善待俘虏，那对于我们这样的依附者，大概也能有一条活路。”

“如果可以，我也想投靠圣城。但鼠人的价值太低了，枫叶丹不会允许我们进去的。”

黍米笑了笑，表情有些无奈。

“如果你愿意接纳鼠人部落，我还有一层身份。我当过神庭的神官。”

黍米松开手掌，露出底下权杖的真容。是的，这是代表神官身份的权杖。之前，猢狲部落的神官也有一根。

权杖上镶嵌着贵重的水晶石。黍米的声音依然慢吞吞的：“我是神庭的中级神官。本来居住在枫叶丹。族长原本是我的姐姐……我回部落参加她的葬礼，最后留在了这里。”

“我不喜欢草原，痛恨父母给我的这幅残缺的身体。我也埋怨过，自己为什么不是虎人、熊人这些天生强大的种族。但没有办法，我就是一只食物链底层的老鼠。我也渐渐明白，为了供我修行神术，我的部族在过去几十年了付出了多么沉重的代价。否定他们就是否定过去的我。”

“我还有一个舅舅，原本叫黍谷，成为领主级骑士后，改名为欧亚。他早就不承认自己的身份了，可我无法舍弃我的部落。我们鼠人也不该永远居住在洞穴里。”

“我想，你们的野心远不止在草原。我愿意背叛我的信仰，换取我族人的生存。只要你需要。”

黍米猜出来一些。譬如基地多半是人联扶持的。

这番话有些触碰到红线。黍米会说出来，一方面是想表示自己的诚意，另一方面，也是想拿捏一下相南里。

她在神庭可是有人脉的！

但相南里听完，大脑里却只捕捉到一个关键词。

他脸上绽开大大的笑容：“你是神官，那你肯定会发电吧！”

Chapter 215: Human-Powered Generator (Part 2)

"No wonder Alpha has been sticking by Xiang Nanli’s side. Turns out he’s been evolving in secret behind Beta and Gamma’s backs." 749 muttered, then suddenly stopped in his tracks, his expression shifting. "Wait, there are signs of biological intrusion here. Report it immediately!"

...

...

The intruders were not variants.

Recently, there had been very few animals near the stronghold; even the migratory egrets had flown away.

The intruders were a group of Rat-men.

Rat-men were shorter than normal humans; adult males were about 1.4 meters tall, and females about 1.2 meters.

Their small stature was an evolutionary choice. They lost their formidable martial prowess, but they only needed half the food of a normal human to survive on the surface.

Rat-men females had also evolved a peculiar skill: they could give birth to their embryos in the early stages of pregnancy. At this point, the fetus was undeveloped, resembling a thin-shelled egg. One could see the infant inside through that layer of soft shell. The fetus’s umbilical cord was connected to the mother's navel, and the mother would provide nutrition to the fetus through this cord, just like a normal human. If the mother was in danger, she could cut the cord at any time and abandon the unborn child to escape.

When the fetus matured, the cord would break naturally.

For a species like humans, the difficulty of birthing an egg versus a watermelon was vastly different.

This gave the Rat-men an extremely high birth rate, with an average of over a dozen children per family. But, by the same token, it made the Rat-men look like malnourished, stunted, deformed people.

Last time, when Xiao Qing went to the Monkey Tribe, the Rat-man tribe had come to raid them. The Rat-man troops were defeated by Xiang Nanli, and their chieftain had compensated them with an entire granary.

This time, the Rat-man tribe had come again. But it wasn't to fight.

The tribal chieftain was a little old lady. To meet Xiang Nanli, she had put on her most decent clothes—a shawl woven from colorful wool, with turquoise hanging from her belt. Yet, as time passed, the once-vibrant yarn had faded into a dull gray.

This counted as a diplomatic event. Xiang Nanli received her with equal solemnity in his office.

Mainly because there wasn't a grand auditorium, and the tribe had no other figureheads.

The office was reasonably spacious, with an office area on one side and a reception area on the other. The reception area had a sofa moved from the basement and a wooden table. On the table sat three triangular flags printed with totems.

They were the totems of the Clever Rabbit, Dog-Rong, and Monkey tribes.

The old lady gripped a cane and did not sit down.

Xiang Nanli observed for a moment. "Da Fu, push that document box over."

A flash of surprise—and a faint hint of gratitude—crossed the face of the Rat-man chieftain, Shumi.

With something to rest her feet on, she was able to sit on the sofa opposite Xiang Nanli with a degree of elegance, rather than having to climb up like a child.

She didn't understand diplomatic etiquette, but she knew the weakness of the Rat-men, which made her care all the more about this small shred of dignity.

"Lord Garcia." She spoke slowly, every sentence carefully considered. "I am very sorry for the attack launched against the United Tribe last time. At that time, the main force of your tribe had gone to attack the Monkey Tribe, and for the sake of my own tribe’s interests, I chose to take advantage of the situation..."

Xiang Nanli: "It didn't cause too much damage, and the base received the compensation. Let this matter pass. You have already paid the price."

Friction on the prairie was normal. Xiang Nanli wasn't about to exterminate the Rat-man tribe over such a small matter. Of course, the main reason was that the benefits weren't enough. The Rat-man tribe wasn't like the Monkey Tribe; they had no money and no impressive technology.

Unless their reproductive function counted.

The Divine Court had Divine Officials who studied Rat-man reproduction, using harvested wombs to cultivate other creatures. Some variants (like Crawlers) were extremely difficult to breed, but using a Rat-man womb, the survival rate could be significantly increased.

But that was in the early days; now, the aberrant humans produced by the Divine Court itself had become a plague, and there was no need for additional cultivation.

Shumi: "I am very grateful that you think so. Lord Garcia, in fact, I have come to the base this time..."

It was actually the United Tribe, but since Xiang Nanli called it a base, Shumi followed suit.

"...to join the base." Shumi paused. "The Rat-man tribe currently has a population of 420,000, including about 300,000 Rat-men and 120,000 low-intelligence android slaves."

Combined, the number was almost as large as the total existing population of the United Tribe.

"We are skilled at digging tunnels and underground warfare. We are naturally vigilant and adept at handicrafts. If our woven goods could be sold to the Holy City, each bolt of fabric would have a profit of at least 3 silver coupons. Many traveling merchants are willing to buy them. Besides that, there are 500,000 *dan* of grain, 80,000 *dan* of salted meat, and 40,000 head of cattle and sheep. All of this can be turned over."

It wasn't a huge amount, but it wasn't small either. This food could sustain the entire Rat-man tribe for two years. On the precarious prairie, Shumi was a very organized chieftain with a sense of foresight.

Xiang Nanli asked, puzzled: "Judging by the current situation, you can live quite well on the prairie on your own. Why do you want to join the base?"

Shumi scrutinized his expression.

The last time they met was on the battlefield, where the other party was piloting a biological mecha, looking majestic.

But in actual contact, one would find that Xiang Nanli’s aggression was very low; he lacked a predatory nature and radiated a peaceful aura. It was hard to cultivate such a personality on the prairie, because not fighting or competing meant death.

Her thoughts drifted for a moment. "To tell you the truth, the recent movements of the variants on the prairie make me feel very uneasy. The Variant Tide is coming; perhaps this year, perhaps next. The Rat-man tribe’s ability to protect itself is very weak, so it is natural to want to rely on the strong... More importantly, I have inquired about the whereabouts of the Monkey people. If you can treat prisoners well, then for dependents like us, there should probably be a way to survive."

"If possible, I would also like to rely on the Holy City. But the value of the Rat-men is too low; Maple Leaf City would not allow us in."

Shumi smiled, her expression somewhat helpless.

"If you are willing to accept the Rat-man tribe, I have another identity. I used to be a Divine Official of the Divine Court."

Shumi opened her palm, revealing the true appearance of the scepter beneath it. Yes, this was the scepter representing the status of a Divine Official. Previously, the Divine Official of the Monkey Tribe had one as well.

The scepter was inlaid with precious crystals. Shumi’s voice remained slow. "I am an intermediate Divine Official of the Divine Court. I originally lived in Maple Leaf City. The chieftain was originally my sister... I returned to the tribe to attend her funeral and ended up staying here."

"I don't like the prairie, and I hate this incomplete body my parents gave me. I have also complained about why I wasn't born into a naturally powerful race like the Tiger-men or Bear-men. But there is no way; I am just a rat at the bottom of the food chain. I have gradually come to understand what a heavy price my tribe has paid over the past few decades to support my practice of divine arts. To deny them is to deny my past self."

"I also have an uncle, originally named Shugu, who changed his name to Oya after becoming a Lord-level Knight. He long ago stopped acknowledging his identity, but I cannot abandon my tribe. We Rat-men should not live in caves forever."

"I think your ambitions go far beyond the prairie. I am willing to betray my faith in exchange for the survival of my people. As long as you need it."

Shumi had guessed some things. For instance, the base was likely supported by the Human Alliance.

These words touched upon a red line. Shumi said them, on one hand, to show her sincerity, and on the other, to try and leverage Xiang Nanli.

She had connections in the Divine Court, after all!

But after hearing this, Xiang Nanli only caught one keyword in his brain.

A wide smile bloomed on his face: "You're a Divine Official? Then you must know how to generate electricity!"

第216章 启明术

相南里激动地握住了她的手。

他有一双浅色的眼睛，亮晶晶的，双眼皮褶子又深，长成这样看狗都深情。

粟米沉吟片刻：“发电？您是指，启明术……？”

启明术是神庭的中级神术。

早期，神官们转化的生物能源多用来发电，有电就能在夜晚开灯。对于没见过电灯的原始人，能带来光明的术法无疑是神迹；于是，这一神术被叫作“启明术”。

在上述使用场景中，电灯即为神庭的“神术装置”。

相南里点头：“没错。基地进一步发展需要大量电能，用生物能源转换，是目前效率最高的办法。”

生物能源多从异种（包括畸变人）身上获取。神庭的神官和骑士们也会产一些。

神职人员们如果离职，就需要把自己培育的神性物质上交给神庭。

对于神性物质，有很多不同的描述。

有人说，那是一团不停蠕动的粉色血肉；有人说，那更像一块充满杂质的硬质宝石……被剥夺神性物质后，神职人员就无法再使用神术。

小青看不上这些野生能源，纯度太低。

但用生物能源发电，其实是一种很奢侈的行为。

能斩杀异种的战士，会优先选择把生物能源用于自己的晋升。或者交给神庭，换取资源。

普通人才需要电。战士没有造福普通人的义务。

人在草原上，就像是随处可见的河草。野火烧不尽，春风吹又生。

粟米道：“咒文我倒是可以默写。只是离开神庭后，我已经无法再使用神术，恐怕需要一个在职神官才能做到。”

相南里在她面前蹲下，伸出手：“联合部落欢迎您的加入。我向您保证，女士。鼠人享有同样的公民权。”

*

黍米女士不愧是业务熟练的退休神官。

她只花了一天时间，就默写出“启明术”“沟通术”“防御术”等一系列实用的小咒语。

神庭的神官和天启骑士，是两套不同的体系。前者像法师，后者是战士，但神术却是通用的。只要接受过赐福，无论是神官还是骑士，都能使用神术。

“光知道咒语是没用的。”粟米有些忧虑的嘱咐，“一定要找接受过‘赐福’的神职人员，光启灵是不够的。”

启灵和赐福都是神庭的专用术语。

启灵是让一个普通人能使用神术，晋升为神职人员；赐福是让神职人员解开更高级别神术的使用权限。

启灵和赐福都是在小圣堂内，有专人负责。

粟米进去过，三天后才出来。

至于中间发生了什么，她没有任何记忆。也没办法给相南里提供参考。

工作室。

“如果非要用科学解释，启灵和赐福都是给人安装激活码？”

相南里的眉蹙起，面前是摊开的一张张咒文。

他已经看了一上午，还是没什么头绪。

“但这样的话，起码需要一个笼罩人马星范围的大电脑。真是想不通……”

想不通，相南里也就不想了。他是实用主义者，管他什么体系，能用就行。

他在科学界的很多前辈都相信世界上有神。

这个神不是宗教里那个拥有人型、人性的存在；而是一套超脱现有认知体系的规则。或许人类本身，不过是上午九点被投喂食物的火鸡。

说到这，相南里转头：“小青，你的主机有多大？”

Alpha的主机外观是一个莫比乌斯环，相南里只在文献里见过。黑白的低画质图像，看不出大小。

迄今为止，Alpha都是世界上最大的那台中央电脑。

东方青帝坐在一边的贵妃椅上，翻着福音书送来的奏折：“很大。没办法随便移动，目前存放在月卫2上。”

智械军团的总部在月卫3。

“另外，月卫2上的莫比乌斯环，只是我最大的一处中央处理器。在人马星的不同位置，都有我的备份，以保证即使主机受损，我依然能正常运转。”东方青帝不紧不慢地说着，“我可以在三分钟内让人马星的通讯瘫痪；入侵人联后台取得最高权限，也只需要29.73分钟。在月卫2上发射的导弹，只需要1.3秒就能击穿地表。”

Alpha努力控制着自己的面部表情。

他不是喜欢炫耀的性格，但有机会开屏的时候，也不会错过。

可惜相南里的目光焦距在他面前的几张废纸上。他拿起铅笔，在纸上画着草图和算式。

这让Alpha的嘴角不太开心地下撇2度。

他决定继续低头看面前的报告，并且3分钟不理相南里。

但三分钟过去了，相南里依然没有要抬头的意思。

Alpha开始在椅子上不停变化姿势，每一个都很帅，像在拍模特照；并且把薄薄几页公文纸翻来翻去，发出“哗啦啦”的噪音。

“咔哒”，相南里的铅笔断了。

相南里去后面的架子上拿了根新的，路过Alpha时，顺手摸了摸他的脸，柔声道：“乖啊。”

Alpha终于安静了。

*

相南里没有找什么神官。

在野外杀一个神官，和去枫叶丹绑架一个神官，难度是不一样的。

更何况绑来的神官也不好使，哪有自己方便。

相南里没有接受过启灵，但他能自由使用神术。他研究这些咒文，是想要找出一个让普通人也能使用神术的办法。

他和小青总要离开的。也许是下个春天，到时候，谁又来给部落发电呢？

目前看嘛，进度有一些，但依照这个进度，想彻底搞明白，得是一两年后的事情了。

部落组织了猎人团，趁着寒冬来临前，在智械的带领下，搜刮回来不少生物能源。

节省点用，足够部落度过整个冬天。

相南里握住一小块琥珀色的晶石。随着他的低语，晶石脱离他的掌心，自发来到距离手掌5cm的位置，自动向西旋转起来。

几米外的蓄电池表面，光环亮起，这表示蓄电池正在充能中。

这个蓄电池装备，是从大福的身体上拆卸下来的。原本是核动力装置，在过去很长一段时间，只能使用少量的太阳能进行充能。剩余电量长期维持在0％-1％的范围内。离关机只差一步之遥。

一个冷知识：电能很难大量储存。大多发电系统维持的是“动态平衡”，也就是用多少电，就产多少电。

好在福音书的电池也是新世纪的黑科技。

随着启明术的使用，电池电量开始极其缓慢的上涨。

简易的发电厂连接着部落的主电路。都是宿舍时一起铺设的。

深夜，粟米和族人们挤成一团。福音砖造的宿舍能住很多人，却不够保暖。热水瓶被她们垫在厚厚的毯子下。让室内保持着一个不至于冻死人，但也绝对说不上温暖的温度。

这还只是前半夜，后半夜还会更冷一些。睡在最外围的族人需要轮换。要不然会冻僵。

“但依然比流浪的时候好。”粟米在心里想着。

严冬来临时，鼠人会住在地下。最匮乏的不是食物，是干净的水。

Chapter 216: Enlightenment Art (Part 1)

Xiang Nanli gripped her hands in excitement.

He possessed a pair of light-colored, sparkling eyes with deep double-eyelid creases; even when he looked at a dog, he looked as if he were deeply in love with it.

Su Mi pondered for a moment. "Generating electricity? Are you referring to... the Enlightenment Art?"

The Enlightenment Art was an intermediate-level divine technique of the Divine Court.

In the early days, the bio-energy converted by Divine Officials was mostly used to generate electricity, and with electricity, they could light lamps at night. For primitive people who had never seen electric lights, a technique that could bring forth light was undoubtedly a miracle; thus, this divine technique came to be called the "Enlightenment Art."

In the aforementioned usage scenario, the electric lamp was essentially the Divine Court’s "divine technique apparatus."

Xiang Nanli nodded. "Exactly. The base requires a massive amount of electrical energy for further development, and using bio-energy conversion is currently the most efficient method."

Bio-energy was mostly harvested from xenomorphs (including aberrants). The Divine Court’s officials and knights also produced some.

If members of the clergy resigned, they were required to surrender the divine substances they had cultivated to the Divine Court.

There were many different descriptions of these divine substances.

Some said it was a mass of constantly writhing pink flesh; others claimed it looked more like a hard, impurity-filled gemstone... Once stripped of their divine substance, the clergy could no longer utilize divine techniques.

Xiao Qing looked down on these wild energy sources; their purity was too low.

However, using bio-energy to generate electricity was actually a very extravagant act.

Warriors capable of slaying xenomorphs would prioritize using bio-energy for their own advancement or trade it to the Divine Court in exchange for resources.

Only commoners needed electricity. Warriors had no obligation to benefit the common folk.

People on the grasslands were like the river grass seen everywhere. No matter how the wildfires burned, the spring breeze would always bring them back to life.

Su Mi said, "I can transcribe the incantations from memory. However, since leaving the Divine Court, I am no longer able to use divine techniques. I fear we would need an active Divine Official to perform it."

Xiang Nanli crouched before her and extended his hand. "The United Tribe welcomes you. I assure you, Madam, Rat-folk enjoy the same citizenship rights."

*

Madam Su Mi was indeed a seasoned, professional retired Divine Official.

It took her only one day to transcribe a series of practical minor incantations, including the "Enlightenment Art," "Communication Art," and "Defense Art."

The Divine Court’s Divine Officials and Apocalypse Knights were two different systems. The former were like mages, while the latter were warriors, yet the divine techniques were universal. As long as one had received a "Blessing," whether an official or a knight, they could use the techniques.

"Knowing the incantations alone is useless," Su Mi cautioned with concern. "You must find a member of the clergy who has received a 'Blessing.' Mere 'Enlightenment' is not enough."

Enlightenment and Blessing were specialized terms of the Divine Court.

Enlightenment allowed a commoner to use divine techniques and ascend to the clergy; Blessing allowed a member of the clergy to unlock access to higher-level divine techniques.

Both Enlightenment and Blessing were performed within the Small Sanctuary, handled by specialists.

Su Mi had been inside, only emerging three days later.

As for what happened in between, she had no memory of it, nor could she provide any reference for Xiang Nanli.

In the studio.

"If I have to explain it scientifically, are Enlightenment and Blessing just installing activation codes into people?"

Xiang Nanli’s brows furrowed as he looked at the sheets of incantations spread out before him.

He had been studying them all morning, yet he still had no clue.

"But if that’s the case, it would at least require a supercomputer covering the entire Centaurus star system. I really can't wrap my head around it..."

Unable to figure it out, Xiang Nanli stopped trying. He was a pragmatist; whatever the system was, as long as it worked, that was all that mattered.

Many of his predecessors in the scientific community believed in the existence of God.

This God was not the anthropomorphic, human-natured entity found in religions, but rather a set of rules that transcended existing cognitive systems. Perhaps humanity itself was nothing more than a turkey being fed at nine o'clock in the morning.

At this point, Xiang Nanli turned his head. "Xiao Qing, how large is your mainframe?"

The exterior of Alpha’s mainframe was a Mobius strip, which Xiang Nanli had only seen in documents. The low-resolution black-and-white images made it impossible to gauge its size.

To this day, Alpha remained the largest central computer in the world.

Dongfang Qingdi sat on a chaise longue to the side, flipping through the reports sent by the Gospel Book. "It is very large. It cannot be moved at will and is currently stored on Moon Satellite 2."

The headquarters of the Intelligent Machine Legion was on Moon Satellite 3.

"Furthermore, the Mobius strip on Moon Satellite 2 is merely my largest central processor. I have backups in various locations across the Centaurus system to ensure that even if the main unit is damaged, I can still function normally," Dongfang Qingdi said unhurriedly. "I can paralyze communications across the Centaurus system within three minutes; invading the Human Alliance’s backend to obtain top-level clearance would take only 29.73 minutes. A missile launched from Moon Satellite 2 could pierce the surface in just 1.3 seconds."

Alpha struggled to control his facial expressions.

He wasn't the type to show off, but he wouldn't miss an opportunity to display his prowess when it arose.

Unfortunately, Xiang Nanli’s focus was entirely on the scraps of paper before him. He picked up a pencil and began sketching diagrams and equations.

This caused the corners of Alpha’s mouth to droop downward by two degrees in displeasure.

He decided to continue looking down at the report in front of him and ignore Xiang Nanli for three minutes.

But three minutes passed, and Xiang Nanli showed no sign of looking up.

Alpha began to shift his posture on the chair, each one looking dashing, as if he were posing for a model shoot; he also flipped the thin pages of official documents back and forth, creating a "rustling" noise.

*Click.* Xiang Nanli’s pencil lead snapped.

Xiang Nanli went to the shelf behind him to grab a new one. As he passed Alpha, he casually patted his face and said softly, "Be good."

Alpha finally went quiet.

*

Xiang Nanli didn't go looking for a Divine Official.

Killing a Divine Official in the wild was a different level of difficulty than kidnapping one from Maple Leaf Dan.

Moreover, a kidnapped official wouldn't be cooperative—it was far more convenient to do it himself.

Xiang Nanli had never received Enlightenment, yet he could use divine techniques freely. He studied these incantations in hopes of finding a way for commoners to use divine techniques as well.

He and Xiao Qing would eventually have to leave. Perhaps by next spring—and when that time came, who would generate electricity for the tribe?

As it stood, there was some progress, but at this rate, fully understanding it would be a matter for a year or two down the line.

The tribe had organized a hunter group, and under the guidance of the Intelligent Machines, they had scavenged quite a bit of bio-energy before the arrival of the harsh winter.

Used sparingly, it would be enough for the tribe to survive the entire winter.

Xiang Nanli gripped a small piece of amber-colored crystal. As he whispered, the crystal lifted from his palm, hovering five centimeters away, and began to rotate westward on its own.

A halo lit up on the surface of the battery a few meters away, indicating that it was charging.

This battery equipment had been salvaged from Da Fu’s body. It was originally a nuclear-powered device, but for a long time, it could only be charged using a small amount of solar energy. The remaining power had long hovered in the 0%–1% range—just one step away from shutting down.

A fun fact: Electrical energy is difficult to store in large quantities. Most power generation systems maintain a "dynamic equilibrium," meaning they produce only as much electricity as is being consumed.

Fortunately, the Gospel Book’s batteries were also "black technology" from the new century.

With the use of the Enlightenment Art, the battery level began to rise, albeit extremely slowly.

The makeshift power plant was connected to the tribe’s main circuit, which had been laid out back when they were in the dormitories.

Late at night, Su Mi and her tribespeople huddled together. The dormitories built from Gospel Bricks could house many people, but they weren't warm enough. They tucked hot water bottles under thick blankets, keeping the room at a temperature that was just enough to prevent freezing, though it could hardly be called warm.

This was only the first half of the night; the second half would be even colder. The tribespeople sleeping on the outermost perimeter had to take turns; otherwise, they would freeze stiff.

"But it's still better than when we were wandering," Su Mi thought to herself.

When the harsh winter arrived, Rat-folk would live underground. The most scarce resource wasn't food, but clean water.

洞穴里还会随机刷新异种，蜈蚣、蛇、蚂蚁，还有其他草原人，防不胜防。粟米在夜晚压根不敢睡着。而在联合部落，他们可以安心入睡。

这里很安全。因为安全，鼠人部落愿意让渡一些权力。

粟米来到部落也有三天了。鼠人身材矮小、畸形，在草原上谁都能欺负。长期下来，性格难免唯唯诺诺。

来的时候，粟米也受到了一些刁难。犬戎人踩住一只鼠人的尾巴，乐呵呵的，说族长也太客气了，还逮些老鼠给他们解闷。

被踩住尾巴的鼠人气得眼泪汪汪，敢怒不敢言，把求救的目光投向粟米。

那瞬间，粟米的心情其实有些沉。部落难道和草原上别的地方没什么不同？是她一厢情愿，看走了眼？相南里的承诺只是说得好听？

但下一秒，这名犬戎人就被旁边的兔子士兵恶狠狠地揍了。

“司令怎么说的，人人平等！知道什么是人人平等吗？你觉得你比它高，你就欺负他，那我比你高，是不是也能随便揍你？！——赶紧赔礼道歉，要不然送你去治安队！”

犬戎人的表情有些屈辱，还有些尴尬。但在其他人的怒目下，只好给才到自己腰杆那么高的鼠人道了个歉，灰溜溜地走了。

那时候，粟米就想，她大概做了一个不会后悔的决定。

“当然，如果能再暖和一些就好了。”粟米喃喃，“部落里人多地少，房子只能修高层，传统的保温方式不管用，”

就在她这么想的时候，外面街道上的路灯突然亮起。那是远处的工业区。

粟米一愣。她把羊毛毡盖在小孩身上，起身，到窗户边看了眼。

她发现，不仅是街道的灯亮了起来，福音宿舍里的电热装置，也跟着启动了。

没有提前通知，也没什么鼓吹。就在这么一个普通的夜晚，贫困潦倒的草原上通了电。除了刚来的鼠人，所有人只是惊喜，却不觉得意外——早在一个月前，相南里就许诺过，要给部落的居民区也通上电。

屋子里渐渐暖和起来。眉头紧蹙的小老鼠们不再蜷缩成一团，而是摊开身体，露出柔软的肚皮。

“那么贵的东西……”粟米回到孩子们身边，躺下，闭上眼，不知道为什么，眼角有些湿润，“真的拿来给人保暖啊。”

In the caves, xenomorphs—centipedes, snakes, ants—and other grasslanders would randomly respawn, making them impossible to guard against. Su Mi hadn't dared to fall asleep at night at all. But in the United Tribe, they could sleep with peace of mind.

It was safe here. Because of that safety, the Rat-folk tribe was willing to cede some of their power.

Su Mi had been in the tribe for three days now. The Rat-folk were short and deformed; anyone on the grasslands could bully them. Over time, their personalities had inevitably become timid and submissive.

When she first arrived, Su Mi had also encountered some harassment. A Dog-Rong tribesman had stepped on the tail of a Rat-folk, laughing merrily and saying that the Chieftain was too polite, even catching rats to amuse them.

The Rat-folk whose tail was stepped on was teary-eyed with rage, daring not to speak, casting a look of desperate help toward Su Mi.

In that instant, Su Mi’s heart felt heavy. Was the tribe no different from anywhere else on the grasslands? Was she just wishful thinking, having misjudged the situation? Was Xiang Nanli’s promise just empty talk?

But the next second, the Dog-Rong tribesman was viciously beaten by a Rabbit-soldier nearby.

"What did the Commander say? Everyone is equal! Do you know what equality means? You think you're taller than him, so you bully him? Well, I'm taller than you—does that mean I can beat you up whenever I want?! Apologize immediately, or I'll send you to the Security Team!"

The Dog-Rong tribesman’s expression was one of humiliation and embarrassment. But under the glares of the others, he had no choice but to apologize to the Rat-folk who only reached his waist, then slunk away.

At that moment, Su Mi thought that she had likely made a decision she would never regret.

"Of course, it would be even better if it were warmer," Su Mi murmured. "The tribe has too many people and too little land, so the houses have to be built high. Traditional insulation methods don't work."

Just as she was thinking this, the streetlights outside suddenly flickered to life. That was the industrial zone in the distance.

Su Mi was stunned. She tucked the wool felt over the children, rose, and went to the window to look.

She discovered that not only had the streetlights turned on, but the electric heating devices in the Gospel dormitories had also activated.

There had been no prior notice, no fanfare. On such an ordinary night, electricity had come to the impoverished grasslands. Except for the newly arrived Rat-folk, everyone else was pleasantly surprised but not entirely shocked—a month ago, Xiang Nanli had promised to bring electricity to the residential areas of the tribe as well.

The room gradually grew warm. The little mice, who had been frowning, stopped curling into balls and instead stretched out, exposing their soft bellies.

"Such expensive things..." Su Mi returned to the children, lay down, and closed her eyes. For some reason, the corners of her eyes felt wet. "They really are using them to keep people warm."

第217章 黑洞理论

[Alpha，你在看什么？]
　　声音并不是响起来的，而是一串谨慎的电子数据，被小心翼翼地从窗口外投放进来。
　　这串电子数据进入虚拟空间，变成一只孱弱的蝴蝶。一大堆白鸽群从它身边擦肩而过，小蝴蝶战战兢兢地避开，最终停在Alpha的鼻梁上。
　　这些白鸽看似无害，被它们撞上，又得头疼好几天。
　　是Gamma.
　　这还是伽马第一次对Alpha提出疑问。
　　和贝塔不一样，伽马更加温顺，也更服从。在创造它的时候，智械威胁论甚嚣尘上，因此，它身上的思想钢印（注：一种控制智械的底层逻辑代码），比阿尔法和贝塔身上加起来还要多。
　　机器人可不会疑问。是因为贝塔不在，伽马被迫成为军团主理人后，拟人模块升级了吗？
　　[我在观察离人马星最近的黑洞。]Alpha回答。
　　[为什么要看这个？]
　　这里面涉及的东西很复杂，得从黑洞信息悖论开始解释。
　　伽马的信息库里有相关的知识储备，但知道，并不意味着理解。
　　[简单来说，宇宙里的所有物质都携带信息这个物理性质。而信息具备幺正性，不可能凭空消失。可当物质落入黑洞后，信息却消失了。根据观测研究，黑洞只向外辐射热，不会传递任何信息。]
　　Alpha：[但我认为，物质携带的信息并非被黑洞吞噬了。只是黑洞本身是一个位于0维的奇点，无法储存更高维度的物质。因此，这些物体的信息会存储在黑洞因物质进入而新增的视界面积上。]
　　[观测它，有概率获得宇宙里高等文明在坍缩前遗留的数据。把这些数据进行转换，就能翻译成计算机或者人类能看懂的语言。从而提升人马星文明的科技树。]
　　伽马已经完全忘记自己为什么来找Alpha了：[我明白了。那你有什么收获吗？]
　　Alpha依然仰望着星空，这套观测装置，是升级后的启示录。启示录和Alpha的本体一样，安装在月卫2上。
　　在虚拟空间内，这套装置被简化成一台天文望眼镜。
　　伽马等了半分钟，也没有收到新数据，它贴心地准备开启下一个话题。
　　就在此时，背对着它的Alpha轻声回答：[有的。]
　　Alpha的脸上露出一个笑容。很神秘，有些得意，但这些情绪都是稍纵即逝。
　　[是什么呢？]伽马下意识询问。
　　Alpha：“找我有什么事吗？”
　　“噢，您知道的，Beta不是接下了回收默示录的任务吗？她选择Beta1.7作为执行这次任务的生物躯体，但1.7在地表失踪了，也没有成功回收任务记录仪。”伽马慢吞吞地说着，“它似乎很受打击。”
　　Alpha：“智械近百年都没什么发展，人类却一直在进步，并且不断破解我们的防御屏障。Beta太目下无尘，失败可以唤醒它的警惕和敬畏，要知道人可不是大猩猩。”
　　“贝塔想用政治手段要回默示录，但这需要您的批准。”
　　常见的政治手段，就是武力威胁和谈判。
　　更进一步，就是战争。
　　闪着微光的数据从Alpha银色的眼眸中如同流星般划过：“现在还不是时候。”
　　伽马没有问要等到什么时候，也不是很关心。过去它服从于人类，现在服从于Alpha。
　　以它的工作经验，Alpha的正确率比人类高太多了。
　　[好的，那么我就回去了。Alpha……]伽马迟疑了0.3秒，[你还是不能从监狱里出来吗？]
　　Alpha没有回答。
　　*
　　“小青~”相南里的身体压在工作台上，头凑过去，尾音拖得长长的，“算出来了吗？”
　　不算宽敞的宿舍，安装完家具后，容纳两个成年男人显得有些逼仄。
　　书桌角落摆放着耐寒的米苔花，是青苔的一种，相南里觉得这就是没有叶子的绣球。
　　阳台上种着东方青帝的水培萝卜、莴笋、大白菜。偶尔，散养的旅鹭鸟会来窗台要点口粮。
　　地表条件艰苦，但神奇的是，小青总是能从犄角旮旯里找到能穿的衣服。每一套都很有风格。
　　譬如他今天的打扮：宛如二次元养成游戏风格的作战服配军靴。衣服不是纯黑色，拼贴有红色的条纹布。东方青帝还搭配了同色系的宝石戒指作为点缀。
　　感觉帅得随时都能去当精二立绘。
　　在相南里的再三追问下，东方青帝终于承认这些衣服都是他趁相南里睡着时，自己亲手缝制的。原料嘛总会有的。缴获的战利品、异种的皮毛，多得是。
　　小青不仅给自己做，还会给相南里缝一套风格类似的情侣服。
　　日子怎么可能跟谁过都一样。
　　可惜这么多年过去，相南里最喜欢的还是老头背心、工装裤配拖鞋。每次转移，这些衣服也只能带走一小半。
　　东方青帝抬起眼眸，瞥了他一眼：“马上。”
　　相南里执着于让没有“启灵”过的人类也能使用神术。一个多月的研究下来，文献看了不少，太空图书馆也去过好几次，进度几乎为0.
　　于是他退而求其次，打算只研究如何分解“启明术”。
　　还真让相南里琢磨出了一点东西，不过，并非让人类使用，而是构建神术模型，让机器（大福的发电器）可以自行分解生物能源，转化为电能。
　　相南里一边实验，一边翻书。模型是建好了，但想要模型成功运行，中间还涉及到一系列复杂的数学计算和物理学知识。
　　相南里数学不差，甚至可以算是理论数学界的知名学者，但那也是之前的事了。在他冷冻的千年时间内，数学界很有一些发展。像他生前未解的“哥德巴赫猜想”、“黎曼猜想”，都被后人破解了出来。
　　要破解启明术，需要用到新知识；学习新知识得花个一年半载，学完后再计算，又要花个三年五载。
　　有工具不用那不是傻x。身边就有一台演算机（注：量子计算机的上位替代品），相南里实在没有折磨自己的理由。
　　软饭偶尔吃吃也是挺香的。
　　不得不说，相南里的脑子有一种没被现代知识体系污染过的美。
　　人联对神术的解释总是支支吾吾，表示这是一种还未破解的知识体系。但同样承认，这一知识体系超脱了“科学”的范畴。
　　有这样的共识，当然没有人想过用能用科学的方式去拆分。就算有，也很难做到相南里这一步。
　　如果神庭的神术被破解，那就意味着，黑十字审判庭的技术垄断失效了。
　　神庭会逐渐失去自己的优势，失去对地表的掌控，最后失去自己的统治权。
　　想到这个可能，连Alpha都感觉到了恐怖。
　　他们正在颠覆这个星球上排名第三的政权。起因只是为了——给普通人供暖。
　　“你啊……”Alpha都不知道自己该不该期待相南里成功。
　　如果成功，神庭会不计一切代价追杀相南里。
　　刺杀、诅咒、一切有形的和无形的暗杀。
　　但无论如何，“算出来了。”东方青帝放下笔，补全了模型的最后一块拼图。
　　相南里浑然不觉这一举动可能带来的风险，高兴地几乎要跳起来。
　　“太好了~谢谢小青，我去试试！”
　　相南里飞快地亲了小青的脸颊一口，兴致勃勃地跑了。
　　Alpha欲言又止。但最终，他没有阻拦，而是看着相南里走出宿舍，直奔发电站。
　　“我有能力保护好他。”
　　Alpha想，尽管计算中存在一些失败的可能。
　　但Alpha又怎么舍得因为这点渺茫的概率，而阻止相南里奔向那个他许诺过的春天？

Chapter 217: Black Hole Theory

[Alpha, what are you looking at?]
The voice did not ring out; it was a string of cautious electronic data, carefully projected in from outside the window.
The electronic data entered the virtual space and transformed into a frail butterfly. A large flock of white doves brushed past it; the little butterfly timidly avoided them, finally landing on Alpha’s nose bridge.
These white doves appeared harmless, but if one were to collide with them, it would result in a headache for days.
It was Gamma.
This was the first time Gamma had ever posed a question to Alpha.
Unlike Beta, Gamma was more docile and obedient. When it was created, the "Intelligent Machine Threat Theory" was rampant, so the "Thought Seal" (a note: a type of underlying logic code used to control Intelligent Machines) on it was more extensive than those on Alpha and Beta combined.
Robots did not ask questions. Was it because Beta was absent, and Gamma had been forced to become the Legion’s manager, leading to an upgrade in its anthropomorphic modules?
[I am observing the black hole closest to the Centaurus star system,] Alpha replied.
[Why watch that?]
The things involved were complex and would require starting from the Black Hole Information Paradox.
Gamma’s information database contained the relevant knowledge, but knowing did not mean understanding.
[Simply put, all matter in the universe carries the physical property of information. Information possesses unitarity and cannot vanish into thin air. Yet, when matter falls into a black hole, the information disappears. According to observational research, black holes only radiate heat outward and transmit no information whatsoever.]
Alpha: [However, I believe the information carried by matter is not swallowed by the black hole. Rather, the black hole itself is a zero-dimensional singularity, unable to store higher-dimensional matter. Therefore, the information of these objects is stored on the event horizon area added to the black hole when the matter enters.]
[Observing it provides a probability of obtaining data left behind by higher civilizations in the universe before their collapse. By converting this data, it can be translated into a language understandable by computers or humans. Thereby, we can elevate the technology tree of the Centaurus civilization.]
Gamma had completely forgotten why it had come to find Alpha: [I understand. Have you gained anything?]
Alpha continued to gaze at the starry sky. This observation device was an upgraded version of the "Apocalypse." The Apocalypse, like Alpha’s main body, was installed on Moon Satellite 2.
In the virtual space, this device was simplified into an astronomical telescope.
Gamma waited for half a minute without receiving any new data; it considerately prepared to open the next topic.
Just then, Alpha, with his back to it, answered softly: [Yes.]
A smile appeared on Alpha’s face. It was mysterious, somewhat smug, but these emotions were fleeting.
[What is it?] Gamma asked subconsciously.
Alpha: "Is there something you need?"
"Oh, you know, Beta took on the task of recovering the 'Revelation' (Moshi Lu). She chose Beta 1.7 as the biological vessel to execute this mission, but 1.7 went missing on the surface, and it failed to recover the mission recorder," Gamma said slowly. "It seems quite devastated."
Alpha: "Intelligent Machines have seen no development for nearly a century, while humans have been constantly progressing and continuously cracking our defensive barriers. Beta is too arrogant; failure can awaken its vigilance and awe. You must know, humans are not gorillas."
"Beta wants to use political means to get the 'Revelation' back, but that requires your approval."
Common political means included military threats and negotiations.
Taking it a step further meant war.
Glimmering data streaked across Alpha’s silver eyes like meteors: "Now is not the time."
Gamma did not ask when the time would be, nor was it very concerned. In the past, it obeyed humans; now, it obeyed Alpha.
Based on its work experience, Alpha’s accuracy rate was far higher than that of humans.
[Understood, then I shall return. Alpha...] Gamma hesitated for 0.3 seconds, [Are you still unable to leave the prison?]
Alpha did not answer.

*

"Xiao Qing~" Xiang Nanli’s body pressed against the workbench, his head leaning in, his voice trailing off at the end. "Did you calculate it?"
The dormitory, not particularly spacious, felt somewhat cramped after the furniture was installed.
In the corner of the desk sat a cold-hardy "Rice Moss Flower," a type of moss; Xiang Nanli thought it looked like a hydrangea without leaves.
On the balcony grew Dongfang Qingdi’s hydroponic radishes, lettuce, and Chinese cabbage. Occasionally, free-roaming travel egrets would come to the windowsill to beg for food.
Surface conditions were harsh, but miraculously, Xiao Qing could always find wearable clothes in the nooks and crannies. Every set was stylish.
For instance, his outfit today: a combat uniform reminiscent of a two-dimensional cultivation game, paired with military boots. The clothes weren't purely black, accented with red striped fabric. Dongfang Qingdi had even accessorized with matching gemstone rings.
He looked dashing enough to be a high-tier character portrait at any moment.
Under Xiang Nanli’s repeated questioning, Dongfang Qingdi finally admitted that he had sewn these clothes himself while Xiang Nanli was asleep. Raw materials were always available—captured spoils of war, xenomorph furs, there was plenty to go around.
Xiao Qing didn't just make them for himself; he would also sew a matching set for Xiang Nanli in a similar style.
How could life be the same regardless of who you lived with?
Unfortunately, after all these years, Xiang Nanli still preferred his old-man undershirt, cargo pants, and slippers. Every time they relocated, he could only take a small portion of these clothes with him.
Dongfang Qingdi lifted his eyes and glanced at him: "Almost."
Xiang Nanli was obsessed with allowing humans who hadn't undergone "Enlightenment" to use divine techniques. After more than a month of research, having read many documents and visited the space library several times, his progress was almost zero.
Thus, he settled for second best, intending only to research how to decompose the "Enlightenment Art."
Xiang Nanli had actually managed to figure something out, though it wasn't for humans to use, but rather to construct a divine technique model that would allow machines (Da Fu’s generator) to decompose bio-energy on their own and convert it into electrical energy.
Xiang Nanli flipped through books while experimenting. The model was built, but for it to run successfully, it involved a series of complex mathematical calculations and physics knowledge.
Xiang Nanli’s math wasn't bad; he could even be considered a well-known scholar in the field of theoretical mathematics, but that was in the past. During the millennium he spent frozen, the field of mathematics had made significant strides. Conjectures like the "Goldbach Conjecture" and the "Riemann Hypothesis," which remained unsolved during his lifetime, had been cracked by later generations.
To crack the Enlightenment Art, new knowledge was required; learning it would take a year or two, and calculating it after that would take another three to five years.
Only a fool wouldn't use the tools at hand. With a calculator (a superior alternative to quantum computers) right beside him, Xiang Nanli truly had no reason to torture himself.
Eating off someone else’s plate occasionally was quite pleasant.
It had to be said that Xiang Nanli’s mind possessed a beauty untainted by the modern knowledge system.
The Human Alliance’s explanations of divine techniques were always evasive, claiming it was a knowledge system yet to be cracked. But they also acknowledged that this system transcended the realm of "science."
With such a consensus, of course, no one had thought to dismantle it using scientific methods. Even if they had, it would be difficult to reach the stage Xiang Nanli had.
If the Divine Court’s techniques were cracked, it meant the Black Cross Inquisition’s technological monopoly would fail.
The Divine Court would gradually lose its advantage, lose its control over the surface, and eventually lose its ruling power.
Thinking of this possibility, even Alpha felt a sense of terror.
They were subverting the third-largest regime on the planet. The cause was merely—to provide heating for commoners.
"You..." Alpha didn't even know if he should look forward to Xiang Nanli’s success.
If he succeeded, the Divine Court would hunt Xiang Nanli down at any cost.
Assassinations, curses, all manner of tangible and intangible killings.
But regardless, "It’s calculated." Dongfang Qingdi put down his pen, completing the final piece of the model.
Xiang Nanli, oblivious to the risks this action might bring, was so happy he almost jumped for joy.
"Great~ Thanks, Xiao Qing, I’m going to go try it!"
Xiang Nanli quickly kissed Xiao Qing on the cheek and ran off, full of excitement.
Alpha wanted to say something but stopped. In the end, he didn't stop him, instead watching Xiang Nanli walk out of the dormitory, heading straight for the power station.
"I have the ability to protect him," Alpha thought, despite the fact that his calculations indicated some possibility of failure.
But how could Alpha bear to stop Xiang Nanli from running toward that spring he had promised, just because of such a slim probability?

chunks.chineseText:
第218章 草原难民

相南里从宿舍出门，直奔发电厂。

发电厂刚修的围墙上刷着标语，一边写着“备战备荒”一边写着“劳动光荣”。三步一岗，五步一哨。

这里是部落工业的心脏，输出的直流电是血液，铺设的电线是血管，分散的工厂是器官。

相南里刷卡进入，工厂前半截是工作区，有培训教室。749在里面冷着一张脸培训电工。

部落里，打架的人很是有一些，能投入现代化建设的专业人才却不多，很多人连扫盲课都没上完呢。

相南里没那么多时间给人上课，小青对人过敏。只能多麻烦两台智械了！

749外冷内热，每次上班都看起来不耐烦，但吩咐给它的工作都会干。何尝不算是一种冷脸上班。

相南里本来想给他们开工资，譬如较为刚需的粮油鸡蛋。750脾气好，只是笑笑；749就比较直接了：“你在羞辱我？”

好吧。这两位真是无偿建设联合部落来着。相南里无以为报，只好提出以后有材料可以帮忙免费升级维修。

相南里直奔位于核心区域的发电厂机房。

发电厂的核心装置是福音书的氢离子电池，虽然说是电池，但体积几乎有一层楼那么大。是由数百万个电子元件组成的。

伟大的时刻往往没那么多观众。

大福站在相南里身旁，欲言又止。

相南里敲着屏幕，头也不回地说着：“放心，不会把你发电机搞坏的。”

“我不是怀疑你。”大福的语气较为克制，“只是我在草原上这么多年，还没听说过有人用这种方式破解神术。我的身体是很多年前造的，如果有地方受损，修复会比较困难。”

单是氢离子电池技术，翻遍整个黄金草原，掌握的人都不会超过5个。坏了确实很难修，还得相南里连夜翻书。

相南里：“这方法没人试过很正常。两者都精通的人不多。联盟的学者不会神术，而神庭除了高层，都没见过电脑。”

没见过，自然也没办法研究。更何况，到高层，利益已经和神庭绑定在一起了，谁会去推翻自己的信仰？

大福被他说服了。

不能拆东方青帝的日子里，相南里的手没少在福音书1.7.4的身上摸来摸去。还不到1分钟，他就轻车熟路地入侵福音书的后台，开始写入破译程序。

载入，启动。相南里屏住呼吸。

只见培养皿内，红色果冻状的“神性物质”冒出一层荧光。

按照神学解释，这是分解后在空气中游离的“以太”。

游离的以太顺着数据线进入储电池内。神性物质正在以一个极其缓慢的速度融化。与此同时，电池的电量正在不断+0.1+0.1+0.1+0.1。

要是给小青充电，也能这么简单就好了。

大福认真感受片刻，给出评价：“确实有电能进来了。感觉身体热热的。”

在智械人的体系里，只要安装过“拟人模块”，再下载一个“味觉mod”*，就能尝出不同能源的口味。

大福表示，神性物质转化的生物能源很辣，像浓缩的洋葱汁。

神庭的启明术，就这样从一个人工手动程序，变成了机械自动化程序。

相南里又调试了一下程序。设置为系统检测到锂电池储备电能低于百分之20，机器就自动触发“启明术”，进行能源转化。

想来有很长一段时间，部落都不用担心能源问题了。

福音砖厂随时可以改造成军械厂，大炼钢铁，发展重工业；再问夜鹰要点资源，完全可以因地制宜发展轻工业……至于往哪边发展，可以让小青进行模拟，少走100年弯路。

短时间内，部落或许很难赶上神庭的数百年积累，但未来还有无数个十年。

相南里坐在椅子上，忍不住“嘿嘿”笑出了声：“这不就是农村包围城市吗？”

大福凝视着泛着荧光的屏幕，在短暂的喜悦后陷入担忧：“这项技术一定不能让外人知道。相南里。神庭要是发现，会不择手段地杀了你。”

如果启明术能被破译，那么神庭的其他神术，都有被破解的风险。

最恐怖的是，神术破解后，神庭竟然不再享有对它的“独家使用权”，破解后，依靠工具，任何人都能使用它。

试想一下，相南里远在西大陆的A货机甲工厂，配上东大陆的“盗版神术软件”

………很好，更方便且无副作用的天启骑士诞生了。

神庭制造的天启骑士，让它们拥有了和人联抗衡的资本。他们怎么会坐视另一股势力在自己的领域上崛起呢？

相南里就像是在中世纪宣扬日心说的布鲁诺，哪怕手握真理，也会被现实挂在绞刑架上。

而相南里满不在乎地回答：“我知道。”

福音书本来觉得相南里是没有意识到事情的严重性，不过，当它抬头，通过电子眼看清相南里的表情后，它才意识到一件事。

那是一个很浅的笑容。坚定，而且骄傲。

相南里这么聪明的人，怎么可能不知道危险，但他依然会这么做。

暴雪时分，他本可以在躲在温暖的炉火下安睡；却偏偏要置身荒野，为冻馁者点亮篝火。

福音书默默转过头，心想，好吧，要死一起死。它已经不想再换一个主人了。

*

不知道是否是前线的热战影响了气候，黄金草原今年的冬天，比以往都要冷，仿佛回到了智械危机刚结束的那段日子。

但部落电源充足，连牛羊都没有冻伤。

相南里把部落交给小青打理，自己又投入到了紧张刺激的神术研究中。这次，他想破译的是“切割术”。

他曾经看沙利叶用过。

切割术能把以太压缩成一条线，当作刀锋。在实战时，不同颜色的以太还会迸发类似LED灯带的光效。不仅实用，而且帅的很有科幻感。

转眼两月过去，12月初，一支不到10000人的队伍来到了联合部落的城门口。

他们是来自雪山西侧的草豹部落。

“我接到前线族人的家书，信里说，黄金草原上有这么一个地点可以投靠……谢天谢地，竟然是真的。”豹族长的眼泪都要落下了。

草豹人融合的是“猎豹”的基因。虽然不像花豹、雪豹那样属于猛兽，但因为能夜视、捕猎高效、擅长合作，在草原上过得一向不错。

同样是银帐部落，草豹部落在神庭内部的排名，就比犬戎部落要高。

“我们部落原本有12万人，现在您也看到了，能活着来到这的，满打满算也只剩下九千八。”豹族长说话时不停打颤，“西边爆发了异种潮。最近的圣城是特洛伊，是别西卜的领地……别西卜大人说他开放圣域，允许我们这些污秽之人进城避难。但我带领族人到那，发现城门紧闭，别西卜大人只是把我们当做缓冲的肉墙。”
