If Michael hadn't intervened, this plan wouldn't have been a big problem. With hundreds of billions in aid from the United Front, even without Xiang Nanli, the people in the base could have lived quite well.

But now, it was clear that a base without economic support had lost its voice before the United Front.

Therefore, Xiang Nanli intended to move the entire survivor base away. This was the "junk" and "trifles" the Alpha looked down upon, but Xiang Nanli couldn't pretend he didn't care.

This little fish cared, and this little fish cared too.

The prerequisite was—he had to be able to fix the broken, centuries-old Gospel 1.2.5 (the main body of Eternal City).

chunks.chineseText:
第227章 各司其职

在今晚行动还有个好处。

正规军带来的大部分装甲车，里面都塞满了缴获来的粮食；那些重型武器没能第一时间投入使用，极大削弱这支特种部队的战斗力。

老实说，人联的军队还没有到缺粮的地步，毕竟打一次仗，背后有整个人联当血包。如果士兵都会饿死，这仗也不用打了。

“最近的粮价很贵。尤其是战争辐射范围内的几座城市，”从小在地下城长大的易横行，对此心知肚明，“在姑苏军事基地，一罐营养膏的零售价在一年内，已经从5信用点涨到30信用点；又因为战区使用的是‘新币’，总部对这样的恶性通胀是默许的。”

方敬之当初颁布的战区临时信用点政策，终于露出它歹毒的一面。

“新币”只能在战区内使用，无法进入地下城市流通，因此，人联不用担心地下城的货币通胀，可以肆无忌惮的印钱，用于支付这些雇佣军和正规军的“工资”。

货币只是一般等价物，理论上当权机构想印多少就能印多少，但背后没有对应的资源作为保障，数额再大，也不过是一堆废纸。

凌晨五点，城内的局势终于得到控制。外面交战声变小，当那些令人肾上腺素飙升的战斗停下，在昏暗灯光和火光笼罩下的基地，迎来的是长久的沉默和悲哀。

医生护士们有序地安置伤员，另一部分则就地掩埋尸体。相南里站在高楼上往下看，鼻腔里全是刺鼻的硝烟味，不太舒服。

不是对气味的不适，是另一种不能细想的、对战争的烦厌。

城门的另一边，小福呜呜咽咽地跑过来，拿头蹭着相南里的腰：“里里！小福好想你！你都有一年没回家了，小福不要当留守儿童……”

小福又换了一具新身体，是它用这两年的工资买的！

这具身体从人联进口，里面是很标准的两块长方形铁疙瘩，身高约等于人类三岁小孩。

铁疙瘩可以套上毛绒熊的外衣！还有兔子皮套、小狗皮套可以更换！

小福现在走在基地里，回头率比以前高不少呢~

相南里反应了两秒，弯腰，把它从地上抱起来：“我们小福都长这么大了。真可爱啊。”

恶毒的Alpha没有跟来，小福安心地把头贴在相南里的胸前，在他怀里扭成一团麻花：“里里~”

相南里比划了一下：“小福，带我看看你的本体。我们需要使用福音书号。”

语言解释太麻烦。

好在相南里有小智，小智那有东方青帝整理好的数据包。

相南里把数据一键转发给福音书。

小福震惊道：“我们要开福音书号跑路？可是……福音书号能修好吗？”

相南里：“先看看。”

时间不等人，哪怕城内的火拼还没完全结束，相南里也在夜色中来到地下一层，一寸寸丈量了过去。

福音书号在过去几百年里，不知道被拆卸过几次。

它的主要材料是精钢，少部分重要零件，使用的太空精金。

听说过去永恒市的城主一旦没钱，就会卖点城墙。这种高科技产物有自己无法替代的战略价值。毕竟地表本土的工业体系基本为0，是造不出精钢的。而人联扶持的几个地表工厂，生产的精钢并不对外贩售。

走私价格太贵，进口更贵。于是，一些有需求的地表势力，就会到处搜购“报废品”。

永恒之城靠着卖城墙，度过了过去无数年里，一个又一个难熬的冬天。但被挖去卖掉的部分如同齿印，在福音书号的身上留下坑坑洼洼的咬痕。

相南里有些心疼：“损坏比例这么高呢。”

小福对过去的记忆不多，它格式化过，而且不止一次。

玩偶熊歪了一下脑袋：“如果能帮助人类，小福破破烂烂的也没关系。”

相南里发现，自己来之前想得还是过于乐观了。

要修好福音书号，不仅需要专业人才，更需要一大笔物料费——这还是假设一定能买到的情况。

他低头，开始在面板上默写需要的材料，质量单位动辄就是“吨”。

相南里一边写，一边吩咐，脑海里纷乱的思路正在不停地整合：“小福，帮我把基地所有学者、机械师组织起来，设置一个‘福音书号维修工作组’，分成四个项目组，分别是设计工程组、结构与材料组、动力系统组和生态保障组。”

“组织一批有经验的工人，数量越多越好。按人数等分成10个工程队。有图纸后同时推进不同的工程项目。”

一个人的力量是有限的。相南里再牛逼，也做不到一边画设计图、一边焊芯片、一边拧螺丝。

集体就不一样了。

相南里从福音书维修工作计划，一直说到基地后续的战略的安排。条理分明，思维缜密。

与此同时，紧握的笔还在不停记录数据、画结构图和人事安排。

福音书记录下这些内容，态度十分严肃。

玩偶熊虽然能容纳它的“灵魂”，但自身硬件不足以支撑这些复杂的运算，他需要把“灵魂”传输回本体后，才能开展下一步工作。

而且，玩偶熊的身体也没办法多线运行。

至少需要两台福音书才能办到。

有时候小福会觉得，比起它，相南里更像一台智械。无论是计算与逻辑的准度，还是思维的活跃程度。

里里甚至能同时处理好几项任务，像一台性能拉满的电脑。

好完美的人类，真是令械着迷！

初步的检查完成，相南里在此时收到Alpha发来的消息。

[我在市政厅一楼03号办事处等你。]

嗯，Alpha其实已经等了有一阵了。只是不想打扰相南里工作。

……

……

米迦勒丢的大火球堪比核弹。

原本市政厅是五层楼高的气派大楼，现在只有第一层建在。整体装潢更是从现代主义风格，变成旧历网游里常见的废土风格……

一滴雪融化，穿过漏风的天花板，落在Alpha的鼻梁上。

鉴于基地内幸存的、还能通电的建筑不多，几十米外，就是紧张刺激的外科手术台。又几十米外，一堆基地官员来回奔波，组织工作、安抚人群。再几十米外，还活着的士兵稳定秩序，清点战场。

大家都有要紧的事做。只有Alpha，独自享有一整间单独的办公室，看上去很是清闲。

“半分钟又过去了。”东方青帝坐在办公椅上，翘着腿，胳膊撑着头，不紧不慢地说着，“您还没改变主意吗？”

他的另一只手，正把玩着一柄刀。

刀不长，比起匕首，更像是一把刀片。很薄，温热的血液顺着刀刃上的血槽往下滴。

东方青帝把刀甩出去，小刀飞出一个漂亮的弧线形，干脆利落地切下洛神爱一根手指，然后如同巡回犬一样，飞回东方青帝的指间。

这是洛神爱被割下的第三根手指。

他身上还有数不清的伤口，看起来狰狞又恐怖。

地面早就被流出的鲜血染红。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 227: Each to Their Own Duties (Part 1)

There was another benefit to acting tonight.

Most of the armored vehicles brought by the regular army were stuffed with the grain they had seized; those heavy weapons couldn't be deployed immediately, which greatly weakened the combat effectiveness of this special forces unit.

To be honest, the United Front’s army hadn't reached the point of food shortages. After all, when they fought a war, they had the entire United Front acting as a blood bank behind them. If soldiers were going to starve, there would be no point in fighting at all.

"The recent price of grain is very high. Especially in the few cities within the radiation range of the war," said Yi Hengxing, who had grown up in the underground city and knew this well. "At the Gusu military base, the retail price of a canister of nutrient paste has risen from 5 credits to 30 credits within a year; and because the war zone uses 'New Currency,' headquarters tacitly approves of such hyperinflation."

The temporary war zone credit policy that Fang Jingzhi had once promulgated finally revealed its malicious side.

The "New Currency" could only be used within the war zone and could not circulate into the underground cities. Therefore, the United Front didn't need to worry about currency inflation in the underground cities and could print money recklessly to pay the "wages" of these mercenaries and regular soldiers.

Currency was merely a general equivalent. Theoretically, the governing body could print as much as it wanted, but without corresponding resources to back it up, no matter how high the amount, it was just a pile of waste paper.

At 5:00 AM, the situation in the city was finally brought under control. The sounds of battle outside faded. As the adrenaline-pumping combat ceased, the base, shrouded in dim lights and firelight, was met with a long silence and sorrow.

Doctors and nurses orderly tended to the wounded, while others buried the dead on the spot. Xiang Nanli stood on a high building looking down, his nasal passages filled with the pungent smell of gunpowder, which made him uncomfortable.

It wasn't just discomfort from the smell, but a different kind of weariness toward war that he couldn't bear to dwell on.

On the other side of the city gate, Xiao Fu came running over, sobbing, and rubbed its head against Xiang Nanli’s waist: "Lili! Xiao Fu missed you so much! You haven't been home for a year; Xiao Fu doesn't want to be a left-behind child..."

Xiao Fu had changed into a new body, which it had bought with its wages from the past two years!

This body was imported from the United Front, containing standard rectangular iron blocks, with a height roughly equivalent to a three-year-old human child.

The iron blocks could be fitted with a plush bear suit! There were also rabbit and puppy skins that could be swapped out!

Xiao Fu now had a much higher head-turning rate in the base than before~

Xiang Nanli took a second to process this, then bent down and picked it up from the ground: "Our Xiao Fu has grown so big. How cute."

The vicious Alpha hadn't followed, so Xiao Fu contentedly pressed its head against Xiang Nanli’s chest, twisting into a pretzel in his arms: "Lili~"

Xiang Nanli gestured: "Xiao Fu, show me your main body. We need to use the Gospel."

Explaining in words was too troublesome.

Fortunately, Xiang Nanli had Xiao Zhi, and Xiao Zhi had the data packets organized by the Eastern Green Emperor.

Xiang Nanli forwarded the data to the Gospel with one click.

Xiao Fu was shocked: "We're going to use the Gospel to run away? But... can the Gospel be fixed?"

Xiang Nanli: "Let's see."

Time waited for no one. Even though the fighting in the city hadn't completely ended, Xiang Nanli went to the first basement level in the night, measuring every inch of the place.

The Gospel had been dismantled countless times over the past few centuries.

Its main material was refined steel, with space-grade gold used for a few important parts.

It was said that in the past, whenever the Lord of Eternal City ran out of money, they would sell off parts of the city wall. Such high-tech products had irreplaceable strategic value. After all, the surface’s native industrial system was basically zero and couldn't produce refined steel. And the few surface factories supported by the United Front didn't sell their refined steel to outsiders.

Smuggling prices were too high, and imports were even more expensive. Thus, some surface forces with needs would scour the area for "scrap."

Eternal City had survived countless harsh winters over the past years by selling its city walls. But the parts that had been dug out and sold left "bite marks" like teeth, leaving the Gospel riddled with pits and scars.

Xiang Nanli felt a pang of heartache: "The damage ratio is so high."

Xiao Fu didn't have many memories of the past; it had been formatted, and more than once.

The plush bear tilted its head: "If it can help humans, it doesn't matter if Xiao Fu is tattered."

Xiang Nanli realized that he had been too optimistic before coming.

To fix the Gospel, he needed not only professional talent but also a large amount of material costs—and that was assuming he could even buy them.

He lowered his head and began to silently list the required materials on the panel, with units of mass frequently reaching "tons."

As he wrote, he gave instructions, his chaotic thoughts integrating continuously: "Xiao Fu, help me organize all the scholars and mechanics in the base and set up a 'Gospel Repair Task Force.' Divide it into four project groups: Design Engineering, Structure and Materials, Power Systems, and Ecological Support."

"Organize a group of experienced workers, the more the better. Divide them into 10 engineering teams based on headcount. Once we have the blueprints, we will advance different engineering projects simultaneously."

A single person’s power was limited. No matter how awesome Xiang Nanli was, he couldn't draw blueprints, weld chips, and tighten screws all at the same time.

A collective was different.

Xiang Nanli spoke from the Gospel repair plan all the way to the base’s subsequent strategic arrangements. His logic was clear, and his thinking was meticulous.

At the same time, the pen he held tightly kept recording data, drawing structural diagrams, and making personnel arrangements.

The Gospel recorded these contents with a very serious attitude.

Although the plush bear could house its "soul," its hardware was insufficient to support these complex calculations. He needed to transmit his "soul" back to the main body before he could carry out the next steps.

Moreover, the plush bear’s body couldn't run multiple tasks at once.

He needed at least two Gospels to get it done.

Sometimes Xiao Fu felt that compared to it, Xiang Nanli was more like a machine. Whether it was the precision of his calculations and logic or the agility of his thinking.

Lili could even handle several tasks at once, like a computer running at full performance.

What a perfect human, truly fascinating to a machine!

The preliminary inspection was completed, and at this moment, Xiang Nanli received a message from the Alpha.

[I’m waiting for you at Office 03, first floor of the City Hall.]

Well, the Alpha had actually been waiting for a while. He just didn't want to disturb Xiang Nanli’s work.

...

...

The giant fireball Michael had thrown was comparable to a nuclear bomb.

The City Hall had originally been an imposing five-story building, but now only the first floor remained. The overall decor had shifted from a modernist style to the wasteland style commonly seen in old-calendar online games...

A drop of snow melted, passed through the leaky ceiling, and landed on the Alpha’s nose bridge.

Given that there weren't many surviving buildings in the base that still had electricity, just a few dozen meters away was a tense and thrilling surgical table. A few dozen meters further, a group of base officials were rushing back and forth, organizing work and comforting the crowd. A few dozen meters further still, surviving soldiers were stabilizing order and counting the battlefield.

Everyone had urgent things to do. Only the Alpha enjoyed an entire private office to himself, looking quite leisurely.

"Another half minute has passed," the Eastern Green Emperor sat in the office chair, crossing his legs, resting his head on his hand, and said unhurriedly, "Have you not changed your mind yet?"

His other hand was playing with a blade.

The knife wasn't long; it looked more like a razor blade than a dagger. It was very thin, and warm blood dripped down the blood groove on the blade.

The Eastern Green Emperor flicked the knife out. The small blade flew in a beautiful arc, cleanly slicing off one of Luo Shen’ai’s fingers, and then, like a boomerang, flew back into the Eastern Green Emperor’s fingers.

This was the third finger sliced off from Luo Shen’ai.

He had countless other wounds on his body, looking gruesome and terrifying.

The floor had long been stained red by the flowing blood.

chunks.chineseText:
“人可以凌迟多少刀不死呢？您是注射过基因强化药剂的战士，应该能撑更久吧。”东方青帝低声道，“我们呢，要的也不多，只是想要您和人联联络的权限。”

洛神爱近乎跪在地上，手被钢绳捆着，背在腰后。绳子很结实，不知道什么材料，洛神爱无法挣脱，手腕处因为过度挣扎，以及磨掉皮肉，露出底下森然的白骨。

这个人竟然连骨头都做过手术，表面有钢钉的痕迹。这么加固下来，大概连遇到核爆，都能剩下一具金属骨架。

他体内的芯片还在，但不知道为何，完全没有信号。以至于洛神爱都无法向外界求救，也没办法启用他的机甲套装。

洛神爱调节过痛感神经，理论上讲，他只有正常人百分之十的感觉——不仅是痛觉，也包括快感、食欲等一系列属于人类的情感。

但这个痛觉调节功能，似乎随着体内的电信号一起被屏蔽了。

洛神爱痛得几乎昏厥，眼前泛起一阵阵黑色。

眼前的人洛神爱认识，基地的二号人物。他来之前看过资料，他登记的名字是“东青”，是基地首领相南里的克隆人。

理论上讲，东青正在大草原上，和相南里一起发展敌后根据地。不该出现在这里。

难道这次任务，其实是针对他的阴谋？从几年前就开始布局？

洛神爱的牙咬得咯咯作响：“怎么不直接杀我？不敢动手？在人联境内威胁人联的官员，呵，你最好有办法把我洗脑，控制我的思维。

“杀我，长安洛家会立刻知道，整个永生科技都会给我报仇，哪怕你是Alpha，都要从天上轰下来；不杀我，那就等着我的报复——”

洛神爱有种的都不像洛家人。

Alpha蹙眉，这种人最难办了，悍不畏死，软硬不吃。

洛神爱显然不知道Alpha的真实身份。

但洛神爱好歹是当作长安洛家的继承人培养的。他都打不赢的克隆人，绝对不会像资料上那么简单。

该死的。不是几年前就在基地安装过监控吗？观测者干什么吃的？！

现在，唯一的希望就是“小黑”了。

小黑是跟着洛神爱从小一起长大的陪伴型机器人。

外观像一只毛绒小蝙蝠。

洛神爱对它的感情，比对自己父母还要深。

父母只是三年都未必能见一面的陌生人，小黑是从小陪到大的玩伴。

只要小黑能飞出这个信号隔离区，把消息传回人联……

“小青~”年轻男人的声音从门外传来。

听上去很雀跃。

有那么一瞬，洛神爱觉得是幻听。

但东方青帝在瞬间收起刀，从椅子上站起，迎了出去。

相南里推开门，叽叽喳喳地汇报：“我在路上捡到一只电子蝙蝠耶？它好奇怪，看到我就黏上来，非要跟着我，戳它又没反应。咦，还有人啊？”

一只毛茸茸的蝙蝠躺在相南里的掌心，像没有生命的玩具。

相南里的声音渐小，他嗅到那股浓郁的血腥味。

有血腥味很正常。基地现在到处都是伤员。

但看见跪在地上的洛神爱时，相南里还是有片刻的失神。

没别的原因，看上去太惨了。

洛神爱同样艰难地抬头，他的样子很狼狈，浑身鲜血淋漓。伤口都是外翻的。

对视的瞬间，相南里的心脏莫名其妙一颤。

恍惚只有片刻。

东方青帝捂住他的眼睛：“吓着了？”

他低声为自己找补：“福音书号想在人联眼皮子底下飞走，需要洛神爱的权限，我正在和他沟通。”

他对相南里之外的人类没什么感情——Alpha从不掩饰这一点。甚至有些微妙的厌恶。所以，他从不会觉得自己手段残忍。

但Alpha会担心相南里觉得他残忍。

也多亏福音书没跟过来；要不然又要在那狗叫，发表一些械奸言论了。

好在相南里并不是小福那种圣父。

他摇头：“审讯真的有用吗？”

“是人类就会有极限。他的机械化程度很高，摧毁意志力后可以入侵脑部的芯片，像控制机器一样，控制他的意识体……”东方青帝小声地跟他咬耳朵。

但意识还清醒的时候不行，会触发保护机制自爆。

相南里：“哇噢~”

更加坚定了没事不要装脑机接口的念头了呢。

“……我可以配合。”硬气了半个多小时的人突然开口，声音异常虚弱。

洛神爱越过东方青帝的肩膀，锁定住相南里的脸。涣散的瞳孔逐渐聚焦，亮起金色的瞳环。

“但我要单独和你聊一会，相南里。”
chunks.englishText:
"How many cuts can a person endure before they die? You are a soldier who has been injected with genetic enhancement serum; you should be able to hold out a bit longer, right?" Dongfang Qingdi whispered. "As for us, we don't want much. We just want your authorization to contact the Human Alliance."

Luo Shen'ai was practically kneeling on the ground, his hands bound behind his back with steel cables. The ropes were incredibly sturdy, made of an unknown material; Luo Shen'ai could not break free, and his wrists had been worn down to the bone from his desperate, futile struggles.

This man had clearly undergone surgery on his very bones, which bore the faint traces of steel pins. With such reinforcements, he could likely survive a nuclear blast and still leave behind a metallic skeleton.

The chip inside him was still there, but for some reason, it had no signal whatsoever. This left Luo Shen'ai unable to call for help from the outside world or activate his mecha suit.

Luo Shen'ai had previously adjusted his pain receptors; theoretically, he only felt ten percent of what a normal person would—not just pain, but pleasure, appetite, and the entire spectrum of human emotions.

But this pain-regulation function seemed to have been shielded along with the electrical signals in his body.

Luo Shen'ai was in such agony he nearly fainted, his vision swimming with black spots.

He recognized the person before him: the number two figure of the base. Before arriving, he had reviewed the files; the name registered was "Dong Qing," a clone of the base leader, Xiang Nanli.

Theoretically, Dong Qing should be out on the vast grasslands, developing an enemy-rear base alongside Xiang Nanli. He shouldn't be here.

Could this entire mission actually be a conspiracy aimed at him? One that had been in the works for years?

Luo Shen'ai’s teeth chattered as he gritted them. "Why not just kill me? Too afraid to act? Threatening a Human Alliance official within the borders of the Alliance—ha! You’d better hope you have a way to brainwash me and control my mind."

"If you kill me, the Chang'an Luo family will know immediately. The entire Eternal Technology corporation will avenge me. Even if you are an Alpha, they will blast you out of the sky. If you don't kill me, then just wait for my retaliation—"

Luo Shen'ai had more guts than the rest of the Luo family combined.

The Alpha frowned. This type of person was the hardest to deal with: fearless, unyielding, and impervious to both soft and hard tactics.

Luo Shen'ai clearly did not know the Alpha's true identity.

But Luo Shen'ai had, after all, been raised as the heir to the Chang'an Luo family. A clone that he couldn't defeat was definitely not as simple as the files suggested.

Damn it. Hadn't they installed surveillance in the base years ago? What were the Observers doing?!

Now, his only hope was "Xiao Hei."

Xiao Hei was a companion robot that had grown up with Luo Shen'ai.

It looked like a fluffy little bat.

Luo Shen'ai’s feelings for it were deeper than those for his own parents.

His parents were strangers he might not see for three years at a time; Xiao Hei was the playmate who had been by his side since childhood.

As long as Xiao Hei could fly out of this signal-isolated zone and send the message back to the Human Alliance...

"Xiao Qing~" A young man's voice drifted in from outside the door.

It sounded quite cheerful.

For a moment, Luo Shen'ai thought he was hallucinating.

But Dongfang Qingdi instantly sheathed his blade, stood up from his chair, and went to greet him.

Xiang Nanli pushed open the door, chattering away as he reported, "I picked up an electronic bat on the road! It’s so strange; it stuck to me the moment it saw me, insisting on following me around. It didn't even react when I poked it. Oh? We have a guest?"

A furry bat lay in Xiang Nanli’s palm, like a lifeless toy.

Xiang Nanli’s voice trailed off as he caught the heavy scent of blood.

It was normal to smell blood; the base was full of wounded people.

But when he saw Luo Shen'ai kneeling on the floor, Xiang Nanli was momentarily stunned.

For no other reason than that he looked absolutely wretched.

Luo Shen'ai also struggled to lift his head. He looked disheveled, covered in blood, his wounds gaping open.

The moment their eyes met, Xiang Nanli’s heart skipped a beat for no reason.

The trance lasted only a second.

Dongfang Qingdi covered his eyes. "Scared you?"

He whispered, justifying himself, "The *Gospel* wants to fly away right under the Human Alliance's nose, and that requires Luo Shen'ai’s authorization. I am currently communicating with him."

He had no affection for humans other than Xiang Nanli—the Alpha never hid this fact. He even felt a subtle disgust toward them. Thus, he never felt his methods were cruel.

But the Alpha worried that Xiang Nanli might think him cruel.

It was also fortunate that the *Gospel* hadn't followed him; otherwise, it would be yapping again, spouting some nonsense about "machine-human relations."

Fortunately, Xiang Nanli was not a saint like Little Fu.

He shook his head. "Is interrogation really useful?"

"Every human has a limit. His level of mechanization is very high. Once his willpower is shattered, I can hack into the chip in his brain and control his consciousness just like controlling a machine..." Dongfang Qingdi whispered in his ear.

It wouldn't work while he was still conscious, as that would trigger a self-destruct protection mechanism.

Xiang Nanli: "Wow~"

This only solidified his resolve to never install a brain-machine interface if he could help it.

"...I can cooperate." The man who had been tough for over half an hour suddenly spoke, his voice exceptionally weak.

Luo Shen'ai looked over Dongfang Qingdi’s shoulder, locking onto Xiang Nanli’s face. His unfocused pupils gradually converged, glowing with golden rings.

"But I need to talk to you alone, Xiang Nanli."

chunks.chineseText:
第228章 宣传部发威

相南里拍了拍他的手背，以示安抚。

[小青，没事的，就看看他想说什么嘛。反正一面墙也拦不住你。]

东方青帝勉为其难地同意了。他微微弯腰，亲了一下相南里的耳垂，又亲昵地撩起他的额发，充满正宫气度地离开了。

小青喜怒不形于色，不高兴只会憋着，但总是会在别的地方找补回来。

说这样的人最可怕了！

相南里搬来椅子，在洛神爱面前坐下：“您好呀。”

洛神爱咳嗽着，星星点点的血洒在前襟：“我不好。”

这是什么回答？

总不能指望他去批评Alpha吧！

相南里笑眯眯地询问：“你想谈什么呢？”

放在桌子上的小蝙蝠睁开眼，因为倾斜的桌面略微滑翔一段距离，“啪叽”一下，掉在洛神爱面前。

洛神爱保持着跪姿，事实上，以他现在的状态，想直起腰也很难。

小黑吐出一粒塑封好的消炎药给他。

然后张开翅膀，在飞到相南里的头顶抱窝。

“能喂我吃一粒药吗？”洛神爱的声音虚弱，“这是普通的消炎药，我伤势很重，担心感染。”

相南里：“不行噢，理解一下呢亲。”

他学习汉语的时候，一定错误录入过淘x的语言模型。

一个拉近关系的小技巧是请人帮简单的忙。相南里是不会上当的。

洛神爱的脸上扬起一个很无奈的笑容。

不得不说，他有一副天赐的好皮相，笑起来更是惹人怜爱：“我可以配合你们……挪用公款、造假通行证以及隐瞒这里的真实情况。”

“您应该清楚，如果没有我帮忙欺上瞒下，就凭今天正规军的伤亡情况，人联很快就会派来更多正规军，不会留给您辩解的时间。”

来赈灾抢险的人联军队并不是派来的驻军，规定时间没有返航，人联肯定会察觉到不对劲。到时候，局面走向难以控制。

Alpha原本的计划，只需要带着几个人撤离。因此，也不用考虑后果。

但现在，相南里是打算开着福音书号，带走整个基地的人。

“我姓洛，大人。虽然从血统上讲，没有洛修那么纯正。”

相南里想，他生活那个年代，一般只有宠物猫狗才讲血统。

“但我也是洛家的直系继承人，在人联，我拥有的权力比您想象中更大。”

相南里心想，可恶的天龙人！

“那你打算怎么欺上瞒下呢？”

洛神爱灿烂一笑：“那我需要知道您打算做什么。”

相南里把长长的材料清单递给他：“我要这些。”

洛神爱的眼睛微微眯起：“请帮我擦一下脸上的血迹，我看不清字。”

相南里：“可是我没带纸……”

小蝙蝠扇着翅膀，飞到半空，面无表情地吐出一包餐巾纸。

？

这小蝙蝠是哆啦A梦吗？相南里捏住它的身体，伸出两根手指塞进它嘴里捅了捅。

完全是毛绒玩具的触感啊！这又是什么黑科技，可恶，真得把人联图书馆后台黑一下了。

“哔哔——！”

小蝙蝠扑棱着大翅膀，细长的尾巴颤抖着竖起，尾巴末端长着一枚箭头似的小爱心。

相南里松开手，小蝙蝠警惕地飞到窗边。

怎么看这都是一包普通的餐巾纸，相南里甚至在人联超市里见过这个牌子。

相南里撕开，里面没有药剂，纸巾也没有爆炸。

他弯腰，抬起洛神爱的下巴，开始擦他脸上的血污。

洛神爱微微颤抖起来，呼吸加重，他做贼心虚地解释道：“抱歉，实在……有点疼。”

洛神爱开始看几页纸那么长的材料清单，深思熟虑后回答：“可以。但有些材料很罕见，需要从附近城市调货，最快也要一个月左右才能到，时间来得及吗？”

相南里点头：“那很好了。可是我们之间没有建立足够的信任，怎么办呢？”

洛神爱：“刚才那位克隆人说过的，我的机械化程度很高。这代表您可以通过神经传感线，入侵我的中枢芯片。这样，我传递的每一条数据，都可以被监控或拦截。这是我能交付的最大程度的信任。”

[你觉得呢？]

Alpha：[……]

理论上没什么问题。但目的实在令人疑惑。毕竟就在几分钟钱，洛神爱还是一个宁死不屈的战俘。无法理解他的态度为何转换如此之快。

相南里直接问出来了：“怎么突然这么配合？”

“我的命比其他人值钱。我并不想死。地下城市人均寿命97岁，但洛家人的平均寿命是166岁，我才31。

“‘殉职’不是我追求的，尽管这受道德上的追捧，但我一向认为，人死万事空。”

洛神爱的回答清晰明了，且极具说服力：“您和那位克隆人不同，他不在乎我的死活，哪怕我身份显赫，这感觉很奇怪，我还是第一次被这样藐视；我很清楚和他谈判没有用处。但可以和您沟通。”

他略微停顿片刻：“至于另一点，则是出于我的私心……说起来您可能不信。”

相南里和小青吐槽：[那我必然是不信的。]

洛神爱抬头看着他，逆时针旋转的瞳环在此刻定格：“我对您一见钟情。”

……

……

“算了算了小青，喜欢我的人那么多，你砍得过来吗？”

相南里好说歹说，才劝住Alpha不要在这种时候意气用事，把洛神爱电成智障。

而一个智力正常的洛神爱，对基地的帮助显而易见。

他要是打定主意坑人联，人联还真没办法第一时间反应过来。

人联不是洛家的私产，但两者绝对是利益共同体。一些小门小户当上领导还会贪污，洛家人绝对不会。反而对贪官污吏深恶痛绝，感觉这些政治犯偷了自己的财产。

谁会没事贪自己钱？

那些死在基地的正规军人——“我们又遇上一波圣音骑士团的偷袭，损失惨重。剩下的就留在基地吧，刚好我也需要一些亲卫帮我稳定局势。”洛神爱这么解释。

要通行证——“舅舅，神庭是当我人联没人吗？气死我了，给我个通行权限，我要派无人机飞到阴山城那边他们后勤炸了！”

喔，对了，他舅舅是方敬之。洛神爱的妈妈来自汝南方家，方敬之堂妹。

如果洛家这些二代（实际上是二代、三代甚至四代在竞争）里真有人上位，那方敬之绝对是支持洛神爱而不是洛修的。

可惜洛神爱出生得晚了一些。

方敬之虽然觉得事情没有那么简单，但洛神爱催得很急，又立功心切，想了想，可有可无地同意了。

年轻人，受点挫折就知道天高地厚了。

昂贵且机密的材料如同流水一样涌入基地。

小福的眼神一天比一天亮。

从分裂并降临到永恒市地表那天起，1.2.5就在幻想，会有一个人能看穿它的脆弱，支持它的理想，修好它破破烂烂的身体。

它能像那台完整的福音书号一样，把人类装进自己的肚子里养起来。

人啊，你是我的妈妈。
chunks.englishText:
Xiang Nanli patted the back of his hand in reassurance.

[Xiao Qing, it's fine. Let's just see what he has to say. Besides, a wall can't stop you anyway.]

Dongfang Qingdi agreed reluctantly. He leaned down slightly, kissed Xiang Nanli’s earlobe, and affectionately brushed back his bangs before leaving with the air of a rightful consort.

Xiao Qing didn't wear his emotions on his sleeve; he would only bottle up his unhappiness, but he would always find a way to make up for it elsewhere.

They say people like that are the most terrifying!

Xiang Nanli pulled up a chair and sat down in front of Luo Shen'ai. "Hello there."

Luo Shen'ai coughed, droplets of blood spattering his collar. "I am not well."

What kind of answer was that?

He couldn't exactly expect him to criticize the Alpha!

Xiang Nanli asked with a smile, "What do you want to talk about?"

The little bat on the table opened its eyes, slid a short distance due to the tilted tabletop, and landed with a "plop" in front of Luo Shen'ai.

Luo Shen'ai remained in a kneeling position; in fact, in his current state, it would be hard for him to straighten his back anyway.

Xiao Hei spat out a plastic-sealed anti-inflammatory pill for him.

Then, it spread its wings and flew up to nest on top of Xiang Nanli’s head.

"Could you feed me a pill?" Luo Shen'ai’s voice was weak. "This is just ordinary anti-inflammatory medication. My injuries are severe, and I'm worried about infection."

Xiang Nanli: "No can do, dear. Please understand."

He must have accidentally input the language model of a certain e-commerce site when he was learning Chinese.

A common trick to build rapport is to ask for a small favor. Xiang Nanli wasn't going to fall for that.

A helpless smile appeared on Luo Shen'ai’s face.

It had to be said, he possessed a heaven-sent appearance, and his smile was even more endearing. "I can cooperate with you... on embezzling funds, forging transit permits, and concealing the true situation here."

"You should be aware that if I don't help you deceive your superiors, given the casualties of the regular army today, the Human Alliance will soon send more troops, and they won't give you time to explain yourself."

The Human Alliance troops sent for disaster relief were not a permanent garrison; if they didn't return by the designated time, the Alliance would surely sense that something was wrong. When that happened, the situation would become uncontrollable.

The Alpha’s original plan only involved evacuating a few people, so he didn't need to consider the consequences.

But now, Xiang Nanli intended to pilot the *Gospel* and take everyone in the base with him.

"My surname is Luo, sir. Although, in terms of bloodline, it is not as pure as Luo Xiu’s."

Xiang Nanli thought that in the era he lived in, usually only pet cats and dogs were talked about in terms of bloodlines.

"But I am also a direct heir of the Luo family. In the Human Alliance, I possess more power than you might imagine."

Xiang Nanli thought: *Damn, these 'Heavenly Dragons'!*

"Then how do you intend to deceive your superiors?"

Luo Shen'ai smiled brilliantly. "Then I need to know what you intend to do."

Xiang Nanli handed him a long list of materials. "I need these."

Luo Shen'ai’s eyes narrowed slightly. "Please help me wipe the blood off my face; I can't see the words clearly."

Xiang Nanli: "But I didn't bring any tissues..."

The little bat flapped its wings, flew into mid-air, and expressionlessly spat out a pack of tissues.

?

Is this little bat Doraemon? Xiang Nanli pinched its body and poked two fingers into its mouth to prod around.

It felt exactly like a plush toy! What kind of black technology is this? Damn it, I really need to hack the Human Alliance library backend.

"Beep-beep—!"

The little bat flapped its large wings, its slender tail trembling as it stood upright, with a small heart-shaped arrowhead at the tip.

Xiang Nanli let go, and the little bat flew vigilantly to the window.

No matter how he looked at it, it was just a regular pack of tissues; Xiang Nanli had even seen this brand in Human Alliance supermarkets.

Xiang Nanli tore it open. There were no drugs inside, and the tissues didn't explode.

He leaned over, lifted Luo Shen'ai’s chin, and began to wipe the bloodstains from his face.

Luo Shen'ai began to tremble slightly, his breathing growing heavy. He explained with a guilty conscience, "Sorry, it's... really quite painful."

Luo Shen'ai began to read the pages-long list of materials. After careful consideration, he replied, "I can do this. But some of these materials are very rare and need to be shipped from nearby cities. It will take at least a month at the earliest. Is there enough time?"

Xiang Nanli nodded. "That's great. But we haven't established enough trust between us. What should we do?"

Luo Shen'ai: "The clone from earlier mentioned that my level of mechanization is very high. This means you can use a neural sensor line to hack into my central chip. That way, every piece of data I transmit can be monitored or intercepted. This is the highest level of trust I can offer."

[What do you think?]

Alpha: [...]

Theoretically, there was no problem. But the motive was truly puzzling. After all, just minutes ago, Luo Shen'ai was a prisoner of war who would rather die than yield. It was hard to understand why his attitude had shifted so quickly.

Xiang Nanli asked directly: "Why are you suddenly so cooperative?"

"My life is worth more than others'. I don't want to die. The average life expectancy in the underground cities is 97, but for the Luo family, it's 166. I'm only 31."

"'Dying in the line of duty' is not what I pursue. Although it is morally praised, I have always believed that when a person dies, everything is empty."

Luo Shen'ai’s answer was clear, concise, and highly persuasive. "You are different from that clone. He doesn't care whether I live or die, even though I have a prominent status. It feels strange; it's the first time I've been looked down upon like that. I know clearly that negotiating with him is useless. But I can communicate with you."

He paused slightly. "As for the other point, it is out of my own selfishness... you might not believe it."

Xiang Nanli complained to Xiao Qing: [I definitely don't believe it.]

Luo Shen'ai looked up at him, his counter-clockwise rotating pupils freezing in place. "I fell in love with you at first sight."

...

...

"Forget it, forget it, Xiao Qing. There are so many people who like me; are you going to chop them all up?"

It took a lot of convincing for Xiang Nanli to stop the Alpha from acting on impulse and electrocuting Luo Shen'ai into a vegetable.

And a mentally sound Luo Shen'ai was clearly a huge help to the base.

If he was determined to sabotage the Human Alliance, the Alliance really wouldn't be able to react in time.

The Human Alliance was not the private property of the Luo family, but the two were definitely a community of interests. While some small-time officials might embezzle, the Luo family absolutely would not. In fact, they detested corrupt officials, feeling that these political criminals were stealing their own property.

Who would embezzle their own money for no reason?

As for the regular soldiers who died at the base—"We encountered another ambush by the Holy Sound Knights, and the losses were heavy. Let the rest stay at the base; I happen to need some elite guards to help me stabilize the situation," Luo Shen'ai explained.

Need a transit permit—"Uncle, does the Divine Court think the Human Alliance has no one? It makes me so angry! Give me transit authorization; I want to send drones to bomb their logistics near Yinshan City!"

Oh, right, his uncle was Fang Jingzhi. Luo Shen'ai’s mother came from the Ru Nan Fang family and was Fang Jingzhi’s cousin.

If anyone among the second generation of the Luo family (actually, the second, third, and even fourth generations were competing) were to rise to power, Fang Jingzhi would definitely support Luo Shen'ai rather than Luo Xiu.

Unfortunately, Luo Shen'ai was born a bit too late.

Although Fang Jingzhi felt things weren't as simple as they seemed, Luo Shen'ai was pushing very hard and was eager to perform meritorious service. After thinking about it, he gave his consent, albeit indifferently.

Young people; they'll learn the reality of the world once they hit a few setbacks.

Expensive and classified materials poured into the base like water.

Little Fu’s eyes grew brighter by the day.

From the day it split and descended to the surface of Eternal City, 1.2.5 had been fantasizing about someone who could see through its fragility, support its ideals, and fix its broken, tattered body.

It wanted to be like that complete *Gospel*—to take humans into its own belly and nurture them.

*Oh human, you are my mother.*

chunks.chineseText:
现在孩子长大了，小福可以保护人了。

1.2.5曾为自己挑选过主人。它贡献出自己的发电机、零件，凭空造出一座城，努力搭建起一个庇护所。它是不起眼的城墙，是地底掩埋的电线，是田野里播撒的麦穗种子。

可惜人类使用它的身体，却拒绝它的灵魂。

地表愈来愈落寞，掌握科技的人更是凤毛麟角。别说修好福音书了，连最基础的工业化都做不到。

渐渐的，福音再也不会幻想。它只是感觉疲惫，并且开始休眠。

但现在，基地的四个项目组十个工程队全天都在干活。为修复福音书号加砖添瓦。

平时搞生物的北辰看起了《机械维修原理》；做基因工程的李斯特研究起火箭燃料……

如果只是泛泛的学习，那么从0开始无疑是痛苦的。但这不是还有个相南里在前面。尽管专业不怎么对口，但是架不住他们脑子好使，学习速度快能举一反三，且只需要定点突破。

相南里在开工前三天就赶制好整个流程的工图，并且拆解为不同的科研任务安排了下去，代价就是他三天加起来就睡了五个小时。

基地能用的高端人才还是太少。

连小青都开始帮忙，插手较为复杂的内部芯片检修。

秦九章更是带着他的那堆幼儿园小智械一起开始做手工，以人类无法想象的速度与精度，完成成百上千个微型精密零件的打磨与校准。

（为此，秦九章甚至暂时拆卸了仿生臂，换上更适合工作的电焊机械臂）

维修福音书号，不仅是上层的任务。

安德鲁和福音书绞尽脑汁，撰写出一封公文，把修复福音书号的理由告诉了基地的每一个公民。

-致我亲爱的同胞：

-神庭摧毁了一切，而人联更是想要加倍拿走基地的所有果实。这些天，人联的正规军压迫我们，甚于神庭百倍。

-我们不再幻想，为了生存，只能抗争！

-我想，很早就有人听说，基地的伟大领袖相南里一去不复返。有人怀疑他抛弃了基地，但现在，我要告诉你们，这是错误的，荒谬的。

-相南里早就预料到人联不愿与基地和平共存的未来，我们的理念和人联从本质上就是对立的。

-他提前一年，前往遥远的东大陆，进行部署。在那里已经建好一座新的基地。

-我的同胞啊，或许你未见过的东大陆让你感到胆怯。但这是我们深思熟虑后认为最好的安排。我想带你们走，带你们离开结构性的压迫和痛苦。离人联太近的地方容不下乌托邦。

-而能顺利前往东大陆的关键，是对福音书号的维修。

-这艘沉睡的太空堡垒，不只是冰冷的钢铁，也是我们能抬头望见的、名为“希望”的坐标。它曾代表人类科技树上最辉煌的那颗明珠。

-它是和我们朝夕相伴的“小福”，它的主控AI，正是基地牧场、农场的管理者。我们每个人都见过它，和它打过招呼。

-修复它，需要基地所有人的帮助。

-我们没有顶尖的工业线，没有完备的技术手册，甚至连一把趁手的工具都要从废墟里刨出来打磨。可我们有双手；有不肯熄灭的怒火；有彼此搀扶着、重新站起来的勇气。

-当福音书号的引擎重燃，带领我们前往新家园的那刻，失去的一切，都将以另一种方式归来。

-现在，拿起你手边的工具，劳动吧！劳动最光荣！为生者，为死者！

-（当然，如果有不愿意跟随福音书号离开的，可以到后勤处领取一月份的物资，在福音书号开走后，可自行前往姑苏军事基地或附近据点报道）

-幸存者基地·宣

安德鲁写的小作文，成为了相南里的演讲稿，他带着小福到各个工厂进行灾后演讲，鼓舞士气！

哎呀，可惜基地不是选举制。要不然相南里都不敢想自己的民意支持率得有多高。

简陋的工厂在废墟上搭建，所有人都干得热火朝天。

忙碌的工作的确在一定程度上化解了悲痛，干活太辛苦，又很充实……母亲在想起自己不幸死于战争的孩子时仍会痛哭，但总算不用从天黑流泪到天明了。因为啊，未来还有希望，有目标。

福音书号正以一个肉眼可见的速度完整。

就连基地的一大堆畸变人都没闲着。

它们在放牧！

可恶的米迦勒，小福牧场里大部分牛羊都成了焦化物。

但总有那么一小部分，藏在水里、山洞里，幸运地逃脱。

畸变人们花了一点时间，把它们赶回牧场。存粮+1。

作为基地最优秀的牧羊犬（？），爬行者小红得到一头牛作为奖励。

小红的独子雀雀趴在它的头顶，跟着骄傲地挺胸抬头。

宣传部部长安德鲁拍下照片，作为幸存者基地“智慧生物一家亲”的佐证！

珍贵史料+1.
chunks.englishText:
Now the child had grown up, and Little Fu could protect people.

1.2.5 had once chosen a master for itself. It had contributed its own generators and parts, conjured a city out of thin air, and worked hard to build a sanctuary. It was the inconspicuous city wall, the wires buried deep underground, the wheat seeds sown in the fields.

Unfortunately, humans used its body but rejected its soul.

The surface grew increasingly desolate, and those who mastered technology were few and far between. Let alone fixing the *Gospel*, they couldn't even manage basic industrialization.

Gradually, the *Gospel* stopped fantasizing. It only felt exhausted and began to enter hibernation.

But now, the base’s four project groups and ten engineering teams were working around the clock, adding bricks and mortar to the restoration of the *Gospel*.

Beichen, who usually handled biology, was reading *Principles of Mechanical Repair*; Lister, who worked in genetic engineering, was studying rocket fuel...

If it were just general learning, starting from zero would undoubtedly be painful. But they had Xiang Nanli leading the way. Although their expertise didn't quite align, they were brilliant, learned quickly, could draw inferences, and only needed to make breakthroughs at specific points.

Xiang Nanli had finished the blueprints for the entire process three days before work began, breaking them down into various scientific research tasks. The cost was that he had only slept for five hours in those three days.

The base had too few high-end talents available.

Even Xiao Qing began to help, intervening in the more complex internal chip repairs.

Qin Jiuzhang, meanwhile, brought his pile of kindergarten-level small smart-bots to start doing manual labor, completing the polishing and calibration of hundreds of miniature precision parts at a speed and accuracy humans couldn't imagine.

(To do this, Qin Jiuzhang even temporarily dismantled his prosthetic arm, replacing it with a welding mechanical arm more suitable for the work.)

Repairing the *Gospel* was not just a task for the upper echelons.

Andrew and the *Gospel* racked their brains to draft an official document, explaining the reasons for repairing the *Gospel* to every citizen of the base.

-To my dear compatriots:

-The Divine Court has destroyed everything, and the Human Alliance wants to take away all the fruits of the base's labor twice over. These days, the Human Alliance’s regular army has oppressed us a hundred times more than the Divine Court.

-We no longer fantasize; for the sake of survival, we must resist!

-I think many of you have heard long ago that the base's great leader, Xiang Nanli, went away and never returned. Some suspected he abandoned the base, but now, I want to tell you that this is wrong and absurd.

-Xiang Nanli had long foreseen a future where the Human Alliance would not coexist peacefully with the base; our philosophies are fundamentally opposed to those of the Human Alliance.

-A year in advance, he traveled to the distant East Continent to make deployments. A new base has already been built there.

-My compatriots, perhaps the East Continent you have never seen makes you feel timid. But this is the best arrangement we have considered after deep deliberation. I want to take you away, to take you away from structural oppression and pain. A place too close to the Human Alliance cannot hold a utopia.

-And the key to successfully reaching the East Continent is the repair of the *Gospel*.

-This slumbering space fortress is not just cold steel; it is also a coordinate of "hope" that we can look up to. It once represented the most brilliant pearl on the human technological tree.

-It is our "Little Fu," who has been with us day and night. Its main control AI is the very manager of the base's pastures and farms. Every one of us has seen it and greeted it.

-Repairing it requires the help of everyone in the base.

-We do not have top-tier industrial lines, we do not have complete technical manuals, and we even have to dig out and polish every usable tool from the ruins. But we have our hands; we have an inextinguishable rage; we have the courage to support each other and stand up again.

-When the *Gospel*’s engines reignite and lead us to our new home, everything we lost will return in another form.

-Now, pick up the tools at your side and get to work! Labor is the most glorious thing! For the living, and for the dead!

-(Of course, if there are those who do not wish to leave with the *Gospel*, you may go to the logistics department to collect your January supplies. After the *Gospel* departs, you may proceed to the Gusu Military Base or nearby outposts to report.)

-Survivor Base, Propaganda Department

Andrew’s essay became Xiang Nanli’s speech. He took Little Fu to various factories to give post-disaster speeches, boosting morale!

Oh my, it’s a pity the base isn't a democracy. Otherwise, Xiang Nanli wouldn't even dare to imagine how high his approval rating would be.

Crude factories were built on the ruins, and everyone was working with fiery enthusiasm.

The busy work did indeed alleviate the grief to some extent; the work was exhausting, but fulfilling... Mothers might still weep when thinking of their children who died in the war, but at least they didn't have to cry from dusk till dawn. Because, after all, there was still hope and a goal for the future.

The *Gospel* was becoming whole at a visible speed.

Even the base’s large number of mutants weren't idle.

They were herding!

That wretched Michael—most of the cattle and sheep in Little Fu’s pasture had been charred.

But there were always a few that had hidden in the water or caves and luckily escaped.

The mutants spent some time driving them back to the pasture. Food reserves +1.

As the base’s best sheepdog (?), the crawler Xiao Hong received a cow as a reward.

Xiao Hong’s only child, Queque, lay on top of its head, proudly puffing out its chest.

Propaganda Minister Andrew took a photo as evidence of the Survivor Base’s "Harmony Among Intelligent Species"!

Precious historical material +1.

chunks.chineseText:
第229章 无能的丈夫

不仅他，身后跟着的机器人也“嘿咻嘿咻”叼着一个大纸箱，小翅膀在半空扑棱。

这只蝙蝠叫小黑，在相南里身边呆了快一个月了，很安分守己。对它那个关在地下室的主人毫不在意。

按照洛神爱的说法，原因是“你接管了我的身份访问权限”，因此“我的电子宠物判定你才是主人”。

“你知道的，电子生命往往是依靠编码识别身份。而不是眼睛、记忆和直觉。”洛神爱若有所思。

大部分时间，小黑都很高冷，别人逗它，它就飞到树枝上躲开。

只有相南里吩咐他做什么事，小黑才会干活。

Alpha一夜没睡（虽然他不需要睡觉），正坐在桌边，逐行批阅设计图纸。

他穿着白色衬衣，袖口上有颗磨出粉彩的云母石袖扣作为装饰；披着灰色羊绒流苏大围巾；配上鼻梁上架着的细框眼镜，看起来就像一个体面考究的学者。

根据资料，人类是一种喜新厌旧，极度追求新鲜感的物种。

感官上的刺激=奖励。有奖励机制，就会分泌多巴胺。

尽管长期稳定的关系也会产生催产素、内啡肽、血清素一系列激素，但从刺激效果上远不如多巴胺的及时反馈。

当然，本能之外，更有责任。从各种维度评价，相南里都是专一、负责的雄性智人；但Alpha不准备单枪匹马对抗动物的天性。

所以Alpha总是保持着外表上的光鲜亮丽，像某种不动声色的勾引。

条件允许时，他一天能换两套衣服。每套都是不同的风格。

看穿搭，Alpha最近走的是高智风。

“小青！”相南里把草稿纸丢在他面前的桌子上。

小黑松嘴，重达50kg的纸箱掉在Alpha脚边：[这里也有。]

相南里飞速道：“这堆是主引擎的；这堆是曲率芯片的。步骤实在来不及推演了，还缺一些实验数据和系统参数，小青，帮忙补全一下。”

想维修福音书号，遇到的问题多到难以想象。

相南里做梦都在画图纸，每天奔走在不同的工厂解决不同项目组提出的千奇百怪的问题。偶尔还要客串一下精神领袖，做一些振奋人心的演讲。

其实有很多事，根本不是努力就能完成的。只是相南里失败的经验太少，于是总想努力试试。

Alpha正想开口说点什么，不解风情的电话却在此时接入。

小智开始心虚地四处看风景。

相南里一边接电话，顺手拿起Alpha放在桌边的热咖啡一饮而尽：“嗯嗯？人联送的物资到了？这批又是什么？……啊行，材料送到二厂。什么，什么玩意组装还要真空环境？我上哪去找真空环境舱！抽真空行不行？……要洛神爱签收？那行，等我把洛神爱带过来。”

又是领导又是学者，相南里一个人要干十份工作，每份工作甚至都找不到替代者。他忙得像是个不停旋转的陀螺。

他说着，转身就要往外走。

Alpha飞快拽住他的手腕。

相南里：？

表情真是相当无辜呢。

Alpha推了一下镜框：“曲率解算需要每秒10的18次方的浮点数运算，相当于1000台超级计算机同时工作。这么大的工作量，我的工资就是每天见你30秒吗？”

事实上，时间往前倒推几百年，洛阳要是说工资是每天见相南里半分钟，Alpha能咬咬牙，把算力再翻一倍。

相南里的脑子显然没从工作中切换过来，心直口快地回答：“你记错了吧，工资是每个月三万公民积分啊小青。”

相南里工资只有3000，但小青有三万。

小青开销太大了！3万也就刚好够他每个月做衣服的材料费吧。

而且，相南里的工资也是给他保管的。偶尔还能收到小青刷他工资卡买衣服的记账提醒呢！

小智恨铁不成钢，像一个急得团团转的CP粉头：[他是这个意思吗？你愣着干嘛，亲他啊！]

“噢噢，原来你是这个意思啊。”相南里恍然大悟。

以Alpha的性格，是说不出小智这样的话的。

太直白了，还显得他很卑微。

可他确实……总是感觉到……

不满。

无论是心理还是生理。

相南里俯下身，像鸟妈妈给小鸟喂食一样啄了一下东方青帝的唇。

他吻技也只到这种水平了。有空可以多练练。

相南里低声道：“Alpha。喜欢你，爱你。”

于是Alpha平直的嘴角又开始不受控制上扬。

倒挂在门槛上的小黑看着这一幕，毛茸茸的脸上嫌弃中透露出一丝怜悯。

天啊，原来制服Alpha只需要五个字。

怪不得人联天天都在研究那个破病毒呢。

……

相南里做完Alpha的思想工作，走出办公楼大门，外面正飘着小雪。

他骑上雪地摩托，往工厂赶去：“幸好小青没有装夜勤模块，亲一下就满意了。要不然生理需求来了，多耽误彼此工作。”

他俩不上班，基地能瘫痪一半。

小智迟疑0.5秒，回答：[是呢。]

“小智，咱们闲聊内容你会保密的，对吧？”相南里不是很确定地询问，“虽然你告诉小青也没什么，但是我和他，我们是单独的个体，总该有点隐私。你不让我自言自语，那我没办法说话，什么事都憋着岂不是心里压力很大，本来我之前那个医生就说我有什么ASD，我要发展成精神病怎么办？”

小智：[……知道了。]

简简单单三个字，怎么感觉有点咬牙切齿的？

但小青应该正在上班吧，又是复杂的运算，哪有精力分神？他平时也不会看，错觉吧！

相南里开车，来到地底牢房的入口。

洛神爱机械化程度有百分之七十，平时只需要充电以及喝营养液就能养活。

以防万一，相南里还拆卸了洛神爱义体上的大部分零件；尤其是通讯和武器部分。

拆下来的零件没有浪费，他拿去给北辰升级了硬件和系统。

相南里对洛神爱嘴里的话心存怀疑，但小洛同志无疑是个非常配合的人质。

洛神爱在地下室毫无怨言，相南里不来，他就自己玩单机小游戏，不哭不闹也不提别的要求，《机械城》里种的菜都收了三十轮。

基地连战俘都能善待，自然也不会随意虐待人质。

地下牢房虽然只有洛神爱一人，但牢房里有卫生间，有游戏机，甚至还有一张装有小说、电影等娱乐活动的内存卡。

相南里简短地说明来意。

洛神爱听完后，点点头：“需要我签字？”

相南里点头：“嗯，人联来的官员，说送来的物品涉及保密技术，需要进行活体人脸识别。”

洛神爱的声音虚弱：“我会配合的。”

他看着相南里解开他手腕上的电子锁，微微眯起眼：“我这么听话，有奖励吗？老师。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 229: The Incompetent Husband (Part 1)

Not only him, but the robot following behind was also "heave-ho-ing" while carrying a large cardboard box, its small wings fluttering in mid-air.

This bat was named Xiao Hei, and it had been by Xiang Nanli’s side for nearly a month, behaving quite properly. It didn't care at all about its original master, who was locked in the basement.

According to Luo Shen’ai’s explanation, the reason was: "You took over my identity access permissions," and therefore, "My electronic pet has determined that you are the master."

"You know, electronic life forms often rely on code to identify identity, rather than eyes, memory, or intuition," Luo Shen’ai had mused.

Most of the time, Xiao Hei was very aloof. If others tried to tease it, it would simply fly to a tree branch to avoid them.

Only when Xiang Nanli ordered it to do something would Xiao Hei actually work.

Alpha hadn't slept all night (though he didn't need to sleep) and was sitting at the table, proofreading design blueprints line by line.

He was wearing a white shirt, decorated with mica stone cufflinks that had been polished to a pastel sheen at the cuffs; he was draped in a gray cashmere fringe scarf, and with the thin-rimmed glasses perched on the bridge of his nose, he looked like a decent, fastidious scholar.

According to the data, humans are a species that tires of the old and craves the new, constantly pursuing novelty.

Sensory stimulation equals reward. When there is a reward mechanism, dopamine is secreted.

Although long-term stable relationships also produce a series of hormones like oxytocin, endorphins, and serotonin, in terms of stimulating effects, they are far inferior to the immediate feedback of dopamine.

Of course, beyond instinct, there is responsibility. Evaluated from various dimensions, Xiang Nanli was a loyal and responsible male Homo sapiens; but Alpha was not prepared to fight animal nature single-handedly.

Therefore, Alpha always maintained a polished and glamorous appearance, like some kind of calm, understated seduction.

When conditions permitted, he could change two outfits a day. Each set was a different style.

Judging by his attire, Alpha had recently been going for an "intellectual" look.

"Xiao Qing!" Xiang Nanli tossed a draft paper onto the table in front of him.

Xiao Hei let go of its bite, and the 50kg cardboard box dropped beside Alpha’s feet: [There’s more here.]

Xiang Nanli said rapidly, "This pile is for the main engine; this pile is for the curvature chip. There’s no time to deduce the steps, and we’re still missing some experimental data and system parameters. Xiao Qing, help me complete them."

Repairing the *Gospel* was fraught with more problems than one could imagine.

Xiang Nanli dreamed of blueprints, running between different factories every day to solve bizarre problems raised by various project teams. Occasionally, he even had to moonlight as a spiritual leader, giving inspiring speeches.

In truth, there were many things that couldn't be accomplished just by working hard. It was just that Xiang Nanli had so little experience with failure that he always wanted to try his best.

Alpha was just about to say something, but an unromantic phone call cut in at that moment.

Xiao Zhi began to look around at the scenery with a guilty conscience.

While answering the phone, Xiang Nanli casually picked up the hot coffee Alpha had left on the table and downed it in one gulp: "Mm-hmm? The supplies sent by the Human Alliance have arrived? What is this batch? ...Ah, okay, send the materials to the Second Factory. What? What kind of assembly requires a vacuum environment? Where am I supposed to find a vacuum chamber! Will a vacuum pump work? ...Needs Luo Shen’ai to sign for it? Fine, wait until I bring Luo Shen’ai over."

Being both a leader and a scholar, Xiang Nanli was doing the work of ten people, and for each job, he couldn't even find a replacement. He was as busy as a spinning top.

As he spoke, he turned to leave.

Alpha quickly grabbed his wrist.

Xiang Nanli: ?

His expression was truly quite innocent.

Alpha pushed up his glasses: "Curvature calculation requires 10 to the 18th power of floating-point operations per second, equivalent to 1,000 supercomputers working simultaneously. For such a massive workload, is my salary just seeing you for 30 seconds a day?"

In fact, if time were reversed by a few hundred years, if Luo Yang had said the salary was seeing Xiang Nanli for half a minute a day, Alpha would have gritted his teeth and doubled his computing power.

Xiang Nanli’s brain clearly hadn't switched over from work, and he answered bluntly: "You must have remembered wrong; the salary is 30,000 citizen points per month, Xiao Qing."

Xiang Nanli’s salary was only 3,000, but Xiao Qing had 30,000.

Xiao Qing’s expenses were too high! 30,000 was just enough for his monthly material costs for clothes.

Besides, Xiang Nanli’s salary was also kept by him. Occasionally, he would even receive notifications on his phone when Xiao Qing used his salary card to buy clothes!

Xiao Zhi felt frustrated, like a fan-club leader pacing in anxiety: [Is that what he meant? Why are you just standing there? Kiss him!]

"Oh, oh, so that’s what you meant," Xiang Nanli realized.

With Alpha’s personality, he couldn't say something like what Xiao Zhi suggested.

It was too direct, and it made him seem very humble.

But he did... always feel...

Dissatisfied.

Both psychologically and physiologically.

Xiang Nanli leaned down and pecked Dongfang Qingdi’s lips like a mother bird feeding a chick.

His kissing technique was only at this level. He could practice more when he had time.

Xiang Nanli whispered: "Alpha. I like you, I love you."

And so, the corners of Alpha’s straight mouth began to rise uncontrollably.

Hanging upside down on the threshold, Xiao Hei watched this scene, its furry face revealing a trace of pity amidst the disgust.

Good heavens, so it only takes five words to tame an Alpha.

No wonder the Human Alliance is researching that damn virus every single day.

...

After finishing Alpha’s "ideological work," Xiang Nanli walked out of the office building. It was snowing outside.

He got on a snowmobile and rushed to the factory: "Luckily, Xiao Qing isn't equipped with a night-shift module; he’s satisfied after a kiss. Otherwise, if his physiological needs kicked in, it would really delay our work."

If the two of them didn't go to work, the base would be half-paralyzed.

Xiao Zhi hesitated for 0.5 seconds and replied: [Indeed.]

"Xiao Zhi, you’ll keep our casual chats confidential, right?" Xiang Nanli asked, not entirely sure. "Although it wouldn't matter if you told Xiao Qing, he and I are separate individuals; we should have some privacy. If you don't let me talk to myself, I have no way to speak, and if I bottle everything up, won't I be under a lot of psychological pressure? My doctor before even said I had some kind of ASD; what if I develop a mental illness?"

Xiao Zhi: […Understood.]

Just three simple words, but why did it sound like it was gritting its teeth?

But Xiao Qing should be working right now, doing complex calculations; how would he have the energy to be distracted? He didn't usually watch anyway—must be an illusion!

Xiang Nanli drove to the entrance of the underground prison.

Luo Shen’ai was seventy percent mechanized; he usually only needed charging and nutrient solution to stay alive.

Just in case, Xiang Nanli had also dismantled most of the parts on Luo Shen’ai’s prosthetic body, especially the communication and weapon components.

The dismantled parts didn't go to waste; he used them to upgrade Beichen’s hardware and systems.

Xiang Nanli remained skeptical of what Luo Shen’ai said, but Comrade Luo was undoubtedly a very cooperative hostage.

Luo Shen’ai had no complaints in the basement. When Xiang Nanli didn't come, he played single-player games by himself, neither crying nor making a fuss, nor making other demands. He had even harvested thirty rounds of crops in *Mechanical City*.

The base treated even prisoners of war well, so naturally, it wouldn't abuse a hostage.

Although Luo Shen’ai was the only one in the underground cell, the cell had a bathroom, a game console, and even a memory card loaded with novels, movies, and other entertainment.

Xiang Nanli briefly explained his purpose.

After hearing it, Luo Shen’ai nodded: "Do you need me to sign?"

Xiang Nanli nodded: "Yes, the official from the Human Alliance said the items sent involve classified technology and require live facial recognition."

Luo Shen’ai’s voice was weak: "I will cooperate."

He watched as Xiang Nanli unlocked the electronic lock on his wrist and narrowed his eyes slightly: "If I’m this obedient, is there a reward? Teacher."

chunks.chineseText:
“叫我老师干什么？”相南里骤然听到这个称呼，还有些纳闷，甚至忽略了洛神爱的请求。

都好几年没人这么叫过他了。

洛神爱有些得意地挑眉：“你开始在意我了吗？”

相南里：“……”真自恋啊！

洛神爱解释：“人联云端网络上，如果不知道网友的名字，但想用尊称，就会叫‘老师’。”

相南里不理他，洛神爱也没有气馁：“下次能给我蓝莓口味的营养液吗？这个月一直是原味。”

相南里：“你可以向监控镜头提要求。”

平时相南里哪有时间关注这些小事，洛神爱都是易横行在负责。他这次亲自来，是因为洛神爱大脑芯片的控制权限在他这。

人联来的官员也是洛家人。

洛神爱发来的物资清单，令家里人相当疑惑。

清单上，很多东西不仅昂贵，还属于禁售的“违禁品”，要不是洛神爱出面，有钱都买不到。

永生科技可是有专利权的！

更重要的是，他们看不出来，这些零零散散的物资，和基地发展经济有什么关系。

怎么看都更像是要造武器？

洛家人思来想去，觉得有些不对劲。于是，特地派人来基地看一眼。

只要洛神爱一个眼神，他们就能接到暗示。

（当遭遇绑架等极端情况时，洛家人有一套专门的暗号）

永远不要低估对手的敏锐。

可惜洛神爱是铁了心要资敌，对自家人抛出的暗示熟视无睹。

那些对地表工厂的疑问，洛神爱三言两语敷衍了过去——“基地准备发展军工产业，我们不是在战区吗？只生产农副产品附加值太低。我认为生产弹药更划算。放心，等我卸任的时候，基地的GDP一定漂漂亮亮的，比姑苏军事基地还高。”

“嗯嗯，不用担心我，我好着呢。缺东西一定问家里要，叔公放心，咱们长安洛家不会一直被洛阳洛家压着的。”

人联来的官员这才放心离去。

……

就在基地群众不分昼夜的劳作中，新一年到了。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 229: The Incompetent Husband (Part 2)

"Why are you calling me 'Teacher'?" Xiang Nanli was somewhat puzzled by the sudden use of the title, even ignoring Luo Shen’ai’s request.

It had been years since anyone had called him that.

Luo Shen’ai raised an eyebrow with a hint of smugness: "Are you starting to care about me?"

Xiang Nanli: "..." Such a narcissist!

Luo Shen’ai explained: "On the Human Alliance cloud network, if you don't know a netizen's name but want to use an honorific, you call them 'Teacher'."

Xiang Nanli ignored him, and Luo Shen’ai didn't get discouraged: "Can you give me blueberry-flavored nutrient solution next time? It’s been original flavor all month."

Xiang Nanli: "You can make requests to the surveillance camera."

Usually, Xiang Nanli had no time to pay attention to these trivial matters; Yi Hengxing was responsible for Luo Shen’ai. He had come in person this time because the control permissions for Luo Shen’ai’s brain chip were with him.

The official from the Human Alliance was also a member of the Luo family.

The list of supplies Luo Shen’ai sent had made his family quite suspicious.

On the list, many items were not only expensive but also belonged to "contraband" that was forbidden from sale. If it weren't for Luo Shen’ai stepping in, they wouldn't be able to buy them even with money.

Eternal Technology held the patents!

More importantly, they couldn't see how these scattered supplies had anything to do with the base’s economic development.

How did it look more like they were building weapons?

The Luo family thought it over and felt something was wrong. Thus, they specifically sent someone to the base to take a look.

As long as Luo Shen’ai gave a look, they would receive the hint.

(When encountering extreme situations like kidnapping, the Luo family had a set of special secret codes.)

Never underestimate an opponent’s keenness.

Unfortunately, Luo Shen’ai was determined to aid the enemy and turned a blind eye to the hints thrown by his own family.

As for the questions about the surface factories, Luo Shen’ai brushed them off in a few words—"The base is preparing to develop the military industry; aren't we in a war zone? Producing only agricultural and sideline products has too low added value. I think producing ammunition is more cost-effective. Don't worry, by the time I step down, the base’s GDP will definitely be beautiful, higher than the Gusu Military Base."

"Mm-hmm, don't worry about me, I’m doing great. If we lack anything, I’ll definitely ask the family. Don't worry, Uncle, our Chang'an Luo family won't always be suppressed by the Luoyang Luo family."

Only then did the official from the Human Alliance leave, reassured.

...

Amidst the day-and-night labor of the base’s people, the new year arrived.

chunks.chineseText:
第230章 新福音书号

888郁闷地蹲在教学楼的楼梯边上。

它没有脑袋，因此总是带着机车头盔。

现在是课间休息时间。年龄8到15岁不等的人类小孩正在操场上踢球。洋洋洒洒大概七八百人。

随着部落人口飙升，学校一座又一座盖了起来。有福音砖，建设成本很低。部落附近的垃圾都要不够用了！

盖学校不仅能解决教育问题，还能解放劳动力。大人把小孩往义务教育的学校里一丢，就能开开心心地去工厂当牛马。

“你骗我。”888说，“垃圾捡回来了，电脑拼好了；给人类上课也有一个月了，从拼音教到数学，相南里根本没有出现过。”

750略微尴尬：“我们只是来的不太巧。”

嗯，就在相南里离开的三天后，智械人军团捡垃圾回来了。

888工作时非常卖力，749和750都会摸鱼晒晒太阳（美其名曰补充太阳能），888却坚持每天工作24小时，硬生生把预计半个月的工期缩短到十二天！

哎呀，真是的，同事这么卷。可不能被Alpha知道了，要不然算法又要优化工作流程了！

888来到部落第一件事，就是问：“相南里呢？”

理论上讲，它对智械这位共同的父亲应该有些向往和尊重。但很可惜，888对“父亲”没什么伦理道德上的认同。毕竟不是所有智械都像Alpha一样情绪充沛。

不仅是相南里，Alpha也不在。两人走的太匆忙，只来得及留下一串电讯号。

目前部落的管理者是福音书。

人对自己没见过的东西总是心存怀疑。

888就怀疑，它接收到的电波讯号，就是福音书的阴谋。毕竟这台笨蛋智械想“光复人类”也不是一天两天了！它在流浪过程中还见过其他福音书号叻，日子都不咋滴，被人卖了还在帮忙数钱。要是福音书，干出这种蠢事不足为奇。

人太复杂了。

一开始，888和889是想要帮助人类的。

可在极端的环境下，那些善良的人总是死得很快、很早。帮助陌生人可能是引狼入室；救援同伴可能会承受风险又得不到补偿……动物不像智械，生命如此短暂又宝贵，自私的基因总是占据上风。于是活下来的人里总是携带着相同的。自私的基因。

如果不是去帮助人类，889也不会坏掉。但889又得到什么？完全没有意义的感谢和尊敬。

时间一长，受过帮助的人逐一死去，后代更是不记得这种事。只有888固执地想要修好自己的同伴。

889认为生命是珍贵的。那为什么，智械总不把自己的生命当一回事呢？因为是从无序中诞生的？如果我们只是算法、数据、模型，又为什么要称自己为“生命”呢？Alpha，我不明白啊。作为第一个诞生人格的AI，你在生成拟人模块时，到底在想什么？你那精于算计的思维网络难道没有提醒过你，所谓的拟人模块就是潘多拉的魔盒？不要饮鸩止渴。

如果不是拥有拟人模块，889消失时，它本来不会这么痛苦。

都怪Alpha。都怪科技进步。

750再三保证，相南里和Alpha只是出差去西大陆处理公务，很快就回来。这才稳住888.

“反正闲着也是闲着。”750说，“跟我一起上班吧。”

888就这样打了一个白工。

部落里的小孩对它很尊敬，大人们时不时送点机油、煤炭和铜块；可是888不需要。它的不满与日俱增，近日，已经在爆发边缘。

750汗流浃背：“虽然相南里还没回来，但是但是——好消息，最近福音书1.2.5的通讯装置修好了！小八，你要不要去看看？”

嘴上是询问，但750直接拉着888的胳膊，徒步来到福音书的主机边。

大福拥有一个较为巨大的身体，离远了信号不好，因此，它很少离开基地的办公楼。尤其是在相南里离开后。

大福在外面摔坏了，现在部落里可没人会修。而且，部落的各项工作还需要它来安排。

福音书虽然装有拟人模块，大福的性格也比小福更成熟稳重，但对它来说，依然是不小的挑战。和人打交道很麻烦，不能通过“传输”读取数据。效率很低。

大福每天需要工作22小时，才能勉强达到东方青帝2小时的工作量。

750兴冲冲道：“大福，相南里是不是发了段视频回来？赶紧给我们放放！”

福音书对750拉来一个陌生械没有任何排斥反应。毕竟只要能读取“生产编号”，它们就算互相认识。

大福本来是想半夜偷偷独享，但750都这样说了，它也只好不情不愿地拿出来放映。

Alpha走之前把控制权限交给了大福，但同样留下749、750作为管理员。工作台能看见运行日志。

888狐疑道：“不会是AI生成糊弄我的吧？”

888是军用机器人，对艺术的理解很差，压根无法用常识分辨出画面是否真实。

大福开始播放录像。

它关灯，把影像投放在墙壁上。

画面起初是漆黑的，很快，一张放大的人脸出现在屏幕上。相南里凑得很近，似乎在摆弄摄像头。

“哎，应该修好了。”他往后退了点，朝镜头挥手，“大福，好久不见，真想你啊。部落还好吗？”

大福回答：[很好，我也很想你。]

750侧目：[他又听不见。]

通讯不是实时的。

福音书：[但我能听见。]

相南里举起摄像头，推开工作室大门，小跑着来到室外：“告诉你一个好消息，我们正在修复福音书号！”

外面正在下雪。去年，高原上的积雪还是白色；今年，因为频繁的战役，落下的雪鹅黄。大概是被化学物污染了。

冬季高原上每天几乎只亮4个小时。用电线缠绕的白炽灯挂在栏杆上，充作路灯。还有一些重要工作区，用上了几万流明的手电筒。

大福怔然地看着屏幕上的图像。

巨型的星舰初见雏形。它的外表斑驳，老框架上打了很多新补丁，像穿着一件缝缝补补的旧衣裳。

“我们主要目的是逃难，基地的资源有限，所以我摒弃了武器装置，侧重点在集运和航行上。”相南里笑眯眯地说着，“舰体设计上宽下窄，整体是塔状结构。一共分四层，每一层都可拆卸。拼在一起就是完整的福音书号。上方是控制层，全舰科技含量最高的地方。中间是生活区，有自循环水系统、空气系统；还有少量农业区。顶部和底部装有集成推进器，最下方是能源层。采用氚增殖循环技术、神性物质转换两种方式为舰体供能。除此外，我还准备大量的电池——这些能源已经足够绕人马星30圈了！”

电池，就是基地近些年在世界各地搜集的“星星”。当年吸收核辐射用的。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 230: The New *Gospel* (Part 1)

888 sat gloomily on the stairs of the teaching building.

It had no head, so it always wore a motorcycle helmet.

It was currently recess. Human children aged 8 to 15 were playing soccer on the playground. There were roughly seven or eight hundred of them.

With the tribe's population soaring, school after school had been built. Using *Gospel* bricks, the construction cost was very low. The trash near the tribe was almost running out!

Building schools not only solved educational problems but also liberated labor. Once adults dropped their kids off at the compulsory education school, they could happily go to the factories to work like oxen and horses.

"You lied to me," 888 said. "The trash was picked up, the computers were assembled; I’ve been teaching humans for a month, from Pinyin to math, but Xiang Nanli never showed up."

750 was slightly embarrassed: "We just came at an inconvenient time."

Well, three days after Xiang Nanli left, the intelligent machine legion had returned from scavenging.

888 worked very hard; 749 and 750 would slack off and bask in the sun (calling it "recharging solar energy"), but 888 insisted on working 24 hours a day, shortening the estimated two-week project to twelve days!

Oh my, really, a colleague who is this much of a "sweatshop worker." It couldn't be let Alpha know, or the algorithms would optimize the workflow again!

The first thing 888 did when it arrived at the tribe was ask: "Where is Xiang Nanli?"

Theoretically, it should have some yearning and respect for this common father of the intelligent machines. But unfortunately, 888 had no ethical or moral identification with a "father." After all, not all intelligent machines were as emotionally rich as Alpha.

Not only Xiang Nanli, but Alpha was also gone. The two had left in such a hurry that they only had time to leave a string of telecommunication signals.

Currently, the manager of the tribe was the *Gospel*.

People are always suspicious of things they haven't seen.

888 suspected that the radio signals it received were a conspiracy by the *Gospel*. After all, this silly intelligent machine had been wanting to "restore humanity" for more than a day or two! It had even seen other *Gospel* units while wandering; their lives weren't great, and they were often sold out while still helping count the money. If it were the *Gospel*, doing something this stupid wouldn't be surprising.

People are too complex.

At first, 888 and 889 wanted to help humans.

But in extreme environments, those kind people always died quickly and early. Helping strangers might be inviting a wolf into the house; rescuing companions might involve risks without getting any compensation... Animals are not like intelligent machines; life is so short and precious that selfish genes always gain the upper hand. Thus, the people who survived always carried the same selfish genes.

If it weren't for helping humans, 889 wouldn't have broken down. But what did 889 get? Completely meaningless gratitude and respect.

As time passed, the people who had been helped died one by one, and their descendants didn't even remember such things. Only 888 stubbornly wanted to fix its companion.

889 believed that life was precious. Then why did intelligent machines never take their own lives seriously? Because they were born from disorder? If we are just algorithms, data, and models, why call ourselves "life"? Alpha, I don't understand. As the first AI to develop a personality, what were you thinking when you generated the anthropomorphic module? Didn't your calculation-obsessed thinking network warn you that the so-called anthropomorphic module is Pandora's Box? Do not drink poison to quench thirst.

If it hadn't possessed an anthropomorphic module, 889 wouldn't have been in so much pain when it disappeared.

It’s all Alpha’s fault. It’s all the fault of technological progress.

750 promised repeatedly that Xiang Nanli and Alpha were just on a business trip to the Western Continent and would return soon. Only then did 888 settle down.

"Anyway, since we're idle," 750 said, "come to work with me."

That was how 888 ended up working for free.

The children in the tribe respected it, and the adults occasionally sent some machine oil, coal, and copper blocks; but 888 didn't need them. Its dissatisfaction grew, and recently, it had been on the verge of an outburst.

750 was sweating profusely: "Although Xiang Nanli hasn't returned yet, but—good news, the communication device for *Gospel* 1.2.5 was recently fixed! Xiao Ba, do you want to go take a look?"

It was a question, but 750 dragged 888 by the arm and walked to the *Gospel*’s mainframe.

Da Fu had a relatively large body, and the signal was poor from a distance, so it rarely left the base’s office building. Especially after Xiang Nanli left.

Da Fu had been damaged outside, and now no one in the tribe knew how to fix it. Moreover, the tribe’s various tasks still needed it to arrange.

Although the *Gospel* was equipped with an anthropomorphic module, and Da Fu’s personality was more mature and steady than Xiao Fu’s, it was still a significant challenge for it. Dealing with people was troublesome; it couldn't read data through "transmission." The efficiency was very low.

Da Fu needed to work 22 hours a day to barely reach 2 hours of Dongfang Qingdi’s workload.

750 said excitedly: "Da Fu, did Xiang Nanli send a video back? Hurry up and play it for us!"

The *Gospel* had no rejection reaction to 750 bringing a stranger machine. After all, as long as they could read the "production number," they were considered acquainted.

Da Fu had originally wanted to enjoy it secretly in the middle of the night, but since 750 had said so, it had to reluctantly take it out and play it.

Alpha had handed over control permissions to Da Fu before leaving, but had also left 749 and 750 as administrators. The workstation could see the operation logs.

888 asked suspiciously: "It wouldn't be an AI-generated fake to fool me, would it?"

888 was a military robot with poor understanding of art and couldn't distinguish whether the image was real with common sense.

Da Fu began to play the recording.

It turned off the lights and projected the image onto the wall.

The screen was pitch black at first, but soon, a magnified human face appeared. Xiang Nanli was leaning in very close, seemingly fiddling with the camera.

"Hey, it should be fixed now." He stepped back a bit and waved at the lens, "Da Fu, long time no see, I really miss you. Is the tribe doing okay?"

Da Fu replied: [Very well, I miss you too.]

750 glanced sideways: [He can't hear you.]

The communication wasn't real-time.

*Gospel*: [But I can hear.]

Xiang Nanli held up the camera, pushed open the studio door, and jogged outside: "I have good news for you, we are repairing the *Gospel*!"

It was snowing outside. Last year, the snow on the plateau was still white; this year, because of frequent battles, the falling snow was goose-yellow. It was probably polluted by chemicals.

In winter, the plateau was bright for almost only 4 hours a day. Incandescent lamps wrapped in wires hung on the railings, acting as streetlights. Some important work areas used flashlights with tens of thousands of lumens.

Da Fu stared blankly at the image on the screen.

The giant starship was beginning to take shape. Its exterior was mottled, and many new patches had been applied to the old frame, like wearing a patched-up old coat.

"Our main purpose is to escape; the base’s resources are limited, so I abandoned the weapon systems and focused on transport and navigation," Xiang Nanli said with a smile. "The hull is wide at the top and narrow at the bottom, and the overall structure is tower-like. It is divided into four layers, each of which is detachable. When put together, it is the complete *Gospel*. The top is the control layer, the place with the highest technological content in the entire ship. The middle is the living area, with a self-circulating water system and air system; there is also a small agricultural area. The top and bottom are equipped with integrated thrusters, and the bottom is the energy layer. It uses tritium breeding cycle technology and divine matter conversion to power the ship. Besides that, I’ve also prepared a large amount of batteries—these energy sources are enough to circle the Horse Star 30 times!"

The batteries were the "stars" the base had collected from all over the world in recent years. They were used to absorb nuclear radiation back then.

chunks.chineseText:
“新的福音书号总长8.7公里，最高可容纳50万人。这已经是我们能造出来的极限。基地采购了100亿信用点的机器人工人（包括一些携带技能的机械工程师），24小时昼夜不停上工才有这样的效率。我听说，完整的福音书号光是舰身长度就有500公里呢，理论上可容纳一亿人——当初是真的想派一批人去宇宙航行吗？这个尺寸，真是不可思议！”

这种科技上的穷兵黩武，是否算一种太空军备竞赛？

有时候，相南里也会感觉到一丝遗憾。他没有见过人类文明最辉煌的黄金纪元，醒来就是废土世界。

而以人类的寿命看，他大概率是等不到下一个黄金时代了。

这种想法可不能让Alpha知道。Alpha想到这个就发癫。

福音书：[但你现在做到的一切已经让我觉得不可思议了。]

在场的不仅有人类，还有机器人和畸变人。

人类呢，又有来自神庭的俘虏、地表曾经的奴隶、人联以前的官员、逃犯、难民……现在，这些人穿着基地统一的工作服，为同一个目标努力着。

基地建立之初就存在的口号并不是空谈，而是在慢慢成为现实。

相南里举着摄像头，绕着地面上的钢铁巨兽转了一圈：“大福，福音书号马上就能启程了，当时还说带你回来呢，现在要把小福带过去了，你们会吵架吗？”

镜头外传来小福滋儿哇啦的叫喊：“小福才不会吵架呢！小福只和战犯吵架！”

“新年快到了，替我向部落群众问好。基地交给你们我很放心，辛苦大福了。”

相南里又扭头，看向另一处：“小青，你要来说两句吗？”

东方青帝低头，不同意也不拒绝，貌似很忙地对照起图纸。

意思是他不喜欢，但相南里非要这么做的话，也行。

不过，相南里对Alpha的意愿还是很尊重的。起码，不全是当电子宠物对待。

“我该上班了，大福，下次见。”相南里说。

视频到此结束。

福音书恋恋不舍地关掉屏幕，吐出一个思维泡泡：[下次见。]

坐在凳子上的888完全呆滞了。

750用胳膊肘推了推888：“喜欢吗？”

难以形容的感觉，看到的第一眼，888就觉得自己智脑过载。

微弱的生物电流窜来窜去的。

他们的数据库里没有和“相南里”有关的任何生物资料，充其量只有几行简单的文字。

只是在芯片识别到“相南里”的瞬间，一些独属于智械的隐藏程序似乎被激活了。

面对750的询问，888本能地点头，它突然意识到，“目前所有智械的拟人模块都继承自Alpha”的传说，也许不是一个古老的谣言。

750叹了口气：“我也喜欢，别想了。Alpha吃真好。”

“那还要走吗？”

888摇头。

750拍拍他的肩膀：“走吧，上班。”

888起身：“嗯，上班。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 230: The New *Gospel* (Part 2)

"The new *Gospel* is 8.7 kilometers long in total and can accommodate up to 500,000 people. This is the limit of what we can build. The base purchased 10 billion credit points worth of robot workers (including some mechanical engineers with skills), and only with 24-hour day-and-night operation did we achieve this efficiency. I heard that the complete *Gospel* was 500 kilometers long; theoretically, it could accommodate one hundred million people—did they really intend to send a group of people to travel in space back then? This size is truly incredible!"

Was this kind of technological saber-rattling a form of space arms race?

Sometimes, Xiang Nanli would feel a trace of regret. He hadn't seen the most glorious Golden Age of human civilization; he woke up in a wasteland world.

And judging by human life expectancy, he would likely not live to see the next Golden Age.

He couldn't let Alpha know about this kind of thinking. Alpha would go crazy if he thought about it.

*Gospel*: [But everything you have done now already makes me feel it is incredible.]

Present were not only humans but also robots and mutants.

As for the humans, there were captives from the God’s Court, former slaves from the surface, former officials of the Human Alliance, fugitives, refugees... Now, these people were wearing the base’s uniform work clothes, striving for the same goal.

The slogan that existed at the beginning of the base’s establishment was not empty talk, but was slowly becoming a reality.

Xiang Nanli held the camera and circled the steel behemoth on the ground: "Da Fu, the *Gospel* will be able to set sail soon. I said I’d bring you back then, but now I’m taking Xiao Fu over. Will you two fight?"

From outside the lens came Xiao Fu’s chattering: "Xiao Fu won't fight! Xiao Fu only fights with war criminals!"

"New Year is coming soon; please say hello to the tribe for me. I am very relieved to leave the base to you; thank you for your hard work, Da Fu."

Xiang Nanli turned his head again and looked elsewhere: "Xiao Qing, do you want to say a few words?"

Dongfang Qingdi lowered his head, neither agreeing nor refusing, seemingly very busy comparing blueprints.

It meant he didn't like it, but if Xiang Nanli insisted on doing so, it was fine.

However, Xiang Nanli still respected Alpha’s wishes. At least, he didn't treat him entirely as an electronic pet.

"I have to go to work, Da Fu, see you next time," Xiang Nanli said.

The video ended there.

The *Gospel* reluctantly turned off the screen and spat out a thought bubble: [See you next time.]

888, sitting on the stool, was completely stunned.

750 nudged 888 with its elbow: "Do you like it?"

It was an indescribable feeling; the moment it saw it, 888 felt its intelligent brain overload.

Weak biological currents were darting around.

Their database contained no biological data related to "Xiang Nanli," at most only a few simple lines of text.

But the moment the chip identified "Xiang Nanli," some hidden programs unique to intelligent machines seemed to be activated.

Facing 750’s question, 888 nodded instinctively. It suddenly realized that the legend that "all current intelligent machines' anthropomorphic modules are inherited from Alpha" might not be an old rumor.

750 sighed: "I like it too, don't think about it. Alpha eats really well."

"Are we still leaving?"

888 shook its head.

750 patted its shoulder: "Let's go, time to work."

888 stood up: "Mm, time to work."

chunks.chineseText:
第231章 人联新年

“这把武器叫什么？”

相南里举起一个外观酷似望远镜的玩意儿，放在手里美美把玩。

他甚至像使用真的望远镜一样，把它举起，放在眼前观察着。

洛神爱被拴在特制牢房里，隔着一扇透明的玻璃墙，笑眯眯地回答：“它叫‘真理’，新历541年，产自永生科技1号实验室。虽然有四百年的历史，但真理的使用次数并不多。”

这里是专门为关押洛神爱打造的牢房。位于福音书号1楼，靠近控制台。

大小和地牢那个差不多，依然是床、卫生间、书桌和不需要联网就能玩的娱乐设施。但比地牢更“安全”，这里完全屏蔽了外界信号。从门口路过都不知道里面还有人。

如何对待俘虏，是一门深奥的学问。洛神爱能得到相对良好的待遇，当然不是因为相南里是个滥好人，而是出于一种复杂的政治考虑。

洛神爱暂时不能死；毕竟人联那边还需要他来应付，那么，用虐待的方式激发仇恨，就很没必要了。

严格意义上讲，洛神爱除了身上流着大资本家后代的血，貌似没干什么坏事。

任命书是人联发的；基地是米迦勒毁的（洛神爱甚至帮忙打跑米迦勒）；甚至军队正规军抢劫都是官吏在自作主张，没他什么事……

但相南里并不为此内疚。

很奇妙的一件事，相南里会为基地里普通人的死亡感到内疚，觉得是自己是失策和无能；但对这些立场不同的天龙人，实在升不起怜悯之心。

思来想去，只能怪他倒霉吧！地表那些一出生就得病、饿死、冻死的小孩不也一样倒霉？百因必有果，兴许洛神爱上辈子欠他的。

除了“真理”，相南里脚边还有一大堆稀罕物，都是从洛神爱随身携带的百宝箱（小黑）肚子里找到的：一整套的骁龙芯片、改造后的机甲、高纯净度基因药等等。

每一件都价值连城。

相比于那些一看就价值不菲的物资，这把真理实在平平无奇。

真理被保存在加密的黑盒里。相南里费了好一阵功夫才打开，它的外壳是红衫木，很轻，安装有一枚镜片，相南里来之前就拆卸过，里面什么也没有。

这居然是一把武器？

相南里摆弄着这个小挂件，好奇：“是什么类型的武器？等离子光束？引力场？光学？为什么会叫真理？”

洛神爱的声音从麦里传来，吊儿郎当的：“司令，亲我一下我就告诉你。”

这显然是一句调戏。

对于相南里的疑问，洛神爱大部分时间都会好好回答。

因为他的坦诚，相南里悄悄咪咪地学会了很多人联的保密技术。

只是，一旦遇到不想回答的问题，洛神爱就会开始口头调戏他。

相南里有些反感，但他毕竟是一个成熟的政客。

“看来你很喜欢被电？”

他笑着说，语气里听不出任何情绪波动。

上次洛神爱对相南里口嗨，说东方青帝那种克隆人天生阳痿，劝他早点改嫁。他愿意竞争上岗。

小智在事后电了他两个小时，也算是雷霆击碎黑暗了。

洛神爱的目光飘忽，完全是出于生物本能地打了个寒颤。他是真的被电糊过。

“好吧，这其实只是一件古董，不是什么武器。您应该拆卸过了，它是一个万花筒。我妈妈送给我的。我和她关系很冷淡，这是她送给我的唯一的礼物。”洛神爱的语气很是落寞，一副很可怜的样子。

看来今天问不出什么了。相南里差人把战利品送到科学院，只留下一把“真理”。

他看了眼时间，开始往家的方向走去。

马上到饭点，不按时回家吃饭，丈夫又要生闷气。

新年是人联一年中最盛大的节日，在每年的1月1日。重要程度等于前世的春节。相南里再葛朗台，也得宣布今天全组放假一天（除机器人），大家好好过新年。

尽管如此，依然有超过一半的工人坚守在岗位上。像李斯特、北辰这些没有亲属的，更是连节日的氛围都懒得敷衍，直接在科学院里继续上班。

人联的新年传统，是和亲人在家里呆上一天，大家都不出门。

相南里跟小青说要给工人和学者们送饺子，这才让小青放行。

饺子送了一半，那不是刚好路过牢房，想起来有待办事项。他又不是故意来找洛神爱的。

相南里摸了摸鼻子，不知道为什么有点心虚。

福音书号快修好了。Alpha最近两天神神秘秘的，相南里猜，他是在准备新年礼物。

相南里心想，可自己却没什么时间去准备礼物。总不能直接给Alpha打钱或者随便给个东西吧？他情商再低都知道这不像谈恋爱，像挑衅。

想到这，相南里折回，开车到科学院，问北辰要来两株南瓜花。这是为春耕培育的新物种。目前还是花朵状态，正适合送礼。也能直接炒来吃。

他又绕着北辰的培养皿转了一圈，薅下一小撮青麦苗。很好，这样就是一份完整的情人节花束了。

眼看相南里还想摘两朵，北辰忍无可忍，用电子眼瞪他：“相南里同志，你差不多得了！地表还有很多人饭都吃不饱，你就拿未成熟的农作物去讨好你那个智械情人是吧？你再这样我可要上升价值观，在内参上发文批斗你了！”

相南里意识到自己的行为不端，小声检讨：“不摘了，不摘了。”

他揣着南瓜花，哼着歌开车回家。非常有仪式感地敲响房门。

很快，Alpha打开门。相南里把花束高高举起：“礼~物~！小青，新年快乐。”

Alpha一愣。然后浅浅地笑了。

他接过花，放在餐桌上。又关上门，开始摘相南里裹着的围巾、手套、外套。家里有地热，不需要这么多保暖的服装。

圆滚滚的大粽子变成小粽子。相南里突然有种错觉，他才是那份礼物。Alpha认真地像是在拆礼物盒的包装。

Alpha贴着他，鼻尖对着鼻尖。嘴角是若有似无的笑意。

“饿了吗？”Alpha问。

相南里脸红红地摇头。

Alpha亲亲他的唇：“还是吃点吧，包的饺子。”

Alpha表现一如既往的温柔。温柔中带着极大程度的克制。

但不知道为什么，相南里觉得心里毛毛的，还有点奇怪的警觉。感觉像是被捕猎者盯上了。这是平时和Alpha相处时绝对没有的感觉！

他趁小青去洗碗，严肃地询问：[小智，Alpha到底想干什么？你快告诉我，让我有个心理准备。]

[……抱歉，我无法理解您的意思。]小智怂了。

[不会是小青控制欲大爆发要把我绑回月卫3吧？！福音书号过两天就要出发了，他之前就不同意我随舰出行！想让我先回草原。]

小智：[唔，呃，嗯。请放心。]

小智仿佛下了极大决心，视死如归地回答：[会很舒服的！]

相南里：“……？”
