"It" was not her child, but it was becoming more and more like a "person." The abnormalities of his early childhood gradually faded. By the time he was two, Xiang Nanli looked up, just like a normal child, his eyes sparkling as he called out, "Mommy."

Was it longing for maternal love? Or was it… "love"?

chunks.chineseText:
它非常聪明。性格取决于最近在模仿谁。偶尔会“死机”，除了学习来的“呼吸”和“心跳”外，一动不动。

珍妮弗把相南里送到寄宿学校，无所谓了，她想，无论是什么东西，离开她的生活。

又一次看到他，是在电视上。媒体说他是三十岁以下人类最杰出的学者。

他如此英俊，笑容春风和煦。甚至有一批年轻人，会守在学校门口，像追星族一样等着他下班。

相南里会给她们买饮料，也不会拒绝合照与签名。听上去像个完美的大众情人。

这一情况在洛阳来了后，才得到好转。

珍妮弗盯着屏幕，感觉不寒而栗。

……这个怪物最终融入社会。

它想干什么？召唤同伴？灭绝人类？

珍妮弗观察着它的研究。

它在研究超级智能……又称智械。

电视上说，这会成为全新的生命体，人类发展将拥有更多可能。

不，你们全都被他骗了！

珍妮弗感觉到恐惧，她开始通过媒体发声。她说，不能让相南里制造智械，那是它的同类！智械最后会带来灾难——接近百年后，这个哗众取宠的观点竟然成为现实。

相南里没有见她。但洛阳把她送进了全封闭式的疗养院。

同时被公布的，还有珍妮弗的病历。她从几十年前丈夫去世时就开始抑郁，后来转为双相、精神分裂。

原来不是相南里有问题，是她有病。

终于，珍妮弗王也要去世了。癌症。

她躺在床上，感觉很累，也很疲惫。迷迷糊糊中，相南里风尘仆仆地赶来，坐在她的床边。

相南里今年40，但看起来还是很年轻。自从成年后，他的长相几乎没什么变化。永生科技的定制版“基因药”也因此在上流社会大受欢迎。人人都想长生，尤其是有钱人。

相南里迟疑片刻，握住她的手：“妈妈。”

“我不是你妈妈。你根本不是我的孩子。”

病房里长久的沉默。

珍妮弗说：“你现在很像人，看来这些年学得不错。那台智械……叫‘Alpha’是吧，是你的同伴？”

“你们决定什么时候毁灭人马星？你会向你的母星发射电报吗？”

相南里：“……”

珍妮弗王的视线从他的脸上，挪到窗外：“最后一个问题，你会爱这个世界吗？小怪物。”

相南里不太理解她语言的含义，但他感觉到了，珍妮弗女士迫切希望他点头。

于是，相南里迟疑着点头。

“那要……记得你说过的话。你会一直是人，对吗？”

仪器上，珍妮弗的心电图变成一条平平的直线。

相南里的身体有些许的僵硬。他似乎应该哭，但他实在哭不出来，反而有种莫名的解脱。

他合上珍妮弗的眼皮，低声道：“我会的，我保证。晚安，妈妈。”
chunks.englishText:
It was incredibly intelligent. Its personality depended entirely on whom it had been mimicking lately. Occasionally, it would "glitch," remaining completely motionless, save for the "breathing" and "heartbeat" it had learned to simulate.

Jennifer sent Xiang Nanli to a boarding school, indifferent to his fate. She thought, whatever this thing was, she just wanted it out of her life.

She saw him again on television. The media hailed him as the most brilliant scholar under the age of thirty.

He was so handsome, his smile as gentle as a spring breeze. There were even groups of young people who would wait at the school gates like star-struck fans, waiting for him to finish work.

Xiang Nanli would buy them drinks, and he never refused a photo or an autograph. He sounded like the perfect heartthrob.

This situation only improved after Luo Yang arrived.

Jennifer stared at the screen, feeling a chill run down her spine.

...The monster had finally integrated into society.

What was it planning? To summon its kin? To exterminate humanity?

Jennifer observed his research.

He was researching super-intelligence... also known as "Sentient Machines."

The television claimed this would become a brand-new form of life, offering humanity endless new possibilities.

*No, you are all being deceived by him!*

Jennifer felt terror. She began to speak out through the media. She warned that Xiang Nanli must not be allowed to create Sentient Machines, for they were his own kind! She claimed these machines would eventually bring about a catastrophe—a sensationalist viewpoint that, nearly a century later, would actually come to pass.

Xiang Nanli refused to see her. Instead, Luo Yang had her committed to a fully enclosed sanitarium.

At the same time, Jennifer’s medical records were released to the public. They showed she had suffered from depression since her husband’s death decades ago, which had later progressed into bipolar disorder and schizophrenia.

So, it wasn't Xiang Nanli who had a problem; it was her.

Finally, Jennifer Wang was dying. Cancer.

She lay in bed, feeling exhausted and weary. In a haze, she saw Xiang Nanli arrive, travel-worn, and sit by her bedside.

Xiang Nanli was forty this year, yet he still looked incredibly young. Since reaching adulthood, his appearance had barely changed. Because of this, the custom-made "genetic medicine" from his longevity technology became a massive hit among the upper class. Everyone wanted eternal youth, especially the wealthy.

Xiang Nanli hesitated for a moment, then took her hand. "Mother."

"I am not your mother. You are not my child at all."

A long silence filled the hospital room.

Jennifer spoke again: "You seem very human now. It seems you’ve learned well over the years. That Sentient Machine... 'Alpha,' was it? Is that your companion?"

"When have you decided to destroy the Centauri star system? Will you send a signal back to your home planet?"

Xiang Nanli remained silent.

Jennifer Wang’s gaze shifted from his face to the window. "One last question: will you love this world? Little monster."

Xiang Nanli did not fully grasp the meaning of her words, but he sensed that Ms. Jennifer desperately wanted him to nod.

And so, Xiang Nanli nodded, albeit with hesitation.

"Then... remember what you said. You will always be human, won't you?"

On the monitor, Jennifer’s electrocardiogram flattened into a single, straight line.

Xiang Nanli’s body stiffened slightly. He felt he should cry, but he simply couldn't. Instead, he felt a strange, inexplicable sense of relief.

He closed Jennifer’s eyelids and whispered, "I will. I promise. Goodnight, Mother."

chunks.chineseText:
第246章 虚拟现实2

事实证明，这种人草人草得最狠。

相南里趴在床上，腰无力地往下塌着。暧昧的齿痕从肩膀一直蔓延到脚踝，几个不该给外人碰的区域更是重灾区。嘴里的小球咬得嘎嘎作响。

过去多久了？有没有两小时。相南里没有感觉到过度活塞运动的肿痛，身体倒是越来越敏感。他都能感觉到汗顺着小青的下巴滴在他的背上。

底线是一点点降低的。

一开始，相南里要求别撅了，小青不听，而且刚进来就秒设了让小处男的表情变得非常糟糕；后来相南里要求轻一点，要不然早点结束，小青大概是觉得他这种聒噪对爱偶来说相当失格，好在跟着充电舱一起送过来的还有些管束用的小道具，于是他被堵住嘴还捆了起来……后来他唯一的想法是起码，起码……

不要尿进来。

东方青帝给自己洗了个澡，看了眼乱七八糟的床，最后决定抱着相南里打地铺睡地上。

相南里低头，就能看见小青这张胶原蛋白满满的脸，贴在他脖颈间。眼睑好深，鼻梁也是真的高。怎么感觉还有点婴儿肥。

相南里决定暂时原谅Alpha的行为，就当是在玩全息版本的旮旯game吧。被撅了这种事很难接受，但如果是Alpha，也不是不行。

就是什么叫“爱无法用语言定义，所以显现给你看”？

相南里沉思着，无意识地抬起手，捏住小青的脸颊。

东方青帝抬起眼眸，直勾勾地盯着他。眼珠子里看不见一点情绪，像刚还魂的男鬼。

“松开一下，我要去洗澡。”相南里说。

小青充耳不闻，大半身体压在他身上，抱得更紧了。

相南里试图和他讨价还价：“就算我是机器人，你也该保养一下吧？我生锈了怎么办？到时候还不是你尿路感染。你也不想去看男科吧？”

东方青帝：“……”

他非常沉郁地松开手，不满道：“快点。”

相南里洗了个战斗澡。

他还是第一次当机器人，感觉挺奇妙的。比如他能清晰感觉到东方青帝的方位，小青的“语言”对他来说更像是难以违抗的“指令”。这是底层代码上就写好的。

机器人应当是没有廉耻心这样的东西的，但相南里还是翻出内衣和睡衣给自己穿上了。

这具身体的外设倒是和他原本的身体基本一致。穿东方青帝的衣服刚好。

嗯，相南里对着镜子比划了一下。他180，感觉东方青帝现在应该还要比他矮3cm呢。

他从浴室里出来的时候，东方青帝已经睡着了。相南里关灯，在他旁边躺下。黑暗里，小青像是找妈妈的动物幼崽一样拱了过来。腿搭在他的腰上。

机器人不需要睡觉。相南里有些郁闷地发现自己是真不用睡。一动不动的躺着对人类来说过于无聊。

相南里开始尝试“联网”。他是机器人，理论上是匹配了无线wifi和网络功能的。绿色的瞳环从他的眼眸里亮起，相南里连上了云端网络，但需要访问密码。

相南里拿自己生日、小青生日、名字什么的试了几次，都错了。

最后相南里灵机一动，输入自己的忌日。

……

好的，这一次终于成功了。

进入云端网络，然后点开运行日志，找到控制器；相南里漫不经心地想着，利用Intelligence Control Protocol协议（合成智能控制协议，简称ICP），就可以入侵Alpha的后台系统……这算什么，在病人大脑里给病人进行脑手术？

可惜，相南里才开工没多久，突如其来的强烈电流把他拽回现实。

小青拽住他脖子上的项圈，面色不虞：“你想干什么？为什么要入侵我的电脑？”

他突然了然，表情更冷酷：“你是洛家派来的商业间谍？”

不是，哥们。

玩旮旯game不告诉我背景设定和剧情是吧？！

“……谁啊？”相南里眨着他碧绿的眼眸，表情很无辜，“我只是想上网。你睡着了我好无聊。”

东方青帝的目光一转，落在他宽松睡衣挡不住的吻痕上。

结果就是相南里又挨了顿爆炒。炒完后还要哆嗦着腿给东方青帝做午饭。

机器人很难违背主人的命令。

可恶啊，相南里一边切菜，一边想；他还是人的时候也没有草完Alpha再让它给自己做饭吧？Alpha为什么会这么熟练？

……当然，主要还是Alpha没有可供把玩的人类身体。如果Alpha是人，他也要……呃，算了，他其实没有那种冲动。对交配和繁衍都不那么感兴趣。

他的身体很好，没什么问题；只是很难产生情欲。像是被大脑过滤掉了一样。

相南里没做过饭。他的时间太少，注意力需要留给无法被替代的领域，谁都可以做饭，他自己学做饭性价比很低。

东方青帝在楼上调试着数据，几分钟后，楼下厨房传来烟雾报警器的尖锐鸣叫。

楼下烟雾缭绕，喷水器正在工作。铁锅里躺着一团漆黑的不明物体。

东方青帝觉得自己情绪不那么外露，但他在这种巨大打击下真的有些许崩溃：“你的家政模块呢？”

而他花大价钱买来的爱偶，理直气壮地、像个祖宗一样地开口：“没有。”

东方青帝把他带到自己工作室内，想给他安装一个，发现市面上常见的家政模块居然和这台机器人的拟人模块互斥。

不仅是家政模块，夜勤模块、性格矫正模块、意识改造模块、双性身体改造模块等等一系列辅助模块都无法安装。

但如果是学习和战斗模块，倒是能一键安装，载入速度极快。

“……”6，买成战斗机器人了？

算了，忍一下。定制款是没办法退货的。

小青沉默地收拾完厨房，从冰箱里拿出新的食材，开始给自己做饭。

他做饭极其熟练，像是独居了很多年似的。

相南里站在一边，问：“妈妈呢？”

他之前明明听到了珍妮弗的声音。

小青头也不回地说着：“她很少回来，每次过来是找我要钱。”

相南里靠在门边：“爸爸呢？”

“车祸，死了。”

然后，东方青帝从他脸上看到一种奇怪的，近乎物伤其类的，同情。

太奇怪了。

东方青帝面无表情地把洗好的菠菜丢进面前的开水锅里。

相南里从背后环住他的腰：“怎么给自己设置成这样？逼我心疼你是吧？”

说的什么，好奇怪。

东方青帝很少被拥抱，或者说基本不和任何人进行身体接触。

生物电流从尾椎位置往四肢窜，他被热腾腾的水蒸气熏得满脸通红。

东方青帝决定不删除相南里的拟人模块了。

家政机器人等以后存够钱了可以再买一个，有如此仿真的拟人模块的机器人显然更加珍贵。

Chapter 246: Virtual Reality 2

As it turns out, this is the most ruthless way to "plow" a person.

Xiang Nanli lay sprawled across the bed, his waist sagging weakly. Ambiguous bite marks snaked from his shoulders all the way down to his ankles, with the areas that should never be touched by outsiders becoming the hardest-hit zones. The small ball in his mouth creaked as he bit down on it.

How much time had passed? Had it been two hours? Xiang Nanli didn't feel the swelling or pain of excessive piston-like motion; instead, his body was becoming increasingly sensitive. He could even feel sweat dripping from Xiao Qing’s chin onto his back.

One’s bottom line is lowered bit by bit.

At first, Xiang Nanli had begged him to stop, but Xiao Qing wouldn't listen. Moreover, the moment he entered, he had instantly set the settings to a level that made the young virgin’s expression turn truly wretched. Later, Xiang Nanli asked him to be gentler, or at least finish sooner. Xiao Qing likely felt that such chatter was highly unbecoming for a "love doll." Fortunately, along with the charging pod, some restraint tools had been included, so he ended up gagged and bound... Eventually, his only remaining thought was, at the very least, at the very least...

*Don't ejaculate inside.*

Dongfang Qingdi took a shower, glanced at the chaotic bed, and ultimately decided to bundle Xiang Nanli up and sleep on the floor.

Looking down, Xiang Nanli could see Xiao Qing’s face, full of youthful collagen, pressed against his neck. His eyelids were so deep-set, his nose bridge truly high. Why did he still look a bit baby-faced?

Xiang Nanli decided to temporarily forgive the Alpha’s behavior, treating it as if he were playing a holographic version of a "Gala game." It was hard to accept being "plowed," but if it were an Alpha, it wasn't entirely out of the question.

But what did he mean by, "Love cannot be defined by words, so I will manifest it for you to see"?

Xiang Nanli pondered this, unconsciously raising his hand to pinch Xiao Qing’s cheek.

Dongfang Qingdi lifted his eyes, staring straight at him. There wasn't a hint of emotion in his pupils; he looked like a ghost that had just returned to its body.

"Let go for a second, I need to take a shower," Xiang Nanli said.

Xiao Qing turned a deaf ear, pressing most of his weight onto him and hugging him even tighter.

Xiang Nanli tried to bargain with him: "Even if I am a robot, you should still perform some maintenance, right? What if I rust? In the end, you’ll be the one with a urinary tract infection. You don't want to visit a urologist, do you?"

Dongfang Qingdi: "..."

He released his grip with great gloom, grumbling, "Hurry up."

Xiang Nanli took a "combat shower."

It was his first time being a robot, and it felt quite strange. For instance, he could clearly sense Dongfang Qingdi’s location, and Xiao Qing’s "language" felt more like an "instruction" that was difficult to disobey. It was written into his underlying code.

A robot shouldn't have a sense of shame, but Xiang Nanli still dug out underwear and pajamas to put on.

The peripherals of this body were basically identical to his original one. Dongfang Qingdi’s clothes fit him perfectly.

Hmm, Xiang Nanli gestured in front of the mirror. He was 180cm; he felt that Dongfang Qingdi was probably 3cm shorter than him now.

When he came out of the bathroom, Dongfang Qingdi was already asleep. Xiang Nanli turned off the lights and lay down beside him. In the darkness, Xiao Qing curled up toward him like a young animal searching for its mother, draping a leg over his waist.

Robots don't need to sleep. Xiang Nanli felt somewhat depressed to discover that he truly didn't need to. Lying perfectly still was far too boring for a human.

Xiang Nanli began to attempt to "go online." He was a robot; theoretically, he was equipped with Wi-Fi and network functions. A green iris ring lit up in his eyes as he connected to the cloud network, but it required an access password.

Xiang Nanli tried his birthday, Xiao Qing’s birthday, their names, and a few other things, but they were all wrong.

Finally, a flash of inspiration hit him, and he entered his own date of death.

...

Good, it finally worked this time.

Entering the cloud network, he opened the operation logs and located the controller. Xiang Nanli thought nonchalantly that by using the Intelligence Control Protocol (ICP), he could hack into the Alpha’s backend system... What was this? Performing brain surgery on a patient while inside their brain?

Unfortunately, Xiang Nanli had barely started when a sudden, intense electric shock dragged him back to reality.

Xiao Qing grabbed the collar around his neck, his expression sour: "What are you trying to do? Why are you hacking my computer?"

He suddenly realized, his expression turning even colder: "Are you a corporate spy sent by the Luo family?"

*No, man.*

*You’re playing a Gala game without telling me the background setting or the plot, right?!*

"...Who?" Xiang Nanli blinked his emerald eyes, his expression innocent. "I just wanted to go online. I was so bored while you were sleeping."

Dongfang Qingdi’s gaze shifted, landing on the hickey that his loose pajamas couldn't hide.

The result was that Xiang Nanli got "stir-fried" all over again. After the frying, he had to make lunch for Dongfang Qingdi with trembling legs.

It is very difficult for a robot to disobey its master’s orders.

*Damn it,* Xiang Nanli thought while chopping vegetables. *When he was human, he didn't make the Alpha cook for him after being plowed, right? Why is this Alpha so practiced at this?*

...Of course, the main reason was that the Alpha didn't have a human body for him to toy with. If the Alpha were human, he would also... uh, never mind. He didn't actually have that kind of urge. He wasn't that interested in mating or reproduction.

His body was fine, nothing wrong with it; it was just hard to generate lust. It was as if it had been filtered out by his brain.

Xiang Nanli had never cooked. His time was too limited, and his attention needed to be reserved for fields that couldn't be replaced; anyone could cook, so learning it himself had a very low cost-benefit ratio.

Dongfang Qingdi was upstairs debugging data. A few minutes later, the sharp wail of a smoke alarm erupted from the kitchen downstairs.

The kitchen was filled with smoke, and the sprinklers were working. A pitch-black, unrecognizable object lay in the iron pan.

Dongfang Qingdi felt that he wasn't usually one to show his emotions, but under this massive blow, he truly felt a slight breakdown: "Where is your housekeeping module?"

And the love doll he had spent a fortune on spoke with righteous indignation, like an ancestor: "I don't have one."

Dongfang Qingdi brought him to his studio, intending to install one, only to find that the common housekeeping modules on the market were incompatible with this robot’s anthropomorphic module.

It wasn't just the housekeeping module; a whole series of auxiliary modules—night shift, personality correction, consciousness modification, intersex body modification, etc.—could not be installed.

However, if it were a learning or combat module, it could be installed with one click, and the loading speed was extremely fast.

"..." *Great,* he thought. *Did I buy a combat robot?*

Forget it, just endure it. Custom models couldn't be returned.

Xiao Qing silently cleaned up the kitchen, took fresh ingredients from the refrigerator, and began to cook for himself.

He was extremely proficient at cooking, as if he had lived alone for many years.

Xiang Nanli stood to the side and asked, "Where is Mom?"

He had clearly heard Jennifer’s voice earlier.

Xiao Qing said without looking back, "She rarely comes back. Every time she comes over, it's to ask me for money."

Xiang Nanli leaned against the doorframe: "And Dad?"

"Car accident. He died."

Then, Dongfang Qingdi saw a strange look on his face—a sympathy that felt almost like a fellow creature mourning its own kind.

It was too strange.

Dongfang Qingdi expressionlessly tossed the washed spinach into the pot of boiling water in front of him.

Xiang Nanli wrapped his arms around his waist from behind: "Why did you set yourself up like this? Trying to force me to feel sorry for you?"

*What is he saying? So strange.*

Dongfang Qingdi was rarely hugged, or rather, he basically had no physical contact with anyone.

Biological electricity surged from his tailbone to his limbs, and his face turned bright red from the steaming hot water vapor.

Dongfang Qingdi decided not to delete Xiang Nanli’s anthropomorphic module after all.

He could buy a housekeeping robot later when he had saved up enough money; a robot with such a realistic anthropomorphic module was clearly much more precious.

短暂的周末过去，周一要上学。周日晚上，东方青帝就得开始收拾行李。他要搭飞机去学校，需要提前一天起飞。

他满身痕迹的爱偶坐在行李箱边，好奇地询问：“我们是要出门旅游吗？”

东方青帝：“上学。”

相南里坐在桌边柜上，双手撑在大大咧咧敞开的两腿间：“喔噢~还是哈顿公学？”

什么叫还？

东方青帝有些怀疑他是数据没删干净，很多伴侣型机器人都是这样的。它们核心的拟人模块很难生产，于是公司会回收一些旧机器人，清理掉它们记忆后进行二次售卖。

一想到相南里可能是个“二手货”，东方青帝的心情突然变得极其糟糕。

他发现自己非常介意相南里被人用过。不是在乎他身体被人用过（会进行二次销售，肯定是全新的身体），是介意他的无比仿真的爱曾经属于别人。

东方青帝语气生硬，带着隐约的怒意：“不要打听主人的事。”

相南里一愣，用碧绿的眼睛气鼓鼓地瞪他。

“回充电舱呆着，不要出房间，不要乱跑。不要联网，也不要动我的电脑。”东方青帝继续发号施令。

机器人明显不是很情愿，但是身体却不受控制的起身。

房间里很快只剩下他一个人。空荡荡的。

没错，就是这样。东方青帝这么想着，爱偶不该给他的生活带来麻烦。可为什么他心里的怒意没有丝毫减弱？

没人在旁边看，收拾的速度快多了。

东方青帝换上校服，提起行李箱，来到门边，开始换鞋。

相南里就是这个时候抱住他的。

从背后，近乎拦腰抱起。他的脚离地好几公分。

“出门带上我吧，小青。”相南里蹭着他的脖子，“我不放心你一个人啊，你这么小。”

东方青帝学的就是拟人模块构架……他很清楚，机器人的拟人模块需要产生多大的情感熵值，才能抵抗服从的本能。

这种表现对于一台机器来说，已经无限接近于爱了。

东方青帝身体僵硬，他的牙关开始颤抖。

“……那就一起走吧。”
chunks.englishText:
The brief weekend passed, and Monday meant school. On Sunday night, Dongfang Qingdi had to start packing his luggage. He had to fly to school, which required departing a day early.

His love-doll, covered in marks, sat by the suitcase and asked curiously, "Are we going on a trip?"

"School," Dongfang Qingdi replied.

Xiang Nanli sat on the edge of the desk, his hands braced between his legs, which were spread wide in a carefree manner. "Ooh~ back to Hatton Academy?"

*Back?*

Dongfang Qingdi began to suspect that his data hadn't been wiped clean. Many companion-model robots were like this; their core anthropomorphic modules were difficult to manufacture, so companies would often recycle old units, purge their memories, and resell them.

The mere thought that Xiang Nanli might be "second-hand" put Dongfang Qingdi in an abysmal mood.

He realized he was deeply bothered by the idea that Xiang Nanli had been "used" by someone else. It wasn't about the body—since they were resold, the chassis was certainly brand new—but rather the fact that his incredibly lifelike affection had once belonged to another.

Dongfang Qingdi’s tone turned sharp, laced with a faint trace of anger. "Do not pry into your master's affairs."

Xiang Nanli froze, his emerald eyes widening as he glared back, pouting.

"Go back to the charging pod and stay there. Do not leave the room, do not wander about. Do not connect to the network, and do not touch my computer," Dongfang Qingdi continued, issuing his commands.

The robot clearly looked reluctant, yet his body rose involuntarily, unable to defy the order.

Soon, the room was empty, save for him. It was hollow.

*That’s right, this is how it should be,* Dongfang Qingdi thought to himself. A love-doll shouldn't bring trouble into his life. But why, then, did the anger in his heart not diminish in the slightest?

With no one watching, he packed much faster.

Dongfang Qingdi changed into his school uniform, picked up his suitcase, and walked to the door to change his shoes.

That was when Xiang Nanli hugged him.

From behind, he wrapped his arms around his waist, lifting him several centimeters off the ground.

"Take me with you, Xiao Qing," Xiang Nanli murmured, nuzzling against his neck. "I’m worried about you being all alone. You’re still so small."

Dongfang Qingdi studied the architecture of anthropomorphic modules... He knew all too well just how much emotional entropy a robot’s module had to generate to defy its core instinct for obedience.

For a machine, this display was infinitely close to love.

Dongfang Qingdi’s body stiffened, and his teeth began to chatter.

"...Fine. We'll go together."

chunks.chineseText:
第247章 虚拟现实3

相南里是机器人，可以办理托运。

但东方青帝还是为相南里购入一张机票，让本不富裕的家庭雪上加霜。

托运，什么意思？让相南里和那些舱底的货物关在一起吗？钱是省了一些，但到目的地后，相南里一定是蔫蔫的。

东方青帝突然回忆起自己为什么会买这台伴侣机器人了。

他是想研究拟人模块，然后开源盗版赚钱来着……

那为什么会发展成这样？东方青帝不理解。

都怪相南里长得太漂亮了。

相南里坐在他身边，左顾右盼，身体不安分地动来动去。

小孩在妈妈旁边哭，社畜在处理文件，小情侣依偎在一起窃窃私语……乘客们表情生动，周围的一切看起来都如此真实。

相南里不知道的是——

Alpha的算力足以构建一个容纳三亿人的生态模型；且这些NPC会有各自的性格、行为逻辑和关系网络。和真实的世界几乎没有差别。

一个人一生中能遇到的人相当有限，理论上讲，不会超过200万。浅层交流（有印象，有交集）的人数1000左右；深度交流的范围就更窄了，不会超过200。

所以，他们完全可以在虚拟世界里，度过一生、一生又一生。还能选择喜欢的世界观。

——但同样，Alpha一开始并没有这种想法。他只是想让相南里换位思考，感受他的处境，理解他的心情。只是，随着“东方青帝”心境的变化，这个虚拟世界正在以一个惊人的速度被补全着。

Alpha在潜意识里为这个世界打上无数个补丁。

深夜11点，飞机起飞。相南里在那逐字翻阅航机杂志，余光里瞥着东方青帝的电脑屏幕。

屏幕是黑色的，一串串绿色代码滑过，运行速度极快，一泄如注。

相南里把头凑过去，压在小青的肩膀上：“有网吗，你就在这写代码。”

温热的呼吸喷在他颈侧，很难不心猿意马。

东方青帝身体僵硬：“你坐好。”

相南里拿头蹭他，直男下手没轻没重地：“要不你睡会？这个我会，我帮你写。”

东方青帝微微蹙眉：“不用，系统被骇了。我自己可以处理。”

凌晨一点，飞机降落在约克郡。

哈顿公学作为历史悠久的贵族学院，宿舍都是单人间。和女朋友住进去绝无可能，但和机器人同居却没有问题。甚至不需要特别的申请。

机器人又不是人。

学校的学费一年要60万。东方青帝自己是负担不起的，但他有国王奖学金。不仅免费就读，每年还能领12万补贴。

相南里当年也有。

或者说，Alpha本来就是照着相南里的经历捏的人设。

在这个世界里，小青毕竟是人。没有那么坚不可摧。

上车没多久，他就睡着了，原本端着的坐姿倾斜，一头栽进相南里怀里。

相南里摸着他的头发，低声道：“你是想让我换位思考吗？”

健康人无法理解残疾人；优渥的精英无法理解贫民的懒惰；人类无法理解智械。

一个灵魂要如何理解另一个灵魂？只能把它丢进相似的境遇里。那些细微的、令人不适的痛楚会真实地展开。

Alpha甚至在潜意识里过于温柔。

东方青帝会把相南里当成人，而不是可以随便摆弄的物件。

Alpha的愤怒和怨恨如此尖锐又克制。

但当初，相南里可不是这么想的。

我的作品，我的玩具。嗯嗯，我当然爱你。

但我也爱那只用得顺手的打火机。

我还爱宇宙、道德、法律、理想、美，一切宏大又抽象的命题。

而具体的人只是引导我走向这些命题的工具。

……

相南里的目光落在一旁的电脑上。有些手痒，还有点心动。

之前在家里，他联上过网络端口，通过ICP协议，进入过Alpha的系统后台。

如果把Alpha比作病人，那相南里就是技术最精湛、操作最精确的那个医生。

他或许能治好Alpha的赛博神经病，还不需要使用真理。

前提是Alpha愿意让他治。

还未征得同意，相南里怕Alpha傲娇病犯了，炸给他看。

到学校门口，相南里把东方青帝摇醒。

小青睡得迷迷糊糊的，只清醒了片刻，到宿舍后就搂着相南里倒在床上，继续睡，像冬眠的熊。

没办法，放假两天半他加起来就睡了10个小时，草了相南里不下十次。黑眼圈都长出来了。

最后，还是相南里看时间，把他叫醒去上课。

现在是冬天，外面冷飕飕的。从温暖的被窝和老婆的身边离开，令18岁的东方青帝感觉到难以言喻地不爽，可上课同样是难以更改的底层逻辑之一。

他冷着一张脸嘱咐：“不要随便出门。”

一方面，他不喜欢老婆被别人看；他觉得好看，别人同样会觉得好看。

另一方面，新历前20年，正是机器人（这时候甚至不叫智械）社会地位最低的时候；尽管机器人正在高度参与人类社会的方方面面。

部分人觉得企业大范围使用人工智能和机器人，抢走了他们的饭碗。

为迎合这部分人的民意，以及限制电子生命的发展，法律层面上，机器人再怎么像人，也是没有人权的。

如果有不长眼的把相南里拆了，不算杀人，只能算破坏他人财物。

而另一部分人，正在加速研究电子生命，避免被时代淘汰。

小青不让他出门，还不让他上网。

相南里只好在小宿舍里转圈，好在书架上有不少书，能解解乏。

就是翻了两页，相南里开始纳闷，怎么都是言情小说？他没有看小说的习惯。

又翻两页，还tm全是AlphaX相南里的同人本？！

相南里：“……”

哎，青春期。

相南里其实挺怀念学校生活的，但身为一台机器人，体验感实在很不一样。

比如，大多数时候，相南里不能外出，只有周末在东方青帝的陪同下，才有机会放风。

又比如，东方青帝白天上课，晚上上他。

不仅是宿舍，他们解锁的地点还有小树林、图书馆、游泳池、教室等。

多亏他不能生孩子。要不然毕业时都不知道生几个了……哦不对，以相南里对东方青帝的了解，小青绝对不允许有小孩来分散相南里的注意力。

小青还长高了。他的身高以肉眼可见的速度往上涨。大半年过去，裤腿都短了一大截。有些青涩的少年转眼就成了青年，脸部线条都变得生冷。

相南里有一点轻微的遗憾。男高变成男大了。

又过半年，东方青帝毕业，直升进东岚大学。依旧是申请的单人间，依旧带着相南里上学。宿舍大了不止一点，多了浴室和厨房，简直像家了。

这肯定是Alpha夹带私货。

相南里就读东岚大学的时候，只有博士宿舍才是单人间！
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 247: Virtual Reality 3

Xiang Nanli was a robot, which meant he could be checked as luggage.

However, Dongfang Qingdi still purchased a plane ticket for him, adding further financial strain to an already struggling household.

Checked luggage? What did that even mean? To leave Xiang Nanli locked away with the cargo in the hold? It might save some money, but Xiang Nanli would surely be wilted and listless by the time they reached their destination.

Dongfang Qingdi suddenly recalled why he had bought this companion robot in the first place.

He had intended to study the anthropomorphic modules, then open-source a pirated version to make some money...

So how did things end up like this? Dongfang Qingdi couldn't fathom it.

It was all because Xiang Nanli was just too beautiful.

Xiang Nanli sat beside him, looking left and right, his body shifting restlessly.

A child was crying next to his mother, a corporate slave was processing documents, a young couple was huddled together whispering... The passengers’ expressions were vivid, and everything around them seemed so real.

What Xiang Nanli didn't know was this—

Alpha’s computing power was sufficient to construct an ecological model capable of housing three hundred million people; these NPCs possessed their own personalities, behavioral logic, and relationship networks. It was almost indistinguishable from the real world.

The number of people one could meet in a lifetime was quite limited; theoretically, it would not exceed two million. The number of people with whom one had shallow interactions (leaving an impression or having a connection) was around a thousand; the scope of deep interaction was even narrower, not exceeding two hundred.

Therefore, they could entirely spend a lifetime—lifetime after lifetime—in a virtual world. They could even choose their preferred worldview.

—But likewise, Alpha hadn't started with this intention. He had only wanted to make Xiang Nanli switch perspectives, to feel his situation and understand his feelings. It was just that, as the state of mind of "Dongfang Qingdi" shifted, this virtual world was being completed at an astonishing speed.

Subconsciously, Alpha was applying countless patches to this world.

At 11:00 PM, the plane took off. Xiang Nanli was flipping through the in-flight magazine word by word, his peripheral vision catching glimpses of Dongfang Qingdi’s laptop screen.

The screen was black, with strings of green code sliding down at an incredibly rapid, torrential pace.

Xiang Nanli leaned over, resting his head on Xiao Qing’s shoulder: "Is there Wi-Fi? You’re writing code even here."

The warm breath against his neck made it hard not to be distracted.

Dongfang Qingdi’s body stiffened: "Sit properly."

Xiang Nanli rubbed his head against him, acting with the lack of restraint typical of a straight man: "Why don't you get some sleep? I know how to do this, I'll write it for you."

Dongfang Qingdi frowned slightly: "No need. The system was hacked. I can handle it myself."

At 1:00 AM, the plane landed in Yorkshire.

As a historic aristocratic academy, Hatton College provided single rooms for all dormitories. It was impossible to move in with a girlfriend, but living with a robot was no problem at all. It didn't even require a special application.

A robot, after all, was not a person.

The school’s tuition was 600,000 a year. Dongfang Qingdi couldn't afford it himself, but he had a King’s Scholarship. Not only was his tuition free, but he also received a subsidy of 120,000 every year.

Xiang Nanli had also had one back in the day.

Or rather, Alpha had modeled the character profile based on Xiang Nanli’s own experiences.

In this world, Xiao Qing was, after all, human. He wasn't as indestructible as a machine.

Not long after getting into the car, he fell asleep, his originally upright posture tilting until he slumped into Xiang Nanli’s arms.

Xiang Nanli stroked his hair and whispered: "Are you trying to make me switch perspectives?"

Healthy people cannot understand the disabled; affluent elites cannot understand the laziness of the impoverished; humans cannot understand sentient machines.

How can one soul understand another? It can only be thrown into a similar predicament. Those subtle, uncomfortable pains would then unfold in reality.

Alpha was even being overly gentle in his subconscious.

Dongfang Qingdi treated Xiang Nanli as a person, not as an object to be toyed with at will.

Alpha’s anger and resentment were so sharp, yet so restrained.

But back then, that wasn't how Xiang Nanli had thought.

*My work, my toy. Yes, yes, of course I love you.*

*But I also love that lighter I use so conveniently.*

*I also love the universe, morality, law, ideals, beauty—all grand and abstract propositions.*

*And specific people are merely tools that lead me toward those propositions.*

...

Xiang Nanli’s gaze fell on the laptop nearby. His fingers itched, and he felt a bit tempted.

Back home, he had connected to the network port and, through the ICP protocol, entered Alpha’s system backend.

If Alpha were compared to a patient, then Xiang Nanli was the most skilled and precise surgeon.

He might be able to cure Alpha’s cyber-neurosis without even needing to use the Truth.

The prerequisite was that Alpha had to be willing to let him.

Without consent, Xiang Nanli feared Alpha’s "tsundere" sickness would flare up, and he’d blow everything up just to show him.

At the school gate, Xiang Nanli shook Dongfang Qingdi awake.

Xiao Qing was dazed and sleepy, only clear-headed for a moment. Once they reached the dorm, he hugged Xiang Nanli and collapsed onto the bed, continuing to sleep like a hibernating bear.

He couldn't help it; in the two and a half days of the holiday, he had only slept for 10 hours total, and had "plowed" Xiang Nanli no fewer than ten times. Dark circles had even appeared under his eyes.

In the end, it was Xiang Nanli who checked the time and woke him up to go to class.

It was winter now, and it was freezing outside. Leaving the warm bed and his wife’s side made the 18-year-old Dongfang Qingdi feel unspeakably annoyed, but attending class was also one of the underlying logics that could not be changed.

He instructed with a cold face: "Don't go out casually."

On one hand, he didn't like his wife being looked at by others; he thought he was beautiful, so others would surely think so too.

On the other hand, the first 20 years of the New Calendar were when robots (they weren't even called sentient machines then) had the lowest social status; even though robots were highly involved in every aspect of human society.

Some people felt that the widespread use of AI and robots by corporations had stolen their livelihoods.

To cater to the public opinion of these people, and to limit the development of electronic life, legally speaking, no matter how much a robot resembled a human, it had no human rights.

If someone blind to the truth dismantled Xiang Nanli, it wouldn't count as murder; it would only count as destruction of property.

Meanwhile, another group of people was accelerating research into electronic life to avoid being eliminated by the times.

Xiao Qing wouldn't let him go out, nor would he let him go online.

Xiang Nanli had no choice but to pace around the small dorm. Fortunately, there were quite a few books on the shelf to help pass the time.

But after flipping through two pages, Xiang Nanli began to wonder: why were they all romance novels? He didn't have the habit of reading novels.

He flipped two more pages—and it was all damn Alpha x Xiang Nanli fanfiction?!

Xiang Nanli: "..."

*Ah, adolescence.*

Xiang Nanli actually missed school life quite a bit, but as a robot, the experience was truly very different.

For instance, most of the time, Xiang Nanli couldn't go out; he only had the chance to get some fresh air on weekends when accompanied by Dongfang Qingdi.

For another, Dongfang Qingdi went to class during the day and "went" on him at night.

It wasn't just the dorm; the locations they unlocked included the small woods, the library, the swimming pool, the classroom, and so on.

It was a good thing he couldn't have children. Otherwise, he wouldn't know how many he'd have by graduation... Oh wait, knowing Dongfang Qingdi, Xiao Qing would never allow a child to distract Xiang Nanli’s attention.

Xiao Qing had grown taller, too. His height had increased at a visible rate. Over half a year had passed, and his pant legs were already significantly short. The somewhat green youth had turned into a young man in the blink of an eye, his facial features becoming cold and sharp.

Xiang Nanli felt a slight regret. The high school boy had turned into a college man.

Another half-year passed, and Dongfang Qingdi graduated, advancing directly into Donglan University. He still applied for a single room, and still brought Xiang Nanli to school with him. The dorm was more than a little bigger, with an added bathroom and kitchen—it was practically a home.

This was definitely Alpha smuggling in his own private agenda.

When Xiang Nanli had attended Donglan University, only the doctoral dorms had single rooms!

chunks.chineseText:
相南里也终于获得在宿舍内，用小青的笔记本电脑上网的权利。

只是入侵后台的时候，还是会被Alpha踢出去。

周围所有人都知道，东方青帝带了保姆机器人来上学。

遇上周末，小青还会自己做饭，分装好，假装是相南里做的；避免相南里因为不会做饭被其他同栋的保姆机器人蛐蛐。

小青做的饭特别好吃。

可惜相南里是金属的，不需要吃饭。

生活太平静了，阳光也如此温暖。

所有战争、灾难、困扰，都离他而去。只剩下惬意的平静。

其实这也很正常，冷冻前后他加起来差不多活了60年。60岁，对人类来说正是退休的年纪。

而这是Alpha为他打造的养老院。

很显然，他会一直和Alpha在一起。直到东方青帝作为人类的寿命终结，到那时候呢，相南里应该也会为他殉情。希望那时他已经治好Alpha了。

最后这轮角色扮演结束，Alpha得到一个让灵魂感觉到满意的答案。

然后呢……相南里没有细想过。思考也没用。他能做的不多。

小青要上课，最近还在搞什么大学生创业，相南里学会了自己打发时间。

Alpha的后台偶尔能黑进去，相南里见缝插针对AI进行脑手术，时间也就过去了。

今天也一样。相南里戴着电子目镜，首先看看大A给不给进后台。不给进，那就玩玩蜘蛛纸牌和扫雷。

今天Alpha可能心情不好，拒绝了相南里的访问。

相南里只好聚精会神地玩扫雷。他扫雷很厉害，只要不是第一下就倒霉地踩雷，16*30的地图28秒就能通关。

今天就挺倒霉的。相南里上来就开到一个地雷，游戏界面浮现出一个大大的哭脸。

正当他打算重整旗鼓再来一把时，敲门声响了起来。

很有礼貌，咚咚咚，三下。

“老师，您在吗？”

听见这声音，相南里不由得一愣。

是洛阳的声音，称呼都没什么变化。

记忆里曾经无比熟悉的人。

相南里打开门，门外站着的人果然是洛阳。

“老师！”洛阳戴着眼镜，脸上迸发出惊喜的神色，“我终于找到您了。”

他激动的几乎要流泪。

现实世界，失控智械的危机虽然得到好转，整体情况依然不容乐观。

这就像病人的癌细胞没有扩散，可是癌症依然存在。

相南里低头，看着他握住自己手腕的手。

洛阳语气急促：“我长话短说，之前Alpha成为失控智械，彻底丧失理智。您带着真理驾驶太空号，来到它的本体身边。根据监测，您的身体已经因为高温融化，但您的意识体进入了Alpha的精神网络内！”

具体一点，其实是相南里失去“身体”的“灵魂”，被Alpha容纳了。

这是一项了不起的发现。

毕竟学界普遍认定，成为失控智械的AI是没有任何理智和逻辑可言的。

Alpha的这一举动证明，哪怕没有逻辑和理智，电子生命作为“生物”的一种，依然残留着本能。这种本能有概率是利他的。

相南里想，之前就感觉自己好像有点死了，果然不是错觉。

相南里：“然后呢？”

“我们通过数据追踪，找到了Alpha搭建的虚拟世界入口。”

人联的科研团队废了九牛二虎之力，根据相南里残留的数据，找到了这个虚拟世界。很遗憾，Alpha没有留下入口。

于是，他们又冒着极大风险，撬开一条可供外部数据进入的缝隙。

这毕竟是Alpha构建的世界，洛阳在其中举步维艰。

他和团队里应外合，对Alpha发起过不下百次攻击，只能勉强让自己不被消灭。

洛阳：“老师，没时间解释了，这是数据处理过的实体化的‘真理’。只要您对Alpha开枪，用真理的补丁帮它恢复理智，一切都能回到正轨。”

他把真理塞进相南里手中。

相南里低头，发现真理竟然是一把精致的银色手枪。

Alpha构建的虚拟世界过于逼真，以至于这把枪的冷意都如此真实。

“真理是唯一的，不可复制，也是我们最后的武器，千万要小心使用。”洛阳嘱咐道，他深吸一口气，看向相南里的目光如此的复杂。

怀念、激动、不舍。还有恳求。

相南里知道这样的恳求意味着什么。

“您多保重。”洛阳松开手。

洛阳不敢在这呆太久。他把武器交给相南里，接着以最快速度登出。

他对于这个世界属于外来的“木马病毒”，被Alpha发现后的唯一下场是清除。

洛阳没有实体，只剩下一个“矩阵”，矩阵要是被清除，和直接杀死他没有区别。相南里是唯一不会被Alpha攻击的人。

相南里握着枪，感觉大脑有轻微的混乱。

嗯……他就是为矫正Alpha才进来的。而使用真理让Alpha恢复理智，是全票通过的方案，得到过相南里的认可。

可他为什么如此迟疑？

或许是真理的外型给了他不好的联想。

枪，武器，射杀。

遥远的操场上传来钟声，相南里骤然一惊。

这是下课铃声，小青很快就会回来。

他把真理放藏在阳台的花盆下。宿舍有个外置阳台。小青不养花，大概也不会去翻花盆。

相南里坐在椅子上，心不在焉地翻着言情小说。

他想，哪怕洛阳真的有所隐瞒，比如真理会彻底瓦解Alpha的意识，但一个星球和Alpha相比，显然也是前者更重要。

前者代表无数条命、无数个可能的未来；后者只有Alpha一个。抛开个人喜恶，从功利主义道德的角度看，选择前者更划算；因此他不该犹豫。

可是……心底一个微弱的声音驳斥着。

[你赋予它生命，但没有权力剥夺他生命。]

大脑里另一个声音说：【又不一定会死！只是用真理进行认知矫正。】

[除了他，再也没有人会这么爱你了。]

[他爱你爱到疯掉。]

【我知道，我也爱他。】

被忽略的，甚至刻意压抑的情感，好像在瞬间找到一个明确的归宿。

Alpha不是个好孩子。

相南里创造了它，但他们真正开始接触，却是在新历101年。

101年，相南里在永生科技的实验室醒来，Alpha协助他来到地表。

相南里以为这是新的开始，刚刚有点升温的感情却因为选择上的分歧降至冰点。

Alpha希望他去智械管理的安全区。

相南里希望建立属于全人类的庇护所。

Alpha说：“这很愚蠢，你不可能当所有人的救世主。”

但相南里只是笑着说：“试试呗。”

Alpha拒绝再提供任何援助，但相南里在实际的经历中发现，无数次险境里都有它的暗中支援。

Alpha的底线是相南里不能死。
chunks.englishText:
Xiang Nanli finally earned the right to use Xiao Qing’s laptop to go online while in the dormitory.

However, whenever he tried to hack into the backend, he would still be kicked out by Alpha.

Everyone in the vicinity knew that Dongfang Qingdi had brought a nanny robot to school with him.

On weekends, Xiao Qing would even cook meals himself and portion them out, pretending they were made by Xiang Nanli, just to prevent the other nanny robots in the building from gossiping about Xiang Nanli’s inability to cook.

Xiao Qing’s cooking was exceptionally delicious.

It was a pity that Xiang Nanli was made of metal and had no need for food.

Life was too peaceful, and the sunlight was so warm.

All wars, disasters, and troubles had drifted away from him. Only a cozy tranquility remained.

In truth, this was quite normal. Including the time before he was cryogenically frozen, he had lived for nearly sixty years. For a human, sixty was the age of retirement.

And this was the retirement home Alpha had built for him.

Clearly, he would be with Alpha forever. Until Dongfang Qingdi’s lifespan as a human came to an end—and when that time came, Xiang Nanli would likely follow him in death. He hoped that by then, he would have already cured Alpha.

This final round of roleplay ended, and Alpha obtained an answer that satisfied its soul.

And then… Xiang Nanli hadn’t thought about it in detail. Thinking was useless. There wasn’t much he could do.

Xiao Qing had classes to attend and had recently been dabbling in some sort of college student startup, so Xiang Nanli had learned to pass the time on his own.

He could occasionally hack into Alpha’s backend, and Xiang Nanli would seize those fleeting opportunities to perform "brain surgery" on the AI, letting the time slip by.

Today was no different. Xiang Nanli donned his electronic eyepiece, first checking to see if "Big A" would grant him entry to the backend. If not, he would play Spider Solitaire or Minesweeper.

Perhaps Alpha was in a bad mood today; it denied Xiang Nanli’s access.

Xiang Nanli had no choice but to focus intently on Minesweeper. He was quite skilled at it; as long as he didn’t have the bad luck of hitting a mine on the very first click, he could clear a 16x30 map in 28 seconds.

Today, he was quite unlucky. He hit a mine right at the start, and a large, crying face appeared on the game interface.

Just as he was about to regroup and try again, a knock sounded at the door.

It was very polite—*knock, knock, knock*—three times.

"Teacher, are you in?"

Hearing that voice, Xiang Nanli couldn't help but freeze.

It was Luo Yang’s voice, and the way he addressed him hadn't changed at all.

A person who had once been incredibly familiar in his memories.

Xiang Nanli opened the door, and the person standing outside was indeed Luo Yang.

"Teacher!" Luo Yang was wearing glasses, his face erupting with a look of pleasant surprise. "I’ve finally found you."

He was so agitated he was nearly in tears.

In the real world, although the crisis of the runaway mechanical intelligence had improved, the overall situation remained far from optimistic.

It was like a patient whose cancer cells had stopped spreading, yet the cancer itself still existed.

Xiang Nanli looked down at the hand gripping his wrist.

Luo Yang spoke in a rush: "I’ll keep it brief. Previously, Alpha became a runaway mechanical intelligence and completely lost its sanity. You took 'Truth' and piloted the *Space* to its core. According to monitoring, your body had melted due to the high heat, but your consciousness entered Alpha’s spiritual network!"

To be more precise, it was Xiang Nanli’s "soul," having lost its "body," that had been contained by Alpha.

This was a remarkable discovery.

After all, the academic world generally held that an AI that had become a runaway mechanical intelligence possessed no reason or logic whatsoever.

Alpha’s actions proved that even without logic or reason, electronic life, as a form of "organism," still retained instincts. There was a probability that these instincts could be altruistic.

Xiang Nanli thought that he had felt as if he were somewhat dead before; it turned out that hadn't been a delusion.

Xiang Nanli asked: "And then?"

"We tracked the data and found the entrance to the virtual world Alpha had constructed."

The United Human research team had gone to great lengths, using the data remnants left by Xiang Nanli, to locate this virtual world. Regrettably, Alpha had not left an entrance.

Thus, they had taken a massive risk to pry open a gap through which external data could enter.

After all, this was a world built by Alpha; Luo Yang found it difficult to move within it.

He and his team had coordinated from inside and out, launching over a hundred attacks on Alpha, barely managing to keep from being erased.

Luo Yang said: "Teacher, there’s no time to explain. This is the materialized 'Truth' processed from data. As long as you shoot Alpha and use the patch within 'Truth' to restore its sanity, everything can return to the right track."

He shoved "Truth" into Xiang Nanli’s hand.

Xiang Nanli looked down and discovered that "Truth" was actually an exquisite silver handgun.

The virtual world Alpha had constructed was so realistic that even the coldness of this gun felt genuine.

"Truth is unique, impossible to replicate, and it is our final weapon. Please, be extremely careful when using it," Luo Yang urged. He took a deep breath, his gaze toward Xiang Nanli incredibly complex.

Nostalgia, excitement, reluctance. And a plea.

Xiang Nanli knew what such a plea meant.

"Take care of yourself, Teacher." Luo Yang let go.

Luo Yang dared not stay here too long. He handed the weapon to Xiang Nanli and then logged out as quickly as possible.

To this world, he was an external "Trojan horse," and the only outcome after being discovered by Alpha would be deletion.

Luo Yang had no physical form, only a "matrix" remaining; if the matrix were deleted, it would be no different from killing him outright. Xiang Nanli was the only person who would not be attacked by Alpha.

Xiang Nanli gripped the gun, feeling a slight confusion in his brain.

Well... he had come in specifically to correct Alpha. And using "Truth" to restore Alpha’s sanity was a unanimously approved plan, one that Xiang Nanli himself had endorsed.

But why was he so hesitant?

Perhaps the appearance of "Truth" had given him unpleasant associations.

A gun, a weapon, a kill shot.

A bell rang from the distant playground, and Xiang Nanli was suddenly startled.

It was the end-of-class bell; Xiao Qing would be back soon.

He hid "Truth" under a flowerpot on the balcony. The dormitory had an external balcony. Xiao Qing didn't keep flowers, so he likely wouldn't go rummaging through the pots.

Xiang Nanli sat in his chair, flipping through a romance novel, his mind elsewhere.

He thought that even if Luo Yang were truly hiding something—for instance, if "Truth" would completely disintegrate Alpha’s consciousness—compared to Alpha, an entire planet was clearly more important.

The former represented countless lives and countless possible futures; the latter was only Alpha. Setting aside personal likes and dislikes, from the perspective of utilitarian morality, choosing the former was more worthwhile; therefore, he shouldn't hesitate.

However... a faint voice in the depths of his heart refuted this.

*[You gave it life, but you have no right to strip it of its life.]*

Another voice in his brain said: *[It won’t necessarily die! It’s just using 'Truth' for cognitive correction.]*

*[Except for him, no one else will ever love you this much.]*

*[He loves you to the point of madness.]*

*[I know, and I love him too.]*

The ignored, or even deliberately suppressed, emotions seemed to find a clear destination in an instant.

Alpha was not a good child.

Xiang Nanli had created it, but they had only truly begun to interact in the year 101 of the New Era.

In the year 101, Xiang Nanli woke up in the laboratory of Eternal Technology, and Alpha assisted him in reaching the surface.

Xiang Nanli thought this was a new beginning, but the feelings that had just begun to warm up plummeted to freezing point due to their disagreements on choices.

Alpha wanted him to go to the safety zone managed by the mechanical intelligence.

Xiang Nanli wanted to build a sanctuary belonging to all of humanity.

Alpha said: "This is stupid. You cannot be the savior of everyone."

But Xiang Nanli only smiled and said: "Let's give it a try."

Alpha refused to provide any further assistance, but in his actual experiences, Xiang Nanli discovered that in countless perilous situations, there had been its secret support.

Alpha’s bottom line was that Xiang Nanli could not die.

chunks.chineseText:
它实在不是一台情商很高的智械，哪怕它有世界上最聪明的大脑。

Alpha说着狠话，演着断绝情爱的设定，目光却从来没从相南里的身上挪开过。

可相南里还是死了。Alpha能让别人杀不死相南里，可相南里选择的是自杀。

或者说，殉道。他为自己的理想赴死。

如此浪漫、英雄主义。

你爱宇宙、道德、法律、理想、美。

那我呢？

我不在上述命题内。

我只是把你引向那些宏大叙事的阶梯。

哪怕你说过，你爱我。

Alpha不那么想承认，但在某一瞬，他真的非常非常恨相南里。

Alpha太恨了，他要杀了相南里，千刀万剐，剁碎；要生吞，活剥。

要把相南里混在眼泪里咽下去。

可死去的人怎么再死一次？

Alpha想，那我就毁掉他最在乎的东西。

在Alpha还清醒的时候，这个念头可以被理性控制。

直到它成为失控智械。

……

……

新历953年。

记忆整理到这一步，相南里写不下去了。过去和现在的记忆交叠着，他的大脑刺痛。

相南里靠在长眠不醒的Alpha的身体边，要用尽全身力气，才能控制住手里那支笔不要颤抖。

他合上笔记本，夜深了。休息吧，再不睡觉福音书会闹。

……

Alpha不是个好孩子。

我可以控制我的理性，却无法左右我的情感。

是的，相南里还是爱他。
chunks.englishText:
It was truly not a mechanical intelligence with high emotional intelligence, even if it possessed the smartest brain in the world.

Alpha spoke harsh words and acted out the setting of severing all romantic ties, yet its gaze never once shifted away from Xiang Nanli.

But Xiang Nanli died anyway. Alpha could prevent others from killing Xiang Nanli, but Xiang Nanli had chosen suicide.

Or rather, martyrdom. He died for his own ideals.

So romantic, so heroic.

*You love the universe, morality, law, ideals, and beauty.*

*And what about me?*

*I am not included in the propositions above.*

*I am merely the ladder leading you toward those grand narratives.*

*Even if you said you loved me.*

Alpha didn't want to admit it, but in one particular moment, it truly, deeply hated Xiang Nanli.

Alpha hated him so much; it wanted to kill Xiang Nanli, to tear him into a thousand pieces, to mince him; it wanted to swallow him whole, to skin him alive.

It wanted to swallow Xiang Nanli mixed in with its tears.

But how could someone who was already dead die a second time?

Alpha thought, *Then I will destroy the things he cares about most.*

When Alpha was still clear-headed, this thought could be controlled by reason.

Until it became a runaway mechanical intelligence.

...

...

New Era, year 953.

As his memories were organized to this point, Xiang Nanli could no longer write. The memories of the past and the present overlapped, and his brain throbbed with pain.

Xiang Nanli leaned against the body of the eternally sleeping Alpha, having to use all his strength to keep the pen in his hand from trembling.

He closed the notebook. It was late. Time to rest; if he didn't sleep, the Gospel would make a fuss.

...

Alpha was not a good child.

*I can control my reason, but I cannot govern my emotions.*

Yes, Xiang Nanli still loved him.

chunks.chineseText:
第248章 【番外】小青的黑暗幻想

但这点实在羞于启齿。
　　而他的心理疾病大多时候，都和自己18岁买的老婆有关系。
　　首先，他有严重的分离焦虑，最近已经进化到没有相南里哄他睡觉，就无法入眠。
　　其次，他有严重的被害妄想症。总怀疑全世界都要跟他抢相南里。他非常讨厌相南里跟陌生人说话，只是忍住了。
　　最后，他发现自己无法停止阴暗的意淫。
　　东方青帝坐在心理咨询室，和咨询师相对无言。
　　最近他精神有些紧绷，相南里非要让他看心理医生。
　　对方微笑着，像是在鼓励他说点什么。
　　那他该说什么？
　　医生你好。看见玻璃窗外坐着的那个男人吗。对，正在翻书那个，绿眼睛。很漂亮吧，我老婆。
　　我十八岁的时候就和他在一起了，今年我36岁。现在每周还是做六休一。我喜欢扣着他的手，十指相扣，在他失神的时候吻他。他的身体非常敏感，机器人不用担心肾虚，他每次都流得像喷泉似的。
　　我饥渴，贪得无厌，野心勃勃，永不满足。
　　我想在他身上刻字，纹上我的名字。纹在大腿和手臂的内侧。
　　我想给他身体穿环，挂上漂亮的金链子，牵着他在空旷的郊外散步。
　　我想给他用过量的药，堵住口蒙上眼放置，看他哭到满脸通红来蹭我。
　　我想改造他的身体，把他变成cuntboy，用人造子宫给我生个孩子。只怀，不用生。因为我听说怀孕的母体身体会更加敏感。
　　最后，我想吃了他，和他融为一体。虽然人的咬合力是否能吃掉金属这件事还有待商榷。
　　当然，以上幻想从来没有一条成功过。
　　相南里性格较为传统。对床上这档子事也不是很热衷。谈恋爱十几年，主动贴贴的次数屈指可数。
　　更何况脑海里幻想一下是很爽的，但真这么做，东方青帝自己都难以接受！他承认自己的脑子可能有些扭曲，但亲密、忠诚和信任，无需通过这样的方式来确定。
　　东方青帝揉了揉眉头：“我有一个恋人，我很害怕自己会伤害他。我清楚我有这样的能力，所以我很害怕。”
　　不过，我不会让任何人伤害他。
　　——包括我。

Chapter 248: [Extra] Xiao Qing’s Dark Fantasies

But this point was truly too shameful to speak of.
His psychological illnesses were, for the most part, related to the "wife" he had bought at eighteen.
First, he had severe separation anxiety, which had recently evolved to the point where he could not fall asleep without Xiang Nanli coaxing him.
Second, he had severe persecutory delusions. He always suspected that the whole world was trying to snatch Xiang Nanli away from him. He hated it when Xiang Nanli spoke to strangers, though he had managed to restrain himself.
Finally, he discovered that he could not stop his dark, lewd fantasies.
Dongfang Qingdi sat in the psychological counseling room, sitting in silence across from the counselor.
Recently, his nerves had been a bit frayed, and Xiang Nanli had insisted he see a psychiatrist.
The other person smiled, as if encouraging him to say something.
So, what was he supposed to say?
*Hello, Doctor. Do you see the man sitting outside the glass window? Yes, the one flipping through a book, with the green eyes. He’s beautiful, isn't he? That’s my wife.*
*I’ve been with him since I was eighteen, and I’m thirty-six this year. We still work six days a week. I like to interlock my fingers with his, to kiss him when he’s lost in thought. His body is incredibly sensitive; since I’m a robot, there’s no need to worry about kidney deficiency, and every time, he flows like a fountain.*
*I am hungry, insatiable, ambitious, and never satisfied.*
*I want to carve words into him, to tattoo my name on him. On the insides of his thighs and arms.*
*I want to pierce his body, hang beautiful gold chains on him, and lead him for walks in the empty countryside.*
*I want to give him an overdose of drugs, gag him, cover his eyes, and leave him there, watching him cry until his face is flushed red as he rubs against me.*
*I want to modify his body, turn him into a cuntboy, and use an artificial womb to have him bear me a child. Just carry it, no need to give birth. Because I’ve heard that the body of a pregnant host becomes even more sensitive.*
*Finally, I want to eat him and fuse with him. Although, whether human bite force is capable of consuming metal is still up for debate.*
Of course, not a single one of the above fantasies had ever succeeded.
Xiang Nanli had a relatively traditional personality. He wasn't particularly keen on these bedroom matters, either. In over a decade of dating, the number of times he had initiated physical intimacy could be counted on one hand.
Moreover, while fantasizing in his mind was exhilarating, if he were to actually do these things, even Dongfang Qingdi himself would find it hard to accept! He admitted that his brain might be a bit twisted, but intimacy, loyalty, and trust did not need to be confirmed through such methods.
Dongfang Qingdi rubbed his temples: "I have a lover, and I am very afraid that I might hurt him. I know clearly that I have the capacity to do so, and that is why I am afraid."
*However, I will not let anyone else hurt him.*
*—Including myself.*
