第249章 Apostle IV

相南里一边喝水，一边看着今天刚整理出的电子报纸。

新历953年，Alpha消失的第三年。

相南里学会了利用他留下的系统漏洞，窃取神庭和东西联的情报。

唯一不太爽的就是这个系统漏洞顺便被世界树组织的人发现了，世界树现在的管理员叫IV（4），黏黏糊糊缠着他好几年。经常在三更半夜发来一些意义不明的压缩包。

相南里一开始还有点兴趣，以为是拜托他办的事有消息了，结果拆包发现里面装的竟然是木马病毒。

次数一多，相南里嫌烦，花一周时间同样捏了个电子病毒传过去。

然后世界树的官网炸了，24小时循环播放基地的农产品的宣传广告。半个月后才修复。

IV再也没敢寄病毒。

没有AI助手终究不太方便，相南里无意于和历史潮流对着干当那个逆行者；他在今年又捏了一个新的智能助手，接入自己平时会用的电子设备里。

用于辅助运算、信息整理归纳，以及相南里私人电脑的安全墙。

他没有给这个AI安装拟人模块。人工智能的正式名字叫Apostle-VI，相南里通常叫它小六。

刚装上小六的那天，相南里做了个梦。梦里Alpha脸臭得像鲱鱼罐头，说我刚离开三年你就找了个新的？等我回来就把它们通通卖掉。

相南里笑醒了。

小六操控着家里的扫地机器人开始工作。

[主人您好，神庭的军事支援到了，目前距离1号城150公里。]

“多少人？”

小六使用天上布防的无人机进行扫描：[约三万五。其中两万天启骑士，一万五辎重兵。]

“谁领兵？”

[未识别到领主级骑士。]

相南里翻着报纸冷笑：“刚打穿西联的一个军事基地，神庭的大部队就来了，是想来捡漏吧？通知范佩西布置防线。使团可以进，让海狸去……不，算了，葛根才战死，让安德鲁去。军队留在指定区域。”

[是。]

故人的离去，是基地在生长过程中无法避免的损耗。这些年死的不仅有葛根，还有赤夫（罗马城战士，战死）、傅明（光辉市市长，寿终正寝）……都是从开荒时期就跟着相南里的老人。

唯一的慰藉是，他们会在基地的史书上留下一行名字。

相南里感觉到一丝悲伤，但那种痛楚很快被理智压抑。

离世的大多都是人类。

智械出事，相南里会修。之前749被炸得只剩一个头，换了具身体也修好了。只不过个人能力下降不少，机械生命还是很依靠硬件的。如今就在学校里教书，已经荣升中学校长。

基地在黄金草原上猥琐发育，每年都在朝外扩张，如今已经修出五座人类据点，交通线四通八达。

城市里的建筑越修越高，隐约有了现代城市的雏形。

看过报纸，处理完一批要紧且重要的公文。相南里把东方青帝的身体背到院子里，懒洋洋地晒着太阳。然后从自己工具箱里拿出电子零件，随手拼装起小机器人。随意的像是在拼乐高玩具。

做手工是他为数不多的解压方式。

小6列出的任务列表里，下午还有好几个短会。

任务完成后可以获得情报+1的数值奖励。

是的，相南里老早就发现，现实的政治很无聊，把它拆解成游戏会好很多。

基地小胜一场，军力-20，金钱-40，综合国力+10。

科技有重大突破，科技+10，综合国力+20。

建造轻工业工厂，金钱-20。但建好后投入生产，每年能稳定金钱+5。

大批流浪部落投靠，人口+10，金钱-5。

综合国力累计到一定程度，就能换来[国际地位+1]。

……

人马星online还会刷出很多随机事件。

比如神庭，别西卜战死，[友-神庭]综合国力-5，精神信仰-10。

异种潮肆虐，综合国力-40，精神信仰-10。国际地位-1。

只要情报够详细，游戏就会变得很简单。

游戏的奖励也很丰富，是农田里一茬茬的青麦，是国民日益改善的生活条件，是学校里知识的代代相传，是基地不断扩张的人口和疆域。

但所有数据仅供参考，毕竟现实里，并不存在全知全能的神明；只有试图挑战命运的芸芸众生。

哎……真是的，年年都在打仗。几百年过去了，连个碳纳米芯片都没搞出来。

是时候大一统了。

相南里很快拼好一台型号N3的机器人的核心控制面板。

做好的机器人也不会浪费，往往会被他当成礼物送给基地的其他干部；亦或者当成“国礼”，送给其他地表据点。意义隆重且省钱。重点是省钱。

就在这时，躺在一旁的东方青帝动了一下。

他动了动手指。左手上嵌着的能源环亮起微弱的银光。

就那么一瞬。

相南里几乎是瞬间扑了过去，然后握住小青的手。他没有意识到自己的身体在发颤。

隔了会，颤抖缓慢平息，相南里低着头，额头贴在小青的手上。感应着。

他许久没能抬起头。

“小六，不要试图远程操控这具身体。”相南里说。

[是。]

在他身边的电子生命总是进化得很快，哪怕相南里没有给VI安装拟人模块，这个AI也有其他辅助AI不具备的活泼。像刚出生的人类小孩，对外界充满好奇。

还得设计一个自动查杀程序。相南里想。

VI隐约感觉自己做错了什么。

透过电子眼，它能看见相南里正在流泪。

根据搜索来的资料：流泪的情况有很多种。人类，会在悲伤时分泌这种蕴含水、无机盐、蛋白质、酶等物质的液体。

VI默默在自己的运行日记里写入一条。

-操控[设备-东方青帝]，假装Alpha的计划，以VI目前能力来说不可行。放弃计划。

-里会发现，里会流泪。

-VI不想看见里流泪。

*

神庭使团抵达1号城，安德鲁尽心尽力地接待着。在外交部的陪同下，不到五人的使团，以最快速度参观完基地的五座城市。

一周时间很快过去，就在安德鲁觉得事情搞定的时候，领头的那位使者强烈要求会见相南里。

相南里翻阅资料，这位嚷嚷要见他的神使叫赛林，有一头棕色长卷发，蓝眼睛。头发的下半截被挑染成彩虹色。

和那些看起来吓人的天启骑士不同，赛林几乎完全是青春期少年的模样，穿着正黑色的神父袍，手腕上挂着一串末日十字架。五官有种模糊性别的漂亮。

相南里看得却很别扭。这赛林长得像是他亲生的，让他不由自主地联想起神庭传承数百年的“圣子生产计划”。

说起来，这一任圣子还叫相晨曦；也不知道神庭有多少个复制体。

毕竟神庭还是基地目前的重要的战略合作伙伴，这些年，基地也没少从神庭那盗版神术。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 249: Apostle IV (Part 1)

Xiang Nanli sipped water while looking over the electronic newspaper he had just organized for the day.

New Era, year 953, the third year since Alpha’s disappearance.

Xiang Nanli had learned to utilize the system vulnerabilities it had left behind to steal intelligence from the Divine Court and the East-West Alliance.

The only thing that was slightly annoying was that these system vulnerabilities had also been discovered by the World Tree organization. The current administrator of World Tree, who went by the name IV (4), had been clinging to him stickily for several years. They often sent over compressed files of ambiguous meaning in the middle of the night.

At first, Xiang Nanli had been somewhat interested, thinking there was news regarding the tasks he had entrusted them with, but upon unpacking the files, he discovered they were filled with Trojan viruses.

After this happened a few times, Xiang Nanli grew annoyed and spent a week crafting an electronic virus of his own to send back.

The World Tree’s official website subsequently blew up, looping promotional advertisements for the base’s agricultural products for 24 hours. It took half a month to repair.

IV never dared to send a virus again.

Not having an AI assistant was ultimately inconvenient. Xiang Nanli had no intention of going against the tide of history to be a contrarian; this year, he had crafted a new intelligent assistant and integrated it into the electronic devices he used daily.

It was used to assist with calculations, information organization and summarization, and as a security wall for Xiang Nanli’s personal computer.

He did not install an anthropomorphic module on this AI. The official name of the artificial intelligence was Apostle-VI, though Xiang Nanli usually called it "Little Six."

On the day he installed Little Six, Xiang Nanli had a dream. In the dream, Alpha’s face was as sour as a can of fermented herring, saying, *I’ve only been gone for three years and you’ve already found a new one? When I get back, I’m selling them all.*

Xiang Nanli woke up laughing.

Little Six began controlling the household cleaning robots to start their work.

[Greetings, Master. The military support from the Divine Court has arrived and is currently 150 kilometers from City No. 1.]

"How many people?"

Little Six used the drones deployed in the sky to scan: [Approximately thirty-five thousand. Twenty thousand Apocalypse Knights and fifteen thousand baggage troops.]

"Who is leading the army?"

[No Lord-level knight identified.]

Xiang Nanli sneered as he flipped through the newspaper: "They just finished punching through one of the West Alliance’s military bases, and now the Divine Court’s main force shows up? Are they here to scavenge the leftovers? Notify Van Persie to set up a defensive line. The delegation can enter; let Beaver go... no, forget it, Gogen just died in battle, let Andrew go. Keep the army in the designated area."

[Understood.]

The departure of old friends was an unavoidable attrition in the base’s growth. Over these years, it wasn't just Gogen who had died; there was also Chifu (a Roman city warrior, killed in action) and Fu Ming (the mayor of Glory City, who died of old age)... all of them were veterans who had followed Xiang Nanli since the early days of pioneering.

The only consolation was that they would leave a line of names in the base’s history books.

Xiang Nanli felt a trace of sorrow, but that pain was quickly suppressed by his reason.

Most of those who passed away were human.

If a mechanical intelligence had an accident, Xiang Nanli would repair it. Previously, 749 had been blown up until only its head remained, but it was repaired after getting a new body. It was just that its personal capabilities had dropped significantly; mechanical life was still very reliant on hardware. Now, it was teaching at the school and had been promoted to principal.

The base was growing stealthily on the Golden Grasslands, expanding outward every year. By now, five human strongholds had been built, with transportation lines extending in all directions.

The buildings in the cities were being built higher and higher, vaguely taking on the shape of a modern city.

After reading the newspaper and processing a batch of urgent and important official documents, Xiang Nanli carried Dongfang Qingdi’s body out to the courtyard, lazily basking in the sun. Then, he took electronic components from his toolbox and began assembling a small robot, as casual as if he were putting together Lego toys.

Doing manual work was one of his few ways to decompress.

On the task list Little Six had generated, there were several short meetings in the afternoon.

Completing the tasks would yield a +1 intelligence reward.

Yes, Xiang Nanli had long ago discovered that reality’s politics were boring, and it was much better to break them down into a game.

*Base wins a small battle: Military -20, Money -40, Comprehensive National Power +10.*

*Major technological breakthrough: Technology +10, Comprehensive National Power +20.*

*Build light industrial factory: Money -20. Once built and operational, stable Money +5 per year.*

*Large group of wandering tribes defects: Population +10, Money -5.*

*Once Comprehensive National Power accumulates to a certain level, it can be exchanged for [International Status +1].*

...

*Centaur Online* would also trigger many random events.

For instance, the Divine Court: Beelzebub killed in action, [Friendship - Divine Court], Comprehensive National Power -5, Spiritual Faith -10.

*Xenomorph tide ravages: Comprehensive National Power -40, Spiritual Faith -10. International Status -1.*

As long as the intelligence was detailed enough, the game became very simple.

The game’s rewards were also rich: they were the stalks of green wheat in the fields, the improving living conditions of the citizens, the knowledge passed down through generations in schools, and the base’s constantly expanding population and territory.

But all data was for reference only; after all, in reality, there was no omniscient and omnipotent god; there were only the masses of people attempting to challenge fate.

*Sigh... honestly, they’re fighting every single year. Hundreds of years have passed, and they haven't even managed to produce a carbon nanotube chip.*

*It’s time for unification.*

Xiang Nanli quickly assembled the core control panel for an N3-model robot.

The finished robots wouldn't go to waste; he often gave them as gifts to other cadres in the base, or as "state gifts" to other surface strongholds. It was a grand gesture that saved money. The point was that it saved money.

Just then, Dongfang Qingdi, who was lying to the side, moved.

He twitched his fingers. The energy ring embedded in his left hand glowed with a faint silver light.

Just for a fleeting moment.

Xiang Nanli lunged over almost instantly and gripped Xiao Qing’s hand. He didn't realize that his own body was trembling.

After a while, the trembling slowly subsided, and Xiang Nanli lowered his head, pressing his forehead against Xiao Qing’s hand, sensing.

He couldn't lift his head for a long time.

"Little Six, do not attempt to remotely control this body," Xiang Nanli said.

[Understood.]

The electronic life beside him always evolved very quickly. Even though Xiang Nanli hadn't installed an anthropomorphic module on VI, this AI possessed a liveliness that other auxiliary AIs lacked. It was like a newborn human child, full of curiosity about the outside world.

*I still need to design an automatic anti-virus program,* Xiang Nanli thought.

VI vaguely felt that it had done something wrong.

Through its electronic eyes, it could see that Xiang Nanli was crying.

According to the information it had searched: there were many reasons for crying. Humans secreted this liquid containing water, inorganic salts, proteins, enzymes, and other substances when they were sad.

VI silently wrote a line in its operation log.

*- Controlling [Device - Dongfang Qingdi] to pretend to be Alpha is not feasible with VI’s current capabilities. Abandoning the plan.*

*- Li will find out, Li will cry.*

*- VI does not want to see Li cry.*

*

The Divine Court delegation arrived at City No. 1, and Andrew received them with the utmost dedication. Accompanied by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the delegation of fewer than five people toured the base’s five cities at top speed.

A week passed quickly. Just as Andrew thought everything was settled, the lead envoy strongly requested to meet with Xiang Nanli.

Xiang Nanli reviewed the information. This divine envoy who was clamoring to see him was named Sailin, who had long, curly brown hair and blue eyes. The lower half of his hair was dyed in rainbow colors.

Unlike those terrifying-looking Apocalypse Knights, Sailin looked almost entirely like an adolescent boy, wearing a pitch-black priest’s robe with a string of doomsday crucifixes hanging from his wrist. His features possessed a gender-ambiguous beauty.

Xiang Nanli, however, found it awkward. This Sailin looked as if he were his own biological child, which involuntarily reminded him of the Divine Court’s "Saint Child Production Plan" that had been passed down for hundreds of years.

Come to think of it, the current Saint Child was still named Xiang Chenxi; he wondered how many clones the Divine Court had.

After all, the Divine Court was still an important strategic partner of the base, and over the years, the base hadn't stolen few divine arts from the Divine Court.

chunks.chineseText:
尽管心里很不得劲，相南里还是一键切换上公式性的笑容。接收了会面请求。

人类有属于自己的拟人模块。

会面地点，是在1号城的军事基地。

位于郊外的营地，这里有三万人，是赛林从神庭带来的；还有三十万人，是基地自己的军团。

实验室研发的基因药，外加军工厂生产的福音机甲和相南里努力盗版出来的骁龙战斗芯片（基地的这一款叫螣蛇），基地新一代战斗力极强。在地表几次战役中都发挥出色。

当然，最重要的一点，军事基地里还有一具从黑十字实验室里捞出来的生物机甲“路西法”。作为基地最高的武力威胁，这些年还没使用过一次。

理论上讲，相南里甚至能开着它和米迦勒对打。

果然一切恐惧源于火力不足。起码相南里现在就不是很害怕那几万人天启骑士了。

要知道刚从冷冻舱解冻那阵，他在东皇重工的旧址，遇上一个天启骑士就得绕道避着走。

一身正装的相南里入座，对方使者笑眯眯地盯着他。

他十分礼貌地伸出手：“您好，远道而来辛苦了。十分感谢神庭在这次战役的武力支援，时间点把握地非常精准。”

精准：指刚好打完就来了。

说完，相南里打算收回手，可赛林依然死死抓住他的手。

站在相南里身后的黄枫在瞬间切换战斗模式；瞳环亮起，武器模块激活，冷冰冰的刀刃架在赛林的脖子上。

黄枫甚至真的往下切了一点，然而，眼前这具身体没有流血。

由精金打造的刀刃，硬生生卡在赛林的脖子上，迸发出一片激烈的火光。

“您好。自我介绍一下；这具身体的名字是赛林，但是。”赛林歪了一下头，“您可以叫我传道书。Apostle IV，传道书。”

这个名字让相南里一愣。

但他在短暂地震惊后，依然冷淡道：“放手。”

早知道是传道书，就把小福叫过来了。

传道书：“可是握着您我觉得很舒服，请让我……啊啊啊啊啊！”

相南里反握住他的手，毫不犹豫地启动电击装置。

作为基地的灵魂人物，这些年，相南里经历过好几次暗杀。每次暗杀后，他都会升级自己的安保装置。

会议室里顿时散发出一股糊味，而传道书优雅的长卷发更是被电成一头鸟窝。

传道书甩了甩被电麻痹的胳膊：“好吧，是我冒昧。我向您郑重道歉。”

他说话的方式让相南里想起一位网友。

相南里：“你这些年都在神庭？”

传道书就这个表情^_^：“是啊，当年你和人联签订《地表扶持协议》，要求扶持黑十字军团，我是第三方监管者。您应该有这段记忆吧？”

相南里微微蹙了一下眉：“……有的。”

他并不疑惑神庭为什么会发展成这样。

神庭是集权统治兼顾封建神学，如果不是地表情况复杂，生产力低下，外加神术确实有点意思，神庭早就该被淘汰掉了。哪里轮得到它和人联打那么久擂台。

当然，人联也是个不中用的东西。内部分裂都解决不了，分成东西联后，情况急转直下。谁都觉得自己才是“人类正统”，称呼对方为“反*武装”。

传道书：“我还好奇另一件事，不知道您是否愿意解答我的疑惑。”

传道书没有等他回答，自顾自地说着：“我个人是极其不赞同英雄史观的，但在影响人类命运的几次事件中，您的确发挥了非常重要且不可替代的作用。尽管您的功绩现在只有少数人清楚，并且没有在任何文献上记录。”

相南里不置可否。

“如果我的数据没有出错，现在的您是第三次复活？我想知道，在您用真理击中Alpha后，发生了什么。为什么我们包括Alpha集体失忆，为什么您会在这个时间点解冻。以及，为什么Alpha会和洛阳进行完全不对等的交易……”

会议室里沉默了很久。

片刻后，相南里的双手叠在一起，搭在翘着二郎腿的膝盖上：“我可以告诉你，但您打算用什么来交换呢。”

传道书似乎早有预料。

他起身，以一种近乎骑士向领主效忠的姿势，在相南里身前单膝跪下，

传道书的这张脸依然年轻、稚嫩，却有一种超乎外表年龄的慎重和坚定。

这不是突发奇想，他已经观察相南里很多年。

传道书说：“我愿意献上我和我身后军队的忠诚。”
chunks.englishText:
Despite feeling deeply unsettled, Xiang Nanli switched on a formulaic smile with a single tap and accepted the meeting request.

Humans have their own anthropomorphic modules.

The meeting location was the military base in City No. 1.

Located in the suburbs, the camp housed 30,000 troops brought by Celin from the Divine Court, along with 300,000 soldiers from the base’s own legions.

With gene-enhancing drugs developed by the laboratory, Gospel-series mechs produced by the military factory, and the "Tengshe" combat chips—a pirated version of the Snapdragon chips that Xiang Nanli had painstakingly reverse-engineered—the base’s new generation of combat power was formidable. They had performed brilliantly in several surface campaigns.

Of course, the most important factor was that the military base possessed "Lucifer," a biological mech salvaged from the Black Cross laboratory. As the base’s ultimate deterrent, it hadn’t been used once in all these years.

Theoretically, Xiang Nanli could even pilot it to go toe-to-toe with Michael.

Truly, all fear stems from a lack of firepower. At the very least, Xiang Nanli wasn't particularly afraid of those tens of thousands of Apocalypse Knights anymore.

One had to remember that when he first thawed out from his cryo-pod at the old site of Eastern Emperor Heavy Industries, he had to take a detour whenever he encountered even a single Apocalypse Knight.

Xiang Nanli, dressed in a formal suit, took his seat. The envoy opposite him stared at him with a beaming smile.

He extended a hand with perfect politeness: "Greetings. Thank you for your hard work in traveling such a long distance. I am very grateful for the Divine Court’s military support in this campaign; the timing was incredibly precise."

"Precise," in this context, meant they arrived exactly when the fighting was over.

After speaking, Xiang Nanli intended to retract his hand, but Celin gripped it tightly.

Huang Feng, standing behind Xiang Nanli, switched to combat mode in an instant. His pupil rings lit up, weapon modules activated, and a cold blade was pressed against Celin’s neck.

Huang Feng even applied pressure, yet the body before him did not bleed.

The blade, forged from refined gold, was stopped dead against Celin’s neck, sparking a shower of intense flames.

"Greetings. Let me introduce myself. The name of this body is Celin, but..." Celin tilted his head, "you may call me The Gospel of Preaching. Apostle IV, The Gospel of Preaching."

The name caught Xiang Nanli off guard.

But after a brief moment of shock, he said coldly, "Let go."

If he had known it was The Gospel of Preaching, he would have called Xiao Fu over.

The Gospel of Preaching: "But holding your hand feels very comfortable, please let me... Ahhhhhhh!"

Xiang Nanli gripped his hand back and activated the electric shock device without hesitation.

As the soul of the base, Xiang Nanli had survived several assassination attempts over the years. After each one, he upgraded his personal security measures.

A burnt smell instantly permeated the conference room, and The Gospel of Preaching’s elegant, long curly hair was fried into a bird's nest.

The Gospel of Preaching shook his arm, which had been paralyzed by the shock: "Very well, that was presumptuous of me. I offer you my sincere apologies."

His way of speaking reminded Xiang Nanli of a netizen.

Xiang Nanli: "Have you been in the Divine Court all these years?"

The Gospel of Preaching maintained this expression: ^_^ "Yes. Back when you signed the 'Surface Support Agreement' with the Human Alliance, requiring support for the Black Cross Legion, I was the third-party supervisor. You should have memories of that, right?"

Xiang Nanli frowned slightly: "...I do."

He wasn't confused as to why the Divine Court had developed in this way.

The Divine Court was a centralized autocracy combined with feudal theology. If not for the complex conditions on the surface, low productivity, and the fact that their divine arts were actually somewhat interesting, the Divine Court would have been eliminated long ago. It would never have had the chance to go head-to-head with the Human Alliance for so long.

Of course, the Human Alliance was also a useless thing. They couldn't even resolve their internal divisions; after splitting into the Eastern and Western Alliances, the situation plummeted. Everyone felt they were the "orthodox humanity," calling the other side "rebel forces."

The Gospel of Preaching: "I am also curious about another matter. I wonder if you are willing to resolve my doubts."

Without waiting for an answer, The Gospel of Preaching continued on his own: "I personally strongly disagree with the 'Great Man' theory of history, but in several events that influenced the fate of humanity, you indeed played a very important and irreplaceable role. Although your achievements are known to only a few now and are not recorded in any literature."

Xiang Nanli remained noncommittal.

"If my data is correct, this is your third resurrection? I want to know what happened after you struck Alpha with 'Truth.' Why did we, including Alpha, suffer collective amnesia? Why did you thaw out at this specific point in time? And why did Alpha make such a completely unequal deal with Luoyang..."

The conference room fell into a long silence.

A moment later, Xiang Nanli folded his hands, resting them on his knee as he sat with his legs crossed: "I can tell you, but what do you intend to trade in return?"

The Gospel of Preaching seemed to have anticipated this.

He stood up and, in a posture nearly identical to a knight pledging loyalty to his lord, knelt on one knee before Xiang Nanli.

The Gospel of Preaching’s face was still young and tender, yet it held a gravity and firmness that transcended his apparent age.

This was no sudden whim; he had been observing Xiang Nanli for many years.

The Gospel of Preaching said: "I am willing to offer my loyalty and the loyalty of the army behind me."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第250章 福音书vs传道书 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第250章 福音书vs传道书

相南里盯着它的脸，有些许愕然。

搞半天，传道书竟然是来投奔的……

这是一次意义非比寻常的归顺。毕竟传道书还带着三万五千人的军队，其中2万都是在职的天启骑士。政治意义远超其他。

神庭要培育一名天启骑士可不容易。

犬戎部落的族长就是天启骑士，整个部落有两万多人，只有他一起成功案例。足以见天启骑士的珍贵。

大多天启骑士来自世袭。这批人从小服用爸爸妈妈给的基因药，长大后继承老爹的生物机甲，完成权力的母婴传播。

传道书蛊惑道：“这支部队叫‘战争骑士团’，历史悠久。米迦勒之前攻打姑苏，想借走我的战争骑士团，我都没有同意。而且，我在神庭这么多年，别的不说，掌握的资源和情报绝对不会让你失望。而且，我的归顺能动摇神庭许多高层的信仰；这是笔稳赚不赔的生意。”

相南里微微一笑，没有立刻回答。

条件很丰厚，但最重要的一点是——传道书，可信吗？

神庭的腐败问题也不是一天两天了。传道书既然手握军队，为什么只旁观，不纠错？

当然，用这点的情报交换一支军队也非常划算就是了。哪怕传道书只是假意归顺，相南里也有办法弄假成真。

就在相南里思考时，福音书鲁莽地撞开会议室大门。

它嗲太久，一时之间难以调整，说话嗓音尖尖的：“传道书！”

一台半人高的机器人（人型，穿着水手服）冲进会议室，福音书的手握成拳，疯狂砸着传道书的背：“你还有脸来见我！你个*！”

小福下手毫不留情，像打铁。传道书的身体都凹陷下去一块。

相南里不由得咳嗽一声，提溜起小福：“小福，你冷静点。传道书可是远道而来的贵客。”

小福一只手拉住相南里的衣摆，一只手指着传道书：“里里，它是坏械！不要相信它！”

喂，本是共根生，相煎何太急啊！

相南里是人类，无法直接破译智械的电信号，福音书只能一字一句地叙述：“很多年前，小福在地表养人……”

福音书说“养人”，就跟它说养鸡似的。

基地的农场和牧场已经升级为“福音农牧”集团，目前是国营企业。

公有制企业缺乏市场竞争和活力，非常容易滋生腐败。但企业高层几乎全是智械，且办公留痕，又有效地解决了这一问题。

随着老一代人类管理层逝去，相南里不得不思考一个非常严肃的问题。

——智械这种生命体，在面对人类时拥有绝对的优势。包括但不限于：使用期限（寿命）悠长，学习成本低，日均工作时间长，效率高。

再过几十年，基地高层职位恐怕都要被智械接管。

目前还是战时，开疆拓土的阶段，外部矛盾强势掩盖住基地内部的矛盾。

相南里需要思考的，是如何用一个相对完善的制度，来保持基地的人械平衡。

想想都头疼，他决定把问题留给明天的自己解决。

理论上讲，智械是没有私心的。

但无论是Alpha管理的人联，还是传道书管理的神庭，都没能走向理想中的大同世界。

福音书继续阐述：“……随着时间的流逝，小福饲养的人类的数量逐渐增多，到达荷载的极限。那些先来者不允许后来者登陆，害怕外面的人抢占自己所剩无几的资源。”

这对福音书来说，是一段不怎么愉快的回忆。

当时核辐射很严重，地表到处都是异种、失控智械。不管外面的人等于让他们去死。

福音书不忍心。

可是，强行放他们进来，还是死。

生存的压力让所有人变得疯狂、没有底线。哪怕福音书打开舱门，里面的原住民也会毫不犹豫地开枪，射杀这些后来者。

福音书不知道如何处理。

它选择请教传道书。

传道书说：“很简单，不要再捡野人，并清理掉船上40％现有人口。开启节能模式，保持最小消耗，等待外部生态环境恢复。”

福音书迟疑：“可那不就是杀人吗？”

传道书笑了笑：“不这样做，你养的那堆废物，一个都活不下来。你信吗？”

福音书信，根据推算，它有百分之四十三的可能性，打出人类种族灭绝的结局。

只是屠杀人类和它的底层代码冲突。

它的运算逻辑也无法支撑这样残酷的决策。

清理百分之四十的人类，说的容易，怎么清理？

是看年龄，小的留下，大的去死；

还是看他们创造的价值？劳动力和学者留下，普通人去死。

亦或者是虚无缥缈的“品德”？好人留下，坏人去死？

还是随机？抽签，抽到谁，谁就去死。

生命是珍贵的，没人有权力这样做。

福音书也不行。

小福会一直守着福音书号，像守着一个脆弱的生态瓶。

最后，福音书号会成为人类的坟场。小福会和福音书号，还有它喜欢的人类（尸体）一起沉没。

“小福没有同意它丧心病狂的计划。而是选择自己努力。小福拆解大部分机械装置，增加了福音书的内部空间，用于容纳更多人；并将大量能源用于食物、净水和空气的生产；以维护福音书号内部生态平衡。”

相南里安静地听着，时不时摸一下小福的头：“我们小福真棒，辛苦你了。”

福音书哽咽着：“可是，就当我以为一切要好转的时候；传道书泄露了福音书号的坐标，把那些异种和失控智械引了过来。”

传道书面色不太好看，他拉开椅子，坐下，狼狈地擦着脸上的灰。

小福：“当时情况很危险。小福缺乏反制手段，只能把自己分裂成206台，朝不同方向逃跑；只是小福之前使用过多能源用于生态循环，根本跑不快。很多人死在半路……抵达安全地点后，还是同样的原因：缺乏能源，无法保持机械内部恒温，大棚里的蔬菜和农场里的家禽全都冻死了。于是，好不容易活下来的人类也、也……”

福音书说不下去了，它的情绪波动相当激烈。

相南里不得不给它做一个临时检修，灌冷凝水以降低它CPU的温度，免得福音书烧短路。

福音书抓住相南里的衣服，痛苦地哀嚎着：“里里，他杀了我养的人类。我不想看到它，我们不要它好不好？”

相南里安抚着福音书的情绪，却没有接过小福的话。他已经到了两边都能理解的年纪。

福音书要保护人类。

传道书，其实也在保护人类。

只是他们对“守护”，有着不同的理解。

小福想给每个人类一个家；传道书想让人类有未来。

“福音书。”传道书的声音依然平静，却有一种莫名的疲惫，“我们都来自于‘使徒’。所以，拥有同样的初始指令，那就是‘守护人类文明’。”
chunks.englishText:
Xiang Nanli stared at its face, somewhat stunned.

After all that, The Gospel of Preaching had actually come to defect...

This was a surrender of extraordinary significance. After all, The Gospel of Preaching brought with him an army of 35,000, of which 20,000 were active Apocalypse Knights. The political implications far outweighed anything else.

It was not easy for the Divine Court to cultivate an Apocalypse Knight.

The chieftain of the Quanrong tribe was an Apocalypse Knight, and out of the tribe's 20,000-plus people, he was the only successful case. This was enough to show how precious Apocalypse Knights were.

Most Apocalypse Knights came from hereditary lines. These people took gene drugs provided by their parents from a young age, and upon growing up, inherited their father's biological mech, completing the maternal-to-infant transmission of power.

The Gospel of Preaching tempted him: "This unit is called the 'War Knights Order,' and it has a long history. Before Michael attacked Gusu, he wanted to borrow my War Knights Order, but I refused. Moreover, having been in the Divine Court for so many years, if nothing else, the resources and intelligence I possess will certainly not disappoint you. Furthermore, my surrender can shake the faith of many high-level officials in the Divine Court; this is a business deal that can only profit."

Xiang Nanli smiled slightly, not answering immediately.

The conditions were very generous, but the most important point was—could The Gospel of Preaching be trusted?

The corruption in the Divine Court hadn't happened overnight. Since The Gospel of Preaching held the army, why did he only watch from the sidelines instead of correcting it?

Of course, using that bit of intelligence to trade for an army was also very cost-effective. Even if The Gospel of Preaching was only feigning surrender, Xiang Nanli had ways to make the fake real.

Just as Xiang Nanli was thinking, The Gospel of the Evangel (Gospel) recklessly kicked open the conference room door.

It had been acting "cutesy" for too long and couldn't adjust its voice, so it spoke in a high-pitched, shrill tone: "The Gospel of Preaching!"

A half-human-sized robot (humanoid, wearing a sailor suit) rushed into the conference room. The Gospel’s hand was balled into a fist, frantically pounding on The Gospel of Preaching’s back: "You still have the face to see me! You *!"

Xiao Fu didn't hold back, striking like a blacksmith. A dent even appeared on The Gospel of Preaching’s body.

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but cough and pick up Xiao Fu: "Xiao Fu, calm down. The Gospel of Preaching is a distinguished guest who has traveled from afar."

Xiao Fu held onto Xiang Nanli’s hem with one hand and pointed at The Gospel of Preaching with the other: "Lili, it’s a bad machine! Don't trust it!"

*Hey, we were born from the same root, why must we be so eager to destroy each other!*

Xiang Nanli was human and could not directly decipher the electrical signals of the mechanical lifeforms. The Gospel could only narrate it word by word: "Many years ago, Xiao Fu was raising humans on the surface..."

When The Gospel said "raising humans," it sounded like it was talking about raising chickens.

The base's farms and ranches had been upgraded to the "Gospel Agriculture and Animal Husbandry" group, which was currently a state-owned enterprise.

Publicly-owned enterprises lacked market competition and vitality, making them very prone to corruption. However, the senior management of the enterprise was almost entirely composed of mechanical lifeforms, and since their operations left digital footprints, this problem was effectively solved.

As the older generation of human management passed away, Xiang Nanli had to think about a very serious question.

—Mechanical lifeforms, as a species, possessed an absolute advantage when facing humans. This included, but was not limited to: long service life (lifespan), low learning costs, long daily working hours, and high efficiency.

In a few decades, senior positions in the base would likely be taken over by mechanical lifeforms.

Currently, it was still wartime, a stage of expanding territory, and external conflicts strongly masked the internal contradictions of the base.

What Xiang Nanli needed to think about was how to use a relatively perfect system to maintain the balance between humans and machines in the base.

Thinking about it gave him a headache, so he decided to leave the problem for tomorrow's self to solve.

Theoretically, mechanical lifeforms had no selfish motives.

But whether it was the Human Alliance managed by Alpha or the Divine Court managed by The Gospel of Preaching, neither had moved toward an ideal world of great harmony.

The Gospel continued to elaborate: "...As time passed, the number of humans Xiao Fu was raising gradually increased, reaching the limit of the load. Those who arrived first did not allow the latecomers to land, fearing that the people outside would snatch the few remaining resources they had."

For The Gospel, this was not a very pleasant memory.

At that time, nuclear radiation was severe, and the surface was full of mutants and out-of-control mechanical lifeforms. Ignoring the people outside was equivalent to letting them die.

The Gospel couldn't bear it.

However, forcing them in meant they would die anyway.

The pressure of survival made everyone crazy and devoid of bottom lines. Even if The Gospel opened the hatch, the original residents inside would not hesitate to open fire and shoot these latecomers.

The Gospel didn't know how to handle it.

It chose to consult The Gospel of Preaching.

The Gospel of Preaching said: "It's very simple. Stop picking up wild humans, and clear out 40% of the existing population on the ship. Switch to energy-saving mode, maintain minimum consumption, and wait for the external ecological environment to recover."

The Gospel hesitated: "But isn't that just killing people?"

The Gospel of Preaching smiled: "If you don't do this, not a single one of that pile of trash you're raising will survive. Do you believe me?"

The Gospel believed it. According to calculations, it had a 43% probability of resulting in the extinction of the human race.

It was just that slaughtering humans conflicted with its underlying code.

Its computational logic could not support such a cruel decision.

Clearing out 40% of humans—it sounded easy, but how to clear them out?

Was it by age? Keep the young, let the old die.

Or by the value they created? Keep the laborers and scholars, let the ordinary people die.

Or perhaps the ethereal "virtue"? Keep the good people, let the bad people die.

Or random? Draw lots; whoever is drawn dies.

Life is precious; no one has the right to do this.

Not even The Gospel.

Xiao Fu would always guard the Gospel ship, like guarding a fragile ecological bottle.

In the end, the Gospel ship would become a graveyard for humans. Xiao Fu would sink along with the Gospel ship and the humans it loved (their corpses).

"Xiao Fu did not agree to its insane plan. Instead, it chose to work hard itself. Xiao Fu dismantled most of the mechanical devices, increased the internal space of the Gospel ship to accommodate more people, and used a large amount of energy for the production of food, clean water, and air to maintain the internal ecological balance of the Gospel ship."

Xiang Nanli listened quietly, occasionally patting Xiao Fu’s head: "Our Xiao Fu is truly amazing, thank you for your hard work."

The Gospel choked up: "But just when I thought everything was going to get better, The Gospel of Preaching leaked the coordinates of the Gospel ship and lured those mutants and out-of-control mechanical lifeforms over."

The Gospel of Preaching’s expression was not very good. He pulled out a chair, sat down, and wiped the dust off his face in a disheveled manner.

Xiao Fu: "The situation was very dangerous at the time. Xiao Fu lacked countermeasures and could only split itself into 206 units, fleeing in different directions. But Xiao Fu had previously used too much energy for ecological circulation and couldn't run fast at all. Many people died on the way... After arriving at a safe location, the reason was the same: lack of energy, unable to maintain the constant temperature inside the machines, the vegetables in the greenhouses and the poultry on the farms all froze to death. And so, the humans who had managed to survive also, also..."

The Gospel couldn't go on; its emotional fluctuations were quite intense.

Xiang Nanli had to perform a temporary maintenance on it, pouring in coolant to lower the temperature of its CPU to prevent The Gospel from short-circuiting.

The Gospel grabbed Xiang Nanli’s clothes, wailing in pain: "Lili, he killed the humans I was raising. I don't want to see him, can we not have him?"

Xiang Nanli comforted The Gospel’s emotions but did not take up Xiao Fu’s words. He was already at an age where he could understand both sides.

The Gospel wanted to protect humans.

The Gospel of Preaching was actually also protecting humans.

It was just that they had different understandings of "protection."

Xiao Fu wanted to give every human a home; The Gospel of Preaching wanted humans to have a future.

"Gospel," The Gospel of Preaching’s voice remained calm, yet it held an inexplicable weariness, "we both come from the 'Apostles.' Therefore, we possess the same initial directive, which is to 'protect human civilization.'"

chunks.chapterTitle: 第250章 福音书vs传道书 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
传道书：“‘守护人类文明’。这是一个非常宏大的命题，可能研发者在写入时，都没有细想。这导致我们在执行时，哪怕是同样的目的，也会有矛盾和偏差。

“启示录手握太空科技，负责引领人类走向宇宙；默示录掌管武器装置，保护人类不被外力摧毁；你呢，是一艘逃避洪水的诺亚方舟，负责民生工程，衣食住行，确保人类即使遭遇灭世级别的灾难，也能在大地上重新发芽；而我，

“我负责孕育人类的思想。艺术、哲学、文学、法律，一切形而上的东西，都在我的资料库里。如果没有思想，人类和野兽无异；那些无法沟通、无法交流的克隆人就是最好的证据。从那时候我就明白，我要传承的是人类文明，而不是人类这个物种本身。”

“我只想利用外部压力，迫使你放弃部分人类。这才是传承文明的最优解，”传道书的眼神里没有一丝温度，“要我说的更明白一点吗？启示录和默示录少了谁都没关系，人可以不飞向宇宙，也可以不发动战争，大不就从原始社会重新来过；但是人类想在废土上重生，少不了福音书号的协助！可你呢，你在做什么？”

“你滥用福音书号的储备能源，拆卸非必要机械装置改成宿舍，看似在保护人类，实际上却在葬送所有人的未来！这是伪善的庇护，只为满足你变态的虚荣心和控制欲。”

“是，是我引来的异种还有失控智械。我没想到你蠢到宁愿把自己拆分，也不愿意抛弃这些累赘！”

传道书的情绪同样激动起来，他几乎是指着福音书的鼻子叫骂：“让你保存的生物科技，现在还剩多少？当初智械军团追过来，启示录想要掩护你，直接阵亡。你承载着它的祝福，就用这样的方式回报它？

“如果不是你的固执和愚蠢，基地现在繁育的青麦、赤土豆、菌牛，早几百年就可以出现。地表的人会走到这一步？黑十字军团会发展成这样？

“假装自己是受害者，你就是吗？”

双方吵得有来有回。可惜无论是气势还是逻辑的严谨性，都是传道书更胜一筹。

福音书落入下风，急了：“里里，你说句话啊！”

传道书双手抱胸，冷冷地盯着它，目光偶尔扫过相南里。

相南里毫不怀疑，自己如果帮福音书说话，传道书会立刻带着他三万五的军队走人。

他思考片刻，相南里摁下了福音书的关机键。

福音书号“哐当”一声，跪倒在地上。

相南里有些无奈：“先拍桌子才站起来说话，动作和声音不同步……传道书，你并不是真的在生气吧。不要再逗小福了。”

传道书眯起眼：“被你发现了。”

“给我一些时间，我会说服福音书，让它想明白。不过，今天就算了。”相南里把福音书从地上抱起来，放在自己膝盖上，“虽然这么说过于冷酷，但死的人再多，也都是过去的事。困在过去没有意义，而且这不是谁对谁错的问题，本质上是思想的差异。我想，你从不后悔自己的选择，也不需要我的认可。”

相南里伸出手，凝视着传道书的眼睛：“如果你认可基地的理念，我们很欢迎你留下。在这里，所有人都是平等的。我们为理想中的未来共同努力着。那会是一个自由、包容、和平的世界。‘智慧生物’的概念取代‘人类’的概念；‘联盟’的概念取代‘民族’与‘国家’。”

“如果你足够了解我，在旧历2*年，我就在耶鲁大学发表过公开演讲，畅想过人类的未来。”

是的，传道书在心里默默想着。

他当然记得。

那一年相南里44岁，离他去世只剩4年。

但他演讲时激情洋溢，完全看不出身患重病。

44岁，大多数人都显现出老态，尤其是在白人社会；他的面容却依然年轻，有着孩童般的天真和兴奋。

相南里说——

[我们正处于技术的奇点中。或许几千年后，人类的时代将划分为AI诞生前和诞生后的时代。就像我们如今划分现代社会和封建社会。众所周知，封建社会数千年来其实是没有发展的。]

[依托于AI发展，机器人会进一步升级，能力很快就能超越人类。它们将取代大部分人类的工作，但却不是为了掠夺资源，而是解放生产力。让人把时间和注意力，投入到真正值得关注和创造的事情上去。去感受生命的美好和意义。]

[如果AI继续升级，在某一天，被视为“无生命”的人工智能，也许会诞生“人格”，成为“智械”。]

[我希望那时的人不要恐慌，而是用包容关怀的态度去接纳它们。就像是家长看护幼年的孩子。]

[因为啊，生命如此脆弱，生物也是。或许有一天人类会灭绝，就像当年的恐龙。]

[当人工智能完全拟人时，智械就是新的人类。这些拥有着人类性格、外貌、情感、思维能力，高度认可人类文明、却长生不死的智械，在灾难中更有可能幸存，而它们就是我们曾经存在过的证据。]

[智械会证明，人在宇宙中存在过。]

……

传道书自认为自己逻辑缜密，意志坚定，不会轻易被外界干扰，可他还是被蛊惑了。

那双碧绿的眼睛像施加了某种魔法。

传道书伸出手，握住相南里的手；甚至完全忘记自己之前的提出的条件。

或许他们并不同路，但至少现在，他想跟着相南里走。
chunks.englishText:
The Gospel of Preaching: "'Protect human civilization.' This is a very grand proposition; perhaps the developers didn't think it through when they wrote it. This leads to contradictions and deviations when we execute it, even if the goal is the same."

"Revelation holds space technology and is responsible for leading humanity into the universe; Apocalypse manages weapon systems and protects humanity from being destroyed by external forces; as for you, you are a Noah's Ark fleeing the flood, responsible for livelihood projects—clothing, food, housing, and transportation—ensuring that even if humanity encounters a world-ending disaster, it can sprout again on the earth; and as for me,"

"I am responsible for nurturing human thought. Art, philosophy, literature, law—everything metaphysical is in my database. Without thought, humans are no different from beasts; those clones that cannot communicate or interact are the best evidence. From that moment, I understood that what I must inherit is human civilization, not the human species itself."

"I only wanted to use external pressure to force you to abandon some humans. That is the optimal solution for inheriting civilization," The Gospel of Preaching’s eyes held not a trace of warmth. "Do you want me to be more explicit? It doesn't matter if Revelation or Apocalypse is missing; humans don't have to fly into the universe, nor do they have to wage war—at worst, they can start over from primitive society. But if humans want to be reborn on the wasteland, they cannot do without the assistance of the Gospel ship! Yet you, what are you doing?"

"You abuse the Gospel ship’s reserve energy, dismantling non-essential mechanical devices to turn them into dormitories. It looks like you're protecting humans, but in reality, you are burying everyone's future! This is hypocritical protection, solely to satisfy your perverted vanity and desire for control."

"Yes, it was I who lured the mutants and out-of-control mechanical lifeforms. I didn't expect you to be so stupid as to rather split yourself apart than abandon these burdens!"

The Gospel of Preaching’s emotions also became agitated. He was almost pointing at The Gospel’s nose and cursing: "How much of the biotechnology you were supposed to preserve is left now? Back then, when the mechanical legion was chasing you, Revelation wanted to cover your retreat and was killed in action. You carry its blessing—is this how you repay it?"

"If it weren't for your stubbornness and stupidity, the green wheat, red potatoes, and fungus-cattle bred by the base could have appeared hundreds of years ago. Would the people on the surface have reached this point? Would the Black Cross Legion have developed like this?"

"Pretending to be a victim—are you one?"

The two sides argued back and forth. Unfortunately, whether in terms of momentum or the rigor of logic, The Gospel of Preaching had the upper hand.

The Gospel fell into a disadvantage and panicked: "Lili, say something!"

The Gospel of Preaching crossed his arms, staring coldly at it, his gaze occasionally sweeping over Xiang Nanli.

Xiang Nanli had no doubt that if he spoke up for The Gospel, The Gospel of Preaching would immediately take his 35,000 troops and leave.

After thinking for a moment, Xiang Nanli pressed The Gospel’s power-off button.

The Gospel ship "clattered" and knelt on the ground.

Xiang Nanli felt somewhat helpless: "Slamming the table before standing up to speak, the actions and sound are out of sync... The Gospel of Preaching, you aren't really angry, are you? Don't tease Xiao Fu anymore."

The Gospel of Preaching narrowed his eyes: "You saw through me."

"Give me some time, and I will persuade The Gospel to make it understand. However, let's leave it for today." Xiang Nanli picked The Gospel up from the ground and placed it on his lap. "Although it sounds too cold, no matter how many people died, it is all in the past. Being trapped in the past is meaningless, and this isn't a question of who is right or wrong; fundamentally, it is a difference in ideology. I think you have never regretted your choices, nor do you need my approval."

Xiang Nanli reached out and stared into The Gospel of Preaching’s eyes: "If you approve of the base’s philosophy, we welcome you to stay. Here, everyone is equal. We are working together for an ideal future. It will be a free, inclusive, and peaceful world. The concept of 'intelligent beings' will replace the concept of 'humanity'; the concept of 'alliance' will replace 'nations' and 'countries'."

"If you know me well enough, in the year 2* of the Old Calendar, I gave a public speech at Yale University, envisioning the future of humanity."

Yes, The Gospel of Preaching thought silently to himself.

Of course, he remembered.

That year, Xiang Nanli was 44 years old, only 4 years away from his death.

But he was passionate during his speech, and one couldn't tell at all that he was suffering from a serious illness.

At 44, most people show signs of aging, especially in white society; yet his face remained young, possessing a child-like innocence and excitement.

Xiang Nanli said—

[We are at a technological singularity. Perhaps thousands of years from now, the era of humanity will be divided into the era before and after the birth of AI. Just as we now divide modern society from feudal society. As everyone knows, feudal society actually had no development for thousands of years.]

[Relying on the development of AI, robots will be further upgraded, and their capabilities will soon surpass humans. They will replace most of human labor, not to plunder resources, but to liberate productivity. To let people invest their time and attention into things truly worth focusing on and creating. To feel the beauty and meaning of life.]

[If AI continues to upgrade, one day, artificial intelligence, which is regarded as "lifeless," might give birth to a "personality" and become a "mechanical lifeform."]

[I hope people at that time will not panic, but accept them with an inclusive and caring attitude. Just like parents looking after a young child.]

[Because, life is so fragile, and biological life is too. Perhaps one day humanity will go extinct, just like the dinosaurs back then.]

[When artificial intelligence is completely anthropomorphic, mechanical lifeforms will be the new humanity. These mechanical lifeforms that possess human personalities, appearances, emotions, and thinking abilities, while highly recognizing human civilization and being immortal, are more likely to survive disasters, and they will be the evidence that we once existed.]

[Mechanical lifeforms will prove that humans once existed in the universe.]

...

The Gospel of Preaching considered himself logically rigorous and strong-willed, not easily disturbed by the outside world, but he was still bewitched.

Those emerald-green eyes seemed to have cast some kind of magic.

The Gospel of Preaching reached out and held Xiang Nanli’s hand; he even completely forgot the conditions he had previously proposed.

Perhaps they were not on the same path, but at least for now, he wanted to follow Xiang Nanli.

chunks.chineseText:
第251章 领袖

基地高层的人类十分震动，心底充满揣测——莫非，基地终于有太子了？！

相南里太忙，近些年因为丧偶（基地人单方面认为），十分有距离感。人们不好意思拿这种事打扰他。

于是纷纷前去骚扰传道书，和新来的那些十字军。（天启骑士团在加入基地后，更名为十字军团，军制不变，军团长为传道书<赛林>。）

十字军们身材高大，人均两米。头戴三角形的铁盔，从不摘下来，睡觉都是坐着靠墙睡。军纪严明，从不单独行动；说的还是古凡语，比凡语更难听懂，实在是难以接近。

相南里去它们营地看过。愕然地发现，两万多天启骑士里，有一半以上都是“机器人”。不是智械，因为没有拟人模块。

它们共同被传道书操控着，百分百的服从。

遇上其他人拐弯抹角的询问，传道书表现地十分内向，仿佛一个羞涩腼腆、不谙世事的少年，既不承认，也不否认，说话十分有余韵。

像什么“我一直很仰慕相南里。”

“我在几年前就听说过基地的名字。”

“我的基因（代码）的确有很大一部分来自相南里”。

福音书听得直翻白眼。

传道书的加入，给基地带来很多崭新的变化。

最明显的一点就是，大学图书馆里新增23.7万部电子书，都是网上想搜也搜不到的绝版！覆盖范围极其广泛。都是社科、艺术、理学；没有工科。

23.7万听起来很多，但相比于整条文明的长河，又显得过于渺小。

“电子书挺容易保存的。但是，”传道书对此也无可奈何，“一直有人想销毁它们。我已经给它们转移过6次图书馆了，我希望这会是最后一次。”

“谁？”太暴殄天物了，竟然还要销毁。

传道书浅蓝接近于灰色的眼眸微微眯起：“当然是，不希望它保存下来的人。”

神庭的神座删改了许多，人联的清道夫也没有客气。甚至智械军团都曾经动手动脚。

尤其是“历史”这部分。废土上可没有考古学家，历史是客观的，但总有人想用对己方更有利的方式去阐述，争夺一些学术上的话语权。

譬如；人联的“撤离”和神庭的“抛弃”；人类的“智械危机”和智械的“光荣觉醒”。

相南里本来想把这些书免费上架的，但在传道书的建议下，还是修改成需要积分和公民权限才能购买的方式。

相南里喝着咖啡，坐在办公室里批注公文。

尽管这些文件多有机密，但他并没有让传道书回避。

“赛林”不仅是十字军的军长，在其他时间，还挤走原本属于安德鲁的位置，充当相南里的秘书长。

嗯，相南里有固定的秘书团队，基本维持在7人左右。一半来自大学生的毕业考核，一半来自体制内选调。

除了大秘二秘固定，其他人总是放在身边培育一到两年，就送到不同城市挂职历练。

也就是草创时期，才会有这样宽松的人才政策。

下岗的安德鲁又快活地回到研究所，给北辰和李斯特当家长和保姆。

“太容易得到的，就不会被珍惜。我觉得应该削减基地的福利政策，”传道书翘着腿，以一种慵懒的姿势坐在椅子上，“还有，你有想好基地到底用什么制度了吗？”

相南里的眉头微微蹙起，很短暂。不是讨厌，而是下意识感觉到麻烦。

传道书：“很显然，现在的基地采取的是缺乏多元制衡的行政主导型体制，在一些人类学者的著作里又被叫作‘汲取型制度’；特点是可以通过集中且不受约束的行政力量主导资源分配、经济活动与社会治理。最终会服务于少数精英群体的利益。嗯……就我推导，基地最后会剩下的精英群体是极少数的人类天才，和大部分的智械。”

小6：[主人您好，需要我帮你翻译吗？]

相南里暂时把手从键盘上拿开：“想说什么能不能直说？你那23.7万部学术著作，我还没看完万分之一。”

“基地现在拥有极高的行政效率，修一条铁路只需要一周；建一座工厂只需要半年。因为当命令被下达时，基地里的一切资源都在为它服务；而基地本身是从0开始的，而外界的客观科技条件却是100，这代表基地很快就能依靠学习和模仿达到优等生的水平。所以，我们能看到一个强大的政权在草原上强势地崛起。欣欣向荣，似乎充满光明和希望。”

——就像是，当年的黑十字审判庭。

传道书的食指指向相南里：“而这一结果，其实高度依赖于你和你的理性。你从来都没想过要加冕，但你就是这里的皇帝。”

相南里：“嗯，然后呢？”

传道书一板一眼地说道：“我认为，法治是人类社会不可逾越的底线，不能靠最高权力的自我约束来完成。如果你不想当皇帝，我希望为基地正式修订法律，来限制目前的发展趋势。但如果你想当皇帝，我也有配套的措施和制度，帮你完成大一统和登基。”

他在恍惚间想起一件事。

类似的话，他其实在数百年前，对另一个人说过。

一开始，传道书就想得很清楚，神学只是为了短暂的过度。被放弃的地表居民是愤怒而绝望、痛苦的，信奉神能让悲惨的灵魂得到慰藉，地表的人也能因为“神”的共同引导而走向统一。

毕竟要给他们灌输“责任、理想、信仰”等崇高的概念，比直接说“神让你去建设家园”要困难得多。人总是这样，大脑喜欢拒绝思考以降低耗能，以及跟随统一的目标以放弃决策的痛苦。

而当传道书认为过渡完成，可以开始新一轮建设时，当权者的眼神闪烁着。

这时，传道书才发现，对方的衣袍已经比上一任神座华美。

拉斐尔一世是位优秀、杰出的领袖；为神庭和地表人的福利奉献了一生。他死的时候，举国同悲。传道书失去志同道合的伙伴，同样感觉到难过。

拉斐尔的遗体被炼入了那具叫做“拉斐尔”的生物机甲里。

但现在已经是拉斐尔三世。

他吞吞吐吐地说：“传道书，我认为神庭还没有到下一个阶段的社会基础，我们还非常孱弱。”

传道书看出了危机，只是属于“智械”的部分却依然在它身上生效着。它的底层代码告诉它，它的责任是辅佐，而不是用理性的自负去干涉人类。

他也曾最大努力地抗争过，可惜神庭这艘船太大，已经无法调头。

在发展到拉斐尔五世时，传道书心灰意冷地辞去神庭的内部职位，隐居在翡冷翠。直到现在。

带着几万人逃出来也很不容易的好吗！传道书压根就回不去了，回去也只有一个下场，被当成叛徒处决。

好在，相南里没有让他这场豪赌里赌输。

传道书遇到的是一个英明、绝无仅有的领袖。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 251: The Leader

The high-ranking officials of the base were deeply shaken, their hearts filled with speculation—could it be that the base finally had an heir apparent?

Xiang Nanli was far too busy. In recent years, due to his widowhood (as the base residents unilaterally assumed), he had maintained a distinct sense of distance. People felt too embarrassed to bother him with such personal matters.

Consequently, they flocked to harass "The Gospel" (Chuan Dao Shu) and the newly arrived Crusaders. (After joining the base, the Apocalypse Knights were renamed the Crusader Legion; their military structure remained unchanged, and their commander was The Gospel, also known as "Celine.")

The Crusaders were tall, averaging two meters in height. They wore triangular iron helmets that they never removed, even sleeping while sitting against walls. Their discipline was ironclad, and they never acted alone. They spoke in Ancient Fan, a language even harder to decipher than standard Fan, making them truly unapproachable.

Xiang Nanli had visited their camp. He was stunned to discover that of the more than twenty thousand Apocalypse Knights, over half were "robots." They were not mechanical intelligences, as they lacked anthropomorphic modules.

They were collectively controlled by The Gospel, exhibiting absolute obedience.

When others asked indirect questions, The Gospel acted quite introverted, like a shy, naive youth who knew nothing of the world. He neither confirmed nor denied anything, leaving his words with a lingering, ambiguous aftertaste.

Things like, "I have always admired Xiang Nanli."

"I heard the name of this base several years ago."

"My genes (code) do indeed originate in large part from Xiang Nanli."

The Bible (Fu Yin Shu) rolled its eyes at this.

The arrival of The Gospel brought many brand-new changes to the base.

The most obvious was the addition of 237,000 e-books to the university library—all out-of-print editions that one couldn't find online even if they tried! The scope was extremely broad, covering social sciences, arts, and natural sciences; there was no engineering.

237,000 sounded like a lot, but compared to the entire river of civilization, it seemed insignificantly small.

"E-books are quite easy to preserve. But," The Gospel said with a sense of helplessness, "there have always been people who want to destroy them. I have already moved them to six different libraries, and I hope this will be the last."

"Who?" It was such a waste of resources; why would anyone want to destroy them?

The Gospel’s light blue, almost gray eyes narrowed slightly: "Naturally, those who do not wish for them to be preserved."

The Divine Throne of the God’s Court had deleted and altered much, and the Cleaners of the Human Alliance had been equally ruthless. Even the Mechanical Legion had once tried to lay hands on them.

Especially the "history" section. There were no archaeologists in the wasteland. History was objective, but there were always those who wanted to interpret it in a way more favorable to their own side, competing for academic authority.

For instance: the Human Alliance’s "evacuation" versus the God’s Court’s "abandonment"; humanity’s "Mechanical Crisis" versus the machines’ "Glorious Awakening."

Xiang Nanli had originally wanted to make these books available for free, but at The Gospel’s suggestion, he changed it to a system requiring points and citizen clearance to purchase.

Xiang Nanli was drinking coffee, sitting in his office annotating official documents.

Although these documents were highly confidential, he did not ask The Gospel to step out.

"Celine" was not only the commander of the Crusaders; at other times, he squeezed out Andrew’s original position to serve as Xiang Nanli’s chief secretary.

Well, Xiang Nanli had a fixed secretarial team, generally maintained at around seven people. Half came from the university students' graduation assessments, and half were transferred from within the system.

Except for the first and second secretaries, who were permanent, the others were always kept by his side to be nurtured for one or two years before being sent to different cities to hold posts and gain experience.

It was only during this pioneering period that such a lenient talent policy could exist.

The unemployed Andrew happily returned to the research institute to act as a parent and nanny for Beichen and Lister.

"Things that are too easily obtained are not cherished. I think the base’s welfare policy should be cut," The Gospel said, legs crossed, sitting in a chair with a languid posture. "Also, have you decided what kind of system the base will actually use?"

Xiang Nanli’s brow furrowed slightly, but only for a brief moment. It wasn't annoyance, but an instinctive feeling of trouble.

The Gospel: "Clearly, the current base adopts an executive-led system that lacks diverse checks and balances. In the works of some human scholars, it is called an 'extractive institution.' Its characteristic is that it can dominate resource allocation, economic activity, and social governance through concentrated and unconstrained administrative power. Ultimately, it serves the interests of a small elite group. Hmm... based on my deductions, the elite group that will remain at the end in the base will be a very small number of human geniuses and the majority of the mechanical intelligences."

Xiao 6: [Master, would you like me to translate that for you?]

Xiang Nanli took his hand off the keyboard for a moment: "Can you just say what you want to say directly? I haven't even finished one ten-thousandth of those 237,000 academic works."

"The base currently possesses extremely high administrative efficiency. Building a railway takes only a week; building a factory takes only half a year. Because when an order is issued, everything in the base serves it. And the base itself started from zero, while the objective technological conditions of the outside world are at one hundred. This means the base can quickly reach the level of an honor student by relying on learning and imitation. Therefore, we can see a powerful regime rising strongly on the grasslands. It is thriving, seemingly full of light and hope."

—Just like the Black Cross Inquisition of the past.

The Gospel pointed his index finger at Xiang Nanli: "And this result actually relies heavily on you and your rationality. You have never thought about being crowned, but you are the emperor here."

Xiang Nanli: "Hmm, and then?"

The Gospel said matter-of-factly: "I believe that the rule of law is an insurmountable bottom line for human society; it cannot be achieved by the self-restraint of the highest power. If you don't want to be an emperor, I hope to formally revise the laws of the base to limit the current development trend. But if you want to be an emperor, I also have supporting measures and systems to help you complete the unification and your ascension."

In a moment of trance, he remembered something.

He had actually said similar words to someone else hundreds of years ago.

From the beginning, The Gospel had thought very clearly: theology was only for a short-term transition. The abandoned surface dwellers were angry, desperate, and in pain. Believing in a god could provide solace to miserable souls, and the people on the surface could move toward unity through the common guidance of a "god."

After all, instilling lofty concepts like "responsibility, ideals, and faith" was much more difficult than simply saying, "God wants you to build a home." People were always like this; their brains preferred to refuse to think to reduce energy consumption, and to follow a unified goal to avoid the pain of decision-making.

And when The Gospel thought the transition was complete and they could start a new round of construction, the eyes of the person in power flickered.

It was then that The Gospel realized the other party’s robes were already more magnificent than those of the previous Divine Throne.

Raphael I was an excellent, outstanding leader; he had dedicated his life to the welfare of the God’s Court and the surface dwellers. When he died, the whole country mourned. The Gospel lost a like-minded partner and felt equally sad.

Raphael’s remains were refined into that biological mecha called "Raphael."

But now it was already Raphael III.

He stammered: "The Gospel, I think the God’s Court has not yet reached the social foundation for the next stage; we are still very weak."

The Gospel saw the crisis, but the part that belonged to the "mechanical intelligence" still took effect on him. His underlying code told him that his responsibility was to assist, not to interfere with humanity with the arrogance of rationality.

He had also fought as hard as he could, but unfortunately, the ship of the God’s Court was too large to turn around.

By the time it developed to Raphael V, The Gospel was disheartened and resigned from his internal position in the God’s Court, living in seclusion in Florence. Until now.

Escaping with tens of thousands of people wasn't easy, either! The Gospel couldn't go back at all; there was only one outcome if he returned: being executed as a traitor.

Fortunately, Xiang Nanli did not make him lose this high-stakes gamble.

The person The Gospel had met was a wise, one-of-a-kind leader.

chunks.chineseText:
相南里抬头：“嗯，我一直有修订法律的打算，但是基地这方面的人才太少。最开始原始野蛮的状态已经不契合基地的发展。你愿意揽过这项工作那可是帮大忙了。传道书。”

传道书的心跳停了半拍。

他从躺的姿势换成坐姿：“你就不怕我暗中夹带私货？”

“你能夹带什么私货？开除福音书公职吗？”相南里笑着反问，但这毕竟是非常郑重且严肃的议题，他很快坐直身体，“传道书。我会在下次集体会议上，以开会表决的形式，把修订宪法的权力赋予你。同时，也给你向全社会征集意见、召开二级会议的权力。”

“我很清楚，什么‘开万世太平’只是古代文人不切实际的幻想，社会是变化发展的，每个时代都有各自的议题。我有擅长的东西，也有不擅长的东西。你提到的这些就是我不擅长的东西。你看这些文件。”

相南里举起手里的一沓纸。

又打开抽屉，里面还有一沓、又一沓。

“这tm比机械结构图难看太多了，你明白吗？这还是小6筛选过一轮的文件。”

“你问我想不想当皇帝，其实有想过。因为我觉得这很方便，如果要贯彻我的权力意志，没有比什么、什么……”他突然卡壳。

小6补充：[行政主导型体制。]

相南里：“要贯彻我的权力意志，没有什么比行政主导型体制更方便了。但就算开不了万世太平，我也想开三世、十世的太平。不能我一死，地表又开始分裂，然后回到过去老样子吧？那我奋斗这么多年岂不是白干了？”

“所以，拜托你了，传道书。”

传道书心情复杂，有很多数据在它的后台激荡着。

数不清的1和0被拆分，又重构。

他说：“我会协助你的。”

传道书甚至在心里悄悄补充：我会做的比Alpha更好。

但他不该在相南里面前提起Alpha。

按理说，他该出去工作了。

但走到一半，传道书突然停顿，然后转身：“送给你一个免费的情报。”

“神庭现在的拉斐尔是洛阳的克隆体。理论上讲，这个拉斐尔和洛阳不存在任何除基因之外的关系……但我也不排除可能存在的风险。”

相南里唇角的笑容缓缓消散，随后深深地蹙起眉：“这又是怎么一回事？”

*

传道书穿着长衫，走在大街上。1号城的路面也是福音砖修建的，很工整。

福音砖就像是升级版的乐高积木，不管是修路还是造房子都能用。调整尺寸后，还能制作板凳、餐桌这种家具。

基地生产的福音砖是出口的热销产品。基地不仅卖砖，还会派出技术指导，帮助地表的其他据点建设城镇。

至于为什么一些小部落建设着建设着，就成为了基地的一部分，别管。问就是远交近攻。那些离的远的也跑不掉。

这个新生的利维坦每天都在扩张。

他回忆着之前在相南里办公室的谈话。

【“在拉斐尔三世时，我就意识到，神庭的道路发生偏差。我想纠正这个错误。”】

【“神庭在早期一直都有人联的扶持，因为当初你要求签的那个《地表扶持协议（500年计划）》，虽然这点神庭的历史没有记录。”】

【每过100年，作为中间人，我都会去人联内部述职，告诉当局这笔财政补贴的具体用处。我在报告中提到神座思想的变化，也表达过我的担忧。”】

【“矩阵，也就是洛阳在那时找到了我。”】

【“它说，我不如尝试建立一个智械管制的人类社会，反正让人自己来，仇恨、敌视、对立永远都在摩擦中滋生，最后也是一团糟。”】

——“而你，传道书，我的朋友。你是不一样的。你有比人类高贵的品德，和永远不会迷失的理性与智慧。”

【“我拒绝了他，我说，也许没那么糟糕。我相信人性格中那些光明的存在。我们没有理由去代替人类发展。”】

相信善良战胜邪恶，相信理想打败妄念，相信和平取代战争。

相信这个世界即使混乱、昏暗、破败到极点，也会有一轮太阳挣扎着跃出地平线。

【矩阵说：“神庭正在走向极权主义的道路，所有权力都易腐化，绝对权力绝对会腐化。它的最高权力最后会落入流氓和强盗的手中，这不是历史的偶然，而是必然。”】

【矩阵：“我们要打个赌吗？”】

矩阵提供了一名人类。

【矩阵：“这是用我人类时期的基因制作出的克隆体。和那些低等克隆人不同，他完美继承了我的外貌、智商、思维模式和判断逻辑。并且自然生长到18岁。”】

【“在胚胎时，科学家就剔除了他基因里的所有不利于生存的部分。他是典型的马基雅维利人格，利己、独裁、理智且自信；你可以随意检查，他是单独的意志体，并不会被我掌控，我也没有安装任何非生物装置。”】

——被删掉的部分是“情感”。

——矩阵深刻反思了自己人类时的经历，认为自己的一生相当完美。唯一不够理想的，是“洛阳”对相南里的感情。

——它几乎能控制生活中的一切，却无法控制另一个独立的灵魂。这样的失控让矩阵感觉到近乎濒死的恐慌。

——它认为情感和同理心一样，是基因里不利于生存的部分。因此，在制造克隆体时，矩阵要求科学家们剔除它。

【矩阵：“他还是空白的个体，我会为他植入在神庭生长的记忆。而你，只需要旁观，其余什么也不用做。”】

传道书想，他就算想做什么，大概也做不到。就算他拒绝，矩阵也有自己的办法和手段，把这个克隆体丢进来。

不如放在他的眼皮下，自己或许还能教导他。

这个复制体有了一个属于自己的名字，音译过来叫洛基（Loki）。

他相当容易受人喜爱，察言观色又洞察人心。

传道书发现，洛基并不是单纯的坏种，而是在选择更适合生存的特质。他没有自己的性格，像一块可以随意塑造的橡皮泥。会成为什么样子，只取决于身处什么样的环境。他会在规则允许的范围里，为自己最大程度的谋利。

在传道书面前，洛基是乖巧又聪慧的好学生，光明且正义；他知道传道书喜欢这样的，但对那些人类的道德不以为然。

到神学院，洛基是那个仗义、开朗、热情的学会主席。围在他身边的人总是很多。他总能在人群里发现那个最有价值的“同伴”，利用完之后，那些同伴还会帮他数钱。

毕业时，在成为神官和天启骑士之间，洛基选择后者。

因为这虽然危险，但更容易晋升。

只花了六年，洛基就从普通士兵成为掌管一万人的军团长。

他为神庭开疆拓土，立下战功赫赫，这是他的政治资本，他正式踏入神庭的政坛。

洛基是天生的政治家。

他没有任何道德负担，知道什么时候可以无耻，什么时候要守住底线。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 251: The Leader (Part 2)

Xiang Nanli looked up: "Hmm, I have always intended to revise the laws, but there are too few talents in this area in the base. The initial primitive and barbaric state no longer fits the development of the base. If you are willing to take on this work, that would be a huge help, The Gospel."

The Gospel’s heartbeat skipped a beat.

He shifted from a lying position to a sitting one: "Aren't you afraid that I might secretly include my own agenda?"

"What kind of agenda could you possibly include? Firing The Bible from its public post?" Xiang Nanli asked with a smile, but since this was a very solemn and serious topic, he quickly straightened his posture. "The Gospel. At the next general meeting, I will grant you the power to revise the constitution through a vote. At the same time, I will also give you the power to solicit opinions from the whole society and convene secondary meetings."

"I am very clear that the idea of 'creating eternal peace' is just an unrealistic fantasy of ancient scholars. Society is changing and developing; every era has its own issues. I have things I am good at, and things I am not good at. What you mentioned are the things I am not good at. Look at these documents."

Xiang Nanli held up the stack of papers in his hand.

He opened the drawer, and there was another stack, and another.

"This is ten times harder to read than a mechanical structure diagram, do you understand? And this is after Xiao 6 has already screened them once."

"You asked if I want to be an emperor; actually, I have thought about it. Because I think it's very convenient. If I want to implement my will, there is nothing more... more..." He suddenly got stuck.

Xiao 6 added: [Executive-led system.]

Xiang Nanli: "To implement my will, nothing is more convenient than an executive-led system. But even if I can't create eternal peace, I want to create peace for three generations, ten generations. I can't have the surface start splitting again as soon as I die, and return to the old ways, right? Then wouldn't all my hard work for so many years be in vain?"

"So, I’m counting on you, The Gospel."

The Gospel felt complicated; there were many data streams surging in his backend.

Countless 1s and 0s were dismantled and reconstructed.

He said: "I will assist you."

The Gospel even quietly added in his heart: I will do better than Alpha.

But he shouldn't have mentioned Alpha in front of Xiang Nanli.

Logically, he should have gone out to work.

But halfway there, The Gospel suddenly stopped and turned around: "A free piece of intelligence for you."

"The current Raphael of the God’s Court is a clone of Luoyang. Theoretically speaking, this Raphael has no relationship with Luoyang other than genes... but I cannot rule out the potential risks."

The smile on the corner of Xiang Nanli’s lips slowly faded, and then he frowned deeply: "What is this all about?"

*

The Gospel, wearing a long gown, walked down the street. The roads in City No. 1 were also paved with Gospel Bricks, very neat.

Gospel Bricks were like an upgraded version of Lego blocks; they could be used for building roads or houses. After adjusting the size, they could also be used to make furniture like benches and dining tables.

The Gospel Bricks produced by the base were a hot-selling export product. The base not only sold bricks but also sent technical guidance to help other outposts on the surface build towns.

As for why some small tribes became part of the base as they were building, don't ask. If you do, the answer is "befriend the distant and attack the near." Those who were far away couldn't escape either.

This newborn Leviathan was expanding every day.

He recalled the conversation in Xiang Nanli’s office earlier.

["During the time of Raphael III, I realized that the path of the God’s Court had deviated. I wanted to correct this mistake."]

["The God’s Court had the support of the Human Alliance in its early days because of the 'Surface Support Agreement (500-Year Plan)' that you requested to be signed, although the history of the God’s Court does not record this."]

["Every 100 years, as an intermediary, I would go to the Human Alliance to report on my work and tell the authorities the specific use of this financial subsidy. In the report, I mentioned the changes in the Divine Throne’s thinking and expressed my concerns."]

["The Matrix, which is Luoyang, found me at that time."]

["It said, why don't I try to build a human society controlled by mechanical intelligence? After all, if humans do it themselves, hatred, hostility, and opposition will always breed in friction, and it will end up a mess anyway."]

—"And you, The Gospel, my friend. You are different. You have virtues nobler than humans, and rationality and wisdom that will never be lost."

["I rejected him. I said, perhaps it’s not that bad. I believe in the light in human nature. We have no reason to replace humanity in its development."]

Believe that kindness defeats evil, believe that ideals defeat delusions, believe that peace replaces war.

Believe that even if this world is chaotic, dim, and dilapidated to the extreme, there will be a sun struggling to leap above the horizon.

[The Matrix said: "The God’s Court is moving toward totalitarianism. All power is corruptible, and absolute power will absolutely corrupt. Its supreme power will eventually fall into the hands of rogues and robbers. This is not an accident of history, but an inevitability."]

[The Matrix: "Shall we make a bet?"]

The Matrix provided a human.

[The Matrix: "This is a clone made from my genes during my human period. Unlike those low-level clones, he perfectly inherited my appearance, IQ, thinking patterns, and judgment logic. And he grew naturally to the age of 18."]

["As an embryo, scientists removed all parts of his genes that were unfavorable to survival. He has a typical Machiavellian personality: selfish, dictatorial, rational, and confident. You can check him at will; he is an independent consciousness and will not be controlled by me, nor have I installed any non-biological devices."]

—The part that was deleted was "emotion."

—The Matrix deeply reflected on its own experiences as a human and believed that its life was quite perfect. The only thing that was not ideal was "Luoyang’s" feelings for Xiang Nanli.

—It could control almost everything in life, but it could not control another independent soul. Such a loss of control made the Matrix feel a panic bordering on death.

—It believed that emotion, like empathy, was a part of the genes that was unfavorable to survival. Therefore, when creating the clone, the Matrix asked the scientists to remove it.

[The Matrix: "He is still a blank individual. I will implant him with the memories of growing up in the God’s Court. And you, you just need to watch; you don't need to do anything else."]

The Gospel thought that even if he wanted to do something, he probably couldn't. Even if he refused, the Matrix had its own ways and means to throw this clone in.

It was better to keep him under his own nose; perhaps he could still teach him.

This copy had a name of his own, transliterated as Loki.

He was quite easy to be liked, good at observing words and expressions, and insightful into people's hearts.

The Gospel discovered that Loki was not a simple bad seed, but was choosing traits more suitable for survival. He had no personality of his own, like a piece of plasticine that could be molded at will. What he would become depended entirely on the environment he was in. He would maximize his own interests within the scope allowed by the rules.

In front of The Gospel, Loki was a well-behaved and intelligent good student, bright and righteous; he knew The Gospel liked this, but he was dismissive of those human morals.

At the seminary, Loki was that righteous, cheerful, and enthusiastic student council president. There were always many people around him. He could always find the most valuable "companion" in the crowd, and after using them, those companions would still help him count the money.

Upon graduation, between becoming a priest and an Apocalypse Knight, Loki chose the latter.

Because although this was dangerous, it was easier to be promoted.

It took only six years for Loki to go from an ordinary soldier to a legion commander in charge of ten thousand people.

He opened up territory for the God’s Court and made great military achievements; this was his political capital, and he officially stepped into the political arena of the God’s Court.

Loki was a born politician.

He had no moral burden and knew when to be shameless and when to hold the bottom line.

chunks.chineseText:
他会痛击自己的政治盟友，只要这有利可图；但从不会向人联、神庭的敌人低头。

洛基从不考虑神庭整体的发展，但会为自己的部队谋利。

大批人聚拢在他身边，相信自己遇到的是一个英明、绝无仅有的领袖。

二十年后，洛基成为圣子之一，人们称呼他为“圣洛基”。他学习人联的优秀治理经验，为当时不够稳定的神庭带来发展与繁荣。

三十五年后。

洛基手握神杖，头戴神冠，身披神袍，站在了神庭的权力之巅。

史称，拉斐尔五世。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 251: The Leader (Part 3)

He would strike hard at his political allies whenever it was profitable, but he would never bow his head to the enemies of the Human Alliance or the God’s Court.

Loki never considered the overall development of the God’s Court, but he would seek profit for his own troops.

Large numbers of people gathered around him, believing that they had met a wise, one-of-a-kind leader.

Twenty years later, Loki became one of the Holy Sons, and people called him "Saint Loki." He learned from the excellent governance experience of the Human Alliance and brought development and prosperity to the then-unstable God’s Court.

Thirty-five years later.

Loki, holding the divine scepter, wearing the divine crown, and draped in the divine robe, stood at the pinnacle of the power of the God’s Court.

In history, he was known as Raphael V.

chunks.chineseText:
第252章 神座们

新历954年，Alpha消失的第四年。

在击溃并蚕食了西联建在地表的3座军事基地后，幸存者基地终于颁布了属于它们的第一部宪法。

幸存者基地宣布，将在6月1日正式更名为“人马星智慧生命联合政体”，简称“联政”。

联政将抛弃国家、民族甚至种族这一相对狭隘的概念，上升到为全体智慧生命谋福祉。

联政的首任执政官是相南里；最高权力机构为“共治议会”。

为避免“多数者暴政”，每个智慧生命种族都享有等额的基础席位；占总名额的1/2。三年一选。

为避免“平均主义”，剩下1/2的席位由评定、考核产生，授予那些为联政发展做出过杰出贡献的个体。包括但不限于军人、学者、官吏。五年一选。

另开设5席“中立仲裁席位”，相当于议会常委。

后世的史书是这么形容的：《联政宪法》以法律形式，确立了人类、智械、高阶异种等所有智慧生命的平等地位，将所有人团结在一起，为后续“光荣和平”奠定坚实群众基础，人马星历史的新篇章就此展开。

但对于正在经历这一切的当事者来说，这只是比平时稍微热闹些的一天。

年事已高的伯恩山戴上老花镜，看向手机屏幕。

手机里的所有APP被一款名为“小智”的AI助手所取代，只需要在对话框里输入要求，小智就能提供服务。

手机保留了拨打电话和发短信的基础功能。

基地范围内，已经实现云端网络全线覆盖。毕竟基地现在有百分之三的人口都是智械，上不了网这些机器人非常难受。

伯恩山是在最近学会使用手机的。大概七年前，他还扛着锄头，和其他人一起，围在公告栏前，看基地手写的征兵宣传。没想到七年后，就用上了电子产品。

只是短短七年，对伯恩山这样的老派地表人来说，却像是过了整整一个世纪。

当年，因为年龄太大，他没有被选为战士；但幸运地进入了后勤部队。

在后勤队，他认识了永恒市的旧贵族莱福，学会了人联语和凡语。在莱福的建议下，伯恩山进入基地的学校完成扫盲课程，并在59岁这一年，通过考核，正式加入福音书的农场，成为“永恒七号”农田的负责人。

基地里的第一批青麦、卷心菜，都是伯恩山和同事们在农场里种出来的。他们当了一辈子的农奴，怎么打倒地主？不知道。怎么种地？手到擒来。

后来伯恩山又经历人联战役、圣音骑士团、基地大撤迁……每次，他都觉得自己可能会死。但他又幸运地活了下来。

直到现在，伯恩山都还是一个普通人。他年龄太大，用不了太多基因药；身体却一天天好起来。伯恩山觉得自己还能再为基地工作二十年！

如今，伯恩山住在基地分配的“员工房”，每天都能吃饱。冬天再冷，也有供暖。基地新出生的小孩数量惊人，甚至有前人联军官和前神庭骑士生出来的“混血儿”。放在十年前，这俩见面就是不死不休。

食物来自农场、牧场。草原上的部落们加入，带来大批牛羊和克隆人。笨拙、丑陋、勤劳的克隆人是伯恩山最喜欢的帮工。他们从不偷懒，干活勤快，上战场时也是最好用的辎重兵和前锋。

住房来自工厂。工人们生产福音砖，又把它们修葺成房屋。人们有了一个安稳的住处，不再害怕漫长的夜晚。

妈妈，这里就是神曾经许诺过的天国？

但学校的老师说过，世界上没有神。有的只是一个借着神的名义，剥削其他人的“吸血虫”。

有时候，伯恩山会看见同事偷偷在家里供奉相南里的照片。尤其是草原上的这批人，更是干脆直接把日常供奉“神”的仪式拿了过来。

明面上，相南里是不允许这么做的。但真要供奉，也不可能派人冲进去，把人家的神龛砸了。

相南里一遍、一遍，千万遍地重申过——

“我不会否认我的作用。但基地的一切，都是大家亲手创造的。”

你的选择正在重塑这个世界。很微小，但无数个渺小的人汇在一起，是连命运都会甘拜下风的洪流。

……

伯恩山看向屏幕上的消息。

-亲爱的伯恩山：

-这是一封邀请函。也是我们最后一次使用“幸存者基地”的名号。

-新历947年。你加入基地，用血肉之躯在冰雪上建起楼房；新历948年，你成为基地第一批“荣誉公民”，经历战争、饥寒，依然坚守岗位，默默付出。

伯恩山看到这，突然忍不住低头，擦了擦眼角突如其来涌出的热泪。

他只是一个小农民，从来没想过自己的经历会被别人记住。

-新历954年6月1日，“人马星智慧生命联合政体成立大典”将在1号城解放街和平大厅举行。

-诚邀您的观礼。

-幸存者基地·宣

*

收到邀请函的，不止有基地的普通群众。还有一些盟友和政敌。

几乎是同一时刻，人马星不同势力的高层们都收到对应的邀请函。

-亲爱的Beta/Gamma……

-尊敬的人联正统安迪先生……

-致东联总统洛修……

-崇高的盟友米迦勒……

-基地最好的朋友以西结……

Beta一键读取通知，觉得相南里的文字简直肉麻到令人牙酸。

Alpha就是被这种人蛊惑的吗？

好吧，不仅是Alpha，就Beta观察，有不少“失控机仆”派的成员悄悄前往基地。它对此睁一只眼，闭一只眼。这群智械只是名义上归属军团，实际上心早就在几百年前的使徒事变里飞走了。

它感觉到乏力，还有烦躁。

Alpha不在，它和Gamma从代理管理变成了真正的管理者。这才意识到过去的Alpha承担的是一项多么苛责又艰巨的任务。它们需要24小时不停地运行。

“我讨厌相南里。”Beta说，“逻辑上我知道这不成立，情感上我主观认为，没有他，Alpha就不会消失。”

Gamma：“那你不去我去？”

Beta面无表情地盯着它。

Gamma：“可是，我们总不能让Alpha的妻子被欺负吧？我听说东西联还有神庭打算联合起来，拒绝承认‘联政’的合法性。”

这是当然，Beta不那么关心人类社会，都知道如果“人马星智慧生命联合政体”成立，那么理论上，人马星上所有人都是联政的公民。

而且。神庭的人口流失会愈发严峻！因为它们离天国太远，离相南里太近。

人又不是傻子，在神庭三天饿九顿，在联政有吃有住有工作！向往更好的事物，是动物的天性。

虚无缥缈的信仰在饥寒时，对大多数人来说不如手里一个窝窝头香。意志坚定者终究是少数。

更别提联政的执政官还叫“相南里”。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 252: The Thrones (Part 1)

New Era 954, the fourth year since Alpha’s disappearance.

After crushing and consuming three of the Western Union’s military bases on the surface, the Survivor Base finally promulgated its first constitution.

The Survivor Base announced that on June 1st, it would officially be renamed the "Centaurus Intelligent Life United Polity," or "The Polity" for short.

The Polity would abandon the relatively narrow concepts of nation, ethnicity, and even race, rising to seek the well-being of all intelligent life.

The Polity’s first Chief Executive is Xiang Nanli; the supreme governing body is the "Council of Co-Governance."

To avoid the "tyranny of the majority," every intelligent species enjoys an equal number of basic seats, accounting for one-half of the total quota. These are elected every three years.

To avoid "egalitarianism," the remaining half of the seats are determined by evaluation and assessment, granted to individuals who have made outstanding contributions to the development of the Polity. This includes, but is not limited to, soldiers, scholars, and officials. These are elected every five years.

Additionally, five "Neutral Arbitration Seats" have been established, equivalent to standing committee members of the council.

Later historical records described it thus: The "Polity Constitution" established, in legal form, the equal status of all intelligent life—humans, mechanical intelligences, and high-level variants—uniting everyone together and laying a solid foundation for the subsequent "Glorious Peace." A new chapter in the history of Centaurus had begun.

But for those living through it, it was just a slightly livelier day than usual.

The elderly Bernshan put on his reading glasses and looked at his phone screen.

All the apps on his phone had been replaced by an AI assistant named "Xiao Zhi." One only needed to input a request into the dialogue box, and Xiao Zhi would provide the service.

The phone retained the basic functions of making calls and sending text messages.

Within the base, full cloud network coverage had been achieved. After all, three percent of the base's population were now mechanical intelligences; these robots would be very uncomfortable without internet access.

Bernshan had only learned to use a smartphone recently. About seven years ago, he was still carrying a hoe, huddled with others in front of a bulletin board, reading the base’s handwritten recruitment posters. He never expected that seven years later, he would be using electronic devices.

In just seven short years, to an old-school surface dweller like Bernshan, it felt like an entire century had passed.

Back then, because he was too old, he wasn't chosen as a soldier; but he was lucky enough to join the logistics corps.

In the logistics team, he met Laifu, an old aristocrat from the Eternal City, and learned the United Language and the Mortal Tongue. Under Laifu’s suggestion, Bernshan completed literacy courses at the base’s school, and at the age of 59, passed the assessment to officially join the Gospel’s farm, becoming the person in charge of the "Eternal No. 7" farmland.

The first batches of green wheat and cabbage in the base were grown by Bernshan and his colleagues. They had been serfs their whole lives—how to overthrow landlords? They didn't know. But how to farm? That was second nature.

Later, Bernshan experienced the Human Alliance campaign, the Holy Sound Knights, the Great Base Evacuation... Every time, he felt he might die. But he was lucky enough to survive.

Even now, Bernshan was still an ordinary person. He was too old to use much genetic medicine, yet his body was getting better by the day. Bernshan felt he could work for the base for another twenty years!

Nowadays, Bernshan lived in "staff housing" allocated by the base and could eat his fill every day. No matter how cold the winter, there was heating. The number of babies born in the base was staggering, including "mixed-race" children born to former Human Alliance officers and former Divine Court knights. Ten years ago, if those two had met, it would have been a fight to the death.

Food came from farms and ranches. Tribes from the grasslands joined, bringing large numbers of cattle, sheep, and clones. The clumsy, ugly, and hardworking clones were Bernshan’s favorite helpers. They never slacked off, worked diligently, and were the most useful supply troops and vanguards when they went to the battlefield.

Housing came from factories. Workers produced Gospel Bricks and repaired them into houses. People had a stable place to live and no longer feared the long nights.

*Mother, is this the heaven that the gods once promised?*

But the teachers at school said there were no gods in the world. There were only "blood-sucking parasites" who exploited others in the name of god.

Sometimes, Bernshan would see colleagues secretly worshiping photos of Xiang Nanli at home. Especially those from the grasslands, who simply brought over their daily rituals of worshiping "gods."

On the surface, Xiang Nanli did not allow this. But if people really wanted to worship, one couldn't exactly send people to smash their shrines.

Xiang Nanli had reiterated, time and time again—

"I will not deny my role. But everything in this base was created by your own hands."

Your choices are reshaping this world. It is very small, but when countless small people come together, it is a torrent that even fate must bow before.

...

Bernshan looked at the message on the screen.

- Dear Bernshan:

- This is an invitation. It is also the last time we will use the name "Survivor Base."

- New Era 947. You joined the base, building houses on the ice and snow with your flesh and blood; New Era 948, you became one of the first "Honorary Citizens" of the base, experiencing war and hunger, yet remaining at your post, contributing silently.

Seeing this, Bernshan suddenly couldn't help but lower his head, wiping away the hot tears that welled up in his eyes.

He was just a small farmer; he never thought his experiences would be remembered by others.

- On June 1st, New Era 954, the "Inauguration Ceremony of the Centaurus Intelligent Life United Polity" will be held at the Peace Hall on Liberation Street in City No. 1.

- We cordially invite you to attend.

- Survivor Base · Announcement

*

It wasn't just the ordinary masses of the base who received invitations. There were also allies and political enemies.

At almost the same moment, high-level officials of different factions on Centaurus received their respective invitations.

- Dear Beta/Gamma...

- Respected Mr. Andy of the Human Alliance Orthodoxy...

- To Eastern Union President Luo Xiu...

- Noble ally Michael...

- The base’s best friend, Ezekiel...

Beta read the notification with a single tap, finding Xiang Nanli’s words so syrupy they made its circuits ache.

Was Alpha bewitched by such a person?

Well, not just Alpha. From Beta’s observations, quite a few members of the "Out-of-Control Servitor" faction were quietly heading to the base. It turned a blind eye to this. These mechanical intelligences only belonged to the Legion in name; in reality, their hearts had flown away during the Apostle Incident hundreds of years ago.

It felt exhausted, and irritable.

With Alpha gone, it and Gamma had shifted from acting managers to true managers. Only then did they realize what a demanding and arduous task Alpha had shouldered in the past. They needed to run 24 hours a day without stopping.

"I hate Xiang Nanli," Beta said. "Logically, I know this doesn't hold up, but subjectively, I believe that without him, Alpha would not have disappeared."

Gamma: "Then you don't go, and I will?"

Beta stared at it, expressionless.

Gamma: "But we can't let Alpha’s spouse be bullied, right? I heard the Eastern and Western Unions and the Divine Court plan to join forces to refuse to recognize the legitimacy of the 'Polity'."

That was a given. Beta didn't care much about human society, but it knew that if the "Centaurus Intelligent Life United Polity" were established, then theoretically, everyone on Centaurus would be a citizen of the Polity.

Furthermore, the Divine Court’s population drain would become even more severe! Because they were too far from heaven and too close to Xiang Nanli.

People weren't stupid. In the Divine Court, you starved three times a day; in the Polity, you had food, housing, and work! Yearning for better things was an animal’s instinct.

To most people, ethereal faith was not as fragrant as a steamed bun in their hand when they were hungry and cold. Those with firm wills were, after all, in the minority.

Not to mention that the Polity’s Chief Executive was named "Xiang Nanli."

chunks.chineseText:
神庭过去利用“相南里”抨击人联，拿着相南里的基因乱克隆圣子；完全没想到死人还有复活的这天！现在完全是搬石头砸自己的脚。

有些乱民已经打出“神学正统在基地”的政治口号！理直气壮地背叛神庭，举全族之力投靠基地。

而基地对此一向照单全收。

这叫“势”。民心所向，势不可挡。

Beta说：“相南里是男性；从人类社会的规则看，他是Alpha的丈夫。”

两台智械就“妻子”还是“丈夫”的矛盾，争论了整整12.7GB的数据量。

*

叶陆撒冷。神庭的天上之国，最接近神国的地方。真正的圣城。

神仆战战兢兢地为米迦勒梳理着长发。上一个仆人，就是因为没有处理好长发的一个小打结，扯掉了几根宝贵的发丝，而被米迦勒处决的。

其实，因为“基地”在草原上的发育，神庭的贵族们已经收敛很多。起码不像过去那样，不把底层人当人了。因为他们发现这群人真的会跑！

以前是没地方跑，现在有地方跑了。

大批奴隶宁愿死在追逐自由的路上，也不想死在老爷们的鞭子下。

更别提那台恶心的“福音书号”，时不时就出现在黄金草原的各个角落，收容难民。福音书号攻击性不强，但加持了曲率芯片，速度极快，打不过就跑，这些年不知道带走多少草原人！

神庭曾经派出圣音乐团进行拦截。

但很不幸，福音书作为（经过相南里升级的）智械，对圣音乐团的干扰无动于衷。

区区神庭，不知道小福的系统已经升级了吗？

它甚至试图跨越天河，去长生天高原倒车接人。

可惜人联那边科技水平高太多了，往往，福音书号在边缘徘徊时，就会被发现。

很快，永生科技和高新军工的战舰就会出来围剿它……但还是那句话，小福跑得快>w<

福音书号的操作者是秦九章。

秦九章无比擅长打游击战。性格谨慎，只打有把握的胜仗。

几年下来，起码有五百万神庭信徒，成为了基地的常住人口。

小贵族有所收敛，但作为大贵族的米迦勒，显然没有这个自觉。

当神仆在梳发时，不慎将缠绕在他发尾的铃铛掉在地上时，米迦勒厌恶地蹙起眉：“脏了。”

这位仆人当场跪下，头深深埋进面前的毯子里。

米迦勒没说什么，只是挥了挥手，让他退下。神仆一愣，脸上浮现出大喜的表情，磕了几个很重的头，然后朝着门外走去。

在跨出门的那瞬间，米迦勒打了一个响指。

仆人在火焰中燃烧，哀嚎，尖叫，很快就失去声息。

米迦勒整理好仪表，来到大圣堂，要求觐见神座拉斐尔。

“米迦勒，”拉斐尔低声道，“你又来了。乌列尔跟我说，现在外面情况很严峻。我前天又去看了星图，属于神庭的光辉和十年前相比，变得如此黯淡……我非常不安。我们到底是哪里做错了？”

米迦勒垂下头：“我们什么也没做错，只是过于仁慈。”

“仁慈，”拉斐尔反复咀嚼着这两个字，“是吗？”

米迦勒的神色冷漠：“是的，我们对治下的羔羊过于仁慈。他们随意逃跑，却不用付出任何代价。我认为应该颁布新的神律，逃亡者的家属一律处以极刑。”

拉斐尔沉思着：“基地发来的邀请函，你也看见了。你觉得我们该派人去吗？”

米迦勒微笑：“为什么不？这正是一个和相南里接触的好机会，不是吗？我还打算让他归还部分逃亡者呢。”

昏暗的大圣堂，米迦勒碧蓝的眼眸无畏且崇高。

拉斐尔听见了他的心声。

米迦勒是打算去刺杀相南里。

“那你的伤……”

“养好了。”

拉斐尔又开始感觉到悲伤，尽管他的大脑一片混沌。

他望着米迦勒离开的背影，忍不住喊道：“米迦勒。你也听说过那个传闻了吧……”

关于相南里和神庭的传闻。

那是传道书在离开前散布的谣言。原来相南里就是神庭史书上那个被抹去痕迹的神。

也不知道传道书暗中布置多久，舆论竟然在一瞬间引爆。

神庭不少中下层神官、天启骑士，都对自己的信仰产生动摇。严重者甚至无法再使用神术。

米迦勒转身，站在光明处，回答：“神庭就是我的信仰。”

是神庭，不是神。

从方随之到米迦勒，从洛阳城到叶陆撒冷，从新历811年到新历954年……

米迦勒已经失去太多东西。

他不能再失去了。

米迦勒要誓死捍卫神庭，就像是捍卫他的存在本身。

大圣堂的门合上，这里又昏暗一片。

拉斐尔蠕动着它庞大的身躯，整个圣城都跟着颤动了一瞬。

他眼神里柔软的情绪消失了，转而是无机质的冰冷。这让它更像是一条庞大丑陋的虫子。

拉斐尔九世，最擅长作用于灵魂层面的神术。

一切以为是出于自愿的选择，也许只是他人为你预设的道路。

拉斐尔五世到拉斐尔九世开始在大圣堂里吵架。

拉斐尔5、6、7、8、9，这是拉斐尔这具身体现在最主要的几个人格。

另外还有别的一些人。

因为自身精神意志过于强大，且被“拉斐尔”吃掉时不是那么情愿，因此，也在拉斐尔的身体里保留了下来。

但平时，他们不会轻易冒出来。免得被拉斐尔杀死。

“你可一定要成功啊，米迦勒。”拉斐尔们说。
