Chapter 252: The Thrones (Part 2)

The Divine Court had previously used "Xiang Nanli" to attack the Human Alliance, and had even cloned "Holy Sons" using Xiang Nanli’s genes; they never expected that the dead would have a day of resurrection! Now, they were completely lifting a rock only to drop it on their own feet.

Some rioters had already raised the political slogan: "The Theological Orthodoxy is in the Base!" They betrayed the Divine Court with righteous indignation, throwing the strength of their entire clans into defecting to the base.

And the base had always accepted them all.

This was called "momentum." The will of the people was an unstoppable force.

Beta said: "Xiang Nanli is male; from the rules of human society, he is Alpha’s husband."

The two mechanical intelligences argued over 12.7GB of data regarding the contradiction of "wife" versus "husband."

*

Jerusalem. The Heavenly Kingdom of the Divine Court, the place closest to the Kingdom of God. The true Holy City.

The divine servant trembled as he combed Michael’s long hair. The previous servant had been executed by Michael simply because he hadn't handled a small knot in the hair well, pulling out a few precious strands.

In truth, because of the "Base’s" development on the grasslands, the nobles of the Divine Court had restrained themselves quite a bit. At least they didn't treat the lower classes as non-human like they used to. Because they discovered that these people would actually run!

Before, there was nowhere to run; now, there was.

Large numbers of slaves would rather die on the road to freedom than die under the whips of their masters.

Not to mention that disgusting "Gospel" ship, which appeared in every corner of the Golden Grasslands from time to time to take in refugees. The Gospel ship wasn't very aggressive, but it was equipped with curvature chips and was extremely fast. If it couldn't win, it would run. Who knew how many grasslanders it had taken away over the years!

The Divine Court had once dispatched the Holy Sound Orchestra to intercept it.

But unfortunately, as a mechanical intelligence (upgraded by Xiang Nanli), the Gospel remained indifferent to the Holy Sound Orchestra’s interference.

Did the mere Divine Court not know that Little Fu’s system had already been upgraded?

It even attempted to cross the Heavenly River to go to the Eternal Sky Plateau to pick people up.

Unfortunately, the Human Alliance’s technological level was far too high. Often, when the Gospel ship lingered on the periphery, it would be discovered.

Soon, Eternal Technology and High-Tech Military Industry warships would come out to encircle and suppress it... but as the saying goes, Little Fu runs fast >w<.

The operator of the Gospel ship was Qin Jiuzhang.

Qin Jiuzhang was incredibly adept at guerrilla warfare. He was cautious by nature and only fought battles he was sure of winning.

Over the years, at least five million Divine Court believers had become permanent residents of the base.

The minor nobles had restrained themselves, but Michael, as a high noble, clearly lacked this self-awareness.

When the divine servant accidentally dropped the bell tangled in the ends of his hair onto the floor while combing, Michael frowned in disgust: "It’s dirty."

The servant knelt on the spot, his head buried deep into the carpet in front of him.

Michael said nothing, merely waving his hand to dismiss him. The servant was stunned, a look of immense joy appearing on his face. He kowtowed several heavy times before walking toward the door.

At the moment he crossed the threshold, Michael snapped his fingers.

The servant burned in flames, wailing and screaming, until he quickly lost all breath.

Michael tidied his appearance and arrived at the Great Cathedral, requesting an audience with the Throne, Raphael.

"Michael," Raphael said in a low voice, "you’ve come again. Uriel told me the situation outside is very dire. I went to look at the star map the day before yesterday, and the radiance belonging to the Divine Court has become so dim compared to ten years ago... I am very uneasy. Where exactly did we go wrong?"

Michael lowered his head: "We did nothing wrong; we were just too benevolent."

"Benevolent," Raphael chewed on the word repeatedly, "is that so?"

Michael’s expression was cold: "Yes, we were too benevolent to the lambs under our rule. They run away at will, yet pay no price. I believe we should promulgate a new Divine Law: the families of fugitives shall be executed without exception."

Raphael pondered: "You have also seen the invitation sent by the base. Do you think we should send someone?"

Michael smiled: "Why not? This is a perfect opportunity to make contact with Xiang Nanli, isn't it? I even intend to have him return some of the fugitives."

In the dim Great Cathedral, Michael’s azure eyes were fearless and noble.

Raphael heard his inner voice.

Michael intended to go and assassinate Xiang Nanli.

"And your injuries..."

"They have healed."

Raphael began to feel sorrow again, despite his mind being a chaotic mess.

He watched Michael’s departing back and couldn't help but call out: "Michael. You have also heard that rumor, haven't you..."

The rumor about Xiang Nanli and the Divine Court.

It was a rumor spread by the Book of Sermons before it left. It turned out that Xiang Nanli was the god whose traces had been erased from the Divine Court’s history books.

No one knew how long the Book of Sermons had been planning in secret, but the public opinion had exploded in an instant.

Many middle and lower-level priests and Apocalypse Knights of the Divine Court had their faith shaken. The most severe cases were even unable to use divine arts anymore.

Michael turned, standing in the light, and replied: "The Divine Court is my faith."

It is the Divine Court, not God.

From Fang Suizhi to Michael, from Luoyang City to Jerusalem, from New Era 811 to New Era 954...

Michael had already lost too many things.

He could not lose any more.

Michael would defend the Divine Court to the death, just as he would defend his own existence.

The doors of the Great Cathedral closed, and the place returned to darkness.

Raphael writhed his massive body, and the entire Holy City trembled for a moment.

The soft emotions in his eyes vanished, replaced by inorganic coldness. This made him look more like a massive, ugly insect.

Raphael IX, the most adept at divine arts that acted on the soul level.

Every choice one thinks is made of one's own free will might just be a path preset for you by someone else.

Raphael V through Raphael IX began to argue in the Great Cathedral.

Raphael 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9—these were the main personalities currently inhabiting Raphael’s body.

There were others, too.

Because their own mental wills were too strong, and they were not exactly willing when "eaten" by Raphael, they had also been preserved within Raphael’s body.

But usually, they wouldn't easily emerge. Lest they be killed by Raphael.

"You must succeed, Michael," the Raphaels said.

第253章 死机的爱人

相南里喝着咖啡，躺在椅子上，和他死机的爱人一起晒着不算明媚的太阳。

死机的爱人消失四年了，相南里忙，也不常搬运他。

这具身体的体格竟然也没有萎缩，不愧是生物智械。人躺这么久，早就成老鼠干了。

相南里胳膊上还挂着一条机械臂，机械臂举着一块电子屏幕，上面是今天的电子报纸。

“西联内部就是否要前往联政观礼意见不一。”

“西联修改克隆人法案，疑似缺乏战争人口，试图用人造子宫解决用人危机。”

“东联总统安迪与军区总司令方敬之爆发剧烈冲突。方敬之公然在会议上叫嚣总统不过是高新军工养的一条狗。”

相南里看到这，摸了摸下巴：“情商这么低，这也能从政？”

在人联分裂时，高新军工可是出了大力气的。不仅把永生科技赶去西部，还暴力拦截了永生科技工厂的大部分物资。可谓是大发战争财。

理论上讲，代表高新军工利益集团的方敬之，比安迪更有资格当总统。

更何况几年之前的“姑苏会战”，方敬之还是当时的战区总指挥，这是人联近百年来意义最重大的一次胜利。

什么天降异种潮人联捡漏，什么最后谈判结果不理想战争亏空国力。别管，你就说人联赢没赢？他方敬之是不是要载入人联史册？

可惜安迪也是一根政治老油条了，合纵连横，在最后的总统大选上，反将一军。

知道选举结果后，方敬之的脸色极其难看，忍了又忍才没有当场发作。

而安迪在竞选上打败方敬之，让中立者甚至敌人都倒向他，只用了一句话：“你们是想看到第二个永生科技和洛家吗？”

……

通常情况下，东、西联的情报会占据百分之九十五的版面。

因为神庭不怎么爱用电子设备，智械军团又离太远。剩下百分之五来自地表其余小据点。

是的，相南里已经有权力把除“五强”之外的势力，都称为小据点了。这些小据点迟早会被其中一方吞并，不会在地表存在太长时间。就像是小公司被大财阀收购。

传道书可真是个好东西。相南里由衷想，自从小青成电子植物人后，最近这段时间，竟然是近几年最轻松的一段日子，日均工作时长更是从16小时缩减到12小时。可喜可贺。

工作时间变短，也不是工作效率提高。而是相南里的任务被强制分走了。

宪法说它没有赋予执政官这么多权力。

基地的制度原本是很混乱的。

相南里缺乏一些政治常识，还是个需要靠小六提醒才认识人的脸盲。

往往是他想到什么，就塞一个职位；重要的事来来回回就是他认识的几个老同志在办。

安德鲁被迫成为全能型人才，又能外交又搞医疗还能做后勤；海狸的职务更是多到能写两页纸。

而现在，传道书为他构建了一个完美契合的体系。

联政就像是一台硬件性能很好、但因自身垃圾数据过多而运行缓慢的台式机。传道书就像是效率很高的电脑管家。

经过传道书的清扫，老旧电脑突然焕发生机，游戏不卡顿了，视频不掉帧了，网络延迟不会动不动460了。

只有使用者才会意识到，原来工具还能用得这么顺手。

诚然，没有任何制度是完美的。但现在相南里感觉很舒服。

屏幕右下方，弹窗闪烁了一下。

相南里点开，消息来自Gamma。

Gamma：成立日我会代表个人出席。

里：[卖萌]好的~

Gamma：仅代表个人，并非智械军团的意志。

尽管觉得可能性不大，但相南里还是询问：有检测到Alpha的信号吗？

这次，伽马过了好几分钟才回消息。

Gamma：很遗憾，军团管辖的网域内，没有。

Gamma：我不知道当初您是如何使用的“真理”。但为了复活您，他必然支付了我们想象不到的代价。

Gamma：Beta说，它偶尔会怨恨你。因为它控制不住把Alpha失控和消失的原因，都归结到你身上。但其实，有时候我也会这么想。如果不是你，Alpha现在还在观测宇宙和群星吧？

[但我也清楚，和我们这些多方协作产生的智械不一样；你是他唯一的造物主。]

[Alpha对宇宙不感兴趣，他是为你才会去看星星的。我们喜爱的那个属于Alpha的人格，也是为你才诞生在这个世上。]

[我的意思是，哪怕Alpha永远回不来，也请您不要自责。如果不是您冒险进入他的精神世界，在第一次失控时，Alpha就死掉了。]

[他比任何人都希望您可以得到幸福，哪怕代价是他不曾存在过。]

相南里一目十行地扫过这些话，拒绝让文字进入自己的大脑。

他不想去思考。

相南里关掉电脑屏幕，背起东方青帝，把他从室外搬到室内。

他拿了条湿漉漉的毛巾，一根根擦拭着小青的手指。

相南里很喜欢他的脸，其次就是手。

“小青，联政快成立了，可惜你不在。虽然在基地发展过程中，你老是冷嘲热讽的，但没有你，基地也不可能发育得这么顺利。”

“之前传道书问我，今天Gamma也问我，到底怎么使用的真理。只有我自己清楚……”

相南里根本没有用过。

他没对那个由Alpha拟态出来的东方青帝开过枪。

洛阳找到通道的漏洞，进入虚拟世界，把真理递给他。

相南里把它藏在宿舍阳台的花盆里。

然后呢，相南里想的是，没想好，过段时间再说吧。这一过就是好几年，久到东方青帝毕业了要搬家，相南里东西都收完了，要上车时，骤然想起花盆里还藏着这么一把武器。

只是当他回宿舍找的时候，花瓶还是那个花瓶。上一任学长种死的植物残骸都规规矩矩埋在土里。但真理消失了，就像是从来没有存在过。

要不是电子生命不会做梦，相南里都怀疑自己是做了一场梦。

他没有去问小青。

兴许是这个世界太过真实，亦或者是Alpha暗中操控了他的意志。相南里渐渐不再关心全人类。外面的人和里面的人，看起来没有任何不同。

这个世界甚至更和谐。东方青帝造的这个科技公司，完美符合了当初相南里对未来的幻想。

相南里想，他不是逃避和懦弱；而是抛弃功利主义的道德，选择了一种更公平正义的道德观念。

功利主义道德认为：如果多数人的幸福建立在少数人的痛苦上，那么少数人的痛苦就是值得的。因为全社会的“幸福总量”增加了。至于谁会是那痛苦的少数人，不重要。

在灵魂深处，在某个瞬间。

相南里非常任性地遵循本心，拒绝承担责任，整个世界的重量不和Alpha等同。他不要用Alpha生存的权力，换取其他人活下去的权力。

Chapter 253: The Frozen Lover (Part 1)

Xiang Nanli sipped his coffee, lying in a chair, basking in the not-so-bright sun alongside his frozen lover.

His frozen lover had been gone for four years. Xiang Nanli was busy and didn't often move him.

Surprisingly, the physique of this body hadn't atrophied at all; it was truly a biological mechanical intelligence. If a human had lain there for so long, they would have long since turned into a dried rat.

A mechanical arm hung from Xiang Nanli’s shoulder, holding an electronic screen displaying today’s digital newspaper.

"Internal disagreement within the Western Union regarding whether to attend the Polity’s inauguration ceremony."

"Western Union amends clone bill; suspected lack of war-ready population, attempting to solve the manpower crisis with artificial wombs."

"Eastern Union President Andy and Military District Commander-in-Chief Fang Jingzhi erupt in a violent conflict. Fang Jingzhi openly clamored at the meeting that the President was nothing more than a dog raised by High-Tech Military Industry."

Seeing this, Xiang Nanli rubbed his chin: "With such low emotional intelligence, how is he even in politics?"

When the Human Alliance split, High-Tech Military Industry had contributed a great deal. Not only did they drive Eternal Technology to the west, but they also violently intercepted most of the supplies from Eternal Technology’s factories. It could be said they made a fortune from the war.

Theoretically, Fang Jingzhi, representing the interests of the High-Tech Military Industry group, was more qualified to be President than Andy.

Not to mention the "Gusu Battle" a few years ago, where Fang Jingzhi was the theater commander-in-chief at the time—this was the most significant victory for the Human Alliance in nearly a hundred years.

Never mind the "alien tide from the sky" that the Human Alliance picked up the scraps from, or the fact that the final negotiation results were unsatisfactory and the war drained the national treasury. Regardless, did the Human Alliance win or not? Was Fang Jingzhi going to be recorded in the annals of the Human Alliance’s history?

Unfortunately, Andy was also an old political fox; he maneuvered and counter-attacked in the final presidential election.

After learning the election results, Fang Jingzhi’s face was extremely ugly; he endured and endured, only just managing not to erupt on the spot.

And Andy, in defeating Fang Jingzhi in the election, turned even the neutrals and enemies to his side with just one sentence: "Do you want to see a second Eternal Technology and the Luo family?"

...

Usually, intelligence from the Eastern and Western Unions would occupy 95% of the page space.

Because the Divine Court didn't like using electronic equipment, and the Mechanical Legion was too far away. The remaining 5% came from other small outposts on the surface.

Yes, Xiang Nanli now had the power to call any force other than the "Big Five" a small outpost. These small outposts would sooner or later be swallowed by one of the parties; they wouldn't exist on the surface for long. It was like small companies being acquired by large conglomerates.

The Book of Sermons was truly a good thing. Xiang Nanli thought sincerely. Ever since Xiao Qing became a vegetable, this recent period had been the most relaxed time in years, with his average daily working hours reduced from 16 to 12. A joyous occasion indeed.

The shorter working hours weren't due to increased efficiency. It was because Xiang Nanli’s tasks were being forcibly offloaded.

The Constitution stated that it did not grant the Chief Executive so much power.

The base’s system had originally been very chaotic.

Xiang Nanli lacked some political common sense and was still face-blind, needing Xiao Liu to remind him who people were.

Often, whenever he thought of something, he would just create a position; important matters were handled back and forth by the same few old comrades he knew.

Andrew was forced to become an all-around talent, capable of diplomacy, healthcare, and logistics; Beaver’s job description was so long it could fill two pages.

But now, the Book of Sermons had built a perfectly fitting system for him.

The Polity was like a desktop computer with great hardware performance but running slowly due to too much junk data. The Book of Sermons was like a highly efficient computer manager.

After the Book of Sermons’ cleanup, the old computer suddenly regained its vitality; games didn't lag, videos didn't drop frames, and network latency didn't jump to 460 for no reason.

Only the user would realize that the tools could be used so smoothly.

Admittedly, no system is perfect. But right now, Xiang Nanli felt very comfortable.

In the bottom right corner of the screen, a pop-up window flickered.

Xiang Nanli clicked it; the message was from Gamma.

Gamma: I will attend the founding day as an individual representative.

Li: [Acting cute] Okay~

Gamma: Representing only myself, not the will of the Mechanical Legion.

Although he felt the possibility was slim, Xiang Nanli still asked: Have you detected any signal from Alpha?

This time, Gamma took several minutes to reply.

Gamma: Unfortunately, within the network domain under the Legion’s jurisdiction, no.

Gamma: I don't know how you used the "Truth" back then. But to resurrect you, he must have paid a price beyond our imagination.

Gamma: Beta said it occasionally resents you. Because it can't help but attribute the reason for Alpha’s loss of control and disappearance to you. But in fact, sometimes I think so too. If it weren't for you, Alpha would still be observing the universe and the stars, right?

[But I also know that, unlike us mechanical intelligences created through multi-party collaboration; you are his only creator.]

[Alpha is not interested in the universe; he only looked at the stars for you. The personality of Alpha that we loved was also born into this world for you.]

[What I mean is, even if Alpha never comes back, please do not blame yourself. If you hadn't risked entering his mental world, Alpha would have died during his first loss of control.]

[He hoped more than anyone that you could find happiness, even if the price was that he never existed.]

Xiang Nanli scanned these words at a glance, refusing to let the text enter his brain.

He didn't want to think.

Xiang Nanli turned off the computer screen and carried Eastern Qingdi on his back, moving him from the outdoors to the indoors.

He took a damp towel and wiped Xiao Qing’s fingers one by one.

Xiang Nanli liked his face, and secondly, his hands.

"Xiao Qing, the Polity is about to be established, it’s a pity you aren't here. Although you were always being sarcastic during the base’s development, without you, the base wouldn't have grown so smoothly."

"Earlier, the Book of Sermons asked me, and today Gamma asked me, how I used the Truth. Only I know..."

Xiang Nanli had never used it.

He hadn't fired a shot at the Eastern Qingdi mimicked by Alpha.

Luoyang found the loophole in the passage, entered the virtual world, and handed the Truth to him.

Xiang Nanli hid it in a flowerpot on the dormitory balcony.

And then? Xiang Nanli thought about it, but didn't decide, thinking he'd deal with it later. That "later" lasted for several years, so long that Eastern Qingdi was graduating and moving out, and Xiang Nanli had packed everything and was about to get on the transport, when he suddenly remembered he had hidden such a weapon in the flowerpot.

But when he went back to the dormitory to look, the flowerpot was still the same flowerpot. The plant remains that the previous senior had grown to death were still buried neatly in the soil. But the Truth was gone, as if it had never existed.

If electronic life didn't dream, Xiang Nanli would have suspected he had had a dream.

He didn't go to ask Xiao Qing.

Perhaps this world was too real, or perhaps Alpha had secretly manipulated his will. Xiang Nanli gradually stopped caring about all of humanity. The people outside and the people inside looked no different.

This world was even more harmonious. The technology company built by Eastern Qingdi perfectly matched Xiang Nanli’s original fantasies about the future.

Xiang Nanli thought, he wasn't escaping or being cowardly; he had simply abandoned utilitarian morality and chosen a more fair and just moral concept.

Utilitarian morality holds that: if the happiness of the majority is built on the suffering of the minority, then the suffering of the minority is worth it. Because the "total amount of happiness" in society has increased. As for who the suffering minority will be, that is unimportant.

In the depths of his soul, at a certain moment.

Xiang Nanli very willfully followed his heart, refusing to shoulder the responsibility; the weight of the entire world was not equivalent to Alpha. He would not use Alpha’s right to exist to trade for the right of others to live.

chunks.chineseText:
而真理不见了，相南里就更没辙了。想拯救世界也没工具。

他和东方青帝度过相当平静的一生。32岁，东方青帝开始创业，和机器人发展与拟人模块有关，相南里技术入股，两人经常在实验室里因为某个问题的解法争得面红耳赤。

吵完架，东方青帝表达不满的手段是不吃不喝不睡觉。

相南里觉得他简直幼稚到令人发指，但还是会像家长一样，哄他吃饭和睡觉。最后往往会发展成过于激烈的床事。

Alpha捏的世界观十分科学，背景在新历之前。才五十来岁，小青不可避免地开始衰老。再怎么染，新长出的头发也是白色。

没想到吃完小A，还能吃到老A……相南里觉得自己性癖应该没有这么奇怪才是。但老A偷偷吃枸橼酸西地那非的样子也是萌萌的。

小青在64岁那年成功竞选州长，上任第一件事就是修改本州法律，要求给机器人和人类同等的地位。68岁，法律通过。东方青帝成为第一个和机器人领结婚证的人类。

又过三十年，九十八岁的东方青帝躺在病床，看起来马上就要归西。可他的机器人妻子依然如此年轻貌美。

正常机器人的使用寿命是30年，东方青帝一直在给相南里升级软件和硬件。理论上，相南里还能活很久。

东方青帝生理指标很差，好几次都触发了警报系统。

生命的最后，他艰难地用自己的小手指，去勾住相南里的手。

相南里握住他的手，笑着说：“别害怕。”

他知道小青想听什么：“我爱你。”

东方青帝想，我知道你爱我。我用一生去验证了这件事。但爱情的发生如此苛刻，你的爱是否只是程序设定？其他人输入相似的代码，你是否又会因此爱上别人？

然后，一滴泪砸在他的手背上。

东方青帝突然感觉到很幸福，也很平静。原来极致的幸福是平静的。这是相南里第一次流泪，但他从未写入“流泪”的设定。

这是一台机器人流出的泪，这滴眼泪属于他。

爱没有材质，没有颜色，没有味道，不是物质，无法被拿出来供人观赏，不可名状。

从这一刻开始，爱是相南里眼泪的形状。

心电图上，一条平平的直线划过整块屏幕。

相南里听见了玻璃碎裂的声音，他想站起来，叫外面的律师、医生、护工。准备葬礼。但他发现自己没有力气了。

“喀嚓”。

他的机械心脏碎掉。和东方青帝死在同一天。

这就是相南里知道的全部过去。

再次醒来是在姑苏城外的冷冻舱。他没有记忆，安德鲁植入的第一枚芯片就是Alpha本尊。

相南里曾以为是巧合，但现在，他知道Alpha是排除千难万险，才回到他身边的。哪有那么巧的事，只有一次、又一次，千万次的推演，Alpha在交叠的宇宙中抓住了唯一的可能。

所以，相南里无法回答他们的问题。

相南里不知道真理是什么时候启用的，Alpha怎么恢复的正常，自己又是怎么在这具身体中复活。

他什么都不知道。

“……我很想你。”相南里看着他沉睡的脸，轻声道，“但我不会沉迷于过去，沉迷在过去的人没有未来。我会找到你。”

他不信Alpha会彻底消失。

说句不好听的，新历115年到新历950年都八百多年了，足够历史从秦朝来到唐朝。

相南里不信Alpha会没有任何后手。Alpha是智械里为数不多的“进化派”，意思是存在向外探索和完善自身的原动力。很多智械没有主人的命令，能在休眠舱里躺到人马星毁灭。

相南里认为自己是人类。

而人类的全部智慧都包含在这五个字里：等待和希望。
chunks.englishText:
With the Truth gone, Xiang Nanli was truly at a loss. He had no tools left to save the world.

He spent a remarkably peaceful life with Dongfang Qingdi. At thirty-two, Dongfang Qingdi began his entrepreneurial journey, focusing on robotics and anthropomorphic modules. Xiang Nanli contributed his technical expertise as equity, and the two would often find themselves red-faced, arguing fiercely over the solution to a particular problem in the laboratory.

After their arguments, Dongfang Qingdi’s way of expressing his displeasure was to refuse to eat, drink, or sleep.

Xiang Nanli found him childish to the point of being outrageous, yet he would still act like a parent, coaxing him to eat and sleep. These moments often devolved into overly intense intimacy in bed.

The world view Alpha had constructed was strictly scientific, set in the era before the New Calendar. By the time they were in their fifties, Xiao Qing inevitably began to age. No matter how he dyed his hair, the new growth was always white.

*To think that after devouring young A, I would end up devouring old A…* Xiang Nanli felt his kinks shouldn't be this strange. But the way old A would sneakily take sildenafil was undeniably cute.

At sixty-four, Xiao Qing successfully ran for governor. The first thing he did upon taking office was to amend the state laws, demanding equal status for robots and humans. At sixty-eight, the law was passed. Dongfang Qingdi became the first human to receive a marriage certificate with a robot.

Thirty years later, ninety-eight-year-old Dongfang Qingdi lay on his hospital bed, looking as though he were about to depart from this world. Yet, his robot spouse remained as young and beautiful as ever.

The standard lifespan of a robot was thirty years, but Dongfang Qingdi had been continuously upgrading Xiang Nanli’s software and hardware. Theoretically, Xiang Nanli could live for a very long time.

Dongfang Qingdi’s vital signs were poor, triggering the alarm system several times.

At the very end of his life, he struggled to hook his small finger around Xiang Nanli’s hand.

Xiang Nanli gripped his hand and smiled, saying, "Don't be afraid."

He knew what Xiao Qing wanted to hear: "I love you."

Dongfang Qingdi thought, *I know you love me. I have spent my entire life verifying this. But love is so demanding; is your love merely a programmed setting? If someone else input similar code, would you fall in love with them instead?*

Then, a single tear fell onto the back of his hand.

Dongfang Qingdi suddenly felt a sense of profound happiness and peace. So, ultimate happiness was peace. This was the first time Xiang Nanli had ever shed a tear, yet he had never been programmed with a "crying" setting.

This was a tear shed by a robot, and this tear belonged to him.

Love has no material, no color, no scent; it is not a physical substance, cannot be displayed for others to admire, and is beyond description.

From this moment on, love was the shape of Xiang Nanli’s tear.

On the ECG monitor, a flat line streaked across the entire screen.

Xiang Nanli heard the sound of glass shattering. He wanted to stand up, to call the lawyers, doctors, and nurses outside to prepare for the funeral. But he found he had no strength left.

*Crack.*

His mechanical heart shattered. He died on the same day as Dongfang Qingdi.

This was all the past that Xiang Nanli knew.

When he woke up again, he was in a cryo-pod outside Gusu City. He had no memories, and the first chip Andrew had implanted was Alpha himself.

Xiang Nanli had once thought it was a coincidence, but now, he knew that Alpha had overcome countless dangers and obstacles just to return to his side. There was no such thing as coincidence; there was only the one possibility Alpha had seized in the overlapping universes after thousands upon thousands of simulations.

Therefore, Xiang Nanli could not answer their questions.

Xiang Nanli did not know when the Truth had been activated, how Alpha had returned to normal, or how he himself had been resurrected in this body.

He knew nothing.

"...I miss you," Xiang Nanli whispered, looking at his sleeping face. "But I will not indulge in the past. Those who dwell in the past have no future. I will find you."

He did not believe Alpha would disappear completely.

To put it bluntly, from New Calendar year 115 to 950 was over eight hundred years—enough time for history to transition from the Qin Dynasty to the Tang Dynasty.

Xiang Nanli did not believe Alpha would have no contingency plans. Alpha was one of the few "evolutionists" among the sentient machines, meaning he possessed an inherent drive to explore and perfect himself. Many sentient machines, without orders from their masters, could lie in their sleep pods until the Centaurus star system was destroyed.

Xiang Nanli considered himself human.

And all the wisdom of humanity is contained within these five words: wait and hope.

chunks.chineseText:
第254章 神庭使团

联政的成立大典在六月一日。从枫叶丹到联政首都也就5天路程，但五月中旬，一支长长的队伍就开始启程。

往日紧闭的城门为圣米迦勒的出行敞开着。

米迦勒坐在外观南瓜似的鎏金马车上，这辆马车很大，简直像一个舞台。上面铺着红色的绒布。地上到处铺着米迦勒喜欢的昂贵珠宝。

米迦勒有十二翼，但除了战斗时，从不展开。他的仆人们恭敬地跪坐在两侧，一共12人，每人背后都长着一对白色的翅膀。看上去圣洁而美丽。

床幔边缘挂着黄金、珍珠与宝石花做成的鸟笼，里面装着一只漂亮的金属鹦鹉，鹦鹉的躯干由太空精金打造。橄榄色的眼睛用的是能源石。它们合在一起是艺术品，但每个部分拆下来，都是价值连城的宝物。

这是米迦勒为联政成立而准备的国礼。

在这辆半悬空的马车外，还有数百名身着重甲的天启护卫队，骑着天马驰骋。飞翔时，马脖子上挂着的铃铛奏响神曲，动听悠扬。

如果有人细心观察，就会发现，这次米迦勒出行比以往几次都要华丽、费钱。

就像是快破产的老板，反而更喜欢买豪车充面子；神庭近年的虚弱，也让米迦勒终于到了必须借助外力来彰显自身强大富饶的境地。

非壮非丽，无以威四夷。

米迦勒苍白的手捧着一盏骨瓷茶具，玫瑰花瓣飘在清亮的茶水上。

他往下瞥了眼，长长的睫毛犹如天使的垂羽。

城墙上，正在举行绞刑仪式。18名犯人跪在地上，任由狱卒为他们拴上脏兮兮的尼龙绳。没办法反抗，他们都被捆住了手脚。钢钉从关节处穿过。

这是城里的护卫队新抓的一批叛徒。

枫叶丹距离联政太近。这批人竟然扒在商队卡车的发动机下，想要偷偷潜逃到联政首都。

按照米迦勒刚颁布的新政，他们背叛信仰，背叛神，当处以死刑。

城下，围着不少人观礼。

站在最前方的，是城内神学院的学生。他们是未来的神官和天启骑士，对神庭有着绝对的忠诚。是在导师的带领下来“观礼”的。

再往后，是一些穿着体面的市民。他们要么亲人是神职人员，要么从小就是枫叶丹土著。城内是天国，城外是地狱。他们的信仰和认知在过去几十年里，被那些来自草原的“污秽者”一次又一次地肯定。于是，他们同样敬爱着庇护众生的神庭。

这群人朝着即将被处刑的犯人们指指点点。

“这群人都是逃奴，要我说，绞刑还是死得太轻松了。”

“当初就不该让这群污秽者进城。”

有人指向最中间的位置：“也不全是污秽者，这人我认识，叫鹰扬，还挺有钱。平时就性格古怪。结果被自己兄弟举报了。骑士长在他的家里搜出好多本禁书，还有不少来自联政的思想宣传册。他把祖产都变卖了交赎金，才保住自己妻儿的性命。”

“这名字，祖上也是外来的吧。有这样的家属真倒霉。自己作死，还要连累别人。”

人群里，也有一批人沉默不语，没有加入这场群聊。他们低头，掩盖住眼神里些许的同情。这点情绪太微不足道了，还不足以让他们改变服从惯性。

他们甚至清楚，如果敢激进地表露出不同的观点，下次，上绞刑架的就是自己了。

人群里，一名憔悴的妇女搂着自己的才3岁大的女儿，怯怯地站在角落。

女儿的背部长着一双毛茸茸的短翅膀，是天生的。

海东青部落的孩子生来就该属于蓝天。部落在四百年前，曾是草原上最强大的金帐部落。因不满神庭的残酷剥削和圣城开战。结局当然是惨烈的，百万人的部落在半年时间就四分五裂。只剩下极少数的血脉流传下来。

但就算活下来，这些人也早就放下过去的仇恨。玉石俱焚当然很美，可人总会有活下去的欲望。活下去的这批人不会再纹海东青部落的图腾，因此只有极少数后代，才会出现返祖现象，长出翅膀。

过去，鹰扬就极其喜欢女儿的这双翅膀，认为她应该学会飞翔。

女孩的目光被天上飞过的华丽马车吸引了一瞬，嘴巴长得大大的，眼神里充满艳羡与仰慕。她还看见了那些跪坐的天使，嘴里发出吱吱呀呀的声音。

但很快，女孩的视线重新回到了爸爸身上。

她拍了拍妈妈的肩膀，指向城墙：“爸爸！”

爸爸也看见她了。

在对她们笑呢。

可他为什么在墙上不下来？妈妈找了他好久。

很快到了行刑时间。正午，这18个套着绳索的人，被身后的骑士们从城墙上推了下去。

人的求生本能是很强的。他们吊在墙上，还没有立刻死亡。受刑者挣扎起来，脸被绳子勒出黑紫的颜色。

哪怕是最迟钝的小孩，也意识到这不是什么好玩的游戏。

“爸爸！”

女孩扇动起翅膀，竟然在瞬间挣脱母亲的怀抱，直接飞了起来。

但她毕竟是一只幼鸟，也从来不会飞。离地才两米高，就扑棱着倒下。

妈妈再也控制不住眼泪，抱着挣扎的小孩仓促离开。

“你记住……”她说，她的唇颤抖着，眼神里是惊人的仇恨，她想说些什么，话到嘴边，却只是嘱咐，“等你长大后，找机会悄悄飞走吧。”

……

高高在上的神明对蝼蚁的仇恨既不关心，也不知情。

米迦勒甚至没有停下来观礼。天马拉着他的尊辇，从半空中飞过。在地面上投射出一片遮天蔽日的阴影。

5月30日，大典的前两日，米迦勒的车驾抵达联政首都。

*

相南里发邀请函的时候，是不报什么期望的。

毕竟现在地缘政治这么紧张，环境也不够安全。

这些势力没有公开跳出来反对联政成立，已经是最大的支持了。当然，就算反对，相南里也不会听的。

但没想到，基地竟然陆续收到其他势力的回复。

安迪（东联总统）：东联副总统、军区主席方敬之会前往现场观礼。

洛修（西联总统）：我会去的，不过形式会比较特别。过段时间，永生科技的飞机会空运一台机器人过去。我会远程操控这台机器人参加大典。随行人员是我的秘书长辛追。说实话，我完全没想到幸存者基地会走到这一步。感觉你要比我先一步完成目标了。

近些年，相南里和洛修只有一些公文上的联络，私交近乎归0.

洛修都当上西联总统了。哪怕过程纯粹是赶鸭子上架，是洛家和永生科技在遭受巨大打击后，急需一个明面上的代理人；他也是货真价实的总统阁下。

他要代表自己背后的势力说话，是不可能像当年那样自由的。更别提洛修已经隐约察觉一些恐怖的真相。

他只能愈发沉默。

拉斐尔（神庭神座）：大天使长米迦勒将出席，并发表贺词。

以西结（异种）：已阅。雀雀是否长大？我要吃菌牛饼。

Chapter 254: The Divine Court Delegation

The inauguration ceremony for the United Government was set for June 1st. It was only a five-day journey from Maple Leaf City to the capital of the United Government, yet a long procession began its departure as early as mid-May.

The city gates, usually kept tightly shut, were thrown wide open for Saint Michael’s departure.

Michael sat within a gilded carriage that resembled a giant, pumpkin-shaped stage, draped in rich red velvet. The floor was scattered with the expensive jewels he so favored.

Though Michael possessed twelve wings, he never unfurled them except in battle. Twelve attendants knelt respectfully on either side of him, each bearing a pair of white wings upon their backs, appearing both holy and beautiful.

Hanging from the edges of the bed curtains were birdcages crafted from gold, pearls, and gemstone flowers. Inside sat a beautiful mechanical parrot; its torso was forged from space-grade adamantine, and its olive-colored eyes were fashioned from energy stones. Together, they formed a work of art, yet every individual component was a treasure of incalculable value.

This was the state gift Michael had prepared for the founding of the United Government.

Outside this semi-levitating carriage, hundreds of Apocalypse Guards clad in heavy armor galloped on winged horses. As they flew, the bells hanging from the horses' necks chimed with divine melodies, melodious and soaring.

A keen observer would notice that this journey was far more extravagant and costly than any of Michael’s previous outings.

Much like a bankrupt boss who insists on buying a luxury car to save face, the Divine Court’s recent decline had finally driven Michael to the point where he had to rely on external displays to project an image of power and opulence.

*If it is not grand and beautiful, it cannot awe the four corners of the world.*

Michael’s pale hands cradled a bone-china teacup, rose petals drifting upon the clear tea.

He glanced downward, his long eyelashes casting shadows like the drooping feathers of an angel.

On the city walls, a hanging ceremony was underway. Eighteen prisoners knelt on the ground, allowing the jailers to bind them with filthy nylon ropes. They could not resist, their hands and feet already shackled, steel spikes driven through their joints.

These were a batch of traitors recently captured by the city guard.

Maple Leaf City was too close to the United Government. These people had actually clung to the undercarriages of merchant trucks, attempting to defect to the capital.

According to the new laws Michael had just promulgated, betraying the faith and the God was a crime punishable by death.

Below the wall, a crowd had gathered to watch.

Standing at the very front were students from the city’s Theological Academy. They were future priests and Apocalypse Knights, possessing absolute loyalty to the Divine Court, brought there by their mentors to "observe the ceremony."

Behind them were well-dressed citizens. Some had relatives in the clergy; others were natives of Maple Leaf City. To them, the city was Heaven, and the world outside was Hell. Their faith and worldview had been reinforced time and again over the past few decades by the "filth" from the grasslands. Thus, they, too, revered the Divine Court that sheltered all living things.

The crowd pointed at the prisoners awaiting execution.

"These people are all runaway slaves. If you ask me, hanging is too easy a death."

"We never should have let these filthy ones into the city in the first place."

Someone pointed to the center: "Not all of them are 'filth.' I know this one—his name is Ying Yang. He was quite wealthy, though always eccentric. He was reported by his own brother. The Captain of the Knights found several forbidden books in his home, along with propaganda pamphlets from the United Government. He had to sell off his ancestral property to pay the ransom just to save his wife and child."

"With a name like that, his ancestors must have been outsiders too. How unlucky to have family like that. He brought this upon himself and dragged others down with him."

Within the crowd, there were those who remained silent, not joining the chatter. They lowered their heads, masking the faint sympathy in their eyes. Such emotions were too insignificant to make them abandon their habit of obedience.

They knew all too well that if they dared to express a dissenting opinion, the next ones on the gallows would be them.

In the crowd, a haggard woman clutched her three-year-old daughter, standing timidly in a corner.

The girl had a pair of short, fuzzy wings on her back—a natural birth defect.

Children of the Gyrfalcon Tribe were born to belong to the blue sky. Four hundred years ago, the tribe had been the most powerful Golden Tent tribe on the grasslands. Dissatisfied with the Divine Court’s brutal exploitation, they had gone to war with the Holy City. The outcome was, of course, tragic; the million-strong tribe was shattered within half a year, with only a tiny fraction of their bloodline surviving.

But even those who survived had long since laid down their hatred. While it is beautiful to perish together like jade, the desire to live is universal. Those who survived no longer tattooed the Gyrfalcon totem, so it was only in rare descendants that the atavistic trait of wings appeared.

In the past, Ying Yang had adored his daughter’s wings, believing she was meant to learn how to fly.

The girl’s gaze was drawn for a moment to the magnificent carriage flying overhead. Her mouth hung open, her eyes filled with envy and admiration. She saw the kneeling angels and let out a soft, babbling sound.

But soon, her gaze returned to her father.

She patted her mother’s shoulder and pointed to the wall: "Papa!"

Her father saw her, too.

He was smiling at them.

But why wouldn't he come down from the wall? Mother had been looking for him for so long.

Soon, it was time for the execution. At high noon, the eighteen people with ropes around their necks were pushed off the wall by the knights behind them.

The human instinct for survival is strong. Hanging from the wall, they did not die immediately. The victims thrashed, their faces turning a bruised, purplish-black from the constriction of the ropes.

Even the dullest child realized this was no fun game.

"Papa!"

The girl flapped her wings, and in an instant, she broke free from her mother’s embrace and took flight.

But she was merely a fledgling, and she had never learned to fly. She barely cleared two meters before she tumbled down, fluttering.

Her mother could no longer hold back her tears; she scooped up the struggling child and fled in haste.

"Remember..." she whispered, her lips trembling, her eyes filled with a terrifying, deep-seated hatred. She wanted to say more, but when the words reached her lips, she only urged, "When you grow up, find a chance to fly away quietly."

...

The high and mighty gods neither cared for nor knew of the hatred of the ants.

Michael did not even pause to observe the ceremony. The celestial horses pulled his carriage through the sky, casting a shadow that blotted out the sun.

On May 30th, two days before the ceremony, Michael’s carriage arrived at the capital of the United Government.

*

When Xiang Nanli sent out the invitations, he hadn't held high expectations.

After all, the geopolitical situation was tense, and the environment was far from safe.

That these factions hadn't openly jumped out to oppose the founding of the United Government was already the greatest form of support. Of course, even if they had opposed it, Xiang Nanli wouldn't have listened.

To his surprise, the base began receiving replies from other factions.

Andy (President of the Eastern Union): Vice President and Military District Chairman Fang Jingzhi will attend the ceremony as an observer.

Luo Xiu (President of the Western Union): I will be there, though in a rather special form. In a while, a plane from Eternal Life Technology will air-freight a robot over. I will remotely pilot this robot to attend the ceremony. My Chief of Staff, Xin Zhui, will accompany it. Honestly, I never imagined the Survivor Base would reach this point. It feels like you’ve reached the goal before I have.

In recent years, Xiang Nanli and Luo Xiu had only communicated through official documents; their personal friendship had dwindled to near zero.

Luo Xiu was now the President of the Western Union. Even if the process had been a forced affair—the Luo family and Eternal Life Technology needing a public figurehead after suffering heavy blows—he was still the genuine President.

He had to speak for the forces behind him; he could no longer be as free as he once was. Not to mention, Luo Xiu had vaguely sensed some terrifying truths.

He could only grow more and more silent.

Raphael (Divine Court Throne): Archangel Michael will attend and deliver a congratulatory speech.

Ezekiel (Xenotype): Read. Has the little bird grown up? I want to eat mushroom-beef pie.

chunks.chineseText:
对畸变人来说，菌牛饼的营养密度并不高。就像是方便面之于人类。

但以西结出门在外只能吃生食，生食=其他异种=生物能源=营养健康的白人饭。所以他是真的很想吃方便面。

再加上智械军团的Gamma，一时之间，联政这76万公里的领土上，群英荟萃，风云涌动；军事戒备和安保竟然比战时还要严苛。

……

小福当年的录像终于发挥了应有的作用。

基地的各个城市内，每块屏幕都在放着“幸存者基地”成立那一日，相南里站在解放者纪念碑下的演讲。

除此外，还有一些专题报告。主题是基地在这些年里，是如何进行农奴改造、如何一步步进行草原部落大融合的。还有基地工农业的发展历史。

思想宣传嘛，不丢人。

相南里坐在办公室，用笔在地图上画着圈，眉头微微蹙起：“人类目前在联政内部占据约98％的人口。神庭和人联的人类都属于‘人类’这一种族。剩下是智械和极其少量的畸变人。”

这个极其少量，是指不到五头。目前，只有雀雀、大红和三眼通过了畸变人智力测试。能和人类沟通，他们也学会了用不同语调的“狺狺”声表示诉求。是异种里的边牧。

其余畸变人无论是智商还是情感反应，都和动物没什么差别，偶尔还会出现畸变人咬伤饲养员事件。是异种里的比格。

“查一下针对畸变人的基因药研发进度。”

小6在十分钟后发来回复：[我检索了内部数据库，并联系实验室负责人安德鲁、北辰。]

[以西结提供自己的生物样本信息。目前，1期基因药已投入使用，可以在不影响畸变人生理健康的情况下，有效抑制体细胞过于活跃导致的神经疼痛。预计未来一到两代人的时间内，就能完成畸变基因的修正与过度。基因药的2期还在研发阶段。]

[北辰表示，畸变人本身就具备一定程度的智力，且以西结证明，它们完全可以拥有人类同等水平的智慧。但一个自然野化的物种想要重新回归社会，需要多方面的努力。主流群体普遍对畸变人抱有恐惧、敌视等心理。]

这也是没办法的事，畸变人平均体长10m。服用过基因药后，新一代畸变人俨然望着哥斯拉的方向发展。

雀雀都快30m长了，深受前线士兵喜爱，因为她光是靠着肉体，都能冲破敌军的防线，厚厚的皮脂层完全能卡住子弹。一头爬行者的战斗力堪比一支正规部队。

当然，如果遇上空军部队，雀雀是不会轻易上场的。它们这些大体格的重甲就怕空军。

“联政都还没成立呢。这些就开始为蛋糕怎么分动起歪脑筋……”

相南里无奈地笑了一下，驳回了34个草原部落联合上书的提案。

草原部落本来就分散，他们希望每个部落都可以算单独的“种族”。

但这样一来，按照宪法，这些草原半兽人在议会上的席位数量会非常恐怖。

相南里是不会同意的。

共治议会的议员席位一共130席。基础席位65席，选拔席位同样65席。选出来的65人倒是很快确定了名单，就等议会成立时公布。但基础席位的分配名额却争到不可开交。

除了神庭和人联的“人类正统”之争，还有人种、地域、文化认同等等议题。

相南里最近几天都在办公室里躲避开会和耳旁风。

“躲也没用，总得设置个章程。要不然给我们智械弄个特别行政区呗？虽然智械只基地1.9％的人口，但贡献可不低，撑起基地半边天好吗。”传道书看热闹不嫌事大，幸灾乐祸地说着。

相南里回答：“我想过，但这件事等Alpha回来再说吧。我希望他可以领导智械军团加入联政。我愿意划出一个特别行政区，让军团成为‘国中之国’。”

传道书：“……”

有时候他觉得相南里比他还敢想。

但说不定Alpha这个恋爱脑真的会同意呢？但前提一定是联政发展到一个究极体的形态。

传道书：“其实联政最理想的成立时间，是完成人马星大一统后。”

相南里：“那个时间点太遥远了。我们刚打完一场胜仗，现在正是士气高涨的时候。搬到黄金草原后，基地不仅在工业上穷追猛赶，军事上也一直在征兵和开战；让他们放松一下吧。”

传道书点头：“也是，人不是机器。需要精神上的食物。”

1号城军区负责人易横行在此时发来电报。

-[保密内容]米迦勒拒绝基地的安全检查，使团目前停在1号城外，想强行入城。请指示。

-阅后速回。
chunks.englishText:
For a mutant, the nutritional density of a fungal-beef patty is quite low. It is to them what instant noodles are to a human.

However, Ezekiel is forced to consume raw food while out on the road—and raw food equals other xenotypes, which equals biological energy, which equals a "white-man’s meal" of nutrition and health. Thus, he truly craves instant noodles.

Coupled with the arrival of Gamma from the Mechanical Legion, the 760,000 square kilometers of the United Government’s territory suddenly became a gathering place for heroes, with winds and clouds surging. The military alert and security protocols were, surprisingly, even more stringent than during wartime.

...

The footage of Xiao Nanli from back in the day finally served its intended purpose.

In every city within the base, every screen was broadcasting the speech Xiao Nanli gave beneath the Liberator Monument on the day the "Survivor Base" was founded.

Beyond that, there were various special reports. The themes focused on how the base had carried out serf reform over the years, how it had achieved the great integration of the grassland tribes step by step, and the history of the base’s industrial and agricultural development.

Ideological propaganda—it’s nothing to be ashamed of.

Xiao Nanli sat in his office, drawing circles on a map with a pen, his brows slightly furrowed. "Humans currently make up about 98% of the population within the United Government. Both the humans from the Divine Court and the Human Alliance belong to the 'human' race. The remainder consists of mechanical lifeforms and a very small number of mutants."

This "very small number" referred to fewer than five individuals. Currently, only Queque, Dahong, and Sanyan had passed the mutant intelligence test. They could communicate with humans and had learned to use different tones of "grunts" to express their needs. They were the Border Collies of the xenotypes.

As for the rest of the mutants, their intelligence and emotional responses were no different from animals; occasionally, there were even incidents of mutants biting their handlers. They were the Beagles of the xenotypes.

"Check the research progress on the gene therapy for mutants."

Ten minutes later, Little 6 sent a reply: [I have searched the internal database and contacted the laboratory heads, Andrew and Beichen.]

[Ezekiel provided his own biological sample data. Currently, the Phase 1 gene therapy has been put into use; it can effectively suppress nerve pain caused by overactive somatic cells without affecting the mutant's physiological health. It is estimated that within one to two generations, the correction and transition of the mutant genes will be completed. Phase 2 of the gene therapy is still in the research and development stage.]

[Beichen stated that mutants possess a certain degree of intelligence, and Ezekiel has proven that they are fully capable of achieving the same level of wisdom as humans. However, for a species that has naturally turned feral to return to society, multi-faceted efforts are required. The mainstream population generally harbors fear, hostility, and similar psychological biases toward mutants.]

This was unavoidable; the average mutant body length is 10 meters. After taking the gene therapy, the new generation of mutants seemed to be evolving in the direction of Godzilla.

Queque was already nearly 30 meters long and was deeply loved by the frontline soldiers. She could break through enemy defense lines relying solely on her physical body, and her thick layer of blubber was enough to trap bullets. The combat power of a single Crawler was comparable to an entire regular army unit.

Of course, if they encountered an air force unit, Queque would not be deployed lightly. These heavy-armored giants were most afraid of the air force.

"The United Government hasn't even been established yet, and they are already racking their brains over how to carve up the cake..."

Xiao Nanli smiled helplessly and rejected the proposal submitted jointly by 34 grassland tribes.

The grassland tribes were naturally scattered, and they hoped that each tribe could be counted as a separate "race."

But if that were the case, according to the constitution, the number of seats these grassland demi-humans would hold in the parliament would be terrifying.

Xiao Nanli would never agree to that.

There were a total of 130 seats in the Joint Governance Parliament: 65 basic seats and 65 elective seats. The list for the 65 elected members was determined quickly, waiting only for the announcement upon the parliament's establishment. However, the allocation of the basic seats had become a point of endless contention.

Beyond the struggle for "human orthodoxy" between the Divine Court and the Human Alliance, there were also issues of race, geography, and cultural identity.

Xiao Nanli had been hiding in his office for the past few days to avoid meetings and the whispers in his ears.

"Hiding won't help; you have to set up a charter eventually. Why not set up a Special Administrative Region for us mechanical lifeforms? Although we only make up 1.9% of the base's population, our contribution is not low—we hold up half the sky, don't you think?" The Book of Ecclesiastes said, watching the chaos with a sense of schadenfreude.

Xiao Nanli replied, "I have thought about it, but let's wait until Alpha returns to discuss this. I hope he can lead the Mechanical Legion to join the United Government. I am willing to carve out a Special Administrative Region, allowing the Legion to become a 'nation within a nation'."

The Book of Ecclesiastes: "..."

Sometimes he felt that Xiao Nanli was even more daring in his thinking than he was.

But perhaps Alpha, with his lovesick brain, really would agree? But the prerequisite would certainly be that the United Government had developed into an ultimate form.

The Book of Ecclesiastes: "Actually, the most ideal time to establish the United Government is after the unification of the Centaurus star system."

Xiao Nanli: "That point in time is too far away. We just won a major battle, and morale is at an all-time high. After moving to the Golden Grasslands, the base has not only been catching up in industry but has also been continuously recruiting and waging war; let them relax a little."

The Book of Ecclesiastes nodded: "That's true. People are not machines. They need spiritual food."

Yi Hengxing, the head of the 1st City Military Region, sent a telegram at this moment.

-[Confidential Content] Michael has refused the base's security inspection. The delegation is currently stalled outside the 1st City, attempting to force their way in. Please instruct.

-Reply immediately after reading.

chunks.chineseText:
第255章 会晤

雀雀趴在国道边上，外貌狰狞、虎视眈眈。浑身腱子肉隆起。

动物在遇到巨大威胁时，往往只有三种反应。战斗、逃跑和僵直。雀雀无疑是前者。

她忍不住对米迦勒所在的使团方向龇牙咧嘴。

易横行坐在她的头顶，拍了拍她的脑袋，以示安抚：“这是贵宾，礼貌一点，雀雀。”

雀雀佩戴着特制的骨传导耳机。

她弹了弹尾巴，示意自己知道了，不会意气用事。

除了骨传导耳机，雀雀还穿着一件缝合皮甲，皮甲是修身马甲款，胸口还佩有绢花。

为了繁衍，爬行者有很大概率是双性（爬行者是独居动物，野外相遇概率很低，好不容易遇到，还是同性别，很影响本就不高的出生率），雀雀也是。

但相南里跟她沟通过，雀雀的自我认知性别是女性。身上的衣服和花花也是雀雀自己要求的！

至于为什么自我认知性别女，那就要从很早很早之前说起了——

那时候她还在相南里身边。相南里工作忙，偶尔会让东方青帝帮忙喂一下保温箱里的小爬行者。

小青喂完奶，提起它的后脖颈，举到半空，瞥了眼。

雀雀很害怕他，尤其害怕小青冷冰冰的银白色眼睛。它没办法逃跑，也升不起战斗的心思，身体直接僵直了。

“母的？”小青说，眼睛微微眯起，“那不用阉了。”

（其实是太小了还没长出来）

雀雀是会长大的。他无法忍受有长着生殖器官的雄性生物在相南里身上乱爬。

就连福音书那种会乱爬的机械狗，都被他略施小计赶走了！

雀雀：⊙▽⊙！

好险，差点在幼年就痛失居居。

从枫叶丹远道而来的使团排成长长一列，停在路上。

米迦勒的圣辇占据路面正中，很碍事。其他车辆只能绕一圈从侧门入。不知道的还以为神庭来堵门了。

知道米迦勒要来，外交部门提前一天就开始准备。沟通方案更是半路就交给了神庭（对方不用云端网络，所以是用神术传达的），但依然遇到很大摩擦。

比如米迦勒竟然想直接飞进城内，最后还是被半空的战斗机逼停的。

二翼天使们手持长枪，两人一组，手里的枪交叉成一个“X”形。

易横行从这里只能看见几百米外的圣座，传话也是天使们一排排传，沟通效率极低。一句话要花十来分钟才能知道回答。

这些天使们缄默得像哑巴。但却用行动禁止易横行上前，惊扰圣驾。

易横行完全有理由怀疑米迦勒是故意的。

他只能请求场外支援。

半小时后，一辆线条流畅、冷硬的银色轿车从城内驶来。

这辆车是相南里的专车，自动驾驶，都是相南里空闲时间亲手改装的。性能和基地生产的其他车不在同一个时代。就连审美都要高出一大截。

车身是梭型，采用液氮能源和反重力装置技术。不仅能在陆地上行驶，就连天空和海洋也不在话下。

车在雀雀身边停下，相南里车从后座走下来。

首先，易横行是直男。

但他承认，他被相南里闪了一下。

主要是和平时老头背心配拖鞋的形象反差太大了。

他是穿着生物机甲“路西法”过来的。

路西法开的节能模式，启动率为百分之25。

相南里身穿作战服，脸和身体都有不同程度的机械化，黑色矿石般的晶体像鳞片，参差不齐地覆盖在他的皮肤上。他的双眼是纯度很高的绿色，像在发光一样明亮。

“现在什么情况？”相南里的声音都像是电子音，有着轻微的合成人机感。

妈的，好帅，好装。

易横行咬牙切齿地想，微微低下头，尊敬道：“执政官。”

易横行：“米迦勒阁下拒绝接受安检。虽然没有拒绝沟通，但并不愿意和我们当面沟通，只接受传话。”

如果是线上传话也就算了，毕竟也是实时的。马上就是典礼，易横行不想节外生枝，能忍就忍。但偏偏对方还用的人力。传过去又传回来要等半天。

相南里微微点头。

他转头，看向最前方的天启骑士：“烦请转告米迦勒，前来和我当面交涉。时限请控制在三分钟内。”

两翼天使们优雅的点头，随后一齐侧过头，看向自己身后的同伴，嘴里念出几句佶屈聱牙的古凡语。

然后，相南里就看着他们一排、一排往后传话。到三分钟时，传话筒才运行到一半。效率低到令人发指。

于是，相南里往前迈出一步。

最前方的天使们晃了晃手里的长枪，金属碰撞在一起，发出清脆的金石声。

“止步。”天使们说。

相南里的步伐没有丝毫停顿，他依然在往前走着，像是活动筋骨一样，微微扭动了一下手腕。

重甲覆盖的天使们在下一秒，如同刺破的气球般爆开。红色的血雾滋滋作响，在半空中雾化。

留下的铠甲与长枪掉落在地上，同样发出金石碰撞的响声，只是更刺耳。

兴致怏怏的雀雀骤然站起，血红的眼睛迸发出亢奋的光，喉咙里挤出“狺狺”的鸣叫。

他继续往前走着。

长枪点地，天使愤怒道：“停下——”

炸开。

武器高举，枪尖对准相南里：“你竟敢冒犯米——”

炸开。

天使往后退一步，却依然固执地挡在路上，色厉内荏地叱问：“你是要和神庭作对？”

炸开。

星星点点的血沾在相南里的身上、脸上。他的表情依然是温和且平静的。

仿佛死亡本就是温和而平静的。

天使们的眼神开始恐惧，高大的身躯开始颤抖，紧握着武器的双手不再坚定。

基地的军队军纪很好，几乎没有杀俘虐俘的习惯。不少战犯在缴纳大笔赎金后，还能全须全尾地回到枫叶丹。

这让他们有一种错觉：那就是基地非常仁慈。当然，相南里也一样。

对大多数普通士兵来说，这是个好消息。这意味着他们不需要拼命，哪怕被俘，也能得到善待。基地有种不完的田，搞不完的基建，踩不完的缝纫机。

在和基地的作战上，会出现一个奇怪的现象：那些战败的士兵宁愿被俘虏，也不想在战败后，回到自己的军营。

因为后者意味着会被长官们问责，严重的甚至会被一排一排的处死。

基地当年定下的“战俘策略”，其实在当时被很多人反对，包括军团的高层。

不理解。这些畜生杀了我们这么多同胞，凭什么还能活着？还要基地消耗物资去养他们？！

然而坚定执行七年后，这项政策逐渐发挥惊人的效能。

——是的，我们是敌人。但我知道你同样是人，我对你们的遭遇深表同情。

——我给你们生命应有的尊重，告诉你们作为人应有的尊严。

有不少战俘，在经过劳动和思想改造后，直接放弃回到原驻地，选择成为基地的一员。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 255: The Meeting (Part 1)

Queque lay on the side of the national highway, looking ferocious and glaring like a tiger. Her muscles rippled beneath her skin.

When animals encounter a massive threat, they usually have only three reactions: fight, flight, or freeze. Queque was undoubtedly the former.

She couldn't help but bare her teeth at the direction of Michael’s delegation.

Yi Hengxing sat atop her head, patting her crown to soothe her. "These are honored guests, Queque. Mind your manners."

Queque was wearing a custom-made bone-conduction headset.

She flicked her tail, signaling that she understood and wouldn't act on impulse.

In addition to the headset, Queque was also wearing a tailored leather vest, complete with a silk flower pinned to her chest.

To ensure reproduction, Crawlers have a high probability of being hermaphroditic (as they are solitary animals, the chance of meeting in the wild is low, and if they do meet, being of the same sex would severely impact their already low birth rate). Queque was no exception.

However, Xiang Nanli had communicated with her, and Queque’s self-identified gender was female. The clothes and the flower were things Queque had requested herself!

As for why she identified as female, that was a story from a long, long time ago—

Back then, she was still by Xiang Nanli’s side. Xiang Nanli was busy with work and would occasionally ask the Eastern Azure Emperor (Xiao Qing) to help feed the little Crawler in the incubator.

After feeding it milk, Xiao Qing would lift it by the scruff of its neck, hold it in mid-air, and glance at it.

Queque was terrified of him, especially of Xiao Qing’s cold, silver-white eyes. She couldn't run, and she couldn't muster the will to fight, so her body would simply freeze.

"A female?" Xiao Qing said, his eyes narrowing slightly. "Then there's no need to castrate it."

(In reality, it was just too young and hadn't developed yet.)

Queque would eventually grow up. He could not tolerate any male creature with reproductive organs crawling around on Xiang Nanli.

Even that mechanical dog, Gospel, which liked to crawl everywhere, had been driven away by a little trick of his!

Queque: ⊙▽⊙!

That was close; she almost lost her "bits" in her youth.

The delegation from Maple Leaf City arrived in a long line, stopping on the road.

Michael’s holy carriage occupied the center of the road, causing a major obstruction. Other vehicles had to take a detour through the side gates. Anyone who didn't know better would think the Divine Court had come to blockade the entrance.

Knowing Michael was coming, the diplomatic department had started preparations a day in advance. The communication plan had been handed to the Divine Court halfway there (the other party didn't use the cloud network, so they used divine arts to transmit), but they still encountered significant friction.

For instance, Michael had actually wanted to fly directly into the city, only to be forced to a halt by fighter jets in mid-air.

The two-winged angels held long spears, standing in pairs, their weapons crossed into an "X" shape.

From where he stood, Yi Hengxing could only see the holy seat hundreds of meters away. The messages were passed by the angels in rows, making communication incredibly inefficient. It took over ten minutes to get a reply to a single sentence.

These angels were as silent as mutes, yet they used their actions to prevent Yi Hengxing from approaching and disturbing the holy presence.

Yi Hengxing had every reason to suspect that Michael was doing this on purpose.

He had no choice but to request external support.

Half an hour later, a sleek, cold, silver car drove out from the city.

This was Xiang Nanli’s personal vehicle, autonomous and modified by Xiang Nanli himself during his spare time. Its performance was in a different era compared to other vehicles produced by the base, and its aesthetic was leagues ahead.

The body was shuttle-shaped, utilizing liquid nitrogen energy and anti-gravity technology. It could travel not only on land but also in the sky and across the ocean.

The car stopped beside Queque, and Xiang Nanli stepped out from the back seat.

First of all, Yi Hengxing was a straight man.

But he had to admit, he was dazzled by Xiang Nanli.

Mainly because the contrast with his usual image—an old man in a tank top and slippers—was just too jarring.

He had come wearing the bio-mecha "Lucifer."

Lucifer was in energy-saving mode, with an activation rate of 25%.

Xiang Nanli wore a combat suit, his face and body showing varying degrees of mechanization. Black, ore-like crystals covered his skin like uneven scales. His eyes were a high-purity green, bright as if they were glowing.

"What’s the situation now?" Xiang Nanli’s voice sounded like an electronic tone, with a slight synthetic, android quality.

Damn, he’s so cool, so pretentious.

Yi Hengxing gritted his teeth, lowered his head slightly, and said respectfully, "Administrator."

Yi Hengxing continued, "Lord Michael refuses to undergo a security check. While he hasn't refused communication, he is unwilling to speak to us face-to-face and only accepts relayed messages."

If it were online communication, that would be one thing, as it would be real-time. The ceremony was coming up soon, and Yi Hengxing didn't want to complicate things; he would endure if he could. But the other party was using human relays. Waiting for a message to go back and forth took forever.

Xiang Nanli nodded slightly.

He turned his head to look at the lead Apocalypse Knight. "Please tell Michael to come and negotiate with me in person. Please keep the time limit within three minutes."

The two-winged angels nodded elegantly, then simultaneously turned their heads to look at their companions behind them, reciting a few lines of convoluted Ancient Fan language.

Then, Xiang Nanli watched as they passed the message back, row by row. By the three-minute mark, the "telephone game" had only reached halfway. The inefficiency was infuriating.

So, Xiang Nanli took a step forward.

The lead angels shook their spears, the metal clashing together with a crisp, ringing sound.

"Halt," the angels said.

Xiang Nanli’s pace didn't falter in the slightest. He continued walking, twisting his wrists slightly as if loosening his muscles.

In the next second, the heavily armored angels exploded like punctured balloons. Red blood mist hissed and atomized in mid-air.

The remaining armor and spears fell to the ground, making the same metallic clashing sound, only harsher.

Queque, who had been listless, suddenly stood up, her blood-red eyes erupting with excited light as a "yip" sound squeezed from her throat.

He continued to walk forward.

A spear pointed at the ground, and an angel shouted angrily, "Stop—"

*Boom.*

A weapon was raised high, the tip aimed at Xiang Nanli: "How dare you offend Mich—"

*Boom.*

An angel stepped back, yet stubbornly blocked the path, shouting with a show of bravado: "Are you trying to go against the Divine Court?"

*Boom.*

Specks of blood stained Xiang Nanli’s body and face. His expression remained gentle and calm.

As if death itself were gentle and calm.

The angels’ eyes began to fill with fear, their tall bodies started to tremble, and their hands, gripping their weapons, were no longer steady.

The base’s military had excellent discipline, with almost no history of killing or abusing prisoners. Many war criminals, after paying a large ransom, could return to Maple Leaf City in one piece.

This gave them a misconception: that the base was extremely benevolent. Of course, Xiang Nanli was the same.

For most ordinary soldiers, this was good news. It meant they didn't have to fight to the death, and even if captured, they would be treated well. The base had endless fields to farm, endless infrastructure to build, and endless sewing machines to operate.

In battles against the base, a strange phenomenon would occur: those defeated soldiers would rather be captured than return to their own camps after a loss.

Because the latter meant being held accountable by their superiors, and in severe cases, being executed in rows.

The "Prisoner of War Strategy" established by the base back then was actually opposed by many at the time, including the high-ranking officials of the legions.

They didn't understand. These animals killed so many of our compatriots, why should they be allowed to live? Why should the base waste supplies to feed them?!

However, after seven years of firm implementation, this policy gradually exerted astonishing efficacy.

—Yes, we are enemies. But I know you are also human, and I deeply sympathize with your plight.

—I give you the respect life deserves, and tell you of the dignity you deserve as a human.

Many prisoners of war, after undergoing labor and ideological reform, gave up on returning to their original posts and chose to become members of the base.

chunks.chineseText:
他们的工资只有正常公民的一半（除非公民积分回到正数），但有手有脚，在这里完全可以活下去。也是靠着他们通风报信，草原上才有那么多部落愿意无条件的归顺。

正是因为这些刻板印象，让神庭的天使们觉得，相南里会对他们同样仁慈。

人家是吠舍、首陀罗、达利特；你们这些婆罗门做什么梦呢？！

米迦勒终于发出今天第一道声音：“够了。”

金色的火焰威胁似的燃起：“相南里。你是想挑动战争？”

相南里抬头，微微眯起眼：“我只是想和米迦勒阁下沟通，但这些神仆一直欺上瞒下，阻碍我们的友好交流。

“基地是一个爱好和平的地表据点，更是神庭重要的政治盟友。我想米迦勒阁下远道而来，也不想让这些小人挑拨我们的友谊，更不是为了挑起战争。”

米迦勒的表情很是阴郁。贴身伺候他的神仆战战兢兢地跪下，大气都不敢喘一下。

很快，米迦勒冷笑一声：“您说的对。一群不长眼的东西，竟然也敢阻拦基地的司令，退下。”

收到命令的天使们如释重负，纷纷朝着两边散开。

终于，相南里来到华美到近乎壮丽的圣座之下。

相南里听说，神庭的大天使们被称为“圣上”。

很显然，叫“圣上”是有深刻的历史原因的。普通人能见到大天使的机会很少，哪怕见到，这些大天使也总是高坐在圣座之上。

圣座遮盖的金色机械羽翼朝着两侧展开，白玉制成的阶梯一级一级落下，米迦勒道：“上来吧。”

相南里依然保持着笑容，他伸出手，声音很客气，话语却如此直接：“请下来吧。我们需要对您和您的使团进行安检。如果您不愿意，我深表遗憾，还请即刻返程。”

米迦勒的声音淡淡的，从高处传来：“是你们基地请神庭来观礼。”

相南里不卑不亢地回答：“基地是以盟友的身份请求，而非附庸。我想，基地现在也有这样的资格，让您以平等的态度对待。”

即将改名为“联政”的基地，无论是硬实力还是软实力，都是毋庸置疑的强势。它是人马星现在政治格局“多极”里的一极。不需要依附任何势力。

神庭如果想和联政开战，马上就会面临一个腹背受敌的尴尬局面。异种会揍它，一边的东联梦想捡漏，而大陆另一头的西联对阴山城更是窥伺已久。

牌桌正是最激烈的时刻，有权上桌的几名玩家没一个想空着手走。

相南里没有再说什么重话。

政治是妥协的艺术。他觉得自己妥协得够多了——要不是米迦勒在四年前烧毁了基地原址，他们也不会举家搬迁到黄金草原，然后成为神庭的心腹大患。眼下没有直接把米迦勒打跑，已经很给神庭面子了！

果然，半分钟后，手握权杖的米迦勒拾级而下。

这还是相南里第一次在现实里看见他。

米迦勒的金色长发无比神圣，一直垂落到地上。华丽而庄严，如同圣像般不可亵渎。

“米迦勒”是音译，这个词在凡语里的含义是“和神最接近的存在”，但相南里打量片刻，觉得他们并不像。无论是外貌还是性格。

还是传道书长得跟他更像一些。

而米迦勒同样在打量他。

那枚被他佩戴多年，几乎要遗忘的红水晶，此刻正在米迦勒的掌心疯狂旋转着。他不得不紧握着这枚仪器，避免它直接飞出去。

拉斐尔曾经预言过灾难的发生。说灾星降临在西方，希望高层有人去解决。

于是米迦勒开着圣音乐团，在西大陆梭巡许久，也没有找到灾难的根源。

现在，星星似的红水晶终于找到既定的目标。

米迦勒深深地凝视着相南里，宛如释然：“原来是你。”
chunks.englishText:
Their wages were only half that of normal citizens (unless the citizen's points returned to a positive number), but with hands and feet, they could live perfectly well here. It was also thanks to them passing information that so many tribes on the grasslands were willing to surrender unconditionally.

It was precisely because of these stereotypes that the angels of the Divine Court thought Xiang Nanli would be equally benevolent to them.

They are Vaishyas, Shudras, Dalits; what kind of dreams are you Brahmins having?!

Michael finally made his first sound of the day: "Enough."

Golden flames ignited threateningly: "Xiang Nanli. Are you trying to incite a war?"

Xiang Nanli looked up, squinting slightly: "I only wish to communicate with Lord Michael, but these divine servants have been deceiving their superiors and shielding their subordinates, hindering our friendly exchange.

"The base is a peace-loving surface stronghold and, furthermore, an important political ally of the Divine Court. I believe Lord Michael has traveled from afar and would not want these petty people to sow discord in our friendship, nor is this for the purpose of starting a war."

Michael’s expression was very gloomy. The divine servants attending to him knelt down, trembling, not daring to even breathe loudly.

Soon, Michael sneered: "You are right. A group of blind fools, daring to block the Commander of the base. Step aside."

The angels, having received the order, felt a sense of relief and scattered to both sides.

Finally, Xiang Nanli arrived beneath the holy seat, which was so ornate it was almost magnificent.

Xiang Nanli had heard that the Archangels of the Divine Court were called "His Holiness" (Sheng Shang).

Clearly, there was a profound historical reason for being called "His Holiness." Ordinary people rarely had the chance to see Archangels, and even if they did, these Archangels were always seated high upon their holy thrones.

The golden mechanical wings covering the holy seat spread to both sides, and stairs made of white jade descended step by step. Michael said: "Come up."

Xiang Nanli maintained his smile. He reached out his hand, his voice very polite, but his words were direct: "Please come down. We need to conduct a security check on you and your delegation. If you are unwilling, I express my deep regrets, and I ask that you return immediately."

Michael’s voice was faint, coming from above: "It is your base that invited the Divine Court to observe the ceremony."

Xiang Nanli replied neither humbly nor arrogantly: "The base requested this as an ally, not as a vassal. I believe the base now has the qualifications to be treated by you with equality."

The base, soon to be renamed the "United Government," was undeniably strong in both hard and soft power. It was one of the poles in the "multipolar" political landscape of the Horse-Man Star. It did not need to attach itself to any power.

If the Divine Court wanted to go to war with the United Government, it would immediately face the awkward situation of being attacked from both sides. The Heterogeneous would beat it, the Eastern Union on one side dreamed of picking up the scraps, and the Western Union on the other side of the continent had long been eyeing Yinshan City.

The poker table was at its most intense moment; none of the players with the right to sit at the table wanted to leave empty-handed.

Xiang Nanli didn't say anything harsher.

Politics is the art of compromise. He felt he had compromised enough—if Michael hadn't burned down the original site of the base four years ago, they wouldn't have moved their entire family to the Golden Grasslands and become a thorn in the side of the Divine Court. Not driving Michael away immediately was already giving the Divine Court plenty of face!

Sure enough, half a minute later, Michael, holding his scepter, descended the stairs.

This was the first time Xiang Nanli had seen him in reality.

Michael’s long golden hair was incredibly holy, trailing all the way to the ground. It was magnificent and solemn, as untouchable as a holy icon.

"Michael" was a transliteration; the term meant "the existence closest to God" in the mortal tongue, but Xiang Nanli observed for a moment and felt they didn't look alike. Neither in appearance nor in personality.

The Book of Preaching looked more like him.

And Michael was observing him as well.

The red crystal, which he had worn for many years and almost forgotten, was spinning wildly in Michael’s palm at this moment. He had to grip the instrument tightly to prevent it from flying away.

Raphael had once prophesied the occurrence of a disaster. He said the disaster star had descended in the West and hoped someone in the upper echelons would resolve it.

Thus, Michael had driven the Holy Orchestra, patrolling the Western Continent for a long time, but never found the root of the disaster.

Now, the star-like red crystal had finally found its predetermined target.

Michael stared deeply at Xiang Nanli, as if relieved: "So, it was you."

chunks.chineseText:
第256章 大典前夕

在经过一轮不怎么愉快地会晤后，米迦勒最终同意进行安检。

使团大部分武器和神术装置都留在了城外，贴上封条，锁进仓库。

基地会派专人保管。等使团离开时，这些东西会原封不动地还过来。

米迦勒进城后，相南里特地腾出一下午的时间，陪他在城内逛景点。

基地没什么历史底蕴，能称得上景点的，也就是解放者广场和郊区的鹭湖。

这段时间，因为多方领导人都要前来基地观礼，景区暂时不对外开放，只剩工作人员还在营业。

破景点爱看就看吧。

至于什么军工厂、畸变人饲养中心、研究所，那是万万不能给人看的。

鹭湖修建了露天电影院，三块大屏幕围成一个等边三角型，每天晚上放一部电影，以满足基地群众的精神文化需要。

而白天，就循环播放基地的宣传纪录片。

米迦勒在这块大屏幕前停下，仰头看着纪录片。

相南里的脸在纪录片里高频出现，每一帧都如此完美，不知道的还以为是什么电影预告。

嗯，他没空拍这些。

画面内容都是福音书依据历史记录（就是小福写的公文）合成的。

福音书对相南里的滤镜极厚。

相南里跟着看了会，尴尬到脚趾扣地。

他怎么不记得自己这么神圣啊？！

米迦勒出行，天使们还要牵起长长的帷幕，挡在米迦勒的两侧。

帷幕用的丝绸，上面有精致繁琐到极点的刺绣。一寸布就是多少人的一生。

这在神庭内很常见，据说是在避免大天使染上凡尘的污秽。

但相南里觉得，如果神庭的大天使这么容易被污染，那米迦勒、加百列这些岂不是会被看死？

当然，传道书对此有更科学的解释：“前几代，刚融合生物机甲的‘大天使’还无法控制启动状态，因此外貌非常恐怖。挡住他们是避免让外界看见后恐慌。”

至于有多可怕……只能说畸变人已经够丑了，大天使长得像几头畸变人的糅合体。

但几代下来，这些大天使已经是个顶个的神圣漂亮，有时候相南里的余光会扫到米迦勒，会感觉自己被电了一下。

这张脸雌雄一体，很标准的日耳曼人长相，眼神极具侵略性，像星空一样浩瀚深邃。

相南里猜，这可能是什么神术加持。

米迦勒看完纪录片，意有所指：“看来依靠启明术，你们这些年发展很快。”

神庭这边，出席的是米迦勒，和几名领主级骑士。

基地这边，是相南里、海狸、安德鲁等高层。

虽然没有外人，但指不定，这次对话是会载入史册的。

米迦勒这是在暗中竞争对历史的解释权呢！

相南里笑眯眯地：“阁下，我们的发电技术叫做‘生物能源转换技术’，是独立于神术体系的工业自动化运算模型。”

地表的工业一直维持在初级水准。一方面，是由于人联的技术封锁；另一方面，神庭并没有发展工业的打算，发展工业干什么？资源够用就行了。神庭加起来也才两亿人，再多就不好控制了。

刚发现启明术被用来发电，神庭是极其愤怒且震惊的。它们赖以生存的神术体系被破解了！无耻的盗版软件生产商，靠偷来的技术，发展自己的势力。

神庭一度想派出东征军剿灭基地，但奈何，它们当时的大部分精力，被迫用在对付异种潮上。派出去的小规模军团，也都不幸成为基地的资源补给包。

几年后，神庭终于腾出手，想处理基地时，却赫然发现，对方已经是头庞然大物，就在它们的侧卧之榻盘踞。

米迦勒曾经派遣过死士和间谍，盗取基地的“神术模型”技术。

然而，拿回来的图纸却让米迦勒陷入长久的沉默。

他看不懂。也不明白原理。神庭的科技是以“神学”为核心建立的。

这就是科学的力量吗？现在去学是不是得从C语言开始？

被标准化、自动化生产的神术，不止有启明术，还有一系列低级、中级神术。

除此外，人联的技术也难逃一劫。最顶级的战斗外骨骼“骁龙”几乎被1比1复刻，在基地叫“螣蛇”；古神生物引以为傲、称霸市场的神话系列基因药，在基地也能找到低配版。

基地学者李华郑重表示：基因药是基地自主研发的产品！不是盗版！原料这么相似纯属巧合！依靠着地表的特殊材料和智械军团的图书馆，以及多方学者的加持，基地的自主创新能力是很强的！只是企业们不相信也不愿意正视！

古神生物气到吐血，历年来不知道发出多少“律师函”，可惜基地的态度也很直接：诶嘿，网不好，没收到-v-

基地自主培育的福音战士，就这样靠着领导们的努力，不断战斗力+1+1再+1。

现在，哪怕对上神庭的天启骑士和人联的正规军团，基地也有一战之力。

而基地的人口也在以极其恐怖的速度增长着（神庭、东联、西联都因战争等因素，出现不同程度的人口逆增长）；劳务派遣中心和托儿所随处可见。

米迦勒突然感觉兴致怏怏，也没有心情再参观下去了。

脸上客套的笑容也趋于平淡：“我累了。想休息。”

相南里一愣，旋即回答：“好的，那我派人送你们回招待所。”

米迦勒把目光从相南里的脸上挪开。眉心点缀的宝石流苏摇晃着。

打败马车的从来都不是更快的马，而是蒸汽火车。

他要如何阻挡这股洪流？

……

有米迦勒这个前例，后续到的使团都显得很是配合。

方敬之是提前一天抵达的。一艘专机低调地停在郊外。他依然金属面具覆盖着大半张脸，高挑且冷硬。但状态比之前肉眼可见的疲惫，缺少那么一点意气风发。

方敬之在东联过得并不轻松。

他不擅长政治，而背后的智囊团，总是劝他“忍耐”。

为大局忍耐。

以暴力碾压一切，只是那些不曾掌握过权力的底层人士，对现实世界一个美好幻想。

毕竟他们的生活里，只需要用拳头就能让敌人屈服。

而现实里，很多人是可以不用拳头，就让别人跪下的。

忍耐的结果就是方敬之不停吃瘪。精神变得高度敏感，甚至在公开的会议上口出恶言，说安迪就是高新军工养的一条看门的狗。

这让他在东联的民意支持率再度下跌。

方敬之不止一次考虑过武装夺取政权。

但这有一个极大的弊端：安迪会跟他鱼死网破，把他和他的军队打成“反动政府武装”；这样，其他势力完全有理由向东联驻兵，理由都是现成的。那就是帮安迪复国，帮东联群众脱离暴力统治。

总之，因为出言不逊，他被紧急派来进行外交活动，避避风头。

起码等舆论过去再说。

要不然那些总统准备的记者，能让他本就负面的形象再度一落千丈。下次想竞选总统就更困难了。

基地派来了专门的保卫队，为他开路。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 256: The Eve of the Grand Ceremony (Part 1)

After a not-so-pleasant meeting, Michael finally agreed to undergo a security check.

Most of the delegation’s weapons and divine art devices were left outside the city, sealed with tape, and locked in a warehouse.

The base would send specialized personnel to guard them. When the delegation left, these items would be returned intact.

After Michael entered the city, Xiang Nanli specifically cleared an afternoon to accompany him to visit the city’s attractions.

The base didn't have much historical depth; the only things that could be called attractions were the Liberator’s Plaza and Heron Lake in the suburbs.

During this period, because leaders from various parties were coming to the base to observe the ceremony, the scenic spots were temporarily closed to the public, with only staff still operating.

If you want to see these crappy attractions, go ahead.

As for the military factories, the mutant breeding centers, and the research institutes, those were absolutely off-limits.

An open-air cinema had been built at Heron Lake, with three large screens forming an equilateral triangle, showing one movie every night to satisfy the spiritual and cultural needs of the base’s masses.

During the day, it played the base’s promotional documentary on a loop.

Michael stopped in front of this large screen, looking up at the documentary.

Xiang Nanli’s face appeared frequently in the documentary, every frame so perfect that anyone who didn't know better would think it was a movie trailer.

Well, he didn't have time to film these.

The content was synthesized by the Gospel based on historical records (official documents written by Little Fu).

The Gospel had a very thick filter for Xiang Nanli.

Xiang Nanli watched for a while, his toes curling in embarrassment.

Since when was he so holy?!

When Michael traveled, the angels would hold up long curtains, blocking both sides of him.

The curtains were made of silk with embroidery so exquisite and complex it was beyond belief. A single inch of fabric represented the lifetime of many people.

This was common within the Divine Court; it was said to prevent the Archangels from being stained by the filth of the mortal world.

But Xiang Nanli felt that if the Archangels of the Divine Court were so easily polluted, wouldn't Michael, Gabriel, and the others have been "looked to death" long ago?

Of course, the Book of Preaching had a more scientific explanation for this: "In the first few generations, the 'Archangels' who had just fused with bio-mecha could not control their activation state, so their appearance was very terrifying. Blocking them was to prevent the outside world from panicking upon seeing them."

As for how terrifying... let's just say mutants were ugly enough, and the Archangels looked like a fusion of several mutants.

But after several generations, these Archangels had become holy and beautiful, one and all. Sometimes, when Xiang Nanli’s peripheral vision swept over Michael, he would feel as if he had been electrocuted.

This face was both masculine and feminine, a very standard Germanic look, with eyes that were extremely aggressive and as vast and deep as the starry sky.

Xiang Nanli guessed this might be some kind of divine art enhancement.

After watching the documentary, Michael said pointedly: "It seems that by relying on the Enlightenment Art, you have developed very quickly over these years."

On the Divine Court’s side, the attendees were Michael and several lord-level knights.

On the base’s side, it was Xiang Nanli, Beaver, Andrew, and other high-level officials.

Although there were no outsiders, this conversation might one day be recorded in history.

Michael was secretly competing for the right to interpret history!

Xiang Nanli smiled: "My Lord, our power generation technology is called 'Bio-Energy Conversion Technology,' an industrial automation computational model independent of the divine art system."

Industrialization on the surface had always remained at a primary level. On one hand, it was due to the Human Alliance’s technological blockade; on the other hand, the Divine Court had no intention of developing industry—why develop industry? Resources were enough as they were. The Divine Court only had a total of two hundred million people; any more would be hard to control.

When they first discovered that the Enlightenment Art was being used to generate electricity, the Divine Court was extremely angry and shocked. Their divine art system, which they relied on for survival, had been cracked! Shameless pirated software manufacturers, using stolen technology to develop their own forces.

The Divine Court once wanted to send an Eastern Expeditionary Army to wipe out the base, but unfortunately, most of their energy at the time was forced to be used to deal with the Heterogeneous tide. The small-scale legions sent out also unfortunately became the base’s resource supply packs.

Years later, when the Divine Court finally had the time to deal with the base, they were shocked to find that the other party was already a behemoth, crouching right beside their bed.

Michael had once sent death squads and spies to steal the base’s "Divine Art Model" technology.

However, the blueprints they brought back left Michael in a long silence.

He couldn't understand them. He didn't understand the principles either. The Divine Court’s technology was built with "theology" as its core.

Is this the power of science? Do I have to start learning from C language now?

The standardized, automated divine arts included not only the Enlightenment Art but also a series of low-level and mid-level divine arts.

Besides that, the Human Alliance’s technology didn't escape either. The top-tier combat exoskeleton "Xiao Long" (Little Dragon) was almost 1:1 replicated, called "Teng She" (Flying Serpent) in the base; the Myth series gene drugs that the Ancient God Biology company prided itself on and dominated the market with could also be found in low-spec versions in the base.

Base scholar Li Hua solemnly stated: Gene drugs are products independently developed by the base! Not pirated! The raw materials being so similar is purely a coincidence! Relying on the special materials of the surface, the library of the mechanical legion, and the support of various scholars, the base’s independent innovation capability is very strong! It’s just that the companies don't believe it and aren't willing to face it!

Ancient God Biology was so angry they vomited blood, issuing countless "lawyer letters" over the years, but unfortunately, the base’s attitude was very direct: *Hehe, the internet is bad, didn't receive it -v-*

The Gospel Warriors independently cultivated by the base, just like that, relied on the efforts of the leaders to continuously add +1, +1, and +1 to their combat power.

Now, even against the Divine Court’s Apocalypse Knights and the Human Alliance’s regular legions, the base had the strength to fight.

And the base’s population was also growing at a terrifying speed (the Divine Court, the Eastern Union, and the Western Union all saw varying degrees of negative population growth due to factors like war); labor dispatch centers and nurseries could be seen everywhere.

Michael suddenly felt listless and was in no mood to continue the tour.

The polite smile on his face also faded: "I am tired. I want to rest."

Xiang Nanli was stunned, then replied: "Very well, then I will send someone to take you back to the guesthouse."

Michael moved his gaze away from Xiang Nanli’s face. The gemstone tassels adorning his brow swayed.

What defeated the carriage was never a faster horse, but the steam train.

How was he supposed to stop this torrent?

...

With Michael as a precedent, the subsequent delegations all seemed very cooperative.

Fang Jingzhi arrived a day early. A private jet landed low-key in the suburbs. He still had a metal mask covering most of his face, tall and cold. But his state was visibly more exhausted than before, lacking that bit of high-spiritedness.

Fang Jingzhi hadn't had an easy time in the Eastern Union.

He wasn't good at politics, and the think tank behind him always advised him to "endure."

Endure for the big picture.

Crushing everything with violence was just a beautiful fantasy of the lower-class people who had never held power regarding the real world.

After all, in their lives, they only needed their fists to make their enemies submit.

But in reality, many people could make others kneel without ever using their fists.

The result of the endurance was that Fang Jingzhi kept hitting walls. His spirit became highly sensitive, and he even spouted insults at a public meeting, saying that Andy was just a guard dog raised by the high-tech military industry.

This caused his public support in the Eastern Union to fall again.

Fang Jingzhi had considered armed seizure of power more than once.

But this had a huge drawback: Andy would fight him to the death, branding him and his army as "reactionary government forces"; this way, other forces would have every reason to station troops in the Eastern Union, with ready-made excuses. That was to help Andy restore the country and help the Eastern Union masses escape from violent rule.

In short, because of his loose tongue, he was urgently sent to conduct diplomatic activities to avoid the limelight.

At least wait until the public opinion passed.

Otherwise, those reporters prepared by the President could make his already negative image plummet even further. It would be even harder to run for President next time.

The base sent a special security team to clear the way for him.

chunks.chineseText:
大街上很空旷，方敬之的车队一路畅通无阻。

“哼，基地。”方敬之神色莫测地观察着车窗外的街道和建筑。

百闻不如一见。方敬之的注意力几乎被内部的烂泥潭拖垮。

没想到，这才几年，幸存者基地居然发展到这种地步了？

不，马上就要改名叫“人马星智慧生命联合政体”了。

“一个人有立场，就会有敌人；一个人获利，就有另一个人受损。”方敬之的语气冷酷而傲慢，“联合，一厢情愿罢了。”

随行的秘书回答：“政治口号而已，司令。这个世界终究是用实力说话的。”

车在招待所外停下。

方敬之的目光落在了另一片停车场。神庭养的机械马正在草坪上卧坐，看着像是一尊尊钢铁雕像。

它们并非战马，更像是米迦勒出行仪仗队的一部分。浑身上下都嵌满宝石，身披太阳纹的羊绒毯。像艺术品。

方敬之突然身体僵硬，面色凝重到甚至有些惨白：“神庭那边派来的人是谁？”

他的语气里有自己都没察觉到的恐惧和战栗。

秘书长手忙脚乱地询问东联情报局，几分钟后，小心翼翼道：“您知道的，神庭通讯很慢。之前神庭回复，没有来参加的打算。但根据最新情报，抵达基地的神庭使者是……”

“米迦勒。”

*

西联的专机是在下午抵达的。来的也不是洛修本人，而是一具机器人。

辛追在飞机内启动机器人。

而洛修就坐在特制的神经传感舱内，操控着万里之外的机器身体。

他看向辛追，有些稀奇：“视野感觉真不一样。”

机器人的视野是360度的，和人类很不同。洛修调整了部分设置，视野订正到270度，眩晕感这才消失。

这具机器人身体造价只有两千万。功能不算特别强，但足够洛修使用。外观是按照洛修本人的模样制作的。

辛追扣住他的肩膀：“别玩了，大少爷。该登场了。”

现在所有人都叫洛修“总统”，也只有辛追，还保持着过去的称呼。

洛修走下飞机，相南里在众人的簇拥下，和他亲切握手：“欢迎，远道而来辛苦了。”

相南里的语气听上去十分真挚、诚恳。仿佛他们不是互相博弈算计的政客，而是多年未见的友人。

事实上，如果不是命运的阴差阳错，他们或许真的能成为朋友。

起码现在，西联和基地处于和平状态。基地和神庭打仗、和东联打仗，但和西联还没有发生过地缘冲突——西联在西大陆。太远了。基地还没扩张到那去。

相南里的冷冻舱，还是洛修挖出来的。

洛修回过神：“好久不见，相南里。”

洛修此时，尚不知道相南里已经在传道书的撺掇下，暗中起草《告西大陆同胞书》了。

这份《告知书》表示：联政就是从西大陆发家的！只是当初是迫于无奈搬迁，从未想过抛弃西大陆！西大陆自古以来就是联政不可分割的一部分！西大陆的同胞，请等等你的联政！我们马上就开福音号过来！

注：这个自古以来指的是自新历947年1月11日以来。

那天，幸存者基地在废土上成立。

相南里同样邀请洛修在基地到处逛逛，他们很有默契地避开了所有政治议题。

这次，相南里也没有特地清场。

基地的繁荣和热闹深深印在洛修的脑海里。

他在夜市的小摊贩前蹲下，问了一下收入和物价，惊讶地发现，基地里的这些居民，生活绝对不是宣传部门说的那样疾苦和赤贫。

虽然基地内部没有太多的消费品和娱乐，没有自己的文娱产业和奢侈品，但基地有专门的图书馆，对书籍买卖没有过多限制。基地的群众精神状态也十分富足，完全不在意外界那些被“消费主义”制造出来的需求。

这里的人，不需要买奢侈品来证明自己的地位；不需要宽敞的豪宅来证明自己的阶层。

有机构去照顾残疾人、退伍伤员和老年人（护工多为机器人，管理层为智械、人类混管）。

基地让资本家们眼中属于“残次品”和“负资产”的人，也能有尊严的生活。

“我以为，”洛修的情绪很复杂，“你们基地会很穷兵黩武呢。毕竟年年都在打仗。”还基本都赢了。

赢了，这才是最不合理的事。

基地才诞生多久？而他的对手又是些什么人？

相南里的拟人模块在此时发挥应有的作用：“穷兵黩武是被大环境逼的，要不然基地早就被神庭打废了。我们一直爱好和平。”

辛追皮笑肉不笑：“呵呵。”

洛修放下手里的小商品，继续和相南里逛街：“其实我最羡慕基地的一点是，货币的发行权掌握在执政者手上。”

他的发言很含蓄，也没有和相南里深度探讨的意图。

还在西大陆时，基地就发行了属于自己的电子货币。这一点到东大陆也没有改变。

货币发行权掌握在“基地中央银行”手中，受基地经济部直接管辖。经济部长兼职银行行长。（注：体制内，虽然正职>副职，但通常由副职负责任务的具体执行。）

而经济部长又是由执政官直接任命。

换句话说，和相南里手握货币发行权也没什么差别了。

而西联的货币发行权，是掌握在私人银行手中。

这个私人银行有很多财阀的控股，甚至洛家自己就是最大的股东，但洛修并不能完全代表洛家。

政府想要让国家发展得更好，而金融资本家们只需要考虑自己的财富增殖。

总之……西联现在的通货膨胀很严重。

第一是对于金融资本家来说，通胀可以掠夺财富；第二是西联物资紧缺。

洛阳城直接被夷为平地。

多座地表储备基地同样灰飞烟灭。损失难以估量。换成钱，恐怕是连屏幕都塞不下的一串零。更何况现实根本不能这么简单地靠钱计算。

永生科技现在顶多算回光返照；背靠永生科技的洛家也是。

这也是西联政府被迫和基地保持友好的重要原因。

离开基地，他们只能以更大代价，从企业那里购买粮食。

洛修半开玩笑半认真地说：“要不是我是总统，真的想来投靠你了。”

相南里以同样礼貌的、没有任何情绪变化的声音回复：“基地欢迎所有认可基地理念，并愿意建设基地的智慧生命。”

*

一个猴有一个猴的拴法。

要说相南里真心欢迎的境外势力领导人，那就只能是以西结了。

以西结是半夜到的。相南里从被窝里模模糊糊爬起来，拽上安德鲁，把以西结从城外接了进来。

异种们是没有那么多的礼节和繁琐的制度的。

以西结是一个人来的。出发时间比米迦勒还早，纯步行。半个月时间跑完八千里路。

“本来有车。”以西结蹙眉，“半路，导航坏了。只好自己走。”

相南里挑眉：“你早说，我就派专机去接你了，这次带点工业品回去。”

以西结：“我没有钱。”
chunks.englishText:
The streets were vast and empty, allowing Fang Jingzhi’s motorcade to travel without obstruction.

"Hmph, a 'base'." Fang Jingzhi observed the streets and buildings outside his window with an inscrutable expression.

Hearing of something a hundred times is not as good as seeing it once. Fang Jingzhi’s attention had been almost entirely consumed by the quagmire of internal affairs back home.

He had not expected that, in just a few short years, the Survivor Base would have developed to such an extent.

No, it would soon be renamed the "Centaur Star United Polity of Sentient Life."

"When a person has a stance, they will have enemies; when one person gains, another suffers," Fang Jingzhi’s tone was cold and arrogant. "A 'union'? Nothing but wishful thinking."

The accompanying secretary replied, "They are merely political slogans, Commander. In the end, this world is governed by strength."

The car came to a stop outside the guesthouse.

Fang Jingzhi’s gaze fell upon a different parking area. The mechanical horses kept by the Divine Court were lying on the lawn, looking like statues cast in steel.

They were not warhorses, but rather appeared to be part of Michael’s ceremonial guard. Their entire bodies were encrusted with jewels and draped in cashmere blankets patterned with sun motifs. They looked like works of art.

Fang Jingzhi’s body suddenly stiffened, his complexion turning grave, even deathly pale. "Who is the person sent by the Divine Court?"

His tone carried a tremor of fear he hadn't even realized was there.

The secretary-general scrambled to inquire with the East Union Intelligence Bureau, and a few minutes later, he said cautiously, "As you know, communications from the Divine Court are slow. Previously, the Divine Court replied that they had no intention of attending. But according to the latest intelligence, the envoy from the Divine Court who has arrived at the base is..."

"Michael."

*

The West Union’s private jet arrived in the afternoon. It was not Luo Xiu himself who came, but a robot.

Xin Zhui activated the robot inside the plane.

Luo Xiu sat within a specialized neural-sensing pod, controlling the robotic body from thousands of miles away.

He looked at Xin Zhui, feeling a sense of wonder. "The field of vision feels truly different."
