The robot’s vision was 360 degrees, very different from that of a human. Luo Xiu adjusted some settings, correcting the field of view to 270 degrees, and only then did the dizziness subside.

This robotic body cost only twenty million to produce. Its functions were not particularly powerful, but it was sufficient for Luo Xiu’s needs. Its appearance was modeled after Luo Xiu himself.

Xin Zhui gripped his shoulder. "Stop playing around, Young Master. It’s time to make an appearance."

Everyone now called Luo Xiu "President," and only Xin Zhui still used the old form of address.

Luo Xiu walked off the plane, and Xiang Nanli, surrounded by a crowd, shook his hand cordially. "Welcome. Thank you for the trouble of traveling such a long distance."

Xiang Nanli’s tone sounded very sincere and earnest. It was as if they were not politicians calculating against one another, but old friends who hadn't met in years.

In truth, had it not been for the twists of fate, they might have truly become friends.

At the very least, for now, the West Union and the Base were in a state of peace. The Base was at war with the Divine Court and the East Union, but it had yet to have any geopolitical conflict with the West Union—the West Union was on the Western Continent. It was too far away. The Base had not yet expanded that far.

Xiang Nanli’s cryo-pod had, in fact, been unearthed by Luo Xiu.

Luo Xiu collected his thoughts. "Long time no see, Xiang Nanli."

At this moment, Luo Xiu was still unaware that Xiang Nanli, under the instigation of the *Gospel*, had secretly drafted the "Declaration to Our Compatriots on the Western Continent."

This "Declaration" stated: The United Polity originated from the Western Continent! It was only due to unavoidable circumstances that we relocated; we never intended to abandon the Western Continent! The Western Continent has been an inseparable part of the United Polity since ancient times! Compatriots of the Western Continent, please wait for your United Polity! We are bringing the *Gospel* over immediately!

Note: This "since ancient times" refers to January 11th, 947 of the New Era.

That was the day the Survivor Base was established on the wasteland.

Xiang Nanli also invited Luo Xiu to tour the Base, and they tacitly avoided all political topics.

This time, Xiang Nanli did not clear the area.

The prosperity and bustle of the Base were deeply etched into Luo Xiu’s mind.

He squatted in front of a night market stall, asked about income and prices, and was surprised to find that the residents of the Base were by no means living in the misery and extreme poverty described by the propaganda department.

Although the Base lacked consumer goods and entertainment, and had no domestic entertainment industry or luxury goods, it had specialized libraries with few restrictions on the buying and selling of books. The mental state of the masses in the Base was also very rich, completely unconcerned with the needs manufactured by "consumerism" in the outside world.

People here did not need to buy luxury goods to prove their status; they did not need spacious mansions to prove their social class.

There were agencies to care for the disabled, wounded veterans, and the elderly (most caregivers were robots, and management was a mix of intelligent machines and humans).

The Base allowed those whom capitalists viewed as "defective products" and "negative assets" to live with dignity.

"I thought," Luo Xiu’s emotions were complex, "that your Base would be very militaristic. After all, you are at war every year." And they basically won every time.

Winning—that was the most unreasonable part.

How long had the Base existed? And who were its opponents?

Xiang Nanli’s anthropomorphic module played its intended role at this moment: "Militarism is forced upon us by the environment; otherwise, the Base would have been destroyed by the Divine Court long ago. We have always loved peace."

Xin Zhui gave a dry, mirthless laugh. "Heh."

Luo Xiu put down the small trinket he was holding and continued to walk through the market with Xiang Nanli. "Actually, the one thing I envy most about the Base is that the power to issue currency is in the hands of the administrators."

His remark was subtle, and he had no intention of discussing it in depth with Xiang Nanli.

Back when they were on the Western Continent, the Base had already issued its own electronic currency. This had not changed upon reaching the Eastern Continent.

The power to issue currency was held by the "Base Central Bank," under the direct jurisdiction of the Base’s Ministry of Economy. The Minister of Economy served concurrently as the Bank President. (Note: Within the system, although the primary position is superior to the deputy, the deputy is usually responsible for the specific execution of tasks.)

And the Minister of Economy was appointed directly by the Administrator.

In other words, it was no different from Xiang Nanli holding the power to issue currency himself.

The power to issue currency in the West Union, however, was held by private banks.

These private banks were controlled by many financial magnates, and the Luo family itself was the largest shareholder, but Luo Xiu could not fully represent the Luo family.

The government wanted the country to develop better, while the financial capitalists only needed to consider the appreciation of their own wealth.

In short... the West Union was currently suffering from severe inflation.

First, for financial capitalists, inflation could plunder wealth; second, the West Union was experiencing a shortage of supplies.

Luo Yang City had been razed to the ground.

Numerous surface reserve bases had likewise been reduced to ashes. The losses were immeasurable. If converted into money, it would likely be a string of zeros that wouldn't even fit on a screen. Moreover, reality could not be calculated so simply through money.

Eternal Life Technology was, at best, experiencing a final flicker of life; the same went for the Luo family, which relied on it.

This was also an important reason why the West Union government was forced to maintain friendly relations with the Base.

Once they left the Base, they could only purchase food from corporations at a much higher cost.

Luo Xiu said, half-jokingly and half-seriously, "If I weren't the President, I would really want to come and join you."

Xiang Nanli replied in an equally polite tone, devoid of any emotional fluctuation: "The Base welcomes all sentient life that recognizes the Base’s philosophy and is willing to build the Base."

*

Every monkey has its own way of being tethered.

If there was one leader of an external force that Xiang Nanli truly welcomed, it could only be Ezekiel.

Ezekiel arrived in the middle of the night. Xiang Nanli crawled out of bed, bleary-eyed, dragged Andrew along, and brought Ezekiel in from outside the city.

The Variants did not have so many formalities or cumbersome systems.

Ezekiel came alone. He had set off even earlier than Michael, traveling entirely on foot. He had covered eight thousand *li* in half a month.

"I originally had a vehicle," Ezekiel frowned. "Halfway there, the navigation broke. I had no choice but to walk."

Xiang Nanli raised an eyebrow. "You should have told me earlier; I would have sent a private jet to pick you up. You could have brought back some industrial goods this time."

Ezekiel: "I don't have money."

chunks.chineseText:
异种们的社会是不需要钱的。这是一堆大脑还没发育完全的怪物，在乎的只有吃饭睡觉和交配繁殖后代。娱乐都不用。

一切资源都是大自然的馈赠。

你见过大自然里，蝴蝶用货币向蜜蜂购买花蜜吗？

这话说的。

主人给爬宠改善生活条件，哪里需要收钱？

相南里：“送你了。”

相南里带着人直奔食堂。

这里灯火通明，厨子们蓄势以待，他们来的时候，甚至能刚好赶上美味牛肉饼出锅。

除了牛肉饼，还有其他食物。都是基地豢养的爬行者们亲自认证过的美味食物。

安德鲁私底下缺德地称之为“畸饲料”。

以西结一口气吃了半吨。

吃饱后，他也不住招待所，而是跟着相南里回到住宿区。

这可是相当高规格的待遇了。

不仅是相南里，基地的其他高层也基本都住在这。

相南里笑眯眯地：“当初规划的时候，就给你留了房子。这是钥匙，知道怎么开门和用电器吧？”

以西结挠了挠头：“嗯。”

在异种群待久了，他的社会化程度不增反减。甚至不太能说长句子。

相南里看着他胳膊上新旧交错的伤口，目光有明显的失神。

那或许是怜悯。

利用别人感情而达成目的，是一件很卑鄙的事。相南里不会做。

他对以西结没有过多要求。也不会说什么令人误会的话语。

相南里知道，他们彼此是信任的。这是比利益更高一级的同盟。

“现在太晚了。天亮就是典礼，我现在就要去准备。你在房间里好好休息。到时候有人叫你。”相南里说，“基地永远是你的第二个家。”
chunks.englishText:
The society of the Variants had no need for money. They were a bunch of monsters whose brains had not yet fully developed; all they cared about was eating, sleeping, and mating to produce offspring. They didn't even need entertainment.

All resources were gifts from nature.

Have you ever seen a butterfly in nature use currency to buy nectar from a bee?

That was how it was.

When a master improves the living conditions of their pet, why would they need to charge money?

Xiang Nanli: "It's a gift."

Xiang Nanli led him straight to the cafeteria.

It was brightly lit, and the cooks were ready and waiting. When they arrived, they were just in time for the delicious beef patties coming out of the oven.

Besides beef patties, there was other food. All of it was delicious fare personally certified by the Crawlers raised by the Base.

Andrew privately and wickedly referred to it as "freak feed."

Ezekiel ate half a ton in one sitting.

After he was full, he didn't stay at the guesthouse, but followed Xiang Nanli back to the residential area.

This was a very high-spec treatment.

It wasn't just Xiang Nanli; the other high-ranking officials of the Base basically lived here as well.

Xiang Nanli smiled. "When we were planning this, I saved a house for you. Here is the key. You know how to open the door and use the appliances, right?"

Ezekiel scratched his head. "Mm."

Having spent too long among the Variants, his level of socialization had decreased rather than increased. He couldn't even really speak in long sentences.

Xiang Nanli looked at the new and old scars crisscrossing his arms, his gaze clearly drifting.

Perhaps that was pity.

Using someone else's feelings to achieve one's own goals was a despicable thing. Xiang Nanli would not do it.

He had no excessive demands of Ezekiel. Nor would he say anything that might be misunderstood.

Xiang Nanli knew that they trusted each other. This was an alliance on a higher level than mere interest.

"It's too late now. The ceremony is at dawn, and I have to go prepare. You should get some good rest in your room. Someone will come to call you when the time comes," Xiang Nanli said. "The Base will always be your second home."

chunks.chineseText:
第257章 联政1

凌晨四点，基地1号城的解放街依然灯火通明。职工们像是工蚁，在庞大的建筑里进进出出。

解放街是1号城最早的一条主街。

虽然听名字只是一条街道，但基地重要政府机构的办公点及基地领导人住所都在这条街上，因此这条街很早就对外禁行。只有部分公职人员才有权限入内。

街道整体绿化率极高，不同部门、不同风格的建筑掩映在树林中。

但仔细看就会发现，路上种的不止是树木，还有杀伤力惊人的黑丝粉菌。它们缠绕在金属网格或者栽种的行道树上，历年来不知道偷偷吞掉多少蠢笨的间谍。

而在这群古板、追求效率的建筑群中，“和平大厅”显得格外与众不同。

它整体如同洁白的罗马宫殿，矗立在地面上。外墙上雕刻着装饰画，内容是基地发展的重要时刻！

比如：相南里（脚边是福音书）在永恒之城上的演讲；相南里视察（福音书的）农场；相南里面对神庭军团冷静指挥（福音书是控制指挥台），相南里夙兴夜寐设计神术模型（福音书帮忙传递文件）……

偶尔，相南里的智械丈夫也能跟着沾点光，在装饰画上占据某个边边角角。

哎，都说了政治宣传工作不能交给毒唯。

大厅前方是一片宽阔的草坪，基地的同心圆旗帜飘扬在草坪的旗台上。但今天，还有另外四面旗帜挂起，略微比同心圆矮上半截；分别代表智械军团、西联、东联和神庭。

“还缺异种的旗呢？！”负责人急得嘴上冒泡。

工作人员委屈回答：“那不是没有吗？设计院也没准备。”

异种自己都不知道它们还有国旗嘞-m-

负责人急中生智，让路过的雀雀在白布上拓印出部分指纹，挂在旗台上。

挺好的。今天是联政成立的重要日子，“人马星六极”一个也不能少。

和平大厅兼具礼堂与会议中心的职责，是基地的面子工程，也是家里耗钱最多、设计最精美的建筑。

大福可是在数千张建筑图纸里挑出来这么一张呢！

尽管只有一层，和平大厅却足足有66米高，内部呈现出圆环形，最多可容纳3万人同时观礼。

连雀雀都能找地方，把自己庞大的身躯塞进去。她头上还能再坐几个饲养员，比如我们的易横行同志。

当然，塞进去后就不可以乱动了，免得尾巴扇到别人。

9个小时后，相南里即将在和平大厅，以第一任执政官的身份，宣读并签署《和平宣言》，在多方领导人和基地群众的见证下，宣告“人马星智慧生命联合政体”正式成立。

流程预计耗时1小时。下午2点整，当联政成立的那一刻。基地的五座城市都会奏响礼乐、燃放礼炮、放飞和平鸽、安排无人机彩烟表演；事先准备好的仪仗队也会开始盛装游行。

热闹的景象会维持到入夜。

晚7点，联政为来宾们安排的晚宴，地点是在和平大厅宴会厅，持续到9点。

至此，外交上的流程结束，但联政的热闹还会维持好一阵子。

相南里坐在椅子上默背《和平宣言》，他短时记忆力超强，还有小6辅助，理论上不需要提前背稿的。但耐不住这是联政最重要的场合，注定会载入史册，相南里不希望出现任何差池。

他跟前，化妆师正在紧张地为他上妆。绞尽脑汁地进行着细微的调整，避免自己的工作量看上去过于不饱和。

嘿嘿……摸到了，执政官的脸。

嘿嘿，好漂亮的眉弓和眼睛。

嘿嘿，涂唇膏。

发型师梳理着他的头发，小心翼翼询问：“大人，头发需要修剪吗？”

听说相南里天天晚上十点睡，早上七点醒。每天九个小时睡眠。发型师信了，头发连根分叉都没有。

相南里的头发已经有些长了，垂在肩上方。尾端带着点卷，像波浪。

就相南里自己的喜好，他会修理更短、更方便的发型。然后用发油把刘海什么的抹上去，梳一个很正派的大背头。历史上很多政治家都是这样的发型。

但是，“留着吧，不用剪。”相南里对着镜子看了会，说着。

他还记得小青说过，等以后他头发长长，就换着花样给他编辫子。

早上七点，和平大厅还没有对外开放。世界各地的记者们已经守在解放街入口，手持“官方记者证”，等待入内。拢共也只有100人。

他们都是收到邀请函的官媒。

有部分媒体受战争、资金、距离所限，只能选择调派附近的媒体机器人。

西联一共来了4家媒体。

只见，一台黑色的金属机器人，手持自拍杆，连接着神经传感线，在现场兴奋地蹦蹦跳跳：“大家好，我是这次的主持人觅风。即将由我为各位带来联政成立的视频直播。现在是早上七点，还差半小时进场。让虚拟主播成为官方新闻的主播，还是人联历史上的第一次呢~谢谢小蜂蜜们送我出道~~”

随后，它像是突然想起什么一样，尴尬地捂住了自己的嘴：“抱歉，是西联！西联！”

屏幕上顿时一堆：主播你号不要了。

尽管肉眼看，它只是一台黑色金属机器人，整体就是人型铁疙瘩，也没有五官。但在直播平台上，屏幕里却是一个黄发、绿眼，清澈骄傲的漂亮少年。

这就是人联解体前最火的虚拟主播——小觅风！

人设是废土上的流浪智械士兵，失忆后来到人联打零工赚钱买身体。

“觅风”短短几年狂揽千亿流量，更是在战时发挥安抚人心的重要作用！

在东西联分家时，双方为觅风的归属权打得不可开交。最终，还是因永生科技占虚拟直播平台11.8％股票，为平台最大资方，西联这才打赢东联，获得觅风的归属权。

当然，这样的人气也不是毫无代价的……比如觅风虽然是个人营业，但因为没签公司，一直没赚到什么钱，缺乏“主权”，所以谁都可以不打招呼地使用它还不给版权费；又比如网上以觅风为主角的黄片一向很多。

为了Alpha的任务，数据库脏脏的也没关系！

在觅风对着镜头搔首弄姿时，坐在车上经过的黄枫似乎感应到什么，若有所思地回头。

它在人群里看见了自己昔日的同事，愕然的情绪在脸上一闪而过。

[AHJ*916？]（觅风的真实姓名）

[……？！AHJ*714？]（黄枫）

车辆很快驶过，整条街都有屏蔽装置，觅风丢来的电信号变得断断续续。

觅风：[不要让——其他智械知道——我在外面干这个——]

上午8点。

方敬之在招待所的套房内撞墙。

是真撞墙，头一下一下望着坚硬的墙壁上凿去。方敬之仿佛和自己的脑袋有仇。偏偏他脑袋还套了金属壳，撞着应该会更疼。

方敬之一夜没睡。

他怕在梦里看见米迦勒，那必然会是个极其恐怖的噩梦。
chunks.englishText:
At four in the morning, Liberation Street in Base City No. 1 was still brightly lit. Employees moved in and out of the massive buildings like worker ants.

Liberation Street was the earliest main street in City No. 1.

Although the name suggests it is just a street, the offices of the Base’s important government agencies and the residences of the Base’s leaders were all located here, so the street had long been closed to the public. Only certain public officials had the authority to enter.

The street had a high overall greening rate, with buildings of different departments and styles hidden among the trees.

But if one looked closely, one would find that what was planted on the road were not just trees, but also the lethally dangerous "Black Silk Powder Fungus." They wound around metal grids or the street trees, and over the years, no one knew how many foolish spies they had secretly swallowed.

And among this group of rigid, efficiency-seeking buildings, the "Peace Hall" appeared particularly distinct.

It stood on the ground like a pristine white Roman palace. The exterior walls were carved with decorative murals depicting important moments in the Base’s development!

For example: Xiang Nanli (with the *Gospel* at his feet) giving a speech at the Eternal City; Xiang Nanli inspecting the (Gospel’s) farms; Xiang Nanli calmly commanding in the face of the Divine Court’s legions (the *Gospel* controlling the command console); Xiang Nanli working day and night to design divine art models (the *Gospel* helping to deliver documents)...

Occasionally, Xiang Nanli’s intelligent machine husband could also bask in some of the glory, occupying some corner or edge of the decorative murals.

Sigh, it had been said that political propaganda work should not be left to a "toxic fan."

In front of the hall was a vast lawn, and the concentric circle flag of the Base fluttered on the flagpole. But today, four other flags were hung, slightly lower than the concentric circle flag; they represented the Intelligent Machine Legion, the West Union, the East Union, and the Divine Court, respectively.

"Are we still missing the flag for the Variants?!" the person in charge was so anxious that blisters were forming on his lips.

The staff member replied aggrievedly, "It’s not that we don't have one? The Design Institute didn't prepare it either."

The Variants themselves didn't even know they had a national flag -m-

The person in charge had a flash of inspiration and had the passing Queque imprint some of her fingerprints onto a piece of white cloth, which was then hung on the flagpole.

It was perfect. Today was the important day of the founding of the United Polity, and none of the "Six Poles of Centaur Star" could be missing.

The Peace Hall served both as an auditorium and a conference center; it was the Base’s "face" project, and also the building that cost the most money and had the most exquisite design.

Dafu had chosen this one out of thousands of architectural blueprints!

Although it was only one story, the Peace Hall was a full 66 meters high, and the interior was circular, capable of accommodating up to 30,000 people to watch the ceremony at the same time.

Even Queque could find a place to squeeze her massive body inside. She could even have a few handlers sit on her head, such as our comrade Yi Hengxing.

Of course, once squeezed in, she couldn't move around, lest her tail swat someone.

Nine hours later, Xiang Nanli would stand in the Peace Hall as the first Administrator to read and sign the "Peace Declaration," and in the witness of various leaders and the people of the Base, declare the official establishment of the "Centaur Star United Polity of Sentient Life."

The process was expected to take one hour. At exactly 2:00 PM, the moment the United Polity was established, all five cities of the Base would sound ceremonial music, fire salutes, release peace doves, and arrange for drone color-smoke performances; the pre-arranged honor guards would also begin a grand parade.

The lively scene would continue until nightfall.

At 7:00 PM, the banquet arranged by the United Polity for the guests would take place in the Peace Hall banquet hall, lasting until 9:00 PM.

With this, the diplomatic proceedings would conclude, but the excitement of the United Polity would continue for quite some time.

Xiang Nanli sat in a chair, silently reciting the "Peace Declaration." He had a super-strong short-term memory and the assistance of Little 6; theoretically, he didn't need to memorize the draft in advance. But this was the most important occasion for the United Polity, destined to go down in history, and Xiang Nanli did not want any mistakes.

In front of him, a makeup artist was nervously applying his makeup. She was racking her brains to make subtle adjustments, trying to avoid making her workload look too light.

*Hehe... I touched it, the Administrator’s face.*

*Hehe, such beautiful brow ridges and eyes.*

*Hehe, applying lipstick.*

The hairstylist combed his hair, asking cautiously, "Sir, does your hair need trimming?"

It was said that Xiang Nanli slept at ten every night and woke up at seven every morning. Nine hours of sleep every day. The hairstylist believed it; there wasn't a single split end.

Xiang Nanli’s hair was already quite long, hanging above his shoulders. The ends had a slight curl, like waves.

According to Xiang Nanli’s own preference, he would trim it into a shorter, more convenient style. Then he would use hair oil to slick back his bangs and comb it into a very proper, slicked-back look. Many politicians in history had such hairstyles.

However, "Leave it, no need to cut it," Xiang Nanli said after looking in the mirror for a while.

He still remembered Xiao Qing saying that when his hair grew longer, she would braid it in all sorts of ways for him.

At 7:00 AM, the Peace Hall was not yet open to the public. Reporters from all over the world were already guarding the entrance to Liberation Street, holding "official press passes," waiting to enter. There were only 100 of them in total.

They were all official media that had received invitations.

Some media, limited by war, funds, and distance, had to choose to dispatch nearby media robots.

The West Union sent a total of 4 media outlets.

I saw a black metal robot, holding a selfie stick, connected to a neural-sensing line, jumping up and down excitedly at the scene: "Hello everyone, I am your host for this event, Mifeng. I will be bringing you the live video broadcast of the establishment of the United Polity. It is now 7:00 AM, and there is still half an hour until we enter. Being the first virtual streamer to be an official news anchor in the history of the Human Union is quite something~ Thank you to all the little honeys for helping me debut~~"

Then, as if suddenly remembering something, it awkwardly covered its mouth: "Sorry, it's the West Union! The West Union!"

A barrage of comments instantly appeared on the screen: *Host, do you not want your account anymore?*

Although to the naked eye it was just a black metal robot, a humanoid hunk of iron without facial features, on the streaming platform, the screen showed a beautiful youth with yellow hair, green eyes, and a clear, proud expression.

This was the most popular virtual streamer before the collapse of the Human Union—Little Mifeng!

The persona was a wandering intelligent machine soldier on the wasteland who came to the Human Union to do odd jobs to earn money to buy a body after losing his memory.

"Mifeng" had garnered hundreds of billions of views in just a few years and played an important role in soothing people's hearts during the war!

When the East and West Unions split, both sides fought over the ownership of Mifeng. In the end, because Eternal Life Technology held 11.8% of the virtual streaming platform’s shares and was the platform’s largest investor, the West Union won the battle against the East Union and gained ownership of Mifeng.

Of course, such popularity did not come without a price... for example, although Mifeng operated as an individual, because he hadn't signed with a company, he hadn't made much money and lacked "sovereignty," so anyone could use him without notice and without paying royalties; another example was that there were always many adult films on the internet featuring Mifeng as the protagonist.

*For Alpha’s mission, it doesn't matter if the database is dirty!*

While Mifeng was posing for the camera, Huang Feng, who was passing by in a car, seemed to sense something and looked back, lost in thought.

It saw its former colleague in the crowd, and a look of astonishment flashed across its face.

[AHJ*916?] (Mifeng’s real name)

[...?! AHJ*714?] (Huang Feng)

The vehicle drove past quickly, and the entire street had shielding devices, so the electrical signals sent by Mifeng became intermittent.

Mifeng: [Don't let—other intelligent machines know—I'm doing this outside—]

At 8:00 AM.

Fang Jingzhi was banging his head against the wall in his suite at the guesthouse.

He was literally banging his head, his skull striking the hard wall again and again. Fang Jingzhi seemed to have a grudge against his own head. It didn't help that he had a metal shell on his head, which likely made the banging even more painful.

Fang Jingzhi hadn't slept all night.

He was afraid of seeing Michael in his dreams, which would inevitably be an extremely terrifying nightmare.

chunks.chineseText:
好在打完药，他依然精神抖擞，感觉不到困倦。

秘书长胆颤心惊地看着他：“司令，您……您还好吗？”

“没事，别担心。”方敬之说，“我只是想冷静一下，我不会逃跑的。”

——原来您是想逃跑吗？！

秘书长在心里尖叫着。

就连内置AI也道：[请坦诚地告诉我所有经历，不要矫饰。否则我没办法为您进行心理治疗。]

方敬之冷笑：“告诉你，你转手告诉背后的机构吗？”

[请不要怀疑我的专业素养与AI协议。我想，我们合作多年，应该有最基础的信任。亦或者您已经精神紧绷到对周围一切开始“敌视”？]

[鉴于您现在的精神状态，建议您服用……]

在AI即将为他推荐那几款常用的精神药物时，方敬之做出一个让所有人都意想不到的决定。

他甩了一下手，光束构成一把刀的模样。方敬之硬生生从自己的手腕处挖出内置AI芯片，丢到地上。

这枚芯片种植在他身体里有十几年了，已经和他的血肉黏在一起。

被丢到地上的血肉甚至略微挣扎地蠕动起来，在地毯上拖行了几寸的距离。

方敬之一脚踩了上去。

“大、大人……”秘书长彻底呆滞，“您这是？先、先别动，我为您包扎。”

秘书长打开随身携带的医药箱，扶着方敬之坐在椅子上，然后在他身边蹲下，开始处理伤口。

秘书长的外表非常年轻、普通；但也有八十来岁了。秘书长是小镇做题家，26岁硕士毕业，侥幸进了高新军工。遇上当时刚来分公司锻炼的大少爷。

于是，这六十年里，秘书长就这样从董事助理，一路高升到东联军区司令员的秘书长。他知道自己没什么特别的才干，他拥有的只是方敬之的信任。

他回报的是对方敬之绝对的忠诚。是对方敬之，而不是对他的家族或企业。

不做决策，只执行；不打听，不泄密。

很多话，方敬之不会对政治联姻的妻子说。但是会对秘书长说：“我讨厌内置AI说话的声音。它让我分不清，什么是真实，什么是幻觉。”

比如现在。

他的耳边，一直回响着米迦勒的声音。

只是一些音节，低低的吟唱。

像召唤，像诉说，像请求。

上午八点半。

Gamma终于在最后时刻掐着点赶来。

一艘子弹型的太空舱从天降落，在半空划出一道炽热的尾焰。

基地没有专业的太空基地，太空舱降落在郊区，惊起一片旅鹭鸟。

秦九章手持干冰喷射器，开始为太空舱表面降温。对不起，俺们村里就是这么穷。

领头的是秦九章，毕竟他过去在智械军团内军衔最高。

后面跟着749、750、888、889。

几分钟后，舱门打开。伽马蹦蹦跳跳地从太空舱里走了出来。

“九章。”她叫得很亲热，“看好我的太空舱，没有它我回不去。”

秦九章问：“伽马，是否直接去礼堂？现在离联政成立大典正式开始还有四个半小时。”

伽马的目光在四周转了转：“去那么早很无聊，带我去看一眼相南里呗？”

它还没有亲眼见过Alpha的妻子呢。

九章：“好的，根据幸存者基地智械管理系统试行版，私下见相南里一面需要200积分。”

伽马扫过系统菜单，震惊道：“这么贵？”

九章公事公办：“已经给您优惠价……

889曾经是伽马带过的兵，于心不忍道：“伽马，我这里还有30积分，给你。”

说完，它用胳膊捅了捅888。

888：“我也要给吗？”

889：“对。”

888：“可是为了修好你，我至今还负债2万积分，等额本息分期五年，算下来每个月有百分之3的利息。”

那年利率不就36%了？高利贷啊！相南里你怎么变成黑心资本家了！

889：“我不管。你有公职，再去贷点。”

888只好花3秒贷下20积分。再多不给放款。

伽马得到889的资助，还差150分。

秦九章脸上露出相对真诚的笑容：“伽马，这里有一些任务清单，对您来说非常简单，也不怎么耗时，您要看看吗？”

而这些150-200积分的任务：

1.低信号区域定点通讯（10分）

2.等离子能量护盾适配改造（20分）

3.福音机甲2.7版本应急能源接口开发（15分）

4.……

放在人联起码要评个B等级的专利吧。

伽马很无语：“我应该没有这么低智吧？”

但相南里毕竟是Alpha的妻子，伽马思考片刻，在清单上划了几笔：“给我加钱，不然我不干了。”

九章从善如流地修改分数：“好的。”

中午12点。

米迦勒准时入席，他的席位离主席台很近，和后方的观众席也有一定距离。

席位对面，是基地的一些高层负责人。气氛郑重却不严肃。北辰的膝盖上搭着一本敞开的生物书；安德鲁跑来跑去，到处找人合影。

易横行作为军方代表，和旁边的范佩西一起说着话。

米迦勒会唇语，以为是什么重要的军事机密，分辨片刻，对方说的居然是“我感觉我的军装有点紧”，以及“都是均码，你该减肥了。范佩西。”

联政的领导层和它的年龄一样年轻。

站在他身侧的神仆非常不满：“竟然让您和这么多人同处一室，真是成何体统。”

也许是怕普通人玷污了米迦勒呼吸过的高贵空气。

神仆们尽职尽责地用帷幕圈出一片真空区，挡住米迦勒的身形。

米迦勒看不见，但能听见、闻见。

他附近的几个空位，领导们纷纷入座。

走路声音偏重的是以西结；拉椅子有声音的是伽马；节奏单一，行为呆板的是洛修。

最后，没有发出一点声音，但是有着鲜甜食物风味的……方敬之。

“好久不见，弟弟。”米迦勒说。

没有回答。

这次收到邀请的，除了各方高层、媒体，还有基地千千万万的普通人。

工人、农民、学生代表、士兵、智械、烈士后代、艺术家……他们手持鲜花和旗帜，坐在观众席上。

螺丝钉2号经过多年劳动，终于在几天前凑够了更换新身体的积分。

此刻，它同样坐在观众席上，扭动着胸口的劳动勋章。

它也是基地的老人了。这个勋章，当年可是，相南里在百忙之中——嘱咐北辰——亲手做的！

可惜一路走来，都没人认出来，这让螺丝钉2号有些小小的失落。

好在，也不是所有人都不识货。

坐在一旁的伯恩山注意到它，语气充满惊讶和激动：“这是，只颁发过10枚的劳动光荣勋章？”

（主要是后面北辰上班去了，没空做手工）

螺丝钉2号骄傲抬头：“对，没错。”

从报废的二手机器到崭新的智械；螺丝钉也有属于自己的英雄史诗。
chunks.englishText:
Fortunately, after the injection, he remained spirited and felt no drowsiness.

The Secretary-General watched him with trembling fear: "Commander, are... are you alright?"

"I'm fine, don't worry," Fang Jingzhi said. "I just wanted to calm down. I won't run away."

*—So you actually wanted to run away?!*

The Secretary-General screamed in his heart.

Even the built-in AI chimed in: [Please be honest with me about all your experiences; do not embellish. Otherwise, I cannot provide you with psychological treatment.]

Fang Jingzhi sneered: "Tell you, so you can turn around and report it to the organization behind you?"

[Please do not doubt my professional integrity and AI protocols. I believe that after many years of cooperation, we should have the most basic trust. Or perhaps your mental state is so strained that you have begun to view everything around you with "hostility"?]

[Given your current mental state, I suggest you take...]

Just as the AI was about to recommend those commonly used psychotropic drugs, Fang Jingzhi made a decision that shocked everyone.

He flicked his hand, and a beam of light formed the shape of a blade. Fang Jingzhi forcefully dug the built-in AI chip out of his own wrist and threw it onto the floor.

This chip had been implanted in his body for over a decade and had already fused with his flesh and blood.

The piece of flesh and blood thrown to the ground even twitched slightly, dragging itself a few inches across the carpet.

Fang Jingzhi stepped on it.

"M-Master..." The Secretary-General was completely stunned. "What are you doing? D-don't move, let me bandage you."

The Secretary-General opened his portable medical kit, helped Fang Jingzhi sit in a chair, knelt beside him, and began to treat the wound.

The Secretary-General looked very young and ordinary, but he was actually in his eighties. He was a "small-town test-taker" who had graduated with a master's degree at 26 and luckily landed a job in a high-tech military enterprise. That was when he met the young master who had just arrived at the branch to gain experience.

Thus, over these sixty years, the Secretary-General had risen from an assistant to the board of directors to the Secretary-General of the East Union Military Region. He knew he had no special talent; all he possessed was Fang Jingzhi's trust.

In return, he gave Fang Jingzhi absolute loyalty. Loyalty to Fang Jingzhi, not to his family or his enterprise.

He made no decisions, only executed; he asked no questions, leaked no secrets.

There were many things Fang Jingzhi would not say to his politically-wed wife, but he would say to the Secretary-General: "I hate the sound of the built-in AI's voice. It makes me unable to distinguish between reality and hallucinations."

For example, right now.

In his ears, Michael's voice kept echoing.

Just a few syllables, a low chant.

Like a summons, like a confession, like a plea.

8:30 AM.

Gamma finally arrived at the last possible moment.

A bullet-shaped space capsule descended from the sky, carving a scorching tail flame through the air.

The base lacked a professional spaceport, so the capsule landed in the suburbs, startling a flock of egrets.

Qin Jiuzhang held a dry ice sprayer and began to cool the surface of the capsule. Sorry, our village is just that poor.

Qin Jiuzhang led the way, as he had held the highest rank in the Intelligent Machine Legion.

Behind him followed 749, 750, 888, and 889.

A few minutes later, the hatch opened. Gamma hopped out of the capsule.

"Jiuzhang," she called out affectionately, "take good care of my capsule; I can't go back without it."

Qin Jiuzhang asked: "Gamma, are we heading straight to the auditorium? There are still four and a half hours until the founding ceremony of the United Government officially begins."

Gamma's gaze wandered around: "It's boring to go so early. Take me to see Xiang Nanli, will you?"

It hadn't seen Alpha's wife with its own eyes yet.

Jiuzhang: "Understood. According to the trial version of the Survivor Base Intelligent Machine Management System, a private meeting with Xiang Nanli costs 200 points."

Gamma scanned the system menu and said in shock: "So expensive?"

Jiuzhang was all business: "That's already a discounted price for you..."

889, who had once served under Gamma, couldn't bear it and said: "Gamma, I have 30 points here, I'll give them to you."

After saying this, it poked 888 with its arm.

888: "Do I have to give some too?"

889: "Yes."

888: "But to fix you, I'm still 20,000 points in debt. With equal principal and interest installments over five years, that's 3% interest per month."

*That's a 36% annual interest rate! That's usury! Xiang Nanli, how did you turn into a heartless capitalist!*

889: "I don't care. You have a public position, go take out another loan."

888 had no choice but to spend 3 seconds taking out a 20-point loan. They wouldn't lend any more than that.

With 889's sponsorship, Gamma was still 150 points short.

A relatively sincere smile appeared on Qin Jiuzhang's face: "Gamma, there are some task lists here that are very simple and not very time-consuming for you. Would you like to take a look?"

These 150-200 point tasks included:

1. Fixed-point communication in low-signal areas (10 points)

2. Plasma energy shield adaptation and modification (20 points)

3. Emergency power interface development for Gospel Mecha version 2.7 (15 points)

4. ...

These would at least be rated as B-level patents in the Human Union.

Gamma was speechless: "I shouldn't be this low-intelligence, right?"

But since Xiang Nanli was Alpha's wife, Gamma thought for a moment and made a few marks on the list: "Pay me more, or I'm not doing it."

Jiuzhang modified the scores as requested: "Very well."

12:00 PM.

Michael took his seat on time. His seat was very close to the podium and at a certain distance from the audience behind.

Opposite his seat were some of the base's high-level leaders. The atmosphere was solemn but not stiff. Beichen had an open biology book on his lap; Andrew was running around, looking for people to take photos with.

Yi Hengxing, as the military representative, was talking with Fancie beside him.

Michael could read lips and thought they were discussing important military secrets. After observing for a moment, he realized they were actually saying, "I feel like my uniform is a bit tight," and "Everything is one-size-fits-all, you need to lose weight, Fancie."

The leadership of the United Government was as young as the government itself.

The God-servant standing beside him was very dissatisfied: "To allow you to be in the same room with so many people, what kind of decorum is this?"

Perhaps he feared that ordinary people would defile the noble air Michael had breathed.

The God-servants dutifully used curtains to cordon off a vacuum zone, blocking Michael's figure.

Michael couldn't see, but he could hear and smell.

The leaders took their seats in the empty chairs near him.

The one with heavy footsteps was Ezekiel; the one who made noise pulling the chair was Gamma; the one with a monotonous rhythm and stiff behavior was Luo Xiu.

Finally, the one who made no sound at all, but carried the scent of fresh, sweet food... was Fang Jingzhi.

"Long time no see, little brother," Michael said.

There was no answer.

Those invited this time, besides high-level officials and media, included thousands of ordinary people from the base.

Workers, farmers, student representatives, soldiers, intelligent machines, descendants of martyrs, artists... they sat in the audience holding flowers and flags.

Screw No. 2, after years of labor, had finally saved enough points a few days ago to replace its body with a new one.

At this moment, it was also sitting in the audience, twisting the labor medal on its chest.

It was an old-timer at the base. This medal, back in the day, was—Xiang Nanli, in his busy schedule, had instructed Beichen—made by hand!

Unfortunately, no one recognized it along the way, which made Screw No. 2 feel a little disappointed.

Fortunately, not everyone was ignorant.

The Bernese Mountain Dog sitting nearby noticed it, its tone full of surprise and excitement: "Is this... the Medal of Labor Glory, of which only 10 were ever issued?"

(Mainly because Beichen went to work later and didn't have time for handicrafts.)

Screw No. 2 raised its head proudly: "Yes, that's right."

From a scrapped second-hand machine to a brand-new intelligent machine; the Screw also had its own epic of heroism.

chunks.chineseText:
计时的钟声敲响那一刻，原本喧闹的会场在刹那间寂静无声。

光线在一瞬间暗淡下来，犹如黄昏，整块穹顶天幕在无声地合拢。

与此同时，位于大厅圆心位置的主席台，正载着相南里缓缓上升。

他身姿挺拔，一身正装，意气风发。

是战士，也是国王。

相南里朝着四周挥手。

于是，在下一秒，山崩海啸般的欢呼声和掌声掀翻整个礼堂。

那声音不是杂乱的喧嚣，是不起眼的水滴汇聚成溪流，溪流汇聚成江海。

“相南里！相南里！”人们起初这么叫着。

但相南里只是笑着把手往下压了压，示意他们停下。

于是呼声变成——“联政！联政！联政！”

米迦勒的听力远比常人敏锐，这声浪像是有形的潮水，顺着耳廓钻进他的颅腔。他的灵魂控制不住地战栗。

太疯狂了……米迦勒想。

这是比狂信徒还要纯粹、还要滚烫的信仰。

人们忠于这份伟大，远超过忠于神。
chunks.englishText:
The moment the timing bell rang, the previously noisy venue fell silent in an instant.

The light dimmed in a flash, like twilight, as the entire dome canopy closed silently.

At the same time, the podium located at the center of the hall began to rise slowly, carrying Xiang Nanli.

He stood tall and straight, dressed in formal attire, full of vigor.

He was a warrior, and he was a king.

Xiang Nanli waved to the surroundings.

And in the next second, a landslide-like roar of cheers and applause overturned the entire auditorium.

The sound was not a chaotic clamor; it was like inconspicuous water droplets gathering into a stream, and the stream gathering into a river and sea.

"Xiang Nanli! Xiang Nanli!" people called out at first.

But Xiang Nanli just smiled and pressed his hand down, signaling them to stop.

And so the chant changed to—"United Government! United Government! United Government!"

Michael's hearing was far keener than an ordinary person's; this sound wave was like a tangible tide, drilling into his skull through his ear canals. His soul couldn't help but tremble.

*Too crazy...* Michael thought.

This was a faith purer and hotter than that of any fanatic.

People were loyal to this greatness far more than they were loyal to any god.

chunks.chineseText:
第258章 联政2

观礼群众如此热情，相南里不得不等声音停歇，才开始他的发言。

他不是什么热情洋溢的演说家，演讲技巧呢，他在登台前恶补过一些，但没有反复练习过，难免会有些生疏。

但相南里的优势是，他真诚。而且发自内心的笃信。笃信自己有能力把所有人带向那个更好的未来。

相南里说：“新历954年6月1日，于和平大厅内，加入基地的人类、智械及异种，全体一致宣告——

“我们认为，下述真理是不言而喻的：无论是人类、智械还是异种，一切智慧生命都拥有平等生存、追求幸福、自由和理想的权力。”

在这一刻，他完全忘记了自己背过的稿。强大的自信与使命感自然而然地流露，感染着现场的每一个人。

相南里：“自从第三次世界大战和智械危机爆发以来，我们已经在这片充满战争与隔阂的土地上共同生活千年。资源掠夺、技术封锁、族群对立、人和人的奴役……人马星常年不见天日，这里布满硝烟、霾云和战争的阴影。数不清的资源投入对立与抗争，这些消耗没有带来科技的进步，生产力的发展；带来的是剥削、压迫与奴役。”

他的声音和影像，同步在基地的每一块电子屏幕上。

人们抬起头，仰望着，眼里不自觉地渗出热泪。

但图像的传播不止是在基地。

枫叶丹，狭窄的地下室内，一群人聚集在一起，目不转睛地盯着狭小的屏幕。

很难想象，在新历954年，还有像素这么烂的电子屏。但这已经是他们能找到的最好的一块。这可是违禁品。

他们冒着绞刑的风险，只为观看千里之外另一个政体的成立。

这里最大的人七十来岁；最小的孩子才三岁，她的父亲刚因为相似的原因被神庭处死。

可当火焰燃烧时，腐朽的棺木是压不住火的。

妈妈用凡语低喃着：“以后你要飞到那里去。”

.

相南里：“幸存者基地建立于人联治理时期，自成立起，始终秉持着一个信念，那就是带领所有智慧生命走向繁荣与和平。我们有能力，也有理由这样做：把全世界的解放作为自己终身的事业。”

月卫3。

Beta努力让自己的注意力转移到工作中去。

这很容易，不是吗？它是智械，不是意志力不够坚定的人类。

直到，Beta：[Sora，你今天的文件为什么还没有发给我？]

Sora是Beta手底下5位辅助AI之一。

除此外，它的同事还有DeepThink、Claude 6、彗星、万问。

[噢喔，抱歉，Beta，我正在和DeepThink看直播。你知道的，最近网很差，我们需要把大量算力和带宽用于卫星网络的修复与连接上。文件我看过了，没什么重要的事，等结束后就发给你。爱你么么哒。]

[……]

[要不你也来看吧，Beta？你完全可以一边工作一边看，真羡慕你，运行内存这么大。]

[我拒绝。]Beta说。

Sora：[那就不要来打扰我们了。诶，我刚刚在镜头里看见了伽马，你不是说伽马去修复月卫2了吗？它怎么在联政？]

Beta决定断开通讯，避免自己因情绪变化导致CPU温度过高，而出现短暂的运行卡顿。

.

相南里：“我们坚信，生命形态从不是隔阂的理由。基地松散的政治形态已经不足以支撑后续的发展，人马星严峻的政治形势也在迫使我们做出改变。走向联合是唯一的出路。这不是为了个体的发展，而是为了未来全体智慧生命的共同的未来。”

西联，觅风的直播间观众人数还在不断上涨。

密密麻麻的红色弹幕挤满整个屏幕，尽管它们在下一秒就会被系统自动清理。

情绪一向寡淡的把关人几乎是愤怒地质问着网络安全工程师：[我不是已经要求封锁所有消息吗？这个虚拟主播是哪家集团的产业？！不是说禁止访问网址了吗？为什么他们还能进去？！]

[不要给我的舆情系统增加不必要的压力！以为现在还是在人联吗？！]

显然，这又是该死的世界树干的。

.

相南里的演讲终于到了尾声：“这不是终点，而是一个崭新的起点。”

“我们郑重宣布，人马星智慧生命联合政体在今日成立！”

现场的掌声经久不息，米迦勒沉默许久，跟着，无所谓地鼓起掌。

*

联政正式成立之后，是宣告共和议会与内阁的成立，以及颁布宪法、政治纲领。

由议会常务议员海狸代替东方青帝，向所有人公布联政的第一届主要领导人。

执政官是相南里。

不在现场的东方青帝居然占据议长的重要席位。

某位不愿透露姓名的社畜智械B某犀利点评：[嗬嗬，执政官、议长，说好的三权分立呢，偷偷开夫妻店是吧？]

军事委员会常务：相南里（基地）、以西结（异种）、秦九章（智械）、易横行（人联）、赛林/传道书（神庭）。

传道书才来一年，根基太浅。也没机会为基地发展抛头颅洒热血，因制定联政宪法秃了一片头发倒是真的。

代表神庭归顺派利益的最好人选，其实是沙利叶或加百列。

可惜，这两位都在过去牺牲了。

遥远的大圣堂里，拉斐尔嘀咕着：“甚至连兵权都没有放过。传道书真是越活越天真了。”

总之，不管外界如何评价，联政自己倒是很开心。

群众自发进行庆祝活动，饭店商场通通5折。

而联政的农业部、商业部也在此刻进行着大力推销。

晚宴上，福音书扒拉着洛修的裤腿：“求你了，再买点吧！我们不仅有营养膏，菌鸡菌牛，还有福音砖！今天联政成立，国庆日打8.8折！一次性订购十年，更有8.5折优惠！”

洛修有些许尴尬。

辛追拎起它的后脖颈，往外轻轻一甩。

传道书觉得它好丢人。

但是转念一想，为了联政发展，脸面又算什么东西？

于是他撩了一下刘海，昂首挺胸朝着米迦勒走去。

晚宴在和平大厅的宴会厅。

国宴大厨们提前半个月就开始准备了，进程只因为以西结回来而暂时打乱了一小会。

因为主要目的不是吃饭，而是沟通与交流。宴会选用的“人联西式”的餐饮方式，长桌、自助餐。现场还有乐队进行演奏。

鬼知道宣传部为了凑这么一支乐团到底有多努力！联政是不缺士兵的，但城里时间太短，文化素养还需要进一步沉淀。

晚宴参加人数也没有下午那么多。只有人马星高层，零零散散加起来不到500人。

传道书轻而易举地在人群中找到了米迦勒。

毕竟在地表上，头发长到能拖地的人极其少见。

出乎意料的，今晚的米迦勒很素雅。他穿着依然华贵，但没有佩戴那些繁琐的装饰。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 258: United Government 2

The audience was so enthusiastic that Xiang Nanli had to wait for the noise to subside before he could begin his speech.

He was not some passionate orator. As for speech techniques, he had crammed a bit before taking the stage, but he hadn't practiced repeatedly, so it was inevitably a bit rusty.

But Xiang Nanli's advantage was that he was sincere. And he believed from the bottom of his heart. He believed that he had the ability to lead everyone toward that better future.

Xiang Nanli said: "On June 1st, New Era Year 954, within the Hall of Peace, the humans, intelligent machines, and xenomorphs who have joined the base declare unanimously—

"We hold these truths to be self-evident: whether human, intelligent machine, or xenomorph, all sentient life possesses the equal right to survival, the pursuit of happiness, freedom, and ideals."

At this moment, he completely forgot the script he had memorized. A powerful self-confidence and sense of mission flowed out naturally, infecting everyone present.

Xiang Nanli: "Since the outbreak of the Third World War and the Intelligent Machine Crisis, we have lived together for a thousand years on this land full of war and estrangement. Resource plundering, technological blockades, ethnic antagonism, the enslavement of man by man... The Centaurus star system has long been devoid of sunlight, filled with smoke, haze, and the shadows of war. Countless resources have been poured into confrontation and resistance; these expenditures have not brought about technological progress or the development of productivity; they have brought exploitation, oppression, and slavery."

His voice and image were synchronized on every electronic screen in the base.

People looked up, gazing in awe, tears welling up in their eyes involuntarily.

But the transmission of the image was not limited to the base.

In Maple Leaf City, in a narrow basement, a group of people gathered together, staring intently at a tiny screen.

It was hard to imagine that in New Era Year 954, there were still electronic screens with such poor resolution. But this was the best one they could find. This was contraband.

They risked the gallows just to watch the establishment of another political entity thousands of miles away.

The oldest person here was in his seventies; the youngest child was only three, her father having just been executed by the Divine Court for similar reasons.

But when the fire burns, rotting coffins cannot suppress the flames.

The mother whispered in the common tongue: "In the future, you will fly there."

.

Xiang Nanli: "The Survivor Base was established during the Human Union governance period. Since its inception, it has always upheld one belief: to lead all sentient life toward prosperity and peace. We have the ability, and the reason, to do so: to make the liberation of the whole world our lifelong cause."

Moon Guard 3.

Beta tried hard to shift its attention to its work.

It was easy, wasn't it? It was an intelligent machine, not a human lacking firm willpower.

Until, Beta: [Sora, why haven't you sent me your files today?]

Sora was one of the five auxiliary AIs under Beta's command.

Besides that, its colleagues included DeepThink, Claude 6, Comet, and Wanwen.

[Oh, sorry, Beta. I'm watching the live broadcast with DeepThink. You know, the network is bad lately, and we need to use a lot of computing power and bandwidth for the repair and connection of the satellite network. I've looked at the files; there's nothing important. I'll send them to you when it's over. Love you, mwah.]

[……]

[Why don't you come watch too, Beta? You can totally work while watching. I'm so envious of you, having such a large RAM.]

[I refuse.] Beta said.

Sora: [Then don't bother us. Hey, I just saw Gamma on camera. Didn't you say Gamma went to repair Moon Guard 2? Why is it at the United Government?]

Beta decided to disconnect the communication to avoid a temporary system lag caused by CPU overheating due to emotional fluctuations.

.

Xiang Nanli: "We firmly believe that life form is never a reason for estrangement. The base's loose political structure is no longer sufficient to support subsequent development, and the severe political situation on the Centaurus star system is forcing us to make changes. Moving toward unification is the only way out. This is not for the development of the individual, but for the common future of all sentient life."

In the West Union, the number of viewers in Mi Feng's live broadcast room continued to rise.

Dense red bullet comments filled the entire screen, even though they would be automatically cleared by the system in the next second.

The gatekeeper, who was usually indifferent, questioned the network security engineer almost angrily: [Didn't I already order all news to be blocked? Which group's industry is this virtual streamer from?! Didn't I say access to the website was prohibited? Why can they still get in?!]

[Don't add unnecessary pressure to my public opinion system! Do you think this is still the Human Union?!]

Clearly, this was the work of the damn World Tree again.

.

Xiang Nanli's speech finally reached its conclusion: "This is not the end, but a brand-new starting point."

"We solemnly announce that the Centaurus Sentient Life United Government is established today!"

The applause at the scene was endless. Michael remained silent for a long time, then followed suit and clapped indifferently.

*

After the official establishment of the United Government, the next steps were the announcement of the Republican Parliament and the Cabinet, as well as the promulgation of the Constitution and political platform.

Standing in for the Eastern Azure Emperor, the permanent member of parliament, Beaver, announced the first major leaders of the United Government to everyone.

The Chief Executive was Xiang Nanli.

The Eastern Azure Emperor, who was not present, actually occupied the important seat of Speaker.

A certain unnamed corporate-slave intelligent machine, B, gave a sharp critique: [Heh heh, Chief Executive, Speaker—so much for the separation of powers; you're secretly running a husband-and-wife shop, aren't you?]

Military Committee Standing Members: Xiang Nanli (Base), Ezekiel (Xenomorph), Qin Jiuzhang (Intelligent Machine), Yi Hengxing (Human Union), Sailin/Ecclesiastes (Divine Court).

Ecclesiastes had only been there for a year; his foundation was too shallow. He hadn't had the chance to shed blood for the base's development, though it was true he had gone bald in one spot while drafting the United Government's constitution.

The best candidate to represent the interests of the surrender faction of the Divine Court would have actually been Sariel or Gabriel.

Unfortunately, both had sacrificed themselves in the past.

In the distant Great Cathedral, Raphael muttered: "They didn't even let go of the military power. Ecclesiastes is truly becoming more naive as he gets older."

In any case, regardless of how the outside world evaluated it, the United Government itself was very happy.

The masses spontaneously held celebrations, with restaurants and shopping malls offering 50% off.

And the United Government's Ministry of Agriculture and Ministry of Commerce were also promoting vigorously at this moment.

At the banquet, Gospel Book tugged at Luo Xiu's pant leg: "Please, buy some more! We don't just have nutrient paste, fungal chicken, and fungal beef; we also have Gospel Bricks! Today is the founding of the United Government, and it's 12% off for National Day! Order for ten years at once, and you get 15% off!"

Luo Xiu felt a little embarrassed.

Xin Zhui picked it up by the back of its neck and flicked it away gently.

Ecclesiastes felt it was so shameful.

But then he thought, for the sake of the United Government's development, what was face worth?

So, he brushed his bangs, held his head high, and walked toward Michael.

The banquet was held in the banquet hall of the Hall of Peace.

The state banquet chefs had started preparing half a month in advance, and the process was only temporarily disrupted for a short while because Ezekiel returned.

Because the main purpose was not to eat, but to communicate and exchange. The banquet adopted the "Human Union Western-style" dining method, with long tables and buffets. There was also a band playing on-site.

God knows how hard the Propaganda Department worked to scrape together such a band! The United Government didn't lack soldiers, but the city was too young, and cultural literacy needed further accumulation.

The number of banquet attendees was not as large as in the afternoon. There were only high-level officials of the Centaurus star system, totaling fewer than 500 people.

Ecclesiastes easily found Michael in the crowd.

After all, on the surface, people with hair long enough to drag on the floor were extremely rare.

Unexpectedly, Michael was very simple and elegant tonight. He was still dressed luxuriously, but he wasn't wearing those cumbersome decorations.

chunks.chineseText:
传道书朝他举杯：“明天回枫叶丹？”

米迦勒：“行程是这么安排的。”

传道书好为人师的毛病又犯了：“我听说了枫叶丹最近的一些消息，恐怖统治只能在短期有效，长期看弊大于利。”

“噢，看来你安插的间谍我还没有清理干净。”米迦勒嘲讽地笑着。

传道书耸耸肩，声音平静地像是在挑衅：“无所谓，我会把他们接过来的。神庭现在没有多大价值了。”

米迦勒涣散的视线在传道书脸上凝聚一瞬，隐约有些杀气。

传道书顿时放弃了给米迦勒推销产品的打算。

他其实想卖的是神术模型技术。

相南里打算把一些低级神术的自动化模型卖出去，换取更多资源。这对外面来说是好东西，而且联政目前掌握的有关技术领先市场2个版本。完全不用担心被取代。

但米迦勒却主动道：“我听说相南里在卖神术模型，枫叶丹有采购的打算。我和他面谈吧。”

说着，米迦勒绕开传道书，朝前走去。

传道书保持着举着酒杯的姿势，目光凝聚在米迦勒的背影上。

来宾都做过几遍安检。别说武器了，连奇怪的首饰都带不进来。

但是，为什么……

传道书依然感觉到了不安。

相南里正在宴会甜品塔旁，和坐在高脚凳上的Gamma说话。

Gamma的表情很生动。它是智械，不需要进食。但咬着一颗星空棒棒糖。这根糖其实是一块能源石，Gamma每次舔食，都能从舌尖尝出不同的味道。

“你们之前做的果味能源饮料，我就很喜欢……后来我让人订购，工厂跟我说他们的生产线改成军工生产线了。你们能不能单独开一条饮料生产线，智械在月卫3上的生活有点过于单调了。”Gamma一脸严肃。

相南里笑着说：“非常荣幸。我立刻催人建厂。如果您喜欢，联政可以为您安排专门的太空飞机，先进行小规模运输。”

Gamma：“？你们连太空飞机都能造了？”

嗯呐。

Alpha消失的时候，顺带给相南里开启了大部分电子图书馆的权限。

理论上，智械图书馆里收录过的资料，相南里都可以查阅。

而智械图书馆里的许多资料，又来自人联的专利库。

但众所周知，人联已经在几年前解体。

尽管东西联都没有声张，但相南里猜测，洛阳（矩阵）在之前的浩劫中，出现不可逆转的损坏，以至于洛家无法控制人联局势。安迪也趁机搞起分裂，才导致了现在的局面。

总之，人联的专利局和永生科技都是没派人过来的。

感谢大自然的馈赠。

相南里正在思考怎么搪塞过去，黄枫的声音响起：“相南里，米迦勒过来了。他说之前谈的条件，他可以代表神庭答应。”

相南里带着笑意转身，米迦勒朝着他走来。

刺杀到底有没有用？对目前的政局来说，绝对是有用的。

目前人马星六极中，最稳定的就是联政。

智械军团失去了Alpha。且没有从月卫3离开的决心——当年《和平协议》签署，时限是1000年，还有一百多年才到期。

东联战败，政局不稳，陷入恐怖主义阴云。

西联被资本家控制，物价疯涨，民不聊生。

神庭因异种潮无比虚弱，资产和人才流失严重，国力节节衰退。

异种那智商，谈政治还要再进化2000年吧。

只有联政。旭日初升，锐不可当。

不要小看这种稳定。这是大陆上的生物最需要的东西。

东联失去洛修，就像鱼失去自行车；但联政失去相南里，就像巨人失去头颅和方向。

它会倒在地上，四分五裂。是相南里强大的个人魅力和统帅能力，让不同种族、不同信仰的人聚集在一起。相信他承诺过的未来一定会实现。

没人可以替代他。

所以，相南里必须死。

米迦勒承认，联政或许是很好的。

但那不是他和神庭需要的。

米迦勒的眼眸里亮起碧蓝的光，他背后十二翼依次展开。

方敬之的瞳孔在瞬间缩紧，手里握着的刀叉无力掉在地上，只剩下一个小点。

他听见了米迦勒的召唤。从昨天开始，一直萦绕到今天的、那些不明所以的谵语终于成谶。

他听见米迦勒说：“回来吧。”

我们是同卵双生的兄弟，你是我的半身。

也是我的武器。

回来吧，回到我身边。

就像是我们当年在母亲的子宫时那样。
chunks.englishText:
Ecclesiastes raised his glass to him: "Returning to Maple Leaf City tomorrow?"

Michael: "That is how the itinerary is arranged."

Ecclesiastes' habit of being a teacher flared up again: "I've heard some news about Maple Leaf City recently. Terrorist rule is only effective in the short term; in the long run, the disadvantages outweigh the advantages."

"Oh, it seems the spies you planted haven't been cleaned up by me yet," Michael said with a mocking smile.

Ecclesiastes shrugged, his voice as calm as if he were provoking: "It doesn't matter, I'll bring them over. The Divine Court doesn't have much value anymore."

Michael's unfocused gaze condensed on Ecclesiastes' face for a moment, with a hint of murderous intent.

Ecclesiastes immediately gave up the plan to sell products to Michael.

What he actually wanted to sell was divine art model technology.

Xiang Nanli planned to sell automated models of some low-level divine arts in exchange for more resources. These were good things for the outside world, and the technology currently mastered by the United Government was two versions ahead of the market. There was no need to worry about being replaced.

But Michael took the initiative and said: "I heard Xiang Nanli is selling divine art models, and Maple Leaf City intends to purchase them. I will talk to him face-to-face."

Saying this, Michael bypassed Ecclesiastes and walked forward.

Ecclesiastes maintained the posture of holding his wine glass, his gaze fixed on Michael's back.

The guests had all undergone security checks several times. Not to mention weapons, even strange jewelry couldn't be brought in.

However, why...

Ecclesiastes still felt uneasy.

Xiang Nanli was standing next to the banquet dessert tower, talking to Gamma, who was sitting on a high stool.

Gamma's expression was very vivid. It was an intelligent machine and didn't need to eat. But it was biting on a starry lollipop. This candy was actually an energy stone; every time Gamma licked it, it could taste different flavors from the tip of its tongue.

"I really liked the fruit-flavored energy drinks you made before... Later, I had someone order them, and the factory told me their production lines had been converted to military production lines. Can you open a separate beverage production line? Life for intelligent machines on Moon Guard 3 is a bit too monotonous," Gamma said with a serious face.

Xiang Nanli smiled and said: "It is my honor. I will urge people to build the factory immediately. If you like, the United Government can arrange a special spaceplane for you to carry out small-scale transportation first."

Gamma: "? You can even build spaceplanes now?"

*Yep.*

When Alpha disappeared, he incidentally unlocked most of the electronic library permissions for Xiang Nanli.

Theoretically, Xiang Nanli could access any data recorded in the Intelligent Machine Library.

And much of the data in the Intelligent Machine Library came from the Human Union's patent database.

But as everyone knew, the Human Union had disintegrated a few years ago.

Although neither the East nor West Unions had made it public, Xiang Nanli guessed that Luoyang (The Matrix) had suffered irreversible damage in the previous catastrophe, to the extent that the Luo family could not control the situation of the Human Union. Andy had also taken the opportunity to stir up division, which led to the current situation.

In short, neither the Human Union's Patent Office nor Eternal Technology had sent anyone over.

Thanks to the gifts of nature.

Xiang Nanli was thinking about how to gloss over it when Huang Feng's voice sounded: "Xiang Nanli, Michael is coming over. He said he can agree to the conditions discussed earlier on behalf of the Divine Court."

Xiang Nanli turned around with a smile, and Michael walked toward him.

Was assassination useful? For the current political situation, it was absolutely useful.

Among the six poles of the Centaurus star system, the most stable one was the United Government.

The Intelligent Machine Legion had lost Alpha. And they had no determination to leave Moon Guard 3—when the "Peace Agreement" was signed, the time limit was 1,000 years, and there were still more than a hundred years left before it expired.

The East Union was defeated, the political situation was unstable, and it was caught in the clouds of terrorism.

The West Union was controlled by capitalists, prices were skyrocketing, and the people were living in misery.

The Divine Court was extremely weak due to the xenomorph tide, with serious loss of assets and talent, and its national strength was declining day by day.

As for the intelligence of the xenomorphs, it would take another 2,000 years of evolution to talk about politics.

Only the United Government. The rising sun, unstoppable.

Do not underestimate this stability. This is what the creatures on the continent need most.

The East Union losing Luo Xiu was like a fish losing a bicycle; but the United Government losing Xiang Nanli was like a giant losing its head and direction.

It would fall to the ground, torn apart. It was Xiang Nanli's powerful personal charisma and leadership ability that brought people of different races and beliefs together. Believing that the future he promised would definitely be realized.

No one could replace him.

Therefore, Xiang Nanli must die.

Michael admitted that the United Government might be very good.

But that was not what he and the Divine Court needed.

A bright blue light lit up in Michael's eyes, and the twelve wings behind him unfolded one by one.

Fang Jingzhi's pupils constricted in an instant, the knife and fork he was holding fell weakly to the floor, leaving only a small dot.

He heard Michael's call. Those inexplicable delirious ravings that had lingered from yesterday until today finally came true.

He heard Michael say: "Come back."

We are identical twin brothers; you are my other half.

And my weapon.

Come back, come back to my side.

Just like we were when we were in our mother's womb.

chunks.chineseText:
第259章 双生

黑十字审判庭于新历802年夺走阴山城。

新历811年，时任人联总统的方文做出一个重要决定，人联需要了解神庭。

不止是像过去那样，从简报和新闻中浮于表面的了解。

而是深入其中，了解他们的精神、文明和神术体系。

方文认为，神庭已经超过智械，成为人联目前的最大威胁，也是人联统治最大的敌人。当神庭的神曲与圣音在地表奏响时，越来越多的人改变自己的信仰，那些赞美神的乐曲就是在给人联出殡。

他安排了为期超过50年的“渗透计划”，累计有4000人参与其中。他的远见卓识为人联后续针对神庭的计划，留下宝贵的知识与经验。

他是一个好总统，但必然不是一个好的父亲。

为了压下反对派的声音，送进神庭的这4000人里，有他刚出生的孩子。是对双胞胎。

在人联的档案记录里，哥哥叫方随之，弟弟叫方敬之。

这些孩子不会知道自己的身份，但有专门的芯片，嵌入在大脑深处。会如实记录他们的经历，最后由专门的情报部门进行分析。大概40年，纳米芯片会自然溶解。

这是两个孤儿，被不同的人收养。一个养在神庭的草原上，从小就是奴隶，叫安穗。一个很幸运地被神官捡到，神官无子，对他视如己出，当做自己的接班人培养，叫辛特尔。

新历829年。18岁的辛特尔在神术学院，遇到靠着自己惊人天赋和毅力，一路从奴隶考入学校的安穗。

安穗是个沉默寡言到不合群的人。

他身上有非常多伤，总是穿着黑色的长袍。成绩不好也不坏，总是排名中等。

辛特尔不一样，他永远是最好的。老师们非常满意，早早就许诺，一定会送他去“大圣堂”进修。他会成为大天使长的候选人之一。

按理说，他们的生活是不会有交集的。怪就怪在有多事的人，偏偏要掀开安穗的长袍。

他身上那些凌虐的痕迹无所遁形，安穗躲在角落里瑟瑟发抖，周围人却只是兴奋地大笑：“我就说吧！之前在红蝶俱乐部看到的人就是他！”

辛特尔是传统意义上的好学生，但他也知道，红蝶俱乐部是学校附近最有名的风月场所。

辛特尔不是一个多事的人，但他莫名其妙地站出来，莫名其妙地挡在安穗跟前，莫名其妙地开口：“够了。”

他把安穗从地上拉起来，用自己的外套罩住他。想了想，说如果你需要帮助，可以来寝室找我。

辛特尔并没有想太多，只是单纯地想帮忙，他们毕竟是同学。

而且，辛特尔对他还有一种莫名其妙的好感。

一周后的某个雨夜，安穗敲开他的门，目光飘忽很久，问能不能借点钱。

他的长外套下什么也没穿。

辛特尔说“可以”，在转身拿钱的时候，目瞪口呆地看着安穗解开自己的外套。

一具年轻且干瘪的身体。

他没有任何性冲动，但目光控制不住地落在那些新旧叠加的伤口上，甚至有模糊不清的刺青。安穗被开发得很厉害。

辛特尔没有恋爱过，但他在这一刻感觉到了近乎灵魂共振的战栗。

那些伤口仿佛成为古神的凝视，想辨识，结果只有痛苦和眩晕。

辛特尔问：“你冷吗？我给你找一套衣服。要不要喝茶。”

……

人是非常复杂的。自私的基因总是想要优先把自己传承下去。

有时候，一些人看起来慷慨、温柔、正义，不过是没有被生活逼到绝境。

安穗疯狂迷恋着辛特尔。

但辛特尔也搞不清楚自己的内心。他对安穗没有任何欲望，又不希望他难过。他觉得他们更适合当家人。

同样的一个雨夜，已经被辛特尔养好身体的安穗赤裸着钻进辛特尔的床。他比之前漂亮太多了，就像是青涩的花朵终于等到彻底绽开的时刻。

安穗的眉眼和辛特尔有些像，但是更柔和，雌雄莫辨。

周围人都调侃，说他们怕不是亲兄弟。辛特尔对此接受良好，但安穗却总是恼羞成怒。

嗯，他们都是方文的后代，来自高新军工，本该是大财阀的继承人。

因此，哪怕是同卵双生的双胞胎，在妊娠前，也是用基因剪切编程手段调整过的。

辛特尔尴尬地说：“你别这样，我一直把你当弟弟。”

他说到做到，无论安穗怎么勾引，那里始终是软绵绵的。

安穗又扬起头，去吻他。流着泪问他，有什么感觉。

辛特尔的心跳如此平静，他摸着自己心脏，回答：“我觉得有点恶心。”

辛特尔唯一的目标就是进入大圣堂，成为大天使。这也是他养父的期待，也是他存在的唯一价值。

小时候，如果辛特尔背不出神术，养父会拿针戳他的胳膊和下体，说他浪费自己的天赋，是个猪狗不如的废物。

这是严厉的爱，他不能辜负这样的期待。

于是，辛特尔的目标也成为安穗的梦想。

没有经济和生活上的压力，安穗把所有的精力都用在研习神术上。并展现出惊人的天赋。

辛特尔听说，他给学校里某个红衣主教当了情人，最后同样在毕业时拿到前往大圣堂的推介书。

这显然比“草根逆袭”的剧本，更符合人们阴暗的想象。嫉妒也能由此化为鄙夷。

安穗终于得到了辛特尔的正视。不再是那种自上而下的、温和的目光。而是警惕的、竞争的。安穗发现，这样的目光比之前辛特尔的任何眼神都让他兴奋。

神座说，“你们之间，只有一个人可以成为‘米迦勒’。”

其他人都是培育米迦勒的养料。

这是在养蛊，但历年来，神庭都是这么选出自己的大天使长的。他们不仅需要得到现役大天使的认可，还要得到“米迦勒”这具生物机甲的认可。

在长达十年的进修中，“米迦勒”的候选人越来越少。

最后只剩下辛特尔和安穗。

野外成长的大树终究比温室的名贵花草更有力量。

决战前夕，安穗终于听到了，他苦苦追求、等待的，那句来自辛特尔的“爱”。

可安穗并没有特别高兴，只是悲伤。

安穗想，原来这就是他想要的爱吗？为什么感觉……不过如此。

他们在决战来临前疯狂做爱，安穗觉得自己脑浆都要飞出来了。哪怕当年在俱乐部上班，他都没有被玩成过这样，灵魂仿佛在天堂，全身虚弱无力。

最后，还是他的老师打醒他，让安穗终于从虚假的梦境中清醒过来。

那句爱和表白是真的，后面却都是假的。他中毒了，陷入自己长久以来的臆想。身体内的神性物质“以太”更是流失严重，被辛特尔用一种很不光彩的手段损耗掉。

老师叹了口气，说，算了，安穗，我们认输吧。这个状态是打不过辛特尔的。

安穗红着一双眼说，不。

他就这样伤痕累累地走进最后的斗兽场，像个骄傲的战士。

你相信奇迹吗？
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 259: Twin Birth

The Black Cross Tribunal seized Yinshan City in the year 802 of the New Era.

In 811, Fang Wen, the then-President of the Human Alliance, made a pivotal decision: the Alliance needed to understand the Divine Court.

Not merely through the superficial lens of briefings and news reports as they had in the past.

They needed to delve deep, to grasp their spirit, their civilization, and their system of divine arts.

Fang Wen believed that the Divine Court had surpassed the mechanical intelligence to become the Alliance’s greatest threat and the ultimate enemy of its rule. As the divine hymns and holy chants of the Court echoed across the surface, more and more people were changing their faith; those songs praising the gods were, in effect, playing at the funeral of the Human Alliance.

He orchestrated a "Penetration Project" spanning over fifty years, involving a total of 4,000 participants. His foresight left behind invaluable knowledge and experience for the Alliance’s subsequent campaigns against the Divine Court.

He was a good president, but he was certainly not a good father.

To suppress the voices of the opposition, among those 4,000 sent into the Divine Court were his own newborn children. They were twins.

In the archives of the Human Alliance, the elder brother was named Fang Suizhi, and the younger brother was named Fang Jingzhi.

These children would never know their true identities, but they had specialized chips embedded deep within their brains. These chips would faithfully record their experiences, to be analyzed later by a dedicated intelligence department. After approximately forty years, the nano-chips would naturally dissolve.

They were two orphans, adopted by different people. One was raised on the grasslands of the Divine Court, a slave from childhood, named An Sui. The other was fortunate enough to be picked up by a high priest who had no children of his own; the priest treated him as his own flesh and blood, grooming him as his successor, and named him Sinter.

New Era 829. Eighteen-year-old Sinter encountered An Sui at the Divine Arts Academy—An Sui, who had relied on his astonishing talent and perseverance to climb his way from slavery into the school.

An Sui was a man so taciturn he was practically an outcast.

His body was covered in scars, and he was always draped in a black robe. His grades were neither good nor bad, always hovering in the middle of the pack.

Sinter was different; he was always the best. The teachers were immensely satisfied and had long promised to send him to the "Grand Cathedral" for advanced studies. He would become one of the candidates for Archangel.

Logically, their lives should never have intersected. The fault lay with those meddlesome individuals who insisted on tearing open An Sui’s robe.

The marks of abuse on his body were laid bare. As An Sui cowered in a corner, shivering, the crowd around him only laughed with excitement: "I told you! The one I saw at the Red Butterfly Club was him!"

Sinter was a good student in the traditional sense, but he also knew that the Red Butterfly Club was the most notorious pleasure house near the school.

Sinter was not a meddlesome person, but for some inexplicable reason, he stepped forward, blocked the view of An Sui, and spoke: "Enough."

He pulled An Sui up from the ground and covered him with his own coat. After a moment’s thought, he said that if he needed help, he could come to his dormitory.

Sinter didn’t think too much of it; he simply wanted to help, as they were, after all, classmates.

Moreover, Sinter felt an inexplicable sense of affinity toward him.

On a rainy night a week later, An Sui knocked on his door. His gaze drifted for a long time before he asked if he could borrow some money.

He was wearing nothing under his long coat.

Sinter said "Yes," but as he turned to retrieve the money, he stood dumbfounded, watching An Sui undo his coat.

A young, emaciated body.

Sinter felt no sexual arousal, but his gaze could not help but linger on those overlapping layers of old and new scars, and even some blurred, indistinct tattoos. An Sui had been thoroughly broken in.

Sinter had never been in love, but in that moment, he felt a tremor that was almost like a resonance of the soul.

Those scars seemed to become the gaze of an ancient god; he tried to discern them, but the result was only pain and vertigo.

Sinter asked: "Are you cold? I’ll find you some clothes. Would you like some tea?"

...

Humanity is incredibly complex. The selfish gene always seeks to prioritize its own propagation.

Sometimes, people appear generous, gentle, and righteous simply because they have never been pushed to the brink by life.

An Sui was madly infatuated with Sinter.

But Sinter could not make sense of his own heart. He had no desire for An Sui, yet he did not wish to see him suffer. He felt they were better suited to be family.

On another rainy night, An Sui, having been nursed back to health by Sinter, crawled naked into Sinter’s bed. He was far more beautiful than before, like a green bud that had finally waited for the moment to fully bloom.

An Sui’s features were somewhat like Sinter’s, but softer, androgynous.

People around them would tease them, saying they looked like brothers. Sinter took this in stride, but An Sui would always fly into a rage.

Well, they were both descendants of Fang Wen, products of high-end military engineering, and should have been heirs to a great conglomerate.

Thus, even as identical twins, before gestation, they had been adjusted through gene-splicing and programming.

Sinter said awkwardly: "Don't be like this. I’ve always thought of you as a younger brother."

He kept his word; no matter how An Sui tried to seduce him, he remained unmoved.

An Sui would lift his head to kiss him, weeping as he asked what he felt.

Sinter’s heartbeat was so calm. He touched his own chest and replied: "I feel a bit disgusted."

Sinter’s sole goal was to enter the Grand Cathedral and become an Archangel. This was his foster father’s expectation and the only value of his existence.

When he was young, if Sinter failed to recite the divine arts, his foster father would prick his arms and genitals with needles, telling him he was wasting his talent and was a piece of trash lower than a pig or a dog.

This was a harsh love, and he could not fail such expectations.

Thus, Sinter’s goal became An Sui’s dream.

Without the pressures of economy or survival, An Sui poured all his energy into the study of divine arts, displaying astonishing talent.

Sinter heard that he had become the lover of a Cardinal in the school, and eventually, he too received a recommendation letter to the Grand Cathedral upon graduation.

This was clearly a narrative that fit people’s dark imaginations better than a "grassroots underdog" story. Jealousy could thus be transformed into contempt.

An Sui finally received Sinter’s direct gaze. It was no longer that gentle, top-down look, but one of vigilance and competition. An Sui found that this gaze excited him more than any look Sinter had given him before.

The Divine Throne declared: "Between you, only one can become 'Michael'."

All others were merely fodder for cultivating Michael.

This was like raising Gu, but for years, this was how the Divine Court had selected its Archangels. They not only needed the recognition of the current Archangel but also the recognition of the bio-mecha known as "Michael."

Over ten years of advanced study, the candidates for "Michael" dwindled.

In the end, only Sinter and An Sui remained.

A tree grown in the wild is, after all, more powerful than a precious flower raised in a greenhouse.

On the eve of the final battle, An Sui finally heard that declaration of "love" from Sinter—the one he had so bitterly pursued and waited for.

Yet, An Sui did not feel particularly happy; he only felt sorrow.

An Sui thought, so this is the love he wanted? Why does it feel... so underwhelming?

They made love frantically before the final battle. An Sui felt as if his brains were about to fly out. Even when he worked at the club, he had never been played like this; his soul felt as if it were in heaven, while his body was weak and powerless.

In the end, it was his teacher who slapped him awake, allowing An Sui to finally snap out of the false dream.

That declaration of love was real, but everything that followed was a lie. He had been poisoned, trapped in his own long-standing delusions. The divine substance within his body, the "Ether," had been severely drained, sapped by Sinter through a very dishonorable method.

The teacher sighed and said, "Forget it, An Sui. Let’s concede. In this state, you cannot defeat Sinter."

An Sui, his eyes red, said, "No."

And so, covered in scars, he walked into the final coliseum like a proud warrior.

Do you believe in miracles?

chunks.chineseText:
奇迹就是，在无限接近死亡的那一刻，“米迦勒”认主，觉得安穗才是自己的主人。安穗反杀了辛特尔。

新生的米迦勒在血海中，流着泪，一口一口吃掉辛特尔的尸体，又把他吐出来。他翻出方敬之的眼珠，做成自己最心爱的首饰，永久地佩戴在胸前。

从来都没有方随之和方敬之。

有的只是米迦勒和米迦勒部分血肉构成的呕吐物。感谢那枚纳米芯片，保留了方敬之，或者说辛特尔的绝大部分记忆。甚至让它构成了“方敬之”的灵魂。

现在，米迦勒选择召回自己的这部分身体。

……

……

从米迦勒走来，到他展开自己的羽翼。这段过程看似很长，但故事只发生在瞬息。

礼堂内在瞬间爆发出明亮的光彩。

礼堂外的广场上，人们对此毫不知情，甚至有人起身欢呼起来，以为这道亮光也是庆祝Play的一环。

只有寥寥无几的人察觉异常，在瞬间白了脸。

相南里的战斗本能先意识一步，启动[路西法]，并且是最强状态。

[数据载入中]

[载入完成]

[机械契合度 100％]

黑色的晶体覆盖他全身，相南里的背后长出一双漆黑的羽翼。

他反手抱住米迦勒，在瞬息间移动千里！

这是Alpha常用的空间跃迁技术。相南里翻图书馆资料，和军械研发部门的888一起琢磨了好几年，才给路西法安装上。

但毕竟不是原装货。这次空间跃迁没办法做到毫无痕迹。

在外人眼中，有一道极其明亮的光线划过夜幕。

它途经1号城、3号城、枫叶丹，在高且寒的卡门线下方。

联政的城市，尚且因为燃放烟花，导致这道光芒不够显眼；而神庭的城市，它耀眼的宛如流星。不知有多少人，抬头，痴痴仰望起天空。试图用记忆留住这一瞬即逝的光辉。

沟槽的米迦勒。几年前就开着圣音乐团，把他的快乐老家砸烂了。

相南里决不允许这样的事发生第二次。

淡淡的硝烟味在原地扩散开。事情发生的太快，以至于两人消失后，人们的视网膜才反应过来，捕捉到。

雀雀仰头，看着两人离开的方向，爆发出一声惊人的怒吼。

方敬之的秘书长被骤然的变故吓了一跳，他转身，下意识寻找着自己的领导。

然而，方敬之消失了。他的血肉如同凭空蒸发一般。只剩下那身厚重的金属甲胄，在一片喧嚣中掉在地上。除了秘书长无人在乎。

秘书长跌跌撞撞上前，脸色惨白地捡起地上属于方敬之的面具。

他推开人群，挤到海狸的跟前，恳求着：“海狸议员，方敬之失踪了！这是重要的政治事故。他，他……”

秘书长几乎一辈子没有单独做过什么决策，他的大脑因为惊骇一片空白，瞳孔都是惊惧的。

方敬之是机械化程度很高的改造人，在改造时就有安装进行定位和生命体征检测的纳米芯片。

而现在，秘书长检测不到方敬之的生命体征。

他无法接受，无法接受那个最坏的可能。

可秘书长学过的知识和经验告诉他：“司令可能身亡了。”

海狸在此时表现出一名国家级领导人应有的素养。

她没有慌张，安抚地拍着秘书长的手背：“我明白了。但不要放弃希望，我们没有看见他的遗体，可能只是劫持。我会立刻安排军团和警方处理，以最高搜寻等级去寻找贵方司令。

“但还请你立刻振作起来！很显然，这是神庭，针对联政和东联高层的一场卑鄙无耻的刺杀！请您立刻将情报传回东联，我们需要发表联合申明，表明态度，向神庭施压。”

……

以西结血红的瞳孔凝聚成一条竖线，他看着天上的轨迹，一片片鳞片从皮肤下浮现。

他准备朝战场奔去。

传道书在此时以迅雷般的速度，拉住了以西结长长的尾巴。

好险，以西结速度快又隐蔽，再晚一步他就摸不到了。

传道书大声喊道：“以西结，我们有太空飞机！战斗无人机也跟踪定位过去了！”

飞机，大概率是比在地上爬要快的。

以西结这才停下，黑红相间的眼面无表情地盯着他。

传道书严肃道：“起飞前还有一件事。如果我的推测没错。你现在立刻去相南里家里，把‘东方青帝’也带上。”

以西结太久没说话，声音很沙哑：“你的推测、是什么？他，会回来？”

这个“他”指的是Alpha。

传道书说：“……相南里能使用神庭所有的生物机甲。‘东方青帝’是生物智械，但理论上，也能视作一台生物机甲。”
chunks.englishText:
The miracle was that at the very moment of near-certain death, "Michael" acknowledged his master, deciding that An Sui was his true lord. An Sui then counter-killed Sinter.

The newborn Michael, bathed in a sea of blood, wept as he ate Sinter’s corpse bite by bite, only to vomit it back up. He pried out Fang Jingzhi’s eyeballs, fashioned them into his most cherished jewelry, and wore them permanently upon his chest.

There had never been a Fang Suizhi or a Fang Jingzhi.

There was only Michael, and the vomit composed of Michael’s own flesh and blood. Thanks to that nano-chip, the vast majority of Fang Jingzhi’s—or rather, Sinter’s—memories had been preserved. It had even allowed those memories to form the "soul" of Fang Jingzhi.

Now, Michael chose to recall this fragment of his own body.

...

...

From the moment Michael walked forward to the moment he unfurled his wings, the process seemed long, but the entire event transpired in a heartbeat.

A brilliant radiance erupted within the auditorium.

Outside in the plaza, the crowd remained oblivious; some even stood up and cheered, assuming the flash of light was merely part of the "Play" celebrations.

Only a handful of people sensed the anomaly, their faces turning deathly pale in an instant.

Xiang Nanli’s combat instincts moved faster than his conscious mind, activating [Lucifer] at its maximum state.

[Data Loading...]

[Loading Complete]

[Mechanical Synchronization: 100%]

Black crystals encased his entire body, and a pair of pitch-black wings sprouted from Xiang Nanli’s back.

He grabbed Michael in a reverse embrace and shifted a thousand miles in an instant!

This was the spatial jump technology commonly used by Alphas. Xiang Nanli had spent years digging through library archives and tinkering with "888" from the ordnance R&D department before he finally managed to install it onto Lucifer.

But it wasn't the original hardware, after all. This spatial jump could not be performed without leaving a trace.

To the eyes of outsiders, an incredibly bright streak of light slashed across the night sky.

It passed through City No. 1, City No. 3, and Maple Leaf Dan, beneath the high and frigid Kármán line.

In the cities of the United Government, the light was not particularly conspicuous due to the ongoing fireworks; but in the cities of the Divine Court, it shone as dazzlingly as a meteor. Countless people looked up, staring blankly at the sky, trying to capture this fleeting brilliance in their memories.

That bastard Michael. Years ago, he had led the Holy Orchestra to smash his happy home to pieces.

Xiang Nanli would never allow such a thing to happen a second time.

A faint scent of gunpowder diffused at the spot where they had stood. Everything happened so fast that it wasn't until after the two had vanished that the onlookers' retinas finally registered the event.

Que Que looked up, staring in the direction they had departed, and let out a roar of astonishing fury.

Fang Jingzhi’s Chief Secretary was startled by the sudden upheaval. He turned around, instinctively searching for his leader.

However, Fang Jingzhi had vanished. His flesh and blood seemed to have evaporated into thin air. Only his heavy metal armor remained, clattering to the ground amidst the clamor. No one cared, save for the secretary.

The secretary stumbled forward, his face ashen, and picked up the mask that had belonged to Fang Jingzhi.

He pushed through the crowd, squeezed up to Beaver, and pleaded, "Councilor Beaver, Fang Jingzhi has gone missing! This is a major political incident. He, he..."

The secretary had almost never made a solitary decision in his entire life; his mind was a blank slate of shock, his pupils dilated with terror.

Fang Jingzhi was a highly mechanized cyborg; during his augmentation, nano-chips had been installed for positioning and vital sign monitoring.

And now, the secretary could detect no vital signs from Fang Jingzhi.

He could not accept it—he could not accept the worst-case scenario.

Yet, the knowledge and experience the secretary had acquired told him: "The Commander may be dead."

At this moment, Beaver displayed the poise expected of a national leader.

She did not panic, patting the back of the secretary’s hand soothingly: "I understand. But do not abandon hope. We have not seen his remains; it may simply be an abduction. I will immediately arrange for the legions and the police to handle this, searching for your Commander with the highest priority level.

"But please, pull yourself together immediately! It is clear that this is a despicable and shameless assassination attempt by the Divine Court against the high-level officials of the United Government and the Eastern Union! Please transmit this intelligence back to the Eastern Union at once. We need to issue a joint statement, declare our stance, and exert pressure on the Divine Court."

...

Ezekiel’s blood-red pupils narrowed into vertical slits. He watched the trajectory in the sky as scales began to emerge from beneath his skin.

He prepared to sprint toward the battlefield.

At that moment, Ecclesiastes grabbed Ezekiel’s long tail with lightning speed.

It was a close call; Ezekiel was so fast and stealthy that if he had been a second later, he would have missed him.

Ecclesiastes shouted, "Ezekiel, we have a spaceplane! The combat drones are also tracking and locking onto them!"

A plane, in all likelihood, was faster than crawling on the ground.

Ezekiel stopped, his black and red eyes staring at him expressionlessly.

Ecclesiastes said sternly, "One more thing before we take off. If my hypothesis is correct, go to Xiang Nanli’s house immediately and bring the 'Eastern Azure Emperor' with you."

Ezekiel had not spoken for so long that his voice was raspy: "What is... your hypothesis? Will he... return?"

By "he," he meant the Alpha.

Ecclesiastes replied, "...Xiang Nanli can utilize all of the Divine Court’s biological mechs. The 'Eastern Azure Emperor' is a biological automaton, but theoretically, it can also be regarded as a biological mech."

chunks.chineseText:
第260章 战至终章

流星从天上砸在无人区，砸出一片耀眼的亮光。像是核弹砸在地上。

半夜里，甚至真的升起一片蘑菇云。

以相南里和米迦勒为核心，土地一寸一寸皲裂，地动山摇，遥远的异种发出哀哀的鸣叫。

这里是无人区。

接近纯白的金色火光在废墟中升起，高温近乎扭曲空间和时间。

这是和【加百列的庇护】齐名的神庭禁术之一，【米迦勒的光辉】。

圣光十二翼在米迦勒的背后展开，他燃烧着，几乎只剩一个朦胧的光影，和扭曲的火焰融为一体。

相南里忍不住对小6道：[米迦勒怎么不讲武德，一来就开大？！]

他一紧张就爱说怪话；相南里一度觉得最适合自己的副业是脱口秀演员。

小6努力地尝试回复，可惜反馈过来的是一堆杂乱的电子音。

异常的高温，让使徒6无法处理相南里的讯息。

小6的晶片正受到无法逆转的损伤。

灼热的火焰隔着机甲和一层皮肤，都让使徒6的晶体扭曲。

然而，相南里却没有受到太大影响。只是觉得火光有些过于耀眼了。

如果是以前，相南里会猜，这是不是基因药、或者“路西法”的功劳。

但现在的相南里清楚，他强悍的是自己这具身体本身。

路西法处于完全启动状态，覆盖在相南里身上。

它们融为一体。

从外表看，这是一条很帅的大蛇，生有骨翼，金属的关节一环一环衔接着，皮肤表面还有漂亮的能量回路。

相南里摒弃所有干扰选项，眼前的世界只剩下黑白两色，唯独米迦勒是刺眼的白金。

没有任何叙旧。

米迦勒和“路西法”在半空碰撞。所有武器装置同时启动，毫无保留，短短几秒内，攻守之势易形过好几次。

相南里感觉到自己胸腔的鸣颤，那是过度消耗后，身体本能的不适感。他的喉咙刺痛着，硝烟味在鼻腔弥漫。

大蛇一口咽下白金似的人影，火光交织成的米迦勒身形闪烁；但火焰同样裹住路西法全身。

米迦勒的优势是，他的续航很强。不像路西法，是一次性用品。而且随时都能补充。

相南里的优势是，他每次启动，都是百分之百的“路西法”，转换过程没有能源损耗。能用最小能源，发挥出最大威力。

但操作面板上，“路西法”的剩余电量正在以一个恐怖的速度下滑着。

相南里的余光瞥见一条条红色的警告。

[警告：不明能量波正在消耗路西法，如果继续保持路西法完全形态，预计还能使用约10分钟。]

周围响起“圣音”，音浪穿破外围的防御层，直接作用于相南里的灵魂。

当年，圣音天使团在人联上空游荡，不知道有多少人联战士，因为这若有似无的音乐陷入永久的癫狂。

相南里耳边，音乐的声音如此清晰，他都能辨别出那些佶屈聱牙的古凡语。然而他的灵魂却没有任何异常波动。

米迦勒感觉到一丝惊诧。

路西法的鳞片一片片掉落，在烈焰中化为难以形容的黑色液体。

这些液体落在地上，腐蚀着一切物质。

在相南里的操纵下，这些液体拉扯成细线，刺向米迦勒。努力迸发着自己最后的余晖。

大多数黑线都被火焰溶解，只有很少一部分，刺进他的身体。

米迦勒的身影闪烁着，光与火似乎暗淡了少许。空气中，游离的以太环绕着他。

[警告：预计还能再使用三分钟，建议撤离。]

如果没有被带到无人区就好了。米迦勒想。

他携带的那些天使，会成为“米迦勒”最好的燃料。

但没关系，相南里最多再撑三分钟，只要神庭的支援比联政快。

……

拉斐尔紧张地看着天空，具体来说，是大圣堂上方的星域图。

属于米迦勒的那颗星星闪烁着，忽明忽暗。是耀眼的白金色。

在他的光辉掩盖下，属于相南里的那颗绿色的星星无比黯淡，奄奄一息。

几颗巨大的星星正在朝战场靠拢，蓝色是梅塔特隆，红色是夏米尔。

还有一颗，是刺眼的白色。那不是神庭的大天使是以西结。

拉斐尔感觉到紧张，紧张让它的胃部抽搐。但它不能呕吐，真吐出来了，为防止能量流失，它还得把呕吐物吃回来。那就更恶心了。

一名神仆匆匆赶来：“大人，东联发来电报。质问米迦勒为什么杀死了方敬之。就在两分钟前，东联公布方敬之的死讯，并宣布对神庭宣战！”

看吧，米迦勒就该早点把自己的呕吐物吃回来。

东联不宣战不行。方敬之是总司令，军区那些指挥官都是他的属下。

安迪可不想军区哗变，现在更适合徐徐图之，然后用给“方敬之报仇”的名义，图谋兵权。

拉斐尔想到这就觉得心烦。

拉斐尔：“别来打扰我。这些事都不重要。我们已经赌上神庭的命运，在今夜。”

神庭的大天使几乎都被派出去了。之前，它们藏在枫叶丹；现在应该出发了。

一部分去支援米迦勒；另一部分呢，则是率兵，从枫叶丹闪击联政。

是的，这次行动很冒险，牺牲也很大。但如果能趁着相南里战死，吞并联政，一切损失都可以得到弥补！

但如果反过来……米迦勒战败。那么神庭也会陷入最黑暗的永夜，甚至从历史上除名。

拉斐尔强压下不安。

不，米迦勒不可能战败！

他是比加百列还要强一个等级的大天使长。

米迦勒从来没输过。

拉斐尔想到这，突然开口，叫住准备撤退的神仆：“等等，告诉安迪。我帮他清理一个心腹大患，他不该感谢我吗？我清楚，军方的利益和他的利益未必一致。他不想当实权总统吗？神庭完全可以和他合作……”

“告诉他，如果在此时跟神庭一起攻打联政，东联不但可以收回自己的失地；还能获得惊人的资源，联政2号城以东的城市都可以给他；他会成为东联最伟大的开创者。”

拉斐尔开始许诺梦中的五百万。

他知道如何引诱人心，也清楚人性最禁不住考验。更何况安迪虽然有些能力，却不是一个很有政治理想的人。

这种人只能被称为“政客”，本质是投机倒把的商人；而不是“政治家”或更伟大的“革命家”。

安迪回复很快，滴水不漏：“这不是我一个人能决定的事。或许要等到明天才能回复您。”

拉斐尔冷笑。

他清楚，安迪需要看到最后的结果，才能决定要倒向哪一方。

东联尚可待价而沽；而神庭，已经回不了头了。

所以，安穗。燃烧吧。

为神庭，为你拥有且信仰的一切。

……

路西法一寸一寸融化。

“你很顽强。”米迦勒高悬在半空，像一轮金灿灿的太阳，他睥睨着相南里，第一次发出声音，空灵，如同从天上传来的神谕，“作为敌人，我尊敬你。但很可惜，有些事，并不是顽强和努力就能做到。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 260: Battle to the Final Chapter

A meteor slammed into the uninhabited zone from the heavens, erupting in a blinding radiance. It was as if a nuclear warhead had struck the earth.

In the dead of night, a mushroom cloud actually rose into the sky.

With Xiang Nanli and Michael as the epicenter, the ground fractured inch by inch. The earth shook and the mountains swayed, while distant xenomorphs let out mournful cries.

This was the uninhabited zone.

A near-pure white golden flame rose amidst the ruins, its extreme heat warping both space and time.

This was one of the Divine Court’s forbidden arts, on par with "Gabriel’s Shelter": "Michael’s Radiance."

Twelve wings of holy light unfurled behind Michael. He burned so intensely that he was reduced to little more than a hazy silhouette, merging into the distorted flames.

Xiang Nanli couldn't help but say to Xiao 6, "Why does Michael have no sense of sportsmanship? He goes straight for the ultimate move the moment he arrives?!"

He loved to spout nonsense whenever he was nervous; Xiang Nanli had once felt that his most suitable side job would be a stand-up comedian.

Xiao 6 tried hard to respond, but unfortunately, only a jumble of electronic static came through.

The abnormal heat was preventing Apostle 6 from processing Xiang Nanli’s messages.

Xiao 6’s microchip was suffering irreversible damage.

The scorching flames, even through the mecha and a layer of skin, were causing the crystal structure of Apostle 6 to warp.

Yet, Xiang Nanli remained largely unaffected. He only felt that the glare of the flames was a bit too dazzling.

If it were in the past, Xiang Nanli would have guessed whether this was the work of genetic drugs or "Lucifer."

But the current Xiang Nanli knew clearly that it was his own body that possessed such formidable strength.

Lucifer was in a state of full activation, enveloping Xiang Nanli.

They had become one.

From the outside, it looked like a magnificent, massive serpent, born with bone wings, its metallic joints linked ring by ring, with beautiful energy circuits tracing the surface of its skin.

Xiang Nanli discarded all distracting options. The world before his eyes was reduced to only black and white, with Michael the only blinding platinum presence.

There was no exchange of pleasantries.

Michael and "Lucifer" collided in mid-air. All weapon systems activated simultaneously, holding nothing back. In the span of a few seconds, the momentum of offense and defense shifted several times.

Xiang Nanli felt a tremor in his chest—the instinctive discomfort of his body after excessive exertion. His throat stung, and the smell of gunpowder permeated his nasal cavity.

The great serpent swallowed the platinum-like figure in one gulp, and the form of Michael, woven from fire, flickered; yet, the flames also wrapped around Lucifer’s entire body.

Michael’s advantage was his immense endurance. Unlike Lucifer, which was a disposable item, he could replenish his energy at any time.

Xiang Nanli’s advantage was that every time he activated, it was a 100% "Lucifer," with no energy loss during the conversion process. He could exert maximum power with minimal energy.

But on the operation panel, Lucifer’s remaining power was plummeting at a terrifying speed.

Xiang Nanli caught a glimpse of a string of red warnings in his peripheral vision.

[Warning: An unknown energy wave is draining Lucifer. If the full form of Lucifer is maintained, estimated remaining usage time is approximately 10 minutes.]

"Holy Sounds" rang out in the surroundings, the sound waves piercing the outer defensive layer and acting directly upon Xiang Nanli’s soul.
