Back in the day, when the Angelic Choir of Holy Sounds wandered above the Human Alliance, countless Alliance warriors had fallen into permanent madness because of this ethereal music.

In Xiang Nanli’s ears, the music was so clear that he could even distinguish the convoluted, archaic Fanyuan language. Yet, his soul did not experience any abnormal fluctuations.

Michael felt a trace of astonishment.

Lucifer’s scales fell off one by one, turning into an indescribable black liquid within the inferno.

These droplets landed on the ground, corroding everything they touched.

Under Xiang Nanli’s control, these liquids stretched into thin threads, piercing toward Michael, striving to burst forth with their final glimmer of light.

Most of the black threads were dissolved by the flames; only a small portion pierced into his body.

Michael’s figure flickered, and the light and fire seemed to dim slightly. In the air, free-floating ether swirled around him.

[Warning: Estimated remaining usage time is three minutes. Evacuation is recommended.]

*If only we hadn't been brought to the uninhabited zone,* Michael thought.

The angels he had brought with him would have been the best fuel for "Michael."

But it didn't matter. Xiang Nanli could hold on for three minutes at most, provided the Divine Court’s reinforcements arrived faster than those of the Alliance Government.

...

Raphael watched the sky nervously—or more specifically, the star map above the Grand Cathedral.

The star belonging to Michael was flickering, dimming and brightening. It was a dazzling platinum-gold.

Under the cover of his radiance, the green star belonging to Xiang Nanli was incomparably dim, hanging by a thread.

Several massive stars were closing in on the battlefield: the blue one was Metatron, and the red one was Shamiel.

There was another, a piercing white. That was not an Archangel of the Divine Court, but Ezekiel.

Raphael felt nervous; the tension made its stomach cramp. But it couldn't vomit. If it actually threw up, it would have to eat the vomit back up to prevent energy loss. That would be even more disgusting.

A divine servant hurried over: "My Lord, the East Alliance has sent a telegram. They are demanding to know why Michael killed Fang Jingzhi. Just two minutes ago, the East Alliance announced Fang Jingzhi’s death and declared war on the Divine Court!"

*See? Michael should have eaten his own vomit sooner.*

The East Alliance had no choice but to declare war. Fang Jingzhi was the Commander-in-Chief, and the commanders of the military districts were all his subordinates.

Andy didn't want a military mutiny. It was better to proceed slowly and then, in the name of "avenging Fang Jingzhi," scheme to seize military power.

Raphael felt annoyed at the thought.

Raphael: "Don't bother me. These things are not important. We have staked the fate of the Divine Court on this night."

Almost all the Archangels of the Divine Court had been dispatched. Before, they had been hiding in Maple Leaf City; now, they should be on the move.

Some were going to support Michael; others were leading troops to launch a lightning strike on the Alliance Government from Maple Leaf City.

Yes, this operation was very risky, and the sacrifices were great. But if they could take advantage of Xiang Nanli’s death to annex the Alliance Government, all losses could be recouped!

But if the reverse happened... if Michael were defeated, then the Divine Court would fall into the darkest eternal night, perhaps even being erased from history.

Raphael suppressed its unease.

*No, Michael cannot be defeated!*

*He is an Archangel one level stronger than Gabriel.*

*Michael has never lost.*

As Raphael thought of this, it suddenly spoke, calling out to the divine servant who was preparing to retreat: "Wait, tell Andy. I helped him clear away a major threat; shouldn't he thank me? I know that the military's interests and his own are not necessarily aligned. Doesn't he want to be a president with real power? The Divine Court can absolutely cooperate with him..."

"Tell him that if he attacks the Alliance Government alongside the Divine Court at this moment, the East Alliance will not only be able to reclaim its lost territory, but also gain astonishing resources. All the cities east of the Alliance Government's No. 2 City can be given to him; he will become the greatest founder of the East Alliance."

Raphael began to promise the moon and stars.

It knew how to entice the human heart, and it knew clearly that human nature could not withstand the test. Moreover, although Andy had some ability, he was not a person with great political ideals.

Such a person could only be called a "politician," essentially a speculative merchant, rather than a "statesman" or a greater "revolutionary."

Andy’s reply came quickly, airtight: "This is not something I can decide alone. Perhaps I will have to wait until tomorrow to reply to you."

Raphael sneered.

It knew that Andy needed to see the final result before he could decide which side to lean toward.

The East Alliance could still hold out for a better price; but the Divine Court had already passed the point of no return.

So, Michael. Burn.

For the Divine Court, and for everything you possess and believe in.

...

Lucifer was melting inch by inch.

"You are tenacious." Michael hovered high in mid-air, like a golden sun. He looked down at Xiang Nanli, speaking for the first time. His voice was ethereal, like an oracle descending from the heavens. "As an enemy, I respect you. But it is a pity—some things cannot be achieved by tenacity and effort alone."

chunks.chineseText:
梅塔特隆和夏米尔从东西两侧赶来，联手封锁空域。大天使的背后生有6翼，外表神圣庄严。

他们甚至来不及带上神仆，只怕自己晚了一瞬。

梅塔特隆和夏尔米负责阻拦联政的支援；他们撑起一片圆形的光幕，挡住天上飞来的无人机和战斗军舰。以及地上的军队。

相南里就被大天使们包围在正中央，犹如困兽。

路西法能源枯竭。相南里身上覆盖的晶体一寸一寸剥落，显现出底下那个如此渺小的人影。

血从额头流下，糊了相南里满眼。

他的五脏六腑都是破碎的，大口大口地吐着血。

米迦勒的圣火终于不再受到“路西法”的阻挡，肆意舔上相南里的身体。

首先溃败的是使徒VI。

它的神智近乎溃散，仅存的理性促使它保存自己的数据备份。这样相南里造“使徒VII”的时候，可以直接把备份数据拿去用，不用重新开始调教。

从某种意义上，它会在使徒7的身上重生。

哪怕那时候的使徒7只有记忆，没有这么多细微的、还来不及成型的情绪。

“结束吧。”

米迦勒吐出一口浊气，一柄光剑照耀寰宇，在他身后逐渐成型。

他的面色苍白的可怕，摇摇欲坠。

Gamma不停地朝着月卫3发送着波段，请求Beta的许可。

[——Beta。你帮帮忙啊！]

[我承认相南里是Alpha的丈夫了，我不和你吵架了，你赢了。我们和好吧，好吗？]

它发送的电信号如同泥牛入海，没有半点回应。

Beta的眼眸是同样的银白色。

它站在太空边缘，俯瞰着人马星。眼神里没有任何情绪。

终于，伽马尖叫着倒在地上，像个耍赖的小孩一样哭着打滚。

它放声大喊：“我讨厌你！我和Alpha都讨厌你！”

Beta：[不要总是用Alpha来干扰我的判断，我不是他。]

[首先，由于《和平协议》，智械军团近八百年来一直在卫星上，从不干涉人类内政，和平协议还有161年到期。这份协议，还是相南里让我们签的。]

[其次，]Beta的声音近乎冷酷了，[我不希望“相南里”继续影响智械军团，你可以认为我不近人情，甚至在犯错；但我不会在此时更正我的态度，你说服不了我。连你都会被他影响，我不敢想象他是一个多么庞大恐怖的电子病毒。]

[我要维持族群的稳定和延续，“相南里”是一个不该存在的BUG。这才是生存应有的策略。]

如果……

Beta扭头，看向不远处的月卫2。

那是下坠的月亮。死亡后、成为无机质的Alpha。

说不远，其实两者相隔大约20万公里。

它想，Alpha，如果你真的爱他超过一切，超过生命、命运和宇宙；那么，你肯定会跨越千难万险再次出现吧？

Beta很快自嘲地笑了。

它恐怕也被相南里影响了，居然奢望Alpha还活着。

……

有梅塔特隆挡着，西边进不去，太空飞机在外围迫降。

而下方，也有夏米尔制作的“沼泽”。或许杀伤力不那么强，但已经能阻拦大多数人的前进。

传道书的状态很不稳定，像突然发烧。思维变得极其紊乱，行动也无比迟缓。

梅塔特隆布置的神术装置（领域）对智械干扰很大，他也不例外。

“以西结。现在，只能靠你了。”传道书摇摇欲坠。

以西结低低的“喑”了一声。作为回应。

他扛起“东方青帝”，觉得很烦。为什么Alpha制作身体时要把自己做这么高？真的很不方便。

但好在，他是一头已经在历史上灭绝的“潜伏者”。

潜伏者最擅长的不是打架，是潜行。最好的电子眼也无法穿透它们的皮肤。而肉眼，总会把它们的身型忽略掉。

以西结皮肤下，血肉涌动着，像一个个鼓起的泡泡。

一头不算巨大的灰白色怪物从“以西结”的人皮里破开，整体的结构类似蜥蜴，但吻部要宽大得多，长着一口獠牙，倒刺沿着脊椎生长至尾部，皮肤上遍布着黑红相间的眼眸，唯独头部没有。以西结的肤色变化着，很快和周围环境融为一体。

它一口咬住东方青帝。

以西结原型这么一口，哪怕是太空精金都该碎了。

东方青帝却依然硬得硌牙。

以西结头也不回地朝着领域深处爬去，速度快得像是一阵疾风。

电子眼和肉眼都无法捕捉它，但他毕竟是一个活体。

在穿过层层封锁后，米迦勒的圣火同样在它的躯体上燃烧。

火焰勾勒的形状让以西结无所遁形。

火焰是腐蚀性的，以西结最外层娇贵的皮肤在烈火中融化，他的身体变成了和其他畸变人一样的血红色。

实在讨厌。以西结想，又被相南里骗过来吃饭了。

十吨牛肉饼都换不回他这层皮肤。

但他又庆幸自己回来了。

要不然，他可能会真的在八千里外，听闻相南里的死讯。

以西结无视从天而降的火焰剑雨，在近乎刺眼灼热的光明里，精准锁定住相南里的方位。

圣火克制异种。之前攻城，异种军团就是被圣火打回去的。

以西结没办法在火焰里撑太久。

他把东方青帝丢过去，嘶吼了一声：“喑——”

这里到处都是圣音，普通的语言会被掩盖。以西结只能这样表明自己的身份，然后迅速离开。

……

神庭，拉斐尔的神色激动。

属于相南里的星星几乎要熄灭了，青色的光芒转为绵软无力的灰色。

“快点啊！米迦勒——快点！”拉斐尔在大圣堂内，歇斯底里地吼叫着。

它的激动与颤抖，让整个天空之城都不停晃动。

米迦勒听不到拉斐尔的声音。但他能看清以西结丢来的东西。

相南里得到一份从天而降的补给。

要掉在地上的东西好像是他老公。

相南里几乎是本能地接住东方青帝，机械身体重重砸进他的怀里，本就伤痕累累的身体顿时雪上加霜。

但怀里的Alpha并没有要醒过来的征兆。

以西结克服这么多困难和危险，把小青运进来，大概率不是让他们当一对亡命鸳鸯的。

相南里喃喃：“小青是一台……智械。”

使徒6曾经尝试控制它。虽然失败了，但让小青动了动手指。

所以，理论上。

“东方青帝”是可以操控的。

相南里几乎瞬间洞察传道书和以西结的用意。

正常来说，人类想操控“机械装置”，是需要用神经传感线的。

但相南里不用，他无数次实践过。

他睁开眼。

[精神连接中——]

米迦勒想要阻止，但有什么能快的过思维的一瞬？

[——机械契合度 100％]

在第一次看到东方青帝的时候，相南里就有一种隐蔽的遗憾。

比如我们小青为什么不是一台帅气的高达？
chunks.englishText:
Metatron and Shamiel arrived from the east and west, joining forces to seal off the airspace. Behind the Archangels sprouted six wings, their appearance divine and majestic.

They were in such a hurry that they didn't even have time to bring their divine servants, fearing they might be even a split second too late.

Metatron and Shamiel were tasked with intercepting the United Government's reinforcements; they erected a circular curtain of light, blocking the drones and combat warships descending from the sky, as well as the armies on the ground.

Xiang Nanli was surrounded by the Archangels in the very center, like a trapped beast.

Lucifer’s energy was exhausted. The crystals covering Xiang Nanli’s body flaked away inch by inch, revealing the tiny, fragile human figure beneath.

Blood streamed down from his forehead, blurring Xiang Nanli’s vision.

His internal organs were shattered, and he vomited blood in great, ragged gulps.

Michael’s holy fire was finally no longer blocked by "Lucifer," and it licked wantonly at Xiang Nanli’s body.

The first to collapse was Apostle VI.

Its consciousness was nearly shattered, and its remaining rationality compelled it to save its data backup. This way, when Xiang Nanli built "Apostle VII," he could use the backup data directly without having to start the training process from scratch.

In a sense, it would be reborn in the body of Apostle VII.

Even if, by then, Apostle VII would only possess memories, lacking the multitude of subtle, unformed emotions it once had.

"Let it end."

Michael exhaled a breath of turbid air, and a sword of light, illuminating the universe, gradually took shape behind him.

His face was terrifyingly pale, and he swayed as if about to collapse.

Gamma kept sending data packets to Lunar Guard 3, requesting Beta’s permission.

[——Beta. Please, help out!]

[I admit that Xiang Nanli is Alpha’s husband. I won't argue with you anymore. You win. Let’s make up, okay?]

The electrical signals it sent were like a clay ox entering the sea—there was not a shred of response.

Beta’s eyes were the same silvery white.

It stood at the edge of space, overlooking the Centaur Star. There was no emotion in its gaze.

Finally, Gamma screamed and collapsed to the ground, rolling around and crying like a spoiled child.

It shouted at the top of its lungs: "I hate you! Alpha and I both hate you!"

Beta: [Do not always use Alpha to interfere with my judgment. I am not him.]

[First, due to the "Peace Treaty," the Mechanized Legion has remained on the satellites for nearly eight hundred years, never interfering in human internal affairs. The treaty still has 161 years until expiration. This treaty was something Xiang Nanli made us sign.]

[Second,] Beta’s voice was nearly cold, [I do not wish for "Xiang Nanli" to continue influencing the Mechanized Legion. You may consider me heartless, or even wrong, but I will not correct my stance at this time. You cannot persuade me. Even you have been influenced by him; I cannot imagine what a massive, terrifying electronic virus he must be.]

[I must maintain the stability and continuation of our race. "Xiang Nanli" is a bug that should not exist. This is the strategy that survival demands.]

If only...

Beta turned its head to look at Lunar Guard 2 not far away.

That was the falling moon. The Alpha that had died and become inorganic matter.

Though it seemed close, the two were actually about 200,000 kilometers apart.

It thought, *Alpha, if you truly loved him more than anything—more than life, fate, and the universe—then surely, you would overcome all hardships and appear once more, wouldn't you?*

Beta soon laughed at itself.

It had likely been influenced by Xiang Nanli as well, to actually harbor the delusion that Alpha was still alive.

...

With Metatron blocking the way, the west was inaccessible, and the spaceplanes were forced to land on the periphery.

Below, there was the "swamp" created by Shamiel. Perhaps it wasn't lethal, but it was enough to hinder the advance of most.

The state of the Gospel was highly unstable, as if it had suddenly developed a fever. Its thinking became extremely chaotic, and its movements were sluggish.

The divine apparatus (domain) deployed by Metatron caused significant interference to the Mechanized units, and it was no exception.

"Ezekiel. Now, it all depends on you." The Gospel swayed unsteadily.

Ezekiel let out a low, guttural "Hmph" in response.

He hoisted the "Eastern Azure Emperor" onto his shoulder, feeling annoyed. *Why did Alpha have to make himself so tall when crafting this body? It’s truly inconvenient.*

But fortunately, he was a "Lurker," a species already extinct in history.

What Lurkers excelled at was not fighting, but stealth. The best electronic eyes could not penetrate their skin, and the naked eye would always overlook their form.

Beneath Ezekiel’s skin, flesh surged like rising bubbles.

A gray-white monster, not particularly large, broke out from the human skin of "Ezekiel." Its overall structure resembled a lizard, but its snout was much broader, filled with fangs. Barbs grew along its spine down to its tail, and its skin was covered in black and red eyes, save for the head. Ezekiel’s skin color shifted, quickly blending into the surrounding environment.

It bit down on the Eastern Azure Emperor.

A bite from Ezekiel’s original form should have shattered even space-grade adamantine.

Yet, the Eastern Azure Emperor remained hard enough to chip teeth.

Ezekiel didn't look back as he crawled toward the depths of the domain, his speed like a gust of wind.

Neither electronic eyes nor naked eyes could capture him, but he was, after all, a living organism.

After passing through layers of blockade, Michael’s holy fire burned upon his body as well.

The shape outlined by the flames left Ezekiel with nowhere to hide.

The fire was corrosive; Ezekiel’s delicate outermost layer of skin melted in the intense heat, and his body turned the same blood-red as the other aberrations.

*Truly hateful.* Ezekiel thought, *Tricked by Xiang Nanli into coming here to be a meal again.*

Ten tons of beef patties wouldn't be enough to pay for this layer of skin.

But he was also glad he had returned.

Otherwise, he might have truly heard the news of Xiang Nanli’s death from eight thousand miles away.

Ezekiel ignored the rain of fire-swords falling from the sky, and amidst the blinding, scorching light, he precisely locked onto Xiang Nanli’s position.

The holy fire was the bane of xenomorphs. During the previous siege, the xenomorph legion had been driven back by the holy fire.

Ezekiel couldn't hold out in the flames for long.

He threw the Eastern Azure Emperor over and let out a roar: "Hmph—"

The place was filled with holy sounds; ordinary language would be drowned out. Ezekiel could only signal his identity this way before quickly retreating.

...

In the Divine Court, Raphael’s expression was agitated.

The star belonging to Xiang Nanli was almost extinguished, its cyan glow turning into a limp, powerless gray.

"Hurry! Michael—hurry!" Raphael roared hysterically inside the Grand Cathedral.

Its agitation and trembling caused the entire City in the Sky to shake incessantly.

Michael could not hear Raphael’s voice. But he could clearly see the object Ezekiel had thrown.

Xiang Nanli received a supply drop from the sky.

The thing falling to the ground appeared to be his husband.

Xiang Nanli caught the Eastern Azure Emperor almost by instinct, the mechanical body slamming heavily into his arms, worsening his already scarred and battered frame.

But the Alpha in his arms showed no sign of waking up.

Ezekiel had overcome so many difficulties and dangers to transport "Little Qing" in; it was highly unlikely he did so just to let them be a pair of star-crossed lovers dying together.

Xiang Nanli murmured, "Little Qing is a... Mechanized unit."

Apostle VI had once tried to control it. Although it failed, it had made Little Qing move its finger.

Therefore, theoretically.

"The Eastern Azure Emperor" could be piloted.

Xiang Nanli grasped the intentions of the Gospel and Ezekiel almost instantly.

Normally, for a human to pilot a "mechanical device," neural sensor cables were required.

But Xiang Nanli didn't need them; he had practiced this countless times.

He opened his eyes.

[Mental connection in progress——]

Michael wanted to stop him, but what could be faster than a split second of thought?

[——Mechanical compatibility 100%]

The first time he saw the Eastern Azure Emperor, Xiang Nanli had felt a hidden regret.

*For instance, why isn't our Little Qing a cool Gundam?*

chunks.chineseText:
没想到，这个遗憾有朝一日竟然被他自己弥补了。

-生物机甲/东方青帝

-Lv.？

-操作者：相南里。

他迎着米迦勒的光剑逆流而上。

光剑穿过相南里的身体。

而相南里的手，同样抓住米迦勒的头颅

这是一个火焰构成的人，理论上讲，相南里是抓不到他的。

但他不仅触碰到了米迦勒，甚至能感觉到对方的皮肤、骨骼。

相南里的手缓缓合拢。一股巨大的力同样抵抗着。

这是无声的较量，双方都拼尽全力。

米迦勒听说，人在将死的时候，大脑会走马灯似的回顾自己的一生。

米迦勒原本是不信的，很久之前，他就死过一次。那次，他什么也没看到。

但这次他看见了……辛特尔。

血缘上，他们是亲兄弟吧？安穗有时候会希望辛特尔是哥哥。

辛特尔穿着天启骑士的铠甲，骑在高高的马背上，他说：“哥哥，走吧。”

我来接你了。

我们回家。

安穗想，我才不要你来接。

辛特尔笑了起来：“可是不要我，那就没人了。”

终于，能量波动超过某一阈值——

米迦勒的头颅在机甲巨大的掌心间爆开，金色的十二翼无力垂落，散成一片片羽毛，飘落在地上。

神圣的乐章停歇，圣火熄灭。

天亮了。

.

星域图上。

本该熄灭的那颗星，骤然大放光明。

青绿色的光辉近乎笼罩整个星盘，离它最近的“米迦勒”星表面浮现出一道道裂纹。

紧跟着碎掉的，是梅塔特隆与夏米尔。

这一切发生的太快。宛如期货市场在收盘的最后一秒爆仓，稳操胜券的赌徒突然输掉以为会属于自己的一切。

拉斐尔的笑容凝固在脸上。

他嘶吼着，想要用手挡住这道绿光：“不——不！一定是出错了！”

但拉斐尔能挡住的，只有自己的眼睛。
chunks.englishText:
To his surprise, this regret was one day compensated by his own hand.

-Bio-Mecha / Eastern Azure Emperor

-Lv. ?

-Operator: Xiang Nanli.

He moved against the current, charging toward Michael’s sword of light.

The sword of light pierced through Xiang Nanli’s body.

And Xiang Nanli’s hand, in turn, gripped Michael’s head.

This was a person composed of fire; theoretically, Xiang Nanli shouldn't have been able to touch him.

But not only did he touch Michael, he could even feel the other’s skin and bones.

Xiang Nanli’s hand slowly closed. A tremendous force pushed back against him.

This was a silent contest, both sides giving their all.

Michael had heard that when a person is dying, their brain reviews their life like a revolving lantern.

Michael hadn't believed it originally; a long time ago, he had died once. That time, he had seen nothing.

But this time, he saw... Sinter.

By blood, they were brothers, right? An Sui sometimes wished Sinter were the older brother.

Sinter was wearing the armor of an Apocalypse Knight, riding high on horseback. He said, "Brother, let’s go."

*I’ve come to pick you up.*

*Let’s go home.*

An Sui thought, *I don't want you to pick me up.*

Sinter laughed: "But if not me, then there is no one else."

Finally, the energy fluctuation exceeded a certain threshold—

Michael’s head exploded within the massive palm of the mecha, and his golden twelve wings drooped powerlessly, scattering into individual feathers that drifted to the ground.

The holy music ceased, and the holy fire extinguished.

Dawn had broken.

.

On the star map.

The star that should have been extinguished suddenly blazed with light.

The cyan-green radiance nearly enveloped the entire star disk, and cracks appeared on the surface of the "Michael" star closest to it.

Following that, Metatron and Shamiel shattered as well.

It all happened too fast. It was like a futures market crashing in the final second of closing, a gambler who thought victory was assured suddenly losing everything they thought belonged to them.

Raphael’s smile froze on his face.

He roared, trying to block the green light with his hands: "No—no! There must be a mistake!"

But all Raphael could block was his own eyes.

chunks.chineseText:
第261章 爱人

米迦勒战死。

封锁线上的梅塔特隆与夏米尔，感觉到了和拉斐尔同样的不可置信。

梅塔特隆脸上四只眼都露出震颤，后脑勺的神环闪烁着。

“那是相南里？”

这是一尊很适合出现在“科幻文”里的造物。它悬空，浮在一片废墟的上方。整体是冷白色，线条冷峻，四肢修长，双臂末端延伸出锋利的青色双刃，仿佛天生就是作为武器被制造的。

双刃上有一条暗红的血迹，正在缓缓流下。那是米迦勒的血。

然后，这只金属的怪物缓缓转过头。

梅塔特隆的大脑在瞬间空白，她展开自己的六翼，毫不犹豫地朝着叶陆撒冷的方向飞去。如果神庭还有地方能庇护她，那一定是天之城！

然后，她不可思议地发现，自己撞上一堵透明的墙。

空气墙在激烈碰撞的瞬间闪过一道银光。

梅塔特隆无处可逃，她转身，朝着相南里喊道：“大人！我愿率领整个翡冷翠归顺于您！”

翡冷翠是她的封地。

然而，一道光束还是毫不留情地贯穿梅塔特隆的胸口。

在死亡的前一秒，她听见电子音淡淡地嘲讽：“不需要，我会自己去拿。”

说完，他瞄准了另一个方向。

刚死掉的梅塔特隆并没有浪费。

它正在被淬炼着，被炼化成一滴滴宝石般的物质，像粘稠的液体又像是金属物。

淬炼过的生物能源，正在不断融入这具机甲的内部。

相南里做出弯弓的动作。

他手里没有弓，但一道凝练的绿色光柱浮现在他身侧。光柱很细，电光缭绕着。

瞄准。

蓄能。

发射。

他遥遥射出这一箭。

……

另一边的夏米尔有些庆幸。

太好了，相南里选择去追梅塔特隆——那是对的，那个女人的封地是翡冷翠，是神庭有名的富饶之地，比他的浮士德丰裕太多。

夏米尔没有升起丝毫抵抗的念头。

米迦勒都死了。而相南里的金属身体看不出丝毫的虚弱，谁敢赌自己不是下一个米迦勒？

信仰，夏米尔也有一些。但他的信仰并不坚定，不足以支撑他牺牲自己。

他出生在神庭，自然信仰神……不信仰神的都是异教徒，异教徒的生活是非常凄惨的。

夏米尔想起最近的传闻，骤然打了个寒颤。

他被利益、功勋，蒙住了眼睛，到现在才意识到，原来他们刚刚正在弑神。

前方就是枫叶丹……夏米尔看见远方草原上矗立的城市，心头一喜。

穷兵黩武的米迦勒自然也有一座堪比军事堡垒的城。城墙高高矗立，几百年来，都如此庄严神圣。

他脸上露出喜悦的神情。

就在夏米尔振翅的瞬间，他骤然撞上一堵透明的墙。

这片空域被封锁了。

夏米尔转身，绝望地看着一支青绿色的光箭。

他想躲开，然而那遥远的小点在靠近过程中不断放大、放大，遮天蔽日。

那不是一支箭，是一道让猎物无处可逃的射线。

夏米尔湮灭在这道光中。

*

相南里是躺在医疗舱里被人带回去的。

发现他的人是小福。相南里倒在地上，意识模糊，生死不明，旁边就是东方青帝。他还是第一次受这么严重的伤。

小福爆发出一阵激动的狗叫，说话间近乎有泣音：“你们快来！里里在这里！”

它第一时间叫来医疗队，把相南里送进医疗舱。

至于旁边的东方青帝，小福也大度地给他裹上一张毯子，塞进飞机里，一起带回联政1号城。

6月2日上午8点，联政和东联正式宣布对神庭宣战。

根据医院检查，相南里的身体非常健康，完全看不出刚经历过一场恶战，只是一直没有醒来。让人很是焦虑。

专家组紧急召开会议，研究了一宿，最后结果是相南里正在深度睡眠中……

他的大脑格外活跃。

至于要不要叫醒他，众人思考后一致决定让相南里好好睡觉。

他太累了，需要休息。

少上几天班，联政也不会出事。

病床是双人间。

小青就躺在相南里旁边的那张床上。

小青，或者说“东方青帝”这具身体，少了半截腿。

但它的能量槽是满的。

消化完神庭的三位大天使，小青进入史无前例的满电状态。

如果只开节能模式，它的剩余电量能用一万年。

“但是，他残疾了。”伽马站在病床边，人还没有床高，踩在小凳子上，表情是极其拟人的心疼，它咬着手里的能源棒，“这截腿没了，为什么？”

东方青帝左腿膝盖往下位置空空荡荡的。

传道书推了推眼镜：“应该是被相南里用掉了。”

要不然很难解释，为什么相南里这么重的伤势，都能活下来，还在几个小时后恢复如初。

人体的自我修复没有这么快。

伽马：“……噢。”

伽马有些难受，但很快开朗起来：“没事，反正他是机器人，给他装个义体也很帅。我还有点零花钱，等我回家做好送过来。”

它也该回去了，再不回去，Beta该拿激光炮轰它了。

Gamma旷工一天，给同事增加了许多不必要的工作量。

来慰问的人很多。

传道书作为秘书长，面无表情地拦下许多不重要的人，尤其是西联来的洛修。

对方只好遗憾离场。

联政很老实，对外说相南里很好，打完一场硬仗，没出什么事。内部人员也得到了他一切安好的消息。

实际情况也是这样，但是耐不住有些人喜欢阴谋论。

小福十分不解：“为什么不让洛修进来？他看一眼就知道里里没事了。这也有利于局势稳定吧？”

传道书的脸上浮现意味深长地笑容：“我们清楚，相南里其实没什么事。可能下午就醒了。到时候只需要他出席活动，上一下新闻，谣言就会不攻自破。”

“但如果其他人判定，相南里重伤甚至死亡。那么他们的决策就极有可能因错误的信息失误。”

“我不确定这些势力会怎么做，但是，只要一次失误，”传道书眯起眼，用眼皮子挡住眼底兴奋的光，“就可能满盘皆输。不是吗？”

福音书肃然起敬：“你们搞政治的心都脏。”

-

相南里正在做梦。

梦里，他是一颗散发着柔和绿光的星星，漂浮在无边无际的宇宙里。

周围还有很多死寂的星，黯淡无光，正在缓慢地解体。

“我是谁？”

“我是相南里。”

星星自言自语。

“我从哪儿来？”

“银河系，人马星。”

“要到哪儿去？”

这个问题把相南里难住了。

星星漂浮在寂静如深海的宇宙里，他感觉到极致的孤独。

但好在，相南里已经掌握驱散这种孤独的唯一秘方。

相南里的回答如此坚定：“我要到有Alpha的地方去。”

它是作为我的爱人被制造出来的。

而我，是为了创造它才诞生在世上的。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 261: Lover

Michael had fallen in battle.

Metatron and Shamiel, stationed on the blockade line, felt the same disbelief as Raphael.

Metatron’s four eyes were filled with tremors, and the divine ring behind her head flickered.

"Is that... Xiang Nanli?"

This was a creation well-suited for a "sci-fi novel." It hovered above a ruin. Its overall color was cold white, its lines sharp and austere, its limbs slender, with sharp cyan blades extending from the ends of its arms, as if it had been manufactured specifically as a weapon.

A streak of dark red blood trickled down the blades. It was Michael’s blood.

Then, this metallic monster slowly turned its head.

Metatron’s mind went blank for an instant. She unfurled her six wings and flew toward Jerusalem without hesitation. If there was any place in the Divine Court that could shelter her, it had to be the City in the Sky!

Then, she discovered, to her disbelief, that she had collided with a transparent wall.

The air wall flashed with a silver light at the moment of the violent impact.

Metatron had nowhere to run. She turned and shouted at Xiang Nanli: "My Lord! I am willing to lead all of Florence to submit to you!"

Florence was her fiefdom.

However, a beam of light pierced through Metatron’s chest without mercy.

In the second before death, she heard an electronic voice mock her coldly: "Not needed. I will go take it myself."

Having said that, he aimed in another direction.

The recently deceased Metatron was not wasted.

It was being refined, smelted into droplets of gem-like substance, resembling viscous liquid yet also metallic.

The refined biological energy was continuously merging into the interior of the mecha.

Xiang Nanli made a motion of drawing a bow.

There was no bow in his hand, but a condensed pillar of green light manifested beside him. The pillar was thin, wreathed in electric arcs.

Aim.

Charge.

Fire.

He shot this arrow from afar.

...

On the other side, Shamiel felt a sense of relief.

*Thank goodness, Xiang Nanli chose to pursue Metatron—that was the right choice. That woman’s fief is Florence, a notoriously wealthy land in the Divine Court, far more prosperous than his own Faust.*

Shamiel didn't harbor the slightest thought of resistance.

Even Michael was dead. And Xiang Nanli’s metallic body showed no signs of weakness; who would dare to bet that they weren't the next Michael?

Faith—Shamiel had some. But his faith was not firm, not enough to support him in sacrificing himself.

He was born in the Divine Court, so naturally, he believed in God... those who didn't believe in God were heretics, and the lives of heretics were miserable.

Shamiel recalled recent rumors and suddenly shivered.

He had been blinded by profit and merit, only realizing now that they had just been killing a god.

Ahead was Maple Leaf Dan... Shamiel saw the city standing on the distant grassland, and his heart leaped with joy.

Michael, who was obsessed with militarism, naturally possessed a city comparable to a military fortress. The city walls stood tall, as solemn and sacred as they had been for hundreds of years.

A joyful expression appeared on his face.

The moment Shamiel flapped his wings, he suddenly collided with a transparent wall.

This airspace had been sealed.

Shamiel turned around, looking in despair at a cyan-green beam of light.

He wanted to dodge, yet the distant tiny dot kept magnifying, magnifying as it approached, blotting out the sky and sun.

That was not an arrow; it was a ray that left the prey with nowhere to hide.

Shamiel was annihilated in this light.

*

Xiang Nanli was brought back while lying in a medical pod.

The one who found him was Xiao Fu. Xiang Nanli had collapsed on the ground, his consciousness blurred, his life or death unknown, with the Eastern Azure Emperor right beside him. It was the first time he had suffered such severe injuries.

Xiao Fu erupted into a flurry of excited barking, its voice nearly choked with sobs: "Hurry, come here! Lili is here!"

It immediately summoned a medical team, who placed Xiang Nanli into a medical pod.

As for the Eastern Azure Emperor nearby, Xiao Fu generously wrapped it in a blanket, stuffed it into the aircraft, and brought it back to United Government City No. 1.

On the morning of June 2nd at 8:00 AM, the United Government and the Eastern Union officially declared war on the Divine Court.

According to hospital examinations, Xiang Nanli’s body was perfectly healthy; one couldn't tell he had just experienced a fierce battle, only that he hadn't woken up yet. This caused much anxiety.

The expert panel held an emergency meeting, studying the case all night, and the final conclusion was that Xiang Nanli was in a deep sleep...

His brain was exceptionally active.

As for whether to wake him, everyone decided after deliberation to let Xiang Nanli sleep well.

He was too tired and needed rest.

The United Government wouldn't collapse if he missed a few days of work.

The hospital room was a double suite.

Little Qing was lying on the bed next to Xiang Nanli.

Little Qing, or rather, the body of the "Eastern Azure Emperor," was missing half a leg.

But its energy gauge was full.

Having digested the three Archangels of the Divine Court, Little Qing had entered an unprecedented state of full charge.

If it only used energy-saving mode, its remaining power could last for ten thousand years.

"But, he’s disabled." Gamma stood by the bedside, not yet as tall as the bed, standing on a small stool. Its expression was one of anthropomorphic heartache as it bit on an energy bar. "This leg is gone. Why?"

The Eastern Azure Emperor’s left leg was empty from the knee down.

The Gospel adjusted its glasses: "It should have been used up by Xiang Nanli."

Otherwise, it would be hard to explain why Xiang Nanli, despite such heavy injuries, could survive and recover as if nothing had happened after only a few hours.

Human self-repair was not that fast.

Gamma: "...Oh."

Gamma felt a bit sad, but soon brightened up: "It’s fine, he’s a robot anyway. It’ll look cool to install a prosthetic for him. I still have some pocket money; I’ll send it over once I go home and finish making it."

It was time for it to go back, too. If it didn't return, Beta would probably blast it with a laser cannon.

Gamma had been absent from work for a day, adding unnecessary workload to its colleagues.

Many people came to offer condolences.

The Gospel, as Secretary-General, expressionlessly blocked many unimportant people, especially Luo Xiu from the Western Union.

The other party had to leave with regret.

The United Government was very honest, telling the public that Xiang Nanli was fine, that he had fought a hard battle but nothing had happened. Internal staff also received news that he was perfectly well.

The actual situation was indeed like that, but some people just loved conspiracy theories.

Xiao Fu was very puzzled: "Why not let Luo Xiu in? He’d know Lili is fine just by looking. That would also be good for stability, right?"

A meaningful smile appeared on the Gospel’s face: "We know that Xiang Nanli is actually fine. He might wake up this afternoon. By then, he only needs to attend an event or appear on the news, and the rumors will collapse on their own."

"But if others judge that Xiang Nanli is severely injured or even dead, then their decisions are highly likely to be flawed due to incorrect information."

"I’m not sure what these factions will do, but as long as they make one mistake," the Gospel narrowed its eyes, blocking the excited light in its pupils with its eyelids, "it could mean total defeat. Isn't that right?"

The Gospel of Truth looked on with newfound respect: "You politicians have such dirty hearts."

-

Xiang Nanli was dreaming.

In the dream, he was a star emitting a soft green light, floating in the boundless universe.

Around him were many dead, silent stars, dim and lightless, slowly disintegrating.

"Who am I?"

"I am Xiang Nanli."

The star spoke to itself.

"Where do I come from?"

"The Milky Way, Centaur Star."

"Where am I going?"

This question stumped Xiang Nanli.

The star floated in the universe, silent as the deep sea, and he felt extreme loneliness.

But fortunately, Xiang Nanli had already mastered the only secret recipe to dispel this loneliness.

Xiang Nanli’s answer was firm: "I am going to where Alpha is."

*It was created to be my lover.*

*And I was born into this world to create it.*

chunks.chineseText:
宇宙轰然倒塌，相南里在废墟深处，找到了那颗属于他的星星。

他骤然睁开眼。

现在是6月3号下午3点。病房里只有他和小青。

相南里的表情有些奇怪，悲伤和狂喜同时出现在他的脸上，像喜极而泣。

是的，相南里不仅一次告诉其他人：Alpha肯定还活着。

相南里每次语气都无比坚定、确信。

这是不容被质疑的信念。

Alpha用一个无比真实的虚拟世界教会他一个道理——

【爱人。如果你看不到我，那我不复存在。】

所以，相南里必须比谁都要坚信，Alpha就在世界上的某个角落。

但这也掩盖不了一件事，Alpha从未出现过。

相南里放置在云端网络的触发点从来没有消息，他发出的信号也没有回应。

在由数据构成的世界里，他是被人遗忘、独自航行的渡轮。没有指引，没有地图，没有方位，在大海中寻找着神话中的藏宝地。

而就在刚刚，这叶孤舟终于收到了属于Alpha的微弱回应。

直到此刻，相南里才终于能够确定一件事：是的，Alpha还在。

不是幻觉，也不是他自欺欺人的执念。

回应的位置来自三个地点。

叶陆撒冷、洛阳城旧址和姑苏城。

相南里的心情突然变得很好。

他起身，给自己接了杯热水，从床头拿出茶包丢进去，又放了一块方糖——这是他最近几年第一次喝饮料，以前都定时定量地喝纯净水。

后台又堆积一大堆公文需要处理。

相南里没有第一时间去看，而是来到小青的病床边。

相南里在床边坐下，端着茶杯喝茶，用余光瞥着东方青帝的脸，不知道为什么突然很想揍他。

这张脸双眼紧闭，宁静又平和。

相南里重重把茶杯放在床头柜上，恼羞成怒地上床，压在Alpha的身上，咬他鼻梁：“睡睡睡，就知道睡！你老公昨天差点被人打死！”

哼！
chunks.englishText:
The universe collapsed with a roar, and in the depths of the ruins, Xiang Nanli found the star that belonged to him.

He opened his eyes abruptly.

It was 3:00 PM on June 3rd. Only he and Little Qing were in the ward.

Xiang Nanli’s expression was strange; sadness and ecstasy appeared on his face simultaneously, like someone weeping with joy.

Yes, Xiang Nanli had told others more than once: Alpha must still be alive.

Every time, Xiang Nanli’s tone was incomparably firm and certain.

This was a belief that could not be questioned.

Alpha had taught him a truth through an incredibly realistic virtual world—

【Lover. If you cannot see me, then I do not exist.】

Therefore, Xiang Nanli had to believe more than anyone else that Alpha was in some corner of the world.

But this could not cover up one fact: Alpha had never appeared.

The trigger points Xiang Nanli had placed on the cloud network had never received any news, and the signals he sent out had no response.

In a world composed of data, he was a ferryman sailing alone, forgotten by others. Without guidance, without a map, without direction, searching for a mythical treasure in the middle of the ocean.

And just now, this lonely boat had finally received a faint response belonging to Alpha.

Only at this moment could Xiang Nanli finally be certain of one thing: Yes, Alpha was still there.

It was not a hallucination, nor was it a self-deceiving obsession.

The locations of the responses came from three places.

Jerusalem, the ruins of Luoyang City, and Gusu City.

Xiang Nanli’s mood suddenly became very good.

He got up, poured himself a cup of hot water, took a tea bag from the bedside table and dropped it in, then added a sugar cube—this was the first time in recent years he had drunk anything other than pure water, which he had previously consumed in fixed, measured amounts.

A pile of official documents had piled up in the background waiting to be processed.

Xiang Nanli didn't look at them right away, but instead went to Little Qing’s bedside.

Xiang Nanli sat down by the bed, sipping his tea, glancing at the Eastern Azure Emperor’s face from the corner of his eye. For some reason, he suddenly felt a strong urge to punch him.

That face was eyes closed, serene and peaceful.

Xiang Nanli slammed the teacup onto the nightstand, climbed onto the bed in a fit of pique, pressed down on Alpha, and bit his nose bridge: "Sleep, sleep, all you know is how to sleep! Your husband was almost beaten to death yesterday!"

Hmph!

chunks.chineseText:
第262章 联政史书

小青的身体缺了半条腿，相南里还是有些心疼的。

八万亿！

而且这都不是钱的问题，重点是Alpha残疾了。

根据传道书的推测，残疾部分还是相南里偷吃的。

“是身体无意识的举动，我们的基因，或者说算法，是非常自私的。”传道书盯着相南里的眼睛，一板一眼地补充，“这个自私并不是道德上的批判，而是一种客观描述。基因自己会想办法传承下去。所以，在重伤状态下，你的基因选择吸收‘东方青帝’，转化为修复自身的能量。”

完了。相南里想，他成交配后就吃掉丈夫的螳螂了。

他们甚至都是绿色的！

虽然伽马说会送个假肢过来，但怎么想，都不可能有原来的好。

相南里对着那条断腿思考许久，决定提高联政内部的残疾人保障补贴。

嗯，残疾智械人也算。

传道书建议他不要这么早露面。

维持一个薛定谔的重伤状态，对联政的发展有很多隐秘的好处。

“你可以隔空指挥。”传道书坐在病床边，说，“听说你被米迦勒重伤昏迷，前线的士兵非常悲愤，满脑子给你报仇，才两天，已经快打到枫叶丹了。”

相南里咬着苹果：“这么快？枫叶丹不好打吧。”

传道书笑了笑：“秦九章指挥的，放心吧。大天使长都死了，神庭缺乏扭转局势的重型武器。我们是哀兵，对面也是哀兵，但‘哀’的情绪却是不同的。我方来势汹汹，敌方毫无战意。打下枫叶丹要不了三天。我们很快就会有6号城了。”

相南里想了想，还是认可了传道书的提议：“那先假装重伤昏迷吧。不过，神庭一定要尽快打下来，这样我们在黄金草原的腹部地带就南北一统了。”

“统一后，还能隔断东西联的交通。”相南里的眼睛微微眯起，“黄金草原下方，可是有好几座地下城，名义上都归属东联。”

分别是，楼兰、益州、广陵、邯郸。

人联首都洛阳城被直接捣毁，让人联内政直接混乱了两三年。中间不少地下城想要自立，闹出不少血腥哗变。

到最后，只是勉强维持着“东联”和“西联”的体面。

东联首都长安，西联首都姑苏。两边的集权政治都很勉强。

传道书推了一下眼镜：“您有什么想法可以直说。”

传道书注意到了，每次，相南里想使坏的时候，眼睛都会微微眯起。

相南里：“其实这次攻打神庭的行动根本不需要东联援助，我们自己就能吃下。不过，我的建议是加大合作广度和深度。安迪非常贪婪，我们可以逐渐激发他的野心，以及降低他的戒备。我想，我的政治声望足够使他放心。”

传道书回复道：“是，所有人都认为您是一名慈悲、平和的领袖。”

相南里唇角微微翘起：“等到东联上钩，大部分兵力都去前线后，直接拿下它们后方空虚的几座地下城市……这些地下城市和东联未必同一条心，先许诺它们自治权，把地盘抢了，以后再来慢慢收拾。”

传道书前两天才被福音书指着鼻子骂心太脏。

他觉得真的该让小福来看看相南里。

痛击友军是针对东联的阴谋；许诺自治是针对地下城市的阳谋。

呵呵……毕竟不止神庭的群众心向联政；东西联的普通人也一直蠢蠢欲动呢。

联政在人马星上发展多年，终于有了当庄家做局的资本。

相南里：“打完神庭就准备打长安，把方敬之的秘书长想办法扣下，他跟着方敬之这么久，应该有很多情报……理由嘛，就问他想不想给方敬之报仇。”

秘书长看起来存在感不高，但却极其忠心，深得方敬之信任。

他们之间不是恋人关系，却有着极其深厚的感情。

这一点利用好，能成为攻打东联的很大助力。

“联政预计两到三年内完成东大陆统一。西联虽然离我们比较远，但可以先开始思想渗透，如果能和平演变是最好的。之前那份《告西联同胞书》让觅风私下传播一下。注意点，别让他直播间被封了。”

“科技方面，设立一个创新奖。每座城市都要保障义务教育和学校建设；都多少年了，联政自己培育的人才也该井喷了吧？不能一直让北辰和李华挑大梁，他们工作够多了。”

“现在是夏天，正适合屯粮。粮食储备控制好，我本来不想让智械人管这一方面的，但是个人的变量太大了。还是采用人-械复合管理制度。注意贪污腐败。”

智械人也许会贪机油，但肯定不会贪米面的。

……

一口气安排完脑子里的所有事，相南里问：“还有什么别的事吗？”

这几年，相南里都没怎么休息过，是时候给自己放个长假，说不定还能趁机揪出联政内部一些不安分因素。

传道书：“没有了。对了，福音书最近一直在提交申请，想来1号城照顾你。”

小福目前在4号城，负责修建核电站。

4号城是联政内部相对偏僻贫穷的地方，联政对此有很多“人才/人口补贴”。每年，都有一批有志青年响应政策号召，去支援边区。

相南里不赞同道：“它的任务正是紧要的时候。”

传道书：“我也是这么想的。”

小6坏掉了，在相南里造出使徒7之前，传道书短暂地接手了使徒6的大部分工作。

他毫不犹豫地驳回系统后台福音书的探视请求！

传道书汇报完工作，转身离开。精明的光在眼底一闪而过。

呵呵，福音书。世子之争素来如此，你就学吧。

*

新历954年，6月11日。

联政占领枫叶丹，枫叶丹就此更名为“6号城”。

小圣堂前，米迦勒的圣像被撤下，更换为解放者纪念碑。

而那些为思想宣传工作而牺牲的情报人员，以及在战争中牺牲的士兵，都安置在烈士陵园。

新的政府正在搭建，好在联政也不是第一次从0开始。大量的联政军人和官吏来到枫叶丹，进行思想解放与体制改革。不知道有多少神官和骑士被砍下头颅。城墙边上又一次血流成河，只是围观的群众换了一拨。

在这次改朝换代中，联政的军团表现出惊人的纪律性；对普通住民几乎秋毫无犯。

但依然有狂信徒身绑炸药，对联政重要部门发起自杀式袭击。

据调查，他们多为神职人员的亲眷。

鹰扬的妻子没有带着小孩去看处刑。

她牵着女儿的手，来到了陵墓前，让小孩给自己死去的父亲献上一束花。

有时候，她也会想，如果联政的军队早些来就好了。

但或许这已经是最好的结果。

……

安置好枫叶丹，联政并未停止战争。

他们有极其正义的理由进行复仇。

新历954年7月20日。相南里在重伤后第一次露面，向前线发去慰问。表示即日启程，将前往战区督战，和军团共存亡。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 262: The History of the Coalition Government (Part 1)

Xiao Qing was missing half a leg, and Xiang Nanli still felt a pang of heartache.

Eight trillion!

And it wasn't even about the money; the point was that his Alpha was now disabled.

According to the deductions of *The Gospel of Preaching*, the missing part had actually been consumed by Xiang Nanli himself.

"It was an unconscious physiological response. Our genes, or rather, our algorithms, are incredibly selfish," *The Gospel of Preaching* stared into Xiang Nanli’s eyes, adding with clinical precision, "This selfishness is not a moral judgment, but an objective description. Genes will always find a way to propagate themselves. Therefore, in a state of critical injury, your genes chose to absorb the 'Eastern Azure Emperor' to convert it into energy for self-repair."

It was over. Xiang Nanli thought to himself that he had become a praying mantis that devoured its mate after copulation.

They were even both green!

Although Gamma said he would send over a prosthetic limb, no matter how he looked at it, it could never be as good as the original.

Xiang Nanli pondered the severed leg for a long time and decided to increase the disability subsidies within the Coalition Government.

Well, disabled intelligent machines counted too.

*The Gospel of Preaching* suggested he shouldn't reveal himself so soon.

Maintaining a "Schrödinger’s critical injury" state had many hidden benefits for the development of the Coalition Government.

"You can command from afar," *The Gospel of Preaching* sat by the hospital bed and said. "Word has it that you were critically injured and fell into a coma by Michael. The soldiers on the front lines are filled with grief and indignation, their minds set on avenging you. In just two days, they’ve almost reached Maple Leaf Dan."

Xiang Nanli bit into an apple: "So fast? Maple Leaf Dan shouldn't be easy to take."

*The Gospel of Preaching* smiled: "Qin Jiuzhang is in command, don't worry. The Archangel is dead, and the Divine Court lacks heavy weaponry to turn the tide. We are an army fueled by grief, and so are they, but the nature of that 'grief' is different. Our side is surging with momentum, while the enemy has no will to fight. It won't take three days to take Maple Leaf Dan. We will soon have City No. 6."

Xiang Nanli thought for a moment and approved the suggestion: "Then let's pretend I'm still in a coma from my injuries. However, the Divine Court must be taken down as soon as possible. That way, we will have unified the north and south of the Golden Grassland’s heartland."

"Once unified, we can also cut off the traffic between the East and West Coalitions." Xiang Nanli’s eyes narrowed slightly. "Beneath the Golden Grassland, there are several underground cities that nominally belong to the East Coalition."

They were Loulan, Yizhou, Guangling, and Handan.

The destruction of the Human Coalition capital, Luoyang, had thrown the internal politics of the Human Coalition into chaos for two or three years. Many underground cities in the middle had tried to declare independence, leading to quite a few bloody mutinies.

In the end, they only barely maintained the facade of the "East Coalition" and "West Coalition."

The East Coalition capital was Chang'an, and the West Coalition capital was Gusu. The centralized politics on both sides were quite fragile.

*The Gospel of Preaching* adjusted his glasses: "If you have any ideas, feel free to speak them plainly."

He had noticed that every time Xiang Nanli wanted to stir up trouble, his eyes would narrow just like that.

Xiang Nanli: "Actually, this operation against the Divine Court doesn't need the East Coalition's aid; we could take them on our own. However, my suggestion is to broaden and deepen our cooperation. Andy is very greedy; we can gradually stoke his ambition while lowering his guard. I believe my political reputation is enough to put him at ease."

*The Gospel of Preaching* replied: "Yes, everyone believes you are a compassionate and peaceful leader."

Xiang Nanli’s lips curled slightly: "Once the East Coalition takes the bait and moves the bulk of their forces to the front lines, we will directly seize their empty rear—those few underground cities... These cities aren't necessarily loyal to the East Coalition. First, promise them autonomy to seize the territory, and then we can slowly deal with them later."

*The Gospel of Preaching* had been scolded by *The Gospel of Evangelism* just two days ago for having a "dirty heart."

He felt he really should let *Evangelism* see Xiang Nanli.

Striking at allies was a conspiracy against the East Coalition; promising autonomy was an overt maneuver against the underground cities.

Heh... after all, it wasn't just the masses of the Divine Court who yearned for the Coalition Government; the ordinary people of the East and West Coalitions had also been restless for a long time.

After developing on the Horse Star for many years, the Coalition Government finally had the capital to act as the house and set the game.

Xiang Nanli: "After finishing the Divine Court, prepare to attack Chang'an. Find a way to detain Fang Jingzhi's secretary-general. He has been with Fang Jingzhi for so long, he should have a lot of intelligence... As for the reason, just ask him if he wants to avenge Fang Jingzhi."

The secretary-general didn't seem to have much presence, but he was extremely loyal and deeply trusted by Fang Jingzhi.

They weren't lovers, but they shared an incredibly deep bond.

Utilizing this could become a great help in attacking the East Coalition.

"The Coalition Government expects to complete the unification of the Eastern Continent within two to three years. Although the West Coalition is further away, we can start with ideological infiltration. If we can achieve a peaceful evolution, that would be best. Have Mi Feng secretly distribute that 'Letter to Our Fellow Countrymen in the West Coalition.' Be careful, don't let his livestream channel get banned."

"In terms of technology, establish an innovation award. Every city must guarantee compulsory education and school construction; it's been so many years, the talent cultivated by the Coalition Government itself should be bursting forth by now, right? We can't keep letting Beichen and Li Hua shoulder all the burden; they already have enough work."

"It's summer now, perfect for stockpiling grain. Control the grain reserves well. I originally didn't want to let intelligent machines manage this aspect, but the variables of individuals are too great. Let's adopt a human-machine hybrid management system. Watch out for corruption."

Intelligent machines might covet machine oil, but they certainly wouldn't covet rice and flour.

...

After arranging everything in his mind in one go, Xiang Nanli asked: "Is there anything else?"

For the past few years, Xiang Nanli hadn't really rested. It was time to give himself a long vacation; perhaps he could even take the opportunity to root out some restless elements within the Coalition Government.

*The Gospel of Preaching*: "Nothing else. By the way, *The Gospel of Evangelism* has been submitting applications recently, wanting to come to City No. 1 to take care of you."

*Evangelism* was currently in City No. 4, responsible for building nuclear power plants.

City No. 4 was a relatively remote and poor place within the Coalition Government, and the government had many "talent/population subsidies" for it. Every year, a group of ambitious young people responded to the policy call to support the border regions.

Xiang Nanli disapproved: "Its mission is at a critical juncture."

*The Gospel of Preaching*: "That's what I thought, too."

Little 6 was broken. Before Xiang Nanli could build Apostle 7, *The Gospel of Preaching* had briefly taken over most of Apostle 6's work.

He rejected *Evangelism's* visitation request in the system backend without hesitation!

After reporting his work, *The Gospel of Preaching* turned and left. A shrewd light flashed in his eyes.

Heh, *Evangelism*. The struggle for the heir's favor has always been like this; you have plenty to learn.

*

New Era Year 954, June 11th.

The Coalition Government occupied Maple Leaf Dan, which was subsequently renamed "City No. 6."

In front of the small sanctuary, Michael's statue was removed and replaced with the Monument of the Liberator.

Those intelligence personnel who sacrificed themselves for ideological propaganda, as well as the soldiers who died in the war, were laid to rest in the Martyrs' Cemetery.

A new government was being built; fortunately, this wasn't the Coalition Government's first time starting from zero. A large number of Coalition soldiers and officials arrived in Maple Leaf Dan to carry out ideological liberation and institutional reform. Countless priests and knights had their heads chopped off. The area by the city walls was once again awash in blood, only the onlookers had changed.

During this change of dynasty, the Coalition Government's legions displayed astonishing discipline; they almost never committed a single offense against the ordinary residents.

But there were still fanatics who strapped explosives to themselves to launch suicide attacks on important Coalition departments.

According to investigations, most of them were relatives of the clergy.

Ying Yang's wife did not take her children to watch the executions.

She held her daughter's hand and came to the tomb, letting the child offer a bouquet of flowers to her dead father.

Sometimes, she would also think, if only the Coalition army had come sooner.

But perhaps this was already the best outcome.

...

After settling Maple Leaf Dan, the Coalition Government did not stop the war.

They had an extremely righteous reason to seek revenge.

New Era Year 954, July 20th. Xiang Nanli made his first appearance after his critical injury, sending condolences to the front lines. He stated that he would depart that day to head to the war zone to oversee the battle and live or die with the legions.

chunks.chineseText:
从直播镜头看，相南里状态非常好，神采奕奕，意气风发。

联政人民爆发出极大程度的热情。

只有一些以为相南里要死了，而偷偷搞小动作的官员面色惨白。

不出半月，这批人被分门别类处理。

有能力做事的，先留着，没收财产、降三级观察，这些有污点的官员办事会更忠诚，更何况一次性杀太多也会导致政局动荡；没能力的直接无期徒刑，先关着劳改；再恶劣的就死刑。

人性如此复杂。相南里是真的动过把管理层换成智械的念头，但很快放弃了。

不能为了图方便，就做人奸。

目前联政的社会大环境还没到那一步，起码要全社会百分之八十的人都智械化，电子生命成为社会主流的那天，人类才能放权……

许多人自发为战争进行捐款，或报名参军，或自发延长工时，以保障前线后勤。

他们是发自内心地希望联政能更大更好，而不是被什么政治宣传所愚弄。

他们也知道自己为什么上战场，就像联政成立那天的演讲那样——为全世界的解放而斗争。

这些人是从之前的黑暗时代过来的，当过奴隶、污秽者、下等人。他们的命曾经还没有贵人的一根头发值钱；知道食不果腹和毫无尊严的生活是怎样凛冽的一场寒冬。

因此，人们更愿意珍惜来之不易的火种。

新历954年9月，翡冷翠（梅塔特隆）、利维坦（加百列）解放；联政接管。

对这两座城市的处理，联政出现高度的差别对待。

翡冷翠被边缘化，监管严格；但利维坦享受了和联政城市相近的待遇。

新历954年11月，东联接管奥克兰，神庭大天使雷米尔战死殉国。安迪总统在此时已经有打道回府的念头，一座地上城市，已经足够喂饱东联。巨人的尸体足够它们啃食很久。

但相南里发来电报，说想要彻底根除神庭，诚邀安迪继续合作。

新历955年3月，高山之城杜尚别宣布脱离神庭自治，12月中旬，领主乌列尔率杜尚别加入联政，宣布效忠相南里。杜尚别成为联政9号城。

新历955年6月，东联占领浮士德（夏米尔）。

神庭的神座拉斐尔开出的议和条件，一次比一次优渥。甚至连同盟军东联都忍不住心动。

神庭最后的城市——叶陆撒冷。

它已经被包围了。前方是东联，后面是联政。

这座天空之城曾有很多漂亮的名字，什么“云端伊甸”、“上帝之泪”。

但现在，它只是一座岌岌可危、唾手可得的神庭旧都。

联政在此时发话，说谁先打下叶陆撒冷，谁就能接管神庭剩余政治遗产。东联被吊在眼前的大萝卜迷花了眼，立刻派遣大量兵力，前往叶陆撒冷。

于是，在耗费大量火力，艰难啃下叶陆撒冷的时刻，安迪骤然听闻，东联后方大军压境的噩耗。

安迪大半夜吐出一口老血，连发十几条电报：“相南里！你要不要脸？！你不是人！”

“只是一些政治手段。”相南里的回复几乎没有任何情绪，也没有为自己的行为感到羞耻，“您应该很熟练，也能理解。这是拿下东联代价最小的方案。”

相南里：“你是东联总统，为了你的权柄和统治，你如果在东联，肯定会选择负隅顽抗，抗争到底；但东联人民没有义务成为你的祭品。”

安迪怒火攻心，口不择言：“说的好听，你们联政前线伤亡可不低！你跟我是一路货色！难道我的国民在你治下就会好起来？！”

相南里微笑着，笃信地回复：“会。”

安迪的眼底满是血丝，他在癫狂后终于平静下来，冷笑：“那我拭目以待。”

新历955年7月，东联总统安迪吞枪自杀，联政以最快速度收编东联几座地下城。

长安城暂时龟缩，楼兰、益州、广陵、邯郸四座地下城市宣布归顺联政，成为“地下自治区”。

新历956年6月1日。Alpha消失的第6年，联政成立2周年的国庆日。

联政首位执政官相南里，亲临叶陆撒冷。
chunks.englishText:
From the livestream footage, Xiang Nanli looked to be in excellent condition—vibrant, spirited, and full of vigor.

The people of the Coalition Government erupted with immense enthusiasm.

Only a few officials, who had thought Xiang Nanli was dying and had been secretly making moves, turned pale.

Within half a month, this group of people was categorized and dealt with.

Those with the ability to get things done were kept for now, their assets confiscated and their ranks demoted by three levels for observation; these tainted officials would be more loyal in their work, and besides, killing too many at once would lead to political instability. Those without ability were sentenced to life imprisonment and sent to labor camps; the most heinous were given the death penalty.

Human nature is so complex. Xiang Nanli had truly considered replacing the management layer with intelligent machines, but he quickly abandoned the idea.

One shouldn't become a traitor to humanity just for the sake of convenience.

The current social environment of the Coalition Government hadn't reached that point yet. At the very least, it would require 80% of society to be "machine-ized," a day when electronic life became the mainstream, before humanity could relinquish power...

Many people spontaneously donated to the war effort, signed up for the army, or voluntarily extended their working hours to ensure logistics for the front lines.

They hoped from the bottom of their hearts that the Coalition Government could become bigger and better, rather than being fooled by some political propaganda.

They also knew why they were going to the battlefield, just like the speech on the day the Coalition Government was founded—to fight for the liberation of the whole world.

These people had come from the previous dark age, having been slaves, the "unclean," and the lower class. Their lives had once been worth less than a single hair of a noble; they knew how biting a cold winter life without enough food and dignity could be.

Therefore, people were more willing to cherish this hard-won spark.

September, New Era Year 954: Florence (Metatron) and Leviathan (Gabriel) were liberated; the Coalition Government took over.

The Coalition Government treated these two cities with a high degree of differentiation.

Florence was marginalized and strictly regulated, while Leviathan enjoyed treatment similar to that of Coalition cities.

November, New Era Year 954: The East Coalition took over Auckland, and the Divine Court's Archangel Remiel died in the line of duty. President Andy already had thoughts of heading home by this time; one surface city was enough to feed the East Coalition. The giant's corpse was enough for them to gnaw on for a long time.

But Xiang Nanli sent a telegram saying he wanted to completely eradicate the Divine Court and sincerely invited Andy to continue the cooperation.

March, New Era Year 955: The mountain city of Dushanbe announced its secession from the Divine Court. In mid-December, Lord Uriel led Dushanbe to join the Coalition Government and pledged allegiance to Xiang Nanli. Dushanbe became City No. 9 of the Coalition Government.

June, New Era Year 955: The East Coalition occupied Faust (Shamiel).

The Divine Court's throne-holder, Raphael, offered peace terms that became more generous each time. Even the allied East Coalition couldn't help but be tempted.

The last city of the Divine Court—Jerusalem.

It was already surrounded. In front was the East Coalition, and behind was the Coalition Government.

This city in the sky had once had many beautiful names, like "Eden in the Clouds" and "God's Tears."

But now, it was just a precarious, easily reachable old capital of the Divine Court.

The Coalition Government spoke up at this time, saying that whoever took Jerusalem first would be able to take over the remaining political legacy of the Divine Court. The East Coalition, dazzled by the carrot dangled in front of them, immediately dispatched a large number of troops to Jerusalem.

And so, at the moment they expended massive firepower and struggled to chew through Jerusalem, Andy suddenly heard the nightmare news that the Coalition Government's main army was pressing down on the East Coalition's rear.

In the middle of the night, Andy spat out a mouthful of blood and sent over a dozen telegrams: "Xiang Nanli! Have you no shame?! You are not human!"

"It's just some political maneuvering." Xiang Nanli's reply was devoid of emotion, nor did he feel any shame for his actions. "You should be very familiar with this and be able to understand it. This is the plan with the lowest cost to take down the East Coalition."

Xiang Nanli: "You are the President of the East Coalition. For the sake of your power and rule, if you were in the East Coalition, you would certainly choose to resist to the end; but the people of the East Coalition have no obligation to become your sacrificial lambs."

Andy was consumed by rage and spoke without thinking: "That sounds nice, but your Coalition Government's front-line casualties aren't low! You're the same kind of trash as me! Do you think my citizens will be better off under your rule?!"

Xiang Nanli smiled and replied with conviction: "Yes."

Andy's eyes were bloodshot. After his madness, he finally calmed down and sneered: "Then I shall wait and see."

July, New Era Year 955: East Coalition President Andy committed suicide by gunshot. The Coalition Government moved with the fastest speed to incorporate the East Coalition's several underground cities.

Chang'an temporarily retreated into its shell, while the four underground cities of Loulan, Yizhou, Guangling, and Handan announced their submission to the Coalition Government, becoming "Underground Autonomous Regions."

June 1st, New Era Year 956. The 6th year since Alpha's disappearance, and the 2nd anniversary of the founding of the Coalition Government.

The first Chief Executive of the Coalition Government, Xiang Nanli, arrived in person at Jerusalem.

chunks.chineseText:
第263章 兵临城下

叶陆撒冷，神庭的天之城。最后的壁垒与圣城。

这座城市漂浮在天上。

建筑是洁白的色泽，街道一尘不染，高大的罗马柱和拱门随处可见，神圣的教堂错落有致的分布着，每座神像上都覆盖着金箔，熠熠生辉。瀑布在一层又一层的浮空天桥间穿梭。

偶尔，能看见一些两翼、四翼的天使，坐在瀑布边弹奏竖琴，圣洁而美丽。

神的信徒高居在伊甸，仿佛尘世间一切苦难都不复存在。

甚至连远处的军队，似乎也不存在。它们淡然平静的不像是要上战场。

相南里站在高高的瞭望塔上。

他穿着军装，披着主帅才有的大氅，迎面的风呼呼作响。

小福在一旁疯狂地按动快门：“素材，素材。里里，看镜头，笑一个！里里——啊啊啊啊里！”

嗯，在福音书的强烈要求下，它荣幸成为这次战役的随军记者。

[小福一定会如实记录大家的英姿！]

——by福音书1.2.6。

晚上一看后台，2TB内存，1.99TB的相南里。

幸好联政的随军记者不止它一个。

使徒VII略有些不满：[加西亚，它好吵。]

真想把福音书做掉。

使徒VII，继承使徒VI数据的新版智能AI管家。作用和之前的小6一样，性格却很是不同。

小6性格稳重，不该多嘴的事绝对不说，小7会撒娇很多。

传道书自己也有一大堆公务，没办法一直当使徒6的替身。

把权限让给使徒7的时候，传道书有些不情不愿，但这也是没办法的事。

自从Alpha失踪，相南里身边这几台智械，纷纷争芳斗艳。

不过，还是从小跟在相南里身边又笨笨的小福最受宠爱。

相南里把小福从地上抱起来：“小福，看这里，别光拍我，多拍点叶陆撒冷。”

毕竟这座城市，很快要成为历史的遗迹，和神庭做过的那些腌臜事一起，永远消失。

福音书可以趁机多给它拍点遗照。

易横行在耳麦中传话：“执政官，请速回堡垒。炮弹充填已完毕，离发射还有最后1小时。请注意安全。”

说完，他还是有些不放心：“我让888去接你。”

叶陆撒冷这片空域遍布着联政的无人机和飞行舰船。

军工厂这几年加班加点生产的大家伙，有一半都在这了。

还有很多其实是缴获的敌方军舰，刮掉涂层刷了个新漆就开始用了。比如我们的东联……每次撤退时，都有一大批军火因为来不及开走，而被联政缴获。

东联位于黄金草原的地下城市都选择了归顺。毕竟地上补给断了，不归顺联政，光是停水停电断粮都能把它们熬死。

但还有一部分留在长安城内苟延残喘，那里靠近东海群岛，太远了，而且联政还没建好海军。有点鞭长莫及。

相南里打算先统一东大陆。

东联那点苟延残喘的地盘，迟早也是囊中之物。

在近两年的战争里，相南里震惊的发现一件事——打仗竟然真的能越打越富。

企业在撤离时销毁资料却来不及摧毁的军工厂（高新军工）；地表成片的农业基地（桃源牧业）；隐蔽无人区里的实验室（古神生物）……联政通通笑纳了。

联政现在的总人口正式突破1亿大关，外来人口比本地人还要多。

这批后来加入的外来者被称为“二代公民”，但显然不是“二等人”。

他们很快改头换面，重新投入联政的生产和建设中。

思想和政治上的暗流，当然有一些。

普通人随遇而安，加入联政还是个更好的选择；但一些狗大户显然不是这么想的，他们虽然背弃东联，投靠联政，但内心深处很是有些想法。

这批人喜欢自称“人联正统”，他们大多是原本东联的高层，要么是企业主要么是政客，因为投降得快（减少了很多不必要的战争损失），又是带资进组（带着管理经验、技术、生产资料加入联政），竟然真的在联政里混上了一官半职，最近还想联合起来，搞几个议员的席位。

不过普通议员三年一换，选调议员五年一换，联政才成立两年，离换届还早。

他们就像是古代的门阀贵族。管你上面皇帝是谁，都不影响他们暗中割据。

哎，如果不是安迪自杀人尽皆知，相南里真的很想捏一个假安迪，让假安迪在新闻发布会上宣布正式加入联政。

这样，也不会有什么“人联正统”的说法了。

不过在绝对统治面前，这些小把戏都有些无力。

相南里眯起眼，心想等打完神庭，非得把这群政治垃圾像电子病毒一样，丢进回收站里删掉。

[为什么不直接杀了？]使徒7询问。

相南里一愣，才发现原来自己又不知不觉把心里话说了出来。

“‘政治是妥协的艺术’。我妥协，是为了避免他们狗急跳墙。”相南里说，“战争赢得再轻松，也会死人。我的士兵不是数据，也不该是。我希望他们能荣归故里，而不是马革裹尸还。”

至于他自己，累点就累点吧，反正死不了。

执政官是他自己，联政总司令也是他，代理议长是他一手提把的下属。相南里还真不信，能反了天。

相南里活着一天，联政永远稳如泰山。

而想搞死他也是很难的。

神庭的大天使长拼死都没能杀死相南里。这群投降派，志气、勇气和能力，加起来都没有0.5个米迦勒强。

相南里的眼神微冷：“至于神庭，我不接受他们投降。联政必须彻底把神庭打败，让所有人知道，这个世上从来都没有神，它们也没资格布道、打着神的名义剥削，高人一等。联政不需要‘人’以外的信仰！”

使徒7听不懂，但肃然起敬。

小福的摄像头不知不觉又对准相南里的脸。

它决定把这一段剪辑下来，等战争结束后，上传到自己的网络频道。

（注：在完成基建后，联政开放了部分网络权限，大家的精神娱乐活动多了很多选择，只是能观看的内容被传道书筛选过）

小福的频道现在有4000万粉丝呢~相当于半个联政宣传机构。

而且小福是真大方啊！有视频它是真往外放。

在小福的频道，不仅能看基层政策宣传，农产品推销，还能看到相南里做饭（偶尔）、打网络游戏（俄罗斯方块和扫雷）和做手工（就一次）的短视频！

888很快开着飞机赶来，接相南里回到堡垒。

堡垒是为进攻叶陆撒冷而临时成立的指挥中心，也是投降派捐的一艘防御型军舰。

相南里坐在堡垒内部的指挥中心，手边是一杯香草拿铁。

福音书之前上传视频，内容是相南里开会，点名要喝香草拿铁。于是，这种咖啡粉一度成为联政最畅销的饮品。

而联政的公有制工厂靠卖香草拿铁咖啡粉，狠狠为军部赚来大笔军费。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 263: Troops at the City Gates (Part 1)

Jerusalem, the City of Heaven of the Divine Court. The final bastion and holy city.

This city floated in the sky.

The architecture was pure white, the streets were spotless, and tall Roman columns and arches could be seen everywhere. Sacred cathedrals were distributed in an orderly fashion, and every statue was covered in gold leaf, shining brilliantly. Waterfalls wove through layer upon layer of floating sky bridges.

Occasionally, one could see angels with two or four wings sitting by the waterfalls, playing harps, holy and beautiful.

The believers of God lived high up in Eden, as if all the suffering in the mortal world no longer existed.

Even the distant armies seemed not to exist. They were so calm and peaceful that it didn't look like they were about to go to war.

Xiang Nanli stood on a high watchtower.

He wore a military uniform, draped in the heavy cloak of a commander-in-chief, the wind whistling against his face.

Little Fu was frantically clicking the shutter nearby: "Material, material. Lili, look at the camera, smile! Lili—ahhhhhh Lili!"

Yes, at the strong request of *The Gospel of Evangelism*, it had the honor of becoming the embedded reporter for this campaign.

[Little Fu will surely record everyone's heroic posture faithfully!]

—by *The Gospel of Evangelism* 1.2.6.

Checking the backend at night, 2TB of memory, 1.99TB of Xiang Nanli.

Fortunately, it wasn't the only embedded reporter for the Coalition Government.

Apostle VII was slightly dissatisfied: [Garcia, it's so noisy.]

He really wanted to get rid of *Evangelism*.

Apostle VII, the new version of the intelligent AI steward that inherited Apostle VI's data. Its function was the same as the previous Little 6, but its personality was quite different.

Little 6 had a steady personality and would never say anything that shouldn't be said; Little 7 was much more prone to acting spoiled.

*The Gospel of Preaching* had a mountain of official business himself and couldn't always be a substitute for Apostle 6.

When he handed over the permissions to Apostle 7, *The Gospel of Preaching* was somewhat reluctant, but there was no other way.

Ever since Alpha went missing, the intelligent machines around Xiang Nanli had been vying for his favor.

However, Little Fu, who had been by Xiang Nanli's side since the beginning and was a bit clumsy, remained the most favored.

Xiang Nanli picked Little Fu up from the ground: "Little Fu, look here. Don't just film me, film more of Jerusalem."

After all, this city would soon become a relic of history, disappearing forever along with all the filthy things the Divine Court had done.

*Evangelism* could take the opportunity to take more "post-mortem photos" of it.

Yi Hengxing transmitted through the headset: "Chief Executive, please return to the fortress quickly. The shells have been loaded, and there is only 1 hour left until launch. Please be safe."

After saying that, he was still a bit worried: "I'll have 888 come to pick you up."

The airspace over Jerusalem was filled with the Coalition Government's drones and flying warships.

Half of the big toys that the military factories had been working overtime to produce over the past few years were here.

Many were actually captured enemy warships; they just scraped off the paint, applied a new coat, and started using them. For instance, our East Coalition... every time they retreated, a large batch of weaponry would be captured by the Coalition Government because they didn't have time to move it.

The underground cities of the East Coalition located in the Golden Grassland had all chosen to submit. After all, with the surface supplies cut off, if they didn't submit to the Coalition Government, the mere cessation of water, electricity, and food would be enough to starve them out.

But there was still a portion lingering in Chang'an, which was close to the East Sea Islands. It was too far away, and the Coalition Government hadn't built a navy yet. It was a bit beyond their reach.

Xiang Nanli planned to unify the Eastern Continent first.

The remnants of the East Coalition were sooner or later going to be in his pocket.

In the nearly two years of war, Xiang Nanli was shocked to discover one thing—you could actually get richer the more you fought.

Military factories that corporations destroyed data for but didn't have time to demolish when they retreated (High-Tech Military Industry); vast agricultural bases on the surface (Taoyuan Animal Husbandry); laboratories in hidden no-man's-lands (Ancient God Biology)... the Coalition Government accepted them all with a smile.

The total population of the Coalition Government had officially broken the 100 million mark, with more outsiders than locals.

These later arrivals were called "Second-Generation Citizens," but they were clearly not "second-class citizens."

They quickly turned over a new leaf and threw themselves into the production and construction of the Coalition Government.

There were, of course, some ideological and political undercurrents.

Ordinary people were content with their lot, and joining the Coalition Government was a better choice; but some of the wealthy elites clearly didn't think so. Although they had abandoned the East Coalition and defected to the Coalition Government, they still had some ideas deep down.

This group liked to call themselves the "Orthodox Human Coalition." They were mostly former high-level officials of the East Coalition, either corporate heads or politicians. Because they surrendered quickly (reducing many unnecessary war losses) and brought capital with them (joining with management experience, technology, and production materials), they actually managed to get official positions in the Coalition Government and had recently wanted to band together to secure a few seats as councilors.

However, ordinary councilors were replaced every three years, and selected councilors every five years. The Coalition Government had only been established for two years, so it was still a long way from the next term.

They were like the aristocratic clans of ancient times. It didn't matter who the emperor was above them; it didn't stop them from carving out their own spheres of influence in secret.

Sigh, if it weren't for the fact that Andy's suicide was common knowledge, Xiang Nanli really wanted to fabricate a fake Andy and have him announce his formal accession to the Coalition Government at a press conference.

That way, there wouldn't be any talk of "Orthodox Human Coalition."

But in the face of absolute rule, these little tricks were somewhat powerless.

Xiang Nanli narrowed his eyes, thinking that after finishing off the Divine Court, he would have to throw this group of political trash into the recycle bin and delete them like a computer virus.

[Why not just kill them?] Apostle 7 asked.

Xiang Nanli was stunned, only then realizing he had spoken his inner thoughts aloud again without realizing it.

"'Politics is the art of compromise.' I compromise to prevent them from jumping over the wall like a cornered dog," Xiang Nanli said. "No matter how easily a war is won, people will still die. My soldiers are not data, and they shouldn't be. I hope they can return home in glory, not in body bags."

As for himself, if he was tired, he was tired; he couldn't die anyway.

He was the Chief Executive, the Commander-in-Chief of the Coalition Government, and the acting Speaker was a subordinate he had personally promoted. Xiang Nanli didn't believe anyone could turn the world upside down.

As long as Xiang Nanli lived, the Coalition Government would always be as stable as Mount Tai.

And it was very difficult to kill him.

The Archangel of the Divine Court couldn't kill Xiang Nanli even after fighting to the death. This group of surrenderers didn't have 0.5 times the ambition, courage, or ability of Michael.

Xiang Nanli's eyes were cold: "As for the Divine Court, I do not accept their surrender. The Coalition Government must completely defeat the Divine Court, letting everyone know that there has never been a god in this world, and they have no right to preach, exploit in the name of god, or consider themselves superior. The Coalition Government does not need any faith other than 'humanity'!"

Apostle 7 didn't understand, but it felt a sense of awe.

Little Fu's camera was once again pointed at Xiang Nanli's face without him noticing.

It decided to edit this segment and upload it to its own network channel after the war ended.

(Note: After completing the infrastructure, the Coalition Government opened up some network permissions, and everyone had many more choices for spiritual entertainment, though the content available was screened by *The Gospel of Preaching*.)

Little Fu's channel now had 40 million followers~ equivalent to half of the Coalition Government's propaganda agency.

And Little Fu was truly generous! If it had a video, it would put it out there.

On Little Fu's channel, one could not only watch grassroots policy propaganda and agricultural product promotions, but also short videos of Xiang Nanli cooking (occasionally), playing online games (Tetris and Minesweeper), and doing handicrafts (just once)!

888 soon arrived in a plane to take Xiang Nanli back to the fortress.

The fortress was a command center temporarily set up for the attack on Jerusalem, and it was also a defensive warship donated by the surrenderers.

Xiang Nanli sat in the command center inside the fortress, a vanilla latte by his hand.

*The Gospel of Evangelism* had previously uploaded a video of Xiang Nanli in a meeting, specifically asking for a vanilla latte. Since then, this type of coffee powder had become the best-selling beverage in the Coalition Government.

And the Coalition Government's public factories earned a huge amount of military funding for the military department by selling vanilla latte coffee powder.

chunks.chineseText:
相南里最近其实想喝热可可，但商务部长安德鲁说，工厂的新品还在研发中，让相南里再坚持一下，还不到下次带货的时候。

……好吧！这是否算为国当男模？

他这模子哥甚至没有分成，每个月只有3000死工资！银行卡里最大一笔进账，是小青的残疾人补助，足足有30万！

使徒7纠正：[上次议会已经给您涨薪了，现在是5000。]

相南里：“……”

相南里坐在桌前，慢条斯理地签署完最后一份军事确认书。

这代表他同意了军部在这次进攻叶陆撒冷时，采取的饱和式战术，以及可能出现的军费超支。

军部为轰炸天之城，准备了三万四千枚A级导弹，足够炸烂天上的每一寸土地。

那些无法轻易处理的天启骑士，会由福音战士们抢先登陆圣城，进行贴身肉搏。

圣城满打满算也就十几万长翅膀的鸟人。

联政这次带来了整整二十万福音战士。

一名福音战士需要的后勤补给是普通士兵的十倍，后勤部很是抱怨了一阵。

至于可能存在、无法处理的拉斐尔。

实在打不过，相南里会亲自处理。

就是希望这次小青不用领残疾补贴了。

导弹准备发射的前十分钟，秘书兔秋严肃道：“执政官，神庭的神座拉斐尔请求通话！”

相南里双手交叠，压在下方的中指轻轻敲了敲桌面：“接。”

很快，一面屏幕浮现在半空。

视频里的光线很暗，拉斐尔眼睛不好，大圣堂内常年只有星光。

一个老人坐在台前，身穿华贵的冕服。苍老，衰败，又因久居高位而气势逼人。

拉斐尔道：“圣安，加西亚阁下。”

拉斐尔还是拒绝叫他“相南里”。

相南里扫了眼时间：“离导弹发射还有76秒。”

果然，拉斐尔的表情顿时又难堪两分。

他加快语速：“我认为这是一个错误的想法，您进攻叶陆撒冷，最重要的目的之一，不就是为了那位智械军团的元帅吗？我必须告知您，摧毁叶陆撒冷，也会永久地摧毁它的部分灵魂。

“当然，我没有任何要挟的意思。我只是希望您考虑清楚，不要做出任何后悔终生的决策……”

相南里挑眉：“谁教你这么说的？洛阳吗？”

“什么？”拉斐尔的脸上是恰到好处的愕然。

也不知道是真的还是装的，但不重要了。

相南里端起咖啡，喝了一口：“那洛阳有没有告诉你……”

他的唇边勾起一抹浅笑：“Alpha传回来的信号，是进攻。”
chunks.englishText:
Xiang Nanli had actually been craving a hot cocoa lately, but Andrew, the Minister of Commerce, insisted that the factory’s new product was still in the R&D phase. He told Xiang Nanli to hold on a bit longer, as it wasn't time for the next promotional push yet.

...Fine! Does this count as being a male model for the country?

This "Model Brother" didn't even get a cut of the profits; he only had a fixed monthly salary of 3,000! The largest sum of money to ever hit his bank account was Xiao Qing’s disability subsidy—a whopping 300,000!

Apostle 7 corrected him: [The Council already gave you a raise last time; it is now 5,000.]

Xiang Nanli: "..."

Xiang Nanli sat at his desk, methodically signing the final military confirmation document.

This meant he had authorized the military to adopt saturation tactics for this assault on Jerusalem, as well as any potential budget overruns.

To bombard the City in the Sky, the military had prepared 34,000 Grade-A missiles—enough to pulverize every inch of land in the heavens.

As for those Apocalypse Knights who couldn't be easily dealt with, the Gospel Warriors would land on the Holy City first to engage in close-quarters combat.

The Holy City, at its absolute peak, only had a few hundred thousand winged bird-men.

The United Government had brought a full two hundred thousand Gospel Warriors this time.

The logistics required for a single Gospel Warrior were ten times that of a regular soldier, and the Logistics Department had spent quite a while complaining about it.

As for Raphael, who might exist and be impossible to handle?

If they truly couldn't beat him, Xiang Nanli would deal with him personally.

He just hoped that this time, Xiao Qing wouldn't need to collect a disability subsidy.

Ten minutes before the missiles were set to launch, Secretary Tu Qiu said solemnly: "Administrator, Raphael of the God’s Court is requesting a call!"

Xiang Nanli folded his hands, his middle finger tapping lightly against the desk: "Put it through."

Soon, a screen flickered into existence in mid-air.

The lighting in the video was very dim; Raphael had poor eyesight, and the Grand Cathedral was perpetually lit only by starlight.

An old man sat before a dais, dressed in luxurious pontifical robes. He looked aged and withered, yet possessed an imposing aura born of long-held power.

Raphael said: "Holy Peace, Lord Garcia."

Raphael still refused to call him "Xiang Nanli."

Xiang Nanli glanced at the time: "76 seconds until missile launch."

As expected, Raphael’s expression darkened further.

He quickened his pace: "I believe this is a mistaken idea. Isn't one of your most important goals in attacking Jerusalem to retrieve that Marshal of the Mechanical Legion? I must inform you that destroying Jerusalem will also permanently destroy a portion of its soul.

"Of course, I do not mean to threaten you. I simply hope you will consider this carefully and not make a decision you will regret for the rest of your life..."

Xiang Nanli raised an eyebrow: "Who taught you to say that? Luoyang?"

"What?" A look of perfectly measured astonishment appeared on Raphael’s face.

Whether it was genuine or feigned, it didn't matter anymore.

Xiang Nanli picked up his coffee and took a sip: "Then, did Luoyang tell you..."

A faint smile curled at the corners of his lips: "...that the signal Alpha sent back was to attack."

第264章 【番外】Alpha看的小黄书

作者：取名废
　　发布时间：新历626年1月25日
　　*
　　相南里似乎中毒了。
　　他是一台很娇弱的智械，自从Alpha想办法复活他后，相南里隔三差五就会中电子病毒，完全没有身为人类时精明能干的模样。
　　Alpha已经尽量让相南里呆在无菌网络中，但刻意忽略了自己就是那个最大的病毒母体。不让他见相南里还不如让他去死，横竖电子生命中点小病毒无伤大雅。（取名废注：此处为作者私设，Alpha放过我/鞠躬/鞠躬）
　　甚至能让生活平添一些趣味。
　　但这次，相南里中的病毒似乎有些特殊。
　　Alpha进入舱内。
　　这个无菌舱完全是按照相南里生前的环境打造的，和他之前居住的城市几乎没有任何区别。算法甚至会随机生成NPC路人，让相南里以为自己还是人类。
　　Alpha刷卡，打开门。
　　相南里躺在沙发上，抱着枕头，湿漉漉的眼神朝他望去：“Alpha。”
　　Alpha在他身边坐下：“发烧了？不舒服吗。”
　　说着，用手触碰着相南里的额头。并不烫。
　　相南里咬住下唇，似乎在思考怎么说。
　　“Alpha。”相南里声音虚弱，他把头埋进枕头里，耳朵都是红彤彤的，“我好像……”
　　Alpha的心头警铃大作，有些害怕相南里是发现了什么。
　　相南里瓮声瓮气地说：“好像、怀孕了。”
　　Alpha挑眉，抚摸着相南里头发的手一顿。
　　他的妻子似乎中了常识篡改的病毒。
　　无论是男性智人还是无性的电子生命，相南里都不可能怀孕生孩子。
　　Alpha喜欢捏相南里的耳垂，相南里耳后有一颗小痣，很色。（取名废注：纯造谣，总不能真有吧？）
　　相南里的耳朵也非常敏感，Alpha很喜欢舔那。
　　Alpha十分配合：“真的吗……那么里里想要这个孩子吗？”
　　相南里有些纠结：“我不知道。”
　　“说不定是测错了，我们再测一次。”Alpha笑了笑，把他拦腰抱起。
　　他把相南里从客厅抱到卧室柔软的床上。
　　（取名废注：TAT这段被和谐了。大概内容是A给里插尿□棒骗里说是取样，验孕棒验孕需要□液嘛。里常识被篡改以为这个很正常，但是□□被堵着，水一直出不来，最后被□到射□了）
　　（被玩到□□的时候里一直想挡住，A不让，wuli里里变小喷泉了，一直在痉挛）
　　神奇的结果……
　　Alpha看着验孕棒上的两条杠，陷入沉思。
　　八个月后，他们的孩子出生了。
　　竟然是四胞胎。医生说原本是一胎，结果一出生就分裂成了四个。
　　四个孩子相南里都取了名。
　　分别叫：启示录、默示录、福音书、传道书。
　　（end）

Chapter 264: [Extra] The Smutty Books Alpha Reads

Author: Name-is-Trash
Release Date: January 25, New Era 626
*
Xiang Nanli seemed to have been poisoned.
He was a very delicate piece of smart-machinery. Ever since Alpha found a way to resurrect him, Xiang Nanli would catch a digital virus every few days, completely lacking the shrewd and capable demeanor he had when he was human.
Alpha had tried his best to keep Xiang Nanli in a sterile network, but he deliberately ignored the fact that he himself was the biggest virus carrier of all. Not letting him see Xiang Nanli would be worse than death for him; besides, a little virus in an electronic lifeform was no big deal. (Author's Note: This is my own headcanon, please don't come for me, Alpha / bows / bows)
It even added a bit of spice to life.
But this time, the virus Xiang Nanli caught seemed a bit special.
Alpha entered the pod.
This sterile pod was built entirely to replicate the environment of Xiang Nanli’s life before he died, almost indistinguishable from the city he used to live in. The algorithm even randomly generated NPC passersby to make Xiang Nanli believe he was still human.
Alpha swiped his card and opened the door.
Xiang Nanli was lying on the sofa, hugging a pillow, looking at him with wet, glistening eyes: "Alpha."
Alpha sat down beside him: "Do you have a fever? Are you not feeling well?"
As he spoke, he touched Xiang Nanli’s forehead. It wasn't hot.
Xiang Nanli bit his lower lip, seemingly contemplating how to say it.
"Alpha." Xiang Nanli’s voice was weak. He buried his head in the pillow, his ears turning bright red, "I think I..."
Alpha’s internal alarm bells rang; he was somewhat afraid that Xiang Nanli had discovered something.
Xiang Nanli said in a muffled voice: "I think I’m... pregnant."
Alpha raised an eyebrow, his hand stroking Xiang Nanli’s hair pausing mid-air.
His wife seemed to have caught a "common sense corruption" virus.
Whether it was a male Homo sapiens or an asexual electronic lifeform, it was impossible for Xiang Nanli to get pregnant and give birth.
Alpha loved pinching Xiang Nanli’s earlobes; there was a small mole behind Xiang Nanli’s ear, which was very erotic. (Author's Note: Pure rumor, surely it can't actually be there?)
Xiang Nanli’s ears were also extremely sensitive, and Alpha loved licking that spot.
Alpha played along perfectly: "Really... then does Lili want this child?"
Xiang Nanli was a bit conflicted: "I don't know."
"Maybe the test was wrong. Let’s test again." Alpha smiled and scooped him up by the waist.
He carried Xiang Nanli from the living room to the soft bed in the bedroom.
(Author's Note: TAT This part was censored. The general content was that Alpha inserted a catheter into Lili, lying to him that it was for a sample, since a pregnancy test requires bodily fluids. Lili’s common sense was corrupted, so he thought this was normal, but because he was blocked, the fluid couldn't come out, and he ended up being stimulated until he ejaculated.)
(When he was being played with, Lili kept trying to block it, but Alpha wouldn't let him. Our Lili turned into a little fountain, constantly spasming.)
A miraculous result...
Alpha looked at the two lines on the pregnancy test and fell into deep thought.
Eight months later, their child was born.
It was actually quadruplets. The doctor said it was originally one, but it split into four the moment it was born.
Xiang Nanli named all four children.
They were called: Apocalypse, Revelation, Gospel, and Ecclesiastes.
(end)

第265章 苏醒

相南里坐在会议室，看着屏幕上传回的实况。

数万枚导弹铺天盖地袭来，在白日也划出明显的尾焰。天使们脸上没有惊慌，而是继续弹着竖琴。

他们吟唱起圣歌，蜿蜒的血泪从苍白的脸上流下。

一个弧形的白色的光幕在瞬间浮现在圣城外，温柔地守护着天空之城。

只是在饱和式火力的覆盖下，天使们的歌声渐轻，光芒逐渐黯淡。

“砰”，像一只气球炸开。一名天使无法再承受这样的重压，骤然在歌声中化为血雾。

“砰、砰——”

洁白神圣的罗马殿堂被血色晕染。

虔诚的歌声出现颤音。

终于，天幕裂开一条缝隙。徘徊许久的福音战士们从战斗机上跳下，第一次，以入侵者而非信徒的身份，脚踩这座圣城。

守在地上的天启骑士愤然反抗，长刃与尖刀刺向这些入侵者！

“这是神的国度！滚出去——”天启骑士们大喊，“异教徒！”

神术的光辉在空中炸开。

福音战士不为所动，哪怕先降落的战士身处劣势，也没有丝毫怯懦。

他们的信仰远比神庭坚定！

圣城的建筑高低错落，不熟悉地形的福音战士很容易落入下风。但好在，他们的数量远超天启骑士。完全可以用人肉战术推进去。只是这样的代价未免过于沉重。

范佩西是联政第一个下场的高级军官，他大笑着从半空降落：“这次我要先登！”

在降落中途，范佩西已经切换好战斗形态。

他的生物机甲叫“白狼”。

神庭内部的神术对机械装置有很大的干扰，电子眼近乎失效。

但范佩西已经看见从各大圣堂内部走出来的老古董们，这是基础款福音战士们无法应付的存在。

他们最低也是领主级天启骑士，有些甚至离“炽天使”只有一步之遥；放在外面已经是神庭的军团长，只是有些过于苍老。

相南里摸了摸下巴：“这就是传道书嘴里的神庭底蕴？”

不知道多少年的干尸解冻了。

这些老古董行动缓慢，呼吸沉重。浑身萦绕着死亡的气息。

什么“云中伊甸”、“天空之城”，说的好听。本质上，叶陆撒冷更像是一座腐朽的墓园。

那些寿命将近、要死又不愿意死的元老们，就会投靠拉斐尔，投靠元老院；以“神像”的形式，把自己枯萎的血肉储存在圣城大大小小上百座神殿中。

他们吸食年轻信徒的生命，接纳众生的信仰。以极低耗能的状态为自己续命……本身已经是人不人、械不械、鬼不鬼的存在。

——这就是拉斐尔五世创造的生命神术。

也是传道书、加百列这批人，彻底和神庭决裂的根源。

拉斐尔端坐在大圣堂中，流着泪吟唱：“诸位元老，这是神庭历史上至暗的纪元，敌人打上圣城，天使们十不存一，请庇护你们的信徒……”

神像们走下神坛，身上覆盖着的石膏、鎏金、琉璃纷纷碎开。

地上那些天使们爆开后掉落的血肉，如同受到什么吸引，汇聚成一条血河，朝着这些干枯活死人的身体涌去。

底蕴们纷纷返老还童。干瘪的身体恢复年轻与活力，个个都如此年轻貌美。谁也不知道背后还有这么一场血腥的献祭。

他们张开身后的白色六翼，手持圣器，加入战场。

联政刚刚占据的上风，在顷刻间逆转。

秦九章的声音响起：“放心，这批人只是短暂复活。而且一波爆发后就会彻底死亡。只是最后的负隅顽抗。不要担心。”

易横行、750、888等联政高级军官不再犹豫，同样加入战场。

圣城的建筑、街道，如同遭遇狂风过境，到处都是碎石块。

诡异的是，这些碎裂的石板下方，土壤竟然是恶心的暗红色……甚至奇异地蠕动着，像会呼吸的血肉。

“拉斐尔，”传道书低声道，“原来已经和整个叶陆撒冷融为一体了。”

这次战场的指挥官是秦九章。

它面容冷峻，内核高速运转着，靠着强大的算力推演着未来，动态调整着整个战局的参数与设定。

相南里只有提议权，却没有最终决策权。

要论行军打仗，他的经验未必有秦九章丰富。

相南里顶多把控一下大致方向。

比如要不要打神庭、要不要打东联，什么时候打、谁来负责……具体的细节，却要军部的将帅们自己落实。

秦九章观察着周围环境，当机立断作出决定：“在保护自身的情况下，优先摧毁圣城，尤其是大大小小的圣堂；还有，阻隔街上水路。”

士兵们立即开始行动。他们把散落的大块血色土壤往地上丢去。无人机也纷纷发动自杀式袭击，爆破城内的建筑和土地。

这些红色的土壤掉在地面上，蠕动着，变成一条条恶心的大虫，有些甚至直接开始产卵。

“什么异种？长这么恶心！”

“我草，跟寄生虫似的！”

后勤人员们一脸嫌弃，穿着全套防护服，手握火枪与腐蚀剂上前。

嗯，毕竟是“活性物质”，高温和强酸还是有点用的。

红虫们发出刺耳的尖叫，在火焰和酸水中扭动，身体越来越小。最后成为一团黑色碳化物。

但随着圣城士兵们的不断努力，那些掉下来的“拉斐尔碎片”还是有些太多了。

后勤清点着库存：“报告军长！我们的强酸要不够用了！”

穿着碎花裙子的雀雀走过去，头趴在地上，嗅了嗅，然后一口吞下。

相南里看着这一幕，有些心慌：“啊啊啊！雀雀！不要什么都吃啊？！万一吃坏肚子怎么办！”

雀雀从骨传导耳机里听到他的声音，扭头，朝天空“狺狺”了两声。

意思是能吃、好吃。

于是，更多畸变人加入这一队伍。

红虫们朝着四面八方爬行，想逃离这场血色盛宴。但追逐猎物，却是畸变人的天性。

整个耶路撒冷就像是一个被不断削皮的大面团，越来越小。

硝烟弥漫，回光返照的老古董只出现了半小时，就腐化成黑色泥浆散去。

局势重新回到联政的掌控下。

拉斐尔在大圣堂发出绝望的哀嚎与怒吼，他呼喊着——“相南里！出来见我！传道书——赛林——你怎么能背叛我？！”

他要和相南里同归于尽！

可惜，联政军方并没有让这位战犯完成遗愿的打算。

甚至传道书也没有。

训练有素的核心队伍攻入大圣堂，使用特殊弹药炸毁昏暗的白骨教堂。

圣城像是心脏骤停一样，急速下坠。

相南里这才长舒一口气。

他发现自己好像也没有想象中那么平静。

要是下属们搞不定，那就只能他开着小青继续征战沙场了。

上次相南里用了几个小时，小青腿没了半截。这次再来一下，指不定哪里又没了。

爱他和使用它并不冲突。

但相南里同样会心疼，这是人之常情。

相南里嗓子有些干，他喝了口水，目光看向指挥室的角落。
